chapter.verse: Glan i rah rah tsiro kras o Dewel o bolepen un i phub.
Har i phub kerdo was, his tchi koi pre. Kek djipen his koi. His rati un sorelo pani his pral halauter. Un o Debleskro ducho his pral o pani.
Un o Dewel penas: “Mu well diwes!” Koi was diwes.
O Dewel dikas, kai ko diwes mishto hi. Un o Dewel das jek tsiro o diweske un jek tsiro i ratsjake.
Un o Dewel das o diwes ko lab ‘diwes’ un ap i rati penas job ‘rati’. Jaake was rati un pale taissarlakro. Kowa his o ersto diwes.
Un o Dewel penas, te well o bolepen, un pani koi pral un pani koi tel. Un jaake was kowa.
O Dewel kras o bolepen. Un pani his koi pral, un pani his koi tel ap i phub.
Un o Dewel das o bolepen o lab ‘bolepen’. Un was rati un pale taissarlakro. Kowa his o duito diwes.
Un o Dewel penas, te well ko pani ap i phub khetne ap jek rig, te well o truk them diklo. Un jaake was kowa.
Un o Dewel penas: “Ko truk them kharella ‘phub’.” Un kowa, kai o pani khetne hi, kharas lo ‘baro pani’. Un o Dewel dikas, kai kowa mishto hi.

Un o Dewel penas: “Mu well hako senlepen dran i phub win, an koleste hi tikno djob dren, jaake te well lestar pale newo senlepen. Mu wenna ninna ruka dran i phub win, kolendar hakeno peskre rukengre hidjrella. An kolende hi tikno djob, jaake te well lendar pale newe ruka baro.” Un jaake was kowa.

Un dran i phub was senlepen win. Hako senlepen mukas peskro tikno djob bares te well, jaake te well lestar pale newo senlepen. Ninna ruka wan baro. Hako ruk hidjras peskre rukengre, an kolende tikno djob hi, jaake te wenn lendar pale newe ruka baro. Un o Dewel dikas, kai kowa mishto hi.
Un was rati un pale taissarlakro. Kowa his o triinto diwes.
Un o Dewel penas, te wenn momlia an o bolepen, hoi sikrenna: Kanna hi diwes, un kanna hi rati. Kolla sikrenna ninna: Kanna well nijal, kanna well o wend. Kanna well i baro diwes, kanna i newo bersh.
Jon hi an o bolepen tardo, te denn le momeli ap i phub. Un kowa was jaake.
Un o Dewel kras kol dui bare momlia: o kham, te well lo rai pral o diwes, un o tchon, te well lo rai pral i rat, un ninna i wawar bolepangre momlia.
Un o Dewel tchiwas len an o bolepen, te denn le momeli ap i phub.
Jon hi rai pral o diwes un pral i rat, te dell jek tsiro o diweske un i wawar tsiro o ratsjake. Un o Dewel dikas, kai kowa mishto hi.
Un was rati un pale taissarlakro. Kowa his o starto diwes.
Un o Dewel penas, te wenn bud vieche an o pani un bud tchirkle an o bolepen.
Jaake kras o Dewel bare panjengre viechen, un ninna hako wawar viecho, hoi an o pani hi, ninna hake tchirkle. Un o Dewel dikas, kai kowa mishto hi.
Un o Dewel rakras latche laba pral lende win un penas: “Lenn bud terne, te wenn bud tumendar an o baro pani un bud tchirkle an o bolepen.”
Un was rati un pale taissarlakro, o pantchto diwes.
Un o Dewel penas, te dell i phub hake viechenge o djipen: i diwje viechenge un kolenge, kai gar diwje hi, ninna i tsele tikne vieche. Un jaake was kowa.
Un o Dewel kras hake diwje viechen un hake viechen, kai gar diwje hi, ninna i tsele tikne viechen ap i phub. Un job dikas, kai kowa mishto hi.

Un o Dewel penas: “Kanna krah menshen. Jon wenn jaake har mer. Jon hi rai pral i matchende an o baro pani un pral i tchirklende an o bolepen, pral i diwje viechende un pral kolende, kai gar diwje hi, ninna pral i tikne viechende, hoi djan pral i phub.”
Un o Dewel kras i menshen jaake har job hi. Awa, jaake har job hi, kras lo len: o murshes un i djuwjat.

Un o Dewel rakras latche laba pral lende win un penas: “Anenn bud tchawen ap i phub, te well i phub tumendar pherdo! Un awenn rai pral i phub! Awenn rai pral i matchende an o baro pani, pral i tchirklende an o bolepen, un pral hake viechende, hoi ap i phub hi!”
Un o Dewel penas: “Shunenn, tumer nai chan halauterestar, hoi well baro ap i phub un an koleste tikno djob hi. Ninna i tsele rukengre, kai tikno djob an lende hi, dau tumen te chal.
I tsele viechen, kai djiwenn ap i phub, ninna i tsele tchirklen un tikne viechen dau me o tselo senlepen te chal.” Un jaake was kowa.
Un o Dewel dikas halauter, hoi job kras, un tchatchepah halauter his mishto. Un was rati un pale taissarlakro. Kowa his o shobto diwes.
Jaake was o bolepen un i phub kerdo, un halauter, hoi koi hi.
Ap o eftato diwes his o Debleskri budi kerdo. Job budras buder gar. Halauter his kerdo.
Un o Dewel penas: “Ko eftato diwes hi i baro diwes mange. Ko diwes hi miro.” Ap o eftato diwes his leskri budi halauter kerdo, un job budras buder gar.
Kowa hi ko liil, kai tchinlo hi, har o bolepen un i phub kerdo wan.

Ap ko tsiro, har o baro Dewel, maro rai, i phub un o bolepen kras, his kek ruka ap i phub, witar kek senlepen. O baro Dewel, maro rai, das kek brishin ap i phub. Un his kek mensho koi, kai budras ap i phub.
I sapeno ducho was dran i phub un kras lauter sapenes.
Un o baro Dewel, maro rai, kras o romes dran tchik i phubjatar. Un phurdas peskro ducho, hoi della o djipen, an o romeste. Un o rom was djido.
Un o baro Dewel, maro rai, kras i baar an Eden, ap koi rig, kai o kham pre djala. Kote tchiwas job ko romes, koles job kras.

Un o baro Dewel, maro rai, mukas bud ruka baro te well dran i phub. Kolla his shukar. Un lengre rukengre his latcho chapaske. Mashkral i baar his ko ruk tardo, kai della djipen, ninna ko ruk, kai della goswepen, hoi hi latcho un hoi hi tchilatcho.
Un i lengsto pani nashas an Eden, hoi krell koi baar sapenes. Un ko pani nashas dran i baar win, un dran ko pani wan star panja.
O lab o ersto panjestar hi Pison. Kowa nashell trul o tselo them Hawila. Koi hatsenn le sonakai.
Un o sonakai dran ko them hi mishto. Kote hi ninna kutch harza, hoi sungella mishto, ninna kutch barra, hoi kharenna Onyx.
Un ko lab o duito panjestar hi Gihon. Kowa nashell trul o tselo them Kush.
Un ko lab o triinto panjestar hi Tigris. Kowa nashell ap koi rig o themestar Assur, kai o kham pre djala. Un o starto pani hi o Eufrat.
Un o baro Dewel, maro rai, las o romes un tchiwas les an i baar ‘Eden’, te budrell job kote, ninna te dell job jak ap i baar.
Un o baro Dewel, maro rai, penas soreles ap o romeste: “Tu nai chah hako rukestar an i baar, har tu kameh.
Kokres ko ruk, kai della goswepen, hoi hi latcho un hoi hi tchilatcho, kolestar te chas tu gar. Te chah kolestar, mereh.”
Un o baro Dewel, maro rai, penas: “Hi gar mishto, te atchell o rom kokres. Me krau jekes har job, kai pash leste hi.”
Un o baro Dewel, maro rai, kras dran tchik i tsele viechen ap o them un i tsele tchirklen an o bolepen. Un job anas len pash o romeste, te dikell lo, hawo lab job len della.
Ko lab, hoi ko rom len das, jaake kharan jon. Un o rom das hake viechen un hake tchirklen i lab. O mensheske his kek koi, kai jaake hi har job, un pash leste hi.
Koi mukas o baro Dewel, maro rai, o romes soreles dren te sowell. Un o Dewel las jek kokalo dran leskri rig win un kras ko kotar o masseha pale khetne.
Un job kras i djuwjat dran ko kokalo o romestar. Un anas lat pash o romeste.
Un o rom penas: “Ake li! Joi hi har me: miro kokalo un mass. O romestar hi li lino. Doleske kharell li romni.”
Doleske mukella i rom peskro dades un peskri dat un djala peskri romjah. Un jon wenna jek.
Un jon dui, o rom un peskri romni, his nango. Un jon ladjan gar.
O sap his gosweder har i tsele wawar vieche, hoi kras o baro Dewel, maro rai. Un o sap penas ap i romjate: “Penas o Dewel tchatchepah, te hunte chan gar i rukendar an i baar?”
Koi penas i romni ap o sap: “Mer nai chah i rukendar an i baar.
Kokres ko rukestar, hoi mashkral an i baar tardo hi, penas o Dewel ‘Ma chan kolestar, taprenn les gar an, te merenn gar!’”
Koi penas o sap ap i romjate: “Tchatchepah, tumer merenna gar.
O Dewel djinell, kai djana tumenge i jaka pre ap ko diwes, kai chan ko rukestar. Un tumer wenna har o Dewel un djinenna, hoi latcho un tchilatcho hi.”

Un koi romni dikas ap ko ruk un penas ap peste: “Mishto wals, te chaus ko rukestar. Shukar hi lo! Un mishto wals, te waus gosewo.” Un joi las o rukestar, chas un das ninna peskro romeste, kai pash late his. Un job chas ninna.
Koi djan lenge i jaka pre. Un jon haiwan, kai jon nango hi. Un jon pandan patria khetne i faigetikro rukestar un kran penge ripja.
I rati, har buder gar tato his, shunan jon, kai djas o baro Dewel, maro rai, trujel an i baar. O rom un peskri romni khatran pen o Deblestar, maro rajestar, mashkral kol ruka an i baar.
Un o baro Dewel, maro rai, das o romes gole: “Kai hal tu?”
Penas o rom: “Me shunom, kai hal an i baar. Un man his traash. Me hom nango. Koi khatrom man.”
Un o Dewel putchas lestar: “Koon penas tuke, te hal nango? Chal tu ko rukestar, kai penom tuke soreles, te chas gar lestar?”
Penas o rom: “Koi romni, kai tu man dal, koja das man ko rukestar. Un me chom.”
Un o baro Dewel, maro rai, penas ap i romjate: “Hoske kral tu kowa?” “O sap chochras man”, penas i romni, “jaake kai chom.”

Koi penas o baro Dewel, maro rai, ap o sap: “Praassedo wess koleske, hoi tu kral. Tuke djan le dran o drom, – tuke kokres un gar i tsele wawar viechenge. Tu djas ap tiro per un chas tchik tiro tselo djipen.

Tu un koi romni, tumen hi choli jek ap o wawareste. Ninna tire tchawen hi choli ap lakre tchawende. Un lakre tchawen hi choli ap tire tchawende. Jek lakre tchawendar stakrell tiro shero khetne. Un tu dandreh les an leskri heri.”
Ap i romjate penas o Dewel: “Me kamau tuke phares te krell, te weh an wawar koowa. Dukentsa aneh tu tchawen ap i phub. Un tiro dji dell gole pal tiro romeste. Job hi pral tute o rai.”

Un ap o romeste penas o Dewel: “Tu shunal ap tiri romjate un chal ko rukestar, kai penom tuke: ‘Ma cha kolestar.’ Doleske well bibacht ap i hachetikri phub. Tu budress phares ap i phub, te well tut chapaske, jaake rah har djiweh.
Subjengre burra wenn baro ap tiri hachetikri phub un tu chah ko senlepen, hoi well koi pre baro.
Tu hunte budress jaake phares tiro chapaske, te nashell o pani pral tiro mui, bis te weh pale phub. Tu hal kerdo dran i tchik i phubjatar. Un tu weh pale, hoi tu hals.”
Un o rom – leskro lab his Adam – das peskri romjat o lab Eva. Joi hi i dai i tsele menshendar.
Un o baro Dewel, maro rai, kras ripja dran felle o Adameske un i Evake un riwas kolla lenge an.

Un o baro Dewel, maro rai, penas: “Dikenn, o mensho was jaake har mer: Job djinell, hoi hi latcho un hoi hi tchilatcho. Kanna hi gar mishto, te chal lo ninna ko rukestar, hoi della o djipen. Palle djiwell job hako tsireske.”
Un o baro Dewel, maro rai, bitchras les win dran i baar ‘Eden’, te budrell job ap i hachetikri phub. Dran i tchik i phubjatar was o mensho kerdo. Un kanna hunte budrell job koi pre.

Un o Dewel tradas len win. Glan i baar ‘Eden’, ap koi rig, kai o kham pre djal, tchiwas o Dewel bolepangre i chareha, hoi chatchella un djal jek rigjatar ap i wawar, te denn le garda, te djal kek pash ko ruk, hoi della o djipen.
O Adam was khetne peskri romjah Eva. Un joi was an wawar koowa un anas i tchawes ap i phub un das les o lab Kain. Un joi penas: “Me lom i mursh tchawo. O baro Dewel das les mande.”
Un pal kowa anas joi i duito tchawes ap i phub. Koles das li o lab Abel. O Abel was i bakrengro. O Kain was i hacho un budras ap i hachetikri phub.
Pal i tsiro las o Kain kolestar, hoi ap leskri phub baro was un chatchras les o baro Debleske.

Un o Abel las tikne bakren, kai i phureder tchawe pengre dajendar hi, maras len un chatchras lengre feteder kotja o Debleske. Un o baro Dewel dikas latches ap o Abel un ap kowa, hoi job chatchras leske.
Ap o Kain dikas job gar latches, witar gar ap kowa, hoi job chatchras o Debleske. Koi las o Kain i bari choli un dikas chojedo tele ap i phub.
Koi penas o baro Dewel ap o Kain: “Hoske hal tu chojedo? Hoske dikeh tele?

Kowa hi jaake: Te kreh, hoi mishto hi, nai dikeh tu i menshen an i jaka. Te kreh, hoi gar mishto hi, hi o tchilatchepen gar dur tutar, un kamell rai pral tute te well. Tu hunte wess rai pral o tchilatchepen.”
O Kain penas ap peskro phraleste Abel: “Am! Djas win ap o them!” Un har jon win ap o them his, hadas pes o Kain ap peskro phraleste Abel un das les mulo.
Koi penas o baro Dewel ap o Kain: “Kai hi tiro phraal Abel?” Penas job: “Djinau gar. Dap me hunte jak ap miro phraleste?”
Un o Dewel penas: “Hoi kral tu? Shun! Tiro phraleskro rat dell gole pal mande dran i phub.
I phub kras peskro mui pre un pijas tiro phraleskro rat, koles tu mulo dal. Kanna nai budress buder gar ap i phub. Tu wess praassedo ap i phub.
Te kreh tiri budi ap i hachetikri phub, well kote tchi tuke baro. Tu hunte djas trujel ap i phub. Tut wella kek them, kai khere hal.”
Koi penas o Kain ap o baro Debleste: “Miri phagi hi jaake baro, kai rikrau lat nai gar win.
Tu tradeh man kau diwes win dran o them! Me hunte khatrap man glan tute. Man wella kek them, kai khere hom. Me hunte dap man trujel. Hakeno, koon hatsell man, nai dell man mulo.”

Koi penas o baro Dewel: “Na-a! Hakeno, koon o Kaines mulo della, koleskre menshendar wenn efta menshe mulo dino.” Un o baro Dewel kras i sikepen glan ap leskro shero, te djinell hakeno, koon hatsell les, te nai marell lo les gar.
Un o Kain djas peske o baro Deblestar. Un djas an ko them Nod wergel i baar Eden, ap koi rig, kai o kham pre djala.
Un o Kain was khetne peskri romjah. Kaja was an wawar koowa un anas o Henoch ap i phub. Un o Kain kras i foro, un das ko fores ko lab peskro tchawestar Henoch.
O Henoch las i tchawo. Leskro lab his Irad. Koleskro tchawo his o Mehujael. Koleskro tchawo his o Metusael. Un koleskro tchawo his o Lamech.
O Lamech las peske dui romjen. O lab kol jekatar his Ada. Koi wawar kharas Zilla.
I Ada anas i tchawes ap i phub. Leskro lab his Jabal. Job was o dad kolendar, kai an plachtene khera djiwenn un ap i viechende jak denn.
Un o lab leskro phralestar his Jubal. Kowa was o dad halauterendar, kai haiwenn ap dorjengre bashepangre un tikne phurdepangre te bashrell.
I Zilla anas ninna i tchawes ap i phub. Leskro lab his Tubal-Kain. Job was o dad halauterendar, kai haiwenn sasterno koowa te krell. Leskri pheen his i Naama.

Un o Lamech penas ap peskre romjende: Ada un Zilla, shunenn, hoi me penau! Tumer, mire romja, denn garda ap mire laba! Te dukrell man i mursh, koles dau mulo. Te dell man i terno mursh dawa, dau les me mulo.
Koon o Kaines mulo della, koleskre menshendar wenna efta mulo dino. Koon man, o Lameches, mulo della, koleskre menshendar wenna 77 (efta-deesh-te-efta) menshe mulo dino.
Un o Adam was pale khetne peskri romjah. Un joi anas i tchawes ap i phub, un das les ko lab Set, un penas: “O Dewel das man i wawar tchawes miro tchaweske Abel, koles o Kain mulo das.”
Un o Set las ninna i tchawo. Koles das job ko lab Enosh. An ko tsiro mangan i menshe o ersto kopo o baro Debles an.
Kowa hi ko liil, kai i laba tchinlo hi kol menshendar, kai wan pal o Adam. Ap ko diwes, har o Dewel o menshes kras, kras les lo jaake har job hi.
Job kras o murshes un i djuwjat un tchiwas peskri soor ap lende un das len ko lab ‘mensho’.
Har o Adam 130 (sheel-te-triin-deesh) bersha phuro his, was job o dad i tchawestar, kai win dikas har job. Un das les ko lab Set.
Koi pal, har o Set boldo was, djiwas o Adam 800 (ochta-sheel) bersha. Un lestar wan bud tchawe un tcha bolde.
Leskro tselo djipen his 930 (enja-sheel-te-triin-deesh) bersha. Un job meras.
Har o Set 105 (sheel-te-pantch) bersha phuro his, was lestar o Enosh boldo.
Koi pal, har o Enosh boldo was, djiwas o Set 807 (ochta-sheel-te-efta) bersha. Un lestar wan bud tchawe un tcha bolde.
Leskro tselo djipen his 912 (enja-sheel-te-deesh-te-dui) bersha, un job meras.
Har o Enosh 90 (enja-deesh) bersha phuro his, was lestar o Kenan boldo.
Koi pal, har o Kenan boldo was, djiwas o Enosh 815 (ochta-sheel-te-deesh-te-pantch) bersha. Un lestar wan bud tchawe un tcha bolde.
Leskro tselo djipen his 905 (enja-sheel-te-pantch) bersha. Un job meras.
Har o Kenan 70 (efta-deesh) bersha phuro his, was lestar o Mahalalel boldo.
Pal kowa, har o Mahalalel boldo was, djiwas o Kenan 840 (ochta-sheel-te-star-deesh) bersha. Un lestar wan bud tchawe un tcha bolde.
Leskro tselo djipen his 910 (enja-sheel-te-deesh) bersha. Un job meras.
Har o Mahalalel 65 (shob-deesh-te-pantch) bersha phuro his, was lestar o Jered boldo.
Koi pal, har o Jered boldo was, djiwas o Mahalalel 830 (ochta-sheel-te-triin-deesh) bersha. Un lestar wan bud tchawe un tcha bolde.
Un leskro tselo djipen his 895 (ochta-sheel-te-enja-deesh-te-pantch) bersha. Un job meras.
Har o Jered 162 (sheel-te-shob-deesh-te-dui) bersha phuro his, was lestar o Henoch boldo.
Koi pal, har o Henoch boldo was, djiwas o Jered 800 (ochta-sheel) bersha. Un lestar wan bud tchawe un tcha bolde.
Leskro tselo djipen his 962 (enja-sheel-te-shob-deesh-te-dui) bersha. Un job meras.
Har o Henoch 65 (shob-deesh-te-pantch) bersha phuro his, was lestar o Metuselach boldo.
Koi pal, har o Metuselach boldo was, djiwas o Henoch 300 (triin-sheel) bersha o Debleha. Un lestar wan bud tchawe un tcha bolde.
Leskro tselo djipen his 365 (triin-sheel-te-shob-deesh-te-pantch) bersha.
Un o Henoch djiwas o Debleha. Palle his job buder gar koi. O Dewel las les krik.
Har o Metuselach 187 (sheel-te-ochta-deesh-te-efta) bersha phuro his, was lestar o Lamech boldo.
Koi pal, har o Lamech boldo was, djiwas o Metuselach 782 (efta-sheel-te-ochta-deesh-te-dui) bersha. Un lestar wan bud tchawe un tcha bolde.
Leskro tselo djipen his 969 (enja-sheel-te-shob-deesh-te-enja) bersha. Un job meras.
Har o Lamech 182 (jek-sheel-te-ochta-deesh-te-dui) bersha phuro his, was lestar jek tchawo boldo.
Un job das les ko lab Noah un penas: “Mari budi hi pharo ap i hachetikri phub, kai tchiwas o baro Dewel i bibacht pre. O Noah dell mare djia newi soor.”
Koi pal, har o Noah boldo was, djiwas o Lamech 585 (pantch-sheel-te-enja-deesh-te-pantch) bersha. Un lestar wan bud tchawe un tcha bolde.
Leskro tselo djipen his 777 (efta-sheel-te-efta-deesh-te-efta) bersha. Un job meras.
O Noah his 500 (pantch-sheel) bersha phuro un lestar wan o Sem, o Ham un o Jafet boldo.
I menshe wan bud un budeder ap i phub. Un tcha wan boldo lendar.
Koi dikan i Debleskre tchawe, har shukar i menshengre tcha hi. Un jon lan penge kolen, kai jon kaman, te romedinerenn jon len.
Koi penas o baro Dewel: “Miro djipaskro ducho atchell gar hako tsiro an o mensheste. Job hi mass. Job well gar phureder har 120 (sheel-te-biish) bersha.”

An ko tsiro, har i Debleskre tchawe khetne wan i menshengre tchentsa un lendar tchawe bolde wan, djiwan bare menshe ap i phub. Ninna pal ko tsiro. Kolla his tchatche mursha an ko phuro tsiro: baro un an-diklo.
O baro Dewel dikas, kai o menshengro tchilatchepen baro hi ap i phub. Halauter, hoi len an lengre djia hi, his tchilatcho o tselo diwes.
Kowa dukas les an leskro dji. Un o baro Debles khaitas, kai kras job i menshen ap i phub.
Doleske penas o baro Dewel: “Me lau i tsele menshen, kai me krom, pale krik i phubjatar, ninna i viechen, i baren un i tiknen, un i tchirkle. Khaitell man, kai krom len.”
O Noah kokres his latcho glan o baro Debleskre jaka.

Kowa hi ko liil, kai tchinlo hi pral o Noah peskre tchawentsa. O Noah his i mursh, kai latcho un tchatcho his. I tsele menshendar an ko tsiro kras job kokres kek tchilatchepen. O Noah djiwas o Debleha.
Les his triin tchawe: o Sem, o Ham un o Jafet.

Un i phub his buder gar latcho glan o Debleskre jaka. I menshe kran, kai his i phub pherdo tchilatchepen un midjak koowa. Har o Dewel ap i phub dikas, dikas lo, te djan i tsele menshe ap i tchilatcho drom.

Doleske penas o Dewel ap o Noah: “Kolla, kai djiwenn ap i phub, kran, te was i phub pherdo tchilatchepen un midjak koowa. Kamau gar, te djiwenn le dureder. Awa, me krau, te merenn i tsele menshe un halauter, hoi ap i phub hi.
Kre tuke i panjeskro kheer dran sorelo kasht. Kre bud isema dren. Un mak win un dren teera pre!
Kre ko panjeskro kheer jaake: 150 (sheel-te-pantch-desha) metarja lengsto, 25 (biish-te-pantch) metarja buchlo un 15 (deesh-te-pantch) metarja pral.

Kre i dacha! Un tel i dacha muk i paash metari pre trul o tselo kheer! Un kre i wudar ap i rig! Kre ko panjeskro kheer jaake, te wenn triin isema jek pral o wawar. Jaake hi les bud isema tella, mashkral un pral.
Dik! Me mukau i baro pani te well pral i tseli phub, te tassenn lauter, kai djipen an lende hi. Halauter merella, hoi ap i phub djiwella.
Tut dau miro lab, kai atcheh djido. Koi dau miro wast pre. Un tu djas tire tchawentsa un tiri romjah un tire tchawengre romjentsa an o panjeskro kheer dren.
I tsele viechendar, an dui kotar an o panjeskro kheer dren: i mursh un i djuwel, te atchenn le ninna djido.
Dui kotar hake tchirklendar un hake viechendar, ninna hake tikne viechendar ap i phub, hunte djan pash tute an o panjeskro kheer, te atchenn le djido.
Le hako viecheske peskro chapen peha un ninna doha tuke un tire menshenge!”
Un o Noah kras lauter jaake, har o Dewel leske penas.
Un o baro Dewel penas ap o Noah: “Dja an ko panjeskro kheer: tu un tiri tseli familja. I tsele menshendar ap i phub hal tu kokres latcho un tchatcho glan mande.
Le viechen tuha an o panjeskro kheer: Hake viechendar, kai hi gar pale-tchiddo, le efta murshen pengre djuwjentsa! Un hake pale-tchidde viechendar le jek murshes un peskri djuwel.
I tchirklendar le ninna efta murshen un efta djuwjen! Kre kowa, te lenn le tchawe un merenn gar win ap i phub.
An efta diwessa mukau me brishin tele te well ap i phub: star-desha diwessa un star-desha rati, jaake te merell ap i phub o tselo djipen, hoi krom.”
Un o Noah kras halauter jaake, har o baro Dewel leske penas.
Un o Noah his 600 (shob-sheel) bersha phuro, har was o baro pani pral i phub.
Un o Noah djas an o panjeskro kheer. Khetne leha djan leskre tchawe, leskri romni un leskre tchawengre romja, te tassenn le gar.

Ninna i vieche wan pash o Noah an o panjeskro kheer, hakenestar dui: o mursh un peskri djuwel: i viechendar, kai gar pale-tchiddo hi un kolendar, kai pale-tchiddo hi, ninna i tchirklendar un i tsele tikne viechendar ap i phub, jaake har o Dewel leske penas.
Un pal efta diwessa was o baro pani pral i phub.
Har o Noah 600 (shob-sheel) bersha phuro his, an o duito tchon an ko bersh, ap o deesh-te-eftato diwes was o pani, hoi an i phub hi, i sorjah win.
Un dran o bolepen was baro sorelo brishin ap i phub: star-desha diwessa un star-desha rati.
Ap ko diwes djas o Noah peskri romjah un peskre tchawentsa, o Sem, o Ham un o Jafet, un kolengre romja an o panjeskro kheer.
Khetne lentsa djan ninna hake viechendar – kolendar, kai diwjo hi un kolendar, kai gar diwjo hi, ninna hake tikne viechendar, hoi djan pral i phub, un hake tchirklendar.
Jon djan pash o Noah an o panjeskro kheer dui hakenestar, hoi djiwella: jek mursh un peskri djuwel,
jaake har o Dewel leske penas, te krell lo kowa. Un o baro Dewel kras o wudar pandlo pal lende.
Un o baro pani was pral i phub 40 (star-desha) diwessa, un djas pre un hadas o panjeskro kheer pre un hidjras les.
Un o pani was bud un budeder pral i phub. Un o panjeskro kheer rikras pes pral o pani.
Un o pani was jaake baro ap i phub, kai his i tsele bare berge tel o pani.
O pani atchas tardo efta metarja pral i berge, jaake kai i tsele berge tel o pani his.
Un koi meras halauter ap i phub, hoi djido his: i tchirkle un i vieche, – kolla, kai diwjo hi un kolla, kai gar diwjo hi, ninna i tikne vieche, hoi djan pral i phub, un i tsele menshe.
Halauter meras, hoi ap i phub djiwas.

Jaake was o tselo djipen ap i phub tassedo: i menshe, i vieche, i bare un i tikne, ninna i tchirkle. Halauter was tassedo. O Noah kokres atchas djido un kolla, kai djan khetne leha an o panjeskro kheer.
O pani his tardo ap i phub 150 (sheel-te-paash-sheel) diwessa.

O Dewel bistras o Noah gar, witar gar i viechen, kai pash leste an o panjeskro kheer his: kol diwje vieche un kolla, kai gar diwje hi. Un o Dewel mukas i baro ducho pral i phub te phurdell. Koi djas o pani tele.
Kek sorelo pani was buder dran i phub. Un o bolepen rikras o baro brishin pale.
Pal 150 (sheel-te-paash-sheel) diwessa djas o pani pale.
Ap o deesh-te-eftato diwes, an o eftato tchon atchas o panjeskro kheer ap kol berge Ararat tardo.
Un o pani djas dureder pale bis an o deshto tchon. Ap o ersto diwes an o deshto tchon wan i berge dran o pani win – lengre pralstune kotja.
Pal 40 (star-deesh) diwessa kras o Noah koi wochni an leskro panjeskro kheer pre,
un mukas i korako win. Kowa djas peske, un was pale pale, jaake rah bis te his i phub buder gar sapeno.
Un job mukas i tauba win, te dikell lo, te his o pani tele naashedo.
I tauba hatsas kek platsa, kai nashte beshas pes li tele. His jaake bud pani ap i phub. Doleske was joi an o panjeskro kheer pale. Un o Noah las koi tauba o wasteha an o panjeskro kheer dren.
Pal efta diwessa mukas job pale i tauba dran o panjeskro kheer win.
Un i tauba was pale ap i rati. Un an lakro mui his i newi patri i djeteskro rukestar. Kanna djinas o Noah, te his buder gar bud pani ap i phub.
Pal wawar efta diwessa bitchras job i tauba pale win. Un i tauba was buder gar pale.

Un ap o ersto diwes an o ersto tchon ko bershestar, kai o Noah 601 (shob-sheel-te-jek) bersh phuro was, his buder kek pani ap i phub tardo. Un o Noah las i kotar dran i dacha tele un dikas, kai i phub buder gar sapeno his.
Ap o biish-te-eftato diwes an o duito tchon his i tseli phub truk.
Un o Dewel penas ap o Noah:
“Kanna dja win dran o panjeskro kheer, tu un tiri romni un tire tchawe un lengre romja.
Kol tsele vieche, kai pash tute hi, muk len win te djal: i tchirkle, i bare vieche, un i tikne vieche, kai djan pral i phub. Kamau, te lenn le tchawe, jaake te well lendar i phub pherdo.”
Koi djas o Noah peskre tchawentsa un peskri romjah un peskre tchawengre romjentsa dran o panjeskro kheer win.
I tsele vieche, i bare un i tikne, un i tsele tchirkle, halauter, hoi djiwell ap i phub, djas ninna dran o panjeskro kheer. Hako kopo djan kolla khetne, kai his i emlige viechendar.

Un o Noah kras i chatchepaskri platsa un las hake viechendar, kai gar pale-tchiddo hi un hake tchirklendar, kai gar pale-tchiddo hi. Un das len mulo un chatchras len ap koi platsa, te parkrell lo pes pash o baro Debleste.

Un o baro Dewel sungas ko latcho sungepen un penas ap peste: “Me dau man sowel, te anau buder gar hawi bari bibacht pral i phub doleske, hoi i menshe krenna. Djinau, o mensheskro dji hi tchilatcho fun tiknes pre. Me kamau buder gar o tselo djipen ap i phub te marell, jaake har krom.
Jaake rah, har i phub koi hi, witsrenn le djob ap i phub un anenn le pale newo djob dren. Jaake rah, har i phub koi hi, atchenna shilapen un tatepen, nijal un wend, diwes un rati.”
Un o Dewel rakras latche laba pral o Noah un pral leskre tchawende win un penas: “Anenn bud tchawen ap i phub, te well i phub tumendar pherdo!
I tsele vieche ap i phub un i tsele tchirkle an o bolepen hunte darenn un trashenn tumendar. Halauter, hoi djiwella ap i phub, un i tsele matche an o baro pani, dau an tumare wasta.
Halauter, hoi djiwella, dau me tumende, te chan kowa nashte. Me dau les tumen te chal, jaake har dom tumen o senlepen.
Kokres o mass, kai hi gomme rat dren, kowa hunte chan gar; an o rat hi o djipen.
Kek hunte lell tumaro djipen. Hakeno koon lell tumaro djipen, kolestar lau me ninna leskro djipen: hako viechestar un hako menshestar.
O Dewel kras o menshes, jaake har job hi. Doleske hunte well kowa mulo dino i menshestar, kai i menshes mulo das.
Anenn tchawen ap i phub, – bud tchawen, te well i phub tumendar pherdo!”
Un o Dewel penas ap o Noah un ap leskre tchawende:
“Shunenn, me dau tumen miro lab un dau miro wast koi pre. Ko lab hi tumenge un tumare tchawenge, kai pal tumende wenna,
un lauterenge pash tumende, hoi djido hi, – lauterenge, kai djan win dran o panjeskro kheer: hake tchirkle un hake vieche ap i phub, kolla, kai diwje hi un kolla, kai gar diwje hi.
Kowa hi ko lab, kai dau miro wast koi pre: Me anau buder gar sawo baro pani pral i phub, te tassell hako djipen ap i phub. Sawo baro pani well buder gar pral i phub.”
Un o Dewel penas: “Me dau tumen i sikepen, te djinenn tumer, ko lab, hoi dom me tumende un hake viechende pash tumende, ninna lauterende, kai wenna pal tumende, ko lab atchella hako tsireske:
Me tchiwom miro brishineskro bogo an o bolepen. Te dikenn les, djinenn tumer, kai well buder gar sawo baro pani pral i phub.
Hako kopo, kai dau brishin pral i phub un ko brishineskro bogo tardo hi an o bolepen,
well ko lab an miro shero, hoi me dom tumen un lauteren, kai djiwenna: ‘Me mukau kek pani buder te well, hoi jaake baro well, te tassell o tselo djipen.’
Te hi miro brishineskro bogo an o bolepen tardo, dikau les, un ko lab, hoi dom, well an miro shero. Ko lab atchell tardo hako tsiro mange un hakeneske, kai djiwella ap i phub.”
Un o Dewel penas ap o Noah: “Ko brishineskro bogo hi ko sikepen, te rikrau miro lab, hoi me dom hakeneske, hoi ap i phub djiwella.”
Un o Noaheskre tchawe, kai djan dran o panjeskro kheer, his o Sem, o Ham un o Jafet. (O Ham hi kowa, kolestar o Kanaan well.)
Kolla triin hi i tchawe o Noahestar. Lendar wenna i tsele menshe ap i phub.
Un o Noah his i hacho un tchiwas drakengre ruka an i phub.
Dran i drake kras job mool, was lo mato, riwas peskre koola win un his nanges an peskri plachteno kheer tchiddo.
Un o Ham, koleskro tchawo o Kanaan hi, dikas peskro dades nanges, un djas win un penas kowa peskre dui phralenge.
Koi lan o Sem un o Jafet i ripen un tchiwan les pral pengre phika un djan pengro dumo glan-wi pash pengro dadeste, jaake kai dikan les jon nashte gar. Un jon tchakran les.
Har o Noah djangelo was dran peskro matepen un shunas, hoi leskro terneder tchawo kras, penas job:
“Bibacht ap o Kanaan! Job wella o telstuno budepaskro peskre phralenge!”
Palle penas job: “Me sharau o baro Debles, ko Debles kones o Sem an-mangella. Un o Kanaan well peskro phraleskro budepaskro!
Mu krell o Dewel o Jafeteskro them jaake buchlo, te djiwenn leskre menshe mashkral i menshende, kai wenna pal o Sem. Un o Kanaan well leskro budepaskro!”
O Noah djiwas 350 (triin-sheel-te-paash-sheel) bersha pal o baro pani, hoi was pral i phub.
Leskro tselo djipen his 950 (enja-sheel-te-paash-sheel) bersha. Un job meras.
Kowa hi ko liil, kai i laba tchinlo hi kol menshendar, kai wan o Noaheskre tchawendar: o Sem, o Ham un o Jafet. Kolenge wan tchawe boldo pal o baro pani.
O Jafet: Leskre tchawe hi o Gomer, o Magog, o Madai, o Jawan, o Tubal, o Meshech un o Tiras.
I menshe, kai wan pal o Gomer, hi: o Ashkenas, o Rifat un o Togarma.
I menshe, kai wan pal o Jawan, hi o Elisha, o Tarsis, i Kitarja un Rodanarja.
Kolendar wenna i menshe, kai djiwenna an i themma pash o baro pani. Kolla hi i tchawe o Jafetestar pengre menshentsa. Lendar wan bare familje. Hakeni rakras peskro rakepen un djiwas an peskro them.
O Ham: Leskre tchawe hi: o Kush, o Mizrajim, o Put un o Kanaan.
I menshe, kai wan pal o Kush, hi: o Seba, o Hawila, o Sabta, o Ragma, un o Sabteka. I menshe, kai wan pal o Ragma hi: o Seba un o Dedan.
O Kush, les his i tchawo, leskro lab his Nimrod. Kowa his o ersto, kai las bari soor pral wawar menshende ap i phub.
Un job his i baro jegari glan o baro Debleste. Doleske well penlo: ‘Kowa hi i baro jegari glan o baro Debleste har o Nimrod.’
An ko ersto tsiro was job o rai pral i forja Babel, Erek, Akkad un Kalne an o them Shinar.
Kotar djas job an o them Assur un kras i forja Ninive, Rechobot-Ir, Kelach
un ninna Resen, kai mashkral Ninive un ko baro foro Kelach hi.
O Mizrajim was o dad kol menshendar Lud, Anam, Lehab, Naftu,
Patros, Kaslu un Kaftor, kolendar wenna i Filistarja.
O Kanaan: Leskre tchawe hi o Sidon un o Het. O Sidon hi o phureder tchawo.
O Kanaan was ninna o dad kol menshendar Jebus, Amor, Girgash,
Hiw, Ark, Sin,
Arwad, Zemar un Hamat. Pal i tsiro atchan kolla bare familje, kai wan pal o Kanaan, buder gar khetne un djan dureder.

Lengro tselo them djas pral pash o foro Sidon un tele pash o foro Gaza. Un ap koi rig, kai o kham pre-djala, djas lo pash o foro Gerar un dureder pash kol forja Sodom, Gomorra, Adma, un Zebojim pash o foro Lesha.
Kolla hi i tchawe o Hamestar pengre menshentsa. Lendar wan bare familje. Hakeni rakras peskro rakepen un djiwas an peskro them.
O Jafeteskro phureder phraal, o Sem, las ninna tchawe. Job his o dad i tsele menshendar Eber.
Kolla hi i tchawe o Semestar: o Elam, o Assur, o Arpaksad, o Lud, un o Aram.
O Aram: Leskre tchawe hi: o Uz, o Hul, o Geter, un o Mash.
O Arpaksad las i tchawo, o Shelach. Koleskro tchawo hi o Eber.
O Eber las dui tchawe: Jek kharas Peleg. An leskro tsiro atchan i menshe buder gar khetne. Haki bari familja las peskro them. O Peleges his i phraal. Kowa kharas Joktan.
Koleskre tchawe his: o Almodad, o Shelef, o Hazarmawet, o Jerach,
o Hadoram, o Usal, o Dikla,
o Obal, o Abimael, o Saba,
o Ofir, o Hawila, un o Jobab. Kolla halauter wan pal o Joktan.
Un o them, kai jon khere his, his mashkral Mesha un Sefar, kai hi tchiddo an kol berge kote, kai o kham pre djala.
Kolla hi i tchawe o Semestar pengre menshentsa. Lendar wan bare familje. Hakeni rakras peskro rakepen un djiwas an peskro them.

Kolla hi halauter i menshe, kai wenna o Noaheskre tchawendar. Lengre laba hi jaake pre tchinlo, te well diklo, koon lengro dad hi, un hawe menshe lendar wenna. Kol menshendar wenna i tsele menshe ap i phub pal o baro pani.
An ko tsiro his i tsele menshen jek rakepen.
Un jon mukan pengro them un djan kote, kai o kham pre djala. An o them Shinar hatsan le i buchlo them un atchan koi.

Un jon penan jek ap o wawareste: “Awenn, las tchik, te kras barra dran lende, un chatchras len, te wenn le soreles.” Un jon lan tchik un kran barra dran. Un lan teera te tchiwenn le lat mank i barra, te atchenn kol barra khetne.
Un jon penan: “Awenn, mer krah menge i foro un i baro kheer, hoi djal an o bolepen. Jaake sikrah hakeneske, har baro mer ham. Un mer atchah khetne an ko them.”
Koi was o baro Dewel tele, te dikell lo ko foro un ko baro kheer, hoi kol menshe krenn.

Un o baro Dewel penas: “Dik, jon hi halauter khetne an jek them un rakrenn jek rakepen. Kanna krenn le kau foro. Hoi krenn le pal kowa? Dell tchi, hoi jon gar haiwenna. Jon krenn lauter, hoi lenge an o shero wella.
Awenn, djas tele pash lende un das hakenes i wawar rakepen, jaake, kai jek i wawares buder gar haiwella.”
O baro Dewel kras jaake, te atchan le koi buder gar khetne un hunte djan dran jek them an i wawar pral i tseli phub. Un jon mukan tele, te krenn le ko foro.

Doleske kharell ko foro Babel. Kote kras o baro Dewel, kai jek i wawareskro rakepen buder gar haiwella. Jaake kras job, te atchan le koi buder gar khetne un hunte djan dran jek them an i wawar pral i tseli phub.
Kowa hi ko liil, kai tchinlo hi i laba kol menshendar, kai wan pal o Sem. Har o Sem 100 (sheel) bersha phuro his, was lestar o Arpaksad boldo. Kowa his dui bersha pal o baro pani.
Koi pal, har o Arpaksad boldo was, djiwas o Sem pantch-sheel (500) bersha. Un lestar wan wawar tchawe un tcha bolde.
Har o Arpaksad 35 (trijanda-te-pantch) bersha phuro his, was lestar o Shelach boldo.
Koi pal, har o Shelach boldo was, djiwas o Arpaksad 403 (star-sheel-te-triin) bersha. Un lestar wan tchawe un tcha bolde.
Har o Shelach 30 (trijanda) bersha phuro his, was lestar o Eber boldo.
Koi pal, har o Eber boldo was, djiwas o Shelach 403 (star-sheel-te-triin) bersha. Un lestar wan tchawe un tcha bolde.
Har o Eber 34 (trijanda-te-star) bersha phuro his, was lestar o Peleg boldo.
Koi pal, har o Peleg boldo was, djiwas o Eber 430 (star-sheel-te-trijanda) bersha. Un lestar wan tchawe un tcha bolde.
Har o Peleg 30 (trijanda) bersha phuro his, was lestar o Regu boldo.
Koi pal, har o Regu boldo was, djiwas o Peleg 209 (dui-sheel-te-enja) bersha. Un lestar wan tchawe un tcha bolde.
Har o Regu 32 (trijanda-te-dui) bersha phuro his, was lestar o Serug boldo.
Koi pal, har o Serug boldo was, djiwas o Regu 207 (dui-sheel-te-efta) bersha. Un lestar wan tchawe un tcha bolde.
Har o Serug 30 (trijanda) bersha phuro his, was lestar o Nahor boldo.
Koi pal, har o Nahor boldo was, djiwas o Serug 200 (dui-sheel) bersha. Un lestar wan tchawe un tcha bolde.
Har o Nahor 29 (biish-te-enja) bersha phuro his, was lestar o Terach boldo.
Koi pal, har o Terach boldo was, djiwas o Nahor 119 (sheel-te-deesh-te-enja) bersha. Un lestar wan tchawe un tcha bolde.
Har o Terach 70 (efta-deesh) bersha phuro his, was job dad. Leskre tchawe his o Abram, o Nahor, un o Haran.
Kowa hi ko liil, kai tchinlo hi i laba kol menshendar, kai wan pal o Terach. O Terach: Leskre tchawe his o Abram, o Nahor un o Haran. O Haran las i tchawo, o Lot.
O Haran meras glan peskro dadeste an peskro dadeskro them Kaldea, an o foro Ur.
O Abram romedineras i Sarai. Un o Nahor romedineras i Milka, kolakro dad o Haran his. Koles his kol dui tcha, i Milka un i Jiska.
I Sarai nashte las kek tchawe.

Un o Terach las peskro tchawes Abram peha un o Lot, ko tchawo peskro tchawestar Haran, un i Sarai, koi romni peskro tchawestar Abram. Un khetne mukan le ko foro Ur, hoi an o them Kaldea tchiddo hi, te djan le an o them Kanaan. Un jon wan pash o foro Haran un atchan kote.
O Terach was 205 (dui-sheel-te-pantch) bersh phuro un meras an o foro Haran.
O baro Dewel penas ap o Abrameste: “Dja win dran tiro them! Muk tire menshen un tiro dadeskro kheer! Un dja an ko them, hoi me sikrau tute!
Me kamau te well tutar i bari natsjona. Me tchiwau miri soor un miri bacht ap tute, un kamau tiro lab bares te krell. Un koi bacht, hoi me tut dau, djal dureder ap i wawar menshenge.

Kolla kai penenna, te well tut bud bacht, ap kolende tchiwau miri bacht. Un kolla, kai penenna, te well tut bibacht, ap kolende anau ninna bibacht. Koi bacht, hoi me tut dau, djal dureder ap i tsele menshende, kai ap i phub hi.”
Un o Abram djas peske, jaake har o baro Dewel leske penas. Un o Lot djas leha. Har djas o Abram dran o foro Haran, his job 75 (efta-deesh-te-pantch) bersh phuro.

Job las peskri romjat Sarai peha un peskro phraleskro tchawes Lot. Job las ninna pengro tselo koowa peha, pengre viechen un pengre budepangren, kai lengre an o foro Haran wan. Un jon tserdan win un wan an ko them Kanaan.
Un job djas dureder an o them un was an o foro Sichem pash ko baro ruk ‘More’. An ko tsiro djiwan i Kanaanitarja an ko them.

Un o baro Dewel mukas pes o Abramestar te dikell, un penas ap leste: “Tire tchawen un kolengre tchawen un lauteren, kai pal tute wenna, kolen kamau kau them te dell.” Koi kras o Abram i chatchepaskri o baro Debleske, kai wenn vieche leske chatchedo – kote, kai o Dewel mukas pes lestar te dikell.

Kotar djas o Abram dureder an i berge pash o foro Betel. Mank kol forja Betel un Ai tchiwas job peskro plachteno kheer pre. Ko foro Betel hi tchiddo ap koi rig, kai o kham tele djala. Un o foro Ai hi tchiddo ap koi rig, kai o kham pre djala. Kote kras job pale i chatchepaskri o baro Debleske, kai wenn vieche leske chatchedo, un kharas o baro Debles an.
Pal kowa djas job dureder un was pash ko them Negev.
Koi was i tsiro an ko them, kai his i menshen un i viechen tchi te chal. Len his bari bok. Dran kowa djas o Abram dureder, te djiwell lo an o them Egiptia.
Job his buder gar dur o themestar Egiptia. Koi penas job ap peskri romjate: “Sarai, me djinau, kai hal i shukar djuwel.
Te dikenn tut kol Egiptarja, penenn jon: ‘Koja hi leskri romni.’ Palle denn le man temerl un tut mukenn le te djiwell.
Pen lenge, tu hal miri pheen. Jaake lenn le tut penge, un doleske hi le latches ap mande un mukenn man te djiwell.”
Har jon an o them Egiptia wan, dikan i Egiptarja, hawi shukar djuwel joi hi.
Un i pralstune budepangre o baro rajestar pral o them dikan lat un sharan lat glan lengro rajeste. Un jon anan lat an o baro rajeskro kheer.
Un doleske kras o baro rai o Abrameske latchepen. Un o Abram las bakre, grumja, burike, khamele un budepangre: mursha un djuwja.
Har las o baro rai peske o Abrameskri romjat, i Sarai, anas o baro Dewel i bari bibacht ap leste un ap leskro tselo kheer.
Koi mukas o baro rai o Abrames te kharell, un penas ap leste: “Hoi kral tu mantsa? Hoske penal mange gar, kai hi joi tiri romni?
Hoske penal tu, kai joi tiri pheen hi? Jaake, kai lom lat mange, te well li miri romni. Ake! Le tiri romjat un dja tuke!”
Un o baro rai penas ap peskre lurdende, te anenn jon o Abrames win dran o them: les, leskri romjat un halauter, hoi pash leste his.
O Abram djas dran o them Egiptia: job un leskri romni un halauter hoi les his, un leskro phraleskro tchawo Lot. Un jon djan an o them Negev.
O Abram his brawelo: Les his bud vieche, rup un sonakai.
Un ko themestar Negev djas job dureder fun jek platsa ap i wawar. Un was pash o foro Betel ap koi platsa mank Betel un Ai, kai leskro plachteno kheer o ersto kopo tardo his.
Kote his koi platsa, kai job i Debleskri chatchepaskri kras. Un kote kharas job pale o baro Debles an.
O Lot, kai djal o Abrameha, koles his ninna bakre, grumja un plachtene khera.
O Abrameskro brawlepen un o Loteskro brawlepen his jaake baro, kai nashte djiwan jon buder gar khetne. Lengre vieche hatsan gar doha te chal.
Jaake tchingran pen o Abrameskre budepangre un o Loteskre budepangre, kai dan garda ap lengre viechende. An ko tsiro djiwan ninna i Kanaanitarja un i Perisarja an ko them.
Koi penas o Abram ap o Lot: “Me kamau kek tchingepen mank mende, witar gar mank tire budepangre un mire budepangre. Mer ham phrala.
Rode tuke win, hawo them tu kameh. Un dja tuke mandar! Kameh tu serwes te djal, djau me tchatches. Un te kameh tu tchatches te djal, djau me serwes.”

O Lot dikas ap o tselo them pash o pani Jordan. Kowa his halauter sapeno. Bis pash o foro Zoar his ko them har o baro Debleskri baar un har o them Egiptia. Kowa his glan ko tsiro, kai kol forja Sodom un Gomorra chatchedo wan.
Un o Lot rodas peske o tselo them pash o pani Jordan win. Un djas kote, kai o kham pre djala. Un hakeno djas i wawar drom:
O Abram djiwas an o them Kanaan. Un o Lot djiwas an kol forja pash o pani Jordan, un tchiwas peskre plachtene khera pre bis pash o foro Sodom.
Kol menshe an Sodom his tchilatcho un djiwan an baro tchilatchepen glan o baro Debleste.
Har o Lot peske djas, penas o baro Dewel ap o Abrameste: “Dik tut trujel un dik kote, kai tardo hal, ap haki rig: serwes, tchatches, glan tute un pal tute!
Ko tselo them, hoi dikeh, kowa dau tut un tire tchawen, kai pal tute wenna. Ko them hi tumaro hako tsiro.
Un me dau tut bud tchawen, kai pal tute wenna, – jaake bud har i tchik ap i phub. Kek mensho nai djinell, har bud tchik ap i phub hi. Jaake djinell nai kek, kitse menshe tutar wenna.
Dja trujel an o tselo them! Tut dau ko tselo them.”

Un o Abram djas peskre plachtene kherentsa trujel, un was pash o foro Hebron un atchas tel i bare ruka ko murshestar Mamre. Un kote kras job i chatchepaskri o baro Debleske, kai wenn vieche leske chatchedo.

An ko tsiro his i kurepen. Star bare raja kuran pen pantch forjengre rajentsa. Kolla bare raja his: o Amrafel, ko baro rai pral o them Shinar, o Arjoch, ko baro rai pral o them Ellasar, o Kedor-Laomer, ko baro rai pral o them Elam, o Tidal, ko baro rai pral o them Gojim.

Kol pantch forjengre raja his: o Bera, ko rai pral o foro Sodom, o Birsha, ko rai pral o foro Gomorra, o Shinab, ko rai pral o foro Adma, o Shemeber, ko rai pral o foro Zebojim, o rai pral o foro Bela. Kowa hi kanna o foro Zoar.
Kol pantch raja kran win, te rikrenn jon khetne un wan an i tala Siddim. Kowa hi kanna o Londo Baro Pani.
Deesh-te-dui bersha his o Kedor-Laomer o baro rai pral kol pantch forjengre rajende. Un jon budran leske. An o deesh-te-triinto bersh hadan pen le pral leste un shunan buder gar ap leste.

An o deesh-te-starto bersh was o baro rai Kedor-Laomer un kol wawar bare raja, kai leha khetne his. Un jon kuran pen: kol menshentsa an o foro Asterot-Karnajim – kolla his i Refajarja; kol menshentsa an o foro Ham, – kolla his i Susarja; kol menshentsa, kai djiwenna an o them, kai o foro Kirjatajim tardo hi, – kolla his i Emarja;
kol menshentsa ap i berge Seir, – kolla his i Horarja. Un jon dan len bis El-Paran, hoi pash o mulo tato them tchiddo hi.

Koi pal rissran pen kol star bare raja trujel un wan an ko foro En-Mishpat. Kowa hi kanna Kadesh. Un jon maran i tsele menshen an ko them, kai i Amalekarja djiwan, ninna i Amorarja, kai an Hazezon-Tamar djiwan.
Kanna djan kol pantch raja pral i forja Sodom, Gomorra, Adma, Zebojim un Bela dran i forja win. Bela kharella kanna Zoar. Un jon djan pengre lurdentsa an i tala Siddim.

Kote kuran pen le kol star bare rajentsa. Kolla his: o baro rai Kedor-Laomer pral o them Elam, o baro rai Tidal pral o them Gojim, o baro rai Amrafel pral o them Shinar, o baro rai Arjoch pral o them Ellasar.

An i tala Siddim his bud chebja an i phub, kai pherdo teera his. I raja pral i forja Sodom un Gomorra pengre lurdentsa hunte nashan penge. Un bud peran an kol chebja. Un kol wawar, kai pral atchan, nashan an i berge.
Un kol star bare raja lan lauter peha, hoi jon an i forja Sodom un Gomorra hatsan. Jon lan ninna o tselo chapen dran kol forja un djan penge.
O Abrameskro phraleskro tchawo Lot, kai djiwas an Sodom, koles lan jon ninna peha, un leskro tselo koowa, hoi les his.

Un jek kolendar, kai peske nashas, was pash o Abrameste un penas leske halauter. O Abram his i Hebreari. An ko tsiro djiwas o Abram pash i bare ruka ko murshestar Mamre. Kowa his i Amorari. Leskre phrala his o Eshkol un o Aner. Kolla triin kran o Abrameha win, te rikrenn jon khetne, un dan pengro dadeskro wast koi pre.

Har o Abram shunas, kai leskro phraleskro tchawo pandlo un krik anlo was, kharas job peskre murshen. Les his 318 (triin-sheel-deesh-te-ochta) tchatche mursha, kai pash leste boldo wan. Kolentsa tradas job i star bare rajen un lengre lurden bis pash ko foro Dan.
An i rati bitchras job peskre murshen ap dui rigja. Un job un leskre mursha djan ap lende pre un dan len, un lan len palla bis pash ko foro Hoba, hoi ap i serwi rig o forestar Damaskus tchiddo hi.
Un o Abram anas kowa pale, hoi tchoredo was, ninna peskro phraleskro tchawes, o Lot. Un leskro koowa anas job pale, ninna i tsele djuwjen un i tsele menshen.

Jaake das o Abram o baro rajes Kedor-Laomer un kol bare rajen, kai pash leste his. Koi pal djas o Abram khere. Ap o drom khere an i tala Shawe was o rai pral o foro Sodom pash leste. Koi tala kharella ninna Rajeskri tala.
Un o Melchisedek, ko rai pral o foro Salem, anas lenge maro un mool dran o foro. Job his i rashai ko Deblestar, kai hi o Dewel pral halauter.
Un job sharas o Abrames un penas: “Tu, Abram, ap tute hi tchiddo i soor un i bacht ko Deblestar, kai hi o Dewel pral halauter un kras o bolepen un i phub.
Un sharedo well o Dewel pral halauter, kai das kolen an tire wasta, kai tuha kuran pen.” Un o Abram das les o deshto kotar halauterestar, hoi job pale anas.
Un o rai pral Sodom penas ap o Abram: “De man mire menshen pale! Ko wawar, hoi hatsal, rikreh nashte.”
Koi penas o Abram ap leste: “Me dau man sowel glan o baro Debleste, kai hi o Dewel pral halauter, un kras o bolepen un i phub:
Kek kotar thab, witar kek dori, hoi i kircha khetne pandella, lau tutar. Te peness tu gar, tu kral man brawelo.
Me rikrau tchi, kokres kowa, hoi i mursha chan. Un kol mursha, kai mantsa djan, o Aner, o Eshkol un o Mamre, kolla lenn pengro kotar peha.”
Koi pal mukas o baro Dewel o Abrames leskri gole te shunell un penas ap leste: “Ma traash, Abram! Me rikrau mire wasta pral tute. Un me hom tuke i baro brawlepen.”
Koi penas o Abram: “Miro rai, baro Dewel, hoi kameh man te dell? Man hi kek tchawe. Me te merau, lell halauter, hoi man hi, o Elijeser, ko well dran o foro Damaskus.
Man dal tu kek tchawen. Un miro pralstuno budepaskro lell pal mande halauter, hoi miro hi.”
Koi penas o baro Dewel ap o Abrameste: “Na-a, kowa lell gar, hoi tiro hi. Tu weh dad i tchawestar. Un tiro tchawo lell halauter, hoi tiro hi.”
Un o Dewel anas les win un penas: “Dik an o bolepen! Un dik i bolepangre momlia! Nai peneh tu, har bud kolla hi? Jaake bud menshe wenna tutar.”
Un o Abram patsas o baro Debles. Un doleske kras o Dewel les tchatcho glan peskre jaka.
Un o baro Dewel penas ap leste: “Me hom o baro Dewel, kai anom tut dran o foro Ur, hoi an o them Kaldea hi. Kau them, kai tu kanna hal, dau tut, te well kowa tiro them.”
Koi penas o Abram: “Miro rai, baro Dewel, har djinau me, te well kau them miro?”
Koi penas o Dewel ap leste: “An mange i terni grumni – triin bersh phuro, i busni – triin bersh phuro un i bakro – triin bersh phuro, i diwji tauba un i wawar tauba!”
Un job anas leske kol tsele viechen un tchinas len mashkral khetne. Un tchiwas jek kotar ap kai rig, ko wawar kotar ap koi rig. Kokres i tchirkle tchinas job gar an kotja.
Koi wan diwje tchirkle un mukan pen ap kol mule viechende te perell. Un o Abram tradas len krik.
Har o kham tele djas, sowas o Abram soreles dren. Un ap leste was bari daar. Un rati was trul leste.

Un o Dewel penas ap o Abrameste: “Tchatchepah, tu djiness: Tire menshe, kai tutar wenna, wenn wi-themarja an i them, kai gar lengro hi. Un i menshe an ko them djan soreles ap lende un krenn budepangre lendar. Un jon hunte budrenn lenge 400 (star-sheel) bersha.
Kolla, kai krenn lendar budepangre, lenn i phagi mandar. Koi pal djan tire menshe win baro brawlepah.
Un tuke penau me: ‘Te mereh, soweh bachtelo dren. An i mishto phurepen weh tu paskedo.’
Un pal star menshengro phurepen wenna tire menshe kate pale. Koi doosh kolendar, kai kanna kate djiwenn – kolla hi i Amorarja – hi kanna gar bares doha, te tradap len win.”
Un har o kham tele djas un rati was, dikas o Abram i bob, dran koleste i jagakro ducho pre djas. Un jag djas mank kol kotja mass.
Jaake das o baro Dewel o Abrameste ap ko diwes peskro lab, un penas: “Tire tchawen, kai tutar wenna, dau me kau them mank o lengsto pani o themestar Egiptia un o baro lengsto pani Eufrat.
Un kolla, kai an kau them khere hi, dau me an tiro wast: i Kenarja, i Kenasarja, i Kadmonarja,
i Hetarja, i Perisarja, i Refajarja,
i Amorarja un i Kanaanitarja, i Girgasharja un i Jebusarja.”
O Abrameskri romni, i Sarai, anas leske kek tchawen ap i phub. Pash late budras i budepaskretsa dran o them Egiptia. Lakro lab his Hagar.
Un i Sarai penas ap o Abrameste: “Tu dikeh, o baro Dewel das man kek tchawe. Le miri budepaskretsa, un dja lah khetne! Jaake nai well man latar i tchawo.” Un o Abram shunas ap peskri romjate.

Un o Abrameskri romni, i Sarai, las peskri budepaskretsa, i Hagar, kai dran o them Egiptia his, un das lat peskro romes Abram, te well li leskri romni. An ko tsiro djiwas o Abram deesh bersha an o them Kanaan.
Un o Abram djas lah khetne. Un i Hagar was lestar an wawar koowa. Har i Hagar haiwas, kai well li dai, molas lakri rani an lakre jaka tchi buder.

Koi penas i Sarai ap o Abram: “Kai bibacht, hoi man hi, hi tiri doosh. Me dom tut miri budepaskretsa, te well li tiri romni. Kanna, kai joi haiwella, kai well li dai, hom me buder tchi moldo an lakre jaka. O baro Dewel mu well miro tchatchepaskro rai.”
Koi penas o Abram ap i Sarai: “Tiri budepaskretsa hi an tiro wast. Kre tu lah, hoi an tire jaka mishto hi!” Un i Sarai his tchilatcho ap late. Un i Hagar nashas peske latar.
Un o baro Debleskro bolepaskro hatsas lat pash i pani, hoi wella dran i phub. Ko pani his an o mulo tato them pash o drom, hoi djala an Shur.
Un o bolepaskro putchas latar: “Hagar, tu i Sarajakri budepaskretsa, kai weh tu un kai djah tu?” Penas joi: “Me nashom mange miri ranjatar Sarai.”
Penas o bolepaskro ap late: “Dja pale pash tiri rani! Un shun ap late!”
Palle penas o baro Debleskro bolepaskro ap late: “Me kamau tire tchawen, kai pal tute wenna, jaake bud te krell, kai nai djinell kek mensho, har bud jon hi.
Tu hal an wawar koowa. Tu leh i mursh tchawo. Koles dess tu o lab Ismael. O baro Dewel shunas, har dal gole i bibachtjatar.
Tiro tchawo wella i mensho har i diwji burika. Job kurell pes hakeneha. Un hakeno kurell pes leha. Job lell peske i kotar them gar dur peskre phralendar, te choirell lo len.”
Koi putchas i Hagar pestar: “Dikom me tchatchepah o Debles, kai man dikell?” Un joi das o baro Debles, kai lah rakras, ko lab ‘Tu hal i Dewel, kai man dikell’.
Doleske kharell ko pani, kai joi his Beer-Lachai-Roi. Kowa hi tchiddo mank kol forja Kadesh un Bered.
Un i Hagar anas o Abrameske i tchawes ap i phub. Un o Abram das peskro tchawes o lab Ismael.
Har o Ismael boldo was, his o Abram 86 (ochta-deesh-te-shob) bersha phuro.
O Abram his 99 (enja-deesh-te-enja) bersh phuro. Koi mukas pes o baro Dewel glan leste te dikell, un penas ap leste: “Me hom o sorelo Dewel. Dja ap miro drom, te hatsap kek tchilatchepen ap tute!
Me kamau tuha win te krell, te wap tiro Dewel, un tu un tire menshe wenn mire menshe. Un me dau tut bud bud tchawe, kai pal tute wenna.”
Koi mukas pes o Abram ap i phub te perell. Un o Dewel rakras leha un penas:
“Shun, kowa hi, hoi me tuke krau: Tu weh o dad bud menshendar. Jon wenn jaake bud, kai lendar bud natsjone wenna.
Doleske kharess tu buder gar ‘Abram’. Kanna well tiro lab ‘Abraham’. Me krau te wess o dad bud natsjonendar.
Me dau tut jaake bud tchawen, kai pal tute wenna, te wenn lendar natsjone. Ninna bare raja wenna tutar.
Kowa, hoi me tuha win krau, atchell hako tsiro mange un tuke, tire tchawenge, kolengre tchawenge un lauterenge, kai pal tute wenna. Me hom tiro Dewel un ko Dewel tire tchawendar, kai pal tute wenna.
Un me dau tut un tire tchawen kau them, kai tu kanna i wi-themari hal. Kau tselo them Kanaan well lengro hako tsiro. Un me hom lengro Dewel.”
Un o Dewel penas pale ap o Abrahameste: “Tu un tire tchawe un kolengre tchawe un lauter, kai pal tute wenna, tumer hunte krenn tumaro kotar kolestar, hoi mer win kram.
Kawa hunte krenn tumer, tu un tire tchawe, kai pal tute wenna: Tchinenn hake murshen pash tumende ap lengro mass.
Kowa hi o sikepen, kai han mire menshe.

Hako mursh tchawo pash tumende hunte well tchinlo, te hi job ochta diwessa phuro. Krenn kowa ninna i tsele mursh tchawentsa, kai pal tumende wenna! Tchinenn ninna i mursh tchawen tumare budepangrendar: kolla, kai pash tumende boldo wan, un kolla, kai ginan wawarendar, kai gar tumare menshendar hi.
Tchinlo hunte well hako budepaskro, kai pash tumende boldo was un tumendar ginlo was. Ap tumaro mass dikenn tumer, kai han mire menshe. Kau koowa atchell jaake hako tsiro.
Hako mursh, kai gar tchinlo hi ap peskro mass, kowa hunte atchell buder gar djido mashkral peskre menshende. Job rikras pes gar ap kowa, hoi mer win kram.”
Un o Dewel penas pale ap o Abrahameste: “Tu peness buder gar Sarai ap tiri romjate. Lakro lab well kanna Sara.

Un me tchiwau miri soor un miri bacht ap late. Un ninna latar dau tut i tchawes. Awa, me tchiwau miri soor ap late. Joi well i dai bud menshendar. Latar wenna jaake bud menshe, kai lendar natsjone wenna. Ninna bare raja pral bud menshende wenna latar.”
Koi mukas pes o Abraham ap i phub te perell, sanas un penas peske: “Me hom sheel bersh phuro. Un man te well i tchawo? Un i Sara hi enja-deesh bersh phuro. Joi te lell i ternepen?”
Un o Abraham penas ap o Debleste: “Ach, muk kowa, hoi tu mange penal, ap o Ismael te well!”
“Na-a”, penas o Dewel, “tiri romni, i Sara, anell tuke i tchawes ap i phub. Koles dess tu o lab Isaak. Koleske un leskre tchawenge atchell kowa, hoi me tuha win krom hako tsireske.

Ninna, hoi tu mandar mangal tiro tchaweske Ismael, kamau me te krell. Shun, me tchiwau miri soor un miri bacht ap leste. Un me dau les bud tchawen, te wenn lestar bud bud menshe. Job well o dad deesh-te-dui rajendar un lestar well i bari natsjona.
Kokres ko koowa, hoi me tuha win krom, te wap tumaro Dewel un te wenn tumer mire menshe, kowa djal dureder ap o Isaak. Koles leh tu tiri romjatar Sara ko wawar bersh an kau tsiro.”
Un o Dewel heras pre, te rakrell lo o Abrahameha un djas peske.

Un o Abraham las peskro tchawes Ismael un kol murshen, kai pash leste boldo wan un kolen, kai job i wawarendar ginas. Un tchinas len ap lengro mass. Ap kau diwes tchinas job i tsele murshen an peskro kheer, jaake har o Dewel leske penas.
Har o Abraham ap peskro mass tchinlo was, his lo 99 (enja-deesh-te-enja) bersha phuro.
Un leskro tchawo Ismael his 13 (deesh-te-triin) bersh phuro, har job ap peskro mass tchinlo was.
Jaake wan o Abraham un peskro tchawo Ismael ap kau diwes tchinlo.
Un i tsele mursha an leskro kheer, kai pash leste boldo wan, ninna kolla, kai i wawarendar ginlo wan, wan lentsa tchinlo.
Un o baro Dewel mukas pes te dikell o Abrahamestar pash kol bare ruka ‘Mamre’, har o diwes tato his un o Abraham glan peskro plachteno kheer beshdo his.
Ap jek kopo dikas job triin murshen. Kolla his i kotar glan leste tardo. Har job len dikas, stas lo pre, nashas pash lende un mukas pes glan lende ap i phub te perell.
Un penas: “Miro rai! Te hal tu mange latcho, dja mandar gar dureder! Me mangau tut: Atch kai!
Tumenge well pani anlo, te thowenn tumare herja. Un beshenn tumen tel ko ruk!
Me lau tumenge maro, te wenn pale soreles. Pal kowa nashte djan dureder, har tumer kamenna. Jaake wan gar tchitcheske pash mande.” Un jon penan: “Kre jaake, har tu penal!”
Koi nashas o Abraham sik an o plachteno kheer pash i Sara un penas: “Le sik triin khore parno jarro un kre merklia!”
Un job nashas pash i grumjende, un rodas peske i latchi terni grumni win. Un das lat o budepaskreste, te krell job sik i latcho chapen.
Un o Abraham las latcho khil, thud un ko mass. Un tchiwas lauter glan lende tel ko ruk. Un job atchas glan lende tardo, har jon chan.
Koi putchan jon lestar: “Kai hi tiri romni Sara?” “Kote an o plachteno kheer”, penas job.

Koi penas jek kol trinendar ap leste: “Tchatchepah, wawar bersh an kau tsiro wau me pale pash tute. Koi hi tiri romjat, i Sara, i tchawo.” Un i Sara his tardo pal leste, pal o wudar ko plachteno kherestar, un shunas lengro rakepen.
O Abraham un i Sara his hake dui phuro. Un i Sara djinas, kai nai lell li buder kek tchawe.
Koi sanas joi peske un penas: “Kanna hom me phuro. Un miro rai, miro rom, hi ninna phuro! Har nai lau me i ternepen?”
Koi penas o baro Dewel ap o Abrahameste: “Hoske sanas i Sara un penas: ‘Kanna, kai phuro hom, lau me i ternepen?’
Dell tchi, hoi o baro Dewel gar haiwella. Wawar bersh an kau tsiro, wau me pale pash tute. Koi hi lat i tchawo.”
Koi las i Sara daar un das buchoste un penas: “Me som gar!” “Na-a, tu sal”, penas o Dewel.
Un i mursha stan pre un djan penge. Un o Abraham djas i kotar lentsa. Un jon dikan ap ko them, kai o foro Sodom tardo hi.
Koi penas o baro Dewel peske: “Penap me o Abrahameske gar, hoi me kamau te krell? Na-a!
Me dom les miro lab: Job well o dad jaake bud menshendar, te well lendar i bari un soreli natsjona. Un koi bacht, hoi dau leste, djal dureder ap i tsele natsjone, kai ap i phub hi.

Me rodom les mange win, te penell lo peskre tchawenge un kolenge, kai pal leste wenna, te rikrenn pen le ap miro drom un krenn, hoi mishto un tchatcho hi, te nai mukap me halauter ap o Abrahameste te well, hoi me leske penom.”
Un o baro Dewel penas: “Bud djungelo koowa was pral i forja Sodom un Gomorra rakedo, kai jon an baro tchilatchepen djiwenna.
Doleske kamau me tele te djal, te dikap: Hi kowa ninna tchatcho, hoi rakedo was? Un te hi wawartchandes, kamau kowa ninna te djinell.”
Un kol dui mursha rissran pen trujel un djan an o foro Sodom. O baro Dewel atchas glan o Abrahameste tardo.
Un o Abraham djas pash leste un penas: “Kameh tu tchatchepah lauteren temerl dell, kolen, kai kek tchilatchepen kran – khetne kolentsa, kai tchilatcho hi?

Te hi an ko foro 50 (paash-sheel) menshe, kai krenn, hoi mishto un tchatcho hi, kameh tu kolen ninna te marell? Te hatseh kote 50 (paash-sheel) menshen, kai kek tchilatchepen kran, de o fores kek phagi!

Ko nashte kreh tu gar, te dess kolen temerl, kai kek tchilatchepen kran – khetne kolentsa, kai tchilatcho hi. Jaake te djal koleske, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi, har koleske, kai tchilatcho hi. Tu hal o tchatchepaskro rai pral i tseli phub. Kameh tu tchomone te krell, hoi gar mishto un tchatcho hi?”
Koi penas o baro Dewel: “Te hatsau me 50 (paash-sheel) menshen an o foro Sodom, kai krenna, hoi mishto un tchatcho hi, dau o tselo fores kek phagi.”
Penas o Abraham: “Shun, miro rai, me lom man khetne, te rakrap tuha, kai me tchik un tchi moldo hom.

Hoi kameh te krell, te hi pantch kol 50 (paash-sheel) menshendar gar an o tchatchepen tardo? Kameh dran kol pantchende ko tselo foro te marell?” Koi penas job: “Te hatsau me 45 (star-deesh-te-pantch) menshen kote, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi, kamau ko foro tchi te krell.”

Un o Abraham rakras pale leha un penas: “Te hatseh lendar kote 40 (star-deesh), hoi kameh te krell?” Penas o Dewel: “Te hi kote 40 (star-deesh) menshe, kai krenna, hoi mishto un tchatcho hi, kamau ko foro tchi te krell.”
Un o Abraham penas: “Miro rai, ab gar chojedo, te rakrau pale tuha. Hoi, te hatseh kote 30 (trijanda)?” Penas job: “Te hatsau 30 (trijanda), kamau ko foro tchi te krell.”
Koi penas o Abraham: “Shun miro rai, me lom man khetne, te rakrap pale tuha. Hoi, te hatseh kote 20 (biish)?” Penas job: “Te hi kote 20 (biish), kamau ko foro tchi te krell.”
Koi penas o Abraham: “Miro rai, me mangau tut, ab gar chojedo! Me kamau gomme jek kopo tuha te rakrell. Hoi, te hatseh kote deesh?” Penas job: “Te hi kote deesh, kamau ko foro tchi te krell.”
Un o baro Dewel heras pre, te rakrell lo o Abrahameha un djas peske. Un o Abraham djas pale khere.
Har i rati was, wan i dui bolepangre an o foro Sodom. Koi his o Lot an o baro wudar ko forestar beshdo. Har o Lot len dikas, stas lo pre, djas pash lende un mukas pes glan lende ap i phub te perell.

Un penas: “Mire raja, awenn an miro kheer! Me mangau tumen, atchenn i rati pash mande! Thowenn tumare herja! Un djan taissarlakro tumaro drom!” “Na-a”, penan le, “mer kamah i tseli rati win te atchell.”
Job mukas gar tele, te mangell lo len, bis te djan jon leha an leskro kheer. Un job kras lenge i chapen un pekas lenge maro, kai kek shutlo jarro dren hi. Un jon chan.
Har jon kaman pen tele te tchiwell, wan i mursha o forestar Sodom pash o Loteskro kheer khetne. I tsele mursha dran o foro, kol terne un kol phure his tardo trul ko kheer,
un dan pal o Lot gole un putchan lestar: “Kai hi kol mursha, kai i rati pash tute wan? De len mende, te kras dinelo koowa lentsa!”
Koi djas o Lot win pash lende glan o wudar. Un kras o wudar pal peste pandlo.
Un penas: “Kamle mala, ma krenn lentsa sawo djungelo koowa!
Dikenn, man hi dui tcha. Kol wan kek murshestar an-tapedo. Kolen anau tumenge win. Krenn lentsa, hoi tumer kamenna! Me mangau tumen, ma taprenn kal murshen an, kai pash mande an miro kheer wan!”

Jon dan gole: “Dja tuke! Tu hal i wi-themari un kameh tut rai pral mende te krell. Kanna shun, mer kamah tuha djungleder koowa te krell har kolentsa, kai pash tute an o kheer hi.” Un jon djan ap o Lot pengri tseli sorjah, un kaman o wudar pre te phagell.
Koi tserdan kol dui mursha o Lotes pash pende an o kheer dren, un pandan o wudar tele.
Palle kran le, te wenn kol tsele mursha korelo, kai glan o kheer tardo hi. Lauter, tikne un bare, dikan buder tchi. Jaake nashte hatsan jon buder gar o wudar.
Kol dui mursha, kai pash o Lot an o kheer his, putchan lestar: “Hi tut kate an kau foro gomme jek tire menshendar: i tchakro rom, mursh tchawe un tcha, wawar menshe? An len sik win dran ko foro!
Bud djungelo koowa was glan o baro Debleskre kanda, hoi i menshe an kau foro kran. Doleske bitchras men o baro Dewel, te kras kau foro paash.”

Koi djas o Lot win, un penas ap kol murshende, kai romedinerenn leskre tchen: “Stenn pre! Djan sik dran kau foro! O baro Dewel kamell lauteren an kau foro temerl dell!” An lengre jaka his job har jek, kai rakrell narwelo koowa.

Sik taissarlakro penan i bolepangre ap o Lot: “Kre sik! Ste pre, le tiri romjat un tire dui tchen, kai pash tute hi! Un dja dran kau foro, te wess tu gar maredo, te lenn i menshe an kau foro pengri phagi.”
O Lot las peske bud tsiro. Koi tapran kol mursha les, leskri romjat un leskre dui tchen pash o wast un anan len win dran o foro. O baro Dewel kamas gar, te merenn le.
Har jon glan o foro his, penas ko jek bolepaskro ap o Lot: “Naash, te atchess tu djido! Ma dik pal tute! Ma atch tardo kate an kau them pash o pani Jordan! Naash ap kol berge, te wess tu gar maredo!”
“Ach, na-a, miro Rai”, penas o Lot.
“Tu sikral, kai hal mange latcho. Un tiro kamlepen hi bares mange, te mukeh man te djiwell. Kol berge hi dur. Me nashte nashau gar kote. Koi bibacht nai lell man palla, te merap me.
Dik! Koi hi i foro gar dur. Koi nashau me, te atchap djido. Ko hi i tikno foro.”
“Mishto”, penas job ap o Loteste. “Me shunau ap tute an ko koowa. Me dau i menshen an ko foro gar mulo.
Kanna naash sik kote! Me nashte krau tchi, bis te tu an ko foro hal.” Dran kowa hi o lab ko forestar Zoar.
Har o Lot an o foro Zoar was, djas o kham pral i phub pre.
Koi mukas o baro Dewel jag un jagakri khand pral i forja Sodom un Gomorra te perell dran o bolepen.
Jaake chatchras job kol forja un ko tselo them pash o pani Jordan. I tsele menshe an kol forja un o tselo senlepen ap ko them was chatchedo.
Un o Loteskri romni dikas pal peste. Dran late was i loneskro bar.
Taissarlakro stas o Abraham pre un djas kote, kai job o wawar diwes pash o baro Debleste tardo his.
Un o Abraham dikas tele ap kol forja Sodom un Gomorra un pral ko tselo them pash o pani Jordan, un dikas i bari jagakro ducho pre te djal har dran i baro bob.
Har o Dewel chatchras kol forja an ko them pash o pani Jordan, kai o Lot khere his, bistras job o Abrahames gar un anas o Lotes win dran kol forja.
O Lot trashas, te atchell lo an o foro Zoar. Doleske djas job peskre dui tchentsa dran ko foro an i berge. Un job djiwas peskre dui tchentsa an i grotta.
His i diwes, koi penas koi phureder tchai ap koi terneder tchate: “Maro dad hi phuro. Un kek mursha hi buder an kau them, te romedinerenn men, jaake har i tsele menshe krenna.
Djineh hoi? Mer dah maro dadeste mool te pijell, un tchiwah men pash leste, te well men tchawe lestar, te meras gar win.”

Un an koi rati dan le pengro dadeste mool te pijell. Un i phureder tchai djas pash lakro dadeste un tchiwas pes pash leste. Job haiwas gar, har joi pes pash leste tchiwas, witar gar, har joi lestar pre stas.

Un o wawar diwes, koi penas i phureder tchai ap o terneder tchate: “Shun, me tchiwom man taissar rati pash miro dadeste. Kai rati dah les pale mool te pijell. Koi tchiweh tut tu pash leste, te well men tchawe maro dadestar, te meras gar win.”
Koi dan jon rati pengro dades mool te pijell. Un i terneder tchai djas un tchiwas pes pash leste. Ninna kau kopo haiwas job gar, har joi pes pash leste tchiwas, witar gar, har joi lestar pre stas.
Koi wan kol dui pengro dadestar Lot an wawar koowa.
Un i phureder tchai anas i tchawes ap i phub. Koles das joi ko lab Moab. Kolestar wenna kol menshe, kai hi kau diwes i Moabarja.
Un i terneder tchai anas ninna i tchawes ap i phub. Koles das joi ko lab Ben-Ammi. Kolestar wenna kol menshe, kai hi kau diwes i Ammonarja.
Un o Abraham djas dureder un was an o them Negev. Job atchas mank kol dui forja Kadesh un Shur un djiwas an o foro Gerar.
Kote penas job peskri romjatar Sara: “Joi hi miri pheen.” Un o baro rai pral o foro Gerar – leskro lab his Abimelech – bitchras murshen, te anenn le i Sara pash leste.
An i rati was o Dewel an i suni pash o Abimelech un penas ap leste: “Tu hunte meress. Koi djuwel, kai tu lal, hi romedino.”
O Abimelech tapras lat gar an un penas: “Miro rai, kameh tu tchatchepah kolen te marell, kai kek tchilatchepen kran?
O Abraham penas ap mande: ‘Joi hi miri pheen.’ Un joi penas ninna: ‘Job hi miro phraal.’ Me djinom gar, kai joi romedino hi. Miro dji un mire wasta hi djudjo.”
Koi penas o Dewel ap leste an i suni: “Me djinau, kai djinal kowa gar. Me rikrom tut pale, te kress kek tchilatchepen glan mire jaka, un mukom gar, te tapress lat an.
Un kanna, de koi romjat pale o romeste! Job hi i Debleskro rakepaskro. Un te mangell o Abraham tuke, atcheh tu djido. Te deh lat gar pale, hunte meress un lauter, hoi tiro hi.”
Taissarlakro stas o Abimelech pre, das peskre tsele murshen khetne gole, un penas lenge kol tsele laba, te shunenn le kowa lauter. Koi lan kol mursha bari traash.

Un o Abimelech kharas o Abrahames, te well lo pash leste un penas: “Hoi kral tu mentsa? Un hoi krom me tut, kai tu anal bari doosh ap mande un ap miro tselo them! Tu kral tchomone, hoi hunte krals tu gar!
Pen mange, hoske kral tu kowa?”
O Abraham penas: “Me patsom, kai an kau foro kek menshe hi, kai patsenn o djijestar ap o Debleste un krenn, hoi o Dewel kamell. Darom, kai jon man mulo denna, te lenn le miri romjat.
Tchatchepah hi li miri pheen: i tchai miro dadestar. Lat hi i wawar dai har man. Jaake nai was joi miri romni.

An ko tsiro, har o Dewel mange penas, te djap dran miro dadeskro kheer an i dur them, penom me ap late: ‘Jaake nashte sikreh mande, kai kameh man: Kote, kai mer wah, hunte peness tu, kai me tiro phraal hom.’”
Koi las o Abimelech bakre, grumja un budepangre: mursha un djuwja. Un das len o Abrahameste. Un das les ninna leskri romjat, i Sara, pale.
Un o Abimelech penas: “Miro tselo them hi glan tute tchiddo. Atch kote, kai tu kameh!”
Un ap i Sara penas job: “Shun, me dom tiro phrales 1.000 (jek sero) rupene beme. Kol lowe sikrenn kolende, kai pash tute hi, kai tu hunte ladjess gar. Jaake hal tu tchatcho glan i menshengre jaka.”

Har o Abimelech o Abrahameskri romjat las, kras o baro Dewel, kai kek djuwel an o Abimelecheskro kheer i ternepen lella. Un kanna mangas o Abraham o Debles lenge. Un o Dewel kras o Abimeleches sasto un leskri romjat un i djuwjen, kai leske budran, jaake, te lan le pale tchawe.
Un o baro Dewel bistras i Sara gar. Un job rikras peskro lab.
Un i Sara was an wawar koowa. Un joi anas o Abrahameske an leskro phurepen i tchawes ap i phub, an ko tsiro, har o Dewel lenge penas.
Un o Abraham das peskro tchawes, kai i Saratar boldo was, ko lab Isaak.
Ap o ochtato diwes tchinas job peskro tchawes Isaak, jaake har o Dewel leske penas.
O Abraham his sheel bersh phuro, har peskro tchawo Isaak boldo was.
Un i Sara penas: “O Dewel das man i sapen. Hakeno, kai shunella, hoi mange djas, sal mantsa.
Koon penals ap o Abrahameste, te dell i Sara i ternepen i betch te pijell? Un me anom leske an leskro phurepen i tchawes ap i phub.”
Un ko tchawo was bareder un pijas buder gar ap i betch. Ap ko diwes, har job buder gar ap i betch pijas, kras o Abraham i baro chapen.
Un o Abrahameskro tchawo Ismael, koleskri dai i Hagar dran o them Egiptia his, kowa sanas pral o Isaak. Un i Sara dikas kowa.
Koi penas joi ap o Abrahameste: “Trade kol budepaskretsa peskro tchaweha krik, te lell lakro tchawo pal maro merepen tchi kolestar, hoi maro hi. Te lell o Isaak kokres halauter.”
Ko rakepen his gar mishto an o Abrahameskre jaka. O Ismael his ninna leskro tchawo.

Koi penas o Dewel ap o Abraham: “Ab gar chojedo pral kowa, hoi i Sara pral tiro tchaweste Ismael un leskri dai penas. Shun ap late un kre halauter, hoi joi tuke penell. O Isaak well o dad kol tchawendar, kolendar me tuke penom, te dap len tut.
Ko tchawo, koleskri dai i budepaskretsa hi, kowa well ninna o dad jaake bud menshendar, te wenn lendar i natsjona. Kowa krau doleske, kai job tiro tchawo hi.”

Sik taissarlakro stas o Abraham pre, las maro un i gono pherdo pani un tchiwas kowa i Hagar ap o phiko, das late ninna o tchawes, un bitchras len pestar krik. Koi djas joi peske un nashas trujel an o mulo tato them pash o foro Beersheba.
Har len kek pani buder his, tchiwras joi kol tchawes tel i burra.
Un beshas pes i tselo kotar lestar. Joi penas peske: “Me nashte dikau kowa gar, har miro tchawo merella.” Har joi kote beshdo his, rowas joi soreles.

Un o Dewel shunas ko tchaweskri gole. Un o Debleskro bolepaskro das i Hagar gole dran o bolepen un penas ap late: “Hoi hi tut, Hagar? Ma traash! O Dewel shunas ko tchaweskri gole, kote kai job tchiddo hi.
Dja pash tiro tchaweste un hade les pre! Un le les ap o wast. Me kamau te well job o dad bud menshendar, te wenn lendar i natsjona.”
Un o Dewel kras lake i jaka pre. Un joi dikas i tikno pani, djas kote, kras ko gono pherdo pani, un das kol tchawes te pijell.
Un o Dewel his kol tchaweha. Un job was baro un djiwas an o mulo tato them, un was i mursh, kai haiwas mishto karje te dell i bogeha.
Un job djiwas an ko mulo tato them, hoi kharella ‘Paran’. Un leskri dai las leske i romni dran o them Egiptia.
An ko tsiro was o Abimelech peskro pralstuno lurdeha Pichol pash o Abrahameste un penas ap leste: “O Dewel hi tuha an halauter, hoi tu kreh.
Kanna de tut sowel ap o Debleste, te chochess man gar, witar gar mire tchawen un kolengre tchawen. Me homs tuke latcho. Ab tu ninna latcho ap mande un ap ko them, kai tu djiweh.”
Penas o Abraham: “Me dau man sowel koi pre.
Tumendar kamau te djinell, hoske tire budepangre mari brunna krik lan.”
Koi penas o Abimelech: “Me djinau gar, koon kowa kras. Mange was tchi penlo, gar tutar, witar gar i wawarendar. Kau diwes shunau kowa o ersto kopo.”
Koi las o Abraham bakre un grumja, un das len o Abimeleches. Un jon dan pengro wast koi pre, kai kek o wawares chochella.
Un o Abraham rodas efta terne bakre win, un tchiwas len ap i rig.
Koi putchas o Abimelech: “Hoi kreh tu kol efta terne bakrentsa, kai tchiwal ap i rig?”
O Abraham penas: “Kol efta terne bakre less tu mandar. Jaake sikreh, kai me koi brunna krom, un koja miro hi.”
Dran kowa kharella koi platsa, kai dan pen kol dui sowel, Beersheba.
Jaake dan le pengro wast koi pre an Beersheba, kai kek o wawares chochella. Pal kowa djas o Abimelech un peskro pralstuno lurdo Pichol pale an ko them, kai i Filistarja djiwenna.
O Abraham tchiwas i ruk an i phub an Beersheba. Un kote mangas job o baro Debles an, ko Debles, kai hako tsiro koi hi.
Un o Abraham atchas i rah tsiro an o them Filistia.
Pal kau koowa kamas o Dewel te dikell, te shunell o Abraham ap leste o tselo djijeha, un penas ap leste: “Abraham!” Un job penas: “Kate hom.”
Penas o Dewel: “Le tiro jek tchawes, koles, kai tu o djijestar kameh, o Isaakes. Un dja leha an ko them Morija ap koi berga, hoi me tuke penau! Un mare un chatch les mange kote!”
Koi stas o Abraham sik taissarlakro pre, kras kasht tikno chatchepaske, tchiwas ko kasht ap peskri burika un las dui budepangre un peskro tchawes Isaak peha, un djas kote, kai o Dewel leske penas.
Ap o triinto diwes dikas o Abraham koi platsa dur glan peste.
Un penas ap peskre budepangre: “Atchenn koi burikah kai! Me un miro tchawo djah ap koi berga, te mangas o Debles an. Pal kowa wah mer pale.”
O Abraham las ko kasht chatchepaske, un das ko kasht peskro tchaweste te hidjrell. Job kokres las i jag un i tchuri. Jaake djan jon dui khetne dureder.
Koi penas o Isaak ap peskro dadeste: “Tata!” “Hoi kameh tu, miro tchawo?” putchas o Abraham. Penas o Isaak: “Men hi jag un kasht! Kai hi ko bakro, te chatchras les o Debleske?”
Koi penas o Abraham leske: “O Dewel della o bakres, te chatchras les leske, miro tchawo.” Un jon dui djan khetne dureder.
Jaake wan le ap koi platsa, hoi o Dewel leske penas. Kote kras o Abraham i chatchepaskri o Debleske, tchiwas ko kasht koi pre, las peskro tchawes, pandas les un tchiwas les ap ko kasht pral pre.
Un las ko tchuri, te marell lo o tchawes.
Koi das o baro Debleskro bolepaskro dran o bolepen gole: “Abraham, Abraham!” Penas job: “Kate hom!”
Penas o bolepaskro: “Tape kol tchawes gar an! Un kre les tchi! Kanna djinau me, kai shuneh o tselo djijeha ap o Debleste un kreh, hoi job penell. Tu rikral tiro jek tchawes mandar gar pale.”

Koi dikas pes o Abraham trujel. Pal leste hi i bakro mank i burra. Leskre shinga hi an kal burra un job nai was gar win. O Abraham djas koi, las ko bakro, maras les un chatchras les o Debleske, gar peskro tchawes.
O Abraham das koi platsa ko lab ‘O baro Dewel dikella’. Jaake well bis kai diwes penlo: ‘Ap koi berga, kai o baro Dewel dikella’.
Un o baro Debleskro bolepaskro das i duito kopo ap o Abrahameste gole dran o bolepen

un penas: “O baro Dewel penell: Tu kamal tiro jek tchawes mange te marell. Kowa kamal tu mange te krell. Doleske dau man ap mande sowel, te tchiwap miri soor un miri bacht ap tute. Un tutar wenna bud bud menshe. Jon wenn jaake bud har bolepangre momlia ap o bolepen hi, un har i santa pash o baro pani. Un tire tchawe, kai pal tute wenna, wenna rai pral kolende, kai kurenn pen lentsa un lenn kolengre forja krik.
Tu kral, hoi me tuke penom. Doleske djal koi bacht, hoi dau tire menshende, dureder ap i tsele natsjone, kai ap i phub hi.”
Pal kowa djas o Abraham pale pash peskre budepangre. Un khetne djan le an Beersheba. Un o Abraham atchas koi.
Pal kowa was o Abrahameske penlo: “I Milka, koi romni tiro phralestar Nahor, anas leske ninna mursh tchawen ap i phub:
O phureder kharell Uz, o duito hi o Bus, un o triinto hi o Kemuel, kolestar i Aramarja wenna.
Koi pal well o Kesed, o Haso, o Pildash, o Jidlaf un o Betuel.”
O Betuel hi o dad i tchatar Rebekka. Kolla ochta hi i mursh tchawe, kolen o Abrahameskro phraal Nahor peskri romjatar Milka las.
Un les his ninna i wawar romni. Lakro lab his Rehuma. Koja las ninna tchawe. Kolengre laba hi: Tebach, Gaham, Tahash un Maacha.
Un i Sara was 127 (sheel-biish-te-efta) bersh phuro.
Un joi meras an o foro Kirjat-Arba. Kowa hi kanna Hebron an o them Kanaan. Un o Abraham was pash late, rowas un das i djijestar gole pral lakro merepen.
Pal kowa stas o Abraham peskri muli romjatar pre, un djas pash i Hetarja, te rakrell lo lentsa.
Un job penas ap lende: “Me hom mank tumende i wi-themari. Man hi kek kotar them pash tumende. Kanna mangau tumen: Denn man i kotar them pash tumende, te paskrap miri muli romjat.”
I Hetarja penan ap o Abrahameste:
“Shun ap mende, maro rai: Tu hal i Debleskro mursh mashkral mende. Paske tiri muli romjat an o feteder mulengro kheer, hoi men hi. Hakeno mendar dals tut i kotar them, te paskress tiri romjat koi.”
Koi stas o Abraham pre un parkras pes pash lende.
Un job penas ap lende: “Te kamenn tumer, te paskrap miri muli romjat kai, palle mangau tumen: Rakrenn o mursheha Efron, – leskro dad hi o Zohar –

un mangenn les, te dell lo man leskri grotta, hoi kharella Machpela. Koi grotta hi ap i palstuni rig ap leskro kotar them tchiddo. Me kamau te plaissrell, hoi koi grotta moldo hi, te lap i mulengro kheer pash tumende.”
O Hetari Efron his mank peskre menshende beshdo. Un job penas ap o Abrahameste glan kolende, kai pashel his, glan hakeneste, kai an o baro wudar o forestar his:
“Na-a, miro rai, shun, hoi me penau: Tu hunte plaissress mange tchi. Me dau tut ko kotar them un koi grotta. Glan mire menshende dau tut kowa, te paskress tiri muli romjat.”
Koi parkras pes o Abraham pash kol menshende,
un penas ap o Efron glan lauterende: “Mangau tut, te shuness ap mande: Me plaissrau, hoi ko kotar them moldo hi. Le mandar kal lowe! Jaake nashte paskrau miri muli romjat.”
Penas o Efron ap o Abrahameste:
“Miro rai, shun ap mande! Hoi hi i kotar them mange un tuke, hoi molella star-sheel rupene beme? Kowa hi tchi! Paske tiri romjat kote!”
Un o Abraham das o Efrones kol lowe, hoi jon glan i Hetarja win kran: star-sheel rupene beme. Jek bema his jaake pharo har jek bema pash i parepangre pharo his.
Jaake las o Abraham o Efroneskro kotar them, kai pash Machpela glan Mamre tchiddo hi: ko kotar them un koi grotta un kol ruka, kai kote tardo his.
Un kol Hetarja, kai an o wudar o forestar his, his pashel, har o Abraham lauter ginas.
Pal kowa paskras o Abraham peskri romjat, i Sara, an koi grotta pash Machpela wergel Mamre. Kowa hi kanna o foro Hebron an o them Kanaan.
Jaake bikran i Hetarja ko kotar them un koi grotta o Abrahameske, te well kote i mulengro kheer peskri familjake.
O Abraham his phuro. Un o baro Debleskri soor un bacht his tchiddo ap halauter, hoi les his.
Koi penas o Abraham ap peskro pralstuno budepaskro, kai das garda ap halauter, hoi o Abrahames his: “De tiro wast koi pre,
un de tut sowel ap o baro Debleste, ap o Debleste pral o bolepen un i phub, te less miro tchaweske kek romjat, kai well kate dran o them Kanaan.
Dja an miro dadeskro them, pash mire menshende! Kolengre tchendar le miro tchaweske Isaak i romjat!”
Penas o budepaskro ap leste: “Un hoi krap me, te kamell koi djuwel gar mantsa an kau them te djal? Lap tiro tchawes pale an ko them, kai tu win djal?”
Koi penas o Abraham: “De tut garda! Ma an miro tchawes an ko them pale, kai me win djom!

O baro Dewel, o Dewel pral o bolepen, anas man win dran miro dadeskro kheer un miro dadeskro them, un rakras mantsa. Un das pes sowel, te dell lo mire tchawen kau them, kai kanna hom. Kowa bitchrell peskro bolepaskres glan tute, te less miro tchaweske i romjat mire menshendar.
Te kamell koi djuwel gar tuha te djal, well koi sowel tutar krik lino. An kek tsiro aness tu miro tchawes pale an ko them!”
