Koi das o budepaskro peskro wast koi pre un das pes sowel, te krell lo jaake, har leskro rai Abraham leske penas.
Pal kowa las o budepaskro deesh khamele un kutch koowa peskro rajestar peha, un djas an o them Mesopotamia an o foro, kai o Nahor djiwell.
Un job mukas i khamele tele te tchiwell pash o pani glan o foro. His an i rati, har i djuwja o pani lenna.
Un job penas: “Baro Dewel, o Dewel miro rajestar Abraham, de man kanna bacht ap miro drom! Un ab miro rajeske Abraham latcho!
Dik, me hom kate pash kau pani tardo. Un i tcha dran ko foro wenna, te lenn le pani.

Me te penau ap jekate: ‘De man dran tiro khoro te pijell!’ Un joi penella ap mande: ‘Pi!’ Un joi della ninna i khamelen te pijell, palle hi li koja, kai tu o Isaakeske wi-rodal. Ap kowa dikau me, kai hal miro rajeske latcho.”
Job rakras gar win, koi was i Rebekka un hidjras i khoro ap peskro phiko. Lakro dad his o Betuel. Koleskri dai his i Milka. Kolakro rom his o Nahor, kai o Abrahameskro phraal his.
Koi tchai his shukar. Un lat his kek mursh. Joi djas tele pash o pani, kras o khoro pherdo pani un was pale pre.
Koi nashas ko budepaskro pash late un penas ap late: “De man pani dran tiro khoro te pijell!”
“Pi, miro rai!” penas joi, un las sik o khoro tele an lakro wast, te pijell lo.
Har les kek trush buder his, penas joi: “Tire khamelenge kamau ninna pani te anell, jaake bud, te hi len buder kek trush.”
Un joi djas sik un tchoras ko pani dran lakro khoro an o viechengro tcharo. Un nashas bud kope un las i tsele khamelenge pani.
O mursh las lat an i jak un penas tchi. Job kamas te djinell, te das les o baro Dewel bacht ap leskro drom.
Har i khamele tchalo his, las job i sonakaskri gustri: shob gramme pharo, un dui sonakangre mussjengre gustria: 120 (sheel-te-biish) gramme pharo. Un das kowa late. Un job putchas latar:
“Koneskri tchai hal tu? Pen mange: Della an tiro dadeskro kheer i tchiben, te nai sowah pash tumende?”
Koi penas joi ap leste: “Miro dad hi o Betuel. Leskri dai hi i Milka un leskro dad hi o Nahor.
Men hi doha phuss un viechengro chapen. Ninna i tchiben, te nai sowenna pash mende.”
Koi parkras pes ko mursh pash o baro Debleste un witsras pes tele glan leste,

un penas: “Sharedo well o baro Dewel, o Dewel miro rajestar Abraham. Job rikras peskro latchepen un tchatchepen gar pale miro rajestar. O baro Dewel anas man ap o drom pash o kheer miro rajeskre menshendar.”
Koi nashas koi tchai an peskri dakro kheer un penas lenge kowa lauter.
I Rebekka, lat his i phraal, ko kharella Laban.
Har dikas o Laban i gustri un i mussjengre gustria ap lakre mussja un shunas, hoi ko mursh peskri phenjake Rebekka penas, nashas lo sik pash leste. Kowa his i khamelentsa pash ko pani tardo.
Un o Laban penas ap leste: “Am kai dren! I soor un i bacht o baro Deblestar hi ap tute tchiddo. Hoske hal tu win tardo? Me krom tuke o kheer djudjo. Un i khamelenge hi ninna platsa.”
Koi was o mursh an o kheer. Un jon lan i khamelendar o koowa tele. Un dan len phuss un chapen. O mursheske un kolenge, kai pash leste his, anan le pani, te thowenn jon pengre herja.
Koi pal anan le lenge te chal. Koi penas o budepaskro ap o Laban: “Me kamau gar te chal, bis te rakrom man win.” Un o Laban penas: “Rake!”
Koi penas job: “Me hom o Abrahameskro budepaskro.
O baro Dewel tchiwas bari soor un bud bacht ap miro rai. Jaake was job brawelo. O Dewel das les bakre un grumja, rup un sonakai, budepangre: mursha un djuwja, ninna khamele un burike.
Har i Sara, miro rajeskri romni, phuro his, anas li miro rajeske i tchawes ap i phub. Koleste das job halauter, hoi les his.
Ap mande penas miro rai: ‘De tut sowel, te less miro tchaweske kek romni dran o them Kanaan.
Dja an miro dadeskro kheer un pash mire menshende. Kolendar le miro tchaweske i romjat.’
Un me penom ap miro rajeste: ‘Un hoi krap me, te kamell koi djuwel gar mantsa te djal?’

Koi penas o Abraham ap mande: ‘O baro Dewel, kai djau ap leskro drom, bitchrell peskro bolepaskres glan tute un dell bacht ap tiro drom, te less miro tchaweske i romjat mire menshendar un dran miro dadeskro kheer.
Te weh tu pash mire menshende, un jon te denn tut kek djuwel, well koi sowel hoi tu dal, krik lino.’
Jaake wom kau diwes pash kau pani un penom: Baro Dewel, o Dewel miro rajestar Abraham, te deh tu tchatchepah bacht ap ko drom, kai me djau, sike les mande!
Me hom kate tardo pash kau pani. Te penau me kanna ap koi tchate, kai wella, te lell li pani: ‘De man i mui pherdo pani dran tiro khoro te pijell’. Un joi penell ap mande:
‘Pi, un tire khamelen kamau ninna pani te dell’, hi joi koi romni, kai o baro Dewel miro rajeskro tchaweske wi-rodas.
Har me jaake an miro dji rakrom, koi was i Rebekka. Lakro khoro his ap lakro phiko. Joi djas pash ko pani tele, te lell li pani. Koi penom me ap late: ‘De man te pijell!’
Un joi las sik o khoro peskro phikestar tele un penas: ‘Ake, pi! Tire khamelen kamau ninna pani te dell.’ Koi pijom me. Un joi das ninna i khamelen te pijell.

Un me putchom latar: ‘Koneskri tchai hal tu?’ ‘Miro dad hi o Betuel’ penas li. ‘Leskro dad hi o Nahor un leskri dai hi i Milka.’ Un me tchiwom i gustri ap lakro nak un i mussjengre gustria ap lakre mussja.

Koi pal witsrom man tele glan o baro Debleste un parkrom man pash leste. Un sharom les, o Debles miro rajestar Abraham. Job anas man ap o tchatcho drom, te anap miro rajeskro tchaweske i tchai leskro phraleskro tchawestar.
Kanna penenn mange, kamenn tumer miro rajeske latchepen un kamlepen te krell? Un te hi kowa gar jaake, penenn mange kowa ninna. Un me djinau, hoi te krap.”
Koi penan o Laban un o Betuel: “Kau koowa kras halauter o baro Dewel. Pral ko koowa nai penah mer tchi, kek latcho koowa, witar kek tchilatcho koowa.
Dik, i Rebekka hi glan tute. Le lat peha un dja kote, te well li tiro rajeskro tchaweskri romni, jaake har o baro Dewel rakras.”
Har o Abrahameskro budepaskro lengre laba shunas, witsras pes lo tele glan o baro Debleste, te parkrell lo pes pash leste.
Koi pal las job rupeno un sonakaskro koowa win, ninna shukar ripja. Un das kowa i Rebekka. Lakro phrales un lakri dat das lo ninna kutch koowa.
Un job un kol mursha, kai pash leste his, chan un pijan. Un jon atchan pral i rati pash lende. O wawar diwes, taissarlakro, penas job: “Kanna mukenn man pale pash miro rajeste te djal!”
Koi penas lakro phraal un lakri dai ap leste: “Muk kai tchat jaake deesh diwessa pash mende te atchell. Pal ko tsiro, mu djal li tuha.”
Koi penas o budepaskro ap lende: “Ma rikrenn man pale! O baro Dewel das bacht ap miro drom. Kanna mukenn man te djal, te wap pale pash miro rajeste.”
Koi penan jon: “Mer dah i tchat gole, te putchas latar, hoi joi penella.”
Un jon dan i Rebekka gole un putchan latar: “Kameh tu kau mursheha te djal?” Un joi penas: “Me kamau te djal.”
Koi mukan jon pengri phenjat Rebekka te djal, khetne koi djuwjah, kai das garda ap late, har his li tikno, te djan le o Abrahameskro budepaskreha un leskre murshentsa.

Un jon rakran i bacht pral late win un penan: “Tu, mari pheen, tutar te wenna bud serja menshe: serja kope deesh-serja! Mu wenn tire tchawe rai pral kolende, kai kurenn pen lentsa, te lenn le kolengre forja krik!”
Un i Rebekka un kol djuwja, kai budrenn lake, stan pre, beshan pen ap i khamele, un djan ko mursheha. Jaake las ko budepaskro i Rebekka peha.
An ko tsiro djiwas o Isaak an o them Negev pash o pani ‘Lachai-Roi’.
Ap jek rati djas job win, te well lo peske kokres. Un har job pre dikas, dikas lo, kai khamele wenna.
Un i Rebekka dikas pes ninna trujel un dikas o Isaakes. Koi stas joi sik tele i khamelatar un putchas o budepaskrestar:
“Koon hi ko mursh, kai kote pash mende wella?” “Kowa hi miro rai”, penas o budepaskro. Koi tchiwas joi i diklo glan peskro mui, te khatrell li peskro mui.
O budepaskro penas o Isaakeske halauter, hoi job kras.
Un o Isaak anas i Rebekka an o plachteno kheer, kai leskri dai i Sara, djiwas, un romedineras lat. Un job kamas lat. Un o Isaakeskri duk an peskro dji pral peskro dakro merepen was krik lino.
Un o Abraham las peske i newi romni. Lakro lab his Ketura.
Un joi anas leske tchawen ap i phub. Kolengre laba hi: Simran, Jokshan, Medan un Midian, Jishbak un Shuach.
O Jokshan was o dad dui tchawendar: o Saba un o Dedan. O Dedan was o dad kol menshendar, kai kharenna Ashurarja, Letusharja un Leummarja.
O Midianeskre tchawe his: o Efa, o Efer, o Henoch, o Abida un o Eldaa. Kolla lauter hi i tchawe un tchawengre tchawe o Abrahameskri romjatar Ketura.
Un o Abraham das halauter, hoi leskro hi, o Isaakeste.

Un kol tchawen, kai leskre wawar romjendar bolde wan, das o Abraham kutch koowa pestar. An ko tsiro har job djiwas, bitchras lo len dur krik peskro tchawestar Isaak an ko them, hoi kote tchiddo hi, kai o kham pre-djala.
O Abraham was 175 (sheel-efta-deesh-te-pantch) bersh phuro.
Les his i rah djipen. Un job meras an o mishto phurepen un was paskedo.
Leskre tchawe, o Isaak un o Ismael, paskran les an koi grotta, hoi kharella Machpela, ap ko kotar them, hoi hi tchiddo glan Mamre. Glan kau tsiro his ko kotar them o Efrones, koleskro dad o Zohar hi.
Kolla his Hetarja un o Abraham ginas les lendar. Kote was job un peskri romni Sara paskedo.
Pal o Abrahameskro merepen tchiwas o Dewel peskri soor un peskri bacht ap leskro tchaweste Isaak. An ko tsiro djiwas o Isaak pash ko pani, hoi kharella ‘Lachai-Roi’.
Kowa hi ko liil, kai tchinlo hi i laba kol menshendar, kai wenna o Abrahameskro tchawestar Ismael. Koleskri dai his i Hagar dran o them Egiptia, koi budepaskretsa, kai budras i Sarake.
Un kolla hi i laba o Ismaeleskre tchawendar jaake har jon boldo wan: O phureder his o Nebajot. Palle was o Kedar, o Adbeel, o Mibsam,
o Mishma, o Duma, o Massa,
o Hadad, o Tema, o Jetur, o Nafish un o Kedema.
Kolla his i deesh-te-dui tchawe o Ismaelestar. Hakeno his o pralstuno pral i bari familja. Jon dan pengro lab kol gaba un platse, kai lengre plachtene khera tardo his.
O Ismael was 137 (sheel-te-trijanda-te-efta) bersha phuro. Un job meras un was paskedo.

Leskre tchawe, kai pal leste wan, djiwan an o them mashkral Hawila un Shur. Shur hi tchiddo glan o them Egiptia ap o drom, hoi djala an Assur. Jaake was tchatcho, hoi pral o Ismael penlo was: ‘Job lell peske i kotar them gar dur peskre phralendar, te choirell lo len.’
Kowa hi ko liil, kai tchinlo hi pral o Abrahameskro tchaweste Isaak.
O Isaak his star-desha bersh phuro, har job romedineras i Rebekka. Lakro dad his o Betuel, un lakro phraal his o Laban. Kolla his Aramarja dran o them Paddan-Aram.
Joi nai las kek tchawe. Un o Isaak mangas o baro Deblestar peskri romjake. Un o baro Dewel shunas ap o Isaak. Un i Rebekka, leskri romni, was an wawar koowa.
Un i tchawe stakran pen an lakro per. Koi penas joi: “Hoske djal mange kowa?” Un joi djas te putchell li o baro Deblestar.

O baro Dewel penas ap late: “Tu weh i dai dui tchawendar. Kol dujendar wenna bud menshe, jaake bud, kai hakenestar jek natsjona wella. Ko terneder well sorleder har ko phureder un well o rai pral leste.”
Har lakro tsiro koi his, wan dui mursh tchawe boldo.
Ko ersto, kai boldo was, his lolo. Un les his bud bal ap leste, jaake har i balni plaashka. Un doleske las job ko lab Esau.
Pal leste was leskro phraal boldo. Job rikras peskro wasteha i heri peskro phralestar Esau. Doleske las job ko lab Jakob. O Isaak his 60 (shob-deesh) bersh phuro, har kol tchawe boldo wan.
I tchawe wan baro. O Esau was i wesheskro, kai haiwas mishto viechen te taprell. O Jakob was i mursh, kai his pokones. Job atchas pash i plachtene khera.
O Isaak kamas te chal i viechendar, kai o Esau tapras. Un job kamas o Esaes budeder har o Jakobes. I Rebekka kamas o Jakobes budeder har o Esaes.
His i diwes, kai keras o Jakob i chapen. Har o Esau dran o weesh khere was, his job khino un les his i bari bok.
Koi penas o Esau ap o Jakobeste: “Muk man sik te chal ko lolo chapastar. Hom khino un man hi bari bok.” Doleske dan le les ko lab Edom.
Penas o Jakob ap leste: “Tu hal o phureder tchawo un leh halauter, hoi o phureder tchawo lella. Kanna de tiro wast pre, kai me hom har o phureder, un kowa lauter lella, hoi o phureder tchawo lella.”
Penas o Esau: “Dik! Hoi molell man kowa lauter, te merau i bokatar?”
Penas o Jakob: “De tut sowel!” Un job das pes sowel, te lell o Jakob halauter, hoi o phureder tchawo lella.
Un o Jakob das maro un i linsengro chapen o Esaes te chal. Koi chas un pijas job, stas pre un djas peske. Jaake his leske lauter tchi moldo, hoi o phureder tchawo lella.
His i tsiro, kai was i bari bok an o them, jaake har an o Abrahameskro tsiro. Doleske djas o Isaak an o foro Gerar pash o Abimelech. Kowa his o baro rai pral i Filistarja.
Koi mukas pes o baro Dewel o Isaakestar te dikell un penas ap leste: “Ma dja tele an o them Egiptia! Djib an ko them, kai me tuke penau.

Atch i tsiro an kau them. Me hom pash tute, te tchiwap miri soor un miri bacht ap tute. Kalla tsele themma dau me tut un tire tchawen, kai pal tute wenna. Me rikrau miro lab, hoi dom tiro dadeste Abraham, un kai dom miro wast koi pre.

O Abraham shunas ap mande un kras kowa, hoi me leske penom. Job rikras pes ap mire laba un djiwas pal miro tchatchepen. Doleske krau me, te wenn tire tchawe jaake bud har i bolepangre momlia. Un me dau len kalla tsele themma. Un koi bacht, hoi dau tire tchawende, djal dureder ap i tsele natsjone, kai ap i phub hi.”
Jaake atchas o Isaak an o foro Gerar.

Har i menshe an ko foro leskri romjat dikan, putchan le: “Koon hi koja?” Penas job: “Joi hi miri pheen.” Les his traash te penell: ‘Joi hi miri romni.’ Job daras, te denn le les mulo, te lenn jon lat, jaake shukar his li.
Har job i rah tsiro koi his, dikas o Abimelech, ko rai pral kol Filistarja, dran i wochni. Un dikas, har las o Isaak peskri romjat, i Rebekka, an i mussi.

Koi mukas o Abimelech o Isaakes te kharell un penas ap leste: “Dik! Koja hi tiri romni. Hoske penal tu, kai joi tiri pheen hi?” Penas o Isaak ap leste: “Me darom, te denn man le mulo un lenn jon lat.”
Penas o Abimelech: “Hoske kral tu kowa mentsa? Har sik nashte wals jek i murshendar un lals tiri romjat un tchiwals pes pash late. Tu anals bari doosh ap mende!”
Koi pal penas o Abimelech ap lauterende: “Koon kol murshes ninna leskri romjat an-tapella, ko hunte merella.”
O Isaak tchiwas djob an i phub an ko them. Un o baro Dewel tchiwas peskri soor koi pre. Jaake las o Isaak an ko bersh sheel kope jaake bud djob, har lo an i phub tchiwras.
Un o Isaak was brawelo un brawleder, un les his i baro brawlepen:
bud bakre, busja, grumja un budepangre. Un i Filistarja dikan tchilatche jakentsa ap leskro brawlepen.
Un i tsele brunne, kai leskro dadeskre budepangre kran an o Abrahameskro tsiro, witsran le pherdo tchik, te nai lenn jon kek pani buder.
Un o Abimelech penas ap o Isaak: “Dja dran maro them! Tu wal sorleder har mer.”
Jaake djas o Isaak peske un tchiwas peskre plachtene khera pre an i tala pash o foro Gerar un atchas koi.

Un mukas kol brunne pale newes te krell, hoi jon kran an ko tsiro, kai leskro dad Abraham djiwas, un kolen i Filistarja pherdo tchik witsran pal leskro merepen. Un o Isaak das kol brunne ko lab, har leskro dad len das.
Un o Isaakeskre budepangre hadan tchik win an koi tala un hatsan pani.
Koi tchingran i bakrengre dran o foro Gerar ap o Isaakeskre bakrengre un penan: “Kau pani hi maro.” Koi das o Isaak koi brunna ko lab ‘Esek’.
Un o Isaakeskre budepangre kran i wawar brunna. Pral koja das ninna tchingepen. Koi das o Isaak kai brunna ko lab ‘Sitna’.

Un job djas dureder un kras i wawar brunna. Pral koja tchingran pen le gar. Koi das lo lat ko lab ‘Rechobot’, un penas: “Kanna das men o baro Dewel i buchlo them. Mer nai wah an kau them bud menshe un bud vieche.”
Kotar djas job an Beersheba.

An koi rati mukas pes o baro Dewel lestar te dikell un penas: “Me hom o Dewel tiro dadestar Abraham. Ma traash! Me hom tuha. Me tchiwau miri soor un miri bacht ap tute. Tire tchawe, kai pal tute wenna, wenna bud un budeder. Jaake dom miro lab o Abrahameste, kai mange koi his.”
Un kote kras o Isaak i chatchepaskri, te wenn vieche chatchedo o Debleske, un mangas o baro Debles an. Un kote tchiwas job peskro plachteno kheer pre. Un peskre budepangre hadan kote i brunna win.
Un o Abimelech was dran o foro Gerar peskro maleha Ahussat un peskro pralstuno lurdeha Pichol pash o Isaak.
Un o Isaak penas ap lende: “Hoske wenn pash mande? Tumer kamenn man gar un tradan man tumendar krik.”
Penan le: “Mer dikah un haiwah, kai o baro Dewel tuha hi. Doleske penam menge: Mer hunte kras tuha win, un das men sowel, te krah buder kek tchingepen jek o wawareha.
De tiro dadeskro wast koi pre, te kress menge kek tchilatchepen, jaake har mer hams tuke latcho un mukam tut te djal, har tu kamal. Ap tute hi i bacht o baro Deblestar tchiddo.”
Koi kras o Isaak lenge i chapen, te chan un pijan le.
Taissarlakro stan le pre, un jek pal o wawar das pes sowel. Un o Isaak mukas len te djal. Un jon djan penge an o latchepen.
Ap ko diwes wan o Isaakeskre budepangre pash leste, un rakran leha pral koi brunna, hoi jon wi-hadan, un penan: “Mer hatsam pani.”
Koi das job koi brunna ko lab ‘Shiba’. Doleske kharell ko foro gomme kau diwes ‘Beersheba’.
O Esau his star-deesh bersh phuro. Un job romedineras i Judit, – lakro dad his o Beeri. Ninna romedineras job i Basmat. Lakro dad his o Elon. O Beeri un o Elon his Hetarja.
Kalla dui romja kran o djipen pharo o Isaakeske un i Rebekkake.
O Isaak was phuro un nai dikas buder tchi. Un job kharas peskro phureder tchawes, o Esau, un penas ap leste: “Miro tchawo!” “Ake hom”, penas kowa.
Un o Isaak penas ap leste: “Dik, me wom phuro. Djinau gar hawo diwes me merau.
Le tire faile un tiro bogo! Un dja win ap o them! Un de mange i vieches karje!
Un kre mange i latcho chapen, jaake har me kowa kamau. Un an les mange, te chap un te rakrap nai glan miro merepen o Debleskri bacht pral tute win.”
Har o Isaak peskro tchaweha Esau rakras, shunas i Rebekka kowa. Un o Esau djas win, te dell lo i vieches karje, te anell lo kowa khere.
Koi penas i Rebekka ap peskro tchaweste Jakob: “Djineh tu? Me shunom, har tiro dad penas ap tiro phraleste Esau:
‘An mange i vieches, un kre mange i latcho chapen, te chap un te rakrap o baro Debleskri bacht pral tute win glan miro merepen.’”
“Kanna, miro tchawo”, penas i Rebekka dureder, “shun ap mande un kre, hoi tuke penau.
Dja pash i viechende un an mange dui latche terne busja. Kolendar kamau i latcho chapen tiro dadeske te krell, jaake har job kowa kamella.
Kowa an tiro dadeske, te chal lo les, un rakrell o Debleskri bacht win pral tute glan leskro merepen.”
Koi penas o Jakob ap peskri date Rebekka: “Tu djineh, kai miro phrales, o Esau, bud balla ap peste hi. Ap mande hi gar bud balla.
Nashte well, kai miro dad taprell man an. Palle homs i chocheno glan leste un anaus bari bibacht ap mande un kek bacht.”
Koi penas leskri dai ap leste: “Koi bibacht mu well ap mande, miro tchawo. Shun ap mande! Dja un an mange kol viechen!”
Un job djas, las dui busja un anas len peskri dake. Un joi kras i latcho chapen, jaake har leskro dad kowa kamas.
Un i Rebekka las kutch ripja peskro phureder tchawestar Esau, hoi pash late an o kheer his. Un riwas len lakro terneder tchaweske Jakob an.
Kol felle kol busjendar tchiwas joi trul leskre mussja un trul leskri meen, kai kek balla his.
Un joi das peskro tchaweste Jakob ko latcho chapen un ko maro, hoi joi kras.
Un job djas dren pash peskro dadeste un penas: “Miro dad!” Kowa penas: “Ake hom. Koon hal tu, miro tchawo?”

Koi penas o Jakob ap peskro dadeste: “Me hom o Esau, tiro phureder tchawo. Me krom, hoi tu mange penal. Ste kanna pre un besh tut un cha ko mass, hoi anom tuke, jaake te rakress nai o Debleskri bacht pral mande win.”
Koi putchas o Isaak peskro tchawestar: “Har hatsal kowa jaake sik, miro tchawo?” “O baro Dewel, tiro Dewel, das man bacht”, penas o Jakob.
Koi penas o Isaak ap o Jakobeste: “Am pash mande, miro tchawo, te taprap tut an, te djinap, kai hal tchatchepah miro tchawo Esau.”
Kanna djas o Jakob glan peskro dadeste Isaak. Un o Isaak tapras les an un penas: “Te rakreh, shunau o Jakobes. Kal mussja hi o Esaeskre mussja.”
Job prindjras les gar. Ap leskre mussja his bud balla har ap i mussja leskro phralestar Esau.
Har job kamas o Debleskri bacht pral leste win te rakrell, putchas lo pale: “Hal tu miro tchawo Esau?” “Awa, me hom kowa”, penas o Jakob.

Kanna penas o Isaak: “Miro tchawo, an mange ko chapen, te chap ko massestar, hoi anal mange, jaake te rakrap nai o Debleskri bacht pral tute win.” Un o Jakob anas kowa leske, te chal lo. Un job chas. Un anas leske ninna mool, te pijell lo. Un job pijas.
Pal kowa penas o Isaak ap leste: “Am pash mande un de man i tchum, miro tchawo!”

Koi was o Jakob pash leste un tchumras les. Koi sungas job leskre koola un rakras o Debleskri bacht pral leste win un penas: Dik, o sungepen miro tchawestar hi har ko sungepen i phubjatar, kai o baro Dewel tchiwas peskri soor pre.
Mu dell tut o Dewel brishin dran o bolepen un bud chapaske dran i phub, bud djob un mool.

Menshe dran wawar themma hunte budrenn tuke un witsrenn pen tele glan tute. Wess rai pral tire phralende. Un tiri dakre tchawe hunte witsrenn pen tele glan tute. Kolla kai penenna, te well tut bibacht, ap kolende well bibacht. Un kolla, kai penenna, te well tut bacht, ap kolende well bacht.
Har o Isaak kol latche laba pral o Jakobeste rakras un o Jakob win djas peskro dadestar, was leskro phraal, o Esau, khere.
Un job kras ninna i latcho chapen, anas les peskro dadeske un penas ap leste: “Miro dad, ste pre un cha ko massestar, hoi anom tuke, jaake kai nashte rakress o Debleskri bacht pral mande win!”
Koi penas leskro dad Isaak ap leste: “Koon hal tu?” “Me hom o Esau, tiro phureder tchawo”, penas job.

Koi was i bari daar ap o Isaakeste. Un job putchas: “Koon his kowa, kai das i viecho karje un anas mange o chapen, un me chom? Koi pal wal tu. Me rakrom o Debleskri bacht win pral koleste, kai anas mange o chapen. Un koi bacht atchell ap leste. Me nashte lau lat gar pale.”
Har o Esau shunas kol laba peskro dadestar, das lo i bari gole i choljatar un dukatar, un penas ap peskro dadeste: “Rake o Debleskri bacht pral mande win, ninna pral mande, tata!”
Koi penas leskro dad: “Tiro phraal was chochepah pash mande un las peske i Debleskri bacht, hoi tuke his.”

Koi penas o Esau: “Leskro lab hi tchatchepah Jakob. Job chochras man kanna dui kope. Job las mandar kowa, hoi loms me, ko phureder tchawo. Un kanna las lo peske ninna o Debleskri bacht, hoi mange wals.” Un palle putchas job: “Hi tut kek latche laba mange?”

Koi penas o Isaak ap o Esau: “Shun, me krom, kai job o rai pral tute hi. Un leskre tsele phralen krom, te wenn jon leskre budepangre. Dom les ninna djob un mool. Hoi nai krau kanna tuke, miro tchawo?”
“Tata”, penas o Esau, “nai rakreh tu gar dui kope i bacht win? Rake ninna i Debleskri bacht pral mande win!” Un o Esau rowas soreles.
Koi penas leskro dad Isaak ap leste: Shun, kote, kai djiweh, dell o bolepen kek brishin, witar gar anell i phub bud chapaske.
Tu djiweh kolestar, hoi tiro charo anella tuke, un hunte budress tiro phraleske. I diwes wella, kai hadeh tut ap leste, un mukeh les buder gar rai pral tute te well.

Kol latche laba, hoi o Isaak pral o Jakobeste rakras, kran, te was o Esau chojedo ap o Jakobeste. Doleske penas o Esau ap peste: “Ko tsiro wella sik, kai rowenn le pral miro dadeskro merepen. Te hi lo mulo, dau miro phrales mulo.”
Har i Rebekka shunas, hoi lakro phureder tchawo Esau kamell te krell, mukas li lakro terneder tchawes Jakob te kharell un penas ap leste: “Shun, tiro phraal Esau kamell tut mulo te dell.
Kanna, shun ap mande, miro tchawo. Kre tut ap o drom, dja tuke sik un dja pash miro phraleste Laban an o foro Haran.
Atch i tsiro pash leste, bis te djal tiro phraleskri choli krik,
un job bistras, hoi tu les kral. Palle bitchrau jekes, kai anell tut pale. Hoske nashrap me tumen dujen ap jek diwes?”

Un i Rebekka penas ap o Isaakeste: “Kol dui chalja, kol Hetarja, kolen o Esau romedineras, krenn mange miro djipen pharo. Te romedinerell ninna o Jakob i tchat dran kau them, i Hetaretsa, wals feteder, te merap.”
Koi das o Isaak o Jakobes gole un penas: “Dja o Debleha! Ma le i romni dran o them Kanaan!
Dja an o them Paddan-Aram, an o kheer tiro dakro dadestar Betuel. Le tuke kote i tchai tiri dakro phralestar, o Laban.
O sorelo Dewel tchiwell peskri soor un peskri bacht ap tute un dell tut bud tchawe, te wenn tutar bud natsjone!
Koi bacht un koi soor, hoi o Dewel tchiwas ap o Abrahameste, mu well ap tute un ap tire menshende! Tu leh kau them, kai tu kanna i wi-themari hal – ko them, hoi o Dewel o Abrahameste das.”
Un o Isaak mukas o Jakobes te djal. Un job djas an o them Paddan-Aram pash o Laban. Koleskro dad his o Aramari Betuel. O Labaneskri pheen his i Rebekka, koi dai o Jakobestar un o Esaestar.

O Esau dikas, kai o Isaak o Debleskri bacht pral o Jakobeste win rakras un les an o them Paddan-Aram bitchras, te lell job peske kote i romni. Un job shunas, kai o Isaak o Jakobeske soreles penas: ‘Ma le i romni dran o them Kanaan.’
Job dikas ninna, kai o Jakob shunas ap peskro dadeste un ap peskri date un djas an o them Paddan-Aram.
Koi haiwas o Esau, kai leskre romja, kai wan dran o them Kanaan, gar latcho his glan peskro dadeskre jaka.
Un o Esau djas pash o Abrahameskro tchaweste Ismael, un las peske koleskri tchat, i Machalat. Koja was leskri triinti romni. Lakro phraal his o Nebajot.
O Jakob djas dran ko foro Beersheba un kras pes ap ko drom, kai djal an o them Haran.
Har o kham tele djas, was job ap i platsa un atchas i rati koi. Job las jek bar, hoi kote tchiddo his, tchiwas les tel leskro shero un tchiwas pes tele.
Koi das lo suni: Job dikas i treppa ap i phub tardo. Koja djas bis an o bolepen. Un o Debleskre bolepangre djan pre un tele.

Un o baro Dewel his tardo pral pre un penas: “Me hom o baro Dewel, ko Dewel tiro papestar Abraham un ninna o Isaakeskro Dewel. Kau them, kai tu tchiddo hal, dau tut un tire tchawen, kai pal tute wenna.
Jon wenna jaake bud har i tchik, hoi ap i phub hi. Un krau lengro them baro un buchlo ap hake rigja. Un koi bacht, hoi dau tute un tire tchawende, djal dureder ap i tsele menshende, kai ap i phub hi.
Tu djiness, me hom tuha un dau garda ap tute, kote, kai tu djah. Un anau tut pale an kau them. Me mukau tut gar, bis te krom halauter, hoi tuke penom.”
Koi djangras o Jakob dran o sopen pre un penas: “Tchatchepah, o baro Dewel hi ap koi platsa. Un me djinom kowa gar.”
Un job daras un penas: “Har darenes hi kai platsa, – hi tchatchepah o Debleskro kheer un o wudar an o bolepen.”
Taissarlakro stas o Jakob pre, las ko bar, hoi tel leskro shero tchiddo his, tchiwas les pre, un tchoras djet koi pre.
Un job das kol platsa ko lab ‘Betel’. Glan ko tsiro his o lab ko forestar ‘Lus’.
Un o Jakob das pes sowel un penas: “Hi o baro Dewel mantsa un dell garda ap mande ap miro drom, kai me djau, un dell man chapaske un an-ripaske,
jaake te wap pale mishto an miro dadeskro kheer, hi job miro Dewel.
Un kau bar, hoi tchiwom pre, kowa mu well i Debleskro kheer. Un halauterestar, hoi tu man deh, dau me tut o deshto kotar pale.”
Un o Jakob djas dureder un was an ko them, kai kote tchiddo hi, kai o kham pre djala.

Un job dikas pes trujel un dikas i brunna ap o them. Ap triin platse pash i brunna his bud bakre un busja tchiddo. Dran koi brunna lan i bakrengre o pani, hoi denn le pengre viechen te pijell. Un i baro bar his ap i brunna tchiddo.
Te his i tsele bakre khetne anlo, lenn le ko bar tele un denn i bakren te pijell. Pal kowa tchiwenn le ko bar pale ap i brunna.
O Jakob penas ap i bakrengre: “Kamle phrala, kai wenn tumer?” “Ham dran o foro Haran”, penan jon.
“Prindjrenn o Labanes?” putchas job lendar. “Koleskro papo hi o Nahor.”
“Prindjrah les”, penan le. “Djal leske mishto?” putchas job. “Awa”, penan le. “Leske djal mishto. Ake, koi well leskri tchai Rachel i bakrentsa.”
Koi penas job: “O tselo diwes hi glan mende. Ko tsiro, kai wenn i bakre khetne tradedo, hi gar koi. Denn i bakren te pijell un djan lentsa koi, kai hi len te chal.”
Koi penan jon: “Kanna krah nai tchi. Te hi i tsele bakre khetne anlo, lah ko bar o panjestar tele un dah i bakren te pijell.”
Har job lentsa rakras, was i Rachel peskro dadeskre bakrentsa. Joi das garda ap lende.
Har dikas o Jakob o Labaneskri tcha, i Rachel, ninna o Labaneskre bakre, djas lo pash i brunna, las ko bar tele, un das i viechen peskro kakestar te pijell. O Laban his o phraal leskri datar.
Un o Jakob tchumras i Rachel un rowas soreles, kai lauter kowa shunan.
Un penas lake, kai job lakro dadeskre menshendar hi, un leskri dai i Rebekka. Koi nashas joi un penas lauter peskro dadeske.

Har o Laban shunas, kai was peskri phenjakro tchawo, o Jakob, nashas lo pash leste, tchiwas peskre mussja trul leste, tchumras les un anas les an peskro kheer. Un o Jakob penas o Labaneske halauter, hoi djas.
Koi penas o Laban: “Tchatchepah, tu hal mire menshendar.” Un o Jakob atchas pash o Labaneste jek tchon.
Pal jek tchon penas o Laban ap o Jakobeste: “Tu hal mire menshendar. Tu budress mange gar tchitcheske. Pen mange, hoi plaissrap tuke!”
O Labanes his dui tcha. Koi phureder kharas Lea, koi terneder Rachel.
I Leakre jaka his gar sasto. I Rachel his i shukar un raili tchai.
Un o Jakob kamas i Rachel un penas ap o Laban: “Me kamau te budrap tuke efta bersha. Koi pal deh tu man i Rachel, tiri terneder tchai, te romedinerap lat.”
Koi penas o Laban: “Hi feteder te dap lat tute har i wawareste. Atch pash mande!”
Jaake budras o Jakob efta bersha, te romedinerell lo i Rachel. Un kal bersha his an leskre jaka har i tikno tsiro, jaake bud kamas lo lat.
Pal ko tsiro penas o Jakob ap o Laban: “De man kanna miri romjat! Ko tsiro hi koi, te romedinerap lat.”
Un o Laban penas hakeneske an ko foro, te wenn le koi ap i bijab. Un job kras i bari bijab.
Ap i rati las o Laban peskri tchat Lea un anas lat pash o Jakobeste. Un job was lah khetne.
O Labanes his i budepaskretsa. Koja kharas Silpa. Kolat das lo peskri tchate Lea, te well li kanna lakri budepaskretsa.
Taissarlakro dikas o Jakob, kai joi his i Lea. Koi penas lo ap o Laban: “Hoske kral kowa? Budrom tuke, te lap i Rachel. Hoske chochral man tu?”
Penas o Laban ap leste: “An maro them krenn le kowa gar jaake, kai denn le koi terneder tchat krik glan koi phureder.
Kre i bijab efta diwessa kalah. Koi pal dau tut ninna koi wawar. Un tu budreh mange pale efta bersha lake.”
Un o Jakob kras jaake un kras i bijab efta diwessa mit i Lea. Koi pal das o Laban les peskri tchat Rachel, te romedinerell job lat.
O Labanes his i wawar budepaskretsa. Koja kharas Bilha. Kolat das lo peskri tchate Rachel, te well li kanna lakri budepaskretsa.
Un o Jakob un i Rachel wan khetne. Un o Jakob kamas i Rachel budeder har i Lea. Un job budras pale o Labaneske efta bersha.
Har o baro Dewel dikas, kai o Jakob i Lea gar kamas, kras job, kai i Lea anas nai tchawen ap i phub. I Rachel nai las kek tchawen.
Un i Lea was an wawar koowa un anas i tchawes ap i phub. Koles das joi ko lab Ruben un penas: “O baro Dewel dikas miri bibacht. Tchatchepah, kanna kamell man miro rom.”
Un joi was pale an wawar koowa un anas i tchawes ap i phub un penas: “O baro Dewel shunas, kai miro rom man gar kamell. Doleske das lo man ninna kau tchawes.” Un joi das les o lab Simeon.
Un joi was pale an wawar koowa un anas i tchawes ap i phub. Un joi penas: “Kau kopo djal miro romeskro dji ap mande. Me anom leske triin tchawen ap i phub.” Doleske dan le kau tchawes ko lab Levi.
Un joi was pale an wawar koowa un anas i tchawes ap i phub un penas: “Kanna sharau o baro Debles.” Doleske das joi les ko lab Juda. Pal kowa anas joi i tsiro buder kek tchawen ap i phub.
Har i Rachel dikas, kai anas joi o Jakobeske kek tchawen ap i phub, silweras joi ap peskri phenjate, un penas ap o Jakob: “De man tchawe! Te deh man kek, merau me.”
Koi las o Jakob i bari choli ap i Rachel un penas: “Hom me o Dewel, te nai dap tut tchawe!”
Koi penas joi: “Me dau tut miri budepaskretsa Bilha. Ab lah khetne, te anell li mange i ternepen ap i phub, te wap ninna pral i ternepen dai.”
Un joi das les lakri budepaskretsa Bilha, te well joi leskri romni. Un o Jakob djas pash late.
Un i Bilha was an wawar koowa un anas o Jakobeske i tchawes ap i phub.
Koi penas i Rachel: “O Dewel das man miro tchatchepen. Job shunas ap miri gole un das man i tchawo.” Dran kowa das les li o lab Dan.
Un i Bilha was pale an wawar koowa un anas o Jakobeske i duito tchawes ap i phub.
Koi penas i Rachel: “Man his i baro kurepen miri phenjah un homs sorleder har joi.” Un joi das les ko lab Naftali.
Har i Lea dikas, kai las joi kek tchawe buder, das joi peskri budepaskretsa Silpa peskro romeste, te well joi leskri romni.
Un i Silpa anas o Jakobeske i tchawes ap i phub.
Koi penas i Lea: “Hawi bacht! Un joi das les ko lab Gad.”
Un i Silpa anas o Jakobeske i duito tchawes ap i phub.
Koi penas i Lea: “Har bachtelo hom me. I romja sharenna man un penenna ‘Hawi bachteli romni!’” Un joi das les ko lab Asser.

Ap ko tsiro, har anan le o djob dren, djas o Ruben win ap o them un hatsas kamlepaskre phabja, un anas len peskri dake Lea. Koi penas i Rachel ap i Lea: “De man dui, triin kamlepaskre phabja, hoi tiro tchawo hatsas!”

“Hi tuke gar doha, te lal mange miro romes mandar krik”, penas i Lea. “Kanna kameh ninna i kamlepaskre phabja miro tchawestar mandar te lell?” Koi penas i Rachel: “Te deh man kolla, sowell o Jakob kai rati pash tute.”

O Jakob budras ap i hachetikri phub. Har job i rati khere was, djas i Lea o paash drom pash leste un penas: “Tu hunte wess kai rati pash mande. Me ginom tut un plaissrom mit kol kamlepaskre phabja miro tchawestar.” Un job sowas koi rati pash late.
Un o Dewel shunas ap i Lea. Un joi was an wawar koowa un anas o Jakobeske o pantchto tchawo ap i phub.
Un i Lea penas: “Me dom miri budepaskretsa miro romeste. Doleske his o Dewel latcho ap mande.” Un joi das peskro tchawes ko lab Issachar.
Un i Lea was pale an wawar koowa un anas o Jakobeske i shobto tchawes ap i phub.
Un penas: “O Dewel das man i kutch koowa. Kau kopo sharell man miro rom. Anom leske shob tchawen ap i phub.” Un joi das les ko lab Sebulon.
Pal kowa anas li i tchai ap i phub un das lat ko lab Dina.
Un o Dewel bistras i Rachel gar. Job shunas ap late un kras, te well joi dai.
Joi was an wawar koowa un anas i tchawes ap i phub un penas: “O Dewel las miri ladj mandar krik.”
Un joi das les ko lab Josef un penas: “Mu dell man o baro Dewel i wawar tchawo.”
Har i Rachel o Josefes ap i phub anas, penas o Jakob ap o Labaneste: “Muk man te djal pash mire menshende an miro them!
De man mire romjen un mire tchawen, kolenge budrom tuke. Un muk men te djal! Tu djineh, har mishto budrom tuke.”
Koi penas o Laban ap leste: “Ab mange latcho un atch kai! Haiwau, kai o baro Dewel peskri soor un peskri bacht ap mande tchiwella jaake rah, har tu pash mande hal.
Pen mange, hoi te plaissrap tuke! Dau tut, hoi kameh.”
Koi penas o Jakob ap leste: “Tu djineh, har me budrom tuke mishto, un tire vieche wan bud un budeder, jaake rah har me pash tute hom.

Har wom pash tute, his tut gar bud vieche. Kanna hi tut bud. O baro Dewel tchiwas peskri soor un peskri bacht ap tiro koowa – ap halauter, hoi lom an miro wast. Kanna hunte budrap ninna mange un miri familjake.”
Koi penas o Laban: “Hoi te plaissrap tuke?” “Tu hunte dess man tchi”, penas o Jakob. “Te kreh kowa, hoi tuke penau, kamau te dap dureder jak ap tire viechende:

Kai diwes djau mank tire tsele viechende, te tchiwap hake tikne bakre ap i rig, kai kalo hi un kolen kalo bal hi mank pengro parno bal. Ninna tchiwau ap i rig hake tikne busja, kolen parno bal hi mank pengro kalo bal. Jon hi mire. Kolentsa plaissreh tu man.

Hake busja, kai hi len kek parne balla, hi tire, ninna hake parne bakre. Te chochau tut, dikeh tu kowa sik an ko tsiro, kai wella. Te hatseh tu mank mire viechende busja, kai hi len kek parne balla, ninna parne bakre, kolla hi, har te tchoroms len tutar.”
Un o Laban penas: “Mishto. Mer krah kowa jaake, har tu peneh.”
Ko diwes tchiwas o Laban ap i rig: hake busja, kai his len ninna parne balla, un hake kale bakre. Un job das len peskre tchawende an o wast, te denn jon jak ap lende.
Un job bitchras len krik o Jakobestar, te djan le triin diwessa dur. O Jakob das jak ap o Labaneskre wawar viechende.
Un o Jakob las kashta kol rukendar, hoi kharenna: pappeltikro ruk, mandeltikro ruk un platantikro ruk, un tchinas kotja dran lende win, jaake kai dikan le o parno kasht.
Kol tchinle kashta tchiwas job an i viechengre tchare, kai kol vieche dran pijenna, te wenn jon koi an wawar koowa.
Un i vieche wan an wawar koowa glan i kashta un lan terne, kai his kalo-un-parno.

Kal terne tchiwas o Jakob peske ap i rig. I wawar vieche anas job khetne kol mursh viechentsa, kai his len parne un kale kotja mashkral o Labaneskre viechende. Jaake kras job peske bud vieche khetne. Kolen anas job gar o Labaneskre viechentsa khetne.
Har i sorele vieche bipandlo his, tchiwas o Jakob kol tchinle kashta glan lende an i viechengre tchare, jaake kai wan le an wawar koowa glan kol kashta.
Kol vieche, kai gar sorelo his, glan kolende tchiwas job kek kashta. Jaake wan o Labaneske kolla boldo, kai gar sorelo his. O Jakobes wan i sorele.
Jaake was o Jakob hako diwes brawleder. Un les his bud vieche un budepangre: djuwja un mursha. Ninna bud khamele un burike his les.
Un o Jakob shunas, hoi o Labaneskre tchawe pal leste rakran un penan: “O Jakob las peske halauter, hoi maro dadeskro his. Kowa, hoi maro dadeskro his, kolestar was lo jaake brawelo.”
Un o Jakob haiwas, kai o Laban buder gar latcho ap leste his, har glan kau tsiro.
Un o baro Dewel penas ap o Jakobeste: “Dja khere an tiro dadeskro them pash tire menshende! Me hom pash tute.”
Un o Jakob bitchras jekes pash i Rachel un i Lea, te penell job len: “Awenn win pash mande ap o them, kai mire vieche hi!”
Un job penas ap lende: “Haiwom, kai tumaro dad dikell buder gar latcho ap mande har glan kau tsiro. Miro dadeskro Dewel his mantsa.
Un tumer djinenn, har budrom tumaro dadeske miri tseli sorjah.
Tumaro dad chochras man: Deesh kope kras lo miro plaissepen wawartchandes. O Dewel mukas les gar te krell lo mange tchilatchepen.

Te penas o Laban: ‘Tu leh kol vieche, hoi hi len tikne kotja wawar ballentsa har ko wawar bal’, palle his kol tsele ternen, kai bolde wan, tikne kotja wawar ballentsa. Un te penas job: ‘Me plaissrau tut kol viechentsa, hoi hi len lengste sane kotja wawar balentsa’, palle his i tsele ternen, kai bolde wan, lengste sane kotja.
O Dewel las kol tsele viechen tumaro dadestar un das len mande.

Har ko tsiro was, kai wan i vieche bipandlo, dikom an i suni i mursh busja, kai djan ap i viechende. Len his kotja wawar ballentsa har ko wawar bal. Kol kotja his lengsto un sano, ninna bud un tikne, ninna bare kotja.
Un o Debleskro bolepaskro penas ap mande an i suni: ‘Jakob!’ Penom: ‘Ake hom.’

Koi penas job: ‘Me dikom halauter, hoi o Laban tut kras. Doleske krom me, kai kol tsele mursh busja, kai djan ap i viechende pre, kolen hi kotja wawar ballentsa: lengste un sane kotja, ninna bud un tikne kotja, ninna bare kotja.

Me hom o Dewel, kai mukas pes tutar te dikell an o foro Betel, kai tchiwal mange i bar pre, tchoral djet koi pre un dal tut sowel ap mande. Kanna ste pre, dja dran kau them! Un dja khere an ko them tire menshendar!’”
I Rachel un i Lea penan ap o Jakobeste: “Men well kek brawlepen un kek wawar koowa buder an maro dadeskro kheer pal leskro merepen.
Ham leske har chale. Job bikras men. Un kol lowe, hoi job menge las, das lo lauter win.
Tchatchepah o tselo brawlepen, hoi o Dewel maro dadestar krik las, hi menge un mare tchawenge. Kre jaake, har o Dewel tuke penas!”
Koi hadas o Jakob peskre tchawen un romjen ap i khamele,
un tradas peskre tsele viechen glan peste. Ninna las lo peskro tselo brawlepen, hoi job kras peske khetne an o them Paddan-Aram, te djal lo pash peskro dadeste Isaak an o them Kanaan.
Glan lengro naashepen, har his o Laban win, te tchinell lo o bal peskre bakrendar, tchoras i Rachel i khereskre deblen, hoi lakro dad an-mangell. Un joi las len peha.
Un o Jakob chochras o Labanes, ko Aramari un penas leske gar, kai jon kaman penge te djal.
Un o Jakob un halauter, hoi les his, nashan un djan pral o lengsto pani Eufrat. Un djan ap o drom an i berge, kai kharenna ‘Gilead’.
Ap o triinto diwes was o Labaneske penlo, kai o Jakob nashas peske.
Un o Laban las peskre phralen peha. Un khetne lan le o Jakobes palla efta diwessa un hatsan les ap i berge Gilead.
An i rati was o Dewel an i suni pash o Laban, ko Aramari. Un penas ap leste: “Kre o Jakobes kek tchilatchepen un de jak ap tire laba, hoi rakreh o Jakobeha!”
Un o Laban was pash o Jakobeste ap kol berge, kai job peskro plachteno kheer pre tchiwas. Un ninna o Laban peskre phralentsa tchiwas peskro plachteno kheer pre ap kol berge Gilead.
Un o Laban penas ap o Jakobeste: “Hoi kral tu? Hoske chochral man un tchoral mire tchen mandar krik, har te wans jon an o kurepen tapedo?
Hoske nashal tuke tchorchanes? Hoske chochral man un penal mange gar, kai kameh tuke te djal? Bachteles djoms me tumentsa i kotar peha ap o drom i gipah un i bashepah.
Hoske mukal man gar te tchumrap mire tchengre tchawen un mire tchen? Kowa his dinelo tutar!

Kowa hi an miro wast, te krap tuke tchilatchepen. Krau kowa gar. O Dewel tumaro dadestar rakras mantsa taissar rati un penas ap mande: ‘Kre o Jakobes kek tchilatchepen un de jak ap tire laba, hoi rakreh o Jakobeha!’
Me djinau, tiro dji hi pash tire menshende. Doleske djal tuke. Pen mange, hoske tchoral mire deblen, kolen me an-mangau?”
“Tchatchepah”, penas o Jakob ap o Labaneste, “man his traash, te less tire tchen mandar krik.

Tire deblen lom me gar. Pash koneste tu len hatseh, kowa hunte merella! Glan mare menshende nai rodeh pash mande! Te hatseh tchomone, hoi tiro hi, le kowa!” O Jakob djinas gar, kai i Rachel tchoras kol deblen.

Jaake djas o Laban an i plachtene khera, kai djiwas o Jakob, i Lea, ninna kol dui budepangre leskre tchendar un hatsas tchi. Palle djas job win dran i Leakro plachteno kheer un djas an o plachteno kheer, kai i Rachel djiwas.
I Rachel las kol khereskre deblen, khatras len tel i khamelakri pernitsa, un beshas pes pral pre. Un o Laban rodas an o tselo plachteno kheer un hatsas tchi.
Un joi penas ap peskro dadeste: “Ab gar chojedo, miro dad, kai nai stau gar pre glan tute. Man hi i djuwjakro koowa.” Doleske hatsas job kol khereskre deblen gar, jaake bud job ninna rodas.
Kanna was o Jakob chojedo un tchingras ap o Labaneste un penas ap leste: “Hawo tchilatcho koowa krom me? Hoi hi miri doosh, kai leh man palla?
Tu rodal an miro tselo koowa. Hatsal tu tchomone, hoi tiro hi? Te hi kowa jaake, tchip kowa, hoi hatsal, glan mire menshende un tire menshende, te penenn jon, koon mendar tchilatcho koowa kras!
Biish bersha homs pash tute. An ko tselo tsiro anas kek tire bakrendar un busjendar i mulo ternepen ap i phub. Me lom mange kek mursh bakro tire bakrendar chapaske.

Kol bakren, hoi kol diwje vieche maran, anom me gar pash tute. Me hunte plaissrom tuke kolen un dom tut mire bakrendar. Kowa kamal tu jaake. Tuke his jek, te his diwes, te his rati, kai wan kol vieche tchoredo.
Jaake djas mange: Ap o diwes maras man o kham un an i rati o shilapen. Bud kope nai sowom me gar.
Biish bersha his kowa jaake. Deesh-te-star bersha budrom tuke, te lap tire dui tchen. Shob bersha budrom tire viechenge. Deesh kope kral tu miro plaissepen wawartchandes.

O Dewel miro dadestar, kai ninna o Abrahameskro Dewel hi, un kolestar trashell miro dad Isaak, te wals ko Dewel gar ap miri rig, tchatchepah, mukals man tchorweles te djal. O Dewel dikas, har marom man tuke tele un har pharo miri budi his. Doleske his job taissar rati ap miri rig tardo.”
Koi penas o Laban ap o Jakobeste: “Mire tcha hi mire. Lengre tchawe hi mire, kol vieche hi mire. Halauter, hoi dikeh hi miro. Kanna nai krau me tchi buder mire tchenge un lengre tchawenge.
Kanna am, mer dah maro dadeskro wast koi pre, kai krah mer buder kek tchingepen jek o wawareha.”
Un o Jakob las i bar un tchiwas les o Debleske pre.
Un job penas ap peskre menshende: “Rodenn barra!” Koi anan le barra un tchiwan len khetne. Un ap kol barra chan le i chapen.
O Laban das kol barra ko lab ‘Jegar-Sahaduta’. Un o Jakob das kol barra ko lab ‘Gal-Ed’.
Un o Laban penas: “Tchatchepah, kol barra hi i sikepen un sikrenn mande un tute, kai dam men mer sowel kai.”
Doleske wenn le ‘Gal-Ed’ kharedo, ninna ‘Mizpa’. O Laban penas: “O baro Dewel mu dell jak, te rikras men ap kowa an ko tsiro, kai wella, kai ham buder gar khetne.
Te hal tu tchilatcho ap mire tchende un te leh tu wawar romjen, djiness, o Dewel dikell kowa, ninna te djinau me kowa gar.”
Un palle penas o Laban ap o Jakobeste: “Ake! Kal barra, hoi tchiwom pre, un ko bar, hoi tchiwal o Debleske pre, hi koi tardo.
Kol barra penenn mange un tuke, te djap gar ap tiri rig un tu gar ap miri rig, te krell kek o wawareske tchilatchepen.
Ko Dewel, kai hi o Abrahameskro Dewel un o Nahoreskro Dewel, kowa mu dell koles i phagi, kai rikrell pes gar ap kowa.” Jaake das pes o Jakob sowel ap ko Debleste, kai leskro dad Isaak daras lestar.
Un job maras i viecho o Debleske ap koi berga un kras i chapen peskre menshenge. Un jon chan un atchan i rati koi.
Taissarlakro stas o Laban pre, tchumras peskre tchengre tchawen un peskre tchen un penas ap lende: “Atchenn miro Debleha!” Un djas khere.
Un o Jakob djas dureder. Un o Debleskre bolepangre tapran les ap o drom.
Har o Jakob len dikas, penas lo: “Kate hi o Debleskri platsa.” Un das koi platsa ko lab: ‘Mahanajim’.
Un o Jakob bitchras murshen glan peste pash peskro phraleste Esau an o them Seir an o them Edom.
Ap lende penas job: Penenn miro rajeske Esau: “Jaake penell tiro budepaskro Jakob: ‘Me homs o tselo tsiro pash o Laban un wau kanna pale.
Man hi grumja un burike, bakre un busja, un budepangre: mursha un djuwja. Bitchrau kal murshen, te penenn le kowa tuke, miro rajeske, te wess latcho ap mande.’”
I mursha wan pale pash o Jakobeste un penan ap leste: “Mer hams pash tiro phraleste Esau. Job hi ap o drom te well lo pash tute. Star-sheel mursha hi pash leste.”
Koi trashas o Jakob. Un les his bari daar. Un job bitchras i paash leskre budepangrendar, leskre bakrendar, grumjendar un khamele ap jek rig. Un koi wawar paash bitchras lo ap i wawar rig.
Job penas peske: “Te well o Esau un dell kolen ap koi jek rig mulo, nashenn nai kolla ap koi wawar rig.”

Un o Jakob penas ap o Debleste: “Tu, o Dewel miro papestar Abraham un miro dadestar Isaak, tu hal o baro Dewel, kai penal ap mande: ‘Dja pale an tiro them un pash tire menshende. Me krau tuke latchepen.’

Me, tiro budepaskro, hom gar moldo, kai hal jaake latcho un kamlo ap mande. Har djom pral o pani Jordan, his man tchi har i kasht an o wast. Kanna hi man i bari familja un kal bud vieche, kai hi ap dui bare platse.
De jak ap mande, te krell miro phraal o Esau mange tchi! Man hi daar lestar, te well lo un marell man, ninna i daja pengre tchawentsa.
Tu penal: ‘Tchatchepah, kamau te wap tuke latcho. Kamau te krap tire tchawen, kai pal tute wenna, jaake bud har i tikne barra pash o baro pani, kolendar kek djinell kitse jon hi.’”
Un o Jakob atchas i rati koi. Un las i viechendar, hoi pash leste his, te dell lo len peskro phraleste Esau:
i busjendar: dui-sheel djuwja un biish mursha; i bakrendar: dui-sheel djuwja un biish mursha;
i khamelendar: triin-desha djuwja un lengre terne; i grumjendar: star-desha djuwja un deesh mursha; i eslendar: biish djuwja un deesh mursha.
Un job das len peskre budepangrende an o wast un penas ap lende: “Djan glan mande, jek pal o wawareste leskre viechentsa! Mukenn i kotar drom mank hakeneste!”
Ap o glanstuneste penas lo: “Te dikell miro phraal Esau tut un putchell tutar: ‘Koon hi tiro rai? Kai djah tu? Kones hi kol vieche?’
Peness: ‘Jon hi tiro budepaskres Jakob. Job anell len tuke, leskro rajeske. Tiro budepaskro Jakob well pal mende.’”
Ap o duito budepaskro, ap o triinto un ap i tsele wawarende, kai djan pal i viechende, penas o Jakob: “Te dikenn o Esaes, penenn kal laba ap leste!

Bistrenn gar te penenn leske kowa: ‘Dik, tiro budepaskro Jakob well pal mende.’” O Jakob penas peske: “Kamau, te bistrell o Esau peskri choli ap mande. Te dikell lo kowa, hoi me les dau, nashte well, kai lell man lo latches pre.”
Jaake djan i budepangre i viechentsa glan o Jakobeste. Un job atchas i rati ap koi platsa.
Mashkral an i rati stas o Jakob pre, las peskre dui romjen, i Rachel un i Lea, un leskre dui wawar romjen, un leskre deesh-te-jek mursh tchawen, un djas lentsa wergel ko pani, hoi kharella ‘Jabbok’.
Pal lende anas lo lauter, hoi les his, ap i wawar rig.
Job kokres atchas pale. Un i mursh kuras pes leha i tseli rat.
Har ko mursh dikas, kai nashte witsrell lo gar o Jakobes ap i phub an kau kurepen, das lo les ap o kokalo ap leskri rig. Un ko kokalo djas win kote, kai lo dren his.
Koi penas o mursh: “Muk man te djal, o diwes wella.” Penas o Jakob: “Me mukau tut gar te djal, bis te tu rakral o Debleskri bacht pral mande win.”
Koi putchas lestar ko mursh: “Har khareh tu?” “Jakob”, penas job.
Penas ko mursh: “Tiro lab hi buder gar Jakob. Kanna well tiro lab Israel. Tu kural tut o Debleha un i menshentsa. Un tu hals sorleder har jon.”
Penas o Jakob ap leste: “Kanna pen mange tiro lab!” Penas job: “Hoske putcheh pal miro lab?” Un job penas ‘Atch o Debleha!’ ap o Jakobeste.
Un o Jakob das koi platsa ko lab ‘Penuel’. Job penas: “Me dikom o Debles an i jaka. Un me merom gar.”
Har mukas lo koi platsa Penuel, djas o kham pre pral leste. Un job djas bango. O kokalo ap leskri rig his buder gar ap peskri platsa.
Ko mursh, kai kuras pes leha, das les ap ko kokalo. Doleske chan i Israelitarja bis kau diwes gar ko viechengro mass, hoi ap ko kokalo hi.

Un o Jakob dikas dur glan peste un dikas, kai was o Esau pash leste. Khetne leha wan star sheel mursha. Koi tchiwas o Jakob peskre tchawen pash lengre dajende: pash i Lea, pash i Rachel un pash kol dui budepangre.
Un job tchiwas kol dui budepangre pengre tchawentsa glan i wawarende. Pal lende tchiwas lo i Lea pengre tchawentsa un pal kolate i Rachel un o Josef.
O Jakob djas glan lende un tchiwas pes efta kope tele ap i phub, bis te was job pash peskro phraleste.
Koi nashas o Esau pash leste, las les trul i meen un tchumras les. Un hake dui rowan.

Un o Esau dikas pre un dikas i djuwjen i tchawentsa un putchas lestar: “Koon hi kolla, kai pash tute hi?” Penas o Jakob: “Miro Rai, kalla hi mire tchawe. O Dewel his mange jaake latcho, kai das lo man kal tchawe.”
Kanna wan kol dui budepangre pengre tchawentsa glan un tchiwan pen tele glan o Esau.
Ninna i Lea peskre tchawentsa was glan un tchiwas pes tele glan o Esau. Pal halauterende wan o Josef un i Rachel un tchiwan pen tele glan o Esau.
“Hoi kameh tu kol tsele viechentsa, hoi pash mande wan?” putchas o Esau. “Kamau te dap len tute, te wess mange latcho, miro rai”, penas o Jakob.
“Man hi doha, miro phraal”, penas o Esau. “Rike kowa, hoi tiro hi.”
“Na-a”, penas o Jakob. “Mangau tut: Te hal mange latcho, le mandar kowa, hoi me tut dau dran mire wasta. Me dikom an tiro mui, har te dikap an o Debleskro mui, jaake kamlo dikal ap mande.
Le kowa, hoi tuke bitchrom. O Dewel das man halauter. Un man hi doha.” Un job mukas gar tele te mangell lo les, bis te las o Esau kowa.
Un o Esau penas: “Djas mer dureder! Me djau glan tute.”
Penas o Jakob: “Miro rai, tu djineh, kai i tchawe tikno hi. Pash mande hi ninna grumja un bakre, kai len terne hi. Te nashens jon hunte jek diwes sik, merans i tsele vieche.
Miro rai, dja tuke glan win. Un me djau i viechentsa un i tchawentsa pal tute, jaake sik har djala, bis te wau pash tute, miro rai, an o them Seir.”
Penas o Esau ap leste: “Me kamau mire murshendar pash tute mukell.” “Hoske?” putchas o Jakob. “Mange hi doha, kai tu, miro rai, mange latcho hal.”
Jaake kras pes o Esau ko diwes pale ap o drom an o them Seir.
Un o Jakob djas dureder an Sukkot, kras peske i kheer un khera i viechenge. Doleske das lo koi platsa ko lab Sukkot.
Pal kowa was o Jakob mishto pash o foro Sichem, kai an o them Kanaan tchiddo hi. Kate atchas lo, har job dran o them Paddan-Aram was, un tchiwas peskre plachtene khera pre glan o foro.
Un ginas ko kotar phub, kai leskro plachteno kheer tardo his, un das sheel rupene kotja i tchawende ko murshestar Hamor. Leskro tchawo hi o Sichem.
Kote kras o Jakob i chatchepaskri o Debleske, te wenn vieche leske chatchedo, un das koi chatchepaskri ko lab ‘O Dewel hi o Israeleskro Dewel’.
Un i Dina, koi tchai, hoi i Lea o Jakobeske ap i phub anas, djas win te dikell li i djuwjen an ko them.
Koi dikas lat o Sichem, koleskro dad o Hiwari Hamor his. O Hamor his o rai pral ko them. Un o Sichem tapras lat i sorjah un tchiwas pes pash late.
Un job kamas lat o djijestar un rakras latche labentsa ap late.
Ap peskro dadeste penas job: “Le mange koi tchai, te romedinerap lat.”
Har o Jakob shunas, kai leskri tchai an-tapedo was i sorjah, kras lo tchi, bis te leskre tchawe khere wan. Kolla his leskre viechentsa win ap o them.
Un o Sichemeskro dad, o Hamor, was win pash o Jakobeste, te rakrell lo leha.

Har o Jakobeskre tchawe khere wan un shunan, hoi o Sichem kras, dukas kowa len an o dji un len was i bari choli pral o Sichem. Job kras tchomone, hoi te well gar kerdo un anas bari ladj pral o Israel.
Un o Hamor rakras o Jakobeha un leskre tchawentsa un penas: “Miro tchawo Sichem kamell tumari phenjat o djijestar. Denn lat leste te romedinerell lo lat!
Un mer tchiwah men khetne. Denn men tumare tchen! Un lenn tumenge mare tchen!
Un djiwenn pash mende! Kau them hi ninna tumenge. Atchenn kai! Un djan trujel parepaske un krenn tumenge khera!”
Un o Sichem penas ap o Jakobeste un ap leskre tchawende: “Awenn mange latcho un penenn mange, hoi te dap tumen! Me dau tumen, hoi tumer mandar kamenna.
Mangenn mandar bud. Me plaissrau, hoi mangenn mandar. Denn man koi tchat, te romedinerap lat!”
Koi rakran o Jakobeskre tchawe chochepah kol dui murshentsa, o Sichem un leskro dadeha Hamor doleske, kai tapras o Sichem lengri phenjat i sorjah an. Un jon penan:
“Mer krah nai kowa gar, te das mari phenjat i romeste, kai gar tchinlo hi. Kowa wals menge i bari ladj.
Te wenn tumer har mer, jaake te well hako mursh pash tumende tchinlo, palle krah mer, hoi tumer kamenna.
Mer dah tumen mare tchen un lah menge tumare tchen, un djiwah pash tumende, jaake kai well jek natsjona dran mende un tumende.
Te shunenn gar ap mende un kamenn tumen gar tchinell mukell, lah mer mari pheen un djah menge.”
Hoi jon koi penan his mishto glan o Hamor un leskro tchawestar Sichem.
Un ko terno mursh Sichem nashras kek tsiro, te krell lo kowa. Job kamas koi tcha. Un leskre tsele menshe an leskro dadeskro kheer shunan ap leste.

Un o Hamor un leskro tchawo Sichem djan an o baro wudar lengro forestar, te rakrenn le i murshentsa an ko foro un penan ap lende: “Kal mursha kamenn kek tchingepen mentsa. Doleske mu atchenn le an kau them, te djan le trujel parepaske. Hi doha platsa koi. Un mer kamah lengre tchen te romedinerell. Un mer dah len mare tchen.
Kowa hi, hoi te kras mer: Jon kamenn, te tchinas mer hako murshes mendar, jaake har jon tchinlo hi. Te krah kowa, kamenn jon ap mende shunell un atchenn pash mende un wenn jek natsjona mentsa.
Lengre vieche, lengro brawlepen un lauter, hoi len hi, well maro! Kras, hoi jon kamenna, te atchenn le pash mende!”
Un kolla lauter, kai djan an o foro dren un win, shunan ap o Hamor un ap o Sichem, leskro tchaweste. Un hako mursh an ko foro was tchinlo.

O triinto diwes, har len duka his, lan dui tchawe o Jakobestar, o Simeon un o Levi, i Dinakre phrala, hakeno peskro charo un wan an ko foro, har kek jak das. Un jon maran i tsele murshen pengre charentsa,
ninna o Hamor un leskro tchawes Sichem. Dran leskro kheer lan le i Dina peha un djan penge.
Palle tchoran o Jakobeskre tchawe kol mulendar an ko foro, kai lengri pheen i sorjah an-tapedo was.
Lengre bakre, lengre grumja, lengre burike un halauter, hoi an o foro un glan o foro his, lan le penge.
Lengro tselo brawlepen un lengre tsele tchawen un djuwjen lan le penge. Ninna tchoran le halauter, hoi an i khera his.

Koi penas o Jakob ap o Simeon un ap o Levi: “Tumer anan bibacht un ladj ap mande pash kolende, kai djiwenn an kau them: pash i Kanaanitarja un i Perisarja. Mer ham gar bud menshe. Te wenn jon lauter khetne un perenn pral mende, denn le men mulo. Un me merau miri tseli familjah.”
Penan kol dui ap leste: “Job las mari phenjat, har te wals joi i lubni. Un mer te kras tchi?”

Un o Dewel penas ap o Jakobeste: “Kre tut ap o drom, dja an o foro Betel! Atch kote un kre kote i chatchepaskri, te chatchress mange viechen. Me hom ko Dewel, kai mukas pes tutar te dikell, har tu tiro phralestar Esau krik nashal.”

Koi penas o Jakob ap peskri familja un ap lauterende, kai pash leste his: “Tchiwenn tumendar krik kol deblen dran barra un kashta, hoi tumer an-mangenna! Thowenn tumen un riwenn tumen djudje ripja an!
Awenn, djas an o foro Betel. Kote krau i chatchepaskri o Debleske, kai shunas man ap ko diwes, kai an i bibacht homs. Ko Dewel his pash mande ap miro drom bis kanna.”
Un jon dan o Jakobeste pengre tsele deblen dran barra un kashta, hoi jon an-mangan, un i tsele kanengre, hoi an lengre kanda his. Un o Jakob paskras len tel o baro ruk pash o foro Sichem.
Un jon kran pen ap o drom. Un o Dewel tchiwas i daar ap kol menshende, kai djiwan an i forja trul lende. Un kolla lan len gar palla.
Jaake was o Jakob lauterentsa, kai pash leste his, an o them Kanaan an o foro Lus. Ko foro kharell kanna Betel.

Har o Jakob peskro phralestar krik nashas, mukas pes o Dewel kote lestar te dikell. Doleske kras job kote i chatchepaskri o Debleske, kai wenn vieche leske chatchedo. Un das koi platsa ko lab ‘El-Betel’.

Kote meras i Debora, koi djuwel, kai das garda ap i Rebekka, har his joi tikno. Un i Debora was paskedo tel ko baro ruk, kai pash o foro Betel tardo his. Un o Jakob das kol rukes o lab ‘ropaskro ruk’.
Har o Jakob dran o them Paddan-Aram an o foro Betel was, mukas pes o Dewel pale lestar te dikell un rakras latche laba pral leste win.
Un penas: “Tu khareh Jakob. Kanna khareh tu buder gar Jakob. Kanna well tiro lab Israel.” Jaake las o Jakob ko lab Israel.

Un o Dewel penas ap leste: “Me hom o sorelo Dewel. Me dau tut bud tchawe. Jaake bud menshe wenna tutar, kai lendar jek bari natsjona un bud wawar natsjone wenna. Ninna bare raja hi mank tire menshende.
Un ko them, hoi dom o Abrahameste un o Isaakeste, dau tute ninna un tire menshende.”
Un o Dewel djas peske kotar, kai job o Jakobeha rakras.
Un ap koi platsa, kai o Dewel rakras leha, tchiwas o Jakob i bar pre. Un tchoras mool un djet koi pre o Debleske.
Un job das koi platsa ko lab Betel.
Pal kowa mukan le ko foro Betel un djan an o foro Efrata. Un ap o drom anas i Rachel i tchawes ap i phub. Un lat his bare duka.
Har lakre duka baro his, penas koi chatchepaskri gadji ap late: “Ma traash! Ninna kowa hi i mursh tchawo.”
I Rachel his ap o merepen tchiddo. Har joi meras, das joi kol tchawes ko lab Ben-Oni. Leskro dad das les ko lab Ben-Jamin.
Un i Rachel meras un was paskedo ap o drom pash o foro Efrata. Kowa hi kanna Betlehem.
Un o Jakob, kai kharella ninna Israel, tchiwas i bar pre kote, kai li paskedo hi. Kowa nashte well diklo bis kai diwes.
Un o Israel djas dureder un tchiwas peskro plachteno kheer pre wergel koi platsa Migdal-Eder.
An ko tsiro har o Israel an ko them djiwas, djas o Ruben pash o Jakobeskri wawar romjate, i Bilha, un tchiwas pes pash late. Un o Jakob shunas kowa. O Jakobes his deesh-te-dui tchawe.
I tchawe, kolen i Lea ap i phub anas his o Ruben, ko phureder tchawo o Jakobestar. Pal leste was o Simeon, o Levi, o Juda, o Issachar un o Sebulon.
I tchawe, kolen i Rachel ap i phub anas his o Josef un o Benjamin.
I tchawe, kolen i Bilha ap i phub anas, his o Dan un o Naftali. I Bilha his koi budepaskretsa, kai his i Rachelake koi.
I tchawe, kolen i Silpa ap i phub anas, his o Gad un o Asser. I Silpa his koi budepaskretsa, kai his i Leake koi. Kolla his o Jakobeskre tchawe, kai bolde wan an o them Paddan-Aram.
Un o Jakob was pash peskro dadeste Isaak an Mamre pash o foro Kirjat-Arba. Kowa hi kanna Hebron, kai ninna o Abraham un o Isaak djiwan.
Un o Isaak his 180 (sheel-te-ochta-deesh) bersh phuro.
Un job meras un was paskedo. Les his i lengsto djipen un meras an o mishto phurepen. Un leskre tchawe, o Esau un o Jakob, paskran les.
Kowa hi ko liil, kai tchinlo hi pral o Esau peskre tchawentsa. Job kharell ninna Edom.
O Esau las peske dui romjen dran o them Kanaan: i Ada, lakro dad hi o Elon, ko Hetari; un i Oholibama, lakro dad hi o Ana. Koleskro dad hi o Zibeon, ko Hiwari.
Leskri triinti romni his i Basmat, lakro dad hi o Ismael. Lakro phraal hi o Nebajot.
I Ada anas o Elifas ap i phub. I Basmat anas o Reguel ap i phub.
I Oholibama anas o Jehush ap i phub, ninna o Jalam un o Korach. Kolla hi i tchawe, kai o Esaeske bolde wan an o them Kanaan.

Un o Esau las peskre romjen un peskre tchawen un tchen un i tsele menshen, kai an leskro kheer his, ninna peskre bakren un peskre tsele viechen un halauter, hoi les was an o them Kanaan, un djas peske an i wawar them, un mukas peskro phrales Jakob.
Kowa, hoi kol dujen his, his jaake bud, kai nashte djiwenn le gar an jek them. An ko them his gar doha chapaske lengre bud viechenge.
Un o Esau, djiwas ap o pralstuno them, hoi kharella Seir. O Esau hi o Edom.
Kolla hi i laba kol menshendar, kai wenna pal o Esau. Jon hi i Edomarja, kai djiwan ap o pralstuno them Seir:
Kolla hi i laba o Esaeskre tchawendar: Elifas, ko tchawo leskri romjatar Ada; Reguel, ko tchawo leskri romjatar Basmat.
O Elifas las tchawe. Kolla his: o Teman, o Omar, o Zefo un o Gatam un o Kenas.
O Elifas, les his i duiti romni. Lakro lab hi Timna. Joi anas o Amalek ap i phub. Kolendar lauterendar hi o Esaeskri romni Ada i mami.
Ninna o Reguel las tchawe: Kolla his: o Nahat un o Serach, o Shamma un o Missa. Lengri mami hi o Esaeskri romni Basmat.
Un kolla hi i tchawe o Esaeskri romjatar Oholibama: o Jehush, o Jalam, o Korach. I Oholibama hi i tchai ko murshestar Ana, leskro dad hi o Zibeon.

Un kolla hi i raja, kai wenna o Esaeskre tchawendar: Leskro phureder tchawestar, o Elifas, wenna o rai Teman, o rai Omar, o rai Zefo, o rai Kenas, o rai Korach, o rai Gatam, o rai Amalek. Kolla hi i raja, kai wenna pal o Elifas an o them Edom. Lengri mami hi i Ada.

Un kolla hi i raja, kai wenna o Esaeskro tchawestar Reguel: o rai Nahat, o rai Serach, o rai Shamma, o rai Missa. Kolla hi i raja, kai wenna pal o Reguel an o them Edom. Lengri mami hi o Esaeskri romni Basmat.
Un kolla hi i tchawe o Esaeskri romjatar Oholibama: o rai Jehush, o rai Jalam un o rai Korach. Kolla hi i raja, kolengri dai o Esaeskri romni Oholibama hi, kolakro dad o Ana hi.
Kol tsele menshe un lengre raja wenna pal o Esau. Jon khetne hi i Edomarja.

Har was o Esau peskre tchawentsa un lengre familje an ko them Edom, djiwan kote i Horarja. Lengro phuro dad his o Seir. Leskre tchawe his i raja pral i Horarja: o Lotan, o Shobal, o Zibon, o Ana, o Dishon, o Ezer un o Dishan.
O Lotan his o dad dui tchawendar: o Hori un o Hemam. O Lotanes his i pheen. Koja his i Timna.
O Shobal his o dad pantch tchawendar: o Alwan un o Manahat un o Ebal, o Shefi un o Onam.
O Zibon his o dad dui tchawendar: o Aja un o Ana. Kowa hi ko Ana, kai hatsas o tato pani an o mulo them, har das lo jak ap i burike peskro dadestar Zibon.
O Ana his o dad i tchawestar un i tchatar. Leskro tchawo his o Dishon un leskri tchai his i Oholibama.
O Dishon his o dad star tchawendar: o Hemdan un o Eshban un o Jitran un o Keran.
O Ezer his o dad triin tchawendar: o Bilhan un o Saawan un o Akan.
O Dishan his o dad dui tchawendar: o Uz un o Aran.
Kolla hi i raja pral i Horarja an o them Seir: o rai Lotan, o rai Shobal, o rai Zibon, o rai Ana, o rai Dishon, o rai Ezer, o rai Dishan. Pal lende wan lengre menshe kharedo.
Un kolla hi i bare raja an o them Edom glan ko tsiro, har was i baro rai pral o them Israel:
O Bela his o baro rai pral o Edom. Leskro dad his o Beor. Un ko lab leskro forestar his Dinhaba.
Har o Bela meras, was o Jobab dran o foro Bozra o baro rai. Leskro dad his o Serach.
Har o Jobab meras, was o Husham o baro rai. Job his dran o them Teman.
Har o Husham meras, was o Hadad o baro rai. Leskro dad his o Bedad. Kowa kuras pes i Midianarja an o them Moab un das len. Un ko lab o forestar, kai o Hadad djiwas, his Awit.
Har o Hadad meras, was o Samla dran Masreka o baro rai.
Har o Samla meras, was o Shaul o baro rai. Job his dran Rechobot pash o lengsto pani Eufrat.
Har o Shaul meras, was o Baal-Hanan o baro rai. Leskro dad his o Akbor.

Har meras o Baal-Hanan, koleskro dad o Akbor his, was o Hadar o baro rai. Un ko lab peskro forestar his Pagu. Un ko lab peskri romjatar his Mehetabel. Lakri dai his i Matred, kolakro dad o Mesahab his.

Un kolla hi i laba kol rajendar, kai wenna pal o Esau. Pal lende wan pengre menshe kharedo. Ninna kol forja, kai djiwan le, lan lengro lab: o rai Timna, o rai Alwa, o rai Jetet, o rai Oholibama, o rai Ela, o rai Pinon, o rai Kenas, o rai Teman, o rai Mibzar, o rai Magdijel, o rai Iram. Kolla hi i raja pral i Edomarja an lengre forja an o them, kai lengro his. Lengro phuro dad hi o Esau. Lestar wenna i Edomarja.
O Jakob djiwas an ko them Kanaan, kai ninna leskro dad djiwas.

Kowa hi ko liil, kai tchinlo hi pral o Jakobeskre tchawende. O Josef, i terno mursh, – job his deesh-te-efta bersha phuro, – das jak ap i bakrende khetne peskre phralentsa. Kolla his i tchawe leskro dadeskre romjendar, i Bilha un i Silpa. Un te kran leskre phrala tchilatcho koowa, penas lo kowa pengro dadeske.
O Josef was boldo, har leskro dad Israel phuro his. Un o Israel kamas les budeder har peskre tsele wawar tchawen un kras leske i shukar ripen.
Har leskre phrala dikan, kai lengro dad les budeder kamas har len, wan le tchilatcho ap pengro phraleste un rakran nai buder gar latches leha.
Un o Josef das suni, un penas kowa peskre phralenge. Koi wan jon tchilatcheder ap leste.
“Shunenn, hoi dom suni”, penas lo ap lende.
“Mer pandam djob khetne ap i hachetikri phub. Un ap jek kopo stas miri djob pre un atchas tardo. Un tumari djob was un his trul miri djob tardo un witsras pes tele glan miri djob.”
Koi penan leskre phrala ap leste: “Kameh te wess rai pral mende? Kameh tchatchepah te wess o pralstuno mendar?” Un jon his leske budeder tchilatcho pral leskri suni un leskro rakepen.
Un job das i wawar suni un penas kowa peskre phralenge: “Shunenn, me dom i wawar suni. Kau kopo witsras pes o kham un o tchon un deesh-te-jek bolepangre momlia glan mande tele.”
Har job kowa peskro dadeske un peskre phralenge penas, tchingras leskro dad ap leste un penas: “Hoi dal tu suni? Hunte witsrap man me, tiri dai un tire phrala glan tute tele?”
Un leskre phrala dikan tchilatche jakentsa ap leste. Leskro dad rikras kol laba an peskro dji.
His i diwes, koi his leskre phrala ap o them pash o foro Sichem, te denn le garda ap pengro dadeskre bakrende.
Un o Israel penas ap o Josefeste: “Tire phrala denn garda ap i bakrende pash o foro Sichem. Kamau te bitchrap tut pash lende.” “Mishto”, penas o Josef, “me krau, hoi peneh.”
Koi penas o Israel: “Dja koi un dik, har lenge un i bakrenge djala. Un pen les mange!” Jaake bitchras job les dran o telstuno them Hebron. Un job was pash o foro Sichem.
Koi hatsas les i rom, har job ap o them trujel nashas. Un ko rom putchas lestar: “Hoi rodeh tu?”
“Me rodau mire phralen”, penas o Josef. “Pen mange, kai jon ap i bakrende garda denna!”
“Jon djan dureder”, penas ko rom. “Me shunom, har jon penan: ‘Mer kamah an Dotan te djal.’” Koi djas o Josef koi, kai leskre phrala hi un hatsas len an Dotan.
Har i phrala dikan, kai o Josef wella, lan jon penge glan, te denn le les mulo.
Jek penas ap o wawareste: “Kote well kowa, kai dell narwelo koowa suni.
Awenn, mer dah les mulo un witsrah les an i gruba un penah, kai i diwjo viecho les chas. Jaake dikah mer, hoi leskre sunja molenna.”
Har shunas o Ruben kowa, kamas job les win te lell dran lengre wasta, te well job gar maredo, un penas ap lende: “Mer dah les gar mulo!
Mukenn les djido! Witsrenn les an kai gruba, kai an o mulo them! Un krenn leske tchi!” Job penas kowa, te lell lo les win dran lengre wasta, te anell job les pale pash leskro dadeste.
Har o Josef pash pengre phralende was, riwan jon leskro ripen win – kowa shukar ripen, hoi ap leste his.
Un lan o Josefes un witsran les an i gruba. Koi his kek pani dren.
Palle beshan pen le tele un chan. Dur glan lende dikan le Ismaelarja. Kolla wan dran ko them Gilead un djan an o them Egiptia. Len his khamele. Kolla hidjran kutch rukengro djet, hoi sungella mishto.
Koi penas o Juda ap peskre phralende: “Hoi molell menge, te dah mer maro phrales mulo un anah doosh ap mende, te nashell leskro rat?
Awenn, mer bikrah les ap i Ismaelarja. Jaake mukah mer les djido. Job hi maro phraal un maro mass un rat.” Un jon shunan ap leste.

Har i parepangre dran o them Midian pashel wan, tserdan les o Josefeskre phrala dran i gruba win, un bikran les ap i Ismaelarja, un lan lendar biish rupene kotja. Un jon anan o Josefes an o them Egiptia.
Har was o Ruben pale pash i gruba un dikas, kai o Josef buder gar dren his, kras job peskre ripja paash i dukatar.
Un job was pale pash peskre phralende un penas: “Ko tchawo hi buder gar koi. Hoi krap me kanna?”
Koi lan jon o Josefeskro ripen, maran i busni un tchiwan ko ripen an o rat.
Palle bitchran le ko ripen lengro dadeske un mukan leske te penell: “Mer hatsam kowa. Dik, hi kowa gar o ripen tiro tchawestar?”
Un o Jakob prindjras ko ripen un penas: “Kowa hi miro tchaweskro ripen. I diwjo viecho dandras les an kotja un chas les pre.”
Un o Jakob kras peskre ripja paash i dukatar. Un tchiwas i gono trul peste un rowas i rah tsiro pral peskro tchaweste.

Un leskre tsele tchawe un tcha wan pash leste, te rakrenn le leha latches. Un job kamas gar, te well leskri duk krik lino. “Na-a” penas job, “miro dji rowella, bis te merau un wau pash miro tchaweste.” Jaake rowas leskro dad pral o Josefeste.

Un i parepangre dran o them Midian bikran o Josefes an o them Egiptia ap jekeste kol rajendar, kai an o baro rajeskro kheer hi. Leskro lab his Potifar. Job his o pralstuno kolendar, kai denn garda ap o baro rajeste pral o them Egiptia.
Ap ko tsiro mukas o Juda peskre phralen un djas tele pash i romeste dran Adullam. Leskro lab his Hira.
Kote dikas o Juda jek tchat i murshestar, kai kharas Shua. Kowa his i Kanaanitari. Un o Juda romedineras lat un was lah khetne.
Un joi was an wawar koowa un anas i tchawes ap i phub. Un job das les ko lab Er.
Un joi was pale an wawar koowa un anas i tchawes ap i phub. Un joi das les o lab Onan.
Un pale anas joi i tchawes ap i phub. Un joi das les o lab Shela. Ap ko tsiro, har ko tchawo boldo was, his o Juda an o foro Kesib.
Un o Juda das peskro phureder tchaweste, o Er, i romjat. Lakro lab his Tamar.
Un o Er his tchilatcho an o baro Debleskre jaka. Un o baro Dewel mukas les te merell.
Koi penas o Juda ap o Onan: “Ab khetne koi romjah tiro phralestar, te well tiro phrales i tchawo, har pash mende kowa jaake hi.”

O Onan djinas, kai kol tchawe gar leskre hi. Doleske kras job jaake, kai peskro phraleskri romni gar an wawar koowa wella, hako kopo har was lo lah khetne. Job kamas gar, te well i tchawo leskro phraleske boldo.
Un kowa, hoi job kras, his tchilatcho an o baro Debleskre jaka. Un job mukas les ninna te merell.

Koi penas o Juda ap i Tamar, peskro tchaweskri romjate: “Atch kokres an tiro dadeskro kheer, jaake rah bis te miro tchawo, o Shela, baro was.” O Juda penas peske: Te merell job gar har leskre phrala! Un i Tamar djas peske un atchas pash peskro dadeste.

Pal i rah tsiro meras i romni o Judaestar, kolakro dad o Shua hi. Un har o tsiro o ropaske trujel his, djas o Juda an o foro Timna pash peskre budepangre, kai tchinenn i bal i bakrendar. Leskro maal, o Hira dran Adullam, djas leha.
Un was penlo ap i Tamar: “Ake, tiro romeskro dad djal an o foro Timna, te tchinell job i bal peskre bakrendar.”

Joi djinas, kai o Shela baro was, un kai joi leste gar dino was, te well li leskri romni. Doleske riwas joi kanna kol ripja win, hoi i romni hidjrella, kolakro rom mulo hi. Un tchiwas i diklo pral peskro mui, jaake kai dikan le nai gar lakro mui. Un beshas pes pash o baro wudar glan o foro Enajim. Kowa hi tchiddo ap o drom an o foro Timna.
Un o Juda dikas lat un patsas, kai joi i lubni hi. Joi his pash o drom beshdo un lat his i diklo glan o mui.
Un job djas ap i rig pash late un penas: “Muk man pash tute te well!” Job djinas gar, kai joi leskro tchaweskri romni hi. Un joi penas: “Hoi deh man, te weh mantsa khetne?”
Penas job: “Bitchrau tuke i terni busni – i mursh.” “De man tchomone”, penas joi, “hoi me nai rikrau, bis te man koi busni deh.”

“Hoi dap tut?” putchas job. Koi penas joi: “Tiri gustri tiro labeha, un koi dori, kai i gustri pandlo hi, ninna tiro kasht, hoi an tiro wast hi.” Un job das kowa late un djas lah khetne. Un joi was lestar an wawar koowa.
Un joi djas khere un las peskro diklo tele. Un riwas kol ripja ap peste, kai i romni hidjrella, kolakro rom mulo hi.
Un o Juda bitchras peskro males, ko Adullamari pash late, un das les i terni busni peha lake, te lell job kowa latar pale, hoi o Juda lat das. Un job hatsas lat gar.
Koi putchas job i menshendar ko forestar: “Kai hi koi lubni, kai pash o foro Enajim ap o drom his?” Un jon penan: “Kek lubni his kai.”
Un job djas pale pale pash o Juda un penas: “Hatsau lat gar. Ninna i menshe kote penan: Kek lubni his kai.”
Koi penas o Juda: “Joi nai rikrell kowa, hoi me lat dom. Te rodah mer lat dureder, rakrenn i menshe pral mande. Mer kram, hoi nashte kram. Me bitchrom lake koi busni, un tu hatsal lat gar.”
Pal triin tchon was o Judaeske penlo: “I Tamar, tiro tchaweskri romni lubras pes trujel, un joi hi an wawar koowa.” Koi penas o Juda: “Anenn lat win, te well li pre chatchedo.”
Har joi win anlo was, mukas joi lakro romeskro dadeske te penell: “Ko murshestar hom me an o wawar koowa, koneske kawa hi. Prindjreh tu, koneskri gustri un dori un kasht kowa hi?”
Un o Juda prindjras kowa un penas: “Joi hi feteder an o tchatchepen tardo har me. Me dom lat gar miro tchaweste Shela. Doleske kras joi kowa.” O Juda was buder gar khetne lah.
Un joi las dui tchawe.
Un har jon boldo wan, tchiwas jek peskro wast win. Un i chatchedi gadji pandas i loli dori trujel un penas: “Kowa was glan peskro phraleste win.”
Un har job peskro wast pale tserdas, was leskro phraal win. Un joi penas: “Tu wal sorjah win.” Un leske was o lab Perez dino.
Un pal leste was leskro phraal win, kowa kai koi loli dori trul leskro wast his. Un jon dan les o lab Serach.

I Ismaelarja anan o Josefes an o them Egiptia. Kote ginas les lendar i Egiptari. Leskro lab his Potifar. Kowa his jek kol rajendar, kai an o kheer o baro rajestar pral o them Egiptia hi. Job his ninna o pralstuno i lurdendar, kai denn garda ap o baro rajeste.
Un o baro Dewel his pash o Josefeste. Lauter, hoi job kras, his mishto. Un job atchas an o kheer peskro egiptikro rajestar.
Har leskro rai Potifar dikas, kai o baro Dewel pash o Josefeste his un les bacht das an lauter, hoi job peskre wastentsa kras, his job latches ap leste.
Un job mukas o Josefes peske budrell un tchiwas les pral peskro kheer un das lauter, hoi leskro his, an o Josefeskro wast.

Ap ko tsiro, har o Egiptari Potifar das peskro kheer un halauter, hoi leskro his, an o Josefeskre wasta, tchiwas o baro Dewel peskri soor un peskri bacht ap i menshende an o Potifareskro kheer. Jaake rah har o Josef koi his, his o baro Debleskri soor un peskri bacht ap halauter, hoi les his an o kheer un ap o them.
Jaake mukas o Potifar halauter, hoi les his, an o Josefeskro wast un dikas ap tchi, kokres ap peskro chapen. Un o Josef his i shukar un railo mursh.
Ko diwes was, kai leskro rajeskri romni kamas les un penas: “Tchip tut pash mande!”
Job kamas kowa gar un penas ap late: “Dik, miro rai dikell ap tchi an peskro kheer, jaake rah har me koi hom. Lauter krau me. Un hoi les hi, das job an miro wast.
Kek hi bareder an kau kheer har me. Un miro rai rikras tchi peske har tut kokres. Tu hal leskri romni. Har nai anau hawi bari doosh ap mande, te krap kowa, hoi o Dewel gar kamella?”
Jek diwes pal o wawar was joi kol labentsa. Un job shunas gar ap late un tchiwas pes gar pash late. Witar gar kamas job pash late te well.
Ap jek diwes, har job an o kheer was, te krell lo peskri budi, his kek wawar budepaskro koi.
Koi tapras joi les ap leskro ripen un penas: “Tchip tut pash mande!” Koi mukas job peskro ripen an lakro wast un nashas dran o kheer win.
Har joi dikas, kai mukas job peskro ripen an lakro wast un nashas peske, kharas joi i budepangre an lakro kheer.
“Dikenn”, penas joi ap lende, “ko Hebreari, koles miro rom anas pash mende, kamell te krell lo dinelo koowa mentsa. Job was, te tchiwell lo pes pash mande. Un me dom bari gole.
Un har job shunas, kai dom bari gole, mukas job peskro ripen pash mande un nashas peske.”
Un joi rikras leskro ripen pash peste, bis te o Josefeskro rai khere was.
Ninna ap leste penas joi kol laba: “Ko Hebreari, koles anal pash mende, was pash mande, te krell job dinelo koowa mantsa.
Har dom bari gole, mukas job peskro ripen pash mande un nashas peske.”
Har o Potifar kol laba peskri romjatar shunas, har joi penas ‘jaake kras tiro budepaskro mantsa’, was job an i bari choli.
Un job las o Josefes un tchiwas les an o stilepen, kote, kai i stilde o baro rajestar stildo his.
Har job kote an o stilepen his, his o baro Dewel pash leste, un his kamlo ap leste un kras, kai hi o pralstuno pral o stilepen latches ap leste.
Un o pralstuno pral o stilepen das i tsele stilden an o Josefeskro wast. Un les his penepaske pral i tseli budi.
Jaake rah, har lauter an o Josefeskro wast his, hunte kras o pralstuno pral o stilepen tchi. O baro Dewel his pash o Josefeste un das les bacht an halauter, hoi job kras.
Pal ko tsiro anan dui pralstune budepangre an o baro rajeskro kheer doosh ap pende. Kol dui his i pralstune pral o pipen un o pral o maro.
Un o baro rai was an i bari choli pral kol dujende,
un tchiwas len stildo an ko kheer o pralstunestar i lurdendar. An ko stilepen his ninna o Josef.
Un ko pralstuno lurdo bitchras lenge o Josefes, te well job lenge koi. Un jon his i tsiro an o stilepen.
Jek rati dan kol dui suni, o pralstuno pral o pipen un o pralstuno pral o maro. Hakeno das suni. Un koi suni kamas lenge tchomone te penell.
Taissarlakro was o Josef pash lende un dikas, kai djal lenge gar mishto.
Koi putchas job kol dujendar: “Hoske djal tumenge gar mishto?”
Penan jon ap leste: “Mer dam suni. Un kek hi koi, kai penell nashte, hoi mare sunja menge penenna.” Penas o Josef ap lende: “O Dewel penell nai, hoi kol sunja penenna. Penenn tumare sunja mange!”
Koi penas o pralstuno pral o pipen peskri suni o Josefeske un penas: “An miri suni dikom i drakengro ruk glan mande tardo.
Ap ko drakengro ruk his triin kashta. Kolla wan senelo un lan blume. Un jaake sik har blume koi his, djan le pre un drake wan baro ap lende.
Man his o baro rajeskro khoro an miro wast, tchiwom i mool dran kol drake an o baro rajeskro khoro, un dom les o baro rajeste te pijell.”
Un o Josef penas ap leste: Kai suni penella: “Kol triin drakengre kashta hi triin diwessa.
An triin diwessa mukell tut o baro rai dran o stilepen win un dell tut pale tiri budi. Un tu deh o baro rajeste pale te pijell, jaake har tu kral, har tu o pralstuno pral leskro pipen hals.”
O Josef penas dureder: “Te djal tuke mishto, biste man gar! Rake mange latcho pash o baro rajeste! Un an man dran kau kheer win!
Hom tchoredo dran o them, kai djiwenn i Hebrearja. Un kate krom me witar tchi, kai hunte djap an o stilepen.”
Har o pralstuno pral o maro dikas, kai kowa latcho his, hoi ko wawar suni das, penas job ap o Josefeste: “Me dom ninna suni: Ap miro shero his triin tchare pherdo mare.
An o pralstuno kashteno tcharo his lauter latcho peklo koowa o baro rajeske. Un tchirkle wan un chan lauter dran o tcharo ap miro shero krik.”
Penas o Josef: “Kai suni penell menge: Kol triin tchare hi triin diwessa.
An triin diwessa mukell tut o baro rai dran o stilepen win un bladell tut ap i kasht. Un i tchirkle chan tiro mass tutar krik.”

Ap o triinto diwes his o diwes, kai was o baro rai i bersh phureder. Un job kras i baro chapen kol tsele pralstunenge, kai leske budran, un mukas kol dujen, ko pralstunes pral o pipen un o pralstunes pral o maro, dran o stilepen win.
