Un job das o pralstunes pral o pipen pale leskri budi, te dell job o baro rajes pale te pijell.
Un o pralstunes pral o maro mukas job te bladell ap i kasht, jaake har o Josef lenge glan-wi penas.
Un o pralstuno pral o pipen bistras o Josefes. Un job was leske buder gar an o shero.
Pal dui bersha das o baro rai suni: An i suni dikas pes job tardo pash o pani Nil.
Dran o pani Nil wan efta shukar un thulle grumja win. Kolla chan o senlepen pash o pani.
Pal i tsiro wan pal lende efta wawar grumja dran o pani win. Kolla his djungelo. Len his kek thullo mass. Un jon his tardo pash kol shukar grumja pash o pani.
Un kol djungele grumja, kai gar thullo his, chan kol shukar un thulle grumjen. Un o baro rai djangras pre.
Un job sowas pale dren un das i duito kopo suni: An i suni dikas job efta halme, hoi hidjrenn djob. Kolla wan dran jek halmo win. Jon hi pesso un sasto.
Pal lende wan efta wawar halme dran i phub win. Kolla hidjrenn djob, hoi hi gar pesso. I tato ducho, hoi phurdas dran o mulo tato them, kras len truk.
Un kol halme, kai gar pesso his, chan kol efta wawar pre, kai pesso un pherdo djob his. Un o baro rai djangras pre un haiwas, kai job suni das.

Taissarlakro daras job. Un job mukas i tsele durkepangre un gosewe an o them Egiptia te kharell. Un o baro rai penas lenge, hoi job suni das. Un kek his koi, kai penell nashte, hoi koi suni leske penella.
Koi penas o pralstuno pral o pipen ap o baro rajeste: “Kau diwes well mange miri doosh an miro shero.
O baro rajes his i bari choli ap mande un ap o pralstuno pral o maro un tchiwas men stildo an o kheer o pralstuno lurdestar.
Mer dui dam suni an jek rati. Koi suni penas menge, hoi wella.
Un kote his pash mende i terno mursh, i Hebreari. Kowa his i budepaskro kol pralstuno lurdestar. Leske penam, hoi suni dam. Un job penas hakeneske mendar, hoi koi suni penella.
Un jaake har job penas, jaake was kowa. Man das o baro rai pale miri budi. Un o wawares mukas job ap i kasht te bladell.”
Koi bitchras o baro rai jekes, te kharell job o Josefes. Un jon mukan les sik dran o stilepen win. Un job tchinas peskri tchor tele, riwas newe ripja ap peste un was pash o baro rajeste.
Un o baro rai penas ap o Josefeste: “Me dom suni. Un kek hi koi, kai penell nai, hoi miri suni penella. Tutar penan jon mange: Te shuneh i suni, peneh nai, hoi i suni penella.”
Koi penas o Josef ap o baro rajeste: “Me nai krau kowa gar. O Dewel penella, hoi o baro rajeske mishto hi.”
Koi penas o baro rai ap o Josefeste: “An miri suni hom tardo pash o pani Nil.
Un dikom, kai wan dran o pani efta thulle un shukar grumja win. Kolla chan o senlepen pash o pani.
Pal lende wan efta wawar grumja dran o pani win. Kolla his gar thullo. Jon his djungelo un sano. An o tselo them Egiptia dikom kek djungleder grumjen har kolla.
Un kol sane djungele grumja chan kol efta thulle grumjen.
Un har jon len pre chan, dikan jon win, har te chans le len gar. Jon atchan djungeles, har jon his. Koi djangrom pre.
Dom pale suni un dikom efta halme, hoi hidjrenn djob. Kolla wan dran jek halmo win un his pesso un sasto.
Pal lende wan efta wawar halme dran i phub win. Kolla hidjran djob, hoi his gar pesso. I tato ducho, hoi phurdas dran o mulo tato them, kras len sano un truk.
Un kol sane halme chan kol efta pesse halme. Un me penom kowa, hoi dom suni, kol durkepangre. Un kek his koi, kai penell nashte mange, hoi kol sunja mange penenna.”
O Josef penas ap o baro rajeste: “O baro rajeskre dui sunja hi jek suni. Hoi o Dewel kamell te krell, sikras job tute.
Kol efta shukar grumja hi efta bersha. Un kol efta shukar halme mit djob hi ninna efta bersha. Kowa hi jek suni.
Un kol efta sane un djungele grumja, kai djan pal lende dran o pani win, hi efta bersha. Jaake hi ninna kol efta halme, hoi hi sano un truk, efta bersha, kai bokenn le.
Hi jaake har penom tuke: O Dewel sikrell tute, hoi kamell lo te krell.
Efta latche bersha wenna, kai hi bud chapen an o tselo them Egiptia.
Un pal kowa wenna efta bersha, kai bokenn le. Ko bud latcho chapen, hoi len his, wella bistedo an o them Egiptia. Jaake baro well koi bok an o them.
Lauter bistrenn ko tsiro, kai bud chapen koi his. Jaake baro well i bok koi pal.
Kai o baro rai das kowa dui kope suni, penell menge, te krell o Dewel kowa tchatchepah, un te krell lo les sik.
Kanna mu rodell o baro rai i gosewo murshes, te lell lo o tselo them Egiptia an o wast.
Mu tchiwell job ninna pralstunen pral o them, te lenn le o pantchto kotar ko djobestar an kal efta latche bersha, kai wenna.
Un tchiwenn ko djob khetne un anenn les an i forja. Un o baro rai mu dell garda, kai kowa jaake kerdo wella.
Ko djob hi i menshenge un i viechenge, te merenn le gar i bokatar an kol efta bersha, kai hi tchi te chal an o them Egiptia.”
Un ko lab his mishto o baro rajeske un leskre tsele pralstune budepangre.
Un o baro rai putchas peskre pralstune budepangrendar: “Nai hatsah mer i mursh har kawa, kai o goswepen o Deblestar an leste hi?”
Ap o Josefeste penas o baro rai: “O Dewel sikras tute kau tselo koowa. Kekes hi jaake bud goswepen har tut.
Tu wess rai pral miro baro kheer. I tsele menshe an miro them hunte krenn kowa, hoi tu peneh. Me kokres hom bareder har tu un atchau baro rai pral o them Egiptia.”
Un o baro rai penas dureder ap o Josefeste: “Me dau o tselo them Egiptia an tire wasta.”
Un o baro rai las peskri gustri peskro wastestar un tchiwas les ap o Josefeskro wast. Un das les ripja dran shukar laintikro than. Ninna tchiwas lo i sonakaskri werkli trul leskri meen.
Un mukas les te ulerell ap o duito wurdin. Glan leste dan le win gole: “Witsrenn tumen tele glan leste!” Jaake das o baro rai o tselo them Egiptia an o Josefeskre wasta.
Un o baro rai penas ap o Josefeste: “Ninna te hom me o baro rai pral o them Egiptia, nai hadell kek mensho an o tselo them Egiptia peskro wast un peskre pire pre, te kameh tu kowa gar.”
Un o baro rai das o Josefes o lab ‘Zafenat-Paneach’. Ninna das job les i romni, i Asnat. Lakro dad his o Potifera. Kowa his o rashai an o foro On. Jaake las o Josef i soor pral o tselo them Egiptia.
O Josef his 30 (trijanda) bersha phuro, har das les o baro rai pral Egiptia koi budi. Un o Josef djas peske o baro rajestar un djas an o them Egiptia trujel.
Un o them das bud djob an kol efta latche bersha.
Un o Josef tchiwas ap i rig ko bud djobestar, hoi len his an kol efta latche bersha an ko them Egiptia. Un anas kowa an i forja, – hako kopo an i foro, hoi gar dur his.
Un o Josef tchiwas bud djob khetne, jaake bud har i tikne barra pash o baro pani. Un jon mukan tele, te tchinell an i liil, har bud kowa his.
Glan ko tsiro, kai i bok pral o them was, wan o Josefeske dui mursh tchawe boldo. Lengri dai his i Asnat, kolakro dad o rashai Potifera an o foro On his.
Un o Josef das o phureder tchawes ko lab Manasse un penas: O Dewel kras te bistrap miri tseli bibacht un mire tsele menshen.
Un o duito tchawes das job ko lab Efrajim un penas: O Dewel das man tchawen an o them, kai djas mange gar mishto.
Un kol efta brawele bersha djan trujel an o them Egiptia.
Un palle wan kol bersha, kai bokenn le, jaake har o Josef penas. Un an i tsele themma bokan le. Kokres an o them Egiptia his doha chapaske.
Har i bok ninna an o them Egiptia was, dan i Egiptarja gole ap o baro rajeste, te dell job len te chal. Koi penas o baro rai ap lende: “Djan pash o Josefeste! Krenn, hoi job tumenge penella!”
Un i bok was bareder. An o tselo them his i menshen gar doha te chal. Koi kras o Josef i wudja pre an kol tsele khera, kai djob dren hi. Un bikras o djob ap i Egiptarja.
Ninna dran i tsele wawar themma wan i menshe pash o Josefeste an o them Egiptia, te ginenn le djob. Jaake baro his i bok an i tsele themma.
Har o Jakob shunas, kai hi djob an o them Egiptia, penas job ap peskre tchawende: “Hoske krenn tumer tchi?
Shunom, koi hi djob an o them Egiptia. Djan koi un ginenn menge djob, te djiwas mer un meras gar!”
Un o Josefeskre deesh phrala djan, te ginenn le djob an o them Egiptia.
O Benjamin, o Josefeskro terneder phraal, djas gar lentsa. O Jakob kamas gar, te djal job peskre phralentsa. Job penas: “Te taprell les kek bibacht!”
Un har i bok baro was an o them Kanaan, djan ninna wawar an o them Egiptia, te ginenn le djob. Lentsa khetne wan o Jakobeskre tchawe an o them Egiptia.
Un o Josef his o rai pral o them Egiptia un bikras djob ap kol menshende an ko them. Har leskre phrala wan, witsran pen le tele glan leste o mujeha ap i phub.
O Josef dikas peskre phralen un prindjras len. Un job kras, har te prindjrell lo len gar, un rakras soreles ap lende un penas: “Kai wenn tumer?” Penan jon: “Dran o them Kanaan, te ginas djob.”
O Josef prindjras peskre phralen, jon prindjran les gar.
Un kowa, hoi job lendar suni das, was an leskro shero. Un job penas ap lende: “Tumer han phukepangre un kamenn te dikenn, har sorelo o them hi. Dran kowa han tumer kai.”
Penan jon ap leste: “Na-a, miro rai. Mer wam te ginas menge djob.
Mer halauter ham i tchawe jek romestar. Mer djah i tchatcho drom. Mer ham kek phukepangre, kai kamenn te dikell, har sorelo tumaro them hi.”
“Na-a”, penas o Josef. “Tumer wan te dikenn, har sorelo maro them hi.”
Penan jon: “Miro rai, deesh-te-dui phrala ham mer. Ham tchawe jek romestar an o them Kanaan. O terneder hi kanna pash maro dadeste. Un jek hi buder gar koi.”
Penas o Josef ap lende: “Kowa hi jaake, har me penom: Tumer han phukepangre.
Ap kowa kamau te dikell, kai penenn tumer o tchatchepen: Te well tumaro terneder phraal kate! Pash o djipen o baro rajestar dau man sowel: Te well lo gar, wenn tumer gar buder krik.

Bitchrenn jekes tumendar, te lell lo tumaro terneder phrales. Tumer wawar atchenn an o stilepen. Jaake dikau me, kai tumare laba tchatcho hi. Pash o djipen o baro rajestar! Te chochran man, djinau, kai han phukepangre.”
Un job tchiwas len an o stilepen. Koi atchan jon triin diwessa.
Ap o triinto diwes penas o Josef ap lende: “Te krenn tumer, hoi penau, atchenn tumer djido. Me darau o Deblestar.
Te penenn tumer o tchatchepen, palle mukenn jek tumendar kate an o stilepen. Tumer wawar djan khere un lenn tumenge doha djob khere tumare menshenge un viechenge!
Anenn tumaro terneder phrales pash mande! Koi pre dikau me, kai tumare laba tchatcho hi. Un tumer merenna gar.” Un jon penan: “Mishto, kowa krah mer.”

Un jek penas ap o wawareste: “Tchatchepah, kanna lah koi phagi, hoi mer maro phraleske kram. Mer dikam leskri daar, hoi les his, har job men mangas, te mukas les te djiwell. Un mer shunam gar ap leste. Dran kowa well koi bibacht pral mende.”
Un o Ruben penas ap lende: “Penom me gar ap tumende: Ma krenn tchilatchepen o tchaweske? Tumer shunan gar. Kanna well leskro rat ap mende.”
Jon djinan gar, kai o Josef lengro rakepen haiwas. Job rakras lentsa an o egiptikro rakepen. Un i wawar penas lenge, hoi job penas.
Har o Josef kanna lengre laba shunas, rissras pes lo lendar krik un rowas. Koi pal was job pale, te rakrell lo lentsa. Un job mukas o Simeones te pandell glan lengre jaka.
Un o Josef penas ap peskre budepangre, te krenn le lengre gone pherdo djob, un te denn le len lengre lowe pale, – hakeneske an leskro gono, un te denn le len chapen ap o drom. Kowa kran jon.
Un o Jakobeskre tchawe tchiwan ko djob ap pengre burike un djan penge.
Ap koi platsa, kai jon i rati atchan, kras jek lendar peskro gono pre, te dell lo leskri burika te chal. Un job dikas, kai kol lowe an leskro gono hi.
Koi penas job ap peskre phralende: “Mire lowe hi an miro gono!” Koi lan jon traash. Un jon dikan pen darenes an un penan: “Hoske kras o Dewel kowa mentsa?”
Un jon wan an o them Kanaan pash pengro dadeste Jakob un penan leske halauter, hoi lenge djas un penan:
“Ko rom, kai hi o rai pral o them Egiptia, rakras soreles mentsa un kras, har te wams phukepangre, kai kamenn te dikenn, har sorelo leskro them hi.
Un mer penam ap leste: Mer djah i tchatcho drom. Mer ham kek phukepangre.
Ham deesh-te-dui phrala, kol tchawe jek dadestar. Jek hi buder gar koi. Un ko terneder hi kanna pash maro dadeste an o them Kanaan.

Un ko rom, kai hi o rai pral o them Egiptia, penas ap mende: ‘Ap kowa dikau, kai tumer o tchatchepen penenna: Jek tumare phralendar mukenn pash mande. Un tumer wawar lenn doha chapen tumare familjenge un djan tumenge.
Un anenn tumaro terneder phrales pash mande! Ap kowa dikau, kai chochenn gar, un kai han kek phukepangre. Jaake dau tumen tumaro phrales pale. Un tumer nai parenn an kau them.’”
Har tchoran kol phrala pengre gone win, hatsas hakeno peskre lowe an peskro gono! Har jon un lengro dad kol lowe dikan, was len daar.

Un lengro dad, o Jakob, penas ap lende: “Tumer tchoran mire tchawen mandar: O Josef hi buder gar koi. Un o Simeon hi buder gar koi. Un o Benjamines kamenn tumer ninna mandar te lell. Kowa lauter well ap mande!”
Koi penas o Ruben ap peskro dadeste: “Te dau me les tute gar pale, nai mareh tu mire dui tchawen. Tu deh les an mire wasta un me dau les tute pale.”

“Na-a”, penas o Jakob. “Miro tchawo djal gar tumentsa! Leskro phraal hi mulo. Un job kokres atchas mange leskri datar i Rachel. Me hom i phuro rom. Te taprels les i bibacht ap o drom, meraus i bari dukatar.”
Un i bok his baro an o them.
Har jon o tselo djob pre chan, hoi lan jon dran o them Egiptia, penas o Jakob ap peskre tchawende: “Djan pale an o them Egiptia un ginenn menge budeder djob!”
Koi penas o Juda ap leste: “Ko rom penas soreles ap mende: ‘Te hi tumaro phraal gar pash tumende, dikenn tumer man buder gar.’
Te bitchreh maro phrales mentsa, djah mer kote te ginas tuke chapaske.
Te bitchreh les gar mentsa, djah mer gar. O rom penas ap mende: ‘Tumer dikenn man gar pale, te hi tumaro phraal gar pash tumende.’”
Koi penas o Jakob, koleskro lab hi ninna Israel: “Hoske anenn tumer hawi duk ap mande un penan ko romeske, kai hi tumen i wawar phraal?”

Penan jon: “Ko rom putchas men win pral mende un pral mari familja. Job putchas: ‘Djiwell tumaro dad? Hi tumen i wawar phraal?’ Jaake penam, hoi job kamas te djinell. Djinam gar, kai job penell: ‘Anenn tumaro phrales kai!’”
Un o Juda penas ap peskro dadeste Israel: “Bitche ko tchawes mantsa! Un mer nai djah kanna, te djiwas un meras gar i bokatar – tu un mer un mare tchawe!
Me dau miro wast koi pre, kai anau les pale. Te anau les tuke gar pale, well i doosh ap mande un atchell ap mande, jaake rah har djiwau!
Tchatchepah, te atchams gar jaake rah kate, wams kanna o duito kopo pale.”
Un o Israel, lengro dad, penas ap lende: “Te djal gar wawartchandes, krenn kowa: Lenn o feteder dran maro them un anenn les ko romeste: kutch rukengro djet un gwin, khorja un mandle.
Lenn dui kope jaake bud lowe peha har o ersto kopo. Tumer hunte denn kol lowe pale, kai hatsan an tumare gone. Nashte well jekeskri doosh, hoi job gar djinas.
Lenn tumaro phrales un krenn tumen ap o drom! Djan pale pash o romeste!
Un o sorelo Dewel mu krell, te well o rom tumenge latcho, jaake kai mukell lo tumaro wawar phrales un o Benjamines tumentsa pale te djal. Me krau nai tchi. Nashrau mire tchawen, nashrau len!”
Kanna lan i mursha ko kutch koowa, hoi anenn le o romeske. Un lan ninna dui kope lowe un o Benjamines pentsa un kran pen ap o drom, te djan le an o them Egiptia. Un jon wan glan o Josefeste.
Har o Josef dikas o Benjamines pash lende, penas lo ap koleste, kai ap leskro kheer garda das: “An kol murshen an o kheer! Marenn viechen un krenn i chapen! Kol mursha chan kau diwes mantsa.”
Un o rom kras jaake, har o Josef penas un anas i murshen an o Josefeskro kheer.

Har jon dikan, kai wan le an o Josefeskro kheer anlo, was len daar. Un jek penas ap o wawareste: “Kol lowe, hoi an mare gone his o wawar kopo, hi, hoske wah kanna kate anlo. I Egiptarja kamenn mare burike te lell un men te taprell, te budras lenge.”
Un jon djan pash koleste, kai ap o Josefeskro kheer garda das, un rakran leha glan o wudar.
“Miro rai”, penan le. “Mer wam kate o wawar kopo te ginas djob.
Har mer pale djam, kram mare gone pre kote, kai atcham pral i rati. Un hakeno mendar hatsas peskre lowe an o gono, jaake bud, har plaissram. Kanna anam mer kal lowe pale pale.
Wawar lowe anam ninna mentsa, te ginas djob. Mer djinah gar, koon tchiwas mare lowe an mare gone.”
“Hi mishto”, penas ko rom. “Ma darenn! Tumaro Dewel, kai ninna tumaro dadeskro Dewel hi, tchiwas kol lowe an tumare gone. Me lom tumare lowe, hoi dan man.” Un job anas o Simeones pash lende.
Un ko rom anas len an o Josefeskro kheer un das len pani, te thowenn le pengre herja, un das lengre buriken te chal.
Un jon lan ko kutch koowa, hoi anan le peha, un tchiwan les jaake, te denn le les o Josefeste. Jon shunan, te well job ap o paash diwes un te chan jon leha.
Har o Josef khere was, anan le ko kutch koowa an o kheer. Un witsran pen glan leste ap i phub.
Un job putchas lendar: “Har djal tumenge? Djal tumaro phuro dadeske mishto, kolestar rakran? Hi lo djido?”
Penan le: “Miro rai, maro dadeske djal mishto. Job hi djido.” Un jon witsran pen ap i phub glan leste.

Un job dikas pes trujel un dikas peskro phrales Benjamin, ko tchawes peskri datar, un putchas: “Hi kowa tumaro terneder phraal, kolestar rakran?” Un ap leste penas lo: “O Dewel mu dell tut latchepen, miro tchawo.”
Har o Josef peskro phrales dikas, his leske ropaske. Un job djas sik an peskri isema un rowas koi.
Pal kowa thowas lo peskre jaka, djas win un las pes khetne un penas: “Anenn o chapen!”

Un jon anan o Josefeske o chapen ap i wawar chapaskri har peskre phralenge. Ninna i Egiptarja, kai leha chan, chan ap i wawar chapaskri. I Egiptarja chan gar khetne kolentsa, kai kharenn Hebrearja. Kolla hi lenge pale-tchiddo.
O Josefeskre phrala wan glan leste wergel beshdo, pal lengro phurepen: o phureder, o duito, o triinto bis pash o terneder. Koi dikan le bare jakentsa jek ap o wawareste.

O Josef mukas leskro chapastar peskre phralenge te anell. Un ko chapen, hoi mukas job o Benjamineske te anell, his pantch kope jaake bud, har o chapen leskre wawar phralenge. Un jon chan un pijan un wan bachtelo leha.
Un job penas ap koleste, kai ap leskro kheer garda das: “Kre i gone kol murshendar pherdo djob, jaake bud har dren djala. Un tchip hakeneskre lowe pral an lengre gone!
Un miro rupeno khoro tchip khetne lengre lowentsa pral an o gono ko terneder murshestar!” Un ko rom kras, har o Josef leske penas.
Taissarlakro djan i mursha pengre burikentsa penge.

Har jon gar dur glan o foro his, penas o Josef ap koleste, kai ap leskro kheer garda das: “Le sik kol murshen palla! Te tapreh len, pen ap lende: Hoske kran tumer tchilatcho koowa ap miro rajeste? Job his latcho ap tumende.
Tumer tchoran miro rajeskro rupeno khoro, dran koleste job pijell un durkrell. Hi gar mishto, hoi kran!”
Un ko pralstuno pral o Josefeskro kheer las len palla, tapras len un penas kal laba ap lende.
Kolla penan ap leste: “Hoske rakrell miro rai sawe laba? Sawo koowa kram mer gar.
Kol lowe, hoi hatsam pral an mare gone, anam tuke pale dran o them Kanaan. Hoske tchorams dran tiro rajeskro kheer rup un sonakai?
Miro rai, tu te hatseh ko khoro pash jekeste mendar, nai deh les mulo! Un mer wawar wah tire budepangre.”
“Mishto”, penas job. “Mer krah jaake, har penan. Kowa well miro budepaskro, kai hatsau o khoro pash leste. Tumer wawar nai djana.”
Koi las hakeno sik peskro gono tele ap i phub un kras les pre.
Un job rodas an o gono hakenestar: pash o phureder bis pash o terneder. Un job hatsas o khoro an o Benjamineskro gono.
Koi kran le pengre koola an kotja i dukatar. Un hadan pengre gone pale ap i burike un djan pale an o foro.
Un o Juda djas peskre phralentsa an o Josefeskro kheer. O Josef his gomme koi. Un jon witsran pen glan leste ap i phub.
Un o Josef penas ap lende: “Hawo tchilatcho koowa kran tumer? Djinenn gar, kai i rom har man, durkrell nai?”

Penas o Juda ap leste: “Hoi penas mer tuke, miro rai? Har nai sikrah, kai hi men kek doosh an kau koowa? O Dewel dell men i phagi. Miro rai, mer ham kanna tire budepangre: mer un kowa, kai hatsan o khoro pash leste.”
Penas o Josef: “Sawo koowa krau gar. Ko rom, kai hatsan o khoro pash leste, hunte well miro budepaskro. Tumer wawar nai djan an o latchepen khere pash tumaro dadeste.”
Koi was o Juda glan un penas ap leste: “Mangau tut, miro rai, muk man tuha te rakrell! Ab gar chojedo ap mande, miro rai! Tu hal jaake baro har o baro rai pral o them Egiptia.
Tu, miro rai, putchal mendar, har hams o wawar kopo kai: ‘Hi tumen i dad, ninna i wawar phraal?’

Un mer penam ap tute, miro rai: ‘Men hi i phuro dad un i terno phraal, kai boldo was, har maro dad phuro his. Leskro phraal hi mulo. Un job kokres atchas pral peskri datar. Un leskro dad kamell les i djijestar.’
Un tu, miro rai, penal ap mende: ‘Anenn les pash mande, te dikap les!’
Un mer penam ap tute, miro rai: ‘Ko tchawo mukell nai gar peskro dades. Mukell job les, merell leskro dad.’
Koi penal tu, miro rai, ap mende: ‘Te well gar tumaro terneder phraal tumentsa, kamau te dikap tumen gar pale.’
Har wam khere pash maro dadeste, penam leske tire laba, miro rai.
Har maro dad penas ‘Djan, ginenn menge chapaske’, penam mer:
‘Te well maro terneder phraal gar mentsa, nai djah gar. Te hi job gar pash mende, nai wah gar glan ko romeskre jaka.’
Un miro dad, penas ap mende: ‘Djinenn, kai miri romni anas mange dui tchawen ap i phub.
Ko jek djas peske mandar un me penom mange: I diwjo viecho maras les. Un me dikom les buder gar pale bis kanna.
Me hom i phuro rom. Te lenn tumer ninna o duites mandar un te taprels les i bibacht, merau me i dukatar.’
Un kanna, miro rai, te wau me pale pash miro dadeste, un job dikell, kai o tchawo gar pash mande hi, merell job i dukatar.
Leskro dji hi pandlo ap ko tchaweste. Man wals doosh, te merals maro phuro dad i dukatar.
Miro rai, me dom miro wast koi pre, kai anau o tchawes pale. Me penom ap miro dadeste: ‘Te anau les tuke gar pale, well i doosh ap mande un atchell ap mande, jaake rah har djiwau!’
Doleske, muk man te wap tiro budepaskro, miro rai! Muk kol tchawes te djal peskre phralentsa!
Me nai djau gar pash miro dadeste, te hi ko tchawo gar pash mande. Me nai dikoms gar koi duk, hoi well ap miro dadeste, te hi ko tchawo gar pashel!”
Koi rikras pes nai o Josef buder gar pale glan lauterende, kai trul leste tardo hi. Un job bitchras i tsele Egiptarjen win. Un kek his pashel, har job penas, kai job lengro phraal hi.
Un job rowas soreles. Un i Egiptarja shunan kowa, ninna i menshe an o kheer o baro rajestar.
Un o Josef penas ap peskre phralende: “Me hom o Josef. Djiwell miro dad?” Leskre phrala penan nai tchi ap leste. Lenge atchas o rakepen krik i trashatar.

Koi penas o Josef ap peskre phralende: “Awenn pash mande!” Un jon djan pash leste. Un job penas pale: “Me hom o Josef, tumaro phraal, kowa, kai bikran tumer ap i parepangre, kai anan man an o them Egiptia.
Kanna hunte khaitell tumen kowa gar, kai bikran man! Choirenn tumen gar pral kowa! O Dewel bitchras man glan tumende kai, te merenn i menshe gar i bokatar.
Dui bersha bokan le an kau them. Un pantch bersha hi glan lende, kai tchiwrenn le nai kek djob an i phub, witar gar anenn le djob dren.
Un o Dewel bitchras man glan tumende an kau them, te lell job tumen dran i bari bok win, te atchenn tumer un tumare tchawe djido ap i phub.
Jaake han gar tumer, kai anan man kate. O Dewel anas man kai. Un job kras man dad pral o baro rajeste an o them Egiptia un rai pral koleskro tselo kheer un pral o tselo them Egiptia.
Kanna, djan sik pash miro dadeste pale un penenn leske: ‘Jaake penell tiro tchawo Josef: O Dewel kras man rai pral o tselo them Egiptia. Kanna am pash mande! Am sik!
Tu djiwess an o them Gosen, hoi hi gar dur mandar: tu un tire tchawe un tire tchawengre tchawe, ninna tire bakre un busja, tire grumja un halauter, hoi tut hi.
Un me dau tut halauter, hoi tut hunte well djipaske. Jaake te wess gar tchorwelo, tu un tiri familja un lauter hoi tut hi. Pantch bersha hi glan mende, kai hi i menshen tchi te chal.’
Tumer dikenn tumare jakentsa, ninna miro phraal Benjamin dikell, kai tchatchepah me hom, kai rakrell tumentsa.
Penenn miro dadeske, hawo railepen man hi an o them Egiptia. Penenn leske halauter, hoi dikan! Un anenn les kai! Anenn les sik!”
Un job peras peskro phraleske Benjamin trul i meen un rowas. Un ninna o Benjamin rowas ap leskro betch.
Un job tchumras peskre tsele phralen un rowas ap lengro betch. Un koi pal rakran leskre phrala leha.
An o kheer o baro rajestar shunan le, kai o Josefeskre phrala wan. Un kowa his mishto o baro rajeske un i pralstunenge an leskro kheer.
Un o baro rai penas ap o Josefeste: “Pen tire phralenge: ‘Krenn jaake: Tchiwenn tumaro koowa ap tumare vieche un djan an o them Kanaan!
Un lenn tumaro dades un tumare tsele menshen, un awenn pash mande! Un kamau te dap tumen o feteder kotar them an o them Egiptia, te chan tumer o latcheder chapen ko themestar.’
Ap tute penau, te dess len wurdja dran o them Egiptia lengre tchawenge un romjenge, te lenn le pengro dades kai!
Pen lenge, len hunte khaitell kowa gar, te mukenn le lauter tchiddo. O feteder an o them Egiptia lenn jon.”
Un o Israeleskre tchawe kran jaake. O Josef das len wurdja, jaake har o baro rai leske penas, ninna chapaske ap o drom.
Hakenes das job jek shukar ripen. O Benjamin las triin-sheel rupene kotja lowe un pantch shukar ripja.
Un peskro dadeske bitchras job deesh burike, – kolla hidjran o feteder dran o them Egiptia; un deesh wawar burike. Kolla hidjran djob un maro un chapaske leskro dadeske ap o drom.
Un job bitchras peskre phralen khere. Un penas ap lende: “Ma tchingrenn tumen ap o drom!”
Un jon djan dran o them Egiptia un wan an o them Kanaan pash lengro dadeste Jakob.
Un jon penan ap leste: “O Josef djiwella. Un job hi o rai pral o tselo them Egiptia.” Koi atchas leskro dji tardo. Un job patsas len gar.
Un jon penan leske lauter, hoi o Josef penas. Un har job dikas kol wurdja, hoi o Josef bitchras leske, was lo pale soreles.
Un o Israel penas: “Kanna hi doha! Me patsau tumen! O Josef, miro tchawo, djiwella. Me djau kote, te dikap les glan miro merepen.”
Un o Israel kras pes ap o drom mit halauter, hoi les his, un was an o foro Beersheba. Un job maras viechen un chatchras len o Debleske peskro dadestar Isaak.
I rati rakras o Dewel leha an i suni un penas ap leste: “Jakob, Jakob!” Un job penas: “Ake hom.”
Un o Dewel penas: “Me hom o Dewel, ko Dewel tiro dadestar. Ma traash te djas an o them Egiptia! Koi krau me, te wess o dad i bari natsjona.
Me djau tuha an o them Egiptia. Un tchatchepah me anau tut pale pale. Un te mereh, krell o Josef tire jaka pandlo.”
Koi mukas o Jakob Beersheba. Un o Jakobeskre tchawe hadan pengro dades, pengre tchawen un pengre romjen an kol wurdja, hoi o baro rai pral Egiptia lenge bitchras.
Un jon lan pengre viechen un halauter, hoi lengre an o them Kanaan was, un djan an o them Egiptia: o Jakob peskri tseli familjah:
Leskre tchawe un leskre tchawengre tchawe, leskre tcha un tchawengre tcha, leskri tseli familja anas job peha an Egiptia.
Kolla hi i laba o Israeleskre tchawendar, kai wan an o them Egiptia: O Jakob un leskre tchawe. O Jakobeskro phureder his o Ruben.
Leskre tchawe his: o Henoch, o Pallu, o Hezron un o Karmi.
O Simeon un leskre tchawe: o Jemuel, o Jamin, o Ohad, o Jachin un o Zohar, ninna o Shaul, ko tchawo i djuwjatar dran o them Kanaan.
O Levi un leskre tchawe: o Gershon, o Kohat un o Merari.
O Juda un leskre tchawe: o Er, o Onan, o Shela, o Perez un o Serach. O Er un o Onan meran an o them Kanaan. O Perez his o dad dui tchawendar: o Hezron un o Hamul.
O Issachar un leskre tchawe: o Tola, o Puwa, o Jashub un o Shimron.
O Sebulon un leskre tchawe: o Sered, o Elon un o Jachleel.
Kolla hi i tchawe un tchawengre tchawe o Jakobestar un i Lea, kai an Paddan-Aram bolde wan, ninna lengri tchai, i Dina. Lauter khetne his jon 33 (trijanda-te-triin) tchawe un tchawengre tchawe.
O Gad un leskre tchawe: o Zifjon un o Haggi, o Shuni un o Ezbon, o Eri, o Arod un o Areli.
O Asser un leskre tchawe: o Jimna, o Jishwa, o Jishwi, o Beria un lengri pheen, i Serach. O Beria, les his dui tchawe: o Heber un o Malkijel.

Kolla his i tchawe un tchawengre tchawe o Jakobestar un i Silpa. I Silpa his koi budepaskretsa, kai o Laban peskri tchate Lea das. Lauter khetne his jon 16 (deesh-te-shob) tchawe un tchawengre tchawe.
I tchawe o Jakobeskri romjatar Rachel his o Josef un o Benjamin.
O Josefeske wan dui tchawe boldo an o them Egiptia: o Manasse un o Efrajim. Lengri dai his i Asnat. Kolakro dad his o rashai Potifera dran o foro On.
O Benjamin un leskre tchawe: o Bela, o Becher, o Ashbel, o Gera, o Naaman, o Ehi, o Rosh, o Muppim, o Huppim un o Ard.
Kolla his i tchawe un tchawengre tchawe o Jakobestar un i Rachel. Lauter khetne his jon 14 (deesh-te-star) tchawe un tchawengre tchawe.
O Dan un leskro tchawo: o Hushim.
O Naftali un leskre tchawe: o Jachzeel, o Guni, o Jezer un o Shillem.
Kolla his i tchawe un tchawengre tchawe o Jakobestar un i Bilha. I Bilha his koi budepaskretsa, kai o Laban peskri tchate Rachel das. Lauter khetne his jon efta tchawe un tchawengre tchawe.
I tsele tchawe un tchawengre tchawe o Jakobestar, kai leha an o them Egiptia djan, his 66 (shob-deesh-te-shob). Koi pashel wenna leskre tchawengre romja.
O Josefes his dui tchawe, kai an o them Egiptia bolde wan. Khetne lentsa his jon efta-desha menshe an o Jakobeskri familja, kai djan an o them Egiptia.
Har jon an Egiptia wan, bitchras o Jakob peskro tchawes Juda glan win pash o Josefeste, te sikrell job lende o drom an o them Gosen.

Har jon an o them Gosen wan, pandas o Josef i graja glan peskro wurdin un uleras an o them Gosen pash peskro dadeste Israel. Har o Josef les dikas, tchiwas job peskre mussja trul leste, un rowas ap leskro betch un nai heras gar pre.
Un o Israel penas ap o Josefeste: “Kanna nai merau, kanna, kai dikom tut un djinau, tu djiweh.”

Un o Josef penas ap peskre phralende un ap i wawarende an peskro dadeskri familja: “Me djau pash o baro rajeste te penap leske: Mire phrala un kol wawar dran miro dadeskri familja, kai an o them Kanaan djiwan, wan pash mande.
I mursha hi bakrengre un denn jak ap pengre viechende. Un lengre bakre un grumja un lauter, hoi len hi, anan le pentsa.
Un kanna, te kharell o baro rai tumen un putchell: Hoi krenn tumer?
Penenn ap leste: ‘Miro rai, mer ham bakrengre fun tiknes pre, jaake har mare phure.’ Penenn kowa, te nai atchenn an o them Gosen.” Hako bakrengro hi i pale-tchiddo glan i Egiptarja.
Un o Josef djas pash o baro rajeste un penas ap leste: “Miro dad un mire phrala pengre bakrentsa un pengre grumjentsa un halauter, hoi len hi, wan dran o them Kanaan un hi kanna an o them Gosen.”
Un o Josef rodas pantch peskre phralendar win un anas len glan o baro rai.
Un o baro rai putchas lendar: “Hoi krenn tumer?” Un jon penan ap leste: “Miro rai, mer ham bakrengre jaake har mare phure.”
Un jon penan ninna: “I bok hi baro an o them Kanaan. Hi kek senlepen chapaske mare bakrenge. Doleske wam mer, te atchas i tsiro kai. Kanna mangah tut, miro rai, muk men te djiwell an o them Gosen.”
Koi penas o baro rai ap o Josefeste: “Tiro dad un tire phrala wan pash tute.

O them Egiptia hi ninna tuke koi. Rode tiro dadeske un tire phralenge o feteder kotar them win, te djiwenn le kote! Muk len te djiwell an o them Gosen! Un te dikeh, kai hi mursha mank lende, kai krenn pengri budi mishto, kre te wenn le pralstune pral mire viechende.”
O Josef anas peskro dades, o Jakobes, glan o baro rajeste. Un o Jakob penas ap leste: “Latcho diwes! Mu dell tut o Dewel peskri soor un bacht!”
Un o baro rai putchas lestar: “Har phuro hal tu?”
Penas o Jakob: “Hom 130 (sheel-te-triin-deesh) bersh phuro. Kowa hi kek phurepen. Man hi kek shukar djipen. Mire phure wan phureder har me.”
Un o Jakob penas ap o baro rajeste: “Atch mo Debleha!” un djas lestar.
Un o Josef sikras peskro dadeste un peskre phralende, kai jon djiwenn nai. Un das len o feteder kotar them, hoi an o them Egiptia his, ko them Ramses, jaake har o baro rai penas.
Ninna maro das job peskro dadeste un peskre phralende lengre familjentsa, jaake bud, kai hakenes doha his.
Un i bok was baro an o them Egiptia un Kanaan, jaake kai buder tchi chapaske his an i tsele themma. Un i menshe un i vieche merans i bokatar.
Un o Josef anas i tsele lowe khetne, kai i menshe an o them Egiptia un an o them Kanaan plaissran o chapaske. Un anas kol lowe an o baro rajeskro kheer.
Har buder kek lowe his an o them Egiptia un an o them Kanaan, wan i tsele Egiptarja pash o Josefeste un penan: “De men chapaske! Hoske meras mer glan tire jaka? Men hi buder kek lowe.”
Koi penas o Josef ap lende: “Te hi tumen buder kek lowe, anenn tumare vieche! Un me dau tumen te chal.”
Jaake anan le pengre viechen pash o Josefeste. Un job das len chapaske lengre grajenge, lengre bakre, grumja un burike an ko tselo bersh.
O wawar bersh wan le pale pash leste un penan ap leste: “Miro rai, mer dam tut mare lowe un mare viechen. Men hi buder tchi, hoi mer tut nai dah. Kanna le men un maro them!

Muk men gar nashedo te djal, men un maro them! Gin men un maro them un de men te chal! Mer kamah o baro rajeske te budrell. Un maro them dah leste. De men djob, te djiwas un meras gar! Un de men djob, te tchiwras kowa an i phub, te well dran maro them kek mulo them!”
Un o Josef ginas o tselo them Egiptia o baro rajeske. I bok his jaake baro, kai bikras hako Egiptari peskro kotar phub. Jaake was o tselo them an o baro rajeskre wasta.
Un o Josef ginas i menshen an o tselo them Egiptia – fun jek rig o themestar ap i wawar rig, te wenn le budepangre o baro rajeske.
O them i rashajendar ginas job gar. I rashajen his doha lowe te ginenn le penge chapen. Jon wan plaissedo o baro rajestar. Doleske bikran jon pengro them gar.
Un o Josef penas ap i menshende: “Kau diwes ginom tumen un tumaro them o baro rajeske. Ake, kau djob tchiwrenn nai an i phub.

Un te hi tumen newo djob, denn o pantchto kotar o baro rajeste! Kol wawar star kotja mu atchenn tumenge, jaake te hi tumen doha, kai nai witsrenn an i phub. Ninna hi tumen chapaske tumenge un tumare tchawenge, un kolenge, kai djiwenn an tumare khera.”
Penan jon: “Tu kral, kai meram gar. Ab menge latcho un le men, te was mer budepangre o baro rajeske!”
Jaake rakras o Josef i lab, hoi hunte rikrenn le: I tsele menshen an o them Egiptia hunte denn o pantchto kotar o baro rajeste. O rashajengro them las o baro rai gar. Jaake hi kowa gomme kau diwes.
Un i Israelitarja djiwan an o them Egiptia, an o them Gosen, lan bud tchawe un wan bud bud menshe.
Un o Jakob djiwas an o them Egiptia 17 (deesh-te-efta) bersha. Un job was 147 (sheel-te-star-deesh-te-efta) bersha phuro.
Har ko tsiro was, kai merell lo, kharas job peskro tchawes, o Josef, un penas ap leste: “Ab mange latcho, de tiro wast koi pre, kai rikreh tiro lab: Paske man gar an o them Egiptia!
Te hom mulo, an man dran o them Egiptia un paske man an o mulengro kheer mire menshendar!” “Me krau, har tu peneh”, penas o Josef.
“De tut sowel!” penas o Jakob. Un job das pes sowel. Un o Israel parkras pes glan leste ap peskro tchiben.
Pal i tsiro was o Josefeske penlo: “Tiro dad hi nasselo.” Koi las o Josef peskre dui tchawen, o Efrajim un o Manasse, un jon djan pash leste.
Un o Jakobeske was penlo: “Tiro tchawo o Josef well pash tute.” Koi las o Israel peskri tseli soor khetne un beshas pes an o tchiben pre.
Un o Jakob penas ap o Josefeste: “O sorelo Dewel mukas pes mandar te dikell an o foro Lus an o them Kanaan. Un job rakras latche laba ap mande un penas:
‘Tchatchepah, me dau tut bud tchawen, te wenn tutar jaake bud menshe, te wenn le bud natsjone. Un kau them dau me tut un tire menshende, te well kowa tumaro hako tsireske.’”

Un o Jakob penas dureder ap o Josefeste: “Kanna shun, tire dui tchawe, kai bolde wan glan ko tsiro, kai wom pash tute an o them Egiptia, – o Efrajim un o Manasse – kamau te wenn jon mire, jaake har o Ruben un o Simeon.
Te leh tu wawar tchawe, hi kolla tire. Jon lenn pengro kotar them an o them pengre phralendar, pash o Efrajim un o Manasse.

Me krau kowa miri romjake Rachel, kai hi tiri dai. Joi meras an o them Kanaan, har wom dran Paddan. Homs ap o drom, i tikno kotar glan o foro Efrata. Un me paskrom lat kote pash o drom, hoi djal an Efrata. Kowa hi kanna Betlehem.”
Har o Israel o Josefeskre tchawen dikas, putchas job: “Koon hi kalla?”
Un o Josef penas peskro dadeske: “Kolla hi mire tchawe, kai o Dewel das man kai.” “An len pash mande”, penas o Jakob, “te rakrap o Debleskri bacht pral lende win.”
O Israeleskre jaka hi buder gar mishto. Job his phuro un dikas nai buder gar. Doleske anas o Josef kol tchawen pash leste. Un job tapras len trujel un das hakenes i tchum.
Un o Israel penas ap o Josefeste: “Patsom gar, te dikap tut pale. Un ake, o Dewel kamas te dikap ninna tire tchawen.”
Un o Josef las len lestar krik un witsras pes glan leste tele, peskro mui ap i phub.

Un o Josef las kol dujen: Peskro tchawes Efrajim las job ap peskro tchatcho wast un anas les glan o Israeleskro serwo wast. Un peskro tchawes Manasse las job ap peskro serwo wast un anas les glan o Israeleskro tchatcho wast.

Un o Israel tchiwas peskri jek mussi pral o wawar un tchiwas peskro tchatcho wast ap o Efrajimeskro shero. Kowa his ko terneder. Un peskro serwo wast tchiwas lo ap o Manasseskro shero. Kowa his o phureder.

Un job rakras o Debleskri bacht win pral o Josefeste un penas: Ko Dewel, kai djas miro papo Abraham un miro dad Isaak ap leskro drom, ko Dewel, kai das garda ap mande bis kau diwes, har dell garda i bakrengro ap peskre bakre,

ko bolepaskro, kai las man win dran hako tchilatchepen, kowa mu tchiwell peskri bacht un soor ap kol tchawende, te djiwell miro lab dureder an lende, ninna o lab miro papestar Abraham un miro dadestar Isaak. Un lendar wenna bud menshe ap i phub.
Har o Josef dikas, kai leskro dad tchiwas peskro tchatcho wast ap o Efrajimeskro shero, his leske kowa gar mishto. Un job tapras peskro dadeskro wast, te tchiwell lo les ap o Manasseskro shero.
Un o Josef penas ap peskro dadeste: “Kre gar jaake, tata! Kawa hi o phureder. Tchip tiro tchatcho wast ap leskro shero!”

Leskro dad kamas gar un penas: “Me djinau, tchawa, me djinau. Ninna kolestar wenna jaake bud menshe, te well lendar jek natsjona. Leskro terneder phraal well bareder har job. Lestar wenna jaake bud menshe, te wenn lendar bud natsjone.”

Jaake rakras o Israel ap ko diwes o Debleskri bacht win pral kol tchawende un penas: “Tumare labentsa sharenn pen i menshe an Israel. Jon penenna: O Dewel mu krell tut har o Efrajim un o Manasse!” Jaake tchiwas o Israel o Efrajimes glan o Manasse.
Un o Israel penas ap o Josefeste: “Me merau. O Dewel hi pash tumende un anell tumen pale an tumaro dadengro them.
Me dau tute un gar tire phralende ko kotar them Sichem, hoi lom miro chareha un miro bogo dran o wast fun i Amorarja.”
Un o Jakob das peskre tchawen gole un penas: Awenn khetne! Me penau tumenge, hoi tumenge djala an ko tsiro, kai wella.
Tumer, o Jakobeskre tchawe, awenn un shunenn! Shunenn, hoi tumaro dad, o Israel, tumenge penell!
Tu, o Ruben, miro phureder tchawo hal, miri soor hi an tute. Har homs terno un sorelo, wom tiro dad. Tu hal bareder un sorleder har tire phrala.
Diwjo har i pani hals, pash jekate miri romjendar sowal. Ap tiro dadeste i ladj anal. Doleske buder gar ko pralstuno hal.
O Simeon un o Levi hi phrala. Lengre charentsa maran le.
Kamau gar te wap jek lendar, har krenn le tchilatcho koowa win. Kamau gar te wap pash lende, kai jon khetne wenna. I choljatar dan le murshen mulo un dan gurma bango tchitcheske.

Lengri choli chatchrell sik baro. An lengri choli krenn le sawo tchilatcho dareno koowa. Doleske wenn le praassedo! Kamau te wenn le jaake tradedo, te atchenn le buder gar khetne an Israel. Awa, kate te kote an o tselo them hunte djiwenn lengre tchawen, kai pal lende wenna.
Tu, o Juda hal kowa, kones leskre phrala sharenna. Tiro wast hi soreles ap o shero kolendar, kai kamenn tuke tchilatchepen. Glan tute witsrenn pen tele tire phrala.
Miro tchawo, tu hal sorelo har i terno lewo, kai hi tchalo o viechestar, hoi maras lo, un djal pale, kai lo khere hi, beshell pes un tchiwell pes tele. Un hakenes hi daar, te taprell lo les an.

Hako tsiro well o baro rai dran o kheer Juda, un jek leskre menshendar rikrell o rajeskro kasht an o wast jaake rah, bis te well kowa, kai tchatchepah o baro rai hi. Ap koleste shunenn i natsjone ap i phub.
Job pandell peskri burika ap i drakengro ruk. Un lakro ternepen pandell lo ap o latcho drakengro ruk. Peskro ripen thowell lo an mool, peskri baja an loli mool.
Leskre jaka hi kalo i moljatar. Leskre danda hi parno i thudatar.
O Sebulon djiwell pash o baro pani, kote, kai i shiffe tchiddo hi. Leskro them djal bis pash o foro Sidon.
O Issachar hi har i soreli burika, kai tchiddo hi mashkral dui gone.
Job dikas, har shukar leskri platsa hi un har kamlo o them hi, un tchiwas peskro phiko tele, te hidjrell lo pharo koowa un budrell i wawarenge.
O Dan dell jak, te well o tchatchepen dren rikedo pash peskre menshende. Doleske sharenn les leskre phrala an Israel.
O Dan hi har i sap ap o drom, hoi dandrella o grajes an i herja. Un kowa, kai hi beshdo ap o grai, perell tele.
Baro Dewel, ab ap miri rig!
O Gad, bud lurde tradenn les. Un job rissrell pes trujel un lell len palla.
O Asser, ap leskro them well latcho djob baro, leskri phub anell shukar chapen win – chapen, hoi i bare raja chana!
O Naftali hi har i wesheskri grumni, hoi nashell trujel un lell shukar terne.
O Josef hi har i terno ruk pash o pani, hoi hidjrell bud rukengre. Leskre kashta wenn baro un djan pral i pre-tchidde barra, kai lo tardo hi.
I kurepangre his chojedo ap leste. Ninna te dan le ap leste karje un lan les palla,
his leskro bogo soreles an leskro wast, un leskre mussja his soreles kerdo, o Jakobeskro sorelo Dewel das les soor. Job dell garda ap o Israel har i bakrengro ap peskre bakre, un dell len gar pre.
Tiro dadeskro Dewel well ap tiri rig. Job hi o sorelo Dewel. Job dell tut brishin dran o bolepen un pani dran i phub, ninna bud tchawe un vieche.

Dik i berge, hoi djan pral bis an o bolepen un atchenna hako tsiro! Tiro brawlepen well bareder har kolla. Awa, bareder har ko latcho koowa ap i berge, hoi atchenna hako tsiro. Kowa lauter lell o Josef, kai hi o wi-rodedo mank leskre phralende.
O Benjamin hi har i diwjo djuklo, kai marella. Taissarlakro chal lo kowa, hoi dandras job an kotja. Un rati dell job i wawaren kolestar, hoi pral atchas.

Kolla lauter hi i deesh-te-dui bare familje, hoi wenna o Israeleskre deesh-te-dui tchawendar. Kol labentsa penas lenge lengro dad, har lenge djala an ko tsiro, kai wella. Hakeneske his les i wawar lab.
Un o Jakob penas soreles ap lende: “Te wau me paskedo, paskrenn man pash mire phurende an koi grotta, hoi hi ap ko kotar phub, hoi o Hetares Efron his.
Koi grotta hi pash Mamre ap ko kotar phub, hoi kharella Machpela an o them Kanaan. Ko kotar phub ginas o Abraham o fun o Hetari, o Efron, te well kote peskri familja paskedo.
Kote paskran le o Abrahames un leskri romjat Sara. Kote paskran le ninna o Isaakes un leskri romjat Rebekka. Un kote paskrom miri romjat Lea.
Ko kotar phub, kai i grotta tchiddo hi, hi maro. Mer ginam les fun i Hetarja.”
Har o Jakob kowa peskre tchawenge penas, tserdas job peskre herja ap o tchiben un meras.
Koi peras o Josef ap peskro dadeskro mui un rowas pral leste un tchumras les.
Un job penas ap i dramangre, kai leske budran, te makenn le leskro dades kutch djeteha dren. Un kol dramangre makan o Israel kutch djeteha dren.
Star-desha diwessa makan le les dren. Kowa hi o tsiro o makepaske. Un i Egiptarja rowan pral leste 70 (efta-desha) diwessa.
Pal kol 70 (efta-desha) diwessa rakras o Josef ap o baro rajeskri familja un penas: “Awenn mange latcho un rakrenn o baro rajeha un penenn leske mandar:

‘Miro dad mukas man sowel te dell un penas: Me merau. Paske man an miro mulengro kheer, hoi krom mange an o them Kanaan!’ Kanna muk man te djal, te paskrap miro dades an o them Kanaan. Pal kowa wau pale.”
O baro rai mukas leske te penell: “Dja koi, paske tiro dades, jaake har dal tut glan tiro dadeste sowel.”
Jaake djas o Josef, te paskrell lo peskro dades. Khetne leha djan i tsele pralstune budepangre o baro rajestar, i phureder an leskro kheer un i tsele pralstune pral o them Egiptia.
Ninna i tsele menshe dran o Josefeskro kheer un leskre phrala un i wawar menshe dran leskro dadeskro kheer djan leha. Kokres lengre tchawe, lengre bakre un grumja mukan jon an o them Gosen.
Ninna wurdja un klissepangre djan lentsa. Halauter khetne his bud bud menshe.

Un jon wan ap i platsa, hoi kharella Goren-Atad. Koi platsa hi tchiddo ap i wawar rig o panjestar Jordan. Kote rowan le un dan bari gole pral o Jakobeskro merepen. Un o Josef rowas lentsa efta diwessa pral peskro dadeste.

Har i Kanaanitarja, kai koi djiwan, dikan, har jon rowan ap i platsa Goren-Atad, penan le: “Hawo baro ropen krenn i Egiptarja kote!” Doleske dan le koi platsa ko lab Abel-Mizrajim. Koi platsa hi tchiddo ap i wawar rig o panjestar Jordan.
Un o Jakobeskre tchawe kran leha jaake, har o Jakob lenge penas.
Jon anan les an o them Kanaan un paskran les an i grotta ap ko kotar phub pash Mamre, hoi kharella Machpela. Ko kotar phub ginas o Abraham fun o Hetari, o Efron, te well kote leskri familja paskedo.
Har o Josef peskro dades paskras, was job pale an o them Egiptia: job un leskre phrala un lauter, kai leha djan.
Har o Josefeskre phrala dikan, kai lengro dad mulo his, penan le: “Hoi krah mer, te hi o Josef menge tchilatcho un dell men o tchilatchepen pale, hoi mer ap leste kram?”
Doleske bitchran le jekes pash o Josefeste un penan leske: “Tiro dad penas glan peskro merepen:

‘Jaake hunte penenn ap o Josefeste: Mangau tut, biste ko tchilatcho koowa, hoi tire phrala ap tute kran!’ Doleske mangah mer, kai ninna tiro dadeskro Debles an-gole dah: Biste ko tchilatchepen, hoi mer kram!” Har o Josef kowa shunas, rowas job.
Un leskre phrala djan pash leste un tchiwran pen tele glan leste un penan: “Ake, mer ham tire budepangre!”
O Josef penas ap lende: “Ma darenn! Hom me o Dewel?
Tumer kaman te krenn mange tchilatchepen. O Dewel las peske glan, te krell lo lauter mishto, jaake har hi kau diwes: Bud menshe atchan djido.
Ma darenn! Me dikau ap tumende un tumare tchawende.” Jaake rakras job latche labentsa ap lengre djia.
Un o Josef djiwas an o them Egiptia, job un peskro dadeskri familja. Un o Josef was 110 (sheel-te-deesh) bersha phuro.
Un job dikas i tchawengre tchawen peskro tchawestar Efrajim. Ninna i tchawe peskro tchaweskro tchawestar, o Machir, wan pash leste baro. O Machir his o Manasseskro tchawo.

Un o Josef penas ap peskre phralende: “Me merau kanna. O Dewel dikella latches ap tumende, un anell tumen dran kau them win, an ko them, kai job peskro wast pre das, te dell lo les o Abrahameste, o Isaakeste un o Jakobeste.”
Un o Josef kamas te denn pen o Israeleskre tchawe sowel un penas ap lende: “Te anell o Dewel tumen khere, lenn man tumentsa!” Un jon dan pen sowel glan leste.
Un o Josef meras, har job 110 (sheel-te-deesh) bersha phuro his. Un job was dre-maklo o kutch djeteha un tchiddo an i mochton an o them Egiptia.
Kolla hi kol laba kol mursh tchawendar, kai wan o Jakobeha an o them Egiptia. Hakeno was peskri familjah:
o Ruben, o Simeon, o Levi, o Juda, o Issachar, o Sebulon, o Benjamin, o Dan, o Naftali, o Gad, o Asser
Khetne pengre tchawentsa un tchawengre tchawentsa his le 70 (efta-deesh). O Josef his glan lende an o them Egiptia.
Pale meras o Josef un peskre phrala un leskre tsele menshe, kai an ko tsiro djiwan.
Lengre tchawe lan jaake bud tchawe, kai was o them pherdo lendar.
Pal bud bersha was i newo baro rai an o them Egiptia. Kawa djinas o Josefestar tchi,
un rakras peskre menshentsa un penas: “Kol menshe, i Israelitarja, hi budeder un sorleder har mer.
Mer hunte hatsas i drom, te wenn jon gar gomme budeder. Te phagals i baro kurepen win, nai dans pen jon ap i wawar rig, un mer hunte kurams men lentsa, un jon djans dran ko them win.”

I Egiptarja tchiwan pralstune pral i Israelitarja. Kolla dan garda te budran i Israelitarja phares, un jaake rikran le len tele. Un jon kran i forja Pitom un Ramses, te well kote o chapen tchiddo o baro rajeske, o Farao.
Ninna te djan le soreles ap lende, wan jon budeder un sorleder. Un i Egiptarja daran lendar,
un kran, te budrenn i Israelitarja gomme phareder.
Len his kek dji lenge un kran lengro djipen phares. Un i Israelitarja hunte chatchan barra dran tchik. Ninna hunte budran le phares ap i hachetikri phub.
O baro rai pral o them Egiptia das kol dui chatchede chalja, i Shifra un i Pua, gole. Kolla his hebretikre djuwja. Un job penas ap lende:
“Te lenn kol hebretikre djuwja tchawen, pale krenn i mursh tchawen mules, kol tchen mukenn te djiwell!”
Kol dui chatchede chalja daran o Deblestar un shunan gar ap o baro rajeste, hoi job penas. Jon mukan ninna kol mursh tchawen te djiwell.
Palle mukas o baro rai kol chatchede chalja te well un penas: “Hoske shunan tumer gar ap mande un mukan kol mursh tchawen te djiwell?”
Kol chatchede chalja penan ap o Farao: “Kol hebretikre djuwja hi gar jaake har kol egiptikre djuwja, jon hi sorleder djuwja. Glan kowa, kai mer wah, hi i tchawe boldo.”
I chatchede chalja daran o Deblestar. Doleske mukas o Dewel lenge mishto te djal un das len bari bacht. I Israelitarja wan bud un budeder un sorelo un sorleder.
Kanna penas o Farao ap i Egiptarja an peskro tselo them: “Kol tsele mursh tchawe, hoi newes boldo wan, witsrenn an o pani Nil! Un i tchen mukenn te djiwell!”
Koi his i mursh kol menshendar, kai wenna pal o Levi. Kowa las peske i romni, kai his ninna i Leviteskre menshendar.
Joi was an wawar koowa un las i tchawo. Har dikas joi, kai hi o tchawo sasto un shukar, khatras joi les triin tchon.

Har khatras li les nai buder gar, kras joi i tikni korba, makas i korba mit tchomone dren, kai djal kek pani dren, un tchiwas lakro ternepen koi dren, las koi korba, tchiwas les mank ko baro panjeskro khass pash o pani Nil.
O tikno tchaweskri pheen khatras pes gar dur, te dikell joi, hoi leha djala.

Koi was o baro rajeskri tchai un kamas pes an ko pani Nil te thowell. Un kol djuwja, kai lake budran, nashan pash o pani. Ap jek kopo dikas joi koi korba mank ko baro panjeskro khass, un bitchras lakri budepaskretsa koi, te anell li koi korba.
Har joi koi korba pre kras, dikas joi i tikno tchawes, hoi rowas. Kowa khaitas lat un joi penas: “Kowa hi i hebretikro tchawo.”
O tikno tchaweskri pheen putchas o rajeskri tchatar: “Dap me i hebretikri djuwel gole, hoi dell kol ternepen o betch te pijell?”
“Awa, kre kowa!” penas joi. Koi las koi tchai o ternepaskri dat.
Un o rajeskri tchai penas ap late: “Le ko ternepen un de leste te pijell! Me plaissrau tut mishto.” Jaake las i dai peskro ternepen pale un das les te pijell.
Har his o tchawo bares doha, anas joi les pale o rajeskri tchake. Koja las ko tchawes har te wals lo lakro tchawo. Joi penas: “Me tserdom les dran o pani win.” Doleske das joi les o lab Mose.
Har his o Mose baro, was i diwes, kai djas lo pash peskre menshende. Koi dikas job har jon phares hunte budrenn, un har das jek Egiptari i Hebreares.
Koi dikas o Mose pes trujel, te nai dikell les kek. Palle das job o Egiptari mulo, un tchiwas les tel i phub.
O wawar diwes djas job pale win. Job dikas har tchingran pen dui Hebretikre mursha. Un job penas ap koleste, hoi gar an o tchatchepen his: “Hoske deh tu i romes, kai hi tire menshendar?”
Kawa penas: “Koon penas, te wess tu rai pral mende? Kameh tu man ninna mules te dell har ko Egiptares?” Kote las o Mose traash un penas peske: “Har was kowa win?”
Har o Farao kowa shunas, kamas job o Moses te marell. O Mose nashas an ko them Midian. Kote beshas job pes pash i brunna.
O rashai an ko them Midian his efta tcha. Kolla wan pash i brunna, te denn le pengro dadeskre bakre un busja pani te pijell.
Palle wan bakrengre un tradan len ap i rig. O Mose stas pre un was ap lengri rig, un das lengre bakre un busja pani te pijell.
Har wan i tcha khere pash pengro dadeste, o Reguel, putchas lo len: “Hoske wan tumer jaake sik pale?”
Koi penan jon: “Jek Egiptari was ap mari rig, un das mare bakre un busja te pijell.”
“Kai hi lo? Hoske mukan les win?” putchas o Reguel peskre tcha. “Anenn les, te chal lo mentsa!”
O Reguel putchas o Mosestar, te atchell job pash leste, un o Mose penas: “Awa! Mishto!” O rashai das peskri tchai, i Zippora, leste, te romedinerell job lat.
Har joi i mursh tchawo ap i phub anas, penas o Mose: “Me nashom an i them, hoi hi gar miro them. Doleske dau les ko lab Gershon.”
Pal i rah tsiro meras o baro rai pral o them Egiptia. Fothe phares hunte budran i Israelitarja tel dawa un dan gole, te shunas len o Dewel.
Un job shunas lengri gole, un bistras gar ko lab, hoi das job o Abraham, o Isaak, un o Jakob, te well lo lengro Dewel un jon peskre menshe.
Un o Dewel dikas latches ap i Israelitarja un was ap lengri rig.

O Moseskri romjakro dad his o Jetro, ko rashai an o them Midian. Koles his bakre un busja. Un o Mose das jak ap lende, un anas len pral o tato mulo them, un was pash o Debleskri berga, hoi kharella Horeb.
Un kote mukas pes o baro Debleskro bolepaskro lestar te dikell, an i jag an i burra. O Mose dikas, kai i burra chatchan un chatchran gar pre.
Un job penas ap peste: “Kowa haiwau me gar. Me djau kote un kamau te dikell, hoske chatchrenna gar i burra pre.”
Un o baro Dewel dikas, har well o Mose, te dikell lo feteder. Un o Dewel das ap leste gole dran i burra: “Mose! Mose!” Un o Mose penas: “Kate hom.”
Penas o Dewel: “Ma dja dureder! Rib tire kircha win! Kai tu tardo hal, hi o Debleskri phub.”

Un pale penas lo ap o Moseste: “Me hom tiro dadeskro Dewel, un o Abrahameskro Dewel, un o Isaakeskro Dewel un o Jakobeskro Dewel.” Un o Mose tchiwas i diklo glan peskre jaka. Job daras, te dikell lo ap o Debleste.
Un o baro Dewel penas: “Me dikom har djungelo mire menshenge djala an o them Egiptia. Me shunom lengri gole, har dan i pralstune chale len dawa. Me prindjrau lengre duka.

Me wom tele, te lap len dran o wast kol menshendar an o them Egiptia win, un anau len dran kau them win un dau len i latcho un baro them, kai hi bud thud un gwin. An ko them djiwenn kanna i Kanaanitarja, i Hetarja, i Amorarja, i Perisarja, i Hiwarja un i Jebusarja.
Me shunom i Israelengri gole un dikom, hoi i Egiptarja ap lende krenna. Jon phagenn len, fothe denn le len dawa.
Kanna dja pash o Farao! Me bitchrau tut, te less mire menshen, i Israelitarja, win dran o them Egiptia.”
Koi penas o Mose ap o Debleste: “Me, koon hom me, te djap me pash o Farao, un anap i tsele Israelitarja dran o them Egiptia win?”
Koi penas o Dewel: “Me hom pash tute. Te anal tu mire menshen dran o them Egiptia win, palle djan tumer pash kai berga un marenn kate viechen mange. Kowa hi i sikepen, te bitchrom me tut.”

O Mose penas ap o Debleste: “Dik, me te djau pash i Israelitarja un penau lenge: ‘O Dewel, koles tumare phure an-mangan, kowa bitchras man pash tumende.’ Hoi te penap lenge, te putchenn le mandar, hawo lab tut hi?”

O Dewel penas ap o Moseste: “Me hom, koon me hom. Rake ap i Israelitarja: ‘O baro Dewel, kai kharella Me-Hom bitchras man pash tumende. Job hi o baro Dewel, kones tumare phure dada, o Abraham, o Isaak un o Jakob an-mangan.’ ‘Baro Dewel’ hi miro lab i tsele tsirja. Un jaake hunte kharenn man tire menshe, kai wenna pal tute.

Dja kanna an o them Egiptia, un de i phureden i menshendar Israel khetne gole, un pen ap lende: ‘O baro Dewel, ko Dewel tumare phure dadendar, mukas pes te dikell glan mande. Job hi o Dewel, koles o Abraham, o Isaak un o Jakob an-mangan. Un job penas ap mande: Me dom ap lauter jak, hoi jon tumentsa an o them Egiptia kran.

Me dau miro wast pre: Kau djungelo djipen herell pes pre. Me, o baro Dewel, lau tumen dran o them Egiptia win, un anau tumen an ko them, kai djiwenna i Kanaanitarja, i Hetarja un i Amorarja, i Perisarja, un i Hiwarja un i Jebusarja. Un kowa hi jek them, kai hi bud thud un gwin.’

Un i phureder shunenna ap tiro lab. Palle dja lentsa pash o baro rajeste pral o them Egiptia. Un penenn ap leste: ‘O baro Dewel, koles i Hebrearja an-mangenna, was pash mende. Kanna muk men triin diwessa dur an o mulo tato them te djal, te maras viechen maro Debleske.’”
Un palle penas o baro Dewel: “Me djinau, o baro rai pral o them Egiptia, te well lo gar phagedo, mukell lo tumen gar dran o them win te djal.
Doleske tchiwau bari bibacht ap i Egiptarja, un krau baro koowa mank lende, hoi sikrella miri soor. Pal kowa mukenn le tumen te djal.
Un darjatar krenn le pengre djia tumenge pre un denn tumen bud latcho koowa peha.
Tumare djuwja djan pash kolende, kai langs lende khere hi un mangenn lendar sonakai un rup, un shukar ripja. Kawa lauter lenn lendar un denn les tumare tchawende, te hidjrenn le les.”

O Mose putchas o baro Deblestar: “Hoi hi, te patsenn i Israelitarja gar, hoi me lenge penau, un jon shunenn gar ap mande? Nai well, jon penenna ap mande: ‘O baro Dewel mukas pes gar glan tute te dikell.’”
Penell o baro Dewel ap o Mose: “Hoi hi tut kote an o wast?” “Jek kotar kasht”, penell o Mose.
“Witse o kasht ap i phub”, penell leske o baro Dewel. Un o Mose witsras o kasht ap i phub. Koi was o kasht jek djido sap. Un i darjatar nashas o Mose peske.
Koi penas o baro Dewel ap o Mose: “Tchip tiro wast win! Un tape o sap ap i pori!” Un o Mose tapras o sap. Un har his o sap an leskro wast, was o sap pale i kasht.

Un o baro Dewel penas: “Mose, kre kawa glan i Israelitarja! Palle patsenn le ap tute, te mukom man me, o baro Dewel, glan tute te dikell. Palle djinenn le, te hom me o Dewel, koles lengre phure, o Abraham, o Isaak un o Jakob an-mangan.”
Un pale rakras o baro Dewel ap o Moseste: “Tchip tiro wast tel tiri plaashka!” Un o Mose tchiwas peskro wast tel peskri plaashka. Un har las lo les pale win, his leskro wast nasselo un parno har gib.
Un o baro Dewel penas ap leste: “Tchip tiro wast pale tel i plaashka!” Un job tchiwas peskro wast pale tel i plaashka! Un har las lo les pale win, his o wast pale sasto.
Un o baro Dewel penas: “Te dikenn le ko baro koowa, hoi me tiro kashteha krom, un jon patsenn tut gar, palle patsenn le, te sikreh tu len kau duito baro koowa.

Un te patsenn le tut pale gar, ninna te dikan le ko baro koowa, hoi krom o kashteha un o wasteha, un shunenn gar koi pre, hoi tu lenge peneh, palle le pani dran o Nil, un tchore o pani ap i phub! Palle well ko pani rat.”
Un o Mose penas ap o baro Debleste: “Miro Rai, me haiwau gar mishto te rakrell, ninna kanna kai rakreh mantsa, hi mange phares te rakrap.”

Pale penas o baro Dewel ap o Moseste: “Koon krell, te nai rakrenn i menshe? Un koon krell kowa, te nai rakrell un shunell jek gar? Koon krell kowa, te nai dikenn le? Un koon krell, te nai dikell jek gar? Hom kowa gar me?
Un kanna dja pash lende! Me kamau tiro mui te well, un kamau tuke lauter sikrell, hoi tu lenge te peness!”
Koi penas o Mose: “Miro rai, mangau tut, bitche jek wawares!”

Un har penas o Mose kowa, las o baro Dewel choli ap o Moseste, un job penas ap leste: “Tiro phraal, o Levitari Aron, me djinau, te haiwell lo mishto te rakrell. Shun, job wella pash tute. Un te dikell job tut, palle hi les baro shukapen an peskro dji.
Un pen tiro phraleske halauter, hoi job hunte rakrell! Un me, tumaro Dewel, tchiwau mire laba an tiro mui un leskro mui un sikrau tumen halauter, hoi hunte krenn.
O Aron rakrell tuke ap i Israelitarja, un lauter, hoi tu leske peneh, kowa penell lo! Job hi har tiro mui. Un tu hal leske har i dewel, kai leske i laba an o mui tchiwell.
Un kau kasht le an tiro wast! Koleha kress tu ko baro koowa.”

Un palle djas o Mose pash peskro romjakro dadeste, o Jetro, pale, un penas leske: “Me kamau pale an o them Egiptia pash mire menshende te djal, te dikap, te hi le djido!” Un o Jetro penas ap o Moseste: “Dja o Debleha!”
Un o baro Dewel penas ap o Moseste an o them Midian: “Dja an o them Egiptia palpale! Kol tsele mursha, kai kaman tut te marell, djiwenn buder gar.”
Kote las o Mose peskri romjat un peskre tchawen, un tchiwas len ap i burika. Un jon djan an o them Egiptia. Un o Debleskro kasht las job peha.

Un o baro Dewel rakras ap o Moseste: “Te hal an o them Egiptia, palle kre ko tselo baro koowa, hoi me tut an tiro wast dom, glan o Farao! Un me kamau leskro dji har i bar te krell, te mukell job gar tire menshen dran i Egiptia win.
Un rake ap leste: Jaake rakrella o baro Dewel: ‘O Israel hi miro phureder tchawo.
Un me penau tuke: Muk miro tchawes te djal, te mangell lo man an! Un te mukeh les gar te djal, palle marau me tiro phureder tchawo.’”
Un har his o Mose ap o drom, djas lo an i kheer, kote atchas lo pral i rat. Ap jek kopo was o baro Dewel ap leste, un kamas les te marell.

Palle las i Zippora sik i tchuri, un tchinas peskro tchawes ap o mass, un tchiwas kowa, hoi joi tele tchinas, ap o Moseskre pire. Un joi penas: “Rat ratas, un tu hunte meress gar. Tiro djipen was tuke newes dino. Jaake wal i duito kopo miro rom.”
Kau lab penas li doleske, kai tchinas li peskro tchawes ap o mass. Palle mukas o baro Dewel o Moseske tele.
An ko tsiro penas o baro Dewel ap o Aron: “Dja pash o Moseste an o mulo tato them!” Un o Aron djas koi. Un jon hatsan pen pash i Debleskri berga, un lan pen an i mussi un tchumran pen.
Un o Mose penas o Aroneske halauter, hoi o baro Dewel leske penas, ninna ko baro koowa, hoi job an o Debleskri soor krell.
Un khetne djan le an o them Egiptia un dan i phureden i menshendar Israel khetne gole.
Un o Aron penas lenge i tsele laba, hoi o baro Dewel ap o Moseste penas. Palle kras o Mose glan lengre jaka ko baro koowa an o Debleskri soor.
Un jon patsan len. Un har shunan i Israelitarja, te dikas o baro Dewel lengro pharo djipen, un kamell lenge latchepen te krell, koi witsran pen le ap i phub, un mangan o Debles an.

Palle djas o Mose un o Aron pash o Farao un penan ap leste: “Jaake rakrella o baro Dewel, kai o Israeleskro Dewel hi: ‘Muk mire menshen te djal, te djan le an o mulo tato them, un kote sharenn le man.’”

Un o Farao penas ap o Moseste un ap o Aroneste: “Hawo dewel hi kowa, kai me shunap ap leste? Hoske mukap me i Israelitarja te djal? Me prindjrau ko debles gar, un me mukau gar i Israelitarjen te djal.”

O Mose un o Aron penan ap o Farao: “O baro Dewel, ko Dewel, koles i Hebrearja an-mangenn, job mukas pes glan mende te dikell. Kanna, muk men triin diwessa dur te djal an o mulo tato them. Mer kamah maro Debleske kote viechen te marell. Un kowa te krah mer gar, nai well lo chojedo ap mende, jaake te well baro nasslepen un kurepen ap mende.”

Koi penas o Farao ap lende: “Tumer, Mose un Aron, hoske kamenn tumer kol menshen dran pengri budi te lell? Jon hi budeder har i Egiptarja. Un tumer kamenn len pale te rikrell, te krenn le buder gar pengri budi! Djan tumenge! Hakeno pash peskri budi!”
Ap kau diwes penas o Farao ap kol pralstune Egiptarja un ap kol pralstune Israelitarja, kai dan jak ap i budepangre:
“Denn len buder kek phuss, te tchiwenn le kowa an koi tchik, kolatar jon barra chatchenna! Mukenn len ko phuss penge kokres khetne te tchiwell!

Ninna te hunte tchiwenn le ko phuss penge kokres khetne, hunte krenn le jaake bud barra, har kran le glan kau tsiro. Penenn lenge, te mukenn le gar tele. Jon kamenn gar te budrell. Doleske putchan le mandar, te mukap len te djal, te marenn le viechen lengro debleske.
Denn len jaake bud budi, te shunenn le gar ap kau chocheno rakepen!”
Koi djan kol pralstune Egiptarja un kol Israelitarja, kai dan jak ap i budepangre, pash lende un penan lenge: “O Farao penas, te das mer tumen buder kek phuss.
Djan tumenge koi, un tchiwenn tumen kokres phuss khetne! Krenn jaake bud barra har kran hako diwes!”
Koi djan kol menshe trujel an o tselo them Egiptia, te tchiwenn le penge phuss khetne.
Un kol pralstune Egiptarja tradan len un penan: “Krenn jaake bud barra har an ko tsiro, kai dan le tumende phuss!”

Un kol Israelitarja, kolen i pralstune Egiptarja pral i budepangre tchiwan, te denn le jak lende, kolla chan dawa. Un lenge was penlo: “Hoske kran tumer gar kau diwes un witar gar taissar jaake bud barra har glan kowa?”
Koi djan kol Israelitarja, kai ap i budepangre jak dan, pash o Farao un penan leske: “Maro rai, hoske kreh tu jaake mentsa?
Kek dell men phuss, un menge well penlo: ‘Krenn barra!’ Un mer, tire budepangre, chah dawa. Tire menshe krenn mentsa, hoi gar mishto hi.”
O Farao penas: “Tumer kamenn gar te budrell. Jaake hi kowa! Doleske penan: Mer kamah te djal, te maras viechen o baro Debleske.
Kanna djan ap tumari budi! Kek phuss well tumende dino! Un jaake bud barra har glan kowa hunte krenna!”
Har shunan i mursha, kai hunte krenn le hako diwes jaake bud barra har glan kowa, koi dikan le, te dikell lenge gar mishto win.
An ko tsiro his o Mose un o Aron win tardo. Har wan i mursha dran o Faraeskro kheer win, djan le pash lende un penan lenge:
“O baro Debleskri choli well ap tumende! Tumer kran, te ham o Faraeske un leskre pralstunenge har djukle. Kanna hi an lengre wasta, te nai marenn le men.”
Un o Mose was pale glan o baro Debleste un penas ap leste: “Miro rai, hoske kreh tu sawo tchilatchepen ap kal menshende? Hoske bitchral tu man pash lende?
Hako kopo, har djom pash o Farao un penom leske, hoi tu kamal, kras lo i menshenge o djipen gomme phareder. Tu kral tchi, te less tire menshen koi win!”
Koi penas o baro Dewel ap o Mose: “Kanna dikess tu, hoi me o Faraeske krau. Dran miri bari soor mukell lo len te djal. Miro wast well jaake sorelo ap leste, te tradell lo len dran o them win.”
Un o Dewel rakras o Moseha un penas leske: “Me hom o baro Dewel,
un sikrom man o Abrahameste un o Isaakeste un o Jakobeste. Har wom pash lende, sikrom lende, kai hom o sorelo Dewel. Miro lab ‘baro Dewel’, mukom len gar te djinell.
Ninna dom lende miro wast koi pre, te dap len o them Kanaan, ko them, kai jon wi-themarja his.
Ninna shunom me i gole, har i Israelitarja gole dan i dukatar, har i Egiptarja lenge i sorjah phari budi pre tchiwan. Un me bistrom miro lab gar un rikrau les.
Doleske pen ap i Israelitarja: ‘Me hom o baro Dewel! Me lau tumen win dran tumari phari budi, hoi i Egiptarja ap tumende tchiwan. Miri bari choli well ap lende, un bari sorjah lau tumen win.

Kamau, te wenn tumer mire menshe, un me kamau tumaro Dewel te well. Un tumer dikenn un haiwenn, te hom me, o baro Dewel, tumaro Dewel, kai las tumen win dran i phari budi, hoi i Egiptarja ap tumende tchiwan.

Palle anau me tumen an ko them, koleske me miro wast dom, un man sowel dom, te dau les o Abrahameste un o Isaakeste un o Jakobeste. Kau them dau me tumende, te well lo tumaro them. Me, o baro Dewel, dau les tumende.’”
Kal laba penas o Mose ap i Israelitarja. Ninna har rakras job jaake ap lende, shunan le gar ap leste. Jaake phari his lengri budi ap lende, un an lengre djia his buder kek soor.
Kote rakras o baro Dewel ap o Moseste un penas:
“Dja dren pash o Farao, ko baro rai pral o them Egiptia, un pen leske, te mukell lo i Israelitarja dran leskro them te djal.”
O Mose penas ap o baro Debleste: “Dik, i Israelitarja shunan gar ap mande. Har shunell palle o Farao ap mande? Ninna haiwau gar mishto te rakrell.”
Un o baro Dewel rakras ap o Moseste un ap o Aroneste un bitchras len pash i Israelitarja un pash o Farao, ko baro rai pral o them Egiptia, te mukell lo i Israelitarjen dran o them Egiptia te djal.

Kalla hi i laba kol phure dadendar, kolendar i Israelitarja wan: O Ruben his o Israeleskro phureder tchawo. Leskre tchawe hi: o Henoch, o Pallu, o Hezron un o Karmi. Lendar wan bare familje, kolengro phuro dad o Ruben his.

O Simeon his i wawar Israeleskro tchawo. Leskre tchawe hi: o Jemuel, o Jamin, o Ohad, o Jachin, o Zohar un o Shaul. O Shaouleskri dai his i Kanaanitetsa. Lendar wan bare familje, kolengro phuro dad o Simeon his.
O Levi his i wawar Israeleskro tchawo. Leskre tchawe hi: o Gershon, o Kohat un o Merari. Kolendar wan i Levitarja. Un o Levi was 137 (sheel-te-trijanda-te-efta) bersha phuro.
O Gershon, les his dui tchawe. Kolla hi: O Libni un o Shimi un lengre familje.
O Kohat, les his tchawe. Kolla hi: o Amram, o Jizhar, o Hebron un o Usijel. O Kohat was 133 (sheel-te-trijanda-te-triin) bersha phuro.
O Merari, les his tchawe. Kolla hi: o Machli un o Mushi. Kalla hi lauter i menshe, kai wan pal o Levi, hakeno an ko tsiro, kai job djiwas.
Un o Amram las peske i romni, i Jochebed, i pheen leskro dadestar. Un koja las dui tchawe: o Aron un o Mose. Un o Amram was 137 (sheel-te-trijanda-te-efta) bersha phuro.
O Jizhar, les his triin tchawe. Kolla hi: O Korach, o Nefeg un o Sichri.
O Usijel, les his triin tchawe. Kolla hi: O Mishael, o Elizafan un o Sitri.
O Aron las peske i romni: i Elisheba. Lakro dad hi o Amminadab. Un lakro phraal hi o Nachshon. Un joi las tchawe: o Nadab, un o Abihu, o Eleasar un o Itamar.
O Korach, les his triin tchawe. Kolla his: O Assir, o Elkana un o Abjasaf. Kolendar wan i bare familje, hoi kharenna Koracharja.
O Aroneskro tchawo, o Eleasar, las peske i romni. Kolakro dad his o Putijel. Un joi las i tchawo, o Pinhas. Kal phure dadendar wenna bare familje, jon hi lauter Levitarja.
Kowa Aron un kowa Mose hi kolla, ap kolende o baro Dewel penas: “Anenn i Israelitarja win dran o them Egiptia! Anenn len jaake win, te djal haki bari familja khetne!”
Jon his kol mursha, kai penan ap ko baro rajeste pral o them Egiptia, o Farao, te mukell job i Israelitarjen dran o them Egiptia win te djal.
Ap ko diwes har o baro Dewel ap o Moseste rakras an o them Egiptia,
penas lo: “Me hom o baro Dewel. Pen ap o Farao, ko baro rajeste pral i Egiptia, halauter, hoi me tuke penom.”
Un o Mose penas ap o baro Debleste: “Tu djineh, me haiwau gar mishto te rakrell. Har shunell o Farao ap mande?”
Un o baro Dewel penas ap o Moseste: “Shun, me krom, te wess har o Dewel o Faraeske. Un tiro phraal Aron rakrell tuke. Job rakrell, hoi leske peneh.
Tu peness o Aroneske lauter, hoi me tuke penau. Un job penell les ap o Farao, te mukell job i Israelitarjen dran peskro them te djal.
Me kamau leskro dji har i bar te krell, jaake te nai krap bud baro koowa an o tselo them Egiptia, te sikrap miri bari soor.
Un o Farao shunella gar ap tumende, ninna te well miri choli bud kope pral leste un leskro them. Un palle lau mire menshen, i Israelitarja, win dran o them Egiptia.
Un kol Egiptarja dikenn un haiwenn, kai hom me o baro Dewel, te hadau me miro wast pral o them Egiptia un lau i Israelitarja mashkral lende win.”
Un o Mose un o Aron kran jaake, har o baro Dewel lenge penas.
Un o Mose his 80 (ochta-deesh) bersha un o Aron 83 (ochta-deesh-te-triin) bersha phuro, har jon ap o Farao rakran.
Un o baro Dewel penas ap o Mose un ap o Aron:

“Te rakrell o Farao ap tumende un penell: ‘Krenn jek baro koowa an o Debleskri soor, jaake te patsap tumen’, palle peness tu ap o Aron: ‘Le tiro kasht un witse les glan o Farao!’ Palle well o kasht i sap.”

Kote djan o Mose un o Aron pash o Farao dren, un kran les jaake, har o baro Dewel lenge penas. Un o Aron witsras peskro kasht ap i phub glan o Farao un glan kol pralstunende an o rajeskro kheer. Un o kasht was i sap.
Kote mukas o Farao i gosewe murshen un i durkepangren gole te dell. Un kol egiptikre durkepangre kran emligo koowa an pengri soor.
Jon witsran ninna pengre kashta ap i phub. Un ninna lendar wan sapa. O Aroneskro kasht chas ko wawar kashta pre.
Har dikas o Farao kowa, atchas leskro dji pandlo, un job shunas gar ap lende. Jaake was, hoi o baro Dewel penas.
Un o baro Dewel penas ap o Mose: “O Faraeskro dji hi har dran bar. Job mukell gar i Israelitarjen te djal.
Dja taissarlakro pash o Farao! Job djala tele pash o pani Nil. Le ko kasht an tiro wast, kolestar i sap was.

Un pen ap leste: ‘O baro Dewel, o Dewel pral i Hebrearja, bitchras man pash tute, un mukell tuke te penell: Muk mire menshen te djal, te mangenn le man an an o mulo tato them. O tselo tsiro shunal tu gar.
Doleske penell o baro Dewel: Dikess un haiwess, te hom me o baro Dewel. Dik, me dau o kashteha, hoi an miro wast hi, ap o pani Nil. Un ko pani well rat.
Palle merenn i tsele matche dren. Un o Nil khandella jaake djungeles, te nai pijell kek Egiptari o pani buder.’”

Un o baro Dewel penas ap o Mose: “Pen ap o Aron: Le tiro kasht un rike tiro wast pral i panja an o them Egiptia: pral i panja, hoi nashenna un pral o pani, hoi tardo hi. Jaake te well o tselo pani rat an o tselo them Egiptia. Ninna an i khore dran kasht un bar hi palle rat dren.”
Un o Mose un o Aron kran jaake, har o baro Dewel lenge penas. Un job hadas o kasht un das ap o pani Nil. Un o Farao un i pralstune an leskro kheer dikan kowa. Un o tselo pani an o Nil was rat.
Un i matche an o Nil meran. Un o Nil was khandlo un khandas jaake soreles, te nai pijas kek Egiptari o pani dran o Nil. Un o rat his an o tselo them Egiptia.
Un i durkepangre an o them Egiptia kran ninna jaake an pengri soor. Un o Faraeskro dji atchas pale pandlo, un job shunas gar ap lende. Jaake was, hoi o baro Dewel penas.
Un o Farao rissras pes trujel un djas pale an peskro kheer un mukas peske kowa gar an o dji te djal.
I tsele Egiptarja hadan i phub win pash o pani Nil, te hatsenn le pani te pijell. O pani dran o Nil nai pijan le gar.
Un efta diwessa djan trujel pal ko diwes, kai o baro Dewel ap o pani Nil das.
Koi rakras o baro Dewel ap o Mose: “Dja pash o Farao dren, un pen ap leste: ‘Kawa penell o baro Dewel: Muk mire menshen te djal, te nai mangenn le man an.
Te mukeh tu len gar te djal, palle dau me o tselo them jaake, te well lo pherdo djambe.

O tselo Nil well pherdo djambe. Un jon wenn pre an tiro kheer, an tiri isema, kai soweh, un an tiro tchiben, ninna an i khera, kai i pralstune djiwenna, ninna an i tsele khera, kai i Egiptarja djiwenna, an lengre boba, un an i tchare, kai jon o maro dren krenn.
Awa, i djambe wenna pre ap tute un ap i tsele Egiptarja, ninna ap i tsele pralstunende.’”
Un o baro Dewel penas ap o Mose: “Pen ap o Aron, te rikrell lo peskro kasht pral i tsele panja, kolla, hoi nashenna un kolla, hoi tardo hi! Un muk i djambe pral o tselo them Egiptia pre te well.”
Kote rikras o Aron peskro wast pral i panja an o them Egiptia. Un i djambe wan pre, un his jaake bud, te his o tselo them lentsa pherdo.
Koi wan i durkepangre un kran pengri sorjah ninna jaake, un mukan ninna djambe pral o them Egiptia te well.

Kote mukas o Farao o Moses un o Arones pash peste gole te dell un penas: “Mangenn o baro Debles, te lell lo i djambe mandar un mire menshendar krik! Palle mukau i Israelitarjen te djal, te nai denn le o baro Debleske viechen temerl.”

Un o Mose penas ap o Farao: “Tu nai peneh mange, kaana te mangap tuke un i pralstunenge an tiro kheer, un tire menshenge, te hunte merenn i djambe pash tute un an tiro kheer, te atchenn le kokres an o Nil.”
Un job penas: “Taissar.” Un o Mose penas: “Jaake har tu penal, jaake te dikess un haiwess, te hi kek wawar jaake, har maro baro Dewel.
Un i djambe hunte djan penge tutar un dran tiro kheer, ninna dran i khera kol pralstunendar un tire tsele menshendar. Kokres an o Nil atchenn le pral.”
Un o Mose un o Aron djan dran o Faraeskro kheer win. Un o Mose das o baro Debles gole un mangas les, te lell lo i djambe krik, hoi job pral o Farao anas.
Un o baro Dewel kras jaake, har o Mose lestar mangas. Un i djambe meran an i khera un glan i khera un ap lengri hachetikri phub.
Un jon tchoran kol bud djambe khetne. Un o tselo them khandas lendar.
Har dikas o Farao, te hi i bibacht lestar krik, jaake har leske penlo was, kote pandas job pale peskro dji un shunas gar ap lende. Jaake was, hoi o baro Dewel penas.
Un o baro Dewel penas ap o Mose: “Pen ap o Aron: ‘Hade tiro kasht pre un de an i tchik ap i phub!’ Palle well koi tchik an o tselo them Egiptia matsille, kai denn tchurje.”
Un jaake kran le kowa: O Aron hadas peskro kasht, un das an i tchik ap i phub. Kote wan i matsille pral i menshende un viechende. I tseli tchik was matsille an o tselo them Egiptia.
I durkepangre kaman kowa ninna pengri sorjah te krell. Un jon haiwan les gar. Un i matsille his ap i menshende un ap i viechende.
Kote penan i durkepangre ap o Farao: “Kawa hi o Debleskro wast!” Ninna kanna rikras o Farao peskro dji pandlo un shunas gar ap lende. Jaake was, hoi o baro Dewel penas.
Un o baro Dewel penas ap o Mose: “Taissarla, te djal o Farao pash o pani Nil, dja pash leste un pen ap leste: ‘Kawa penell o baro Dewel: Muk mire menshen te djal, te mangenn le man an!

Te mukeh tu mire menshen gar te djal, palle mukau me wawar matsille te well, hoi tchurje denn. Jon wenna pral tute un tire pralstunende un tire tsele menshende. Tumare khera wenna pherdo matsille, hoi tchurje denn. Ninna i phub, kai i Egiptarja djiwenna, wella pherdo lendar.
Ap ko diwes krau kowa an ko them Gosen, kai mire menshe djiwenna, wawartchandes. Kote wenn kek matsille, hoi tchurje denn. Jaake te dikess un te haiwess, te hom me o baro Dewel kate an kau them.
Un tu dikess, te hi wawartchandes pash mire menshende har pash tire menshende. Ko baro koowa well taissar pral tumende.’”
Un o baro Dewel kras kowa jaake. Un i matsille, hoi tchurje denn, wan an o Faraeskro kheer un an i khera kol pralstunendar un an o tselo them Egiptia. Jaake was kowa i bari bibacht o tselo themeske.
Kote mukas o Farao o Moses un o Arones gole te dell un penas ap lende: “Djan un marenn kate an o them viechen tumaro Debleske!”

O Mose penas: “Kowa djal gar. Kol viechen, hoi mer maro baro Debleske marah, hi pale-tchiddo pash i Egiptarja. Te marah mer kol viechen kote, kai i Egiptarja nai dikenn men, palle hadenn jon barra pre un witsrenn men lentsa mules.
Triin diwessa kamah mer te nashell dur an o mulo tato them dren, un kote kamah mer maro baro Debleske viechen te marell, jaake har job menge penas, te hunte kras kowa.”
Kote penas o Farao: “Me mukau tumen te djal, te nai marenn viechen leske an o mulo tato them. Ma djan jaake dur krik! Un mangenn tumaro Debles mange!”

Un o Mose penas: “Awa, te djom me tutar win, palle mangau o baro Deblestar, te djan i matsille, hoi tchurje denn, taissar penge tumendar lauterendar: tutar, o Farao, ninna tire pralstunendar un tire tsele menshendar. Jek koowa penau tuke: Rike tiro lab! Ma pen pale, te mukals men te djal, te nai marah mer viechen o baro Debleske. – Un palle mukeh tu men gar te djal.”
Un o Mose djas win dran o Faraeskro kheer un mangas o baro Debles leske.
Un o baro Dewel kras jaake har o Mose lestar mangas, un las i tsele matsille, hoi tchurje denn, krik o Faraestar un leskre pralstunendar, ninna leskre tsele menshendar, jaake te atchas gar jek pral.
Un ninna kau kopo pandas o Farao peskro dji un mukas i Israelitarja gar te djal.
Kote penas o baro Dewel ap o Mose: “Dja pash o Farao dren un pen leske: Kawa penell o baro Dewel, o Dewel pral i Hebrearja: Muk mire menshen te djal, te nai mangenn le man an.
Te mukeh len tu gar te djal, un rikreh len pale pale,
palle dikeh tu, te well o baro Debleskro wast pral tire viechende: pral tire graja, tire burike, tire khamele, tire grumja un tire bakre un busja. Jek baro nasslepen well ap lende.
Kau baro nasslepen well gar ap i viechende, hoi i Israelitarjen hi. O baro Dewel krell wawartchandes pash i Egiptarja har pash i Israelitarja. Kolendar merell kek viecho.”
Ninna penas o baro Dewel o tsiro, kaana job kowa krella, un penas: “Taissar mukell o baro Dewel kai bibacht pral o them te well.”
Un o baro Dewel kras kowa ap o wawar diwes jaake. Un i tsele vieche, hoi i Egiptarjen his, meran. Kol viechendar, hoi i Israelitarjen his, meras kek viecho.

Un o Farao bitchras murshen pash lende, te dikenn le palla, hoi i Israeltikre viechentsa hi. Un har kolla koi his, dikan le, te meras pash lende kek lengre viechendar. Ninna kau kopo atchas o Faraeskro dji pandlo un job mukas i Israelitarjen gar te djal.
Kote penas o baro Dewel ap o Mose un ap o Aron: “Lenn tumenge i dui wastentsa tchik dran o bob win, un o Mose witsrell lat glan o Faraeskre jaka pre an o bolepen.
Palle well i tchik phurdedo pral o tselo them Egiptia. Un i menshe un i vieche taprenn i djungelo nasslepen ap pengro mass.”
Un o Mose un o Aron lan tchik dran o bob un djan glan o Farao. Un o Mose witsras koi tchik pre an o bolepen. Koi tapran i menshe un i vieche i djungelo nasslepen ap pengro mass.
Kau kopo nai wan i durkepangre gar glan o Mose, te krenn le jaake har job. Ko djungelo nasslepen his ninna ap lende har ap hako Egiptari.
Un o baro Dewel pandas o Faraeskro dji, un job shunas gar ap lende. Jaake was, hoi o baro Dewel ap o Mose penas.

Kote penas o baro Dewel ap o Moseste: “Taissarla ste sik pre, dja glan o Farao un pen ap leste: ‘Kawa penell o baro Dewel, o Dewel pral i Hebrearja: Muk mire menshen te djal, te nai mangenn le man an.
