Te shuneh tu kau kopo pale gar, palle kamau me i djungleder bibacht pral tute un tire pralstunende un pral tire tsele menshende te bitchrell, te dikess un haiwess, te hi kek ap kai phub jaake har me.
Me nai hadoms glan rah tsiro miro wast pre un doms tut i nasslepah temerl, tut un tire tsele menshen, jaake te wans tumendar kek buder ap kai phub.
Me mukom tut doleske djido, te dikess miri bari soor, un te rakrenn le mandar ap i tseli phub.
Tu patseh, tu nai kreh mire menshentsa, hoi kameh, un mukeh len gar te djal.
Dik, taissar an ko emligo tsiro mukau brishin te dell, hoi hi har barra. Kol brishineskre barra hi jaake baro, har an o them Egiptia gar das, jaake rah kau them della.
Kanna pen, te lenn le i viechen dren. Un kowa, hoi win tardo hi, te anenn le les khere. Lauter, hoi win hi, menshe har vieche hunte merenna.’”
Kol Faraeskre pralstune, kai daran, hoi o baro Dewel penas, kolla mukan pengre budepangren un viechen an i khera te anell.
Kolla, kai mukan penge kol laba, hoi o baro Dewel penas, gar an o dji te djal, kolla mukan pengre budepangren un pengre viechen win.

Un o baro Dewel penas ap o Mose: “Hade tiro wast pre ap o bolepen! Palle dell brishin, hoi hi har barra, ap i menshende, ap i viechende un ap o tselo senlepen ap i hachetikri phub an o tselo them Egiptia.”

Kote hadas o Mose peskro kasht pre ap o bolepen. Un o baro Dewel mukas barrengro brishin ap i phub te perell. Un o bolepen das bari gole, un das jag karje pral un tele ap i phub. Ko brishin, kai jag pral un tele karje das, un brishineskre barra ap i phub peran, kowa his jaake pharo, har gomme gar das, jaake rah har i menshe an o them Egiptia djiwenna.
Un kol brishineskre barra dan an o tselo them Egiptia lauter paash, hoi win his: menshe har vieche, ninna o tselo senlepen ap i hachetikri phub. Un i ruka wan tele phagedo.
Kokres an o them Gosen, kai i Israelitarja djiwan, kote peras kek barrengro brishin tele.
Kote bitchras o Farao pash o Mose un o Aron, te wenn le, un penas ap lende: “Kau kopo anom doosh ap mande. O baro Debles hi tchatches. Man un mire menshen hi gar tchatcho.
Mang o baro Debles, te well kanna o barrengro brishin doha, un te dell o bolepen buder gar gole! Palle mukau me tumen te djal, un rikrau tumen buder gar kai.”

O Mose penas leske: “Jaake sik har djom dran o foro win, kamau mire wasta pre te hadell ap o baro Debleste. Palle dell o bolepen buder kek gole, un kek barrengro brishin perell buder, te dikess un haiwess, te hi i phub o baro Debleske.
Tu un tire pralstune, kowa haiwom, tumer darenna gomme gar o baro Deblestar.”
Jaake was o djob paash dino, ninna ko senlepen, hoi kharella ‘Flachs’. O djob his baro un pherdo, un o Flachs djas pre.
O gib un o wawar djob, hoi gomme gar pre djas, wan gar paash dino.

Palle djas o Mose win dran o Faraeskro kheer un dran o foro, un hadas peskre wasta pre ap o baro Debleste. Un o bolepen das buder kek gole. Un buder kek barrengro brishin peras tele. Un kek depen das buder ap i phub.
Har o Farao dikas, te heras kowa lauter pre, kras lo gar, hoi o baro Dewel lestar kamella, un pandas pale peskro dji. Un jaake kran ninna i pralstune an leskro them.
Jaake was tchatcho, hoi o baro Dewel ap o Moseste penas un o Mose i Israelenge dureder penas: O Faraeskro dji atchas pandlo, un job mukas i Israelitarjen gar te djal.
Pal kowa penas o baro Dewel ap o Mose: “Dja pash o Farao dren! Me pandom leskro dji, ninna i djia leskre pralstunendar, te nai krom kau baro koowa an miri soor mashkral lende.
Kowa krom, te nai peness tu tire tchawenge un tire tchawengre tchawenge, har krom me ap i Egiptarja, un hawo baro koowa me krom mank lende an miri soor. Tumer hunte djinenn, te hom me o baro Dewel.”

Kote djas o Mose un o Aron pash o Farao dren un penan ap leste: “Kawa penell o baro Dewel, o Dewel pral i Hebrearja: ‘Har rah kameh tu gar te dikell, kai hom sorleder har tu? Muk mire menshen te djal, te nai mangenn le man an!
Te mukeh tu gar mire menshen te djal, palle kamau me taissar stepangre pral tiro them te bitchrell.

Kolla tchakrenn o them, un hi jaake bud, te nai dikeh i phub buder gar. Un kolla chan kowa pre, hoi pral atchas, har o barrengro brishin peras un bud djob paash das. Ninna i patria ap i ruka chan le pre.

Un tiro kheer un i khera, kai tire pralstune un i wawar Egiptarja djiwenn, wenn pherdo stepangre. Sawo koowa was gar diklo an o them Egiptia, jaake rah har tire phure an kau them djiwan.’” Pal kowa rissras pes o Mose un djas peske dran o Faraeskro kheer win.
Kote penan i pralstune ap o Farao: “Har rah anell kau mursh gomme bibacht pral mende? Muk kol menshen te djal, te mangenn le lengro baro Debles an. Haiweh tu gar, te djal i tseli Egiptia nashedo?”
Kote pre was o Mose un o Aron pale glan o Farao anlo. Un job penas ap lende: “Djan un mangenn tumaro baro Debles an! Koon hi kolla tumendar, kai djan?”
Un o Mose penas: “Mer djah i ternentsa un i phurentsa, mare tchawentsa un tchentsa. Ninna mare bakre, busja un grumja lah mentsa. Mer kamah maro baro Debles te sharell un leske viechen te marell.”
O Farao penas ap lende: “O baro Debleskri bacht pral tumende! Patseh tu tchatchepah, kai me mukau tumen tumare tchawentsa te djal? Ap kowa dikenn, te hi tumen tchilatchepen an o shero.
Na-a, jaake gar! Tumer mursha kokres, djan un mangenn tumaro baro Debles an! Kowa hi, hoi tumer kaman.” Un jon tradan len dran o Faraeskro kheer win.
Kote penas o baro Dewel ap o Mose: “Hade tiro wast pral o them Egiptia pre, te wenn i stepangre pral o tselo them, un chan lauter hoi pral atchas, har o barrengro brishin ap o them peras.”

Un o Mose hadas peskro kasht pral o them Egiptia. Kote mukas o baro Dewel ko tselo diwes un i tseli rat jek sorelo ducho pral o them te phurdell, hoi was katar, kai o kham pre djal. Un taissarlakro phurdas ko ducho i stepangre an o them.
Un jaake wan i stepangre pral o tselo them Egiptia. Jon his jaake bud, har gomme gar koi his un gar buder wenna,

un tchakran i phub, jaake te was o tselo them kales. Un jon chan o tselo senlepen un lauter, hoi ap i ruka baro was, hoi pral atchas, har o barrengro brishin ap o them peras. Kek senlepen atchas pral ap i ruka un ap i hachetikri phub an o tselo them Egiptia.
Kote mukas o Farao o Moses un o Arones sik gole te dell, un penas ap lende: “Me anom doosh ap mande glan tumaro baro Debleste, un ninna glan tumende.
Jaake mangau tumen, bistrenn miri doosh kokres kau jek kopo, un mangenn tumaro baro Debles, te lell lo kau merepen mandar krik.”
Un o Mose djas win dran o Faraeskro kheer un mangas o baro Debles leske.

Un o baro Dewel kras, te phurdas ko baro ducho kanna soreles katar, kai o kham tele djal. Un ko ducho hadas i stepangre pre un witsras len an o baro pani, hoi kharella ‘Baro Lolo Pani’. An o tselo them Egiptia atchas kek stepaskro pral.
Ninna kau kopo pandas o baro Dewel o Faraeskro dji. Un job mukas i Israelitarjen gar te djal.
Kote penas o baro Dewel ap o Mose: “Hade tiro wast pre pash o bolepen! Palle well sawi kali rat pral o tselo them Egiptia, kai dikeh nai tiro wast gar glan i jaka.”
Un o Mose hadas peskro wast pash o bolepen pre. Kote was i kali rat pral o tselo them Egiptia. Triin diwessa atchas li.
Jaake kales his, te nai dikas jek o wawares gar. Un kek stas kote pre, kai job his. Pash i Israelitarja his diwes, kote kai jon djiwan.
Kote mukas o Farao o Moses gole te dell, un penas ap leste: “Djan un mangenn tumaro baro Debles an! Ninna tumare romja un tchawe nai djan tumentsa. Kokres tumare bakren, busja un grumjen mukenn kai!”
O Mose penas: “Na-a, ninna te kamals tu men viechen te dell, hoi mer maro baro Debleske marah un chah, ninna sawen, hoi mer leske tseles chatchrah,

ninna palle djan mare tsele vieche mentsa. Kek heri lendar nai atchella kai. Kol viechendar lah mer, te das len maro baro Debleske. Un mer djinah gar, hawe vieche te maras mer leske ap o drom, kote kai djah.”
Un pale pandas o baro Dewel o Faraeskro dji, te mukas lo len pale gar te djal.
Un o Farao penas ap leste: “Dja tuke mandar! Un de tut jak, te wess buder gar glan mire jaka! Ap ko diwes, kai tu pale glan mire jaka weh, dau tut mulo.”
Koi penas o Mose: “Jaake har tu penal, me wau tuke buder gar glan tire jaka.”
Palle penas o baro Dewel ap o Mose: “Jek wawar bibacht kamau me pral o Farao un pral o tselo them Egiptia te anell. Pal koja mukell lo tumen te djal. Un kowa hi gar doha: job tradell tumen win.

Jaake pen kanna ap i Israelitarja, te mangell hako rom peske rup un sonakai ko egiptikro murshestar, kai langs leste djiwella. Ninna haki romni mangell kowa koi egiptikri djuwjatar, kai langs late djiwella.”
Un o baro Dewel kras, te wenn i Egiptarja latches ap lende. Ninna his o Mose bud an-diklo an o them Egiptia an i jaka kol pralstunendar an o Faraeskro kheer un ninna pash i tsele Egiptarja.
Har his o Mose gomme pash o Farao, penas lo leske: “Kawa penell o baro Dewel: Mashkral an i rat kamau me mank o them Egiptia te djal.

Palle merenna i tsele mursh tchawe an o them Egiptia, kai hi i phureder tchawe pengre dajendar: o Faraeskro phureder tchawo, kai ap o rajeskri beshepaskri beshdo hi, un ninna o phureder tchawo kol djuwjatar, kai dran o djob jarro krella. Un ninna kol mursh vieche, kai hi i phureder tchawe pengre dajendar hunte merenn.
Un palle well i baro ropen an o tselo them Egiptia, jaake har his gomme kek ropen un well buder kek ropen.

Hi wawartchandes pash i Israelitarja. Kote dell kek djuklo gole, gar ap i mensheste, witar gar ap i viecheste. Jaake te dikenn un haiwenn tumer, te djinell o baro Dewel, koon Egiptari hi un koon Israelitari hi.

Palle wenna tire pralstune lauter pash mande un witsrenn pen glan mire pire tele un mangenn man an un penenn: ‘Djan tumenge, tu un tire tsele menshe, djan!’ Un palle djah mer menge.” Un mulo chojedo djas o Mose peske dran o Faraeskro kheer win.
Jaake was kowa tchatcho, hoi o baro Dewel penas ap o Mose: “O Farao shunella gar ap tumende, jaake te krau bud un baro koowa, un sikrau miri soor an o tselo them Egiptia.”
Un o Mose un o Aron kran ko tselo baro koowa an o Debleskri soor glan o Farao. Un o baro Dewel pandas leskro dji, te mukas lo i Israelitarjen gar dran peskro them te djal.
Un o baro Dewel penas ap o Mose un ap o Aron an o them Egiptia:
“Kawa tchon well tumenge o ersto tchon an o bersh.
Rakrenn ap i tsele Israelitarja un penenn: Ap o deshto diwes an kawa tchon lell peske hako dad i terno bakro peskre menshenge an peskro kheer.
Te hi gar doha menshe an leskro kheer, te chan le ko tselo bakro, palle chan le les khetne kol menshentsa, kai langs lende djiwenna. Hakenes te well i kotar mass.
Lenn jek viecho, hoi sasto hi, i mursh, hoi jek bersh phuro hi, nai well i bakrendar, nai well i busjendar.
Un rikrenn les pash tumende bis ap o deesh-te-starto diwes. Rati ap ko diwes, hunte marell haki Israeltikri familja peskro bakro.
Palle lenn le ko rat un makenn les ap kol kashta, hoi tchatches un serwes pash o wudar hi, un pral o wudar ninna, an ko kheer, kai chan le o bakro.
Ko mass well peklo pral i jag. Un jon hunte chan les an koi rat khetne o maro, kai kek shutlo jarro dren hi. Un shutlo senlepen chan le pashel.
Ma chan ko mass jales, witar gar keredo an o pani! Pral i jag well o tselo bakro peklo, o shero, i herja, ninna i buke.
Tchi kolestar atchell pral bis ap o wawar diwes. Te atchas tchomone pral, hunte chatchrenn kowa.

Jaake hunte chan les: trul tumaro per i dori pandlo, i kircha ap tumare herja, un i kasht an tumaro wast. Chan o chapen sik! Ko chapen kharell Passa. Tumer chan les, te sharenn man, tumaro baro Debles.

Un me djau an kaja rat mashkral o tselo them Egiptia, un dau i tsele mursh tchawen temerl, kai hi i phureder tchawe pengre dajendar, kolla, kai i menshestar, ninna i viechestar boldo wan. Jaake dau me kolende lauterende i phagi, kai kharenn pen dewel, un kolen i Egiptarja an-mangenna. Me hom o baro Dewel.
O rat ap i khera sikrell mande, kai tumer han. Un dikau me o rat, djau me dureder, te djal tumenge tchi. Un ko merepen, hoi anau ap o them Egiptia, well gar ap tumende.
Bistrenn kau diwes gar! Krenn lestar i baro diwes, kai sharenn o baro Debles, tumer un tumare tchawe, kai wenna pal tumende! Hako bersh well kawa jaake pash tumende kerdo kanna un hako tsiro.

Efta diwessa chan tumer maro, kai kek shutlo jarro dren hi. Ap o ersto diwes tchiwenn tumer o shutlo jarro krik. Kowa, kai an kol efta diwessa maro chal, kai shutlo jarro dren hi, kowa well pale-tchiddo, un hunte djiwell buder gar mank i Israelitarja.
Ap o ersto diwes awenn khetne, te mangenn man an. Ninna ap o eftato diwes krenn kowa! Ma budrenn ap kol dui diwessa! Kokres o chapen, hoi hakeno chala, nai krenn tumer.

Rikrenn tumen ap kal laba: An kol efta diwessa chan tumer maro, kai kek shutlo jarro dren hi. Ap kau diwes lom me tumen lauteren dran o them Egiptia win. Doleske rikrenn tumen ap kawa, un krenn kowa hako bersh, tumer un tumare tchawe, kai wenna pal tumende hako tsiro.
An o ersto tchon ap o deesh-te-starto diwes ap i rat chan tumer maro, kai kek shutlo jarro dren hi, bis ap o biish-te-jekto diwes ap i rat.

Efta diwessa hunte well kek shutlo jarro an tumare khera hatslo. Hakeno, kai maro chala, kai shutlo jarro dren hi, well pale-tchiddo, un hunte djiwell buder gar mashkral i Israelitarja. Kowa nai well i wi-themari, ninna i Israelitari.
Ma chan shutlo maro, kai tumer ninna djiwenn! Chan kokres maro, kai kek shutlo jarro dren hi!”
Un o Mose mukas i tsele phureden i menshendar Israel pash peste te well, un penas ap lende: “Lenn tumenge tumare familjenge bakre win ko chapaske, hoi kharella Passa! Marenn len!

Palle lenn patria kol kashtestar, hoi kharella Ysop, un rikrenn len an ko tcharo, hoi o rat dren hi! Un makenn lentsa o rat win pral o wudar un ap kol dui kashta, hoi tchatches un serwes pash o wudar hi! Un kek tumendar djal dran o wudar win koi tseli rati.

Un o baro Dewel djala mashkral o them, te dell lo i Egiptarja temerl. Te dikell lo o rat pral ap o wudar un ap kol dui kashta, hoi tchatches un serwes pash o wudar hi, palle djal job dureder un mukell koles, kai anell o merepen, gar pash tumende dren te djal, te dell lo jekes tumendar temerl.
Doleske rikrenn tumen ap kal laba, tumer un tumare tchawe, kai wenna pal tumende, kanna un hako tsiro.
Ninna an ko tsiro, kai wenn tumer an ko them, hoi o baro Dewel tumenge peskro lab das, te anell job tumen koi dren, krenn pal kal laba!
Un te putchenna tumare tchawe tumendar: Hoske krah mer kowa?

Palle penenn lenge: ‘Kau bakro, hoi maram ap ko diwes, hoi kharella Passa, kau bakro maram o baro Debleske. Har das job an o them Egiptia i Egiptarja temerl, djas job gar an i khera, kai i Israelitarja djiwan. Job djas dureder. I menshe an mare khera mukas lo te djiwell.’” Kote witsran pen i Israelitarja tele un mangan o Debles an.
Palle djan le un kran jaake, har o baro Dewel o Moseske un o Aroneske penas.

Un mashkral an i rat maras o baro Dewel i tsele mursh tchawen, kai his i phureder tchawe pengre dajendar, an o tselo them Egiptia: o Faraeskro phureder tchawes, kai ap o rajeskri beshepaskri beshdo hi, un ninna i phureder tchawen kolendar, kai stilde hi. Awa, ninna i mursh vieche, hoi his i phureder tchawe pengre dajendar, wan temerl dino.
Koi rati stas o Farao pre, ninna i tsele pralstune un i tsele Egiptarja, un kote djas i ropaskri gole an, hoi o dji tchinella. O merepen his an hako kheer.

Un o Farao mukas an kaja rat o Moses un o Arones gole te dell un penas ap lende: “Sik, mukenn kau them, tumer un i wawar Israelitarja! Djan tumenge mire menshendar krik! Djan un mangenn tumaro baro Debles an, jaake har tumer kaman.
Lenn tumare bakre un busja un tumare grumja, jaake har tumer kaman! Un djan un mangenn tumaro baro Debles, te well lo mange latches.”
Un i tsele Egiptarja mangan len, te djan le jaake sik har djala, un tradan len dran o them. Jon penan penge: “Te djan le gar sik, hunte meras mer lauter.”
Jaake lan i Israelitarja i tchare, kai ko maro dren hi, hoi gomme gar peklo was, un kai kek shutlo jarro dren his, un tchiwan kol tchare an pengre koola, un hidjran len ap pengro phik.
Un i Israelitarja kran pal i laba, hoi o Mose ap lende penas, un djan pash i Egiptarja un mukan pen lendar rupeno un sonakaskro koowa te dell, ninna shukar ripja.

Un o baro Dewel das i Egiptarjen an o dji, te wenn le kamles ap i Israelitarja, jaake te nai mangens le, hoi jon kaman. Un i Egiptarja dan len lauter. Jaake lan i Israelitarja kolendar lengro brawlepen krik un lan les lentsa.
Un i Israelitarja djan win dran o foro Ramses un djan pash o foro Sukkot. Kokres i mursha his 600.000 (shob-sheel-serja). Ninna lengre romja un tchawe his pashel.
Lentsa djan ninna bud menshe, kai his kek Israelitarja, ninna bud bud bakre, busja un grumja.

I Israelitarja mukan o them Egiptia jaake sik, te nai tchiwan le kek chapen penge khetne, te lan le les lentsa ap o drom. Kokres kol mare, hoi gar peklo his, lan le peha. Kolla mare, kai kek shutlo jarro dren hi, pekan le kanna.
Ko tsiro, kai i Israelitarja an o them Egiptia djiwan, his 430 (star-sheel-te-triin-deesh) bersha.
Un har kal bersha trujel his, ap ko diwes, djan o baro Debleskre menshe win dran o them Egiptia.

Koja rat, kai o baro Dewel kokres ap lende garda das, te lell lo len win dran o them Egiptia, kaja rat hunte well o baro Debleske an hako bersh. An kaja rat hunte atchenn i Israelitarja pre, te sowenn le gar. Jaake sharenn le o baro Debles.
Un o baro Dewel rakras ap o Mose un ap o Aron: “Hako kopo, kai chan tumer o chapen, hoi kharella Passa, rikrenn tumen ap kal laba: Kek wi-themari chal kau chapen.
Hako ginlo budepaskro well tchinlo ap peskro mass. Palle nai chal lo ko Passa.
I wi-themari, kai djiwell jek tsiro pash tumende, kowa hunte chal gar ko Passa, witar kek budepaskro, kai budrell i lowenge tumenge.
Ko tselo mass well an o kheer chalo. Kek kotar mass hidjress tu win glan o wudar! Un kek kokale phagess tu!
I tsele Israelitarja hunte chan ko Passa.

Te djiwell i wi-themari pash tumende, kai kamell o baro Debleske o Passa te chal, palle hunte well hako mursh an leskri familja tchinlo ap peskro mass. Kowa te kras lo, palle well lo, un nai chal lo. Un job well har jek tumendar. Kowa, kai gar tchinlo hi ap peskro mass, kowa chal ko Passa gar.
Ko lab hi tumenge un kolenge dran wawar themma, kai mashkral tumende djiwenna.”
Har i tsele Israelitarja shunan, hoi o baro Dewel ap o Mose un ap o Aron penas, kran le les jaake har jon lenge penan.
Un ap kau diwes anas o baro Dewel i tsele Israeleskre familjen win dran o them Egiptia, jek familja pal i wawar.
Pal kowa rakras o baro Dewel ap o Moseste un penas:
“Hako mursh tchawo, kai hi o phureder peskri datar pash i Israelitarja, ninna pash lengre viechende, dess tu mange. Kowa hi miro.”

Un o Mose penas ap i tsele menshende: “Kau diwes an o tchon Abib djan tumer win dran o them Egiptia. Kote, kai tumer pandle budepangre hans, las tumen o baro Dewel peskro sorelo wasteha win. Rikrenn kau diwes an tumare shere! Un chan kek shutlo maro!

O baro Dewel das pes sowel glan tumare phurende, te dell lo tumen ko them, kai djiwenn kanna i Kanaanitarja, i Hetarja, i Amorarja, i Hiwarja un i Jebusarja. Kowa hi i them, kai hi bud thud un gwin dren. Ap ko tsiro, kai anas tumen o baro Dewel an ko them, krenn pale jaake hako bersh an o tchon Abib:
Efta diwessa chan tumer maro, kai kek shutlo jarro dren hi. Un o eftato diwes well i baro diwes, kai wenn khetne o baro Debleske.
Kol efta diwessa chan tumer maro, kai kek shutlo jarro dren hi. Un kek shutlo jarro, witar kek shutlo maro, well pash tumende diklo, kote kai djiwenna.
Un ap kawa diwes penenn tumer tumare tchawenge: ‘O baro Dewel anas men dran o them Egiptia win. Doleske rikrah mer kowa.’
Kawa well tuke har i sikepen ap tiro wast, un i sikepen mashkral tire jaka, te bistress tu kowa gar, un peness i wawarenge, har las tut o baro Dewel peskro sorelo wasteha win dran o them Egiptia.
Jaake rikress tu kal laba hako bersh an o emligo tsiro.
Ap ko tsiro, kai anas tumen o baro Dewel an o them, har job pes glan tute un tire phurende sowel das, te dell lo les tumende, – ko them, kai kanna i Kanaanitarja djiwenna, –
aness tu leske i tsele mursh tchawen, kai hi i phureder tchawe pengre dajendar. Ninna hako mursh viecho, hoi hi o phureder ternepen peskri datar, hi o baro Debleske.

Te hi ko viecho i burikakro ternepen, hunte dess tu kowa leste gar. Tu nai deh i terno bakro. Te kameh tu kowa gar te krell, palle phage koi burikake i meen! Hako phureder mursh tchaweske maress tu i viecho.
An ko tsiro, hoi wella, te putchenn tutar tire tchawe: ‘Hoske kreh tu kowa?’ palle peness tu ap lende: ‘O baro Dewel las men i sorelo wasteha win dran o them Egiptia, kai hunte budram tel dawa.

Har pandas o Farao peskro dji un mukas men gar te djal, maras o baro Dewel an o tselo them Egiptia i tsele mursh tchawen, kai his i phureder tchawe pengre dajendar pash i menshende un ninna pash i viechende. Doleske dau me ko phureder mursh ternepen, hoi i viechestar boldo wella, o baro Debleske. Pash mire tchawende hi wawartchandes. Hako phureder mursh tchaweske marau i viecho.’
Kawa well tuke har i sikepen ap o wast un mashkral tire jaka, te bistress gar, te las men o baro Dewel peskro sorelo wasteha dran o them Egiptia win.”

Un har mukas o Farao i menshen te djal, anas len o baro Dewel gar mashkral o them, kai i Filistarja djiwenn, ninna te his kau drom o tikneder. O baro Dewel penas peske: “Te dikenn i Israelitarja, kai hunte kurenn le pen, nai khaitals len kowa. Un jon kamenn pale pale an o them Egiptia te djal.”

Doleske mukas lo len i baro drom trul o Filistarengro them te djal. Ko drom anas len an o mulo tato them pash ko baro pani, hoi kharella ‘Baro Lolo Pani’. Un i Israelitarja djan penge dran o them Egiptia jaake har te djan le an o kurepen.

O Mose las o Josefeskre kokale peha. Har o Josef meras, penas lo ap peskre phralende: “O Dewel bistrell tumen gar un lell tumen win dran kau them. Denn tumen sowel, te lenn palle ninna mire kokale tumentsa.”
Un jon mukan o foro Sukkot un djan dureder un wan an Etam, kai pash o mulo tato them tchiddo hi un atchan kote i tsiro.
O baro Dewel djas glan lende ap o diwes an i bari wolka, te anell lo len ap o tchatcho drom, un rati an i bari jag, te well lenge i momeli, jaake te nai djan le ap o diwes un ninna an i rat.
Un koi wolka djas peske gar, un atchas glan lende ap o diwes. Un koi jag djas peske gar lendar an i rat.
Un o baro Dewel rakras ap o Moseste un penas:
“Pen, te rissrenn pen i Israelitarja, un te djan le pash ko foro Pi-Hachirot mashkral Migdol un o baro pani. Glan Baal-Zefon ap i wawar rig pash o baro pani atchenn!
O Farao patsella palle: Jon nashran pen an o mulo them un hatsenn kek drom win.

Palle pandau me leskro dji, te lell lo len palla. Un me sikrau miro barepen un miri soor ap leste un ap leskre tsele lurdende. Un i Egiptarja haiwenn: Me hom o baro Dewel.” Un i Israelitarja kran jaake har o Mose lenge penas.

Har o rajeske pral o them Egiptia penlo was, te nashan i Israelitarja penge, khaitas les un leskre pralstunen, te mukan le len te djal. Un jon penan: “Hoske kram mer kowa, te mukam i Israelitarja te djal? Mer nashram mare budepangren!”
Jaake mukas o Farao peskro kurepaskro wurdin te anell, un las peskre lurden peha.
Ninna las lo peskre shob-sheel feteder wurdja peha, un i tsele wawar wurdja, hoi an o them Egiptia hi. Ap hako wurdin his kurepangre tardo.
Un o baro Dewel pandas o Faraeskro dji, jaake te las job i Israelitarja palla, har jon i hadede wastentsa bachteles win djan.

Un i Egiptarja lan len palla pengre grajentsa, wurdjentsa un murshentsa. I tsele rajeskre lurde lan len palla, un dikan len, har his le beshdo pash o baro pani pash ko foro Pi-Hachirot glan o foro Baal-Zefon.
Har i Israelitarja pre dikan, un dikan, te lell len o Farao peskre lurdentsa palla, was i bari traash pral lende. Un jon dan ap o baro Debleste gole.
Un jon penan ap o Moseste: “Lal tu men doleske kai an o mulo tato them, te meras kate? His an o them Egiptia kek phub, te was mer paskedo? Hoske kral tu kowa, un lal men dran o them Egiptia win?
Penam tuke gar, har hams an o them Egiptia: Muk tele mendar! Mer kamah i Egiptarenge te budrell. Feteder i Egiptarenge te budrell, har kate an o mulo them te merell.”

O Mose penas ap i tsele menshende: “Ma darenn! Atchenn soreles! Dikenn har o baro Dewel tumen kau diwes win lell dran i wasta kol Egiptarendar! Kal Egiptarjen, kai tumer kau diwes dikenna, kolen dikenn tumer buder gar, witar gar an ko tsiro, hoi wella.
O baro Dewel kurell pes tumenge. Tumer hunte krenn tchi.”
Un o baro Dewel penas ap o Moseste: “Hoske deh tu ap mande gole? Pen ap i Israelitarja, te djan le dureder!
Tu, hade tiro kasht pre un tiro wast pral o baro pani, te krell lo pes pre un djal ap dui rigja. Jaake te nai djan i Israelitarja mashkral o baro pani ap i drom, hoi gar sapenes hi.
Me krau, te pandenn i Egiptarja pengre djia jaake, te lenn le tumenge palla. Un me sikrau miro barepen un miri soor ap o Farao, ap leskre wurdja un ap leskre kurepangre.
Palle dikenn i Egiptarja, te hom me o baro Dewel, te sikrom me miro barepen un miri soor ap o Farao, ap leskre wurdja un leskre kurepangre.”
Un o Debleskro bolepaskro, kai djal glan i Israelitarja, stas pre un djas pal lende. Un koi bari wolka glan lende hadas pes, un tchiwas pes pal lende jaake,
te was li mashkral i Egiptarja un i Israelitarja. Un joi his kali glan i Egiptarja. Pash i Israelitarja his li i momeli an i rat. Un i tseli rat nai wan i Egiptarja gar pash lende.

Un o Mose hadas peskro wast pral o baro pani. Un o baro Dewel mukas i baro sorelo ducho pral o pani te phurdell, hoi was kotar, kai o kham pre djal. Ko ducho phurdas i tseli rat. Un o baro pani djas pale. Kote, kai pani his, hi kanna phub, hoi gar sapenes hi. Un o baro pani kras pes pre, te was i drom.
Koi djan i tsele Israelitarja mashkral o baro pani ap i drom, hoi gar sapenes hi. Un o pani his tardo ap i tchatchi rig, ninna ap i serwi rig lendar, har bare barra trul i foro tardo hi.
I Egiptarja lan len palla. Un kol tsele rajeskre graja un kurepangre wurdja, ninna i lurde djan pal lende ap o drom mank o baro pani.
Sik taissarlakro, har o kham gomme gar pre djas, dikas o baro Dewel dran koi jagakri wolka tele ap i tsele Egiptikre lurdende un tchiwas i daar ap lende.
Lengre wurdja atchan an i tchik jaake te wan le phares glan. Un i Egiptarja penan: “O baro Dewel kurell pes lenge un hi ap lengri rig. Djas menge katar!”
O baro Dewel penas ap o Moseste: “Hade tiro wast pral o baro pani, te well o pani pale un perell ap i Egiptarja, lengre wurdja un kurepangre.”
Kote hadas o Mose peskro wast pral o baro pani. Un har o kham pre djas, was o pani pale un peras ap kol Egiptarja, kai ap o naashepen his. Jaake tradas len o baro Dewel mashkral an o baro pani.
Un o baro pani was pale pale un tchakras i tsele wurdja un kolen, kai klissan, un i tsele rajeskre lurden, kai djan lenge mashkral o pani palla. Kolendar his kek, kai pral atchas.

Jaake djan i Israelitarja mashkral o baro pani ap i wawar rig. Jon djan ap i drom, hoi gar sapenes hi. Un o pani his tardo ap i tchatchi rig, ninna ap i serwi rig lendar, har bare barra, hoi trul i foro tardo hi.
Jaake las o baro Dewel i Israelitarjen ap kau diwes win dran o wast i Egiptarendar. Un i Israelitarja dikan i mule Egiptarjen pash o baro pani tchiddo.
Jaake dikan le, hawi bari sorjah o baro Dewel i Egiptarjen das. Un i Israelitarja daran o baro Deblestar, un patsan, hoi penas job un o Mose, koles leskro tchatcho wast his.
An kowa tsiro giwas o Mose un i Israelitarja kaja gili, un jon penan: Me kamau te giwap i gili o baro Debleske. Baro un sorelo hi lo! Graja un mursha witsras lo an o baro pani.
Peskri sorjah was o baro Dewel ap miri rig. Miri giljah sharau les dran o dji. Job las man win. Miro Dewel hi lo, un me kamau les te sharell. Miro dadeskro Dewel hi lo, un me kamau les pre te hadell.
I kurepaskro hi lo. Leskro lab hi tchatcho: ‘Baro Dewel’ kharell lo.
I wurdja un i lurden, hoi o Farao bitchras, an o baro pani – mo Dewel len witsras. I sorele kurepangre, hoi ap i wurdja djan, an o Baro Lolo Pani jon lauter sik tassan.
I panja wan un len tchakran; har barra djan le tele, har barra djan le tele.
Tu, mo baro Dewel, har sorelo hi tiro tchatcho wast! Tu, baro Dewel, tiro tchatcho wasteha dal tu kolen an kotja, kai kuran pen tuha.
Railo un baro hal, un khetne stakral, koon pes pral tute hadas. Tiri choli was har i jag pral lende. Har i jag o phuss chatchrell, jaake lendar tchi atchell.
Tu phurdal tiro ducho, un o pani hadas pes bares pre, un atchas tardo har i kheer, un nashas gar buder.
I Egiptarja penan: Las len palla, las len dren! Las menge, hoi lengro hi! Hakenes hi doha koi! Las mare chare, das len temerl!
Tu phurdal tiro ducho, – un o baro pani tchakras len. Jon tassan un djan tele har saster an o baro pani.

Kek hi jaake har tu, o baro Dewel. Kek hi jaake har tu mank lauterende, kai kharenn pen Dewel! Tu hal o tchatcho Dewel, un kek wawar hi jaake sorelo har tu! Tu kral dareno koowa, hoi kek wawar nai krella.
Tu hadal tiri tchatchi mussi, un i phub chas kolen pre, kai hadan pen pral tute.
Tire menshenge kamlo hal, kolenge, kai tu i sorjah win lal un ap i latcho drom anal, hoi pash tiro Debleskro kheer djal.
An i wawar themma i menshe shunan, hoi tu tire menshenge kral. I daar tapras len un jon trissan, ninna kol menshen, kai an o them Filistia djiwan.
I bare raja an o them Edom trashan, un kol sorele raja an o them Moab trissan. I tsele menshe an o them Kanaan daran, awa, lauteren tapras i daar.
I trashatar his le har bango. Tiri sorjatar wan le har barra, har tu mukal tire menshen glan lende win te djal, tire menshen, kai tu tuke win rodal, baro Dewel.
Tu aneh len ap i berga, hoi tu tuke win rodal, kote, kai tu khere hal, te djiwenn le pash tute. Koja berga hi tiro kheer, baro Dewel, hoi tu tuke tire wastentsa kral, te wess kote sharedo.
O baro Dewel hi o baro rai kanna un hako tsireske.

Ap ko tsiro har o Farao un leskre graja un wurdja un kurepangre mashkral an o baro pani djan, mukas o baro Dewel o pani pral lende pale te well. I tsele Israelitarja djan ap i drom, hoi gar sapenes his, mashkral o baro pani ap i wawar rig.

Un i Mirjam, o Aroneskri pheen, his i Debleskri rakepaskretsa. Un joi las peskri bashepaskri, hoi kharella pauka, an o wast, un i tsele djuwja lan ninna pengre bashepangre, un djan lake palla, un bashran un khelan.
Un i Mirjam giwas lenge glan: Me kamau te giwap i gili o baro Debleske. Baro un sorelo hi lo! Graja un mursha witsras lo an o baro pani.
Un i Israelitarja mukan o Baro Lolo Pani pal pende. Un o Mose anas len an o mulo tato them, hoi kharella Shur. Un jon djan triin diwessa trujel an o mulo them, un hatsan kek pani.
Palle wan le pash i pani. Ko pani his shutlo, un jon nai pijan les gar. Doleske kharan le les ‘Mara’.
Un i menshe wan chojedo ap o Moseste un penan: “Hoi pijas mer?”

Koi das lo gole ap o baro Debleste. Un o baro Dewel sikras les i kotar kasht. Kowa witsras lo an o pani, un o pani was latcho. Kote das o baro Dewel len laba, hoi sikrenna, hoi lo lendar kamell, un har te djiwenn le an leskro tchatchepen. Un kote kamas lo ninna te dikell, te shunenn le ap leste.

Un job penas: “Te shuneh tu ap mande, tiro baro Debleste, un kreh, hoi me penau, lauter, hoi an mire jaka tchatcho hi, un rikreh tut ap mire laba un kreh, hoi me tutar kamau, palle tchiwau me kek nasslepen ap tute, hoi tchiwom ap i Egiptarja. Me hom o baro Dewel, kai tut sasto krell.”
Pal kowa wan le ap koi platsa, hoi kharella Elim. Un kote his deesh-te-dui panjengre un efta-deesh palmtikre ruka. Kote pash o pani atchan le.

An o duito tchon, ap o deesh-te-pantchto diwes pal ko diwes, kai jon penge dran o them Egiptia djan, mukan le koi platsa Elim un djan dureder. Un i tsele Israelitarja wan an o mulo tato them Sin. Kowa hi mashkral Elim un i berga Sinai.
Kote an o mulo tato them wan le chojedo ap o Moseste un o Aroneste.

Un jon penan: “Wals feteder, te dals men o baro Dewel mulo an o them Egiptia, har hams beshdo pash i pirja pherdo mass, un kai his men doha maro, te nai cham men tchalo. Tumer anan men kate an o mulo tato them, te meras halauter i bokatar.”

Kote rakras o baro Dewel ap o Moseste: “Me mukau tumenge maro dran o bolepen tele te perell. Pen i menshenge te djan le hako diwes win, te lenn le penge jaake bud, har jon an jek diwes nai chan. Jaake nai dikap me palla, te kamenn le tchatchepah pal miro lab te djiwell.
Ap o shobto diwes lenn le dui kope jaake bud khetne har hako diwes un pekenn les.”
Un o Mose un o Aron penan ap i tsele Israelitarja: “Kau diwes ap i rat dikenn tumer, te hi kowa o baro Dewel, kai las tumen win dran o them Egiptia.

Un taissarlakro dikenn tumer o railepen o baro Deblestar. Job shunas, har tumer tumen ap leste choiran. Har choiran tumen ap mende, choiran tumen tchatchepah ap leste, gar ap mende. Hoi ham mer, te choirenn tumen ap mende?”

Palle penas o Mose: “Ap i rat dell lo tumen mass un taissarlakro jaake bud maro, te wenn tchalo. O baro Dewel shunas, har choiran tumen ap leste. Koon ham mer? Gar ap mende choiran tumen, na-a, han chojedo ap o baro Debleste.”
Un o Mose penas ap o Aroneste: “Pen ap i tsele Israelitarja: ‘Awenn glan o baro Debleste! Job shunas tumari choli.’”
Har o Aron ap i tsele Israelitarja rakras, dikas hakeno kote, kai o mulo tato them hi. Un ap jek kopo was o railepen o baro Deblestar an i wolka diklo.
Un o baro Dewel rakras ap o Moseste un penas:
“Me shunom, har chojedo i Israelitarja his. Rake ap lende un pen: ‘An i rat chan tumer mass. Un taissarlakro chan tumer tumen tchalo ap o maro, te dikenn, te hom me tumaro baro Dewel.’”
Un har i rat was, wan pesse tchirkle, un wan tele ap i tseli platsa. Un taissarlakro his i phub sapeno trul i tseli platsa.
Un har o kham was, un i phub buder gar sapeno his, his tikne sane kotja ap i phub tchiddo, hoi dikan win har tikne kotja djajedo pani.
Kawa dikan i Israelitarja un penan jek ap o wawareste: “Hoi hi kawa?” Jon djinan gar, hoi kowa hi. O Mose penas ap lende: “Kawa hi ko maro, hoi o baro Dewel tumenge bitchras.
Un kawa hi o lab o baro Deblestar, hoi hunte rikrenn: Hakeno lell jaake bud khetne, har job nai chala. I khoro jekeske an tumare familje.”
Un jaake kran i tsele Israelitarja, un lan khetne, ko jek bud un ko wawar gar jaake bud.

Har jon palla dikan, har bud hakeno khetne las, his koles, kai bud khetne las, gar budeder har les hunte wals. Un koles, kai gar bud khetne las, his ninna doha. Hakenes his jaake bud, har les hunte well chapaske.
Un o Mose penas ap lende: “Kek tumendar hadell tchomone pre pral i rat.”
His sawe koi, kai shunan gar ap o Moseste un mukan tchomone pral o wawar diweske. Kowa was lauter khandlo, un kirme his dren. Un o Mose choiras pes pral lende.
Un hako diwes taissarlakro djan le win un lan o maro khetne, jaake bud har jek nai chal. Pal i tsiro, har o kham tateder was, nashas kowa har pani.
Ap o shobto diwes lan le dui kope jaake bud maro khetne: dui khore jekeske. Un i tsele pralstune pral i Israelitarja wan pash o Moseste un penan kowa leske.

Un job penas ap lende: “Kawa hi, hoi o baro Dewel penas: Taissar hi i diwes, kai well kek budi kerdo. Kowa hi i diwes o baro Debleske, te well job sharedo. Kau maro, hoi kamenn te pekell, kowa pekenn! Kowa, hoi kamenn te kerell an o pani, kowa kerenn an o pani! Lauter, hoi pral atchella, hadenn pre i taissarlake!”
Kote hadan le pre o wawar diweske taissarlakro, jaake har o Mose penas. Un tchi khandas un kek kirmo was dren.
O Mose penas: “Chan les kau diwes! Kau diwes hi o baro Debleskro diwes. Kau diwes hatsenn tumer kek maro win.
Shob diwessa lenn tumen maro khetne! O eftato diwes hi o Debleskro diwes. Ap ko diwes dell kek maro.”
Har o eftato diwes was, his sawe koi, kai djan win, te lenn le maro khetne. Jon hatsan tchi.
Kote rakras o baro Dewel ap o Moseste: “Har rah krenn tumer kowa gar, hoi me tumenge penau, un djiwenn gar jaake, har me tumenge penom?

Dom me, o baro Dewel, tumen gar o Debleskro diwes? Doleske dau me tumen ap o shobto diwes doha maro, te nai chan les dui diwessa. Jaake atchell hakeno tumendar khere. Kek mukell ap o eftato diwes i platsa, kai lo khere hi.”
Jaake kran i tsele Israelitarja tchi ap ko diwes.
Un i Israelitarja dan ko maro o lab ‘Manna’. Un job his har tikno parno djob, un latcho har i merkli, kai gwin dren hi.

Un o Mose penas: “Kawa hi, hoi o baro Dewel menge penas, te kras mer: Jek khoro pherdo well pre hadedo mare menshenge, kai pal mende wenna. Jaake nai dikenn le o maro, hoi das lo men te chal an o mulo tato them, har anas lo men dran o them Egiptia.”

Un o Mose penas ap o Aroneste: “Le i khoro un tchip jaake bud Manna dren, har jek mursh ap jek diwes chal. Un tchip ko khoro glan o baro Debleste tardo, te dikenn les tumare tchawe, kai pal tumende wenna.”
Jaake har o baro Dewel o Moseske penas, tchiwas o Aron ko khoro glan o sonakaskro mochton, kai o Debleskre deesh laba dren hi, te atchell ko khoro koi.
Un i Israelitarja chan ko Manna star-deesh bersha, jaake rah bis te wan le pash ko them Kanaan.
Kowa, hoi hakeno ap jek diwes chas his i khoro pherdo. Kowa hi jaake dui litarja.

Un i tsele Israelitarja djan win dran o mulo tato them, hoi kharella Sin, un djan dureder hako kopo har o baro Dewel les lenge penas. Un jon wan ap i platsa, hoi kharella Refidim. Kote his kek pani te pijell.

Un jon tchingran ap o Moseste un penan: “De men pani te pijell!” Un o Mose penas: “Hoske tchingrenn tumer ap mande? Hoske patsenn gar, te hi o baro Dewel pash mende un dell men kowa, hoi men hunte wals?”
Un lengri trush was jaake baro, te penan le i choljatar ap leste: “Hoske lal tu men dran o them Egiptia win? Kameh, te meras mer kate i trushatar, mer un mare tchawe un mare vieche?”
Kote das o Mose ap o baro Debleste gole: “Hoi krap me kal menshentsa? An i tikno tsiro witsrenn le man i barrentsa mules.”
Un o baro Dewel penas ap leste: “Le murshen kol phurendar tuha un dja lentsa glan i Israelitarja! Le ninna ko kasht an tiro wast, hoi dal ap o pani Nil!

Un me tchiwau man glan tute tardo ap o baro bar pash i berga Horeb. Un palle dess tu ap o baro bar, un dran leste nashella pani, jaake te well len te pijell.” Un o Mose kras kowa jaake glan i jaka kol phurendar.
Koi platsa, kai i menshe tchingran ap leste un kai jon gar patsan, te hi o baro Dewel pash lende un dell len kowa, hoi len hunte well, koi platsa das o Mose i laba ‘Massa’ un ‘Meriba’.
Har i Israelitarja an Refidim his, peran i Amalekarja pral lende.
Un o Mose penas ap o Josua: “Rode menge mursha win un dja lentsa an o kurepen un denn i Amalekarja! Taissar kamau me man ap koi berga tardo te tchiwell, o Debleskro kasht an miro wast.”
Un o Josua kras, hoi o Mose leske penas, un anas i Israelitarja an o kurepen. Un jon kuran pen kol menshentsa Amalek. Un o Mose djas pre ap i berga. Khetne leha djan o Aron un o Hur.
Un jaake djas, te hidjrell o Mose peskre mussja pre, palle his o Israel sorleder har o Amalek. Te mukell lo i mussja tele, palle his o Amalek sorleder.

Har o Moseskre mussja leske phares wan, lan kol dui wawar i bar, te beshell lo pes. Un jek tchiwas pes tchatches un jek serwes pash leste tardo, un jon rikran leskre mussja pre. Jaake kran le bis te o kham tele djas.
Un o Josua das i Amalekarja temerl.

Palle penas o baro Dewel ap o Moseste: “Tchin kawa pre, te bistrenn le kowa gar! Un rake les o Josua an o dji, te bistrell lo kau kurepen gar. Un pen leske ninna, te kamau me te marap i tsele Amalekarja jaake, te wenn le hakenestar bistedo ap kai phub.”
Un o Mose kras i chatchepaskri o Debleske, te wenn kote vieche chatchedo o Debleske, un das koi chatchepaskri o lab ‘O baro Dewel krell man soreles an o kurepen’.
Un o Mose penas: “Kowa was, har hadom mire wasta pre ap o baro Debleste. An ko tsiro, hoi wella, dell o baro Dewel i Amalekarja pale te pale.”

O rashai an o them Midian, – leskro lab his Jetro, his o Moseskri romjakro dad. Job shunas kawa lauter, hoi o baro Dewel ap i tsele Israelitarja un ap o Moseste kras, te las lo len dran o them Egiptia win.
Pash leste djiwas o Moseskri romni, i Zippora. Kolat bitchras o Mose pale pash lakro dadeste, har djas lo pash o Farao. Kanna kras pes o Jetro ap o drom, las peskri tchat Zippora peha,
lakre dui mursh tchawentsa. Ko jek kharas Gershon. Har kowa boldo was, penas o Mose: “Me wom i wi-themari an o wi-them.” Doleske kharas lo les Gershon.
Ko wawar kharas Elijeser. Har kawa boldo was, penas o Mose: “O Dewel miro dadestar was ap miri rig. Job las man win dran o wast o Faraestar, kai kamas man mulo te dell.”
Kanna was o Jetro o Moseskre tchawentsa un leskri romni an o mulo tato them pash i Debleskri berga, kai i Israelitarja beshdo hi.
Un job mukas o Moseske te penell: “Me, o Jetro, tiri romjakro dad, wau pash tute. Un tiri romni un tire tchawe hi pash mande.”
Kote djas o Mose win pash leste, djas ap i tchanga glan leste un tchumras les. Un jon putchan jek o wawarestar, har lenge djala.

Un o Mose penas peskri romjakro dad lauter, hoi o baro Dewel ap o Faraeste un ap i tsele Egiptarja kras, har las lo i Israelitarja win. Ninna penas lo leske, har phares his ap o drom un har o baro Dewel pale te pale ap lengri rig was.
Kote was o Jetro bachtelo pral ko tselo latchepen, hoi o baro Dewel ap i Israelitarja kras, te las lo len dran o wast i Egiptarendar win.
Un o Jetro penas: “Me sharau o baro Debles, kai las tumen win dran o wast i Egiptarendar un dran o wast o Faraestar.
Kanna haiwom, te hi o baro Dewel bareder har hako wawar dewel. Job las i Israelitarja win dran o wast i Egiptarendar, kai kran pen bares pral lende.”

Un o Jetro las i viecho, hoi job o Debleske maras un tseles chatchras, un ninna wawar vieche, hoi job maras, te chan le len khetne glan o Debleste. Un o Aron un i tsele phureder dran Israel wan un chan khetne o Moseskri romjakro dadeha kote, kai jon o Debles an-mangan.
O wawar diwes beshas pes o Mose tele, te rakrell lo o tchatchepen pral i Israelitarja win. Un o tselo diwes his i menshe kote trul leste tardo.

Har o Moseskri romjakro dad kowa dikas, hoi o Mose i tsele menshenge kras, penas job: “Hoi hi kawa, hoi tu kate kreh? Hoske hal tu kokres o tchatchepaskro rai kol bud menshenge? Un i tsele menshe hunte wenn pash tute tardo o tselo diwes!”
Un o Mose penas ap leste: “I menshe wenn pash mande, te nai putchenn le o Deblestar, hoi job lendar kamella.
Te hi len tchingepen mashkral pende pral i koowa, palle wenn jon pash mande. Un me penau lenge, hoi te krenn le, jaake har o Dewel lendar kamella un lenge penell.”
Kote penas leskri romjakro dad: “Kawa, hoi tu kate kreh, hi gar mishto.
Tu mareh tut tele un kol tsele menshen, kai trul tute hi. Kai budi hi jaake baro, te nai krell lat kek kokres.
Shun ap mande: Me kamau tuke te penell, hoi te kress. Un tiro Dewel well ninna tuha. Ab tu lenge glan o Debleste un mang lestar, hoi len hunte well.
Un sike tu len, hoi o Dewel kamella un lenge penella, te djan le ap leskro drom un krenn, hoi job lendar kamella.

Tu, rode tuke dran i tsele menshende tchatche murshen win, hoi ap o Debleste shunenna, sawe mursha, hoi pengro lab rikrenna, un kekes i lowenge chochenna! Un kolen tchip pral i Israelitarja! Kre pralstunen lendar pral i serja, wawaren pral i sheel, un pale pral i paash-sheel un pral deesh.

Kolla wenn i tchatchepangre mursha, kai rakrenn hako tsiro o tchatchepen pral i menshende win. Pral hako tikno tchingepen rakrenn jon kokres o tchatchepen win. Un o baro koowa anenn le glan tute. Jaake well tuke gar jaake phares, un jon hidjrenna tuha khetne.
Te kreh tu kowa jaake, palle hi tuke koi budi gar jaake pharo, hoi o Dewel tut das. Un i tsele Israelitarja nai djan khere i tchalo djijeha.”
Un o Mose shunas ap peskri romjakro dad un kras lauter, hoi job leske penas.
Jaake rodas o Mose peske tchatche murshen win un kras lendar pralstune pral i Israelitarja: Pralstune pral i serja un pralstune pral i sheel, ninna pral i paash-sheel un pral deesh.
Kolla rakran pral i menshende o tchatchepen win. Pral i tikno tchingepen rakran jon kokres o tchatchepen win. Un o bareder koowa anan le glan o Mose.
Palle mukas o Mose peskri romjakro dad pale te djal. Un kowa djas pale pale an peskro them.
Un i Israelitarja djan penge dran Refidim un wan an o mulo tato them Sinai. Ap kowa diwes his triin tchonna, har nashan le dran o them Egiptia. Un jon atchan glan i berga.
Un o Mose djas pre ap i berga pash o Debleste. Kote das o baro Dewel ap leste gole: “Kawa peness tu ap i Israelitarja, kol menshende, kai wenna pal o Jakob:
‘Tumer dikan, hoi me halauter ap kol Egiptarja krom, un har anom tumen pash mande jaake har i baro tchirklo hidjrell peskre tchawen ap peskro dumo.

Kanna shunenn: Te rikrenn tumer lauter, hoi me tumenge penau, un shunenn ap mire tsele laba, palle han tumer mange kutcheder har i tsele wawar menshe ap kai phub. Ninna te hi i tseli phub miro, han tumer kokres mire menshe,
un han wi-rodedo, te wenn bare raja un rashaja, kai hi mange koi.’ Kal laba peness tu ap i tsele Israelitarja.”
Koi djas o Mose pale un das i tsele phureden gole un penas lenge kal laba, hoi o baro Dewel leske penas.
Un i tsele menshe penan har dran jek mui: “Lauter kowa, hoi o baro Dewel penas, kowa kamah te krell.” Un o Mose penas o baro Debleske, hoi i tsele Israelitarja penan.

Kote penas o baro Dewel ap o Mose: “Shun, an i pessi wolka khatemen wau me pash tute. Jaake te nai shunenn i tsele Israelitarja, hoi me tuke penau, jaake te patsenn le tut hako tsireske.” Un o Mose penas o baro Debleske, hoi i Israelitarja penan.
Un o baro Dewel penas ap o Mose: “Dja pash lende un pen lenge, te krenn le pen djudjo mange kau diwes un taissar, te thowenn le pengre koola.
Jaake te wenn le djudjes mange koi tardo o triinto diwes. Ap o triinto diwes wau me, o baro Dewel, glan i tsele menshende tele ap i berga Sinai.
Pen lenge, har dur nai djan le, te denn le jak, te djal kek lendar ap koi berga. Kek tchiwell peskri heri ap i berga! Hakeno, koon kowa krella, hunte merell.

Koles hunte taprell kek an. Witsrenn les mulo i barrentsa! Tumer nai denn les ninna tele karje. Krenn kowa ninna i viecheske, hoi tchiwas peskre herja ap koi berga. Kowa atchell gar djido. Te well ko tsiro, kai shunenn, har phurdell jek ap i phurdepaskri, palle wenn pre ap i berga!”
Koi djas o Mose i berga tele un penas i menshenge, te krenn le pen djudjo o Debleske. Un hakeno thowas peskre koola.
Un job penas: “Rikrenn tumen djudjo o triinto diweske! Un kek mursh taprell an kau tsiro peskri romjat an!”

Ap o triinto diwes taissarlake das o bolepen bari gole, un jag das tele karje, un i pessi wolka his pral i tseli berga, un i phurdepaskri das bari gole. Un i tsele Israelitarja lan i bari traash, te trissan lengre kokale.
O Mose anas len pash i berga, kai o Dewel hi. Un jon atchan tardo tele glan i berga.
Un trul koi tseli berga Sinai his jagakro ducho, har was o baro Dewel an i jag tele ap i berga. Un i jagakro ducho djas pre dran i berga jaake har dran i baro bob. Un koi tseli berga trissas soreles.
Un koi phurdepaskri das sorleder un sorleder gole. Un o Mose rakras o Debleha. Un o Dewel rakras pale ap leste jaake soreles, har o bolepen gole della.
Un o baro Dewel was tele ap i berga Sinai, un das o Mose pre gole. Un kowa djas pre ap i berga.
O baro Dewel penas ap o Mose: “Dja tele un pen lenge, te wenn le gar dureder pre, te dikenn le man. Te wenn le pre, hunte merenn bud lendar.
Ninna i rashaja, hoi wenn glan mande, hunte krenn pen djudjo mange, te merenn le gar!”
O Mose penas ap o baro Debleste: “I menshe nai wenn gar pre ap i berga. Tu penal menge, te hi kai berga tuke, un penal mange, te sikrom len, har dur nai djan le.”
O baro Dewel penas: “Dja tele! Un ab pale kai pre! Un an o Arones tuha! Kek rashai un kek wawar Israelitari hunte well dureder har was lenge penlo, te merenn le gar.”
Jaake djas o Mose pale tele un penas i menshenge, hoi o baro Dewel penas.
Un o Dewel penas:
Me, o baro Dewel, hom tiro Dewel, koon tut win las dran o them Egiptia, kai tu i pandlo budepaskro hals.
Un tut well kek wawar Dewel har man.
Un tu kress tuke kek dewel, hoi wi-dikell har tchomone an o bolepen, witar gar har tchomone ap i phub un witar gar har tchomone an o baro pani.

Tu witsress tut gar glan i wawar debleste tele, un mangess les gar an. Me, o baro Dewel, hom tiro Dewel, un kamau, te kamess man kokres. Kolen, kai kamenn mandar tchi te djinell un anenn doosh ap pende, dau me i phagi. Me dau ninna i phagi lengre tchawende un kolengre tchawende jaake rah har triin-te-star familje jek pal i wawar djiwenn.

Latchepen un kamlepen dau me ap kolende, hoi man o djijestar kamenn un krenn, hoi me penau. Ninna lengre tchawenge, kai pal lende wenna, hom latcho, jaake rah har i seri familje jek pal i wawar djiwenn.
Ma le miro lab ‘baro Dewel’ tchitcheske an tiro mui! Me, o baro Dewel, hom tiro Dewel un dau i phagi hakenes, koon kowa krella.
Ma biste, kai o eftato diwes o Debleskro diwes hi!
Shob diwessa dja ap tiri budi un kre tiri tseli budi!

O eftato diwes hi mange, tiro baro Debleske. Ap ko diwes kress tu kek budi, witar gar tire tchawe un tcha, witar gar tiro budepaskro un tiri budepaskretsa, witar gar tire vieche, witar gar kol wi-themarja, kai an tiro foro djiwenna.
An shob diwessa kras o baro Dewel o bolepen un i phub, o pani un halauter, hoi koi dren hi. Un o eftato diwes kras lo tchi. Doleske penas lo: Kau diwes hi i baro diwes mange. Kau diwes hi miro.
Dik ap tiro dadeste un ap tiri date, te djal lenge mishto. Jaake djiweh i rah djipen an ko them, hoi tut tiro baro Dewel della.
Ma mare kekes!
Romeha, ma dja i wawar djuwjah! Romnija, ma dja i wawar mursheha!
Ma tchore!
Ma an kek chochepen pre ap jekeste!
Ma rode, har nai less tu kowa tuke, hoi i wawares hi: leskro kheer, leskri romni, budepaskro, budepaskretsa, grumni, burika, tchi, hoi i wawares hi.

Un i tsele Israelitarja shunan, har o bolepen gole das, un dikan, har jag dran o bolepen tele karje das. Ninna shunan le, har jek ap i phurdepaskri phurdas, un dikan i jagakro ducho. Un har jon kawa shunan un dikan, nashan le penge un atchan i kotar dureder tardo un trissan i darjatar.
Un jon penan ap o Moseste: “Rake tu mentsa, un mer kamah kowa te shunell un krell, hoi tu peneh. Mer kamah gar, te rakrell o Dewel mentsa, te meras gar.”
Koi penas o Mose: “Ma darenn! O Dewel was, te dikell lo, te krenn tumer, hoi job tumenge penas. Job kamell te shunenn ap leste un krenn kek tchilatcho koowa.”
Un i menshe atchan i kotar dureder tardo. Un o Mose djas pash koi kali wolka, an koja o Dewel his.
Koi penas o baro Dewel ap o Moseste: Jaake peness tu ap i tsele Israelitarja: Tumer dikan, te rakrom me dran o bolepen tumentsa.
Doleske krenn tumenge kek wawar debles, kek dran rup, witar kek dran sonakai.

Hi mange doha, te krenn mange i chatchepaskri dran phub! Koi pre anenn mange kol marede bakren un grumjen, hoi chatchrenn tseles mange, ninna kolen, hoi mange marenn, te chan tumer lengro mass khetne glan mande. Kote, kai kamau, te mangenn man an, kote wau me pash tumende un dau tumen miri bacht un miri soor.
Te krenn tumer mange i chatchepaskri dran barra, palle lenn i barra jaake, har hi le. Denn tchi lendar tele! Te well i saster pral lende, hi le mange pale-tchiddo.
Tchiwenn i barra gar jaake pre, te nai dikell jek tel i ripja kolestar, kai djal i barra pre.
Kolla hi i laba, hoi lenge peness. Ap kolende hunte rikrenn le pen.
Te gineh tu tuke i hebretikro budepaskro, palle budrell lo tuke shob bersha. Un an o eftato bersh muk les te djal! Job hunte plaissrell tuke tchi.
Te was lo kokres pash tute, djal lo ninna kokres. Te his lo romedino, lell lo ninna peskri romjat pale peha.
Te das les peskro rai i romjat, un les hi ninna tchawe lah, atchell i romni un i tchawe pash leskro rajeste. Job hunte djal peske kokres.
Te penell o budepaskro: “Me kamau miro rajes un miri romjat un mire tchawen. Me kamau te atchap pandlo ap miro rajeste un kamau gar te djal.”

Palle lell les leskro rai un anell les glan o Debleste, un tchiwell les glan o wudar tardo, un dell i kashteni sub an leskro kand tchurje. Kowa sikrell, te atchell lo peskro tselo djipen leskro budepaskro.
Te bikrell i mursh peskri tchat, te well li i pandli budepaskretsa, palle hunte atchell li pandli. Un joi nai djal peske gar, har i pandlo budepaskro mursh nai djal peske.

Te ginas lakro rai lat, te well li peskri romni, un palle kamell lo lat buder gar, hi les gar o tchatchepen, te bikrell lo lat ap i wi-themari. Kowa wals i ladj. Job hunte mukell lat lakre menshenge, te ginenn jon lat pale.
Te ginas o rai lat peskro tchaweske, palle hunte well li leske har jek leskre tchendar.
Te lell i rom peske i duiti romjat, palle hunte dell lo i glanstunate lauter jaake har glan ko tsiro: chapen, ripja, un job hunte sowell lah har glan ko tsiro.
Te rikrell lo pes gar ap kal triin koowa, palle nai djal li peske un hunte plaissrell tchi. Un kek hunte plaissrell lake.
Kowa, kai dell i menshes jaake phares, te merell lo, kowa hunte merell.
Te kamas lo les gar temerl te dell, un o Dewel mukas, te was kowa jaake, palle nai nashell lo an i foro, hoi o baro Dewel wi-rodas sawe menshenge.

Te das lo les tchorchanes un an o tchilatchepen temerl, dell kek platsa, kai atchell lo nai djido, witar gar, te nashell lo an o Debleskro kheer pash o Debleskri sasterni chatchepaskri. Lenn les kotar krik un denn les temerl!
Kowa, hoi dell peskro dades un peskri dat, kowa hunte merell.
Kowa, kai tchoras i menshes, hunte merell. Te bikras lo les, oder te hatsenn le les pash leste, kowa hi jek. Job hunte merell.
Ma rake bibacht win pral tiro dadeste, witar gar pral tiri date! Koon kowa krell, hunte merell.
Te tchingrenn pen mursha, un jek dell ko wawares i barreha, oder i kashteha, jaake te hunte well kowa an o tchiben tchiddo, un job merell gar,

un nai stell pale pre, un nai djal ap i kasht win trujel, palle lell kowa, kai das les, kek phagi. Job hunte plaissrell o tsiro, kai hunte atchas ko wawar khere un nai djas gar ap peskri budi. Ninna hunte plaissrell lo lauter, te well kowa pale sasto.
Te dell jek peskro budepaskres i kashteha, jaake te merell lo, palle lell lo i phagi. Kowa well ninna jaake kerdo pash i budepaskretsa.
Te atchell ko budepaskro jek te dui diwessa djides tchiddo un merell palle, lell leskro rai kek phagi. Kowa hi leskri phagi, te nashras lo peskro budepaskres, koleske job lowe plaissras.

Te tchingrenn pen dui mursha, un i romni, hoi an wawar koowa hi, lell i dap, jaake te nashrell li peskro ternepen, un joi well pale sasto, palle hunte plaissrell kowa, hoi das lat koi dap, lowe. Glan i tchatchepangre hunte plaissrell lo jaake bud lowe, har lakro rom mangella.
Te was koi romni jaake dukedo, te atchell li nasselo, palle djal kowa jaake: I djipen jek djipaske,
i jak i jakeske, i dand i dandeske, i wast i wasteske, i heri i herjake,
i chatchepaskro dukepen i chatchepaskro dukepaske, i tchinepen i tchinepaske, i dap i dapeske.

Koon dell peskro budepaskro i jak win, kowa hunte mukell les te djal o jakeske, hoi das lo les win. Ninna kowa, kai das peskro budepaskro i dand win, hunte mukell les te djal o dandeske, hoi das lo les win. Kowa well ninna jaake kerdo pash i budepaskretsa.

Te dell i grumni i murshes i dap, jaake te merell lo, palle witsrenn i grumjat i barrentsa mules! Kowa well ninna jaake kerdo, te dell i grumni i djuwjat i dap, te merell li. Kek chal o mass koi grumjatar! Un koleske koi grumni hi, kowa lell kek phagi.

Djinas job, te dell koi grumni pale un pale peskre shingentsa, un job pandas lat gar dren, un joi das pale jekes, jaake te meras lo, palle well koi grumni i barrentsa mules witsedo. Un koleske i grumni hi, kowa hunte merell ninna.
Te kamenn le les gar te marell, un tchiwenn le i plaissepen ap leste, palle hunte plaissrell lo lauter, hoi jon mangenna, koleske te nai atchell lo djido.
Ninna te das i grumni i tchawes i dap, rikrenn tumen ap kal laba, ninna pash i tchate!

Te das i grumni i budepaskres i dap, jaake te merell lo, palle hunte dell kowa, koleske koi grumni hi, 30 (trijanda) kotja rup koleste, kai nashras peskro budepaskres. Kowa well ninna jaake kerdo pash i budepaskretsa. Koi grumni hunte well i barrentsa mulo witsedo.

Te mukas jek peskri brunna pre, un i viecho perell dren – nai well i grumni, nai well i burika, – un ko viecho merella, palle hunte plaissrell lo lowe koleske, koles ko viecho his. Ko mulo viecho nai rikrell lo peske. Kowa hi ninna jaake, te krell lo peske i brunna an i phub un tchakrell lat gar tele.
Te das i grumni i wawareskri grumjat i dap, jaake te meras li, palle bikrenn le i djidi grumjat, un hakeno lell i paash lowe, un jek paash muli grumni.
Djinas lo, te dell leskri grumni peskre shingentsa un pandas lat gar dren, palle dell lo i djidi grumni kolake, hoi meras. Koi muli nai rikrell lo peske.

Te tchoras jek i grumjat, un marell lat, hunte dell lo koi jek grumjake pantch wawar grumjen. Te tchorell lo i bakro, un marell les, hunte dell lo ko jek bakreske star wawar bakren pale. Kowa hunte krell lo ninna jaake, te bikras lo kol tchorede viechen.
Te well i tchorepaskro tapedo, har job rati an i kheer dren phagell, un well jaake dino, te merell lo, hi koles, hoi les das, kek doosh ap leskro rat.

Djas o kham pre, har phagas lo dren, hi koles, hoi les mules das, i doosh ap leskro rat. I tchorepaskro hunte dell lauter pale, hoi job tchoras. Te nai krell job kowa gar, palle well lo bikedo un well i pandlo budepaskro.
Te tchoras lo i viecho, – i grumni, i burika, i bakro, – un kowa well djides pash leste hatslo, palle hunte dell lo dui kope jaake bud pale.

Te dell i mursh gar jak ap peskre viechende, un mukell len ap i wawareskro them te djal un kote te chal, palle hunte dell lo kowa pale. Te chan i vieche djob, palle dell lo o latcheder djob, hoi leskro hi. Te chan i vieche drake, palle dell lo peskre latcheder drake.

Te krell jek i jag, un koi jag taprella i subjengre burra, un palle djob, hoi tardo hi, ninna djob, hoi khetne pandlo hi, palle hunte plaissrell kowa, kai koi jag kras, ko tselo djob, hoi i jag chatchras.
Te dell i mursh i wawares lowe, ninna kutch koowa, te dell lo jak koi pre, un ko koowa well dran leskro kheer tchoredo, un ko tchorepaskro well hatslo, palle dell kowa dui kope jaake bud pale.
Te well ko tchorepaskro gar hatslo, palle dell pes ko mursh, dran koleskro kheer ko koowa tchoredo was, glan o Debleste sowel, te tchoras lo ko koowa gar kokres.

Kote, kai dui mursha tchingrenn pen pral i grumni, i burika, i bakro, i ripen, ninna pral wawar koowa, hoi nashedo was, kote hunte wenn kol dui glan o Debleste. Un kones o Dewel i doosh dell, kowa dell ko wawares dui kope jaake bud pale.
Te dell jek o wawares i burika, i grumni, i bakro, ninna i wawar viecho, te dell lo jak ap leste, un ko viecho merell, dukrell pes, oder well krik tradedo un kek dikas tchomone,
palle dell job pes ap o baro Debleste sowel, te tapras leskro wast ap tchi, hoi o wawares hi. Palle hunte lell ko wawar koi sowel an, jaake te dell les ko wawar tchi pale.
Te was ko viecho leske tchoredo, palle hunte plaissrell lo ko viecheske, hoi tchoredo was.
Te was ko viecho khetne dandedo i wawar viechestar, palle anell lo ko mulo vieches, hoi dandedo was, un sikrell, te was lo khetne dandedo. Kowa te krell lo, hunte dell lo tchi pale.
Te patsell jek peske i viecho, un ko viecho phagell peske i kokale, oder merell, un kowa, koleske ko viecho hi, hi gar pashel, palle hunte plaissrell lo leske ko viecho.
Te his kowa pashel, koleske o viecho hi, hunte dell lo koles tchi pale. Te plaissras lo lowe, har job ko viecho patsas, palle das lo doha lowe. Job hunte dell gar budeder.

Te krell pes jek ap i tchate, hoi hi lat gomme kek romes, witar kek pirnes, un rakrell ap late un sowell lah, hunte romedinerell lo lat, un hunte dell lo i lowe, hoi hi glan tchinlo i tchake, hoi romedino wella.
Te kamell lakro dad les gar peskri tchat te dell, ninna palle hunte plaissrell job kol lowe.
I durkepaskretsa hunte denn temerl.
Hakeno, hoi i viecheha sowell, hunte merell.
Kowa, hoi dell i wawar debleske i viecho temerl, un gar o baro Debleske, kowa well infam.
Ma krenn kolen o djipen phares, kai hi wi-themarja pash tumende! Un mukenn len gar tchitcheske tumenge te budrell! Bistrenn gar, te hans tumer ninna wi-themarja an o them Egiptia.
Ma krenn o djipen i djuwjenge phares, kolenge o rom meras! Ma krenn o djipen i tchawenge phares, kolen kek dad buder hi!
Te kreh tu lenge o djipen phares, un jon denn ap mande gole, shunau me len.
Un me taprau sawi bari choli, te dau tumen o chareha temerl, jaake te hi palle tumare djuwjen buder kek rom un tumare tchawen buder kek dades.
Te patseh lowe i tchorweleske mire menshendar, palle kre tut ap leste gar braweles! Un le lestar gar budeder pale, har les dal.
Te hi jek tire menshendar tuke lowe sijaan, un tu leh leskri baja ko tsireske, kai job tuke lowe sijaan hi, palle dik, te dess leste peskri baja pale glan ko tsiro, kai o kham tele djal.
Leskri baja hi leskri plachta, kolah tchakrell lo pes, un tatsrell lo pes. Te deh tu les peskri baja gar pale un job dell ap mande gole, palle shunau me les. Me krau miro dji leske pre.
Ma praasse o Debles! Un ma rake bibacht win pral i pralstuno tire menshendar!
An ko tsiro, kai aneh tiro djob un tire drake dren, de tiro Debles, hoi leske hi! Tiro phureder mursh tchawes dess tu tiro Debles.
Jaake kress ninna tire grumjentsa un tire bakrentsa un busjentsa. Efta diwessa atchenn le pash pengri date. Un ap o ochtato diwes dess len mande.
Tumer han mire wi-rodede menshe. Doleske ma chan o mass kol viechendar, hoi wan mulo dandedo diwje viechendar. Denn ko mulo vieches tumare djuklen!
Tu rakress kek koowa dureder, hoi tu shunal, un tu gar djineh, te hi kowa tchatcho! Ma choche i wawareske, kai anas doosh ap peste!
Ma rike pash kolende, hoi djan ap i tchilatcho drom, ninna te hi jon bud! Te putchenn tutar i tchatchepangre, ma pen tchomone wawares har o tchatchepen, ninna te chochenn i tsele wawar.
Pen o tchatchepen, ninna te hi kowa i tchorwelo, kai chochras.
Te dikeh tu i grumni, i burika, hoi nashedo hi, hunte aness ko viecho pale pash koleste, koles ko viecho hi, ninna te hal tu leha an o tchingepen.

Te phagas i burika khetne tel ko kowa, hoi ap late tchiddo was, dja koi un dja koleske pash o wast, koleske i burika hi, ninna te hal tu leha an o tchingepen, un dik, te well koi burika pale ap i herja!
Te hal tu i tchatchepaskro, hunte dess tu koles peskro tchatchepen, koon an o tchatchepen hi, ninna te hi lo tchorwelo.

Ma shun ap kolende, hoi anenn chochepen pre ap i wawareste! Ma pen, te well kowa temerl dino, kai kek tchilatcho koowa kras un kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi. Miri phagi well ap koleste, kai sawo tchilatcho koowa krella.

Te hi jek an o tchingepen i wawareha un kamell tut te ginell, te dess les tchatchepen, ma le kowa, hoi job kamell tut dell! Koon sau koowa an-lell, well korelo o tchatchepaske un dikell buder gar, koon an o tchatchepen hi.
Ma krenn kolenge o djipen phares, kai wi-themarja hi! Tumer djinenn, har kowa hi! Tumer hans wi-themarja an o them Egiptia.
Shob bersha witsress tu o djob ap tiri phub win. Un te was ko djob bares, aness les dren.

An o eftato bersh ma witse tiri djob ap tiri phub win! Un ko djob, hoi an ko bersh pre djal un bares well, kowa muk i tchorwelenge tardo! Un kowa, hoi i tchorwele pral mukenn, kowa muk i diwje viechenge tardo! An ko eftato bersh muk ninna i molengre drake un i olivtikre drake ap i ruka i tchorwelenge. Un kowa, hoi jon pral mukenn, well i diwje viechenge.

Shob diwessa budress tu! Ap o eftato diwes budress tu gar! Ninna tire grumja, tiri burika, tire budepangre un i wi-themarja, hoi pash tute hi, budrenn ap ko diwes gar, jaake te nai lenn le pale newi soor.
Denn jak un rikrenn ap lauter, hoi me tumenge penom! Ma mangenn wawar deblen an! Lengre laba hunte wenn gar dran tumare muja win!
Triin kope an o bersh rikress tu mange bare diwessa dren:

kol bare diwessa, kai chah tu efta diwessa ko maro, an koleste kek shutlo jarro dren hi. Kol diwessa rikress tu an o tchon Abib. Kowa kress tu, te bistress gar, te nashal an ko tchon dran o them Egiptia. Un ab gar an o Debleskro kheer, te hi tchi an tiro wast, hoi tu leske aneh!

Rikrenn ninna bare diwessa mange an ko tsiro, kai anenn o newo djob dren. Un bare diwessa rikrenn mange ninna an ko tsiro pal i nijal, te anan i drake dren, un lauter, hoi bares was ap i ruka un ap tiri phub.
An kal bare diwessa, triin kope an o bersh, hunte wenn i tsele mursha glan o baro Debleste, pengro rajeste an leskro kheer.

Te mareh tu i viecho o Debleske, palle dess tu kek maro pashel, hoi shutlo jarro dren hi. Un o thulepen o viechestar, hoi maral tu o Debleske, hunte well ko diwes chatchedo un atchell gar pral i rat tchiddo.
Tu aness o feteder halauterestar, hoi ap tiri phub bares was tiro baro Debleske an leskro kheer. Tu keress gar i terni busni an i thud peskri datar.
Me bitchrau i bolepaskro glan tumende, koon dell jak ap tumende ap o drom, hoi tumer djan. Un kowa anell tumen an ko them, hoi me tumenge wi-rodom.
Denn jak, te shunenn ap kowa, hoi job tumenge penell! Me bitchrom les. Te shunenn tumer gar ap leste, bistrell lo tumari doosh gar.
Te shunenn tumer ap leste un krenn halauter, hoi me tumenge penau, palle djau me ap kolende, hoi ap tumende djan. Un kolla, hoi tumenge o djipen phares krenn, kolenge krau me les ninna phares.
Awa, miro bolepaskro djal glan tute un anell tut an o them, kai djiwenna i Amorarja, i Hetarja, i Perisarja, i Kanaanitarja, i Hiwarja un i Jebusarja. Un me dau len temerl.

Ma mangenn lengre deblen an! Ma anenn viechen, te chatchrenn len lenge! Ma krenn jaake har kolla, kai an ko them djiwenna! Denn lengre tsele deblen paash, un phagenn kol bare barra, hoi jon lenge pre-tchiwan!
Mangenn man, tumaro baro Debles, kokres an! Palle krau, te hi tumen doha maro un bud pani. Un me lau hako nasslepen, hoi mashkral tumende hi, tumendar krik.
Kek romni, hoi wawartchandes hi, nashrell peskro ternepen. Un haki romni nai lell i ternepen. Hakeno well phuro.
An hako them, kai tu djah, krau me i menshenge sawi daar glan tute, te nashenn le i darjatar penge.
I Hiwarja, i Kanaanitarja un i Hetarja nashenn i darjatar glan tute penge, te weh tu pash lende.
Hi jaake: Gar an jek bersh tradau len tutar krik. Te kroms kowa jaake, wals o them diwjo un anals buder kek chapen win. Un i diwje vieche wans budeder un budeder. Un kowa wals gar mishto tumenge.
Dran jek them pal o wawar tradau len glan tute win. Jaake dau i tsiro te wenn tumer jaake bud, te nai lenn o tselo them tumenge dren.

Un me penau, har bares tiro them wella. Job djal fun ko Baro Lolo Pani bis pash ko baro pani, kai i Filistarja djiwenn, un fun o mulo tato them bis pash o lengsto pani Eufrat. Kolla, hoi kote djiwenna, dau an tiro wast, te tradenn tumer len dran o them win.
Ma awenn lengre mala! Ma mangenn tchomone lengre deblendar!
Mukenn len gar tumentsa khetne an tumaro them te djiwell! Te krans le kowa, nai anans le tumen jaake dur, te mangenn tumer lengre deblen an un shunenn buder gar ap mande. Un kowa wals tumaro merepen.
Un o baro Dewel penas ap o Moseste: “Ab kate pre pash mande, tu un o Aron, o Nadab, o Abihu un 70 (efta-desha) i phurendar dran Israel. Kal mursha atchenn dureder krik tardo un mangenn man kote an!
Tu, o Mose, ab kokres pash mande! Kolla wawar wenn gar pash mande! Un i tsele wawar Israelitarja atchenn tele glan i berga!”

Un o Mose was pash i menshende un penas lenge hako lab, hoi o baro Dewel penas, kol tsele laba, hoi penenn, hoi job lendar kamella. Un i tsele Israelitarja penan har dran jek mui: “Lauter, hoi o baro Dewel penas, kamah mer te krell.”

Koi tchinas o Mose hako lab, hoi o baro Dewel penas, an i liil. Un sik taissarlakro stas job pre un kras i chatchepaskri tele glan i berga, kote pre vieche chatchedo wenna o baro Debleske. Ninna tchiwas lo deesh-te-dui barra pre kol deesh-te-dui bare familjenge, kai wan o Israeleskre tchawendar: jek bar haki familjake.

Un job bitchras terne murshen win, te marenn le viechen un chatchrenn len o baro Debleske. Koi pashel his ninna terne gurma. Kolen maran le, te nai chan i Israelitarja ko mass khetne glan o baro Debleste.
Un o Mose las o rat un tchoras jek paash an tchare. Un o wawar paash tchoras lo ap i chatchepaskri, kai i vieche chatchedo wan o Debleske.

Un job las o liil, kai job dren tchinas, hoi o baro Dewel peskre menshendar kamella, un draweras kau liil i menshenge glan. Un i tsele menshe penan: “Lauter, hoi o baro Dewel penas, kamah mer te krell, un ap leste shunell.”

Koi las o Mose o rat un witsras les ap i Israelitarja un penas: “Dikenn, kawa hi o rat, hoi sikrella, te was o baro Dewel tumaro Dewel, un tumer wan leskre menshe, kai rikrenn kal tsele laba, hoi job tumenge penas.”
Palle djas o Mose, o Aron, o Nadab, o Abihu un 70 (efta-deesh) i phurendar dran Israel ap i berga pre.
Un jon dikan o Israeleskro Debles. Un tel leskre herja his tchomone, hoi wi-dikas har kol kutch barra, hoi kharenna Safire. Un kowa his jaake djudjo un blaueto har o bolepen.
Ninna te dikan kol pralstune Israelitarja o Debles, hadas lo gar peskro wast pral lende, te marell lo len. Un pal kowa chan le un pijan le.

Un o baro Dewel penas ap o Moseste: “Ab pash mande ap i berga pre un atch kote, te dap tut kol barra, kai tchinom mire laba dren, te sikrap mire menshende, har te djiwenn le, te djinenn jon, hoi te krenn un hoi te krenn gar.”
Koi djas o Mose pre ap o Debleskri berga. Leskro budepaskro Josua djas leha.
Ap i phurende penas o Mose: “Kate atchenn, bis te wau me pale! O Aron un o Hur atchenn pash tumende. Te hi jekes i tchingepen i wawareha, nai djan le pash lende! Jon penenn palle, hoi kerdo te well.”
Har o Mose ap i berga djas, tchakras koi wolka i tseli berga.
Un o railepen o baro Deblestar mukas pes tele ap i berga Sinai. Un i wolka tchakras i berga shob diwessa. Un ap o eftato diwes das o baro Dewel dran koi wolka ap o Moseste gole.
O railepen o baro Deblestar his glan i Israelengre jaka har i bari jag, hoi pral ap koi berga chatchella.
O Mose djas mashkral dren an koi wolka, un djas dureder pre ap i berga, un atchas star-deesh diwessa un star-deesh ratsja pral ap koi berga.
Un o baro Dewel rakras o Moseha un penas:
Pen ap i Israelitarja: Hakeno, hoi les an o dji chatchella, te dell lo man pestar tchomone, kowa anell les pash tumende.
Kawa hi ko koowa, hoi jon tumenge anenna: Sonakai, rup, un lolo saster,
ninna kutch bakrengro bal, hoi blaueto, lolo un lolo har jag kerdo was, latcho laintikro than un busjengre balla.
Bakreskri ledertikre plachte, hoi lolo kerdo wan, wawar latche ledertikre plachte un kasht i rukestar, hoi kharella Akatsia,
momelengro djet, kutch sungepaskro koowa, hoi well chatchedo, ninna kutch sungepaskro koowa, hoi well an o makepaskro djet tchiddo, te nai makenn le jekes dren.
Lenn lendar ninna kol kutch barra, hoi kharenna Onyx un wawar kutch barra, te wenn le ap o rashajeskri damdira un ap o betcheskri possita sido.
Kamau lendar, te krenn le mange i kheer, te djiwap nai mashkral lende.
Jaake har me les tut kanna sikrau, jaake krenn tumer o kheer, ninna ko tselo koowa, koleha budrenn le an miro kheer. Krenn lauter jaake, har me les tut sikrau.

Kre i mochton dran o kasht ko rukestar, hoi kharella Akatsia, 125 (sheel-te-biish-te-pantch) centimetarja lengsto, 75 (efta-deesh-te-pantch) centimetarja buchlo un 75 (efta-deesh-te-pantch) centimetarja pral.
Pral o kasht, dren un win, tchip latcho sonakai! Un pral trul o tselo mochton tchip i sonakaskro pandepen!
Kre ninna star sonakangre gustria! Un kre len ap o mochton, ap leskre star herja, dui ap kai jek rig un dui ap i wawar rig!
Palle tchin lengste kashta dran akatstikro kasht un tchip sonakai trul lende!
Kol kashta tchip an kol gustria, hoi ap o mochton hi, jaake te nai hidjrenn le ko mochton trujel.
Kol kashta hunte atchenn an kol gustria un kek lell len win.
An ko mochton tchip kol dui barra kol deesh labentsa, hoi me tut dau.
Kre i pralstuno kotar dran latcho sonakai, hoi tchiweh ap o mochton. Ko pralstuno kotar well 125 (sheel-biish-te-pantch) centimetarja lengsto un 75 (efta-deesh-te-pantch) centimetarja buchlo.
Kre ninna dui bolepangre, hakeno dran jek kotar sonakai. Un tchip ko jek glan ap o pralstuno kotar un ko wawar palla ap o pralstuno kotar!
Jon hadenn pengre mussja pre, jaake te tchakrenn le o pralstuno kotar. Un lengre shere dikenn pen an. Un lengre jaka dikenn tele ap o pralstuno kotar.
Tchip o pralstuno kotar pral ap o mochton. Un an o mochton tchip i dui barra kol deesh labentsa, hoi me tut dau.
Kote kamau pash tute te well. Mashkral kol dui bolepangre, hoi ap o mochton hi, kai i deesh laba dren hi, kotar rakrau tuha un penau tuke lauter, hoi i Israelitarja hunte krenn.
Kre ninna i chapaskri dran o kasht ko rukestar, hoi kharella Akatsia, jek metari lengsto, jek paash metari buchlo, un 75 (efta-deesh-te-pantch) centimetarja pral.
Tchip trul i tseli chapaskri latcho sonakai! Un pral trul i tseli chapaskri tchip i sonakaskro pandepen!
Tchip ninna i tikno kasht trul i chapaskri, hoi jek wast buchlo hi. Un trul kau kasht well ninna i sonakaskro pandepen.
Kre star sonakangre gustria! Un tchip jek gustri ap haki heri tel ko kasht, hoi trul i chapaskri djal, jaake te nai tchiwenn le lengste kashta dren, kolentsa nai hidjrenn le koi chapaskri.
Kol hidjepaskre kashta kress tu dran o kasht ko rukestar, hoi kharella Akatsia. Un makess sonakai trul lende!
Dran latcho sonakai kress tu ninna kol tchare un khore, an kolende i mool o Debleske tchoredo well.
Ap i chapaskri wenn hako tsiro i Debleskre mare tchiddo, te dikap len.

Un tu kress i momelengri dran jek kotar latcho sonakai. Lakre tsele kotja, o piro un o mashkralstuno kotar, ninna i tchare un i blume, hoi koi pre hi, lauter well kerdo dran jek kotar sonakai. Hi sawe blume koi pre, hoi hi pandlo un wawar, hoi hi pre.
Shob mussja djan latar win: Triin djan ap jek rig win, un triin djan ap i wawar rig win.

Ap haki mussi hi triin tchare, hoi dikenna win har i blume ko rukestar, hoi kharella mandeltikro ruk. Hi sawe blume koi pre, hoi hi pandlo un sawe, hoi hi pre. Jaake well kowa ap haki mussi kol shob mussjendar.
Dran o mashkralstuno kotar wenn star tchare win, hoi win dikenna har mandeltikre blume. Ap kolende hi blume, hoi hi pandlo un ninna sawe, hoi hi pre.
Triin blume, hoi pandlo hi, hi kote, kai i mussja win wenna, hako kopo jek bluma tel dui mussja.
Koi tseli momelengri peskre mussjentsa un blume well kerdo dran jek kotar latcho sonakai.
Kre ninna efta momlia un tchip len pral ap i momelengri jaake, te dikenn le glan.
Kre ninna tchare, kai i momelengri tchik dren wella, un tchinepangre, kolentsa i dorja an i momlia tele tchinlo wenna. Kolla lauter wenn dran o latcho sonakai kerdo.
Tut hunte well 35 (trijanda-te-pantch) kilogramme latcho sonakai, te kress kai momelengri peskre tsele koola.
Un tu kress lat jaake, har kowa tuke ap i berga sikedo was.

Ko kheer kress tu dran deesh pesse plachte. Un kolla wenn sido dran latcho sorelo laintikro than, kai ninna kutch bakrengro bal dren hi. Kowa hi blaueto, lolo un lolo har jag. An kol plachte wenna bolepangre dren sido an shukar wastengri budi.
Kre haki plachta 14 (deesh-te-star) metarja baro un dui metarja buchlo.
Pantch sawe plachte wenn khetne sido, un kol wawar pantch ninna.
Ap kol rigja, kai kol dui bare kotja khetne pandlo wenn, kre dorjengre gustria dran blaueto kutch bakrengro bal:
50 (pantch-deesh) ap hako baro kotar, jaake te well jek dorjengri gustri wergel ko wawar.
Kre pantch-deesh sonakangre rikepangre! Kolla tchip jaake an i dorjengre gustria, te pandess kol dui bare kotja khetne.
Kre 11 (deesh-te-jek) pesse plachte dran busjengre balla, te wenn le pral o kheer tchiddo.
Jek plachta well 15 (deesh-te-pantch) metarja lengsto un dui metarja buchlo. Haki plachta well jaake baro har koi wawar.
Sib pantch plachte penge khetne! Un i wawar shob sib ninna penge khetne! Un tchip koi shobti plachta jaake ap i pantchti plachta, te wenn glan ap o kheer dui plachte jek ap o wawar.
Kre 50 (paash-sheel) dorjengre gustria un pande len ap kol dui bare kotja kote, kai i kotja khetne pandlo wenna.
Palle kre pantch-deesh rikepangre dran lolo saster, un tchip len jaake an i dorjengre gustria, te wenn kol dui bare kotja khetne pandlo.
Ko kotar plachta dran busjengre balla hi jek metari bareder har o kheer. Doleske muk jek metari ap i palstuni rig pral tele bladell!
Un serwes un tchatches muk jek paash metari pral tele bladell, te well o kheer ap kol dui rigja tchakedo.

Palle kre i wawar kotar dran bakrengri ledertikre plachte, hoi tu loles kral. Kowa well tchiddo pral o Debleskro plachteno kheer. Un pral koleste well i wawar kotar dran latche ledertikre plachte tchiddo.
Dran ko ruk, hoi kharella Akatsia, kre tchinle kashta, te wenn le pre tardo.
Jek tchinlo kasht well pantch metarja baro un 75 (efta-deesh-te-pantch) centimetarja buchlo.
Hako kashtes well dui tikne gushte, kolentsa wenn i tchinle kashta khetne rikedo.
Biish tchinle kashta wenn pre tardo ap koi rig, kai o kham pralstunes hi.
Tel ko biish tchinle kashta tchiwess tu star-deesh rupene herja, kai i gushte dren tchiddo wenna: tel hako tchinlo kasht dui herja, kai dui gushte dren tchiddo wenna.
Ninna ap i wawar rig, kai o kham gar wella, wenn biish tchinle kashta pre tardo.
Tel kolende kress tu ninna star-deesh rupene herja: dui herja tel hako tchinlo kasht.
Ap i palstuni rig, koi rig, kai o kham tele djal, wenn shob tchinle kashta pre tardo,
ninna dui wawar kashta, hoi krenn serwes un tchatches i ekka ap i palstuni rig.
Kol dui kashta wenn tele un pral khetne rikedo kol tchinle kashtentsa ap i serwi rig un ap i tchatchi rig, jaake te krenn le serwes un tchatches i ekka.
Jaake wenn ochta tchinle kashta ap i palstuni rig un deesh-te-shob rupene herja: tel hako tchinlo kasht dui herja.
Kre pandepangre kashta dran o kasht ko rukestar, hoi kharella Akatsia, un tchip pantch lendar ap kol tchinle kashta ap koi jek lengsti rig o kherestar,
pale pantch ap i tchinle kashta ap i wawar lengsti rig, un pale pantch ap i palstuni rig o kherestar kote, kai o kham tele djala.
Kre ninna i pandepaskro kasht, hoi djal mashkral ap i tchinle kashta fun jek rig ap i wawar.
Tchip sonakai trul kol tchinle kashta, ninna trul i pandepangre kashta! Un kre sonakangre gustria! An kolende wenn i pandepangre kashta dren tchiddo.
Dran kol tsele kotja tchiwess tu ko kheer jaake pre, har sikrom tuke ap i berga.

Muk ninna i kotar latcho sorelo laintikro than te krell, kai ninna kutch bakrengro bal dren hi. Kowa hi blaueto, lolo un lolo har jag. An ko kotar than wenn bolepangre dren sido an shukar wastengri budi.

Tchin star pesse kashta dran akatstikro kasht, tchip sonakai trul lende un tchip len ap star rupene herja. Tchip sonakangre rikepangre pral ap lende un pande ko kutch kotar than koi pre. Kau kutch than well o wudar mank o Debleskri glanstuni isema un o Debleskri palstuni isema, hoi leskri kutcheder isema hi. Palle an ko mochton, kai o Debleskre deesh laba dren hi, un tchip les pal ko wudar dran o kutch kotar than an o Debleskri palstuni isema!
Un ap o mochton, kai o Debleskre deesh laba dren hi, tchip ko pralstuno kotar, hoi sikrella, kai o Dewel peskre menshenge latches hi.
O Debleskri chapaskri tchip glan o wudar dran o kutch kotar than ap i serwi rig! Un i momelengri tchip ap i tchatchi rig!

Kre ninna i plachta, hoi well an ko wudar, kai weh dren an o kheer. Kre lat an shukar wastengri budi dran latcho sorelo laintikro than, kai ninna kutch bakrengro bal dren hi, hoi blaueto, lolo un lolo har jag kerdo was.
Tchin pantch pesse kashta dran akatstikro kasht. Tchip sonakai trul lende! Un kre lenge pantch herja dran lolo saster, ninna sonakangre rikepangre! Ap lende well koi plachta pandlo.

O Debleskri chatchepaskri kress tu dran o kasht ko rukestar, hoi kharella Akatsia. Pral i tseli chatchepaskri well lolo saster. I chatchepaskri well 2,50 (dui-te-paash) metari lengsto un ninna jaake buchlo, un well 1,50 (jek-te-paash) metari pral. Ap haki pralstuni ekka well i shing win. Kol shinga wenn kerdo dran jek kotar kasht har i chatchepaskri.

Kre ninna kol tsele koola dran saster, kolentsa budrenn le ap o Debleskri chatchepaskri: pirja, an kolende i jagakri tchik dren wella, bare roja, tchare, kai o rat dren wella, massengre forshette, jagakre tchare.
Kre ninna i sasterni netsa, kai i jagakri tchik tele perella. Un tchip star sasterne gustria ap lakre star rigja, kote kai i rigja khetne wenna.
