Tchip kai sasterni netsa jaake tele an i sasterni chatchepaskri, te well li paash pre har i chatchepaskri un djal bis kote, kai o tikno kasht trul i chatchepaskri hi.
Kre dui lengste kashta dran akatstikro kasht, un de lolo saster trul lende. Kol kashta wenn an i gustria ap o Debleskri chatchepaskri tchiddo, jaake te nai hidjrenn le lat.
Dran tchinle kashta well o Debleskri chatchepaskri kerdo – dren well tchi, jaake har les tute ap i berga sikedo was.

Glan o Debleskro kheer kress tu i platsa. Trul koi platsa pandess tu laintikre kotja dran latcho sorelo than mank pesse kashta, hoi tardo hi ap lole sasterne herja. I rikepangre un kol shelle, hoi rikrenn i laintikre kotja, kress tu dran rup. I platsa well ap koi rig, kai o kham pralstunes hi, 50 (paash-sheel) metarja lengsto. Kote wenn kol laintikre kotja ap biish pesse kashta rikedo, hoi ap biish sasterne herja tardo hi.

Ninna koi rig, kai o kham gar wella, well 50 (paash-sheel) metarja baro. Ninna kate rikrenn biish pesse kashta kol laintikre kotja. Jaake har ap i wawar rig wenn kal pesse kashta tardo ap biish sasterne herja. Un lengre rikepangre un kol shelle, hoi rikrenn kol kotja, kress tu dran rup.
Ap i rig, kai o kham tele djal, well koi platsa 25 (biish-te-pantch) metarja buchlo. Kote wenn i laintikre kotja ap deesh pesse kashta rikedo, hoi ap deesh sasterne herja tardo hi.
Ninna glan o kheer, ap i rig, kai o kham pre djala, well i platsa 25 (biish-te-pantch) metarja buchlo.

Tchiness pesse kashta, hoi wenn serwes un tchatches pash o wudar tardo: ap haki rig triin kashta ap triin herja. Mank kol kashta wenn i laintikre kotja pandlo. Kolla wenn ap haki rig efta-te-paash metarja lengsto.

Kote, kai weh ap i platsa, tchip star pesse kashta ap star herja, te kress i baro wudar. An o wudar well i bari plachta pandlo. Koja kress an shukar wastengri budi dran latcho sorelo laintikro than, kai ninna kutch bakrengro bal dren hi, hoi blaueto, lolo un lolo har jag kerdo was. Kai plachta well deesh metarja buchlo.
I tsele pesse kashta, hoi trul i platsa tardo hi, kolen hi herja dran lolo saster un rupene rikepangre un rupene shelle, hoi rikrenn kol laintikre kotja.

I platsa hi paash-sheel metarja lengsto un biish-te-pantch metarja buchlo. I pesse kashta ap pengre sasterne herja hi dui-te-paash metarja baro. I laintikre kotja hi kerdo dran latcho sorelo laintikro than.
O tselo koowa, koleha budrenn le an o Debleskro kheer, well kerdo dran lolo saster, ninna kol tikne kotja, hoi denn le an i phub, te well o plachteno kheer un i plachte trul i platsa soreles rikedo.

Pen ap i Israelitarja, te anenn le tuke o latcheder olivtikro djet, te nai chatchenn le haki rat i tikne momlia ap i momelengri an o Debleskro plachteno kheer. Kai momelengri well tardo win glan ko kutch kotar than, hoi glan ko mochton pandlo hi, kai o Debleskre deesh laba dren hi. Kote dell o Aron un leskre tchawe jak, te chatchell i momelengri i tseli rat an o Debleskro kheer. Kawa te well jaake kerdo hako tsireske pash i Israelitarja un lengre tchawende, kai pal lende wenna.
Muk tiro phrales, o Arones, un leskre mursh tchawen glan tute te anell. Kolen rodom win dran i wawar Israelitarja, te wenn le mange rashaja: o Nadab, o Abihu, o Eleasar un o Itamar.
Muk tiro phraleske, o Aroneske, shukar raile koola te siwell, jaake har i rashajeske moldo hi.
Rake kolentsa, kolen me latche wasta un o goswepen dom, te haiwenn le mishto te siwell. Pen lenge, te krenn le ripja o Aroneske, te well job mange i rashai.

Kolla hi i koola, hoi te krenn le: i betcheskri possita, i rashajeskri damdira, i baja un i gad, i shereskro pandepen, un i laintikro pandepen, hoi job trul peskro per pandell. Kol rashajengre koola krenn le o Aroneske un leskre tchawenge, te wenn jon mange rashaja.
I sibangre hunte lenn sonakai, latcho laintikro than, ninna kutch bakrengro bal, hoi blaueto, lolo un lolo har jag hi. Dran kowa krenn le kol koola.
O rashajeskri damdira krenn le an shukar wastengri budi dran latcho sorelo laintikro than, kai sonakai dren sido well, ninna kutch bakrengro bal, hoi blaueto, lolo un lolo har jag kerdo was.
Dui kotja than wenn ap i damdira sido kote, kai i phika hi. Un i pandepen pandell i damdira trul o per khetne.

Ko pereskro pandepen well jaake kerdo har koi damdira: dran latcho sorelo laintikro than, kai sonakai dren sido well, ninna kutch bakrengro bal, hoi blaueto, lolo un lolo har jag kerdo was. I damdira un lakro pandepen hi dran jek kotar than.
Le dui kutch barra, hoi kharenna Onyx! Un an kolende muk i laba o Israeleskre tchawendar dren te tchinell:
Shob laba ap ko jek bar un shob ap ko wawar bar pal lengro phurepen.
Muk koi budi jekestar te krell, hoi haiwell mishto laba an bar te tchinell. Un kol barra wenn tchiddo an sonakangre gustria.

Palle kre kol dui barra ap i damdira pre, kote kai i phika hi. Jaake hidjrell o Aron i laba o Israeleskre tchawendar ap peskre phika, te djal lo an o Debleskro kheer. Un jon wenn mange, o baro Debleske, an o shero, te wap lenge latcho.
Kre ninna dui wawar tikne sonakangre gustria,
un pande dui dorja dran latcho sonakai ap lende, hoi hi khetne lino har i lengste balla i djuwjatar.

Muk i betcheskri possita jaake te krell, har kran le o rashajeskri damdira: dran i latcho sorelo laintikro kotar than, kai sonakai dren sido well, ninna kutch bakrengro bal, hoi blaueto, lolo un lolo har jag kerdo was. An koi possita hi kol dui tikne koola dren, hoi lell o rashai, te hatsell lo win, hoi o Dewel peskre menshendar kamella.
I possita hi biish-te-pantch centimetarja baro un ninna jaake buchlo. Ko laintikro kotar than well dui kope khetne lino.
Kre deesh-te-dui kutch barra ap late pre, hako kopo triin barra tel i wawar: pralstunes kol barra, hoi kharenna Rubin, Topas un Smaragdo.
Tel kolende kol barra, hoi kharenna Karfunkel, Safiro, un Diamanto.
Tel kolende kol barra, hoi kharenna Hiazint, Achat, un Ametist.
Telstunes kol barra, hoi kharenna: Krisolit, Onyx un Jaspis. Tchip kol barra an sonakangre gustria.
Un tchin an lende i laba o Israeleskre tchawendar, kolendar i deesh-te-dui bare familje wenn. Tchin an hako bar jek lab.
Ap i betcheskri possita kre tikne dorja dran latcho sonakai, hoi khetne lino hi har i lengste balla i djuwjatar.
Kre ninna dui sonakangre gustria un sib len serwes un tchatches ap i pralstuni rig ap i possita.
Un tchip kol dui sonakangre dorja jek rigjah an kol dui sonakangre gustria, hoi hi serwes un tchatches ap i possita.
Koi wawar rig tchip an kol sonakangre gustria, hoi ap kol kotja hi, hoi glanstunes ap i damdira sido hi, kote, kai i phika hi.
Palle kre dui sonakangre gustria un sib len dren an i possita ap i telstuni rig, kote, kai i possita ap i damdira sido hi.

Un palle tchip dui wawar sonakangre gustria ap kol dui kotja, hoi kote ap i damdira sido hi, kai i phika hi. Sib len ap i glanstuni rig kote, kai kol kotja khetne lino hi, pral o pereskro pandepen, hoi rikrell i damdira khetne.
Palle tchip i dori dran blaueto kutch bakrengro bal an kol dui gustria, hoi ap o betcheskri possita hi, un pande lat jaake ap i gustria ap i damdira, te hi li soreles rikedo pral o pereskro pandepen.
Jaake hidjrell o Aron i laba kol deesh-te-dui Israeleskre tchawendar ap peskro dji hako kopo, kai djal lo an o Debleskro kheer. Un me bistrau len gar, te wap lenge latcho hako tsiro.

An ko betcheskri possita tchip kol dui tikne koola, hoi kharenna ‘momeli’ un ‘tchatchepen’, te wenn le ap o dji o Aronestar, te djal o Aron dren pash mande. Kol dui tikne koola, kolentsa tumer win hatsenn, hoi me, o baro Dewel, i Israelendar kamau, kolen hidjrell lo ap peskro dji, te well lo glan mande.
Tel i damdira riwell o rashai i baja. Un koi tseli baja kress tu dran blaueto kutch bakrengro bal.
Pral mukess tu lat pre, te nai well kote o shero win. Ko kotar trul i meen siwess tu jaake soreles har pash i ledertikri baja, te nai djal li gar paash.

Ap o telstuno kotar i bajatar kress tu tikne phabja dran kutch bakrengro bal, hoi blaueto, lolo un lolo har jag kerdo was. Kal phabja djan trul i tseli baja. Mank lende wenn tikne sonakangre bashepangre jaake trul o tselo ripen,
te well jek phabi, palle jek bashepaskri, palle jek phabi, un jaake dureder trul i tseli baja.
Koi baja riwell o Aron an, te shunell jek les, te djal lo glan o baro Debleste an leskro kheer dren, ninna te well lo pale win. Kawa krell lo, te merell lo gar.
An i tikno kotar latcho sonakai tchin kol laba: “Kowa hi o baro Debleske”, un pande ko kotar sonakai ap i dori dran blaueto kutch bakrengro bal glan ap o shereskro pandepen.

Ko tikno kotar sonakai hidjrell o Aron glan ap peskro shero, te well lo glan mande. Kowa sikrella, te lell o Aron i doosh ap peste, hoi ap ko koowa hi, hoi i Israelitarja man dan. Un me dikau latches ap lende.
Kre o gad dran i latcho laintikro kotar than an shukar wastengri budi. Kre ninna o shereskro pandepen dran latcho laintikro than, un i pereskro pandepen an shukar wastengri budi.
Ninna o Aroneskre tchawenge kre gada, pereskre pandepangre un rashajengre stadja, hoi railo un shukar hi.
Palle rib o Aroneske un leskre tchawenge kol koola an. Le djet un mak len o Debleske un de len an lengri budi, te wenn le mange rashaja.
Muk lenge ninna laintikre telstune cholopja te krell. Kolla riwenn le tel i wawar koola, te wenn le kote gar nanges.

Hako kopo kai djan le an o Debleskro plachteno kheer, ninna te chatchrenn le i viecho ap o Debleskri sasterni chatchepaskri, hunte riwell o Aron un leskre tchawe kol telstune cholopja. Jaake tchiwenn le penge kek doosh ap pende un hunte merenn gar. Un kowa well jaake o Aroneske un leskre tchawenge, hoi pal leste wenna, lauterenge, kai wenna rashaja, o tselo tsireske.
Un kowa kre, te well o Aron un leskre tchawe rashaja mange. Le i terno gurum un dui mursh bakre, hoi sasto hi.
Le ninna latcho jarro, tchip kek shutlo jarro dren, un kre pesse un sane mare, ninna merklia. An i merklia tchip djet dren, un ap i sane mare mak djet pre.
Tchip len an i korba un an len o Debleske! Ko terno gurum un kol dui bakre an leske ninna!
An o Arones un leskre tchawen pash o wudar glan o Debleskro plachteno kheer, un le pani un thob len!
Palle le i koola un rib o Arones an: o gad un i baja, o rashajeskri damdira un i betcheskri possita ninna. Pande ko pereskro pandepen, hoi ap i damdira hi, trul leste!
Palle tchip o shereskro pandepen trul leskro shero! Un tchip o tikno sonakaskro kotar glan ap koleste!
Le o makepaskro djet un tchore les pral leskro shero, mak les o Debleske!
Muk ninna leskre tchawe pash tute te well! Kolenge rib ninna i gada an!
Palle tchip lenge o pereskro pandepen trujel un tchip i rashajengre stadja ap lengre shere, te wenn le mange rashaja hako tsireske. Un jaake aneh tu len an lengri budi:
An ko terno gurum glan o Debleskro plachteno kheer. Un o Aron un leskre tchawe tchiwenn pengre wasta ap leskro shero.
Un tu mareh les pash o baro Debleskri chatchepaskri glan o Debleskro plachteno kheer glan o wudar.
Tchip tiro gushto an o rat un mak les ap i shinga, hoi pral ap o Debleskri sasterni chatchepaskri hi. Un o tselo wawar rat tchore tella glan o Debleskri chatchepaskri win!

Le o tselo thulepen, hoi ap i buke hi un ko thullo kotar, hoi pral i lebra hi, un kol dui niere un lengro thulepen, hoi ap lende hi! Kowa lauter chatchress tu ap o Debleskri sasterni chatchepaskri, te djal lauter an i jagakro ducho pre.
O mass, i hauta un ko chapen, hoi an i buke hi, chatchress tu win glan koi platsa, kai tumer djiwenna. Kowa lauter well jaake kerdo, te well i rashajengri doosh krik lino.
Palle le ko jek bakro! Un o Aron un leskre tchawe tchiwenn pengre wasta ap leskro shero.
Palle mare les, le leskro rat un tchore les trul o Debleskri chatchepaskri win.
Tchin o mass an kotja! Thob leskre buke un leskre herja, un tchip o shero un kol wawar kotja ap o Debleskri chatchepaskri!

Un chatche o tselo bakro ap i chatchepaskri, jaake te djal lauter pre an i jagakro ducho. Ko bakro hi mange, o baro Debleske, un well tseles chatchedo. Un o latcho sungepen, hoi well win, sungell mange mishto.
Le o duito bakro! Un o Aron un leskre tchawe tchiwenn pengre wasta ap leskro shero.

Palle mare les, le leskro ratestar un tchip les tella ap o Aroneskro tchatcho kand, ninna ap i tchatche kanda leskre tchawenge! Ninna ap o pesso gushto ap lengro tchatcho wast, un ap o baro tsebo ap lengro tchatcho piro tchiwess tu o rat. O tselo wawar rat tchoress tu trul o Debleskri chatchepaskri win.

Le ko ratestar, hoi ap o Debleskri chatchepaskri hi, un tchip les an o makepaskro djet un witse les ap o Aron un leskre koola un ap leskre tchawende un lengre koola, te well job un leskre koola o Debleske, ninna leskre tchawe un lengre koola, te wenn le o Debleske.

Kau duito bakro well doleske maredo, te nai well o Aron peskre tchawentsa an pengri budi dren tchiddo. Le o thulepen kai maredo bakrestar: i thulli pori, ninna o thulepen, hoi ap i buke hi un ko kotar, hoi pral i lebra hi un kol dui niere un lengro thulepen, hoi ap lende hi! Le ninna o pralstuno kotar i tchatchi herjatar.
Palle le jek pesso maro, ninna jek sano maro un jek djeteskri merkli dran koi korba, kai o maro dren hi, kai kek shutlo jarro dren hi, un hoi pash o wudar glan o baro Debleskro kheer tardo hi.
Tchip kowa lauter an o Aroneskre wasta un an i wasta leskre tchawendar. Un jon hadenn kowa pre glan mande, o baro Debleste, te sikrenn le, kai kowa mange hi.

Palle le les dran lengre wasta un chatche les pre ap o Debleskri chatchepaskri pral ko wawar bakro, hoi tu tseles chatchral, jaake te djal kawa lauter ninna pre an i jagakro ducho. Un o latcho sungepen, hoi well win, sungell mange, o baro Debleske, mishto.
Le o betch kau duito bakrestar, un hade les pre glan o baro Debleste, te sikress, kai kowa leske hi. Palle nai chah tu les.
Hako kopo, kai well i mursh mange i rashai, well o betch kau bakrestar un o pralstuno kotar i herjatar glan o baro Debleste pre hadedo, te sikrenn le, kai kowa o Debleske hi.

Kol dui kotja mass wenn pre hadedo glan mande, o baro Debleste. Palle nai chal len o Aron peskre tchawentsa. Un jaake well kowa kerdo hako kopo, kai marenn i Israelitarja i bakres mange, hoi chan le palle khetne glan mande.
Un i rashajengre koola, hoi o Aron riwas, lenn pal leste leskre tchawe ap ko diwes, kai wenn le rashaja.

Koon leskre tchawendar rashai wella, kowa riwell o Aroneskre koola an ap ko diwes, kai well lo rashai. Job hidjrell len an kol efta diwessa, kai djal lo an o Debleskro plachteno kheer, te budrell lo o Debleske.
Ko mass ko duito bakrestar keress tu an pani ap i Debleskri platsa.
Palle chan o Aron un leskre tchawe o mass o bakrestar khetne o maro dran i korba pash o wudar glan o Debleskro plachteno kheer.
Jon kokres chan kol kotja mass ko viechestar, hoi maredo was, te well lengri doosh krik lino, te nai wenn le o Debleskre rashaja. Kek wawar nai chal ko mass, – kowa hi o Debleskro chapen.
Te atchell mass un maro pral i rati pral, hunte well kowa chatchedo. Kek nai chal les. Kowa hi o Debleskro chapen.
Jaake kress tu o Aroneha un leskre tchawentsa lauter, hoi me tuke penom. Efta diwessa kress tu jaake, te wenn le rashaja.

An kol efta diwessa maress tu hako diwes i terno gurum o Debleske, te well i doosh krik lino. Leskro rateha well i doosh krik lino, hoi ap o Debleskri chatchepaskri was. Palle mak djet ap o Debleskri chatchepaskri! Jaake well diklo, te hi kai chatchepaskri o Debleske.

Efta diwessa kress tu kawa hako diwes, te well i doosh ap o Debleskri chatchepaskri krik lino. Ninna makess tu koi chatchepaskri o djeteha dren, te well li o Debleske kokres un kek wawareske. Un hakeno, koon taprell lat an, kowa hi o Debleskro.
Un kawa hi, hoi tu hako diwes ap o Debleskri chatchepaskri chatchress: dui terne bakre, hoi jek bersh phuro hi,
ko jek bakro taissarlakro un ko wawar bakro ap i rat.

Le ninna i khoro latcho jarro un jek litari olivtikro djet, un tchore o djet an o jarro, un kre les khetne, un tchip kowa pash ko bakro pashel! Un le jek litari mool un tchore les win glan o Debleste!
Kowa kre taissarlakro un rati ninna! Jaake aneh tu chapen un pipen o Debleske. Un o latcho sungepen, hoi well win, te well kowa lauter chatchedo an i jag, sungella mishto o baro Debleske.

An o tsiro, hoi wella, krenn jaake, tumer un tumare tchawe, hoi pal tumende wenna! Un denn man hako diwes taissarlakro un rati i bakro! Kowa chatchrenn glan mande pash o wudar glan o Debleskro plachteno kheer! Un kote wau pash tumende un rakrau tuha.
Kote wau pash i Israelitarja. Un miro railepen well mantsa an ko kheer. Un jaake well o kheer miro kheer.
Jaake lau miro plachteno kheer un i sasterni chatchepaskri mange, ninna o Arones un leskre tchawen, te wenn le mange rashaja.
Un me djiwau mashkral i Israelitarja un hom lengro Dewel.
Un jon dikenna, te hom me o baro Dewel, un lom len win dran o them Egiptia, te djiwap mashkral lende, me, lengro baro Dewel.
Kre i bob dran o kasht ko rukestar, hoi kharella Akatsia. Koi pre well sawo koowa chatchedo, hoi o Debleske shukar sungella.
Kre kau bob i paash metari lengsto un ninna jaake buchlo. Les hi star rigja, un kote, kai jon khetne wenna, well i kotar win un djal pre har i shing. O tselo bob hi jek metari baro.
Trul o tselo bob tchip latcho sonakai: pral pre un ninna ap i star rigja un ap i shinga. Un tchip i sonakaskro pandepen trul o bob.

Muk star sonakangre gustria te krell. Kolla wenn ap kol dui rigja o bobestar kerdo: ap haki rig dui sonakangre gustria tel ko sonakaskro pandepen, hoi djal trul o bob. An kol gustria wenn lengste kashta tchiddo. Kolentsa hidjrenn le o sonakaskro bob.
Kre kol kashta dran akatstikro kasht un de sonakai trujel.

Tchip o sonakaskro bob glan o wudar dran o kutch kotar than. Pal ko wudar hi o mochton, kai o Debleskre deesh laba dren hi, un kai o pralstuno kotar pre hi, hoi sikrella, kai o Dewel peskre menshenge latcho hi.
Ap ko sonakaskro bob chatchrell o Aron ko kutch koowa, hoi o Debleske shukar sungella. Kowa krell lo hako diwes taissarlakro, te tchorell lo o djet an i momlia,
ninna haki rat, te chatchell lo i momlia an. Un kowa well hako diwes mange kerdo. Ninna pash tumare tchawende un lauterende, kai pal lende wenna, well kowa jaake kerdo.
Tumer chatchrenn tchi ap kau bob, hoi o Dewel tumenge gar penas, witar kek viecho un kek chapen dran jarro. Un kek mool well ap leste win tchoredo.

Jek kopo an o bersh lell o Aron o rat o bakrestar, hoi maredo was, te lell lo i doosh krik, un djal pash o Debleskro sonakaskro bob un makell ko rat ap i shinga, hoi pral ap o bob hi. Kowa krell lo, te well i doosh krik lino, hoi ap o bob hi. Ninna pash tumare tchawende un kolende, kai pal lende wenna, well kowa hako bersh jek kopo jaake kerdo. O sonakaskro bob hi o baro Debleske kokres.
Un o baro Dewel penas ap o Mose:
Dik, har bud mursha hi mank i Israelitarja! Un pen lenge, te hunte denn le man lowe, te atchenn le djido, te well kek bibacht ap lende an kol diwessa, kai wenn lengre laba pre tchinlo.
Hako mursh, kai hi biish bersh un phureder, kowa dell man i paash kotar rup. Ko paash rupeno kotar hunte well jaake pharo har kolla an o Debleskro kheer: shob gramme pharo.
O brawelo dell gar i bareder kotar, un o tchorwelo gar i tikneder kotar. Hako mursh dell i paash kotar rup o baro Debleske, te atchell lo djido.
Un tu less kol lowe, hoi i Israelitarja tut denna, un dess len kolende, kai ap o Debleskro plachteno kheer budrenna. Jaake bistrau i Israelitarja gar un dikau latches ap lende, te atchenn le djido.
Un o baro Dewel rakras ap o Moseste un penas:

Kre i thopaskro tcharo dran lolo saster, un tchip les ap herja, hoi ninna dran lolo saster hi. Un tchip les mashkral o Debleskro plachteno kheer un o Debleskri sasterni chatchepaskri. Un tchore pani dren,
jaake te nai thowell o Aron un leskre tchawe pengre wasta un herja,
glan kowa kai djan le an o Debleskro plachteno kheer un pash o Debleskri sasterni chatchepaskri, te chatchrenn le i vieches o baro Debleske.
Te thowenn le pen gar, hunte merenn le. Ko lab hi o Aroneske un leskre tchawenge un kolenge, kai pal lende wenna, hako tsireske.
Un o baro Dewel rakras o Moseha un penas:

Tu less i khoro olivtikro djet un tchiwess kutch sungepaskro koowa dren: shob kilo Myrrhe, triin kilo Zimto, triin kilo gudlo sungepaskro khass un shob kilo sungepaskro kasht, hoi kharella Kassia. Jek kilo hi jaake bud har jek kilo an o Debleskro kheer hi.
Kre kolestar i kutch djet, hoi maklo well ap o tselo koowa, hoi o Debleske hi. Muk les jekestar khetne te krell, kai kowa mishto haiwell.
Tu makess ko djet ap o Debleskro plachteno kheer, ap ko mochton, kai o Debleskre deesh laba dren hi,

ninna ap i chapaskri un ap o tselo koowa, hoi koi pre hi, ninna ap i momelengri un lauter, hoi koi pashel hi. Ninna ap o Debleskro sonakaskro bob, kai kutch sungepaskro koowa pre chatchedo wella, well ko djet maklo,
ninna ap o Debleskri sasterni chatchepaskri, kai i vieche o Debleske chatchedo wenna, un ap kol tsele koola, kolentsa budrenn le. Mak ninna o thopaskro tcharo, un leskre herja, hoi les hidjrenna.
Te makeh len jaake, sikreh tu, kai hi le o Debleske, un leske kokres. Un hakeno, koon taprell len an, hi o Debleskro.
Jaake kress kowa ninna o Aroneha un leskre tchawentsa. Mak len o djeteha, te wenn le rashaja mange.

Ap i Israelitarja pen: Ko djet hi o Debleskro djet. Lenn les kokres te makenn i rashaja mange. Ma makenn les ap i wawar mensheste. Un ma krenn tumenge i djet, hoi ninna kowa lauter dren hi har an kawa djet. O Debleskro djet atchell lo. Rikrenn tumen ap kowa hako tsiro, tumer un tumare tchawe, hoi pal tumende wenna.
Koon peske sawo djet krella, nai atchell gar djido mank peskre menshende. Temerl dino well ninna kowa, kai makell jekeste, kai hi kek rashai.

Un o baro Dewel penas ap o Mose: Le tuke ko kutch koowa, hoi mishto sungella: rukengro djet, Onycha, burrengro djet, ninna djudjo sungepaskro koowa, hoi kharella Weihrauch. Hakenestar le jaake bud har ko wawarestar!

Un tchip kowa jaake khetne, har kolla krenna, kai kowa mishto haiwenna, te well lestar i sungepaskro koowa, hoi chatchedo well o Debleske. Tchip ninna loon koi pashel, te well ko koowa djudjo. O Debleske hi lo.

Palle kre les tiknes, jaake tiknes har djala, un tchip ninna lestar glan ko mochton, kai o Debleskre deesh laba dren hi, an o Debleskro plachteno kheer, kote, kai wau me pash tute. Denn jak! Kau sungepaskro koowa, hoi tumer o Debleske kran, hi leske kokres!
Ma krenn sawo koowa tumenge. Shunenn, mange kokres hi kowa!
Koon sawo koowa peske krella, te nai sungell lo o shukar sungepen, kawa nai atchell gar djido mank peskre menshende.
Un o baro Dewel rakras o Moseha un penas:
Shun, me rodom jekes win, te krell lo kai budi mange. Kowa hi o Bezalel. Leskro dad hi o Uri. Koleskro dad his o Hur dran o kheer Juda.
Me tchiwom miro ducho an leste, un dom les goswepen un wasta, hoi haiwenn mishto te budrell,
te nai krell lo shukar koowa dran sonakai, rup un lolo saster.
Ninna haiwell lo kutch barra te tchinell un an gustria te tchiwell. Ninna nai dell lo shukar koowa win tchurje dran kasht, jaake te nai krell lo haki budi.

Shun, me rodom ninna i wawares win, te djal lo leske pash o wast. Kowa hi o Oholiab. Leskro dad hi o Ahisamach, dran o kheer Dan. Lentsa budrenn hake wawar, kai haiwenn mishto lengre wastentsa te budrell. Lenge dom me o goswepen an o dji, te krenn le lauter jaake, har me tuke penom:

O Debleskro plachteno kheer, o mochton, kai o Debleskre deesh laba dren hi, o pralstuno kotar koi pre, hoi sikrella, kai o Dewel latcho ap peskre menshende hi, ninna o tselo wawar koowa, hoi an o kheer well:
i chapaskri un lauter, hoi pre hi, i sonakaskri momelengri un lauter, hoi pashel hi, o Debleskro sonakaskro bob, kai kutch sungepaskro koowa pre chatchedo wella,
koi sasterni chatchepaskri, kai i vieche o Debleske chatchedo wenna, un ko tselo koowa, hoi pashel hi, un o thopaskro tcharo un koleskre herja;
ninna kol rashajeskre koola, hoi o Aron un leskre tchawe riwenna pash pengri budi an o Debleskro kheer;
ninna ko makepaskro djet, hoi ap kowa maklo well, hoi o Debleske hi; un ko kutch sungepaskro koowa, hoi chatchedo wella an o Debleskro kheer. Kowa lauter krenn le jaake, har me les tuke penom.
Un o baro Dewel rakras o Moseha un penas:

Pen ap i tsele Israelitarja: Rikrenn o Debleskro diwes tumenge! Kowa sikrell tumen, kai me tumaro Dewel hom, un tumer mire menshe han an hako tsiro. Kowa hi tumenge un tumare tchawenge un lauterenge, kai pal tumende wenna, te dikenn tumer, te rodom me, o baro Dewel, tumen win, te wenn mire menshe.
Rikrenn o Debleskro diwes tumenge! Koon les gar rikrella, well temerl dino. Awa, hakeno, hoi ap o Debleskro diwes budrella, hunte djiwell buder gar mank peskre menshende.
Shob diwessa budress tu. O eftato diwes kress tu tchi. Ko diwes hi o baro Debleske. Kowa, kai budrella, well mulo dino.
Doleske hunte rikrenn i Israelitarja o Debleskro diwes hako tsiro, jon un lengre tchawe un lauter, kai pal lende wenna, jaake har krom me kowa lentsa win.

O Debleskro diwes hi i sikepen mange un mire menshenge, i Israelitarja, hoi hako tsiro atchella. An shob diwessa kras o baro Dewel o bolepen un i phub. Un o eftato diwes kras job tchi un las newi soor.
Un har o baro Dewel kowa lauter ap o Mose rakras ap i berga Sinai, das job les i dui barra, kai o Debleskre deesh laba dren tchinlo hi. O Dewel tchinas len peskro gushteha dren.

Har dikan i menshe, kai o Mose i rah tsiro krik atchas, un gar buder koi berga tele was, wan le khetne pash o Aron un penan ap leste: “Dja, kre menge i dewel, kai djal glan mende! Mer djinah gar, hoi ko Moseha djas, kai anas men dran o them Egiptia win.”
O Aron penas ap lende: “Lenn i sonakangre kanengre, hoi tumare romja, mursh tchawe un tcha an i kanda hi, un anenn len mange.”
Jaake lan i tsele menshe pengre kanengre dran i kanda, un anan len pash o Aron.
Un job las len dran lengre wasta, un tchiwas len an i jag, un kras i dewel, hoi dikas win har i terno gurum. Un jon penan: “Kawa hi tiro Dewel, Israel, kowa, kai tut dran o them Egiptia win anas.”
Har dikas kowa o Aron, kras job i chatchepaskri glan ko gurum, te chatchrenn le viechen leske koi pre, un mukas wi-gole te dell: “Taissar hi i baro diwes, kai sharah o baro Debles!”

Un jon stan taissarlakro pre un maran viechen, un chatchran len ko debleske, hoi kran le penge. Ninna wawar viechen anan le pashel, te chan le len khetne. Un jon beshan pen, te chan le un te pijenn le. Un jon stan pre un khelan.
O baro Dewel rakras ap o Mose: “Naash, dja tele, tire menshe, kai tu dran o them Egiptia win anal, kran djungelo koowa.

Sik djan le ko dromestar tele, kai me sikrom lende. Jon kran penge i dewel, – i terno gurum, – un mangan les an, maran viechen leske un penan: ‘Kawa hi tiro Dewel, Israel, kowa, kai anas tut dran o them Egiptia win.’”
Un o baro Dewel penas ap o Mose: “Me dikau, kai djiwenn kol menshe pal pengro shero un kamenn gar te shunell.
Ma rike man pale, te anap miri bari choli pral lende, un dap len temerl. Tire tchawendar krau me i bari natsjona.”

O Mose mangas o baro Debles, kai leskro Dewel his, un penas: “Baro Dewel, tiro sorelo wasteha anal tu tire menshen dran o them Egiptia win, un sikral tiri tseli soor. Hoske kameh tu len kanna an tiri choli temerl te dell?

Kameh, te penenn i Egiptarja: ‘Kau Dewel anas i Israelitarjen dran maro them win, te marell lo len an i berge, te atchell kek lendar pral ap i phub.’ Mangau tut, dja pale tiri chatchedi choljatar! Muk kai bibacht gar pral lende te well!

Ma biste tire budepangren, o Abraham, o Isaak un o Jakob! Kolenge dal tut sowel un penal: ‘Me mukau tumare tchawen budeder te well har i momlia an o bolepen. Kau tselo them, kai me penom, te well lo tumaro, dau tumare tchawende, te djiwenn le kote hako tsireske.’”
Koi rikras pes o baro Dewel pale un mukas gar koi bari bibacht pral peskre menshende te well.
O Mose djas pale koi berga tele. An leskro wast his les kol barra, kai o Debleskre deesh laba ap hake dui rigja dren tchinlo hi.
Kol barra kras o Dewel kokres un tchinas kol laba dren.
O Josua, kai his pash o Moseste, shunas har i Israelitarja gole dan, un penas ap o Moseste: “I menshe denn bari gole, har te kurans le pen.”
Koi penas o Mose leske: “Kaja hi kek gole, har pal i kurepen, kai wans le i sorleder, witar kek gole, har te nashans le penge. Me shunau i gole, har te giwenn le un khelenn le.”
Har was o Mose pash i menshende, un dikas ko terno gurum, un har i menshe khelan, was an leste i bari choli. Job witsras kol barra dran peskre wasta un phagas len an kotja tella pash i berga.

Ko terno gurum, hoi kran i Israelitarja penge, witsras job an i jag, te chatchrell lo. Un das les tiknes, bis te stauba pral atchas. Koi stauba witsras lo an o pani, un das les i Israelitarja te pijell.
Pale penas lo ap o Aron: “Hoi kran tuke kol menshe? Hoske anal tu len ap sawo tchilatcho drom!”
O Aron penas: “Am gar chojedo, mo rai! Tu djineh kokres, kai kol menshe tchilatcho hi.
Jon penan ap mande: ‘Kre menge i dewel, kai men o drom sikrella! Koon djinella, hoi ko mursheske Mose djas, kowa, kai anas men dran o them Egiptia win.’
Me putchom: ‘Kones hi sonakai?’ Jaake lan le pengro sonakai tele un dan les mande. Me lom ko sonakai un tchiwom les an i jag, un hoi win was, his ko terno gurum.”
O Mose dikas, kai i Israelitarja bi-pandle wan. O Aron mukas len te krell, hoi jon kaman. Jon kran pen sapaske kolenge, kai kamenn pen lentsa te kurell.
Koi djas o Mose an o wudar glan koi platsa, kai i menshe djiwenn, un das gole: “Koon kamell o baro Debles, kowa te well pash mande!” Jaake wan i tsele Levitarja pash leste.

Un job penas ap lende: “O baro Dewel, o Dewel pral o Israel, penell tumenge: ‘Lenn hakeno peskro charo, un djan pral koi tseli platsa, kate te kote! Hakeno lell peskro phrales, peskro males, un koles, kai langs leste djiwell, un dell les mulo.’”
I Levitarja kran, har o Mose lenge penas. Un ap kowa diwes meran jaake triin serja mursha.

O Mose penas ap i Levitarja: “Kau diwes wan tumer rashaja o baro Debleske. Tumer rikran tumen gar pale, te maran ninna tumare mursh tchawen un phralen. Doleske tchiwell o baro Dewel peskri bacht ap tumende.”
O wawar diwes rakras o Mose ap i Israelitarja: “Tumer anan bari doosh un ladj ap tumende. Kanna kamau pale pash o baro Debleste ap i berga te djal, te mangap lestar, te bistrell lo tumari doosh.”
O Mose djas pash o baro Debleste pale un penas: “Ach, kol menshe anan bari doosh un ladj ap pende. I debles dran sonakai kran jon penge.
Mangau tut: Biste lengri doosh! Te kameh tu kowa gar te krell, palle le miro lab krik dran tiro liil, hoi tu tchinal.”
Un o baro Dewel penas: “Me lau kokres o lab kolestar krik dran miro liil, kai miro drom mukas.
Un kanna dja pale! An kol menshen an ko them, kai me rakrom lestar. Miro bolepaskro djal glan tute. Te well miro tsiro, dau i Israelitarjen pengri phagi.”
Un o baro Dewel das i Israelitarjen doleske, kai jon mangan ko terno gurum an, hoi o Aron kras.

O baro Dewel penas ap o Moseste: “Djan dureder, tu un kol menshe, kolen tu dran o them Egiptia win anal. Djan an ko them, kai me man sowel dom glan o Abraham, o Isaak un o Jakob un lenge penom: ‘Tumare tchawen dau me kau them.’
Un me bitchrau i bolepaskro. Kowa djal glan tumende. Un me tradau i wawar menshen an kau them win: i Kanaanitarja, i Amorarja, i Hetarja, i Perisarja, i Hiwarja un i Jebusarja.
Jaake anau tumen an ko them, kai hi bud thud un gwin. Me wau gar tumentsa. Tumer djiwenn pal tumaro shero un kamenn gar te shunell. Un me doms nai tumen mulo ap o drom, te djoms tumentsa.”
Har i Israelitarja kol phare laba shunan, rowan lengre djia, un kek lendar tchiwas buder peskro sonakai un rup ap peste.

Jaake kran le, hoi o baro Dewel o Moseske penas. Leske penas lo: “Pen ap i Israelitarja: Tumer djiwenn pal tumaro shero un kamenn gar te shunell. Te woms me tumentsa i tikno tsiro ap o drom, doms me tumen mulo. Tchiwenn kanna tumaro sonakai un rup tele! Pal kowa kamau me dikell, hoi tumentsa krau.”
Jaake tchiwan i Israelitarja pengro sonakai un rup tele, har his le pash i berga Horeb.

Hako kopo, kai djan i Israelitarja ap i wawar platsa, tchiwas o Mose o plachteno kheer pre win glan koi platsa, kai i menshe hi. Job penas: “Kowa hi ko kheer, kai o baro Dewel tumentsa khetne well.” Hako Israelitari, kai kamas o baro Deblestar tchomone te putchell, hunte djas kote.

Hako kopo har djas o Mose win pash o Debleskro plachteno kheer, stan i tsele Israelitarja pre un djan an i wudja glan lengre plachtene khera, un atchan koi tardo. Jon dikan o Moseske palla, har job pash o Debleskro plachteno kheer djas.
Was lo koi, was i bari wolka tele un atchas pral ko wudar tardo. Un o baro Dewel rakras o Moseha.
Har dikan i Israelitarja koi wolka pash ko wudar, witsran pen le tele hakeno glan peskro khereskro wudar, te mangenn le o Debles an.

O baro Dewel rakras o Moseha, har mala rakran khetne, kai dikenn pen an i jaka. Palle djas o Mose pale ap i platsa, kai i menshe hi. Leskro terno budepaskro, o Josua, – koleskro dad hi o Nun, – atchas an o Debleskro plachteno kheer.

O Mose penas ap o baro Debleste: “Tu penal mange, te anap me kal menshen an o them Kanaan. Tu sikral man gar, kones tu mantsa bitchreh. Tu penal, te prindjreh man un djineh miro lab, un te dikeh latches ap mande.
Te dikeh latches ap mande, muk man tiro drom te djinell. Me kamau tut feteder te haiwell, te krap, hoi mishto hi glan tire jaka. Biste kowa gar: Kol menshe hi tire menshe.”
O Dewel penas: “Me djau glan tute un anau tut an i them, kai tu khere hal.”
O Mose penas ap leste: “Te djah tu gar mentsa, palle bitche men gar katar krik!
Tu te djah mentsa, palle haiwell hakeno, te dikeh latches ap mande un ap kal menshende. Jaake sikreh i tsele wawar menshende ap kai phub, te ham kutch tuke.”
O baro Dewel penas ap o Moseste: “Ninna kawa, hoi tu mandar mangal, kamau me te krell. Tu hal latches glan mire jaka, me prindjrau tut un djinau tiro lab.”
O Mose mangas: “Muk man tiro railepen te dikell!”

“Mishto”, penas o baro Dewel: “Me kamau glan tute te djal, te dikess tu miro tselo latchepen. Un miro lab ‘Baro Dewel’ rakrau me glan tute win. Me hom latcho koneske, kones me kamau. Un krau miro dji pre koneske me kamau.
Mire jaka un miro mui dikess tu gar. Kek mensho, kai dikas man, atchell djido.
Tu nai atcheh pash mande kate ap i baro bar tardo.
Te djau me an miro railepen glan tute, tchiwau me tut mank i bare barra, un rikrau miro wast pral tute, bis te djom dureder.
Palle lau miro wast pale, un tu nai dikeh mange palla. Mire jaka un miro mui nai dikell kek.”
O baro Dewel penas ap o Moseste: “Kre tuke dui bare barra, har kolla his, kai tu paash dal! Palle kamau me pale kol laba dren te tchinell, hoi an i wawar barra tchinlo his.
Le tuha, hoi tut hunte well, te djas sik taissarlakro pral ap i berga Sinai pre. Kote am pash mande!
Kek nai well tuha. Ap koi tseli berga hunte mukell pes kek te dikell, witar kek bakre un grumja, te chan le pash i berga.”
O Mose kras dui newe bare barra har kol phure. Sik taissarlakro stas job pre, un djas ap koi berga Sinai, har o baro Dewel penas leske. An leskre wasta rikras lo kol dui bare barra.
O baro Dewel was an i wolka tele, djas pash o Moseste un kharas peskro lab ‘Baro Dewel’.

Job djas glan o Moseste dureder un das gole: “Me hom o baro Dewel. O baro Dewel hom me. Man hi i baro dji, pherdo kamlepen. Me wau gar sik chojedo. Miro latchepen hi baro un me dau mire menshen gar pre.

Me sikrau miro latchepen ap lengre tchawende un kolengre tchawende un kolengre tchawende un serja kope jaake dureder. Un bistrau lengri doosh un lau lengro tchilatchepen krik. Koles, kai kamell mandar tchi te djinell, dau i phagi, un gar koles kokres, na-a ninna leskre tchawen un kolengre tchawen jaake rah har triin, star familje, jek pal i wawar, djiwan.”
Koi witsras pes o Mose sik ap i phub un mangas o Debles an:
“Miro rai, te dikeh tu latches ap mande, palle dja mentsa, ninna te djan kal menshe pal pengro shero. Biste mari doosh un ko tchilatcho koowa, hoi kram, un muk men pale tire menshe te well.”

O baro Dewel penas ap leste: Me dau tumen miro lab, un dau miro wast pre: Glan tumare jaka kamau me sorelo un baro koowa te krell, har an kek wawar them un pash kek wawar menshende kerdo was. Te dikenna i tsele menshe, kai trul tumende hi, hawo baro koowa me tumenge krau, palle darenn le un krenn bare jaka.
Me tradau kol Amorarja, Kanaanitarja, Hetarja, Perisarja, Hiwarja un Jebusarja dran lengro them un dau les tumende. Rikrenn kal laba, hoi me penau tumenge kau diwes!
Ma awenn mala kol menshenge an ko them, kai tumer wenna! Te wans lengre mala, nai anans le tumen miro dromestar tele.

Witsrenn kol pre-tchidde barra trujel, kai marenn un chatchrenn le viechen lengro debleske. Phagenn kol bare barra paash, hoi le leske pre-tchiwan! Un denn kol figuren tele, hoi sikrenn i debletsa Ashera.
Mangenn kek wawar Debles an! Me, o baro Dewel, kamau, te kamenn man kokres. Me kamau kokres te wap tumaro Dewel.

Ma awenn mala kol wawar menshenge an o them! Jon mangenn pengre deblen dran kasht un bar an, un marenn viechen lenge. Te wans tumer lengre mala, nai djals, te djan lentsa un chan ko chapen, hoi jon anan lengre deblen.
Tumer romedinerans tumare mursh tchawen lengre tchentsa. Un kolla djuwja anans tumare mursh tchawen o Debleskro dromestar tele, te mangenn le ninna kol deblen dran kasht un bar an.
Ma krenn tumen kek debles dran saster, sonakai un rup!

Ma bistrenn kol bare diwessa, kai chan kek maro dran shutlo jarro. An o tchon Abib chan efta diwessa kek maro dran shutlo jarro jaake har me tumenge penom! An ko tchon djan tumer win dran o them Egiptia.
Tumare phureder mursh tchawe hi mange, ninna hako phureder mursh ternepen, hoi i viechestar boldo wella, nai well i gurum, nai well i bakro.

Te hi o ternepen i burikakro ternepen, dess tu man leske i terno bakro. Kamenn tumer kowa gar, palle phagenn koi terni burika i meen! Tumare phureder mursh tchawe, ma marenn len! Kolenge denn mange i viecho, hoi mange marenn. Kek well an miro Debleskro kheer i wastentsa, kai tchi dren hi.
Shob diwessa krenn tumari budi! Ap o eftato diwes krenn tchi! Kowa te well jaake hako tsireske, ninna ko tsireske, kai tumer budrenn ap tumaro kotar phub un kai tumer anenn o djob dren.

Rikrenn bare diwessa mange dren ap ko tsiro, kai tumer o newo djob dren anenn! Un palle rikrenn bare diwessa dren pal i nijal, te anan i drake dren un lauter, hoi ap i ruka un ap tumari phub bares was.
Ap kol bare diwessa, triin kope an o bersh, hunte wenn i tsele mursha glan mande, lengro rajeste. Me hom o baro Dewel, o Dewel pral o Israel.

Me tradau i tsele wawar menshen glan tumende krik, un krau tumaro them bareder. Jaake well kek an tumaro them, te lell lo peske i kotar them ap ko tsiro, kai djan tumer triin kope an o bersh pash tumaro baro Debleste, te wenn khetne glan leste.

Te marenn tumer i vieches mange, anenn leskro rat gar glan mande khetne o shutlo mareha! Ko viecho, hoi tumer marenn mange ap o diwes, hoi kharella Passa, kolestar hunte atchell tchi pral o wawar diweske.
Hako bersh anenn o feteder halauterestar, hoi ap tumari phub bares was, an o Debleskro kheer! Job hi tumaro baro Dewel. Kerenn gar i terni busni an o thud lakro datar!
O baro Dewel penas o Moseske: “Tchin kal laba an i liil, te rikrenn tumen ap lende. Palle han mire menshe, un me rikrau miro lab, hoi dom miro wast pre un krau tuke un i Israelenge, hoi me penom.”

Star-desha diwessa un ratsja atchas o Mose ap i berga pash o baro Debleste. An kowa tsiro chas lo tchi un pijas lo tchi. Job tchinas kol deesh laba ap kol dui barra, – kol laba, kai penenna, hoi o Dewel peskre menshendar kamella.
Har o Mose kol dui barrentsa an o wast i berga Sinai tele djas, djinas lo gar, kai was leskro mui har o kham, har rakras lo o Debleha.
Un o Aron un kol wawar Israelitarja dikan, har leskro mui hi har o kham, un daran, te djan le pash leste.
Koi kharas o Mose len pash peste. Un o Aron un kol wawar pralstune djan pash leste. Un o Mose rakras lentsa.
Palle wan ninna kol wawar Israelitarja. Un o Mose penas lenge kol tsele laba, hoi o baro Dewel leske penas ap i berga Sinai, te rikrenn le len.
Har o Mose lenge lauter penas, tchiwas lo i diklo ap peskro mui.
Hako kopo har djas o Mose an o Debleskro kheer, te rakrell lo leha, las job ko diklo tele, bis te djals lo pale win dran o kheer.

Har was lo win, te penell lo ap i Israelitarja, hoi o baro Dewel leske penas, dikan jon, har leskro mui hi har o kham. Palle khatras o Mose peskro mui pale tel ko diklo, bis te djas lo pale dren, te rakrell lo o baro Debleha.
O Mose das i tsele Israelitarja khetne gole un penas ap lende: “O baro Dewel penas tumenge:
Shob diwessa krenn tumari budi! O eftato diwes hi o Debleskro diwes. Ap ko diwes krenn tchi! Ko diwes hi o baro Debleske. Koon ap kau diwes budrella, hunte merella.
Ap ko diwes krenn kek jag an tumare tsele khera!”
O Mose penas ap i tsele Israelitarja: O baro Dewel penell tumenge:
Hakeno, hoi les an o dji chatchella, te dell lo man pestar tchomone, kowa nai dell man: Sonakai, rup un lolo saster,
bakrengro bal, hoi blaueto, lolo un lolo har jag kerdo was, latcho laintikro than un busjengre balla.
Bakreskri ledertikre plachte, hoi lolo kerdo wan, wawar latche ledertikre plachte un kasht ko rukestar, hoi kharella Akatsia,
momelengro djet, kutch sungepaskro koowa, hoi tchiwenn le an o makepaskro djet, un ninna kutch sungepaskro koowa, hoi well chatchedo ap o sonakaskro bob,
ninna sawe barra, hoi kharenna Onyx un wawar kutch barra, te wenn le ap o rashajeskri damdira un ap o betcheskri possita kerdo.
Koon mank tumende haiwell shukar koowa te krell, kowa te well un budrell mentsa, te nai kras mer, hoi o baro Dewel penas menge:
ko Debleskro plachteno kheer peskre plachtentsa, peskre rikepangre, tchinle kashta, pandepangre kashta un pesse kashta ap herja;
ko sonakaskro mochton i kashtentsa hidjepaske, o pralstuno kotar koi pre, un ko kutch kotar than, hoi mank i dui iseme pandlo well;
koi chapaskri i kashtentsa hidjepaske un lauter, hoi pashel hi, ninna i Debleskre mare;
koi momelengri un lauter, hoi pashel hi, lakre momlia un lakro djet;
ko bob, kai ko sungepaskro koowa chatchedo wella un leskre hidjepaskre kashta; ko makepaskro djet; ko kutch sungepaskro koowa; koi plachta an o khereskro wudar;
koi sasterni chatchepaskri, kai vieche chatchedo wenna o Debleske, ninna koi netsa dran lolo saster, kol hidjepaskre kashta un lauter, hoi koi pashel hi; ko thopaskro tcharo un leskre herja;
kolla laintikre kotja un i pesse kashta ap herja, hoi trul i glanstuni platsa hi; koi plachta an o wudar glan i glanstuni platsa;
kol tikne sasterne kotja, hoi denn le an i phub, te rikrenn le i plachte soreles, kolla plachte hoi hi ap o kheer, ninna kolla, hoi hi trul i glanstuni platsa, un kol shelle, hoi hi kote an-pandlo;
o rashajengre kutch ripja, hoi o Aron un leskre tchawe an-riwenn, te budrenn le an o Debleskro kheer.
Pal kowa djan i tsele Israelitarja penge.

Halauter, kolengre djia chatchan, un kai kaman pendar tchomone te dell, wan un anan tchomone o baro Debleske, te well leske i plachteno kheer kerdo, kai i rashaja nai budrenn leske, un te nai krenn le ripja kolenge.
Mursha un djuwja anan pendar sonakaskro koowa: sonakangre subja, kanengre, gustria, werklia un wawar sonakangre koola o baro Debleske.

Kones kutch bakrengro bal his, hoi blaueto, lolo un lolo har jag kerdo was, kowa anas les pash o Moseste, ninna latcho laintikro than, busjengre balla, bakrengri ledertikre plachte, hoi lolo kerdo wan, un wawar latche ledertikre plachte.
Kones rup, lolo saster, akatstikro kasht his, anas les o baro Debleske o budepaske ap o Debleskro kheer.
I tsele djuwja, kai haiwan mishto thaba dran kutch bakrengro bal te krell, kran kowa un anan jaake thaba, hoi blaueto, lolo, un lolo har jag kerdo was, ninna latcho laintikro than.
Wawar djuwja, kai haiwan un kaman thaba te krell dran busjengro bal, kran kowa ninna.

Kol deesh-te-dui pralstune mursha, kai his i pralstune pral kol deesh-te-dui bare familje, kai wan o Israeleskre tchawendar, kolla anan kutch barra, hoi kharenna Onyx, un wawar kutch barra, te wenn le ap o rashajeskri damdira un ap o betcheskri possita kerdo.
Ninna anan le momelengro djet un ko koowa, hoi mishto sungella, te well lo chatchedo, ninna kutch sungepaskro koowa, hoi well an o makepaskro djet tchiddo.
Jaake anan i Israelitarja, mursha un djuwja, kolengre djia chatchan, bud koowa pendar, te well koi tseli budi kerdo, hoi o baro Dewel o Moseske penas.
O Mose penas ap o Israelitarja: “Shunenn, o baro Dewel rodas o Bezalel win. Leskro dad hi o Uri, un leskro papo hi o Hur, dran o kheer Juda.
O baro Dewel tchiwas peskro ducho an o Bezalel, un das les goswepen un wasta, hoi haiwenn mishto te budrell,
te nai krell lo shukar koowa dran sonakai, rup un lolo saster.
Ninna haiwell lo kutch barra te tchinell un an gustria te tchiwell. Ninna nai dell lo shukar koowa win tchurje dran kasht, jaake te nai krell lo hako shukar koowa.
O Dewel das les ninna o goswepen an o dji, te sikrell lo i wawaren, har te krenn le kai budi. Ko goswepen das o baro Dewel ninna o Oholiab. Koleskro dad hi o Ahisamach, dran o kheer Dan.

O baro Dewel das kol dujen, o Bezalel un o Oholiab, o goswepen, te haiwenn le mishto sonakaskro koowa te krell, ninna shukar plachte dran latcho laintikro than un dran kutch bakrengro bal, hoi blaueto, lolo un lolo har jag kerdo was. Ninna nai siwenn le shukar koowa an kol kotja than. Jaake nai krenn le haki budi, un haiwenn, an pengro shero glan-wi te dikell, har te krenn le lat.

O Bezalel, o Oholiab un kol wawar, kolen o baro Dewel o goswepen un wasta das, te haiwenn le mishto halauter te krell, hoi lo penas, kolla te krenn leske kanna i kheer un kol tsele koola, hoi koi dren hi.”
O Mose kharas o Bezalel un o Oholiab pash peste, ninna kol tsele wawaren, kai o baro Dewel goswepen an lengro dji das un wasta, te budrenn le mishto, un kai wan pendar, te krenn le koi budi.

Un o Mose das len ko tselo kutch koowa, hoi i Israelitarja anan, te krenn le o baro Debleske i kheer. Un hako diwes taissarlakro wan le pale te pale pash o Moseste un anan leske budeder kutch koowa pendar.
Koi mukan i tsele budepangre, kai ap o kheer budrenn, pengri budi tchiddo, djan pash o Mose
un penan: “Kol menshe anenn budeder, har men hunte well, te kras ko kheer, hoi o baro Dewel penas te kras.”
Koi mukas o Mose ap i tseli platsa wi-gole te dell: “Tumer mursha un djuwja, kek tumendar hunte anenn buder tchomone o Debleskro khereske!” Jaake anan i Israelitarja buder tchi.
Was budeder har doha anlo, te well i tseli budi kerdo, hoi hunte krenn le.

Jaake kran kol tsele budepangre, kai haiwan mishto shukar koowa te krell, o Debleskro kheer dran deesh pesse plachte. Kolla wan sido dran latcho sorelo laintikro than, kai ninna kutch bakrengro bal dren hi. Kowa his blaueto, lolo un lolo har jag. An kol plachte wan bolepangre dren sido an shukar wastengri budi.
Haki plachta his deesh-te-star metarja lengsto un dui metarja buchlo.
Pantch plachte siwan le khetne, un kol wawar pantch ninna.
Ap kol rigja, kai kol dui bare kotja khetne pandlo wenn, siwan le dorjengre gustria dran blaueto kutch bakrengro bal:
paash-sheel ap hako baro kotar, jaake te well jek dorjengri gustri wergel ko wawar.
Pale kran le paash-sheel sonakangre rikepangre. Kolentsa pandan le kol dui bare kotja khetne. Jaake was dran kol dui kotja jek kheer.
Un jon kran deesh-te-jek pesse plachte dran busjengre balla, te wenn le pral o kheer tchiddo.
Haki plachta his deesh-te-pantch metarja lengsto un dui metarja buchlo.
Pantch kolla plachte wan khetne sido, te was jek baro kotar. Un kolla wawar shob wan ninna khetne sido, te was i duito baro kotar.
Un jon kran paash-sheel dorjengre gustria ap hako baro kotar ap koi rig, kai kol dui bare kotja khetne pandlo wenna.
Ninna kran le paash-sheel sasterne rikepangre dran lolo saster, te wenn kol dui bare kotja kolentsa khetne pandlo.
Un jon kran jek baro kotar dran bakrengri ledertikre plachte, hoi le lolo kran, te tchiwenn le les pral o Debleskro plachteno kheer, un pral koleste i wawar kotar dran latche ledertikre plachte.
Un jon kran tchinle kashta dran o kasht ko rukestar, hoi kharella Akatsia, te wenn le pre tardo.
Hako tchinlo kasht his pantch metarja baro un 75 (efta-deesh-te-pantch) centimetarja buchlo.
Hako kashtes hi dui tikne gushte, kolentsa wenn i tchinle kashta khetne rikedo. Jaake kran le i tsele tchinle kashta o khereske.
Biish tchinle kashta kran le, te wenn le ap koi rig tardo, kai o kham pralstunes hi.
Un jon kran star-desha rupene herja tella, tel hako kasht dui herja, kai i gushte dren tchiddo wenna.
Ninna biish tchinle kashta kran le, te wenn le ap koi wawar rig o kherestar tardo, kote, kai o kham gar wella.
Tel kolende tchiwan le star-desha rupene herja, dui herja tel hako tchinlo kasht.
I palstuni rigjake, koi rig, kai o kham tele djal, wan shob tchinle kashta kerdo,
un dui wawar, hoi wenn jaake khetne tardo, te krenn le serwes un tchatches i ekka ap i palstuni rig o kherestar.
Kol kashta wenn tella un pral i gushtentsa khetne rikedo.
Jaake hi ochta tchinle kashta ap i palstuni rig un deesh-te-shob rupene herja: tel hako tchinlo kasht dui herja.
Un jon kran pandepangre kashta dran o kasht ko rukestar, hoi kharella Akatsia, te tchiwenn le pantch lendar ap kol tchinle kashta ap koi jek lengsti rig o kherestar,
pale pantch ap i tchinle kashta ap i wawar lengsti rig, un pale pantch ap i palstuni rig o kherestar kote, kai o kham tele djala.
Un jon kran ko mashkralstuno pandepaskro kasht, hoi djal mashkral ap i tchinle kashta jek rigjatar ap i wawar.
Un jon tchiwan sonakai trul i tchinle kashta. Ninna dran sonakai kran le lengre gustria, kai wenn i pandepangre kashta dren tchinlo. Un tchiwas ninna sonakai trul kolende.
Un jon kran i kotar latcho sorelo laintikro than, kai kutch bakrengro bal dren hi. Kowa hi blaueto, lolo un lolo har jag. An ko kotar than wan bolepangre dren sido an shukar wastengri budi.

Un jon tchinan star pesse kashta dran akatstikro kasht, te well ko kotar than kote pre pandlo. Trul kol pesse kashta tchiwan le sonakai, un kran star rupene herja tella. I rikepangre kran le dran sonakai.

Un jon kran i bari plachta, te well li an o wudar, kote kai jek dren djal an o kheer. Jon kran les an shukar wastengri budi dran latcho sorelo laintikro than, kai kutch bakrengro bal dren hi, hoi blaueto, lolo un lolo har jag kerdo was.

Ninna tchinan le pantch pesse kashta dran akatstikro kasht, te well koi plachta kote pre pandlo. Pralstunes trul kol pesse kashta was sonakai maklo, ninna trul kol shelle, hoi hidjrenn koi plachta. Koi pashel kran le rikepangre. Tel kol pantch pesse kashta kran le pantch herja dran lolo saster.
Un o Bezalel kras ko mochton dran akatstikro kasht, 125 (sheel-te-biish-te-pantch) centimetarja lengsto, un 75 (efta-desha-te-pantch) centimetarja buchlo un ninna jaake pral.
Dren un win tchiwas lo latcho sonakai pre, un kras i sonakaskro pandepen trujel.
Un job kras star sonakangre gustria un tchiwas len ap hake star herja, dui ap haki rig.
Ninna kras lo lengste kashta dran akatstikro kasht, tchiwas sonakai trul lende,
un tchiwas len an kol gustria, jaake te nai hidjrenn le ko mochton trujel.
Un job kras o pralstuno kotar, hoi tchakrell o mochton dran latcho sonakai. Kowa his 125 (sheel-te-biish-te-pantch) centimetarja lengsto un 75 (efta-desha-te-pantch) centimetarja buchlo.
Un job kras dui bolepangre, hakenes dran jek kotar sonakai, un tchiwas ko jekes glan ap o pralstuno kotar un ko wawares palla ap o pralstuno kotar.
Un kol bolepangre hadan pengre mussja pre un tchakran lentsa o pralstuno kotar. Un lengre shere dikan pen an. Un lengre jaka dikan tella ap o pralstuno kotar.
Un job kras koi chapaskri dran akatstikro kasht, jek metari lengsto, i paash metari buchlo un 75 (efta-desha-te-pantch) centimetarja pral,
un tchiwas latcho sonakai trul late. Ninna tchiwas lo i sonakaskro pandepen trul late.
Trul i chapaskri tchiwas lo i tikno kasht ap haki rig, hoi i wast buchlo hi. Un trul ko tikno kasht was ninna i sonakaskro pandepen.
Un job kras star sonakangre gustria un pandas len ap kol star herja,
tel ko tikno kasht, hoi djal trul i chapaskri, jaake te nai tchiwan le lengste kashta dren, te hidjrenn le koi chapaskri.
Un job tchinas kol lengste kashta dran akatstikro kasht, te nai hidjrenn le koi chapaskri, un tchiwas sonakai trul lende.
Un job kras ninna ko tselo koowa, hoi ap i chapaskri well, dran latcho sonakai: tchare un khore, an kolende i mool o Debleske dren anlo well.
Un job kras koi momelengri dran jek kotar latcho sonakai: Lakro piro un ko mashkralstuno kotar un kol tchare. Ap kolende hi blume, sawe, hoi pandlo hi un sawe, hoi pre hi.
Shob mussja djan dran i momelengri win, triin ap jek rig un triin ap i wawar rig.
Ap haki mussi hi triin tchare, hoi win dikenn har blume, sawe, hoi pandlo hi un sawe, hoi pre hi.
Ap ko mashkralstuno kotar hi star tchare, hoi win dikenn har i blume, sawe, hoi hi pandlo, un sawe, hoi hi pre.
Hako kopo hi jek bluma, hoi pandlo hi, tel dui kol shob mussjendar, hoi dran o mashkralstuno kotar win djan.
Un kol blume un i mussja hi leha khetne kerdo dran jek kotar latcho sonakai.
Un ninna dran latcho sonakai kras lo kol efta momlia, lengre tchinepangre, kolentsa i dorja an i momlia tele tchinlo wenna, un i tchare, kai i momelengri tchik dren wella.
Les hunte was jek zentnari latcho sonakai, te krell lo kai momelengri un lakro tselo koowa.

Job kras ninna i bob dran akatstikro kasht. Koi pre well sungepaskro koowa chatchedo. Ko bob his i paash metari lengsto un ninna jaake buchlo un jek metari pral. Ap hake star rigja, kote, kai le khetne wenna, was i kotar win, hoi win dikella har i shing.
Job tchiwas latcho sonakai trul o bob, pral pre un ninna ap i star rigja un ap i shinga. Un tchiwas i sonakaskro pandepen trul o bob.
Ap i dui rigja tchiwas lo dui sonakangre gustria tel o sonakaskro pandepen, te nai tchiwenn le lengste kashta dren un jaake te hidjrenn le les.
Un kol lengste kashta kras lo dran akatstikro kasht, un tchiwas sonakai trul lende.
Un job kras o makepaskro djet, koleha jon o Debleskro koowa dren makenn. Ninna kras lo ko kutch sungepaskro koowa, hoi chatchedo well. Kowa lauter kras job jaake har kolla, kai kowa mishto haiwenna.

Un job kras i sasterni chatchepaskri, kai wenna vieche o Debleske chatchedo. Job kras lat dran akatstikro kasht, dui-te-paash metarja lengsto un ninna jaake buchlo un jek-te-paash metari pral. Pral i tseli chatchepaskri was lolo saster dino. Ap haki pralstuni ekka was i shing win. Kol shinga wan kerdo dran jek kotar kasht har i chatchepaskri.

Un job kras kol tsele koola dran lolo saster, kolentsa budrenn le ap i sasterni chatchepaskri: i pirja, an kolende i jagakri tchik dren wella, bare roja, tchare, kai o rat dren wella, massengre forshette, jagakre tchare.
Un job kras i netsa dran lolo saster, hoi was tella jaake an i sasterni chatchepaskri tchiddo, te djal li paash pre har i sasterni chatchepaskri.
Ap lakre star rigja, kote, kai i rigja khetne wenna, tchiwas lo star gustria dran lolo saster, te wenn an lende lengste kashta tchiddo.
Kolla kras lo dran akatstikro kasht, tchiwas lolo saster trul lende,
un tchiwas len an i gustria jaake, te nai hidjrenn le koi sasterni chatchepaskri. An late his tchi dren.

Un job kras o thopaskro tcharo dran lolo saster un tchiwas les ap herja, hoi ninna dran lolo saster hi. Ko lolo saster las lo dran kol blendarja, hoi dan les kol djuwja, kai pash o wudar glan o Debleskro plachteno kheer pengri budi kran.

Un jon kran kol laintikre kotja dran latcho sorelo than, hoi wenn trul koi platsa pandlo, hoi hi glan o Debleskro kheer. Ninna kran le kol pesse kashta, mank kolende kol laintikre kotja pandlo wenna. Ap koi rig, kai o kham pralstunes hi, hi koi platsa paash-sheel metarja baro. Kate rikrenn biish pesse kashta kol laintikre kotja. Kal pesse kashta wenn tardo ap biish herja dran lolo saster. I rikepangre un kol shelle, hoi rikrenn i laintikre kotja, kran le dran rup.

Koi rig, kai o kham gar wella, hi jaake baro har koi rig, kai o kham pralstunes hi: paash-sheel metarja lengsto. Ninna kate rikrenn biish pesse kashta kol laintikre kotja. Kal pesse kashta wenn tardo ap biish herja dran lolo saster. I rikepangre un kol shelle, hoi rikrenn i laintikre kotja, kran le dran rup.

Ap i rig, kai o kham tele djal, hi koi platsa biish-te-pantch metarja buchlo. Kote wenn i laintikre kotja ap deesh pesse kashta rikedo, hoi ap deesh herja tardo wenn. I rikepangre un i shelle, hoi rikrenn i laintikre kotja, kran le dran rup.
Ninna glan o kheer, ap i rig, kai o kham pre djala, hi i platsa biish-te-pantch metarja buchlo.

Mashkral hi i wudar. Ap koi jek rig hi efta-te-paash metarja: kote wenn triin pesse kashta tardo ap triin herja. Ap koi wawar rig hi ninna efta-te-paash metarja: Kote wenn ninna triin pesse kashta tardo ap triin herja.
I tsele laintikre kotja his dran latcho sorelo laintikro than.
Un i herja tel kol pesse kashta his dran lolo saster. Un i rikepangre un shelle, hoi rikrenn i laintikre kotja, his dran rup. Un i pesse kashta, len his shere, kai rup trul tchiddo his.

Un koi bari plachta, hoi well pandlo an o wudar glan i glanstuni platsa kran le an shukar wastengri budi dran latcho sorelo laintikro than, kai ninna kutch bakrengro bal dren hi. Kowa his blaueto un lolo un lolo har jag. Koi plachta his deesh metarja lengsto un dui-te-paash metarja baro, jaake baro har ninna i wawar laintikre kotja hi, hoi trul i platsa pandlo wenn.
Koi pashel kran le star pesse kashta un star herja dran lolo saster, ninna rupene rikepangre un rupene shelle, hoi rikrenn koi bari plachta. I pesse kashta, len hi shere, kai rup trul tchiddo his.
Ninna kol tikne kotja his dran lolo saster, hoi denn le an i phub, te well o plachteno kheer un i plachte trul i platsa soreles rikedo.

O Bezalel, – leskro dad his o Uri un leskro papo o Hur, dran o kheer Juda – job kras koi tseli budi jaake, har o baro Dewel kowa o Moseske penas. Un o Oholiab, – leskro dad hi o Ahisamach, dran o kheer Dan – job was leske pash o wast. Un peskre wastentsa kras lo shukar koowa dran lolo saster, sonakai, rup un kasht. Ninna haiwas lo mishto latcho laintikro than te krell, un siwas shukar koowa dran kutch bakrengro bal dren, hoi blaueto, lolo un lolo har jag his. O Mose penas ap o Itamar, ko tchawo o rashajestar Aron: “Pen ap i Levitarja, te tchinenn le lauter an i liil, hoi i Israelitarja khetne tchiwan, te krenn le o Debleskro kheer, – ko kheer, kai o Debleskre deesh laba dren hi.”
Ko sonakai, hoi jon pendar dan, his budeder har 29 (biish-te-enja) zentnarja. Jek zentnari his jaake bud har jek zentnari an o Debleskro kheer pharo his.
Ko rup, hoi was khetne, har an i liil tchinlo was, har bud mursha koi hi, ko rup his budeder har 100 (sheel) zentnarja. Jek zentnari his jaake bud har jek zentnari an o Debleskro kheer pharo his.

I tsele mursha, kai phureder his har biish bersha, his 603.550 (shob-sheel-te-triin-serja-pantch-sheel-te-pantch-desha) mursha. Hakeno lendar das i paash rupeno kotar. Jek paash kotar rup his jaake bud har jek paash kotar rup an o Debleskro kheer pharo his.
Sheel zentnarja rup lan le un kran lestar kol sheel herja, ap kolende i tchinle kashta tardo wenna, ninna kolla, kai rikrenn o wudar dran o kutch kotar than. Haki rupeni heri his jek zentnari pharo.
Ko rup, hoi pral atchas, his jaake deesh-te-triin kilogramme. Kolestar kran le i gustria un i shelle, hoi i laintikre kotja rikrenna. Ninna tchiwan le les trul i shere kol pesse kashtendar.
Ko lolo saster, hoi i menshe pendar dan, his budeder har efta-desha zentnarja.

Kolestar mukas o Bezalel kol herja te krell, ap kolende i pesse kashta tardo hi, hoi hi serwes un tchatches pash o wudar. Ninna kran le kolestar koi sasterni chatchepaskri un koi sasterni netsa, hoi koi pashel hi, un i tsele koola, kolentsa i rashaja budrenna.

Dran o lolo saster kran le ninna i herja, ap kolende i pesse kashta trul i glanstuni platsa tardo wenn, ninna i herja tel i pesse kashta pash o wudar glan i glanstuni platsa, un ninna i tsele tikne kotja, hoi wenn an i phub dino, te rikrenn le soreles ko kheer un kol laintikre kotja trul i glanstuni platsa.

Un jon kran shukar rashajengre ripja dran kutch bakrengro bal, hoi blaueto, lolo un lolo har jag kerdo was, te riwell len o Aron pash peskri budi an o Debleskro kheer. Jon kran kal ripja jaake har o baro Dewel o Moseske penas, te krenn le len.
O rashajeskri damdira kran le dran latcho sorelo laintikro than, kai sonakai dren sido was, ninna kutch bakrengro bal, hoi blaueto, lolo un lolo har jag kerdo was.

Jon dan sonakangre kotja khetne, te wenn le sano, un tchinan len an tikne thaba, te nai siwenn le len an o latcho laintikro than un mank o bakrengro bal, hoi blaueto, lolo un lolo har jag kerdo was. Kowa was an latcho wastengri budi kerdo.
Palle lan le dui kotja than un siwan len ap i damdira kote, kai i phika hi. Un i damdira was khetne pandlo.

Ko pereskro pandepen was jaake kerdo har i damdira: dran latcho sorelo laintikro than, kai sonakai dren sido was, ninna kutch bakrengro bal, hoi blaueto, lolo un lolo har jag kerdo was. I damdira un lakro pandepen his dran jek kotar than. Jon kran kowa jaake, har o baro Dewel o Moseske penas.

Un jon lan dui kutch barra, hoi kharenna Onyx, un tchiwan len an sonakangre gustria. Un kolla mursha, kai haiwenn mishto laba an barra te tchinell, tchinan i laba kol Israeleskre tchawendar an i barra dren.
Un jon kran kol barra ap i damdira pre, kote, kai i phika hi, te bistrell o baro Dewel gar i Israelitarja. Jon kran kowa jaake har o baro Dewel o Moseske penas.

Un jon kran i shukar betcheskri possita jaake har i damdira: dran latcho sorelo laintikro than, kai sonakangre thaba dren sido wan, ninna kutch bakrengro bal, hoi blaueto, lolo un lolo har jag kerdo was.
Koi possita his jaake baro har buchlo un was dui kope khetne lino. Haki rig his biish-te-pantch centimetarja baro.
Un jon kran deesh-te-dui kutch barra ap koi possita pre: hako kopo triin barra tel i wawar: pralstunes kol barra, hoi kharenna Rubin, Topas un Smaragdo.
Tel kolende kol barra, hoi kharenna Karfunkel, Safiro, un Diamanto.
Tel kolende kol barra, hoi kharenna Hiazint, Achat, un Ametist.
Telstunes kol barra, hoi kharenna: Krisolit, Onyx un Jaspis. Hako bar his tchiddo an i sonakaskri gustri.
An kol barra wan i laba dre-tchinlo kol deesh-te-dui Israeleskre tchawendar, kolendar i deesh-te-dui bare familje wenn. Ap hako bar his jek lab.
Ap i betcheskri possita kran le tikne dorja dran latcho sonakai, hoi khetne lino his har i lengste balla i djuwjatar.
Ninna kran le dui tikne sonakangre gustria un dui wawar sonakangre gustria. Kolen siwan le serwes un tchatches ap i pralstuni rig ap i possita.
Un tchiwan kol dui sonakangre dorja jek rigjah an kol dui sonakangre gustria ap i possita.
Koi wawar rig tchiwan le an kol tikne sonakangre gustria, hoi ap kol kotja hi, hoi glanstunes ap i damdira sido hi, kote, kai i phika hi.
Palle kran le dui wawar sonakangre gustria un siwan len dren an i possita ap i telstuni rig, kote, kai i possita ap i damdira sido hi.

Un palle kran le dui wawar sonakangre gustria un tchiwan len ap kol dui kotja, hoi kote ap i damdira sido hi, kai i phika hi. Un siwan len ap i glanstuni rig kote, kai kol kotja khetne lino hi, pral o pereskro pandepen, hoi rikrell i damdira khetne.

Palle tchiwan le i dori dran blaueto kutch bakrengro bal an kol dui gustria, hoi ap o betcheskri possita hi, un pandan lat jaake ap i gustria ap i damdira, te hi li soreles rikedo pral o pereskro pandepen, hoi rikrell i damdira khetne. Kowa kran le jaake har o baro Dewel o Moseske penas.
Koi pashel kran le i baja, hoi riwell o rashai tel i damdira. Un koi tseli baja kran le dran blaueto kutch bakrengro bal.
Pral mukan le lat pre, te well nai o shero win. Trul i meen siwan le lat soreles jaake har pash i ledertikri baja, te nai djal li gar paash.
Telstunes trul i tseli baja kran le tikne phabja dran latche sorele laintikre thaba un kutch bakrengro bal, hoi blaueto, lolo un lolo har jag kerdo was.
Ninna kran le tikne bashepangre dran latcho sonakai un tchiwan len jaake mank i phabja,
te well jek phabi, palle jek bashepaskri, palle jek phabi, un jaake trul i tseli baja. Kai baja riwell o rashai te djal lo an o Debleskro kheer. Lauter kran le jaake har o baro Dewel o Moseske penas.
O Aroneske un leskre tchawenge kran le ninna i gada, o shereskro pandepen, i rashajengre stadja, un i telstune cholopja dran latcho sorelo laintikro than.

Un o Aroneske kran le i pereskro pandepen an shukar wastengri budi dran latcho sorelo laintikro than, kai ninna kutch bakrengro bal dren hi, hoi blaueto, lolo un lolo har jag kerdo was. Lauter kran le jaake har o baro Dewel o Moseske penas.

An i tikno kotar latcho sonakai tchinan le kol laba: “Kowa hi o baro Debleske”, un pandan ko kotar sonakai ap i dori dran blaueto kutch bakrengro bal glan ap o Aroneskro shereskro pandepen. Kowa was kerdo jaake har o baro Dewel o Moseske penas.
Jaake was koi tseli budi kerdo: kol tsele kotja o Debleskro plachteno khereske, un lauter, hoi koi pashel hi. I Israelitarja kran lauter jaake, har o baro Dewel o Moseske penas.
Un jon anan lauter pash o Moseste: kol plachte o Debleskro khereske un leskre tsele koola: rikepangre, tchinle kashta, pandepangre kashta, un pesse kashta ap herja;
kol plachte, hoi tchakrenn o kheer: ko kotar dran bakrengri ledertikre plachte, hoi le lolo kran un ko wawar kotar dran latche ledertikre plachte. Ninna anan le ko kutch kotar than o wudareske;
ko mochton, kai o Debleskre deesh laba dren hi, un leskre hidjepaskre kashta, un o pralstuno kotar, hoi tchakrell o mochton un hoi sikrella, kai o Dewel peskre menshenge latcho hi;
koi chapaskri un lauter, hoi pashel hi, ninna i Debleskre mare;
koi momelengri dran latcho sonakai un lakre momlia un lauter, hoi pashel hi, un lakro djet;
ko sonakaskro bob, kai o sungepaskro koowa chatchedo wella; ko makepaskro djet; ko sungepaskro koowa, hoi chatchedo well; koi bari plachta glan o khereskro wudar;
koi sasterni chatchepaskri, kai vieche chatchedo wenna o Debleske, koi sasterni netsa, lakre hidjepaskre kashta un i tsele koola, hoi koi pashel hi; ko thopaskro tcharo un leskre herja;

kolla laintikre kotja un pesse kashta ap herja, hoi trul i glanstuni platsa hi; un koi plachta o wudareske ap i glanstuni platsa; kol tikne sasterne kotja, hoi denn le an i phub, te rikrenn le o plachteno kheer soreles, un kol shelle, hoi hi kote an-pandlo; ninna kol tsele koola, hoi kolen hunte well, kai budrenn an o Debleskro plachteno kheer.
Ninna anan le i rashajengre kutch ripja, hoi o Aron un leskre tchawe an-riwenn, te budrenn le an o Debleskro kheer.
Jaake har o baro Dewel o Moseske penas, kran i Israelitarja i tseli budi.
Un o Mose dikas kowa lauter un haiwas, jon kran lauter jaake har o baro Dewel penas. Un job rakras o Debleskri bacht pral lende win.
O baro Dewel rakras o Moseha un penas:
Tchip o Debleskro plachteno kheer pre ap o ersto diwes an o ersto tchon.
Un tchip ko mochton dren, kai o Debleskre deesh laba dren hi. Glan o mochton pande ko kutch kotar than pre!
An ninna koi chapaskri dren un tchip i Debleskre mare pre! Ninna koi momelengri tchip an o kheer, un tchip i momlia pre.
Glan o mochton, kai o Debleskre deesh laba dren hi, tchip o sonakaskro bob, kai sungepaskro koowa chatchedo wella! Un an o wudar pande koi bari plachta pre!
Glan o Debleskro plachteno kheer tchip i sasterni chatchepaskri, kai i vieche o Debleske chatchedo wenna.
Mank o kheer un i sasterni chatchepaskri tchip o thopaskro tcharo un tchore pani dren!
Trul i platsa glan o kheer tchip i pesse kashta pre, un pande kol laintikre kotja mank lende! Un an o wudar glan i platsa pande koi bari plachta pre!
Le ko makepaskro djet un mak leha o kheer un lauter, hoi koi dren hi, te well lo o Debleske!
Mak ninna i sasterni chatchepaskri un lakre tsele koola, te well li o Debleske un leske kokres!
Mak ninna o thopaskro tcharo un kol herja, ap kolende o tcharo tardo hi, te well lauter o Debleske.
Pen o Aroneske un leskre tchawenge, te wenn le glan o Debleskro plachteno kheer, un thob len!
Rib o Aroneske o rashajeskre ripja an, mak les o djeteha, te well lo miro rashai.
An ninna leskre tchawe koi un rib lenge i rashajengre gada an!
Un mak len o djeteha jaake har makal lengro dad, te wenn le mire rashaja. Jon un lengre tchawe pal lende te wenn le maklo o djeteha, te wenn le mire rashaja hako tsireske.
O Mose kras lauter har o baro Dewel leske penas.
Jaake was o Debleskro kheer pre tardo an o duito bersh ap o ersto diwes an o ersto tchon.
O Mose tchiwas i tchinle kashta ap herja un pandas len i pandepangre kashtentsa khetne. Palle wan i pesse kashta pre tardo.
Un koi pral tchiwas lo kol dui ledertikre plachte, hoi tchakrenn o kheer. Lauter kras lo jaake har o baro Dewel leske penas.

Un job las i barra, kai o Debleskre deesh laba dren tchinlo hi, un tchiwas len an o sonakaskro mochton, un tchiwas i hidjepaskre kashta an i gustria ap o mochton. Un pral ap o sonakaskro mochton tchiwas lo o pralstuno kotar, hoi sikrella, kai o baro Dewel peskre menshenge latcho hi.
Un job anas o mochton an o kheer un pandas ko kutch kotar than glan o mochton, te well lo gar diklo. Job kras kowa jaake, har o baro Dewel leske penas.
Un job anas i chapaskri an o kheer un tchiwas lat glan o kutch kotar than ap i serwi rig,
un tchiwas o Debleskre mare pre glan o baro Debleste. Job kras kowa jaake har o baro Dewel leske penas.
Ap i tchatchi rig an o kheer, wergel i chapaskri, tchiwas lo i momelengri,
un tchiwas i momlia pre jaake har o baro Dewel leske penas.
Glan o kutch kotar than tchiwas lo o sonakaskro bob,
un chatchras ap leste kutch sungepaskro koowa. Job kras les jaake har o baro Dewel leske penas.
An o khereskro wudar pandas lo koi bari plachta.
Win glan o khereskro wudar tchiwas lo i sasterni chatchepaskri, un ap leste chatchras lo viechen un chapen o baro Debleske, jaake har job leske penas.
Mank o kheer un i sasterni chatchepaskri tchiwas lo o thopaskro tcharo un tchoras pani dren thopaske.
Un o Mose, o Aron un leskre tchawe thowan pengre wasta un herja koi dren.
Jon hunte thowenn pen hako kopo, kai djan le an o Debleskro plachteno kheer un pash i sasterni chatchepaskri. Jaake penas kowa o baro Dewel o Moseske.

Un trul o kheer un i sasterni chatchepaskri tchiwas lo i pesse kashta pre un pandas kol laintikre kotja mank lende, te was i platsa. Un an o wudar glan i platsa tchiwas lo koi bari plachta. Jaake kras o Mose koi tseli budi.
Koi was i wolka ap o Debleskro plachteno kheer. Un o kheer was pherdo railepen o baro Deblestar.
Un har i wolka pral o kheer atchas un o kheer pherdo railepen o baro Deblestar his, nai djas o Mose gar dren.
Hako kopo, kai hadas pes i wolka, djan i Israelitarja dureder jaake rah, har his le ap pengro drom an o mulo tato them.
Te atchas i wolka pral o Debleskro kheer, atchan le kote un djan gar dureder jaake rah bis te hadas li pes.
Un i tsele Israelitarja dikan koi wolka. Ap o diwes his li pral o Debleskro kheer, ap i rat his li pherdi jag jaake rah har i Israelitarja ap o drom his.
Un o baro Dewel das o Moses gole, un rakras dran o Debleskro plachteno kheer win un penas:
Rake i Israelentsa un pen lenge: Te kamell i mensho tumendar i vieches o baro Debleske te anell, palle lell lo jekes peskre grumjendar, peskre bakrendar oder peskre busjendar.

Te kamell lo leske i grumni te anell, te well li leske tseles chatchedo, palle hunte lell lo i murshkani grumni, hoi gar nasselo hi. Un job anell lat glan o wudar o Debleskro plachteno kherestar, te dikell o baro Dewel latches ap leste.
Un o mursh tchiwell peskro wast ap o shero ko viechestar, te dikell o Dewel latches ap leste un lell leskri doosh, hoi lo ap peste las, krik.

Palle marell lo kai grumni glan o baro Debleskro kheer. Un kol rashaja dran o kheer Aron lenn o rat un tchorenn les trul o Debleskri chatchepaskri ap leskre star rigja. Kai chatchepaskri hi tardo glan o wudar o plachteno kherestar.
Un ko mursh, kai anas ko vieches, tserdell leske i hauta tele un tchinell les an kotja.
Un i rashaja dran o kheer Aron krenn i jag ap i chatchepaskri un tchiwenn kasht ap koi jag,
palle tchiwenn le kol kotja mass ap kau kasht, ninna o shero un o thulepen.

I buke un i herja hunte wan thodo. Kowa krell ko mursh, kai anas ko vieches. Un o rashai mukell halauter ap i chatchepaskri pre te chatchrell. Jaake hunte well i viecho anlo glan o Debleste, hoi well leske tseles chatchedo. Un o latcho sungepen, hoi well win, sungell mishto o baro Debleske.
Te kamell jek i bakro oder i busni o baro Debleske te anell, te well ko viecho tseles leske chatchedo, palle anell lo i murshkano viecho, hoi gar nasselo hi.

Un job marell les glan o baro Debleste pash koi chatchepaskri, ap koi rig, kai norden hi. Un i rashaja dran o kheer Aron lenn o rat un tchorenn les trul o Debleskri chatchepaskri ap leskre star rigja.

Un ko mursh tchinell les an kotja, thowell i buke un i herja o panjeha. Un o rashai tchiwell kol kotja mass, ninna o shero un o thulepen ap o kasht pral koi jag, hoi ap i chatchepaskri hi. Un mukell halauter pre te chatchrell. Jaake hunte well i viecho anlo glan o Debleste, hoi well leske tseles chatchedo. Un o latcho sungepen, hoi well win, sungell mishto o baro Debleske.
Te kamell jek i tchirklo o baro Debleske te anell, te well ko tchirklo tseles leske chatchedo, palle anell lo i diwji tauba oder i wawar tauba.
Un o rashai anell koi tauba pash i chatchepaskri un phagell lake o shero tele, chatchrell o shero ap i chatchepaskri, un mukell o tchirkleskro rat win ratell ap i rig fun i chatchepaskri.
Leskri meen un kowa, hoi an late hi, witsrell lo win ap i jagakri tchik, hoi pash o chatchepaskri tchiddo hi ap koi rig, kai o kham pre djal.

Palle taprell o rashai o tchirkleskre mussja un tserdell o tchirkles pre, un chatchrell les ap i kasht pral i jag, hoi ap i chatchepaskri hi. Jaake hunte well i tchirklo anlo glan o Debleste, hoi well leske tseles chatchedo. Un o latcho sungepen, hoi well win, sungell mishto o baro Debleske.
Te kamell jek i chapen dran djob glan o baro Debleste te anell, palle anell lo latcho jarro un tchorell djet pral wergel un tchiwell sungepaskro koowa koi pral.

Un job anell kowa pash i rashajende dran o kheer Aron. Jek lendar lell i wast pherdo jarro o djeteha un ko tselo sungepaskro koowa, un mukell kowa ap i chatchepaskri te chatchrell. Kowa sikrell, kai ko tselo chapen, hoi anlo was, o Debleske hi. Un o latcho sungepen, hoi well win, sungell mishto o baro Debleske.
Kowa, hoi o jarrestar o djeteha pral atchell, hi o Aroneske un leskre tchawenge. Kowa hi i Debleskro chapen un hi i rashajenge kokres.

Te kameh i chapen glan o baro Debleste te anell, hoi peklo hi an i bob, palle an tchomone, kai kek shutlo jarro dren hi, nai wenn merklia dran latcho jarro khetne kerdo djeteha, nai wenn sane mare, hoi djet pral maklo well.
Te kameh i merkli te anell, hoi peklo hi ap i sasterno tcharo, palle le jarro, kai kek shutlo jarro dren hi, un hoi kerdo hi o djeteha.
Tu phagess koi merkli an kotja un tchoress djet pral. Jaake hunte well i chapen dran djob anlo glan o Debleste.
Te kameh i chapen glan o baro Debleste te anell, hoi hi keredo an i piri, palle kre les dran latcho jarro, kerdo o djeteha.
un an kowa glan o baro Debleste, un de les o rashajeste. Un kowa hidjrell les glan o Debleskri chatchepaskri.

Un o rashai lell tchomone lestar un chatchrell les ap i chatchepaskri. Kowa sikrell, kai ko tselo chapen, hoi anlo was, o Debleske hi. Un o latcho sungepen, hoi well win, sungell mishto o baro Debleske.
Kowa, hoi pral atchell, hi o Aroneske un leskre tchawenge. Kowa hi i Debleskro chapen, un hi i rashajenge kokres.
Ko tselo chapen dran djob, hoi jek o baro Debleske anell, an koleste hunte well kek shutlo jarro. Tumer hunte denn kek shutlo jarro, witar kek gwin an ko chapen, hoi chatchrenn o baro Debleske.

Ap ko tsiro, kai anenn o newo djob o baro Debleske, nai anenn tumer shutlo jarro un gwin, – ap leskri chatchepaskri nai chatchrenn kowa gar. Kowa hi kek koowa, hoi chatchedo well, te sungell lo latches o Debleske.

Ko tselo chapen, hoi tu o baro Debleske aneh, hunte well londo. Ko loon hi i sikepen, kai kowa, hoi o Dewel tumentsa win kras, hako tsiro atchell. Doleske aneh leske kek chapen dran djob, witar kek viechen, kai kek loon pashel kerdo was.
Te kameh tu tiro newo djob glan o baro Debleste te anell, palle le ko djob un peke les pral i jag, un kre les tikno un an les glan o Debleste!
Tchore djet koi pre un tchip sungepaskro koowa pre. Jaake hunte well i chapen dran djob, hoi glan o baro Debleste anlo well.
O rashai lell i kotar kol djobendar un djetestar tele, un chatchrell kowa khetne ko tselo sungepaskro koowa. Kowa hi i sikepen, kai ko tselo djob, hoi anlo was, o baro Debleske hi.
Te kamell jek o baro Debleske i grumjat te anell, hoi chan i menshe khetne glan leste, palle nai well ko viecho i mursh grumni har ninna i djuwel grumni. Kau viecho hunte well gar nasselo.

Job tchiwell peskro wast ap o viecheskro shero un marell les glan o wudar o Debleskro plachteno kherestar. Un i rashaja dran o kheer Aron lenn o rat un tchorenn les trul o Debleskri chatchepaskri ap leskre star rigja.
I feteder kotja o viechestar wenn chatchedo o baro Debleske. Kal kotja hi: o thulepen, hoi ap un pral i buke hi,
kol dui niere un ko thulepen, hoi ap lende hi, ninna ko thullo kotar, hoi ap i lebra hi. Pash i niere hunte well lo tele tchinlo.

Un i rashaja dran o kheer Aron chatchrenn kowa lauter ap o Debleskri chatchepaskri, ap ko kasht, hoi pral i jag hi. Jon chatchrenn kowa khetne ko wawar viecheha, hoi well o Debleske tseles chatchedo. Un o sungepen, hoi well win, sungell mishto o baro Debleske.

Te kamell jek o baro Debleske i bakro oder i busni te anell, hoi chan i menshe khetne glan leste, palle nai well ko viecho i murshengro viecho har ninna i djuwjengro viecho. Kau viecho hunte well sasto.
Te kamell lo i bakro te anell glan o baro Debleste,
palle tchiwell job peskro wast ap leskro shero un marell les glan o Debleskro plachteno kheer. Un i rashaja lenn o rat un tchorenn les trul o Debleskri chatchepaskri win.
I feteder kotja o viechestar wenn chatchedo o baro Debleske. Kal kotja hi: o thulepen, i thulli pori, tele tchinlo pash o palstuno kokalo, ninna ko thulepen ap un pral i buke,
kol dui niere, un ko thulepen, hoi ap lende hi, ninna ko thullo kotar ap i lebra. Pash i niere hunte well lo tele tchinlo.
Un o rashai chatchrell kowa lauter ap o Debleskri chatchepaskri. Kolla hi kol kotja o viechestar, hoi o baro Debleske hi.
Te kamell lo i busni te anell glan o baro Debleste,
palle tchiwell job peskro wast ap lakro shero un marell lat glan o Debleskro plachteno kheer. Un i rashaja lenn o rat un tchorenn les trul o Debleskri chatchepaskri ap leskre star rigja.
I feteder kotja o viechestar wenn chatchedo o baro Debleske. Kal kotja hi: o thulepen, hoi ap un pral i buke hi,
kol dui niere, un ko thulepen, hoi ap lende hi, ninna ko thullo kotar ap i lebra. Pash i niere hunte well lo tele tchinlo.

Un o rashai chatchrell kowa lauter ap o Debleskri chatchepaskri. Kolla hi kol kotja o viechestar, hoi o baro Debleske hi. Un o sungepen, hoi well win, sungell leske mishto. O tselo thulepen hi o baro Debleske.
Kek tumendar hunte chal o thulepen un o rat. Ap kowa hunte rikrenn tumen un tumare tchawe kanna un hako tsiro, kai tumer ninna djiwenna.
O baro Dewel rakras ap o Mose un penas:
Rake i Israelentsa un pen lenge: Te kras jek tchomone, hoi hunte krals lo gar, anas lo doosh ap peste, ninna te djinas job gar, te penas o baro Dewel: ‘Ma kre kowa!’

Te hi kowa o pralstuno rashai, kai rikras pes gar ap o Debleskro lab, un anas jaake doosh ap i tsele Israelitarjen, palle lell lo i terno gurum, hoi gar nasselo hi, un anell les o baro Debleske, te well leskri doosh, hoi lo ap peste anas, krik lino.
Un job anell ko gurum glan o baro Debleste, pash o wudar glan o Debleskro kheer, un tchiwell peskro wast ap o viecheskro shero un marell les kote glan o baro Debleste.
Un o pralstuno rashai lell o ratestar un hidjrell les an o plachteno kheer.
Job tchiwell peskro gushto an ko rat, un witsrell efta kope ko ratestar glan o laintikro kotar than, hoi hi glan o Debleskri kutch isema.

Ninna makell lo ko ratestar ap i shinga, hoi ap i star ekke o bobestar hi, kai o sungepaskro koowa chatchedo well. Ko bob hi tardo an o Debleskro plachteno kheer.
