O tselo wawar rat tchorell lo win tella pash koi chatchepaskri, kai i vieche chatchedo wenna. Koi chatchepaskri hi tardo win glan o wudar o Debleskro plachteno kherestar.
Palle tchinell lo o tselo thulepen dran ko viecho win: ko thulepen hoi ap un pral i buke hi,
kol dui niere un ko thulepen, hoi ap lende hi, ninna ko thullo kotar, hoi ap i lebra hi. Pash i niere hunte tchinell lo les tele.
Kawa well jaake kerdo har kowa kerdo well pash ko viecheste, hoi jek glan o Debleste anell, te chan le les khetne. Un ko rashai chatchrell kal kotja ap o Debleskri chatchepaskri.
Kol tsele wawar kotja ko gurumestar, leskri hauta, leskro tselo mass, leskro shero, leskre herja, leskre buke un hoi koi dren hi,
kowa lauter hidjrell lo win, krik dran koi platsa, kai i menshe hi. Un anell kowa ap i djudji platsa, kote kai i jagakri tchik win tchoredo well. Kote chatchrell lo lauter an i jag dran kasht.
Te kran i tsele Israelitarja tchomone, hoi gar tchatcho his glan o Debleskre jaka, anan le doosh ap pende, ninna te djinan le gar, te penas o baro Dewel, te krenn le kowa gar.

Te haiwenn le pal i tsiro, kai kowa, hoi jon kran, gar tchatcho his glan o Debleskre jaka, palle hunte anenn le i terno gurum o baro Debleske, te well lengri doosh krik lino. Jon hunte anenn les glan o wudar o Debleskro plachteno kherestar.
Un i phureder lendar tchiwenn pengre wasta ap o viecheskro shero un marenn les kote glan o baro Debleste.
Un o pralstuno rashai lell o ratestar un hidjrell les an o Debleskro plachteno kheer.
Job tchiwell peskro gushto an ko rat, un witsrell efta kope ko ratestar glan o laintikro kotar than, hoi hi glan o Debleskri kutch isema, kai o baro Dewel djiwell.

Ninna makell lo ko ratestar ap i shinga, hoi ap i star ekke o bobestar hi, kai o sungepaskro koowa chatchedo well. Ko bob hi tardo glan o baro Debleste an leskro plachteno kheer. O tselo wawar rat tchorell lo win tella pash koi chatchepaskri, kai i vieche chatchedo wenna. Koi chatchepaskri hi tardo win glan o wudar o Debleskro plachteno kherestar.
Palle tchinell lo o tselo thulepen dran ko viecho win un chatchrell les ap o Debleskri chatchepaskri.

Un job krell kau viecheha jaake har job kowa ko viecheha kras, hoi job peskri doshake maras. Jaake krell o rashai, te well lauter pale mishto mank i Israelitarja un o baro Debleste. Un o baro Dewel bistrell lengri doosh.

Kowa, hoi kau gurumestar pral atchas, anell job win, krik dran koi platsa, kai i menshe hi, un chatchrell les jaake har job kowa chatchras, hoi ko gurumestar pral atchas, hoi job peskri doshake maras. Jaake hunte well i gurumeha kerdo, hoi maredo well, te well i doosh i tsele Israelendar krik lino.
Te kras i pralstuno tchomone, hoi hunte krals lo gar, anas lo doosh ap peste, ninna te djinas job gar, te penas o baro Dewel: Ma kre kowa!
Te haiwell lo pal i tsiro, kai kowa, hoi lo kras, gar tchatcho hi glan o Debleskre jaka, palle hunte anell lo leske i mursh busni, hoi gar nasselo hi.

Un tchiwell peskro wast ap o viecheskro shero un marell les glan o baro Debleste, kote kai i vieche maredo wenn, hoi o Debleske chatchedo wenn. Jaake well i viecheha kerdo, hoi maredo well, te well i doosh krik lino.

Un o rashai lell peskro gushteha ko ratestar un makell les ap i shinga, hoi ap i star ekke pral ap koi chatchepaskri hi, kai i vieche chatchedo wenna. O tselo wawar rat tchorell lo win tella pash i chatchepaskri.

Un o tselo thulepen chatchrell lo ap i chatchepaskri jaake, har chatchrell lo o thulepen ko viechestar, hoi jek o Debleske anell, te chan le les khetne glan leste. Jaake krell o rashai, te well lauter pale mishto mank o pralstuneste un o baro Debleste. Un o baro Dewel bistrell leskri doosh.
Te kras jek i Israelendar tchomone, hoi hunte krals lo gar, anas lo doosh ap peste, ninna te djinas job gar, te penas o baro Dewel: Ma kre kowa!
Te haiwell lo pal i tsiro, kai kowa hoi lo kras, gar tchatcho hi glan o Debleskre jaka, palle hunte anell lo leske i busni, hoi gar nasselo hi. Kowa hunte krell lo, te well leskri doosh krik lino.
Un job hunte tchiwell peskro wast ap o viecheskro shero un marell les kote kai i vieche maredo wenn, hoi chatchedo wenn o Debleske.

Un o rashai lell peskro gushteha ko ratestar un makell les ap i shinga, hoi ap i star ekke pral ap koi chatchepaskri hi, kai i vieche chatchedo wenna. O tselo wawar rat tchorell lo win tella pash i chatchepaskri.

Un o tselo thulepen tchinell lo tele, jaake har tchinell lo o thulepen tele ko viechestar, hoi jek o Debleske anell, te chan le les khetne glan leste. Un ko rashai chatchrell kal thulle kotja ap o Debleskri chatchepaskri, te well i latcho sungepen win, hoi baro Debleske mishto sungella. Jaake krell o rashai, te well lauter pale mishto mank ko mensheste un o baro Debleste. Un o baro Dewel bistrell leskri doosh.
Te kamell jek i bakro o Debleske te anell, te well leskri doosh krik lino, palle anell lo i bakri, hoi gar nasselo hi,
un tchiwell peskro wast ap o viecheskro shero, un marell les kote, kai i vieche maredo wenn, hoi o Debleske chatchedo wenn. Kowa hunte krell lo, te well leskri doosh krik lino.

Un o rashai lell peskro gushteha ko ratestar un makell les ap i shinga, hoi ap i star ekke pral ap koi chatchepaskri hi, kai i vieche chatchedo wenna. O tselo wawar rat tchorell lo win tella pash i chatchepaskri.

Un o tselo thulepen tchinell lo tele jaake har tchinell lo o thulepen tele ko bakrestar, hoi jek o Debleske anell, te chan le les khetne glan leste. Un ko rashai chatchrell kal thulle kotja ap o Debleskri chatchepaskri khetne ko wawar masseha, hoi o baro Debleske chatchedo well. Jaake krell o rashai, te well lauter pale mishto mank o baro Debleste un ko mensheste, kai doosh ap peste anas. Un o baro Dewel bistrell leskri doosh.

Te well jek glan i tchatchepangre anlo, te penell lo, hoi lo dikas un shunas, un job rikrell kowa peske, un penell tchi, ninna te dikas oder shunas lo, hoi koi his. Palle anas lo i doosh ap peste un hunte hidjrell lat.

Te taprell jek tchomone an, hoi pale-tchiddo hi, nai well i mulo diwjo viecho, nai well i wawar mulo viecho, ninna i tikno mulo viecho, hoi djal pral i phub, palle hi lo pale-tchiddo, un anas doosh ap peste, ninna te haiwas lo gar, hoi lo kras.
Ninna te taprell lo ap i mensheste, kai hi pale-tchiddo, hoi kowa ninna hi, palle anas lo doosh ap peste, ninna te haiwas lo gar, hoi lo kras.
Te dell jek pes sowel, jaake te rakrell leskro mui sik, un job haiwell pal i tsiro, hoi lo kras, – hi jek, te hi kowa, hoi lo penas, latcho oder tchilatcho leske – palle anas lo i doosh ap peste.
Te anas job jaake te jaake doosh ap peste, palle hunte penell lo, hawo koowa job kras.

Koi doshake hunte anell lo o baro Debleske i bakri oder i busni, un marell lat, te well leskri doosh krik lino. Un o rashai lell ko viecho un chatchrell leskro thulepen, un jaake krell lo, te well lauter pale mishto mank ko mensheste un o baro Debleste.

Te hi ko mursh tchorwelo un nai anell kek bakri witar kek busni, nai anell lo dui taube. Kolla nai hi dui diwje taube oder dui wawar taube, jek, te well i doosh krik lino, un jek, hoi o baro Debleske tseles chatchedo well.
Job anell len pash o rashajeste. Un kowa anell glanstunes koi tauba hoi i doshake anlo was, un phagell lake i meen, o shero tele tchinell lo lake gar.

Job witsrell ko ratestar ap i rig fun i chatchepaskri, un mukell o tselo wawar rat win ratell tella pash i chatchepaskri. Jaake hunte well i viecheha kerdo, hoi maredo well, te well i doosh krik lino.

Un koi wawar tauba chatchrell lo jaake, har o baro Dewel penas, te well kerdo i viecheha, hoi tseles chatchedo well. Jaake krell o rashai, te well lauter pale mishto mank ko mensheste un o baro Debleste. Un o baro Dewel bistrell koi doosh, hoi ko mensho ap peste anas.

Te hi kowa, kai doosh ap peste anas, jaake tchorwelo, te nai anell lo gar dui taube, palle anell lo jek kilogrammi latcho jarro o baro Debleske, te well leskri doosh krik lino. Job hunte tchiwell kek djet pre, witar kek sungepaskro koowa. Kawa hi i chapen, hoi o Debleske anlo well, te well i doosh krik lino.

Job anell ko jarro pash o rashajeste, un o rashai lell i wast pherdo, un mukell kawa ap i chatchepaskri te chatchrell o baro Debleske. Kawa sikrell, kai ko tselo chapen, hoi anlo was, o baro Debleske hi. Kawa hi i chapen, hoi o baro Debleske anlo well, te well i doosh krik lino.

Jaake krell o rashai, te well i doosh kolestar krik lino, hoi doosh ap peste anas an hako koowa, kolestar kate penlo well. Un lauter well pale mishto mank ko mensheste un o baro Debleste. Un o baro Dewel bistrell leskri doosh. O jarro, hoi pral atchell, hi o rashajeske, jaake har pash o wawar chapen dran djob, hoi o Debleske dino was.
Un o baro Dewel penas ap o Mose:

Te dals jek gar o baro Debleste, hoi hunte dals lo leste, chochras lo o baro Debles, ninna te djinas lo kowa gar. Job hunte anell o Debleske i bakro, hoi sasto hi, te well leskri doosh pale mishto. Kau bakro hunte well jaake bud rupene beme moldo, har tu peneh. Jek rupeni bema hi jaake pharo har i rupeni bema an o Debleskro kheer hi.

Un ninna hunte anell lo ko koowa, hoi anas lo gar o baro Debleske, un o pantchto kolestar gomme pashel. Un kowa lauter dell lo o rashajeste an o wast. Un o rashai marell ko bakro un chatchrell leskro thulepen, te well lauter pale mishto mank o Debleste un o mensheste. Un o baro Dewel bistrell koi doosh.
Te krell jek tchomone, kolestar o baro Dewel penas, te krell lo les gar, anas lo i doosh ap peste, ninna te djinas lo gar, te penas o baro Dewel: “Ma kre kowa!”

Job hunte anell o rashajeske i bakro, hoi sasto hi, te well leskri doosh pale mishto. Kau bakro hunte well jaake bud moldo, har tu peneh. Koleha krell o rashai, te well lauter pale mishto mank o Debleste un ko mensheste, kai gar djinas, kai kowa, hoi lo kras, i doosh his. Un o baro Dewel bistrell leskri doosh.
Jaake hunte krell kowa, kai kras i tchilatchepen ap o baro Debleste, te well leskri doosh pale mishto.
Un o baro Dewel penas ap o Mose:

Hakeno, kai i wawares chochell, krell i tchilatchepen ap mande, o baro Debleste. Koon penell kolestar, hoi i wawar leske patsas, oder das, te dell lo jak pre ‘kowa hi mange’, kowa anell doosh ap peste. Kowa hi ninna jaake, te tchoras jek i wawares, oder las tchomone lestar chochepah,
oder hatsas tchomone, hoi nashedo his, un penell, te hatsas lo tchi. Un dell pes i chocheni sowel an kau koowa oder an wawar koowa, hoi i mensho lauter nai krell, koleha job doosh ap peste lell,
palle las lo doosh ap peste. Un job hunte dell ko koowa pale, hoi lo o wawarestar chochepah las un rikras,

oder pral kowa job pes chochenes sowel das. Kau tselo koowa hunte dell lo pale, oder jaake bud har kowa moldo his, un i pantchto kolestar gomme pashel. Un koneske kowa his, koleste well kowa pale dino ap ko diwes, kai job o baro Debleske i vieches anell, te well leskri doosh pale mishto.
Ko viecho hunte well i bakro, hoi sasto hi, un kolestar tu penal, har bud kowa hunte moldo well. Un job anell les pash o rashajeste, te well leskri doosh pale mishto.

Un o rashai marell ko bakro un chatchrell leskro thulepen, te well lauter pale mishto glan o baro Debleste un ko mensheste. Un o baro Dewel bistrell halauter, hoi ko mensho kras, un koleha job doosh ap peste anas.
Un o baro Dewel penas ap o Mose:

Pen ap o Aron un leskre mursh tchawende: Jaake hunte krenn tumer o viecheha, koleskro tselo mass mange chatchedo well: Ko mass atchell ap i chatchepaskri koi tseli rat, bis te well o newo diwes. Un koi jag ap i chatchepaskri hunte chatchell i tseli rat un djal gar win.

O rashai riwell peskro laintikro gad an, un ninna kol laintikre cholopja. Job lell i jagakri tchik krik, hoi well ko viechestar, koleskro tselo mass chatchedo was. Un job tchorell koi tchik win pash i chatchepaskri.
Palle riwell lo peskre koola win un wawar koola an, un hidjrell koi jagakri tchik win dran koi platsa, kai i menshe hi, ap i platsa, hoi hi djudjo o Debleske.

Un koi jag ap i chatchepaskri chatchell dureder, un djal ko tselo tsiro gar win. Haki taissarla tchiwell o rashai kasht pre, un koi pre ko mass ko viechestar, hoi well tseles chatchedo, ninna kol kotja thulepen ko viechestar, hoi i menshe khetne chan. Un o rashai mukell lauter pre te chatchrell.
Koi jag ap i chatchepaskri hunte chatchell hako tsiro, un hunte djal gar win.
Un jaake hunte well kerdo o jarreha, hoi o baro Debleske dino well. I rashaja dran o kheer Aron anenn les glan o baro Debleste pash koi chatchepaskri.

Jek lendar lell kolestar i wast pherdo jarro, kai djet dren hi, ninna ko tselo sungepaskro koowa, hoi pral o jarro tchiddo hi, un mukell kowa ap o Debleskri chatchepaskri pre te chatchrell. Jaake sikrell lo, te hi ko tselo chapen o baro Debleske. Un ko latcho sungepen, hoi well win, sungell mishto o baro Debleske.

Ko jarro un ko djet, hoi pral atchell, kowa hi o Aroneske un leskre mursh tchawenge. Te krenn le pengro maro kolestar, hunte tchiwenn le kek shutlo jarro dren. Ap koi platsa glan o Debleskro plachteno kheer hunte chan le les. Kaja hi i Debleskri platsa. Kau chapen dell o baro Dewel lenge kolestar, hoi i menshe leske anan. Kowa hi i Debleskro chapen. Doleske nai chan les kokres i rashaja, jaake har ninna ko mass kol viechendar, hoi wenn maredo, te well i doosh un o pale-tchiddo koowa krik lino, un o mass kol viechendar, hoi wenn maredo, te well i doosh pale mishto.
Kokres kol mursh tchawe, kai wenn o Aronestar, nai chan kolestar. Kowa hi hako tsireske lengro kotar kolestar, hoi i menshe o baro Debleske anenna. Hako wawar, kai taprell kowa an, lell peskri phagi.
Un o baro Dewel penas ap o Mose:

Ap ko diwes, kai well jek dran o kheer Aron an peskri budi dren tchiddo, te well lo miro rashai, hunte anell lo mange i khoro latcho jarro – jaake bud har ko chapaske lino well, hoi hako diwes o baro Debleske anlo well. Ko jek paash anell lo leske taissarlakro un ko wawar paash rati.
An o sasterno tcharo well o jarro khetne kerdo o djeteha, palle peklo, an kotja phagedo un o baro Debleske chatchedo. Un ko latcho sungepen, hoi well win, sungell mishto o baro Debleske.

Un ko rashai dran o kheer Aron, kai pal Aroneskro merepen o pralstuno rashai well, kawa krell kowa, un chatchrell ko tselo chapen ap i chatchepaskri. Jaake hunte well kawa kerdo o baro Debleske hako tsireske.
Hako kopo, kai anell i rashai peske i chapen dran djob o baro Debleske, hunte well ko tselo chapen chatchedo. Kek chal les.
Un o baro Dewel penas ap o Moseste:

Pen o Aroneske un leskre mursh tchawenge, har i viecheha kerdo well, hoi i menshe o baro Debleske anenn, te well lengri doosh krik lino. Glan o baro Debleskro kheer, ap koi platsa, kai well ninna ko viecho maredo, koleskro tselo mass chatchedo well, ap kai platsa maress tu ninna ko vieches, hoi hunte merell, te well i doosh krik lino. O mass sau viechestar, hoi o Debleske anlo was, nai chan kokres i rashaja un kek wawar.
Ko rashai, kai leskre feteder kotja o Debleske chatchrell, chal o mass ap i glanstuni platsa glan o Debleskro plachteno kheer. Kaja hi i Debleskri platsa.
Hako wawar, kai ko mass an-taprell, lell peskri phagi. Te well tchomone ko ratestar ap jekeskre koola, palle hunte thowell lo ko kotar ap i platsa, hoi djudjo hi o Debleske.
Te was ko mass keredo an i piri, hoi dran tchik kerdo was, hunte well koi piri an kotja phagedo. Te was ko mass an i sasterni piri keredo, palle well li sorjah un panjeha win thodo.
I tsele mursha un mursh tchawe an i rashajengre familje nai chan kau mass. Jon kokres doleske, kai kau mass ko viechestar was, hoi o baro Debleske anlo was.
Te was o rat sau viechestar an o Debleskro kheer dren lino, te well lauter pale mishto mank i menshende un o baro Debleste, palle hunte chal kek leskro mass. Kau mass well an i jag chatchedo.
Jaake hunte well kerdo ko viecheha, hoi i menshe anenn, te well lengri doosh pale mishto kerdo. O mass sau viechestar nai chan kokres i rashaja un kek wawar.

Ap koi platsa, kai well ninna ko viecho maredo, koleskro tselo mass chatchedo well, ap kai platsa hunte well ko viecho maredo, hoi jek anas, te well leskri doosh pale mishto kerdo. Un o viecheskro rat well win tchoredo trul o Debleskri chatchepaskri.
Leskro tselo thulepen anell o rashai o baro Debleske, koi thulli pori un ko thulepen, hoi ap i buke hi,
kol dui niere un ko thulepen, hoi ap lende hi, un ko thullo kotar, hoi ap i lebra hi. Pash i niere hunte well o thulepen tele tchinlo.
O rashai mukell kowa lauter ap i chatchepaskri pre te chatchrell o baro Debleske. Jaake well ko mensheskri doosh pale mishto kerdo.
I mursha un i mursh tchawe dran i rashajengre familje nai chan o mass ap i Debleskri platsa. Ko mass well i viechestar, hoi o baro Debleske anlo was. Doleske nai chal les kek wawar.

Jaake har pash ko viecho, hoi i doshake maredo well, jaake hi ninna pash ko viecho, hoi maredo well, te well o mensheskri doosh pale mishto kerdo. O viecheskro mass hi ko rashajeske, kai o viecheskro thulepen chatchrell, te well pale lauter mishto mank ko mensheste un o Debleste.
Ko rashai, kai o viecho jekestar glan o baro Debleste anell, koleskro tselo mass chatchedo well, koleske hi o viecheskri hauta.
Un o tselo chapen dran djob, hoi an o bob peklo was, an i piri keredo was, oder an i sasterno tcharo peklo was, kowa hi ko rashajeske, kai ko chapen glan o baro Debleste anas.
Ko wawar chapen dran djob, o djeteha oder kek djeteha, kowa hi i tsele rashajenge dran o kheer Aron, ko jekeske har ko wawareske.
Un jaake hunte well kerdo ko viecheha, hoi well glan o baro Debleste anlo, te chan les i menshe palle khetne.

Te anell jek les, te kamell lo pes pash o baro Debleste te parkrell, palle hunte anell lo ninna merklia kerdo djeteha, an kolende kek shutlo jarro hi, un sane mare an kolende kek shutlo jarro hi, kai djet pral maklo was, ninna merklia kerdo dran latcho djob un djet.
Pash kowa, hoi anenn le, te parkrenn le pen pash o baro Debleste, anenn le mare, hoi shutlo jarreha kerdo was.
Jek kotar hakenestar well glan o baro Debleste anlo. Kowa lell o rashai, kai o rat ko maredo viechestar trul o Debleskri chatchepaskri tchoras.
Ko mass kau viechestar, hoi jek glan o baro Debleste anas, te parkrell lo pes pash leste, hunte well ap kau emligo diwes chalo, un tchi kolestar atchell tchiddo bis taissarlakro.

Te das jek pes sowel te dell lo tchomone o Debleste, un anell doleske sau viecho o Debleske, well ko mass ko emligo diwes chalo. Te atchell tchomone pral, nai chan le les o wawar diwes ninna. Jaake hunte well ninna kerdo, te das jek i viecho pestar o baro Debleste.
Hi gomme o triinto diwes tchomone pral, hunte well kowa an i jag chatchedo.

Te chal jek ap o triinto diwes gomme ko massestar, palle dikell o baro Dewel gar latches ap kowa un ap koleste, kai anas ko viecho glan leste. O mass was pale-tchiddo. Un koon chal kolestar, hunte hidjrell peskri doosh, hoi job koleha ap peste las.

Ko mass, hoi tchomoneha khetne well, hoi pale-tchiddo hi, kowa hunte well gar buder chalo. An i jag witsedo un chatchedo hunte well ko mass. Kokres kowa, kai gar pale-tchiddo hi glan o baro Debleste, nai chal ko mass, hoi o baro Debleske anlo was.
Kowa kai chal ko mass, hoi o baro Debleste dino was, un ap leste hi i pale-tchiddo koowa, kowa well infam un hi buder kek Israelitari.

Te taprell jek tchomone an, hoi pale-tchiddo hi, i menshestar oder i viechestar oder i wawar pale-tchiddo koowa, un palle chal lo kau mass, hoi glan o baro Debleste anlo was, kowa well infam un hi buder kek Israelitari.
Un o baro Dewel rakras ap o Mose:
Rake ap i Israelitarja un pen lenge: “Ma chan o thulepen i grumjendar, bakrendar un busjendar!
O thulepen kol viechendar, kai meran, oder wan mulo dandedo diwje viechendar, nai lenn un krenn tchomone koleha. Ma chan les!
Kowa, kai chal ko thulepen sawe viechendar, kai o baro Debleske anlo wan, kowa well infam un hi buder kek Israelitari.
Ma chan witar kek rat – kek rat i viechestar un kek rat i tchirklestar, kai tumer ninna djiwenna!
Hakeno, kai chal o rat, well infam un hi buder kek Israelitari.”
Un o baro Dewel rakras ap o Mose:
Rake ap i Israelitarja un pen lenge: Kowa kai anell o baro Debleske i viecho, hoi chan i menshe palle khetne glan leste, kowa dell o baro Debleste kolestar ko kotar, hoi o Debleske hi.
Peskre wastentsa hunte anell lo les, te well lo chatchedo o baro Debleske: Ko thulepen un ko betch. Ko betch well pre hadedo glan o baro Debleste.
O rashai mukell o thulepen te chatchrell ap i chatchepaskri. I betch hi o Aroneske un leskre mursh tchawenge.
O tchatchi heri kau viechestar hi ninna ko rashajeske,
kai anell o rat un o thulepen glan o baro Debleste kol viechendar, hoi chan i Israelitarja palle khetne glan o Debleste.

O baro Dewel penell i Israelenge, kai anenn leske i vieches, te chan le les khetne glan leste, te denn le o betch un i tchatchi heri o rashajeste, o Aroneste, un leskre mursh tchawende. Kal kotja mass hi i rashajenge dran o kheer Aron hako tsireske fun ko diwes, kai wan le dren tchiddo an pengri rashajengri budi. Un i Israelitarja hunte denn len i rashajende. Kau lab atchell jaake hako tsireske, hoi wella.

Kawa hi hoi glan tchinlo was: pral ko viecho, koleskro tselo mass chatchedo well; pral o chapen dran djob, hoi o Debleske anlo well; pral ko viecho, hoi maredo well, te well i doosh un o pale-tchiddo koowa krik lino; pral ko viecho, hoi maredo well, te well o mensheskri doosh pale mishto kerdo; pral ko viecho, hoi maredo well ap ko diwes, kai well o rashai an peskri budi dren tchiddo; pral ko viecho, hoi chan le khetne, koleskre feteder kotja o Debleske chatchedo wan.
Jaake penas kowa o baro Dewel ap o Moseste, har his lo pral ap i berga Sinai, ap ko diwes, kai job i Israelenge penas, te anenn le viechen o baro Debleske an o mulo tato them Sinai.
Un o baro Dewel penas ap o Mose:

Le o Arones un leskre mursh tchawen tuha, un i rashajengre koola, un o djet un ko terno gurum, hoi i doshake maredo well, un kol dui mursh bakre un koi korba, kai i mare dren hi, kai kek shutlo jarro dren hi.
Muk i tsele Israelitarjen glan o wudar o Debleskro plachteno kherestar khetne te well.
O Mose kras jaake har o baro Dewel penas. Un i tsele Israelitarja wan khetne glan o wudar o Debleskro plachteno kherestar.
Un o Mose penas ap lende: Kawa hi, hoi o baro Dewel penas, te hunte kras mer.
Un job mukas o Arones un leskre mursh tchawe glan te well, un thowas len o panjeha.
Job riwas o Aroneske o laintikro gad an un tchiwas leske o pereskri dori trujel, palle i baja un o rashajeskri damdira. Palle pandas lo ko pereskro pandepen, hoi ap i damdira hi, trul leste.
Palle tchiwas lo o betcheskri possita ap leste. Un an koi possita tchiwas lo kol dui tikne koola, hoi kharenna ‘momeli’ un ‘tchatchepen’.
Palle tchiwas lo o shereskro pandepen trul leskro shero, un glan ap koleste i tikno sonakaskro kotar, jaake har o baro Dewel les o Moseske penas.
O Mose las o djet un witsras kolestar tchomone ap o tselo plachteno kheer, kai o baro Dewel djiwell, un ap lauter hoi dren hi. Jaake sikras lo, kai kowa lauter o baro Debleske hi.
Efta kope witsras lo ko djetestar tchomone ap i chatchepaskri un kol tsele koola, kolentsa budrenn le, ninna ap o panjeskro tcharo un ap kol herja koi tel, te well kowa lauter o baro Debleske.
Palle las o Mose ko djet, un tchoras kolestar ap o Aroneskro shero, un kras jaake, te well job o baro Debleskro rashai.

Un o Mose mukas o Aroneskre tchawe glan te well, un riwas lenge i laintikre gada an, un pandas lenge i pereskro pandepen trujel, un tchiwas i rashajengre stadja ap lengre shere. Kowa lauter kras lo jaake, har o baro Dewel kowa leske penas.
Job mukas o terno gurum te anell, hoi i doshake maredo well. O Aron un leskre tchawe tchiwan pengre wasta ap o shero ko terno viechestar.

Un o Mose maras les kote, un las tchomone ko ratestar, un makas peskro gushteha ko rat ap i shinga, hoi pral ap i star ekke ap i chatchepaskri hi. Ko tselo wawar rat tchoras lo tella pash i chatchepaskri win. Jaake las lo koi tseli doosh un ko tselo pale-tchiddo koowa krik, hoi ap koi chatchepaskri his, te nai well li o Debleske dino.
Job las o tselo thulepen, hoi ap i buke hi, un ko thullo kotar, hoi pral i lebra hi, un kol dui niere un lengro thulepen, hoi ap lende hi! Kowa lauter chatchras lo ap o Debleskri chatchepaskri.

Kowa, hoi pral atchas kau viechestar, leskri hauta un leskro mass, un ko chapen, hoi an leskre buke his, chatchras lo an i jag win glan koi platsa, kai i menshe his, jaake har o baro Dewel leske penas, te krell lo.
Palle las lo ko jek bakro, koleskro tselo mass chatchedo well o baro Debleske. Un o Aron un leskre tchawe tchiwan pengre wasta ap o viecheskro shero.
Un o Mose maras les, las leskro rat un tchoras les trul o Debleskri chatchepaskri win.
Un job tchinas o mass an kotja, un tchiwas o shero, kol kotja mass un o thulepen ap i chatchepaskri.

Un job thowas leskre buke un leskre herja o panjeha, un tchiwas len ninna ap i chatchepaskri, un mukas ko tselo vieches pre te chatchrell ap o Debleskri chatchepaskri. Jaake har o baro Dewel penas, was ko tselo bakro leske chatchedo. Un o latcho sungepen, hoi was win, sungas mishto o baro Debleske.
Job mukas o duito mursh bakro te anell, kai doleske maredo well, te wenn i rashaja an pengri budi dren tchiddo. Un o Aron un leskre tchawe tchiwan pengre wasta ap o viecheskro shero.
Un o Mose maras les, las leskro ratestar un makas les tella ap o Aroneskro tchatcho kand, ninna ap o pesso gushto ap leskro tchatcho wast, un ap o baro tsebo leskro tchatcho pirestar.

Palle mukas lo o Aroneskre mursh tchawe te well. un makas ko ratestar tella ap lengro tchatcho kand, ninna ap o pesso gushto ap lengre tchatche wasta, un ap o baro tsebo lengre tchatche pirendar. O tselo wawar rat tchoras o Mose trul i chatchepaskri win.

Job las o thulepen kau maredo bakrestar: i thulli pori, ninna o thulepen, hoi ap i buke hi, un ko kotar, hoi pral i lebra hi, un kol dui niere un lengro thulepen, hoi ap lende hi, un o pralstuno kotar i tchatchi herjatar.

Dran koi korba an kolate o maro hi, an koleste kek shutlo jarro hi, un hoi o baro Debleske dino was, las lo jek merkli, kai kek shutlo jarro dren hi, jek djeteskri merkli, un jek sano maro. Un tchiwas len ap ko kotja thulepen, un ap ko pralstuno kotar o tchatchi herjatar.
Kowa lauter das lo an i wasta o Aronestar un leskre mursh tchawendar. Un jon hadan les pre glan o baro Debleste, te sikrenn le, kai kowa leske hi.

Un o Mose las lauter pale dran lengre wasta, tchiwas les ap o Debleskri chatchepaskri pral pre ap ko mass ko viechestar, hoi well tseles chatchedo, un mukas les te chatchrell. Kawa hi ko chapen, hoi was o baro Debleske chatchedo, har wan i rashaja an pengri budi dren tchiddo. Un o latcho sungepen, hoi was win, sungas mishto o baro Debleske.

O Mose las o betch ko duito bakrestar, un hadas les pre glan o baro Debleste, te sikrell lo, kai kowa leske hi. Kau betch his ko kotar, hoi nai las o Mose peske, te chal lo les. Jaake penas kowa o baro Dewel.

Palle las o Mose ko djetestar, hoi o Aroneske un leskre tchawenge ap lengre sherja tchoredo was, ninna ko ratestar hoi ap i chatchepaskri his, un witsras tchomone kolestar ap o Aron un ap leskre koola, ninna ap leskre mursh tchawende un ap lengre koola. Jaake tchiwas lo len ap i rig o baro Debleske, te wenn le leskre rashaja.
O Mose penas ap o Aron un leskre tchawende: Kerenn ko mass pash o wudar glan o Debleskro kheer, un chan les kote, khetne ko mareha dran koi korba! Jaake penas mange kowa o baro Dewel.
Kowa, hoi o massestar un ko marestar pral atchell, chatchrenn an i jag!

Atchenn efta diwessa glan o wudar o baro Debleskro kherestar! Djan gar kotar krik, bis te kol diwessa trujel hi, kai i vieche maredo un chatchedo wenn doleske, kai wenn tumer dren tchiddo an tumari budi.
Jaake har kau diwes vieche un chapen glan o baro Debleste anlo wan, jaake hunte well kerdo ap kol diwessa, kai wenna, te well tumari doosh krik lino. Kowa penas o baro Dewel.
Efta diwessa un ratsja hunte atchenn tumer glan o wudar o baro Debleskro plachteno kherestar. Krenn, hoi job penas, te merenn gar! Jaake penas lo kowa mange.
O Aron un leskre mursh tchawe kran lauter jaake, hoi o baro Dewel ap o Moseste penas.
Har o ochtato diwes was, kharas o Mose o Arones un leskre mursh tchawen un i phureder dran Israel pash peste,

un penas ap o Aron: “Le tuke i terno gurum un i mursh bakro, ko gurum, te well lo maredo, te well i doosh krik lino, un ko bakro, te well lo maredo, un leskro tselo mass o baro Debleske chatchedo. Kal dui hunte wenn sasto. Kolla an glan o baro Debleste:

Un rake i Israelentsa un pen lenge: Anenn jek mursh busni, hoi well maredo, te well i doosh krik lino, ninna i terno gurum un i terno bakro, hoi jek bersh phuro hi, te well lengro mass tseles chatchedo o Debleske. Kol dui hunte wenn sasto.

Anenn ninna i gurum un i mursh bakro, te maras mer len glan o baro Debleste, un chan len kote khetne. Koi pashel anenn jarro, kai djet dren hi, te chatchras mer les o baro Debleske. Kau diwes hi ko diwes, kai o baro Dewel pes tumenge sikrell.”
Jon anan kowa, hoi o Mose penas, glan o wudar o baro Debleskro plachteno kherestar. Un i tsele Israelitarja wan kote khetne glan o baro Debleste.
un o Mose penas: “O baro Dewel penas, te krenn tumer kawa, te sikrell lo pes tumenge an peskro railepen.”

Un o Mose penas ap o Aron: “Ab glan o Debleskri chatchepaskri, un an leske ko vieches, koleha tiri doosh krik lino well, un mare ninna tuke ko vieches, koleskro tselo mass o Debleske chatchedo well. Palle kre kowa kol viechentsa, hoi i Israelitarja anan, te well lengri doosh krik lino. Jaake penas kowa o baro Dewel.”
O Aron was glan i chatchepaskri un maras ko terno gurum, hoi job anas, te well peskri doosh krik lino.

Un leskre mursh tchawe anan leske o rat. Un job tchiwas peskro gushto an o rat, un makas tchomone ko ratestar ap i shinga, hoi ap i star ekke pral ap i chatchepaskri hi. Un o wawar rat tchoras lo tella pash i chatchepaskri.
O thulepen un i niere un ko thullo kotar ap i lebra chatchras lo ap i chatchepaskri, jaake har o baro Dewel kowa o Moseske penas.
O mass un i hauta chatchras lo win glan koi platsa, kai i menshe his.
Palle maras lo ko vieches, koleskro tselo mass o baro Debleske chatchedo well. Un leskre tchawe anan leske o rat. Un job tchoras les trul o Debleskri chatchepaskri ap leskre star rigja.
Un jon anan leske kol kotja mass, ninna o shero. Un job chatchras len ap i chatchepaskri.
Job thowas i buke, un i palstune herja, un tchiwas len pral ap ko wawar mass ap i chatchepaskri, un chatchras len.

Pal kowa anas lo glan o baro Debleste kol viechen, hoi i Israelitarja anan. Job maras koi mursh busni, te well i doosh i Israelendar krik lino, un kras kau viecheha jaake, har lo glan kowa koleha kras, hoi lo peskri doshake maras.
Palle maras lo ko viecho, koleskro tselo mass chatchedo well, un kras leha har o baro Dewel penas.
Ninna anas lo ko jarro, kai djet dren hi, las i wast pherdo un chatchras les ap i chatchepaskri, jaake har kras lo ap i tsalla, har lo o vieches o Debleske anas, koleskro tselo mass chatchedo was.

Palle maras lo ko gurum un ko bakro ko chapaske, hoi i menshe khetne chan glan o baro Debleste. Leskre tchawe anan leske o rat. Un o Aron las ko rat un tchoras les trul i chatchepaskri ap leskre star rigja.
Ko thulepen kol dui viechendar, koi thulli pori un o thulepen ap i buke, un i niere un o thullo kotar, hoi ap i lebra hi,
kau tselo thulepen tchiwas lo ap i betcheskre kotja. Un o Aron chatchras ko thulepen.
Kol betcheskre kotja un i tchatche palstune herja hadas o Aron glan o baro Debleste pre, te sikrell lo, kai kal tsele vieche o baro Debleske his. Jaake penas kowa o baro Dewel o Moseske.
Har anas o Aron kal tsele viechen o Debleske, hadas lo peskre wasta pre pral i tsele menshende, un rakras o Debleskri bacht pral lende win. Palle djas lo koi treppa tele fun koi chatchepaskri.

Un o Mose un o Aron djan pale an o Debleskro plachteno kheer. Un har le pale win wan, rakran le o Debleskri bacht win pral i tsele menshende. Kote sikras pes o baro Debleskro railepen glan i tsele menshende.

I jag djas win o baro Deblestar, un chatchras ko mass pre kol viechendar, koleskro tselo mass chatchedo well, ninna kol thulle kotja, hoi ap o Debleskri chatchepaskri tchiddo his. Har kowa i tsele menshe dikan, dan le i bachtjatar gole, un tchiwan pen tele glan o baro Debleste ap i phub.

Dui mursh tchawe o Aronestar, o Nadab un o Abihu, lan hakeno peskro sasterno tcharo an o wast, tchiwan jag dren un sungepaskro koowa, un djan koleha an o Debleskro plachteno kheer, te anenn le kowa glan o baro Debleste. Kowa kran le pestar. O baro Dewel penas lenge gar, te krenn le kowa.
Kote djas jag o baro Deblestar win, un chatchras len pre. Jon meran kote glan o baro Debleste.

O Mose penas ap o Aron: Kawa hi, hoi o baro Dewel rakras, har penas lo: Kamau, te dikenn kolla, kai wenn glan mande, te hom me kokres o tchatcho Dewel. Glan i tsele menshende kamau te wap sharedo. O Aron penas kek lab.

O Mose das o Mishael un o Elizafan gole. Kolengro dad his o Usijel. Kowa his o Aroneskro kak. Lenge penas lo: “Awenn kai, hidjrenn tumare phralen win dran o Debleskro kheer glan koi platsa, kai i menshe hi!”
Kol dui wan un hidjran len an lengre rashajeskre gada win glan koi platsa, kai i menshe his, jaake har o Mose penas.

O Mose penas ap o Aron un koleskre wawar dui tchawende, o Eleasar un o Itamar: “Mukenn tumare phralen, kol wawar Israelitarjen, te rowenn le kolenge, kai o baro Dewel koi jagah maras. Tumer hunte mukenn gar tumare balla ap tumaro shero diwjes trujel tchiddo, un hunte tserdenn gar tumare koola an kotja, te sikrenn, har phares tumare djia hi. Te krenn kowa, hunte merenn. Un o baro Debleskri choli well pral o tselo kheer Israel.

Ma djan witar gar krik o wudarestar o Debleskro plachteno kherestar, te merenn gar. O baro Debleskro djet was tchoredo ap tumare sherja, te wenn leskre rashaja.” Un jon kran jaake, har o Mose lenge penas.
O baro Dewel penas ap o Aron:
“Tu un tire mursh tchawe, ma pijenn mool un sorelo pipen, te kamenn an miro kheer te djal, te hunte merenn gar. Ap kowa hunte rikrenn tumen un tumare tchawe kanna un hako tsiro.
Tumer hunte dikenn dren, hoi o baro Debleske hi, un hoi gar o baro Debleske hi, un hoi erligo hi un hoi pale-tchiddo hi glan leste.
Un hunte sikrenn i Israelende ko tselo koowa, hoi me, o baro Dewel, lendar kamau, halauter hoi me o Moseske penom, un job lenge dureder penas.”

O Mose penas ap o Aron un ap koleskre dui mursh tchawende, kai leske pral atchan, ap o Eleasar un o Itamar: “Kowa, hoi pral atchas ko jarrestar, hoi glan o baro Debleste anlo was, nai lenn tumenge. Tchiwenn kek shutlo jarro koi pashel. Chan les pash o Debleskri chatchepaskri. Kau chapen hi i Debleskro chapen. Kokres i rashaja nai chan les, un kek wawar.
Kau chapen hi tiro un tire tchawengro kotar kolestar, hoi o baro Debleste chatchedo well. Doleske chan les ap i Debleskri platsa. Jaake penas kowa mange o baro Dewel.

Ko betch un koi tchatchi palstuni heri, hoi pre hadedo wan glan o baro Debleste, hi ninna tumenge. Chan len khetne tumare tchawentsa un tchentsa ap i wawar platsa, hoi djudjo hi o Debleske. Kal kotja mass hi tiro kotar un tire tchawengro kotar kol viechendar, hoi i Israelitarja o baro Debleske anan, te chan le len khetne glan leste.

Glan te chan tumer kowa, wenn koi palstuni heri un kau betch tchiddo pash kol kotja thulepen, hoi chatchedo wenn. Kolentsa khetne wenn le pre hadedo glan o baro Debleste. Pal kowa hi kal kotja mass tuke un tire mursh tchawenge. Jaake te well kowa kerdo hako tsireske. Kowa penas o baro Dewel.”

O Mose rodas koi mursh busni, hoi o Debleske anlo was, te well i doosh krik lino, un hatsas win, te was lakro mass chatchedo. Kote was o Mose chojedo pral o Eleasar un o Itamar, kol dui tchawe o Aronestar, un putchas lendar:

“Hoske chan tumer ko mass gar ap i Debleskri platsa? Kau mass was i viechestar, hoi o baro Debleske anlo was, un his i rashajenge kokres, te chan le les. O baro Dewel das les tumende, te hidjrenn i doosh i Israelendar krik, te well lauter pale mishto mank lende un o baro Debleste.
Tumer djinenn, te was ko viecheskro rat gar an o Debleskro kheer dren anlo. Doleske hunte wals ko viecho gar chatchedo. Ko mass hunte chajans tumer ap i Debleskri platsa. Kowa penom tumenge.”

O Aron penas ap o Mose: “Dik, kau diwes maran le o baro Debleske ko viecho pengri doshake, ninna ko viecho, koleskro tselo mass chatchedo was. Un hoi djas, dikeh tu! Har nai choms kau diwes ko viechestar, hoi i doshake maredo was? Wals kowa an o baro Debleskre jaka palle jaake, te dikals lo mishto ap kowa?”
Har shunas o Mose kowa, his kowa leske mishto.
Un o baro Dewel penas ap o Mose un o Aron:
Penenn ap i Israelitarja: Kalla hi i vieche, hoi nai chan kolendar, kai djiwenn ap o them:
Hako viecho, koles pre-phagede pire hi, tseles pre-phagedo hunte wenn le, un hoi o chapen dui kope chal, kolen nai chan.

Mank kolende, kai o chapen dui kope chan, hi sawe, hoi hunte chan tumer gar: I khamela un o shoshoi, un o bergetikro shoshoi. Ninna te chan le pengro chapen dui kope, len hi kek pre-phagede pire. Pale-tchiddo hi le tumenge!
Un o bales hunte chan gar, ninna te hi les pre-phagede pire. O balo chal o chapen gar dui kope. Pale-tchiddo well lo tumenge.
O mass kek kal viechendar hunte chan. Witar gar taprenn len an, te hi le mulo. Pale-tchiddo wenn le tumenge.
Kalla hi i vieche, hoi nai chan tumer kolendar, kai djiwenn an o pani: Halauter, hoi les flosse un shuppe hi, un djiwell an o baro pani un an i lengste panja, kowa nai chan tumer.
Halauter, hoi djiwell an o baro pani un an i lengste panja, un les hi kek flosse un kek shuppe, ma chan! Pale-tchiddo well kowa tumenge!
Ma chan leskro massestar! Un te hi sau viecho mulo, well lo tumenge pale-tchiddo.
Lauter, hoi an o pani hi, un les kek flosse un kek shuppe hi, well tumenge djungeles.

Kalla hi i tchirkle, hoi hunte chan gar. Kalla wenn tumenge pale-tchiddo: o adlari, kol tchirkle kai chan tikne bakre, kachja un matche; massengre tchirkle, hake ratsjakre tchirkle, hake korake, ninna i straussetikre kachja un i mulengre tchirkle, panjeskre möwe, un o habichto un hake tchirkle dran leskri familja; un o tikno ratsjakro tchirklo un o baro ratsjakro tchirklo, o panjeskri kachni; un o pelikano un o mulo-massengre tchirkle un o shwano; un o storcho un hake matchengre tchirkle; un o wiedehopf un o fledertikre kermuse.
Ninna kal tsele tikne vieche, hoi len tchirklengre mussja hi un ap star herja djan, hi tumenge pale-tchiddo.
Kokres kolla kolendar, kai nai stenn, nai chan tumer.
Jaake nai chan tumer hake stepangre.
Kol tsele wawar tikne vieche, kolen tchirklengre mussja hi un ap star herja djan, wenn tumenge pale-tchiddo.
Kalla hi kol vieche, kai hunte taprenn len gar an, te hi le mule: Hakeno, kai taprell sawo mulo viecho an, kowa hi pale-tchiddo bis te well rati.
Koon sau mulo vieches hidjrell, hunte thowell peskre koola, un well pale-tchiddo, bis te well rati.

Kalla hi kol vieche: Hako viecho, koles pre-phagede pire hi, kai hi gar tseles pre-phagedo, un hoi chal o chapen gar dui kope. Kal vieche hi tumenge pale-tchiddo. Koon taprell les an, well pale-tchiddo.
Kol tsele vieche, kai djan ap tatse, hi tumenge pale-tchiddo. Koon jekes lendar an-taprell, te hi kowa mulo, well pale-tchiddo, bis te well rati.
Kowa, kai sau mulo viecho hidjrell, hunte thowell peskre koola, un well pale-tchiddo, bis te well rati. Kal mule vieche hi tumenge pale-tchiddo.
Kalla hi i vieche, hoi hi tumenge pale-tchiddo mank i tikne viechende, hoi djan pral i phub: o maulwurfo, i kermuse, hake eidekse, o gekko, o salamander un o khameleon.
Kalla hi tumenge pale-tchiddo mank kol tsele tikne viechende. Hakeno, kai len an-taprell, te hi le mulo, well pale-tchiddo, bis te well rati.

Halauter, ap kowa sau mulo viecho perell, well pale-tchiddo: hako kashteno koowa, ninna ripja, fella un gone, ninna hako kowa, koleha jek i budi krell. Kowa lauter hunte well an o pani tchiddo, un atchell pale-tchiddo, bis te well rati. Pal kowa hi ko koowa buder gar pale-tchiddo.
Te perell sau mulo viecho an i piri, hoi dran tchik kerdo was, palle well lauter, hoi an koi piri hi, pale-tchiddo. Sawi piri hunte phagenn tumer paash.
Te well pani dran sawi piri pash i chapen dino, well ko tselo chapen pale-tchiddo, ninna hako pipen dran sawi piri.

Ap lauter, kai sau mulo viecho perell, kowa well pale-tchiddo. Te perell lo ap i bob, ap kolate peklo oder keredo well, well ko bob pale-tchiddo, un tumer hunte phagenn les tele. Pale-tchiddo hi lo tumenge.
Kokres te perell i mulo viecho an i brunna, kai pani dren hi, palle well ko pani gar pale-tchiddo. Kokres kowa, kai taprell ko mulo vieches an, hoi koi dren hi, kowa hi pale-tchiddo.
Te perell sau mulo viecho ap djob, hoi well win witsedo ap i phub, well ko djob gar pale-tchiddo.
Te was pani ap ko djob tchoredo, un palle perell sau mulo viecho koi pre, palle well ko djob tumenge pale-tchiddo.
Te merell i viecho, hoi nai chan tumer, un jek tumendar taprell les an, kowa well pale-tchiddo, bis te well rati.

Koon sawo viechestar chal, kowa hunte thowell peskre koola, un well pale-tchiddo bis te well rati. Koon ko mulo viecho hidjrell, kowa hunte thowell peskre koola, un well pale-tchiddo bis te well rati.
Kol tsele tikne vieche, hoi djan pral i phub, kolla, kai djan ap pengro per, ninna kolla, kai len hi star un budeder herja, jon hunte wenn pale-tchiddo tumenge. Kek chal len!
Ma krenn tumen pale-tchiddo sau tikno viecheha, hoi chan.

Me, o baro Dewel, hom tumaro Dewel. Kek wawar hi har me. An mande hi kek tchilatchepen. Un tumer hunte djiwenn jaake, te well tchi tardo mank mande un tumende. Ma krenn tumen pale-tchiddo ap i tikno viecho, hoi djal pral i phub.
Me hom o baro Dewel, un anom tumen dran o them Egiptia win, te wap tumaro Dewel. Kek wawar hi har me. An mande hi kek tchilatchepen. Un tumer hunte djiwenn jaake har i Debleskre menshe djiwenn.
Kawa hi hoi glan tchinlo hi pral i viechende un pral i tchirklende un pral halauter, hoi djiwell an o pani, un pral kol viechende, kai djan ap o per oder ap tikne herja pral i phub.
Jaake nai djinenn tumer, hoi pale-tchiddo hi un hoi gar pale-tchiddo hi, un hawo viecho nai chan tumer, un hawo viecho nai chan tumer gar.
O baro Dewel penas ap o Mose:
Pen ap i Israelitarja: Te anell i djuwel i mursh tchawes ap i phub, palle well li efta diwessa pale-tchiddo, har an kol diwessa, kai lat i djuwjakro koowa hi.
Ap o ochtato diwes well ko ternepen ap leskro mass tchinlo.

Un joi atchell 33 (trijanda-te-triin) diwessa gomme khere, bis te well li pale erligo. An kau tsiro taprell li tchi an, hoi o Debleske hi. Un an o Debleskro kheer well li gar, bis te kal diwessa trujel hi.
Te well lake i tchai boldo, palle well li dui kurke pale-tchiddo, har te wals lat peskri djuwjakro koowa. Un 66 (shob-deesh-te-shob) diwessa atchell li khere, bis te well li pale erligo.

Pal kal diwessa, kai his li pale-tchiddo, anell li o rashajeske i bakro, hoi jek bersh hi glan o wudar o Debleskro kherestar. Ninna anell li leske i terni tauba oder i diwji tauba. O bakro well maredo un leskro tselo mass well chatchedo o baro Debleske. Un i tauba well maredo, te well o pale-tchiddo koowa krik lino.

O rashai chatchrell kol vieche glan o baro Debleste, te well koi djuwel pale erligo. Jaake well o pale-tchiddo koowa krik lino, hoi ap koi djuwjate his. Jaake hunte krenn i djuwja, kai anan i mursh tchawes oder i tchai ap i phub.

Te hi li jaake tchorwelo, te nai anell li kek bakro, palle anell li dui diwje taube oder dui terne taube, jek, hoi o baro Debleske chatchedo well, un jek, hoi maredo well, te well o pale-tchiddo koowa latar krik lino. Jaake krell o rashai, te well li pale erligo.
O baro Dewel penas ap o Mose un ap o Aron:

Te well pash i mensheste i kotar hauta pesso oder nasselo oder parno, jaake te darenn le, kai kowa i djungelo nasslepen hi, palle well ko mensho pash o rashajeste anlo, pash o Aroneste oder pash jekeste leskre mursh tchawendar.

Un ko rashai hunte dikell peske koi nasseli kotar hauta an. Te wan i balla kote parno, un koi nasseli kotar hauta hi dureder tele an o mass har koi wawar hauta trujel, palle hi kowa i djungelo nasslepen. Kowa te dikell o rashai ap koleste, palle hunte rakrell lo win, te hi ko mensho pale-tchiddo.
Te hi ko parno kotar ap leskri hauta gar dureder tele an leskro mass har koi wawar hauta, un i balla wan gar parno, palle pandell ko rashai ko menshes efta diwessa an i kheer dren.
Ap o eftato diwes dikell lo les pale an. Te patsell lo, te djas ko parno kotar gar dureder, un atchas jaake har glan kowa, palle pandell ko rashai les i duito kopo efta diwessa dren.

Pal kol efta diwessa dikell o rashai pale koi kotar hauta an. Te hi kowa buder gar jaake parno un was gar bareder, palle hunte rakrell lo win, te hi ko mensho erligo. Kawa hi i nasslepen ap i hauta, hoi gar djungelo hi. Ko mensho hunte thowell peskre koola un hi erligo.
Te well ko nasselo kotar bareder pal kowa, kai o rashai pre dikas, palle hunte sikrell lo pes o rashajeste i duito kopo.
Te dikell o rashai palle, kai was ko nasselo kotar bareder, palle hi kowa i djungelo nasslepen, un o rashai hunte rakrell win, te hi ko mensho pale-tchiddo.
Te hi jekes i dukepen ap peskri hauta, hoi wi dikell har i djungelo nasslepen, palle anenn le sawes pash o rashajeste.
Te dikell ko rashai palle, te hi ko dukepen parno un pesso, un i balla an ko dukepen wan parno, un ko dukepen hi pre un lolo,
palle hi kowa ap leskri hauta i phuro djungelo dukepen. O rashai hunte rakrell win, te hi ko mensho pale-tchiddo. Job hunte pandell les gar an o kheer dren, pale-tchiddo hi lo.

Te phagell i nasslepen ap i tseli hauta win, fun leskro shero bis pash leskre pire, un halauter hi parno, hoi o rashai nai dikell, palle hi ko nasslepen tchomone, hoi ko menshes gar pale-tchiddo krell. Un o rashai rakrell win, te hi kowa erligo.

Hatsell o rashai, kai les an-dikell, i dukepen, hoi hi pre un lolo, hi kowa i djungelo nasslepen. Un o rashai, kai kowa dikell, hunte rakrell win, te hi ko mensho pale-tchiddo. Ko lolo mass, hoi pre hi, hi pale-tchiddo, un hi i sikepen, kai kowa i djungelo nasslepen hi.
Te djal ko lolo mass palpale un well parno, palle well ko mensho pale pash o rashajeste.
Te dikell o rashai, te was ko lolo mass parno, hi ko mensho buder gar pale-tchiddo. Un o rashai hunte rakrell win, te hi lo erligo.
Te phagell pash jekeste i dukepen pre ap leskri hauta, un well pale sasto,
un pal kowa well i hauta ap ko emligo kotar pale pesso un parno oder parno-te-lolo, palle sikrell lo kowa o rashajeste.

Te dikell o rashai koi kotar hauta, un kowa hi dureder tele an o mass har i wawar hauta trujel, un i balla ap ko dukepen wan parno, palle hi kowa i djungelo nasslepen, hoi an o dukepen win phagas. Palle rakrell ko rashai win, te hi ko mensho pale-tchiddo.

Te dikell o rashai koi kotar hauta un dikell kek parne balla, un koi kotar hauta hi gar dureder tele an o mass har i tseli wawar hauta, un hi buder gar jaake parno oder lolo-te-parno, palle pandell o rashai ko menshes efta diwessa dren.
Te well ko kotar bareder, palle hi kowa i djungelo nasslepen. Un o rashai hunte rakrell win, te hi ko mensho pale-tchiddo.
Te well ko kotar gar bareder, palle hi i dukepen, hoi sasto was, un mass hoi kote pale khetne djas. O rashai hunte rakrell win, te hi ko mensho erligo.
Te hatsell pes ap jekeste i kotar hauta, hoi chatchedo was, un ko dukepen well lolo-te-parno oder parno,

hunte sikrell lo kowa o rashajeste. Te dikell o rashai, te wan i balla kote dren parno, un ko kotar hauta hi dureder tele har i wawar hauta trujel, palle hi kowa i djungelo nasslepen, hoi an ko kotar hauta, hoi chatchedo was, win phagas. O rashai hunte rakrell win, te hi ko mensho pale-tchiddo.
Te dikell o rashai kek parne balla ap ko dukepen, un koi hauta hi gar dureder tele har i tseli wawar hauta, un hi buder gar jaake parno, palle pandell o rashai ko menshes efta diwessa dren.
Ap o eftato diwes dikell o rashai ko dukepen pale an. Te was ko parno kotar bareder, hi kowa i djungelo nasslepen. Un o rashai hunte rakrell win, te hi ko mensho pale-tchiddo.
Te atchas ko dukepen jaake har lo his, un was gar bareder, un hi buder gar jaake parno, palle hi kowa mass, hoi khetne djas pal ko chatchepen. O rashai hunte rakrell win, te hi ko mensho erligo.
Te hi i murshes oder i djuwjat i nasslepen ap o shereskri hauta oder ap i tchor,

hunte dikell o rashai les peske an. Te hi i hauta kote dureder tele har i wawar hauta trujel, un wan i balla kote djelto un sano, palle hi kowa i djungelo nasslepen ap o shero oder ap i tchor. O rashai hunte rakrell win, te hi ko mensho pale-tchiddo.
Te dikell o rashai, kai i balla kote buder gar kalo hi, ninna te hi i nasseli hauta gar dureder tele har koi wawar hauta trujel, palle pandell o rashai ko menshes efta diwessa dren.
Te dikell lo pal kol efta diwessa palla, un koi nasseli kotar hauta was gar bareder, un hi gar dureder tele har i wawar hauta, un kek djelto bal hi koi,
palle hunte tchinell ko mensho peskre balla trul ko dukepen tele. Un o rashai pandell les pale efta diwessa dren.

Te dikell o rashai ap o eftato diwes palla, un ko dukepen was gar bareder, un hi gar dureder tele an o mass har i wawar hauta, palle hunte rakrell o rashai win, te hi ko mensho erligo. Ko mensho hunte thowell peskre koola un hi erligo.
Te well ko dukepen bareder, pal kowa job erligo kerdo was,
hunte dikell ko rashai les pale. Te dikell o rashai, te was ko dukepen bareder, hunte rodell o rashai buder gar pal i balla, hoi djelto wan. Pale-tchiddo hi lo.
Te dikell an i rashajeskre jaka win, har te was ko dukepen gar bareder, un te wan kote kale balla win, palle was ko mensho sasto. O rashai hunte rakrell win, te hi lo erligo.
Te hi i murshes oder i djuwjat parne kotja ap pengri hauta,
hunte dikell o rashai palla, hoi kowa hi. Te hi kal kotja gar jaake parno, palle hi kowa kek djungelo nasslepen, hoi an i hauta win phagas. Pale-tchiddo hi ko mensho gar.
Te perenn jekeske i balla ap o shero win, palla oder glan, hi lo doleske gar pale-tchiddo.

Te hi kote, kai i balla win peran, palla oder glan, i kotar hauta, hoi parno-te-lolo hi, hunte dikell o rashai pal, hoi kowa hi. Hatsell o rashai i pessepen ap koi hauta, kai i balla win peran, un ko pessepen hi lolo-te-parno, un dikell win har i djungelo nasslepen,
palle hi les tchatchepah kau djungelo nasslepen ap peskro shero. Pale-tchiddo hi lo. Un o rashai rakrell win, te hi lo pale-tchiddo.

Ko mursh ap koleste ko djungelo nasslepen hi, hunte riwell koola, hoi paash hi, un hunte mukell leskri balla diwjes, un hunte tchiwell i diklo trul peskri tchor, un dell win gole: pale-tchiddo, pale-tchiddo!
Un jaake rah, har ko djungelo nasslepen ap leste hi, hi lo pale-tchiddo. Job djiwell kokres, un krell peskro kheer win glan koi platsa, kai i wawar menshe djiwenn.
Te sikrell pes i djungelo kotar ap i ripen oder ap koola, hoi hi dran bakrengre balla, laina oder ledera, un ko djungelo kotar hi senelo oder lolo, hunte dikell pes kowa o rashai an.
Job dikell les peske an un pandell les efta diwessa dren.
Ap ko eftato diwes dikell lo les pale an. Te was ko djungelo kotar bareder, hi kowa i djunglepen, hoi hi pale-tchiddo.
Ko ripen oder kol koola, ap kolende ko djunglepen hi, hunte wenn pre chatchedo an i jag.
Hi wawartchandes, te dikell o rashai ko koowa an, un ko djungelo kotar was gar bareder,
palle penell o rashai, te lenn le ko koowa un thowenn les. Palle pandell lo les o duito kopo efta diwessa dren.

Pal kol efta diwessa dikell les o rashai pale an. Te atchas ko djungelo kotar koi, hi kau ripen pale-tchiddo, ninna te was ko djungelo kotar gar bareder. Kau djunglepen chas pes dren glan oder palla. Doleske hunte well kau ripen oder kal koola chatchedo.

Te dikell o rashai, te was ko kotar, hoi senelo oder lolo his, buder gar jaake senelo oder lolo pal o thopen, palle tchinell lo les tele dran o ripen oder dran i koola dran bakrengre balla oder laina oder ledera.
Te sikrell pes ko djunglepen pal kowa pale, well diklo, te hi tchomone, hoi dureder djal. Palle hunte well kau koowa chatchedo, kai sikrell pes kau djunglepen ap leste.
Te hi ko djunglepen buder gar koi pal o thopen, hunte well kau koowa thodo i duito kopo. Pal kowa hi lo gar pale-tchiddo.
Jaake hunte well kerdo, te sikrell pes i djungelo kotar ap i ripen oder ap koola, hoi hi dran bakrengre balla, laina oder ledera, te well siklo, hi le pale-tchiddo oder gar.
O baro Dewel penas ap o Mose:
Jaake hunte krenn tumer jekeha, kai les i djungelo nasslepen ap peskri hauta his, un pale sasto was, te well lo pale erligo. Job well glan o rashajeste anlo.
O rashai djal win glan koi platsa, kai i menshe hi, un dikell les peske an. Te was ko dukepen ap leste sasto,
palle penell o rashai, te anenn le dui djide tchirkle, hoi hi gar pale-tchiddo, ninna zedertikro kasht, un lole thaba, un patria i burrestar, hoi kharell Ysop.
Un o rashai penell, te marenn le ko jek tchirklo pral i tcharo, kai djudjo pani dren hi.

Palle rikrell lo o djido tchirkles an ko tcharo, kai pani un o rat o maredo tchirklestar dren hi. Khetne leha tchiwell lo ko zedertikro kasht, kol lole thaba un kol patria Ysop koi dren, an ko tcharo,
un witsrell ko ratlo panjestar efta kope ap koleste, kai pale-tchiddo his, te well lo erligo. Un mukell ko djido tchirkles krik te djal.

Kowa, kai sasto was, thowell peskre koola un tchinell peskre tsele balla tele, un thowell pes. Palle hi lo erligo, un nai well pale ap i platsa, kai i menshe djiwenn. Efta diwessa atchell lo win glan peskro plachteno kheer.

Pal kol efta diwessa tchinell lo i duito kopo i tsele balla ap o shero tele, ninna leskri tchora un kol balla pral i jaka un leskre tsele wawar balla, un thowell pes un peskre koola Palle hi lo erligo.

Ap o ochtato diwes anell lo dui terne bakre, hoi mursha hi un sasto, un jek bakri, hoi jek bersh phuro un sasto hi. Ninna anell lo triin kilogramme latcho jarro, kai djet dren hi, te well kowa glan o baro Debleste anlo. Koi pashel anell lo i khoro djet.
Ko rashai anell koles, kai sasto was, un kau tselo koowa glan o baro Debleste, glan o wudar koleskro plachteno kherestar.
O rashai lell ko jek terno bakro un ko jek-paash litari djet, un hadell kowa pre glan o baro Debleste, te well ko mensho pale erligo kerdo glan o Debleste.

Pal kowa marell lo ko terno bakres kote, kai wenn ninna vieche maredo, te well i doosh un o pale-tchiddo koowa krik lino, un kol wawar, kolengro tselo mass chatchedo well. Kai platsa hi i Debleskri platsa. Jaake har hi o rashajeske ko mass i viechestar, hoi well maredo, te well i doosh un o pale-tchiddo koowa krik lino, jaake hi ninna o rashajeske ko mass i viechestar, hoi well maredo, te well ko mensho pale erligo kerdo glan o Debleste. O mass sau viechestar, hoi o Debleske anlo was, nai chan kokres i rashaja un kek wawar.

O rashai lell o ratestar ko viechestar, hoi maredo was, te well o mensho pale erligo glan o Debleste, un makell tchomone tella ap o tchatcho kand kolestar, kai sasto was, ninna ap leskro tchatcho pesso gushto un ap o tchatcho pesso tsebo.
O rashai lell ko khoro djet un tchorell tchomone kolestar an peskro serwo wast.
Palle tchiwell lo peskro tchatcho gushto an ko djet, hoi an leskro serwo wast hi, un witsrell ko djetestar efta kope ap o Debleskri chatchepaskri.

Palle makell lo ko djetestar, hoi an leskro serwo wast pral atchas, tchomone tella ap o tchatcho kand un ap o tchatcho pesso gushto un ap o tchatcho tsebo kolestar, kai sasto was, ap ko rat hoi lo glan kowa kote pre makas.
Ko djet, hoi gomme an leskro wast hi, makell lo ap o shero kolestar, kai sasto was. Jaake krell lo les pale erligo glan o baro Debleste.

Pal kowa marell o rashai ko viecho, hoi maredo well, te well ko pale-tchiddo koowa krik lino kolestar, kai sasto was. Jaake krell lo les pale erligo. Palle marell lo ko viecho, koleskro tselo mass o Debleske chatchedo well,
un chatchrell kowa ap o Debleskri chatchepaskri khetne ko chapen dran jarro hoi glan o baro Debleste anlo was. Un jaake krell lo, te well kowa, kai sasto was, pale erligo.

Te hi lo tchorwelo un nai anell gar jaake bud, palle lell lo i terno bakro, hoi maredo well, te well o mensho pale erligo. Kau bakro well pre hadedo glan o baro Debleste, te well i pale-tchiddo koowa krik lino. Koi pashel lell lo jek kilogrammi jarro, kai djet dren hi, te well kowa ninna glan o baro Debleste anlo. Ninna anell lo jek khoro djet,
dui diwje taube oder dui wawar taube. Koi jek well maredo, te well o pale-tchiddo koowa krik lino, koi wawar, te well li tseles chatchedo o baro Debleske.
Ap o ochtato diwes fun ko tsiro, kai lo erligo kerdo well, anell lo len pash o rashajeste glan o wudar o plachteno kherestar, kai o baro Dewel djiwell.
O rashai lell ko terno bakro, hoi maredo well, te well o mensho pale erligo, un hadell les pre glan o baro Debleste. Jaake krell lo ninna o djeteha.
Palle marell lo ko terno bakro un makell o ratestar tella ap o tchatcho kand kolestar, kai sasto was, ninna ap leskro tchatcho pesso gushto un ap o tchatcho pesso tsebo.
O rashai lell ko khoro djet un tchorell tchomone kolestar an peskro serwo wast.
Palle tchiwell lo peskro tchatcho gushto an ko djet, hoi an leskro serwo wast hi, un witsrell ko djetestar efta kope ap o Debleskri chatchepaskri.

Palle makell lo ko djetestar, hoi an leskro serwo wast pral atchas, tella ap o tchatcho kand un ap o tchatcho pesso gushto un ap o tchatcho tsebo kolestar, kai sasto was, ap ko rat, hoi lo glan kowa kote pre makas.
Ko djet, hoi gomme an leskro wast hi, makell lo ap o shero kolestar, kai sasto was. Jaake krell lo, te well ko mensho pale erligo glan o baro Debleste.
Pal kowa marell o rashai koi jek tauba, hoi ko mensho anas – nai well i diwji tauba, nai well i wawar tauba –

te well o pale-tchiddo koowa krik lino, un koi pal koi wawar tauba, hoi well tseles chatchedo ap o Debleskri chatchepaskri. Un koi pashel anell lo ko chapen dran jarro glan o baro Debleste. Jaake krell o rashai, te well kowa, kai sasto was, pale erligo glan o baro Debleste.
Jaake hunte well kerdo koleha, kai i djungelo nasslepen ap peskri hauta his, un kowa gar jaake brawelo hi, te nai anell lo triin bakre, te well lo pale erligo kerdo.
O baro Dewel penas ap o Mose un ap o Aron:
Te wenn tumer an o them Kanaan, hoi me tumen dau, te well kau them tumenge, un me mukau kote an i kheer i djungelo kotar win te well,
palle hunte djal kowa, koleske ko kheer hi, pash o rashajeste un penell leske: “Mange dikell kowa win, har te phagals i djungelo kotar ap miro kheer win.”
Glan te djal o rashai an ko kheer, te dikell lo peske kowa an, mukell lo ko tselo koowa dran ko kheer win te anell, te well gar kowa lauter pale-tchiddo. Palle djal lo dren un dikell pes ko kheer an.
Te dikell lo djungele senele oder lole kotja ap i barra, un kowa dikell win, har te chals pes ko djunglepen an i barra dren,
palle djal o rashai dran ko kheer win un pandell ko kheer efta diwessa tele.
Pal efta diwessa well lo pale an ko kheer, un dikell peske kol djungele kotja pale an. Te was ko djunglepen bareder ap i barra ko kherestar,
palle penell o rashai, te wenn kal barra wi-phagedo, kai ko djunglepen pre hi, un wenn win witsedo glan o foro ap i pale-tchiddi platsa.
Un ko tchik, hoi dren an o kheer ap i barra maklo was, hunte well tele lino un well wi-tchoredo win glan o foro ap i pale-tchiddi platsa.
Un kote, kai i barra win phagedo wan, wenn wawar barra dren tchiddo. Un wawar tchik well ap i barra pre maklo.
Te well ko djunglepen pale win ap i barra an ko kheer,
palle well ko rashai un dikell kowa peske an. Te djas ko djunglepen dureder, palle hi i djunglepen, hoi trul peste chal. Ko kheer hi pale-tchiddo,
un hunte well tele phagedo. Un leskre barra un leskro kasht un koi tchik ap i barra, kowa lauter well win anlo glan o foro ap i pale-tchiddi platsa.
Kowa, kai djal dren an ko kheer, jaake rah har kowa tele pandlo hi, kowa well pale-tchiddo, bis te well rati.
Kowa, kai sowell oder chal an ko kheer, hunte thowell peskre koola.

Te djal o rashai pale dren, un job dikell, te djas ko djunglepen gar dureder pal kowa, kai makan le wawar tchik ap i barra, palle rakrell o rashai win, te hi o kheer buder gar pale-tchiddo. Ko djunglepen djas krik.
Palle krell lo tchomone, te nai djiwenn i menshe pale an ko kheer: Job lell dui tchirkle, ninna zedertikro kasht, un lole thaba, un patria i burrestar, hoi kharell Ysop.
Un job marell ko jek tchirklo pral i tcharo, kai djudjo pani dren hi.

Palle tchiwell lo o djido tchirkles an ko tcharo, kai pani un o rat o maredo tchirklestar dren hi. Khetne leha tchiwell lo ko zedertikro kasht, kol lole thaba un kol patria Ysop koi dren, an ko tcharo, un witsrell ko ratlo panjestar efta kope ap ko kheer,
te well o pale-tchiddo koowa dran ko kheer krik lino.
Palle mukell lo ko djido tchirkles win te djal dran o foro. Jaake lell lo ko pale-tchiddo koowa ko kherestar krik. Un i menshe nai djiwenn pale an o kheer.
Pal kal laba hunte well kerdo, te hi jekes i nasslepen ap peskri hauta, djungelo oder gar djungelo,
kote, kai sikrell pes i pessepen, nassele kotja un parne kotja ap i hauta. Un pal kal laba hunte well kerdo, te sikrell pes i djunglepen ap ripja oder an khera.
Jaake nai well win hatslo, hi i mensho oder i koowa pale-tchiddo oder gar.
O baro Dewel penas ap o Mose un ap o Aron:
Pen ap i Israelende: Te nashell tchomone dran i mursheskro mass, palle hi lo pale-tchiddo.
Hi jek te nashell kowa o tselo tsiro oder pale te pale; pale-tchiddo hi lo.
Hako tchiben, ap koleste job tchiddo hi, un haki beshepaskri, ap kolate job beshdo hi, hi pale-tchiddo.
Koon koleskro tchiben an-tapras, hunte thowell pes un peskre koola, un hi pale-tchiddo bis te well rati.
Koon beshas pes ap tchomone, kai ko nasselo beshdo his, kowa hunte thowell pes un peskre koola, un hi pale-tchiddo, bis te well rati.
Koon ko nasseles an-tapras, kowa hunte thowell pes un peskre koola, un hi pale-tchiddo bis te well rati.
Te tchungrell ko nasselo ap jekeste, kai gar pale-tchiddo hi, hunte thowell pes kowa un ninna peskre koola, un hi pale-tchiddo, bis te well rati.
Ninna ko ledertikro kotar, ap koleste ko nasselo klissas, hi pale-tchiddo.

Koon tchomone an-taprell, ap koleste ko nasselo tchiddo oder beshdo his, well pale-tchiddo, bis te well rati. Koon tchomone hidjrell, ap koleste ko nasselo tchiddo oder beshdo his, hunte thowell pes un peskre koola, un hi pale-tchiddo, bis te well rati.
Te taprell ko nasselo jekes an, un leskre wasta his gar thodo, palle hunte thowell pes kowa, kai an-tapedo was, un peskre koola, un hi pale-tchiddo bis te well rati.
Kol tchare, hoi dran tchik kerdo hi, un kolen ko nasselo an-tapras, hunte wenn paash dino. Halauter, hoi dran kasht kerdo was, un kolestar an-tapedo was, hunte well an pani tele thodo.
Te well ko nasselo pale sasto, ginell lo peske efta diwessa tele. Palle thowell lo peskre koola un thowell pes djudjo panjeha tele; palle hi lo pale erligo.
Ap o ochtato diwes anell lo dui diwje taube oder dui wawar taube pash o rashajeste glan o wudar o plachteno kherestar, kai o baro Dewel djiwell.

Ko rashai marell koi jek, te well ko pale-tchiddo koowa krik lino, un koi wawar, te well li tseles chatchedo o baro Debleske. Jaake krell o rashai, te well ko mursh, kai dran peskro nasslepen pale-tchiddo his, pale erligo glan o baro Debleste.
Te djal i mursheske jek tele, palle thowell lo peskro tselo kerpro tele, un job well pale-tchiddo, bis te well rati.
Leskro tselo an-ripen un haki ledertikro kotar, ap koleste kowa was, hunte well tele thodo un well pale-tchiddo bis te well rati.
Te sowell i mursh i djuwjah, un leske djal jek tele, hunte thowenn pen kol dui, un hi pale-tchiddo, bis te well rati.
Te hi i djuwjat peskri djuwjakro koowa, palle atchell li efta diwessa pale-tchiddo. Hakeno, kai lat an-taprell, well pale-tchiddo, bis te well rati.
Un halauter, kai li an kau tsiro pre tchiddo oder beshdo his, hi pale-tchiddo.
Hakeno, kai lakro tchiben an-taprell, hunte thowell pes un peskre koola, un atchell pale-tchiddo, bis te well rati.
Hakeno, kai kowa an-taprell, kai li pre-beshdo his, hunte thowell pes un peskre koola un atchell pale-tchiddo, bis te well rati.
Un koon tchomone an-taprell, hoi kote tchiddo his, kai li tchiddo oder beshdo his, atchell pale-tchiddo bis te well rati.
Te hi i mursh pash jekate tchiddo, un lat well peskri djuwjakro koowa, palle hi lo efta diwessa pale-tchiddo. Un ko tchiben, kai job tchiddo his, well pale-tchiddo.
Te hi i djuwjat peskri djuwjakro koowa bud diwessa oder an i tsiro, kai hunte well kowa gar, palle hi li an kau tselo tsiro pale-tchiddo.
Hako tchiben, kai li tchiddo hi, un hako koowa, kai li pre-beshdo hi an ko tsiro, hi pale-tchiddo.
Kowa, kai tchomone kolestar an-taprell, kowa hi pale-tchiddo, un hunte thowell pes un peskre koola, un atchell pale-tchiddo bis te well rati.
Te was li pale sasto un ratell buder gar, ginell li peske efta diwessa tele, pal kolende hi li pale erligo.
Ap o ochtato diwes anell li dui diwje taube oder dui wawar taube pash o rashajeste glan o wudar o Debleskro plachteno kherestar.

Ko rashai marell koi jek tauba, te well o pale-tchiddo koowa krik lino, un koi wawar, te well li tseles chatchedo o baro Debleske. Jaake krell o rashai, te well koi djuwel, kai ratas un doleske pale-tchiddo his, pale erligo.

Un o baro Dewel penas ap o Mose un ap o Aron: Denn i Israelitarjen trad, te atchenn le i kotar dur miro kherestar an ko tsiro, kai hi le pale-tchiddo, te krenn le gar koi platsa pale-tchiddo, kai me djiwau mank lende, te merenn le gar.
Pal kal laba hunte well kerdo i mursheha, dran koleskro mass tchomone win nashell, un koleske jek tele djal, jaake te was lo pale-tchiddo.
Un pal kal laba hunte well kerdo i djuwjah, kolat peskri djuwjakro koowa hi, un i mursheha, kai sowell khetne i djuwjah, kolat peskri djuwjakro koowa hi.
Pal kowa, kai anan o Aroneskre dui tchawe jaake sungepaskro koowa glan o baro Debleste, har kowa gar tchatcho his, un doleske meran, penas o baro Dewel ap o Moseste:

Pen tiro phraleske, o Aroneske, te djal lo gar hako tsireske an o kutch isema an o Debleskro kheer, te merell lo gar. An koi isema, hoi pal ko kotar than hi, sikrau me man an i wolka pral ko sonakaskro pralstuno kotar, hoi ap o mochton tchiddo hi, kai mire deesh laba dren hi.

Te djal lo koi dren, hunte anas lo glan kowa i terno gurum, hoi well maredo, te well i doosh un o pale-tchiddo koowa krik lino, ninna hunte anas lo i bakro, koleskro tselo mass chatchedo well o Debleske.

Glanstunes hunte thowell lo pes, un riwell i rashajengre koola an: ko laintikro gad, un ko laintikro cholop koi tel. Job pandell i pereskro laintikro pandepen trul peste, un i shereskro pandepen trul peskro shero.

I Israelitarja anenn leske dui mursh busja un jek bakro. I busja wenn maredo, te well i doosh un o pale-tchiddo koowa krik lino. Un o bakro well maredo, te well leskro tselo mass chatchedo o Debleske.
O Aron anell peske un peskri familjake i gurum, te well lo maredo, te well lengri doosh un lengro pale-tchiddo koowa krik lino, un lauter pale mishto mank o baro Debleste un lende.
Palle lell job kol dui mursh busja un anell len pash o baro Debleste glan o wudar leskro plachteno kherestar.
O Aron witsrell dui tikne barra, te sikrenn le, hawi busni o baro Debleske hi, un hawi busni an o mulo tato them tradedo well.
Palle marell lo koi busni, hoi o baro Debleske hi, te well i doosh un o pale-tchiddo koowa krik lino.
Koi wawar busni well djides glan o baro Debleste tardo, un lake well i doosh i menshendar pre-tchiddo. Palle well li an o mulo tato them tradedo.
O Aron marell ko gurum, te well i doosh un o pale-tchiddo koowa lestar un leskri familjatar krik lino, un jon tchatcho un erligo tardo hi glan o baro Debleste.

Palle djal lo pash ko sonakaskro bob, hoi glan o baro Debleste tardo hi, un lell kolestar i sasterno tcharo pherdo kasht, hoi chatchell, un dui wasta pherdo sungepaskro koowa, un djal koleha pal ko wudar dran than an i kutch isema.

Kote tchiwell lo ko sungepaskro koowa ap i jag, te djal i jagakro ducho win un tchakrell ko pralstuno kotar ap ko mochton, kai o Debleskre deesh laba dren hi. Kowa hunte krell lo doleske, te merell lo gar.
Un job lell ko ratestar ko gurumestar, un witsrell kowa peskro gushteha glan ap o pralstuno kotar. Un ap koi platsa glan o mochton witsrell lo peskro gushteha efta kope tchomone ko ratestar.

Palle marell job koi mursh busni, te well i doosh un o pale-tchiddo koowa i menshendar Israel krik lino. Un job djal ko rateha pal i wudar dran than an i kutch isema, un krell ko rateha jaake, har lo les ko rateha ko gurumestar kras. Job witsrell peskro gushteha tchomone ap o pralstuno kotar, hoi ap o mochton tchiddo hi, un ap koi platsa glan o mochton.

Un jaake krell lo, te well o pale-tchiddo koowa un koi doosh, hoi i Israelitarja ap pende anan – lengro tselo tchilatcho koowa, dran o Debleskri kutch isema krik lino. Un jaake hunte krell lo ko tselo Debleskro plachteno khereha. Kau kheer hi tardo ap i platsa, kai i Israelitarja djiwenn. Un koi doosh, hoi jon ap pende anenn un lengro pale-tchiddo koowa krell ninna o Debleskro kheer pale-tchiddo.

Kek mensho hunte well an o Debleskro kheer an ko tselo tsiro, kai djal o Aron an o kutch isema dren, un krell te well o pale-tchiddo koowa un koi doosh krik lino lestar, leskri familjatar un i tsele Israelendar.

Palle djal job win pash koi chatchepaskri, hoi glan o baro Debleskro plachteno kheer tardo hi, un lell tchomone ko gurumeskro ratestar un koi busjakro ratestar, un makell kowa ap i shinga, hoi ap i star ekke ap koi chatchepaskri hi, te well koi doosh un ko pale-tchiddo koowa krik lino fun koi chatchepaskri.

Un job tchiwell peskro gushto an o rat, un witsrell tchomone ko ratestar ap i chatchepaskri. Kowa krell lo efta kope, te well i Israelengri doosh un lengro pale-tchiddo koowa krik lino, hoi ap i chatchepaskri hi. Un i chatchepaskri well pale djudjo glan o baro Debleskre jaka.

Te kras o Aron halauter, te well i doosh un o pale-tchiddo koowa krik lino dran o Debleskri kutch isema, dran o tselo Debleskro plachteno kheer un dran i chatchepaskri, palle anell lo koi djidi mursh busni kai,

un tchiwell peskre dui wasta ap lakro shero, un penell haki doosh un hako tchilatchepen, hoi i Israelitarja kran. Jaake tchiwell lo kowa lauter ap i busjakro shero. Palle mukell lo lat i murshestar, kai koleske koi tardo hi, krik te tradell an o mulo tato them.
Kai mursh busni hidjrell lengri tseli doosh peha an o diwjo mulo them. Un kote atchell li.
Pal kowa djal o Aron an o Debleskro plachteno kheer un riwell kol laintikre koola win, hoi job ap peste riwas, har djas lo an o kheer dren. Un kote tchiwell lo len pale tele.

Palle thowell lo pes ap i Debleskri platsa, un riwell peskre koola an. Palle djal lo pale win, marell kol dui bakre, ko jek peske, un ko wawar i menshenge Israel, un chatchrell lengro tselo mass o baro Debleske, te well i doosh un o pale-tchiddo koowa krik lino lestar un kol menshendar Israel.
Kol thulle kotja kol viechendar, hoi maredo wan, te well i doosh un o pale-tchiddo koowa krik lino, kal kotja chatchrell lo ninna ap o Debleskri chatchepaskri.
Ko mursh, kai tradas koi mursh busni an o mulo diwjo them, hunte thowell pes un peskre koola, glan te nai djal lo pale ap i platsa, kai i menshe djiwenn.

Kowa, hoi pral atchas ko terno gurumestar un koi mursh busjatar, kolengro rat an i kutch isema anlo was, te well i doosh un o pale-tchiddo koowa krik lino, kol kotja anell jek win glan i platsa, kai i menshe hi, un chatchrell kote lauter, koi hauta, ko mass, un kol buke.
Ko mursh, kai kowa lauter chatchras, kowa hunte thowell pes un peskre koola. Pal kowa nai well lo pale ap i platsa, kai i menshe djiwenn.

Kawa lauter hunte well kerdo ap o deshto diwes an o eftato tchon. Un jaake hunte krenn tumer hako tsireske. Ma chan ap ko diwes! Ma krenn i budi, tumer gar un witar gar i wi-themarja, kai mank tumende djiwenn.
Ap kau diwes well tumari tseli doosh un ko tselo pale-tchiddo koowa, hoi ap tumende hi, krik lino. Un lauter well pale mishto mank o baro Debleste un tumende.
Kau Debleskro diwes hi i diwes, kai han kokres o baro Debleske koi. Un tumer nai krenn kek budi, un chan tchi. Jaake well kawa kerdo an hako tsiro, hoi wella.

Un kokres sawo rashai krell, te well i doosh un o pale-tchiddo koowa krik lino, koleske djet ap leskro shero tchoredo was, te was lo rashai pal peskro dadeste, o Aroneste. Un job hunte riwell kol laintikre koola an, hoi i rashajenge hi,
un lell i doosh un o pale-tchiddo koowa krik, hoi hi an o Debleskri kutch isema, an o tselo Debleskro plachteno kheer, ap i chatchepaskri, ap i rashaja un ap i tsele menshende Israel.

Jek kopo an o bersh hunte well kowa jaake kerdo, te well i tseli doosh un o tselo pale-tchiddo koowa i Israelendar krik lino. Ap kau lab hunte rikrenn tumen hako tsireske. Un o Aron kras halauter jaake, har o baro Dewel kowa o Moseske penas.
O baro Dewel penas ap o Mose:
Pen ap o Aron un leskre mursh tchawende un ap i tsele Israelitarja: Kawa hi, hoi o baro Dewel tumenge penell:

Hako mursh dran o kheer Israel, kai kamell i gurum, i bakro oder i busni te marell, hunte krell kowa glan o wudar o Debleskro plachteno kherestar, te well ko viecho o baro Debleske dino. Job hunte krell kowa gar ap i platsa, kai i menshe djiwenn, witar gar glan koi platsa. Te rikrell lo pes gar ap kowa, anell lo rat ap peste har jek, kai i menshes marell. Sawo mensho well pale-tchiddo un nai djiwell buder gar mank peskre menshende.

Bis kanna maran i Israelitarja pengre viechen win ap o them. Kanna hunte anenn le len o baro Debleske glan o wudar leskro plachteno kherestar pash o rashajeste. Un kote wenn le maredo, te chan le len khetne glan o baro Debleste.

O rashai lell ko rat un witsrell tchomone lestar ap o baro Debleskri chatchepaskri, hoi glan o wudar leskro plachteno kherestar tardo hi. Un chatchrell o thulepen ko viechestar koi pre. Un o latcho sungepen, hoi well win, sungell mishto o baro Debleste.

I Israelitarja hunte marenn buder kek viechen i bengenge, kolenge jon kanna gomme palla nashenn. Ap kowa hunte rikrenn le pen, ninna lengre tchawenge un kolengre tchawenge un jaake dureder hako tsireske.

Tu peness lenge: Hako mursh dran o kheer Israel, ninna hako wi-themari, kai mank tumende djiwell, kai kamell i vieches o baro Debleske te marell, sau viecho, koleskro tselo mass chatchedo well, oder sau viecho, hoi chan le khetne glan o baro Debleste,
kowa hunte anell les glan o wudar o Debleskro plachteno kherestar, te well lo kote o baro Debleske maredo. Koon kowa gar krell, well pale-tchiddo un nai djiwell buder gar mank peskre menshende.
Hako Israelitari, ninna hako wi-themari, kai mank tumende djiwell, kai rat chal, hawo ninna hi, koleske sikrau miro dumo, un krau, te djiwell lo buder gar mank mire menshende.

An o rat hi o djipen. Un me kamau, te well lo ap i chatchepaskri anlo, te well i doosh un o pale-tchiddo koowa tumendar krik lino. An o rat hi o djipen. Doleske lau leha i doosh un o pale-tchiddo krik.
Doleske penom me ap i Israelitarja: Kek tumendar chal rat. Witar kek wi-themari, kai mank tumende djiwell, chal rat.
Hako Israelitari un hako wi-themari, kai taprell penge i diwjo viecho oder i tchirklo, hoi jek nai chal, hunte mukell leskro rat win nashell ap i phub un tchakrell tchik koi pre.
An o rat hi o djipen. Doleske penom me ap i Israelitarja: Ma chan rat! Koon les chal, well pale-tchiddo un nai djiwell buder gar mank peskre menshende!

Hakeno, kai chal i viecho, hoi meras oder mulo dandedo was, kowa hunte thowell pes un peskre koola, un atchell pale-tchiddo, bis te well rati. Koi pal hi lo pale erligo. Hi jek, te hi kowa i Israelitari oder i wi-themari.
Te thowell lo pes gar, witar gar peskre koola, hunte hidjrell lo peskri phagi.
O baro Dewel penas ap o Mose:
Pen ap i Israelitarja: Me, o baro Dewel, hom tumaro Dewel.
Ma djiwenn jaake har i Egiptarja, an kolengro them djiwan, witar gar har kolla an o them Kanaan, kote kai tumen anau. Ma djiwenn pal lengro koowa.
Pal miro tchatchepen hunte djiwenn, un krenn, hoi me tumendar kamau. Me, o baro Dewel, hom tumaro Dewel.
Doleske krenn, hoi me tumendar kamau, un djiwenn pal miro tchatchepen. I mensho, kai rikrell pes ap kowa, koles hi tchatchepah o djipen. Me hom o baro Dewel.
Kek tumendar hunte sowell i djuwjah dran peskri familja. Kowa penau me, o baro Dewel.
Tu sowess gar tiri dah, te aness kek ladj ap tiro dadeste. Joi hi tiri dai.
Tu sowess gar i wawar romjah tiro dadestar, te aness kek ladj ap tiro dadeste.
Tu sowess gar tiri phenjah, koi tchai tiro dadestar oder tiri datar; hi jek te was li bares an tiri familja oder an i wawar familja.
Tu sowess gar i mit i tchai tiro tchawestar oder tiri tchatar, te aness kek ladj ap tute.
Tu sowess gar mit i tchai tiro dadeskri romjatar. Joi hi tiri pheen.
Tu sowess gar tiri bibjah, koi pheen tiro dadestar. Joi hi leskro ratestar.
Tu sowess gar tiri bibjah, koi pheen tiri datar. Joi hi lakro ratestar.
Tu sowess gar i romjah tiro kakestar. Joi hi tiri bibi.
Tu sowess gar tiro tchaweskri romjah.
Tu sowess gar tiro phraleskri romjah, te aness kek ladj ap tiro phraleste.
Tu sowess gar i djuwjah un ninna mit lakri tchai, oder lakro tchaweskri tchai oder lakri tchakri tchai. Kalla hi lakro ratestar. Kawa wals i wi-ladjedo koowa.
Tu less gar i phenjat tiri romjatar, te well li tiri duiti romni, jaake rah har tiri romni djiwell.
Tu sowess gar i djuwjah jaake rah har lat peskri djuwjakro koowa hi.
Tu sowess gar i romjah i wawarestar, te kress tut gar pale-tchiddo.
Tu chatchress kek tire tchawendar o chocheno debleske Moloch. Sau koowa sikrals, te hom me, tiro Dewel, tuke tchi moldo. Me hom o baro Dewel!
Kek mursh te sowell i wawar mursheha. I baro pale-tchiddo koowa hi sau kowa.
Kek mursh un kek djuwel te sowell i viecheha. Koon kowa krell, krell pes pale-tchiddo un anell bari ladj ap peste.
Ma krenn tumen sau koweha pale-tchiddo! Kowa lauter kras kol wawar menshe pale-tchiddo, kolen me glan tumende dran o them win tradau.
O tselo them was koleha pale-tchiddo kerdo. Me anau lengri doosh ap lende pale, un krau, te wenn kol menshe win tradedo dran ko them, kai le djiwenn.
Doleske krenn kowa, hoi me tumendar kamau, un djiwenn pal miro tchatchepen, tumer un ninna ko wi-themari, kai mank tumende djiwell! Krenn kek sawo pale-tchiddo koowa,
hoi kolla kran, kai glan tumende kate djiwan un o them pale-tchiddo kran.
Te krenn tumer kau them ninna pale-tchiddo, wenn tumer dran kau them win tradedo har kol wawar menshe, kai glan tumende kai his.
Hakeno, koon sau pale-tchiddo koowa krell, well infam, un nai djiwell buder gar mank peskre menshende.
Doleske, djiwenn jaake har me tumenge penom! Ma krenn ko pale-tchiddo koowa, hoi kolla kran, kai glan tumende kate his! Ma krenn tumen sawo koweha pale-tchiddo! Me, o baro Dewel, hom tumaro Dewel.
O baro Dewel penas ap o Mose:
Pen ap i tsele Israelitarja: Me, o baro Dewel, hom tumaro Dewel. Kek wawar hi har me. An mande hi kek tchilatchepen. Un tumer hunte djiwenn jaake har i Debleskre menshe djiwenn.
Hakeno tumendar hunte dikell pre ap peskri date un ap peskro dadeste, un hunte rikrell o Debleskro diwes! Me, o baro Dewel, hom tumaro Dewel.
Ma nashenn i chochene deblen palla! Krenn tumen kek debla tumare wastentsa! Me, o baro Dewel, hom tumaro Dewel.
Te anenn tumer i viecho o baro Debleske, te chan les khetne glan leste, palle krenn kowa jaake, te dikap latches ap tumende!
Chan ko mass ko emligo diwes, kai maran ko vieches, oder ko wawar diwes. Hi gomme o triinto diwes tchomone pral, hunte well kowa an i jag chatchedo.
Te chal jek ap o triinto diwes gomme ko massestar, palle dikell o baro Dewel gar latches ap kowa un ap koleste, kai anas ko viecho glan leste. O mass was pale-tchiddo.

Un koon chal kolestar, hunte hidjrell peskri doosh, hoi job koleha ap peste las. Job kras, har te wals ko viecho, hoi mange, o baro Debleske, dino was, gar feteder har hako wawar mass. Sawo mensho well pale-tchiddo un nai djiwell buder gar mank peskre menshende.

Te anenn tumer o djob dren ap tumaro them, tchinenn gar o djob ap i tseli kotar phub tele. Mukenn tchomone ap i rigja tardo. Djan witar gar i duito kopo pral ko kotar phub, te hadenn kowa pre, hoi tele peras.

Jaake krenn ninna tumare drakentsa. Har anan len dren, ma djan i duito kopo ap ko kotar phub, te anenn kolla dren, kai pral atchan, witar gar sawe, kai tele peran. Kol tchorwelenge, un kolenge dran i wi-them, mukenn len pral! Me, baro Dewel, hom tumaro Dewel.
Ma tchorenn! Ma rakrenn chochepen! Ma krenn chocheno koowa jek o wawareske!
