Ma denn tumen i chocheno sowel pash miro lab! Sau koweha anenn tumer ladj ap miro lab. Me, o baro Dewel, hom tumaro Dewel.
Tu rikress gar o wawares tele un randess les gar win. Tu dess i budepaskres, kai budrell tuke jek diwes peskre lowe ap i rat, un rikress kol lowe gar pral i rat pash tute.
Ma praasse jekes, kai nai shunell gar. Un ma tchip i koreleske tchomone an o drom, te perell lo wergel. Rike tuke tiro Debles glan i jaka pash halauter, hoi kreh! Me hom o baro Dewel.
Te well o tchatchepen win kerdo, palle de koles peskro tchatchepen, koles tchatcho hi! Ma tserde koles glan, kai tchorwelo hi, witar gar koles, kai brawelo hi. Hakeno hunte lell peskro tchatchepen.
Ma dja trujel un pen chochepen pral i wawarende! Te hunte peneh win glan i tchatchepangre, ma pen chochepen, te aness o wawares an o merepen. Me hom o baro Dewel.
Te choiral tut pral jekeste tire menshendar, ma hidje tiri choli tuha trujel. Pen leske, hoi lo gar mishto kras, te aness kek doosh ap tute.
Ma de o tchilatchepen pale, hoi i wawar ap tute kras, un hidje leske tchi palla. Tu wess jaake latches ap leste, har hal latches ap tute kokres. Me hom o baro Dewel.

Djiwenn pal kol laba, hoi tumende sikrenn, hoi me tumendar kamau! Vieche dran dui wawar mass, mukess tu gar khetne te well, te nai krenn le terne. Ap tiro kotar phub, ma witse dui koowa win, te well kowa bares. I ripen kerdo dran dui wawar thaba, well gar ap tute!
Te hi i murshes i pirni, kai i ginli budepaskretsa hi, un joi hi gar win muklo oder win ginlo, un i wawar mursh sowell lah, hunte lell lo peskri phagi. Kal dui hunte merenn gar.
Ko mursh anell i bakro glan o wudar o baro Debleskro kherestar, te well peskri doosh pale mishto.
Ko rashai marell ko bakro glan o baro Debleste, te well ko mursheskri doosh pale mishto. Un o baro Dewel bistrell leskri doosh, hoi lo ap peste anas.
Te wenn tumer an ko them, un tchiwenn bud ruka an i phub, kolendar tumer nai chan, palle chan gar lendar i glanstune triin bersha, har te wans le pale-tchiddo.
O starto bersh well lauter, hoi kol ruka hidjran, o baro Debleske anlo, te parkrenn tumen pash leste.
An o pantchto bersh chan tumer kowa, hoi kol ruka hidjrenn. Te krenn tumer kowa jaake, palle well kowa hoi tumen dren lenn, budeder un budeder. Me, o baro Dewel, hom tumaro Dewel.
Ma chan mass, kai rat dren hi. Ma durkrenn! Ma krenn bengeskro koowa!
Ma tchinenn tumare balla ap i rigja tumaro sherestar! Ma tchinenn tumari tchor tiknes!
Ma tchinenn tumen an tumaro mass, te meras jek. Kek sikepen krenn ap tumende! Me hom o baro Dewel.
Ma bitche tiri tchai kote, kai i chochene debla an-mangedo wenn, te well li kote i lubni. Tu te kreh kowa, hi sik bud lubja an o them, un o tselo them well pherdo wi-ladjedo koowa.
Rikrenn mire Debleskre diwessa dren, un anenn kek ladj ap miro kheer. Me hom o baro Dewel.
Ma djan pash i durkepangre un pash kolende, kai i mulen putchenn! Ma rodenn sawen pre, te krenn tumen gar pale-tchiddo ap lende. Me, o baro Dewel, hom tumaro Dewel.
Glan phure menshende stess tu pre un dikess pre ap lende. Tu rikress tiro Debles glan tire jaka pash halauter, hoi kreh! Me hom o baro Dewel.
Te djiwell i wi-themarja an tumaro them, palle rikrenn les gar tele!
Djan leha jaake trujel, har te wals lo jek tumendar! Tu wess jaake latches ap leste har hal latches ap tute. Tumer ninna hans wi-themarja an o them Egiptia. Me, o baro Dewel, hom tumaro Dewel.
Krenn kek chochepen, te wenn khetne te krenn o tchatchepen win! Ma chochenn witar gar te dikenn palla, har baro oder pharo oder bud tchomone hi!

I waga, hoi sikrell har pharo tchomone hi, hunte sikrell kowa an o tchatchepen. Ninna kol barra, hoi pre tchiwenn, hunte wenn jaake pharo har tchatcho hi. Un kol pirja, kolentsa tumer palla dikenn, har bud tchomone hi, kolla hunte wenn jaake baro har tchatcho hi. Me, o baro Dewel, hom tumaro Dewel, kai tumen dran o them Egiptia win anas.
Krenn halauter, hoi me tumendar kamau, un rikrenn ap miro tchatchepen! Me hom o baro Dewel.
O baro Dewel penas ap o Mose:

Pen ap i Israelitarja: Koon tumendar jek peskre tchawendar o chocheno debleste, o Moloch, das, kowa hunte merell. I tsele menshe hunte witsrenn les i barrentsa mulo. Kowa hi ninna jaake, te krell sau koowa i wi-themari, kai pash tumende djiwell.

Me dikau tchilatches ap hakeneste, kai kowa krell, un me mukau les buder gar te djiwell mank peskre menshende. Job das jek peskre tchawendar o Molocheste, un kras jaake miro kheer pale-tchiddo, un kras mantsa, har te woms gar kokres o tchatcho Dewel.
Te pandan i Israelitarja pengre jaka glan kowa, hoi ko mursh kras, un denn les gar mulo,
palle dau me kokres ko murshes peskri phagi, ninna leskre menshen. Me mukau les un hakenes, kai ko debles Moloch pal nashas, buder gar mank pengre menshende te djiwell.
Miri choli well ninna ap koleste, kai djal pash i durkepangre un pash kolende, kai i mulen putchenn, te putchell lo lendar, hoi te krell lo. Me mukau les buder gar mank peskre menshende te djiwell.
Me, o baro Dewel, hom tumaro Dewel. Doleske awenn mange kokres koi. Tchi hunte well tardo mank mande un tumende!
Krenn, hoi me tumendar kamau! Rikrenn tumen ap kowa! Me, o baro Dewel, rodom tumen win, te wenn mire menshe.
Te rakrell jek pral peskro dadeste oder peskri date bibacht win, palle hunte well lo mulo dino. Koon sawo koowa krell, ap koleste well leskro rat.
Te sowell jek i romjah i wawarestar, hunte wenn kol dui maredo.
Te sowell i mursh i romjah peskro dadestar, anell lo ladj ap peskro dadeste. Job un koi djuwel hunte hidjrenn pengri phagi, un hunte wenn maredo.
Te sowell i mursh peskro tchaweskri romjah, hunte hidjrenn le pengri phagi un hunte wenn maredo. I baro wi-ladjedo koowa kran le.
Te sowell i mursh i wawar mursheha, krenn le i baro pale-tchiddo koowa. Kol dui hunte hidjrenn le pengri phagi un hunte wenn maredo.
Te lell i mursh i romjat un lakri dat gomme pashel, hi kowa i wi-ladjedo koowa. Job hunte well an i jag chatchedo, un kol dui djuwja ninna. Kamau te well kek wi-ladjedo koowa mank tumende.
Te sowell i mursh i viecheha, palle hunte well lo mulo dino. Un ko viecho well ninna maredo.
Te sowell i djuwel i viecheha, palle dess tu koi djuwjat un ko vieches mulo. Jon hunte hidjrenn pengri phagi, un hunte merenn.

Te sowell i mursh peskri penjah, i tchai leskro dadestar oder leskri datar, hi kowa i bari ladj. Kol dui hunte wenn mulo dino glan i tsele menshende. Ko mursh sowas peskri phenjah, un hunte hidjrell peskri doosh.
Te sowell i mursh i djuwjah, kolat peskri djuwjakro koowa hi, krenn pen kol dui pale-tchiddo, un nai djiwenn buder gar mank pengre menshende.
Kek te sowell i phenjah peskri datar oder peskro dadestar. Koon sawo koowa krell, anell ladj ap peskri bibi. Jon hunte hidjrenn pengri doosh.
Koon i romjah peskro kakestar sowell, anell ladj ap peskro kakeste. Kol dui hunte hidjrenn pengri doosh. Jon merenn kek tchawentsa.
Te sowell i mursh i romjah peskro phralestar, hi kowa i pale-tchiddo koowa. Job anas ladj ap peskro phraleste. Kek tchawe well len.
Krenn kowa, hoi me tumendar kamau un rikrenn tumen ap miro tchatchepen, te wenn gar win tradedo dran ko them, an kowa me tumen anau, te djiwenn koi dren.
Ma djiwenn pal ko koowa, pal kowa i wawar menshe djiwenn, kolen me glan tumende win tradau. Jon kran kau tselo pale-tchiddo koowa, un wan infam glan mire jaka.
Tumenge penau: Lengro them dau tumende, te well lo tumaro. Kowa hi i them, kai bud thud un gwin hi. Me, o baro Dewel, hom tumaro Dewel, un rodom tumen mange dran i wawar themma win.

Doleske ma chan sawe viechen un tchirklen, hoi tchiwom ap i rig, te wenn le tumenge pale-tchiddo. Tumer hunte djinenn, hawe viechen nai chan un hawen nai chan gar, ninna hawe tchirklen nai chan un hawen nai chan gar. Ma krenn tumen pale-tchiddo kol viechentsa un tchirklentsa un tikne viechentsa, hoi djan pral i phub, hoi hi tumenge pale-tchiddo. Te chan tumer sawe viechen, wenn tumer ninna pale-tchiddo.

Me hom o baro Dewel. Kek wawar hi har me. An mande hi kek tchilatchepen. Un tumen rodom win dran i wawar themma, te wenn tumer miro. Doleske hunte wenn kokres mange un djiwenn har i Debleskre menshe djiwenn.
Hako mursh un haki djuwel, kai durkrell oder putchell i mulen, hunte hidjrell peskri phagi un merell. Tumer hunte witsrenn len mulo i barrentsa.
O baro Dewel penas ap o Mose: Pen i rashajenge dran o kheer Aron: Ma taprenn i mules an, te wenn gar pale-tchiddo!
Kokres sawen dran tumare familje nai taprenn an, ninna te wenn tumer palle pale-tchiddo: Tumari dai, tumaro dad, tumaro tchawo, tumari tchai, tumaro phraal,
tumari pheen, kai gomme gar romedini hi, un an tumaro kheer djiwell. Kal mulen nai taprenn an, ninna te krell kowa tumen pale-tchiddo.
Ma krenn tumen pale-tchiddo ap jekeste, kai hi romedino jekeha tumare menshendar!
Tumer rashaja, ma tchinenn tumare balla pral ap tumaro shero tele, witar gar tumari tchor. Krenn tumenge kek tchinepen an tumaro mass!

Tumer rashaja hunte djiwenn jaake, te han kokres tumaro Debleske, un hunte krenn tchi, hoi anell ladj ap leskro lab. Tumer han kolla, kai anenn leske chapen, hoi well leske chatchedo. Doleske hunte krenn tchi, hoi krell tumen pale-tchiddo.
I rashai hunte well peskro Debleske koi. Doleske hunte romedinerell lo kek lubni, witar gar i tchai, kai i murshestar an-tapedo was, witar gar i djuwel, kai peskro romestar muklo was.

Tumer Israelitarja, i rashai hi tumenge i Debleskro mursh! Job chatchrell glan mande o chapen, hoi mange anlo well. Doleske well lo tumenge i mursh, koles wi-rodom, te budrell lo mange. Me hom o baro Dewel. Kek wawar hi har me. Un tumen rodom mange win, te wenn mire menshe.
Te well i rashajeskri tchai i lubni, anell i bari ladj ap peste un peskro dadeste. Joi well an i jag chatchedo.

O pralstuno rashai, ap koleskro shero o djet tchoredo was, har was lo an peskri budi dren tchiddo, un ap koleste i rashajengre koola hi, kowa mukell peskro shero gar diwjes win dikell. Un kol koola, hoi lo ap peste hi, tserdell lo gar an kotja, ap ko tsiro, kai rowell leskro dji pral i muleste.
Pash kek muleste djal lo, te well lo gar pale-tchiddo, witar gar, te hi ko mulo peskro dad oder peskri dai.

Jaake rah har i mulo an peskro kheer hi, hunte djal lo gar dran o Debleskro kheer win, te krell lo gar o kheer peskro Deblestar pale-tchiddo. Job was djeteha maklo, te well lo i rashai peskro Debleske. Me hom o baro Dewel.
Job nai romedinerell kokres i tchat, kai kek murshestar an-tapedo was,
kek djuwel kolakro rom meras, kek djuwel, kai peskro romestar muklo was, kek lubni, – kokres i tchai i menshendar Israel.
Kowa hunte krell lo, te lell lo gar tchawe, kai pale-tchiddo wans. Me hom o baro Dewel, un rodom les mange win, te well lo miro rashai.
O baro Dewel penas ap o Mose:
Pen ap o Aron: Kek tire tchawendar, kai pal tute wenna, well glan o Debleskri chatchepaskri, te anell lo chapen glan peskro Debleste,
te hi lo korelo, bango, te hi leskro shero oder leskro kerpro gar jaake, har hunte wals lo,
te hi les i phagedo piro oder i phagedo wast,
te hi les i bango dumo, te hi lo jek, kai tikno atchas, oder koles i parno kotar an i jak hi, oder i nasslepen ap peskri hauta hi, oder jek, koleske tella lauter pash dino hi.
Kek mursh, kai well o rashajestar o Aronestar, un kai sawo koowa ap peste hi, nai well glan o Debleskri chatchepaskri, te chatchrell lo chapen o baro Debleske.
Ko chapen, hoi o Debleske anlo was, nai chal lo, ninna ko chapen, hoi kokres i rashajenge hi.

Pash ko wudar dran than, hoi glan koi kutch isema hi, nai djal lo gar, witar gar pash o Debleskri chatchepaskri, te krell lo o Debleskro kheer gar pale-tchiddo. Me hom o baro Dewel, un rodom kau kheer win, te hi lo mange.
Jaake rakras o Mose ap o Aroneste un ap leskre mursh tchawende un ap i tsele Israelitarjen.
O baro Dewel penas ap o Mose:
Pen ap o Aron un ap leskre mursh tchawende, te djan le mishto trujel ko koweha, hoi i Israelitarja mange anenn, te anenn le kek ladj ap mande. Me hom o baro Dewel.

Pen lenge: Kau lab hi hakeneske tumare mursh tchawendar, kai pal tumende wenna: Hakeno lendar, koles i pale-tchiddo koowa ap leste hi, un kai well pash kowa, hoi anan i Israelitarja mange, o baro Debleske, kowa nai atchell buder gar miro rashai. Me hom o baro Dewel.

Kones o Aroneskre tchawendar i djungelo nasslepen ap peskri hauta hi, oder koleske tchomone dran leskro murshkano mass nashell, kowa te chal gar fun ko chapen, hoi mange anlo was, bis te hi lo pale erligo. Hako rashai, koon jekes an tapras, kai kras pes i muleha pale-tchiddo, oder koleske jek tele djas,

kowa well pale-tchiddo, bis te well rati. Kowa hi ninna jaake, te tapras lo i tikno pale-tchiddo vieches an, hoi djal pral i phub, oder i menshes, kai pale-tchiddo hi, hoi kowa ninna hi. Sawo atchell pale-tchiddo, bis te well rati, un nai chal gar fun ko chapen, hoi o baro Debleske anlo well, bis te thowas lo pes.
Te djas o kham tele, palle hi lo pale erligo, un nai chal fun ko chapen, hoi o Debleske anlo was. Kowa hi kowa, kolestar job djiwell.
I mulo un khetne dandedo vieches chal lo gar, te krell lo pes koleha gar pale-tchiddo. Me hom o baro Dewel.

I rashaja hunte rikrenn halauter, hoi lenge penom, te lenn le kek doosh ap pende, un merenn doleske, kai djan le gar o Debleskro koowa jaake trujel, har hunte krans le. Me hom o baro Dewel, un rodom len win, te wenn le mire rashaja.
Kek wawar chal fun ko chapen, hoi mange anlo well, witar gar kowa, kai jek tsiro pash o rashajeste djiwell, oder kowa, kai i diwes pash o rashajeste budrell un lestar plaissedo well.
I budepaskro, koles o rashai peskre lowentsa ginas, kowa nai chal kolestar. Ninna i budepaskres, kai an leskro kheer boldo was, kowa nai chal fun ko chapen.
Te well o rashajeskri tchai i romni i murshestar, kai kek rashai hi, palle chal li gar buder fun ko chapen, hoi glan o baro Debleske anlo was.

Te meras lakro rom oder mukas lat, un lat hi kek tchawe, un joi djal pale an peskro dadeskro kheer, palle nai chal li fun peskro dadeskro chapen jaake har kras li, har li terni his. Kokres kolla dran o rashajeskri familja nai chan fun ko chapen, hoi o baro Debleske anlo was.
Te chas i wawar kolestar, hoi i rashajeske hi, un djinas kowa gar, hunte dell lo ko chapen o rashajeste pale, un gomme o pantchto kotar pashel.
I rashaja hunte mukenn kek wawares kolestar te chal, hoi mange, o baro Debleske, dino was, un kokres i rashaja nai chan.
Te mukenn le wawar Israelitarjen kolestar te chal, anenn le bari doosh ap i Israelitarjen. Me hom o baro Dewel. Un kowa, hoi i Israelitarja mange anenn, hi kokres mange.
O baro Dewel penas ap o Mose:

Pen ap o Aron un ap leskre mursh tchawende, un ap i tsele Israelitarjen: Hako Israelitari un hako wi-themari, kai pash tumende djiwell, un kai kamell o baro Debleske i vieches te anell, te well kowa leske chatchedo, – nai well te dell lo les pestar, nai well, te dell lo les pal kowa, hoi lo pes sowel das,
palle hunte rodell lo i vieches win i grumjendar, bakrendar oder busjendar, hoi i mursh hi un sasto, te dikell o baro Dewel latches ap leste.
Te anenn tumer leske i vieches, hoi gar sasto hi, dikell lo gar latches ap tumende.

Te anell jek i grumjat oder i bakres glan o baro Debleste, hoi chan i menshe glan leste – nai well i viecho, hoi lo pestar das, nai well i viecho, koleha job kamell peskri sowel, hoi job das, dren rikrell – palle hunte well ko viecho sasto, te dikell o baro Dewel latches ap leste.
I viecho, hoi korelo oder dukedo hi, jek, koles i phagedi heri hi, oder i dukepen oder i nasslepen ap i hauta hi, sawes ma anenn glan o baro Debleste, te chatchrenn les ap leskri chatchepaskri.

Grumja un bakre, kolen i lengsteder heri hi oder i tikneder heri, sau vieches nai anell jek glan o baro Debleste, te dell lo les pestar kokres. Te anell lo les, te rikrell lo peskri sowel dren, hi kowa gar latcho glan o baro Debleskre jaka.
I viecho koleskre jare paash dino, oder win tchinlo hi, ma anenn glan o baro Debleste! An tumaro them ma krenn sau koowa ap i viecheste!
Ginenn witar gar sau viecho jekestar, kai kek Israelitari hi, te anenn les glan tumaro Debleste. Sawe vieche hi buder gar bud moldo. Ap sawende dikell o baro Dewel buder gar latches.
O baro Dewel penas dureder ap o Mose:

Te well i tikni grumni, i tikno bakro oder i tikni busni boldo, palle well kau ternepen efta diwessa pash peskri date. Pal o ochtato diwes nai aneh les o baro Debleske, te well les leske maredo. Palle dikell lo latches ap leste.
Ma marenn i grumni oder i bakro un leskro ternepen ap ko emligo diwes!

Te marenn tumer i vieches o baro Debleske, te parkrenn tumen koleha pash leste, palle chan les ap ko emligo diwes, te dikell o baro Dewel latches ap tumende! Ma mukenn tchomone pral bis ap o wawar diwes! Me hom o baro Dewel.
Rikrenn tumen ap kowa, hoi tumenge penau! Un djiwenn pal kowa! Me hom o baro Dewel.
Ma anenn ladj ap miro lab! Tumer, Israelitarja, hunte djinenn, te hom me kokres tumaro Dewel! Me, o baro Dewel, rodom tumen win, te wenn mire menshe,
un anom tumen dran o them Egiptia win, te wap tumaro Dewel, me, o baro Dewel.
O baro Dewel penas ap o Mose:
Pen ap i Israelitarja: Kalla hi i bare diwessa, kai wenn tumer khetne, te well o baro Dewel sharedo.

Rikrenn o Debleskro diwes! Shob diwessa budrenn, ap o eftato diwes krenn kek budi! Ko diwes hi o baro Debleske. Ap leste awenn khetne glan leste! Ap kau diwes krenn kek budi, kai tumer ninna djiwenna!
Kalla hi i bare diwessa, kai wenn tumer khetne, te well o baro Dewel sharedo. Denn kal diwessa win gole ap pengro tsiro.
Ap o 14. (deesh-te-starto) diwes an o ersto tchon, har o kham tele djas, well ko diwes, hoi hi o baro Debleske. Kau diwes kharell Passa.
Un o 15. (deesh-te-pantchto) diwes ninna an ko tchon, hi ko ersto diwes kol diwessa, kai hunte chan kek maro dran shutlo jarro. Efta diwessa chan tumer kek maro, an koleste shutlo jarro hi.
Ap o ersto diwes hunte wenn khetne glan o baro Debleste. Kek hunte budrell ap ko diwes.
Efta diwessa chatchrenn viechen o baro Debleske. Ap o eftato diwes hunte wenn pale khetne, te well o baro Dewel sharedo. Ap ko diwes hunte krenn witar kek budi.
O baro Dewel penas ap o Mose:
Pen ap i Israelitarja: Te wenn an ko them, hoi me tumen dau, un tumer tchinenn o newo djob tele un pandenn les khetne, palle anenn ko ersto pandepen newo djob glan o rashajeste.
Job hadell kowa pre glan o baro Debleste, te sikrell lo, kai kowa o Debleske hi. Palle dikell o baro Dewel latches ap tumende. Kowa krell o rashai ap o diwes pal o Debleskro diwes.
Ap ko diwes, kai hadell o rashai tumaro newo djob pre glan o Debleste, hunte anenn tumer i terno bakro, hoi jek bersh phuro hi un sasto hi, te well lo chatchedo o baro Debleske.

Koi pashel anenn glan leste dui-te-paash kilogramme latcho jarro, kai djet dren hi. Kau chapen well leske chatchedo. Un ko latcho sungepen, hoi well win, sungella mishto o baro Debleske. Koi pashel anenn jek litari mool, hoi well win tchoredo glan leste.

Chan kek maro dran o newo djob, witar gar peklo djob oder terno djob, bis te anan tumaro Debleske leskro kotar kolestar. Kau lab hi tumenge un tumare tchawenge, kai pal tumende wenna, kanna un hako tsireske, kai tumer ninna djiwenna.
Efta tsele kurke pal ko Debleskro diwes, kai anas o rashai tumaro newo djob o baro Debleske,
ap ko diwes pal o eftato Debleskro diwes – kowa hi o 50. (paash-sheelto) diwes – anenn tumer i newo chapen o baro Debleske.

Haki familja anell dui mare, hakeno kerdo dran dui-te-paash kilogramme latcho jarro. Kol dui mare hadell o rashai pre glan o baro Debleste, te sikrell lo, kai kolla leske hi. Kal mare hi peklo jarreha, kai shutlo jarro dren hi. Kal mare, hoi o baro Debleske anlo wenn, hunte wenn kerdo dran newo gib.

Pash ko maro anenn tumer efta bakre, jek bersh phuro un sasto, ninna jek terno gurum un dui mursh bakre. Kolla wenn maredo un chatchedo o baro Debleske. Khetne lentsa well leske o chapen dran jarro chatchedo, un i mool glan leste win tchoredo. Un ko latcho sungepen, hoi well win, sungella mishto o baro Debleske.
Koi pashel anenn leske i mursh busni, te well tumari doosh un tumaro pale-tchiddo koowa krik lino. Marenn ninna dui bakre, hoi jek bersh phuro hi, te chan len khetne glan o baro Debleste.
O rashai hadell kolen pre glan o baro Debleste, ninna kol mare dran o newo jarro, te sikrell lo, kai jon o baro Debleske hi. Un i rashaja nai chan kowa.

Denn win gole, te wenn khetne ap kau diwes o baro Debleske. Kek budi hunte krenn tumer ap ko diwes. Kau lab hi tumenge un tumare tchawenge, kai pal tumende wenna, kanna un hako tsireske, kai tumer ninna djiwenna.

An ko tsiro, kai tchinenn o djob tele, hoi ap tumaro kotar phub bares was, mukenn tchomone ap i rigja tardo. Ma djan witar gar i duito kopo pral ko kotar phub, te hadenn kowa pre, hoi tele peras. Mukenn kowa i tchorwelenge un kolenge dran i wi-them! Me, o baro Dewel, hom tumaro Dewel.
O baro Dewel penas ap o Mose:
Pen ap i Israelitarja: Ko ersto diwes an o eftato tchon hunte well tumen sawo diwes, kai budrenn gar. Ap ko diwes phurdenn an i phurdepangre, un awenn khetne glan o baro Debleste.
Krenn kek budi, un anenn o baro Debleske viechen un chapen, hoi well leske chatchedo ap leskri chatchepaskri.
O baro Dewel rakras o Moseha un mukas les i Israelenge te penell:

O deshto diwes an kau eftato tchon hi o diwes, kai well halauter krik lino, hoi mank tumende un o baro Debleste tardo hi. Ap ko diwes chan tchi un awenn khetne glan leste un anenn leske viechen un chapen, hoi wenn leske chatchedo.
Kek budi krenn ap ko diwes! Kau diwes hi o diwes, kai well halauter krik lino, hoi mank tumende un tumaro baro Debleste tardo hi.
Hakeno, koon rikrell pes gar pale o chapastar, kowa well pale-tchiddo hako tsireske, un nai djiwell buder gar mank peskre menshende.
Un hakeno, kai budrell ap ko diwes, koles mukell o baro Dewel te merell.
Doleske, krenn kek budi! Kau lab hi tumenge un tumare tchawenge, kai pal tumende wenna, kanna un hako tsireske, kai tumer ninna djiwenna.
Kau diwes hi i baro diwes tumenge, kai hunte krenn kek budi, un chan tchi fun rati ap o enjato diwes bis te well pale rati ap o wawar diwes.
O baro Dewel penas ap o Mose:

Pen ap i Israelitarja: An o eftato tchon hi kol bare diwessa, kai djiwenn tumer an patjengre khera efta diwessa, te well o baro Dewel sharedo. Ko ersto diwes hi o 15. (deesh-te-pantchto) diwes an kau tchon.
Ap kau diwes awenn khetne glan o baro Debleste! Kek budi hunte krenn tumer.

Efta diwessa anenn viechen o baro Debleske, te wenn le leske maredo un chatchedo. Ap o ochtato diwes awenn pale khetne glan o baro Debleste, un marenn un chatchrenn viechen leske. An kal bare diwessa wenn tumer khetne o baro Debleske, un hunte krenn kek budi.

Kalla hi kol bare diwessa, kai hunte wenn tumer khetne glan o baro Debleste, te anenn leske viechen un chapen, jaake har hako diweske glan tchinlo hi: sawe vieche, kai tseles chatchedo wenn, un sawe, kolen chan tumer khetne glan o baro Debleste, ninna chapen dran djob, un mool, hoi glan leste win tchoredo well.
Ninna rikrenn tumer hako kurko o Debleskro diwes dren! Un anenn o baro Debleske ko wawar koowa, hoi glan tchinlo hi, un kowa, hoi tumer tumendar denn, un kowa, hoi tumer sowel dan, leske te dell.

Ap o 15. (deesh-te-pantchto) diwes an o eftato tchon, an ko tsiro, har anan halauter dren, hoi ap tumari phub bares was, krenn efta diwessa i festo o baro Debleske. O ersto diwes un o ochtato diwes hi i diwes, kai krenn kek budi.

Ap o ersto diwes lenn shukar rukengre, hoi ap i ruka bares wan, ninna palmtikre patria, pappeltikre kashta pengre patjentsa un wawar kashta bud patjentsa, un awenn efta diwessa bachteles glan tumaro baro Debleste.
Krenn kowa leske hako bersh efta diwessa an o eftato tchon. Kau lab hi tumenge un tumare tchawenge, kai pal tumende wenna, kanna un hako tsireske.
Djiwenn an ko tsiro an patjengre khera, hakeno, kai an o them Israel djiwell.
Krenn kowa jaake, te djinenn tumare tchawe, te mukom me, o baro Dewel, i Israelitarjen an patjengre khera te djiwell, har anom len win dran o them Egiptia. Me, o baro Dewel, hom tumaro Dewel.
Kal tsele laba penas o Mose i Israelenge, te djinenn le har te rikrenn le kol bare diwessa dren, te well o baro Dewel sharedo.
O baro Dewel penas ap o Mose:

Pen ap i Israelitarja, te anenn le tuke o latcheder olivtikro djet, te nai chatchenn le haki rat i tikne momlia ap i momelengri an o Debleskro plachteno kheer. Kai momelengri well tardo win glan ko kutch kotar than, hoi glan ko mochton pandlo hi, kai o Debleskre deesh laba dren hi. Kote dell o Aron jak, te chatchell i momelengri i tseli rat. Kawa te well jaake kerdo hako tsireske pash i Israelitarja un lengre tchawende, kai pal lende wenna.
O Aron hunte dell jak ap i momlia ap i sonakaskri momelengri, te chatchenn le hako tsiro glan o baro Debleste.
Muk deesh-te-dui mare te pekell dran latcho jarro, hako maro dran dui-te-paash kilogramme jarro!
Un tchip len dui kope shob kotja khetne ap koi sonakaskri chapaskri glan o baro Debleste.
Tchip latcho sungepaskro koowa ap kal mare. Ko sungepaskro koowa well chatchedo o baro Debleske, un jaake well siklo, te hi kal mare o baro Debleske.
Hako kurko ap o Debleskro diwes tchiwell o Aron newe mare glan o baro Debleste. Jaake hunte krenn i Israelitarja hako tsiro, hoi wella.

Kal mare hi o Aroneske un leskre mursh tchawenge. Un jon hunte chan len ap i Debleskri platsa. Kal mare hi lengro kotar kolestar, hoi o baro Debleske chatchedo well, un hi kokres i rashajenge. Jaake hunte well kowa kerdo hako tsireske.

Mank i Israelitarja his i mursh, koleskri dai i Israeltikri djuwel his un leskro dad i Egiptari. Leskri dai kharas Shelomit. Lakro dad hi o Dibri dran o kheer Dan. Ko mursh tchingras pes i mursheha dran Israel. An kau tchingepen tchingras lo ap o baro Debleste djungele labentsa. Koi anan le les pash o Moseste,
un stilan les, bis te penas lenge o baro Dewel, hoi te krenn le leha.
O baro Dewel penas ap o Mose:
An ko murshes win glan koi platsa, kai i menshe hi! Hakeno, kai shunas, hoi lo penas, kowa tchiwell peskre wasta ap leskro shero. Palle witsrenn i tsele menshe les mulo i barrentsa.
Ap i Israelitarja peness: Koon praassell peskro Debles, hunte hidjrell peskri phagi.
Kowa, kai tchingrell ap o baro Debleste djungele labentsa, hunte well mulo dino. I tsele menshe hunte witsrenn les i barrentsa mules. Hi jek, te hi lo i Israelitari oder i wi-themari.
Koon i menshes mulo dell, hunte well mulo dino.
Koon i vieches mulo dell, kowa hunte dell sau viecho pale: I djipen i djipaske.
Koon i wawares dukrell, koleske well kerdo, hoi job kras:

Te phagas lo jekeske i kokalo, hunte well leske i kokalo phagedo. Te das lo leske i jak oder i dand win, hunte well leske i jak oder i dand win dino. Jaake har jek o wawareske kras, jaake well leske pale dino.
Koon i vieches mulo dell, hunte dell sau vieches pale. Koon i menshes mulo dell, hunte merell.
Tumenge un kolenge dran i wi-them, kai pash tumende djiwenna, hunte well jek tchatchepen, pal kowa lauter win kerdo well. Me, o baro Dewel, hom tumaro Dewel.

O Mose penas kowa i Israelenge. Un jon kran jaake, har penas o baro Dewel ap o Moseste, un anan ko murshes, kai o baro Debles praassas, win glan koi platsa, kai i Israelitarja his, un witsran les i barrentsa mulo.
O baro Dewel penas ap o Mose ap i berga Sinai:

Pen ap i Israelitarja: Te wenn tumer an ko them, hoi me tumen dau, palle te well ko themes hako eftato bersh i Debleskro bersh, kai witsrenn tchi an i phub dren, te well kowa baro. Krenn kowa jaake, te sharenn man!
Shob bersha witsress djob an i phub, un tchiness tire drakengre ruka, un aness dren, hoi mukas o them tuke bares te well.
O eftato bersh hi i Debleskro bersh, kai i phub nai lell newi soor. Kau bersh hi o baro Debleske. Ap tiro kotar phub witsress tchi win, un tchiness gar tire drakengre ruka.
Kowa, hoi pre djal ap tiro kotar phub, aness gar dren. I drake hoi wenn, kai tu kol ruka gar tchinal, tchiness gar tele. Koi phub hunte lell pale newi soor.

Hakeno tumendar nai lell khetne, hoi lo hatsell ap o them: tumer un tumare budepangre, mursha har djuwja, ninna kolla, kai budrenn hako kopo jek diwes pash tumende, un kolla, kai jek tsiro pash tumende djiwenn.
Ninna tumare vieche un kol diwje vieche, kai an o them djiwenn, kolla nai chan kolestar, hoi an ko bersh pestar bares was.
Ap ko tsiro, kai rikran efta kope ko Debleskro bersh dren, kowa hi pal 49 (star-deesh-te-enja) bersha,

mukenn an o 50. (paash-sheelto) bersh, an o eftato tchon, ap o deshto diwes an i phurdepaskri te phurdell an o tselo them. Kowa hi o diwes, kai halauter krik lino well, hoi mank tumende un o baro Debleste tardo hi.

O 50. (paash-sheelto) bersh hi o baro Debleske. An kau bersh denn win gole, te well hakeneske, kai an ko them djiwell, peskri sijaan muklo. Un te his leskri sijaan jaake baro, te bikras pes lo ap i wawareske, hunte mukell kowa les pale te djal. Hakeno tumendar lell kowa pale, hoi leskro his, un nai djal khere pash peskre menshende.

An kau 50. (paash-sheelto) bersh hunte well i tseli sijaan muklo. Witsrenn kek djob an i phub, un tchinenn kek djob tele, hoi pestar dran i phub was. Tchinenn witar kek drake tele, hoi wan bares an kau bersh, kai tumer kol ruka gar tchinan.
An kau tselo bersh hunte well kek budi kerdo ap tumari kotar phub. Hakeno nai chal kowa, hoi hatsell lo, kowa hoi pestar bares was.
An ko bersh, kai i tseli sijaan muklo well, lell hakeno peskri phub pale, hoi leskro his.
Te bikreh i kotar phub ap i wawar Israelitari, oder te gineh lestar i kotar phub, palle dess les gar pal o kand!

Kowa, hoi tu leske plaissreh oder job tuke plaissrell, hunte djal pal kol bersha, hoi wenna, bis te well ko bersh, kai i tseli sijaan muklo well. Kol lowe djal pal kowa, kitse bersha nai anell o ginepaskro kowa dren, hoi ap ko kotar phub bares well.
Atchenn bud bersha, palle hunte well budeder plaissedo har te atchenn gar bud bersha. Plaissedo wenn kol bersha, kai djob nai dren anlo well, un gar ko kotar phub.
Kek te dell o wawares pal o kand! Rikrenn tumenge tumaro Debles glan i jaka pash halauter, hoi krenn! Me, o baro Dewel, hom tumaro Dewel.
Doleske krenn, hoi tumendar kamau, un djiwenn pal miro tchatchepen! Palle nai djiwenn tumer an kau them kek darjah.
Un o them anell tumenge jaake bud win, te hi tumen doha chapaske. Un tumer nai djiwenn an kau them, un tumen hunte well kek daar.
Te putchenn: “Hoi chas an ko eftato bersh? Te witsrah tchi ap i phub win, nai anah ninna tchi dren.”
Palle penau me: Me tchiwau miri bacht ap tumari phub an o shobto bersh, te anell i phub jaake bud djob win, te rikrell kowa triin bersha.
Te witsrenn tumer palle an o ochtato bersh djob win ap tumari phub, palle hi tumen gomme doha te chal kolestar, hoi an o shobto bersh dren anan. Un tumen hi doha, bis te lenn o newo djob dren.
Ma bikrenn ko them jaake, te well kowa hako tsireske i wawareske! Ko them hi mange. Un tumer han har wi-themarja, kai mukau pash mande te djiwell.
Te bikrenn i kotar them, palle krenn kowa jaake, te nai well ko them palpale ginlo.
Te was tiro phraal – i wawar Israelitari – tchorwelo un hunte bikrell i kotar leskri phubjatar, palle hunte ginell les jek dran leskri familja pale.
Te hi les kek, kai ko kotar phub nai pale ginell, un leskro wast anell doha lowe khetne, te nai ginell job kokres les pale,
palle plaissrell lo jaake bud, har an kol bersha dren anlo wals, kai atchenn, bis te well ko bersh, kai i tseli sijaan muklo hunte well. Jaake well ko kotar phub pale leskro.

Te anell leskro wast kowa gar khetne, hoi job hunte pale plaissrell, palle atchell ko kotar phub an o wast kolestar, kai les ginas. An ko bersh, kai i tseli sijaan muklo well, lell les kowa pale, koleske ko kotar phub his.
Te bikrell jek i kheer an i foro, kai i massuri trul ko foro hi, palle well les i tselo bersh, te nai ginell lo les pale win.

Te well ko kheer gar win ginlo, un ko bersh hi trujel, palle rikrell les o ginepaskro un kolla, kai pal leste wenna hako tsireske. Kau kheer well gar pale dino koleske kowa his, an ko bersh, kai i sijaan muklo well.
Hi wawartchandes, te hi ko kheer an i gab tardo, kai kek massuri trujel hi. Palle hi ko kheer har i kotar phub. Ko kheer nai well win ginlo, un palpale dino an o bersh, kai i sijaan muklo well.
An kol forja, kolen i Levitarja hi, nai ginenn kolla hako tsiro lengre khera pale.

Te ginell jek lendar peskro kheer gar pale, well ko kheer leske pale dino an ko bersh, kai i sijaan muklo well. I khera, kolen i Levitarja hi an i forja, hoi lenge dino wan an o them Israel, kol forja atchenn lengre.
Ninna ko them glan i forja, kai i vieche chan, well nai gar bikedo. Kowa hi lenge hako tsireske.
Te well tiro phraal tchorwelo, un nai rikrell gar, hoi leskro hi, palle wess ap leskri rig. Muk les pash tute te djiwell, har te wals lo i wi-themari oder jek, kai i tsiro pash tute budrell.
Te patseh leske lowe, putch gar budeder lowe pale. Rike tuke o baro Debles glan i jaka, un kre, te nai djiwell tiro phraal pash tumende!
Tu putchess lestar gar budeder lowe pale, har tu leste dal, witar gar budeder chapen har tu leske patsal.
Me, o baro Dewel, hom tumaro Dewel, un anom tumen dran o them Egiptia win, te dap tumen o them Kanaan, te wap tumaro Dewel.
Te well tiro phraal jaake tchorwelo, te bikrell lo pes ap tute, palle mukess les gar kowa te krell, hoi i ginlo budepaskro hunte krell.

Job te well tuke har jek, kai budrell pash tute un well haki rat plaissedo. Har jek, kai jek tsiro pash tute djiwell un budrell, atchell lo pash tute, bis te well ko bersh, kai i tseli sijaan muklo well.
Palle mukess les tu pale djal, ninna leskre tchawe leha, te nai djan le pale pash lengre menshende un pash lengro kotar phub, hoi jon lengre phurendar lan.
I tsele Israelitarja hi mire budepangre, kolen me dran o them Egiptia win anom. Jon nai wenn gar bikedo, te wenn le ginle budepangre.
Tu wess gar sorjah rai pral lende! Rike tiro Debles glan tire jaka!
Te kameh tuke budepangre te ginell, mursha un djuwja, palle gin len kol wawar menshendar, kai an i themma trul tumende djiwenna,
ninna fun kol wi-themarja, kai pash tumende djiwenn. Len un lengre tchawen, kai an tumaro them boldo wan, nai ginenn tumenge, te wenn le tumare budepangre.

Kolen nai denn ap tumare tchawende dureder, te wenn le lengro pal tumaro merepen. Jon atchenn lengre ginle budepangre jaake rah har djiwenn le. Tire phrala, kol wawar Israelitarja, pral kolende hunte wess gar sorjah rai.

Te well jaake, kai well i wi-themari, kai pash tumende djiwell, brawelo, ninna jek, kai i tsiro pash tumende djiwell. Un tiro phraal, i wawar Israelitari, well tchorwelo, un bikrell pes ap ko braweleste oder leskre tchawende,
palle hunte well jaake, te nai ginell les jek pale. Leskro phraal,
leskro kak, koleskro tchawo oder i wawar dran leskri familja ginell les win. Te nai anell lo kokres jaake bud lowe khetne, palle ginell lo pes kokres win.

Un khetne koleha, kai ginas les, dikell lo palla, kitse bersha job leske budras un kitse bersha atchenn, bis te well ko bersh, kai i tseli sijaan muklo well. Ko tsiro, hoi job pash koleste budras, well tele tserdedo. Kol bershenge, kai atchenn pral, hunte plaissrell lo jaake bud, har jekeske plaissedo well, kai haki rat peskri budjake plaissedo well.
Te hi gomme bud bersha, bis te well ko bersh, kai i tseli sijaan muklo well, hunte plaissrell lo budeder, har te atchenn gar bud bersha pral.
Leskro rai hunte djal leha trujel, har te wals lo i budepaskro, kai haki rat plaissedo well. Denn jak, te krell lo leha gar, har te wals lo leskro ginlo budepaskro.
Nai ginell kek les win, hunte well job peskre tchawentsa win muklo an ko bersh, kai i tseli sijaan muklo well.
Tumer Israelitarja han mange. Mire budepangre han tumer, kolen anom me dran o them Egiptia win. Me, o baro Dewel hom tumaro Dewel.
Ma krenn tumen chochene deblen, witar kek figure un pre-tchiddo barra, oder barra an kolende i shero dino hi, te mangenn len an! Me, o baro Dewel, hom tumaro Dewel.
Rikrenn mire Debleskre diwessa dren, un anenn kek ladj ap miro kheer. Me hom o baro Dewel.
Te djiwenn jaake, har me tumendar kamau un rikrenn kowa hoi me penom,
palle mukau me brishin te dell an ko tsiro, kai hunte well. Un o them mukell tumenge lauter bares te well, un i ruka hidjrenn pengre rukengre.

Ko tsiro kai tumer o djob win denn, djal bis te well ko tsiro, kai tchinenn i drake tele. Un ko tsiro, kai tchinenn i drake tele, djal bis te well ko tsiro, kai witsrenn o djob pale win an i phub. Un tumen well budeder har doha chapen. Kek krell tumenge tchilatchepen.

Tumer nai djiwenn an o latchepen kolentsa, kai trul tumende djiwenn, te nai sowenna, un kek tserdell tumen dran o sopen. Kol diwje viechen tradau me dran o them win. Kek lurde wenna an tumaro them, te marenn le tumen.
Tumer lenn kolenge palla, kai kamenn pen tumentsa te kurell, un tumer denn len o chareha mulo.

Pantch tumendar lenn i sheel lurdenge palla, un i sheel tumendar nashenn 10.000 (deesh-serja) lurdenge palla, te denn le len mulo. Kolla, kai kamenn tumen te marell, wenn tumendar o chareha mulo dino.
Me dikau latches ap tumende, un krau, te lenn bud tchawe, jaake te wenn bud. Un hoi man sowel dom, te dap tumende, rikrau dren.
Tumer anenn jaake bud djob dren, te hi tumen gomme phuro djob te chal, te well o newo djob dren anlo. Un tumer hunte witsrenn ko phuro djob krik, te well platsa, kai tchiwenn o newo djob koi.
Un me djiwau mashkral tumende, un sikrau tumen gar miro dumo.
Me djiwau pash tumende, un hom tumaro Dewel, un tumer han mire menshe.

Me, o baro Dewel, hom tumaro Dewel, un anom tumen dran o them Egiptia win, te atchenn gar buder lengre pandle budepangre. Kote hans har grumja, kai hunte budrenn i kashteha trul lengri meen. Ko kashtes phagom me, te nai djan pale pre hadede sherja.
Te shunenn tumer gar ap mande, un rikrenn kol laba gar dren, hoi me tumenge penom,
un krenn gar, hoi tumendar kamau, un djiwenn gar pal miro tchatchepen, un rikrenn jaake gar dren, hoi tumentsa win krom,

palle krau tumentsa jaake: Bari bibacht anau pral tumende, pharo nasslepen, hoi tumenge o djipen randell. Tumer chatchenn glan fibro, tumare jaka nai dikenn buder gar mishto, un kek soor atchell an tumende. Tchitcheske witsrenn djob win an i phub. Kolla, kai kurenn pen tumentsa, chan les pre.

Me dikau buder gar latches ap tumende, un tumer wenn dino kolendar, kai kurenn pen tumentsa. Kolla, kai kamenn tumaro merepen, wenn rai pral tumende. Tumer han ap o naashepen, ninna te lell tumen kek palla.
Te shunenn tumer ninna palle gar ap mande, dau tumen i phagi, hoi hi efta kope phareder har kaja, hoi bis kanna dom.
Tumaro pre-phurdepen un tumaro pesso shero phagau, un dau tumen buder kek brishin. Ko bolepen pral tumende well har saster, un koi phub tel tumare pire sorelo har barra.
Tumari phari budi hi tchitcheske. Ap tumari hachetikri phub well tchi bares. Un i ruka an o them hidjrenn kek rukengre.
Un te sikrenn mange o dumo un kamenn gar ap mande te shunell, palle dau me tumen i phagi, hoi gomme efta kope phareder hi har kaja bis kanna.
Diwje vieche bitchrau mank tumende, te chan le tumare tchawen un viechen, un marenn jaake bud tumendar, te wenn tumare dromma muklo.
Te mukenn tumer tumenge mandar pale ninna gomme tchi te penell, un sikrenn mange o dumo,
palle sikrau me tumenge o dumo, un dau tumen i phagi, hoi efta kope phareder hi har kaja bis kanna.

Me mukau kurepen an tumaro them win te phagell, un dau tumen pale, te rikran gar dren, hoi mantsa win kran. Un te khatrenn tumer tumen palle an tumare forja, palle bitchrau i pharo nasslepen mashkral tumende, un dau tumen an i wasta kolendar, kai kurenn pen tumentsa.
Tumen well buder gar doha djob, te pekenn maro. Deesh djuwja nai pekenn pengro maro an jek bob. O maro well ap i waga tchiddo, un hakeno lell i kotar. Un tumer chan un wenn gar tchalo.
Te shunenn tumer ninna palle gar ap mande, un sikrenn mange o dumo,
palle djau me an choli ap tumende, un dau tumen i phagi hoi hi efta kope phareder har kaja, hoi bis kanna ap tumende was.
I bokatar chan tumer o mass tumare tchawendar un tchendar.

Me krau kol mulne platse paash, kai tumer tumare deblenge viechen chatchrenna. Un kol boba, kai tumer lenge sungepaskro koowa chatchrenn, phagau khetne. Tumare mulen witsrau ap kol paash-dine figuren, un tumendar kamau buder tchi te djinell.

Me mukau tumare forja an kotja te dell, un dau kol platse paash, kai tumare chochene deblen an-mangan. Un kowa, hoi tumer mange chatchrenn, un ko latcho sungepen, hoi well win, kowa kamau buder gar te sungell.
Me krau te well tumaro them i mulo them. Un kolla, kai kuran pen tumentsa, un wenn, te djiwenn le koi, lenge atchell o rakepen krik, te dikenn le kowa.
Tumen tradau me mank i menshende an i wawar themma, un lau tumen o chareha palla. Tumaro them well i mulo them, un tumare forjendar atchell tchi pral har barra.

Palle nai lell tumaro them peskri soor pale. Har tumer koi dren djiwan, mukan les gar pale soor te lell. An kol bersha, kai hunte mukans les tchiddo, kran tumer kowa gar. Palle, an ko tsiro, kai tumer pandle han an o them kolendar, kai anan tumen krik, un tumaro them muklo tchiddo hi, nai lell lo i tsele bersha palla, un nai lell pale soor.

Kolla, kai tumendar pral atchenn an kol wawar themma, kai le pandle hi, kolen krau jaake dareno, te well len daar glan i patri, hoi krik phurdedo well. Lestar nashenn le, har te lals jek len o chareha palla. Un jon perenn, un jek perell pral o wawareste, ninna te hi kek koi, kai len palla las. Un tumen hi kek soor, te kurenn tumen kolentsa, kai ap tumende djan.
An kol themma kol wawar menshendar merenn tumer. Ko them, kai wenn pandles anlo, chal tumen pre.

Kolla, kai pral atchenn tumendar, lendar merell jek pal o wawar an kol themma kolendar, kai len pandles krik anan. Kowa djal lenge doleske, kai mukan le o baro Debleskro drom, jon un ninna lengre phure.
Palle penenn jon, te his lengri doosh un i doosh lengre phurendar, te rikran le gar ap mande un sikran mange o dumo.
Doleske sikrom lenge o dumo, un tradom len an o them kolendar, kai kuran pen lentsa. Kote krenn le pen tiknes glan mande. Te hidjran le pengri phagi tele,

palle kamau koi sowel, hoi o Jakobeske dom, gar bistrell, witar gar koi sowel, hoi o Isaakeha dren djom, un koi sowel, hoi o Abrahameha krom. Un bistrau gar, te penom lenge, te dap o them lengre tchawenge, kai pal lende wenna.

Glan kowa hunte djan le dran ko them win, te atchell o them tchiddo, un nai lell pale newi soor an jaake bud bersha, hoi leske gar dren rikedo wan. Un i Israelitarja hidjrenn pengri phagi tele. Jon djiwan gar pal miro tchatchepen, un kolestar, hoi lendar kamom, kaman le tchi te djinell.

Ninna te hi le an o them kolendar, kai lan len pandles, hi kowa gar jaake, te rissroms man krik lendar, un kamoms tchi buder lendar te djinell. Me mukau len gar lauter te merell. Miri sowel, hoi lende dom, phagau gar. Me, o baro Dewel, hom lengro Dewel.
Lengre phurentsa krom win, te wap lengro Dewel, har anom len dran o them Egiptia win glan i jaka kol menshendar an i wawar themma. Kowa bistrau me gar, me, o baro Dewel.

Kawa hi kol laba, hoi o Mose i Israelenge jaake dureder penas, har o baro Dewel leske penas ap i berga Sinai, te djinenn le, hoi o baro Dewel lendar kamell, un djiwenn pal leskro tchatchepen, un djan ap leskro drom.
O baro Dewel penas ap o Mose:
Pen ap i Israelitarja: Te das jek pes sowel, te dell lo man, o baro Debleste, i menshes, palle nai ginell lo koles pale win.

I mursheske, kai mashkral 20 (biish) bersha un 60 (shob-deesh) bersha hi, koleske plaissrell lo i 50 (paash-sheel) rupene beme. Jek bema hunte well jaake pharo har i rupeni bema an o Debleskro kheer pharo hi.
I djuwjake wenn 30 (trijanda) rupene beme plaissedo.
I tchaweske mashkral 5 (pantch) un 20 (biish) bersha wenn 20 (biish) rupene beme plaissedo, i tchake an o emligo phurepen 10 (deesh) rupene beme.
I tikno tchaweske mank jek tchon un pantch bersha wenn pantch rupene beme plaissedo, un i tchake triin rupene beme.
I mursheske, kai 60 (shob-deesh) bersha hi un pral shob-deesh, wenn 15 (deesh-te-pantch) rupene beme plaissedo, un i djuwjake 10 (deesh) rupene beme.

Te hi kowa, kai pes sowel das, jaake tchorwelo, te nai anell leskro wast kowa gar khetne, palle anell lo ko menshes pash o rashajeste. Un ko rashai dikell peske koles an, un penell har bud lowe leske plaissedo hunte wenn, pal kowa hoi kowa nai dell, kai pes sowel das.
Te das jek pes sowel, te dell lo o baro Debleste i vieches, sawo vieches, hoi nai well leske maredo un chatchedo, hi ko viecho o baro Debleske.

Job parell les gar win, un dell kek wawar viecho koleske, kek latcho viecho i djungelo viecheske, witar kek djungelo viecho i latcho viecheske. Te parell jek sau vieches i wawar viecheske, palle wenn kol dui vieche o baro Debleske.
Te das jek pes sowel, te dell lo o baro Debleske i vieches, hoi pale-tchiddo hi, hoi nai well gar maredo un leske chatchedo, palle anell lo ko vieches glan o rashajeste.
O rashai dikell peske ko vieches an, un dikell, hoi latcho un hoi tchilatcho ap leste hi, un penell, har bud ko viecho moldo hi. Jaake har o rashai penell, jaake well.
Te kamell jek ko vieches palpale te ginell, palle dell lo ko pantchto kolestar pashel, hoi o rashai penas.

Te das jek pes sowel, te dell lo peskro kheer o baro Debleste, palle dikell o rashai les peske an, un dikell, hoi latcho un hoi tchilatcho ap leste hi, un penell, har bud kowa moldo hi. Jaake har ko rashai penell, jaake well.
Te kamell kowa, koleske ko kheer his, peskro kheer pale win te ginell, palle dell lo pash kowa hoi o rashai penas, o pantchto kotar pashel. Palle well ko kheer pale leskro.

Te das jek pes sowel, te dell lo i kotar phub o baro Debleste, palle well diklo, har bud djob ap ko kotar phub win witsedo well. Hi kowa jek gono djob, palle hi ko kotar phub 50 (paash-sheel) rupene beme moldo.
Te kamell lo ko kotar phub o Debleske te dell an ko ersto bersh pal ko bersh, kai i tseli sijaan muklo was, atchell kowa pash kol 50 rupene beme.
Te kamell lo les i tsiro pal kowa te dell, palle dikell o rashai pal, har bud bersha trujel hi, bis te well ko bersh, kai i sijaan muklo well. Un kal bersha wenn tele tserdedo.
Te kamell kowa, kai ko kotar phub o baro Debleste das, ko kotar palpale ginell, palle dell lo kowa, hoi koi phub moldo hi, un o pantchto kotar pashel. Palle well li pale leskri.
Te ginas lo koi phub gar tele o baro Deblestar, un bikrell lat ap i wawareske, palle nai well ko kotar phub gar buder win ginlo.
An ko tsiro, kai well i sijaan muklo, atchell ko kotar phub o baro Debleske. Un o rashai lell les.
Te das jek pes sowel, te dell lo o baro Debleste i kotar phub, hoi ginas lo, un hoi las lo gar peskro dadestar pral leskro merepen,
palle dikell o rashai har bud ko kotar phub moldo hi, bis te well ko bersh, kai i sijaan muklo well. Un kal lowe plaissrell ko mursh gomme kau diwes. Kal lowe hi o baro Debleske.
An ko bersh, kai i sijaan muklo well, djal ko kotar phub palpale ap koleste, konestar job les ginas, koleskri familjake koi phub hi.
Kol rupene beme hoi plaissedo wenn, te well tchomone pale ginlo, hunte wenn jaake pharo har i rupene beme an o Debleskro kheer pharo hi. Jek rupeni bema hi 12 (deesh-te-dui gramme) pharo.
I viecho, hoi o phureder leskri datar hi, kowa hi o baro Debleske. Te hi sawo viecho i gurum, i bakro, i mursh busni, nai lell les kek mensho, te dell lo les o baro Debleske. Leskro hi lo.

Te hi ko viecho kol viechendar, kai pale-tchiddo hi, palle ginell les peskro rai pale, pal kowa hoi o rashai penell, te hi ko viecho moldo. Un job dell o pantchto kotar gomme pashel. Te well ko viecho gar win ginlo, palle well lo kol lowenge, hoi o rashai penas, bikedo.

Halauter, hoi das jek kolestar, hoi leskro hi, te well kowa hako tsireske o baro Debleske, nai well gar bikedo, witar gar pale ginlo – nai well i mensho, i viecho oder i kotar phub. Kowa hoi o baro Debleske hako tsireske dino was, tchatchepah, kowa atchell leske.
Te hi kowa i mensho, nai well lo gar win ginlo. Job hunte well maredo.
O deshto kotar halauterestar, hoi baro was ap i hachetikri phub un ap i ruka, hi o baro Debleske, un hunte well leske anlo.
Te kamell jek kowa te rikrell, hunte plaissrell lo les, un dell o pantchto kotar pashel.

Ninna i grumjendar, i bakrendar un i busjendar hi hako deshto viecho o baro Debleske. Kek dikell palla, hi ko viecho latcho, hi lo gar latcho. Witar gar well i viecho win paredo. Jaake har djan le glan o bakrengro koi, jaake lell lo hako deshto ap i rig. Te parell lo jekes win, hi kol dui vieche o baro Debleske, un nai wenn gar win ginlo.
Kawa hi kol laba, hoi penas o baro Dewel o Moseske, har his lo ap i berga Sinai, te rikrenn pen i Israelitarja ap lende.

Un o baro Dewel rakras o Moseha an o mulo tato them Sinai, an o Debleskro plachteno kheer, ap o ersto diwes, an o duito tchon, an o duito bersh, har jon dran ko them Egiptia win djan. Un o baro Dewel penas:

Tu un o Aron, tchinenn an i liil har bud mursh Israelitarja koi hi, kai hi soreles doha, te wenn le lurde. Tchinenn i laba hake murshendar pre, kai hi biish bersha phuro un phureder! Tchinenn ninna pre dran hawi familja jon wenna un koon lengro dad hi!

Lenn deesh-te-dui murshen, jek dran haki bari familja, hoi well kol deesh-te-dui Jakobeskre tchawendar, te wenn le ap tumari rig pash koi budi. Kal mursha hunte wenn i pralstune pral pengre menshende.
Kalla hi kol laba kol murshendar, kai ap tumari rig wenn: Dran o kheer Ruben: o Elizur, leskro dad hi o Shedehur.
Dran o kheer Simeon: o Shelumijel, leskro dad hi o Zurishaddai.
Dran o kheer Juda: o Nachshon, leskro dad hi o Amminadab.
Dran o kheer Issachar: o Netanel, leskro dad hi o Zuar.
Dran o kheer Sebulon: o Eliab, leskro dad hi o Helon.
Dran o kheer Efrajim, kai hi o Josefeskro tchawo: o Elishama, leskro dad hi o Ammihud. Dran o kheer Manasse, kai hi ninna o Josefeskro tchawo: o Gamalijel, leskro dad hi o Pedazur.
Dran o kheer Benjamin: o Abidan, leskro dad hi o Gidoni.
Dran o kheer Dan: o Ahijeser, leskro dad hi o Ammishaddai.
Dran o kheer Asser: o Pagijel, leskro dad hi o Ochran.
Dran o kheer Gad: o Eljasaf, leskro dad hi o Deguel.
Dran o kheer Naftali: o Ahira, leskro dad hi o Enan.
Kolla wan wi-rodedo dran i tsele Israelitarja. Hakeno his o pralstuno pral peskre menshende. Un jon wan i pralstune pral kol bud serja menshende an Israel.
Un o Mose un o Aron lan kal deesh-te-dui pralstunen pash pende.

Un jon anan i tsele Israelitarja khetne ap o ersto diwes an o duito tchon. Un i tsele mursha, hoi his biish bersh un phureder, mukan pengre laba an lila dren te tchinell. Jon wan jaake pre-tchinlo, te was diklo dran hawi familja hakeno was un koon leskro dad his.
Kowa kran le an o mulo tato them Sinai jaake har o baro Dewel ap o Moseste penas.
Un o baro Dewel rakras o Moseha un o Aroneha un penas lenge,

har i Israelitarja hunte tchiwenn pengre plachtene khera pre. Un job penas: Hakeno hunte tchiwell peskro kheer pre pash koi pre-tchiddo kotar than, hoi sikrella, hawe menshendar job hi. I tsele khera wenn pre-tchiddo trul o Debleskro plachteno kheer.

I platsa kol menshenge dran o kheer Juda hi glan o Debleskro kheer ap koi rig, kai o kham pre-djala, pash pengri pre-tchiddi plachta. Pash lende hi ninna lengre lurde, 74.600 (efta-deesh-te-star-serja-shob-sheel) mursha. Lengro pralstuno hi o Nachshon, koleskro dad o Amminadab hi.

Langs lende hunte tchiwenn kol menshe pengre plachtene khera pre, kai wenna dran o kheer Issachar, ninna lengre lurde, 54.400 (pantch-deesh-te-star-serja-star-sheel) mursha pengro pralstuneha, o Netanel. Leskro dad hi o Zuar.
Koi pashel wenna kol menshe, kai wenna dran o kheer Sebulon, ninna lengre lurde, 57.400 (pantch-deesh-te-efta-serja-star-sheel) mursha pengro pralstuneha, o Eliab, koleskro dad o Helon hi.
Kol tsele lurde, kai dran kal triin bare familje wenn, hi halauter khetne 186.400 (sheel-ochta-deesh-te-shob-serja-star-sheel) mursha. Un kolla hunte djan glan kol wawarende.

Un kote, kai o kham tato hi, hunte tchiwenn kolla pengre plachtene khera pre pash pengri pre-tchiddi plachta, kai wenna dran o kheer Ruben. Pash lende hi ninna lengre lurde, 46.500 (star-deesh-shob-serja-pantch-sheel) mursha pengro pralstuneha, o Elizur, leskro dad hi o Shedehur.

Langs lende hunte tchiwenn kol menshe pengre plachtene khera pre, kai wenna dran o kheer Simeon, ninna lengre lurde, 59.300 (pantch-deesh-te-enja-serja-triin-sheel) mursha. Lengro pralstuno hi o Shelumijel, leskro dad hi o Zurishaddai.

Koi pashel wenna kol menshe, kai wenna dran o kheer Gad, ninna lengre lurde, 45.650 (star-deesh-te-pantch-serja-shob-sheel-te-pantch-deesh) mursha pengro pralstuneha o Eljasaf, leskro dad hi o Deguel.

Kol tsele lurde, kai wenn dran kal triin bare familje, hi halauter khetne 151.450 (sheel-pantch-deesh-te-jek-serja-star-sheel-te-pantch-deesh) mursha. Un kolla hunte wenn kol duite, kai djan glan kol wawarende.

Pal lende djan i Levitarja. Jon hunte lenn o Debleskro plachteno kheer lentsa, kai o Debleskre deesh laba dren hi, un djan mashkral kol wawar menshende. Un jaake har jon pengre plachtene khera pre tchiwenn, jaake hunte djan jon ninna dureder: hakeno ap koi platsa, kai lengre pre-tchiddi plachta hi.

Ap koi rig, kai o kham tele djala, hunte tchiwenn kolla pengre plachtene khera pre pash pengri pre-tchiddi plachta, kai wenna dran o kheer Efrajim. Pash lende hi ninna lengre lurde 40.500 (star-deesh-serja-pantch-sheel) mursha. Lengro pralstuno hi o Elishama, leskro dad hi o Ammihud.

Langs lende hunte tchiwenn kol menshe pengre plachtene khera pre, kai wenna dran o kheer Manasse, ninna lengre lurde, 32.200 (trijanda-te-dui serja-dui-sheel) mursha. Lengro pralstuno hi o Gamalijel, leskro dad hi o Pedazur.
Koi pashel wenna kol menshe, kai wenna dran o kheer Benjamin, ninna lengre lurde, 35.400 (trijanda-te-pantch-serja-star-sheel) mursha. Lengro pralstuno hi o Abidan, leskro dad hi o Gidoni.
Kol tsele lurde, kai wenn dran kal triin bare familje, hi halauter khetne 108.100 (sheel-te-ochta-serja-jek-sheel) mursha. Un kolla hunte wenn kol triinte, kai djan glan kol wawarende.

Ap koi rig, kai o kham gar wella, hunte tchiwenn kolla pengre plachtene khera pre pash pengri pre-tchiddi plachta, kai wenna dran o kheer Dan. Pash lende hi lengre lurde 62.700 (shob-deesh-te-dui-serja-efta-sheel) mursha. Lengro pralstuno hi o Ahijeser, leskro dad hi o Ammishaddai.

Langs lende hunte tchiwenn kol menshe pengre plachtene khera pre, kai wenna dran kheer Asser, pengre lurdentsa, 41.500 (star-deesh-te-jek-serja-pantch-sheel) mursha. Lengro pralstuno hi o Pagijel, koleskro dad o Ochran hi.
Koi pashel wenna kol menshe, kai wenna dran o kheer Naftali, pengre lurdentsa, 53.400 (pantch-deesh-te-triin-serja-star-sheel) mursha. Lengro pralstuno hi o Ahira, koleskro dad o Enan hi.
Kol tsele lurde, kai dran kal triin bare familje wenn, hi halauter khetne: 157.600 (sheel-pantch-deesh-te-efta-serja-shob-sheel) mursha. Jon djan pal kol wawarende.
Har i tsele mursha, kai nai wenn lurde, dran haki familja an lila dre-tchinlo his, his le khetne 603.550 (shob-sheel-triin-serja-pantch-sheel-pantch-deesh) mursha.
Kokres i Levitarja wan gar pre-tchinlo. Jaake penas kowa o baro Dewel ap o Moseste.

Un i Israelitarja kran halauter jaake, har o baro Dewel kowa o Moseske penas. Jon tchiwan pengre plachtene khera pre, hakeno pash koi pre-tchiddi plachta, hoi sikras, hawe menshendar job hi. Un jaake djan le ninna dureder, hakeno peskre menshentsa un peskri familjah.
Kolla hi i laba o Aroneskre un o Moseskre menshendar, kai djiwan ap ko tsiro, har rakras o baro Dewel o Moseha ap i berga Sinai.
O Arones his star tchawe: Ko phureder kharell Nadab, koi pal well o Abihu, palle o Eleasar, un o Itamar.
Kal star wan o djeteha dre-maklo, te wenn jon rashaja, un budran an o Debleskro kheer.

Dui lendar, o Nadab un o Abihu meran an o mulo tato them Sinai glan o baro Debleste, har chatchran jon glan leste wawar koowa, hoi job gar penas. Un len his kek tchawe. O Eleasar un o Itamar kran pengri rashajeskri budi, khetne pengro dadeha, o Aroneha.
Un o baro Dewel penas ap o Moseste:
“An kol menshen dran o kheer Levi kai! An len glan o rashajeste Aron, te wenn le leske koi.
Jon budrenna leske un i tsele Israelenge glan o Debleskro kheer, un hakeno lendar krell koi budi pash o Debleskro kheer, hoi leste dino well.
Un jon hunte denn jak ap o tselo koowa an o Debleskro kheer. Un jaake krenn jon koi budi, hoi i tsele Israelitarja hunte krans mange.
Un tu aness kol Levitarjen pash o Aron un leskre tchawende. Kowa hi jaake, har te anans len i Israelitarja pash lende, te krans le kolengri budi.
Ap o Aroneste un ap leskre tchawende hunte peness tu, te denn jon jak, te krell kek wawar lengre rashajeskri budi. Te well i wawar, te krell lo kai budi, hunte merell job.”
Un o baro Dewel penas ap o Moseste:

“Djiness, me rodom kol Levitarjen win dran kol Israelitarja, te wenn jon mire. Ap ko diwes, har marom i tsele phureder mursh tchawen an o them Egiptia, tchiwom i tsele phureder mursh tchawen an o Israel mange ap i rig, te wenn jon mire: kolla, kai i menshestar bolde wan har ninna kolla, kai i viechestar bolde wan. I tsele phureder mursh tchawe hi mange, o baro Debleske. Kanna lau gar kolen, kanna lau i Levitarja mange.”
Un o baro Dewel rakras o Moseha an o mulo tato them Sinai un penas:
“Tchin i laba kol murshendar dran o kheer Levi an i liil! Tchin ninna pre dran hawi familja jon wenna un koon lengro dad hi! Tchin kolen pre, kai hi jek tchon phuro un phureder!”
Un o Mose kras jaake har o baro Dewel leske penas.
O Levi, les his triin tchawe: o Gershon, o Kohat, un o Merari.
O Gershon: les his dui tchawe: o Libni un o Shimi.
O Kohat: leskre tchawe his: o Amram, Jizhar, Hebron un Usijel.
O Merari: leskre tchawe his o Machli un o Mushi. Kowa hi i menshe, kai wenna pal o Levi peskre familjentsa.
I menshe, kai wenna o Leviteskro tchawestar Gershon hi i Libnarja un i Shimarja:
Khetne his le 7.500 (efta-serja-pantch-sheel) mursha, halauter, kai hi jek tchon phuro un phureder.
Un len hi pengri platsa pal o Debleskro kheer, ap koi rig, kai o kham tele djala.
Un lengro pralstuno hi o Eljasaf, leskro dad hi o Lael.
Lengri budi pash o Debleskro kheer hi, te denn le garda ap kowa, hoi win ap o kheer hi: kol plachte, hoi tchakrenn o kheer, koi plachta an o khereskro wudar,

ninna kol plachte, kai hi trul i platsa, hoi glan o kheer hi, kai ninna i sasterni chatchepaskri hi, kai vieche o Debleske chatchedo wenna. Ninna denn le jak ap koi plachta an o wudar glan koi platsa un ap i shelle un ko wawar koowa, hoi koi pashel hi.
I menshe, hoi wenna o Leviteskro tchawestar Kohat hi i Amramarja, i Jizhararja, i Hebronarja, un i Usijelarja.
Khetne his le 8.600 (ochta-serja-shob-sheel) mursha, halauter, hoi hi jek tchon phuro un phureder. Lengri budi hi, te budrenn le ap ko koowa an o Debleskro kheer.
Lengri platsa hi pash o Debleskro kheer, ap koi rig, kai o kham tato hi.
Lengro pralstuno hi o Elizafan, koleskro dad o Usijel hi.

Un jon hunte denn garda ap ko sonakaskro mochton, koi chapaskri, koi momelengri, o Debleskro sonakaskro bob un o Debleskri sasterni chatchepaskri, kai vieche chatchede wenna. Ninna denn le garda ap i tselo Debleskro koowa an leskro kheer, koleha jon budrenna, ninna ap koi plachta mank kol dui iseme un ap halauter, hoi koi pashel hi.
O rai pral i tsele pralstunende mank i Levitarja well o Eleasar, ko tchawo o rashajestar Aron, te dell job jak ap kolende, kai budrenn an o Debleskro kheer.
I menshe, hoi wenna o Leviteskro tchawestar Merari hi i Machlarja un i Musharja.
Khetne his le 6.200 (shob-serja-dui-sheel) mursha, halauter, hoi hi jek tchon phuro un phureder.
Lengro pralstuno hi o Zurijel, koleskro dad o Abichajil hi. Lengri platsa hi pash o Debleskro kheer ap koi rig, kai o kham gar wella.

Un lengre budi hi, te denn le garda ap kol kotja, dran kolende o kheer kerdo well: i tchinle kashta, i pandepaskre kashta, i pesse kashta un lengre pire, ap kolende jon tardo wenna, ninna o tselo wawar koowa, hoi koi pashel hi.
Ninna hunte denn le garda ap kol kotja, hoi trul o glanstuni platsa hi: kol pesse kashta un lengre pire, ap kolende jon tardo wenna, kol tikne sasterne kotja, hoi denn le an i phub, un i shelle.

Glan o Debleskro kheer, ap koi rig, kai o kham pre djala, hunte well koi platsa o Moseske un o Aroneske peskre tchawentsa, te denn jon garda, te well o Debleskri budi mishto kerdo i tsele Israelenge. Un te well i wawar pash o Debleskro kheer, te krell lo kai budi, hunte merell lo.

I tsele mursha, kai wenna o Leviteskre mursh tchawendar, his khetne 22.000 (biish-te-dui-serja). Kowa hatsas o Mose un o Aron win, har tchinan le i laba kolendar an i liil, kai hi jek tchon phuro un phureder. Kowa kran le jaake, har o baro Dewel les lenge penas.
Un o baro Dewel penas ap o Moseste: “Hatse win har bud mursha mank i Israelitarja hi, kai hi i phureder tchawe pengre dajendar. Tchin i laba kolendar an i liil, kai hi jek tchon un phureder.

Hako phureder mursh tchawo mank i Israelitarja hi miro. Me hom o baro Dewel. Hako phureder mursh tchaweske dess tu mande jek Levitari. Ninna hako phureder mursh viecho, hoi i Israelitarjen hi, hi miro. Hakeneske lendar dess tu mande jek viecho, hoi i Levitares hi.”
Un o Mose kras, hoi o baro Dewel leske penas, un tchinas i laba kol tsele murshendar an i liil, hoi i phureder tchawe pengre dajendar hi.
Un halauter, hoi jek tchon hi un phureder, his khetne 22.273 (biish-te-dui-serja-dui-sheel-efta-deesh-te-triin).
Un o baro Dewel rakras o Moseha un penas:
“Hako phureder mursh tchaweske mank i Israelitarja le i Levitari, te well lo mange, o baro Debleske! Un le kol viechen, hoi i Levitarjen hi, un gar kolen, hoi i Israelitarjen hi!
Kanna hi 273 (dui-sheel-efta-deesh-te-triin) mursha budeder, kai phureder tchawe hi, har dell Levitarja. Kolen hunte ginenn tumer mandar pale.
Hakeneske lendar less tu pantch kotja rup. Jek kotar rup hunte well jaake pharo har kol kotja rup an o Debleskro kheer hi: deesh-te-dui gramme pharo.
Un tu dess ko rup o Aroneste un leskre tchawende. Ko rup well kol murshenge plaissedo, kai budeder hi har kol Levitarja.”
Koi las o Mose ko rup kolendar, kai budeder hi har kol Levitarja.
Jaake las lo kol murshendar un tchawendar, hoi i phureder tchawe his, khetne 1.365 kotja rup, hako kotar rup jaake pharo har kol kotja an o Debleskro kheer.
Un o Mose das ko rup o Aroneste un leskre tchawende, jaake har o baro Dewel kowa leske penas.
O baro Dewel rakras o Moseha un o Aroneha un penas:
Tchin i laba kol murshendar an i liil, kai wenna o Leviteskro tchawestar, o Kohat. Tchin ninna pre, dran hawi familja hakeno wella un koon leskro dad hi.
Le kokres kolen, hoi mank trijanda un paash-sheel bersha phuro hi, halauter kolen, kai nai wenn budepaske ap o Debleskro kheer.
Kawa hi koi budi, hoi kol Kohatarja ap o Debleskro kheer hunte krenna: Jon hidjrenna o Debleskro koowa, hoi an o kutch isema hi.

Ap ko tsiro, kai stenn i Israelitarja pre, te djan le dureder, djal o Aron peskre tchawentsa an o Debleskro kheer, un jon lenn ko kutch kotar than tele, hoi an o wudar glan o kutch isema hi. Ko kotar than tchiwenn le trul o sonakaskro mochton, kai o Debleskre deesh laba dren hi.
Koi pre tchiwenn le i latchi ledertikri plachta un pral pre i blaueti plachta. Palle tchiwenn le kol hidjepaskre kashta an pengre gustria, jaake te hidjrenn nai le kowa.

Un pral i chapaskri, kai o Debleskro maro pre tchiddo well, hunte tchiwenn le ninna i blaueti plachta. Un koi pre tchiwenn le kol pirja un roja, kol tchare un khore, kai i mool o Debleske dren wella. Ninna o Debleskro maro hunte well koi pre tchiddo.
Pral kowa halauter hunte tchiwenn le i plachta, hoi hi lolo har jag, un koi pral i latchi ledertikri plachta, un tchiwenn i hidjepaskre kashta an pengre gustria.

Un jon hunte lenn i blaueti plachta un tchiwenn koja trul koi momelengri un lakre momlia, ninna trul i tchinepangre, kolentsa i dorja an i momlia tele tchinlo wenn, ninna trul i jagakre tchare un i djeteskre khore, hoi koi pashel hi.
Trul kowa halauter tchiwenn le i latchi ledertikri plachta, un tchiwenn kowa ap i hidjepaskre kashta.
Ninna hunte tchiwenn le i blaueti plachta pral o sonakaskro bob, un koi pral i latchi ledertikri plachta. Palle tchiwenn le i hidjepaskre kashta an i gustria ap o bob.

Ko tselo wawar koowa, kai budrenn jon leha an o Debleskro kheer, hunte lenn jon un tchiwenn les an i blaueti plachta, un tchiwenn i latchi ledertikri plachta pral pre un tchiwenn kowa ap hidjepaskre kashta.
Jon hunte khossenn ninna koi jagakri tchik ap o Debleskri chatchepaskri tele, un tchiwenn i loli plachta koi pral.

Un ko tselo koowa, kai budrenn jon peha, tchiwenn le koi pral pre: jagakre tchare, massengre forshette, bare roja, kolentsa lenn le i jagakri tchik krik, tchare, kai o rat dren wella, un ko tselo koowa, hoi koi pashel hi. Pral halauter tchiwenn le i latchi ledertikri plachta. Palle tchiwenn le kol hidjepaskre kashta an i gustria ap o bob.

Ap ko tsiro, kai djan i Israelitarja dureder, hunte krenn o Aron un leskre tchawe kawa halauter un hunte tchakrenn kol tsele kotja o Debleskro plachteno khereske un halauter, hoi koi pashel hi. Pal kowa wenn kol Kohatarja un hidjrenn kowa. Kaja hi lengre budi. Jon taprenn kokres kol plachte an, hoi trul ko tselo koowa tchiddo hi, un gar ko Debleskro koowa, te merenn jon gar.

Un o Eleasar, ko tchawo o rashajestar Aron, job dell garda ap o momelengro djet, un ap ko djet, hoi lenn le te makenn le i rashajen dren, un ap ko sungepaskro koowa, hoi well chatchedo o Debleske. Ninna dell lo garda ap o chapen, hoi hako diwes o Debleske chatchedo wella. Un job dell garda ap o tselo Debleskro kheer un ap ko tselo Debleskro koowa, hoi koi dren hi.
Un o baro Dewel rakras o Moseha un o Aroneha, un penas:
“Denn jak, te atchenn kol Kohatarja djido mashkral kol Levitarja,
un merenna gar ap ko tsiro, kai djan jon pash o Debleskro koowa! Doleske krenn jaake: O Aron un leskre tchawe djan glan lende an o Debleskro kheer dren un sikrenn hakeneste, hoi job hunte hidjrella.
I Kohatarja hunte djan gar kokres koi dren, witar gar dikenn jon o Debleskro koowa, te merenn jon gar.”
Un o baro Dewel rakras o Moseha un penas:
Tchin ninna i laba kol murshendar an i liil, kai wenna pal o Gershon! Tchin pre dran hawi familja hakeno wella, un koon leskro dad hi.
Le halauter kolen, kai mank trijanda un paash-sheel bersha phuro hi. Un de lauteren, kai wenn budepaske lengre budi ap o Debleskro kheer.
Kaja hi koi budi, hoi kol Gershonarja hunte krenna:

Jon hidjrenn kol plachte, hoi tchakrenn o Debleskro kheer, koi telstuni laintikri plachta, koi plachta dran bakrengro bal, hoi well koi pre un koi latchi ledertikri plachta, hoi well pral pre tchiddo. Ninna hidjrenn le ko kutch kotar than, hoi an ko wudar hi an o Debleskro kheer,
ninna i laintikre kotja trul i glanstuni platsa, un koi bari plachta an o wudar glan i platsa, hoi trul o kheer un i sasterni chatchepaskri hi, ninna i shelle un ko tselo koowa, hoi koi pashel hi.
O Aron un leskre tchawe hunte penenn lenge, hoi te hidjrenn le. Un tumer hunte denn garda, te krenn jon pengri budi mishto.
Kaja hi koi budi, hoi krenna i Gershonarja ap o Debleskro kheer. Un o Itamar, ko tchawo o rashajestar Aron hi o pralstuno pral lende.
Tchin ninna i laba kol murshendar an i liil, kai wenna pal o Merari! Un tchin pre dran hawi familja hakeno wella, un koon leskro dad hi.
Le halauter kolen, kai hi mank trijanda un paash-sheel bersha phuro, kai wenn budepaske. Un de len lengre budi ap o Debleskro kheer!

Kaja hi lengre budi ap o Debleskro kheer: Jon hidjrenna kol tchinle kashta, hoi wenn pre tardo, te krenn le o kheer, lengre pandepangre kashta, un kol pesse kashta, hoi wenn pre tardo, te hidjrenn le o kheer, ninna lengre pire,

ninna kol pesse kashta, hoi wenn pre tardo trul koi glanstuni platsa, lengre pire un kol tikne sasterne kotja, kai deh an i phub, kol shelle un ko tselo wawar koowa, jaake har kowa lengre budi hi. Un tumer hunte sikrenn lende hako kotar, hoi hidjrenn le.
Kaja hi koi budi, hoi i Merarja hunte krenna ap o Debleskro kheer. Un o Itamar, ko tchawo o rashajestar Aron, hi o pralstuno pral lende.
Un o Mose un o Aron khetne kol pralstunentsa tchinan i laba kol murshendar an i liil, kai wan pal o Kohat. Hakenestar tchinan le pre dran hawi familja job was un koon leskro dad his.
Jon lan halauter kolen, kai mank trijanda un paash-sheel bersh phuro his, un nai wan budepaske, te krenn jon pengri budi ap o Debleskro kheer.
Khetne his jon 2.750 (dui-serja-efta-sheel-te-pantch-deesh) mursha.
Jaake bud mursha his kol Kohatarja, kai nai budran ap o Debleskro kheer, un kai o Mose un o Aron an i liil tchinan, jaake har o baro Dewel kowa o Moseske penas, te krenn le.
Un i laba kol murshendar, kai wan pal o Gershon, wan ninna pre tchinlo. Hakenestar tchinan le pre dran hawi familja job was un koon leskro dad his.
Jon lan halauter kolen, kai mank trijanda un paash-sheel bersh phuro his un nai wan budepaske, te krenn jon pengri budi ap o Debleskro kheer.
Khetne his jon 2.630 (dui-serja-shob-sheel-trijanda) mursha.
Jaake bud mursha his kol Gershonarja, kai nai budran ap o Debleskro kheer, un kai o Mose un o Aron an i liil tchinan, jaake har o baro Dewel kowa penas.
Un i laba kol murshendar, kai wan pal o Merari wan ninna pre tchinlo. Hakenestar tchinan le pre dran hawi familja job was un koon leskro dad his.
Jon lan halauter kolen, kai mank trijanda un paash-sheel bersh phuro his, un nai wan budepaske, te krenn jon pengri budi ap o Debleskro kheer.
Khetne his jon 3.200 (triin-serja-dui-sheel) mursha.
Jaake bud mursha his kol Merarja, kolengre laba o Mose un o Aron an i liil tchinan, jaake har o baro Dewel kowa o Moseske penas, te krenn le.

Khetne his kol tsele Levitarja 8.580 (ochta-serja-pantch-sheel-ochta-deesh) mursha. O Mose un o Aron khetne kol pralstunentsa an Israel tchinan lengre laba an i liil, un tchinan ninna pre, dran hawi familja hakeno was un koon leskro dad his. Kolla halauter his mank trijanda un paash-sheel bersh phuro, un nai wan budepaske ap o Debleskro kheer un hidjran pharo koowa.
Hakeno las peskri budi un leske was penlo, hawo koowa job hunte hidjrell. Kowa halauter was jaake har o baro Dewel kowa o Moseske penas, te krenn jon.
Un o baro Dewel rakras o Moseha un penas:

Pen ap kol Israelitarja: “Bitchrenn hakenes win glan tumari platsa, kai jaake nasselo ap peskro mass hi, te merell leskro mass tele! Bitchrenn ninna halauteren win, kai nashell dukepaskro pani dran lende win, un kolen, kai kran pen pale-tchiddo ap kolende, kai mulo hi!
Murshen un djuwjen hunte bitchrenn win glan koi platsa, kai tumare plachtene khera tardo hi, te krenn jon gar koi platsa pale-tchiddo, kai me pash tumende djiwau.”
Un kol Israelitarja kran kowa jaake, un bitchran len win glan i platsa, jaake har o baro Dewel kowa ap o Moseste penas.
Un o baro Dewel rakras o Moseha un penas:
Pen ap i Israelitarja: Hakeno, mursh har djuwel, kai krell tchilatchepen ap jekeste, un jaake ninna ap o baro Debleste, kowa anell i doosh ap peste.
Un job hunte penell o tchilatcho koowa, hoi job kras, un krell kowa pale mishto, un dell ko pantchto kotar koi pashel, ap koleste job o tchilatchepen kras.
Kek te hi koi, koneste nai dell lo kowa, palle dell lo les o baro Debleste o rashajeske. Ninna dell lo i diwjo bakro, hoi o rashai marella, te well leskri doosh krik lino un halauter pale mishto.
Ninna ko wawar koowa, hoi i Israelitarja o baro Debleste denn, hi i rashajenge.
Un kowa, hoi jek ap i rig tchiwella, te well lo o Debleske, kowa hi ninna o rashajeske. Un hoi jek i rashajenge della, kowa hi lenge.
Un o baro Dewel rakras o Moseha un penas:
Pen kol Israelenge: Nai well, te chochell i djuwel peskro romes i wawar mursheha, un lakro rom djinell kowa gar, un kek dikas, te anas li i ladj ap peste un tapras lat koi pashel,
un lakro rom silweras, un putchell pestar: Kras li kowa? – Kras li les gar?

Palle hunte anell ko mursh lat pash o rashajeste, un anell o Debleske jek kilogrammi jarro. Un job hunte tchorell kek djet pral pre, un dell witar kek sungepaskro koowa koi pashel. Ko jarro dell lo o Debleste, te well o tchatchepen win, te djinenn le: chochras li les, – chochras li les gar.
Un ko rashai hunte anell lat glan o baro Debleste,
un tchorell Debleskro pani an i piri, hoi hi kerdo dran pekli tchik, un lell phubjakri tchik dran o Debleskro kheer, un tchiwell kowa an o pani.

Un job hunte anell koi djuwjat glan o baro Debleste, un krell lakre balla pre, un tchiwell ko jarro an lakro wast, te well diklo, chochras li peskro romes, chochras li les gar. Un an peskro wast lell ko rashai ko djungelo nasselo pani.

Un job dell koi djuwjat trad un penell ap late: “Te his kek mursh pash tute tchiddo un chochral tiro romes gar i wawareha, te anal ladj ap tute, palle nai pijeh ko djungelo nasselo pani, un tu weh gar nasselo.
Tu te chochral tiro romes i wawareha, un anal ladj ap tute,

palle anell o baro Dewel i bibacht ap tute, jaake te wenn tire rigja tikneder un tiro per pesseder. Palle penell jek, kai kamell i bibacht pral i wawareste te anell: Mu djal tuke har kai djuwjake!” Kol labentsa hunte dell o rashai kol djuwjat trad, un palle penell lo ap late:
“Jaake djal ko nasselo pani an tiro per, un tiro per well pesseder, un tire rigja perenn khetne.” Un koi djuwel hunte penella: “Amen, jaake te well kowa!”
Palle hunte tchinell o rashai kol laba ap i patri, un thowell len an ko djungelo pani tele.
Ko djungelo nasselo pani hi kol djuwjake pipaske, te well i nasslepen an late dren.
Palle lell ko rashai ko jarro dran lakro wast, te hadell lo les pre glan o Debleste. Un jaake sikrell lo: Kowa hi o baro Debleske.
Un job chatchrell jek wast pherdo jarro ap o Debleskri chatchepaskri, te sikrell lo, te hi o tselo jarro o baro Debleske. Un pal kowa dell lo koja djuwjat ko pani pipaske.

Un te chochras koi djuwjat peskro romes un anas ladj ap peste, palle djal ko nasselo pani an late dren, un joi nai well buder gar an wawar koowa. Lakro per well pesso, un lakre rigja perenn khetne. Un te kamell jek i wawares te praassell, penell lo: Mu djal tuke har kai djuwjake!
Te anas sawi djuwel gar ladj ap peste, un kek doosh hi ap late, palle well joi gar nasselo, un nai well an wawar koowa.

Jaake hunte krenn tumer kowa, te silwerell i mursh un patsell, te chochras les peskri romni i wawareha. Job hunte anell lat glan o baro Debleste. Un ko rashai hunte krell lah kowa jaake har kate penlo hi.
Te his ko murshes gar tchatcho, lell lo kek phagi. Koi djuwel, te anas li doosh ap peste, hunte hidjrell peskri phagi.
Un o baro Dewel rakras o Moseha un penas:
Pen ap i Israelitarja: Te dell jek pes sowel, – nai well i mursh, ninna i djuwel, – un penell o baro Debleske, te well lo leske i tsireske koi,
palle hunte pijell kowa kek mool un soreli chatchedi, witar kek wawar pipen, hoi dran drake kerdo was. Job hunte chal witar kek drake, kek, hoi pesso hi, witar kek, hoi truk hi.
Jaake rah har job koi sowel das, hunte chal job tchi, hoi i drakengro rukestar wella, witar kek drake, hoi jalo hi, witar kek, hoi pral o tsiro ap o ruk hi.

Jaake rah har job koi sowel das, hunte well gar leskro bal tchinlo, bis te ko tsiro trujel hi, kai das job pes an o baro Debleskro wast. Job hi o Debleskro, un hunte mukell peskro bal ap o shero lengsto te well.
An ko tselo tsiro, kai das job pes an o baro Debleskro wast, hunte djal job gar pash jekeste, kai meras.
Ninna te hi ko mulo leskro dad, leskri dai, leskro phraal un leskri pheen, hunte djal lo gar pash lende, te well lo gar pale-tchiddo an ko tsiro, kai hi lo peskro Debleske koi.
Ko tselo tsiro, kai das job pes sowel, hi job kokres o baro Debleske koi.
Te his job pashel, har meras jek ap jek kopo, wenn leskre balla pale-tchiddo shob diwessa. Ap o eftato diwes hunte tchinell job peskro bal ap o shero, un job well pale erligo.
Un ap o ochtato diwes hunte lell job dui diwje taube oder dui wawar taube un anell kolen pash o rashajeste pash o wudar glan o Debleskro plachteno kheer.

Un o rashai hunte dell koi jek tauba o Debleste, te well i doosh krik lino. Un koi wawar hunte chatchrell job o Debleske, te well lo pale erligo un koi doosh lestar krik lino, hoi job ap peste anas, har tapras lo i mules an, un was doleske pale-tchiddo. Palle mukell job peskro bal pale lengsto te well,

te well lo newes o baro Debleske koi ko tsireske, kai das lo pes sowel. Un job hunte lell i bakro, hoi jek bersh phuro hi, un dell les o Debleste, te well halauter pale mishto. Kol diwessa glan te wan leskre balla pale-tchiddo, his tchitcheske.
Kowa hi ko lab, hoi penell koleske, kai hi i tsireske o Debleske koi, hoi te krell lo: Te hi ko tsiro trujel, kai das job pes sowel, hunte well lo pash o wudar glan o Debleskro plachteno kheer anlo.

Un job hunte dell o baro Debles i bakro, jek bersh phuro un sasto, te well kowa tseles chatchedo o Debleske. Ninna dell job o Debles i bakri, jek bersh phuro un sasto, te well leskri doosh krik lino. Un pale anell lo leske i wawar sasto mursh bakro, hoi chan le khetne glan o Debleste.

Ninna anell lo i kashteni piri, kai merklia un mare dren hi, kai kek shutlo jarro dren hi: merklia dran latcho jarro un djet, un sane mare, kai djet pre maklo hi, ninna ko tselo chapen dran jarro un koi mool, hoi koi pashel hi, te well lo dino o Debleske.
Un o rashai hunte anell kowa glan o baro Debleste. Palle marell lo ko jek bakro, te well leskri doosh krik lino un ko duito, hoi o Debleske tseles chatchedo wella.

Palle dell lo o mursh bakro o baro Debleste, ninna koi kashteni piri, kai o maro dren hi, kai kek shutlo jarro dren hi. Ko koowa dell lo o Debleste, te chan le les khetne glan leste. Pal kowa anell lo ko wawar chapen dran jarro, un koi mool, te well kowa o Debleske dino.

Un ko mursh, kai his i tsireske o Debleske koi, hunte tchinell o bal ap peskro shero, hoi mukas lo lengsto te well o Debleske. Un job tchinell les pash o wudar glan o Debleskro plachteno kheer, un lell les un witsrell les ap i jag, kai chatchrenn kol thulle kotja ko bakrestar, hoi chan le khetne glan o Debleste.

Un pal kowa lell o rashai i kotar keredo mass o bakreskro phikestar, ninna i merkli un i maro, kai kek shutlo jarro dren hi, dran i kashteni piri un tchiwell koleske, kai his i tsireske o Debleske koi, an leskre wasta.

Palle lell o rashai kowa an peskre wasta un hadell les pre, te dell lo les o baro Debleste. Ko koowa, khetne o betch un i palstuni heri o bakrestar, hi o rashajeske. Koi pal nai pijell kowa, kai i tsireske o Debleske koi his, pale mool.

Jaake hunte krell ko mensho, kai his i tsireske o Debleske koi, un dell kau koowa o baro Debleste, ninna ko wawar koowa, hoi job pes sowel das. Jaake har job pes sowel das, jaake hunte krell job ninna.
Un o baro Dewel rakras o Moseha un penas:
“Pen ap o Aroneste un ap leskre tchawende: Jaake hunte penenn tumer ap kol Israelitarja, te rakrenn miri bacht pral lende win:
Mu dell tut o baro Dewel bacht un soor, un dell garda ap tute!
O baro Dewel dikell latches ap tumende un krell peskro dji tumenge pre!
O baro Dewel dikell kamles ap tumende un dell tumen shukapen an o dji!
Tumer te rakrenn jaake miro lab pral i Israelitarja win, dau me len bacht un soor.”

Un har o Mose o Debleskro plachteno kheer pre tchiwas, makas lo les o djeteha o Debleske. Ninna ko tselo koowa, hoi koi dren hi, ninna o Debleskri chatchepaskri un halauter, hoi pashel hi, makas job o djeteha o Debleske.

Koi wan kol pralstune pral i Israelitarja un anan kutch koowa o Debleske. Hakeno his o pralstuno pral jek kol deesh-te-dui bare familjendar, kai wan kol deesh-te-dui Jakobeskre tchawendar. Un jon his kolla, kai tchinan i laba kolendar pre, kai an lengre familje hi.

Un jon anan ko kutch koowa glan o baro Debleste: shob sorele wurdja un deesh-te-dui grumja. Dui pralstune khetne anan jek wurdin, un hakeno lendar anas jek grumni. Un jon anan len glan o Debleskro kheer.
Un o baro Dewel rakras o Moseha un penas:
“Le kowa lendar un de les kol Levitarjen, te nai krenn jon pengri budi ap o Debleskro kheer un nai hidjrenn pengre kotja!”
Koi las o Mose kol wurdja un grumja un das kowa kol Levitarjen.
Dui wurdja un star grumja das job kolen, kai wan pal o Gershon, te nai hidjrenn le pengre kotja.
Un star wurdja un ochta grumja das job kolen, kai wan pal o Merari, te nai hidjrenn jon pengre kotja. Un o Itamar, ko tchawo o rashajestar Aron, das garda ap halauter.
Kolen, kai wan pal o Kohat, das job tchi. Lengri budi his, te hidjrenn le o Debleskro koowa, hoi an leskro kheer his. Kowa hunte hidjrenn le ap pengre phika.
