Un kol pralstune dan kutch koowa o Debleske un anan kowa glan o Debleskri chatchepaskri ap ko diwes, kai was koi chatchepaskri o djeteha dre-maklo.
Un o baro Dewel penas ap o Moseste: “Muk hako diwes jekes kol pralstunendar te well, te anell job peskro koowa. Kowa te djal jaake deesh-te-dui diwessa, te well koi chatchepaskri mange koi.”
Un o baro Dewel rakras o Moseha un penas:
Rake o Aroneha un pen leske: Te tchiweh tu i momlia ap koi momelengri pre, hunte tchiwess len jaake, te dikenn hake efta momlia glan.
O Aron kras kowa, un tchiwas kol momlia jaake ap i momelengri, te dikan le glan i momelengri, jaake har o baro Dewel ap o Moseste penas.
Koi momelengri his dran jek kotar latcho sonakai, leskro mashkralstuno kotar un kol blumtikre mussja. Jaake har o baro Dewel les o Moseste sikras, kran le koi momelengri.
Un o baro Dewel rakras o Moseha un penas:
Rode i Levitarja dran i Israelitarja win, un kre len erligo mange!

Jaake hunte kress tu lentsa, te kreh tu len erligo: Tu tchiwess pani ap lende, te well lengri doosh krik lino. Un jon hunte tchinenn halauter pengre balla tele, un thowenn pengre koola, un krenn pen jaake djudjo un erligo.
Tu less i terno gurum, un koi pashel chapen o Debleske: jarro, kai djet mashkral hi. Un i wawar terno gurum less tu chatchepaske o Debleske, te well i doosh krik lino.
Un aness kol Levitarjen glan o Debleskro kheer. Un koi hunte wenn i tsele Israelitarja khetne.

Un tu aness kol Levitarjen glan o baro Debleste. Un kol Israelitarja hunte tchiwenn pengre wasta ap lende, te sikrenn le, jon hi kolla, kolen i Israelitarja o baro Debleste denna, te krenn jon i budi an leskro kheer. Un o Aron anell i Levitarjen glan o baro Debleste.

Un kol Levitarja hunte tchiwenn pengre wasta ap kol terne gurmengre shere. Ko jek well chatchedo, te well i doosh krik lino. Ko wawar well tseles chatchedo o baro Debleske. Jaake well i doosh i Levitarendar krik lino.
Un tu aness kol Levitarjen glan o Aroneste un leskre tchawende, un jaake glan o baro Debleste, te wenn le leske koi.
Jaake less tu kol Levitarjen dran kol Israelitarjen ap i rig, te wenn le miro.

Pal kowa nai djan jon koi, te krenn le pengri budi an o Debleskro kheer. I Israelitarja dan len mande. Doleske hunte kress len djudjo mange un aness len glan mande. Kolen lom mange un gar i wawar mursh tchawen an Israel, kai hi i phureder tchawe pengre dajendar.

Hakeno, kai hi o phureder mursh tchawo peskri datar mashkral kol Israelitarja hi mange, hako mensho un hako viecho. Ap ko diwes, kai marom i tsele murshen, kai his i phureder tchawe pengre dajendar an o them Egiptia, penom: Hako mursh, kai hi i phureder tchawo peskri datar, hi miro.
Un kanna lom i Levitarjen un gar kol wawar murshen, kai hi i phureder tchawe pengre dajendar an Israel.

Un me dom kol Levitarjen o Aroneste un leskre tchawende, te krenn le koi budi an o Debleskro kheer. Jaake krenn le, hoi i budi lauterendar an Israel wals. Un jaake well kek bibacht ap i Israelitarja, hoi hunte wals ap lende, te wans jon ap i Debleskri platsa.
O Mose, o Aron, ninna kol tsele menshe an o Israel kran kolentsa dran o kheer Levi halauter jaake, har o baro Dewel kowa ap o Moseste penas.

Un kol Levitarja mukan pani ap pende te tchorell, te well lengri doosh tele thodo, un thowan pengre koola. Un o Aron anas kol Levitarjen glan o baro Debleste un chatchras kol viechen o baro Debleske, te well i doosh i Levitarendar krik lino, te wenn jon erligo glan o Debleste.

Koi pal djan jon kote, te krenn jon pengri budi an o Debleskro kheer glan o Aroneste un leskre tchawende. Lauter was jaake kerdo, har o baro Dewel o Moseske penas, te krenn le kolentsa dran o kheer Levi.
Un o baro Dewel rakras o Moseha un penas:
“I Levitarja, kai hi 25 (biish-te-pantch) bersh phuro un phureder, hunte wenn budepaske, te krenn le pengri budi ap o Debleskro kheer.
Te wenn jon paash-sheel bersh, hunte budrenn le buder gar.

Jon nai wenn ap i rig pengre phralenge, kai budrenn ap o Debleskro kheer. Koi budi, hoi jon kran, hunte krenn jon buder gar. Jaake hunte kress tu kolentsa dran o kheer Levi, te krell hakeno peskri budi.”
Un o baro Dewel rakras o Moseha an o mulo tato them Sinai, an o duito bersh, har jon dran o them Egiptia win djan, an o ersto tchon, un penas:
“I Israelitarja hunte rikrenn o baro diwes, hoi kharella Passa ap o tchatcho tsiro:
Ap o deesh-te-starto diwes, an kai tchon, ap i rati, ap i tchatcho tsiro hunte chan le ko chapen Passa jaake har tumenge penom, un hunte krenn pal mire tsele laba.”
Un o Mose penas lenge kal laba.
Un jon kran ko chapen, hoi kharella Passa, ap o deesh-te-starto diwes, an ko ersto tchon, ap i rati, an o mulo tato them Sinai. Jaake har o baro Dewel o Moseske penas, jaake kran i Israelitarja.
Koi his mursha, kai tapran i mules an, un wan pale-tchiddo. Kolla nai wan gar glan o Debleste ap ko diwes, te chan le ko Passa. Jon wan glan o Moseste un glan o Aroneste,
un penan ap lende: “Mer tapram i mules an un wam pale-tchiddo. Hunte rikras men pale un nai wah gar glan o baro Debleste, te anas leske i bakro khetne i wawar Israelitarja?”
Un o Mose penas ap lende: “Atchenn kate. Me kamau te shunell, hoi o baro Dewel tumenge penell.”
Un o baro Dewel rakras o Moseha un penas:
Pen ap i Israelitarja: Te was jek tumendar, ninna tumare tchawendar, pale-tchiddo ap i muleste, nai chal lo ko chapen gar ap kau diwes. Kowa hi ninna jaake kolenge, kai hi ap o drom.
Jon hunte chan ko chapen an o duito tchon ap o deesh-te-starto diwes, ap i rati, un hunte chan koi pashel ko maro, kai kek shutlo jarro dren hi, ninna shutlo senlepen.
Un jon hunte mukenn tchi tchiddo pral i rat. Witar kek kokalo hunte well phagedo. Un halauter hunte well jaake kerdo har pash o Passa, hoi chan le ap o tchatcho tsiro.

Koon gar pale-tchiddo hi un gar ap o drom hi, kowa hunte rikrell o Passa ap o tchatcho diwes. Te krell lo kowa gar, hunte well lo infam un atchell buder gar pash peskre menshende. Koi phagi lell lo doleske, kai was lo gar ap o tchatcho tsiro glan o baro Debleste, te anell lo leske i bakro. Leskri doosh atchell ap leste.

Un te hi jek mank tumende, kai gar tumendar hi, un kowa kamell ninna o baro Debleske o diwes Passa te rikrell, jaake nai krell job kowa jaake, har tumenge penom, pal mire tsele laba. Kol laba hi leske har tumenge.
Un ap ko diwes, kai was o Debleskro kheer pre-tchiddo, ko kheer, kai o Debleskre deesh laba dren hi, was i wolka tele pral o kheer. Un an i rati his i jag an late.
Jaake his kowa o tselo tsiro: ap o diwes his koi wolka pral ko kheer tardo. Un ap i rati dikas li win har i jag.
Hako kopo, kai hadas pes koi wolka, djan i Israelitarja dureder. Un kote, kai koi wolka tardo atchas, koi atchan i Israelitarja ninna tardo.

O baro Dewel te penas ‘Djan!’, palle djan jon. Un o baro Dewel te penas, te atchenn jon, palle atchan jon un tchiwan pengre plachtene khera pre. Jaake rah, har koi wolka pral o kheer tardo atchas, jaake rah atchan jon.
Un ninna te atchas koi wolka bud diwessa pral o kheer tardo, shunan i Israelitarja ap o baro Debleste, un djan gar dureder.
Un te atchas koi wolka i tikno tsiro un gar bud diwessa pral o kheer tardo, atchan le i tikno tsiro koi, un palle djan le dureder, hako kopo jaake har o baro Dewel penas.
Te his koi wolka jek rat koi, un palle hadas li pes, djan jon dureder. Un ap ko tsiro, kai hadas pes koi wolka, nai well ap o diwes, nai well ap i rati, palle djan jon ninna dureder.
Te atchas koi wolka dui diwessa, jek tchon, ninna budeder tsiro pral o kheer tardo, jaake atchan i Israelitarja, un djan gar dureder. Un te hadas pes koi wolka, djan jon dureder.

Un te penas o baro Dewel, te atchenn jon, tchiwan jon pengre plachtene khera pre, un te penas job, te djan jon, jaake djan jon. Un jaake shunan jon ap o baro Debleste un kran halauter jaake, har job ap o Moseste penas.
Un o baro Dewel rakras o Moseha un penas:
Kre tuke dui phurdepangre dran latcho rup! An kolende well dren phurdedo, te kameh tu, te wenn i tsele Israelitarja khetne, ninna te hunte djan le dureder.
Un te phurdenn le kol dujentsa, hunte wenn i tsele Israelitarja pash tute khetne glan o Debleskro kheer.
Te phurdenn le ap jekeste, hunte wenn kolla pash tute, kai hi pralstune pral kol bud serja menshende an Israel.
Te phurdenn tumer soreles, hunte stenn kolla pre, kai hi lengre platsa kote, kai i kham pre djala, te djan le dureder.

Un te phurdenn tumer o duito kopo soreles ap i phurdepaskri, hunte stenn kolla pre, kai hi lengre platsa kote, kai i kham tato hi, te djan le dureder. Jaake djinenn le: Te well soreles phurdedo, hunte djan jon dureder.
Te kamenn, te wenn i tsele Israelitarja khetne, hunte phurdenn gar soreles.
Kol rashaja, o Aroneskre tchawe, hi kolla, kai hunte phurdenn an i phurdepangre. Kowa hunte atchell jaake tumenge un tumare tchawenge hako tsireske.

Te perenn wawar menshe an tumaro them dren un kamenn rai pral tumende te well, un tumer djan an o kurepen, te kurenn tumen lentsa, palle hunte phurdenn soreles an i phurdepangre, te wenn tumer tumaro baro Debleske an o shero. Un job lell tumen win dran lengre wasta.

Phurdenn ninna an i phurdepangre ap kol bare diwessa, kai han tumer bachtelo, un ap ko diwes, kai well i newo tchon, un kai tumer o baro Debleske viechen anenn, sawe, hoi tumer leske tseles chatchrenna un sawe, hoi chan tumer glan leste khetne. Palle wenn tumer mange, tumaro Debleske, an o shero. Me hom tumaro baro Dewel.
Ap o biishto diwes an o duito tchon an o duito bersh hadas pes koi bari wolka, hoi pral o Debleskro kheer his, kai o Debleskre deesh laba dren hi.
Un kol Israelitarja djan dran ko mulo tato them Sinai. Un koi wolka djas glan lende un atchas tardo an ko mulo tato them Paran.
Kowa his o ersto kopo, kai djan le jaake dureder har o baro Dewel kowa ap o Moseste penas:

Kol menshe dran o kheer Juda his i glanstune, kai djan win. Lengro pralstuno his o Nachshon, koleskro dad o Amminadab hi. Lentsa djan kol menshe dran o kheer Issachar un dran o kheer Sebulon. I pralstuno pral o kheer Issachar his o Netanel. Leskro dad hi o Zuar. Un o pralstuno pral o kheer Sebulon his o Eliab. Leskro dad hi o Helon.
Palle kran jon o Debleskro plachteno kheer tele. Un kol menshe dran i familje Gershon un Merari djan un hidjran ko plachteno kheer.

Pal lende djan kol menshe dran o kheer Ruben. Lengro pralstuno his o Elizur, koleskro dad o Shedehur hi. Lentsa djan kol menshe dran o kheer Simeon un dran o kheer Gad. O pralstuno pral o kheer Simeon his o Shelumijel, koleskro dad o Zurishaddai hi. Un o pralstuno pral o kheer Gad his o Eljasaf, koleskro dad o Deguel hi.
Pal lende djan kol Kohatarja, un hidjran ko koowa o Debleskro plachteno khereske. Kau kheer hunte was pale pre-tchiddo, bis te kol Kohatarja pal wan.

Pal lende djan kol menshe dran o kheer Efrajim. Lengro pralstuno his o Elishama, koleskro dad o Ammihud hi. Lentsa djan kol menshe dran o kheer Manasse un dran o kheer Benjamin. O pralstuno pral o kheer Manasse hi o Gamalijel, leskro dad hi o Pedazur. Un o pralstuno pral o kheer Benjamin his o Abidan, leskro dad hi o Gidoni.

Pal lende djan kol menshe dran o kheer Dan. Lengro pralstuno his o Ahijeser, koleskro dad o Ammishaddai hi. Lentsa djan kol menshe dran o kheer Asser un dran o kheer Naftali. O pralstuno pral o kheer Asser his o Pagijel. Leskro dad hi o Ochran. Un o pralstuno pral o kheer Naftali his o Ahira, koleskro dad o Enan hi.
Hako kopo, kai djan i Israelitarja dureder, kran le les jaake.

Un o Mose penas ap peskri romjakro phraleste, o Hobab, koleskro dad o Reguel hi dran o them Midian: “Mer djah an ko them, hoi o baro Dewel penas: Me dau kowa tumende. Kanna, ab mentsa! Palle krah tuke latcho koowa. O baro Dewel penas: Me kamau latchepen te krell ap o Israel.”
Koi penas o Hobab: “Me kamau gar tumentsa te djal. Me kamau an miro them un pash mire menshende te djal.”
O Mose penas: “Dja gar krik mendar, tu djineh i platse an o mulo tato them, kai mer nai djiwah. Tu nai sikreh menge o drom.
Un te djah tu mentsa, krah mer tuke o latchepen, hoi o baro Dewel ap mende krella.”

Jaake mukan le o baro Debleskri berga pal pende un djan triin diwessa dur. Un kolla, kai hidjran o sonakaskro mochton, kai o baro Debleskre deesh laba dren hi, djan glan lende un sikran lende, kai atchenn le tardo.
Un ap o diwes, har djan le dureder, his o baro Debleskri wolka pral lende.
Un har djas ko sonakaskro mochton dureder, penas o Mose: “Baro Dewel, ste pre, un trade kolen krik, kai kamenn tuke tchilatchepen! Kre, te nashenn le halauter penge tutar!”
Un te tchiwan jon ko mochton tele, penas job: “Am pale, baro Dewel, pash kol bud serja menshende an Israel!”

Un kol menshe penan glan o baro Debleskre kanda, kai lenge djungeles djala. Un har o baro Dewel kowa shunas, was job chojedo un bitchras i jag, hoi chatchras win ap i platsa, kai lengre plachtene khera his.
Koi dan i menshe ap o Moseste gole. Un o Mose mangas o baro Debles. Koi djas i jag krik.
Un jon dan koi platsa ko lab ‘Tabera’, te bistrenn le gar, kai kote i jag o baro Deblestar mank lende chatchras.
Mank i Israelitarja his ninna wawar menshe, kai lentsa djan. Kolen was i bari bok pal mass. Koi rowan kol Israelitarja ninna pale, un penan: “Koon dell men mass chapaske?
Har shukar his an o them Egiptia, kai men matche tchitcheske chapaske his. Men his kürbisse, melone, senlepen, purma un sirja.
Kate dikah tchi wawar har ko manna, un kowa well men dran o nak win.”
Ko manna dikas win har tikno djob, parno-djelto.
Un kol menshe nashan kate te kote, un lan kowa khetne, un kran jarro dran leste, un keran kowa an pirja, un kran merklia kolestar. Ko manna his an o mui har maro, kai djet dren hi.
Un te well rati i platsa sapeno, perell o manna koi pre.
Har o Mose shunas, kai i tsele menshe khetne tardo his an i wudja glan lengre plachtene khera un rowan, koi tapras o baro Debles i choli, un ninna o Moseske his kowa doha.
Un o Mose penas ap o baro Debleste: “Hoske kreh tu mange, kai tiro budepaskro hom, o djipen jaake pharo? Hoske hi tut kek dji mange, un me hunte marap man tele kol tsele menshentsa?

Hi kalla halauter mire tchawe? Wan jon mandar boldo? Har nai peneh tu ap mande: Hidje len an tire mussja, har i djuwel, kai hidjrell i ternepen, te anap len an ko them, kolestar penal lengre phurenge, te dess ko them lenge?
Kai lap me mass, te dap les kal tsele menshende? Jon rowan glan mande, un penan: ‘De men mass te chal!’
Me nai hidjrau kal tsele menshen gar kokres! Kowa hi jaake pharo mange, te nai krau les buder gar.
Te kameh tu mantsa jaake te krell, palle ab mange latcho un de man mulo, te dikap gar miri bibacht.”

Un o baro Dewel penas leske: “Le tuke efta-deesh mursha kol phurendar an Israel, kolendar, kai tu djineh, kai hi jon pralstune pral i menshende. An len glan o Debleskro plachteno kheer. Kote wenn le glan tute tardo.

Me kamau tele te well, un kote tuha rakrell, un lau i kotar ko duchestar, hoi ap tute hi, un tchiwau les ap lende, te nai krenn jon khetne tuha kai phari budi, hoi hi har i pharo koowa ap tire phika. Tu hunte hidjress kowa gar lauter kokres.

Un ap i menshende hunte peness tu: Krenn tumen djudjo o Debleske! Taissarlake lenn tumer mass chapaske. Tumaro ropen was glan o baro Debleste. Job shunas har penan: ‘Koon dell men mass te chal? Menge djas mishto an o them Egiptia.’ Doleske dell tumen o baro Dewel mass te chal.
Gar jek diwes, gar dui, gar pantch, gar deesh, gar biish diwessa.

Kowa djal jek tchon, bis te nai sungenn les buder gar, un kowa dran tumaro nak win well. Tumer tchiwan o baro Debles ap i rig, koles, kai mashkral tumende hi. Un tumer rowan glan leste un penan: ‘Hoske djam mer dran o them Egiptia?’ Doleske well kau koowa kanna ap tumende.”
Un o Mose penas ap o baro Debleste: “Shob-sheel-serja menshe hi kai, kolentsa me djiwau, un tu peneh: Me kamau len mass te dell, te well len jek tchon chapaske.
Nai maras mer jaake bud bakre un grumja, te hi len doha mass? Nai tapras mer kol tsele matche an o baro pani, te well lenge lauterenge doha?”
O baro Dewel penas ap o Moseste: “Hi miro wast gar sorelo doha, te krap, hoi penom? Tu dikess kanna: Well kowa jaake, har me tuke penom? Well kowa jaake gar?”
Un o Mose djas win un penas i menshenge o baro Debleskre laba, un las khetne efta-deesh mursha kol phurendar, un tchiwas len trul o Debleskro kheer.

Koi was o baro Dewel tele an i wolka un rakras o Moseha, un las i kotar ko duchestar, hoi ap leste his, un tchiwas les ap kol efta-deesh phureder. Un har o Debleskro ducho ap lende his, kharan le laba win har kol Debleskre rakepangre. Jon kran kowa kokres kau jek kopo.

Koi his dui mursha pash i plachtene khera, ko jek kharas Eldad, ko wawar Medad. Lengre laba his ninna pre-tchinlo an ko liil, kai i efta-desha phureder dren tchinlo hi. Jon atchan pash i plachtene khera un djan gar win pash o Debleskro kheer. Un o Debleskro ducho was ninna pral lende. Un ap i platsa mank i khera kharan le laba win har kol Debleskre rakepangre.
Koi nashas i terno mursh pash o Moseste un penas: “O Eldad un o Medad kharenn laba win har kol Debleskre rakepangre!”
Koi his o Josua, koleskro dad o Nun hi, kowa budras o Moseske fun tiknes pre. Un job penas leske: “Mose, miro rai, pen te mukenn le kowa!”
O Mose penas ap leste: “Kreh tu kowa mange? Me kamoms, te dals o baro Dewel peskre tsele menshende peskro ducho, te wans le halauter Debleskre rakepangre, kai leskre laba win kharenna.”
Pal kowa djas o Mose pale pash i plachtene khera un kol Israeleskre phureder djan leha.

Koi bitchras o baro Dewel i baro ducho pral o them, hoi was kotar, kai o baro pani hi, un anas pesse tchirklen peha, un mukas len ap i platsa te perell, jek diwes dur trul i platsa, jaake jek metari pral i phub.

Koi djan kol menshe un lan kol tchirklen khetne o tselo diwes, un i tseli rati, un ko wawar tselo diwes. Un ninna koles, kai gar bud khetne las, his jaake jek sero kilogramme. Un jon tchiwan kol tchirklen trul i platsa, te wenn le truk, te rikrell pes o mass.
Un har jon ko mass chan un kowa gomme mashkral lengre danda his, was o baro Debleskri choli pral i menshende, un job das len i phari phagi un bud lendar meran.
Un jon kharan koi platsa ‘Kibrot-Taawa’. Kote wan kolla paskedo, kolen chantch hi pal o mass.
Un jon mukan Kibrot-Taawa pal pende un djan dureder an Hazerot, un jon atchan kote.

Koi rakras i Mirjam un o Aron djungeles pral o Moseste un penan: “Kowa hi gar mishto, te las job peske i romjat, kai hi i menshendar Kush. Rakras o baro Dewel kokres ap o Moseste? Rakras lo mentsa gar?” Un o baro Dewel shunas kowa.
O Mose his i mensho, kai kras pes gar bares. Kek mensho his ap i phub, kai his jaake har o Mose un hadas pes gar.
Koi penas o baro Dewel ap o Moseste un ap o Aroneste un ap i Mirjam: “Djan wergel tumer triin pash miro kheer!” Un jon djan hake triin kote.
Un koi was o baro Dewel tele an i wolka, un djas an ko wudar glan o Debleskro kheer, un kharas o Aron un i Mirjam. Un kol dui djan kote.
Un job penas: “Shunenn mire laba! Te bitchrau me jekes pash tumende, kai penell tumenge mire laba, sikrau leste tchomone an i dikepen un rakrau leha an sunja.
O Moseha, koles miro tchatcho wast hi, krau gar jaake. Leste dom miro tselo kheer an o wast.

Jaake har rakrell i mensho i wawareha, rakrau me leha, an laba, kai lo mishto haiwella un gar an parmisse. Un job dikell man, o baro Debles, har hom. Hoske his tumen kek traash, te rakrenn djungeles pral o Mose, koles miro tchatcho wast hi?”
Un o baro Debleskri choli was pral lende. Un job djas krik.

Ninna koi wolka pral o Debleskro kheer djas krik. Un ap jek kopo was i Mirjam nasselo ap peskro mass, ko his parno har gib. Un har rissras pes o Aron pash i Mirjam un dikas ko nasslepen ap lakro mass,
penas job ap o Moseste: “Miro Rai, muk kai doosh gar ap mende te atchell! Kowa his dinlepen, hoi mer kram, un anam doosh ap mende.
Kre, te well i Mirjam gar jaake har i ternepen, kai was i datar mulo boldo, un koleskro mass paash krik hi!”
Un o Mose das ap o baro Debleste gole: “Ach Dewel, kre lat sasto!”

O baro Dewel penas ap o Moseste: “Te tchungrals lakro dad lat an o mui, hunte ladjals joi efta diwessa. Mukenn lat kokres efta diwessa win glan koi platsa, kai i plachtene khera hi! Pal kowa lenn lat pale pash tumende!”
Jaake was i Mirjam win anlo glan i platsa, kai i plachtene khera hi, un hunte atchas kote efta diwessa. An ko tsiro djan i menshe gar dureder. Har nai was i Mirjam palpale,
djan le dureder, mukan Hazerot pal pende, un djiwan an o mulo tato them Paran.
Un o baro Dewel rakras o Moseha un penas:

“Bitche murshen, te hatsenn le win, har sorelo ko them Kanaan hi! Kau them kamau me i Israelitarjen te dell. Bitche jek murshes dran haki bari familja, hoi well kol deesh-te-dui Jakobeskre tchawendar! Bitche kolen, kai hi i pralstune pral pengre menshende!”
Un o Mose kras jaake har o baro Dewel leske penas, un rodas deesh-te-dui murshen win, kai pralstune hi mank i Israelitarja, un bitchras len dran o mulo tato them Paran an o them Kanaan.
Un lengre laba hi: Shamua, koleskro dad o Zakkur hi, dran o kheer Ruben.
O Shafat, koleskro dad o Hori hi, dran o kheer Simeon.
O Kaleb, koleskro dad o Jefunne hi, dran o kheer Juda.
O Jigal, koleskro dad o Josef hi, dran o kheer Issachar.
O Hoshea, koleskro dad o Nun hi, dran o kheer Efrajim.
O Palti, koleskro dad o Rafu hi, dran o kheer Benjamin.
O Gaddijel, koleskro dad o Sodi hi, dran o kheer Sebulon.
O Gaddi, koleskro dad o Susi hi, dran o kheer Manasse, koleskro dad o Josef hi.
O Ammijel, koleskro dad o Gemalli hi, dran o kheer Dan.
O Setur, koleskro dad o Michael hi, dran o kheer Asser.
O Nachbi, koleskro dad o Wofsi hi, dran o kheer Naftali.
O Gehuel, koleskro dad o Machi hi, dran o kheer Gad.
Kalla hi i laba kol murshendar, kolen o Mose bitchras, te hatsenn le win, har ko them hi. Un o Mose das o Hoshea o lab Josua. Koleskro dad his o Nun.
Un o Mose bitchras len, te hatsenn le win har ko them Kanaan hi. Un job penas ap lende: “Djan koi pre an o mulo tato them Negev, un palle djan ap o pralstuno them!
Un dikenn tumen an ko them trujel, har kowa hi, un kitse menshe kote djiwenn, un har sorelo jon hi.
Dikenn, har nai djiwenn le kote: mishto? – gar mishto? Dikenn ninna, har lengre forja hi! Djiwenn i menshe an plachtene khera khetne? – Djiwenn le an barrengre khera an forja?

Dikenn ninna, hawi phub koi hi! Hi li mishto, te nai well djob kote bares? Hi ruka kote tardo un hawe? Ma trashenn, te anenn menge kolestar, hoi an ko them bares was!” Kowa his an ko tsiro, kai i molengre drake mishto his.
Un jon djan koi, un dikan, har ko them hi an o mulo tato them Zin un dureder pre, o tselo drom bis pash o foro Rehob pash Lebo-Hamat.

Un jon djan an o them Negev, un wan bis pash o foro Hebron. Kote djiwas o Ahiman un o Sheshai un o Talmai, kolengro dad o Anak his. O foro Hebron was newo kerdo efta bersha glan o foro Zoan an o them Egiptia.
Un jon wan pash o pani Eshkol, un tchinan kote i kasht molengre drake tele, un hidjran kowa dujentsa ap i hidjepaskro kasht, jaake pharo hi lo. Koi pashel anan le ninna granatikre phabja un faige.
Koi platsa kharan le Nachal Eshkol pal kol drake, hoi kol Israelitarja kote tele tchinan.
Un pal star-deesh diwessa, har jon pen an ko tselo them trujel dikan, djan jon pale pale.

Un wan pash o Mose un o Aron un pash kol tsele Israelitarja, kai atchan an o mulo tato them Paran pash i panjeskro kotar them, hoi kharella Kadesh. Un jon penan lenge kowa, hoi jon dikan, un sikran lende kol drake, phabja un faige dran ko them.
Un jon penan: “Mer wam an ko them, kai tu bitchral men. Un tchatchepah an ko them hi bud thud un gwin. Dikenn i drake, faige un phabja, hoi kote bares wan!
Jek koowa hi gar mishto: Kol menshe, kai djiwenn kote, hi sorelo. Kol forja hi baro un sorelo kerdo. Un mer dikah kote ninna kol menshen, kai wenn pal o Anak.
An o them Negev djiwenn i Amalekarja. An o pralstuno them djiwenn i Hetarja, i Jebusarja un i Amorarja. Pash o baro pani un pash o pani Jordan djiwenn i Kanaanitarja.”
Har i menshe kowa shunan, trashan le un tchingran ap o Moseste. Koi das o Kaleb len trad, un penas: “Awenn, mer djah kote, un lah ko them menge! Mer nai ham sorleder har jon.”
Kol mursha, kai djan leha, penan: “Na-a, mer nai kurah men gar kol menshentsa! Jon hi sorleder har mer.”

Un jon anan djungelo koowa pre pral ko them, kai dikan le pen trujel, un penan ap i Israelitarja: “Ko them, kai djam trujel, te dikas, har kowa hi, chal kolen, kai djiwenn kote. Un kol tsele menshen, kai dikam kote, hi bareder har mer.
Mer dikam kote ninna i Nefilim, kai hi bare menshe. Lengro phuro dad hi o Anak. Mer hams an mare jaka har stepangre, un jaake hams ninna an lengre jaka.”
Koi stan kol tsele Israelitarja pre, un dan gole i trashatar. Un kol menshe rowan i tseli rat.
Un i tsele Israelitarja his chojedo ap o Mose un o Aron un penan: “Ach, te merams mer an ko them Egiptia! Te merams kate an o mulo tato them!
Hoske anell men o baro Dewel an kau them, kai wah mulo dino o chareha? Un mare djuwja un tchawe perenn an i wasta kolendar, kai kuram men mer. Hi feteder, te djah pale an o them Egiptia.”
Un jek penas ap i wawareste: “Mer rodas jekes win, te well lo o pralstuno pral mende, un mer djah pale an o them Egiptia.”
Un o Mose un o Aron witsran pen glan i tsele Israelitarja ap pengro mui.
Un o Josua, koleskro dad o Nun his, un o Kaleb, koleskro dad o Jefunne his, his dui kolendar, kai pen an o them trujel dikan. Jon kran pengre koola an kotja i choljatar,
un penan ap i tsele Israelitarja: “Ko them, kai mer trujel djam, te dikas, har kowa hi, hi mishto.
Te hi o baro Dewel kamlo ap mende, anell job men an ko them un dell les mende. Kowa hi i them, kai hi bud thud un gwin.

Ma perenn o baro Deblestar tele, un trashenn gar kol menshendar an ko them! Mer kamah len pre te chal har maro. Lengro dewel, kai das jak ap lende, mukas len. O baro Dewel hi mentsa. Ma trashenn lendar!”
Kol tsele menshe penan: “Witsrenn len mulo i barrentsa!” Koi was o baro Debleskro railepen pral o Debleskro kheer. Un i tsele Israelitarja dikan kowa.
Un o baro Dewel penas ap o Mose: “Har rah rakrenn kol menshe djungeles pral mande? Un har rah kamenn jon gar ap mande te patsell, witar gar, kai krom jaake bud baro un sorelo koowa pash lende?
Me kamau i pharo nasslepen pral lende te anell un len te marell. Un kamau te wenn tutar jaake bud menshe, te wenn le i natsjona, hoi bareder un sorleder hi har kal menshe.”
O Mose penas ap o baro Debleste: “I Egiptarja djinenn, kai tu lal kol menshen tiri sorjah mashkral lende win. Te shunenn le kanna, hoi kral tire menshentsa,

penenn le kowa kol menshenge an kau them. Kolla shunan, kai tu, baro Dewel, mashkral tire menshende hal, un kai nai dikenn jon tut, un tiri wolka pral lende tardo hi, un kai tu, o baro Dewel, glan lende djah, an i wolka ap o diwes, un rati an i jag.
Te deh tu kanna ap jek kopo tire menshen mulo, palle penenn kol wawar menshe, kai shunenn kowa, pral tute:
‘O baro Dewel nai anas kalla menshen gar an ko them, hoi kamas lo lende te dell, kai das job i sowel pre. Doleske maras job len an o mulo tato them.’
Kanna mangau tut, miro rai, sike tiri soor un kre jaake, har penal.

Tu penal: ‘Me, o baro Dewel, wau gar sik chojedo, un man hi i latcho un baro dji, un me bistrau ko tchilatcho koowa, hoi kran un lau i doosh krik. Koles kokres, kai kamell mandar tchi te djinell, dau i phagi, un gar koles kokres, na-a ninna leskre tchawen un kolengre tchawen jaake rah har triin, star familje, jek pal i wawar djiwan.’
Kanna sike tiro baro latchepen un biste ko djungelo koowa kal menshendar jaake har tu bud kope lengri doosh bistral ap o drom dran o them Egiptia bis kate.”
Un o baro Dewel penas: “Me bistrau lengro djungelo koowa, jaake har tu kowa mangal.
Jek koowa hi jaake tchatcho har me djiwau, un i tseli phub pherdo miro railepen well:

Kol tsele mursha, kai dikan miro railepen un ko baro un sorelo koowa, hoi krom an o them Egiptia un an o mulo tato them, un kaman bud kope gar te patsell, kai hom lentsa, un shunan gar ap kowa, hoi me penom,
kolendar dikell kek ko them, kai lengre phurenge penom un man sowel pre dom, te dap les lende. Witar gar dikell kek ko them, kai rakras djungeles pral mande.
Kokres miro budepaskro, o Kaleb, les hi i wawar dji un djas mange hako tsiro palla, koles anau an ko them, an koleste job was. Leskre tchawende un tchawengre tchawende dau ko them.
Kol Amalekarja un kol Kanaanitarja, kai kanna kote djiwenn, atchenn an o telstuno them. Taissar rissrenn tumen trujel un djan pale an o mulo tato them ap ko drom pash o Baro Lolo Pani!”
Un o baro Dewel rakras o Moseha un o Aroneha un penas:
“Har rah tchingrenn kol tchilatche menshe ap mande? Me shunom, har kol Israelitarja djungeles pral mande rakran.
Doleske pen ap lende: Jaake tchatcho har kowa hi, kai me djiwau, penell o baro Dewel, me kamau kowa te krell tumentsa, hoi tumer glan mire kanda penan.
Tumer merenn an kau mulo tato them. Tumer halauter, kai han biish bersha phuro un phureder, un rakran djungeles pral mande,

tchatchepah, tumer wenn gar an ko them, kai me hadom miro wast un dom man sowel, te nai djiwenn koi dren. Kokres o Kaleb, koleskro dad o Jefunne hi, un o Josua, koleskro dad o Nun hi, kolla dui wenn koi dren.
Tumare tchawe, kolendar tumer penan: ‘Jon perenn an i wasta kolendar, kai kuram men mer’, kolen anau an ko them, kai tumer gar kaman. Ko them well lengro.
Tumer merenn an o mulo tato them.
Tumer rikran tumen gar ap mire laba. Doleske hunte djan tumare tchawe pengre viechentsa trujel an o mulo tato them, star-deesh bersha, bis te atchell kek tumendar buder pral.
Star-deesh diwessa dikan tumen trujel, har ko them hi, un star-deesh bersha hunte hidjrenn tumari doosh: jek bersh hako diweske, te haiwenn tumer har kowa hi, te tserdau miro wast tumendar krik.
Me, o baro Dewel, penom kowa, un tchatchepah, kowa kamau me ninna te krell kal tsele menshentsa, kai hadan pen ap mande. An kau mulo tato them merenn le, bis te kek lendar buder koi hi.”

Kol murshen, kai o Mose bitchras, te dikenn le pen trujel an o them, un kai anan tchilatcho rakepen pre pral o them, har wan le pale, un kai kran i tsele menshen chojedo ap o Moseste, kolen das o baro Dewel pengri phagi: Jon meran halauter ap jek kopo.
Kokres o Josua, koleskro dad o Nun hi, un o Kaleb, koleskro dad o Jefunne hi, atchan djido kol murshendar, kai djan, te dikenn le pen trujel, har ko them hi.
Har o Mose kol laba ap kol tsele Israelitarja penas, his kol tsele menshenge ropaske.
Un jon djan taissarlake pral ap i berga, un penan: “Mer anam doosh ap mende. Ake ham, un kamah an ko them te djal, kolestar o baro Dewel rakras.”
O Mose penas: “Hoske kamenn tumer gar ap o baro Debleskro lab te shunell? Kowa djal gar mishto tumenge!
O baro Dewel hi gar pash tumende. Djan gar koi pre, te wenn tumer gar maredo kolendar, kai kamenn tumaro merepen!
Kol Amalekarja un kol Kanaanitarja hi koi wergel tardo glan tumende, un tumer wenn mulo dino o chareha. Tumer djan o baro Deblestar krik. Doleske hi lo gar tumentsa.”
Ninna te rakras job jaake, kran jon pal pengro shero, un djan pral ap i berga. O Mose atchas ap i platsa un djas gar lentsa, witar gar ko sonakaskro mochton, kai o Debleskre deesh laba dren hi.
Koi wan kol Amalekarja un kol Kanaanitarja, kai ap i berga djiwan, tele, un dan len, un lan len palla bis pash o foro Horma.
Un o baro Dewel rakras o Moseha, un penas:
Rake ap kol Israelitarja, un pen lenge: Te wenn tumer an ko them, hoi dau me tumende, te djiwenn koi,

un tumer anenn i vieches tumare grumjendar un bakrendar chatchepaske o baro Debleske, hunte denn tumer i chapen koi pashel. Krenn kowa pash hako viecho, hoi mange anenn: pash ko viecho, hoi well tseles chatchedo mange; pash ko viecho, hoi chan tumer khetne glan mande; pash ko viecho, koleha i mensho sikrell, te das lo pes sowel, te dell lo man tchomone; pash ko viecho, hoi kamell i mensho pestar mande te dell; pash ko viecho, hoi chatchrenn tumer mange ap tumare bare diwessa. O latcho sungepen kol viechendar hi mishto mange. Ko chapen, hoi anenn pashel, hunte well jek kilogrammi latcho jarro, un jek litari djet. Kowa well halauter khetne kerdo.
Anenn ninna mool koi pashel! Pash hako terno bakro, hoi well tseles chatchedo, tchorenn jek litari mool, ninna pash hako terno bakro, hoi chan tumer khetne glan o Debleste.
Pash hako baro bakro, hoi chatchreh tu o Debleske, dess tu dui kilogramme latcho jarro, kai jek-te-paash litarja djet dren hi.
Ninna tchoress tu jek-te-paash litarja mool koi pashel. Kowa hi i chapen un i pipen, hoi sungella mishto o baro Debleske.

Te kameh tu o Debleske i grumni te anell, nai well jek, hoi well leske tseles chatchedo, nai well jek, kolah tu sikreh, te dal tut sowel, te deh tchomone o Debleste; nai well jek, hoi deh, te chan tumer o mass khetne glan o baro Debleste,
palle hunte dess koi pashel triin kilogramme latcho jarro, kai dui litarja djet dren hi.
Ninna tchoress tu dui litarja mool koi pashel. Te well kowa halauter chatchedo o baro Debleske, djal i sungepen pre, hoi sungella mishto o baro Debleske.
Jaake hunte kress tu, te aneh mange i grumni, i baro mursh bakro, i terno bakro, ninna pash i busni.
Pash hako viecheste, hoi o Debleske anlo well, hunte well ninna jarro un mool anlo, jaake bud har glan-tchinlo hi.
Hako Israelitari, kai anell tchomone chatchepaske o baro Debleske, hoi leske shukar sungella, hunte krell pal kal laba.

Un te djiwell i wi-themari mashkral tumende, ninna pash tumare tchawende, hoi pal tumende wenna, un job kamell o baro Debleske tchomone te chatchrell, hoi leske shukar sungella, palle hunte krell job jaake har tumer ninna krenna.

Kal laba, hoi penenn tumenge, hoi te krenn an kau koowa hi tumenge lauterenge: tumenge, kol Israelitarja, un ninna kol wawar menshenge, kai mank tumende djiwenna. Kol laba atchenna hako tsiro tumare tchawenge, hoi pal tumende wenna: Glan o baro Debleste hi o wi-themari jaake har tumer han.
I emlige tchatchepaskre laba un o emligo tchatchepen hi tumenge un kolenge, kai hi wi-themarja mank tumende.
Un o baro Dewel rakras o Moseha un penas:
Rake kol tsele menshentsa, un pen ap lende: Te wenn tumer an ko them, kai me tumen anau,
un tumer chan ko maro dran ko them, palle hunte anenn tumer o baro Debleske tchomone:
Dran ko ersto jarro hunte pekenn tumer leske i merkli.
Ninna hunte denn tumer leste ko ersto jarro. Ko lab atchella hako tsireske.
Un te kran tumer jek kol labendar gar, hoi o baro Dewel o Moseske penas, un djinan gar, kai hunte krans kowa,
tchomone lauterestar, hoi o baro Dewel o Moseske penas, hoi tumer hunte krenna, palle hunte denn tumer o baro Debleske i viecho, te well i doosh krik lino.

Te kran i tsele Israelitarja tchomone, hoi i doosh hi, un djinan gar, kai jon hunte krans kowa gar, palle hunte anenn i tsele menshe i terno gurum chatchepaske o baro Debleske, te sungell o sungepen, hoi pre djal ko viechestar, mishto o baro Debleske. Koi pashel denn le ninna i chapen dran jarro un koi mool, jaake bud har tchatcho hi, ninna i mursh busni, te well i doosh krik lino.

Un jaake krell o rashai i tsele menshenge Israel, te well lauter pale mishto mank lende un o Debleste. Un koi doosh well lendar krik lino, – koi doosh, kolatar jon gar djinan, kai kaja i doosh hi, un kolake jon viechen anan un chapen chatchepaske o baro Debleske.
Awa, kai doosh, hoi ap i tsele menshende Israel tchiddo hi, well lendar krik lino, ninna kolendar, kai wi-themarja hi mank tumende.
Te anell jek i doosh ap peste un djinas gar, kai kaja i doosh his, palle hunte dell job jek busni, kai jek bersh phuro hi, te well leskri doosh krik lino.
Un ko rashai chatchrell lat glan o baro Debleste, te well lauter pale mishto mank o Debleste un koleste, kai djinas gar, kai job tchomone tchilatches kras. Un leskri doosh well lestar krik lino.
Un jaake hunte well kowa hakeneske, kai anas i doosh ap peste un djinas gar, kai kaja i doosh hi – nai well i Israelitari, nai well i wi-themari, kai mank tumende djiwell.

Koon krell i tchilatcho koowa, un djinell, kowa hi tchilatcho, ko mensho praassas o baro Debles. Sawo mensho hunte well infam un nai djiwell buder gar mank peskre menshende. Kowa hi jek, koon job hi, – i Israelitari, – i wi-themari.
Job shunas gar ap o baro Debleskro lab. Un kowa, hoi o baro Dewel penas, kras job gar. Doleske well job infam, un leskri doosh atchell ap leste.
Har i Israelitarja an o mulo tato them his, tapran le i murshes, kowa rodas kashta khetne ap o Debleskro diwes.
Un kolla, kai hatsan les koi pashel, har job kashta pre hadas, anan les pash o Moseste un pash o Aroneste un glan i tsele menshende.
Un jon tchiwan les stildo, un djinan gar, hoi te krenn leha.
O baro Dewel penas ap o Moseste: “Ko mursh hunte merella. Kol tsele menshe hunte witsrenn les mulo i barrentsa win glan i platsa.”
Koi kran le jaake har o baro Dewel ap o Moseste penas un anan ko murshes win glan i platsa un witsran barra ap leste, jaake te meras job.
Un o baro Dewel penas ap o Moseste:
“Pen ap kol Israelitarja, te siwenn jon tella ap pengre koola khetne pandle blauete dorja. Kowa hunte krenn ninna lengre tchawe, kai pal lende wenna.

Un kol dorja hi koleske koi: Jaake bud kope har tumer kolla an-dikenn, well tumenge an o shero halauter, hoi o baro Dewel penas, – kol tsele laba, hoi hunte krenn. Jaake mukenn tumen gar o Debleskro dromestar tele te anell tumare jakendar, witar gar shunenn tumer ap kowa, hoi an tumaro shero trujel djal.
Tumenge hunte well halauter pale an o shero, hoi me penom. Un kowa krenna! Palle han mire menshe, kolla mange kokres koi hi.
Me hom tumaro baro Dewel, kai las tumen dran ko them Egiptia win, te wap me tumaro Dewel. Un me, o baro Dewel, hom tumaro Dewel.”

Un o Korach, – leskro dad his o Jizhar, – i Levitari kolendar, kai wan pal o Kohat, ko Korach was chojedo ap o Moseste. Khetne leha his mursha, kai wan dran o kheer Ruben: o Datan un o Abiram, kolengro dad o Eliab his, un o On, koleskro dad o Pelet his. Pash lende his ninna 250 (dui-sheel-te-paash-sheel) wawar Israelitarja, kai pralstune his mank i Israelitarja, wi-rodede un an-dikle mursha.

Un jon halauter wan khetne pash o Mose un o Aron, tchingran ap lende un penan: “Tumer krenn, har te wans bareder har mer wawar! O tselo kheer Israel hi o Debleskre menshe. Un o baro Dewel hi mashkral lende. Hoske hadenn tumer tumen pral o baro Debleskre menshende?”
Har o Mose kowa shunas, witsras lo pes ap peskro mui,

un penas ap o Korach un ap kolende, kai pash leste his: “Taissar penell o baro Dewel, koon leskre menshe hi, kones job peske wi-rodas, un koon nai well pash leste. Un kones job win rodella, kowa nai well pash leste.
Taissarlakro lenn tumenge pirja, tu o Korach un kol tsele mursha, kai pash tute hi!

Un krenn jag koi dren, un tchiwenn sungepaskro koowa koi pre, un anenn kowa glan o baro Debleste! Kones koi o baro Dewel wi-rodella, kowa hi leskro. Tumer, i Levitarja, han kolla, kai krenn, har te wans i bareder!”
Un o Mose penas ap o Korach: “Shunenn, tumer Levitarja!

Hi kowa tumenge gar doha, kai o Israeleskro Dewel tumen win rodas dran i tsele Israelitarja, te wenn pash leste, te krenn tumari budi ap o Debleskro kheer? Tumer nai wenn i tsele menshenge Israel koi.
Job mukas tut, o Korach, un tire tsele phralen, kol Levitarja, pash leste te well. Un tumer kamenn kanna ninna rashai te well!
Tu un tire tsele menshe tchiwan tumen khetne, te hadenn tumen pral o baro Debleste. Kowa hi gar o Aron, pral koleste hadan tumen.”
Un o Mose mukas kol dui murshen, o Datan un o Abiram, pash peste te kharell. Kolengro dad hi o Eliab. Jon penan: “Mer wah gar.
Hi kowa tuke gar doha, kai lal men dran ko them, kai hi bud thud un gwin, un mukeh men te merell an o mulo tato them? Kameh tu ninna rai pral mende te well?
Hi kawa them i them, kai hi bud thud un gwin? Un dal tu men i hachetikri phub un drakengre themma, kai menge hi? Ma pande kol menshen i jaka! Mer wah gar.”
Koi was o Mose chojedo, un penas ap o baro Debleste: “Ma dik latches ap kowa, hoi jon tut denna! Me lom gar i burika lendar, un krom len kek tchilatchepen.”
Un o Mose penas ap o Korach: “Tu un tire tsele menshe hunte wenn taissar glan o baro Debleste, tu un jon un o Aron!
Un hakeno lell peskri piri, un tchiwell sungepaskro koowa dren, un well glan o baro Debleste, hakeno peskri pirjah, dui-sheel un paash-sheel pirja, – ninna tu un o Aron, hakeno peskri pirjah.”
Un hakeno las peskri piri, un tchiwas jag koi dren, un ko sungepaskro koowa koi pre. Un jon djan pash o wudar glan o Debleskro kheer, ninna o Mose un o Aron.
Un o Korach las i tsele menshen khetne ap peskri rig, un was lentsa glan o Debleskro kheer pash o wudar. Koi was o baro Debleskro railepen glan i tsele menshende.
Un o baro Dewel rakras o Moseha un o Aroneha, un penas:
“Djan kol menshendar krik, te marap len sik.”

Kol dui mukan pen ap pengro mui te perell, un penan: “Ach Dewel, tu hal o Dewel, kai das hakenes o djipen! Te kras jek mursh i tchilatcho koowa, kameh tu doleske tiri choli pral i tsele menshende te tchiwell?”
Un o baro Dewel rakras o Moseha, un penas:
“Pen ap i tsele menshende: Djan halauter krik, kai djiwenn trul koi platsa, kai djiwell o Korach, o Datan, un o Abiram!”
O Mose stas pre, un djas pash o Datan un o Abiram, un kol phureder mank i Israelitarja djan leske palla.

Un job penas ap i tsele menshende: “Djan krik kol plachtene kherendar kol menshendar, kai shunenn gar ap o Debleste! Un taprenn ap tchi, hoi len hi, te merenn tumer gar ap ko tselo tchilatcho koowa, hoi jon kran!”

Un jon djan penge un mukan koi platsa, kai djiwas o Korach un o Datan un o Abiram. O Datan un o Abiram djan win dran lengre plachtene khera un his tardo glan o wudar pengre djuwjentsa, tchawentsa, un tchawengre tchawentsa.
Un o Mose penas: “Koi pre hunte dikenn tumer, kai bitchras man o baro Dewel, te krap ko tselo koowa, un kai me kowa gar mandar krau.
Jon te merenna jaake har i tsele menshe merenna, palle bitchras man o baro Dewel gar.

Te krell o baro Dewel tchomone newes, kai i phub krell peskro mui pre, un tserdell len dren lauterentsa, hoi len hi, jaake te djan jon djides tele an o mulengro them, palle djinenn tumer, kai kalla mursha pral o baro Debleste djungeles rakran.”
Un pal kowa, har job kol tsele laba penas, djas koi phub tel lende pre,
un kras peskro mui pre, un tserdas len tele pengre familjentsa un kol tsele menshentsa, kai pash o Korach his, ninna halauter, hoi len hi.
Un jon djan djides tele an o mulengro them lauterentsa, hoi len hi. Un i phub tchakras len. Un jon meran mashkral win dran kol tsele menshende.
Har i wawar Israelitarja, kai trul lende his, shunan, har jon gole dan, nashan le penge. Jon trashan, te chal len i phub ninna pre.
Un o baro Dewel bitchras jag, kai chas kol 250 (dui-sheel-te-paash-sheel) murshen pre, kai anan ko sungepaskro koowa o Debleske.
Un o baro Dewel rakras o Moseha un penas:

“Pen ap o Aroneskro tchaweste, o rashajeste Eleasar, te lell job kol pirja dran i jag, un witsrell koi jag dur krik! Kol tchilatche, kai meran, anan kal pirja glan o baro Debleste. Doleske hi kal pirja o Debleskro un hunte wenn an o Debleskro kheer. Denn kol pirja buchlo, te wenn sane buchle sasterne patria dran lende! Un kolen denn trul o Debleskri chatchepaskri, te wenn le i sikepen, te bistrenn i Israelitarja gar, hoi djas!”
Un o rashai Eleasar las kol sasterne pirja, hoi anan kolla, kai his djides chatchedo, un das i pirja buchlo, te wenn le trul o Debleskri chatchepaskri dino,

jaake har penas o baro Dewel kowa o Moseske. Kol sane sasterne patria his i sikepen, te denn kol Israelitarja jak, te well kek mursh, kai gar o Aroneskre menshendar hi, un anell sungepaskro koowa glan o baro Debleste, te djal leske gar jaake har o Koracheske un kolenge, kai pash leste his.
O wawar taissarlakro his kol tsele Israelitarja chojedo ap o Moseste un ap o Aroneste, un penan: “Tumer kran o baro Debleskre menshen mulo.”
Un har kol tsele menshe trul o Mose un o Aron tardo his, dikan jon pash o Debleskro plachteno kheer. Un ap jek kopo was koi wolka pral o kheer. Un o baro Debleskro railepen was diklo.
Un o Mose un o Aron djan glan o Debleskro plachteno kheer.
Un o baro Dewel rakras o Moseha un penas:
“Djan win kol menshendar. Me kamau len ap jek kopo te marell.” Un kol dui witsran pen ap pengro mui.

Un o Mose penas ap o Aroneste: “Le koi piri, dja pash o Debleskri chatchepaskri un tchip jag lestar an koi piri, un tchip sungepaskro koowa koi pre, un dja sik pash i tsele menshende, un chatche ko sungepaskro koowa, te well lengri doosh krik lino! O baro Debleskri choli was ap lende, un lengri phagi hi kai.”

Un o Aron kras jaake, har o Mose leske penas, un nashas mashkral i tsele menshende un dikas, kai bud menshe mulo his. Koi chatchras job sungepaskro koowa, te dikell o Dewel buder gar ap i menshengri doosh.
Un job his tardo mashkral kol mulende un kol djidende. Koi djas koi phagi krik.
Kolla, kai meran ap koi phagi, his 14.700 (deesh-te-star-serja-efta-sheel) menshe. Mank lende his gar kolla, kai meran khetne o Koracheha.
Un o Aron was pale pash o Moseste pash o wudar glan o Debleskro kheer. Koi phagi his krik.
Un o baro Dewel rakras o Moseha un penas:

“Rake i Israelentsa un le lendar deesh-te-dui lengste kashta. Le len kol pralstunendar pral kol deesh-te-dui bare familje, kai wenna kol deesh-te-dui Jakobeskre tchawendar: hako pralstunestar jek kasht. Un tchin hakeneskro lab koi dren!
O Aroneskro lab hunte tchiness an ko kasht, hoi o khereske Levi hi. Hako pralstuneske hunte well jek kasht koi.
Un tchip kol kashta an o Debleskro plachteno kheer glan ko mochton, kai o Debleskre deesh laba dren hi, kote, kai wau khetne tumentsa.
Palle sikrau i Israelende, kones me wi-rodau: Koleskro kasht well senelo. Jaake krau, te wenn jon buder gar chojedo ap tumende.”
Un o Mose rakras kol menshentsa Israel. Un lengre tsele pralstune dan les deesh-te-dui kashta. Hako pralstuno pral i bari familja das les jek kasht. Un o Aroneskro kasht his ninna mank kol kashta.
Un o Mose tchiwas kol kashta glan o baro Debleste tele an o Debleskro kheer, kai i deesh Debleskre deesh laba dren hi.
Ap o wawar diwes, har o Mose an o Debleskro kheer djas, dikas job, kai wan patria win dran o Aroneskro kasht, hoi o khereske Levi his. Ninna blume djan pre, un rukengre his ap ko kasht.
Un o Mose hidjras kol kashta halauter win o baro Deblestar, pash kol tsele Israelitarja, te dikenn jon kowa. Un hakeno las peskro kasht.

O baro Dewel penas ap o Moseste: “Hidje o Aroneskro kasht pale glan ko mochton, kai o Debleskre deesh laba dren hi, te atchell ko kasht koi, te dikenn les kolla, kai kaman gar te shunell, un jon te tchingrenn gar buder ap mande un merenn.”
Un o Mose kras, har o baro Dewel kowa penas.
Un i Israelitarja penan ap o Moseste: “Dik kai, koon pash o Debleskro kheer wella, kowa hunte merella. Sik wella, kai merah halauter un kek mendar atchell pral. Kameh, te djas mer halauter tele?”

Un o baro Dewel penas ap o Aron: Tu un tire tchawe, un tire menshe, i tsele Levitarja, tumer hunte hidjrenn koi doosh, te krell jek tchomone, hoi gar tchatcho hi pash peskri budi an o Debleskro kheer. Te was tchomone kerdo, hoi gar tchatcho hi pash i rashajeskri budi, hunte less tu kokres tire mursh tchawentsa koi doosh ap tute.

I Levitarja hi tire phrala, kolen less tu pash tute, te atchenn jon pash tute un budrenn tuke. Tu kokres tire tchawentsa han mire rashaja un budrenn glan o Debleskro kheer, kai o Debleskre deesh laba dren hi.

Un kol wawar Levitarja hunte budrenn tuke, un krenn koi budi ap o tselo Debleskro kheer. O Debleskri chatchepaskri un ko tselo Debleskro koowa, koleha budreh tu an o Debleskro kheer, kowa taprenn le gar an, te merenn jon gar, un tumer lentsa.
I Levitarja hunte wenn tumenge pash o wast pash i tseli budi ap o Debleskro kheer. Mukenn kek wawares tumenge pash o wast te well!
Jaake har kanna penom, krenn koi budi an o Debleskro kheer, un koi budi ap o Debleskri chatchepaskri, te well buder gar miri choli pral kol Israelitarja!
Un me lom tumare phralen, i Levitarja, dran i wawar Israelitarja win, te dap len tumende, te wenn le mange koi, o baro Debleske, un krenn koi budi ap o Debleskro plachteno kheer.

Tu un tire tchawe, tumer han mire rashaja, te krenn tumari budi pash o Debleskri chatchepaskri un dren an o kutch isema, hoi pal o wudar dran o kutch kotar than hi. Kai budi dom me tumen. Te well jek wawar pash o Debleskro koowa, hoi koi dren hi, hunte merell lo.
Un o baro Dewel penas ap o Aroneste: Shun, tu budreh mange. Doleske dau me tut un tire tchawen i kotar lauterestar, hoi i Israelitarja mange anenna. Kowa te well jaake hako tsireske.

Tuke hi kol tsele kotja, hoi wenn gar pre-chatchedo kol tsele viechendar, hoi denn le mande, te well lengri doosh krik lino un te well lauter pale mishto, ninna ko tselo chapen, hoi denn le pashel. Kowa halauter hi mange kutch, un me dau les tute un tire tchawende.
Ko chapen hi i Debleskro chapen. Doleske chan kowa ap i Debleskri platsa! Un kokres i mursha un mursh tchawe nai chan les.
Ninna ko wawar koowa, hoi i Israelitarja mange anenn, dau me tute un tire tchawende un tchende, hako tsireske. Koon gar pale-tchiddo hi an tiro kheer nai chal kolestar.

Ko tselo latcheder djet, un ko latcheder mool un djob, ninna lauterestar hoi glanstunes bares was ap i hachetikri phub, kowa halauter, hoi jon o baro Debles dan, dau me tumende. Koon gar pale-tchiddo hi an tiro kheer nai chal kolestar.
Lauter, hoi i Israelitarja an mire wasta dan, hi tumenge.

Hako mursh, kai o phureder tchawo peskri datar hi, – pash i menshende, ninna pash i viechende, – koles jon o baro Debleske anenna, hi tumenge. I menshes dess tu pale un less lowe leske. Ninna i viecho, hoi pale-tchiddo hi, dess tu pale un less lowe leske.
I mursh tchaweske less tu pantch rupene kotja ap ko tsiro, kai hi lo jek tchon phuro. Jek kotar rup hi deesh-te-dui gramme pharo. Jek grammi hi jaake bud har jek grammi an o Debleskro kheer hi.

I grumni, i bakro un i busni dess tu gar pale un less kek lowe lenge. Jon wenn mange. Lengro rat tchoress tu ap o Debleskri chatchepaskri. Un lengro thulepen chatchress tu o baro Debleske, te sungell o sungepen, hoi pre djala, mishto o Debleske.
Lengro mass hi tuke, jaake har ko betch un koi tchatchi heri, te chan tumer kowa khetne glan mande.

Ko tselo koowa, hoi i Israelitarja o baro Debleske anenna, dau me tuke un tire tchawenge un tire tchenge. Un tumenge hi kowa hako tsireske. Ap ko lab dau me miro wast. Kek nai lell ko lab krik, hoi dom tut un tire tchawende, kai pal tute wenna.

Un o baro Dewel penas ap o Aroneste: Ap ko tsiro, kai wenn i Israelitarja an lengro them, leh tu kek kotar phub, hoi djal o dadestar ap o tchaweste dureder, jaake har kowa i wawar Israelitarja lenna. Me hom tiro, un hom tiro brawlepen.
Kol Levitarjen dau me ko deshto kotar lauterestar, hoi an o them Israel bares wella. Jon budrenn ap miro kheer. Doleske lenn jon kowa.

Kanna un an ko tsiro, hoi wella, hunte djan kokres i Levitarja pash o Debleskro kheer, un gar i wawar Israelitarja, te lenn jon kek doosh ap pende un merenna. Kol Levitarja hunte krenn koi budi ap o Debleskro kheer. Un jon hunte hidjrenn i doosh ap pende, te well tchomone kerdo, hoi gar tchatcho hi. Kowa hunte well jaake hako tsireske pash kolende, kai pal tumende wenna. Un len hunte well kek kotar phub, hoi djal dureder o dadestar ap o tchaweste, har kowa i wawar Israelitarja lenna.

Kowa, hoi i Israelitarja mange anenna, ko deshto kotar lauterestar, hoi ap lengre phub bares was, kowa dau me kol Levitarjen. Kowa hi lengro brawlepen. Doleske penom me ap lende, te well len kek kotar phub, har kol wawar Israelitarja lenna.
Un o baro Dewel rakras o Moseha un penas:

Pen ap i Levitarja: Te anenn tumen i Israelitarja o deshto kotar kolestar, hoi ap lengre hachetikri phub bares was, – kowa hi, hoi dau tumenge, – palle hunte denn tumer kolestar mande ninna o deshto kotar.
Un kawa, hoi tumer mande denna, hi jaake, har te dans tumer djob un mool.

Jaake har hako wawar Israelitari della, jaake hunte denn ninna tumer man, o baro Debles, o deshto kotar lauterestar, hoi denn tumen kol Israelitarja. Tumaro kotar hunte denn kol rashajeste, o Aroneste.
Lauterestar, hoi denn le tumende, hunte denn tumer o baro Debles o feteder kotar.
Te kran kowa, palle nai rikrenn tumenge, hoi pral atchell, jaake har o hacho rikrell o djob un i mool, hoi pral atchell.
Tumer nai chan kowa ap haki platsa, tumer un tumare tchawe. Kowa hi o plaissepen tumari budjake ap o Debleskro plachteno kheer.

Tumer anenn koi pashel kek doosh ap tumende, jaake rah har dan tumer ko feteder kotar o baro Debleste. Kowa, hoi i Israelitarja anenna hi mange, o baro Debleske un hunte atchell mange. Doleske denn jak, te denn man glanstunes o feteder kotar, un palle nai chan tumer. Te krenn kowa gar, hunte merenn!
Un o baro Dewel rakras o Moseha un o Aroneha un penas:

Kowa, hoi kanna penau, hunte krenn jaake har penau, ninna an ko tsiro, hoi wella: Pen ap kol Israelitarja, te anenn le pash tute i loli grumni, kai kek nasslepen ap late hi, un kai budras gar ap i hachetikri phub, jaake rah har djiwell li.
Un de lat ko rashajeste Eleasar. Kowa hunte anell lat win glan i plachtene khera. Un kote glan leskre jaka mukell lo lat te marell.
Un ko rashai Eleasar hunte lell lakro ratestar peskro gushteha, un witsrell kowa efta kope kote ap koi rig, kai o Debleskro plachteno kheer tardo hi.
Un job hunte mukell koi grumjat glan leskre jaka pre chatchrell, lakri fella un lakro mass, ninna lakro rat un ful.
Un ko rashai hunte lell kasht ko rukestar, hoi kharella ‘Zeder’, ninna patria ko burestar, hoi kharella ‘Ysop’, ninna lolo bakrengro bal, un witsrell kowa ap koi grumjate, hoi chatchella.
Pal kowa hunte thowell lo pes un ninna peskre koola. Un pal kowa djal lo pash i plachtene khera un atchell pale-tchiddo bis ap i rati.
Un ko mursh, kai chatchras koi grumjat pre, kowa ninna hunte thowell pes un peskre koola, un atchell pale-tchiddo bis ap i rati.

Un i mursh, kai gar pale-tchiddo hi, hunte lell koi jagakri tchik koi grumjatar, un tchiwell lat win glan i plachtene khera ap i djudji platsa, te atchell kai jagakri tchik kote o tselo khereske Israel, te nai krenn le latar i pani thopaske, hoi lell i pale-tchiddo koowa i menshendar krik.

Un ko mursh, kai koi jagakri tchik koi grumjatar khetne las, hunte thowell peskre koola, un atchell pale-tchiddo bis ap i rati. Kowa, hoi kanna penau, atchell jaake tumenge, i Israelitarja, un ninna i wawar menshenge, kai mank tumende djiwenna, hako tsireske:
Koon i mulo menshes an-tapella, kowa hi efta diwessa pale-tchiddo.

Job hunte thowell pes ap o triinto diwes un ap o eftato diwes ko panjeha, hoi lell i pale-tchiddo koowa i menshestar krik. Palle well lo djudjo un erligo. Te thowell lo pes gar jaake ap o triinto diwes un ap o eftato diwes, atchell lo pale-tchiddo.

Te taprell jek i mulo menshes an un kamell pes gar jaake te thowell, palle krell lo o Debleskro kheer pale-tchiddo. Un sawo mensho hunte well infam kerdo un nai djiwell buder gar mank i Israelitarja. Ko pani, hoi lell o pale-tchiddo koowa krik, was gar ap leste witsedo. Doleske atchell lo pale-tchiddo, un ko pale-tchiddo koowa atchell ap leste.
Kowa hi hoi mer hunte kras: Te merell i mensho an peskro plachteno kheer, hunte well hakeno, koon an ko kheer djala, un koon an ko kheer hi, efta diwessa pale-tchiddo.
Ninna haki piri, hako tcharo un khoro, hoi pre un gar pandlo hi, well pale-tchiddo.

Ninna kowa, kai tapras i menshes an, kai meras win ap o them, hi pale-tchiddo efta diwessa. Kowa hi ninna jaake, te was ko mulo mensho kote temerl dino o chareha. Ninna kowa well pale-tchiddo efta diwessa, koon taprell ap i muleskre kokale, ninna kowa, kai taprell ap koi phub, kai o mulo paskedo hi, – job well pale-tchiddo efta diwessa.
Koleske, kai pale-tchiddo hi, hunte lenn tumer jagakri tchik kol grumjatar, hoi pre chatchedo was, tchiwenn kowa an i piri, un tchorenn djudjo pani pre.

Un i mursh, kai gar pale-tchiddo hi, hunte lell kol patria, hoi kharenna ‘Ysop’ un tchiwell len an ko pani un witsrell kowa ap o plachteno kheer un ap kol pirja, tchare un khore, hoi koi dren hi, ninna ap hakeneste, kai an ko kheer hi. Ninna hunte witsrell lo ko pani ap koleste, kai tapras i mules an, leskre kokale, ninna koi phub, kai was job paskedo.

Jek, kai gar pale-tchiddo hi, hunte witsrell ko pani ap koleste, kai pale-tchiddo hi ap o triinto diwes un ap o eftato diwes. Un ko pale-tchiddo hunte thowell pes an ko pani un peskre koola. Palle well job ap i rati djudjo un erligo.

Koon was pale-tchiddo un kamell gar, te well lo thodo ko panjeha, kowa hunte well infam kerdo un nai djiwell buder gar mank i Israelitarja. Job kras o baro Debleskro kheer pale-tchiddo, un ko pani, hoi lell o pale-tchiddo koowa krik, was gar ap leste witsedo. Doleske atchell lo pale-tchiddo.

Jaake well kowa pash tumende kerdo hako tsireske. Un ninna kowa, kai witsras ko pani ap ko pale-tchiddo, hunte thowell peskre koola. Un koon taprell ko pani an, hoi lell o pale-tchiddo koowa krik, kowa hunte atchell pale-tchiddo bis ap i rati.
Un halauter, hoi ko pale-tchiddo an-tapella, well pale-tchiddo. Un koon koles an-tapella, kai pale-tchiddo hi, hunte well pale-tchiddo bis ap i rati.
Un kol tsele Israelitarja wan an o mulo tato them Zin, an o ersto tchon. Un i menshe tchiwan pengre plachtene khera pre pash o foro Kadesh. Un i Mirjam meras koi un was paskedo.
Un i tsele menshen his kek pani, un wan khetne pash o Moseste un o Aroneste.
Un jon tchingran ap o Mose un penan: “Ach, te merams mer an ko tsiro, har mare menshe meran glan o baro Debleste!
Hoske anan tumer o baro Debleskre menshen an kau mulo tato them, te meras mer kate mare viechentsa?
Un hoske anan men dran o them Egiptia ap koi tchilatchi platsa, kai nai tchiwah tchi an i phub, hoi well baro, kai kek faige, kek drake, un kek phabja hi, un witar kek pani pipaske koi hi?”
Koi djas o Mose un o Aron i tsele menshendar krik, pash o wudar glan o Debleskro kheer, un jon witsran pen ap pengro mui. Un o Debleskro railepen mukas pes lendar te dikell.
Un o baro Dewel rakras o Moseha un penas:

“Le ko lengsto kasht un le i tsele menshen khetne, tu un tiro phraal, o Aron, un rakrenn ap ko baro bar glan lengre jaka! Kowa dell tumen pani. Jaake aness tu lenge pani dran ko baro bar, un dess i tsele menshende te pijell un lengre viechen ninna.”
Koi las o Mose ko lengsto kasht, kai glan o baro Debleste tchiddo his, jaake har job kowa leske penas.
Un o Mose un o Aron lan kol tsele menshen khetne glan ko baro bar. Un o Mose penas ap lende: “Shunenn, tumer kai djan hako tsiro pal tumaro shero! Nai lah mer tumenge pani dran kau baro bar?”
Un o Mose hadas peskro wast, un das ko lengsto kashteha dui kope ap ko baro bar. Koi was jaake bud pani dran win, kai pijan i tsele menshe un lengre vieche.
O baro Dewel penas ap o Moseste un ap o Aroneste: “Tumer patsan gar, hoi penom, un sharan man gar glan kol Israelitarja. Doleske anenn tumer gar kol menshen an ko them, hoi me len dau.”
Kau pani kharan le ‘Meriba’. Kate tchingran i Israelitarja ap o baro Debleste. Un kate sikras lo lende, kai job tchatchepah o baro un sorelo Dewel hi.

Har hi le an o foro Kadesh, bitchras o Mose jekes pash o baro rajeste pral kol Edomarja, un mukas leske te penell: “Kowa mukell tuke tiro phraal Israel te penell: Tu djineh, hawo pharo tsiro ap mende was,
kai mare phure an o them Egiptia djan, un mer i rah tsiro an o them Egiptia djiwam, un kai kol Egiptarja menge un mare phurenge o djipen phares kran.
Un mer dam pal o baro Debleste gole. Kowa shunas men un bitchras i bolepaskres. Un job anas men dran o them Egiptia win. Kanna ham an Kadesh, i foro gar dur tiro themestar.

Muk men mank tiro them te djal ap i wawar rig! Mer kamah ap o drom te atchell un gar ap i hachetikri phub un an i drakengre themma te djal. Kamah witar gar pani dran i brunne te pijell. Na-a, mer djah gar tchatches, witar gar serwes, bis te wam ap i wawar rig.”
O baro rai pral o Edom penas ap lende: “Tu djas gar mank miro them! Te weh, wau me pash tute o chareha.”
I Israelitarja penan ap leste: “Mer kamah ap ko shukar drom te djal. Un te pijah mer tiro pani, mer un mare vieche, kamah mer kowa plaissrell. Mer kamah tchi har te djas mare herjentsa koi wergel.”
O baro rai penas: “Tu djas gar koi wergel.” Un kol Edomarja djan win ap ko drom pash lende bud sorele lurdentsa.
Jaake kran kol Edomarja, te djan kol Israelitarja gar mank lengro them. Un o Israel djas i wawar drom.
Un i tsele Israelitarja djan dran o foro Kadesh dureder, un wan pash koi berga Hor.
Un o baro Dewel rakras o Moseha un o Aroneha pash koi berga Hor, hoi gar dur o themestar Edom hi, un penas:
“O Aroneskro tsiro nashas tele, un job well gar an ko them, kai dom i Israelitarjen. Tumer shunan gar ap kowa, hoi penom pash o pani ‘Meriba’.
Le o Arones un leskro tchawes Eleasar, un an len ap koi berga Hor,
un rib o Aroneske peskre rashajeskre koola win, un rib len leskro tchaweste Eleasar an! Un o Aron merella kote.”
Koi kras o Mose jaake har o baro Dewel leske penas. Un jon djan ap koi berga Hor glan kol tsele menshende Israel.
Un o Mose riwas o Aroneske i rashajeskre koola win, un riwas len leskro tchaweste Eleasar an. Un o Aron meras koi, pre ap i berga. Un o Mose un o Eleasar djan i berga tele.
Un har kol tsele menshe dikan, kai o Aron mulo hi, rowas o tselo kheer Israel pral leste 30 (trijanda) diwessa.

Un har ko baro rai pral o foro Arad, ko Kanaanitari, kai djiwell an ko them, kai o kham pralstunes hi, shunas, kai was o Israel ap ko drom pash Atarim, djas job peskre lurdentsa pash lende un kuras pes lentsa, un tchiwas menshen lendar pandlo.
Koi das pes o Israel sowel glan o baro Debleste, un jon penan: “Te deh tu kal menshen an mare wasta, kamah mer lengre forja paash te krell.”
Un o baro Dewel shunas ap o Israel un das kol Kanaanitarjen an lengre wasta. Un jon maran len un kran lengre forja paash. Un dan ko kotar them o lab ‘Horma’.
Palle mukan jon koi berga Hor pal pende un djan dureder ap ko drom, kai djal pash o Baro Lolo Pani. Jaake djan le trul ko them, kai djiwan kol Edomarja. Un i Israelitarja wan chojedo ap o drom.

Un jon tchingran ap o Debleste un ap o Moseste un penan: “Hoske anal tu men dran o them Egiptia win, te meras mer an o mulo tato them, kai hi kek maro un kek pani? Un menge well djungelo ko chapastar, kai kek thulepen dren hi?”
Koi bitchras o baro Dewel tchilatche sapa mank kol menshende. Kolla dandran len jaake, te meran bud Israelitarja.
Koi wan jon pash o Moseste un penan: “Mer anam doosh ap mende, har tchingram ap o baro Debleste un ap tute. Mange o Debles menge, te lell job kol sapa mendar!” Un o Mose mangas kol menshenge.
Koi penas o baro Dewel ap o Moseste: “Kre tuke i sap dran saster! Un tchip les ap i lengsto kasht! Koon dandedo was un dikell koi pre, kowa atchell djido.”
Koi kras o Mose i sap dran saster un tchiwas les pre ap i kasht. Kanna te was jek i sapestar dandedo, dikas kowa ap ko sasterno sap un atchas djido.
Un kol Israelitarja djan dureder, un atchan i tsiro ap i platsa Obot.
Un kotar djan le dureder un atchan i tsiro ap i platsa Ije-Abarim an ko mulo tato them, ap koi rig ko themestar Moab, kai o kham pre djal.
Kotar djan le dureder, un atchan i tsiro pash ko pani Sered.
Kotar djan le dureder, un atchan i tsiro an ko mulo tato them pash o pani Arnon ap koi rig, kai o kham tato hi. O pani Arnon nashell mank o them Moab un o them, kai i Amorarja djiwenn.
Doleske hi tchinlo an ko liil, hoi o baro Debleskre lurdendar rakrell: “Ko foro Waheb an o them Sufa un ko pani Arnon,
hoi i berga tele nashella pash ko foro Ar un djal bis pash o them Moab.”
Un kotar djan jon pash o pani Beer. Koja hi koi brunna, kai o baro Dewel ap o Moseste penas: “Le kol menshen khetne! Me kamau len pani te dell.”
Ap ko tsiro giwas o Israel koi gili: Pani, ab pre! Giwenn pral leste!
Kaja hi koi brunna, hoi kol pralstune wi-hadan. Lengre kashtentsa, awa, lengro rajeskro kashteha, hadan le lat win. Palle mukan le o pani Beer pal pende un djan dureder un wan pash Mattana.
Un kotar djan le dureder un wan pash Nahalijel, un kotar pash Bamot-Baal.
Un jon mukan Bamot-Baal pal pende un wan an ko telstuno them, hoi an o them Moab tchiddo hi, pash koi berga Pisga, hoi tele dikella ap ko pani Jordan.
Un o Israel bitchras murshen pash o baro rajeste pral i Amorarja, – kowa kharas Sihon, – un mukas leske te penell:

“Muk man mank tiro them te djal ap i wawar rig! Mer kamah ap o drom te atchell un gar ap i hachetikri phub un an o drakengro them te djal. Kamah witar gar dran tumare brunne pani te pijell. Ap o drom kamah mer te atchell, bis te wah ap i wawar rig.”

O Sihon mukas i Israelitarjen gar an leskro them. Job las peskre tsele lurden khetne, un djas win an o mulo tato them, te kurell lo pes lentsa. Un har job pash o foro Jahaz was, djas lo pral lende un kuras pes lentsa.

O Israel his sorleder un das les o chareha un las lestar ko them peske, hoi hi mank o pani Arnon un o pani Jabbok un djal bis pash o them, kai kol Ammonarja djiwenna. Ko them, kai i Ammonarja djiwan, djas bis pash o foro Jaser.
Jaake las o Israel peske kal tsele forja, kai djiwan i Amorarja, ninna o foro Heshbon un kol tsele forja, kai koi pashel hi. Un i Israelitarja djiwan kote.
Heshbon hi ko baro foro, kai djiwas o Sihon, ko baro rai pral i Amorarja. Kowa kuras pes glan i tsiro o baro rajeha pral i Moabarja, un las leske leskro tselo them krik, bis pash o pani Arnon.
Doleske well penlo an i gili: Awenn an Heshbon, te well o Sihoneskro foro pale kerdo.
I jag was dran o foro Heshbon, dran o Sihoneskro foro was i jag. Koja chas o foro Ar an o them Moab, un kol berge pash o pani Arnon chas li pre.
Djungelo tuke Moab! Tumer menshe ko deblestar Kemosh han nashedo. Tire tchawe wan dino un nashan, un tire tcha wan pandlo anlo pash o Sihon, ko baro rai pral i Amorarja.
O Heshbon hi paash, un o tselo them bis pash o Dibon. Tchi atchas. I jag chatchras halauter pre bis pash i forja Nofach un Medeba.
Jaake djiwas o Israel an o them, kai i Amorarja djiwan.

Un o Mose bitchras murshen win pash o foro Jaser, te hatsenn le win, har sorelo ko foro hi. Un i Israelitarja lan ko fores penge dren, ninna kol gaba, hoi koi pashel hi. Un jon tradan kol Amorarja krik, kai koi dren his.

Palle rissran le pen un djan pral ap ko drom, kai djal an o them Bashan. Koi was o baro rai pral o them Bashan, – leskro lab hi Og, – peskre tsele lurdentsa pash lende, te kurell lo pes lentsa, un tapras len pash o foro Edrei.

Un o baro Dewel penas ap o Moseste: “Ma traash lendar! Me dom les an tire wasta, ninna o them i menshentsa. Un tu kress leha jaake, har kral o baro rajeha pral i Amorarja, o Sihoneha, kai an Heshbon djiwas.”
Un i Israelitarja dan o baro rajes Og un leskre tchawen un leskre tsele lurden, – kek lendar atchas pral. Un jon lan lengro them penge.
Pal kowa djan i Israelitarja dureder, un djiwan an ko telstuno them pash o pani Jordan, kai i Moabarja djiwan, ap i wawar rig o forestar Jericho.
Un o Balak, koleskro dad o Zippor hi, dikas halauter, hoi o Israel ap kol Amorarja kras.
Un kol Moabarjen his bari daar kol menshendar Israel, kai jaake bud his. Un kol Moabarja trashan lendar.

Un jon penan ap kol phurende mank kol Midianarja: “Kanna chan kol tsele menshe halauter pre, hoi trul mende hi, har i grumni koi senlepen ap i phub pre chala.” O Balak his an ko tsiro o baro rai pral i Moabarja.

Un job bitchras murshen pash o Bileam, koleskro dad o Beor hi. O Bileam djiwas mank peskre menshende an o foro Petor, kai pash ko pani Eufrat tchiddo hi. O baro rai mukas leske te penell: “Am pash mande! I bari natsjona djas dran o them Egiptia win un hi kate an o tselo them. Kal menshe tchiwan pengre plachtene khera pre ap i wawar rig mandar.

Un jon hi sorleder har mer. Am kanna ap miri rig! Rake i bibacht win pral kal menshende! Nai well jaake, kai marau len, un tradau len dran kau them win. Me djinau: Pral koneste tu rakreh i bacht win, ap koleste hi i bacht tchiddo. Un pral koneste tu rakreh i bibacht win, ap koleste hi i bibacht tchiddo.”
Un i phureder kol menshendar Moab un Midian djan khetne pash o Bileam. Un lowe his an lengre wasta o durkepaske. Un jon wan pash leste, un penan leske kol laba, hoi o Balak penas.
Un o Bileam penas ap lende: “Atchenn kai pral i rati! Jaake kamau me tumenge te penell, har o baro Dewel mange kowa penella!” Koi atchan kol pralstune pral i Moabarja pash o Bileam.
Un o baro Dewel was pash o Bileam, un penas: “Koon hi kol menshe, kai pash tute hi?”
O Bileam penas ap o baro Debleste: “O Balak, koleskro dad o Zippor hi, ko baro rai pral kol Moabarja bitchras len pash mande un mukas mange te penell:
‘I bari natsjona was dran o them Egiptia kate, un hi an o tselo them. Am ap miri rig un rake i bibacht win pral kal menshende! Nashte well jaake, kai kurau man lentsa, un tradau len.’”
O Dewel penas ap o Bileam: “Ma dja lentsa! Ma rake i bibacht pral kol menshende win! Miri bacht un soor hi ap lende tchiddo.”
Koi stas o Bileam taissarlake pre, un penas ap kol pralstunende, kolen o Balak bitchras: “Djan an tumaro them pale! O baro Dewel kamell gar, te djap me tumentsa.”
Un kol pralstune pral kol Moabarja djan pale, un wan pash o Balak, un penan: “O Bileam kamas gar mentsa te djal.”
Koi bitchras o Balak budeder un an-dikleder pralstunen har kolla his, pash o Bileam.
Har kolla pash leste wan, penan le ap leste: “Jaake mukell tuke te penell o Balak, koleskro dad o Zippor hi: Muk tuke tchi an o drom te tchiwell, te wess pash mande!
Me kamau tuke brawlepen te dell. Un hoi tu mange peneh, kamau me te krell. Am ap miri rig un rake i bibacht win pral kal menshende!”

O Bileam penas ap kolende, kai bitchras o Balak: “Ninna te dell man o Balak peskro kheer pherdo rup un sonakai, nai tchiwau me gar i lab ap i rig, hoi well o baro Deblestar, kai miro Dewel hi – gar an i tikno koowa, witar gar an o baro koowa.
Atchenn ninna tumer kai rati pash mande, te djinap me, hoi o baro Dewel mantsa rakrella!”
Koi was o baro Dewel an i rati pash o Bileam, un penas ap leste: “Wan kol mursha, te denn jon tut gole, te djas lentsa, palle dja lentsa!”
Koi stas o Bileam taissarlake pre, un tchiwas i ledertikri plachta ap peskri burika un djas kol pralstunentsa pral kol Moabarja.

Koi was o Dewel chojedo koi pral, kai job lentsa djas. Un o bolepaskro o baro Deblestar djas leske an o drom, te rikrell lo les pale. Un o Bileam his beshdo ap peskri burika. Un dui budepangre djan leha.
Un koi burika dikas o baro Debleskro bolepaskro ap o drom tardo i chareha an o wast. Un koi burika djas o dromestar tele, un djas ap i kotar phub. O Bileam das lat, te anell job lat pale ap ko drom.
Koi was o baro Debleskro bolepaskro ap ko drom mashkral kol drakengre berge, kai ap kol dui rigja massurja his.
Un har koi burika o baro Debleskro bolepaskres dikas, djas joi jaake dur ap i rig, te was o Bileameskri heri dukedo ap kol massuri. Un job das lat o duito kopo.
Koi djas o baro Debleskro bolepaskro dureder, un was pale kote ap o drom, kai gar buchlo his, kai kek platsa his, te djas job nai tchatches, witar gar serwes.
Un har koi burika o baro Debleskro bolepaskres dikas, tchiwas pes li tele. Un o Bileam his pre-beshdo. Koi tapras o Bileames i choli. Un job das koi burika i kashteha.
Koi kras o baro Dewel koi burikake o mui pre. Un joi penas ap o Bileam: “Hoi krom me tut, kai dal tu man triin kope?”
O Bileam penas ap i burika: “Tu rikral man dineleske! Te wals man kanna i charo an o wast, doms tut mulo.”
Koi burika penas ap o Bileam: “Hom me gar tiri burika, kai tu beshal pre tiro tselo djipen? Krom me jaake tuha glan ko tsiro?” Job penas: “Na-a!”

Koi kras o baro Dewel o Bileameske i jaka pre, kai nai dikas job o baro Debleskro bolepaskres ap o drom tardo i chareha an o wast. Un o Bileam tchiwas pes ap peskre tchanga tele un witsras pes ap peskro mui.
Un o baro Debleskro bolepaskro penas ap leste: “Hoske dal tu tiri burika triin kope? Dik, me wom pash tute, te rikrap tut pale. Tiro drom, hoi tu djah, hi gar mishto an mire jaka.
Un koi burika dikas man, un djas peske triin kope mandar. Te djals joi gar mandar, jaake doms me tut mulo. Un koi burika mukoms te djiwell.”
Koi penas o Bileam ap o baro Debleskro bolepaskro: “Me anom doosh ap mande. Me djinom gar, kai tu kamal man pale te rikrell ap o drom. Un kanna, te hi kowa tuke gar mishto, jaake djau me pale pale.”
O baro Debleskro bolepaskro penas ap leste: “Dja kol murshentsa! Ma rake wawar koowa har me tuke penau!” Jaake djas o Bileam kol pralstunentsa, kai o Balak bitchras.
Har o Balak shunas, kai o Bileam was, djas job pash leste an o foro Ar, kai pash o pani Arnon tchiddo hi, – kote kai weh an o them Moab.
Un penas ap leste: “Bitchrom me gar murshen pash tute un mukom tut te kharell? Hoske wal tu gar pash mande? Patseh tu gar, kai me nai dau tut brawlepen?”
Penas o Bileam ap leste: “Ake hom. Shun, me nai rakrau tchi wawar har kowa, hoi mange o baro Dewel an o mui tchiwas. Kowa kokres nai rakrau me.”
Jaake djas o Bileam o Balakeha. Un jon wan an o foro Kirjat-Huzot.
Un o Balak maras grumjen un bakren o Debleske, un bitchras ko massestar pash o Bileam, un pash kol pralstunende, kai pash leste his.
Un taissarlakro las o Balak o Bileames peha, un anas les pral ap i berga Bamot-Baal, te dikell job kotar ap kol tsele menshende Israel.
O Bileam penas ap o Balak: “Muk kate ap efta platse barra pre te tchiwell, kai nai chatchrau viechen o Debleske, un an mange efta terne gurma un efta bakre!”
O Balak kras jaake har o Bileam penas. Un hake dui, o Balak un o Bileam, chatchran o Debleske ap haki chatchepaskri jek terno gurum un jek bakro.

Un o Bileam penas ap o Balak: “Dja pash ko viecho, hoi chatchreh o Debleske. Me kamau dureder te djal. Nai well, te mukell pes o baro Dewel glan mande te dikell. Palle kamau tuke te penell, hoi job mande sikrella.” Un job djas ap i berga, kai hi kek weesh.
Un o Dewel mukas pes glan o Bileam te dikell. Kowa penas ap leste: “Efta chatchepangre krom me, un ap haki chatchepaskri chatchrom i terno gurum un i bakro.”
O baro Dewel tchiwas o Bileameske o lab an o mui un penas: “Dja pale pale pash o Balak un pen jaake!”
Un har job pash o Balak was, his job pash ko viecho tardo, hoi chatchras job o Debleske. Un pash leste his kol tsele pralstune pral i Moabarja.

Koi penas o Bileam kal laba: O Balak, ko baro rai pral i Moabarja, mukas man te anell dran o them Aram, dran kol berge, kai o kham pre djala. Un job penas ap mande: Am ap miri rig, un rake i bibacht pral o Jakobeskre menshende win! Awa, am un praasse i Israeleskre menshen!
Har nai rakrau me i bibacht win pral kolende, ap kolende o baro Dewel kek bibacht tchiwella? Har nai praassau me jekes, koles o baro Dewel gar praassella?
Pral ap i berga hom tardo, un dikau tele ap kol menshende. Jon hi menshe, kai djiwenn penge, un djinenn, kai jon gar hi har i wawar menshe.

Kek djinell, har bud menshe o Jakobeskre menshe hi. Awa, kek nai hatsell win, har bud serja i Israelitarja hi? Me kamau, te merap jaake har jek lendar, kol tchatche menshendar. Miro merepen mu well har lengro merepen!
Koi penas o Balak ap o Bileam: “Hoi kre tu mantsa? Me mukom tut kate te anell, te rakress i bibacht win pral kolende, kai man pre chana. Tu rakreh i bacht pral lende win.”
O Bileam penas: “Rikrap me gar kowa dren un rakrap, hoi o baro Dewel mange an o mui tchiwas?”
O Balak penas ap leste: “Am mantsa ap i wawar platsa, kai dikeh i tsele menshen un gar i tikno kotar lendar har kate! Un kote rake i bibacht win pral o Israel!”
Un job anas les pash i phub, hoi kharella ‘dur dikepen’, ap koi berga Pisga, un kras efta chatchepangre, un chatchras ap haki chatchepaskri o Debleske i terno gurum un i bakro.
Un o Bileam penas ap o Balak: “Dja pash tiro viecho, hoi chatchreh o Debleske! Me kamau dureder te djal, te wap khetne o Debleha.”
Un o baro Dewel was pash o Bileam, un tchiwas leske o lab an o mui, un penas: “Dja pale pash o Balak un pen jaake.”

Un har job pash leste was, his job pash ko viecho tardo, hoi chatchrell job o Debleske. Un kol tsele pralstune pral kol Moabarja his pash leste tardo. Un o Balak putchas lestar: “Hoi penas o baro Dewel?”
Koi penas o Bileam kal laba ap leste: Tu, o Balak, koleskro dad o Zippor hi, ste pre, un shun! Muk kowa an tiro shero dren te djal, hoi me penau!
O Dewel hi gar i mensho, kai chochella, witar gar i mensheskro tchawo, koles khaitell, hoi job kras. Penell job tchomone, hoi job gar krella? Penell job kowa, kai rikrell job gar?
Shun, job penas mange te rakrap i bacht pral kol menshende win. Job tchiwas i bacht pral lende. Un me nai krau tchi wawares.
Me dikau kek bibacht ap o Jakob un kek tchilatchepen ap o Israel. O baro Dewel hi lengro Dewel un hi pash lende. Job hi lengro baro rai, koleske giwenn le i bachtjatar.
O Dewel las len dran o them Egiptia win, un kurell pes lenge har i diwjo gurum.
Koi hi kek durkepen, hoi rakreh nai win pral o Israel, witar kek bengeskro koowa, hoi nai krals tu o Jakobeskre menshentsa. Pral lende well penlo: Dikenn, hawo baro koowa o Dewel lenge kras!
Kai natsjona hi har i terni bari margodja, un well sorelo har i bari margodja, hoi tchiwell pes gar tele, bis te chas li pre, hoi joi maras, un pijas ko rat kolendar, hoi joi mulo das.
Koi penas o Balak ap o Bileam: “Te rakreh tu gar i bibacht win pral lende, hunte rakress tu witar gar i bacht win pral lende!”
O Bileam penas ap leste: “Penom me tuke gar: Lauter, hoi o baro Dewel penella, kowa rakrau me.”
O Balak penas ap leste: “Am kai! Me kamau tut ap i wawar platsa te anell. Nai well jaake, kai hi kowa mishto glan o Debleskre jaka, kai tu kote pral lende i bibacht win rakreh.”
Un o Balak anas les pash i berga Peor, kai nai dikas lo tele ap koi telstuno them pash o pani Jordan.
Un o Bileam penas ap o Balak: “Kre mange kate efta chatchepangre, un an mange kate efta terne gurma un efta bakre!”
O Balak kras, har o Bileam penas, un chatchras ap haki chatchepaskri jek terno gurum un jek bakro.

Har o Bileam kanna dikas, kai o baro Debleske kowa mishto hi, te rakrell lo i bacht pral o Israel win, rodas job gar pal i sikepen, hoi leske penell, hoi o Dewel kamella, jaake har kras job kol wawar kope. Job rissras pes un dikas ap o mulo tato them,
un dikas kol Israelitarja, har lengre plachtene khera tardo hi, haki bari familja peske. Un o Debleskro ducho was ap leste.
Un job penas kal laba: Kowa penell o Bileam, koleskro dad o Beor hi. Kowa penell ko mursh, kai wan leske i jaka pre kerdo.
Kowa penella, kai shunell o Debleskro rakepen. Me dikau, hoi o sorelo Dewel mande sikrella. Mire jaka wenn pre kerdo, te djau ap i tchanga.
Har shukar hi tire plachtene khera, Jakob, kai tu djiweh, Israel.
Har i telstuno them, hoi well buchlo, har i baar pash o pani, har kol sorele ruka, hoi o baro Dewel an i phub tchiwas, har kol zedertikre ruka, hoi pash o pani tardo hi.

An o Israeleskro them hi bud pani, un leskri phub, kai o djob un o gib bares wenna, hi budeder har doha pani. Leskro baro rai well bareder har o Agag. Un leskro them un leskre menshe wenn sorleder har i wawar menshe trul lende.
O baro Dewel anas len win dran o them Egiptia, un kurell pes lenge har i diwjo gurum. Jon chan kol menshen, kai len palla lenna, un denn lengre kokale paash, un denn len mulo karje.

O Israel tchiwas pes tele har i bari margodja, awa, har i terni bari margodja. Kek kamell lat pre djangrell. Bacht un soor well koles, kai rakrell i bacht pral tute win, Israel! Un bibacht well ap koleste, kai rakrell i bibacht win pral tute.

Koi was o Balak chojedo ap o Bileam. Un job das i wasta khetne, un penas ap leste: “Me dom tut gole, te rakress i bibacht win pral kolende, kai man pre chana. Un dik, tu rakral triin kope i bacht pral lende win.
Dja kanna tuke! Dja an tiro them! Me kamom te dap tut bud brawlepen. O baro Dewel kamas gar te dap tut brawlepen.”
Koi penas o Bileam ap leste: “Penom me gar ap tire murshende, kolen pash mande bitchral:

Ninna te dell man o Balak peskro kheer pherdo rup un sonakai, nai tchiwau me gar o Debleskro lab ap i rig. Me nai rakrau gar latchepen un tchilatchepen har me kamau. Hoi o baro Dewel rakrella, kowa rakrau ninna.
Un kanna djau pash mire menshende. Glan kowa kamau tuke te penell, hoi kal menshe tire menshenge krenna an o tsiro, hoi wella!”
Un job penas kal laba: Kowa penell o Bileam, koleskro dad o Beor hi. Kowa penell ko mursh, kai wan leske i jaka pre kerdo.
Kowa penell, kai shunell o Debleskro rakepen, un koon djinella, hoi ko pralstuno krella. Me dikau, hoi o sorelo Dewel mange sikrell. Mire jaka wenn pre kerdo, te djau ap i tchanga.
