Me dikau jekes. Kowa hi kanna gar koi. Dural dikau les. Dran o Jakob well jek, kai djal pre har i bolepaskri momeli. Dran o Israel well i baro rai, un dell i Moabarja khetne. Un kol murshenge, kai wenna pal o Set, dell lo ap o shero.
O tselo them Seir lell job peske, ko them, kai djiwenn i Edomarja, kolla, kai kamenn o Israel pre te chal. O Israel hi sorleder har jon.
Dran o Jakob well kowa, koles penepaske hi, un marell ninna kolen, kai pral atchan an lengre forja.
Un har o Bileam kol Amalekarja dikas, penas lo kal laba: “Amalek hi ko pralstuno mashkral kol natsjone. Ninna job well maredo an ko tsiro, hoi wella.”
Un har job kol Kenarja dikas, penas lo kal laba: “Sorelo hi tiro kheer. Un tu kral tiro kheer har i tchirklengro kheer pral ap i sorelo un baro bar.
Ninna tu, o Kain, weh maredo. Un ap ko tsiro anell o Assur tut pandlo krik.”
Un job rakras pale un penas kal laba: “Koon atchell djido ap ko tsiro, kai krell o Dewel kowa?
Un shiffe wenna dran o them Kittim un anenn lurden, kai perenn an i themma Assur un Eber. Pal halauter djal ninna Kittim paash.”
Un o Bileam hadas pes un djas kote, un was pale an peskro them. Un o Balak djas peskro drom.
Un i Israelitarjen his pengre plachtene khera pash o foro Shittim. Kote mukan pen i mursha dren kol tchentsa dran o them Moab.
Kolla kaman, te wenn i Israelitarja lentsa, te anenn jon viechen pengre deblenge. Un i Israelitarja wan lentsa un chan ko massestar un mangan kolengre deblen an.
Jaake nashas o Israel o chocheno debleske, o Baal-Peor, palla. Koi was o baro Debleskri choli pral o Israel.
Un job penas ap o Moseste: “Le kol tsele pralstunen pral i Israelitarja un pande len glan mande pre, mashkral o diwes, te dikell len hakeno. Palle lau miri bari choli i menshendar Israel krik!”
Un o Mose penas ap kol Israeleskre tchatchepangre: “Denn mulo hakeno peskre menshen, kai nashan o Baal-Peor palla!”

Un i tsele Israelitarja his tchiddo o ropah glan o Debleskro plachteno kheer. Koi anas i mursh dran Israel i Midianetsa an o plachteno kheer peskri familjatar. Un o Mose un i tsele israelitarja dikan kowa.
Har o Pinhas, koleskro dad o Eleasar hi, un koleskro papo o rashai Aron his, kowa dikas, stas lo pre, mukas i wawaren, kai kote khetne his, las i witsepaskro tchuri an o wast,

un djas pal kol Israelitari an leskri isema, un das an kol dujende khetne dren tchurje, an ko mursheste, kai well dran Israel un an koi djuwel. Koi heras ko nasslepen pre, hoi ap i Israelitarja tchiddo his.
Un lestar meran 24.000 (biish-te-star-serja) menshe.
Un o baro Dewel rakras o Moseha un penas:

“O Pinhas, koleskro dad o Eleasar hi, un koleskro papo o rashai Aron his, kowa las miri choli kol Israelendar krik. Job his jaake chojedo har me homs, un kras, te marom me gar i tsele Israelitarjen an miri choli.
Doleske pen leske: ‘Dik, me kamau tuha win te krell, te was mer mala,
un doleske wess tu un tire tchawe pal tute hako tsireske mire rashaja. Tiro dji chatchas tiro Debleske un tu kral, te was kol Israelenge i doosh krik lino.’”
Ko mursh dran Israel, kai was mulo dino khetne koi Midianetsa, kharas Simri, leskro dad his o Salu. Kowa his i pralstuno i menshendar Simeon.
Koi djuwel dran Midian, kai ninna mulo dino was, kharas Kosbi. Lakro dad his o Zur. Kowa his o pralstuno i bari familjatar mank kol Midianarja.
Un o baro Dewel rakras o Moseha un penas:
“Djan ap i Midianarja un marenn len!

Jon anan tumen an i bibacht, har anan le tumen jaake dur, te mangan o Baal-Peor an. Un jon anan tumen an i bibacht lengri phenjah Kosbi, kolakro dad i pralstuno pral kol Midianarja his. Koja was mulo dino ap ko diwes, kai was ko nasslepen pral tumende pash i berga Peor.”
Pal ko pharo nasslepen, rakras o baro Dewel ap o Moseste un ap o Eleasareste, koleskro dad o rashai Aron his, un penas:
“Tchinenn an i liil har bud mursh Israelitarja koi hi, kai hi soreles doha, te wenn le lurde. Tchinenn kolen pre, kai hi biish bersha phuro un phureder! Tchinenn ninna pre hawe menshendar jon wenna!”

Un o Mose un o rashai o Eleasar kran kowa jaake, har o baro Dewel o Moseske penas, un dan kol tsele murshen, kai biish bersh un phureder his, khetne gole pash o pani Jordan an o telstuno them, kai i Moabarja djiwan, wergel o forestar Jericho. Kolla his kol Israelitarja, kai wan dran o them Egiptia win:
O kheer Ruben: O Ruben his o Jakobeskro phureder tchawo. Leskre tchawe his o Henoch, o Pallu,
o Hezron un o Karmi. Kolendar wenna i Henocharja, i Palluarja, i Hezronarja un i Karmarja.
Kalla halauter wan o Rubenestar. Un khetne his le 43.730 (star-deesh-te-triin-serja-efta-sheel-triin-deesh) mursha.
Un kolla, kai wan pal o Pallu his leskro tchawo, o Eliab,

un koleskre tchawe, o Nemuel, o Datan un o Abiram. Kolla hi ko Datan un o Abiram, kai wan wi-rodedo, te wenn le pralstune, un pal i tsiro hadan le pen pral o Mose un o Aron, un kran pen khetne kol menshentsa, kai wan pal o Korach, har jon hadan pen pral o baro Debleste.

Un i phub kras peskro mui pre, un tserdas len tele khetne o mursheha, o Korach. Un kol 250 (dui-te-paash-sheel) mursha, kai djan lentsa, meran an i jag. Jaake wan le i sikepen, te dikan i menshe, hoi hi.
Kol tchawe o Korachestar meran gar halauter.
O kheer Simeon: Leskre tchawe his o Jemuel, o Jamin, o Jachin, o Serach un o Shaul. Lendar wenna i Jemuelarja, i Jaminarja, i Jachinarja, i Seracharja un i Shaoularja.
Kalla halauter wan o Simeonestar. Un khetne his le 22.200 (biish-te-dui-serja-dui-sheel) mursha.
O kheer Gad: Leskre tchawe his o Zifjon, o Haggi, o Shuni, o Osni, o Eri, o Arod un o Areli. Lendar wenna i Zifjonarja, i Haggarja, Shunarja, i Osnarja un i Erarja, i Arodarja un i Areljarja.
Kalla halauter wan o Gadestar. Un khetne his le 40.500 (star-deesh-serja-pantch-sheel) mursha.
O kheer Juda: Leskre phureder tchawe his o Er un o Onan. Kol dui meran an o them Kanaan.
Pal lende was o Shela, o Perez, un o Serach. Kolendar wan i Shelanarja, i Perezarja un i Seracharja. Kol tchawe fun o Perez his o Hezron un o Hamul. Kolendar wenna kol Hezronarja un kol Hamularja.
Kalla halauter wan o Judaestar. Un khetne his le 76.500 (efta-deesh-te-shob-serja-pantch-sheel) mursha.
O kheer Issachar: Leskre tchawe his o Tola, o Puwa, o Jashub, un o Shimron. Kolendar wenna kol Tolarja, kol Puwanarja, kol Jashubarja un kol Shimronarja.
Kalla halauter wan o Issacharestar. Khetne his le 64.300 (shob-deesh-te-star-serja-triin-sheel) mursha.
O kheer Sebulon: Leskre tchawe his o Sered, o Elon, un o Jachleel. Kolendar wenna kol Seredarja, kol Elonarja un kol Jachleelarja.
Kalla halauter wan o Sebulonestar. Khetne his le 60.500 (shob-deesh-serja-pantch-sheel) mursha.
O Josefes his dui tchawe: o Manasse un o Efrajim.
O Manasse his o dad jek tchawestar, kowa his o Machir. Kolestar wenna kol Machirarja. O Machir las i tchawo, kowa kharas Gilead. Kolestar wenna kol Gileadarja.
O Gileadeskre tchawe hi: o Jeser, o Helek, o Asrijel, o Sichem, o Shemida, un o Hefer. Kolendar wenna kol Jeserarja, kol Helekarja, kol Asrijelarja, kol Sichemarja, kol Shemidarja, un kol Heferarja.
O Hefer las i tchawo. Kowa his o Zelofhad. Un koles his kek tchawe. Les his tcha. Kolla kharan Machla, Noa, Hogla, Milka, un Tirza.
Kalla halauter wan o Manassestar. Khetne his le 52.700 (pantch-deesh-te-dui-serja-efta-sheel) mursha.
O Efrajim his o dad triin tchawendar: o Shutelach un o Becher, un o Tachan. Kolendar wenna kol Shutelacharja, kol Becherarja un kol Tahanarja.
O Shutelach las i tchawo. Kowa his o Eran. Kolestar wenna kol Eranarja.
Kalla halauter wan o Efrajimestar. Khetne his le 32.500 (trijanda-te-dui-serja-pantch-sheel) mursha.
O kheer Benjamin: Leskre tchawe his o Bela, o Ashbel, o Ahiram, o Shufam, o Hufam. Kolendar wenna kol Belarja, kol Ashbelarja, kol Ahiramarja, kol Shufamarja, kol Hufamarja.
O Bela his o dad dui tchawendar. Kolla his o Ard un o Naaman. Kolendar wenna kol Naamanarja un kol Ardarja.
Kalla halauter wenn o Benjaminestar. Khetne his le 45.600 (star-deesh-te-pantch-serja-shob-sheel) mursha.
O kheer Dan: Leskro tchawo his o Shuham. Kolestar wenna kol Shuhamarja. Kalla hi halauter, kai wan pal o Dan.
Khetne his kol Shuhamarja 64.400 (shob-deesh-te-star-serja-star-sheel) mursha.
O kheer Asser: Leskre tchawe his o Jimna, o Jishwi un o Berja. Kolendar wenna kol Jimnarja kol Jishwarja un kol Berjarja.
O Berja las tchawe. Kolla his o Heber un o Malkijel. Kolendar wenna kol Heberarja un kol Malkijelarja.
O Asser, les his i tchai, koja kharas Serach.
Kalla halauter wan pal o Asser. Khetne his le 53.400 (pantch-deesh-te-triin-serja-te-star-sheel) mursha.
O kheer Naftali: Leskre tchawe his o Jachzeel, o Guni, o Jezer, o Shillem. Kolendar wenna kol Jachzeelarja, kol Gunjarja, kol Jezerarja un kol Shillemarja.
Kalla halauter wan pal o Naftali. Khetne his le 45.400 (star-deesh-te-pantch-serja-star-sheel) mursha.
I tsele Israelitarja his khetne 601.730 (shob-sheel-te-jek-serja-efta-sheel-te-triin-deesh) mursha.
Un o baro Dewel rakras o Moseha un penas:
“Tu dess hako khereske, kai well o Jakobeskre deesh-te-dui tchawendar, lengro kotar them pal kowa har bud jon hi, te well ko them lengro.
Kol familjenge, kolen bud menshe hi, hunte dess tu bud them, te well lo lengro. Un kol familjenge, kolen gar bud menshe hi, hunte dess gar jaake bud.
Witsrenn i bachtjakre barra, te hatsenn win, koon o Jakobeskre tchawendar hawo kotar them lella.
Jaake har i barra sikrenn, de len lengro them, i bari familjake i baro them un i tikneder familjake i tikneder them.”
O kheer Levi: Lengre laba wan pre tchinlo pal kol triin tchawende o murshestar Levi: o Gershon, o Kohat un o Merari. Lendar wenna kol Gershonarja, kol Kohatarja un kol Merarja.
Kalla hi kol familje, kai wenn pal o Levi: kol Libnarja, kol Hebronarja, kol Machlarja, kol Musharja, kol Koracharja. O murshestar Kohat well o Amram.
Koleskri romni kharas Jochebed, lakro dad his o Levi. Koja was boldo an o them Egiptia. Un joi anas o Aron, o Mose un lengri pheen, i Mirjam ap i phub.
O Aroneske wan tchawe boldo. Kolla his o Nadab, o Abihu, o Eleasar, un o Itamar.
O Nadab un o Abihu meran, har anan jon glan o baro Debleste sawo sungepaskro koowa, hoi gar jaake kerdo his, har o baro Dewel kowa kamas.
Un i tsele mursh Levitarja, kai his jek tchon un phureder, his khetne 23.000 (biish-te-triin-serja). Jon lan kek them har i wawar Israelitarja. Doleske wan le gar lentsa khetne ginlo.

Jaake bud his kol Israelitarja, kolengre laba o Mose un o rashai Eleasar an i liil tchinan, har anan le len khetne pash o pani Jordan an o telstuno them, kai kol Moabarja djiwan, wergel o foro Jericho.
Mashkral kolende his kek buder djido kolendar, kolengre laba o Mose un o rashai Aron an i liil tchinan, har dikan le pal, har bud jon hi, an o mulo tato them Sinai.
O baro Dewel penas lenge, kai jon hunte merenn an o mulo tato them. Un jaake atchan kek lendar djido har kokres o Kaleb, koleskro dad o Jefunne his, un o Josua, koleskro dad o Nun his.

Un o Zelofhad, koleskro dad o Hefer his, koleskro dad o Gilead his, koleskro dad o Machir his, koleskro dad o Manasse his, koleskro dad o Josef his, les his pantch tcha: i Machla, i Noa, i Hogla, i Milka, un i Tirza.
Kolla wan pash o wudar glan o Debleskro kheer un penan ap o Moseste un ap o Eleasar, ko rashajeste, glan kol pralstunende un i tsele Israelitarja, kai koi hi:
“Maro dad meras an o mulo tato them, un his gar mashkral kolende, kai djan o Koracheha un hadan pen pral o baro Debleste. Job meras peskri doshake, hoi job kras. Un les his kek mursh tchawe.
Hoske hunte djal maro dadeskro lab tele doleske, kai les kek mursh tchawe hi? De men ninna i kotar them an o them kol phralendar maro dadestar!”
O Mose anas lengro koowa glan o baro Debleste.
Un o baro Dewel penas ap leste:
“Kol tcha fun o Zelofhad penan o tchatchepen. Tu hunte dess len i kotar them an ko them, hoi deh kol phralende lengro dadestar, un hunte dess lengro dadeskro them lende.
Un pen kol Israelenge: Te merell jek, un koles hi kek mursh tchawo, hunte denn leskro them leskri tchate.
Un te hi les kek tchai, hunte denn kowa leskre phralende.
Te hi les kek phrala, hunte denn kowa kol phralende leskro dadestar.
Te hi leskro dades kek phrala, hunte denn kowa leskre menshende, kai lestar wenna, te lenn jon kowa halauter. Kowa hunte well pash i Israelitarja jaake har o baro Dewel kowa o Moseske penas.”
Un o baro Dewel penas ap o Moseste: “Dja pre ap koi berga Abarim un dik ap ko them, hoi dau me i Israelende.
Un te dikal tu kowa, mereh tu, jaake har tiro phraal Aron ninna meras.

Kowa well doleske, kai shunan gar ap miro lab an o mulo tato them Zin, har i Israelitarja chojedo his un pal pani gole dan, un tumer mukan man gar te sikrap, te hom tchatchepah o baro un sorelo Dewel, kai nai dell len pani.” Kowa his pash o foro Kadesh an o mulo tato them Zin. Ko pani was kharedo ‘tchingepaskro pani’.
Un o Mose rakras o baro Debleha un penas:
“Mo rai, tu baro Dewel, kolestar o tselo djipen well, tchip i murshes pral i Israelitarja,
jekes, kai djal glan lende win un dren, un anell len win un dren, te wenn o baro Debleskre menshe gar har bakre, kai len kek bakrengro hi.”
Un o baro Dewel penas ap o Moseste: “Le o Josua pash tute, koleskro dad o Nun hi. O Josua hi i mursh, ap koleste miro ducho tchiddo hi. Un tchip tire wasta ap leste,
un an les glan o rashajeste Eleasar un glan i tsele Israelitarja. Un pen lenge halauterenge, te hi job kowa, kai pal tute lengro rai well.
Un de les tiro tchatcho wast, te shunenn i tsele Israelitarja ap leste.

Un an tsirja, kai djinell lo gar, hoi te krell, hunte well lo glan o rashajeste Eleasar. Kowa hunte putchell mandar un hunte witsrell kol Debleskre barra, te hatsell lo win, hoi me, o baro Dewel, an kau koowa kamau. Jaake te sikrell o Eleasar o Josueske un i tsele Israelenge, hoi te krenn le.”
O Mose kras jaake har leske o baro Dewel penas, un las o Josua, un mukas les glan o rashajeste Eleasar te djal un glan kol tsele Israelitarja,
un tchiwas peskre wasta ap leste, un tchiwas les an peskri budi dren, jaake har o baro Dewel leske kowa penas.
Un o baro Dewel rakras o Moseha un penas:
Pen ap i Israelitarja: Tumer hunte denn jak, te anenn an o tchatcho tsiro ko koowa, hoi denn o Debleste, – ko chapen, hoi well leske chatchedo un koleskro sungepen leske shukar sungella.
Un pen ap lende: Kalla hi kol vieche, hoi hunte chatchrenn tseles o baro Debleske: hako diwes dui bakre, kai jek bersh phuro un gar nasselo hi.
Jek bakro taissarlakro, ko wawar ap i rati.
Koi pashel jaake jek kilogrammi latcho jarro, hoi was khetne dino jek litari djeteha.

Kowa hi ko chapen, hoi te chatchrenn hako diwes, jaake har anan les o ersto kopo pash koi berga Sinai. Un o latcho sungepen, hoi pre djal, te well kowa halauter chatchedo an i jag, sungell mishto o baro Debleske.
Koi pashel well jek litari mool win tchoredo o baro Debleske an leskro kheer.
Ap i rati aness ko wawar terno bakro! Koi pashel o chapen un i mool har taissarlakro. Un o latcho sungepen, hoi pre djal, te well kowa halauter chatchedo an i jag, sungella mishto o baro Debleske.
Ap o Debleskro diwes aness dui bakre, hoi jek bersh phuro hi. Jon hunte wenn gar nasselo. Koi pashel aness dui kilogramme latcho jarro khetne dino djeteha. Ninna tchoress mool win o Debleske.
Kowa well o Debleske hako Debleskro diwes anlo. Koi pashel kowa, hoi well leske hako diwes chatchedo, un koi mool, hoi well leske win tchoredo.
Ap o ersto diwes an hako tchon hunte chatchrenn tumer o baro Debleske dui terne mursh grumja, jek mursh bakro un efta jek-bershengre bakre, kai gar nasselo hi.
Un pash hako viecho denn o Debleste i chapen dran latcho jarro djeteha: pash i mursh grumni triin kilogramme jarro, pash i mursh bakro dui kilogramme jarro,
un pash i terno bakro jek kilogrammi jarro. Kawa well chatchedo o baro Debleske. Un o latcho sungepen, hoi djal pre, te well kowa halauter chatchedo an i jag, sungella mishto o baro Debleske.

Un koi pashel tchorenn mool win o Debleske: dui litarja pash haki terni mursh grumni, jek-te-paash litarja pash i mursh bakro, un jek litari pash hako terno bakro. Kawa well chatchedo hako newo tchon.
Koi pashel hunte anenn i mursh busni o baro Debleske, te well tumari doosh krik lino. Kowa halauter well pash kol vieche un ko jarro un koi mool, hoi well hako diwes o Debleske anlo.
Ap o deesh-te-starto diwes an o ersto tchon hi ko diwes, hoi hi o baro Debleske, un hoi kharell Passa.
Un ap o deesh-te-pantchto diwes ninna an ko tchon, hi ko ersto diwes kol efta diwessa, kai hunte chan kek maro dran shutlo jarro.
Ap o ersto diwes hunte wenn khetne glan o baro Debleste. Kek hunte budrell ap ko diwes.
Un hunte chatchrenn o baro Debleske dui terne mursh grumja, jek mursh bakro, un efta jek-bershengre bakre, kai gar nasselo hi.
Koi pashel ko chapen dran latcho jarro djeteha: triin kilogramme haki terni mursh grumjake un dui kilogramme hako mursh bakreske,
un jek kilogrammi hakeneske kol efta terne bakrendar.
Koi pashel i mursh busni, te well tumari doosh krik lino un lauter pale mishto, hoi mank tumende un o Debleste tardo his.

Un kowa halauter hunte anenn pash kowa pashel, hoi hako diwes chatchrenn o Debleske taissarlakro, un pash koi mool, hoi leske win tchorenn. Jaake hunte krenn hako diwes efta diwessa. Un o latcho sungepen, hoi djal pre, te well kowa halauter chatchedo an i jag, sungella mishto o baro Debleske.
Ap o eftato diwes hunte wenn pale khetne, te sharenn o baro Debles. Ap ko diwes hunte krenn kek budi.
Un ko diwes, kai anenn tumer o baro Debleske ko newo djobestar, hoi dren anlo was, ko diwes well tumenge i baro diwes, kai wenn khetne glan o baro Debleste. Kek budi hunte krenn tumer ap ko diwes.

Un hunte chatchrenn o baro Debleske dui terne mursh grumja, jek mursh bakro, un efta jek-bershengre bakre, kai gar nasselo hi. Un o latcho sungepen, hoi djal pre, te well kowa halauter chatchedo an i jag, sungella mishto o baro Debleske.
Koi pashel ko chapen dran latcho jarro djeteha: triin kilogramme haki terni mursh grumjake un dui kilogramme hako mursh bakreske,
un jek kilogrammi hakeneske kol efta terne bakrendar.
Koi pashel anenn i mursh busni, te wenn tumari doosh krik lino.
Un kowa halauter hunte anenn pash kol vieche un ko jarro un koi mool, hoi well hako diwes o Debleske anlo. Kol vieche, hoi anenn o Debleske, hunte wenn sasto.
Un ap o ersto diwes an o eftato tchon hunte wenn khetne glan o baro Debleste. Kek budi hunte krenn ap ko diwes. Kawa hunte well tumenge i diwes, kai phurdenn i phurdepaskri.

Un tumer hunte chatchrenn viechen o Debleske. Un ko latcho sungepen, hoi pre djal, te wenn le chatchedo, sungella mishto o baro Debleske. Kolla hi kol vieche, hoi hunte chatchrenn leske tseles: jek terni mursh grumni, jek mursh bakro, un efta jek-bershengre bakre, kai gar nasselo hi.
Un pash hako viecheste denn o Debleste i chapen dran latcho jarro djeteha: pash koi terni mursh grumni triin kilogramme jarro, pash ko mursh bakro dui kilogramme jarro,
un pash hako terno bakro kol efta terne bakrendar jek kilogrammi jarro.
Koi pashel hunte anenn i mursh busni o baro Debleske, te well tumari doosh krik lino.

Kowa halauter hunte anenn pash kowa pashel, hoi chatchrenn hako newo tchon un hako diwes o Debleske, kol viechen un ko jarro un koi mool, hoi leske win tchorenn, jaake har glan tchinlo hi. Un o latcho sungepen, hoi djal pre, te well kowa halauter chatchedo an i jag, sungella mishto o baro Debleske.
Ap o deshto diwes an o eftato tchon hunte wenn khetne glan o baro Debleste. Chan tchi ap ko diwes! Krenn witar kek budi!

Ap ko diwes chatchrenn o Debleske viechen. Un o latcho sungepen, hoi djal pre, te wenn le tseles chatchedo an i jag, sungella mishto o baro Debleske. Kalla hi kol vieche, hoi hunte chatchrenn: jek terni mursh grumni, jek mursh bakro, efta jek-bershengre bakre, kai gar nasselo hi.

O latcho sungepen, hoi djal pre, te well kowa halauter chatchedo an i jag, sungella mishto o baro Debleske. Un pash hako viecheste denn o Debleste i chapen dran latcho jarro djeteha: pash koi terni mursh grumni triin kilogramme jarro, pash ko mursh bakro dui kilogramme jarro,
un pash hako terno bakro kol efta terne bakrendar jek kilogrammi jarro.

Koi pashel hunte anenn i mursh busni o baro Debleske, te well tumari doosh krik lino. Kowa halauter well pash kowa pashel, hoi denn o Debleste ap ko diwes: i mursh busni i doshake, un kol vieche, hoi wenn leske hako diwes chatchedo, khetne ko chapen dran jarro un koi mool, hoi well leske win tchoredo.
Ap o deesh-te-pantchto diwes an o eftato tchon hunte wenn khetne glan o baro Debleste. Kek budi krenn ap ko diwes! Krenn i festo o Debleske efta diwessa,

un chatchrenn leske viechen. Un o latcho sungepen, hoi djal pre, te wenn le chatchedo, sungella mishto o baro Debleske. Ap o ersto diwes chatchrenn leske deesh-te-triin terne mursh grumja, dui mursh bakre, un deesh-te-star jek-bershengre bakre, kai gar nasselo hi.

Un pash hako viecheste denn o Debleste i chapen dran latcho jarro djeteha: pash haki terni mursh grumni kol triin-te-deesh grumjendar triin kilogramme jarro, pash hako mursh bakro kol dui mursh bakrendar dui kilogramme jarro,
un pash hako terno bakro kol deesh-te-star terne bakrendar jek kilogrammi jarro.

Koi pashel hunte anenn i mursh busni o baro Debleske, te well tumari doosh krik lino. Pash kowa halauter wenn kol vieche, hoi wenn hako diwes o Debleske chatchedo, khetne ko jarreha un koi moljah, hoi well koi pashel win tchoredo.

Ap o duito diwes bis ap o eftato diwes denn o Debleste kowa, hoi leske hako diwes hunte well, un koi pashel sawe viechen, kai gar nasselo hi, un ko chapen dran jarro un koi mool, hoi koi pashel well, jaake har glan tchinlo hi: ap o duito diwes: deesh-te-dui terne mursh grumja, dui mursh bakre, un deesh-te-star jek-bershengre bakre, ninna i mursh busni i doshake; ap o triinto diwes: deesh-te-jek terne mursh grumja, dui mursh bakre, un deesh-te-star jek-bershengre bakre, ninna i mursh busni i doshake; ap o starto diwes: deesh terne mursh grumja, dui mursh bakre, un deesh-te-star jek-bershengre bakre, ninna i mursh busni i doshake; ap o pantchto diwes: enja terne mursh grumja, dui mursh bakre, un deesh-te-star jek-bershengre bakre, ninna i mursh busni i doshake; ap o shobto diwes: ochta terne mursh grumja, dui mursh bakre, un deesh-te-star jek-bershengre bakre, ninna i mursh busni i doshake; ap o eftato diwes: efta terne gurma, dui mursh bakre, un deesh-te-star jek-bershengre bakre, ninna i mursh busni i doshake;
Ap o ochtato diwes hunte wenn khetne un krenn i festo. Kek budi hunte krenn ap ko diwes.

Un tumer hunte chatchrenn viechen o baro Debleske. Un ko latcho sungepen, hoi pre djal, te wenn le chatchedo, sungella mishto o Debleske. Kolla hi kol vieche, hoi hunte chatchrenn leske tseles: jek mursh grumni, jek mursh bakro, un efta jek-bershengre bakre, kai gar nasselo hi.
Un pash hako viecheste denn o Debleste o jarro un i mool jaake har glan tchinlo hi: pash koi mursh grumni, pash ko mursh bakro un pash hako terno bakro.
Koi pashel hunte anenn i mursh busni o baro Debleske, te well tumari doosh krik lino. Kowa halauter well pash kol vieche un ko jarro un koi mool, hoi well hako diwes o Debleske anlo.

Kowa halauter hunte anenn tumer o baro Debleske ap kol bare diwessa, kai wenn khetne glan leste. Koi pashel well kowa, hoi denn leste hakeno pestar, ninna kowa, hoi dan tumen sowel, te denn les kowa: vieche, hoi wenn leske tseles chatchedo, djob un mool, ninna vieche, hoi chan tumer khetne glan leste.
Un o Mose penas kol Israelenge halauter, hoi o baro Dewel leske penas.
Un o Mose rakras lengre pralstunentsa, un penas: Kawa hi kowa, hoi o baro Dewel kamell, te krenn tumer kowa.
Te penell jek ap o baro Debleste: “Me dau miro lab, te krap kawa te kowa” oder tchiwell glan leste i sowel tele, palle hunte phagell job gar peskro lab un hunte krell halauter, hoi job penas.
Te hi i djuwel kote, kai penell ap o baro Debleste: “Me dau man sowel, te krap kawa te kowa”, jaake rah joi an ko kheer lakro dadeste hi, un joi gar romedino hi,

un lakro dad shunas lakro labestar, hoi joi o Debleste das, un job penas tchi koi pre, palle hunte rikrell joi halauter, kai das li pes sowel pre. Un halauter, hoi las li ap peste, hunte rikrell li ninna.

Te kamell lakro dad kowa gar an ko diwes har job kolestar shunas, palle hunte rikrell joi gar, hoi das li pes sowel, un hoi joi las ap peste. Un o baro Dewel djinell, kai lakro dad gar kamas te krell joi kowa, un job hidjrell lake tchi palla.
Te romedinerell joi, un ap late hi i sowel tchiddo, ninna te das li pes sowel un djinas gar, hoi joi penella, un pandas pes jaake ap kowa, hoi joi penas,
un lakro rom penell tchi koi pre ap ko diwes, kai shunell lo kowa, palle hunte rikrell joi peskri sowel, un hunte krell, hoi li ap peste las.

Te kamell lakro rom kowa gar ap ko diwes, kai job kowa shunas, palle hunte rikrell joi koi sowel gar dren, hoi ap late tchiddo hi, witar gar ko lab, ap koleste pandas li pes. Un o baro Dewel hidjrell lake tchi palla.
Koi sowel, hoi das i romni, kolakro rom meras, ninna i djuwel, kai muklo was, halauter, hoi joi ap peste las, hunte rikrell joi.
Te dell i djuwel peskro lab an ko kheer peskro romestar, te krell li tchomone o Debleske, un dell pes koi pre sowel,
un lakro rom shunell kowa, un penell tchi koi pre, un penell gar, te hunte krell joi kowa gar, palle hunte rikrell li halauter, ap hoi joi pes sowel das.

Te penell lakro rom, te krell li kowa gar, ap hoi das li pes sowel, ap ko diwes, kai job kowa shunas, palle hunte rikrell li gar peskri sowel un peskro lab. Un o baro Dewel hidjrell lake tchi palla. Job djinell, kai lakro rom kowa gar kamas.
Lauter, kai i djuwel peskro lab pre das, ninna lakre tsele sobja, kolentsa joi penas, te rikrell li pes pale tchomonestar, nai hadell lakro rom pre oder mukell kowa jaake.
Te penell job tchi koi pre bis ap ko wawar diwes, sikrell job, te nai krell li kowa, ap hoi joi pes sowel das, un hoi joi ap peste las.
Te shunas job kowa, un hadas kowa pal jek tsiro pre, hunte hidjrell job lakri doosh.

Kolla hi kol laba, hoi o baro Dewel o Moseske penas, har te well mashkral o mursheste un i djuwjate, mashkral o dadeste un i tchate, jaake rah har koi tchai gar romedino hi un djiwell an lakro dadeskro kheer.
O baro Dewel rakras o Moseha un penas:
“De kol Midianarjen ko tchilatchepen pale, hoi kran le ap i Israelitarjen! Un pal kowa well ko diwes, kai mereh tu.”
Koi penas o Mose ap i Israelitarjen: “Lenn lurden tumendar, te kurenn jon pen kolentsa dran Midian. Jaake te lenn kol Midianarja pengri phagi, hoi o baro Dewel len dell.

Lenn jek sero murshen dran hakeneste kol deesh-te-dui bare familjendar, hoi wenn o Jakobeskre tchawendar, un bitchrenn len an o kurepen.” Un jaake kran le, un 12.000 (deesh-te-dui-serja) mursha wan khetne kurepaske.
Un o Mose bitchras len an o kurepen. Lentsa djas o Pinhas, koleskro dad o rashai Eleasar his. Un o Pinhas las o Debleskro koowa peha, ninna kol kurepaskre phurdepangre.
Un jon djan an o kurepen an o them Midian, te kurenn le pen lentsa, jaake har o baro Dewel kowa o Moseske penas, un dan i tsele murshen kote mulo.
Ninna maran le kol pantch bare rajen pral i Midianarja. Jon kharan Ewi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, un Reba. Ninna dan le o Bileames o chareha mulo, koleskro dad o Beor his.
Un kol Israelitarja pandan kol djuwjen fun kol Midianarja un lengre tchawen. Lengre vieche, un halauter, hoi len hi, tchoran jon.
Un chatchran lengre tsele forja, lengre khera un plachtene khera, kai jon djiwan.
Un jon lan ko tselo tchoredo koowa, un halauter, hoi jon nai lan, menshe un vieche,

un anan len pash o Moseste un o rashajeste, o Eleasar, un pash i tsele wawar Israelitarja. Kolla his ap pengri platsa pash o pani Jordan an o telstuno them, kai kol Moabarja djiwan, wergel o foro Jericho.
Un o Mose un o rashai Eleasar un kol wawar pralstune djan pash lende, win glan i platsa.
Un o Mose was chojedo pral i pralstune lurdende un pral kol pralstune pral i serja un pral sheel lurdende, kai dran o kurepen wan.
Un job penas ap lende: “Hoske mukan tumer i tsele djuwjen djido?

Ma bistrenn, te his kol djuwja, kai kran, hoi o Bileam lenge penas, un tserdan i Israelitarjen o baro Deblestar krik, jaake te nashan le o chocheno debles Baal-Peor palla. Doleske was ko baro nasslepen ap o Debleskre menshende.
Kanna, denn mulo kol tsele mursh tchawen, un kol tsele djuwjen, kolen i rom his.
Kol tsele tcha, kai wan kek murshestar an-tapedo, kolen mukenn tumenge djido!

Un tumer halauter, kai dan jekes mulo oder kai tapran i mules an, atchenn efta diwessa glan koi platsa, kai tumare plachtene khera hi. Ap o triinto diwes un ap o eftato diwes thowenn tumen jaake har glan tchinlo hi, te wenn pale djudjo un erligo. Ninna kol tcha, kai lan tumenge pandlo, hunte thowenn pen jaake.
Ninna kol tsele ripaskre koola, un halauter, hoi dran ledera, busjengro bal un kasht kerdo was, hunte well djudjo kerdo.”
Un o Eleasar, ko rashai, penas ap kol lurdende, kai his an o kurepen: “Kowa hunte well jaake kerdo, har o baro Dewel kowa o Moseske penas.
Ko koowa dran sonakai, rup, lolo saster, saster, zinno un blaio,
un halauter, hoi i jag gar pre chatchrell, kowa hunte rikrenn an i jag, te well kowa djudjo. Un pal kowa witsrenn pani koi pre. Un kowa halauter, hoi chatchrals pre an i jag, tchiwenn an o pani.
Un tumer hunte thowenn tumare ripaskre koola ap o eftato diwes. Palle wenn tumer djudjo. Pal kowa nai wenn pale ap i platsa, kai i plachtene khera tardo hi.”
Un o baro Dewel rakras o Moseha un penas:
“Le kol tsele menshen un kol viechen, kai tapran, kai krik anlo wan, pash tumende pre, tu un ko rashai Eleasar un kol pralstune pral i bare familjende.
un de i paash kolende, kai his an o kurepen, un kol wawar paash de i wawar Israelitarjen.

Un kolla, kai his an o kurepen, hunte denn tchomone o baro Debleske. Kolestar, hoi jon pandles lan, le jek menshes hake pantch-shelendar un jek viecho hake pantch-shelendar, i grumjendar, i bakrendar un fun i burike. Un de les o rashajeste Eleasar, te dell job kowa o baro Debleste.

Kol wawar Israelitarja hunte denn ninna tchomone o Debleske. Lendar less tu jek menshes hake paash-shelendar un jek viecho hake paash-shelendar, i grumjendar, i bakrendar, fun i burike, un i tsele wawar viechendar, un hunte dess len kol Levitarjen, kai krenn pengri budi ap o Debleskro kheer.”
O Mose un o rashai Eleasar kran jaake har o baro Dewel kowa o Moseske penas.
Un kowa, hoi i lurde tapran un hoi djido atchas his 675.000 (shob-sheel-efta-deesh-te-pantch-serja) bakre.
72.000 (efta-dui-serja) grumja,
61.000 (shob-deesh-te-jek serja) burike,
32.000 (trijanda-te-dui-serja) djuwja, kai kek murshestar an-tapedo wan.
Un ko paash, kai kolenge hi, kai an o kurepen djan, his 337.500 (triin-sheel-trijanda-te-efta-serja-pantch-sheel) bakre.
Kolendar hunte dan jon o baro Debleste 675 (shob-sheel-efta-deesh-te-pantch) bakre.
Ninna 36.000 (trijanda-te-shob-serja) grumja. Kolendar hunte dan jon o baro Debleske 72 (efta-deesh-te-dui) grumja.
Ninna 30.500 (trijanda-serja-te-pantch-sheel) burike. Kolendar hunte dan jon o baro Debleste 61 (shob-deesh-te-jek).
Ninna 16.000 (deesh-te-shob-serja) djuwja. Kolendar dan le o baro Debleste 32 (trijanda-te-dui).
Un o Mose das kowa, hoi dan kolla leske o baro Debleske, ko rashajeste Eleasar, jaake har o baro Dewel leske kowa penas.
Ko wawar paash, hoi o Mose ap i rig tchiwas kol wawar Israelenge, his jaake baro har kol lurdengro paash.

Un o Mose las kolestar, hoi i Israelengre hi, o 50. (paash-sheelto) kotar hake viechendar un hake menshendar, un das len kol Levitarjen, kai budrenn ap o Debleskro kheer, jaake har o baro Dewel kowa o Moseske penas.
Un pash o Moseste wan kolla, kai penepaske hi pral kol bud lurdende, kol pralstune pral i sero lurdende un pral i sheel lurdende,
un penan ap leste: “Mer, tire budepangre, lan pre, har bud lurde koi hi, kai men pral lende penepaske hi; un halauter his koi.

Doleske anah mer o baro Debleske ko sonakaskro koowa, hoi hakeno mendar hatsas: brassleta, wastengre werklia, gustria, kanengre un werklia. Mer dah kowa o baro Debleste, te plaissras maro djipaske, te well tchi tardo mank o baro Debleste un mende.”
O Mose un o rashai Eleasar lan ko tselo sonakaskro koowa.
Un ko tselo sonakai, kai kol pralstune o baro Debleske anan, his 200 (dui-sheel) kilogramme pharo.
Kol lurde, kai his kek pralstune, rikran penge kowa, hoi tapran jon an o kurepen.
O Mose un ko rashai Eleasar lan ko sonakai kol pralstunendar un anan kowa an o Debleskro plachteno kheer, te bistrell o baro Dewel gar, te dikell lo latches ap i Israelitarja.
I menshen dran o kheer Ruben un dran o kheer Gad his bud vieche. Un jon dikan, te hi latcho senlepen i viechenge an ko them Jaser un Gilead.
Koi wan le pash o Moseste un ko rashajeste Eleasar un pash kol pralstunende pral i Israelitarja, un penan ap lende:
“Ko them pash kol forja Atarot, Dibon, Jaser, Nimra, Heshbon, Elale, Sibma, Nebo, un Beon,
hoi las o baro Dewel dren peskre menshenge Israel, kote hi bud senlepen i viechenge, un men, tire budepangren, hi vieche.
Te hal menge latcho, de men kau them, te hunte djas mer gar pral o pani Jordan.”
O Mose penas ap lende: “Tumare phrala hunte djan an o kurepen, un tumer kamenn kate te atchell?
Te krenn kowa, lenn i wawar Israelitarja daar un kamenn gar an ko them te djal, kai o baro Dewel len della.
Jaake kran ninna tumare phure, har me len win bitchrom dran Kadesh-Barnea, te dikenn le pal, har ko them hi.
Un har jon koi pre wan pash ko pani Eshkol, un dikan ko them, wan le pale pale un rakran jaake i Israelentsa, te lan jon daar, un kaman gar an ko them te djal, kai kamas o baro Dewel lende te dell.
Un o baro Debleskri choli was baro an ko tsiro, un job das pes sowel un penas:

‘Kowa hi tchatcho, hoi penau: Kalla menshe, kai dran o them Egiptia win djan, un hi biish bersha un phureder, dikenn ko them gar, kai dom man sowel, te dap les o Abrahameste, o Isaakeste, un o Jakobeste. Jon djan mantsa gar o djijeha.
Kokres o Kaleb, koleskro dad o Jefunne hi, kol menshendar Kenas, un o Josua, koleskro dad o Nun hi, wenn kote dren. Jon djan mantsa o tselo djijeha.’
Jaake was o baro Debleskri choli pral i Israelitarja, un job mukas len trujel te djal an o mulo tato them star-deesh bersha, bis te kek buder koi his kol tsele menshendar, kai choiran o baro Debles.
Un kanna krenn tumer ko emligo koowa! Tumer han tchatche tchawe tumare dadendar! Mursha, kai o Debleskro drom tele djan un krenn, te well o baro Debleskri choli pral Israel bareder.
Te djan tumer lestar krik, mukell job kal menshen i rah tsiro an o mulo tato them, un tumen hi doosh, te djan le halauter tele.”
Koi wan jon glan pash leste, un penan: “Mer kamah kate khera te krell mare bakrenge, un forja mare tchawenge.

Palle djah mer khetne mare phralentsa an o kurepen. Mer djah glan lende, bis te anam len an lengro them. An ko tsiro atchenn mare tchawe an kol sorele forja, te krenn lenge kol menshen an kau them tchi.
Mer kamah gar khere te djal, bis te hako Israelitari peskro kotar them las.
Mer kamah gar lentsa i kotar them te lell ap i wawar rig o panjestar Jordan. Maro them lah ap kai rig o panjestar Jordan, kai o kham pre djal.”
O Mose penas ap lende: “Te kamenn tumer kowa tchatchepah te krell, palle lenn tumare chare un hoi tumen hunte well kurepaske, un djan an o kurepen glan o baro Debleste!
Un djan wergel o pani Jordan glan o baro Debleskre jaka, un atchenn kote, bis te tradell job kolen glan peste win, kai kurenn pen tumentsa,

un bis te hi lo o rai pral ko them. Koi pal nai djan tumer pale pale, un kek doosh lan tumer ap tumende glan o baro Debleste un glan Israel. Un o them ap kai rig kate well tumende dino glan o baro Debleste.
Te kamenn tumer kowa gar te krell, palle lenn i doosh ap tumende glan o baro Debleste. Un kowa dikenn tumer, te well koi phagi ap tumende.
Tchiwenn kanna forja pre tumare tchawenge un barra trul kol platse, kai tumare vieche hi, un krenn, hoi tumer penan.”
“Maro rai, mer krah, har tu penal,” penan kol mursha dran o kheer Gad un dran o kheer Ruben.
“Mare tchawe un djuwja, halauter hoi men hi, un mare tsele vieche atchenn an kol forja an o them Gilead.
Mer, tumare budepangre, lah mare chare un djah i wawar lurdentsa an o kurepen glan o baro Debleste, har tu, maro rai, penal.”
Koi penas o Mose ap o rashajeste Eleasar un ap o Josua, koleskro dad o Nun his, un ap kol pralstunende pral i bare familje:

“Te djan i mursha dran o kheer Gad un dran o kheer Ruben tumentsa wergel o Jordan, un kurenn pen jaake rah glan o baro Debleste, bis te ko them tumenge hi, jaake denn lende ko them Gilead, te well kowa lenge.
Djan jon gar tumentsa wergel o pani Jordan an o kurepen, jaake lenn jon i kotar them mashkral tumende an ko them Kanaan.”
I mursha dran o kheer Gad un dran o kheer Ruben penan pale: “Jaake har o baro Dewel menge penas, krah mer.
Mer lah mare chare un djah glan o baro Debleste an o them Kanaan, te las maro kotar them kate ap kai rig o panjestar Jordan.”

Jaake das o Mose kol menshen dran o kheer Gad un dran o kheer Ruben un ko paash kol menshendar dran o kheer Manasse, kai o Josefeskro tchawo his, ko them, kai o Sihon o baro rai pral i Amorarja his un ko them, kai o Og o baro rai pral Bashan his. Job das len o tselo them un kol forja koi dren.
Un i mursha dran o kheer Gad kran kol forja Dibon, Atarot, Aroer,
Atrot-Shofan, Jaser, Jogboha
Bet-Nimra un Bet-Haran, halauter sorele forja; un jon tchiwan barra pre trul kol platse, kai lengre bakre hi.
I mursha dran o kheer Ruben kran kol forja Heshbon, Elale, Kirjatajim,
Nebo, Baal-Meon un Sibma un dan kol forjen, kai jon kran, newe laba.
Un i mursha dran o kheer Machir, koleskro dad o Manasse his, djan an o them Gilead, kuran pen kol menshentsa koi, lan ko them penge un tradan kol Amorarjen krik, kai koi dren djiwan.
Koi das o Mose ko murshes Machir ko them Gilead, un job djiwas koi.
O Jair, koleskro dad o Manasse his, djas koi, un las gaba peske dren un das len ko lab ‘Jaireskre gaba’.
O Nobach djas koi, un las o foro Kenat peske dren un kol gaba trujel, un das les ko lab Nobach, jaake har job kharell.
Kalla hi kol platse, kai tchiwan i Israelitarja pengre plachtene khera pre, har djan le win dran o them Egiptia pengre lurdentsa. Wi las len o Mose un o Aron.
Un jaake har o baro Dewel o Moseske penas, tchinas kowa pre, hawo drom jon djan un ap hawe platse jon atchan. Kalla hi kol platse, kai jon pengre plachtene khera pre tchiwan ap lengro drom.

Jon djan dran o foro Ramses ap o 15. (deesh-te-pantchto) diwes an o ersto tchon. Kowa his o duito diwes kol bare diwessa ‘Passa’. Peskro sorelo wasteha anas len o baro Dewel win glan i jaka kol tsele Egiptarja,
har kolla pengre phureder mursh tchawen paskran, kolen o baro Dewel maras mashkral lende. Jaake sikras lo i Egiptarende, te hi lo sorleder har lengre debla.
Dran o foro Ramses djan i Israelitarja an o foro Sukkot,
un kotar dureder an Etam. Kowa hi pash o mulo tato them tchiddo.
Dran Etam djan le dureder un atchan an Pi-Hachirot, kai wergel o foro Baal-Zefon hi un tchiwan pengre plachtene khera pre glan Migdol.
Dran Pi-Hachirot djan le win un djan mashkral o baro pani an o mulo tato them. Un pal triin diwessa an o mulo tato them Etam wan le an Mara.
Dran Mara djan le win un wan an Elim. Koi his 12 (deesh-te-dui) panja pipaske un 70 (efta-deesh) palmtikre ruka. Un kote tchiwan le pengre plachtene khera pre.
Dran Elim djan le dureder un tchiwan pengre plachte khera pre pash o Baro Lolo Pani.
Kotar djan jon dureder un djiwan i tsiro an o mulo tato them Sin.
Dran o mulo tato them Sin djan le dureder un wan an Dofka,
fun kotar an Alush,
fun kotar an Refidim. Koi his i menshen kek pani pipaske.
Dran Refidim djan le dureder un djiwan i tsiro an o mulo tato them Sinai.
Fun kotar djan le dureder un wan an Kibrot-Taawa,
pal kowa an Hazerot,
an Ritma,
an Rimmon-Perez,
an Libna,
an Rissa,
an Kehelata,
pash i berga Shefer,
palle an Harada,
an Makelot,
an Tachat,
an Terach,
an Mitka,
an Hashmona,
an Moserot,
an Bene-Jaakan,
an Hor-Gidgad,
an Jotbata,
an Abrona,
an Ezjon-Geber,
an Kadesh, hoi hi tchiddo an o mulo tato them Zin.
Un palle wan le pash koi berga Hor, hoi hi tchiddo ap i rig pash ko them Edom.

Kote djas ko rashai Aron ap koi berga Hor, har o baro Dewel leske kowa penas, un meras kote an o star-deshto bersh, har kol Israelitarja dran o them Egiptia win djan, ap o ersto diwes an o pantchto tchon,
har job 123 (sheel-biish-te-triin) bersha phuro his.
Un ko baro rai pral i Kanaanitarja, kai djiwas an o foro Arad ap koi rig o themestar, kai o kham pralstunes hi, job shunas, kai kol Israelitarja wan.
Un fun koi berga Hor djan jon dureder un wan an Zalmona,
palle an Punon,
un palle an Obot,
un an Ije-Abarim. hoi hi tchiddo an ko them Moab.
Kotar djan le dureder un wan an Dibon-Gad,
un an Almon-Diblatajim.
Fun kotar wan le an kol berge Abarim, wergel o foro Nebo ap koi rig, kai o kham pre djal.
Palle wan le an ko telstuno them pash o pani Jordan, wergel o foro Jericho. Kote djiwan i Moabarja.
Kote an o telstuno them Moab tchiwan i Israelitarja pengre plachtene khera pre pash o pani Jordan, mank Bet-Jeshimot un Abel-Shittim.
Un o baro Dewel rakras o Moseha an o telstuno them Moab pash o pani Jordan, ap i wawar rig o forestar Jericho un penas:
“Rake kol Israelentsa un pen lenge: Ap ko tsiro, kai djan tumer pral o pani Jordan an o them Kanaan,
hunte tradenn kol tsele menshen, kai djiwenn kote, glan tumende krik. Un lengre tsele barrengre un sasterne deblen, hoi kran jon penge, krenn paash, ninna kol pre-tchidde barra.
Un lenn ko them tumenge, un djiwenn kote dren. Kau them dom me tumende, te lenn kowa tumenge.

Un tumer hunte denn hakenes i kotar them. Witsrenn i bachtjakre barra, te hatsenn win, hawe menshe hawo kotar them lenna. Kal familjen, kolen bud menshe hi, hunte denn bud them. Un kol familjen, kolen gar bud menshe hi, hunte denn gar jaake bud.

Te tradenn tumer gar kol menshen krik, kai djiwenn an ko them, palle dukrenn tumen kolla, kai tumer djido mukan, har i kasht an o jak, un har i tchupni, kolah i grumni glan tradedo well. Un jon krenn tumenge o djipen phares an ko them kai tumer djiwenna.
Palle krau tumentsa jaake har kamom kol wawarentsa te krell.”
O baro Dewel rakras o Moseha un penas:
Pen ap kol Israelitarja: Djan an o them Kanaan! Ko them well tumenge jek rigjatar ap i wawar: Kolla hi i rigja:
Ap i tchatchi rig djal tumaro them bis pash o mulo them Zin un bis pash o them Edom. I tchatchi rig djal fun o Londo Baro Pani, kotar, kai o kham pre djal,
bis pash i berga Akrabbim pre, un kotar dureder an Zin, un pale dureder bis pash Kadesh-Barnea an o Negev un bis Hazar-Addar, un Azmon.
Fun Azmon djal ko them bis pash koi tala, pal late o them Egiptia hi, un dureder bis pash o Mashkralstuno Baro Pani.
Kote, kai o kham tele djal, djal tumaro them bis pash o Mashkralstuno Baro Pani.
Ap koi serwi rig djal tumaro them fun o Mashkralstuno Baro Panjestar bis pash koi berga Hor.
Un kotar dureder bis kote, kai djal an Hamat, un dureder pash Zedad,
un dureder bis Sifron un bis Hazar-Enan. Kowa hi i serwi rig tumaro themestar.
Un ap koi rig, kai o kham pre djal, djal tumaro them fun Hazar-Enan bis Shefam.
Un dureder tele fun Shefam bis Ribla. Kowa hi ap kai rig o forestar Ajin, kai o kham pre djal. Pal kowa djal tele kol tikne berge pash o pani Kinneret, kote, kai o kham pre djal,
un dureder tele bis pash o pani Jordan un bis pash o Londo Baro Pani. Kowa hi tumaro them peskre rigjentsa koi trujel.

Palle penas o Mose ap kol Israelitarja: “Kol menshe dran o kheer Ruben, dran o kheer Gad, un ko paash kol menshendar dran o kheer Manasse lan pengro kotar them ap kai rig o panjestar Jordan, wergel o forestar Jericho, ap koi rig, kai o kham pre djala. Kawa kate hi ko them, kai lenn tumer wawar. Jaake kamell kowa o baro Dewel. Witsrenn bachtjakre barra te hatsenn win, koon hawo kotar lella.”
Un o baro Dewel rakras o Moseha un penas:
Kalla hi kol laba kol murshendar, kai denn hakenes tumendar i kotar them: ko rashai Eleasar un o Josua, koleskro dad o Nun hi.
Koi pashel hunte lenn jek pralstuno dran hako kheer o Jakobeskre tchawendar, te denn le hakenes i kotar them.

Un kalla hi kol laba kol murshendar: dran o kheer Juda: Kaleb, koleskro dad hi o Jefunne; dran o kheer Simeon: Shemuel, koleskro dad hi o Ammihud; dran o kheer Benjamin: Elidad, koleskro dad hi o Kislon; dran o kheer Dan: Bukki, koleskro dad hi o Jogli; dran o kheer Manasse: Hannijel, koleskro dad hi o Efod; dran o kheer Efrajim: Kemuel, koleskro dad hi o Shiftan; dran o kheer Sebulon: Elizafan, koleskro dad hi o Parnach; dran o kheer Issachar: Paltijel, koleskro dad hi o Asan; dran o kheer Asser: Ahihud, koleskro dad hi o Shelomi; dran o kheer Naftali: Pedahel, koleskro dad hi o Ammihud.
Kal murshenge penas o baro Dewel, te denn le kol Israelitarjen lengro kotar them an ko them Kanaan.
Un o baro Dewel rakras o Moseha an o telstuno them Moab pash o pani Jordan, ap i wawar rig o forestar Jericho, un job penas:

Pen ap kol Israelende: Tumer lenna them un forja. Denn kol forjendar ninna forja kolende dran o kheer Levi, kai jon nai djiwenn. Denn lende ninna them lengre viechenge, ko themestar, hoi trul kol forja hi,
te hi len forja, kai djiwenn le un them lengre viechenge, kai lengre grumja, bakre un wawar vieche nai chana.

Ko them i viechenge, hoi glan kol forja hi, hoi tumer kol Levitarjen denna, hunte djal win o forestar 500 metarja an hake star rigja, jaake te well i platsa, kai haki rig 1.000 jek sero metarja baro hi, un o foro hi mashkral dren.

Kol forjendar, kai denn tumer kol Levitarjen, hunte wenn shob forja sawe menshenge koi, kai dan jekes mulo un hunte nashenn penge. Kolla nai nashenn an kol forja dren. Koi pashel hunte denn lenge 42 (star-deesh-te-dui) wawar forja.
Kol tsele forja, kai tumer kol Levitarjen denna, hi khetne 48 (star-deesh-ta-ochta). Koi pashel well ko them i viechenge.
Hakeni kol deesh-te-dui bare familjendar an Israel hunte dell lenge peskre forjendar. Kolen, kai bud them un forja hi, kolla hunte denn i Levitarjen budeder forja har kolla, kai len gar bud hi.
Un o baro Dewel rakras o Moseha un penas:
Rake kol Israelentsa un pen ap lende: Te wenn tumer wergel o pani Jordan, an ko them Kanaan,
hunte rodenn tumer forja win, kai nai hakeno dren djala, kai naashepaskro hi, un jekes mulo das, un kamas kowa gar.

Un kol forja hi sawenge, kai hunte khatrenn pen kolendar, kai kamenn o rat kol marede menshendar ap lengro shero pale te anell. Jaake hunte merell kowa gar, kai das jekes mulo, bis te job glan i tsillo tardo hi, glan kolende, kai rakrenn o tchatchepen pral leste win.
Un kol forja, kai hako naashepaskro nai djal koi dren, hunte wenn shob forja,
triin ap kai rig o panjestar Jordan, un triin an o them Kanaan.
Kal shob forja hi kol Israelenge un kol menshenge, kai pash tumende djiwenn, ninna te hi le gar tumendar, te nai nashenn kolla kote, kai dan jekes mulo, un kaman kowa gar.
Te das jek i wawares mit i kotar saster jaake, te merell job, hi lo i marepaskro un hunte well mulo dino.
Witsras job i barreha ap leste, hoi bares doha hi, te nai marell lo jekes, un kowa meras koi pre, hi lo i marepaskro un hunte well mulo dino.
Das job jekes i kashteha jaake, te meras kowa koi pre, hi lo i marepaskro un hunte well mulo dino.
Kowa, kai les an peskre wasta hi, te anell lo o rat o mulo murshestar ap o marepaskro shero, kowa hunte marell kol marepaskres. Kai job les taprella, hunte dell lo les mulo.
Te das jek i wawares dran choli i ladini oder witsras tchorchanes tchomone ap leste, te meras kowa,

oder te das job les dran choli o wasteha jaake, te meras kowa, palle hunte well kowa, kai das les, maredo. Job hi i marepaskro. Kowa, kai les an peskre wasta hi, te anell lo o rat o mulo murshestar ap o marepaskro shero, kowa hunte marell kol marepaskres. Kai job les taprella, hunte dell lo les mulo.
Hi wawartchandes jekeha, kai das jekes i ladini un kamas kowa gar, un les hi kek choli ap leste, oder witsras tchomone ap leste, un kras kowa gar bisemake,
oder witsras i bar ap leste, kai nai merell koi pre, un job dikas kowa gar, un ko wawar merell, un les his kek choli ap leste un kamas les kek tchilatchepen te krell.
Palle hunte well lo glan i tsillo anlo glan kolende, kai rakrenn o tchatchepen win mank ko mursheste un koleste, kai kamell o rat o mulo murshestar pale te anell ap o shero kolestar, kai maras les.

Un i Israelitarja hunte lenn kau murshes win dran o wast kolestar, kai kamell les te marell, un hunte anenn les pale pale an ko foro, kai nashas lo peske dren. Un job hunte atchell koi, bis ko pralstuno rashai meras, kai was o Debleskro djeteha dren maklo.
Djal ko marepaskro dran ko foro win, kai nashas lo peske dren,
un ko mursh, kai kamell les te marell, hatsell les win glan o naashepangro foro, un dell les mulo, palle anas job kek doosh ap peste.
Ko naashepaskro hunte atchas an ko foro, bis te ko pralstuno rashai mulo hi. Pal leskro merepen nai djal job khere an peskro them.
Kal laba hunte wenn tchatchepaskre laba tumenge, ap kolende hunte rikrenn hako tsiro, kai tumer ninna djiwenna.
Koon i menshes mulo das, koles hunte denn mulo, te hi menshe koi, kai dikan un penan kowa. Hi gar doha, te penell jek mensho kokres, hoi lo dikas, jaake te well ko wawar maredo.
Te das job tchatchepah jekes mulo, nai ginell lo pes gar win. Tumer hunte lenn kek lowe lestar, witar gar leskre menshendar. Maredo hunte well lo.
Un kowa, kai nashas an ko naashepangro foro, nai ginell pes gar win, te djal lo khere. Job hunte atchell koi, bis te ko pralstuno rashai meras.
Ma krenn ko them pale-tchiddo, kai djiwenn! Pale-tchiddo well ko them dran o rat, hoi ratell, te well jek maredo. Kokres ko rateha kolestar, kai maras jekes, nai well o them pale djudjo.
Krenn ko them gar pale-tchiddo, kai djiwenn tumer, un kai ninna me djiwau. Me hom o baro Dewel, un djiwau mashkral tumende.

Un i pralstune pral i menshende, kai wenn pal o Gilead, wan pash o Moseste. O Gileadeskro dad his o Machir, un leskro papo his o Manasse dran o kheer Josef. Kal pralstune rakran o Moseha un kol wawar pralstunentsa i menshendar Israel,

un penan: “O baro Dewel penas tuke, maro rajeske, te well ko them i Israelitarjen jaake dino, har i bachtjakre barra sikrenn, te well kowa lenge. Ninna penas lo tuke, te dess ko them, hoi maro phrales, o Zelofhades his, leskre tchende.
Te romedinerell jek kol menshendar Israel i tchat o murshestar Zelofhad, well lakro them pash ko them kol menshendar lakro romestar. Un ko them mare phurendar well tikneder.

Te well kanna ko bersh, kai lell hakeno pale, hoi glan i tsiro leskro his, palle well ko them kol tchendar hako tsireske kol menshenge, kolendar lengre romma hi. Un jaake well ko them mare menshendar tikneder.”
O Mose penas i Israelenge, hoi o baro Dewel leske an kau koowa penas: Kol menshe dran o kheer Josef rakran o tchatchepen.

Kawa hi, hoi o baro Dewel rakras pral kol tchende o murshestar Zelofhad, hoi te kras mer. Job penas: Muk len romedinerell, har jon kowa kamenna. Kokres jek koowa hunte rikrenn le dren: Lengre romma hunte wenn kol menshendar lengro dadestar.
Kek them te perell koi jek bari familjatar ap i wawar familjate. Hako Israelitari rikrell ap peskro kotar them an o them kol menshendar peskro dadestar.
Un kol tsele tcha, kai lenn i kotar them mashkral kol menshende Israel, hunte romedinerenn jekes kol menshendar lengro dadestar, te rikrell hakeno mashkral kol Israelitarja ko them leskre phurendar.
Jaake djal kek kotar them kol jek menshendar ap i wawarende. Hakeno kol 12 bare familjendar an Israel hunte rikrell soreles peskro them.
Jaake har o baro Dewel kowa o Moseske penas, kran kol tcha o murshestar Zelofhad:
I Machla, i Tirza, i Hogla, i Milka, un i Noa romedineran kol tchawen lengre kakendar.
dran o kheer Manasse, koleskro dad o Josef his. Jaake atchas lengro kotar them pash kol menshende lengro dadestar.
Kalla hi kol tchatchepaskre laba, kai o baro Dewel o Moseske penas, te rikrenn pen i Israelitarja ap lende. Job penas len lenge an o telstuno them Moab pash o pani Jordan, wergel o foro Jericho.

Kalla hi i laba, hoi o Mose ap i tsele Israelitarja penas, har his le an o mulo tato them ap i wawar rig o panjestar Jordan, an ko telstuno kotar them pash Suf mashkral o foro Paran ap jek rig un kol forja Tofel, Laban, Hazerot un Di-Sahab ap i wawar rig.
[Deesh-te-jek diwessa hi o drom lengsto mank i berga Horeb un o foro Kadesh-Barnea ap i berge Seir.]
An o star-deshto (40) bersh ap o ersto diwes an o deesh-te-jekto tchon penas o Mose ap i tsele Israelitarja halauter, hoi o baro Dewel leske penas, te hunte krenn le.
Kowa his pal kowa job kol dui bare rajen das: o Sihon, ko baro rajes pral i Amorarja, kai an o foro Heshbon djiwas, un palle pash Edrei o Og, ko baro rajes pral Bashan, kai an o foro Astarot djiwas.
Ap i wawar rig o panjestar Jordan an o them Moab, sikras o Mose i menshende o baro Debleskro drom. Kalla hi leskre laba:
Maro baro Dewel rakras mentsa pash i berga Horeb un penas: Doha hans kanna pash kai berga:

Stenn kanna pre un djan dureder pash i berge, kai i Amorarja djiwenn, un kote, kai kol Kanaanitarja djiwenn: an o telstuno them o panjestar Jordan, un an o pralstuno them, un an o diwjo them Shefelah un an o them Negev pash o baro pani bis pash i berge Libanon un o baro lengsto pani Eufrat.

Kau tselo them tchiwom me glan tumende, djan tumer koi, un lenn les tumenge dren! Kowa hi ko them, kolestar o baro Dewel tumare phurende, o Abrahameste un o Isaakeste un o Jakobeste pes sowel das, te dell lo les lende un lengre tchawende un kolende, kai pal lende wenna.
O Mose penas dureder: Kote pash i berga Horeb penom tumenge: “Me kokres nai hidjrau tumen gar.
Tumaro baro Dewel kras tumen jaake bud. Tumer han kau diwes jaake bud har kol momlia an o bolepen hi.
Mu tchiwell job, ko Dewel tumare phurendar, gomme jek sero (1.000) kope jaake bud pashel. Mu tchiwell lo peskri bacht un soor ap tumende, jaake har job pral tumende win rakras.
Djinenn, me nai hidjrau koi budi hoi tumer mange krenn, gar kokres, nai rakrau gar kokres o tchatchepen win an tumaro tselo koowa, un tumaro tselo tchingepen!
Lenn tumenge dran tumare bare familjen gosewe un an-dikle murshen, kai haiwenn, hoi mishto un gar mishto hi! Kolen tchiwau pral tumende, te wenn le tumare tchatchepangre mursha.”
Tumer penan koi pre: “Mishto hi ko kowa, hoi tu kameh te krell.”

Un me lom i pralstune murshen dran tumare bare familjen, gosewe un an-dikle murshen un tchiwom len pral tumende, te wenn le tumare tchatchepangre mursha. Jon wan pralstune pral 1.000 (jek sero), pral 100 (jek sheel) un pral 50 (i paash-sheel) un pral 10 (deesh).

Ap kal tchatchepangre murshende penom ko tsireske, hoi te krenn le, un penom: “Shunenn, hoi tumare phralen, kai tchingepen mashkral pende hi, tumenge penenna. Kowa nai well i tchingepen mashkral tumen Israelitarjen, nai well ninna i tchingepen mashkral jekeste tumare menshendar un jekeste dran i wawar them, kai pash tumende djiwell. Denn koles o tchatchepen, kai an o tchatchepen hi.

Un dikenn gar koi pre, koon glan tumende tardo hi! Shunenn i tiknen un i baren! Ma darenn kekestar! Krenn jaake o tchatchepen win, har te krals kowa o Dewel! Sawo koowa, hoi tumenge phares hi, kowa anenn pash mande, te shunap me kowa.”
Ko tsireske penom me tumenge ninna ko wawar koowa, hoi hunte krenn.

Mer kram, hoi maro baro Dewel menge penas, un djam dureder un mukam i berga Horeb pal mende, un kram men ap o drom an o pralstuno them, kai i Amorarja djiwan. Ap maro drom hunte djam an o baro mulo them trujel, hoi jaake dareno hi, har tumer dikan, un wam pash o foro Kadesh-Barnea.
Kote penom tumenge: “Kanna ham tardo glan o pralstuno them, kai i Amorarja djiwenn. Kau them dell tumen maro baro Dewel.

Job das kau them an tumare wasta. Djan koi un lenn les dren, te well lo tumaro, jaake har penas tumenge o baro Dewel, ko Dewel, kones tumare phure an-mangan. Ma trashenn un mukenn tumenge kek daar te krell!”
Un tumer wan halauter pash mande un penan: “Mer kamah murshen glan win te bitchrell, te dikenn le pen trujel an ko them, te penenn la menge ap hawo drom mer dren djas, un hawe forja koi hi.”
Un kowa his mishto an mire jaka un me lom deesh-te-dui murshen dran tumende, jek murshes dran haki bari familja.
Kolla kran pen ap o drom, un djan pre an o pralstuno them, un wan bis pash i tala Eshkol, un dikan pen kote trujel.
Jon lan kolestar, hoi an ko them bares was, un anan les pash mende. Un penan menge hoi le halauter dikan, un penan: ‘Kau them hi mishto, hoi o baro Dewel men dell.’
Tumer kaman gar koi te djal, un shunan gar ap i laba o baro Deblestar, kai tumaro Dewel hi.
Un tumen tchingran an tumare plachtene khera un penan: ‘O baro Dewel hi chojedo ap mende. Doleske las lo men dran o them Egiptia win, te dell lo men an i wasta fun o Amorarja, te denn kolla men mulo.

Kai djas koi? Mare phrala kran mare djia darenes, har penan le ap mende: Kolla menshe hi sorleder un bareder har mer, lengre forja hi baro un lengre massurja djan pre bis pash o bolepen. Un ninna dikam mer o Anakarja kote!’
Kote penom me ap tumende: “Ma mukenn tumenge daar te krell un ma trashenn lendar!
Tumaro baro Dewel djal glan tumende win un kurell pes tumenge, jaake har lo glan tumare jaka an o them Egiptia tumenge kras.
Un an o mulo tato them hidjras lo tumenge har i dad peskro tchawes ap tumaro tselo drom, hoi djan bis kate, kai kanna han.”
Ninna te dikan tumer kowa lauter, kaman tumer tumaro baro Debles gar te patsell,
koles, kai o tselo drom glan tumende djas, te sikrell lo tumende i platsa, kai nai tchiwenn tumen tele, Job sikras tumenge o drom rati an i jag, un pral o diwes an i wolka.
Har o baro Dewel shunas koi gole hoi dan, was lo chojedo, un das pes sowel, un penas:
“Ma patsenn, te dikell jek mursh kal tsele murshendar kau latcho them, hoi me man pash lengre phurende sowel dom, te dap les lenge.
Kokres o Kaleb, koleskro dad o Jefunne hi, dikell ko them. Un les un leskre tchawen dau ko them, kai job pre stakras. Job patsas man un kras, hoi penom.”
Un dran kowa, hoi tumer kran, was o baro Dewel ninna chojedo ap mande un penas: “Ninna tu, o Mose, wess gar an ko them!
O Josua, koleskro dad o Nun hi, kowa, kai glan tumende tardo hi, kowa well an ko them. Koles kre soreles! Job anell i Israelenge an kau them, te lenn le les dren.”

Palle penas o baro Dewel ap mende lauterende: “Tumer penan: ‘Mare tchawe perenn kolenge an i wasta, kai hi chojedo ap mende.’ Me penau tumenge: Jon, kai kau diwes gomme gar djinenn, hoi mishto un hoi tchilatcho hi, hi kolla, kai wenn an o them dren, te lenn le les dren.
Tumer, rissrenn tumen un djan an o mulo them, ko drom, hoi pash o Baro Lolo Pani djal!”

Kote penan tumer ap mande: “Mer kram tchilatchepen glan o baro Debleste. Kanna kamah pre te djal un men lentsa te kurell, jaake har maro baro Dewel penas, te kras kowa.” Un hakeno tumendar pandas peskre kurepaskre koola trul peste. Un tumer patsan, te hi gar phares pre te djal an o kurepen.
Kote penas o baro Dewel ap mande: “Pen lenge: Ma djan pre, te kurenn tumen lentsa! – Me hom gar tumentsa. – Te wenn gar kolendar mulo dino, kai kamenn tumen te marell.”
Har penom me kowa ap tumende, kaman gar te shunell, un kran gar, hoi o baro Dewel tumenge penas. Tumer djan pal tumaro shero, un djan pre an o pralstuno them.
Un i Amorarja, kai kote djiwan, wan win un djan ap tumende pre, un tradan tumen an o them Seir, har biene jekes palla lenn. Un dan tumen pash o foro Horma.
Kote wan tumer pale pale, un rowan glan o baro Debleste; o baro Dewel shunas gar ap tumende, un das gar jak ap tumari gole.
Jaake atchan tumer ap i panjengri platsa Kadesh i rah tsiro.
Koi pre stam pre un rissram men un djam pale an o mulo tato them ap o drom, hoi djal pash o Baro Lolo Pani, jaake har o baro Dewel kowa mange penas. I rah tsiro nasham trul kol berge Seir.
Palle penas o baro Dewel ap mande:
“Doha tsiro nashan an kal berge trujel. Djan kanna dureder ap koi serwi rig.
Un pen i menshenge Israel: Ap tumaro drom wenn tumer kanna an o them tumare phralendar, kol menshendar, kai wenn pal o Esau, un djiwenn ap i berge Seir. Un jon darenn tumendar. Jaake denn jak,
te mukenn tumen ap kek tchingepen lentsa dren. Me dau tumen kek piro baro kotar lengro themestar. I berge Seir dom me o Esaeste, te hi le leske.
Te wenn an lengro them, ginenn chapen lowentsa lendar, te well tumen tchomone te chal. Un ninna pani ginenn lowentsa lendar, te well tumen tchomone te pijell.”

Ma bistrenn, maro baro Dewel das men bacht an halauter, hoi mare wasta kran. Job das jak ap mende ap o drom an kau baro mulo them: Star-deesh (40) bersha his o baro Dewel mentsa, un halauter hoi men hunte was, das lo men.

Jaake djam dureder un mukam mare phralen pal mende, kol menshen, kai wan o Esaestar, un djiwenn ap i berge Seir. Un mer mukam o drom, hoi djal dran i forja Elat un i Ezjon-Geber an i tala Jordan bis pash o Mulo Baro Pani, un rissram un lam o drom, hoi djal an o mulo tato them Moab.

Un o baro Dewel penas ap mande: “Kre i menshenge an o them Moab kek tchilatchepen, un ma muk tut an i tchingepen lentsa dren! Ma bistrenn, jon hi i menshe, kai wenna pal o Lot. Lenge dom o foro Ar un ko them trujel, te djiwenn le kote. Me kamau tut tchi lengro themestar te dell.”
Glan lende djiwan kol Emarja koi. Kolla his bud un bare lengste menshe, jaake baro har kol menshe Anak.
Jon un kol Anakarja wan ninna kharedo ‘riese’. I Moabarja penenn Emarja ap lende.

Ap i berge Seir djiwan glan kowa i Horarja. Un kol menshe, kai wan pal o Esau, tradan len kotar krik un dan len mulo, un djiwan palle koi, jaake har o Israel les ninna kras ko themeha, hoi les dino was o baro Deblestar.
O Mose penas dureder: Palle kram men ap o drom, jaake har o baro Dewel menge penas, un djam wergel ko lengsto pani, hoi kharella Sered.

Kowa his 38 (trijanda-te-ochta) bersha pal ko diwes, kai djam o ersto kopo dran Kadesh-Barnea. An ko tsiro bersha meran i tsele kurepangre dran Israel, jaake har o baro Dewel pes sowel das, te well kowa jaake.
Leskro wast his phares ap lende, bis te kol tsele kurepangre mulo his, un kek lendar pral atchas.
Un har i kurepangre dran Israel halauter mulo his,
penas o baro Dewel ap mande:
“Tu djah kau diwes an o them, kai i Moabarja djiwenn, pash o foro Ar.

Un tu weh pash o them, kai i Ammonarja djiwenn, kol menshe, kai wenna pal o Lot. Kolenge kress kek tchilatchepen! Un muk tut ap kek tchingepen lentsa dren. Me dau tut kek kotar lengro themestar, hoi dom lende.”
Ninna an ko them djiwan glan i rah tsiro bare lengste menshe, kai wenn ‘riese’ kharedo. I Ammonarja kharenn len Samsumarja.
Kolla his bud un bare lengste menshe, jaake bares har i Anakarja. Un o baro Dewel tradas len krik dran o them glan i Ammonarja, te lenn kolla ko them un djiwenn palle koi dren.
Jaake kras o baro Dewel kowa ninna i menshenge, kai wan o Esaestar un djiwenn an i berge Seir. Glan lende tradas job i Horarja win, un das len kolengro them. Kote djiwenn le bis ap kau diwes.

Un an i gaba pash o Mashkralstuno Baro Pani djiwan menshe, kai his kharedo Awarja. Pral lende wan Filistarja dran Kreta, un dan len mulo, un lan lengro them bis pash o foro Gaza. Un djiwan palle kote.

Har djam win dran o them Moab, penas o baro Dewel ap mende: “Krenn tumen ap o drom, un djan pral ko lengsto pani Arnon! An tiro wast dom o baro rajes pral i Amorarja, o Sihon, kai djiwell an o foro Heshbon. Kurenn tumen leha, un lenn leskro them tumenge dren!
Kau diwesseha krau te darenn tumendar i menshe an hake themma. Koon tumendar shunella, trashell un trissell i darjatar.”
Koi bitchrom murshen dran o mulo them Kedemot pash o Sihon, ko baro rai an o foro Heshbon, te penenn le leske: “Mashkral mende well kek tchingepen un marepen:
Muk men ap koi wawar rig tiro themestar te djal. Ap o drom kamah te atchell, gar tchatches un gar serwes lestar kamah te djal.
Hoi men hunte well chapaske, ginah mer lowentsa tumendar. Ninna pani denn tumer men lowenge, te well men tchomone te pijell. Mer kamah tchi wawar har te djal ap koi wawar rig tiro themestar,

bis te was mer wergel o pani lengsto Jordan an ko them, hoi maro baro Dewel men della. Dik, ninna i Edomarja, kai djiwenn an Seir, un i Moabarja, kai djiwenn an Ar, kolla mukan men wergel lengre themma te djal.”

O Sihon, ko baro rai an Heshbon, kamas men gar wergel leskro themestar te djal. Tumaro baro Dewel mukas leskro dji har bar te well, jaake te dikas lo tchi dren. Jaake das o baro Dewel les un leskro them an tumare wasta. Un kowa his gomme kau diwes jaake.
Un o baro Dewel penas ap mande: “Shun, me mukau tumen o Sihones un leskre lurden te dell, un leskro them dren te lell. Djan koi un lenn les dren, te well les tumenge.”
Un o Sihon djas win dran o foro peskre tsele lurdentsa, te kurenn le pen mentsa pash o foro Jahaz.
Un maro baro Dewel das len an mare wasta, jaake te maram les un leskre tchawen un leskre tsele lurden.
Palle lam leskre tsele forja dren, un dam hakenes mulo: mursha un djuwja un tchawe, kek lendar atchas djido.
Kokres lengre viechen randam lendar, un tchoram lengre forja win, hoi dren lam.

Maro baro Dewel das i tsele forja an mare wasta: ko foro Aroer, hoi pash o lengsto pani Arnon tchiddo hi, un ko foro hoi tella an o panjeskri tala tchiddo hi, un i tsele forja bis pash o them Gilead. Kek foro his koi, hoi sorleder his har mer.
Pash ko them, hoi i Ammonarja djiwenn, djam gar, gar pash o lengsto pani Jabbok, witar gar pash i forja ap i berge. Jaake kamas kowa maro baro Dewel.
Kote rissram un lam o drom, hoi an o them Bashan pre djal. Un o Og, ko baro rai pral Bashan, djas win peskre tsele lurdentsa, te kurenn le pen mentsa pash o foro Edrei.

Un o baro Dewel penas ap mande: “Ma dare lestar, me dom les un leskre tsele lurden un leskro them an tiro wast. Kre leha har kowa o Sihoneha kral, ko baro rajeha pral i Amorarja, kai an o foro Heshbon djiwas.”
Un o baro Dewel das ninna o Og, ko baro rajes pral Bashan peskre tsele lurdentsa an mare wasta. Un mer dam len jaake rah bis te kek lendar buder pral atchas.
An ko tsiro lam ko tselo kotar them Argob dren an o them Bashan, pral kowa o Og o rai his, un leskre tsele forja. Das kek foro lestar, hoi mer gar dren lam. Kolla his 60 (shob-deesh) forja.
Hako foro his i sorelo foro, koles bare massurja trul peste his. An lende his bare wudja, hoi sasterentsa pandlo wan. Ninna his kote bud gaba, kolen kek massurja his.
Un mer dam hakenes mulo, kai kote djiwell: mursha un djuwja un tchawe, jaake har les ninna o baro rajeha Sihon an Heshbon kram.
Lengre vieche un ko kutch koowa, hoi an i forja his, randam menge.

Jaake lam menge an ko tsiro ko them dren, hoi his an i wasta kol dui bare rajendar pral i Amorarja, – ko them, hoi ap i wawar rig o lengsto panjestar Jordan tchiddo hi, mank o lengsto pani Arnon un i berga Hermon.
[Ap i berga Hermon penenn i menshe dran o foro Sidon ‘berga Sirjon’. Un i Amorarja penenn ‘Senir’ ap late.]
Kolla his i tsele forja an o pralstuno them, ninna o tselo them Gilead, un o them Bashan bis pash i forja Salka un Edrei. Kol tsele forja pral kolende o Og dran Bashan o rai his, lam menge dren.

Kokres o Og, ko baro rai pral Bashan, atchas djido kol bare menshendar, kai ‘riese’ kharedo wan. Har meras lo, was lo paskedo an i barrengro mochton. Kowa hi jaake star metarja baro un dui metarja buchlo, un hi tardo an o foro Rabba an o them Ammon.

Kau tselo them lam mer an ko tsiro menge dren. Ko them, hoi hi tchiddo serwes o forestar Aroer un o lengsto panjestar Arnon dom me i familjake Ruben un i familjake Gad. Ninna dom me len o paash them Gilead un kol forja koi dren.

Un ko wawar paash o themestar Gilead un o tselo them Bashan, kai o Og o rai his, kowa dom i paash familjake Manasse. Kowa his o tselo kotar them Argob. [Kau tselo them Bashan well kharedo ‘o them fun i riese’.

O Jair dran i familja Manasse las ko tselo kotar them Argob bis pash o them, kai i Geshurarja un i Maachatarja djiwenn. O Jair kharas kol gaba an o them Bashan pal peskro lab ‘o Jaireskre gaba’. Un jaake kharenn le gomme kau diwes.]
O them Gilead dom me o mursheste Machir dran i familja Manasse.

Un i menshenge dran i familja Ruben un dran i familja Gad dom me ko kotar them tchatches o themestar Gilead bis pash o lengsto pani Arnon – bis mashkral an kau pani. Ap koi rig, kai o kham pre djal, djas lengro them bis pash o lengsto pani Jabbok. Ap leskri wawar rig hi o them Ammon.
Ap i rig, kai o kham tele djal, djal o them bis pash o lengsto pani Jordan, un kote fun o pani Kinneret bis pash o Londo Baro Pani, un bis tella pash i berga Pisga, kote kai o kham pre djal.

An ko tsiro penom i murshenge dran kol familja Ruben, Gad un Manasse: “Tumaro baro Dewel das tumen kawa them, te lenn les tumenge dren. Kanna lenn tumaro kurepaskro koowa un djan tumare phralenge, kol wawar Israelenge glan win.
Mukenn tumare djuwjen un tumare tchawen an tumare forja, hoi me dom tumen. Ninna tumare viechen mukenn kote. Djinau, tumen hi bud vieche.

Tumer kurepangre, awenn tumare phralenge pash o wast jaake rah bis te lan le ko them dren, hoi o baro Dewel len della ap i wawar rig o panjestar Jordan, un bis te mukell lo len kote te djiwell kek kurepah, jaake har job ninna tumenge kras. Palle nai djan tumer pale an tumaro them, hoi tumende dom.”
An ko tsiro penom ap o Josua: “Tire jaka dikan kowa halauter, hoi tumaro baro Dewel kal dui rajentsa kras. Un jaake krell o baro Dewel hako rajeha an hako them, kai tu djah.
Ma dare lendar! Tumaro baro Dewel hi kowa, kai kurell pes tumenge.”
An ko tsiro mangom o baro Debles miro tselo djijeha un penom:
“Baro Dewel, miro rai, tu sikral man, tiro budepaskres, tiro barepen un tiro sorelo wast. An o bolepen un ap i phub hi kek wawar dewel, kai nai krell sawo baro koowa an sawi bari soor har tu.
Mangau tut, muk man pral o pani Jordan wergel te djal un ko latcho them te dikell, hoi kote hi, kol shukar berge un o Libanon.”
O baro Dewel his chojedo pral mande dran kowa har tumer hans, un shunas doleske gar ap mande. Un penas: “Muk tele! Kanna hi doha! Rake mange gar buder pral ko koowa!
Dja pral pre ap i berga Pisga, un dik tut trujel, dik serwes un tchatches un glan un pal tute! Dik lauter mishto an! Tu djiness, te djas tu gar pral o Jordan wergel.
Un pen ap o Josua: ‘Ma traash, ab soreles!’ Job hi kowa, kai djal glan i Israelitarjen wergel o pani Jordan, un anell len dren an ko them, hoi tu dikeh, te lenn le les penge dren.”
Un mer atcham an o telstuno them, ap i wawar rig o forestar Bet-Peor.

Kanna shun, Israel, hoi tumaro baro Dewel tumendar kamell. Denn jak ap leskre tchatchepaskre laba, hoi me tumen sikrau. Rikrenn tumen ap kowa, te atchenn djido, un te wenn dren an ko them, te nai lenn les tumenge dren, ko them, ap koleste tumaro baro Dewel tumare phurenge pes sowel das, te dell lo les lende.
Tchiwenn kek lab koi pashel, hoi me penom, te hunte krenn! Lenn ninna tchi kolestar krik, te rikrenn les gar. Rikrenn tumen ap i laba tumaro baro Deblestar, hoi me tumenge penau.
Tumare jaka dikan, hoi o baro Dewel kras pash i berga Baal-Peor. Hakenes, kai o chocheno debles Baal an-mangas, maras tumaro baro Dewel mashkral tumende.
Tumer, kai rikrenn tumen ap tumaro baro Debleste, tumer halauter djiwenn ninna kau diwes.

Dikenn, me sikrom tumende, hoi o baro Dewel tumendar kamella, leskre tsele tchatchepaskre laba, jaake har miro baro Dewel mange penas, te krenn tumer an o them, an kowa tumer wenna un les tumenge dren lenna.

Jaake denn jak ap kol laba, un rikrenn len! Palle dikenn i menshe an i wawar themma, har gosewe han. Te shunenn le, pal hawe laba tumer djiwenna, palle penenn le: “Hawe gosewe menshe hi kolla, kai prindjrenn pen an halauter win! Hawi bari soreli natsjona!”
Kai hi sawi bari natsjona, kolenge lengro dewel ap i rig well, har menge maro baro Dewel ap i rig well hako kopo, kai dah mer les an-gole?
Kek wawar bari natsjona della, kai i menshen sawe latche un tchatche laba hi, hoi lende sikrenn har te djiwenn le, har kal laba, hoi me kau diwes glan tumende tchiwau.
Denn soreles jak ap tumende, te bistrenn gar – jaake rah har djiwenn, – hoi tumare jakentsa dikan! Un penenn tumare tchawenge un lengre tchawenge,

hoi djas ap ko diwes, har tumer glan tumaro baro Debleste tardo hans pash i berga Horeb. Kote penas job ap mande: “An i tsele menshen khetne, te shunenn le, hoi lenge penau, te krenn le hako diwes, hoi lendar kamau, jaake rah har djiwenn le, un te penenn le kowa ninna pengre tchawenge.”
Kote wan tumer un hans tella pash i berga tardo, un i berga chatchas bis pre an o bolepen. Trul late his kale wolke un baro tamlepen.
Un o baro Dewel rakras ap tumende dran koi jag win. Leskro rakepen shunan tumer, un dikan kekes.

Un job kras tumentsa win, te hi lo tumaro Dewel, un tumer han leskre menshe. Un job das tumen kol deesh laba, hoi tchinas lo an dui barra, un penas tumenge, te hunte rikrenn tumen ap kowa, hoi tumer leha win kran un hunte djiwenn pal kol deesh laba.
An ko tsiro penas o baro Dewel mange, te sikrap tumen, hoi lo tumendar kamell un leskre tchatchepaskre laba, te djiwenn pal lende an ko them, an kowa tumer dren djan, te lenn les tumenge dren.
Jaake denn jak, te bistrenn gar: Ap ko diwes, har o baro Dewel pash i berga Horeb, dran i jag win tumentsa rakras, dikan tumer les gar.
Doleske krenn tumenge kek figura, hoi an-mangenn! Kowa wals i tchilatcho koowa glan o Debleskre jaka, te krans tumer tumenge i dewel, hoi win dikell har i mursh, i djuwel,
i viecho ap o them, i tchirklo ap o bolepen,
i tikno viecho, hoi djal pral i phub, oder i matcho an o pani.

Te hadenn tumare jaka pre pash o bolepen un dikenn o kham un o moonto un i tsele bolepangre momlia, ma mukenn tumen kolendar krik te tserdenn, te tchiwenn tumen tele glan lende un mangenn len an. Tumaro baro Dewel das len i menshenge an i wawar themma ap i phub.

Tumen las o baro Dewel dran o them Egiptia win, har dran i sasterno jagakro bob, jaake bud duka hunte lan kote ap tumende. Tumen las lo koi win, te wenn tumer leskre menshe, kai kokres leske koi hi, jaake har kowa ap kau diwes kate ninna hi.

Un dran kowa, hoi tumer kran, was o baro Dewel ninna chojedo ap mande, un das pes sowel, te djap me gar wergel o lengsto pani Jordan, un te wap gar an ko latcho them, hoi dell tumen tumaro baro Dewel, te well les tumenge.
Me merau an kawa them, me djau gar wergel o pani Jordan. Tumer djan ap i wawar rig, un lenn ko latcho them tumenge dren.

Kanna denn tumen jak, te bistrenn gar, hoi tumaro baro Dewel tumentsa win kras! Ma krenn tumenge i figura tchomonestar, hoi mangenn an, har te wals i dewel. Tumaro baro Dewel penas tumenge soreles, te krenn kowa gar.
Job hi i soreli jag, hoi halauter pre chatchrell, un kamell, te kamenn tumer les kokres.

Te djiwan tumer an o them bud bersha un tumen hi tchawe un tchawengre tchawe kote, ma krenn tumenge i debleskri figura tchomonestar! Kowa wals tchilatcho glan i jaka o baro Deblestar. Te krenn tumer sawo djungelo koowa, krenn tumer les chojedo.

Kau diwes dau man sowel glan o bolepen un i phub, te krenn tumer sawo koowa, djiwenn gar rah an o them, hoi tumer dren lenna wergel o pani Jordan. Kokres i tikno tsiro atchenn tumer koi. Palle wenn tumer lauter krik tradedo.

O baro Dewel tradell tumen mank i menshende an i tsele themma, jekes kate un ko wawares kote. Gar bud menshe atchenn tumendar djido mank kol menshende an i wawar themma, kai o baro Dewel tumen tradas.
Un kote mangenn tumer kol deblen dran kasht un bar an, hoi menshengre wastentsa kerdo wan. Un kol debla nai dikenn un shunenn, nai chan un sungenn gar.
An kol themma rodenn tumer palle o baro Debles, kai tumaro Dewel hi. Te putchenn pal leste tumaro tselo djijeha un tumari tseli sorjah, hatsenn tumer les.
An ko tsiro, hoi wella, kai ap tumende ko tselo koowa was, hoi tumenge penom, an kol djungele phare diwessa wenn tumer pale pash tumaro baro Debleste, un krenn, hoi job tumenge penell.
O baro Dewel hi i Dewel, kai tumenge peskro dji pre krell. Job mukell tumen gar, un mukell tumen gar win te merell, un bistrell gar, hoi lo tumare phurentsa win kras.
Rakrenn pral ko phuro tsiro, har tumer gomme gar koi hans, har o Dewel o menshes ap kai phub kras. Rodenn ap i tseli phub: Was sau baro koowa diklo un shunlo,
te shunan i menshe lengro Debles dran i jag ap lende te rakrell? Un jon atchan djido, har tumenge djas?

Kek wawar dewel djas un las peske menshen win dran i wawar them, har job kras, har las lo tumen win dran o them Egiptia. Job sikras peskri bari soor un kras sau koowa, hoi kek wawar nai krell, un anas bud bibacht ap i Egiptarjen. Job kuras pes tumenge. Peskro sorelo wasteha un peskri pre-hadedi mussjah las lo tumen win, un kras i Egiptarenge bari daar. Kowa lauter dikan tumer.
Tumen mukas lo kowa te dikell, te djinenn, te hi o baro Dewel o tchatcho Dewel, un te dell kek wawar debles har les kokres.
Dran o bolepen win rakras lo ap tumende, te sikrell lo tumen leskro drom. Un ap i phub mukas lo tumen peskri bari jag te dikell. Un dran koi jag win shunan tumer kol laba, hoi job ap tumende rakras.

Job kamas tumare phuren o tselo djijestar, un rodas lengre tchawen win un kolengre tchawen, un halauter kai lendar wenna. Un job djas tumentsa, har anas lo tumen win dran o them Egiptia peskri bari sorjah,
un tradas menshen win dran lengre themma glan tumende, natsjone, kai bareder un sorleder hi har tumer, te dell lo tumende lengro them, jaake har kowa kanna hi.
Jaake hunte djinenn kau diwes un bistrenn kowa gar: Dell kek wawar Dewel har o baro Dewel kokres. Kek wawar dewel hi an o bolepen un witar gar ap i phub.

Denn jak ap kowa, hoi job tumendar kamella, un djiwenn pal leskre laba, hoi tumenge kau diwes penau. Palle djal mishto tumenge un tumare tchawenge pal tumende, un tumer djiwenn i rah tsiro an kau them, hoi tumaro baro Dewel tumenge della, te atchell les tumenge hako tsireske.
Palle rodas o Mose triin forja win ap kai rig o panjestar Jordan, kai o kham pre djal,
te nai nashell kote hakeno, kai i wawares mulo das un kamas kowa gar, un job glan kowa gar chojedo ap leste his. Job nai nashell kote, te well lo gar maredo.
An o them Ruben his kowa o foro Bezer an o pralstuno mulo tato them; an o them Gad his kowa o foro Ramot an o pralstuno them Gilead; un an o them Manasse o foro Golan an o them Bashan.
O Mose sikras i Israelenge o Debleskro drom.
Har le dran o them Egiptia win djan, penas lo lenge kol tsele laba, hoi lende sikran, har te djiwenn le, un hoi o Dewel lendar kamella, un leskre tsele tchatchepaskre laba.

An ko tsiro his le ap koi rig o panjestar Jordan, kai o kham pre djal, wergel o foro Bet-Peor an o them, kai his o Sihon o rai pral i Amorarja. Kowa djiwas an o foro Heshbon. Koles maran o Mose un i Israelitarja, har djan le dran o them Egiptia win.
Un jon lan leskro them penge dren, ninna o them, kai o Og o rai his pral o them Bashan. O Sihon un o Og, kol dui his i raja pral i Amorarja ap kai rig o panjestar Jordan, kai o kham pre djala.
Kau tselo them djas o forestar Aroer, hoi pash o lengsto pani Arnon tchiddo hi, bis pash i berga Sihon, hoi kharella ninna berga Hermon.
An leste his ninna ko tselo telstuno them ap kai rig o panjestar Jordan, kai o kham pre djal, bis pash o Londo Baro Pani un bis pash o piro i bergatar Pisga.

Un o Mose das i tsele menshen Israel khetne gole, un penas ap lende: Shun Israel kowa, hoi o baro Dewel kamell tumendar, leskre tsele tchatchepaskre laba, hoi kau diwes glan tumare kanna penom. Rikrenn len an o shero, un denn jak ap lende, un djiwenn pal lende!
Maro baro Dewel djas mentsa i sowel dren pash i berga Horeb.
Gar mare phurentsa kokres djas lo koi sowel dren, na-a mentsa lauterentsa, kai kau diwes djiwah un kate ham.
Kote ap i berga rakras job dran i jag win, jak an jak tumentsa.
Un me homs mashkral tumende un o baro Debleste tardo an ko tsiro, te penap tumenge, hoi lo penas. Tumer daran i jagatar un djan gar ap i berga pre. Un o baro Dewel penas:
Me, o baro Dewel, hom tiro Dewel, koon tut win las dran o them Egiptia, kai tu i pandlo budepaskro hals.
Un tut well kek wawar Dewel har man.
Un tu kress tuke kek dewel, hoi wi-dikell har tchomone an o bolepen, witar gar har tchomone ap i phub un witar gar har tchomone an i pani tel i phub.

Tu witsress tut gar glan i wawar debleste tele, un mangess les gar an. Me, o baro Dewel, hom tiro Dewel, un kamau, te kamess man kokres. Kolen, kai kamenn mandar tchi te djinell un anenn doosh ap pende, dau me i phagi. Me dau ninna i phagi lengre tchawende un kolengre tchawende jaake rah har triin-te-star familje jek pal i wawar djiwenn.
