Latchepen un kamlepen dau me ap kolende, hoi man o djijestar kamenn un krenn, hoi me penau. Ninna lengre tchawenge, kai pal lende wenna, hom latcho, jaake rah har serja familje jek pal i wawar djiwenn.
Ma le miro lab ‘baro Dewel’ tchitcheske an tiro mui! Me, o baro Dewel, hom tiro Dewel un dau i phagi hakenes, koon kowa krella.
Rike o Debleskro diwes! Ma bude ap leste. Jaake penas tuke tiro baro Dewel.
Shob diwessa dja ap tiri budi un kre tiri tseli budi!

O eftato diwes hi mange, tiro baro Debleske. Ap ko diwes kress tu kek budi, witar gar tire tchawe un tcha, witar gar tiro budepaskro un tiri budepaskretsa, witar gar tiri grumni, tiri burika tire wawar vieche, witar gar kol wi-themarja, kai an tiro foro djiwenna. Jaake har tu hunte budress gar, hunte budrenn tire budepangre witar gar.
Ma biste, kai hals i budepaskro an o them Egiptia, un me, tiro baro Dewel, las tut win miro sorelo wasteha un pre-hadedi mussjah. Doleske penau me tuke: Rike miro diwes jaake.
Dik ap tiro dadeste un ap tiri date, te djal lenge mishto. Jaake djiweh i rah djipen an ko them, hoi tut tiro baro Dewel della.
Ma mare kekes!
Romeha, ma dja i wawar djuwjah! Romnija, ma dja i wawar mursheha!
Ma tchore!
Ma an kek chochepen pre ap jekeste!
Ma rode gar, har nai less tu kowa tuke, hoi i wawares hi: leskri romni, leskro kheer, leskri phub, leskro budepaskro, budepaskretsa, grumni, burika, tchi, hoi i wawares hi.

Kal laba rakras o baro Dewel ap tumende halauter, har wan khetne pash i berga. Dran i jag win, dran koi kali pessi wolka win rakras lo bari goljah. Kek wawar lab tchiwas lo pashel. Un job tchinas len ap dui barra un das len mande.
Un har shunan tumer ko rakepen dran ko kalepen un dikan har i berga chatchas, koi wan tumare pralstune pral i deesh-te-dui bare familjende un tumare phureder pash mande,

un penan: “Dik, maro baro Dewel sikras men peskro railepen un barepen. Un mer shunam leskro rakepen dran i jag win. Kau diwes haiwam mer, te rakrell o baro Dewel i menshentsa, un o jon atchenn djides.
Un kanna, hoske meras mer? Kai bari jag chal men pre. Te shunah mer o rakepen maro baro Deblestar gomme dureder, palle merah mer.
An kek tsiro nai shunas i mensho o rakepen o djido Deblestar dran i jag win, jaake har mer, un atchas djides?
Dja tu koi, un shun halauter, hoi maro baro Dewel penell, un pen kowa menge. Halauter, hoi maro baro Dewel tuke penell, kamah te shunell un les krell.”
Un o baro Dewel shunas tumare laba, hoi tumer ap mande penan. Un o baro Dewel penas ap mande: “Me shunom, hoi kal menshe tuha rakran. Lauter, hoi jon penan, hi mishto jaake.
Har kamoms, te atchans lengre djia hako tsiro jaake, te rikrenn le man glan pengre jaka, un te denn le jak ap mire tsele laba! Palle djals lenge un lengre tchawenge mishto o tselo tsireske.
Dja pash lende un pen lenge: Djan an tumare plachtene khera pale!

Tu, atch kai pash mande! Un me penau tuke o tselo lab, halauter hoi tumendar kamau, un mire tsele tchatchepaskre laba. Kolla lauter peness lenge, te djiwenn le pal lende an ko them, hoi me dau lende, te lenn le les lenge dren.”
Kanna denn jak, te krenn halauter jaake, har tumaro baro Dewel kowa tumenge penas. Rikrenn leskre tsele laba. Tchiwenn kek lendar ap i rig.
Djan jaake ap leskro drom, har job tumenge sikras! Palle atchenn djido, un djal tumenge mishto. Un tumer nai djiwenna i rah tsiro an ko them, hoi tumer dren lenn, te well lo tumaro.

Un kawa hi o lab, lauter, hoi tumaro baro Dewel tumendar kamella, un leskre tchatchepaskre laba, hoi lo mande das, te penap len tumenge, te nai djiwenn pal lende an o them, an kowa tumer kanna djan, te lenn les tumenge dren,

jaake te rikrenn tumaro baro Debles glan i jaka tumaro tselo djipen, un denn jak ap halauter, hoi lo tumendar kamella, ap leskre tsele laba, hoi me tumenge penau, te rikrenn tumen ap lende, tumer un tumare tchawe un tchawengre tchawe. Jaake djiwenn tumer i rah tsiro an tumaro them.

Jaake shun kanna, Israel, un de jak te kress kowa halauter, te djal tuke mishto. Un tumer wenn i bari natsjona an ko them, kai hi bud thud un gwin, jaake har o baro Dewel, o Dewel tumare phurendar, kowa tumenge penas.
Shun Israel! O baro Dewel hi maro Dewel, job kokres un kek wawar!
Tu kamess les tiro tselo djijestar un tiro tselo djipah un tiri tseli sorjah.
Un kol laba, hoi me tuke kau diwes penau, less an tiro dji,
un peness len ninna tire tchawenge, te bistrenn le len gar. Rake lendar, te hal khere beshdo, un te djah ap o drom, un te tchiweh tut tele un te steh pale pre.
Pande kol laba ap i pandepen trul tiro wast un trul tiro shero pral i jaka, te bistress len gar.
Un tu tchiness len ap i pesse kashta tchatches un serwes pash tiro khereskro wudar un ap i wudar pral.
O baro Dewel, kai tiro Dewel hi, anell tut an ko them, kai job pes pash o Abraham, o Isaak un o Jakob sowel das, te dell lo les tute. Kote hi bare un shukar forja, hoi tu gar kral,

ninna khera pherdo latcho koowa, hoi tu gar khetne lal, un wi-dine brunne, hoi tu gar dran o bar win dal, ninna drakengre ruka un djeteskre ruka, hoi tu gar an i phub tchiwal. Un palle, te chah kolestar lauter un weh tchalo,
palle de jak, te bistress gar o baro Debles, kai anas tut win dran o pandepen dran o them Egiptia.
Tu mangess o baro Debles an, un rikress les glan tire jaka pash halauter, hoi kreh. Te deh tut sowel, dess tiri sowel pash leskro lab.
Ma dja wawar deblenge palla, kolen i menshe dran i themma trul tumende, an-mangenn.
Tiro baro Dewel hi mank tumende un kamell te kamess les kokres. Te rikreh gar pash leste, well leskri choli pral tute, un job lell tut krik i phubjatar.
Ma krenn jaake, har te wals o baro Dewel gar pash tumende un dals tumen gar kowa, hoi tumen hunte well djipaske, jaake har kowa kran, har hans an o foro Massa!
Rikrenn mishto o baro Debleskre laba un djiwenn jaake, har tumaro Dewel tumenge sikras. Krenn, hoi job tumendar kamell!

Te krenn, hoi tchatcho un latcho hi glan leskre jaka, djal tumenge mishto. Un tumer wenn dren an ko latcho them, kolestar o baro Dewel tumare phurenge penas, te tradell lo kolen glan tumende kote win, kai tumen gar kamenn. Un job das ninna peskro wast koi pre.
Te well ko tsiro, kai putchell tut tiro tchawo: Hoske hunte rikras kol laba, hoi sikrenn, har te djiwas, un hoi maro baro Dewel mendar kamell, un hunte djiwas pal leskre tchatchepaskre laba?
Palle peness tu ap tiro tchaweste: “Mer hams budepangre o baro rajestar an o them Egiptia. Un o baro Dewel anas men win dran Egiptia peskri bari sorjah.
Un o baro Dewel kras baro un sorelo koowa, hoi kek wawar nai krell un anas bari bibacht pral i Egiptarja un pral o baro rajeste un koleskro tselo kheer. Kowa dikam mare jakentsa.
Un men las lo koi win, te anell lo men an kau them, jaake har job pes sowel das glan mare phurende, te dell lo men kau them.

Un maro baro Dewel penas, te kras kowa lauter, hoi job mendar kamell, un te rikras les glan mare jaka pash halauter, hoi krah, te djal menge mishto an maro tselo djipen, jaake har kowa kau diwes ninna hi.
Mer te krah pal kal tsele laba un shunah ap kowa, hoi maro baro Dewel menge penas, palle ham glan leste an o tchatchepen tardo.”

Tumaro baro Dewel anell tumen an ko them, hoi tumaro well. Un job tradell bud menshen glan tumende win: I Hetarja un i Girgasharja un i Amorarja un i Kanaanitarja un i Perisarja un i Hiwarja un i Jebusarja. Kolla hi efta natsjone, kai hi bareder un sorleder har tumer.
Te dell tumaro baro Dewel len an tumare wasta, un tumer denn len, palle hunte marenn len halauteren. Tumer hunte krenn gar lentsa win, te wenn lengre mala, un hunte sikrenn kek latchepen ap lende.
Ma romedinerenn kek lentsa! Tumare tchen denn gar lengre mursh tchawende! Un lengre tchen lenn gar tumare mursh tchawenge, te romedinerenn le len.
Kol tcha anens tumare mursh tchawen o baro Debleskro dromestar tele, jaake te mangens le wawar deblen an. Palle wals o baro Debleskri choli pral tumende, un sik marals job tumen.

Doleske krenn kawa lentsa: Witsrenn kol pre-tchidde barra trujel, kai marenn le un chatchrenn le viechen lengro debleske. Phagenn kol bare barra paash, hoi le leske pre-tchiwan! Un denn kol kashta tele, hoi sikrenn i debletsa Ashera. Un chatchrenn lengre figuren pre.
Tumer han menshe, kai hi o baro Debleske kokres koi. Tumen rodas lo win dran i menshen an i tsele themma, kai ap i phub hi, te wenn tumer leskre menshe.
Kowa kras lo gar doleske, kai hans budeder har kol wawar. Na-a, tumer han i tikneder natsjona har kol wawar.

Dran peskro kamlepen tumenge rodas o baro Dewel tumen win, te rikrell lo peskri sowel dren, hoi job tumare phurende das. Doleske anas lo tumen peskro sorelo wasteha win dran o them, kai pandlo hans, dran o wast o Faraestar, ko rajestar pral Egiptia.

Djinenn: tumaro baro Dewel hi kokres o tchatcho Dewel. Job rikrell peskro lab, un hoi lo tumentsa win kras. Latchepen un kamlepen dell lo kolende, hoi les o djijestar kamenn un krenn, hoi lo penell. Ninna lengre tchawenge, kai pal lende wenna, hi lo latcho, jaake rah har seri familje jek pal i wawar djiwenn.
Un kolen, kai kamenn lestar tchi te djinell, dell lo i phagi, un marell len sik. Kek tsiro mukell lo pes, te anell lo lenge lengro tchilatchepen pale ap lengre sherja.
Jaake rikrenn tumen hako tsiro ap leskre laba, krenn, hoi lo tumendar kamell, un djiwenn pal leskre tchatchepaskre laba, hoi kau diwes tumenge penau.

Te shunenn tumer leskro tchatchepen, un rikrenn tumen ap leskre laba, un djiwenn pal lende, palle rikrell tumaro baro Dewel, hoi lo tumare phurentsa win kras, un peskro wast pre das, un well tumenge latches.

Dran peskro kamlepen dell job tumen bacht un bud tchawen, ninna bud djob, mool un djet. Un tumare grumja un bakre wenna bud an o them, kolestar job glan tumare phurende pes sowel das, te dell lo les tumende.
Kek wawar menshe an i tsele themma lenn jaake bud bacht. Kek hi mank tumende, witar gar mank tumare viechende, kai nai lell kek ternepen.

Un o baro Dewel lell hako nasslepen tumendar, un anell kek sawo nasslepen ap tumende, hoi ap i menshende an o them Egiptia wan, un hoi tumer prindjrenn. Na-a gar ap tumende tchiwell lo len, ap hakeneste, kai ap tumende pre djal, tchiwell lo len.
Tumer hunte marenn i tsele natsjone, hoi tumaro baro Dewel an tumare wasta dell. Jon hunte khaitenn tumen gar, un lengre deblen hunte mangenn gar an. Jon anans tumen an i bibacht.
Te penenn tumer an tumare djia: “Kal natsjone hi bareder har mer, har nai tradas mer len win?”
Palle ma darenn lendar! Ma bistrenn, hoi tumaro baro Dewel ap o Farao un ap i tsele Egiptarja kras.

Tumer dikan, har lo peskri bari soor sikras, un kras sau koowa, hoi kek wawar nai krell, un anas bud bibacht ap i Egiptarjen. Peskro sorelo wasteha un peskri pre-hadedi mussjah anas lo tumen win. Jaake krell tumaro baro Dewel i menshentsa an i tsele themma, kolendar tumer darenn.
Kote pashel bitchrell tumaro baro Dewel bari bibacht un daar ap lende bis te kolla, hoi pral atchenn un pen glan tumende khatrenn, ninna maredo wan.
Doleske, ma dare lendar! Tumaro baro Dewel hi mashkral tumende, ko baro sorelo Dewel, glan koleste hakenes i daar taprell.
Job tradell kal menshen win glan tumende, jek pal o wawar, un hakeno peskro tsireske. Tumer nai denn len gar ap jek kopo mulo. Palle wens i diwje vieche budeder un djans ap tumende.
Tumaro baro Dewel dell len an tire wasta un krell lenge dineles i darjatar, bis te halauter mulo dino hi.
Un job dell tumen lengre bare rajen an o wast. Un tumer marenn len, un lengre laba wenn bistedo. Kek nai well sorleder har tumer. Tumer marenn len halauter.
Chatchrenn i figure lengre deblendar! Ko rup un ko sonakai, hoi ap lende hi, lenn gar tele tumenge, te wenn tumare djia gar pandles ap kowa. Sawo koowa wals djungeles glan tumaro baro Debleskre jaka.
Tumer hunte anenn kek sawi figura an tumare khera, te wenn tumer gar lentsa khetne mulo dino. Tchatchepah, dikenn ap lende har ap i djungelo koowa, un denn len paash.

Rikrenn kol tsele laba, hoi tumenge kau diwes penau. Djiwenn pal lende! Jaake atchenn djido un wenn bud menshe, un nai lenn ko them tumenge dren, kolestar o baro Dewel glan tumare phurende pes sowel das, te dell lo les lende.

Ma bistrenn, har djas tumaro baro Dewel glan tumende an kol 40 (star-deesh) bersha, har djan an o mulo tato them trujel. Kote sikras lo tumen: Te hi lo gar tumentsa, nai krenn tchi. Ninna kamas lo win te hatsell, hoi an tumare djia hi: Shunenn tumer ap leskre laba oder gar?

Un job mukas tumen te bokell, te haiwenn, tumaro chapen well lestar. Un job das tumen o Manna te chal, hoi tumer gar prindjran un tumare phure witar gar. Kowa kras lo, te sikrell lo tumen, te djiwell o mensho gar o chapastar kokres. Na-a, i mensho djiwell hako labestar, hoi dran o mui o baro Deblestar win djal.
An kol tsele star-deesh bersha djan tumare koola ap tumende gar paash, un tumare pire wan gar pesso.
Jaake haiwenn tumer an tumare djia, tumaro baro Dewel kras tumentsa har i dad peskro tchaweha.
Doleske denn jak ap i laba tumaro baro Deblestar, un djan ap leskre drom, un shunenn o tselo djijeha ap leste.
Tumaro baro Dewel anell tumen an i latcho them. An kau them nashenna panja, hoi wenn win dran i phub, un nashenn i berge tele an i telstuno them.
An kau them well gib un djob bares, ninna drake, faige, granatikre phabja. Djeteskre ruka un gwin dell kote ninna.
Kowa hi i them, kai hi bud chapen tumenge. Halauterestar hi doha koi. An kau them hi ninna barra, kai saster dren hi. Un an i berge nai denn lolo saster win.
Un te chan un wan tchales, palle sharenn tumaro baro Debles ko latcho themeske, hoi lo tumen das.

Denn tumen jak, te bistrenn gar tumaro baro Debles, jaake te denn gar buder jak ap leskre laba, un ap leskro tchatchepen, un ap halauter, hoi job tumendar kamella, kowa hoi me tumenge kau diwes penau, te hunte krenn.
An ko tsiro, kai djal tumenge mishto, un nai chan tumenge tchales, un djiwenn an shukar khera,
un tumen wan bud grumja, bakre, rup un sonakai, un halauter hoi tumen hi, was budeder,
palle denn jak, te wenn gar pre-phurdo, un bistrenn tumaro baro Debles, koles, kai anas tumen win dran o them Egiptia, kai tumer pandle budepangre hans.

Job sikras tumen o drom an ko baro mulo tato them, kai tumen daar his, an koleste tchilatche sapa un skorpione hi. Kote, kai o kham lauter pre chatchras, un kek pani dell, mukas lo tumenge pani dran i baro sorelo bar te nashell,

un das tumen Manna te chal an o mulo tato them, ko maro, hoi tumare phure gar prindjran. Kote sikras lo tumen: Te hi lo gar tumentsa, nai krenn tchi. Ninna kamas lo win te hatsell, hoi an tumare djia hi, te nai krell lo les tumenge pal kowa mishto.
Un tumer te nai penenn gar an tumare djia: Miri soor un mire wastengri budi anas mange kau tselo brawlepen!

Doleske ma bistrenn tumaro baro Debles! Job hi kowa, kai tut i soor das, te nai lenn tumenge brawlepen khetne. Un jaake rikrell job kowa, hoi lo tumare phurentsa win kras. Ninna kau diwes rikrell lo pes ap kowa.

Ma bistrenn tumaro baro Debles! Ma nashenn wawar deblen palla! Un ma witsrenn tumen glan lende tele, te mangenn len an! Te krenn kowa, palle dau tumen kau diwes miro lab pre, te wenn tumer jaake mulo dino,
har kol wawar menshe, kai o baro Dewel glan tumende marell. Tchatchepah, tumer te shunenn gar ap leskro rakepen, wenn tumer maredo.

Shunenn, tumer menshe Israel! Tumer djan kau diwes pral o pani Jordan, te lenn themma tumenge dren kol menshendar, kai hi bareder un sorleder har tumer. Lengre forja hi bares, un bare massurja djan trul lende pre an o bolepen.
I menshe kote hi baro un wenn kharedo ‘riese’. Tumer shunan, har lendar penlo was: Kek nai well sorleder har jon.

Doleske djinenn kau diwes, te djal tumaro baro Dewel glan tumende har i jag, hoi halauter pre chatchrell. Job dell len, te hunte nashenn le penge tumendar. Un tumer tradenn len win un denn len sik mulo. Jaake penas o baro Dewel kowa tumenge.

Pal kowa, kai tradas len tumaro baro Dewel glan tumende win, ma penenn: Dran maro tchatcho djipen anas men o baro Dewel an kau them, te las le menge dren. Na-a, dran o tchilatcho djipen kol menshendar tradas len o baro Dewel win glan tumende.

Hi gar doleske, te wans latche menshe un tumen wals i djudjo dji, te wenn tumer an ko them, te lenn les tumenge dren. Na-a, tumaro baro Dewel tradell kol menshen win ko tchilatchepaske, hoi le kran, te rikrell job koi sowel dren, hoi lo tumare phurende, o Abrahames un o Isaakes un o Jakobes, das.
Jaake djinenn kanna, hi gar dran tumaro tchatcho djipen, te dell tumen tumaro baro Dewel kau latcho them, te lenn les tumenge dren. Tumer han menshe i djijentsa har bar.
Ma bistrenn, har choiran tumaro baro Debles an o mulo them, Ko diwesseha har djan tumer win dran o them Egiptia bis te wan kate, kai kanna han, kaman gar ap leste te shunell.
Un pash i berga Horeb kran tumer o baro Debles jaake chojedo, te kamas lo tumen te marell.

Me homs pre ap i berga, te lap lestar kol barra, an koleste job i deesh laba tchinas, hoi hunte rikrenn, te wenn leskre menshe. Kote atchom me 40 (star-deesh) diwessa un ratsja. Maro chom me kek, un pani pijom me witar gar.

Un o baro Dewel das man dui barra, an kolende job peskro gushteha kol laba tchinas. Glan kowa penas lo kol laba ap tumende, har khetne wan pash i berga, un i berga pherdi jag his. Dran i jag win rakras lo tumentsa.
Har kol 40 (star-deesh) diwessa un ratsja trujel his, das man o baro Dewel kol dui barra, kai kol deesh laba dren tchinlo hi,

un penas ap mande: “Naash, dja sik kai berga tele! Kol menshe, kai tu dran o them Egiptia win anal, kran i tchilatcho koowa. Sik djan le ko dromestar tele, kai me sikrom lende. Jon kran penge i dewel dran sonakai.”
Un o baro Dewel rakras pale mantsa un penas: “Me dikau, kai djiwenn kol menshe pal pengro shero un kamenn gar te shunell.
Ma rike man pale, te anap miri bari choli pral lende, un dap len mulo, te well lengro lab bistedo. Tire tchawendar krau me i natsjona, hoi hi sorleder un bareder har kaja.”
Me rissrom man un djom koi berga tele. Un koi berga chatchas an i jag. Un kol dui barra kol deesh labentsa his an mire wasta.
Un me dikom, tumer kran baro tchilatchepen ap tumaro baro Debleste. Tumer kran tumenge i sonakaskro terno gurum un djan sik tele ko dromestar, hoi o baro Dewel sikras tumende, te hunte djan.
Kote taprom me kol dui barra un witsrom len dran mire wasta win, un phagom len an kotja glan tumare jaka.

Un me witsrom man tele glan o baro Debleste, un homs tchiddo glan leste har koi ersto kopo 40 (star-deesh) diwessa un ratsja. Maro chom kek, un pani pijom gar. Un mangom les tumenge, te dikell lo gar ap tumari bari doosh, hoi tumer ap tumende lan, har sawo djungelo koowa kran, un les jaake chojedo kran.
Leskri choli ap tumende his jaake baro, te darom, te marals job tumen. Un o baro Dewel shunas ninna kau kopo ap mande.
Ninna ap o Aron his o baro Debles i bari choli, un job kamas les te marell. Un me mangom an ko tsiro ninna o Aroneske.

Un ko terno gurum, hoi kran tumenge un jaake o Deblestar tele peran, kai figura lom me un witsrom lat an i jag, dom lat paash un dom lat an sawe tikne kotja, te atchas tchi har stauba pral. Un koi stauba witsrom an ko pani, hoi kote i berga tele nashell.
Ninna kran tumer tumaro baro Debles chojedo, har hans an Tabera un Massa un Kibrot-Taawa.

Un har bitchras o baro Dewel tumen dran o foro Kadesh-Barnea win un penas: “Djan pre un lenn o them tumenge dren, hoi me tumen dom”, koi shunan gar ap leste, un patsan les gar un kran gar, hoi lo tumenge penas.
Jaake rah har prindjrau tumen, hi tumen sherja har barra un krenn gar, hoi o baro Dewel tumenge penell.
Un har kamas o baro Dewel tumen te marell, homs tchiddo glan leste 40 (star-deesh) diwessa un 40 (star-deesh) ratsja.
Un me mangom o baro Debles un penom: “Baro Dewel miro rai, ma mare tire menshen, kol menshen, kai tu win lal dran o them Egiptia tiri bari sorjah un tiro sorelo wasteha, te wenn le tire menshe!
Ma biste tire budepangre, o Abraham un o Isaak un o Jakob! Ma dik koi pre, te hi kal menshen kai djia har barra. Ma dik ap lengro tchilatchepen, un ap koi doosh hoi le ap pende anan.

Muk i Egiptarjen gar te penell: ‘O baro Dewel nai anell len gar an ko them, kolestar job penas, te dell lo les lenge.’ Muk len gar te penell, te anal len win an o mulo tato them dran tiri choli, te merenn le kote.
Jon hi tire menshe, kolen tu win lal dran o them Egiptia tiri bari sorjah un tiro sorelo wasteha, te wenn le tire menshe!”
An ko tsiro penas o baro Dewel ap mande: “De dui barra win, har kol dui glanstune, un ab pre pash mande ap i berga, un kre i kashteno mochton.
Un me tchinau ap kol barra kol laba hoi ap kol glanstune dren tchinlo his, kolen tu paash phagal. Un tu tchiwess kol barra an kau mochton!”
Un me krom i mochton dran akatstikro kasht, un dom dui barra win, hoi jaake har kol glanstune his, un djom pre ap i berga. Un kol dui barra his an mire wasta.
Un har o glanstuno kopo tchinas job kol deesh laba, kolen o baro Dewel ap i berga dran i jag win ap tumende penas, har tumer halauter koi khetne wan. Un o baro Dewel das kol barra mande.
Un me rissrom man un djom i berga pale tele. Un me tchiwom kol barra an ko mochton, hoi me krom. Un kote hi le, jaake har o baro Dewel mange penas.
Un i Israelitarja mukan Beeroth-Bene-Jaakan pal pende un djan dureder an Mosera. Kote meras o Aron un was paskedo. Un leskro tchawo, o Eleasar was rashai pal leste.
Fun kotar djan le dureder an Gudgoda un kotar dureder bis pash Jotbata. Kote das bud pani.

Ko tsireske rodas peske o baro Dewel kol murshen dran o kheer Levi win, te hidjrenn jon o mochton, kai o Debleskre deesh laba dren hi, un te wenn jon rashaja un budrenn leske, un rakrenn an leskro lab bacht win pral i menshende. Un kowa krenn le ninna kau diwes.
Doleske well i Levitarjen kek them har lengre phralen. Kowa hoi jon lenna, well dran lengri budi o baro Debleske. Kowa penas lenge tumaro baro Dewel.
Me atchom ap i berga star-deesh diwessa un star-deesh ratsja har ko ersto kopo. Un o baro Dewel shunas ninna kau kopo miro mangepen un das tumen gar mulo.
Un o baro Dewel penas ap mande: “Ste pre! Un dja glan i menshende win, te wenn le an ko them un lenn les penge dren, ko them, kolestar man glan lengre phurende sowel dom, te dap les lende.”
Un kanna Israel, shun, hoi tiro baro Dewel kamell, te kress! Tu mangess les an, djas ap leskro drom an halauter hoi tu kreh. Tu kamess les o tselo djijestar, un wess leske koi tiri tseli sorjah.
Djib pal leskro lab, un rike leskre tchatchepaskre laba, hoi tuke kau diwes penau. Palle djal tuke mishto.
O baro Debleske hi o bolepen, lauter hoi an o pralstunepen hi. Un ninna i phub un lauter hoi dren hi, hi leskro.
Tumare phuren kamas lo o djijestar. Un tumer, kai lendar wan, rodas lo peske win mank i menshende dran an i tsele wawar themma. Un ninna kau diwes han tumer leskre wi-rodede menshe.
Doleske shunenn kanna ap o baro Debleste, un djan gar buder pal tumaro shero!

Tumaro baro Dewel hi o Dewel pral hako dewel un o rai pral hako rai. Job hi o baro un o sorelo, kolestar halauter darenn. Job dikell gar koi pre, koon jek hi. Un job lell tchi an, hoi kamell jek les te dell, te rissrell lo o tchatchepen trujel.
Job dikell koi pre, te lenn pengro tchatchepen kol tchawe, kolen kek dad buder hi, ninna kol djuwja, kolengro rom meras. Un i wi-themarjen kamell job o djijeha un dell len chapen un koola an-ripaske.
Tumer hans ninna wi-themarja an o them Egiptia. Doleske hunte kamenn tumer i wi-themarjen ninna o tselo djijestar.
Un hunte shunenn ap tumaro baro Debleste un mangenn les kokres an. Rikrenn tumen ap leste kokres. Te denn tumen sowel, denn tumaro sowel pash leskro lab.
Job hi kowa, koleske sharenn tumen i wawar menshe. Job hi tumaro Dewel, kai kras sawo baro un sorelo koowa pash tumende. Kowa dikan tumer tumare jakentsa.
70 (efta-deesh) menshe his tumare phure, har le an o them Egiptia tele djan. Un kanna kras tumaro baro Dewel tumendar jaake bud har i bolepangre momlia.

O Mose penas dureder ap i Israelitarjen: Tumer hunte kamenn tumaro baro Debles o tselo djijestar! Krenn lauter, hoi lo tumendar kamell. Rikrenn tumen ap leskre tchatchepaskre laba, un djiwenn pal leskre laba jaake rah har djiwenn.

Un lenn kau diwes an o dji, hoi sikras o baro Dewel tumende, un gar tumare tchawende. Kolla djinenn kowa gar. Jon dikan les gar. Tumer han, kai dikan leskro railepen un hoi lo tumenge kras peskri sorelo wasteha un pre-hadedi mussjah.
Sawo baro koowa, hoi kek wawar nai krella, kras job ap i Egiptarjen, ap o Faraeste, ko rajeste pral o them Egiptia, un ap leskro tselo them,
ninna ap leskre lurdende, kai tumenge palla lan. Pral lengre graja un wurdja mukas job o pani khetne te phagell. Un jon lauter tassan an o Baro Lolo Pani. Jaake hi kowa bis kau diwes.
Tumer djinenn, hoi lo an o mulo tato them tumenge kras, bis te wan kate ap kai platsa,

un hoi lo kras ap o Datan un ap o Abiram, kolengro dad o Eliab his dran o kheer Ruben: Har i phub peskro mui pre kras un len mashkral i tsele menshende Israel pre chas, len un lengre tsele menshen un lengre plachtene khera, ninna lengre budepangre un vieche, hoi pash lende his.
Tumer dikan tumare jakentsa ko tselo baro kowa, hoi o baro Dewel kras.
Doleske rikrenn tumen ap i tsele laba, hoi tumenge kau diwes penau. Palle han soreles doha, te lenn ko them tumenge dren, an koleste kanna djan.
Un tumer djiwenn i rah tsiro an ko latcho un brawelo them, hoi o baro Dewel pes glan tumare phurende sowel das, te dell lo les lende un lengre tchawende pal lende.
Kau them an kowa tumer wenna, te lenn les tumenge dren, hi gar har ko them Egiptia, dran koleste tumer win djan. Kote hunte budran phares te anenn o pani ap tumari hachetikri phub.
Kau them, kai kanna djan, hi i them, kai dell brishin, hoi perell dran o bolepen ap i berge un ap o telstuno them,
hi i them, ap koleste tumaro baro Dewel jak dell. Leskre jaka dikenn o tselo bersh latches ap leste.
Jaake shunenn ap kol laba, hoi tumenge kau diwes penau, te kamenn tumaro baro Debles o tselo djijestar un wenn leske koi tumari tseli sorjah.
Palle dell job o brishin ap tumaro them an peskro tsiro, an o nijal un an o wend, te nai anenn tumaro djob dren, ninna tumari mool un djet.
Un me mukau o senlepen ap tiri phub pre te djal tire viechenge. Tumen hi hako tsiro doha te chal.
Denn tumen jak, te mukenn tumen gar krik te anell o baro Debleskro dromestar, un perenn lestar tele un mangenn wawar deblen an, un witsrenn tumen glan lende tele.

Te krenn sawo koowa, nashte well i choli o baro Deblestar pral tumende, un job pandell o bolepen tele, te dell buder gar brishin, un i phub nai mukell tchi pre te djal. Palle merenn tumer sik win an kau latcho them, hoi o baro Dewel tumen das.
Ma bistrenn kal laba! Tchiwenn len ap tumare djia, un pandenn len trul tumare mussja un trul tumaro shero, te bistrenn len gar!
Un penenn len tumare tchawenge. Rakrenn kol labendar, te han khere, un ninna te djan ap o drom, te tchiwenn tumen tele, un ninna te stenn pre.
Un tchinenn len ap i pesse kashta tchatches un serwes pash tumaro khereskro wudar un ap i foreskre wudja.
Palle atchenn tumer an kau them, kolestar tumaro baro Dewel glan tumare phurende pes sowel das, te dell lo les tumende, un djiwenn kote jaake rah har o bolepen pral i phub hi.
Te krenn tumer kowa lauter, hoi me penom, te hunte krenn, un kamenn tumaro baro Debles tumaro tselo djijestar, un djan ap leskre tsele dromma, un rikrenn tumen ap leste,
palle tradell o baro Dewel i menshen dran kal tsele themma glan tumende win. Un tumer lenn i themma sawe menshendar tumenge dren, kai hi budeder un sorleder har tumer.
Hako kotar phub ap koleste tumare pire stakrenn, hi tumenge, o tselo them mank o mulo tato them un i berge Libanon, un mank o lengsto pani Eufrat un o Mashkralstuno Baro Pani.
Kek nai atchell glan tumende tardo, Traash un daar mukell tumaro baro Dewel ap i menshende an o tselo them te well glan tumende, jaake har job les tumenge penas.
Kau diwes mukau tumen win rodell: Kamenn tumer o Debleskri bacht? Kamenn tumer i bibacht o Deblestar?
I bacht well ap tumende, te shunenn ap i laba tumaro baro Deblestar, kol laba, hoi me tumenge kau diwes penau.
I bibacht well ap tumende, te shunenn tumer gar ap i laba tumaro baro Deblestar, un djan leskro dromestar tele, un djan wawar deblenge palla, kolen tumer gar prindjrenn.
Te anell tumen tumaro baro Dewel an ko them, an koleste tumer wenn, te lenn les tumenge dren, palle denn koi bacht win gole ap i berga Garizim, un i bibacht ap i berga Ebal.

Kolla hi kol dui berge ap i wawar rig o panjestar Jordan pash ko drom, hoi djal kote, kai o kham tele djal, an o telstuno them, kai o Jordan nashell un kai i Kanaanitarja djiwenn. Kol berge hi gar dur kol bare rukendar pash Gilgal.
Tumer djan tchatchepah pral o Jordan, un wenn an ko them dren, te lenn les tumenge dren. Kau them das tumen tumaro baro Dewel, te lenn les tumenge dren un djiwenn koi.
Jaake denn jak ap halauter, hoi o baro Dewel tumendar kamell, un ap leskre tsele tchatchepaskre laba, hoi me tumenge kau diwes penau. Un djiwenn koi pal!

Kanna penau tumenge, hoi o Dewel tumendar kamella un leskre tchatchepaskre laba, hoi hunte rikrenn an ko them, hoi dell tumen o baro Dewel, kai ninna o Dewel tumare phurendar his, te lenn les tumenge dren. Denn jak ap kal laba, un rikrenn tumen ap lende jaake rah har djiwenn.
Te was ko tsiro, kai lan tumer ko them dren un tradan kol wawar menshen win, palle denn kol tsele platse paash, kai jon pengre deblen an-mangan, ap i bare un tikne berge, ninna tel bare senele ruka.

Witsrenn kol pre-tchidde barra trujel, kai maran le un chatchran le viechen pengro debleske. Phagenn kol bare barra paash, hoi le leske pre-tchiwan! Un chatchrenn kol kashta, hoi sikrenn i debletsa Ashera. Un denn lengre figuren an kotja! Tchi te atchell lendar pral.
Ma mangenn tumaro baro Debles jaake an, har kol wawar menshe lengre deblen an-mangenn.
Mangenn o baro Debles ap i platsa an, hoi job peske win rodell mashkral an o them Israel, te djiwell lo kote. Kote djan, te mangenn les an.

Un kote anenn kol viechen, hoi kamenn leske te marell, sawe, hoi wenn leske tseles chatchedo, un sawe, kolengro rat leske chatchedo well. Kote anenn ninna o deshto kotar kolestar, hoi tumenge dren anan, un ko wawar koowa, hoi glan tchinlo hi, un kowa hoi denna jaake, har tumen sowel dan, ninna kowa, hoi hakeno pestar della, un sawe bakre un gurma, kai i phureder lengre dajendar hi.
Un tumer un tumare familje chan i chapen kote glan tumaro baro Debleste, un awenn bachtelo pral halauter, hoi tumenge khetne anan, ap koleste tumaro baro Dewel peskri bacht tchiwas.
Ma krenn jaake, har mer kau diwes kate krah, kai hakeno krell, har an leskre jaka mishto hi.
Kanna wan gomme gar khere an ko them, hoi tumen tumaro baro Dewel dell, te well les tumaro.
Te djan wergel o pani Jordan un djiwenn an ko them, hoi tumaro baro Dewel tumen dell te wenn kote khere, nai krell kek tumen kote tchilatchepen, un kek rodell kurepen tumentsa.

Palle hi wawartchandes har kanna: Palle anenn kowa, hoi denn o baro Debleste, ap koi platsa, hoi job peske win rodas, te well lo kote an-mangedo. Kote anenn lauter, hoi me tumenge penau: kol viechen, hoi kamenn leske te marell, sawe, hoi wenn leske tseles chatchedo un sawe, hoi chan khetne. Kote anenn ninna o deshto kotar kolestar, hoi dren anan, un ko wawar koowa, hoi glan tchinlo hi, un kowa hoi denna jaake har tumen sowel dan.
Kote glan tumaro baro Debleste awenn bachteles, tumer un tumare tchawe un tcha un tumare budepangre, mursha un djuwja, ninna i Levitarja, kai djiwenn an tumare forja, kolen kek them mank tumende hi.
Denn tumen jak, te anenn gar kol viechen, hoi tumer o Debleske chatchrenn, ap i wawar platsa, hoi hatsenn an o them!
Kokres ap koi platsa, hoi o baro Dewel win rodell an tumaro them, kote anenn kol viechen, hoi kamenn leske te chatchrell, un kote krenn halauter, hoi me tumenge penau.

An tumare gaba un forja nai marenn jaake bud tumare viechendar har kamenn, un har tumaro baro Dewel tumende das, un nai chan lengro mass. Tumer halauter nai chan kolestar, erlige menshe har pale-tchidde. Kowa hi jaake, har chans i wesheskri busni oder i tserfo.
Kokres o rat ma chan! Koles tchorenn ap i phub har pani.

Kolestar, hoi o baro Debleske hi, ma chan: ko deshto tumaro djobestar, moljatar un djetestar, witar gar kol grumja un bakre, hoi i phureder lengre dajendar hi, witar gar kowa koleske tumen sowel dan, un kowa hoi kamenn tumendar kokres te dell, un ko wawar koowa, hoi glan tchinlo hi.

Kowa well anlo glan tumaro baro Debleste ap koi platsa, hoi job peske win rodell. Kote chan tumer les, tumer un tumare tchawe un tcha, un tumare budepangre, mursha har djuwja, un i Levitarja, kai pash tumende djiwenn. Awenn bachtelo glan tumaro Debleste pral halauter, hoi tumare wastentsa khetne lan.
Ma bistrenn i Levitarjen un denn lende, hoi len hunte well, jaake rah har an tumaro them djiwenn.
Te dell tumaro baro Dewel – jaake har lo rakras – tumende budeder them, un tumen hi bok ap mass, palle chan mass an tumare gaba un forja, jaake bud har kamenn!

Tumer hunte djan doleske gar ap koi platsa, hoi tumaro baro Dewel win rodell, te well lo kote an-mangedo. Lauter, kai djiwenn dur koi platsa, nai marenn un chan lengre grumjendar, bakrendar un busjendar, hoi o baro Dewel len das, jaake bud har jon kamenn – kote an lengre forja, kai le djiwenn. Jaake penau les tumenge.
Krenn jaake har te chans i wesheskri busni oder i tserfo. Ko mensho, kai erligo hi, ninna kowa, kai pale-tchiddo hi, kol dui nai chan ko massestar.
Kokres jek koowa rikrenn dren! Ma chan o mass, kai hi gomme o rat dren! An o rat hi o djipen. Un tumer hunte chan gar o djipen khetne o masseha.
Tchore o rat win ap i phub har pani.
Te krenn jaake, hi kowa mishto glan o baro Debleskre jaka, un tumenge un tumare tchawenge pal tumende djal mishto.
Ko wawar koowa, hoi glan tchinlo hi, hoi hunte denn o Debleste, ninna koleske sowel dan, te denn les leste, kowa anenn ap koi platsa, hoi o baro Dewel peske win rodell.
Kote chatchrenn leske kol viechen, hoi wenn tseles chatchedo, lengro mass un rat. Kol wawarendar, hoi tumer chan, tchore o rat ap o baro Debleskri chatchepaskri win.

Denn jak, te rikrenn mishto lauter dren, hoi penom tumenge. Te djiwenn jaake, hi kowa mishto un latcho glan tumaro baro Debleskre jaka. Un tumenge un tumare tchawenge pal tumende djal mishto hako tsireske.
Tumaro baro Dewel tradell i wawar menshen glan tumende win dran o them, kai tumer wenna. Un tumer lenn lengro them tumenge dren un djiwenn kote.
Ap ko tsiro, kai jon buder gar koi hi, denn tumen jak, te mukenn tumen gar ap lengre dromma te anell! Ma putchenn: ‘Har mangan kolla pengre deblen an? Jaake kamah mer les ninna te krell.’

Ma krenn sau kowa tumaro baro Debleha! Kowa lauter, hoi jon pengre deblenge kran, hi djungelo un tchilatcho glan o baro Debleskre jaka. Ninna pengre mursh tchawen un pengre tchen chatchran le lenge an i jag.
Lauter, hoi tumenge penom, hunte krenn un rikrenn. Tchiwenn koleske tchi pashel, un lenn tchi lestar krik!
Te stell mashkral tumende i rakepaskro pre, kai penell, te hi les i lab o Deblestar, oder i wawar, koles sunja hi, un job penell i debleskro sikepen oder i baro koowa glan-wi,

un penell ninna: “Mer djas wawar deblen palla, hoi tumer gar prindjrenn, un mangas len an”, palle shunenn gar ap saweste, ninna te well kowa tchatcho, hoi job penas. Tumaro baro Dewel kamell te dikell, te kamenn les tumare tsele djijentsa un tumari tseli sorjah.
Leske djan palla! Rikrenn les tumenge glan i jaka pash halauter, hoi krenn! Lauter, hoi job penas, krenn! Shunenn ap leste! Mangenn les an! Un rikrenn tumen ap leste!

Un ko rakepaskro, ninna kowa, koles kol sunja hi, job hunte well maredo. Job kamas tumen tumaro baro Deblestar krik te anell, kolestar, kai anas tumen win dran o them Egiptia un las tumen win dran o pandepen. Ko mensho kamas te djan tumer tele o dromestar, hoi tumaro baro Dewel penas, te hunte djan ap leste. Un tumer hunte witsrenn win o tchilatchepen, hoi mashkral tumende hi.

Nai well, te rakrell jek tchorchanes ap tute: ‘Mer djas un mangas wawar deblen an, kolen gar prindjreh, witar gar tire phure prindjran!’ Kowa nai hi tiro phraal, tiro tchawo oder tiri tchai, tiri romni oder tiro maal, koles o djijestar kameh.
Nai well, te penell lo: ‘Mange kol debles an kol menshendar, kai hi trul tute’, oder ‘ko debles kol menshendar, kai hi dur tutar’. Kai le ninna hi ap i tseli phub,
ma kre, hoi job tutar kamell, un shun gar ap leste! Job te khaitell tut gar! Tut well kek dji leske! Ma khate leskri doosh!
Na-a, tu dess les mulo. Tu wess o ersto, kai lell i bar an peskro wast, te witsress ap leste, un pal tute i tsele wawar.
Job kamas tut krik te anell tiro baro Deblestar, kolestar, kai tut win anas dran o pandepen an o them Egiptia. Doleske hunte well job mules witsedo i barrentsa.
Palle shunenn kowa i tsele Israelitarja un darenn. Un kek buder krell sau tchilatcho koowa mashkral tumende.
Te shunenn i forestar, hoi tumaro baro Dewel tumen das, te djiwenn koi dren,
te hi kote tchi-molde, kai anan wawaren o tchatcho dromestar tele un penan: ‘Awenn, mer djas un mangas wawar deblen an, kolen tumer gar prindjrenn’,
palle rodenn mishto, un putchenn palla, un dikenn pal, te hi tchatcho. Te kran le kowa, un sawo djungelo koowa was mashkral tumende kerdo,
palle denn kol menshen an ko foro o chareha mulo. Lauter hunte wenn mulo dino, ninna lengre vieche.

Un lengro tselo brawlepen anenn khetne mashkral ap o foreskri platsa! Un chatchrenn ko tselo foro pre un lauter, hoi an leste hi, tumaro baro Debleske! Tchi har barra hunte atchell pral ko forestar hako tsireske. Un an kek tsiro well lo buder newes kerdo.

Un rikrenn tumenge tchi kolestar, hoi hunte kran paash! Palle lell o baro Dewel peskri bari choli tumendar krik, un well tumenge latcho, un krell tumenge pale peskro dji pre, te krell lo tumendar bud un budeder menshe, jaake har lo pes glan tumare phurende sowel das.
Shunenn ap leskro rakepen un rikrenn leskre tsele laba, hoi tumenge kau diwes penau! Un krenn, hoi glan i jaka tumaro baro Deblestar mishto hi!
Tumer han i tchawe tumaro baro Deblestar. An ko tsiro, kai rowenn i muleske, ma tchinenn tumaro mass leske! Un ma tchinenn i balla pral tumare jaka!
Tumer han o baro Debleskre menshe. Job hi tumaro Dewel. Tumen rodas lo win dran i tsele themma ap i phub, te wenn i natsjona, hoi leske hi.
Tu chas tchi, hoi glan o baro Debleskre jaka pale-tchiddo hi.
Kalla hi i vieche, hoi nai chan: Grumja, bakre, busja,
tserfe un wesheskre busja, diwje bakre un busja, antilope,
un hako viecho, koles pre-phagede pire hi, tseles pre-phagedo hunte wenn le, un hoi o chapen dui kope chal. Kolen nai chan.
Mank kolende, kai o chapen dui kope chan, hi sawe, hoi hunte chan tumer gar: I khamela un o shoshoi, un o bergetikro shoshoi. Kolen hi kek pre-phagede pire. Pale-tchiddo wenn le tumenge.

Un o bales hunte chan gar, ninna te hi les pre phagede pire. O balo chal o chapen gar dui kope. Pale-tchiddo well lo tumenge. O mass kek kal viechendar hunte chan. Witar gar taprenn len an, te hi le mulo.
Kalla hi i vieche, hoi nai chan tumer kolendar, kai an o pani djiwenn: Halauter, hoi len flosse un shuppe hi, nai chan.
Halauter, hoi len kek flosse un kek shuppe hi, ma chan! Pale-tchiddo wenn le tumenge!
Hi tchirkle koi, kai nai chan tumer, un wawar kai nai chan gar. Kolla wenn tumenge pale-tchiddo.
Kalla hi i tchirkle, hoi tumer nai chan gar: adlarja, tchirkle kai chan tikne bakre, kachja un matche,
massengre tchirkle, ratsjakre tchirkle, un halauter, hoi lendar hi.
korake un halauter, hoi lendar hi;
un i straussetikre kachja un i mulengre tchirkle, panjeskre möwe un o habichto un halauter hoi lestar hi;
un o tikno ratsjakro tchirklo un o baro ratsjakro tchirklo, o panjeskri kachni;
un o pelikano un o mulo-massengre tchirkle un o shwano;
un o storcho un o matchengre tchirkle un halauter hoi lendar hi; un o wiedehopf un o fledertikre kermuse.
Un i tsele tikne vieche, hoi pral i phub djan, hoi len tchirklengre mussja hi, wenn tumenge pale-tchiddo. Tumer chan len gar!
I tsele tchirkle, hoi gar pale-tchiddo hi, nai chan tumer.

Tumer hunte chan kek mass i viechestar, hoi mules trujel tchiddo hi. I wi-themares, kai djiwell an tumaro foro, koles nai denn les, te chal job les. Ninna nai bikrenn les ap jekeste dran o wi-them. Tumer han menshe, kai hi o baro Debleske koi, kai tumaro Dewel hi. Tu keress gar i busjakro ternepen an o thud leskri datar.
Hako bersh tchiwess tu o baro Debleske ap i rig o deshto kotar halauterestar, hoi ap tiri hachetikri phub bares was.

An ko deshto kotar tiro djobestar, tiri moljatar un tiro djetestar glan tiro baro Debleste ap koi platsa, hoi job peske win rodella, te well lo kote an-mangedo. An leske ninna kol grumja, bakre un busja, kai hi o phureder lengre dajendar. Cha kote ko chapen un ko mass kal viechendar. Jaake bistreh gar, te djiwess tiro baro Debleha tiro tselo djipen.

Te tchiwell tiro baro Dewel peskri bacht ap tute, un tut well bud chapen, un koi platsa, hoi job peske win rodas, te well job kote an-mangedo, hi jaake dur krik tutar, te nai hidjreh gar ko deshto kotar kote,
palle bike kowa lauter, un le kol lowe un dja pash koi platsa, hoi tiro baro Dewel peske win rodas,

un gin tuke halauter, hoi tiro dji kamell: grumja, bakre, mool un wawar sorelo pipen, oder wawar koowa, hoi tiro dji kamell, un cha kote glan tiro baro Debleste! Un ab bachtelo, tu un tiri familja un tire budepangre,
ninna i Levitarja, kai an tiro foro djiwenn; kolen dess tu ninna tiro chapastar. Jon lan o baro Deblestar kek them un kek phub, har tu lal.
Hako triinto bersh less o tselo deshto kotar halauterestar, hoi tu dren anal an ko bersh, un tchiwess les an tiro foro.

Palle nai wenn i Levitarja, kolen kek phub hi, kai an tiro foro djiwenn, ninna i wi-themarja, i tchawe, kolen kek dad buder hi, un i djuwja, kolengro rom meras, un jon te chan un wenn tchales. Te krenn tumer jaake, tchiwell tumaro baro Dewel peskri bacht ap halauter, hoi krenna.
Hake efta bersha, hunte mukenn tumer koi sijaan, hoi jekes pash tumende hi.

Krenn kowa jaake: Hakeno, kai i wawar Israelitares lowe patsas, mukell leske kanna koi sijaan. Job te mangell gar koi sijaan pale leskro phralestar. Hi i baro Debleskro bersh, kai i tseli sijaan muklo well.
Jekestar, kai hi i wi-themari, nai mangenn tumer leskri sijaan pale. Tumaro phraleske hunte mukenn lat.

Te shunenn tumer ap tumaro baro Debleste un djiwenn pal kol tsele laba, hoi me tumenge kau diwes penau, palle well kek tchorwelo mank tumende. Tumaro baro Dewel tchiwell peskri bacht ap tumende an ko them, hoi job tumen dell.

Job rikrell peskro lab, hoi lo tumende das, un dell tumen jaake bud, te nai patsenn tumer lowe i menshenge dran wawar themma. Tumer hunte patsenn tumenge kekestar lowe. Tumer wenn i raja pral i menshende an bud wawar themma. Pral tumende well kek wawar them o rai.
Te hi i tchorwelo pash tute, kote an ko foro, kai djiweh an ko them, hoi tumaro baro Dewel tumen das, palle ma kre tiro dji pandles, kre tire wasta pre glan leste!
Kre tire wasta leske dur pre! Un pats leske lowe ap kowa, hoi job tuke koi tchiwell, te well les ap halauter pale doha.

De tut jak, te well tuke gar an o dji, te dess les tchi doleske, kai ko eftato bersh gar buder dur hi. Ma pen tuke: ‘Palle hunte mukap leske koi tseli sijaan.’ Un jaake dikeh tchilatches ap leste un deh leste tchi. Un job dell gole ap o baro Debleste pral tute. Un ap tute well i doosh!
De leste o djijestar! Ma ab bokelo! Palle dell tut tiro baro Dewel bacht an halauter, hoi kreh un tiro wast an taprell.
Hako tsiro hi tchorwele an o them. Doleske penau me tumenge: Krenn tumare wasta pre tumare phralenge, kolen gar doha djipaske hi!
Te bikras pes i wawar Israelitari ap tute, – mursh oder djuwel – palle budrell lo tuke shob bersha, un an o eftato bersh mukess les te djal.
Un te mukeh les te djal, palle hunte djal lo gar wastentsa, kai tchi dren hi.
Tu dess les tire bakrendar, tiro djobestar un tiri moljatar, halauterestar, hoi tiro baro Dewel tut das.
Un tu bistress gar, te hals i budepaskro an o them Egiptia, un tiro baro Dewel las tut kote win. Doleske penau me tuke kowa kau diwes.
Job te penell ap tute: “Me kamau gar tutar te djal. Kamau tut un tiri familja o djijestar. Pash tute djal mange mishto.”
Palle less i kashteni sub un dess lat an leskro kand ap tiro wudar tchurje. Jaake well lo tiro budepaskro hako tsireske. I budepaskretsah kress kowa ninna jaake.

Te hunte mukess i budepaskres te djal, muk kowa tuke gar phares te well an tire jaka. Job budras tuke shob bersha jaake bud har dui budepangre, kolen hako diwes hunte plaissress. Palle dell tut tiro baro Dewel bacht an halauter, hoi tu kreh.
Tire tsele mursh grumja un bakre, kai i phureder lengre dajendar hi, hunte dess tiro baro Debleste. Kal grumjentsa budress gar ap tiri hachetikri phub, witar gar tchiness kal bakrenge i balla.
Glan tiro baro Debleste chas len tu un tiro tselo kheer hako bersh ap koi platsa, hoi o baro Dewel peske win rodell.
Te hi tchomone djungelo ap ko viecho, te hi les i bangi heri, te hi lo korelo, oder i wawar doosh hi ap leste, palle chatchress les tu gar tiro baro Debleske.
An tiro foro nai chah les. Hi jek, te hal erligo oder pale-tchiddo. Kowa hi jaake, har chals i wesheskri busni oder i tserfo.
Kokres lakro rat chas tu gar! Tu tchoress les ap i phub har pani.
Denn jak, te bistrenn gar kol bare diwessa, kai kharenn Passa! Rikrenn len an o tchon Abib, te sharenn tumaro baro Debles! O tchon Abib his, kai anas lo tumen rati dran o them Egiptia win.

Djan ap koi platsa, hoi tumaro baro Dewel peske win rodell, te well job kote an-mangedo. Un kote marenn leske i viecho, nai well i bakro, i busni oder i grumni, hoi chan pash o chapen, hoi well Passa kharedo.

Te chan tumer ko chapen, ma chan maro koi pashel, kai shutlo jarro dren hi. Har djan tumenge dran o them Egiptia win, hunte chan efta diwessa maro, an koleste kek shutlo jarro dren his, jaake sik hunte nashenn tumenge. Kanna chan ninna efta diwessa maro, kai kek shutlo jarro dren hi, te bistrenn gar ko diwes, kai djan dran o them Egiptia win, kai anan le jaake bud duka ap tumende. Doleske kharah mer kau maro ‘dukengro maro’.

Un efta diwessa well kek shutlo jarro pash tumende diklo an tumaro tselo them. Un ko mass ko viechestar, hoi tumer an koi rat maran, hunte chan tumer an koi emligi rat. Tchi te atchell pral ap i tsalla.
Tumer nai marenn gar kol viechen o chapaske Passa an tumare gaba un forja, kolen tumaro baro Dewel tumen dell, te djiwenn kote.

Na-a, ap koi platsa, hoi tumaro baro Dewel peske win rodell, kote marenn kol viechen o chapaske Passa. Krenn kowa ap i rat, te djal o kham tele. Kowa hi ko tsiro, har tumer dran o them Egiptia win djan.
Kerenn ko mass, un chan les ap koi platsa, hoi tumaro baro Dewel peske win rodell. Un o wawar diwes taissarlakro djan pale khere!
Palle chan shob diwessa sawo maro, an koleste kek shutlo jarro hi! Un ap o eftato diwes awenn khetne, te sharenn tumaro baro Debles! Ap ko diwes krenn kek budi!
Efta kurke pal ko diwes, kai djan win ap tumari phub te tchinenn o djob tele,

awenn khetne glan tumaro baro Debleste, ap koi platsa, kai job peske win rodell, te well lo kote an-mangedo. Anenn leske kolestar, hoi dren anan, kowa, hoi kamenn tumendar win dran tumaro wast te dell, jaake har tumaro baro Dewel tumende peskri bacht das. Un awenn bachteles glan leste, tumer un tumare tchawe, un tumare budepangre un i Levitarja un i wi-themarja, kai pash tumende djiwenn, ninna kol tchawe kek dadeha un kol djuwjen kolengro rom meras.
Un ma bistrenn, te hans tumer pandle budepangre an o them Egiptia. Un denn jak ap kal laba, te rikrenn tumen ap lende!
Un pal i nijal, te dan tumaro tselo djob win un anan i drake dren, rikrenn kol bare diwessa dren, kai djiwenn an patjengre khera. Efta diwessa djiwenn an lende,

chan un awenn bachtelo, tumer un tumare tchawe un tcha, tumare budepangre un i Levitarja un wi-themarja, kai pash tumende djiwenn, ninna i tchawe, kolen kek dad buder hi, un kol djuwja, kolengro rom meras.

Efta diwessa chan un awenn bachteles glan tumaro baro Debleste ap koi platsa, hoi job peske win rodell. Job tchiwas peskri bacht ap halauter, hoi ap tumari phub bares was un ap tumari tseli budi. Doleske awenn bachtelo!

Triin kope an o bersh hunte wenn tumare tsele mursha glan tumaro baro Debleste ap koi platsa, hoi job peske win rodell: ap kol bare diwessa, kai chan kek maro dran shutlo jarro, un ap ko baro diwes, kai anenn o baro Debleske o newo djobestar, hoi tumer dren anan, un ap kol diwessa, kai djiwenn an patjengre khera. Un kek well, koles tchi pash peste hi, hoi job o baro Debleske anella.
Hakeno della pal kowa, hoi leskro wast nai pre anella, jaake har tumaro baro Dewel leste peskri bacht das.

Tchiwenn tchatchepangre murshen un wawar pralstunen dren an tumare forja, hoi tumen tumaro baro Dewel della! Jaake te hi an hako them kol deesh-te-dui bare familjendar tchatchepangre, kai rakrenn o tchatchepen jaake win pral pengre menshende, te lell hakeno peskro tchatchepen.

Te hal tu i tchatchepaskro, hunte dess tu koles peskro tchatchepen, koon an o tchatchepen hi. Tu dikess gar koi pre, koon glan tute tardo hi. Te dell jek tut kutch koowa, te dess tu les tchatchepen, ma le kowa an! Koon sawo shukar kutch koowa an-lell, well korelo o tchatchepaske, un dikell buder gar, koon an o tchatchepen hi.
Rike tut ap kowa hoi tchatches hi, te djiwess an o them, hoi tiro baro Dewel tut dell.
Tumer hunte tchiwenn kek kasht pre, hoi sikrell i debletsa Ashera, un tchiwenn les pre pash koi chatchepaskri, hoi krenn tumer tumaro baro Debleste.
Tumer hunte tchiwenn kek barra pre, te mangenn i wawar debles an. Sawo koowa hi djungeles glan o baro Debleskre jaka.
Tu maress tiro baro Debleske kek grumni, kek bakro oder busni, hoi nasselo oder djungelo hi. Kowa wals i tchilatcho koowa glan tiro baro Debleste.

Te shunenn tumer i murshestar, i djuwjatar an jek foro tumendar, hoi tumaro baro Dewel tumen dell, un kowa oder koja krell sau koowa, hoi an i jaka tumaro baro Deblestar djungelo hi, un phagell koi sowel, hoi tumer leske dan,
un djal koi un mangell wawar deblen an, un witsrell pes tele glan o kham, o tchon un i bolepangre momlia, un krell jaake sawo koowa, kolestar me penom, te krenn kowa gar,
un kowa well tumenge penlo, palle rodenn mishto un putchenn palla un dikenn, te hi kowa tchatcho. Te hatsenn tumer win, te hi tchatchepah tchatcho, te was sawo djungelo koowa an Israel kerdo,
palle lenn ko murshes oder koi djuwjat, un anenn len win glan tumaro foro, un witsrenn barra ap lende bis te hi le mulo.
Ap o rakepen dui, triin menshendar, kai kowa dikan, wenn le mulo dino. Ap o rakepen jekestar kokres, nai well kek mensho mulo dino.

Kolla, kai dikan ko djungelo koowa, wenn i glanstune, te witsrenn le barra ap lende. Un pal lende wenn kol wawar, kai glan o foro wan, un witsrenn len mulo. Jaake lenn tumer o tchilatchepen mashkral tumende krik.

Te well tchomone glan i tchatchepangre anlo, hoi hi jaake phares lenge, te djinenn le gar, hoi te krenn, – sawo koowa, te das jek i wawares mulo, oder dukas les, oder tchingepen pral kowa, hoi o jekeske oder o wawareske hi, palle krenn tumen ap o drom un djan ap koi platsa, hoi tumaro baro Dewel peske win rodell.
Kote djan pash i rashajende dran o kheer Levi un pash o tchatchepaskro mursheste, kai an kol diwessa koi hi. Un len putchenn! Un jon penenn tumenge, hoi hunte krenn.
Un kowa, hoi le tumenge penenn, hunte krenn tumer. Denn jak, te krenn halauter jaake, har jon tumenge sikran.
Ap lengre laba hunte rikrenn tumen, un kolendar gar tele djan, gar tchatches un witar gar serwes.

Te hi jek koi, kai hi jaake pre-phurdo, te shunell lo gar ap o rashajeste, kai krell i budi o baro Debleske, oder ap o tchatchepaskro mursheste, palle hunte well ko mursh maredo. Tumer hunte lenn o tchilatchepen dran Israel win.
Palle shunell hakeno kowa, un darell. Un kek phurdell pes buder pre, te krell sawo koowa.

Te wenn tumer an ko them, hoi dell tumen tumaro baro Dewel, un tumer lenn les dren, un djiwenn koi dren, un penenn palle: Mer kamah i rai pral mende, jaake har pash kol menshende an i wawar themma trul mende ninna hi,

palle well kowa o rai, koles tumer pral tumende tchiwenn, koles tumaro baro Dewel win rodell. Mashkral tumare phralende lenn jekes un tchiwenn les pral tumende, te well job tumaro rai. Lenn kekes dran o wi-them, kai gar tumare phralendar hi.
Tumaro rajes hunte well gar bud graja un hunte bitchrell gar i Israelitarjen pale an o them Egiptia, te ginenn le leske graja. O baro Dewel penas tumenge, te djan tumer kau drom gar buder pale.
Witar gar hunte lell peske tumaro baro rai bud djuwjen, te well leskro dji gar tele anlo o tchatcho dromestar. Ninna lell lo peske gar bud rup un sonakai khetne.
Ap ko tsiro, kai hi lo ap peskri rajeskri beshepaskri beshdo, hunte mukell lo peske kau liil tele te tchinell, kau liil, hoi pash i rashajende dran o kheer Levi tchiddo hi.

Un kau liil well palle hako tsireske pash leste. Un job drawerell hako diwes an leste jaake rah, har djiwell lo. Jaake te haiwell lo, har te djiwell lo peskro baro Debleha, un dell lo jak ap hako lab an kau liil, un rikrell pes ap kal tchatchepaskre laba, un krell pal lende.

Job hunte krell pes gar bares pral peskre phralende un hunte djal gar tele o baro Debleskro dromestar, gar ap i tchatchi rig un gar ap i serwi rig kolestar, hoi tchinlo hi. Palle atchell lo i rah tsiro baro rai an Israel, job un leskre mursh tchawe pal leste.
I rashaja – jon hi lauter dran o kheer Levi, – kolla lenn kek them an Israel. Jon chan kolestar, hoi i wawar Israelitarja o baro Debleske anenn, te well kowa leske chatchedo.

Kek them lenn i Levitarja an Israel har lengre phrala lenna. Kowa hoi jon lenna, hi lengri budi o baro Debleske. Job kokres dikell ap lende, te hi len lauter, hoi len hunte well. Jaake penas lo lenge.
Kawa hi, hoi i rashajen hunte well: Te anell jek i grumni, oder i bakro o baro Debleske, hunte dell lo kolestar o phik, kol dui tchamja un i buke o rashajeske.
Ninna well i rashajen hako bersh o newo djobestar, i newi moljatar un o newo djetestar, hoi tumer dren anan. Ninna o bakrengro bal, hoi o ersto kopo tele tchinlo well, hi lenge.
Tumaro baro Dewel rodas peske o kheer Levi win dran i tsele Israelitarjen, te wenn i mursha dran o kheer Levi leskre rashaja hako tsireske.
Te kamell i Levitari ko foro te mukell, kai djiwell lo an Israel, un kamell ap koi platsa te djal, hoi o baro Dewel peske wi-rodell,
kowa nai well, te krell lo o baro Debleskri budi jaake har kol wawar Levitarja ninna, kai kote i rashaja hi.
Palle lell job ninna jaake bud chapen har kol wawar ninna lenn. Un kowa, hoi lo peskro dadestar las, hi les gomme pral pre.
Te wenn tumer an o them, hoi tumaro baro Dewel tumen dell, palle krenn gar ko djungelo pale-tchiddo koowa, hoi krenn i menshe, kai kote djiwenn.
Kek mank tumende hunte chatchrell peskro mursh tchawes oder peskri tchat an i jag o Debleske. Kek mank tumende hunte well i durkepaskro, kek i drawepaskro, kek, kai krell wawar bengeskri koowa,
kek, kai rakrell bibacht win an o bengeskri soor, kek, kai i mulentsa rakrell oder i mulen putchell.
Koon sawo koowa krella, hi pale-tchiddo glan o baro Debleskre jaka. Dran sawo djungelo pale-tchiddo koowa tradell tumaro baro Dewel kol wawar menshen dran o them win glan tumende.
Pash tumende hunte well sawo koowa gar hatslo. Tumer han o baro Debleskre menshe.
Kol menshe, kolengro them tumer dren lenna, kolla shunenn ap drawepangre un durkepangre. Tumenge penas tumaro baro Dewel, te krenn kowa gar.
I Debleskro rakepaskro, har me jek hom, jek, kai well tumendar, koles bitchrell tumaro baro Dewel pash tumende. Ap koleste shunenn!

Ap ko diwes, kai hans khetne pash i berga Horeb, mangan tumer kowa tumaro baro Deblestar, un penan: ‘Mer kamah buder gar o rakepen maro baro Deblestar te shunell, un kai bari jag kamah witar gar buder te dikell, te hunte meras gar!’
Un o baro Dewel penas ap mande: Mishto hi, hoi jon rakran.
I Debleskro rakepaskro har tu jek hal, kai well lendar, koles bitchrau me lenge. Un me kamau leske mire laba an leskro mui te tchiwell. Un job rakrell ap lende halauter, hoi me leske penau.
Un ko mensho, kai gar ap mire laba shunell, hoi i rakepaskro an miro lab rakras, koleske dau me i phagi.

Te phurdell pes i Debleskro rakepaskro pre, un penell i rakepen an miro lab, hoi me leske gar penom, te hunte rakrell lo, sawo rakepaskro hunte merell. Ninna te rakrell job an o lab i wawar deblestar, hunte merell lo.
Te putchenn tumenge tumendar: Har djinas mer, hawo lab o baro Dewel gar rakras?

Djinenn: Te rakrell ko Debleskro rakepaskro an o lab o baro Deblestar, un kowa hoi job rakras well gar tchatcho, jaake his ko lab hoi job rakras gar o baro Deblestar. Ko rakepaskro kamas pes peskro rakepah bares te krell. Tu daress gar lestar!

Ap ko tsiro, kai tradas tumaro baro Dewel kol wawar menshen win dran ko them, hoi lo tumende dell, un tumer lan ko them dren, un djiwenn an lengre forja un an lengre khera, palle hunte rodenn tumenge triin forja win, kai nai djan kolla dren, kai naashepangre hi.
Krenn ko tselo themestar triin kotja, an hako kotar jek sawo foro, jaake te hi ko drom koi gar dur koleske, kai jekes mulo das un hunte nashell peske.
Sawo foro hi koleske, kai das jekes mulo un kamas kowa gar, un les his kek choli ap leste. Kowa nai nashell koi, te atchell lo djido.

Kowa nai was jaake: Dui mursha djan an o weesh, te denn le kasht tele, un ko jek hadell peskro wast, an koja i tower hi, un lell win, te dell an o kasht, un o saster phagell tele un djal an koleste, kai pashel hi, un kowa merella. Sawo nai nashell an sau foro un atchell djido.

Te wals an o tselo them kokres jek sau foro, nai wals ko drom dur koleske, kai hunte nashell peske kote. Un kowa, kai kamell o rat o mulestar pale te anell ap o shero kolestar, kai maras les, un lell les pherdi choli palla, kowa nai lals les dren un dals les mulo – koles, kai kek doosh ap leste hi, kolake job hunte merals. Job his glan kowa gar chojedo ap o wawareste.
Doleske penau me tumenge, te rodenn triin forja win.

Te krenn tumer halauter, hoi tumenge kau diwes penau, te hunte krenn, te kamenn tumaro baro Debles o tselo djijeha un djan ap leskre dromma, palle krell tumaro baro Dewel tumaro them bareder, jaake har job pes glan tumare phurende sowel das. Ap ko tsiro, kai das lo tumen o tselo them, palle rodenn tumenge triin wawar forja win!

Jaake hi tumen doha forja kai nai nashell jek dren. Un jaake krenn tumer, te well an tumaro them, hoi tumaro baro Dewel tumenge dell, kek mensho maredo, ap koleste kek doosh hi. Te wals sawo mensho maredo, anans bari doosh ap tumende.
Hi wawartchandes jekeha, kai his chojedo ap jekeste un khatrell pes, un dell jak te taprell lo les, un djal ap leste pre un dell les mulo. Te nashell sawo mensho an sau foro,
palle hunte bitchrenn i phureder dran leskro foro murshen koi, te lenn le les khere, un denn les an i wasta kolestar, kai anell o rat ko mulestar pale ap o koleskro shero, kai das les mulo.
Job te khaitell tumen gar! Sawo marepaskro hunte merell, te djal tumenge mishto an Israel. Job maras jekes, ap koleste kek doosh his.

An ko tsiro, kai djiwenn an ko them, hoi tumaro baro Dewel tumen dell, te lenn les tumenge dren, palle hunte tchiwess gar kol barra ap i rig, hoi sikrenn har baro hi ko kotar them kolestar, kai langs tute djiwell. Kolla his tire phure, kai tchiwan kol barra koi.

Te well i tchilatcho koowa glan i tchatchepangre anlo, hi gar doha, te dikas kokres jek mursh kowa. Na-a dui te triin hunte penenn, te dikan le koles koi pashel, har lo kau koowa kras. Palle nai denn le les i phagi.
Te anell jek chochepah tchomone ap i wawareste pre,
palle wenn kol dui, kolen tchingepen pentsa hi, pash o baro Debleskro kheer, glan i rashajende un glan i tchatchepangre murshende, kolla an kol diwessa koi hi.
Un kol tchatchepangre mursha hunte rodenn mishto palla, hoi tchatcho hi. Te hatsenn le, te hi kowa i chocheno, hoi chochepen ap peskro phraleste pre anas,
palle krenn leha kowa, hoi kamas job peskro phraleha te krell. Jaake lenn tumer o tchilatchepen mashkral tumende krik.
Un halauter an Israel hunte shunenn, har ko chocheno peskri phagi las, te darenn le un krenn buder gar sawo koowa mashkral tumende.
Ko chocheno hunte khaitell tumen gar! Krenn jaake: Jek djipen i djipaske, jek jak i jakeske, jek dand i dandeske, jek wast i wasteske, jek piro i pireske!

Te djan tumer win an o kurepen, te kurenn tumen kolentsa, kai kamenn tumen gar an o them, un tumer dikenn lengre graja un kurepaskre wurdja un lengre lurden, kai hi bud budeder har tumer, palle ma darenn lendar! Tumaro baro Dewel hi tumentsa, kowa kai tumen dran o them Egiptia win anas.
Glan te stenn tumer pre un djan an o kurepen, stakrell o rashai glan un penell ap tumare kurepangre:
“Murshale dran Israel, shunenn! Tumer djan kau diwes an o kurepen, te kurenn tumen kolentsa, kai kamenn tumen gar an o them. Awenn sorelo! Ma darenn lendar! Un ma mukenn tumen traash te krell!
Tumaro baro Dewel hi kowa, kai djal tumentsa un kurell pes tumenge lentsa. Job hi ap tumari rig.”

Pal kowa hunte rakrenn i pralstune ap i kurepangre un putchenn: Hi mank tumende jek, kai i kheer pre tardo tchiwas un mukas gomme gar o Debleskri bacht pral kowa win te rakrell? Kowa hunte djal pale an peskro kheer, te merell lo gar an o kurepen, un i wawar mursh djiwell an leskro kheer.
Hi mank tumende jek, kai drakengre ruka an i phub tchiwas, un las gomme kek drake dren? Kowa hunte djal pale an peskro kheer, te merell lo gar an o kurepen, un i wawar mursh lell kol drake.
Hi mank tumende jek, koles i pirni hi un job las lat gomme gar pash peste? Kowa hunte djal pale an peskro kheer, te merell lo gar an o kurepen, un i wawar mursh lell lat peske.
Un i pralstune hunte putchenn i murshendar pale: Hi mank tumende jek, koles daar hi, un koleskro dji trissella? Kowa hunte djal pale an peskro kheer, te krell lo gar i djia peskre phralendar darenes.
Un pal kau rakepen hunte tchiwenn i pralstune murshen pral i lurdende, te djan jon glan i lurdende an o kurepen.
Te djan tumer glan i foro, te kurenn tumen kolentsa, kai kote djiwenn, pale putchenn lendar glanstunes, te kamenn le pre te dell kek kurepah.
Un te penenn le, te kamenn le kek kurepen, un krenn tumenge o foreskre wudja pre, palle lenn kol tsele menshen, kai kote dren hi, te hunte budrenn tumenge i silah.
Un te kamenn le gar pre te dell, un kamenn pen te kurell tumentsa, palle djan trul ko foro un pandenn les dren, jaake te nai djal kek buder dren un kek buder win.
Un ap ko tsiro, kai dell tumaro baro Dewel les an tumaro wast, denn i tsele murshen mulo o chareha.

I djuwja un i tchawe un i tsele vieche un halauter, hoi tumer dran o foro randan, kowa rikrenn tumenge! Un tumer nai chan ko tselo chapen, hoi his kolen, kai kaman tumen gar. Tumaro baro Dewel das les tumenge.
Jaake krenn tumer i tsele forjentsa, kai hi dur tumendar krik, un gar kate an o them, hoi lenn tumer dren.
An kol forja, hoi hi an ko them, hoi tumaro baro Dewel tumen della, hunte mukenn tumer kekes djido, kek menshes witar kek vieches.
Mulo dino hunte wenn le halauter: i Hetarja, i Amorarja, i Kanaanitarja, i Perisarja, i Hiwarja un i Jebusarja. Jaake penas tumenge tumaro baro Dewel, te hunte krenn.
Te krenn tumer kowa gar, anenn le tumenge pashel, har te krenn ko tselo djungelo koowa, hoi jon pengre deblenge kran. Un jaake anens tumer doosh ap tumende glan tumaro baro Debleste.

Te han bud diwessa trul i foro tardo, koles tumer kamenn te dell un dren te lell, un mukenn kekes dren un kekes win te djal, palle denn gar kol ruka kote tele. Kolendar nai chan. Doleske ma denn len trujel! Jon hi kek menshe, kolentsa hunte kurenn tumen!
Sawe ruka, kolendar djinenn, te chal kek lendar, kolen nai denn tumer trujel, un nai krenn dromma lendar, te nai wenn tumer an ko foro, hoi an o kurepen tumentsa hi, un nai lenn les dren.
Te well i mulo mensho win glan o foro tchiddo hatslo an o them, hoi tumaro baro Dewel tumen dell, te lenn tumer les dren, un kek djinell, koon les mulo das,
palle djan i phureder un i tchatchepangre mursha win pash koi platsa, kai lo tchiddo hi, un dikenn palla, har dur hi bis pash kol forja, hoi kote tchiddo hi.
Un i phureder dran ko foro, hoi o glanstuno pash ko muleste tardo hi, kolla lenn i terni grumni, hoi budras gomme gar ap i hachetikri phub,
un anenn lat tele an i telstuno them, kai i pani nashell, un hoi kek hachetikri phub hi, un kote phagenn le koi terni grumjake i meen.

Palle stakrenn i rashaja dran o kheer Levi glan. Kolen rodas tumaro baro Dewel win, te krenn le leskri budi, un te rakrenn le leskri bacht win pral i menshende. Un an i tchingepen un pal i marepen rakrenn le o tchatchepen win.
Un kol tsele phureder dran ko foro, hoi o glanstuno tardo hi pash ko muleste, kolla thowenn pengre wasta panjeha tele pral koi muli terni grumni.
Un jon hunte penenn: “Mer dran kau foro, mer dam gar ko menshes mulo, un mare jaka dikan gar, koon kowa kras.

Baro Dewel, mangah tut, le kai doosh mendar, tire menshendar Israel, kolen tu dran o pandepen win lal. Ma dik ap mende, har te wams mer kolla, kai maram i menshes, ap koleste kek doosh tchiddo hi.” Palle lell o baro Dewel koi doosh lendar krik.
Jaake krenn tumer, hoi mishto hi glan o baro Debleskre jaka, un tchiwenn ko tchilatchepen krik mashkral tumende. Un job dikell gar ap tumende, har te wans tumer, kai dan koles mulo.
Te djan tumer an o kurepen, un tumaro baro Dewel dell kolen, kai kurenn pen tumentsa an tumaro wast, jaake te anenn tumer lendar pandlen krik,
un jek tumendar dikell i shukar djuwel mank kol pandlende, un kamell lat un kamell te romedinerell lo lat,
palle nai anell lo lat an peskro kheer. Kote hunte tchinell li peskre shereskre bal un peskre naja.

Un joi riwell peskre ripja win, hoi ap late his, har li pandli was. Un joi atchell an leskro kheer un rowell i tselo tchon pral peskro dad un peskri dai. Pal ko tsiro nai djal ko mursh pash late, te romedinerell lo lat.

Te well i tsiro, kai kamell lo lat buder gar, hunte mukell lo lat te djal, kai li kamell. Jek koowa hunte krell job gar: Job nai bikrell lat gar lowenge, un nai rikrell lat gar, te well li leskri budepaskretsa! Joi his leskri romni.
Te hi i murshes dui romja, un job kamell koi jek budeder har koi wawar, un hakeni las lestar jek mursh tchawo, un o phureder mursh tchawo hi kolatar, kolat job gar kamell,
ap ko diwes, kai kamell ko mursh peskro brawlepen peskre tchawende te dell, nai dell lo gar koleste budeder, kai hi kolatar, hoi kamas lo, har te wals job o phureder.

Na-a, job hunte dell ko wawares dui kope jaake bud, job hi o phureder, ninna te his lo koi romjatar, kolat kamell lo gar. Job was glanstunes boldo un leske hi o tchatchepen, te lell lo, hoi o phureder lell.
Te hi i romes i mursh tchawo, kai hi bipandlo, un krell halauter pal peskro shero un shunell gar ap peskro dadeste un peskri date, ninna te tchingrenn le ap leste un denn les dawa,
palle hunte anenn o dad un i dai les pash i phurende an ko foro ap i platsa, kai wenn le khetne.
Un penenn ap lende: “Kawa hi maro mursh tchawo. Job hi bipandlo, un krell halauter pal peskro shero, un shunell gar ap mende. Job hi i pipaskro un i chapaskro.”
Un i tsele mursha dran ko foro hunte witsrenn barra ap leste, bis te hi lo mulo. Jaake witsrenn tumer o tchilatchepen dran tumende win. Un i tsele Israelitarja hunte shunenn kolestar un darenn.
Te kras jek i tchilatcho koowa, koleske job mulo dino hunte well, un job was maredo un ap i kasht pre pandlo,

palle atchell ko mulo gar pral i rat ap ko kashteste. Na-a, job hunte well paskedo ap ko emligo diwes, te well ko them gar pale-tchiddo, hoi tumaro baro Dewel tumen dell. Pash leste hi kowa praassedo, kai hi pre-pandlo ap i kasht.
Te nashrell pes i grumni oder i bakro, hoi i wawar Israelitares hi, un tu dikeh les, palle wess leske ap i rig un aness les tiro phraleske pale.

Te djiwell lo dur tutar krik, un tu prindjreh les ninna gar, palle less ko vieches an tiro kheer pre, te atchell lo pash tute, jaake rah bis te tiro phraal wella un les rodell. Un palle de les leste pale.
Un jaake kress tu ninna, te nashras lo peskri burika, peskre koola un wawar koowa, un tu hatsal les. Tu nai tserdeh tut kote gar win.
Te dikeh tu, har peras i burika ap o drom, ninna i grumni, hoi tiro phraleske hi, palle ab late ap i rig un hade lat pale pre!
I djuwel riwell kek murshengre koola an. Un i mursh riwell kek djuwjengre koola an. Koon sau koowa krell, kowa krell hoi djungeles hi glan tumaro baro Debleskre jaka.
Te hatseh tu i tchirklengro kheer ap i ruk oder ap i phub, un i dai hi beshdo ap i tchawe oder ap i jare, palle less tu gar i dai khetne i tchawentsa.
I tchawen nai leh, te kameh. I dat mukess te djal, te djal tuke mishto un te djiwess i rah djipen.
Te kreh tu tuke i newo kheer, pale tchiwess i rikepen trul i dacha, te perell kek tele un tut hi doosh ap leskro merepen.
Ap tiro moljengro them tchiwess tu gar drake an i phub un ninna djob mashkral lende, te well gar halauter o Debleske, hoi tuke bares was, o djob un i mool.
Tu budress gar ap i hachetikri phub i mursh grumjah khetne i burikah, te rissrenn le i phub trujel.
Tu riwess gar koola an, hoi dran dui thaba kerdo hi: dran bakrengro bal khetne sido laintikre thabentsa.
Ap tiri baja siwess khetne pandle dorja ap kol star rigja.
Te romedinerell i mursh i tchat, un pal i tsiro kamell lo lat buder gar,
un job anell i djunglepen ap late pre un penell: “Kai tchat romedinerom, un har pash late dren djom, hatsom win, te his lat i wawarestar an-tapedo”,
palle djal o dad un i dai koi terni tchatar ap o foreskri platsa un lenn koi plachta pentsa, hoi sikrell, te his koi tchai kek murshestar an-tapedo. Un koi plachta sikrenn le i phurende koi.
Un o dad koi terni tchatar penell ap lende: “Me dom miri tchat kau murshes te romedinerell lo lat. Un kanna kamell lo lat buder gar,
un anell tchilatcho rakepen ap late pre un penell: ‘Me hatsom, te hi li i wawarestar an-tapedo.’ Un kate hi kai plachta, hoi sikrell, te tapras kek wawar mursh lat glan leste an.”
Un kol phureder ko forestar hunte lenn ko romes, un denn les dawa,

un penenn leske, te hunte dell lo sheel rupene beme lakro dadeste. Kowa hi leskri phagi. Job anas i tchilatcho rakepen pre ap i terni tchate an Israel. Job hunte rikrell lat, un job nai mukell lat gar an peskro tselo djipen.
Te his kowa o tchatchepen, te was koi tchai i wawarestar an-tapedo,

palle hunte well li win anlo glan o kheer lakro dadestar. Un i mursha dran ko foro witsrenn barra ap late, bis te muli hi li. Joi kras i wi-ladjedo koowa mank i Israelitarja, har lubras li trujel an peskro dadeskro kheer. Jaake tchiwenn tumer o tchilatchepen mank tumende win.

Te hatsell jek i murshes, kai hi tchiddo pash i djuwel, koja i wawareskri romni hi, palle hunte merenn kol dui: ko mursh, kai pash late tchiddo his, un koi djuwel. Jaake tchiwenn tumer o tchilatchepen dran Israel win.
Te hi i tchai, kolat kek mursh gomme an-tapras, un lat hi i pirno, un i wawar mursh hatsell lat an o foro, un tchiwell pes pash late,

palle lenn kol dujen un anenn len win glan o foro, un witsrenn barra ap lende, bis te hi le mulo: Koi tchai, kai gar gole das, ninna te his li an o foro, kai nai wals li shunlo. Un ko murshes, kai ladj ap i pirnjate i wawarestar anas. Jaake tchiwenn tumer o tchilatchepen mank tumende win.
Te hatsell ko mursh i tchat win ap o them, un koi tchat hi i pirno, un ko wawar mursh taprell lat un tchiwell pes pash late, palle hunte merell ko mursh kokres, kai pes pash late tchiwas.
Koi tchake krenn tchi! Lat hi kek doosh, kolake joi hunte merell. Kau koowa hi jaake, har te djals jek mursh ap i wawareste pre, un dals les mulo.
Job hatsas koi terni tchat win ap o them. Un koi tchai, kolat i pirno his, das gole, un kek his koi, kai ap lakri rig was.
Te hatsell i mursh i terni tchat, kolat kek pirno hi, un taprell lat, un tchiwell pes pash late, un jon wenn hatslo,

palle hunte dell ko mursh, kai pash late tchiddo his, lakro dadeste i paash--sheel rupene beme, doleske kai job ladj ap late anas. Un joi well leskri romni. Un job nai mukell lat gar peskro tselo djipen.
Kek mursh hunte lell peskro dadeskri romjat un anell jaake ladj ap peskro dadeste.
I mursh, kai jaake tchinlo un dukedo hi ap peskro mass, te hi lo buder kek mursh, sawo mursh nai well gar kote, kai o baro Debleskre menshe khetne wenna.

Kek mursh, koleskri dai gar romedini hi, nai well kote tumentsa khetne, kai o baro Debleskre menshe khetne wenna. Ninna leskre tchawe nai wenn gar kote, jaake rah har deesh familje jek pal i wawar djiwenna.
Kek Ammonari un kek Moabari well kote tumentsa khetne, kai o baro Debleskre menshe khetne wenn, jaake rah har deesh familje jek pal i wawar djiwenna. An kek tsiro nai wenn le kote.

Jon wan gar pash tumende mareha un panjeha, har hans ap drom dran o them Egiptia. Un jon plaissran lowe o mursheske Bileam, koleskro dad o Beor his, dran o foro Petor an o them Mesopotamia, te rakrell lo bibacht pral tumende win.
Tumaro baro Dewel kamas gar ap o Bileam te shunell. Job kamas tumen o djijestar. Doleske kras lo, te rakras o Bileam i bacht pral tumende win, un kek bibacht.
Ma rodenn koi pal, te djal kol menshenge mishto an i themma Moab un Ammon, un te wenn le brawelo.
I Edomarjen tchiwenn gar pale! Jon hi tumare phrala. Witar gar tchiwenn i Egiptarjen pale. An lengro them djiwan i rah tsiro.
I tchawe lengre tchawengre tchawendar, kolla nai wenn kote tumentsa khetne, kai o baro Debleskre menshe khetne wenna.
Te djan tumer win, te kurenn tumen kolentsa, kai kamenn tumen gar an pengro them, palle denn tumen jak, te krenn koi platsa gar pale-tchiddo, kai tchiwenn tumare plachtene khera pre.
Te djas i lurdeske mank tumende tchomone an i rat, un job well jaake pale-tchiddo, hunte djal lo win glan i platsa un atchell kote o tselo diwes.
Ap i rati nai thowell lo pes. Un har o kham tele djas, well lo pale nai ap tumari platsa.
Glan koi platsa, kai tumare plachtene khera tardo hi, rodenn i wawar platsa win, kai nai djan tumer ap i rig.
Un hakeno, kai djal kote, lell i kasht peha, hadell i tikni cheb win, beshell pes, un tchakrell palle kowa, hoi lestar win djas.

Tumaro baro Dewel djal tumentsa un hi mashkral tumende ap i platsa, te well lo tumenge ap i rig, un te krell lo tumen sorleder har kol wawar, kolentsa kurenn tumen. Doleske hunte well tumari platsa djudjo. Kek wi-ladjedo koowa te well mank tumende diklo, te djal lo gar peske tumendar.
I pandlo budepaskro, kai peskro rajestar krik nashas un pash tumende well, koles denn tumer gar an o wast peskro rajestar pale.
Job nai djiwell pash tumende an i foro tumendar, hoi job peske win rodell, kote kai les an peskre jaka mishto hi. Un tumer rikrenn les gar i sorjah tele.
Mank i Israelitarja hunte well kek djuwel un kek mursh, kai bikrell pes lowenge an o kheer i wawar deblestar.
Kol lowe, hoi sawe menshe lenna, hunte anell kek an o kheer tumaro baro Deblestar, te plaissrell lo kolentsa i sowel, hoi lo das. Sawe lowe hi djungeles glan o baro Debleskre jaka.
Te patsal lowe tiro phrales, less tu kek lowe budeder ap kol lowe, hoi tu les patsal, witar gar pash chapen un wawar koowa, hoi jek nai patsell. Tu less kowa pale, hoi tu les dal, un gar budeder.

Jekestar, kai hi dran i wawar them, nai leh tu budeder, har tu leske patsal, tiro phralestar less tu gar budeder. Palle nai dell tut tiro baro Dewel bacht an halauter, hoi tu an-tapreh an ko them, an koleste tumer wenn, te lenn les tumenge dren.
Te dal tu tut sowel glan tiro baro Debleste, palle ma muk tuke kek tsiro, te plaissress kowa ninna. Tiro baro Dewel dikell koi pre, te deh tu kowa leste. Te deh les gar, aneh tu doosh ap tute.
Te deh tu tut gar sowel, palle hi ninna kek doosh ap tute.
Te kamal tu tut sowel te dell glan tiro baro Debleste, hunte rikress tu ninna, hoi penal, un kress les jaake har tu win rakral.
Te weh tu an i moljakro them, hoi i wawares hi, palle nai chah tu jaake bud drake, har tu kameh, bis te tchales hal. An i piri tchiwess tu kek drake khetne.
Te weh tu ap i hachetikri phub i wawarestar, palle nai leh ko djob tiro wasteha tele. O djobeskro tchurjeha tchiness tu kek djob tele, te aness les khere.

Te lell i mursh peske i romjat, un palle hatsell lo tchomone ap late, hoi kamell lo gar, un tchinell lake i liil win, an koleste tardo hi, te mukas lo lat, un dell ko liil an lakro wast, un tradell lat dran peskro kheer win,
un joi djal dran leskro kheer un well i romni i wawar murshestar,

un ko wawar mursh kamell lat buder gar, un tchinell lake ninna i liil, an koleste tardo hi, te mukas lo lat, un dell les ninna an lakro wast, un tradell lat dran peskro kheer, palle nai lell lat gar lakro ersto rom i duito kopo. Kowa nai krell lo witar gar, te meras lakro duito rom. Lakro ersto romeske was li pale-tchiddo. Te romedinerals lo lat i duito kopo, wals kowa djungeles o baro Debleske. Tumer hunte krenn gar ko them pale-tchiddo, kowa tumaro baro Dewel tumen dell, te well lo tumenge.
I mursh, kai i tikno tsiro romedino hi, hunte djal gar an o kurepen, witar gar hunte krell lo i budi o foreske. Jek bersh nai atchell lo khere un pash peskri romjate, te wenn le bachteles.

Te patseh tu jekes tchomone un kameh lestar i kutch koowa te lell, hoi deh leske pale ap ko tsiro, kai lo kowa pale dell, hoi lo tutar patsas, palle less tu gar ko bar, koleha job jarro krell. Kau barreha lals tu kowa, hoi les djipaske hunte well.

Te well i mursh tapedo, kai i wawar Israelitares tchoras un leha krell, har te wals lo i ginlo budepaskro, oder job bikras les, palle hunte well ko tchorepaskro mulo dino. Tumer hunte tchiwenn o tchilatchepen mashkral tumende win.

Te lell jek tumendar i djungelo nasslepen ap peskro mass, hoi les pale-tchiddo krell, palle denn jak, te krenn halauter jaake, har kol rashaja dran o kheer Levi tumenge penenn. Me penom lenge, hoi te krenn. Un ap kowa hunte rikrenn tumen.
Ma bistrenn, hoi tumaro baro Dewel ap i Mirjam kras ap o drom, har tumer dran o them Egiptia win djan.
Te patseh tu jekes tchomone, palle djas tu gar an leskro kheer, te rodess tuke win, hoi kameh te rikrell, bis te job pale plaissras, hoi lo tutar patsas.
Win glan leskro wudar atchess tu. Un ko mursh, koles tu tchomone patsal, djal dren un anell tuke tchomone win, hoi job tuke koleske dell, bis te job kowa pale pale das, hoi tu leske patsal.
Te hi lo i tchorwelo mursh, pale tchiweh tu tut gar tele koleha, hoi lo tut das.
Te djal o kham tele, dess tu les kowa pale, te nai tchiwell lo pes tele an peskri plaashka, un job rakrell bacht pral tute win. Un jaake hal tu an o tchatchepen tardo glan tiro baro Debleste.
Te budrell tuke i tchorwelo Israelitari, ninna i wi-themari, kai djiwell an tiro foro un tiro them, hunte rikress gar leskro plaissepen pale, hoi jek diweske hi.

Ap ko emligo diwes dess tu les peskre lowe i budjake, hoi lo tuke budras, glan te djas o kham tele. Job hi tchorwelo, un les hunte well kol lowe djipaske. De len leste, te dell lo gar gole ap o baro Debleste pral tute, un jaake doosh ap tute well.

I dada wenn gar maredo koleske, hoi lengre tchawe kran. Un i tchawe wenn gar maredo koleske hoi lengre dada kran. Hakeno, kai kras sawo tchilatcho koowa, koleske job merell hunte, kowa well peskri doshake maredo.

Te hal tu i tchatchepaskro, hunte dess tu ninna i wi-themares peskro tchatchepen, ninna i tchawen kolengro dad meras. Un kol djuwjen, kolengro rom meras. Ma le o ripen i romjatar, kolakro rom meras, te rikress les, bis te joi peskri sijaan plaissras.
Ma bistrenn te hans pandle budepangre an o them Egiptia, un te las tumen tumaro baro Dewel dran o pandepen win. Doleske penau me tumenge, te dikenn ap i tchorwelende.

Te bistral i pandepen newo djob ap tiro hachetikri phub an ko tsiro, kai aneh tiro djob dren, palle djas tu gar pale, te aness les. Muk les kolenge, kai dran i wawar them pash tumende djiwenn, ninna kol tchawenge, kolengro dad meras, un kol djuwjenge, kolengro rom meras. Koleske dell tut tiro baro Dewel bacht an halauter, hoi tire wasta an-taprenn.

Te lal tu i drake tele tiro djeteskre rukendar, palle djas tu gar pale pash kol ruka, un rodess len tele pal wawar drake. Muk len kolenge, kai dran i wawar them pash tumende djiwenn, ninna kol tchawenge, kolengro dad meras, un kol djuwjenge, kolengro rom meras.
