Te mukenn tumer o baro Debles, un mangenn wawar deblen an, palle dikell lo buder gar latches ap tumende un sikrell tumenge o dumo, un anell bibacht pral tumende, bis te buder kek tumendar koi hi.”
Un i tsele menshe penan pale ap o Josua: “Tchatchepah, o baro Dewel hi kowa, koles kamah an-te-mangell.”
Kote penas o Josua ap i tsele menshende: “Tumer han kolla, kai dikan un shunan, har tumer penan: Mer rodam o baro Debles win, te mangas les an.” Un jon penan: “Awa, jaake hi kowa.”
Koi penas o Josua: “Jaake tchiwenn kanna kol chochene deblen krik, hoi mank tumende hi. Un rissrenn tumare djia pash o baro Debleste, kai o Israeleskro Dewel hi.”
Un i tsele menshe penan ap o Josua: “O baro Debles, kai maro Dewel hi, koles kamah an-te-mangell. Un ap kowa, hoi job penella, kamah mer te shunell.”

Jaake kras o Josua, te dan i Israelitarja o baro Debleske pengro lab, te hi job lengro Dewel. Un kote an o foro Sichem, das lo len kol tchatchepaskre laba un kol wawar laba, hoi sikrenn, hoi o Dewel lendar kamell.
Un o Josua tchinas kal tsele laba an o liil, hoi sikrell o Debleskro drom. Un job las i baro bar un tchiwas les koi tardo, tel ko baro ruk, hoi pash o baro Debleskro plachteno kheer tardo his.
Un o Josua penas ap i tsele menshende: “Dikenn kau bar! Kawa shunas hako lab, hoi o baro Dewel mentsa rakras. Kau bar hi kate tardo, te dell lo tumen trad, te mukenn gar tumaro Debles.”
Un o Josua mukas i tsele menshen khere te djal, hakenes an ko them, hoi les dino was.
Un pal kowa meras o baro Debleskro budepaskro, o Josua, koleskro dad o Nun his. O Josua was 110 (jek-sheel-deesh) bersha.
Un job was paskedo ap peskro kotar phub, hoi leske dino was, an o foro Timnat-Serach, hoi ap i berge Efrajim tchiddo hi, ap i nordetikri rig i bergatar Gaash.
Un i Israelitarja mangan o baro Debles an, jaake rah har o Josua djiwas, un jaake rah, har pal leste kol phureder djiwan, kai ko tselo koowa dikan, hoi o baro Dewel i Israelenge kras.

Un o Josefeskre kokale, hoi i Israelitarja pentsa lan dran o them Egiptia, paskran le an o foro Sichem ap ko kotar phub, hoi o Jakob ginas kol tchawendar o murshestar Hamor, koleskro dad o Sichem his. O Jakob plaissras ko kotar phub 100 (sheel) rupene kotja. Kau kotar them was o Josefeskre tchawenge dino.
Ninna o Eleasar, koleskro dad o Aron his, meras un was paskedo an o foro Gibea. Kowa his ko foro, hoi leskro tchaweske, o Pinhas, dino was ap i berge Efrajim.
Un har o Josua meras, putchan i Israelitarja o baro Debles: “Koon mendar djal glanstunes an o kurepen i menshentsa an o them Kanaan?”
Un o baro Dewel penas: “I mursha dran o kheer Juda djan pre. Me dom ko them an lengro wast.”

Koi penan i mursha dran o kheer Juda ap pengre phralende an o kheer Simeon: “Awenn mentsa pre an ko them, hoi menge well. Un mer khetne marah i Kanaanitarja koi. Un palle kamah mer tumentsa an ko them te djal, hoi tumenge well.” Un i mursha dran o kheer Simeon djan khetne i murshentsa dran o kheer Juda.
Un i mursha dran o kheer Juda djan pre, un o baro Dewel das i Kanaanitarjen un i Perisarjen an lengro wast. Un pash o foro Besek maran le 10.000 (deesh-serja) mursha.
Un jon hatsan lengro baro rajes, o Adoni-Besek an o foro Besek un kuran pen leha, un maran i Kanaanitarja un i Perisarja.
Un o Adoni-Besek nashas peske. Un jon lan les palla, un tapran les, un dan leske i pesse gushte leskre wastendar un i bare tsebe leskre pirendar tele.

Koi penas o Adoni-Besek: “Efta-deesh bare rajenge mukom i pesse gushte lengre wastendar tele te dell un ninna i bare gushte lengre pirendar. Un jon hunte chan, hoi miri chapaskri tele peras. Un jaake har me les lentsa krom, jaake das les man o Dewel pale.” Un jon anan les an o foro Jerusalem. Un kote meras lo.
Un i mursha dran o kheer Juda maran pen ko foreha Jerusalem un lan les dren. Un jon dan kolen o chareha temerl, kai kote djiwan, un chatchran o foro pre.
Pal kowa djan i mursha dran o kheer Juda tele, te kurenn le pen kolentsa an o them Kanaan, kai ap i berge djiwenn, un kote kai o kham pralstunes tardo hi, un kolentsa, kai an o telstuno them djiwenn.

Un palle kuran le pen kolentsa an o them Kanaan, kai an o foro Hebron djiwenn. – Un ko foro kharas glan ko tsiro Kirjat-Arba. – Un jon dan i familjen Sheshai un Ahiman un Talmai un his sorleder har jon.
Un jon djan dureder un kuran pen kolentsa, kai an o foro Debir djiwenn. Un ko foro kharas glan kowa Kirjat-Sefer.
Un o Kaleb penas: “Koon Kirjat-Sefer kurell un dren lell, koles dau miri tchat Achsa, te well li leskri romni.”
Kote las o Otnijel o foro dren. Koleskro dad his o Kenas, koleskro phureder phraal his o Kaleb. Un o Kaleb das les peskri tchat Achsa, te well li leskri romni.
Un har li pash o Otnijel was, rakras lo lake an o dji, te mangell li lakro dadestar jek kotar phub. Un joi stas peskri burika tele. Koi penas o Kaleb ap late: “Hoi hi tut?”

Un joi penas ap leste: “De man latchepen! I phub, hoi tu man dal, kote kai o kham pralstunes hi, hi gar sapeno. De man ninna i them, kai panjengre hi!” Un job das lat pestar kol panja, hoi kharenna pralstuno pani un telstuno pani.

Un i Kenarja, – lengro phuro dad his o Moseskri romjakro dad, – kolla djan win dran o palmtikro foro un djan khetne i murshentsa dran o kheer Juda an o mulo tato them, hoi pash o foro Arad tchiddo hi, ap i tchatchi rig. Un jon atchan kote un djiwan mashkral kol menshende.
Un i mursha dran o kheer Juda djan peskre phralentsa dran o kheer Simeon dureder un maran i Kanaanitarja an o foro Zefat, un dan lauteren mulo, un dan ko fores o lab Horma.
Un o Juda las ninna i forja Gaza, Ashkelon un Ekron dren un o them, hoi koi pashel his.
O baro Dewel his i murshentsa dran Juda. Doleske las o Juda o pralstuno them dren. Kolla, kai an o telstuno them djiwan, len his sasterne wurdja o kurepaske. Doleske nai tradan le len gar win.
Un jon dan o foro Hebron o Kaleb, jaake har o Mose kowa lenge penas. Un job tradas kotar kol triin familjen win, kolengro phuro dad o Anak his.
An o foro Jerusalem djiwan i Jebusarja. Un i mursha dran o kheer Benjamin tradan len gar win. Jaake atchan i Jebusarja pash i Benjaminarja an o foro Jerusalem, un djiwenn gomme kau diwes koi khetne.
Ninna i mursha dran o kheer Josef djan pre pash o foro Betel, un o baro Dewel his lentsa.
Un jon bitchran tchorchanes murshen an o foro dren, te dikenn le pen dren trujel. Ko foro kharas glan ko tsiro Lus.
Un kolla dikan i murshes dran o foro win te well, un penan ap leste: “Sike men, har nai wah mer an o foro dren, palle krah mer tuke tchi.”
Kote sikras job len, har nai wenn le an o foro dren. Un jon maran o tselo foro o chareha. Ko murshes un leskre menshen mukan le te djal.
Un ko mursh djas an o them, kai i Hetarja djiwenn. Un kote kras job i foro, un das ko fores o lab Lus. Un jaake kharell ko foro gomme kau diwes.

I mursha dran o kheer Manasse tradan gar i menshen krik dran i forja Bet-Shean, Taanach, Dor, Jibleam un Megiddo, witar gar dran i gaba pash kol forja. Jaake atchan i Kanaanitarja an ko them un djiwan kote.
Un har i Israelitarja soreles wan, kran le, te wan i Kanaanitarja lengre budepangre, kai lenge phares hunte budran, – win tradan le len gar.
Ninna i mursha dran o kheer Efrajim tradan i Kanaanitarjen gar krik, kai djiwenn an o foro Geser. Un jaake atchan i Kanaanitarja un djiwan mashkral lende an o foro Geser.

Ninna i mursha dran o kheer Sebulon tradan gar kol menshen krik, kai an i forja Kitron un Nahalal djiwenn. Un jaake atchan i Kanaanitarja kote un djiwan mashkral lende. Un jon kran lendar budepangre, hoi lenge phares hunte budran.
I mursha dran o kheer Asser tradan i menshen gar krik, kai djiwenn an kol forja Akko, un Sidon, un Ahaleb, un Achsib un Helba un Afek un Rehob.
Doleske djiwan i menshe dran o kheer Asser mashkral i Kanaanitarja, kai kote khere his. Wi tradan le len gar.

I menshe dran o kheer Naftali tradan kol menshen gar krik, kai an i forja Bet-Shemesh un Bet-Anat djiwenn. Na-a, jon djiwan mashkral kol Kanaanitarja, kai kote khere his. Un kolla wan lengre budepangre un hunte budran lenge phares.
Un i Amorarja tradan i menshen dran o kheer Dan pale an i berge, un mukan len gar tele te well an o telstuno them.

Un i Amorarja atchan ap i berge, hoi kharenna Heres, un mukan pen gar krik te tradell, un atchan jaake an i forja Ajalon un Shaalbim. Pal i tsiro was o kheer Josef sorleder har jon. Un jon wan lengre budepangre, un hunte budran lenge phares.
O them, kai i Amorarja djiwan, djas pral i berga Akrabbim bis pash ko foro Sela, un kotar dureder pral.

Un o baro Debleskro bolepaskro was dran o foro Gilgal pre ap koi platsa, hoi kharella Bochim, un penas: “Me lom tumen dran o them Egiptia win, un anom tumen an kau them, jaake har man sowel dom glan tumare phure dadende, te dau les tumende. Un me penom, te rikrap hako tsireske miro lab, hoi tumende dom.

Un tumendar kamom, te wenn kek mala kol menshenge, kai an kau them djiwenn, un te phagenn tumer lengre pre-tchidde barra tele, kai chatchrenn le viechen lengro debleste. Un hoi kran tumer? Tumer shunan gar ap kowa, hoi penom!
Koi penom me: Me tradau len gar glan tumende win. Un jon wenn tumenge har shelle, kai taprell jek viechen dren. Un ap ko diwes, kai mangenn tumer lengre deblen an, taprenn tumer dren.”
Un har o baro Debleskro bolepaskro kowa lauter ap i Israelitarja penas, koi rowan le soreles.
Un jon penan ap koi platsa ‘Bochim’. Un jon anan kote o baro Debleske viechen, te chatchrenn le len leske.
Un o Josua penas ap i menshenge, te nai djan le penge. Un i Israelitarja djan penge, hakeno an ko kotar them, hoi les dino was, te lell lo ko them dren.
Un jon mangan o baro Debles an, jaake rah har o Josua djiwas, un jaake rah, har pal leste kol phureder djiwan, kai ko tselo baro koowa dikan, hoi o baro Dewel i Israelenge kras.
Un har lo 110 (sheel-te-deesh) bersha phuro his, meras o Josua, koleskro dad o Nun his. O Josua his o baro Debleskro budepaskro.
Un jon paskran les an ko kotar them, hoi les dino was: an o foro Timnat-Heres an o pralstuno them Efrajim pash i berga Gaash, ap i serwi rig.
Palle meran ninna kol tsele wawar menshe, kai an kau tsiro djiwan, har o Josua djiwas. Un pal lende wan menshe, kai o baro Debles gar prindjran, witar gar kowa, hoi job i Israelenge kras.
Un koi kran i Israelitarja kowa, hoi tchilatches hi glan o baro Debleskre jaka. Un jon mangan ko debles an, hoi kharas Baal,

un mukan o baro Debles, kai o Dewel lengre phure dadendar hi, un len win anas dran o them Egiptia. Un jon nashan wawar deblenge palla, – kol deblenge, kolen i menshe an-mangan, kai trul lende djiwan. Un jon peran glan lende tele, un jaake kran le, te well o baro Dewel chojedo.
Un jon mukan o baro Debles un mangan o debles Baal an un ninna i debletsa Astarte.

Kote tapras o baro Debles i bari choli pral i Israelitarja. Un job das len an o wast kolendar, kai len wi-tchorenn. Un ninna mukas lo len an i wasta kol menshendar te perell, kai trul lende djiwenn un lenge o djipen phares kran. Jaake his i Israelitarja buder gar soreles doha, te denn le kolen pale, kai ap lende djan.
Un kai le ninna djan, te kurenn le pen, his o baro Dewel gar lentsa un das len kek bacht. Jaake was kowa, hoi o baro Dewel lenge penas un leskro wast pre das. Un jon wan an phare tsirja.
Un pale te pale mukas o baro Dewel tchatchepangre murshen pre te stell. Kolla lan len win dran o wast kolendar, hoi lendar tchoran.

Un ninna ap pengre tchatchepangre murshende shunan le gar. Na-a, jon witsran pen glan wawar deblende tele un mangan len an. Sik djan le tele ko dromestar, hoi lengre phure djan, kai shunan ap i laba o baro Deblestar. Kowa kran jon gar.

Un te mukas o baro Dewel lenge tchatchepangre murshen pre te stell, palle his job ko tchatchepaskro mursheha, un las len win dran i tchilatche wasta. Les khaitas lengro ropen pral kolende, kai lenge o djipen phares kran. Jaake rah har ko tchatchepaskro rai djiwas, shunan le ap o baro Debleste.

Pal leskro merepen peran le pale o tchatcho dromestar tele, un kran les gomme djungleder har pengre phure kowa kran, un nashan wawar deblenge palla, un witsran pen glan lende tele, un mangan len an. Un mukan pen kekestar ko tchilatcho dromestar tele te anell. Pal pengre shere djan le pengro drom.
Kote chatchras i choli o baro Deblestar pral o Israel pre. Un job penas: “Kal tchilatche menshe rikran pen gar ap mire laba, hoi me lengre phurende dom, un shunan gar ap mande.
Doleske tradau me ninna kanna buder gar kol wawar menshen dran kau them win, kai pral atchan, har o Josua meras.
Jaake nai hatsau win: Atchenn i Israelitarja ap miro drom, ninna te djiwenn le mank wawar menshende? Djan le mange jaake palla, har lengre phure kowa kran? Oder krenn le kowa gar?”
Un doleske mukas o baro Dewel i wawar menshen an o them te atchell, kolen job gar an o wast o Josuestar das, un tradas len gar sik win.

Un kalla hi kol menshe, hoi o baro Dewel an o them mukas, te dikell lo, te shunenn i Israelitarja ap leste. Ninna kamas lo lende te sikrell, har jek pes hunte kurell. Kowa kamas lo lauter kolen te sikrell, kai djinan tchi o kurepastar, hoi djas trul o them Kanaan. Un kal menshe atchan an o them:
I pantch raja pral i Filistarja, i tsele Kanaanitarja un i Sidonarja un i Hiwarja, kai ap i berge Libanon djiwan mank i berga Baal-Hermon un Lebo-Hamat.
Un kolla atchan koi, te dikell o baro Dewel, har rikrenn pen i Israelitarja ap leskre laba, hoi o Mose lengre phurenge penas.
Un jaake djiwan i Israelitarja mashkral i Kanaanitarja, i Hetarja, i Amorarja, i Perisarja, i Hiwarja un i Jebusarja.
Un i Israelitarja lan penge lengre tchen un romedineran len. Un jon dan pengre tchen lengre tchawende, un mangan lengre deblen an.
Un i Israelitarja kran, hoi tchilatches his glan i jaka o baro Deblestar, un bistran, kai o baro Dewel pengro Dewel hi. Un jon mangan o debles Baal un i debletsa Ashera an.

Kote chatchras i choli o baro Deblestar pral o Israel pre. Un job das len an o wast o baro rajestar Kushan-Rishatajim. Kowa his baro rai pral o them Mesopotamia. Un i Israelitarja hunte budran leske ochta bersha.

Koi dan le ap o baro Debleste gole, te lell job len dran koleskre wasta win. Un o baro Dewel mukas i murshes pre te stell, kai lenge ap i rig was. Kowa his o Otnijel, koleskro dad o Kenas his. Koleskro phureder phraal his o Kaleb.

Un o baro Debleskro ducho was pral leste, un job was o tchatchepaskro rai pral i Israelitarja. Un job djas win an o kurepen. Un o baro Dewel das o baro rajes pral o them Mesopotamia an leskro wast. Koleskro lab his Kushan-Rishatajim. Un o Otnijel was sorleder har job.
Un ko themeske Israel djas 40 (star-deesh) bersha latches un kek kurepen his an ko tsiro. Un palle meras o Otnijel, koleskro dad o Kenas his.
Un i Israelitarja kran pale kowa, hoi tchilatches his an i jaka o baro Deblestar. Doleske kras o baro Dewel o baro rajes pral o them Moab sorelo, te djal job ap o Israel. Ko baro rai kharas Eglon.
Un job anas i Ammonarja un i Amalekarja pal peste, djas lentsa koi, un das o Israel un las o palmtikro foro dren.
Un i Israelitarja hunte budran o baro rajeske pral o them Moab 18 (deesh-te-ochta) bersha.

Koi dan le ap o baro Debleste gole, te lell job len dran koleskre wasta win. Un o baro Dewel mukas i murshes pre te stell, kai lenge ap i rig was. Un kowa his o Ehud, leskro dad his o Gera, i Benjaminari. O Ehud his i mursh, kai i serwo wasteskro hi. Un i Israelitarja bitchran les, te anell job lengre lowe o baro rajeske pral o them Moab, kol lowe, hoi jon hunte leske dan.
Un o Ehud kras peske i tikno charo, i paash metari lengsto, hoi hake dui rigjendar tchinas. Un ko charo pandas lo tel peskre koola, ap leskri tchatchi rig.
Un job anas o baro rajeske pral o them Moab kol lowe, hoi jon hunte leske dan. Un o baro rai Eglon his i pesso thullo mursh.
Un har o Ehud les kol lowe das, bitchras lo kolen khere, kai kol lowe hidjran.

Job kokres rissras pes trujel, har his lo pash kol barrengre deblende, hoi pash o foro Gilgal tardo his. Un djas pale pash ko baro rajeste un penas leske: “Man hi tuke tchomone te penell, hoi kek wawar hunte shunell har tu, miro rai.” Un ko baro rai penas leske: “Atch kanna!” Ap kolende, hoi trul leste his, penas lo: “Djan win!”

Un o Ehud was pash leste dren, har o baro rai pral an i isema beshdo his, kai gar jaake tato his, un hoi leske kokres his. Un o Ehud penas: “Ko lab, hoi man tuke hi, hi o Deblestar.” Koi stas o baro rai dran peskri beshepaskri pre.
Un o Ehud las peskro serwo wasteha peskro charo, hoi ap peskri tchatchi rig his, un das les o baro rajeske an o per tchurje.

Un ko charo djas an koleskro per jaake dur dren, te djas ninna ko kotar an leste dren, kai was o charo an-tapedo. Un leskro thulepen tchiwas pes trul o tselo charo. Un o Ehud mukas o charo an leskro per.
Un job kras o wudar an koi pralstuni isema pandlo un rissras o klido trujel, un djas dran o palstuno wudar win.
Un har job win his, wan o baro rajeskre budepangre un dikan, te hi i pralstuni isema pandlo. Kote penan le jek ap o wawareste: “Job nai djas ap i rig.”
Un har jon i rah tsiro kote tardo his un o wudar gar pre kerdo was, lan le o klido, un pandan pre. Un kote hatsan le pengro rajes mules ap i phub tchiddo.
An ko tsiro har his i budepangre glan o wudar tardo, nashas o Ehud peske, un mukas kol barrengre deblen pash o foro Gilgal pal peste, un nashas dureder un was an o foro Seira.
Un har lo kote was an o pralstuno them Efrajim, phurdas lo an i phurdepaskri, te kharell lo i Israelitarjen khetne o kurepaske. Un jon djan leha i berga tele. Un job djas glan lende,

un das gole: “Sik, awenn mange palla! O baro Dewel das i Moabarja, kai tumen tele rikrenn, an tumaro wast.” Un koi nashan le tele, leske palla pash o pani Jordan, un dan garda ap kol platse, kai i menshe ap i wawar rig djan, un mukan kekes wergel.
Un jon dan an ko tsiro jaake 10.000 (deesh-serja) Moabarjen mulo. Kolla his lauter sorele mursha un tchatche kurepangre. Kek lendar nai nashas peske.
Un jaake his i Israelitarja ap kau diwes sorleder har i Moabarja. Un 80 (ochta-deesh) bersha his kek kurepen an o them.

Un pal leste was o Shamgar o tchatchepaskro mursh. Koleskro dad his o Anat. Un o Shamgar das 600 (shob-sheel) Filistarjen mulo sawo kashteha, koleha jek i grumjen tradell. Un ninna job las i Israelitarjen win dran o wast kolendar, kai lenge o djipen phares kran.
Un har o Ehud mulo his, kran i Israelitarja pale, hoi tchilatcho his glan i jaka o baro Deblestar.

Un o baro Dewel das len an o wast o baro rajestar Jabin. Kowa his o baro rai pral o them Kanaan un djiwas an o foro Hazor. Un leskro pralstuno lurdo kharas Sisera. Un kowa djiwas an o foro Haroshet-Gojim.
O baro rajes Jabin his 900 (enja-sheel) sasterne wurdja o kurepaske. Un job kras i Israelenge i pharo djipen biish bersha. Doleske dan le bari gole ap o baro Debleste.
An ko tsiro his i tchatchepaskri djuwel an o them Israel. Koja his i Debleskri rakepaskretsa. Lakro lab his Debora. Lakro rom his o Lappidot.

Un joi his beshdo tel ko palmtikro ruk, hoi kharella ‘palma i Deboratar’. Un koi palma his ap o drom mashkral o foro Rama un o foro Betel an o pralstuno them Efrajim. Un i Israelitarja wan pash late, te krell li o tchatchepen pral lende win.

Was i diwes, kai mukas li i murshes dran o kheer Naftali pash peste te kharell. Leskro lab his Barak. Koleskro dad his o Abinoam dran o foro Kedesh. Un joi penas ap leste: “O baro Dewel, kai o Dewel pral o Israel hi, job penell tuke: ‘Le tuke deesh-serja mursha dran i khera Naftali un Sebulon un dja lentsa ap i berga Tabor!

Un me bitchrau o Sisera, ko pralstuno lurdes pral o Jabineskre lurdende, pash tute win peskre wurdjentsa un peskre tsele lurdentsa pash ko tikno pani, hoi kharella Kishon. Un kote dau les an tiro wast.’”
Kote penas o Barak ap late: “Te djah tu mantsa, palle djau. Tu te weh gar mantsa, palle djau me ninna gar.”
“Mishto”, penas li. “Me djau tuha. Ko jek djin, palle sharenn le gar tut an kau kurepen. O baro Dewel dell o Sisera an o wast i djuwjatar.” Un i Debora stas pre, un djas leha an o foro Kedesh.
Un o Barak das i murshen gole dran i khera Sebulon un Naftali, te wenn le an o foro Kedesh khetne. Un 10.000 (deesh-serja) mursha djan leske palla. Un ninna i Debora djas leha.

Ap i platsa, hoi kharell Zaanannim pash o foro Kedesh djiwas o Kenari Heber an i plachteno kheer tel i baro ruk. Glan i tsiro mukas job peskre menshen. Kolla his tchawe un tchawengre tchawe o Moseskri romjakro dadestar, o Hobab.
Koi was ap o Sisera penlo, te djas o Barak, koleskro dad o Abinoam hi, ap i berga Tabor pre.

Kote mukas o Sisera peskre tsele wurdja khetne gole te dell, 900 (enja-sheel) sasterne wurdja o kurepaske, un peskre tsele lurden, hoi pash leste hi, un djas lentsa dran o foro Haroshet-Gojim pash ko tikno pani, hoi kharella Kishon.

Un i Debora penas ap o Barak: “Dja! Kawa hi ko diwes, kai o baro Dewel o Siseres an tiro wast das. O baro Dewel djas win glan tute.” Un o Barak djas koi berga Tabor tele, un deesh-serja mursha leske palla.
Un har djan le pengre charentsa ap o Sisera un ap leskre tsele wurdja un lurdende pre, kote kras o baro Dewel, te trashenn kolla jaake, te stas o Sisera peskro wurdin tele, un nashas peske.
Un o Barak peskre murshentsa las kol wurdja un kol lurden palla bis pash o foro Haroshet-Gojim un das len lauteren mulo o chareha. Kek lendar atchas pral.

O Sisera nashas pash o plachteno kheer, kai djiwas i Jael. Kolakro rom his o Kenari Heber. Mashkral o baro rajeste pral o foro Hazor, o Jabin, un o Kenari Heber his kek kurepen. Jon his penge latches.
Kote djas i Jael win pash o Sisera, un penas ap leste: “Ab pash mande dren, miro rai, un ma dare gar!” Jaake djas lo dren an lakro plachteno kheer. Un joi tchakras i plachta pral leste.
Un job penas ap late: “De man i tcharo pani te pijell! Man hi trush!” Kote kras li i ledertikri tushni pre, kai thud dren hi, un das les te pijell. Un tchakras pale i plachta pral leste.
Un job penas ap late: “Atch tardo pash o wudar glan o plachteno kheer! Un te well jek, un putchella: ‘Hi jek kai?’ Palle pen: Na-a!”

O Sisera his khino un sowas sik dren. Un i Jael, o Hebereskri romni, las i sasterno depaskro un i tikno saster, koleha o plachteno kheer an i phub pandlo well, un djas tchorchanes pale pale pash leste dren un das leske ko tikno saster an leskro shero jaake dur, te djas lo ap i wawar rig pale win, un an i phub dren. Jaake meras o Sisera kote.

Un har o Barak o Siseres palla las, djas i Jael win pash leste, un penas: “Ab mantsa, un me kamau tuke ko murshes te sikrell, koles tu rodeh!” Un job djas pash late dren, un dikas o Siseres mules koi tchiddo. O saster his an leskro shero.
Jaake anas o Dewel ap ko diwes bari ladj ap o Jabineste, ko baro rajeste pral o them Kanaan glan i Israelitarja.
Un i Israelitarja wan sorleder un sorleder ap o Jabineste, ko baro rajeste pral o them Kanaan, bis te leskri sorjatar tchi buder koi his.
Ap ko tsiro giwas i Debora kai gili khetne o Barakeha, koleskro dad o Abinoam his.
Sharas o baro Debles! Tchatche mursha anan o Israel an o kurepen. Pendar win djan i kurepangre lentsa.
Shunenn, tumer bare raja! Denn jak, tumer pralstune, me giwau un bashrau o baro Debleske, – o Debleske pral o Israel.
Baro Dewel, har tu tele wal dran o them Seir, har tu wal dran o them Edom, kote trissas i phub, un brishin was dran o bolepen, bud pani ap i phub.
I berge trissan glan o baro Debleste, kai sikras pes ap i berga Sinai glan peskre menshende Israel. Lengro Dewel hi lo, – job, o baro Dewel.

An ko tsiro, har o Shamgar djiwas, koleskro dad o Anat hi, ninna an ko tsiro, har i Jael djiwas, his kek mensho ap i dromma, un kolla, kai ap kol bare dromma win djans, hunte djans tchorchanes, ap tikne khatemen dromma.
Kek gole was shunlo an i gaba an o Israel. Palle stas i Debora pre, i dai an o Israel.
Mire menshe rodan penge wawar debla! Kote was o kurepen glan lengre wudja. Un pash 40.000 (star-deesh-serja) mursha an Israel was kek charo hatslo, witar kek shilto.
Miro dji hi i pralstunenge an Israel, un i lurdentsa, kai pendar win djan an o kurepen. Kolenge parkrenn tumen pash o baro Debleste!
Tumer, kai ap i parne burike klissenna, un tumer, kai ap i stakepangre beshenna, un tumer, kai ap o drom djan: Giwenn!

Shunenn, har bashrenn le pash o pani, kote kai denn le pengre viechen te pijell. Kote sharenn le ko baro koowa, hoi o baro Dewel kras, awa, o baro koowa, hoi kras lo ap peskre menshende Israel, har djan le dran lengre forja.
Dja glan! Dja glan, Debora! Dja glan, gib i gili! Dja glan, Barak, tu o Abinoameskro tchawo! Un le stildo kolen, hoi tu tapral!
Kol tchatche mursha, hoi pral atchan, djan tele pash pengre pralstunende. O baro Debleskre menshe djan mantsa khetne an o kurepen, te kurenn le pen leske.
Dran o Efrajim wan kolla, kai dran o them Amalek wan. Pal lende was o Benjamin peskre lurdentsa, dran o Machir wan i pralstune, un dran o Sebulon i bare lurde.
Un i raja dran o Issachar djan khetne i Debora an o kurepen. Jaake har o Issachar kras ninna o Barak un nashas pal leste i berga tele. An o them Ruben his le beshdo pash o pani un rakran bud un rah.
Hoske atchal tu pash tire bakre? Kamal tu i bashepen te shunell, hoi i bakrengre kran? Awa, pash o Ruben rakran le bud un rah.
Un i mursha dran o Gilead atchan ap i wawar rig o panjestar Jordan. Un o Dan? Hoi krell job? Pash peskre shiffe atchell job. Pash o baro pani djiwell o Asser. Un kote atchas lo ninna beshdo.
Dikenn ap kolende dran o Sebulon un dran o Naftali: Kolla hi mursha, kai daran gar, te denn le pengro djipen an o merepen, un djan kek darjah an o kurepen.
Kote wan le, kol bare raja pral o them Kanaan! Jon wan un maran pen mentsa. Awa, an o foro Taanach pash o pani Megiddo maran le pen mentsa. Rup hidjras kek lendar khere.
Ninna i bolepangre momlia djan an o kurepen. Ap lengre dromma djan le ap o Sisera pre.
Un ko phuro tikno pani, ko pani Kishon, tserdas leskre lurden krik. Dureder, dureder! Te was soreles an o kurepen!
Kote nashan i graja sikeder. Klak-klak, klak-klak, shunenn koi bari gole, hoi lengre pire kran!

Praassenn o foro Meros, penas o baro Debleskro bolepaskro. Praassenn kolen, hoi an ko foro djiwenn! Awa, praassenn len! Jon wan gar ap o baro Debleskri rig, un djan gar an o kurepen khetne kol tchatche murshentsa.
O Debleskri bacht well pral i Jael, kolakro rom o Heber hi, ko Kenari! O Dewel dell lat budeder bacht har i tsele wawar djuwjen, kai djiwenn an i plachtene khera!
O Sisera, pani mangas lo, un thud das li les, an i kutch tcharo das li les smentana te pijell.
Lakro wast tapras i saster, un lakro tchatcho wast i sasterno depaskro, kolentsa das li leskro shero paash. An leskro shero djas ko saster dren un was pale win.
Mashkral lakre herja phagas lo khetne, peras lo tele, un koi his lo tchiddo. Khetne phagas lo, tele peras lo, mulo hi lo.
Un leskri dai dikas dran i wali, dikas darenes mashkral kol kashta win. Kai atchell leskro wurdin? Hoske well lo gar? Hoske shunau i graja gar?
Un lakre gosweder djuwja penan lake kawa. Un joi penas les lenge palla:
Tchatchepah hatsan le bud, hoi jon peha lenn, shukar brawlepen hakeneske: Jek rakli, dui raklia hako mursheske, un kutch shukar ripja o Sisereske, ninna menjakre dikle, kai shukar koowa dren sido hi.

Maro baro Dewel, jaake hunte merenn lauter, hoi tut gar kamenna. Kolla, kai kamenn tut o tselo djijestar, jon te wenna railo har o kham, har djal lo pre an peskri soor! Un pal kowa his an o them 40 (star-deesh) bersha kek kurepen.
Un i Israelitarja kran, hoi tchilatches hi glan o baro Debleskre jaka. Doleske das o baro Dewel len efta bersha an o wast kol menshendar, kai kharenna Midianarja.
Un kolengro wast was jaake soreles pral o Israel, te khatran pen i Israelitarja an i berge un djiwan an i grotte mank i bare barra un an sorele khera, hoi kran pen le an i berge.
Un hako kopo, kai witsran i Israelitarja o djob an i phub, palle wan i Midianarja un i Amalekarja un wawar menshe kotar, kai o kham pre djala, un peran an o them dren.

Jon anan pengre viechen un plachtene khera peha un his jaake bud har i stepangre. Kek djinas, har bud jon un lengre khamele hi, jaake bud his le. Un jon beshan pen ap o Israeleskro them un chan lauter pre, hoi kote bares was. An o tselo them bis pash o foro Gaza atchas kek chapen pral, witar kek bakre, grumja un burike. Jaake kran le o them paash.
Un jaake anan i Midianarja o Israel an o tchorwlepen. Un i Israelitarja dan gole ap o baro Debleste, un mangan les, te well lo ap lengri rig.
Un har i Israelitarja lestar mangan, te lell lo len win dran o Midianeskro wast,

kote bitchras o baro Dewel i Debleskro rakepaskro pash lende. Un kowa penas lenge: “Kawa penell o baro Dewel, o Dewel pral o Israel: ‘Me anom tumen dran o them Egiptia win, kai tumer pandle budepangre hans,
un lom tumen win dran i wasta i menshendar an o them Egiptia un lauterendar, hoi tumenge o djipen phares kran, un tradom len glan tumende win, un dom tumen lengro them.
Un me penom tumenge: Me, o baro Dewel, hom tumaro Dewel. Ma mangenn kol deblen an, hoi i Amorarja an-mangenn, an kolengro them tumer djiwenn. Un tumer shunan gar ap mande.’”

Un ko baro Debleskro bolepaskro was, un beshas pes tel ko baro ruk, hoi pash i platsa his, hoi kharella Ofra. Koi platsa his o Joashes dran i familja Abijeser. Un leskro tchawo Gideon his an ko kashteskro, hoi kerdo his, te krenn le mool dran i drake. Un kote das lo khatemen o djob win, te nai taprenn i Midianarja gar ko djob ninna.
Kote sikras pes ko baro Debleskro bolepaskro leske, un penas ap leste: “O baro Dewel hi tuha, tu tchatcho mursh un kurepaskro!”

Un o Gideon putchas lestar: “Mangau tut, miro rai! Te hi o baro Dewel mentsa, hoske was kai tseli bibacht ap mende? Un kai hi ko tselo baro koowa, hoi o baro Dewel kras, kolestar menge mare phure rakran un penan: ‘O baro Dewel anas men dran o them Egiptia.’ Kanna mukas men o baro Dewel un das men an o wast kolendar dran o them Midian.”
Kote rissras pes o baro Dewel pash leste, un penas: “Dja koi an tiri soor! Un le o Israel dran o Midianeskro wast win! Me bitchrau tut.”
Job penas ap leste: “Mangau tut miro rai: Har lap me nai o Israel dran o Midianeskro wast win? Miri familja hi i tikneder an o tselo kheer Manasse. Un me hom o tikneder an miro dadeskro kheer.”
Kote penas o baro Dewel ap leste: “Me djau tuha, un tu mareh i Midianarja, har te wans le jek mursh.”
Kote penas lo: “Te hal tu mange latcho, palle de man tchomone, hoi man sikrell, te hal tu tchatchepah o baro Dewel, kai mantsa rakrell.
Ma dja tuke gar katar, bis te me pale pash tute wau, un tuke chapen anom un glan tute tchiwom.” Un job penas: “Me kamau kai atchell bis te tu weh.”

Kote djas o Gideon koi, un las i terni busni, un maras lat, un kras o chapaske. Palle las lo i baro gono jarro un kras lestar mare, an kolende kek shutlo jarro his. Un o mass tchiwas lo an i kashteno tcharo. Un i summi, an kolate o mass keras, tchiwas lo an i piri. Un jaake anas lo les win pash leste tel ko baro ruk, un tchiwas les leske glan.
Un ko Debleskro bolepaskro penas ap leste: “Le ko mass un kol mare un tchip len ap ko baro bar kote. Un tchore koi summi pral kowa!” Un job kras jaake.

Palle hadas ko bolepaskro peskro kasht, hoi an leskro wast his, un tapras ko mass un kol mare an. Kote was jag dran ko baro bar win, un chatchras ko mass un ko maro pre. Un ap jek kopo his o baro Debleskro bolepaskro buder gar koi.
Har o Gideon dikas, te his kowa o baro Debleskro bolepaskro, penas lo: “Rai, baro Dewel, kanna hunte merap. Tchatchepah dikom o baro Debleskro bolepaskres an i jaka.”
Kote penas o baro Dewel ap leste: “Mank mende hi lauter mishto. Ma dare, tu hunte meress gar.”

Un o Gideon tchiwas kote barra pre, te krell lo i chatchepaskri, kai wenn vieche chatchedo o baro Debleske, un das lat o lab Jahwe-Shalom. Gomme kau diwes hi koi chatchepaskri kote tardo an o foro Ofra, kai kol menshe djiwenn, kai kharenna Abijesarja.

Un an koi rat rakras o baro Dewel ap o Gideon: “Le i terno gurum tiro dadeskre viechendar, un le ninna i gurum, hoi efta bersha phuro hi! Un de koi chatchepaskri tele, hoi ap tiro dadeskro them tardo hi, kai chatchrenn le viechen lengro debleske Baal. Un de koi kashteni debletsa Ashera tele, hoi koi pashel tardo hi!

Un kre i chatchepaskri o baro Debleske, kai tiro Dewel hi, kate pral ap kai berga, kai tumaro sorelo kheer tardo hi! Un le ko duito gurum un mare les mange un chatche les mange kote! Kre koi jag ko kashteha, hoi i debletsa Ashera his, hoi tu trujel dal!”

Kote las o Gideon deesh murshen peskre budepangrendar, un kras kowa jaake, har o baro Dewel leske penas. Un har daras lo i menshendar an peskro dadeskro kheer un an o foro, kras lo kowa an i rat un gar ap o diwes.

Un har i mursha an o foro taissarlakro pre stan, his koi chatchepaskri lengro deblestar Baal paash dino, un i Ashera hoi koi pashel tardo his, his trujel dino. Un ko duito gurum his chatchedo ap koi newi chatchepaskri.
Un jek penas ap o wawareste: “Koon kras kawa?” Un jon rodan un putchan. Un lenge was penlo: “O Gideon, koleskro dad o Joash hi, kras kawa.”
Kote penan i mursha dran o foro ap o Joash: “De tiro tchawes win! Job hunte merell! Job das koi chatchepaskri o deblestar Baal paash, un das i Ashera, hoi pashel tardo his, trujel!”

O Joash penas ap lauterende, kai kote tardo his: “Kamenn tumen o debleske Baal te kurell? Kamenn tumer ap leskri rig te well? Koon pes leske kurell, kowa merell gomme an kai rat. Te hi lo i dewel, palle krell lo peske peskro tchatchepen win. Koja his leskri chatchepaskri, hoi was paash dino.”
Ap ko diwes dan le o Gideones o lab Jerub-Baal. Kowa kharella: “Te kurell pes o Baal leha!” O Gideon das leskri chatchepaskri paash.
Un i tsele Midianarja un i tsele Amalekarja un kolla, kai wan kotar, kai o kham pre djala, wan khetne un djan wergel o pani Jordan un tchiwan pengre plachtene khera pre an o telstuno them Jesreel.
Kote was o baro Debleskro ducho pral o Gideon. Un job phurdas an i phurdepaskri, te dell lo i Abijesarja khetne gole, te wenn le leske palla an o kurepen.
Un job bitchras murshen an o tselo them Manasse, un mukas lenge te penell, te wenn le leske palla. Ninna bitchras lo murshen an o them Asser un Sebulon un Naftali. Un kolla lauter wan pash leste.
Un o Gideon penas ap o Debleste: “Tu te rodal man win, te lap o Israel win dran i tchilatche wasta, jaake har tu mange penal, palle sike les mande!

Dik, me tchiwau kal bakrengre balla, hoi tele tchinlo wan, ap ko djobeskri platsa. Te wenn taissarlakro kal balla kokres sapeno, un gar koi phub, hoi trujel hi, palle dikau, te kameh mantsa o Israel win te lell, jaake har tu ap mande penal.”
Un jaake was kowa. Sik o wawar diwes stas o Gideon pre un las o bakrengro bal mank peskre wasta. Un ko pani, hoi win was, his jek tcharo pherdo.

Un o Gideon penas ap o Debleste: “Ma muk tiri choli ap mande chatchrell, te mangau tut gomme jek kopo: Kamau les i duito kopo i bakrengre ballentsa te krell. Kau kopo muk kek pani ap o bakrengro bal te well, kokres i tseli phub trujel te well sapenes.”
Un o Dewel kras an koi rat jaake, te was kek pani ap o bakrengro bal, un i tseli phub trujel his sapeno.

Un sik taissarlakro djas o Gideon, kai kharell ninna Jerub-Baal, peskre tsele lurdentsa, hoi pash leste hi, pash o pani, hoi kharella Harod. Un kote tchiwan le pengre plachtene khera pre. Jaake his i lurde dran o them Midian serwes lendar pash koi tikni berga More an o telstuno them.
Un o baro Dewel penas ap o Gideon: “Tut hi bud lurde, hoi pash tute hi. Jaake nai dau i Midianarja gar an tumare wasta. O Israel nai sharals pes un nai penals: ‘Mare wasta his, hoi men win lan!’

Un kanna de gole glan i kanda i tsele lurdendar: ‘Kones daar hi, kowa djal i berga Gilead tele un djal khere!’” Kowa kras o Gideon. Un 22.000 (biish-te-dui-serja) mursha djan khere. Un 10.000 (deesh-serja) mursha atchan pash o Gideon.

Un o baro Dewel penas ap o Gideon: “Kol lurde hi gomme bud. An len pash o pani tele! Me kamau kote win rodell, koon tuha djal. Un kolen, hoi me tut sikrau, kolla djan tuha! Un hakenes, hoi tuke penau, te djal lo gar tuha, kowa djal gar tuha!”

Kote anas o Gideon i lurden tele pash o pani. Un o baro Dewel penas ap o Gideon: “Hakeno, kai pijell o pani peskri tchipjah har i djuklo, koles tchip ap jek rig! Un kolen, kai ap pengre tchanga djan, te pijenn le, tchip ap i wawar rig!”
Un kolla, kai pijan pengri tchipjah har i djuklo, his 300 (triin-sheel) mursha. Un kol wawar djan tele ap pengre tchanga un anan o pani pengre wastentsa pash o mui.

Un o baro Dewel penas ap o Gideon: “Kol triin-shelentsa, kai o pani pengre tchipjentsa pijan, kamau me i Midianarja an tiro wast te dell, un o Israel dran lengre wasta win te lell. Kol wawar lurden muk khere te djal!”

Un jon lan kolendar, kai khere djan, lengro chapen un pipen un lengre phurdepangre pash pende. Un jaake bitchras o Gideon i tsele lurden pale pale pash pengre plachtene khera. Kokres kol triin-sheel rikras lo pash peste. Un kol tsele lurde dran o them Midian his tella glan leste an o telstuno them.
Un an koi rat penas o baro Dewel ap o Gideon: “Ste pre, un dja tele kote, kai i Midianarja tchiddo hi! Me dom len an tiro wast.
Un te dareh tu tele te djal, palle le tiro budepaskres, o Pura, peha, te djal lo tuha tele.

Un kote shuneh tu, hoi jon rakrenn. Un te shunal tu kowa, palle wenn tire wasta soreles, jaake te nai djah tu tire lurdentsa tele, te kurenn le pen lentsa.” Un o Gideon un leskro budepaskro, o Pura, djan tele kote, kai kol lurde hi, kai jak denn.

Un i Midianarja un i Amalekarja un lauter, kai wan kotar, kai o kham pre djal, his kote tchiddo an o telstuno them un tchakran o them har i stepangre. Jaake bud his le. Un lengre khamele his jaake bud, te djinas kek, har bud jon hi. Kolla his jaake bud har i santa pash o baro pani.

Un har o Gideon koi tele was, penas jek mursh peskro maleske peskri suni. Un job penas: “Shun, man his i suni: I maro dran djob peras i berga tele pash i platsa, kai i Midianarja hi. Un o maro was pash o plachteno kheer, un das les trujel, jaake te peras lo khetne. Un o pralstuno kotar was tella, un o telstuno kotar was pral.”
Un leskro maal penas: “Kawa hi tchi wawar har o charo o Gideonestar, koleskro dad o Israelitari Joash hi. Koles das o Dewel i tsele Midianarja pengre tsele lurdentsa an leskro wast.”

Un har shunas o Gideon koi suni un kowa, hoi kamas kai suni te penell, kote tchiwas lo pes ap i tchanga glan o Debleste un sharas les. Un djas pale pash i platsa, kai i Israelengre lurde hi, un penas: “Hadenn tumen! O baro Dewel das i Midianarja un lauter, kai pash lende hi, an tumaro wast.”
Un dran kol triin shelendar tchiwas job triin kope sheel murshen khetne. Un hakenes das lo i phurdepaskri un i khoro. Un an ko khoro his i kasht, hoi chatchell.
Un job penas ap lende: “Dikenn ap mande un krenn jaake, har me krau! Kanna djau pash i lurdengri platsa. Denn jak, hoi kote krau! Un krenn mange lauter palla!

Tchiwenn tumen trul i tseli platsa! Un te phurdau me an i phurdepaskri, me un kolla, kai pash mande hi, palle phurdenn tumer ninna an tumare phurdepangre, un denn gole: ‘Kuras men o baro Debleske un o Gideoneske!’”
Un o Gideon un kol sheel mursha, kai leha djan, wan pash koi platsa mashkral an i rat. Un o Gideon un kol mursha trul leste phurdan an i phurdepangre, un dan kol khore paash, hoi an lengre wasta hi.

Kanna phurdan kol triin-sheel lurde an pengre phurdepangre, un dan pengre khore paash. Un jon rikran pengro serwo wasteha o kasht, hoi chatchell, un pengro tchatcho wasteha pengri phurdepaskri, te phurdenn le dren, un dan gole: “Kuras men o baro Debleske un o Gideoneske!”
Un jon atchan kote tardo, kai le his, trul koi tseli platsa trujel. Un kol tsele Midiantikre lurde nashan har diwjes ap koi platsa trujel, dan bari gole un kaman te nashenn penge.

Un har kol triin sheel mursha an pengre phurdepangre phurdan, kras o baro Dewel, te kuras pes ap i platsa hakeno hakeneha. Un jon lauter nashan bis pash o foro Bet-Shitta ap o drom pash o foro Zereda, un ninna bis pash o foro Abel-Mehola pash o foro Tabbat.
Un i mursha an o them Israel wan khetne gole dino: dran o kheer Naftali, dran o kheer Asser, un dran o tselo kheer Manasse. Un jon lan i Midianarja palla.

Un o Gideon bitchras murshen an i berge Efrajim, un mukas kote te penell: “Awenn tele, un tchiwenn tumen i murshenge dran Midian an o drom! Denn jak ap i panjengre platse bis pash o foro Bet-Bara un ninna ap o pani Jordan, te nashenn le penge gar koi wergel!” Koi wan i tsele mursha dran Efrajim khetne kharedo. Un jon kran jaake har o Gideon penas.

Un jon tapran dui murshen, kai pralstune his pral i Midianarja. Lengre laba his Oreb un Seeb. Un jon dan o Oreb temerl pash i baro bar. Kowa was pal leste kharedo: bar Oreb. Un o Seebes dan le temerl pash i moljakro stakepaskro. Koles dan le o lab Seeb. Un jon lan i Midianarja palla. Un i shere kol dujendar, o Oreb un o Seeb, anan le pash o Gideon wergel o pani Jordan.
I mursha dran o kheer Efrajim penan ap leste: “Har nai kral tu sawo kowa mentsa, te djal an o kurepen i Midianentsa, un mukal men gar gole te dell?” Un jon tchingran soreles ap leste.

Un job penas ap lende: “Kowa, hoi tumer kran, hi bud bareder har kowa hoi me krom. Kowa hi jaake har an ko tsiro, kai i drake dren anlo wenna: Kol palstune drake hi feteder har i tsele wawar. Jaake hi kowa, hoi o Efrajim kras, feteder har kowa, hoi mire tsele menshe khetne kran.

An tumaro wast das o Dewel kol pralstunen pral o Midian: o Oreb un o Seeb. Un hoi nai krom me? Te dikeh jek ap kowa, hoi tumer kran, krom me nai jaake bud har tchi!” Un har job jaake lentsa rakras, djas lengri choli pale.
Un o Gideon was pash o pani Jordan, un djas wergel kol 300 (triin sheel) murshentsa, hoi pash leste hi. Un jon his khino, un an lende his buder kek soor, fothe jon kol Midianarja palla lan.
Un job penas ap kol murshende an o foro Sukkot: “Denn kol lurden, hoi pash mande hi, maro te chal! Jon hi khino. Mer lah kol bare rajen pral o Midian palla: o Sebach un o Zalmunna.”
I pralstune an o Sukkot penan: “O Sebach un o Zalmunna hi gomme gar an tire wasta! Hoske das mer tire lurden te chal?”
Kote penas o Gideon: “Tchatchepah, te das o baro Dewel man o Sebach un o Zalmunna an miro wast, dau me tumaro mass kol subjengre kashtentsa dran o mulo tato them.”
Un job mukas o foro pal peste, un djas pre an o foro Penuel. Un penas emlige laba ap kolende, kai kote djiwan. Kolla penan ninna kowa, hoi i mursha an o foro Sukkot penan.
Kote penas o Gideon ninna ap i murshende an o foro Penuel: “Te wau sasto pale, phagau kau baro sorelo kheer khetne.”

Un o Sebach un o Zalmunna his an o them Karkor. Un 15.000 (deesh-te-pantch-serja) lurde his pash lende, lauter kolla, kai pral atchan kol tsele lurdendar, kai dran o them wan, kai o kham pre djal. Kol wawar mursha, kai nai kuran pen o chareha, wan temerl dino. Kolla his 120.000 (sheel-te-biish-serja) mursha.

Un o Gideon djas ko drom, kai kolla djan, kai an plachtene khera djiwenn. Ko drom djal pash i forja Nobach un Jogboha, ap koi rig, kai o kham pre djala. Un job peras pral i lurdende dran Midian kote, kai jon beshde hi, an ko tsiro, kai daran le gar, te merenn le.
Un kol dui bare raja pral o Midian, o Sebach un o Zalmunna, nashan penge. Un job las len palla, un tapras len. Un lengre tsele lurde tapran i bari daar lestar!
Un palle was o Gideon, koleskro dad o Joash hi, pale o kurepastar, un djas ko drom tele, hoi i berga tele nashella, un Heres kharella.
Un job tapras i tchawes i menshendar dran o foro Sukkot. Un putchas les win. Un kowa tchinas leske i laba pre kol 77 (efta-deesh-te-efta) pralstunendar un phurendar an o foro Sukkot.

Un o Gideon djas pash kol murshende an o foro Sukkot un penas ap lende: “Dikenn kai, kate hi o Sebach un o Zalmunna, kolentsa tumer man praassan, har tumer penan: ‘O Sebach un o Zalmunna hi gomme gar an tire wasta! Hoske das mer tire khine lurden te chal?’”
Un job las kol phureden an o foro Sukkot un mukas len te dell subjengre kashtentsa dran o mulo tato them.
Un ko baro sorelo kheer an o foro Penuel phagas lo khetne. Un das i murshen an ko foro temerl.

Un job rakras ap o Sebach un o Zalmunna un putchas lendar: “Har dikan kol mursha win, kolen tumer ap i berga Tabor temerl dan?” Un jon penan: “Jaake har tu hal, jaake his jon ninna, hakeno lendar his har i rajeskro tchawo.”
Kote penas lo: “Kolla his mire phrala, i tchawe miri datar his jon. Pash o djido Debleste dau me man sowel: Te mukans tumer len te djiwell, doms me tumen kanna gar temerl.”
Un job penas ap o Jeter, leskro phureder tchaweste: “Ste pre! Un de len temerl!” Ko tchawo las peskro charo gar glan. Job daras, fothe terno his lo.

Kote penas o Sebach un o Zalmunna: “Ste tu pre un kre kowa kokres! Hawo mursh jek hi, sikrell pes an leskri soor.” Kote stas o Gideon pre, un das o Sebach un o Zalmunna temerl. Un djas koi un las kol sonakangre paash-tchonna hoi lengre khamelenge trul lengre menja hi.
Un i mursha dran o Israel, penan ap o Gideon: “Ab tu maro rai! Tu un tire tchawe un kolengre tchawe wenn rai pral mende! Tu lal men dran i wasta kolendar dran o them Midian win.”
O Gideon penas ap lende: “Gar me kamau pral tumende rai te well, un ninna mire tchawe wenn gar rai pral tumende. O baro Dewel well tumaro rai.”
Un o Gideon penas pale ap lende: “Jek kamau tumendar te mangell: Denn man kol kanengre, hoi lan kolendar, kai kuran tumen lentsa!” Kolla his Ismaelarja un doleske his len sonakangre kanengre.
Un jon penan: “O djijestar dah len tut.” Un jon tchiwan i plaashka ap i phub, un hakeno lendar witsras kol kanengre pre, hoi job i wawar lurdenge krik las.

Un kol sonakangre kanengre, hoi dan le o Gideoneske, his jaake biish kilogramme phares. Un kote his ko tselo wawar koowa gar pashel: kol tikne tchonna, kol kanengre un kol kutch lole ripja, hoi i bare raja dran o them Midian hidjran. Witar gar i werklia, hoi i khamele trul pengre menja hidjran, his kote pashel.

Un o Gideon kras dran ko sonakai jek dewel. Un tchiwas les pre an peskro foro, hoi kharella Ofra. Un o tselo Israel was koi, te mangenn le les an. Un doleske peras o Gideon un leskro tselo kheer o tchatcho dromestar tele.
O Midian his jaake khetne dino, te his jon buder gar soreles doha, te kurenn le pen i Israelentsa. Jaake his kek kurepen an o them Israel 40 (star-deesh) bersha, jaake rah har o Gideon djiwas.
Un o Gideon, kai kharas ninna Jerub-Baal, koleskro dad o Joash his, djas pale an peskro kheer un djiwas kote o tselo tsiro.
Un o Gideones his bud romja un 70 (efta-deesh) mursh tchawe, hoi lestar his.
Un les his ninna i wawar djuwel, kai djiwas an o foro Sichem. Un joi las lestar i mursh tchawo. Un o Gideon das les o lab Abimelech.
Un o Gideon was bud phuro un meras un was paskedo an o mulengro kheer peskro dadestar Joash an o foro Ofra, ko foro, kai i Abijesarja djiwan.
Un har o Gideon meras, djan i Israelitarja o Debleskro dromestar tele un nashan pale kol deblenge palla, kai kharenn Baal. Un jon kran o debles Baal-Berit pengro dewel,
un bistran pengro baro Debles, koles, kai len dran o wast kolendar sorjah win las, hoi trul lende djiwan un pen lentsa kuran.
Un ninna o tselo latcho koowa, hoi o Gideon i Israelenge kras, his lenge gar bud moldo, un jon his gar latches ap leskre tchawende, kai pal leste wan.
Un o Abimelech, o Gideoneskro tchawo, djas an o foro Sichem pash i phralende peskri datar, un rakras lakre tsele menshentsa un penas:

“Penenn ap i tsele murshende an o foro Sichem: ‘Hoi kamenn tumer? Hi feteder tumenge, te hi efta-deesh mursha raja pral tumende, kol tsele tchawe o Gideonestar? Hi gar feteder, te hi jek mursh rai pral tumende? Un ma bistrenn, te hom me tumaro rat un mass.’”
Kote penan i phrala leskri datar kol tsele laba ap i tsele murshende an o foro Sichem. Un jon penan penge: “Job hi maro phraal.” Un wan ap leskri rig.
Un jon dan les efta-deesh rupene kotja dran o kheer, kai mangan le o debles Baal-Berit an. Kol lowentsa ginas o Abimelech diwje depangre, hoi leske palla djan.

Un lentsa djas lo an peskro dadeskro kheer an o foro Ofra, un das peskre phralen temerl. Kol efta-deesh mursh tchawen leskro dadestar Gideon das lo ap jek baro bar temerl. Kokres o Jotam atchas pral, o terneder tchawo o Gideonestar. Kowa khatras pes.

Un i tikno tsiro koi pal wan i tsele mursha dran o foro Sichem khetne, ninna lauter, hoi an o baro sorelo kheer djiwan. Khetne djan le glan o foro Sichem pash ko baro ruk, hoi pash o baro bar tardo hi. Kote tchiwan le o Abimeleches pral pende, te well lo lengro baro rai.
Har shunas o Jotam kowa, djas lo pral pre ap i berga Garizim, un das kotar tele ap lende gole, un penas: Shunenn ap mande, murshale dran Sichem, te shunell ninna o Dewel ap tumende!
His jek tsiro, kai djan i ruka koi, te rodenn le, koon nai well rai pral pende; un jaake penan le ap o djeteskro ruk: Ab tu o rai pral mende!
Kote penas o djeteskro ruk: Mukap me miro thulepen, koleske i debla un i menshe man sharenna, te djap koi, te hadap mire kashta pral i wawar ruka?
Un i ruka penan ap o faigetikro ruk: Ab tu o rai pral mende!
Kote penas o faigetikro ruk: Hidjap me buder gar gudle un latche rukengre, te djap koi, te hadap mire kashta pral i wawar ruka?
Un i ruka penan ap o drakengro ruk: Ab tu o rai pral mende!
Kote penas o drakengro ruk: Mukap me i drake, kolendar i mool kerdo well, hoi i deblen un i menshen bachteles krell, te djap koi, te hadap mire kashta pral i wawar ruka?
Un i tsele ruka penan ap o subjengro bur: Ap tu o rai pral mende!

Kote penas o subjengro bur: Kamenn tumer tchatchepah, te wap me rai pral tumende? Palle awenn pash mande, un khatrenn tumen tel mande glan o kham! Un te krenn kowa gar, palle djal jag win dran o subjengro bur, un chatchrell i zedertikre ruka, hoi ap i berga Libanon tardo hi!

Un kanna penenn mange, rikran tumen ap o tchatchepen, har tchiwan o Abimeleches pral tumende, te well lo tumaro rai? Un kran tumer o latchepen ap o Gideon un ap leskro kheer? Kran tumer leske kowa pale, har job ap tumende his?
Miro dad djas tumenge an o kurepen, kai nai wals lo maredo, un las tumen win dran i wasta kolendar dran Midian.

Tumer hadan tumen kau diwes pral miro dadeskro kheer, un dan leskre tchawen temerl. Efta-deesh murshen dan ap jek baro bar temerl. Un tchiwan tumaro phrales, o Abimeleches, pral tumende, te well lo o rai pral o foro Sichem. Un leskri dai hi miro dadeskro budepaskretsa.
Te his kowa lauter mishto, hoi kran tumer ap o Gideon un ap leskro kheer, palle krenn dureder jaake un wenn bachteles khetne, tumer un o Abimelech!

Te his kowa gar mishto, hoi kran tumer, palle djal jag dran o Abimelech win, un koi jag chal hakenes pre, kai an o foro Sichem djiwella, ninna kolen, kai an o baro sorelo kheer djiwenna! Un lendar lauterendar djal jag win un chal o Abimeleches pre!
Un o Jotam nashas leskro phralestar Abimelech krik, un jon tapran les gar. Un job djas an o foro Beer, un atchas koi.
Un o Abimelech his triin bersha o baro rai pral o Israel.
Un palle bitchras o Dewel i tchilatcho ducho mashkral o Abimelech un i menshende an o foro Sichem. Un kolla rissran pen lestar tele, un rikran buder gar pash leste.

Jaake te well ko tchilatchepen ap leste pale, hoi job ap kol efta-deesh tchawende peskro dadestar Gideon kras. Un lengro rat te well ap lengro phraleste Abimelech, kai len temerl das, un ap kolende, kai an o foro Sichem djiwan un leskre wasta soreles kran.
Un kolla, kai an o foro Sichem djiwan, tchiwan pen khatemen pash i dromma ap i berge, un peran pral hakeneste, koon koi djal, un tchoran les win. Un kowa was o Abimelecheske penlo.
An ko tsiro was o Gaal, koleskro dad o Ebed hi, peskre phralentsa an o foro Sichem. Un i menshe, kai an Sichem djiwenn, tchiwan pengro patsepen ap leste.

Un jon djan win an i drakengre themma un anan i drake dren, un anan len koi, kai le mool lendar krenn. Palle wan le bachteles khetne un djan an pengro debleskro kheer un chan un pijan, un praassan o Abimeleches.

Un o Gaal, koleskro dad o Ebed hi, penas: “Koon hi o Abimelech, te mukas mer les maro rai te well, mer, i menshe dran o foro Sichem? Leskro dad hi o Gideon. Doleske hi lo gar tchatchepah jek mendar. Un job tchiwas peskro budepaskres, o Sebul, pral mende, te dell job jak ap mende. Mer te tchiwas i murshes dran o kheer Hamor pral mende, te well job maro rai, un gar o Abimelech! O Hamor hi o dad maro forestar Sichem.
Te wals man penepaske kate, palle tradoms me o Abimeleches un penoms ap leste: ‘De tire kurepangre khetne gole un ab win, un kure tut mentsa!’”
Har o Sebul, ko pralstuno pral o foro, shunas, hoi o Gaal penas, kote chatchras i choli an leste pre.
Un job bitchras tchorchanes murshen pash o Abimelech un mukas leske te penell: “Dik, o Gaal un leskre phrala wan an o foro Sichem, un krenn, te wenn i menshe chojedo ap tute.
Doleske ab an i rat, tu un tire tsele kurepangre, un tchip tut pash o foro khatemen.
Un taissarlakro, te djal o kham pale pre, pere pral o foro dren! Un te well o Gaal peskre murshentsa palle win, te kurell lo pes tuha, kre les, har tiro wast les tut dell!”
Kote kras pes o Abimelech ap o drom an koi rat, job un peskre tsele kurepangre. Un jon tchiwan pen ap star platse trul o foro Sichem khatemen.
Un o Gaal djas win glan o foreskro baro wudar. Kote wan o Abimelech un leskre tsele kurepangre dran pengro khatepen win.
Un o Gaal dikas len un penas ap o Sebul: “Dik, koi wenn lurde i berga tele.” O Sebul penas ap leste: “Tu dikeh o tamlepen, hoi i berge krenn, har te wans mursha.”
O Gaal rakras pale, un penas: “Dik koi! Lurde wenn i berga tele, un wawar wenn ap o drom, kai o mulno eichtikro ruk tardo hi.”

Kote penas o Sebul ap leste: “Kai hi kanna tiro baro mui? Tu penal: ‘Koon hi o Abimelech, te mukas mer les maro rai te well?’ Hi kolla gar kol lurde, pral kolende tu jaake sal? Dja kanna koi, un kure tut lentsa!”
Koi anas o Gaal i murshen, kai an o foro Sichem djiwenn, an o kurepen. Un jon kuran pen o Abimelecheha un leskre lurdentsa.
Un o Abimelech tradas les, jaake te nashas o Gaal lestar. Un bud mursha wan temerl dino un atchan tchiddo bis glan o foreskro baro wudar.
Un o Abimelech atchas an o gab Aruma. Un o Sebul tradas o Gaales un leskre phralen dran o foro Sichem.
Un o wawar diwes kaman i menshe win te djal dran o foro, te budrenn le ap lengri hachetikri phub. Har o Abimelech kowa shunas,

las lo peskre tsele lurde, kras lentsa triin gruppe, un tchiwas pes lentsa an i hachetikri phub khatemen. Un har dikas lo, te wenn le dran o foro, was lo peskre lurdentsa dran o khatepen, te perell lo ap lende.
Job un kol lurde, hoi pash leste hi, nashan pash o foreskro baro wudar un atchan kote tardo. Un kol wawar lurde peran pral kolende, kai ap i hachetikri phub hi, un dan len temerl.
Un o tselo diwes kuras pes o Abimelech i murshentsa dran o foro, un las o foro dren. Un i menshen, kai an o foro hi, das lo temerl. Un i khera kras lo paash, un witsras loon ap lende.
Un har shunan kowa kol menshe, kai an o baro sorelo kheer djiwenn, nashan le an o baro isema, hoi hi tel o kheer lengro deblestar Baal-Berit.
Un har o Abimelech shunas, te wan le lauter kote khetne,

djas lo peskre tsele lurdentsa pre ap i berga Zalmon. Un o Abimelech las i tower an peskro wast, das leha jek kasht tele i rukestar, un tchiwas les peske ap i phik. Un penas ap i lurde, hoi pash leste his: “Kowa hoi tumer dikan, hoi me krom, sik krenn les har me!”

Un hakeno kol lurdendar das jek kasht tele. Un jon djan o Abimelecheske palla, un tchiwan pengre kashta ap koi bari isema, kai kolla pen khatran, un chatchran kol kashta pral lende. Un jaake meran i tsele menshe, hoi an ko baro sorelo kheer djiwan. Un kolla his jaake 1.000 (jek sero) mursha un djuwja.
Un palle djas o Abimelech dureder pash o foro Tebez, un tchiwas pes peskre lurdentsa trul o foro, un las les dren.
An ko foro his i baro sorelo kheer. Un kote nashan i tsele menshe dran o foro, mursha un djuwja, te khatrenn le pen. Un jon kran o wudar pal pende pandlo, un djan pral pre ap o kheer.
Un o Abimelech was pash ko kheer, te lell lo les dren. Un job djas pash o baro wudar, te chatchrell lo les.
Kote witsras i djuwel i baro bar tele ap o Abimelecheskro shero un dukas les phares.

Koi das lo sik gole ap peskro budepaskro, kai leske o charo hidjrell, un penas ap leste: “Le tiro charo, un de man temerl, te penell kek mandar: ‘I djuwel das les temerl.’” Un leskro budepaskro das les tele tchurje, jaake te meras lo.
Un har i Israelitarja, kai lentsa hi, dikan, te hi o Abimelech mulo, djas hakeno lendar pale khere.
Jaake mukas o Dewel o tchilatchepen ap o Abimelech pale te well, hoi lo ap peskro dadeste kras, har mukas job peskre efta-deesh phralen temerl dell.
Un ninna o tchilatchepen, hoi i mursha dran o foro Sichem kran, mukas o Dewel ap lengre shere pale te well. Un jaake was koi bibacht pral lende, hoi o Jotam win rakras, koleskro dad o Gideon hi.

Un pal o Abimelech stas i mursh pre, te lell lo o Israel win dran i tchilatche wasta. Kowa his o Tola. Leskro dad his o Puwa, un koleskro dad his o Dodo i menshendar Issachar. O Tola djiwas an o foro Shamir an i berge Efrajim.
Un job his 23 (biish-te-triin) bersha o tchatchepaskro rai pral o Israel. Un palle meras lo, un was paskedo an o foro Shamir.
Un pal leste stas o Jair pre. Kowa hi i menshendar Gilead. Un job his 22 (biish-te-dui) bersha o tchatchepaskro rai pral o Israel.
Un koles his trijanda mursh tchawe, kai ap trijanda burike klissan. Un len his trijanda forja. Kolla his an o them Gilead un kharenn gomme kau diwes: Jaireskre forja.
Un o Jair meras, un was an o foro Kamon paskedo.

Un i Israelitarja kran pale kowa, hoi tchilatches his glan o baro Debleskre jaka. Un jon mangan i wawar deblen an: ko debles, kai kharell Baal, un i debletsa, kai kharell Astarte, un kol deblen, kai mangenn kol menshe an, kai djiwenn an Syria, an Sidon, an Moab, an Ammon un an Filistia. Un i Israelitarja mukan o baro Debles un mangan les buder gar an.
Kote chatchas i bari choli pre an o baro Debleste ap i Israelitarja. Un job das len an i wasta i menshendar dran i themma Filistia un Ammon.
Un 18 (deesh-te-ochta) bersha lan jon kol Israelitarjen palla, kai djiwenn ap i wawar rig o panjestar Jordan an o them Gilead, kai i Amorarja djiwan, un kran lenge o djipen phares.
Un i Ammonarja djan pral o Jordan, te marenn le pen i menshentsa dran Juda, Benjamin un Efrajim. Un jaake was i bari daar pral o Israel.
Un kote dan i Israelitarja ap o baro Debleste gole un penan: “Mer kram tchilatchepen ap tute, te mukam tut, maro Debles, un mangam o debles Baal an.”
Un o baro Dewel penas ap lende: “Hi gar jaake, te rikran tumen i Egiptarja tele un i Amorarja, i Ammonarja, i Filistarja,
i Sidonarja, i Amalekarja un i Maonarja? Un har tumer ap mande gole dan, lom me tumen dran lengre wasta win.
Un tumer, hoi kran tumer? Tumer mukan man un mangan wawar deblen an. Doleske kamau tumen buder gar win te lell dran i wasta kolendar, kai tumen tele rikrenn.
Djan koi un denn ap kol deblende gole, hoi tumer tumenge win rodan, te wenn kolla tumenge ap i rig an ko tsiro, kai tumaro djipen pharo hi.”
I Israelitarja penan ap o baro Debleste: “Mer lam bari doosh ap mende! Kre tu mentsa, har tu kameh. Kokres kau jek kopo le men gomme win dran kolengre wasta!
Un jon witsran kol wawar deblen pendar krik un mangan o baro Debles an. Koi khaitas les, te well o Israeleske jaake pharo kerdo.”
Un i Ammonarja wan khetne gole dino, un tchiwan pengre plachtene khera pre pash o foro Gilead. Un i Israelitarja wan khetne pash Mizpa.

Un i pralstune pral kol Israelitarja, kai djiwenn an Gilead, penan jek ap o wawareste: “Koon hi ko mursh, kai glan win djal, te marell lo pes i lurdentsa dran o them Ammon? Kowa te well o pralstuno pral lauterende, kai djiwenn an Gilead.”
Un kote his i tchatcho sorelo mursh dran o them Gilead. Leskro lab his Jefta. Leskri dai his i lubni. Leskro dad kharas Gilead.

O Gileadeskri romni las ninna lestar mursh tchawe. Un har kolla bares wan, tradan le o Jefta pendar, un penan ap leste: “Tu leh tchi, hoi maro dadestar hi, te hi lo mulo. Tu hal o tchawo i wawar djuwjatar.”
Un jaake nashas o Jefta peskre phralendar, un djiwas an o them Tob. Un pash leste wan pale-tchidde un djan leha.
Un pal i tsiro djan i Ammonarja ap i Israelende pre.
Kote djan i phureder dran Gilead pash o Jefta, te lenn le les dran o them Tob.
Un jon penan ap leste: “Ab mentsa, un ab tu maro kurepaskro rai, te nai maras men i Ammonentsa!”

Kote penas o Jefta ap i phureder murshende dran Gilead: “Hans gar tumer, kolla kai kaman man gar un tradan man dran miro dadeskro kheer win? Un hoske wenn tumer pash mande kanna, kai tumenge gar mishto djal un tumen i pharo tsiro hi?”
Un i phureder dran Gilead penan ap leste: “Doleske wam mer kanna pale pash tute, te djas tu mentsa khetne an o kurepen i Ammonentsa. Tu wess maro rai pral lauterende, kai djiwenn an Gilead.”
O Jefta penas lenge: “Te anenn man pale, te kurap man i Ammonentsa, un o baro Dewel dell len an miro wast, hom me palle tchatchepah o pralstuno pral tumende?”
Un i phureder dran Gilead penan ap leste: “O baro Dewel shunas, hoi mer penam. Mer krah tchatchepah har tu penal.”

Kote djas o Jefta i phurentsa, kai wan dran Gilead. Un i tsele menshe tchiwan les pral pende, te well lo lengro rai un pralstuno. Un kote an o foro Mizpa penas o Jefta lenge glan o baro Debleste, hoi job un i pralstune win kran.
Un o Jefta bitchras murshen pash o rajeste pral i Ammonarja, un mukas leske te penell: “Hoi hi mank mande un tute, te weh tu pash mande an miro them, te maress tut mentsa?”

Un o rai pral i Ammonarja penas ap i murshende, kolen o Jefta bitchras: “Har was o Israel win dran o them Egiptia, las lo peske miro them, hoi tchiddo hi mank o pani Arnon un o pani Jabbok un o pani Jordan. Un kanna de kol themma an o latchepen pale pale!”
Un o Jefta bitchras pale murshen pash o rajeste pral i Ammonarja.
Kolla penan leske: Jaake rakrell o Jefta: “O Israel las kek them i Moabendar, witar gar i Ammonendar.
Kowa his jaake: Har djan jon dran Egiptia win, djas o Israel mank o mulo them, bis pash o Baro Lolo Pani, un was bis pash o foro Kadesh.

Un o Israel bitchras murshen pash o rajeste pral o them Edom un mukas leske te penell: Muk men mank tiro them te djal! Un o rai pral Edom shunas gar ap lende. Un ninna pash o rajeste pral o them Moab bitchran le murshen, te mangenn le lestar ko emligo koowa; ninna kowa kamas gar. Jaake atchas o Israel an Kadesh.

Palle djan le an o mulo them, un trul o them Edom un o them Moab trujel. Un wan pash o them Moab koi rigjatar, kai o kham pre djala. Un jon tchiwan pengre plachtene khera pre ap i wawar rig o panjestar Arnon. Jaake wan le gar an o Moabengro them. O pani Arnon nashell mank Moab un o mulo them.
Un o Israel bitchras murshen an Heshbon pash o rajeste pral i Amorarja, o Sihon. Un o Israel mukas leske te penell: Muk men mank tiro them te djal, te nai was an maro them!
Un o Sihon patsas gar, te kamell o Israel tchi wawares har wergel leskro them te djal. Un o Sihon las peskre tsele lurden khetne pash Jahaz, un maras pes i Israelentsa.
Un kote das o baro Dewel, kai o Israeleskro Dewel hi, o Sihones un leskre tsele lurden an i wasta i Israelendar. Un jon maran len. Jaake las o Israel o tselo them dren, kai o Amorarja djiwan,
ko them hoi lenge his mank o pani Arnon un o pani Jabbok, un mank i mulo them un o pani Jordan.
Jaake dikeh, kowa his o baro Dewel, o Israeleskro Dewel, kai tradas i Amorarjen glan peskre menshende win. Un kanna kameh tu men katar pale win tradell?

Hi gar jaake? Te tradals tiro Dewel, o Kemosh, wawar menshen dran lengro them win, lals tu palle gar kolengro them dren? Muk men ko them dren te lell kolendar, kai maro baro Dewel glan mende win tradas!
Patseh tchatchepah, te hal sorleder har o Balak, koleskro dad o Zippor hi, ko rai pral o Moab? Mukas kowa pes ap i tchingepen dren i Israelentsa? Maras lo pes lentsa? Na-a!
Triin-sheel bersha djiwell o Israel kanna an i forja Heshbon un Aroer un an kol gaba trujel un an i forja pash o pani Arnon. Hoske lan ko them gar mendar krik an ko tselo tsiro?

Na-a, me krom kek tchilatchepen ap tute. Tu kameh mange tchilatchepen. Tu weh te maras men! O baro Dewel, kai o tchatchepaskro rai hi, kau diwes mu krell lo o tchatchepen mank mende win, mank o Israel un i Ammonarja!”
O rai pral i Ammonarja shunas gar ap i laba, hoi o Jefta leske mukas te penell.

Kote was o ducho o baro Deblestar pral o Jefta. Un job djas an o tselo them Gilead un Manasse trujel un was pale an o foro Mizpe an Gilead. Un kotar djas lo an o kurepen, te kurell lo pes i lurdentsa dran o them Ammon.
Un o Jefta das pes sowel pash o baro Debleste un penas: “Te deh tu man i Ammonarjen an miro wast,
palle dau tut koles, kai dran miro khereskro wudar win wella, un pash mande well ap ko diwes, kai wau an o latchepen pale dran o kurepen kolentsa dran o them Ammon. Koles chatchrau tuke.”
Un jaake djas o Jefta ap i wawar rig o panjestar pash i Ammonarja, un kuras pen lentsa. Un o baro Dewel das len an leskro wast.
Un job maras len bare dawentsa un las lengre forja dren, hoi mank Aroer, Minnit un Abel-Keramim tchiddo hi. Kolla his biish forja. Jaake wan i Ammonarja tiknes kerdo glan i Israelitarja.
Un o Jefta was pale an Mizpa pash peskro kheer. Un kote was leskri tchai win, un was bashepah un khelepah pash leste. Joi his lauter, hoi les his. Les his kek wawar tchai, witar kek wawar tchawo.

Un har job lat dikas, kote tserdas lo i koola pestar tele, un penas: “Ach miri tchai, hawi bari duk kreh tu mange! Miro dji rowell tuke! Me dom o baro Debleste miro lab, un nai lau les gar buder pale.”

Kote penas joi ap leste: “Miro dad, te dal tu tiro lab o baro Debleste, palle kre mantsa har les dran tiro mui win was. O baro Dewel kras, te nai dal tu i Ammonarjen lengro tchilatchepen pale, hoi jon ap tute kran.”

Un palle penas joi ap peskro dadeste: “Kawa muk man gomme te krell: Muk man dui tchonna, te djap pre ap i berge, me un kol tcha, kai mire mala hi, te nai rowas khetne, te hunte merap glan kowa me romedino homs.”
Un job penas: “Dja koi!” Un job mukas lat dui tchonna te djal. Un jaake djas joi ap i berge kol tchentsa, kai lakre mala hi. Un jon rowan koi pral, te hunte merell li glan joi romedino his.
Un har kol dui tchon trujel his, was li pale pash peskro dadeste. Un job kras lah, har job pes sowel das. Un lat his kek mursh, kai lat an-tapras. Un kolestar was kowa an Israel,
te djan i terne tcha an Israel hako bersh star diwessa koi, te rowenn le pral i tchate ko murshestar Jefta dran Gilead.

Un i mursha dran Efrajim wan khetne gole dino. Un djan wergel o pani Jordan, un dureder pre pash o foro Zafon. Un penan ap o Jefta: “Hoske djal tu an o kurepen, te kuress tut i Ammonentsa? Un men mukal gar gole te dell, te djas tuha? Doleske chatchrah tiro kheer khetne tuha pre!”
Kote penas o Jefta ap lende: “Men his i pharo kurepen i Ammonentsa, man un mire menshen, un me mukom tumen gole te dell. Un tumer wan gar ap miri rig.

Un har dikom, te wenn tumer gar, kote hunte dom kokres ap mande jak un djom koi, te kurap man lentsa. Un o baro Dewel das len an miro wast. Un hoske djan tumer kau diwes pash mande pre, te marenn tumen mantsa?”

Un o Jefta mukas i murshen dran Gilead khetne te well. Un jon maran pen i murshentsa dran Efrajim. Un i mursha dran Gilead dan i murshen dran Efrajim. [Glan i tsiro penan i mursha dran Efrajim: Tumer dran Gilead han tchi har naashepangre, kai nashan penge dran o them Efrajim an o them Manasse. Tumaro them Gilead hi tchiddo mashkral Efrajim un Manasse.]

Un i mursha dran Gilead lan kol platse dren, kai nai djan le wergel o Jordan an o them Efrajim. Un hako kopo te was i Efrajimari, hoi ap o naashepen his, un penas “Muk man wergel te djal!” palle putchan i mursha dran Gilead lestar: “Hal tu i Efrajimari?” Un te penas lo “na-a”,

palle penan le ap leste: “Pen Shibbolet!” Un te nai rakras lo les gar tchatches win un penas “Sibbolet”, palle lan le les, un dan les kote pash o Jordan mulo. Un jaake wan an ko tsiro 42.000 (star-deesh-te-dui serja) mursha dran Efrajim mulo dino.
Un o Jefta dran Gilead his shob bersha o tchatchepaskro rai pral o Israel. Un job meras un was paskedo an jek kol forjendar an o them Gilead.
Un pal leste was o Ibzan dran Betlehem o tchatchepaskro rai pral o Israel.

Un koles his trijanda mursh tchawe un trijanda tcha. Peskre tchen das lo romende, kai gar leskre menshendar his. Un leskre mursh tchawenge las lo trijanda romjen, kai ninna gar leskre menshendar his. Un efta bersha his job o tchatchepaskro rai pral Israel.
Un o Ibzan meras un was paskedo an o foro Betlehem.
Un pal leste was o Elon dran o kheer Sebulon o tchatchepaskro rai pral o Israel un kras deesh bersha o tchatchepen pral i Israelitarja win.
Un har lo meras, was lo paskedo an o foro Ajalon an o them Sebulon.
Un pal leste was o Abdon o tchatchepaskro rai pral o Israel. Leskro dad his o Hillel dran o foro Piraton.
Un koles his star-desha mursh tchawe un trijanda tchawengre tchawe. Un kolla klissan ap 70 (efta-desha) burike. Un job kras o tchatchepen pral o Israel ochta bersha win.
Un har meras lo, was lo paskedo an o foro Piraton an o them Efrajim an ko pralstuno them, kai glan kowa i Amalekarja djiwan.
Un i Israelitarja kran pale, hoi tchilatches hi glan o baro Debleskre jaka. Un o baro Dewel das len an i wasta i Filistarendar. Un kolla his i raja pral lende star-desha bersha.
An ko tsiro djiwas i mursh an o foro Zora. Kowa his dran o kheer Dan. Koleskro lab his Manoach. Un leskri romni nai las kek tchawen.
Un o bolepaskro o baro Deblestar mukas pes latar te dikell un penas ap late: “Tu djineh, te nai leh kek tchawen. Kanna djiness, tu weh wawartchandes un leh i mursh tchawes.
De jak, un ma pi mool, witar kek wawar sorelo pipen! Un ma cha tchomone, hoi pale-tchiddo hi!
Ko tchawes, kai leh, well i mursh, kai o Debleske hi peskro tselo djipen fun ko diwes, kai well lo ap i phub. Leskre balla wenn gar tchinlo. Un job lell o Israel win dran i wasta i Filistarendar.”

Un koi djuwel djas pash peskro romeste un penas ap leste: “I Debleskro mursh was pash mande. Un job dikas win har i bolepaskro o Deblestar, jaake te lom daar. Un doleske putchom me lestar witar gar, kai job wella. Un job penas mange gar, har job kharella.

Job penas ap mande: ‘Tu weh wawartchandes un tu leh i mursh tchawes. Un kanna pi kek mool un kek wawar sorelo pipen! Un cha tchi, hoi pale-tchiddo hi. Tiro tchawo well i mursh, kai o Debleske hi fun tiknes pre bis te merell lo.’”

Kote mangas o Manoach o baro Debles un penas: “Miro rai, mangau tut, bitche gomme jek kopo ko Debleskro murshes pash mende, koles tu menge bitchral, te sikrell lo men, har mer ko tchaweha, kai boldo well, trujel hunte djas.”
Un o Dewel shunas, hoi o Manoach lestar mangas. Un o bolepaskro o Deblestar was pale pash koi djuwel, har li win beshdo his ap i hachetikri phub. Un lakro rom, o Manoach, his gar pash late.
Kote nashas li sik pash peskro romeste, un penas ap leste: “Dik, ko mursh hi pale kai, kowa, kai ko wawar diwes pash mande was.”
Kote kras pes o Manoach pre, un djas pal peskri romjate, was pash ko mursheste un penas ap leste: “Hal tu ko mursh, kai miri romjah rakras?” Un kowa penas: “Me hom kowa!”
Un o Manoach penas: “Te well kowa jaake, har tu les penal, hoi hunte kras pale leha? Hoi nai krell lo, un hoi nai krell lo gar?”
Kote penas o bolepaskro o baro Deblestar ap o Manoach: “Kolestar lauterestar, hoi tiri romjake penom, hunte rikrell li pes pale:
Lauterestar, hoi ap o drakengro ruk bares was, chal li tchi. Un mool un sorelo pipen pijell joi gar. Un pale-tchiddo chapen chal li gar. Kawa lauter, hoi lake penom, hunte rikrell li.”
Un o Manoach penas ap o bolepaskro o baro Deblestar: “Mangau tut, atch i tikno tsiro, bis te kram tuke i terni busni chapaske.”

O bolepaskro o baro Deblestar penas ap o Manoach: “Ninna te rikrals man kai, me chaus tiro chapen gar. Tu te kameh, nai chatchreh koi busni o baro Debleske.” O Manoach haiwas gomme gar, te hi lo o bolepaskro o baro Deblestar.
Un o Manoach penas ap leste: “Har khareh tu? Te well kowa jaake har tu les penal, palle kamah men pash tute te parkrell.”
O bolepaskro o baro Deblestar penas ap leste: “Hoske putcheh tu pal miro lab? Kowa hi i lab, hoi well gar kharedo.”

Kote las o Manoach i tikni busni, un koi pashel maro, maras lat, un chatchras i busni un o maro ap i baro bar o baro Debleske, kai sorelo koowa krella. Un o Manoach un leskri romni his koi pashel tardo un dikan kowa.
Un har i jag ap o bar pre djas an o bolepen, koi djas o baro Debleskro bolepaskro ninna pre an koi jag. Un o Manoach un leskri romni dikan kowa, un witsran pen ap i phub ap pengro mui.
Kanna haiwas o Manoach: Kowa his o bolepaskro o baro Deblestar. Un pal kowa dikan le les buder gar.
Un o Manoach penas ap peskri romni: “Kanna hunte meras! Mer dikam o Debles!”

“Na-a”, penas leskri romni, “te kamals o baro Dewel men te marell, palle lals lo gar ko vieches un ko maro dran maro wast, hoi leske dam un leske chatchram. Un job sikrals men gar kawa lauter, hoi dikam, un penals menge gar kanna sawo koowa.”
Un koi romni las i mursh tchawes, un das les o lab Simson. Un ko tchawo was baro, un o baro Dewel tchiwas peskri bacht ap leste.
Un o ducho o baro Deblestar was ap leste o ersto kopo, har his lo ap i platsa Machaneh-Dan mashkral i forja Zora un Eshtaol.
Un o Simson djas tele an o foro Timna. Un kote dikas lo i rakli i Filistarendar.
Har was lo khere, penas lo ap peskro dadeste un peskri date: “Me dikom an Timna i rakjat i Filistarendar. Kolat lenn mange, te well li miri romni!”

Kote penas leskro dad un leskri dai ap leste: “Hi mank tire tsele menshende kek tchai tuke? Hatseh kek romni mank i tsele Israelitarja, te hunte djas tu pash i Filistarja, un less tuke i romni kolendar, kai gar tchinlo hi ap pengro mass?” O Simson penas ap peskro dad: “Koja le mange! Joi hi i shukar an mire jaka.”
Leskro dad un leskri dai haiwan gar, te was kowa o baro Deblestar, kai i drom rodas, te nai perell lo ap i Filistarja. Kolla his i raja pral o Israel an ko tsiro.
Un o Simson djas peskro dadeha un peskri dai tele an o foro Timna. Un har wan le pash i drakengre ruka glan o foro Timna, stas i terno lewo bari goljah ap leste.
Un o baro Debleskro ducho was pral o Simsoneste. Un peskre wastentsa phagas lo o lewes an kotja, har te wals kowa i busni. Peskro dadeske un peskri dake penas lo tchi kolestar.
Un job djas tele an o foro, un rakras koi rakjah. Un an leskre jaka his joi shukar.
Un pal i tsiro djas job pale an Timna, te romedinerell lo lat. Un job djas tele o dromestar, te dikell lo, hoi ko mulo lewestar was. Kote his an ko mulo lewo biene un gwin.

Un job las o gwin an peskro wast, un chas les ap o drom pash o djapen. Un har job pash peskro dadeste un peskri date was, das lo len ninna kolestar, te chan le. Kai las lo ko gwin dran o mulo lewo, penas lo lenge gar.
Un leskro dad djas tele an o foro, pash koi terni rakjate. Un o Simson kras kote i baro chapen, har i terne mursha kran kowa jaake an ko tsiro.
Un har i mursha les dikan, rodan le trijanda terne murshen win, te djan jon leha.

Un o Simson penas ap lende: “Me kamau tumen tchomone phares te putchell un dikell, koon kowa djinella. Un te hatsenn kowa an kal efta diwessa win, kai chah un pijah khetne, palle dau me tumen trijanda laintikre gada, un trijanda shukar ripja.
Te hatsenn kowa gar win, palle hunte denn tumer man kol trijanda laintikre gada un trijanda shukar ripja.” Un jon penan: “Awa, jaake well! Muk kanna te shunell, hoi jaake phares hi!”
Un job penas: “Dran koleste, kai i chapaskro his, was tchomone win chapaske. Un dran o sorelo was gudlepen win.” Un jon djinan gar, hoi kowa hi. Triin diwessa rodan le, un djinan les gar.

Un ap o eftato diwes penan le ap o Simsoneskri romni: “Rake shukar tiro romeha, te penell lo menge, hoi kal phare laba kamenn te penell! Te kreh kowa gar, chatchrah mer tut un tiro dadeskro kheer. Penan tumer, te was mer pash tumaro chapen, te krenn men tchorwelo?”

Kote rowas i Simsoneskri romni ap leste un penas ap leste: “Tu kameh man gar, un nai dikeh man gar glan i jaka. Mire menshendar putchal tchomone phares, un mange penal tu gar, hoi kowa kamell te penell.” Un job penas: “Dik, miro dadeske un miri dake penom kowa gar. Hoske penap les tuke?”

Un joi rowas glan leste kol efta diwessa, kai chan un pijan le khetne. Un ap ko eftato diwes rikras lo kowa buder gar win, un penas lake, hoi leskre laba kamenn te penell. Un joi penas les i terne murshenge lakre menshendar.

Un ap o eftato diwes, glan o tsiro kai o kham tele djas, penan i mursha dran o foro ap leste: “Hoi hi gudleder har gwin? Un hoi hi sorleder har o lewo?” Un job penas ap lende: “Te lans gar miri terni grumni, te budrenn ap tumari phub, palle djinans tumer gar, hoi mire laba kamenn te penell.”

Un o baro Debleskro ducho was pral leste. Un job djas tele an o foro Ashkelon un das trijanda murshen lendar mulo, un riwas len win, un das kol koola kolen, kai leske penan, hoi peskre laba kaman te penell. Un bari choljah djas lo pale an peskro dadeskro kheer.
Un leskri romni was leskro feteder maleste dino.

Pal i tsiro, an kol diwessa, kai anan le o djob dren, djas o Simson pash o kheer, kai leskri romni hi, un anas lake i terni busni peha. Un job penas: “Me kamau pash miri romjate an lakri isema.” Un lakro dad mukas les gar,
un penas ap leste: “Me patsom, te kameh lat buder gar pale. Un me dom lat tiro feteder maleste. Kanna dik, lakri terni pheen hi shukeder har joi. Le kolat!”
Kote penas o Simson ap leste: “Kau kopo hom gar me, koles doosh hi, te krau i Filistarenge tchilatchepen.”
Un o Simson djas koi, un tapras triin-sheel diwje djukle. Un las i kasht, un pandas hako kopo dui diwje djukle i porjentsa ap ko kasht khetne.

Un chatchras palle ko kasht an. Un mukas kol djukle kote te nashell, kai o djob i Filistarendar tardo hi. Jaake chatchras o djob tele, ninna o djob, hoi khetne lino his. Un i jag djas an i drakengre ruka, un an i djeteskre ruka.

Un i Filistarja putchan: “Koon his kowa?” Un lenge was penlo: “O Simson, kowa kai i tchat o murshestar dran Timna las, un kowa peskri tchat lestar pale krik las, un lat leskro males das.” Kote djan i Filistarja pre, un chatchran lat un lakro dades.
Un o Simson penas ap lende: “Te krenn tumer sawo koowa, palle dau me gar palla, bis te dom tumen lauter pale.”
Un job das len soreles khetne, un djas tele un djiwas an koi barrengri grotta pash Etam.
Un i Filistarja djan pre an o them Juda un tchiwan pengre plachtene khera trul o foro Lehi.
Kote putchan i mursha dran Juda: “Hoske djan tumer ap mende pre?” Un jon penan: “Mer kamah o Simsones te pandell, un leha te krell, har job mentsa kras.”

Kote djan triin serja mursha dran Juda tele pash koi grotta pash Etam, un penan ap o Simson: “Djineh tu gar, te hi i Filistarja pral mende rai? Hoske kral tu kowa mentsa?” Un job penas ap lende: “Jaake har jon les mange kran, jaake krom me les lenge.”
Jon penan ap leste: “Mer ham kai, te pandas tut, un te das tut an i wasta i Filistarendar.” Un o Simson penas ap lende: “Denn tumen sowel, te perenn gar tumer pral mande un denn man temerl.”

Un jon penan ap leste: “Na-a, mer kamah tut te pandell un tut an lengre wasta te dell, un tchi wawares. Mer kamah tut gar mulo te dell.” Un jaake pandan le les dui newe shellentsa. Un anan les le win dran ko barrengri grotta.

Un har lo an o foro Lehi was, dan i Filistarja bari gole i bachtjatar. Un o baro Debleskro ducho was pral leste. Un kol shelle trul leskre mussja wan har laintikre thaba, ap kolende jag was, un peran tele.
Un job hatsas i mujeskro kokalo i muli eslatar, las les an o wast un das leha 1.000 (jek sero) murshen mulo.
Un o Simson penas: “I mujeskro kokalo i eslatar lom, un i sero murshen mulo dom. I mujeskro kokalo i eslatar lom, un i mulen jek ap o wawareste witsrom.”
Un har job kowa win rakras, witsras lo ko kokalo dran peskro wast. Un doleske dan le koi platsa ko lab Ramat-Lehi.

Un les his bari trush, un das ap o baro Debleste gole, un penas: “Tu dal man jaake bari soor, te wom o sorleder pral i Filistarende. Un kanna hunte merap i trushatar, un perau an i wasta kolendar, kai gar tchinlo hi ap pengro mass.”

Kote phagas o Dewel o baro bar pash o foro Lehi, un dran kotar was pani. Un job pijas, un leskri soor was pale, un job was pale pherdo djipen. Doleske dan le ko pani, hoi kote dran i phub was, o lab: ‘Pani kolestar, kai gole das’. Ninna gomme kau diwes hi kau pani kote pash o foro Lehi.
Un an ko tsiro, kai i Filistarja i raja his pral o them, his o Simson biish bersha o tchatchepaskro rai pral o Israel.
