Un me kamau 15 (deesh-te-pantch) bersha pre te tchiwell ap tiro djipen. Kamau tut un kau foro win te lell dran o wast o baro rajestar pral o them Assur. Un me rikrau mire wasta pral kau foro. Ko krau mange un o Davideske, kai miro budepaskro his.’”
Un o Jesaja penas: “Anenn mange i merkli dran faige!” Un jon anan kowa un tchiwan les ap ko dukepen, te well lo pale sasto.
Un o Hiskija penas ap o Jesaja: “Hoi hi ko sikepen, kai o baro Dewel man sastes krella, un me nai pral djau ap o triinto diwes an o baro Debleskro kheer?”
Un o Jesaja penas: “Kowa hi tuke ko sikepen o baro Deblestar, te djiness, kai o baro Dewel kowa rikrella, hoi lo penas: Kameh, te djal koi khameskri kambana deesh kotja glan oder deesh kotja pale?”
O Hiskija penas: “Hi gar jaake phares, te djal li deesh kotja glan. Kowa kamau me gar. Me kamau te djal li deesh kotja pale.”
Kote das o Debleskro rakepaskro, o Jesaja, ap o baro Debleste gole. Un o baro Dewel mukas koi khameskri kambana deesh kotja pale te djal. Koja his i kambana, hoi mukas o Ahas te krell.
O baro rai pral o them Babilonia, o Merodach-Baladan, koleskro dad o Baladan hi, shunas, kai o Hiskija nasselo his. Un job bitchras leske i liil un kutch koowa.

Un o Hiskija las len kamles pre, un sikras lende peskro tselo brawlepen, rup, sonakai, sungepaskro koowa, latcho djet, un ko kheer, kai kol tsele kurepaskre koola dren hi, un leskro tselo kutch koowa. Tchi his an leskro kheer un an leskro them, hoi lo lenge gar sikras.

Kote was o Debleskro rakepaskro Jesaja pash o rajeste Hiskija un putchas lestar: “Hoi penan kal mursha? Un hawo themestar wan le pash tute?” O Hiskija penas: “Jon wan dran i dur them kate pash mande, dran o them Babilonia.”
Un job putchas: “Hoi dikan le an tiro kheer?” O Hiskija penas: “Jon dikan halauter, hoi an miro kheer hi. Un tchi dran miro brawlepen hi koi, hoi me len gar mukom te dikell.”
Koi penas o Jesaja ap o Hiskija: “Shun, hoi o baro Dewel penell:
Ko tsiro wella, kai halauter an o them Babilonia anlo wella, hoi an tiro kheer hi, un hoi tire phure khetne tchiwan bis ap kau diwes. Un tchi atchell kate. Kowa penell o baro Dewel.
Ninna tire tchawendar, kai tutar wenna, wenn lino un wenn budepangre an o kheer o baro rajestar pral o them Babilonia.”
Kote penas o Hiskija ap o Jesaja: “Ko lab o baro Deblestar hi mishto, hoi tu rakral.” O Hiskija penas peske: Mange hi mishto, te hi kek kurepen un marepen an mire diwessa.

Ko tselo wawar, hoi pral o Hiskija penepaske hi, un leskro baro koowa, hoi lo kras, hi tchinlo an o familjakro liil kol bare rajendar pral o them Juda. Kote hi ninna tchinlo, har lo ko tikno pani dren pandas un ko panjeskro drom kras, te nai well ko pani an o foro dren.
Un har o Hiskija meras, was leskro tchawo, o Manasse, baro rai pal leste.
Har was o Manasse baro rai, his lo deesh-te-dui bersha phuro; un job his pantch-deesh-te-pantch bersha baro rai an o foro Jerusalem. Leskri dai kharas Hefzi-Bah.
Un job kras, hoi his tchilatcho glan o baro Debleskre jaka: ko emligo djungelo koowa, har kol wawar menshe kran, kolen o baro Dewel glan o Israel win tradas dran o them.

Job tchiwas kol mulne platse pale pre, kai i mule deblenge vieche chatchedo wan. Kol platse das leskro dad, o Hiskija, khetne. Un o Manasse mukas chatchepangre te krell, kai vieche chatchedo wenn o debleske Baal, kai i chocheno dewel hi. Un job kras i debletsa Ashera, har ko baro rai pral o them Israel, o Ahab, kowa ninna kras. Un job mangas i bolepangre momlia an un witsras pes glan lende tele.
Un an o baro Debleskro kheer tchiwas job chatchepangre pre i mule deblenge, kote, kai o baro Dewel penas: “An o foro Jerusalem kamau te mangenn le man an.”
Un i tsele bolepangre momelenge tchiwas lo chatchepangre pre an kol dui glanstune platse glan o baro Debleskro kheer.

Un job mukas peskro tchawes an i jag te djal un shunas ap tchirklengre golja un wawar sikepen, un rikras peske drawepangre un sawe menshen, kai i mulen putchan. Jaake kras lo bud koowa, hoi tchilatcho hi glan o baro Debleskre jaka, te choirell lo les.

Un job anas koi kashteni debletsa Ashera, hoi lestar kerdo was, an o Debleskro kheer, kolestar o baro Dewel ap o David penas un leskro tchaweste, o Salomo: “An kau kheer un an o foro Jerusalem, hoi me mange wi-rodom dran o tselo Israel, kate kamau me, te mangenn le man an hako tsiro.

Un me kamau te djan i Israelitarja buder gar krik dran kau them, kai me dom lengre phurende, jaake rah jon halauter krenna, hoi me lenge penom, un ko tselo drom djan, hoi sikras len o Mose, koles miro tchatcho wast his.”
I menshe an o them Juda shunan gar ap o baro Debleste. Un o Manasse anas len ap o tchilatcho drom; un jon djiwan tchilatcheder har kol wawar menshe, kolen o baro Dewel glan o Israel krik tradas.
Kote rakras o baro Dewel ap leskre budepangre, kai leskre rakepangre hi. Un kolla penan leskre laba i menshenge dureder. Job penas:

O Manasse, ko baro rai pral o them Juda, kras baro tchilatchepen, hoi djungleder hi har lauter, hoi i Amorarja kran, kai glan leste djiwan. Un job anas ninna i menshen dran o them Juda ap i tchilatcho drom peskre tsele mule deblentsa.
Doleske penell o baro Dewel, kai o Israeleskro Dewel hi: Me anau bibacht pral o foro Jerusalem un pral o them Juda. Hakeno, kai kowa shunella, rikrell peskre kanda i dukatar.

Un me kamau ko emligo koowa ap o foro Jerusalem te krell, har krom ap o foro Samaria. Un dau o fores sawi phagi har tchiwom ap o kheer Ahab. Un kamau i menshen dran o foro Jerusalem win thowell, jaake har tchare win thode wenna, un ap o shero tchiddo wenn.
Un kolla, kai mire menshendar pral atchenna, bitchrau mandar krik, un dau len an o wast kolendar, kai tchorenn o them win un lenn i menshen pandlo pentsa.
Mire menshe kran, hoi glan mande djungeles hi, un choiran man ko tselo tsiro, har lengre phure dran o them Egiptia win djan bis ap kau diwes.

Ninna mukas o Manasse bud menshen te marell, ap kolende kek doosh his. An o foro Jerusalem nashas lengro rat har pani. Koi pashel was koi doosh, hoi lo ap o them Juda anas, har anas lo i menshen ap i tchilatcho drom, kai kran le, hoi gar mishto hi an o baro Debleskre jaka.
Ko tselo wawar, hoi pral o Manasse penepaske hi, un halauter, hoi lo kras, ninna peskri doosh, hoi lo ap peste anas, kowa hi tchinlo an o familjakro liil kol bare rajendar pral o them Juda.
Un o Manasse meras un was paskedo an i baar pash leskro kheer, an koi baar, hoi o Usaes his. Un leskro tchawo, o Amon, was baro rai pal leste.
Har was o Amon baro rai, his lo biish-te-dui bersha phuro; un job his dui bersha baro rai an o foro Jerusalem. Leskri dai kharas Meshullemet, lakro dad his o Haruz dran Jotba.
Un o Amon kras, hoi tchilatcho hi glan o baro Debleskre jaka, jaake har leskro dad o Manasse les kras.
Un djas ap o tchilatcho drom, har leskro dad, un mangas i mule deblen an, har leskro dad kowa ninna kras, un witsras pes glan lende tele.
Un job mukas o baro Debles, ko Debles, koles leskre phure an-mangan, un djas gar ap o baro Debleskro drom.
Un i bare mursha an leskro them tchiwan pen tchorchanes khetne, un maran o rajes Amon an peskro kheer.
I mursha dran Juda dan halauteren mulo, kai pen khetne tchiwan te marenn le o baro rajes Amon. Un jon lan leskro tchawes, o Josia, te well lo baro rai pal leste.
Ko tselo wawar koowa, hoi o Amon kras, kowa hi tchinlo an o familjakro liil kol bare rajendar pral o them Juda.
Un jon paskran les an leskro mulengro kheer an i baar, hoi o Usaes his. Un leskro tchawo, o Josia, was rai pal leste.
O Josia his ochta bersha, har was lo baro rai; un job his 31 (trijanda-te-jek) bersha baro rai an o foro Jerusalem. Leskri dai kharas Jedida, lakro dad his o Adaja dran Bozkat.
Un job kras, hoi mishto hi glan o baro Debleskre jaka, un djas o drom, kai leskro phuro dad o David ninna djas, un peras gar kau dromestar tele, gar ap i tchatchi rig un witar gar ap i serwi rig.

Un har o Josia an o deesh-te-ochtato bersh baro rai his, bitchras lo o Shafan, kai i lila tchinas, an o baro Debleskro kheer. O Shafaneskro dad his o Azalja un leskro papo his o Meshullam. Un o Josia penas:
“Dja pral pash o baro rashajeste o Hilkija, te dikell lo palla, har bud kol lowe hi, hoi an o baro Debleskro kheer anlo was, hoi kol mursha, kai ap o wudar garda denna, i menshendar dren lan.
Un o rashai mu dell kol lowe kol murshenge an o wast, kai pral i budepangre tardo hi, kai ap o baro Debleskro kheer budrenna, te krenn le kowa pale newes, hoi ap o kheer paash djas.
Kal lowentsa hunte wenn kol mursha plaissedo, kai budrenn o kashteha, ninna kolla, kai tchiwenn i barra pre. Ninna kasht un tchinle barra wenna dre-ginlo kol lowentsa.
Kol pralstune budepangre krenn pengri budi an o tchatchepen. Doleske hunte putchell o rashai lendar gar, hoi le kol tsele lowentsa kran.”

Har o Shafan kowa lauter o baro rashajeha Hilkija rakras, penas kowa ap leste: “Me hatsom i liil an o baro Debleskro kheer, kai menge o Debleskro drom siklo wella.” Un o Hilkija das ko liil o Shafaneste, un kowa draweras les.

Un djas pash o baro rajeste un penas leske, har halauter djas, un penas: “Tire budepangre, i rashaja, lan kol tsele lowe win, hoi an o baro Debleskro kheer his, un dan len kol murshenge ap o wast, kai pral kolende hi, kai budrenna an o baro Debleskro kheer.”
O Shafan penas o baro rajeske ninna: “O rashai Hilkija das man i liil.” Un o Shafan draweras ko liil glan o baro rajeste.
Jaake was, har o baro rai i laba dran ko liil shunas, kras lo peskre koola paash, kai ap leste his.

Un o baro rai kharas kol murshen khetne: o rashai Hilkija, o Ahikam, ko his i tchawo o Shafanestar, o Achbor, koleskro dad o Mikaja hi, o Shafan, kai tchinas i lila, un o Asaja, ko his i pralstuno an o baro rajeskro kheer. Un o baro rai penas lenge:

“Djan koi un putchenn o baro Debles mange un i menshenge an o them Juda, pral kol laba an ko liil, hoi hatslo was. Mare phure shunan gar ap kol laba, hoi kote tardo hi, un djiwan gar jaake, har kote tele tchinlo hi. Doleske hi o baro Debleskri choli bares ap mende tchiddo.”

Kote djan o rashai Hilkija, o Ahikam, o Achbor, o Shafan un o Asaja pash i Debleskri rakepaskretsa Hulda. Koja djiwas an o newo kotar o forestar Jerusalem. Lakro rom his o Shallum. Leskro dad his o Tikwa. Koleskro dad his o Harha. O Shallum das garda ap o ripjengro kheer. Un kol mursha rakran lah.
Joi penas ap lende: Kawa penell o baro Dewel, ko Dewel pral o Israel: Penenn ko mursheske, kai tumen pash mande bitchras:

Kawa penell o baro Dewel: “Me anau tchilatchepen pral kau foro un pral i menshende, kai kate djiwenn. Ko tselo koowa, hoi an ko liil tardo hi, un hoi mukas peske o baro rai pral Juda glan te drawerell, anau pral tumende.
I menshe an Jerusalem mukan man un anan wawar deblenge viechen, te choirenn le man halautereha, hoi le pengre wastentsa kran; doleske well miri choli har i jag ap kau foro, un kek nai krell les win.”
Ko baro rajeske pral o them Juda, kowa kai tumen pash mande bitchras, te putchenn o baro Debles, nai penenn: Kawa penell o baro Dewel, ko Dewel pral o Israel: “Tu shunal kol laba an kau liil.

Un kral tiro dji lenge pre. Un kral tut tiknes glan o baro Debleste, har tu shunal, hoi me penom pral kau foro un kol menshende, kai kate djiwenna, te djal lenge jaake djungeles, te atchell wawar menshenge o rakepen krik i trashatar. Un kowa, kai kamell te well i bibacht pral i wawareste, penella: ‘Tuke te djal, har djas o foreske Jerusalem!’ Har tu kowa shunal, kral tire koola paash, kai ap tute his, un rowal glan mande. Doleske shunom me tut ninna”, penell o baro Dewel.

“Un anau kai bibacht gar pral kau foro jaake rah har tu djiweh. Tu dikeh lat gar tire jakentsa. Me mukau tut an o latchepen te merell. Un tu weh paskedo an o mulengro kheer tire phurendar.” Un kol mursha penan kal laba o baro rajeske.
Un o baro rai, o Josia, bitchras peskre bitchepangre, un mukas i tsele phureder an o them Juda un an o foro Jerusalem pash peste khetne gole te dell.

Un job djas pral an o baro Debleskro kheer. Un khetne leha djan i tsele mursha dran o them Juda un i tsele menshe, kai djiwan an o foro Jerusalem, i rashaja un o Debleskre rakepangre un kol wawar menshe, tikne un bare. Un kote mukas lo glan lende i tsele laba te drawerell dran ko liil, hoi an o baro Debleskro kheer hatslo was, kai tchinlo hi, hoi o Dewel peskre menshendar kamella.

Un o baro rai his ap ko pralstuno kotar tardo glan o Debleskro kheer un das o baro Debleste peskro lab, te djan le ap o Debleskro drom, un rikrenn leskre laba, un djiwenn jaake, har job len sikras un pal leskro tchatchepen. Pengro tselo djijeha un pengri tseli sorjah kaman le pal kal laba te djiwenn, hoi o Dewel len das, un hoi an kau liil tchinlo hi. Un i tsele menshe pandan pen an pengro lab, te rikrenn le kowa, hoi an o liil tchinlo hi.

Un o baro rai penas o pralstuno rashajeske Hilkija un wawar bare rashajenge, un kolenge, kai denn garda ap o wudar, te witsrenn le dran o baro Debleskro kheer kol tsele koola win, hoi kol deblenge Baal un Ashera un kol tsele bolepangre momelenge kerdo wan. Un job mukas halauter te chatchrell an i jag, win glan o foro Jerusalem an o telstuno them, hoi kharell Kidron. Un i jagakri tchik mukas lo an o foro Betel te anell.

Un job bitchras i rashajen krik, kai i mule deblenge budrenn, un kolen i bare raja pral o them Juda mukan te well, te chatchrenn le sungepaskro koowa ap i mulne platse an i forja an o them Juda un trul o foro Jerusalem. Kol mule debla, kolenge chatchran le sungepaskro koowa, his: o Baal, o kham un o tchon, un i tsele bolepangre momlia.

Un o Josia mukas koi kashteni debletsa Ashera dran o baro Debleskro kheer te anell glan o foro Jerusalem pash ko tikno pani, kai kharell Kidron. Un kote mukas lo lat te chatchrell. Un hoi latar pral atchas, mukas lo tiknes te krell har phubjakri tchik, un tchiwas kowa khetne koi jagakri tchik ap o handako, kai i tchorwele paskedo wan.
Un job mukas kol tsele lubjengre khera tele te phagell, kai pash o baro Debleskro kheer tardo his. An kol khera kran i djuwja ripja i Asherake.

Un job mukas i tsele rashajen dran o them Juda an o foro Jerusalem te well, un kras i mulne platse pale-tchiddo, kai i rashaja i mule deblenge sungepaskro koowa chatchran. Kowa kras lo an o tselo them mank o foro Geba un o foro Beersheba. Un job phagas koi chatchepaskri tele, hoi his tardo glan ko wudar, hoi o moskro, o Josua, kras, ap i serwi rig, te well jek an o foro dren.

Kol rashaja, kai kol chochene deblenge budran, nai chan ko maro, kai kek shutlo jarro dren hi, khetne i wawar rashajentsa. Jon hunte chatchrenn kek viechen ap koi sasterni chatchepaskri o baro Deblestar an o foro Jerusalem.

O Josia kras ninna koi platsa pale-tchiddo, hoi kharella Tofet, un hi an i tala Hinnom tchiddo. Kowa kras lo, te nai chatchrell kek peskro tchawes witar gar peskri tchai an i jag o chocheno debleske Moloch.

Un job mukas i grajen krik te anell un i wurdja te chatchrell, kolen i bare raja pral o them Juda koi anan, te mangenn le o kham an. Kol graja un kol wurdja his tardo ap i platsa glan o baro Debleskro kheer, pash koi isema, kai djiwas o pralstuno, o Natan-Melech.

Un job kras kol chatchepangre paash, hoi pral ap o kheer koi tardo his, kai o Ahases leskri isema his. Kol chatchepangren mukan i bare raja pral o them Juda te krell. Ninna kolla, kai o Manasse kras, phagas lo tele. Kolla his tardo ap kol dui platse glan o baro Debleskro kheer. Un o Josia djas koi un witsras lengri tchik an ko tikno pani, hoi kharell Kidron.

Ninna kras lo kol mulne platse pale-tchiddo, hoi kras o Salomo, ko baro rai pral Israel. Kolla his tardo ap koi rig o forestar Jerusalem, kai o kham pre-djal, ap i tchatchi rig o djeteskri bergatar. O Salomo kras len, te wenn kote kol djungele mule debla an-mangedo: i Astarte, koi debletsa dran Sidon; un o Kemosh, ko dewel dran o them Moab; un o Milkom, ko dewel dran o them Ammon.
Job phagas kol bare barra paash, hoi le pengre deblenge pre-tchiwan, un das kol figure tele, hoi sikran i Ashera. Un kote, kai le tardo his, witsras lo menshengre kokale pre.

Ninna koi mulni platsa an Betel kras lo paash, hoi o Jerobeam, ko Nebateskro tchawo kras, te anell lo o Israel o baro Debleskro dromestar tele. Koi chatchepaskri phagas lo tele, das lakre barra paash un kras len jaake tiknes, te wan le phubjakri tchik. Un i figura, hoi sikras i debletsa Ashera, chatchras lo pre.

Glan kowa dikas o Josia trujel un dikas i handako ap koi berga, un bitchras koi un mukas i mulengre kokale win te lell un chatchras len ap i chatchepaskri un kras lat pale-tchiddo, jaake har o baro Debleskro rakepaskro win kharas.

Un job dikas pes trujel un putchas: “Koon hi kote paskedo?” Un i menshe dran o foro penan ap leste: “Kote hi ko Debleskro mursh paskedo, kai dran o them Juda was, un wi-kharas, hoi tu kral ap kai chatchepaskri kate an Betel.”
Un job penas: “Mukenn les tchiddo! Kek tumendar hunte lell leskre kokale win!” Jaake atchan leskre kokale tchiddo, ninna kol kokale ko Debleskro rakepaskrestar, kai was dran Samaria.

Un o Josia las ninna i mangepaskre khera an i forja an o them Samaria krik. Kolen kran i bare raja pral o them Israel, te krenn le o baro Debles chojedo. Un o Josia kras halauter jaake har lo kowa an o foro Betel kras.
Un mukas i tsele rashajen, kai i mule deblenge budran, te marell ap lengre chatchepangre, un chatchras menshengre kokale koi pre. Un palle was lo pale an o foro Jerusalem.

Un o baro rai, o Josia, mukas i menshenge soreles te penell: “Krenn tumaro baro Debleske ko chapen, hoi kharell Passa, jaake har tchinlo hi an ko liil, kai tardo hi, hoi o Dewel peskre menshendar kamella!”

Un kek Passa was jaake rikedo har kawa, hoi jon kanna kran, gar an ko tsiro, kai i tchatchepangre raja i menshenge an Israel o tchatchepen penan, un witar gar an ko tsiro pal lende, kai bare raja pral o Israel un o pral o Juda his.
Kau chapen Passa was o baro Debleske rikedo an o deesh-te-ochtato bersh o baro rajestar Josia an o foro Jerusalem.

Ninna tradas o Josia i tsele drawepangren krik, un kolen, kai i mulen putchenn, un mukas i khereskre deblen un i wawar chochene deblen krik te anell dran o them Juda un dran o foro Jerusalem. Kowa kras lo, te well halauter jaake kerdo, har tchinlo hi an ko liil, kai lenge o Debleskro drom siklo well, – ko liil, hoi o rashai Hilkija an o baro Debleskro kheer hatsas.

Kek baro rai his glan leste, kai was jaake har o Josia pash o baro Debleste peskro tselo djijeha un peskro tselo djipah un peskri tseli sorjah, un djiwas jaake har an o Moseskre lila tchinlo hi. Un pal leste his witar kek har job.
Ninna te kras o Josia kowa lauter, mukas o baro Dewel gar tele peskri choljah, hoi les his pral o them Juda, fothe choiras les ko tselo djungelo koowa, hoi o Manasse kras.

Un o baro Dewel penas: “Me kamau ninna i menshen dran o them Juda mandar krik te tchiwell, jaake har me kolen dran o them Israel mandar krik tchiwom. Un kamau kau foro pale te tchiwell, kau foro Jerusalem, hoi me mange wi-rodom, un ko kheer, kolestar me penom: ‘Kamoms te mangenn le man kote an.’”
Ko tselo wawar koowa, hoi pral o Josia penepaske hi, un halauter, hoi lo kras, kowa hi tchinlo an o familjakro liil o bare rajendar pral o them Juda.

An ko tsiro djas o Farao Necho, ko baro rai pral o them Egiptia, pral pash ko pani, hoi kharella Eufrat, te kurell lo pes o baro rajeha pral o them Assur. Un o baro rai Josia tchiwas pes leske an o drom. Un o Necho maras les pash o foro Megiddo, har lo les dikas.

Un i mursha, kai pash leste his, tchiwan ko mules ap o wurdin un anan les dran Megiddo win an o foro Jerusalem, un paskran les an leskro mulengro kheer. Un i mursha dran o them Juda kharan leskro tchawes, o Joahas, un tchoran makepaskro djet pral leste, te well job lengro baro rai pal leskro dadeste.
Biish-te-triin (23) bersh his o Joahas phuro, har lo baro rai was. Un job his triin tchonna baro rai an o foro Jerusalem. Leskri dai kharas Hamutal. Lakro dad his o Jirmeja dran Libna.
Un job kras, hoi tchilatcho hi glan o baro Debleskre jaka, jaake har leskre phure kran.

O Farao Necho tchiwas les stildes an o foro Ribla an o them Hamat, te atchell lo buder gar baro rai an o foro Jerusalem. Un job tchiwas i sijaan ap o them: 70 (efta-deesh) zentnarja rup un 35 (trijanda te pantch) kilogramme sonakai.

Un o Farao Necho kras, te well o Josijeskro tchawo, o Eljakim, baro rai pal leskro dadeste Josia. Un das les i wawar lab un kharas les Jojakim. Leskro phrales, o Joahas, las lo peha un anas les an o them Egiptia; kote meras lo.

Un o Jojakim das o rup un o sonakai o Faraeske. Doleske hunte tchiwas lo i sijaan ap o them, te nai anell lo kol lowe khetne, hoi o Farao kamella. Hakenestar dran o them las lo jaake bud rup un sonakai dren, har koles brawlepen hi, te nai dell lo les o Farao Necho.
Biish-te-pantch bersh phuro his o Jojakim, har lo baro rai was; un job his deesh-te-jek bersh baro rai an o foro Jerusalem. Leskri dai kharas Sebuda. Lakro dad his o Pedaja dran Ruma.
Un job kras, hoi tchilatcho his glan o baro Debleskre jaka, jaake har leskre phure kran.

An ko tsiro, har o Jojakim o baro rai his, djas o baro rai dran o them Babilonia peskre lurdentsa pre ap o them Juda. Leskro lab his Nebukadnezar. Un o Jojakim hunte witsras pes tel leste un hunte plaissras leske bud lowe. Pal triin bersha phagas lo leha un kras buder gar, hoi kowa kamas.

Un o baro Dewel mukas bud lurden pral leste te well, kai trujel djan un randan an o them Juda. Kolla wan dran i themma Babilonia, Syria, Moab, un Ammon, un kran o them paash. Kowa was jaake, har o baro Dewel rakras ap peskre rakepangre, kai leske koi his, un har jon kowa i menshenge dureder penan.

Tchatchepah koi bibacht was jaake pral i menshende an o them Juda, har o baro Dewel penas, te tchiwell lo len pestar krik ko bud tchilatchepaske, hoi o Manasse kras. Kowa anas i menshen o Debleskro dromestar tele,
un maras bud sawen, kai kek tchilatchepen kran, un anas lengro rat pral peste. Un o tselo foro Jerusalem his pherdo rat. Kau koowa kamas o baro Dewel gar te bistrell.
Kowa, hoi budeder penepaske hi pral o Jojakim, un halauter, hoi lo kras, kowa hi tchinlo an i familjakro liil i bare rajendar pral o them Juda.
Un o Jojakim meras un was paskedo pash peskre phurende. Un leskro tchawo, o Jojachin, was baro rai pal leste.

Un o baro rai pral o them Egiptia djas buder gar dran peskro them win. O baro rai pral o them Babilonia las leske halauter krik, hoi lo peske dren las: o tselo them mank o them Egiptia un o pani Eufrat.

Deesh-te-ochta bersh his o Jojachin, har lo baro rai was. Un job his baro rai triin tchonna, un djiwas an ko tsiro an o foro Jerusalem. Leskri dai kharas Nehushta. Lakro dad his o Elnatan dran o foro Jerusalem.
Un o Jojachin kras, hoi djungeles his an o baro Debleskre jaka, jaake har leskro dad ninna kras.
An ko tsiro bitchras ko rai pral o them Babilonia, o Nebukadnezar, peskre lurden pash o foro Jerusalem. Un jon tchiwan pen trul ko tselo foro, te nai nashell kek dran o foro win te dren.
Un o Nebukadnezar was pash ko foro, har leskre lurde ninna koi tardo his, un mukan kekes dren te win.

Un o Jojachin, ko rai pral o them Juda, das pes an i wasta ko rajestar dran o them Babilonia, un djas win pash leste: job un leskri dai un leskre pralstune budepangre un bare lurde, ninna kol raja, kai an leskro kheer his. Un o Nebukadnezar, ko baro rai dran o them Babilonia, tchiwas les stildes. An ko tsiro his o Nebukadnezar an o ochtato bersh baro rai.

Un job las peske o tselo brawlepen, hoi his an o baro Debleskro kheer un an o rajeskro kheer. Un kol tsele sonakangre koola, hoi mukas o Israeleskro rai, o Salomo, te krell o baro Debleskro khereske, kowa mukas o Nebukadnezar khetne te dell. Lauter was jaake, har o baro Dewel les penas.

Un o Nebukadnezar anas i tsele menshen dran o foro Jerusalem an peskro them Babilonia, i pralstune, i bare lurde, un i tsele budepangre, kai nai budran mishto o kashteha un o sasteha. Kolla lauter his 10.000 (deesh serja) pandle. Kek atchas pale, kokres i tchorwele an o them.

Un job mukas an o them Babilonia te anell: o Jojachin un leskri dai un leskre romja; kol raja, kai an leskro kheer his; ninna pandas lo an o foro Jerusalem i pralstunen pral o them Juda, un anas len an o them Babilonia;
koi pashel 7.000 kol feteder murshendar; un 1.000 mursha kolendar, kai nai budran mishto o kashteha un o sasteha; un i tsele kurepangre. Kolen lauteren anas lo an o pandepen an o them Babilonia.
Un o baro rai pral o them Babilonia las o Jojachineskro kak, – leskro lab his Mattanja – un kras, te well lo o baro rai pal o Jojachin pral o them Juda, un das les i wawar lab, un kharas les Zedekja.
Biish-te-jek bersh his o Zedekja, har lo baro rai was; un deesh-te-jek bersha his lo baro rai an o foro Jerusalem. Leskri dai kharas Hamutal. Lakro dad his o Jirmeja dran Libna.
Un o Zedekja kras, hoi djungeles his glan o baro Debleskre jaka, jaake har o Jojakim ninna kras.

Kowa halauter kras o baro Debles jaake chojedo pral o foro Jerusalem un o them Juda, te tradas lo len pestar krik. Un o Zedekja phagas o baro rajeha pral o them Babilonia, un kras buder gar, hoi kowa kamas.

Har o Zedekja an o enjato bersh baro rai his, was o baro rai pral o them Babilonia, o Nebukadnezar, peskre tsele lurdentsa pre glan o foro Jerusalem. Kowa his ap o deshto diwes an o deshto tchon. Un job tchiwas peskre lurden trul o tselo foro, un mukas tchik pre te witsrell trul o foro, te krell lo i drom, hoi djal pral ap o foreskri massuri.
Jaake was ko foro dren pandlo bis an o deesh-te-jekto bersh, kai o Zedekja baro rai his.
Ap o enjato diwes an o starto tchon was i bok bares an o foro, un i menshen his buder tchi te chal.

Kote phagan i Babilonarja an o foro dren. Un an koi rati nashan i tsele kurepangre win dran ko wudar mashkral kol dui massurja, hoi hi pash o rajeskro baar, ninna te his i Babilonarja trul o foro tchiddo. Koi nashas o Zedekja peskre lurdentsa an o telstuno them, kai o pani Jordan nashell.

Un i lurde dran o them Babilonia lan sik o baro rajeske Zedekja palla. Un jon lan les dren un tapran les an o telstuno them pash o foro Jericho. Un kol tsele kurepangre, kai pash leste his, nashan penge lestar krik, un mukan les.
I lurde dran o them Babilonia lan o baro rajes Zedekja un pandan les un anan les an o foro Ribla pash o baro rajeste pral o them Babilonia. Un jon rakran i phagi pral leste win.
Un leskre mursh tchawen maran le kote glan leskre jaka. Un leske wan i jaka win dino. Un jon pandan les sasterne shellentsa un anan les an o them Babilonia.

O baro rajes pral o them Babilonia, o Nebukadnezar, les his i baro lurdo an peskro kheer. Koleskro lab his Nebusaradan. Job his o pralstuno pral i lurdende. Har his o Nebukadnezar an o deesh-te-enjato bersh o baro rai pral o them Babilonia, koi was o Nebusaradan ap o eftato diwes an o pantchto tchon an o foro Jerusalem.
Un job chatchras o baro Debleskro kheer tele, ninna ko kheer o baro rajestar un kol wawar khera an o foro Jerusalem; awa, hako baro kheer chatchras lo tele.
Un kol tsele lurde dran o them Babilonia, kai leha wan, phagan i massurja trul o foro Jerusalem tele.

Un kol menshen, kai pral atchan an o foro Jerusalem, anas o Nebusaradan pandles krik an o them Babilonia, ninna kolla, kai dan pen an o wast o baro rajestar pral o them Babilonia, khetne kolentsa, kai pral atchan kol budendar, kai glan i tsiro koi djiwan.
Kokres i tchorwelendar an o them mukas lo sawe koi, te budrenn le ap o drakengro them un ap o hachetikro them.

Un i lurde dran Babilonia phagan i bare turme paash, hoi dran lolo saster kerdo wan un glan o kheer o baro Deblestar tardo his. Ninna phagan le kol wurdja an kotja un ko thopaskro tcharo, hoi dran lolo saster kerdo was, un hoi an o baro Debleskro kheer tardo his. Un ko tselo lolo saster anan i Babilonarja an o them Babilonia.

Ninna lan le pentsa krik kol pirja, bare roja, i tchinepangre, kolentsa i dorja an i momlia tele tchinlo wenn, un tchare, kai sungepaskro koowa dren well un o tselo wawar koowa dran lolo saster, kai budran le leha an o Debleskro kheer.
Ninna kol jagakre tchare un kol bare tchare, kai o rat dren nashell, halauter, hoi dran sonakai un rup kerdo was, las ko pralstuno, o Nebusaradan, krik.
Kolla dui turme, ko baro thopaskro tcharo un kol wurdja, kai o Salomo mukas te krell o baro Debleskro khereske, kolla lauter his dran jaake bud lolo saster kerdo, te djinas kek, har phares kowa his.

Enja metarja his kol dui turme bares tarde. Un lengre sherja his ninna dran lolo saster kote pre kerdo. Hako shero his jek te paash metarja bares tardo. Un trul hako shero his i shukar pandepen phabjentsa, halauter dran lolo saster. Jek turmo his har ko wawar.
Un o pralstuno lurdo las o pralstuno rashajes, o Seraja, pandlo, ninna ko rashajes Zefanja, kai was pal o Seraja, un ninna kol triin murshen, kai dan jak ap o wudar.

Un an o foro his gomme: ko pralstunes pral i lurdende; wawar pantch murshen, kai an hako tsiro glan o baro rajeste nai wan; ko tchinepaskro, kai i laba i lurdendar pre tchinas un i lurden win rodas; un shob-deesh wawar bare mursha.
Kolen halauteren las o Nebusaradan, ko pralstuno lurdo pandlo, un anas len pash o baro rajeste an o foro Ribla an o them Babilonia.
Un o baro rai pral o them Babilonia mukas len temerl te dell an o foro Ribla an ko kotar them, hoi kharell Hamat. Jaake wan i menshe dran o them Juda krik anlo dran pengro them.
Pral kol menshende, kai pral atchan an o them Juda, kolen o Nebukadnezar, ko rai pral o them Babilonia, pral mukas, tchiwas lo o murshes Gedalja, koleskro dad o Ahikam his, koleskro dad o Shafan his.

Un har i pralstune lurde dran Juda shunan, kai o baro rai pral o them Babilonia o Gedaljes pral o them Juda dren tchiwas, wan le i lurdentsa pash o Gedalja an o foro Mizpa. Kol pralstune lurde his: o Jishmael, koleskro dad o Netanja his; o Johanan, koleskro dad o Kareach his; o Seraja, koleskro dad o Tanhumet his dran Netofa un o Jaasanja dran Maacha.

Un o Gedalja das pes glan lende un kol wawar murshende sowel un penas ap lende: “Ma trashenn i lurdendar dran o them Babilonia! Atchenn an o them un budrenn o baro rajeske dran o them Babilonia, palle djal tumenge mishto.”

Un an o eftato tchon was o Jishmael, koleskro dad o Netanja his, koleskro dad o Elishama his. Kolla his dran o baro rajeskri familja. Un deesh mursha his pash leste. Un jon dan o Gedaljes temerl. Koi pashel maran le ninna kol murshen dran o them Juda un dran o them Babilonia, kai pash leste his an o foro Mizpa.
Un i darjatar glan i Babilonarja kran pen i tsele menshe an o them ap o drom, tikne un bare. Un i pralstune lurde his ninna pashel. Un jon nashan penge an o them Egiptia.

Har o Ewil-Merodach o baro rai pral Babilonia was, mukas lo gomme an kau bersh o Jojachin, ko rajes pral o them Juda dran o stilepen te lell. Kowa his an o 37. (trijanda-te-eftato) bersh, har o Jojachin krik anlo was, ap o 27. (biish-te-eftato) diwes an o deesh-te-duito tchon.
Un o Ewil-Merodach rakras kamles leha, un hadas les pral kol wawar raja, kai pash leste his an o them Babilonia.
Un o Jojachin tchiwas kol ripja pestar krik, hoi les an o stilepen ap leste his, un chas peskro tselo djipen pash o baro rajeste ap leskri chapaskri.
Un leske was dran o baro rajeskro wast hako diwes kowa dino, hoi les hunte well djipaske, jaake rah har job djiwas.
O Adam, o Set, o Enosh,
o Kenan, o Mahalalel, o Jered
o Henoch, o Metuselach, o Lamech
o Noah, o Sem, o Ham, o Jafet.
O Jafet: Leskre tchawe his: o Gomer, o Magog, o Madai, o Jawan, o Tubal, o Meshech un o Tiras.
O Gomer: Leskre tchawe his: o Ashkenas, o Difat un o Togarma.
O Jawan: leskre tchawe his: o Elisha, o Tarsis, i Kitarja un i Rodanarja.
O Ham: Leskre tchawe his: o Kush, o Mizrajim, o Put un o Kanaan.
O Kush: Leskre tchawe his: o Seba, o Hawila, o Sabta, o Ragma, un o Sabteka. O Ragma: Leskre tchawe his: o Saba un o Dedan.
O Kush his o phuro dad ko murshestar Nimrod. Kowa his o ersto, kai kras pes lo i sorelo ap kai phub.
O Mizrajim: Leskre tchawe his: i Ludarja, i Anamarja, i Lehabarja, i Naftuharja,
ninna i Patrusarja, un i Kasluharja un i Kaftorarja; kolendar wan i Filistarja.
O Kanaan: leskro phureder tchawo his o Sidon. Pal leste was o Het,
ninna i Jebusarja, i Amorarja, un i Girgasharja,
un i Hiwarja, i Arkarja, un i Sinarja,
un i Arwadarja, i Zemararja, un i Hamatarja.
O Sem: Leskre tchawe his: o Elam, o Assur, o Arpaksad, o Lud, o Aram, o Uz, o Hul, o Geter, un o Meshech.
O Arpaksad: leskro tchawo his o Shelach. Koleskro tchawo his o Eber.

O Eber: Leske wan dui tchawe boldo. Ko jek kharas Peleg. An leskro tsiro atchan i menshe buder gar khetne. Haki bari familja las peskro them. Doleske was lo Peleg kharedo. Un o lab leskro phralestar his Joktan.
O Joktan: Leskre tchawe his: o Almodad, o Shelef, o Hazarmawet, o Jerach,
o Hadoram, o Usal, un o Dikla,
o Ebal, o Abimael un o Saba,
o Ofir, o Hawila un o Jobab. Kolla halauter wan pal o Joktan.
Kolla wan pal o Sem: leskro tchawo his o Arpaksad, lestar was o Shelach,
lestar was o Eber, lestar was o Peleg, lestar was o Regu,
lestar was o Serug, lestar was o Nahor, lestar was o Terach,
lestar was o Abram, kowa hi o Abraham.
O Abraham his o dad dui mursh tchawendar: o Isaak un o Ismael.
O Ismaeles his deesh-te-jek tchawe, kai jaake boldo wan: O phureder his o Nebajot. Pal leste was o Kedar un o Adbeel, un o Mibsam,
o Mishma un o Duma, o Massa, o Hadad, un o Tema,
o Jetur, o Nafish, un o Kedema. Kolendar lauterendar his o Ismael o dad.
O Abrahames his shob tchawe peskri duiti romjatar Ketura: o Simran, o Jokshan, o Medan, o Midian, o Jishbak un o Shuach. O Jokshan his o dad dui mursh tchawendar: o Saba un o Dedan.
O Midian his o dad kol murshendar: o Efa, o Efer, o Henoch, o Abida, un o Eldaa. Kolendar halauterendar his i Ketura i dai.
O Abraham: Leskro tchawo his o Isaak. Koleskre tchawe his o Esau un o Jakob (Israel).
O Esau: Leskre tchawe his: o Elifas, o Reguel, o Jehush, o Jalam, un o Korach.
O Elifas: Leskre tchawe his: o Teman, un o Omar, o Zefi un o Gatam, o Kenas, i Timna un o Amalek.
O Reguel: Leskre tchawe his: o Nahat, o Serach, o Shamma un o Missa.
O Seir: Leskre tchawe his: o Lotan, o Shobal, o Zibon, o Ana, o Dishon, o Ezer un o Dishan.
O Lotan: Leskre tchawe his: o Hori un o Hemam. O Lotaneskri pheen his i Timna.
O Shobal: Leskre tchawe his: o Alwan, o Manahat, o Ebal, o Shefi, un o Onam. O Zibon: Leskre tchawe his o Aja un o Ana.
O Ana: Leskro tchawo his o Dishon. Un koleskre tchawe his: o Hemdan, o Eshban, o Jitran, un o Keran.
O Ezer: Leskre tchawe his. o Bilhan, o Saawan, un o Akan. O Dishan: Leskre tchawe his o Uz un o Aran.
Kalla hi i bare raja an o them Edom, glan ko tsiro, kai i Israelitarjen i baro rai his: Jaake kharenn le: o Bela, koleskro dad o Beor his, un leskro foro kharas Dinhaba.
Har o Bela meras, was pal leste o Jobab o rai, koleskro dad o Serach his, dran Bozra.
Har o Jobab meras, was pal leste o Husham o rai dran o them Teman.
Har o Husham meras, was pal leste o Hadad o rai, koleskro dad o Bedad his. Kowa kuras pes i Midianarja, un das len an o them Moab, un was o sorleder. Un leskro foro kharas Awit.
Har o Hadad meras, was pal leste o Samla dran Masreka o rai.
Har o Samla meras, was pal leste o Shaul dran Rechobot o rai. O foro Rechobot hi tchiddo pash o lengsto pani.
Har o Shaul meras, was pal leste o Baal-Hanan o rai, koleskro dad o Akbor his.
Har o Baal-Hanan meras, was pal leste o Hadad o rai. Un leskro foro kharas Pagu. Un leskri romni his i Mehetabel, kolakri dai i Matred his, un kolakro papo o Mesahab his.
Un har o Hadad meras, his kolla i pralstune raja pral Edom: o Timna, o Alwa, o Jetet,
o Oholibama, o Ela, o Pinon,
o Kenas, o Teman, o Mibzar,
o Magdijel, un o Iram. Kolla his i pralstune pral Edom.
Kalla hi o Israeleskre mursh tchawe: o Ruben, o Simeon, o Levi, un o Juda, o Issachar, un o Sebulon,
o Dan, o Josef un o Benjamin, o Naftali, o Gad un o Asser.

O Juda his o dad triin mursh tchawendar: o Er, o Onan un o Shela. Kolla triin wan leske bolde peskri romjatar, koi Kanaanitetsa, kolakro dad o Shua his. Un o Er, ko phureder tchawo his tchilatches an i jaka o baro Deblestar; doleske maras lo les.
Un i Tamar, leskro tchaweskri romni anas leske o Perez un o Serach ap i phub. Jaake his o Juda o dad pantch mursh tchawendar.
O Perez: Leskre tchawe his: o Hezron un o Hamul.
O Serach: Leskre tchawe his: o Simri, o Etan, o Heman un o Kalkol un o Darda; khetne his le pantch.
O Karmi: Leskro tchawo his o Achan. Kowa anas Israel an i bibacht. Job rikras peske sawo koowa, hoi o baro Debleske his.
O Etan: Leskro tchawo his o Asarja.
O Hezron: Leskre tchawe his: o Jerachmeel un o Ram un o Kelubai.
O Ram: Leskro tchawo his o Amminadab, un koleskro tchawo his o Nachshon, ko pralstuno pral o kheer Juda.
O Nachshon: Leskro tchawo his o Salma, un koleskro tchawo his o Boas.
Un koleskro tchawo his o Obed, un koleskro tchawo his o Isai.
Un o Isai las tchawe: o phureder his o Eliab, o duito his o Abinadab, o Shimea his o triinto,
o Netanel his o starto, o Raddai his o pantchto,
o Ozem his o shobto, o David his o eftato.
Un lengre phenja his: i Zeruja un i Abigail. Un i tchawe fun i Zeruja his: o Abishai un o Joab un o Asahel; khetne his le triin.
Un i Abigail was i dai ko murshestar Amasa. Leskro dad his o Jeter, ko Ismaelari.
O Kaleb, koleskro dad o Hezron his, romedineras i Asuba. Lengri tchai his i Jeriot. Un lakre tchawe his: o Jesher, o Shobab, un o Ardon.
Un har i Asuba meras, las peske o Kaleb i Efrata, un joi anas leske o Hur ap i phub.
Koleskro tchawo his o Uri, un koleskro tchawo his o Bezalel.
Har o Hezron shob-deesh bersha phuro his, romedineras lo i tchat ko murshestar Machir, koleskro dad o Gilead his. Un joi anas leske i tchawo ap i phub. Ko kharas Segub.
Koleskro tchawo his o Jair. Koles his biish-te-triin forja an o them Gilead.

Pal i tsiro wan i Geshurarja un i Syrarja, un lan lenge shob-deesh forja krik. Mashkral lende his kol ‘Jaireskre gaba’ un ko foro Kenat un kol gaba trujel. Hakeno an ko kotar them was pal ko mursheste Machir, koleskro dad o Gilead his.
Un har o Hezron meras, romedineras o Kaleb i Efrata, koi romjat peskro dadestar Hezron. Un joi anas leske o Ashhur ap i phub. Kowa kras o foro Tekoa.
O Jerachmeel, ko phureder tchawo ko murshestar Hezron, las tchawe: o phureder his o Ram, pal leste was o Buna, o Oren un o Ozem un o Achija.
Un o Jerachmeeles his koi pashel i wawar romni. Koja kharas Atara. Lakro tchawo his o Onam.
O Ram, ko phureder tchawo o murshestar Jerachmeel las tchawe: o Maaz, o Jamin un o Eker.
O Onam: Leskre tchawe his: o Shammai un o Jada. O Shammai his o dad kol dui murshendar: o Nadab un o Abishur.
O Abishures his i romni. Lakro lab his Abihajil. Un joi anas leske o Achban un o Molid ap i phub.
O Nadab: Leskre tchawe his: o Seled un o Appajim. O Seled meras un les his kek tchawe.
O Appajimeskro tchawo his o Jishi. Un koleskro tchawo his o Sheshan. Un koleskro tchai his i Achlai.
O Jada, ko phraal fun o Shammai, les his dui tchawe: o Jeter un o Jonatan. Un o Jeter meras un les his kek tchawe.
O Jonatan, les his dui tchawe: o Pelet un o Sasa. Kalla his i mursha, kai wan pal o Jerachmeel.
Un o Sheshan, les his kek mursh tchawe. Kokres tcha wan les. Un les his i budepaskro, kowa was dran o them Egiptia un kharas Jarha.
Leske das o Sheshan jek peskre tchendar, te well li leskri romni. Koja anas leske i tchawes ap i phub. Kowa his o Attai.
Koleskro tchawo his o Natan. Koleskro tchawo his o Sabad.
Koleskro tchawo his o Eflal. Koleskro tchawo his o Obed.
Koleskro tchawo his o Jehu. Koleskro tchawo his o Asarja.
Koleskro tchawo his o Helez. Koleskro tchawo his o Elasa.
Koleskro tchawo his o Sismai. Koleskro tchawo his o Shallum.
Koleskro tchawo his o Jekamja. Koleskro tchawo his o Elishama.
O Kaleb, koleskro phraal o Jerachmeel his, les his tchawe: leskro phureder his o Mesha. Koleskro tchawo his o Sif. O duito his o Maresha. Koleskro tchawo his o Hebron.
O Hebron: Leskre tchawe his: o Korach, o Tappuach, o Rekem, un o Shema.
O Shema: Leskro tchawo his o Raham, koleskro tchawo his o Jorkoam. O Rekem: Leskro tchawo his o Shammai.
Koleskro tchawo his o Maon. Koleskro tchawo his o Bet-Zur.
O Kaleb, les his budeder romja. Jek kharas Efa. Joi anas o Haran, o Moza un o Gases ap i phub. O Haraneskro tchawo his o Jahdai.
Koleskre tchawe his: o Regem, o Jotam, o Geshan, o Pelet, o Efa, un o Shaaf.
Jek wawar romni ko murshestar Kaleb his i Maacha. Joi anas o Sheber un o Tirhana ap i phub.
Un joi las ninna o Shaaf. Koleskre tchawe his o Madmanna, un o Shewa. O Shewa his o dad kol murshendar Machbena un Gibea. Un i Achsa his o Kalebeskri tchai.

Kolla his i tchawe ko murshestar Kaleb. O Hur his o phureder leskri romjatar Efrata. Leskre tchawe his: o Shobal, o Salma un o Haref. O Shobal kras ko foro Kirjat-Jearim. O Salma kras ko foro Betlehem. Un o Haref kras ko foro Bet-Gader.
Un o Shobal, – kowa, kai kras o foro Kirjat-Jearim, lestar was i familja Reaja, kolla his o paash kolendar, kai djiwenn an o foro Manahat.
An Kirjat-Jearim djiwan: i Jeterarja un i Putarja, un i Shumatarja un i Mishrarja, kolendar wenn i menshe, kai djiwenn an i forja Zora un Eshtaol.
O Salma, leskre tchawe his: Kolla, kai djiwenn an i forja Betlehem, Netofa, Atrot-Bet-Joab, un i paash kolendar, kai djiwenn an Manahat. Kolla wan dran Zora.

Ko murshestar Salma wan ninna kol tchinepangre, kai tchinan an lila, hoi djas an o them. Jon djiwan an o foro Jabez. Kolla his i Tirarja, i Shimatarja, i Sucharja. Kolla hi i Kenarja, un wan pal o Hammat. Kowa his o phuro dad kolendar dran o kheer Rechab.

Un kolla his i tchawe o rajestar David, kolla kai wan leske boldo an o foro Hebron: leskro phureder his o Amnon. Leskri dai his i Ahinoam dran Jesreel. Ko duito his o Daniel. Leskri dai his i Abigajil dran Karmel.
O triinto his o Absalom. Leskri dai his i Maacha, kolakro dad his o Talmai. Kowa his o rai pral Geshur. O starto his o Adonija. Leskri dai his i Haggit.
O pantchto his o Shefatja. Leskri dai his i Abital. O shobto his o Jitream. Leskri dai his i Egla.
Kolla shob wan leske an o foro Hebron boldo. Kote his lo o baro rai efta bersha un shob tchon. Palle djiwas lo an o foro Jerusalem. Kote his lo trijanda bersha o baro rai.
Un kalla wan leske an o foro Jerusalem boldo: o Shimea un o Shobab un o Natan un o Salomo: Kol starendar hi i Batsheba i dai. Kolakro dad his o Ammijel.
O Davideskre wawar tchawe his: o Jibhar, o Elishama, un o Elifelet,
un o Noga, o Nefeg, un o Jafia,
un o Elishama, o Eljada, un o Elifelet. Khetne his le enja.
Koi pashel wan i tchawe leskre wawar djuwjendar. Un i Tamar his lengri pheen.
O Salomo his o dad o murshestar Rehabeam, koleskro tchawo his o Abija, koleskro tchawo his o Asa, koleskro tchawo his o Josafat.
Koleskro tchawo his o Joram, koleskro tchawo his o Ahasja, koleskro tchawo his o Joash,
koleskro tchawo his o Amazja, koleskro tchawo his o Asarja, koleskro tchawo his o Jotam,
koleskro tchawo his o Ahas, koleskro tchawo his o Hiskija, koleskro tchawo his o Manasse,
koleskro tchawo his o Amon, koleskro tchawo his o Josia.
Un i tchawe o murshestar Josia his: o phureder his o Johanan, o duito his o Jojakim, o triinto his o Zedekja, o starto his o Shallum.
Un i tchawe o murshestar Jojakim his o Jekonja, un o Zedekja.
O Jekonja was pandles anlo an o them Babilonia. Leskre tchawe his: o Shealtijel,
o Malkiram un o Pedaja un o Shenazzar, o Jekamja, o Hoshama, un o Nebadja.
O Pedaja his o dad dui tchawendar: o Serubbabel un o Shimi. O Serubbabel his o dad kol dui mursh tchawendar, o Meshullam un o Hananja. Un i Shelomit his lengri pheen.
Les his ninna pantch wawar tchawe: o Hashuba, o Ohel, o Berechja, o Hasadja un o Jushab-Hesed.
Un i tchawe o murshestar Hananja his: O Pelatja un o Jeshaja, o Refaja, o Arnan, o Obadja un o Shechanja.
O Shechanja, les his shob tchawe: o Shemaja, o Hattush un o Jigal, un o Bariach un o Nearja un o Shafat.
O Nearja, les his triin tchawe: o Eljoenai un o Hiskija, un o Asrikam.
O Eljoenai, les his efta tchawe: o Hodawja un o Eljashib, un o Pelaja un o Akkub un o Johanan, un o Delaja, un o Anani.
O Juda: leskre tchawe his: o Perez, o Hezron, o Karmi, o Hur un o Shobal.
O Shobaleskro tchawo his o Reaja. Koleskro tchawo his o Jachat. Koleskre tchawe his o Achumai un o Lahad. Kolla lauter hi i menshe dran o kheer Zora.

O Hur his o phureder tchawo o murshestar Kaleb un leskro romjatar Efrata. Leskre tchawe kran o foro Betlehem. O Hur, les his triin tchawe: o Etam, o Penuel un o Eser. O Etam, les his triin tchawe: o Jesreel, o Jishma, o Jidbash. Un lengri pheen his i Hazlelponi. O Penuel kras o foro Gedor, un o Eser kras o foro Husha.
Un o Ashhur, kowa, kai kras o foro Tekoa, koles his dui romja: i Hela un i Naara.
Un i Naara anas leske o Ahussam ap i phub, ninna o Hefer un o Temni un o Ahashtari ap i phub.
Un i Hela las: o Zeret, o Zohar, un o Etnan.
O murshestar Koz was o Anub un o Zobeba, ninna i menshe dran o kheer Aharhel, koleskro dad o Harum his.
Un o Jabez his an-dikleder har leskre phrala. Har lo boldo was, das les leskri dai ko lab Jabez, un penas: ‘Me anom les bud dukentsa ap i phub’.

Un o Jabez das gole ap o Israeleskro Debleste un penas: Tchip tiri bacht ap mande, un kre miro them bareder har lo kanna hi. Ab mantsa, un rike tiro wast pral mande, te well nai kek duk pral mande! Un o Dewel mukas te well, hoi job putchas peske lestar.
Un o Kelub, koleskro phraal o Shuha his, las i tchawo. Kowa his o Mehir. Leskro tchawo his o Eshton.
Koleskre tchawe his: o Bet-Rafa, un o Paseach un o Techinna. O Techinna kras o foro Nahash. Kolestar wan i mursha, kai djiwan an Reka.
O Kenas, les his kal tchawe: o Otnijel un o Seraja. I tchawe o murshestar Otnijel his: o Hatat un o Meonotai.
Un o Meonotai was o dad o murshestar Ofra. O Seraja was o dad o murshestar Joab. Job kras ko gab, hoi well kharedo: Tala kolendar, kai budrenn o kashteha. Jon his lauter latche wastengre budepangre.
O Kaleb, koleskro dad o Jefunne his, las kal tchawe: o Iru, o Ela, un o Naam. Un o Ela was o dad o murshestar Kenas.
O Jehallelel, les his star tchawe: o Sif un o Sifa, o Tirja un o Asarel.

O Esra, les his star tchawe: o Jeter, un o Mered, un o Efer, un o Jalon. Un o Mered romedineras i Bitja, kolakro dad o baro rai pral Egiptia his. Un len his jek tchai, i Mirjam, un dui mursh tchawe, o Shammai un o Jishbach. O Jishbach kras ko foro Eshtemoa. O Mered romedineras ninna i romjat dran o them Juda. Un khetne lah his les triin tchawe: o Jered, o Heber un o Jekutijel. O Jered kras o foro Gedor. O Heber kras o foro Socho. Un o Jekutijel kras o foro Sanoach.
Un o Hodija romedineras koi pheen o murshestar Nacham. Lendar wan i Garmarja, kai djiwenn an o foro Kehila, un i Maachatarja, kai djiwenn an o foro Eshtemoa.
O Shimon, leskre tchawe his: O Amnon un o Rinna, o Ben-Hanan, un o Tilon. O Jishi, leskre tchawe his: o Sohet un o Ben-Sohet.
O Shela, koleskro dad o Juda hi, leskre tchawe his: o Er, kowa kras o foro Lecha, un o Lada, kai kras o foro Maresha, ninna i menshe, kai djiwan an Ashbea. Kolla kran latcho laintikro than.

O murshestar Shela wan ninna o Jokim un i mursha dran Koseba, ninna o Joash un o Saraf, kolla, kai pralstune his pral o them Moab. Kote djiwan le jek tsiro un wan pale pale an Betlehem, – jaake well penlo.
Jon kran pirja un djiwan an i forja Netajim un Gedera pash o baro rajeste un budran leske.
O Simeon, leskre tchawe his: o Jemuel, un o Jamin, o Jarib, o Serach, o Shaul,
koleskro tchawo his o Shallum, koleskro tchawo his o Mibsam un koleskro tchawo his o Mishma.
Un i tchawe o murshestar Mishma his: o Hamuel, koleskro tchawo his o Sakkur, koleskro tchawo his o Shimi.
Un o Shimi, les his deesh-te-shob mursh tchawe un shob tcha. Leskre phralen his gar jaake bud tchawe. O kheer Simeon was gar jaake baro har o kheer Juda.
Kol menshe, kai wan o Simeonestar djiwan an i forja Beersheba, Molada un an Hazar-Shual,
an Bilha, Ezem un Tolad,
an Betuel, Horma un an Ziklag,
an Bet-Markabot, Hazar-Susim, Bet-Biri un an Shaarajim. Kolla his lengre forja, bis te was o David lengro baro rai.
Ninna his lenge kol pantch forja Etam, Ajin, Rimmon, Tochen un Ashan,
koi pashel kol tsele gaba trul lengre forja bis pash Baal. Jaake hi pre-tchinlo an kol lila, kai lengre familjengre laba dren tardo hi.
Lengre pralstune pral i familje his: o Meshobab, un o Jamlek un o Josha, koleskro dad o Amazja his,
un o Joel un o Jehu, koleskro dad o Joshibja his, koleskro dad o Seraja, koleskro dad o Asijel his;
ninna o Eljoenai un o Jakoba un o Jeshochaja un o Asaja un o Adijel un o Jesimijel un o Benaja;
un o Sisa, koleskro dad o Shifi his, koleskro dad o Allon his, un koleskro dad o Jedaja his, un koleskro dad o Shimri his, un koleskro dad o Shemaja his.
Kal mursha, kolengre laba pre tchinlo hi, his i pralstune pral pengre menshende. Un lengre familje wan baro un bareder.
Un jon djan dur an i tala ap koi rig an i tala, kai o kham pre djal, bis pash Gedor, te nai hatsenn le senlepen lengre bakrenge un busjenge.
Un kote hatsan le latcho pesso senlepen. Un ko them his buchlo ap hake dui rigja, un shukar. Kek kurepen his koi. Kol menshe, kai glan lende koi djiwan, his sawe, kai wan o murshestar Ham.

Un an ko tsiro, kai o Hiskija o baro rai pral Juda his, wan kolla, kai o labeha pre tchinlo his, un djan ap kol menshende Ham pre, kai kote an pengre plachtene khera djiwan, un ninna pral i Meunarja, kai kote djiwan. Un jon maran len lauteren. Jaake djiwenn jon kote bis ap kau diwes. Kote his bud senlepen lengre bakrenge un busjenge.

Mank kolende, kai wan pal o Simeon, his ninna sawe – jaake pantch-sheel mursha – kolla djan pash i berga Seir: Lengre pralstune his o Pelatja un o Nearja un o Refaja un o Usijel, kolengro dad his o Jishi.
Un jon maran kolen, kai atchan pral kolendar dran Amalek, kai nashan penge kote. Un kate djiwenn le gomme kau diwes.

O Ruben his o Jakobeskro phureder tchawo. Doleske his les o tchatchepen, hoi o phureder tchaweske hi. Kowa nashras lo, har sowas lo peskro dadeskri romjah. Un o Rubeneskro tchatchepen was i tchawenge leskro phralestar Josef dino. Ninna te his kowa jaake, was gar tchinlo an i familjakro liil, te his o Josef o phureder.
O sorleder mank peskre phrala his o Juda. Doleske was jek dran o kheer Juda o baro rai pral Israel, ninna te his o Josefes o tchatchepen, hoi i phureder tchaweske hi.
O Ruben his o Jakobeskro phureder tchawo. Leskre tchawe his: o Henoch, o Pallu, o Hezron un o Karmi.
O Joel, leskre tchawe his: o Shemaja, koleskro tchawo his o Gog, koleskro tchawo his o Shimi,
koleskro tchawo his o Micha, koleskro tchawo his o Reaja, koleskro tchawo his o Baal,
koleskro tchawo his o Beera. Koles anas o Tiglat-Pileser, o baro rai pral o them Assur, pandles an leskro them. Ap ko tsiro his lo o pralstuno pral o kheer Ruben.
Wawar i menshendar Ruben his pengre menshentsa pre-tchinlo an o familjakro liil. Kolla his o pralstuno o Jehijel, palle o Secharja,
un o Bela, koleskro dad o Asa his, koleskro dad o Shema his, koleskro dad o Joel his. I menshe dran o kheer Ruben djiwan an o them trul Aroer bis pash o Nebo un Baal-Meon.
Un kote, kai o kham pre djala djiwan le bis an o mulo them dren, hoi pash o lengsto pani Eufrat tchiddo hi. Len his bud vieche an o tselo them Gilead.

An ko tsiro, kai o Saul djiwas, djan le an o kurepen i menshentsa, kai kharenn Hagararja, un wan sorleder har jon. Un jaake djiwan jon an kolengre plachtene khera ap kai tseli rig o themestar Gilead, kai o kham pre djala.
Un i menshe dran o kheer Gad djiwan wergel i menshende dran o kheer Ruben, an o them Bashan bis pash Salka.
Lengro pralstuno his o Joel. Ko duito his o Shafam. Pal lende wan o Janai un o Shafat. Kolla djiwan an Bashan.
Un lengre phrala pengre familjentsa his: o Michael, o Meshullam, o Sheba, o Jorai, o Jakan, o Sia un o Eber. Khetne his le efta.
Kolengro dad his o Abichajil, koleskro dad his o Huri, koleskro dad o Jaroach, koleskro dad o Gilead, koleskro dad o Michael, koleskro dad o Jeshishai, koleskro dad o Jachdo, koleskro dad o Bus.
Lengro pralstuno his o Achi, koleskro dad o Abdijel his, koleskro dad o Guni his.
Kal menshe djiwan an Gilead, an o them Bashan un an kol forja, kai kote his, un ap kol tsele platse, kai lengre vieche his an o tselo them Sharon bis ap leskre rigja.
An ko tsiro, kai o Jotam o rai pral o them Juda his, un o Jerobeam o rai pral o them Israel his, wan i laba kal tsele murshendar pre-tchinlo an o familjakro liil.
I lurde dran i khera Ruben un Gad un dran i paash familja Manasse his 44.760 (star-deesh-te-star-serja-efta sheel-te-shob-deesh) mursha. Kolen his shilte, chare un boge un his latche kurepangre.
Jon kuran pen i menshentsa dran i khera Jetur un Nafish un Nodab. Kolla his Hagararja.

Un i lurde dran i khera Ruben un Gad un Manasse dikan ap o baro Debleste un dan gole ap leste, te well lo lenge ap i rig. Un job shunas ap lende, un das i Hagararja an lengre wasta un lauteren, kai pash lende his.

Un jon tapran lengre vieche: 50.000 (paash-sheel serja) khamele, 250.000 (dui-sheel-te-pantch-deesh serja) bakre, 2.000 (dui serja) burike, un jon lan penge 100.000 (sheel serja) murshen un djuwjen un kran lendar pandepangre.
Ninna atchan bud maredes tchiddo. Kau kurepen was o Deblestar. Un i Israelitarja djiwan an lengro them ap lengri phub bis te wan le pandles krik anlo.
Un koi paash familja Manasse djiwas an o them mank Bashan un Baal-Hermon un bis pash o Senir un i berga Hermon. Un jon wan bud un budeder.
Un kalla his i pralstune pral pengre dadengre khera: o Efer, o Jishi, o Eljel, o Asrijel, o Jeremia, o Hodawja un o Jachdijel. Jon lauter his soreles an o kurepen un mursha o labestar.
Un jon peran tele lengro dadengro Deblestar, un mangan i deblen kol wawar menshendar an, kolen o Dewel glan lende win tradas dran o them.

Kote bitchras o Israeleskro Dewel pral lende o baro rajes dran o them Assur, o Pul, – leskro lab hi ninna Tiglat-Pileser – un job mukas i menshen dran o kheer Ruben un Gad un i paash familja dran o kheer Manasse pandles krik te anell, un anas len an i themma trul i forja Halach un Habor un Hara un pash o lengsto pani Gosan. Kote hi le gomme kau diwes.
O Levi: Leskre tchawe his: o Gershon, o Kohat un o Merari.
O Kohat, leskre tchawe his: o Amram, o Jizhar, o Hebron, un o Usijel.
O Amram, leskre tchawe his: o Aron un o Mose, jaake har ninna i Mirjam. O Aron, leskre tchawe his: o Nadab un o Abihu, o Eleasar un o Itamar.
O Eleasar his o dad o murshestar Pinhas, leskro tchawo his o Abishua,
koleskro tchawo his o Bukki, koleskro tchawo his o Usi,
koleskro tchawo his o Serachja, koleskro tchawo his o Merajot,
koleskro tchawo his o Amarja, koleskro tchawo his o Ahitub,
koleskro tchawo his o Zadok, koleskro tchawo his o Ahimaaz,
koleskro tchawo his o Asarja, koleskro tchawo his o Johanan,
koleskro tchawo his o Asarja. Kowa hi ko rashai, kai kras i rashajeskri budi an o Debleskro kheer, hoi o Salomo mukas te krell an o foro Jerusalem.
O Asarja his o dad o murshestar Amarja, koleskro tchawo his o Ahitub,
koleskro tchawo his o Zadok, koleskro tchawo his o Shallum,
koleskro tchawo his o Hilkija, koleskro tchawo his o Asarja,
koleskro tchawo his o Seraja, koleskro tchawo his o Jozadak,
Un o Jozadak was pandles krik anlo kol menshentsa dran Juda un Jerusalem. Kolen das o baro Dewel an o wast o baro rajestar Nebukadnezar, un kowa mukas len pandles krik te anell.
O Levi: Leskre tchawe his: o Gershon, o Kohat un o Merari.
O Gershon, leskre tchawe his: o Libni un o Shimi.
O Kohat, leskre tchawe his: o Amram un o Jizhar un o Hebron un o Usijel.
O Merari, leskre tchawe his: o Machli un o Mushi. Un kalla hi i menshe, kai wan pal o Levi pal lengre dadengre khera:
O Gershon: leskro tchawo his o Libni, koleskro tchawo his o Jachat, koleskro tchawo his o Simma,
koleskro tchawo his o Joach, koleskro tchawo his o Iddo, koleskro tchawo his o Serach, koleskro tchawo his o Jeatrai.
O Kohat: leskro tchawo his o Amminadab, koleskro tchawo his o Korach, koleskro tchawo his o Assir,
koleskro tchawo his o Elkana, koleskro tchawo his o Abiasaf, koleskro tchawo his o Assir,
koleskro tchawo his o Tachat, koleskro tchawo his o Urijel, koleskro tchawo his o Usija, koleskro tchawo his o Shaul.
O Elkana his o dad kol murshendar: o Amasai un o Achimot,
un o Elkana, koleskro tchawo his o Zuf, koleskro tchawo his o Nachat,
koleskro tchawo his o Eliab, koleskro tchawo his o Jeroham, koleskro tchawo his o Elkana, koleskro tchawo his o Samuel.
Koleskre tchawe his: o Joel, leskro phureder, un o Abija.
O Merari, leskre tchawe his: o Machli, koleskro tchawo his o Libni, koleskro tchawo his o Shimi, koleskro tchawo his o Ussa,
koleskro tchawo his o Shimea, koleskro tchawo his o Haggija, koleskro tchawo his o Asaja.

Mank i Levitarja his kalla, kolen o David i budi das, te giwenn le an o Debleskro kheer. Kowa his an ko tsiro, har o Debleskro mochton kol deesh labentsa khere anlo was, un an o Debleskro kheer dren tchiddo was.
Un jon giwan pengre gilja jaake har lenge penlo was glan o Debleskro plachteno kheer bis ap ko diwes, kai kras o Salomo o baro Debleske i kheer an o foro Jerusalem.
Un kalla hi kol gipangre un lengre tchawe: dran o kheer Kohat his o Heman ko gipaskro, koleskro dad his o Joel, koleskro dad his o Samuel,
koleskro dad his o Elkana, koleskro dad his o Jeroham, koleskro dad his o Eljel, koleskro dad his o Toah,
koleskro dad his o Zuf, koleskro dad his o Elkana, koleskro dad his o Machat, koleskro dad his o Amasai,
koleskro dad his o Elkana, koleskro dad his o Joel, koleskro dad his o Asarja, koleskro dad his o Zefanja,
koleskro dad his o Tachat, koleskro dad his o Assir, koleskro dad his o Abiasaf, koleskro dad his o Korach,
koleskro dad his o Jizhar, koleskro dad his o Kohat, koleskro dad his o Levi, koleskro dad his o Israel.
Un leskro phraal, kai ap leskri tchatchi rig tardo his, his o Asaf. Koleskro dad his o Berechja, koleskro dad his o Shimea,
koleskro dad his o Michael, koleskro dad his o Baseja, koleskro dad his o Malkija,
koleskro dad his o Etni, koleskro dad his o Serach, koleskro dad his o Adaja,
koleskro dad his o Etan, koleskro dad his o Simma, koleskro dad his o Shimi,
koleskro dad his o Jachat, koleskro dad his o Gershon, koleskro dad his o Levi.
Un lengre phrala, i Merarja, his ap i serwi rig tardo: o Etan, koleskro dad his o Kishi, koleskro dad his o Abdi, koleskro dad his o Malluch,
koleskro dad his o Hashabja, koleskro dad his o Amazja, koleskro dad his o Hilkija,
koleskro dad his o Amzi, koleskro dad his o Bani, koleskro dad his o Shemar,
koleskro dad his o Machli, koleskro dad his o Mushi, koleskro dad his o Merari, koleskro dad his o Levi.
Un kol wawar Levitarja, lengre phrala, wan an koi tseli budi an o Debleskro kheer dren tchiddo.

O rashajeskri budi his kokres o Aroneske un leskre tchawenge. Jon chatchran i viechen ap o Debleskri sasterni chatchepaskri, ninna sungepaskro koowa ap o Debleskro sonakaskro bob. Jon kokres nai djan an o Debleskri kutch isema, te krenn le o Debleskro koowa, te well o Israeleskri doosh krik lino, lauter jaake, har penas o Mose, koles o Debleskro wast his.
Un kalla hi o Aroneskre tchawe: leskro tchawo o Eleasar, koleskro tchawo hi o Pinhas, koleskro tchawo hi o Abishua,
koleskro tchawo hi o Bukki, koleskro tchawo hi o Usi, koleskro tchawo hi o Serachja,
koleskro tchawo hi o Merajot, koleskro tchawo hi o Amarja, koleskro tchawo hi o Ahitub,
koleskro tchawo hi o Zadok, koleskro tchawo hi o Ahimaaz.

Un kalla his lengre forja un gaba, kai tchiwan o Aroneskre menshe pengre plachtene khera pre. Kolla his dran o kheer Kohat. Har i Israelitarja tikne barra tchiwan, te hatsenn le win, koon hawe gaba lell, his i Kohatarja i glanstune, kai lan pengre gaba.
Un jon dan len o foro Hebron an o them Juda un koi tseli phub trul Hebron lengre viechengre, te nai chan le.
Ko hachetikri phub pash o foro un kol gaba trujel dan le o Kaleb, koleskro dad o Jefunne his.

O Hebron his jek kol forjendar, kai nashte nashenn kolla, kai jekes mulo dan. Kau fores lan o Aroneskre tchawe, ninna i forja Libna, Jattir, Eshtemoa, Holon, Debir, Ashan un Bet-Shemesh un koi tseli phub trul kol forja, te nai chan lengre vieche.
Un an o them Benjamin dan jon len i forja Geba; Alemet un Anatot un i tseli phub trujel lengre viechenge. Lengre tsele forja his khetne deesh-te-triin lengre tsele familjenge.

Kol wawar menshende dran o kheer Kohat, dan le deesh forja. Kal forja his an o them Efrajim, an o them Dan un an ko them, kai i paash familja Manasse djiwas. Kol forja lan le jaake har kol tikne barra sikran, hoi witsran le.
Kol menshende dran o kheer Gershon dan le deesh-te-triin forja. Kal forja his an i themma, kai i menshe Issachar, Asser, un Naftali djiwan, un an o them Bashan, kai i paash familja Manasse djiwas.
Kol menshende dran o kheer Merari dan le deesh-te-dui forja. Kol forja his an i themma, kai i menshe Ruben, Gad un Sebulon djiwan. Kal forja lan le jaake, har kol tikne barra sikran, hoi witsran le.
Un jaake dan i Israelitarja i menshen dran o kheer Levi forja un phub trul kol forja, te nai chan lengre vieche.
[Kol forja an i themma Juda, Simeon un Benjamin his lende ninna jaake dino, har kol tikne barra sikran, hoi witsran le.]
His familje koi dran o kheer Kohat, kolla lan forja un phub lengre viechenge an o them Efrajim:
o foro Sichem ap i berge Efrajim, kowa his i foro, kai nai khatran pen i naashepangre, ninna kol forja Geser,
Jokmeam, Bet-Horon,
Ajalon un Gat-Rimmon.
Un kol menshende, kai pral atchan dran o kheer Kohat, dan le i forja Aner un Bileam an o them koi paash familjatar Manasse, khetne koi phub trul i forja i viechenge.
I menshende dran o kheer Gershon dan le kal forja khetne koi phub trujel i viechenge: an o them i paash familjatar Manasse: o foro Golan an o them Bashan, un o foro Astarot;
an o them Issachar: i forja Kadesh un Daberat,
Ramot un Anem;
an o them Asser: Mashal, Abdon,
Hukok un Rehob;
an o them Naftali: Kedesh an Galilea, Hammon un Kirjatajim.
Kolla, kai atchan pral i menshendar dran o kheer Merari lan kol forja khetne i phub trujel i viechenge: an o them Sebulon: Rimmon un Tabor;
an o them Ruben, ap i wawar rig o panjestar Jordan, wergel o foro Jericho, kote, kai o kham pre djala: o foro Bezer an o mulo them, un o foro Jahaz;
un Kedemot un Mefaat;
un an o them Gad: Ramot an Gilead un Mahanajim,
Heshbon un Jaser.
O Issachar: Leskre tchawe his: O Tola, o Puwa, o Jashub un o Shimron; lauter khetne his star.

O Tola: Leskre tchawe his: o Usi, o Refaja, o Jerijel, o Jachmai, o Jibsam, un o Samuel. Kolla his pralstune pral pengre familje un bare kurepangre. An o tsiro, kai o David djiwas, his kolla, kai wan pal o Tola, 22.600 mursha. Jaake his dren tchinlo an i familjakro liil.
O Usi: Les his jek tchawo, o Jisrachja. Leskre tchawe his: o Michael, o Obadja, o Joel, un o Jishija; lauter khetne his pantch. Kolla his pralstune pral pengre familje.
Len his jaake bud romja un tchawe, kai wan dran lengre familje 36.000 mursha, kai his kurepangre. Jaake his dren tchinlo an i familjakro liil.
Un lengre phrala an i wawar familje, kolengro phuro dad o Issachar his, kolla his lauter sorele kurepangre. Khetne his le 87.000, kai his dren tchinlo an i familjakro liil.
O Benjamin: Leskre tchawe his: o Bela, o Becher, o Jedjael, lauter khetne his triin.

O Bela: Leskre tchawe his: o Ezbon, o Usi, o Usijel, o Jerimot un o Ir; lauter khetne his pantch. Jon his pralstune pral pengre familje un sorele kurepangre. Lendar wan 22.034 mursha, kai his dren tchinlo an i familjakro liil.
O Becher, leskre tchawe his: o Semira, o Joash, o Elijeser, o Eljoenai, o Omri, o Jeremot, o Abija, o Anatot, un o Alemet.
Jon his dren tchinlo an i familjakro liil pal pengre familje. Lendar wan 20.200 mursha, kai his sorele kurepangre.
O Jedjael: Leskro tchawo his o Bilhan. Leskre tchawe his: O Jehush, o Benjamin, o Ehud, o Khenaana, o Setan, o Tarsis un o Ahishachar.
Kolla his pralstune pral pengre familje. Lendar wan 17.200 mursha, kai his sorele kurepangre un nai djan an o kurepen.
I tchawe o murshestar Ir his o Shuppim un o Huppim. O Hushim his o tchawo o murshestar Acher.
O Naftali, leskre tchawe his: o Jachzeel, o Guni, o Jezer, un o Shallum. I Bilha his lengri mami.
O Manasse, leskre tchawe his: o Asrijel un o Machir; lengri dai his i djuwel dran o them Syria. O Machir was o dad o murshestar Gilead.
Un o Machir las peske i romni, koja his i pheen kol murshendar Huppim un Shuppim. Lakro lab his Maacha. Leskro wawar tchawo his o Zelofhad. O Zelofhad, koles his tcha un kek tchawe.
Un i Maacha, koi romni o murshestar Machir, anas leske dui tchawe ap i phub, ko jekes kharas li Peresh, ko wawar kharas Sheresh, un koleskre tchawe his o Ulam un o Rekem.
Un o Ulam, les his jek tchawo: o Bedan. Kalla hi i mursha, kai wan pal o Gilead; leskro dad his o Machir un leskro papo his o Manasse.
Un leskri pheen his i Molechet. Koja his i dai kol murshendar Ishhod, o Abijeser un Machla.
Un i tchawe o murshestar Shemida his: o Achjan, o Sichem, o Likhi un o Aniam.

O Efrajim: Leskre tchawe his: o Shutelach, o Eser un o Elada. O tchawo o murshestar Shutelach hi o Bered, koleskro tchawo hi o Tachat, koleskro tchawo hi o Sabad, koleskro tchawo hi o Shutelach. Un kol mursha, o Eser un o Elad, djan an o foro Gat, te lenn le kol menshendar dran Gat lengre viechen penge. Un i mursha dran Gat maran len.
Un lengro dad, o Efrajim, rowas i rah tsiro, un leskre phrala wan, te rakrenn leha latche laba.
Un job djas pash peskri romjate, un joi was an wawar koowa, un anas i tchawes ap i phub. Un dran koi bibacht, hoi ap leskro kheer tchiddo hi, das job ko tchawes ko lab Beria.
Un o Efrajim, les his ninna i tchai. Koja his i Sheera. Joi mukas triin forja pre te tchiwell: o telstuno Bet-Horon, ko pralstuno Bet-Horon, un ninna Usen-Sheera.
Un leskre tchawe his: o Refach un o Reshef. Koleskro tchawo his o Telach, koleskro tchawo o Tachan,
koleskro tchawo o Ladan, koleskro tchawo o Ammihud, koleskro tchawo o Elishama,
koleskro tchawo, o Nun, un koleskro tchawo, o Josua.

Un lengro kotar phub un lengre forja his: o foro Betel un kol gaba koi trujel; un kote, kai o kham pre djal: o foro Naaran; kote, kai o kham tele djal: o foro Geser un kol gaba koi trujel; o foro Sichem un kol gaba koi trujel, bis pash Aja un kol gaba koi trujel;

un ap koi rig ko themestar, kai i menshe dran o kheer Manasse djiwenn, his kol forja: Bet-Shean, un kol gaba koi trujel, Taanach un kol gaba koi trujel, Megiddo un kol gaba koi trujel, Dor un kol gaba koi trujel. I menshe, kai djiwan an kal forja un gaba, his i tchawe o murshestar Josef, koleskro dad o Jakob his.
O Asser: Leskre tchawe his: o Jimna, o Jishwa, o Jishwi, o Berja, un i Serach, lengri pheen.
O Berja, leskre tchawe his: o Heber, o Malkijel, kowa hi o dad o murshestar Birsajit.
O Heber, leskre tchawe his: o Jaflet, o Shomer, o Hotam, un i Shua, lengri pheen.
o Jaflet, leskre tchawe his: o Pasak, o Bimhal, o Ashwat.
o Shemer, leskre tchawe his: o Achi, o Rohga, o Jeshubba un o Aram.
Un kol tchawe leskro phralestar, o Helem, his: o Zofach, o Jimna, o Shelesh, un o Amal.
O Zofach, leskre tchawe his: o Suach, o Harnefer, o Shual, o Beri, o Jimra,
o Bezer, o Hod, o Shamma, o Shilsha, o Jitran un o Beera.
Un i tchawe o murshestar Jeter his: o Jefunne, o Pispa un o Ara.
O Ulla, leskre tchawe his: o Arach, o Hannijel, un o Rizja.

Kolla halauter his tchawe o murshestar Asser. Jon his pralstune pral pengre familje, wi-rodede sorele kurepangre, latche pralstune. Lendar wan 26.000 mursha, kai his kurepangre un dren tchinlo an i familjakro liil.
O Benjamin: Leskro phureder tchawo his o Bela, leskro duito o Ashbel, leskro triinto o Achrach,
leskro starto o Noha, leskro pantchto o Rafa.
O Bela, leskre tchawe his: o Addar, o Gera, o Abihud,
o Abishua, o Naaman, o Achoach,
o Gera, o Shefufan un o Huram.

O Ehud, leskre tchawe his: o Naaman, o Achija un o Gera. Kolla his pralstune pral i menshende an o foro Geba. Un jon wan pandles anlo an o foro Manachat. O Gera his kowa, kai anan len kote. Leskre tchawe his o Usa un o Achichud.
O Shaharajim: Job djiwas an o them Moab, un mukas peskre dui romjen, i Hushim un i Baara.
Leskri wawar romjah, i Hodesh his les tchawe: Kolla his o Jobab, o Zibja, o Mesha, o Malkam,
o Jehuz, o Sachja un o Mirma. Kolla his pralstune pral pengre familje.
Leskri romjah, i Hushim, his les kol tchawe, o Abitub un o Elpaal.
O Elpaal, leskre tchawe his: o Eber, o Misham, un o Shemed, kowa tchiwas i forja Ono un Lod pre, un kol gaba trujel.
O Berja un o Shema his i pralstune pral pengre familje, kai an o foro Ajalon djiwan. Jon tradan i menshen, kai djiwan an o foro Gat, dran o foro win.
Lengre phrala his o Achjo, o Shashak un o Jeremot.
I tchawe o murshestar Berja his: o Sebadja, o Arad, un o Eder,
un o Michael, un o Jishpa, un o Joha.
I tchawe o murshestar Elpaal his: o Sebadja, o Meshullam, o Hishi, o Heber,
o Jishmerai, o Jislia, un o Jobab.
I tchawe o murshestar Shimi his: o Jakim, o Sichri, o Sabdi,
o Eljenai, o Zilletai, o Eljel,
o Adaja, o Beraja, un o Shimrat.
I tchawe o murshestar Shashak his: o Jishpan, o Eber, o Eljel,
o Abdon, o Sichri, o Hanan,
o Hananja, o Elam, o Antotija,
o Jifdeja un o Penuel.
I tchawe o murshestar Jeroham his: o Shamsherai, o Secharja, o Atalja,
o Jaareshja, o Elija, un o Sichri.
Kalla hi pralstune pral pengre familje, kai djiwan an o foro Jerusalem.
Un an o foro Gibeon djiwas o Jejel. Job his o dad o murshestar Gibeon. Un o lab leskri romjatar his Maacha.
Leskro phureder tchawo his o Abdon. Leskre wawar tchawe his o Zur, o Kish, o Baal, o Nadab,
o Gedor, o Achjo, o Secher un o Miklot.
O tchawo o murshestar Miklot his o Shima. Ninna jon djiwan an o foro Jerusalem, ap i wawar rig lengre phralendar.
O Ner, leskro tchawo his o Kish. Koleskro tchawo his o Saul, un koleskre tchawe his o Jonatan, o Malkishua, o Abinadab un o Eshbaal.
O Jonatan, leskro tchawo his o Merib-Baal, koleskro tchawo his o Micha.
O Micha, leskre tchawe his o Piton, o Melech, o Tachrea un o Ahas.
O Ahas, les his i tchawo, kowa his o Joadda, koleskre tchawe his o Alemet, o Asmawet un o Simri. O tchawo o murshestar Simri his o Moza.
Koleskro tchawo his o Bina, koleskro tchawo his o Rafa, koleskro tchawo his o Elasa, koleskro tchawo his o Azel.
O Azel, les his shob tchawe: o Asrikam, o Bochru, o Jishmael, o Shearja, o Obadja, un o Hanan.
Un leskro phrales o Eshek his tchawe: o phureder his o Ulam, o duito his o Jehush, leskro triinto tchawo his o Elifelet.

Un i tchawe o murshestar Ulam his sorele kurepangre, kai haiwan mishto o bogeha karje te dell. Len his bud tchawe un tchawengre tchawe, khetne 150 (sheel-te-paash-sheel). Kal tsele familje wenn pal o Benjamin.

Un i tsele Israelitarja wan pengro labeha dren tchinlo an familjengre lila. Kal lila hi khetne lino an o liil i bare rajendar pral Israel. Un i menshe dran o them Juda mukan pengro Debles un wan doleske pandles anlo an o them Babilonia.
Un mank kol erste menshe, kai pale wan, un pale an pengro them un pengre forja djiwan, his Israelitarja, rashaja, Levitarja un sawe, kai budran an o Debleskro kheer.
An o foro Jerusalem djiwan menshe dran o kheer Juda, un dran o kheer Benjamin un dran o kheer Efrajim un dran o kheer Manasse.
Dran o kheer Juda: o Utai, koleskro dad o Ammihud hi, koleskro dad o Omri hi, koleskro dad o Imri hi, koleskro dad o Bani hi. Jon hi menshe, kai wan o murshestar Perez, koleskro dad o Juda his.
O Shela les his tchawe: leskro phureder tchawo his o Asaja un leskre tchawe.
Kol menshendar Serach was o Jehuel un leskre phrala, khetne 690 (shob-sheel-te-enja-deesh) mursha.
Dran o kheer Benjamin: o Sallu, koleskro dad o Meshullam hi, koleskro dad o Hodawja hi, koleskro dad o Senua hi,
un o Jibneja, koleskro dad o Jeroham hi, un o Ela, koleskro dad o Usi hi, koleskro dad o Michri hi, un o Meshullam, koleskro dad o Shefatja hi, koleskro dad o Reguel hi, koleskro dad o Jibnija hi.
Khetne pengre phralentsa dran i wawar familje his le 956 (enja-sheel-te-pantch-deesh-te-shob) mursha. Kolla lauter his pralstune pral pengre familje.
I rashajendar wan pale an o them Juda: O Jedaja, o Jojarib, o Jachin,
o Asarja, koleskro dad o Hilkija hi, koleskro dad o Meshullam hi, koleskro dad o Zadok hi, koleskro dad o Merajot hi, koleskro dad o Ahitub hi, ko pralstuno pral o Debleskro kheer,

ninna o Adaja, koleskro dad o Jeroham hi, koleskro dad o Pashur hi, koleskro dad o Malkija hi, un o Maasai, koleskro dad o Adijel hi, koleskro dad o Jachsera hi, koleskro dad o Meshullam hi, koleskro dad o Meshillemot hi, koleskro dad Immer hi.
Khetne pengre phralentsa his le 1.760 mursha. Kolla his pralstune pral pengre familje, un haiwan mishto pengri budi te krell an o Debleskro kheer.
I Levitarendar wan pale an o them Juda: Dran o kheer Merari: o Shemaja, koleskro dad o Hashub hi, koleskro dad o Asrikam hi, koleskro dad o Hashabja hi,
ninna o Bakbakar, o Heresh, o Galal, un o Mattanja, koleskro dad o Micha hi, koleskro dad o Sichri hi, koleskro dad o Asaf hi,

ninna o Obadja, koleskro dad o Shemaja hi, koleskro dad o Galal hi, koleskro dad o Jedutun hi, un o Berechja, koleskro dad o Asa hi, koleskro dad o Elkana hi, kowa kai an i gab i familjatar Netofa djiwas.
Un kolla, kai denn garda ap i wudja, his: o Shallum, o Akkub, o Talmon un o Ahiman; lengro phraal, o Shallum, his o pralstuno lendar.
Un bis kanna denn kolla garda ap o baro rajeskro wudar, hoi hi kote, kai o kham pre-djal. Lengre phure his kolla, kai dan garda ap koi platsa, kai i Levitarjen pengre plachtene khera his.

O Shallum his o tchawo ko murshestar Kore, koleskro dad o Abiasaf his, koleskro dad o Korach his. O Shallum un wawar mursha dran o kheer Korach dan garda ap o wudar glan o Debleskro plachteno kheer, jaake har lengre phure garda dan pash o wudar ap o baro Debleskri platsa an o mulo tato them.
Glan kau tsiro his o Pinhas, koleskro dad o Eleasar his, o pralstuno pral lende, – o baro Dewel mu well leha!
O Secharja, koleskro dad o Meshelemja his, das garda ap o wudar glan o Debleskro plachteno kheer.

Kolla lauter his win rodedo, te denn le garda ap i wudja. Jon his 212 (dui-sheel-deesh-te-dui) mursha, kolengre laba his dren tchinlo an lila kol gabendar, kai jon djiwan. O David un o Samuel, ko dikepaskro, tchiwan len an lengri budi dren,
te denn jon un lengre tchawe garda ap i wudja glan o baro Debleskro plachteno kheer.
Jon his tardo trul o Debleskro plachteno kheer un dan garda ap hake star rigja: glan un palla, serwes un tchatches.

Star mursha lendar hunte kran pengri budi hako diwes. Lenge wan pengre phrala ap i rig, hakeno efta diwessa. Kau tsireske wan le dran lengre gaba, kai jon djiwenn, te budrenn le lentsa. Kol star his lengre pralstune. Mank i Levitarja his ninna sawe, kai his pralstune pral i iseme un kutch koowa an o Debleskro kheer, un kai dan garda koi pre.
Un jon atchan pral i rat trul o Debleskro kheer. Jon hunte dan garda koi pre, un jon klidewan haki taissarla i wudja pre.
Mank lende his sawe, kai dan garda ap kol tchare, pirja un wawar koola, kolentsa budran le an o Debleskro kheer. Te wan kol koola win un dren hidjedo, hunte dikenn le pal, kitse jon his.
Un wawar lendar dan garda ap o jarro un ap i mool un o djet un o sungepaskro koowa.
Koi his ninna rashaja, kai kran ko sungepaskro djet.
Un o Mattitja, jek kol Levitarendar, – job his o phureder tchawo o murshestar Shallum dran o kheer Korach – kowa das garda, te was hako tsiro o maro peklo, hoi was o Debleske dino un chatchedo.
Lengre phrala, kolla kai wan dran o kheer Kohat, lendar his sawe koi, kai hunte dan jak, te wan hako Debleskro diwes newe mare ap i chapaskri tchiddo an o Debleskro kheer.
I menshendar dran o kheer Levi, his ninna sawe koi, kai his gipangre. Lengre familjakre pralstune djiwan an i iseme pash o Debleskro plachteno kheer. Diwes un rati his le an pengri budi.
Kol tsele pralstune pral pengre familjende, kai dran o kheer Levi hi, kolla djiwan an o foro Jerusalem.
Un an o foro Gibeon djiwas o Jehijel. Lestar wan kolla, kai an kau foro djiwan. Un o lab leskri romjatar his Maacha.
Leskro phureder tchawo his o Abdon. Leskre wawar tchawe his o Zur, o Kish, o Baal, o Ner, o Nadab,
o Gedor, o Achjo, o Secher un o Miklot.
O tchawo o murshestar Miklot his o Shima. Ninna jon djiwan an o foro Jerusalem, ap i wawar rig lengre phralendar.
O Ner, leskro tchawo his o Kish. Koleskro tchawo his o Saul, un koleskre tchawe his o Jonatan, o Malkishua, o Abinadab un o Eshbaal.
O Jonatan, leskre tchawe his o Merib-Baal, koleskro tchawo his o Micha.
O Micha, leskre tchawe his o Piton, o Melech, o Tachrea un o Ahas.
O Ahas, les his i tchawo, kowa his o Joadda, koleskre tchawe his o Alemet, o Asmawet un o Simri. O tchawo o murshestar Simri his o Moza.
Koleskro tchawo his o Bina, koleskro tchawo his o Refaja, koleskro tchawo his o Elasa, koleskro tchawo his o Azel.
O Azel, les his shob tchawe: o Asrikam, o Bochru, o Jishmael, o Shearja, o Obadja, un o Hanan.
I Filistarja maran pen i Israelentsa. Un i Israelitarja nashan glan lende, un bud lendar wan ap i berga Gilboa mulo dino.
Un i Filistarja lan o Saules palla, un dan leskre mursh tchawen, o Jonatan, o Abinadab un o Malkishua mulo.
Un o marepen trul o Saul was sorleder un sorleder. Un i kurepangre, kai denn i failentsa karje, hatsan les un dukran les phares.

Un job penas ap koleste, kai leskro kurepaskro koowa hidjrell: “Le tiro charo un de man mulo, jaake te wenn gar kalla pash mande, kai gar tchinle hi ap pengro mass, un krenn mantsa, hoi jon kamenn!” Un ko lurdo, kai leskro kurepaskro koowa hidjrell, kamas gar. Les his bari daar. Kote las o Saul o charo, un mukas pes an leste perell.
Un har ko hidjepaskro lurdo dikas, te hi o Saul mulo, mukas job pes ninna an peskro charo te perell un meras.
Jaake meras o Saul un leskre triin tchawe, un leskro tselo kheer.

Har shunan kol Israelitarja, kai djiwan wergel i tala Jesreel, te nashan penge i Israelengre lurde, un kai meras o Saul un leskre tchawe, kote nashan jon dran pengre forja un nashan penge ninna. Un i Filistarja wan koi un djiwan an kol forja.
Un ap ko diwes pal o kurepen wan i Filistarja, te randenn le lauter kolendar, kai kote mulo tchiddo hi. Un koi pashel hatsan le o Saules un leskre tchawen mules ap koi berga Gilboa tchiddo.

Un jon randan les win, un lan leskro shero un leskro sasterno ripen, un bitchran murshen koleha lautereha an o tselo them Filistia trujel, te sikrenn le i menshende un lengre chochene deblen, hoi djas.
Un jon tchiwan leskro charo un leskro witsepaskro tchuri an o kheer pengro deblestar. Un leskro shero dan le sasterentsa ap i massuri o kherestar pengro deblestar Dagon.
Har shunan halauter, kai djiwenn an o foro Jabesh an o them Gilead, hoi i Filistarja o Sauleha kran,
kran pen i tsele tchatche mursha ap o drom, un lan o mulo Saules un leskre mule tchawen, un anan len an o foro Jabesh, un paskran len tel ko baro ruk pash o foro Jabesh, un chan tchi efta diwessa.
O Saul meras doleske, kai job gar kras, hoi o baro Dewel leske penas, un kai job pash koi djuwjate djas, kai i mulentsa rakras, un lat putchas.
O baro Debles putchas lo gar. Doleske mukas o baro Dewel les merell, un kras, te was o David baro rai, koleskro dad o Isai hi.
Un pash o Davideste an o foro Hebron wan mursha dran o tselo them Israel, un penan leske: “Shun, mer ham tire menshendar, tiro mass un rat.
Glan i rah tsiro har o Saul baro rai his, anal tu o Israel an o kurepen un pale khere. Un tiro baro Dewel penas tuke ninna: ‘Tu dess jak ap mire menshende Israel, un tu wess o rai pral o Israel.’”

Har kol tsele phureder dran Israel pash o baro rajeste an o foro Hebron his, kras kote o David lentsa win, te well lo lengro baro rai. Un jon dan ap o baro Debleste gole, te shunell job kowa. Un jon tchoran djet pral o Davideskro shero, te well job baro rai pral o Israel, jaake har glan i tsiro o baro Dewel ap o Samuel penas.
Palle djas o David i tsele murshentsa dran Israel glan o foro Jerusalem, kai kharas an ko tsiro Jebus. Kote djiwan i Jebusarja.
Kolla penan ap o Davideste: “Tu weh kai gar dren.” O David las ko sorelo kheer Zion peske dren. Kowa hi kanna o Davideskro foro.
Un o David penas: “Koon o ersto hi, kai dell kol Jebusarjen, kowa wella o pralstuno lurdo!” Kote djas o Joab, koleskri dai i Zeruja hi, glan i wawarende pre an o foro, un was o pralstuno lurdo.
Un o David djiwas an kau sorelo kheer. Doleske well ko kheer kharedo ‘Davideskro foro’.
Un job kras budeder khera un kras o foro buchleder kotar, kai o Millo his. Un o Joab tchiwas ko wawar kotar o forestar pale pre.
