Un o David was bareder un sorleder. Un o baro Dewel, ko rai pral o bolepen un i phub his leha.
Kalla hi kol laba o Davideskre sorele murshendar, kai rikran soreles pash leste. Khetne i tsele menshentsa Israel kran le les baro rai pral Israel, jaake har o baro Dewel penas pral Israel.
Un kolla hi kol laba o Davideskre sorele murshendar: o Jashobam kol menshendar Hachmoni, ko pralstuno kol trinendar. Kowa das peskro chareha 300 (triin-sheel) lurden ap jek kopo mulo.
Pal koleste was o Eleasar, koleskro dad o Dodo hi, dran o gab Ahoach. Job his jek kol trinendar,

kai pash o Davideste an Pas-Dammim his, har kol Filistarja kote khetne wan, te kurenn le pen i Israelentsa. Kote his i kotar phub, kai djob bares was. Un i Israelitarja nashan penge glan i Filistarja.
Un job djas mashkral ap ko kotar phub, tserdas pes gar pale, un maras kol Filistarjen. Un o baro Dewel das bari bacht.
Har his i Filistarja an i tala Refajim tardo, koi wan triin kol trijanda sorele murshendar pash ko baro bar, kai his o David an koi grotta pash o foro Adullam.
Kote his o David an peskro khatepen an i berga. Un kol Filistarja, kai jak dan, his an o foro Betlehem.
Un o Davides his trush, un penas: “Koon kamell mange pani pipaske te lell dran koi brunna pash o foreskro wudar an o foro Betlehem?”

Koi tchoran pen kol triin dren ap i platsa, kai kol Filistarja his, un lan pani dran koi brunna pash ko foreskro wudar an Betlehem, un anan kowa pash o Davideste. Job kamas gar te pijell, un tchoras ko pani win o baro Debleske,

un penas: “Miro Dewel mu mukell man kowa gar te krell! Kowa hi har te pijoms ko rat kol murshendar, kai len kek traash his pengro djipaske, un djan koi, te lenn le ko pani mange.” Un job kamas gar te pijell. Kau baro koowa kran kol triin sorele kurepangre.

O Abishai, koleskro phraal o Joab hi, un kolengri dai i Zeruja hi, kowa his ko pralstuno kol triin-deshendar. O Abishai las leskro witsepaskro tchuri, un das triin-sheel lurden mulo, un les his i baro lab mank kol triin-deshende.
Un job was budeder an-diklo har kol wawar kol triin-deshendar, un his lengro pralstuno. Jaake an-diklo har kol triin, hi job gar.

O Benaja, koleskro dad o Jojada his, dran o gab Kabzeel, his i wawar kurepaskro mursh, kai baro koowa kras. Kowa das kol dui sorele murshen mulo, kai wan kharedo ‘lewe dran Moab’. Ap i diwes, kai gib das, djas lo an i brunna, un das koi i lewes mulo.

Job maras ninna i murshes, i Egiptari. Kowa his pral dui metarja baro. Un les his o witsepaskro tchuri an o wast. Un ko kotar kasht, hoi ko witsepaskro tchuri rikrella, his jaake pesso har i tikno ruk. O Benaja djas pash leste tele, i kasht an o wast, un tserdas ko witsepaskro tchuri dran kol Egiptareskro wast, un das les kolah tele tchurje.
Kowa kras o Benaja, koleskro dad o Jojada his. Job his bares an-diklo mank kol wawar trijanda sorele kurepangre.
Un was budeder an-diklo har i wawar kol triin-deshendar. Job his gar jaake an-diklo har kol triin. Un o David kras, te well job o pralstuno pral leskre lurdende, kai denn jak ap leskro djipen.
I sorele kurepangre hi kolla: o Asahel, koleskro phraal o Joab hi, o Elhanan, koleskro dad o Dodo his dran Betlehem.
O Shammot dran Harod. O Helez dran Pelon,
o Ira, koleskro dad o Ikkesh hi, dran Tekoa, o Abijeser dran Anatot
o Sibbechai dran Husha o Ilai dran Ahoach,
un o Mahrai dran Netofa, o Heled, koleskro dad o Baana hi, dran Netofa,
o Itai, koleskro dad o Ribai hi, dran Gibea an o them Benjamin, o Benaja dran Piraton,
o Hurai dran Nahale-Gaash, o Abijel dran Bet-Araba,
o Asmawet dran Bahurim, o Eljachba dran Shaalbon,
o Hashem dran Gison, o Jonatan, koleskro dad o Shage hi, dran Harar,
o Achijam, koleskro dad o Sachar hi, dran Harar, o Elifal, koleskro dad o Ur hi,
o Hefer dran Mechera, o Achija dran Pelon,
o Hezro dran Karmel, o Naarai, koleskro dad o Esbai hi,
o Joel, koleskro phraal o Natan hi, o Mibhar, koleskro dad o Hagri hi,
o Zelek, ko Ammonari, o Nachrai dran Beerot. Kowa hidjras o charo o murshestar Joab, koleskri dai i Zeruja hi.
O Ira un o Gareb dran Jattir,
o Urija, ko Hetari, o Sabad, koleskro dad o Achlai hi,
o Adina, koleskro dad o Shisa hi; o Adina his jek kol pralstunendar dran o kheer Ruben, un his i pralstuno pral trijanda murshende.
o Hanan, koleskro dad o Maacha hi, O Josafat, dran Meten,
o Usija, dran Astarot, o Shama un o Jehijel, kolengro dad o Hotam hi, dran Aroer,
o Jedjael, koleskro dad o Shimri hi, un o Joha, leskro phraal, dran Tiz,
o Eljel, dran Mahawim, o Jeribai un o Joshawja, kolengro dad o Elnaam hi, o Jitma, ko Moabari,
o Eljel, o Obed un o Jaasijel dran Zoba.

Un kolla hi i mursha, kai wan pash o Davideste an o foro Ziklag, an ko tsiro, kai hunte rikras job pes dur krik o Saulestar, koleskro dad o Kish hi. Jon his sorele kurepangre, kai his pash leste an o kurepen.

Len his boge un faile, un haiwan mishto i failentsa karje te dell. Kowa nai kran le pengro tchatcho wasteha un pengro serwo wasteha. Kalla hi i laba kolendar, kai wan pash o Davideste dran o kheer Benjamin, kai ninna o Saul dran was:
O pralstuno, o Ahijeser, un o Joash, lengro dad his o Shemaa dran Gibea; o Jesijel un o Pelet, lengro dad his o Asmawet; o Berachja un o Jehu, dran Anatot;
O Jishmaja dran Gibeon; job his o pralstuno pral i trijanda sorele kurepangre;
o Jirmeja, o Jahasijel, o Johanan, o Josabad, dran o foro Gedera;
o Elusai, o Jerimot, o Bealja, o Shemarja, o Shefatja, dran o foro Haruf;
o Elkana, o Jishija, o Asarel, o Joeser, o Jashobam, dran o kheer Korach;
o Joela, un o Sebadja, kolengro dad o Jeroham hi dran o foro Gedor.

Kalla hi i laba kolendar, kai wan pash o Davideste dran o kheer Gad, an ko tsiro, har his job pral ap i berga an peskro sorelo kheer an o mulo them. Jon his sorele mursha un kurepangre. Len his shilte un witsepangre tchurja, un jon kuran pen har lewe, un his sik har i tserfe ap i berge.
O ersto his o Eser, o duito his o Obadja, o triinto his o Eliab,
o starto his o Mishmanna, o pantchto his o Jirmeja,
o shobto his o Attai, o eftato his o Eljel,
o ochtato his o Johanan, o enjato his o Elsabad,
o deshto his o Jirmeja, o deesh-te-jekto his o Machbannai.
Kolla his dran o kheer Gad. Jon lauter his pralstune lurde. O tikneder lendar his o pralstuno pral sheel lurdende, un ko bareder his o pralstuno pral i sero lurdende.
Jon djan wergel o pani Jordan an o ersto tchon, har o pani jaake bud his, te djas lo pral peskre dui rigja, un kol telstune themma kai kote tchiddo hi, tele tchinlo his.
Ninna mursha dran kol khera Benjamin un Juda wan pash o Davideskro sorelo kheer ap i berga.

Un o David djas pash lende win, un penas ap lende: “Wan tumer an o kamlepen pash mande, te rikrenn pash mande, palle hi miro dji tumentsa jek! Te wan te phukrenn ap mande pash kolende, kai kamenn man te marell, palle mu dikell o Dewel mare dadendar koi pal, un mu dell tumen i phagi. Job djinell, kai krom kek tchilatcho koowa.”

Kote was o Debleskro ducho pral o Amasai, ko pralstuno pral i trijanda sorele kurepangre, un job penas: David, tire ham mer! ap tute rikrah men, tu o Isajeskro tchawo! Latchepen un bacht mu well pral tute, un ninna pral kolende, kai pash tute hi! Tiro Dewel hi ap tiri rig! Koi las len o David pash peste, un kras lendar pralstune pral peskre lurdende.

Ninna dran o kheer Manasse wan mursha pash o Davideste. Kowa his an ko tsiro, har djas lo khetne i Filistarentsa an o kurepen, te kurenn le pen o Sauleha. O David his ap i Filistarengri rig. Lengre pralstune penan penge: “Job nai nashals an o kurepen pash leskro rajeste, o Saul, ap i rig, palle nashrah mare sherja.” Un jon bitchran o Davides krik.

Har djas o David pale an o foro Ziklag, wan mursha dran o kheer Manasse pash leste: o Adnach, o Josabad, o Jedjael, o Michael, o Josabad, o Elihu, un o Zilletai. Hakeno lendar his i pralstuno pral jek sero lurdende i menshendar Manasse.

Un jon wan o Davideske ap i rig, un kuran pen kol murshentsa, kai dan pen kote trujel un tchoran i menshen win. Kol mursha dran o kheer Manasse his halauter latche kurepangre un wan pralstune pral i lurdende.
Jaake wan hako diwes budeder mursha pash o Davideste, te wenn le leske ap i rig, bis te his le bud bud lurde.
Un kalla hi kol kurepangre, kai wan pash o Davideste, har lo an Hebron his, te krenn le les o baro rai pal o Sauleskro merepen, jaake har o baro Dewel penas.
Dran o kheer Juda: 6.800 lurde, kai hidjran shilte un witsepangre tchurja;
Dran o kheer Simeon, 7.100 sorele kurepangre;
Dran o kheer Levi: 4.600 mursha;
koi pashel o Jojada, ko pralstuno pral o kheer Aron, leha his 3.700 mursha;
o Zadok, i terno sorelo kurepaskro, un leskre menshendar 22 (biish-te-dui) pralstune.
Dran o kheer Benjamin, o Sauleskre menshendar: 3.000; bis ap ko tsiro rikran bud i menshentsa dran o Sauleskro kheer.
Dran o kheer Efrajim: 20.800 sorele kurepangre, kai an-dikle his pash pengre familjende.
Dran o paash kheer Manasse: 18.000 mursha, kolla wan o labeha win rodedo, te djan le koi, te krenn le o Davides o baro rai.
Dran o kheer Issachar, 200 pralstune, kai dikan nai, hoi o Israel hunte krella, un kaana o tchatcho tsiro koleske was. Lengre tsele phrala shunan ap lengro lab.
Dran o kheer Sebulon, 50.000 lurde. Len his kurepaskro koowa pash pende. Jon rikran pengro tselo djijeha pash o Davideste.
Dran o kheer Naftali: 1.000 pralstune, un pash lende his 37.000 lurde, kai hidjran shilte un witsepaskre tchurja.
Dran o kheer Dan: 28.600 mursha; len his kurepaskro koowa pash pende.
Dran o kheer Asser: 40.000 lurde; len his kurepaskro koowa pash pende.
Dran i familje Ruben un Gad un dran i paash familja Manasse, – jon hi kolla kai ap i wawar rig o panjestar Jordan djiwan: 120.000 mursha; len his kurepaskro koowa pash pende.

Kal tsele kurepangre wan an o foro Hebron te krenn le o Davides baro rai. Jon his jaake pre tardo har djans le an o kurepen. Pengro tselo djijestar kaman le, te well o David baro rai pral o tselo them Israel. Len un i wawar Israelitarjen his jek dji, te krenn le kowa.
Un jon his kote pash o David triin diwessa un chan un pijan, lengre phrala anan lenge chapen.

Ninna kol menshe, kai djiwan gar dur, anan lenge chapen. Jon wan jaake dur har dran kol themma Issachar, un Sebulon un Naftali, un anan ko chapen ap burike, khamele, maultikre burike un grumja: chapen dran jarro, faige un pekle drake, mool, djet, ninna bud grumja un bakre. I Israelitarja giwan un bashran.
Un o David beshas pes khetne kol pralstunentsa pral i sero lurdende un kolentsa pral sheel lurdende un kol wawar bare lurdentsa un rakras lentsa.

Palle penas lo ap i tsele Israelitarja, kai kote his: “Te hi tumenge mishto, un latcho glan maro baro Debleskre jaka, palle bitchras mer bitchepangre pash mare phralende an i tsele kotja o themestar Israel, ninna pash i rashajende un i Levitarja, kote kai jon djiwenn. Un mer mukah lenge te penell, te wenn le pash mende khetne.
Mer khetne kamah ko mochton, kai o Debleskre deesh laba dren hi, pale pash mende te lell. An ko tsiro, har o Saul djiwas, putcham gar pal leste.”
Kote penan i tsele Israelitarja, kai kote khetne his: “Kowa hi mishto. Mer krah kowa.”

Jaake mukas o David i tsele Israelitarjen khetne gole te dell, kotar, kai o pani Sihor hi an o them Egiptia, bis kotar, kai djal pash o foro Lebo-Hamat, te lenn le ko mochton o deesh labentsa o Deblestar dran o foro Kirjat-Jearim.

Un o David djas i tsele Israelentsa pral an o foro Baala. Kawa hi i wawar lab o foreske Kirjat-Jearim, un hi an o them Juda tchiddo. Kote his o mochton tardo o baro Deblestar, kai beshdo hi pral i bolepangre, kai kharenna Cherubim, un kai well job an-mangedo.
Un jon mukan ko mochton ap i newo wurdin dran o kheer te anell, kai o Abinadab djiwell. Un o Usa un leskro phraal djan o wurdineha un dan ap leste jak.
O David un i tsele menshe an Israel khelan bachteles glan o Debleste, giwan gilja, un kran bashepen ap dorjengre bashepangre, ap pauke, ap phurdepangre un wawar bashepangre.
Har wan le pash ko djobeskri platsa o murshestar Kidon, kaman i grumja win te phagell, un o Usa rikras o mochton, te perell lo gar.
Kowa hunte krals lo gar. Job hunte tapras gar o Debleskro mochton an. Koi was o baro Debleskri choli pral o Usa. Un o Dewel maras les koi. Un job meras kote glan o Debleste.
Koi was o David chojedo, kai o baro Dewel o Usaes jaake krik las. Doleske kharell koi platsa ‘Perez-Usa’ gomme kai diwes.
Un o David trashas o Deblestar ap ko diwes, un penas: “Har nai lau me o Debleskro mochton pash mande?”
Un job mukas les gar pash peste te anell an o Davideskro foro. Na-a, job mukas les an ko kheer te anell, kai djiwell o Obed-Edom. Kowa his i mursh dran o foro Gat.
Jaake atchas o baro Debleskro mochton triin tchon an koleskro kheer. Un o baro Dewel tchiwas peskri bacht un soor ap leste un ap halauter, hoi les his.

O baro rai pral o foro Tirus, o Hiram, bitchras murshen pash o Davideste, kai anan leske zedertikro kasht, ninna budepangren, kai haiwan mishto i barrentsa un o kashteha te budrell. Kolla kran o Davideske i shukar baro kheer.
O David haiwas, te kras o baro Dewel, te well un atchell job baro rai pral Israel. Kowa kras job peskre menshenge, i Israelenge.
Un o David las peske budeder romja an o foro Jerusalem, Un leske wan budeder tchawe un tcha boldo.
Kalla hi kol laba kol tchawendar, kai wan an o foro Jerusalem boldo: o Shamua, o Shobab, o Natan, o Salomo,
o Jibhar, o Elishua, o Elpelet,
o Noga, o Nefeg, o Jafia,
o Elishama, o Beeljada, un o Elifelet.

Har kol Filistarja shunan, kai was djet pral o Davideskro shero tchoredo, te well job baro rai pral Israel, djan jon lauter koi, te rodenn le les. Har o David kowa shunas, djas job win te kurell lo pes leha.
Un i Filistarja wan, un his an koi tseli tala Refajim.
O David putchas o baro Deblestar: “Djap me pral pash kol Filistarja? Kameh len an mire wasta te dell?” Un o baro Dewel penas ap o Davideste: “Dja pral! Me dau kol Filistarjen an tire wasta.”

Un o David was an Baal-Perazim, un kote das lo i Filistarjen, un penas: “Jaake har i sorelo pani peske i drom krell, kras mange o baro Dewel i drom mashkral kolende, kai kaman mange tchilatchepen.” Doleske kharell koi platsa “Baal-Perazim.”
Har i Filistarja nashan penge, lan le pengre chochene deblen gar pentsa. Un o David penas, te wenn kolla chatchedo.
Kol Filistarja djan pale koi pral, un his an koi tseli tala.
Un o David putchas pale o Deblestar, un o Dewel penas ap leste: “Tu djas gar pral pal lende. Tu wess koi wawar rigjatar pral lende, koi rigjatar, kai i balsamtikre ruka tchidde hi.
Tu te shuneh i gole, har te djal jek pral an i ruka, palle am win! Palle djal o Dewel glan tute, te marell job i Filistarengre lurden.”
Un o David kras jaake, har o Dewel leske penas. Un jon dan kol Filistarjen un tradan len pale o tselo drom dran Gibeon bis pash o foro Geser.
Un o David his i sharedo mursh an i tsele themma. Un o baro Dewel kras, te was i traash glan leste ap i tsele themma.

Un o David mukas peske khera te krell an o Davideskro foro. Job rodas ninna i kotar phub win, kai te well o mochton o Debleskre deesh labentsa pre tchiddo, un mukas leske i plachteno kheer pre te tchiwell.

An ko tsiro penas o David: “Kek hunte hidjrell o mochton o Debleskre deesh labentsa, har kokres i Levitarja, kolen rodas o baro Dewel win, te hidjrenn jon ko mochton, un te budrenn jon leske hako tsiro.”
Un o David mukas i tsele Israelitarjen an o foro Jerusalem khetne te well, te nai anenn le o mochton o baro Debleskre deesh labentsa ap ko kotar phub, kai was leske win rodedo.
Un o David mukas ninna i tchawe o rashajestar Aron khetne te kharell un i Levitarja:
i tchawendar o murshestar Kohat: o Urijel, ko his o pralstuno, un leskre phrala; khetne his le 120 mursha;
i tchawendar o murshestar Merari: o Asaja, ko his o pralstuno, un leskre phrala; khetne his le 220 mursha;
i tchawendar o murshestar Gershon: o Joel, ko his o pralstuno, un leskre phrala; khetne his le 130 mursha;
i tchawendar o murshestar Elizafan: o Shemaja, ko his o pralstuno, un leskre phrala; khetne his le 200 mursha;
i tchawendar o murshestar Hebron: o Eljel, kowa his o pralstuno, un leskre phrala; khetne his le 80 mursha;
i tchawendar o murshestar Usijel: o Amminadab, ko his o pralstuno, un leskre tsele phrala; khetne his le 112 mursha;
Un o David mukas i rashajen o Zadok un o Abjatar pash peste te well, ninna i Levitarjen, o Urijel, o Asaja, o Joel, o Shemaja, o Eljel, un o Amminadab.

Un job penas ap lende: “Tumer han i pralstune pral tumare menshende dran o kheer Levi. Krenn tumen djudjo o Debleske, tumer un tumare phrala, te nai anenn o mochton o deesh labentsa o baro Deblestar, kai o Israeleskro Dewel hi, ap ko kotar phub, hoi me rodom leske win!
Ko wawar kopo hans tumer gar koi pashel. Doleske das men o baro Dewel i pharo dap. Mer putcham lestar gar jaake har hunte wals.”
Koi kran pen i rashaja un i Levitarja djudjo o Debleske, te nai anenn le o mochton koi pral.
Un i Levitarja hidjran o mochton ap pengre phika i hidjepaskre kashtentsa, jaake har o baro Dewel penas kowa o Moseske, un kowa les i Israelenge penas.

Un o David penas i pralstunenge pral i Levitarja, te rodenn jon gipangren win dran pengre phralende. Kalla hunte giwenn i bachtjatar i bari goljah, un bashrenn ap i dorjengre bashepangre un wawar bashepangre.

Koi rodan i Levitarja o gipaskres o Heman win, koleskro dad o Joel hi, un leskro phrales, o Asaf, koleskro dad o Berechja hi. Ninna rodan le o Etan win, koleskro dad o Kushaja hi, dran i familja Merari.

Un lenge ap i rig wan: o Sacharja, o Ben-Jaasijel, o Semiramot, o Jehijel, o Unni, o Eliab, o Benaja, o Maaseja, o Mattitja, o Elifelehu, o Mikneja, o Obed-Edom, o Jehijel, kolendar, kai dan garda ap i wudja.
Un i gipangre his: o Heman, o Asaf, un o Etan. Kolla dan i patria dran lolo saster khetne.
Un kolla, kai bashrenn ap i harfa, his o Secharja, o Jaasijel, o Semiramot, o Jehijel, o Unni, o Eliab, o Maaseja, un o Benaja.
Un kolla, kai bashrenn ap ochta-dorjengre bashepangre his: O Mattitja, o Elifelehu, o Mikneja, o Obed-Edom, o Jehijel, un o Asasja.
O Kenanja, o pralstuno pral i Levitarja, his o pralstuno pral o gipen, job haiwas kowa mishto, un sikras i wawarende, har te giwenn le.
Un o Berechja un o Elkana, his dui kolendar, kai dan jak ap o mochton o Debleskre deesh labentsa.

Glan o mochton djan i rashaja: o Aba, o Shebanja, o Josafat, o Netanel, o Amasai, o Secharja, o Benaja, un o Elijeser. Jon phurdan an bare phurdepangre. Un o Obed-Edom un o Jechija djan pal o mochton un dan jak ap leste.

Un o David un i phureder dran Israel djan kote, te anenn le o mochton o Debleskre deesh labentsa pre dran o kheer o murshestar Obed-Edom. Lentsa djan i pralstune pral i lurdende, kolla pral jek sero un kolla pral jek sheel. Halauteren his bachtele djia.
Un o Dewel his i Levitarentsa, kai o mochton hidjrenn, kai o baro Debleskre deesh laba dren hi, un lauter djas mishto. Doleske maran le leske efta terne gurma un efta mursh bakre.

Un o Davides his i plaashka dran bijalo laintikro than ap peste. Un jaake his ninna i tsele Levitarja an-rido, kai o mochton hidjrenn, ninna i gipangre un o Kenanja, ko pralstuno pral i gipangre. Un o David his ninna i laintikri damdira ap peste, har i rashaja hidjrenn.
Jaake anan i tsele Israelitarja o mochton o baro Debleskre deesh labentsa pral an Jerusalem. Jon dan gole i bachtjatar, giwan un bashran ap phurdepangre, dorjengre bashepangre un wawar bashepangre.

Un har was o mochton o baro Debleskre deesh labentsa an o Davideskro foro anlo, dikas i Michal, kolakro dad o Saul his, dran i wochni. Un har dikas li o baro rajes, o David, har job stas un khelas, dikas li tele ap leste an lakro dji.

Har jon o Debleskro mochton dren anan, tchiwan jon les an ko plachteno kheer, hoi o David leske pre tchiwas, un chatchran viechen o baro Debleske, un maran wawar viechen, te chan le len khetne glan o Debleste.
Un pal kowa rakras o David pral i menshende i bacht o baro Deblestar win.
Un job das hako menshes, kai kote hi, murshen un djuwjen, hakenes, jek maro, jek kotar mass un jek drakengri merkli.
Un job rodas gipangre win dran i Levitarja, te hi le tardo glan o baro Debleskro mochton, te sharenn le o baro Debles un parkrenn pen pash leste pengre giljentsa.

Kolla his: o Asaf, lengro pralstuno; o Secharja his o duito; pal leste o Jasijel, o Semiramot, o Jehijel, o Mattitja, o Eliab, o Benaja, o Obed-Edom un o Jehijel. Jon te giwenn un bashrenn ap pengre dorjengre bashepangre. Un o Asaf te dell ap i sasterne patria.
I rashaja, o Benaja un o Jahasijel, lengri budi his, te phurdenn le ap pengre phurdepangre hako tsiro glan o mochton o Debleskre deesh labentsa.
Ap ko diwes mukas o David o ersto kopo o Asafes un leskre phralen kai gili te giwell, te parkrenn le pen pash o baro Debleste.
Parkrenn tumen pash o baro Debleste, un hadenn leskro lab! Penenn i menshenge an wawar themma kowa, hoi job kras!
Giwenn un bashrenn leske! Rakrenn pral ko tselo baro koowa, hoi job lauter kras!
Sharenn koles, koon kokres o tchatcho Dewel hi! Awenn bachteles pral leste, tumer, kai rodenn o baro Debles!
Putchenn pal o baro Debleste, un pal leskri soor! Awenn glan leste hako tsiro!

Tumer, kai wenn pal o Israel, o Debleskro budepaskro, tumer tchawe o Jakobestar, koles job win rodas, ma bistrenn, hoi job lauter kras an peskri bari soor, kowa, hoi kek wawar nai kras! Ma bistrenn, har job o tchatchepen pral i menshende win rakras!
O baro Dewel hi maro Dewel, un o tchatchepaskro rai pral i tseli phub.
Ma bistrenn, hoi job mentsa win kras! Leskro lab, hoi das lo, atchella jaake rah har menshe ap i phub djiwenna.
Kowa hi ko lab, hoi das lo o Abrahameste, koi sowel, hoi das lo o Isaakeste,
un pal leste o Jakobeste, un das peskro wast pre, te atchell kau lab i Israelenge hako tsireske.
Job penas: “Tuke dau kau them Kanaan, kowa hi ko them hoi tumenge well.”
An ko tsiro his le gar bud, gar budeder har i wast pherdo, un his wi-themarja an o them.
Un jon djan jek themestar an o wawar, djan trujel an bud rajengre themma.
Un o Dewel das jak, te taprell len kek an. Un i bare rajen pral kol themma das lo trad un penas lenge:
“Lenn i wasta krik mire menshenge, kolen mange win rodom! Ma krenn tchilatchepen kolenge, kai mire rakepangre hi!”
Giwenn leske, o baro Debleske, tumer menshe an i tsele themma! Penenn i menshenge, te hi job kowa, kai lell win dran o tchilatchepen.
Penenn kolenge, kai les gar prindjrenna, hawo railepen les hi. Penenn i menshenge an hake themma hawo baro koowa job kras.
O baro Dewel hi o pralstuno, un hakeno hunte sharell les. Mank i tsele wawar debla hi job kowa, konestar daras mer.
I debla i wawar menshendar hi chochene debla. O baro Dewel hi kowa, kai o bolepen kras.
Job hi bareder har hako wawar. Shukapen hi trul leste, Leskri soor un leskri bacht hi an leskro kheer.
Tumer dran i wawar themma, sharenn o baro Debles! Sharenn leskro railepen un leskri soor!
Krenn leskro lab bares jaake har job moldo hi! Awenn glan leste, un anenn leske shukar koowa! Mangenn o baro Debles an ap ko diwes, kai well lo an shukar un kutch ripja.
I tseli phub hunte trissell glan leste. Job kras i phub, te well li soreles tardo.
O bolepen well bachtelo, un i phub sala. Penenn i tsele menshenge: O baro Dewel hi o baro rai.
O baro pani stell i bachtjatar un lauter, hoi an leste hi. O them well bachtelo un lauter, hoi ap leste baro was.
I tsele ruka an o weesh giwenna i bachtjatar glan o baro Debleste. Job wella, un anell o tchatchepen ap i phub.
Sharedo well o baro Dewel! Parkrenn tumen pash o baro Debleste! Job hi i latcho Dewel. Leskro latchepen atchella hako tsireske.

Penenn: Maro Dewel, ab ap mari rig! tu hal kowa, kai lell men win dran o tchilatchepen. Doleske le men win dran i wasta kol wawar menshendar! An men pale lauter khetne, te sharas tut un parkras men pash tute, kai kokres o tchatcho Dewel hal.
Sharedo well o baro Dewel, kai o Israeleskro Dewel hi, kanna un hako tsireske! Un i tsele menshe penan: “Amen! Sharedo well o baro Dewel!”
Un jaake har o David lenge penas, atchan o Asaf un leskre phrala glan o mochton o baro Debleskre deesh labentsa, te krenn le kote koi budi, hoi hako diwes hunte kerdo well.
Ninna o Obed-Edom, koleskro dad o Jedutun his un leskre 68 (shob-deesh-te-ochta) phrala atchan kote. O Obed-Edom un o Hosa dan garda ap i wudja.
I rashaja, o Zadok un leskre phrala, kran pengri budi pash o baro Debleskro plachteno kheer ap i berga pash o foro Gibeon.

Jon hunte anan o baro Debleske hako diwes viechen, kai leske tseles chatchedo wenn ap i sasterni chatchepaskri, taissarlakro un ratsjakro. Jaake his glan tchinlo an o Moseskre lila, kai tardo hi, hoi o baro Dewel peskre menshendar Israel kamella.
Ninna atchan kote wi-rodede gipangre, kai pengro labeha pre kharedo wan, te parkrenn le pen pash o baro Debleste, kai leskro latchepen an hako tsiro kai hi. Mank lende his o Heman un o Jedutun.
Jon sharan o Debles pengro bashepah, un bashran ap i phurdepangre un dorjengre bashepangre un wawar bashepangre. I tchawen o murshestar Jedutun das o David koi budi, te denn le garda ap i wudja.
Un i tsele menshe djan penge, hakeno an peskro kheer. Un ninna o David djas khere, te penell lo peskri familjake ‘latcho diwes’.

Har kanna o David an peskro kheer djiwas, penas lo ap o Debleskro rakepaskro, o Natan: “Me djiwau an i kheer dran zedertikro kasht, un o mochton, kai i deesh laba o baro Deblestar dren hi, hi tardo an i plachteno kheer. Hi kowa mishto?”
Penas o Natan ap leste: “Dja koi un kre lauter, hoi tut ap o dji hi! O baro Dewel hi pash tute!”
Un an koi rati penas o baro Dewel ap o Nataneste:
Dja koi un pen ap miro budepaskro, o David: Jaake penell o baro Dewel: “Tu hal kowa gar, kai krell mange i kheer, te djiwap koi.
Me djiwom an kek kheer, fun ko diwes, kai me kol Israelitarjen win anom dran o them Egiptia bis kai diwes. Man his tchi har i plachteno kheer, har djom lentsa fun jek platsa ap i wawar.
An ko tselo tsiro penom me kekeske, kai das garda ap mire menshende Israel: ‘Hoske kreh tu mange kek kheer dran zedertikro kasht?’”

Doleske hunte peness tu ap miro budepaskro, o David: Jaake penell o baro Dewel, kai hi o rai pral o bolepen un i phub: “Me lom tut i bakrendar krik, kai tu pre garda dal, te wess tu rai pral mire menshende Israel.
Me homs pash tute, kai tu ninna djal, un marom kolen lauteren glan tute, kai kuran pen tuha. Me krom tiro lab bares, jaake prindjedo har i laba kol bare rajendar ap i phub.
Un me kamau mire menshen Israel i them te dell, kai nai atchenn jon. Un koi djiwenn le, kai trashenn jon buder gar, un kai wenn jon gar buder tele rikedo kol tchilatche menshendar, har an ko tsiro,
kai rodom me tchatchepangre raja mire menshenge win. Un me krau kolen tiknes glan tute, kai kurenn pen tuha. Me mukau tuke kanna te penell: Tu kreh mange kek kheer. Me krau tuke i kheer.
Te hi tiro tsiro trujel, un tu mereh, hadau jekes tire tchawendar, kai pal tute wenna, te well lo baro rai, un atchell kowa.
Kowa krell mange i kheer. Un me krau, te atchell lo hako tsiro baro rai.
Me kamau leskro dad te well. Un job well miro tchawo. Miro latchepen lau gar lestar krik, har me miro latchepen kolestar krik lom, kai glan tute o baro rai his.
Me tchiwau les pral mire menshende, te atchell lo baro rai pral lende hako tsireske. Un tiro rajengri beshepaskri atchell hako tsiro.”
Har o Natan kol tsele laba, hoi o Dewel leske sikras, o Davideske penas,
djas o baro rai David an o Debleskro plachteno kheer, witsras pes tele glan o baro Debleste un penas: “Baro Dewel, miro rai, koon hom me, un hoi hi miro kheer, kai tu kral jaake bud mange?
Un kanna hi kowa tuke gar doha, miro Dewel. Tu penal mange, hoi mire tchawende kameh te dell an ko tsiro, hoi dur glan mende hi. Un tu dikal ap mande har ap i baro mensheste, miro baro Dewel.
Tu kral man, tiro budepaskres, jaake railo! – Hoi nai rakrau me gomme budeder? Tu djineh, hoi an miro dji hi.
Baro Dewel, mange kral tu kau tselo baro koowa. Kowa his jaake an tiro dji, te sikress tiro tselo railepen.
Baro Dewel, kek hi jaake har tu! Un dell kek dewel har tu, pal lauter, hoi mer mare kandentsa shunam.

Un kai hi menshe ap i phub har tire menshe Israel? Kolenge djal tu koi, te less len dran o pandepen win. Ko baro un sorelo koowa, hoi tu lenge kral, kras, te wal prindjedo ap i phub. Tu tradal wawar menshen win glan tire menshende, kai tu win lal dran Egiptia.
Tu rodal tuke kol menshen Israel win, te wenn jon tire menshe hako tsireske. Un tu, baro Dewel, wal lengro Dewel.
Un kanna, baro Dewel, muk ko lab tchatcho te well hako tsireske, hoi tu pral mande un pral miro kheer penal. Un kre jaake, har tu penal,

te djinenn i menshe, kai kowa, hoi tu penal, ninna jaake well, un tiro lab sharedo well an hake tsirja, un i menshe penenna: ‘O baro Dewel, ko rai pral o bolepen un i phub, koles i Israelitarja an-mangenn, job hi o Israeleskro Dewel.’ Un o kheer David, kai tiro budepaskro hi, atchell tardo glan tute.
Tu, miro Dewel, sikral man, hoi kameh te krell – un penal mange: ‘Me krau tuke i kheer.’ Doleske lom man khetne un rakrom tuha.
Baro Dewel, tu hal o tchatcho Dewel, un dal man tiro lab, te dess kau latcho koowa mande, tiro budepaskro.
Kanna tchip tiri bacht pral mande un mire menshende, te atchenn le glan tute hako tsiro. Ap koneste tu tiri bacht tchiwal, ap koleste atchell tiri bacht tchiddo hako tsireske.”
Pal kowa kuras pes o David i Filistarentsa un his sorleder har jon, un las o foro Gat un i gaba trul Gat dran lengro wast.
Ninna das lo i Moabarja. Un jon wan o Davideskre budepangre un hunte plaissran ap leste, hoi lo lendar kamas.

O David kuras pes ninna o baro rajeha pral o them Zoba. Leskro lab his Hadad-Eser. Har o Hadad-Eser koi djas, te lell lo o them pash ko pani Eufrat dren, was o David peskre lurdentsa, un das les un leskre lurden pash o foro Hamat.
Un o David las lestar jek sero wurdja, 7.000 (efta serja) klissepangre, un 20.000 (biish-serja) lurden, un kras i tsele grajen bango. Kokres sheel lendar mukas lo pral.
Koi wan kol Syrarja dran o them Damaskus pash o Hadad-Eser, ko baro rai pral o them Zoba, te wenn le leske ap i rig. Un o David maras lendar 22.000 (biish-te-dui-serja) murshen.

Un job tchiwas moskre dren an lengro them. Un o Davides was penepaske pral i Syrarja, un jon hunte plaissran ap leste, hoi lo lendar kamas. Jaake his o baro Dewel o Davideske ap i rig, kai lo ninna djas.
Kol lurden o baro rajestar Hadad-Eser his sonakangre shilte. Kolen anas o David an o foro Jerusalem.

Un bud lolo saster las lo dran i forja Tibhat un Kun. Kal forja his an o them, kai his o Hadad-Eser o baro rai. Kolestar mukas o Salomo o panjeskro tcharo un kol dui turme un wawar koola dran lolo saster o Debleskro khereske te krell.

Ko rai pral o foro Hamat – leskro lab his Toi, – his an o kurepen o baro rajeha Hadad-Eser. Har o Toi kanna shunas, kai maras o David koleskre tsele lurden, bitchras lo peskro tchawes, o Hadoram, pash o baro rajeste David, un parkras pes pash leste, un mukas leske te penell, te well les bud bacht. Un o Hadoram anas peha sonakangre koola un rupene koola un sawe dran lolo saster.
Kowa lauter das o baro rai David o baro Debleste, un tchiwas kowa an leskro kheer, ninna ko rup un sonakai, hoi las job kol menshendar dran i themma Edom, Moab, Ammon, Filistia un Amalek.
Un o Abishai, koleskri dai i Zeruja hi, das i Edomarja ap ko kotar phub, hoi kharell Londi Tala. Un job maras an koi tala 18.000 (deesh-te-ochta-serja) lurden.
Un o David tchiwas moskre dren an hako foro an o them Edom. Un o Davides his penepaske pral o tselo them Edom. O baro Dewel his ap o Davideskri rig, kai job ninna djas.
Jaake his o David baro rai pral o tselo them Israel, un kras, te lell hakeno peskro tchatchepen.
O Joab, koleskri dai i Zeruja hi, his o pralstuno pral i tsele lurdende, un o Josafat, koleskro dad o Ahilud his, his o baro rajeskro rakepaskro.
O Zadok, koleskro dad o Ahitub hi, un o Ahimelek, koleskro dad o Abjatar hi, his rashaja. O Shawsha his kowa, kai tchinas i lila.

O Benaja, koleskro dad o Jojada hi, his o pralstuno pral kol Kretarja un Pletarja, kai his trul o baro rajeste tardo, te denn le ap leste jak. Un o Davideskre tchawe his i glanstune ap i rig o baro rajestar.
Pal ko tsiro meras o Nahash, ko baro rai pral kol Ammonarja. Un leskro tchawo, o Hanun, was baro rai pal leste.

Koi penas peske o David: “Me kamau o tchaweha o Nahashestar, o Hanun, maal te well, jaake har leskro dad miro maal his.” Un o David bitchras murshen koi, un mukas leske kamle laba te penell pral leskro dadeste, te well leske gar buder ropaske. Har kanna kolla, kai o David bitchras, an ko them Ammon wan pash o Hanun, te penenn le leske kamle laba,

koi penan kol pralstune pral kol Ammonarja ap o Hanun: “Patseh tu tchatchepah, kai bitchras o David murshen, te sharenn le tiro dades glan tire jaka, un te penenn le tuke kamle laba pral leste? Patseh tu gar, kai job doleske murshen pash tute bitchras, te dikenn le pal, har sorelo maro them hi, un hoi koi glan djala, te lell lo les dren?”
Koi tapras o Hanun kolen, kai o David bitchras, un mukas lenge i balla un i tchor tele te tchinell, un i koola paash tele tchinell, bis pral i herja, un mukas len te djal.

Un jon djan penge. Kowa, hoi lentsa kerdo was, his i bari ladj kol murshenge. Har o Davideske kowa penlo was, bitchras job murshen pash lende, un mukas lenge te penell: “Atchenn an o foro Jericho, bis te tumari tchor pale bares was! Koi pal awenn pale!”

Har o Hanun un kol Ammonarja dikan, kai kran le o Davides mulo chojedo, lan le jek sero zentnari rup, un bitchran kau rupeha murshen an i themma Mesopotamia un Syria, un kote an i tikne themma Maacha un Zoba, te ginenn le kote lurden un kurepangre wurdja un klissepangre.

Un jon lan penge 32.000 kurepangre wurdja, un o baro rajes dran Maacha un leskre lurden. Kolla wan un tchiwan pengre plachtene khera pre glan o foro Medeba. Un i Ammonarja wan ninna dran pengre forja un wan khetne kurepaske.
Har kowa o David shunas, bitchras job o Joabes pash lende peskre tsele sorele lurdentsa.
Un kol Ammonarja djan win an o kurepen, un atchan tardo pash ko baro wudar lengro forestar. Kol raja dran Syria his kokres penge tardo ap i kotar phub.
Un o Joab dikas, kai kolla kaman pen leha te kurell, un wan fun glan un pal. Koi rodas job peskre feteder murshen win, te kurenn pen kolla kol lurdentsa dran o them Syria.
Kol wawar lurden tchiwas job tel o wast peskro phralestar Abishai, te kurenn pen kolla kol Ammonentsa.
Un penas ap leste: “Te hi kol Syrarja sorleder har me, weh tu ap mari rig. Te hi kol Ammonarja sorleder har tu, wau me ap tiri rig.
Ma dare, las men khetne te kuras kek darjah mare menshenge un kol forjenge maro Deblestar! O baro Dewel krella, hoi mishto hi an leskre jaka.”
O Joab was kol lurdentsa, kai pash leste hi, te kurenn le pen kolentsa dran Syria. Kolla nashan penge lendar.
Har kol Ammonarja dikan, kai kol Syrarja nashan, nashan jon ninna glan o Abishai, un tserdan pen pale an o foro dren. Un o Joab was pale pale an o foro Jerusalem.

Har i Syrarja dikan, kai jon i Israelendar dino his, bitchran le murshen pash i Syrarja, kai djiwenn wergel o pani Eufrat, un mukan len gole te dell, te djan jon ninna an o kurepen. Un o Shobach, ko pralstuno lurdo ko baro rajestar Hadad-Eser, djas glan lende.
Un o Davideske was kowa penlo. Un job las o tsele Israelitarjen khetne un djas pral o pani Jordan. Un har job pash lende was, tchiwas lo peskre lurden wergel lendar pre. Un i Syrarja kuran pen leha.

Un kol Syrarja hunte nashan penge i Israelendar. Un o David maras lendar 7.000 (efta-serja) murshen, kai ap i kurepangre wurdja his, un 40.000 (star-deesh-serja) lurden. Un o Shobach, ko pralstuno lurdo o baro rajestar Hadad-Eser, koles maras lo ninna.

Un kol tsele raja, kolengro pralstuno o Hadad-Eser hi, dikan, kai i Israelitarja i sorleder hi pral lende. Koi mukan le tele, te kurenn le pen o Davideha. Un les was penepaske pral lende. Un kol Syrarja kaman buder gar i lurdenge dran Ammon ap i rig te well.

Un ko bersh djas trujel. Un an ko tsiro, kai kol bare raja an o kurepen djan, djas o Joab peskre lurdentsa an o kurepen. Un jon kuran pen i Ammonentsa, kran lengro them paash un tchiwan pen trul o foro Rabba. O David atchas an Jerusalem. Un o Joab las o foro Rabba dren un das les an kotja.

Palle was ninna o David un las o baro rajeske dran o them Ammon leskro shereskro sonakai tele. Kowa his 35 (trijanda-te-pantch) kilogramme pharo, un ap leste his kutch barra. Un kau shereskro sonakai tchiwan jon ap o Davideskro shero. Un job anas bud brawlepen dran ko foro krik.

Kol menshen dran ko foro anas lo win. Un kolla hunte budran phares ap i tchinepangre, te tchinenn le bar, un ap i sasterne tower un wawar sasterne koola. Jaake kras o David kol tsele forjentsa kol Ammonendar. Pal kowa djas o David peskre tsele lurdentsa pale an o foro Jerusalem.
Koi pal was i wawar kurepen kol Filistarentsa pash o foro Geser. Koi das o Sibbechai dran o gab Husha i wawar murshes kol bare menshendar mulo. Koleskro lab his Sippai. Jaake wan i Filistarja dino.

Pal kowa was pale i kurepen i Filistarentsa. Koi das o Elhanan, koleskro dad o Jair his, o murshes Lachmi mulo. Kowa hi i phraal o Goliatestar dran Gat. Koles his i lengsto witsepaskro tchuri. Un ko kotar kasht, hoi ko witsepaskro tchuri rikrella, his jaake pesso har i tikno ruk.
Pal kowa was pale i kurepen pash o foro Gat. Mank i Filistarja his i wawar baro mursh. Koles his shob gushte ap hako wast, un shob tsebe ap hako piro.
Un job praassas o Israel. Un o Jonatan, koleskro dad o Shimea his, das les mulo. O Shimea his i phraal o Davidestar.
Kolla his bare mursha un djiwan an o foro Gat. Un kolla wan mulo dino o Davidestar un leskre lurdendar.
Un o beng kamas tchilatchepen te krell ap i menshende Israel. Jaake das lo o Davideske an o dji, te hatsell lo win, har bud mursha an Israel hi, kai nai djan an o kurepen.

Un o David penas ap o Joab un ap kol pralstunende pral Israel: “Djan trujel pash kol tsele menshende an o tselo them Israel, jek rigjatar ap i wawar, un hatsenn win, har bud mursha koi hi, kai nai wenn lurde mange! Un penenn kowa mange!”

O Joab penas ap leste: “Miro baro rai, kamau o djijestar, te dell tut o baro Dewel sheel kope jaake bud menshen koi pashel, har kai hi. Jon halauter kamenn tuke koi te well un rikrenn ap tute. Hoske kameh tu, miro rai, sawo koowa te krell un djinell, har bud kolla hi? Hoske kameh te aness i doosh ap Israel?”
O baro rajeskro lab his sorleder har o kol laba o Joabestar. Jaake djas o Joab win, un nashas o tselo them Israel tele, un was pale an o foro Jerusalem.
Un job penas o Davideske, har bud mursha koi hi. Un an o tselo Israel his 1.100.000 (deesh-te-jek-sheel-serja) mursha, kai hidjran i charo un an Juda 470.000 (star-sheel-efta-deesh-serja) mursha.
I mursha dran i khera Levi un Benjamin his gar koi pashel. O Joabeske his o Davideskre laba gar mishto. Doleske dikas lo gar pal, har bud mursha an kal dui bare familje hi.
Kau tselo koowa his djungeles glan o Debleskre jaka. Doleske das lo i Israelenge i phagi.
Un o David penas ap o Debleste: “Kowa hi i bari doosh, hoi anom ap mande. Me krom i tchilatcho koowa. Un kanna mangau tut, le mange koi doosh krik!”
Un o baro Dewel rakras ap o Gad. Kowa his o Davideskro dikepaskro. Un penas ap leste:
Dja pash o Davideste un pen leske: Kawa penell o baro Dewel: “Triin koowa penau tuke. Rode tuke jek win, un kowa krau me tuke.”
Un har o Gad pash o Davideste was, penas lo ap leste: Kawa penell o baro Dewel: Rode win:

“Kameh tu, te well triin bersh i bari bok? Kameh, te nashess triin tchon kolendar krik, kai kamenn tut te marell un lenn tut o chareha palla? Kameh, te well triin diwessa i baro nasslepen an o them? Kau nasslepen hi o baro Debleskro charo, un leskro bolepaskro marell bud menshen an o tselo them Israel. Kanna muk kowa an tiro shero trujel te djal! Palle pen mange, hoi me ap koleste penap, kai bitchras man!”
Un o David penas ap o Gad: “Man hi bari traash. Muk man an o baro Debleskro wast te perell! Leskro kamlepen hi baro. Me kamau gar an i menshengro wasta perell.”
Koi mukas o baro Dewel i baro nasslepen pral o Israel te well, un 70.000 (efta-deesh-serja) menshe meran.

Un o Dewel bitchras ko bolepaskres an o foro Jerusalem, te marell lo len an o foro. Har was ko nasslepen koi, khaitas o baro Debles koi bibacht. Un job penas ap ko bolepaskro, kai anas o merepen pral i menshende: “Kanna hi doha! Le tiro wast lendar krik!” O Debleskro bolepaskro his tardo ap koi djobeskri platsa o murshestar Arauna. Kowa his i Jebusari.

Un o David dikas pral un dikas ko bolepaskres o baro Deblestar tardo mashkral i phub un o bolepen. An leskro wast his i charo, koleha sikras lo pral o foro Jerusalem. Kote peras o David un i phureder ap pengro mui. Halauter his le an gone an-rido.

Un o David penas ap o baro Debleste: “Shun, kowa hom me, kai mukom pal te dikell, har bud mursha an o them hi. Me anom doosh ap mande un krom i tchilatcho koowa. Kol menshe kate kran kek tchilatcho koowa. Jon hi har bakre, ap kolende kek doosh hi. Miro baro Dewel, mangau tut, muk koi phagi ap mande un miro dadeskro kheer te well, un gar ap tire menshende! Kre lenge kek tchilatchepen!”
Un o baro Debleskro bolepaskro penas ap o Gad: Pen o Davideske: “Dja koi pral ap koi djobeskri platsa ko murshestar Arauna, ko Jebusari! Un kre kote o baro Debleske i chatchepaskri!”
Koi djas o David pral, jaake har o baro Dewel lestar kamas, un o Gad leske penas.
Ap ko diwes das o Arauna o djob, te perell o tikno djob win. Un job rissras pes trujel un dikas ko bolepaskres. Un job un leskre star tchawe khatran pen.
Har was o David pash o Arauna, dikas o Arauna pre un dikas o Davides. Un job djas win dran o djobeskri platsa un djas pash o Davideste un tchiwas pes glan leste ap peskro mui tele ap i phub.

Un o David penas ap o Arauna: “Bike mange tiri djobeskri platsa, te krap kote i chatchepaskri o baro Debleske, te djal koi nasslepen i menshendar krik. Me dau tut jaake bud lowe har koi platsa moldo hi.”

O Arauna penas ap o David: “Miro baro rai, le tuke kowa lauter, un kre jaake har kameh. Dik, me dau tut i grumja chatchepaske, un ko wurdin te well tut kasht chatchepaske, ninna djob, hoi nai chatchreh o Debleske, kowa lauter dau tut.”

Un o baro rai David penas ap o Arauna: “Jaake djal gar. Tchatchepah, me kamau tutar kowa tele ginell, un plaissrau, hoi ko koowa molella. Kamau gar kowa te lell o baro Debleske, hoi tiro hi, kamau leske tchi te chatchrell, kai lom tchitcheske.”
Jaake ginas o David ko kotar them un plaissras 600 (shob-sheel) sonakangre kotja.

Un o David kras koi o baro Debleske i chatchepaskri, un anas viechen leske, sawen kai wan tseles chatchedo un sawen, kai chan le khetne glan o baro Debleste. Un har job o baro Debles an-kharas, mukas job jag dran o bolepen te perell ap i chatchepaskri, kai kol mule vieche tchiddo hi.
Un ap o bolepaskro penas o baro Dewel, te lell job peskro charo pale pale.
O David haiwas, kai o baro Dewel les shunas, un te chatchrell lo nai viechen kote ap koi djobeskri platsa o murshestar Arauna, ko Jebusari.
An ko tsiro his o Debleskro plachteno kheer un koi sasterni chatchepaskri ap i berga Gibeon. Kowa his ko kheer, hoi kras o Mose, har his i Israelitarja an o mulo tato them.
Kote, ap i berga Gibeon nai djas o David gar glan o Debleste, te putchell lo lestar, jaake baro his leskri traash glan o charo, hoi o bolepaskres o baro Deblestar an peskro wast his.
Un o David penas: “Kate te well o kheer o baro Debleske tardo. Kate krah leske i chatchepaskri, kai i Israelitarja nai chatchrenn viechen leske.”
Un o David mukas i wi-themarjen khetne te well, kai djiwenn an o them Israel. Un job das len koi budi, te denn le barra o khereske o baro Deblestar.
Un o David mukas bud saster te anell, te wenn lestar nagle i wudjenge un sasterno pandepen kerdo, ninna bud lolo saster, jaake bud, te nashte kek penas, har bud ko lolo saster hi.
I menshe dran Sidon un Tirus anan o Davideske bud zedertikro kasht. Jaake his les jaake bud zedertikro kasht, kai kek nai penas har bud.

O David penas peske: Miro tchawo, o Salomo, hi terno un djinell gomme gar, har te krell i kheer; ko kheer o baro Debleske hunte well jaake baro un railo, te nai well lo prindjedo un sharedo an i tsele themma. Doleske kamau me leske doha koowa koi te tchiwell. Un jaake las o David bud koowa khetne glan leskro merepen.
Un job kharas peskro tchawes, o Salomo, pash peste, un penas leske, te krell lo i kheer o baro Debleske, kai o Israeleskro Dewel hi.
Un o David penas ap o Salomo: “Miro tchawo, an miro dji his, te krap i kheer o baro Debleske, kai miro Dewel hi.
Koi penas o baro Dewel mange: ‘Tu maral bud menshen, un tut his baro kurepen. Dikom ko rat, hoi ap i phub nashas. Doleske kress tu mange kek kheer.

Dik, i tchawo well tuke boldo, job well i mursh, kai djinell kek kurepen. Me krau te kurell pes kek leha kolendar halauterendar, kai trul tumende djiwenn. Jaake rah har job djiwell, nai djiwenn i Israelitarja kek kurepah un marepah. Doleske de les o lab Salomo.
Kowa te krell mange i kheer. Un job mu well miro tchawo, un me kamau leskro dad te well. Un me krau, te well hako tsiro jek leskre tchawendar o rai pral Israel.’
Kanna, miro tchawo, mu well o baro Dewel ap tiri rig, te nai kreh tiro baro Debleske i kheer, jaake har job tutar penas.
Mu dell lo tut goswepen, te djiness, hoi te kress. Job krell tut rai pral Israel, te djas ap leskro drom.

Te rikreh tut ap kol laba, hoi o baro Dewel o Moseske penas, te djiwell o Israel koi pal, un kreh pal o Debleskro tchatchepen, palle djal tuke tiri budi mishto. Ab sorelo! Un ma traash! Ma dare tchi! Un ma traash kekestar!

Un kanna dik, me marom man tele te anom bud koowa khetne o khereske o baro Deblestar: sheel serja (100.000) zentnarja sonakai un i sero serja (1.000.000) zentnarja rup; koi pashel lolo saster un wawar saster jaake bud, kai nai penau gar har bud kowa hi. Ninna mukom kasht un barra te anell. Un tu nai tchiweh gomme budeder pashel.

Un bud budepangre hi koi: sawe, kai denn barra, sawe kai budrenn kashteha, ninna bud mursha, kai haiwenn mishto tchomone te krell dran o sonakai, rup, lolo saster, un wawar saster. Ste pre, un kre tut ap i budi! Un o baro Dewel te well tuha!”
Un o David penas ap i tsele pralstunende pral Israel, te wenn le leskro tchaweske Salomo ap i rig tardo.
Job penas: “Tumaro baro Dewel hi pash tumende! Job kras, te han an kek kurepen kol thementsa trul tumende. Job das len an miro wast, un o baro Dewel un leskre menshe hi o rai pral lende.

Kanna denn tumaro djipen un tumaro dji o baro Debleste, kai tumaro Dewel hi! Un stenn pre un krenn leske i kheer, kai leske kokres hi. Kote te well o mochton o baro Debleskre deesh labentsa dren tchiddo, ninna ko wawar Debleskro koowa. Kau kheer krenn tumer, te well o baro Dewel sharedo.”
O Davides his i lengsto djipen, un his phuro, har kras lo peskro tchawes, o Salomo, o rai pral Israel.
Un job mukas i tsele pralstunen dran Israel un i rashaja un i Levitarja khetne te well.
Un job mukas pal te dikell, har bud mursha mank i Levitarjen his, kai hi trijanda bersha un phureder. Un kolla his khetne 38.000 (trijanda-te-ochta serja) mursha.
Un kolendar las o David 24.000 (biish-te-star serja) mursha, te budrenn le ap o kheer o baro Debleske, un 6.000 (shob serja) mursha, te wenn le pralstune un tchatchepangre mursha.

4.000 (star serja) mursha wan wudjengre mursha, kai hunte denn garda ap i wudja. Un 4.000 (star serja) mursha wan gipangre, kai giwenn gilja o baro Debleske, un bashrenn koi pashel ap kol bashepangre, hoi mukas o David koleske te krell.
I Levitarja his i menshe, kai wan kol triin tchawendar o murshestar Levi: o Gershon, o Kohat un o Merari. Un o David tchiwas dran kol triin familja murshen khetne, te budrenn le khetne.
O Gershon, leskre tchawe his: o Ladan un o Shimi.
O Ladan, les his triin tchawe: o phureder his o Jehijel, palle was o Setam un o Joel.
O Shimi, les his triin tchawe: o Shelomit, o Hasijel, un o Haran. Kolla his i pralstune pral i familje, kolengro phuro dad o Ladan hi.
O Shimi, les his star tchawe: o Jahat, o Sina, o Jehush, un o Benja.
O Jahat his o phureder, un o Sisa his o duito. O Jehush un o Benja, kolen his gar bud tchawe. Doleske wan jon dikles har jek familja, kai khetne budrenn.
O Kohat, les his star tchawe: o Amram, o Jizhar, o Hebron, un o Usijel.

O Amram, leskre tchawe his: o Aron un o Mose. Un o Aron un leskre tchawe wan win rodedo, te wenn le rashaja hako tsireske. Jon kokres nai kran o baro Debleskri budi: nai chatchran viechen ap leskri chatchepaskri, un nai rakran o Debleskri bacht win pral i Israelitarja.
I tchawe o Mosestar, ko Debleskro murshestar, wan pash o kheer Levi kharedo.
Leskre tchawe his o Gershon un o Elijeser.
O Gershon, leskro phureder tchawo his o Shubael.
O Elijeser, les hi kokres jek tchawo, o Rechabja. Koles his bud tchawe.
O Jizhar, leskro phureder tchawo his o Shelomit.
O Hebron, leskro phureder tchawo his o Jerija, palle was o Amarja, o Jahasijel, un o Jekamam.
O Usijel, leskro phureder tchawo his o Micha, o duito his o Jishija.
O Merari, les his dui tchawe: o Machli un o Mushi. o Machli, leskre tchawe his: o Eleasar un o Kish.
O Eleasar, les his kek tchawe, kokres tcha; un lengre nebude, kol tchawe lengro kakestar, o Kish, romedineran len.
O Mushi, les his triin tchawe: o Machli, o Eder un o Jeremot.

Kolla hi i tchawe o murshestar Levi, kai his biish bersh un phureder. Lengre laba his pre tchinlo pal lengre familjende, kolengre pralstune jon his. Jon wan win rodedo, te krenn le i budi an o baro Debleskro kheer.
Kolestar penas o David: O baro Dewel, kai o Israeleskro Dewel hi, das peskre menshen i them, kai le khere hi. Un job kamell hako tsiro an o foro Jerusalem te djiwell.
Jaake hunte hidjran i Levitarja buder gar o Debleskro plachteno kheer un halauter, hoi koi dren his, har glan kowa kerdo was.
I tsiro pal kowa, glan peskro merepen, penas o David, te wenn kol Levitarja pre tchinlo an i liil, kai hi biish bersh un phureder.

Jon te wenn o Aroneskre tchawende pash o wast, pash i budi an o baro Debleskro kheer, ap kol glanstune platse, un an i iseme. Jon hunte krenn ko tselo koowa djudjo, hoi o Debleske hi, un ninna wawar budi an o Debleskro kheer.

Lengri budi his, te dikenn le pal o Debleskre mare, pal ko latcho jarro, hoi leske chatchedo well, un pal o maro, hoi kek shutlo jarro dren hi, un pal o peklo chapen, kai djet dren hi. Ninna hunte dikenn le, kai kol barra, hoi ap waga tchiddo wenn, o tchatcho pharepen sikrenn, un kol kashta, hoi o lengstepen sikrenn, kowa tchatches krenna.
Un haki taissarla hunte wenn i Levitarja koi tardo, te giwenn le o baro Debleske gilja, un parkrenn pen pash leste. Un jaake hunte well ninna haki rati kerdo.

Ninna hunte wenn le glan o baro Debleste tardo, an kol diwessa, kai marenn i rashaja o baro Debleske viechen, hoi leske tseles chatchedo wenn. Kowa his ap o Debleskro diwes, un ap ko diwes, kai o newo tchon diklo well, un ap i tsele wawar bare diwessa. Hako diwes hunte wenn jaake bud Levitarja glan o baro Debleste, har glan tchinlo hi.

Jaake hunte krenn jon pengri budi an o baro Debleskro plachteno kheer, un pal i tsiro an leskro baro kheer, hoi kerdo well, un hunte wenn i rashajenge ap i rig pash lengri budi an o baro Debleskro kheer. I rashaja hi lengre phrala dran o kheer Aron.
Kolla hi i laba kol murshendar, kai his i pralstune pral i rashajende, kai hako kopo khetne budran an o baro Debleskro kheer. O Aroneskre tchawe his: o Nadab, o Abihu, o Eleasar un o Itamar.
O Nadab un o Abihu meran, har o Aron gomme djido his, un len his kek mursh tchawe. O Eleasar un o Itamar wan rashaja.
Un o David tchiwas dran kol dui familja i murshen jaake khetne, har hunte budrenn le khetne. O Zadok dran o kheer Eleasar un o Ahimelech dran o kheer Itamar, wan leske koi pashel ap i rig.
Koi hatsan le win, kai his budeder mursha an o kheer Eleasar har an o kheer Itamar. Un jon lan 16 (deesh-te-shob) pralstune dran o kheer Eleasar un ochta pralstune dran o kheer Itamar.
An kol dui khera his pralstune pral o Debleskro kheer un rashaja. Un jon witsran barra, te dikenn le, hawi budi hakeno hunte krella.

Un o Shemaja, ko Levitari, koleskro dad o Netanel his, tchinas lengre laba pre, hako kopo dui dran o kheer Eleasar un jek dran o kheer Itamar. Koi pashel his o baro rai, i pralstune, o rashai Zadok, o Ahimelech, koleskro dad o Abjatar his, i pralstune pral i familjende o rashajendar un o Levitarendar.

Un jaake har i barra peran, wan le wi-rodedo: 1. o Jojarib; 2. o Jedaja; 3. o Harim; 4. o Seorim; 5. o Malkija; 6. o Mijamin; 7. o Hakkoz; 8. o Abija; 9. o Jeshua; 10. o Shechanja; 11. o Eljashib; 12. o Jakim; 13. o Huppa; 14. o Jeshebab; 15. o Bilga; 16. o Immer; 17. o Hesir; 18. o Pizez; 19. o Petachja; 20. o Jeheskel; 21. o Jachin; 22. o Gamul; 23. o Delaja; 24. o Maasja.

Kalla hi i rashaja, kai wan wi-rodedo, te wenn le i pralstune pral kol rashajende, kai hunte budrenn khetne an o baro Debleskro kheer, jaake har lengro phuro dad, o Aron, lenge glan tchinas. Kowa kras o Aron jaake, har penas leske o baro Dewel, kai o Israeleskro Dewel hi.
Kalla hi wawar pralstune dran i familje, kai wan pal o Levi: dran i familja Amram: o Shubael; dran i familja Shubael: o Jechdeja;
dran i familja Rechabja: o Jishija, ko phureder tchawo;
dran i familja Jizhar: o Shelomit; dran i familja Shelomit: o Jahat.
I tchawe o murshestar Hebron his: o Jerija, ko phureder tchawo, o Amarja, ko duito tchawo, o Jahasijel, ko triinto, o Jekamam, ko starto;
dran i familja Usijel: o Micha; dran i familja Micha: o Shamir.
O Michaeskro phraal his o Jishija; dran i familja Jishija: o Secharja.
I tchawe o murshestar Merari his: o Machli un o Mushi un o Jaasija;
dran i familja Jaasija: o Shoham, o Sakkur un o Ibri,
dran i familja Machli: o Eleasar; koles his kek mursh tchawe.
dran i familja Kish, o Jerachmeel.
I tchawe o murshestar Mushi his: o Machli, o Eder un o Jeremot. Kolla hi i Levitarja, pre tchinlo an i liil pal pengre familje.

Jaake har lengre phralenge, kol rashajenge dran o kheer Aron, wan ninna kal murshenge barra witsedo, te sikrenn le, hawi budi jon hunte krenna: i pralstunenge jaake har i ternenge. Un o baro rai David his koi pashel, ninna o Zadok un o Ahimelech un i pralstune pral i familjende i rashajendar un i Levitarendar.

Un o David khetne i pralstunentsa pral i lurdende, rodas i gipangre un bashepangre win, te giwenn le Debleskre gilja, bashrenn ap dorjengre bashepangre, un denn ap sasterne patria. Kolla wan dran i khera Asaf, Heman un Jedutun.
I tchawe o murshestar Asaf: o Sakkur, o Josef, o Netanja, o Asarela. Lengro dad his lengro pralstuno. Koleske penas o David, te krell lo Debleskre gilja.

I tchawe o murshestar Jedutun: o Gedalja, o Zeri, o Jesaja, o Hashabja, o Mattitja, o Shimi. Khetne his le shob. Lengro dad his lengro pralstuno, kai bashras ap i dorjengri bashepaskri, har giwas lo Debleskre gilja, te hadell lo un sharell lo o baro Debles.
I tchawe o murshestar Heman: o Bukkija, o Mattanja, o Usijel, o Shubael, o Jerimot, o Hananja, o Hanani, o Eljata, o Giddalti, o Romamti-Eser, o Joshbekasha, o Malloti, o Hotir un o Mahasiot.
Kalla lauter his o Hemaneskre tchawe. Job his o baro rajeskro dikepaskro. O Dewel penas leske, te krell lo les an-diklo, un das les deesh-te-star mursh tchawe un triin tcha.
Kalla lauter giwan an o baro Debleskro kheer un bashran ap sasterne patria un dorjengre bashepangre, jaake har o baro rai penas. Lengre dada, o Asaf, o Jedutun un o Heman his i gipangre raja.
Khetne lengre phralentsa, kai haiwan ninna mishto te giwell o baro Debleske, his le 288 (dui-sheel-ochta-desh-te-ochta) mursha – lauter latche gipangre.
Un jon witsran barra, te hatsenn le win, koon pal koneste o gipaske un bashepaske an o Debleskro kheer hunte djal.
Kolla hi i mursha, kai dan garda ap i wudja. Dran o kheer Korach was o Meshelemja, leskro dad his o Kore, leskro papo o Abiasaf.
O Meshelemja, les his tchawe: o phureder his o Secharja, o duito o Jedjael, o triinto o Sebadja, o starto o Jatnijel,
o pantchto o Elam, o shobto o Johanan, o eftato o Eljoenai.

O Obed-Edom: O Dewel his leske latches un das les bud tchawe: o phureder his o Semachja, o duito o Josabad, o triinto o Joach, o starto o Sachar, o pantchto o Netanel, o shobto o Ammijel, o eftato o Issachar, o ochtato o Pehulletai;
Un leskro tchaweske, o Semachja, wan ninna tchawe boldo. Jon his an-dikle mursha, un wan pralstune pral pengre menshende.
Jon his o Otni, o Refael, o Obed un o Elsabad un leskre phrala, o Elihu un o Semachja. Kolla his an-dikle mursha.
Kalla lauter his i mursha, kai wan pal o Obed-Edom. Jon pengre tchawentsa un phralentsa his an-dikle mursha, kai haiwan mishto pengri budi te krell. Khetne his le 62 (shob-deesh-te-dui) mursha.
I mursh tchawe un phrala o murshestar Meshelemja his 18 (deesh-te-ochta).

Dran i familja Merari was o Hosa. Koles his star tchawe: o ersto his o Shimri, o duito o Hilkija, o triinto o Tebalja, o starto o Secharja. O phureder his buder gar koi. Doleske kras o Hosa, te well peskro tchawo Shimri o pralstuno. I tsele mursh tchawe un phrala o murshestar Hosa his 13 (deesh-te-triin).

Kal mursha dan garda ap i wudja glan o Debleskro kheer. Hako kopo budras jek pralstuno kol murshentsa dran peskri familja khetne. Jaake har lengre phrala, i wawar Levitarja, kran le pengri budi ap o baro Debleskro kheer.
Un jon witsran barra, te dikenn le, hawi familja dell garda ap hawo wudar. Kowa kran le i tikne har i bare familjentsa.

O wudar, hoi ap i glanstuni rig hi, koleske peran i barra ap o Meshelemja. O wudar, hoi ap i serwi rig hi, koleske peran i barra ap leskro tchawo, o Secharja. Kowa his i gosewo mursh, kai djinas, hoi te krell.
O Obed-Edom hunte das garda ap o wudar, hoi ap i tchatchi rig his, un leskre tchawe ap o djobeskro kheer.
O Shuppim un o Hosa hunte dan garda ap o wudar hoi ap i palstuni rig hi, ninna ap o wudar, hoi kharell Shallechet, kai o drom pre djal. Jaake hunte denn i mursha garda:
Ap i glanstuni rig hunte wenn shob mursha tardo hako diwes, ap i serwi rig star mursha, ap i tchatchi rig star mursha, pash o djobeskro kheer dui mursha,
ap i palstuni rig, star pash o drom un dui pash koi platsa, hoi kharell ‘Parbar’.
Jaake hi glan tchinlo, har i wudjengre mursha hunte jak denn. Jon lauter wan dran i familje Korach un Merari.
Wawar Levitarja dan jak ap o brawlepen an o Debleskro kheer un ko kutch koowa, hoi i menshe o Debleske dan.
Mank lende his i tchawe o murshestar Ladan dran o kheer Gershon. Jon his i pralstune mank pengre menshende. Mank lende his o Jehijel.
Leskre tchawe, o Setam un o Joel, dan jak ap o brawlepen an o baro Debleskro kheer.
Wawar mursha, kai dan garda ap o Debleskro brawlepen, his dran i familje Amram, Jizhar, Hebron un Usijel.
O Shubael, koleskro dad o Gershon his, un koleskro dad o Mose his, kowa his o pralstuno pral o brawlepen.
Leskro phraal, o Elijeser, les his i tchawo: o Rechabja; koleskro tchawo his o Jesaja, koleskro tchawo his o Joram, koleskro tchawo his o Sichri, koleskro tchawo his o Shelomit.

Kau mursh Shelomit un leskre phrala his i pralstune pral o kutch koowa, hoi o Debleske dino was. Kau koowa anan o baro rai David un i pralstune pral i familjende, ninna i pralstune pral i lurdende, kolla pral jek sero lurdende un kolla pral jek shelende un wawar bare lurde.
Dran kowa, hoi anan le pentsa khere dran o kurepen, dan le les, te well o baro Debleskro kheer kerdo.

O Shelomit un leskre phrala his i pralstune pral halauter, hoi o Debleske dino was, ninna pral kowa, hoi glan ko tsiro o dikepaskro o Samuel o Debleske anas, un o Saul, koleskro dad o Kish his, un o Abner, koleskro dad o Ner his, un o Joab, koleskri dai i Zeruja his.
Dran o kheer Jizhar lan le o Kenanja un leskre mursh tchawe, te wenn jon pralstune un tchatchepangre mursha an Israel.

Dran o kheer Hebron, lan le o Hashabja un leskre phrala, te denn jon jak, te well halauter mishto kerdo, hoi o baro Debleske un o baro rajeske kerdo well an o them ap i wawar rig o panjestar Jordan. Jon khetne his 1.700 an-dikle mursha.

O pralstuno pral o kheer Hebron peskre tsele familjentsa his o Jerija. Har his o David an o star-deshto bersh o baro rai, rodan le an-dikle mursha mank lende un hatsan len an o foro Jaser an o them Gilead.

O Jeria, les his 2.700 an-dikle mursha mank peskre menshende. Kolla his pralstune pengre familjendar. Un o David tchiwas len un lengro pralstuno, o Jerija, pral i familjende Ruben un Gad un pral i paash familja Manasse, te denn le jak, kai kolla pengri budi o baro Debleske un o baro rajeske mishto krenn.

Kalla hi i mursha an Israel, kai djan o baro rajeske an o kurepen. Mank lende his familjengre pralstune, ninna lurdengre pralstune, kolla pral jek sero lurdende, un kolla pral jek sheel lurdende, ninna wawar bare lurde. Hako kopo djan 24.000 (biish-te-star-serja) lurde khetne. Jon hunte wenn jek tchon o baro rajeske koi. Hako tchon his wawar 24.000 mursha koi. Jaake djas kowa o tselo bersh.
An o ersto tchon his o Jashobam, koleskro dad o Sabdijel his, o pralstuno pral 24.000 lurdende.
Job was dran o kheer Perez, un his o pralstuno pral i tsele bare lurdende an o ersto tchon.
An o duito tchon his o Dodai dran Ahoach o pralstuno pral 24.000 lurdende. Un o Miklot his o baro lurdo pral lende.
An o triinto tchon his o Benaja, koleskro dad o baro rashai Jojada his, o pralstuno pral 24.000 lurdende.
O Benaja his jek kol trijanda bareder lurdendar un o pralstuno lendar. Leskro baro lurdo his leskro tchawo Ammisabad.
An o starto tchon his o Asahel, ko phraal o Joabestar, o pralstuno pral 24.000 lurdende. Un pal leste was leskro tchawo, o Sebadja, o pralstuno.
An o pantchto tchon his o Shamhut dran o kheer Serach, o pralstuno pral 24.000 lurdende.
An o shobto tchon his o Ira dran Tekoa, koleskro dad o Ikkesh his, o pralstuno pral 24.000 lurdende.
An o eftato tchon his o Helez dran Pelon, dran o kheer Efrajim o pralstuno pral 24.000 lurdende.
An o ochtato tchon his o Sibbechai, dran o foro Husha dran o kheer Serach o pralstuno pral 24.000 lurdende.
An o enjato tchon his o Abijeser dran o foro Anatot dran o kheer Benjamin o pralstuno pral 24.000 lurdende.
An o deshto tchon his o Mahrai, dran o foro Netofa, dran o kheer Serach, o pralstuno pral 24.000 lurdende.
An o deesh-te-jekto tchon his o Benaja dran o foro Piraton, dran o kheer Efrajim, o pralstuno pral 24.000 lurdende.
An o deesh-te-duito tchon his o Heldai, dran o foro Netofa dran o kheer Otnijel, o pralstuno pral 24.000 lurdende.
Kalla his i pralstune pral kol deesh-te-dui bare familje an Israel: pral i familja Ruben: o Elijeser, koleskro dad o Sichri his; pral i familja Simeon: o Shefatja, koleskro dad o Maacha his;
pral i familja Levi: o Hashabja, koleskro dad o Kemuel his; pral i familja Aron: o Zadok;
pral i familja Juda: o Elihu, jek o Davideskre phralendar; pral i familja Issachar: o Omri, koleskro dad o Michael his;
pral i familja Sebulon: o Jishmaja, koleskro dad o Obadja his; pral i familja Naftali: o Jeremot, koleskro dad o Asrijel his;
pral i familja Efrajim: o Hoshea, koleskro dad o Asasja his; pral i paash familja Manasse: o Joel, koleskro dad o Pedaja his;
pral i paash familja Manasse an o them Gilead: o Jiddo, koleskro dad o Secharja his; pral i familja Benjamin: o Jaasijel, koleskro dad o Abner his;
pral i familja Dan: o Asarel, koleskro dad o Jeroham his. Kolla hi i pralstune pral i khera Israel.
O David mukas gar i laba kolendar pre te tchinell, kai his terneder har biish bersha. O baro Dewel penas bud bersha glan kowa, te krell lo i Israelitarjen jaake bud har i momlia an o bolepen.

O Joab, koleskri dai i Zeruja his, kras pes ap i budi te tchinell i laba pre, un hunte mukas tele, har was o Debleskri choli doleske pral o Israel. Un jaake hi gar tchinlo an o familjakro liil o baro rajestar David, kitse mursha an o them Israel his, kai nai wenn lurde.
O pralstuno pral o rajeskro chapen his o Asmawet, koleskro dad o Adijel his. O pralstuno pral o chapen an o them, an i forja, gaba un lurdengre khera his o Jonatan, koleskro dad o Usija his.
O pralstuno pral i hachende, kai budran ap o baro rajeskri phub, his o Esri, koleskro dad o Kelub his.
O pralstuno pral i drakengre themma his o Shimi dran o foro Ramat. O pralstuno pral i mool ap i drakengre themma his o Sabdi dran o foro Shefam.
O pralstuno pral i djeteskre ruka un i faigetikre ruka an o bergetikro them his o Baal-Hanan dran o foro Geder. O pralstuno pral o djet his o Joash.
O pralstuno pral i grumjende an o them Sharon his o Shitrai, kai dran o them Sharon his. O pralstuno pral i grumjende an i telstune themma his o Shafat, koleskro dad o Adlai his.
O pralstuno pral i khamele his o Obil, ko Ismaelari. O pralstuno pral i burike his o Jechdeja dran o foro Meronot.
O pralstuno pral i bakre his o Jasis, ko Hagarari. Kolla halauter his i pralstune pral o rajeskro koowa.
O Jonatan, o Davideskro kako, job his i gosewo un siklo mursh, kai djinas, hoi te krell. O Jehijel, koleskro dad o Hachmoni his, his pash o baro rajeskre tchawende.
O Ahitofel his ninna jek, kai penas o baro rajeske, hoi wals mishto te krell. O Hushai i menshendar Arki, his o baro rajeskro maal.
Har o Ahitofel meras, his dui mursha koi, kai penan o baro rajeske, hoi mishto wals te krell lo: Kolla his o Jojada, koleskro dad o Benaja his, un o Abjatar. O Joab his o pralstuno pral i lurdende.

O David mukas i tsele pralstunen khetne gole te dell an o foro Jerusalem: Kolla his: i pralstune pral i deesh-te-dui bare familjende, i pralstune pral i lurdende, kai his khetne lino, te wenn le jek tchon an o bersh o baro rajeske koi, i pralstune pral jek sero lurdende un kolla pral jek sheel lurdende, kol mursha, kai dan jak ap o brawlepen un ap i viechende o baro rajestar un leskre tchawendar, i pralstune pral o baro rajeskro kheer, i sorele kurepangre, un i tsele an-dikle mursha.

Un o baro rai David stas pre un penas: “Mire phrala, murshale mire menshendar, shunenn, hoi penau tumenge! An miro dji his, te krap i kheer, kai well o mochton o deesh labentsa o baro Deblestar dren tchiddo, un kai nai atchell o mochton. Kowa hi har i tikno banko tel i pire maro Deblestar. Un me lom bud koowa khetne kau khereske, hoi kamom pre te tchiwell.
Koi mukas o Dewel mange te penell: ‘Tu hal i kurepaskro un maral menshen. Doleske hal gar tu, kai krell mange i kheer.’

Kanna hi jaake, te rodas man o baro Dewel win dran miro dadeskro tselo kheer. Job, o Israeleskro Dewel kamas, te wap me o rai pral Israel hako tsireske. Job rodas o Juda win, te well lo o pralstuno pral peskre phralende. Un dran o kheer Juda rodas lo miro dadeskro kheer win. Un miro dadeskre tchawendar hom me, ap koleste job latches dikas, te krell lo man rai pral o tselo Israel.
Un o baro Dewel das man bud tchawe. Mank lende rodas job miro tchawes, o Salomo win. Koleste das o baro Dewel peskro tchatcho wast, te well job baro rai pral Israel.
Un ap mande penas lo: ‘Tiro tchawo, o Salomo, krell mange i kheer un platse koi glan. Les rodom mange win, te well job miro tchawo, un me wau leskro dad.
Te djiwell lo pal mire laba un miro tchatchepen, jaake har lo kanna krell, krau me, te well hako tsiro jek leskre tchawendar, kai pal leste wenna, o baro rai.’

Kanna penau tumenge glan i jaka i tsele Israelendar – jon hi o baro Debleskro kheer – un glan i kanda maro Deblestar: Rikrenn tumen ap i tsele laba tumaro baro Deblestar, un djiwenn koi pal! Palle nai atchenn tumer an kau latcho them, un nai denn les dureder ap tumare tchawende, kai pal tumende wenna, hake tsirenge.

Un tu, miro tchawo Salomo, pats ap o Debleste tiro dadestar, te well job tiro Dewel. Kre tiro tselo djijeha, hoi lo tuke penell! Job dikell an i menshengre djia, un haiwell, hoi an lengre sherja trujel djal. Te rodeh les, hatseh les. Te mukeh les, tchiwell lo tut pale hako tsireske.
Doleske de tut jak, o baro Dewel rodas tut win, te kress i kheer leske. Ab sorelo, un kre tut ap i budi!”

Un o David das peskro tchawes, o Salomo, i liil, kai pre tardo hi, har te krell lo o Debleskro baro kheer: o wudareskri isema, kol glanstune halle, kol iseme, kai tchomone pre garedo well, kol pralstune iseme, ninna kol iseme, kai dren hi, un koi isema, kai o mochton o Debleskre deesh labentsa dren well.

Koi pashel das o David les kol lila, kai pre tchinlo hi, hoi leske an o shero trujel djas, har ko wawar koowa win dikell: kol glanstune platse un kol iseme, hoi trul o kheer wenn, kai well o brawlepen pre garedo, un ko kutch koowa, hoi i menshe o Debleske denna.

Ninna das o David o Salomes kol lila, kai tchinlo hi, hawe rashaja un hawe Levitarja khetne budrenn an o baro Debleskro kheer, un hawi budi jon krenn, un hawe tchare, pirja un khore hunte kerdo wenn kai budjake.
Un job penas har bud sonakai, rup un saster jon hunte lenn hakeneske lendar,
un har pharo hake sonakangre momelengre un lengre momlia hunte wenn, ninna har pharo hake rupene momelengre un lengre momlia hunte wenn. Kol momelengre his gar emligo baro.
Un job penas ninna har bud sonakai lino well, te krenn le kol chapangre, kai o Debleskre mare pre tchiddo wenn, un har bud rup lino well fer i rupene chapangre,
ninna har bud latcho sonakai fer i forshette, i tchare un i khore, un har bud rup i rupene khorenge,

un har bud sonakai o Debleskro sonakaskro bobeske, un o wurdineske, kai o Debleskro mochton pre tchiddo well. Ap leste his sonakangre bolepangre, kai hadenn pengre mussja pral o baro Debleskro mochton.
Kowa lauter hi pre tchinlo an i liil, jaake har sikras o baro Dewel o Davideste, har kau kheer kerdo hunte well.

Un o David penas ap peskro tchaweste, o Salomo: “Ab sorelo, ma traash un kre tut ap i budi! Ma dare tchi un ma traash kekestar! O baro Dewel, maro rai, kai miro Dewel hi, hi pash tute un well tuke ap i rig. Un job mukell tut gar, bis te tu kai tseli budi ap o baro Debleskro kheer kral.

Dik, i rashaja un i Levitarja wan jaake khetne lino, har jon khetne budrenn an o Debleskro kheer. Haki budjake hi rashaja un Levitarja koi. Ninna koi tseli wawar budjake ap o kheer hi tut budepangre, kai gosewo hi, un haiwenn pengri budi mishto te krell. Koi pashel hi tut i pralstune mursha un menshe, te krenn le halauter, hoi tu lenge peneh.”

Un o baro rai, o David, penas ap i tsele menshende, kai kote khetne his: “O Dewel rodas jek mire tchawendar win, o Salomes: Job hi terno un djinell gomme gar, har te krell lo i kheer. Un i kheer maro Debleske te krell, hi i bari budi. Kowa well gar i kheer i mensheske, na-a, kowa well i kheer o baro Debleske.

Miri tseli sorjah lom bud koowa khetne o khereske miro Deblestar: o sonakai, rup, lolo saster un wawar saster, un kasht, te wenn kol tsele koola kerdo, hoi an o kheer wenna, ninna bud kutch barra, hoi lolo, senelo, blaueto un djelto hi un bud parno marmor.
Te krap o kheer miro Deblestar jaake shukar har djala, dau ninna dran miro brawlepen
triin serja zentnarja sonakai dran Ofir un efta serja zentnarja latcho rup, te wenn i massurja o kherestar koleha pral maklo.

Kolestar, hoi pral atchell, well rupeno un sonakaskro koowa kerdo, ninna ko wawar koowa, hoi kolla krenna, kai haiwenn shukar koowa te krell. Kanna putchau tumendar: Koon tumendar della ninna tchomone pestar o baro Debleske?”

Har shunan kol laba i pralstune pral i bare familjende un pral i deesh-te-dui khera o Jakobeskre tchawendar, ninna i pralstune pral i lurdende, kolla pral jek sero un kolla pral jek sheel, un kol pralstune pral ko tselo koowa, hoi o baro rajeske his,
dan le pendar o Debleskro khereske: 5.000 zentnarja sonakai, 10.000 sonakangre kotja, 10.000 zentnarja rup, 18.000 zentnarja lolo saster un 100.000 zentnarja wawar saster.
Un kones kutch barra his, kowa das len ninna pash o brawlepen an o baro Debleskro kheer. Ap ko brawlepen das o Jehijel, ko Gershonari, jak.
Un i tsele menshe his bachtelo, kai dan lengre pralstune jaake bud kutch koowa dran pengro wast pengro tselo djijeha o baro Debleste. Un ninna o baro rai David his bachtelo pral kowa,
un sharas o baro Debles glan i tsele menshende, un penas: Baro Dewel, tu Dewel maro dadestar Israel, mer sharah tut kanna un hako tsiro.

Baro Dewel, tu hal o baro rai, hal sorelo, railo, sorleder har hako wawar, un o pralstuno pral hako wawareste. Halauter, hoi an o bolepen un ap i phub hi, hi tiro. Tu hal o rai pral i tsele themma, un tut hi penepaske pral halauter.
Brawlepen un sharepen well tutar. Tu kokres hal o rai. Tu kreh sorelo un baro, un nai kreh i menshes baro un sorelo.
Maro Dewel, mer parkrah men pash tute, un sharah tiro railo lab.
Me hom tchi, un mire menshe hi tchi. Mendar nai dah tut gar sawo bud koowa! Lauter, hoi men hi, well tutar. Ninna kau koowa, hoi dam tute, lam tutar.
Har mare phure ham mer ninna wi-themarja glan tute, ham i tikno tsiro ap kai phub un djah dureder. Maro djipen ap kai phub hi har i shatto un atchell gar.
Baro Dewel, maro rai, kau tselo brawlepen, hoi khetne anam, te kras mer tuke i kheer, te well tiro lab sharedo, kowa lauter was tutar un hi tiro.

Miro Dewel, djinau, te dikeh an o dji. Un tuke hi mishto, te hi i menshes i tchatcho dji. Doleske dom tut kawa lauter mandar dran i tchatcho dji, un hom bachtelo te dikau, kai tire menshe, kai kate glan tute tardo hi, tute ninna lauter pendar win dan.
Baro Dewel, tu Dewel mare phurendar, o Abrahamestar, o Isaakestar un o Jakobestar, kre, kai tire menshengre djia hako tsiro tuke pre hi, un jon pen ap tute rikrenn!

Un miro tchaweste Salomo de i tchatcho dji, te rikrell lo tire laba, un krell, hoi tu lestar kameh, un djiwell pal tiro tchatchepen; te krell job ninna lauter, te well tuke kau kheer kerdo, koleske kau tselo koowa khetne anom.

Un o David penas ap i tsele menshende, kai kote khetne his: “Sharenn tumaro baro Debles!” Koi sharan i tsele menshe o baro Debles, ko Debles lengre phurendar. Un jon djan ap pengre tchanga glan o baro Debleste un glan o baro rajeste,

un anan o baro Debleske viechen. O wawar diwes, taissarla, maran le o baro Debleske sawe viechen, kai wan leske tseles chatchedo: jek sero terne gurma, jek sero mursh bakre, un jek sero terne bakre. Ninna tchoran le mool win o baro Debleske, un maran leske bud viechen, hoi chan i tsele Israelitarja khetne glan leste.

Un jon chan un pijan ap ko diwes glan o baro Debleste. Un o duito kopo kharan le win, kai o Davideskro tchawo, o Salomo, o baro rai hi. Un jon tchoran djet ap leskro shero, te well job o baro Debleske koi. Ninna tchoran le djet ap o shero o murshestar Zadok, te well job o rashai.

Palle beshas pes o Salomo ap o rajeskri beshepaskri, un was o baro rai pral o baro Debleskre menshende, jaake har glan leste leskro dad, o David his. Un i menshe dikan pre ap leste un shunan ap leste.
Un i tsele pralstune un sorele kurepangre, ninna o Davideskre wawar tchawe, tchiwan pen tel leste.
Un i tsele Israelitarja nai dikan, har kras o baro Dewel, te was o Salomo bareder un bareder. O Salomo was an-diklo un sharedo har kek wawar rai pral Israel glan leste.
O David, koleskro dad o Isai hi, his star-deesh bersha o baro rai pral o tselo Israel. An ko tsiro djiwas lo an o foro Hebron efta bersha un an o foro Jerusalem trijanda-te-triin bersha.
Un job his i brawelo un an-diklo mursh. Les his i rah djipen. Un job meras an o mishto phurepen. Un pal leste was peskro tchawo, o Salomo, o baro rai.

Ko tselo wawar koowa, hoi pral o Davideskro djipen penepaske hi, kowa hi tchinlo an kol triin lila: ‘O liil pral o dikepaskro, o Samuel’, un ‘o liil pral o Debleskro rakepaskro, o Natan’, un ‘o liil pral o dikepaskro, o Gad’.
Kote hi tardo, hawo baro rai un sorelo kurepaskro job his, un hoi an ko tsiro djas an Israel un an i wawar themma trujel.
Un o Davideskro tchawo, o Salomo, was i sorelo rai. Un o baro Dewel, kai leskro Dewel his, his leha, un kras les baro un bareder.

I diwes was, kai mukas o Salomo i tsele pralstune Israelitarjen pash peste te kharell: i pralstune pral jek sero lurdende, i pralstune pral jek sheel lurdende, i tchatchepangre mursha, i pralstune pral kol deesh-te-dui bare khera, kai wenna o Jakobeskre deesh-te-dui tchawendar, un i pralstune pral bare familje.

Khetne lentsa djas o Salomo ap i mangepaskri platsa pash o foro Gibeon. Kote his o Debleskro plachteno kheer tardo. Ko kheer mukas o Mose, koles o baro Debleskro wast his, an o mulo tato them te krell.

[Ko mochton, kai o Debleskre deesh laba dren hi, mukas o David i tsiro glan kowa dran o foro Kirjat-Jearim te lell, un anas les an o foro Jerusalem, un mukas ko mochton kote an i plachteno kheer te tchiwell, hoi mukas job koleske te krell.]

Glan o baro Debleskro plachteno kheer an o foro Gibeon his ninna koi chatchepaskri dran lolo saster tardo, hoi o Bezalel kras, koleskro dad o Uri his, un koleskro dad o Hur his. Kote djas o Salomo, un khetne leha i Israelitarja.
Un o Salomo chatchras jek sero viechen o baro Debleske ap i chatchepaskri dran lolo saster, hoi glan o Debleskro plachteno kheer tardo his.
An koi rati mukas pes o Dewel o Salomeske te dikell, un penas leske: “Tu nai putcheh man, hoi kameh mandar!”
Kote penas o Salomo ap o Debleste: “Baro latchepen kral tu miro dadeske, o Davideske, un kral, te wom me baro rai pal leste.
Baro Dewel, miro rai, muk tiro lab tchatches te well, hoi tu penal miro dadeske, o Davideske; tu tchiwal man dren, te wom rai pral kal menshende, kai jaake bud hi, har i stauba ap kai phub hi.
De man kanna goswepen, te djinap har te djap lentsa trujel! Har nai dap hakeneste tire bud menshendar peskro tchatchepen, tu te deh man kowa gar?”

Un o Dewel penas ap o Salomo: “Tu nai mangals mandar brawlepen, kutch koowa, an-dikepen, i lengsto djipen un o merepen kolendar, kai kurenn pen tuha. Kowa kral gar. Tut hi an tiro dji, te mangal mandar goswepen, te djiness, har te nai rakress o tchatchepen win pral mire menshende, pral kolende me tut o rai krom.
Doleske dau tut goswepen, te djiness, hoi te kress. Koi pashel dau tut brawlepen, kutch koowa un an-dikepen, har kek baro rajes glan tute his, un kek baro rajes pal tute well.”

Un o Salomo mukas koi mangepaskri platsa, hoi pash o foro Gibeon tchiddo hi, un kai o Debleskro plachteno kheer tardo hi, un djas an o foro Jerusalem. Kote djiwas lo, har his lo o baro rai pral Israel.

Un o Salomo mukas peskre tsele wurdja un klissepangre khetne te well. Un kote his les 1.400 (jek sero-te-star-sheel) wurdja un 12.000 (deesh-te-dui serja) klissepangre. Kolen mukas lo an kol wurdjengre forja un pash peste an o foro Jerusalem te anell.
Un o baro rai kras, te his an o foro Jerusalem jaake bud rup un sonakai har barra. Un i zedertikre ruka his jaake bud har i diwje faigetikre ruka an o telstuno them.
Un o Salomo ginas graja an Egiptia un an Cilicia, leskre parepangre ginan len un plaissran len kote.

Un jon anan wurdja dran o them Egiptia, jekeske plaissran le 600 (shob-sheel) rupene beme. Un jek grajeske plaissran le 150 (sheel-te-paash) rupene beme. Un palle bikran le lendar dureder ap i bare rajende pral i Hetarja un ap i bare rajende pral o them Syria.
Un o Salomo penas peske, te kamell lo i kheer te krell o baro Debleske, te well job kote an-mangedo. Ninna kamas lo peske, o baro rajeske, i kheer te krell.

Un o Salomo mukas 70.000 (efta-deesh-serja) murshen win te rodell, te wenn le hidjepangre, un 80.000 (ochta-deesh-serja), te phagenn le i barra win an i berge. Pral lende his 3.600 (triin-serja-te-shob-sheel) mursha tardo.

Un o Salomo bitchras murshen pash o rajeste pral o foro Tirus, – leskro lab his Hiram – un mukas leske te penell: Ab mange ap i rig har wal tu miro dadeske, o Davideske, ap i rig, un bitchral leske zedertikro kasht, har kamas lo peske i kheer te krell.

Dik, kanna kamau me i kheer miro baro Debleske te krell, – i kheer, hoi leske hi, kai nai mangah les an, un nai chatchrah latcho sungepaskro koowa glan leste, un tchiwah hako tsiro maro glan leste win, un chatchrah viechen leske taissarlake un rati, ninna ap o Debleskro diwes, un ap ko diwes, kai o newo tchon diklo well, un ap wawar bare diwessa, te sharas maro baro Debles. Job penas menge, te kras mer kowa hako tsiro.
Un ko kheer, hoi me kamau te krell, hunte well baro; maro Dewel hi bareder har hako wawar dewel.

Koon nai krell leske i kheer? O tselo bolepen hi gar bares doha leske. Koon palle hom me, te krap leske i kheer? Halauter hoi nai krau, hi, te krap i platsa, kai nai chatchrah sungepaskro koowa glan leste.

Doleske mangau tut, bitche mange i murshes i latcho wasteha, kai haiwell shukar koowa te krell dran o sonakai, rup, lolo saster un wawar saster, lole thaba, blauete thaba un thaba, hoi hi lolo har jag.
