Glan i rah tsiro penas o Mose ap i Israelitarja: “Hako eftato bersh hunte budrell kek tumendar ap peskri hachetikri phub, te lell i phub pale newi soor!” Ap ko lab rikran pen i Israelitarja gar. Kanna atchas ko them efta-deesh bersha muklo tchiddo. Jaake was ko lab tchatcho, hoi o baro Dewel o Jeremijeske an o mui tchiwas: “O them atchell muklo tchiddo efta-deesh bersha, bis te kol bersha trujel hi, kolen i Israelitarja gar dren rikran.”

An o ersto bersh, kai o Kirus o baro rai pral o them Persia his, kras o baro Dewel, te was ko lab tchatcho, hoi lo ap o Jeremia rakras, un job i menshenge dureder penas. O baro Dewel das o baro rajeske, o Kirus an o dji, te mukell lo an peskro tselo them win te kharell un i lilentsa halauterenge te penell:

“Kawa penell o Kirus, ko rai pral o them Persia: O baro Dewel an o bolepen das man i tsele themma ap kai phub. Un job penas mange, te krap leske i kheer an o foro Jerusalem an o them Juda. Koon kanna mank tumende leskre menshendar hi, koleha te well peskro Dewel! Un job nai djal pral an o foro Jerusalem.”

An o ersto bersh, kai o Kirus o baro rai pral o them Persia his, kras o baro Dewel, te was ko lab tchatcho, hoi lo ap o Jeremia rakras, un kowa i menshenge dureder penas. O baro Dewel das o baro rajeske, o Kirus an o dji, te mukell lo an peskro tselo them win te kharell un i lilendar halauterenge te penell:
Jaake rakrell o Kirus, ko rai pral o them Persia: O baro Dewel an o bolepen das man i tsele themma ap kai phub. Un job penas mange, te krap leske i kheer an o foro Jerusalem an o them Juda.

Koon kanna mank tumende leskre menshendar hi, koleha te well peskro Dewel! Un job nai djal pral an o foro Jerusalem an o them Juda, un nai tchiwell o baro Debleskro kheer pre! Kowa hi o Israeleskro Dewel. Un job rodas peske o foro Jerusalem win, te well lo kote an-mangedo.

Un hakeno, kai pral atchas o Debleskre menshendar, kai lo ninna djiwell an kau them, koleske hunte wenn kolla ap i rig, pash kolende job djiwell, un hunte denn les rup un sonakai un vieche un wawar latcho koowa. Un hoi hakeno pestar kamell te dell, te well o baro Debleskro kheer pre-tchiddo an o foro Jerusalem, kowa hi hakeneskro koowa kokres.

Kote kran le pen ap o drom, te tchiwenn le o baro Debleskro kheer pale pre an o foro Jerusalem. Kolla, kai djan, his i pralstune pengre familjendar dran Juda un Benjamin, ninna i rashaja un i Levitarja, halauter kolla, kolenge o Dewel o dji pre kras, te djan le kote.
Un halauter, kai trul lende trujel djiwan, kran lengre wasta soreles un dan len rup, sonakai, wawar latcho un kutch koowa un vieche, ninna wawar koowa, hoi jon len dran pengro kamlepen dan.
Un o baro rai Kirus das len o tselo koowa, hoi an o baro Debleskro kheer tardo his. Glan bud bersha mukas les o Nebukadnezar dran o foro Jerusalem te anell un tchiwas les an o kheer leskro deblestar.

Un o Kirus, ko rai pral Persia, das halauter an o wast kolestar, kai pral o brawlepen his. Leskro lab his Mitredat. Un o Mitredat tchinas kol tsele koola an i liil, un das ko liil o Sheshbazar. Kowa his o pralstuno pral o them Juda.
Un jaake bud koola his kote: 30 (trijanda) sonakangre tchare 1.000 (jek sero) rupene tchare 29 (biish-te-enja) tchurja
30 (trijanda) sonakangre khore un 410 (star-sheel-te-deesh) rupene khore un 1.000 (jek sero) wawar koola.

Kol tsele koola dran sonakai un rup his khetne 5.400 (pantch-serja-star-sheel). Halauter anas o Sheshbazar pral an o foro Jerusalem. Un pash leste his kol tsele menshe, kai wan krik anlo an o them Babilonia, un djan kanna leha pale an o foro Jerusalem.

Kalla hi kol menshe, kai an o them Juda djiwenn. Kolla wan pale dran o pandepen, kai o baro rai pral Babilonia, o Nebukadnezar, len krik anas. Kolla wan pale pale an o foro Jerusalem un an o them Juda, hakeno an peskro foro.

Jon wan khetne kol murshentsa: O Serubbabel, o Jeshua, o Nehemja, o Seraja, o Reelaja, o Mordokai, o Bilshan, o Misperet, o Bigwai, o Rehum un o Baana. Kolla hi i laba kol familjendar, kai wan pale an Israel un kitse mursha an lende his:
o kheer Parosh: 2.172 (dui-serja-jek-sheel-te-efta-deesh-te-dui);
o kheer Shefatja: 372 (triin-sheel-te-efta-deesh-te-dui);
o kheer Arach: 775 (efta-sheel-te-efta-deesh-te-pantch);
o kheer Pahat-Moab: leskre tchawendar o Jeshua un o Joab: 2.812 (dui-serja-ochta-sheel-te-deesh-te-dui);
o kheer Elam: 1.254 (jek-sero-dui-sheel-te-pantch-deesh-te-star);
o kheer Sattu: 945 (enja-sheel-te-star-deesh-te-pantch);
o kheer Sakkai: 760 (efta-sheel-te-shob-deesh);
o kheer Bani: 642 (shob-sheel-te-star-deesh-te-dui);
o kheer Bebai: 623 (shob-sheel-te-biish-te-triin);
o kheer Asgad: 1.222 (sero-dui-sheel-te-biish-te-dui);
o kheer Adonikam: 666 (shob-sheel-te-shob-deesh-te-shob);
o kheer Bigwai: 2.056 (dui-serja-paash-sheel-te-shob);
o kheer Adin: 454 (star-sheel-te-paash-sheel-te-star);
o kheer Ater, kai was ninna Hiskija kharedo: 98 (enja-deesh-te-ochta);
o kheer Bezai: 323 (triin-sheel-te-biish-te-triin);
o kheer Jorah: 112 (jek-sheel-te-deesh-te-dui);
o kheer Hashum: 223 (dui-sheel-te-biish-te-triin);
o kheer Gibbar: 95 (enja-deesh-te-pantch);
dran o foro Betlehem: 123 (jek-sheel-te-biish-te-triin);
dran o foro Netofa: 56 (paash-sheel-te-shob);
dran o foro Anatot: 128 (jek-sheel-te-biish-te-ochta);
dran o foro Bet-Asmawet: 42 (star-deesh-te-dui);
dran i forja Kirjat-Jearim un Kefira un Beerot: 743 (efta-sheel-te-star-deesh-te-triin);
dran i forja Rama un Geba: 621 (shob-sheel-te-biish-te-jek);
dran o foro Michmas: 122 (jek-sheel-te-biish-te-dui);
dran i forja Betel un Ai: 223 (dui-sheel-te-biish-te-triin);
o kheer Nebo: 52 (paash-sheel-te-dui);
o kheer Magbish: 156 (sheel-te-pantch-deesh-te-shob);
o wawar kheer Elam: 1.254 (jek-sero-dui-sheel-te-pantch-deesh-te-star);
o kheer Harim: 320 (triin-sheel-te-biish);
dran i forja Lod un Hadid un Ono: 725 (efta-sheel-te-biish-te-pantch);
dran o foro Jericho: 345 (triin-sheel-te-star-deesh-te-pantch);
o kheer Senaa: 3.630 (triin-serja-shob-sheel-te-trijanda);
o kheer Jedaja, leskro tchawestar o Jeshua: 973 (enja-sheel-te-efta-deesh-te-triin);
o kheer Immer: 1.052 (jek-sero-te-pantch-deesh-te-dui),
o kheer Pashur: 1.247 (jek-sero-dui-sheel-te-star-deesh-te-efta);
o kheer Harim: 1.017 (jek-sero-te-deesh-te-efta);
dran i khera Jeshua, Kadmijel, Binnui un Hodawja: 74 (efta-deesh-te-star);
dran o kheer Asaf: 128 (sheel-biish-te-ochta); kolla his i gipangre;
dran i khera Shallum, Ater, Talmon, Akkub, Hatita un Shobai: khetne 139 (jek-sheel-te-trijanda-te-enja); kolla dan jak ap o foreskre wudja;
i familje, kolendar i mursha wan, kai budran an o Debleskro kheer: Ziha, Hasufa, Tabbaot,
Keros, Siaha, Padon,
Lebana, Hagaba, Akkub,
Hagab, Salmai, Hanan,
Giddel, Gahar, Reaja,
Rezin, Nekoda, Gasam,
Usa, Paseach, Besai,
Asna, Meunim, o Nefusim,
Bakbuk, Hakufa, Harhur,
Bazlut, Mehida, Harsha,
Barkos, Sisera, Temach,
Nezjach un Hatifa.
I familje kolendar, kai budran o baro rajeske Salomo: Sotai, Soferet, Peruda,
Jaala, Darkon, Giddel,
Shefatja, Hattil, Pocheret-Zebajim, Ami.
I tsele budepangre, kai budran an o Debleskro kheer un kolla, kolengre phure o Salomeske budran, his khetne 392 (triin-sheel-te-enja-deesh-te-dui).

Un koi his ninna menshe, kai khetne i Israelitarja pre wan dran Tel-Melach, un dran Tel-Harsha, un dran Kerub-Addon, un dran Immer. Jon nai penan gar, dran hawo dadengro kheer jon hi, un te hi lengre menshe dran o Israel.
Kolla his i familje Delaja, Tobija, un Nekoda. Khetne his le 652 (shob-sheel-te-pantch-deesh-te-dui) menshe.

Mank i rashaja his sawe, kai nai hatsan gar pengro familjakro liil. Kolla his i familje Habaja, Hakkoz un Barsillai. O phuro dad i familjatar Barsillai las i tchai ko murshestar Barsillai dran Gilead, un was pal koleskro lab kharedo. Un har sikran le nai gar, hawe menshendar jon hi, nai atchan le gar rashaja.
Un ko moskro penas lenge, te nai chan le gar o chapen, hoi kokres i rashajenge his, jaake rah bis te i rashai was un win hatsas, hoi i barra Momeli un Tchatchepen pral kau koowa penan.
Halauter khetne his le 42.360 (star-deesh-te-dui-serja-triin-sheel-te-shob-deesh).
Win lino his lengre budepangre: Kolla his 7.337 (efta-serja-triin-sheel-te-trijanda-te-efta) mursha un djuwja: Koi pashel wan lengre gipangre: 200 (dui-sheel) mursha un djuwja.
Un len his 736 (efta-sheel-te-trijanda-te-shob) graja, un 245 (dui-sheel-te-star-deesh-te-pantch) maultikre burike,
435 (star-sheel-te-trijanda-te-pantch) khamele un 6.720 (shob-serja-efta-sheel-te-biish) burike.
Un har i pralstune pral pengre familjen pash o baro Debleskro kheer an o foro Jerusalem wan, dan jon pendar lowe, te nai well o Debleskro kheer pre-tchiddo kote kai lo tardo his.

Un jon dan pash ko lowe, hoi o khereske koi his, jaake bud jon nai denna. Kowa his khetne: 61.000 (shob-deesh-te-jek-serja) sonakangre lowe un 5.000 (pantch serja) funto rup un sheel rashajengre baja.

Un mank lende, kai an o foro Jerusalem djiwan, his i rashaja, un i Levitarja. I gipangre un kolla, kai jak dan ap o foreskre wudja, ninna kolla, kai budran an o Debleskro kheer, jon djan an penge forja un djiwan kote. Ninna kol tsele wawar Israelitarja djiwan hakeno an peskro foro.
Un har o 7. (eftato) tchon was un i Israelitarja an pengre forja his, wan i tsele menshe har jek mursh khetne an o foro Jerusalem.

Un o Jeshua, koleskro dad o Jozadak his, kras pes ap i budi khetne peskre phralentsa, kol rashajentsa, un o mursheha Serubbabel, koleskro dad o Shealtijel his, un leskre phralentsa. Un jon kran i newi sasterni chatchepaskri, te nai chatchrenn le viechen koi pre o Israeleskro Debleske, jaake har tchinlo hi an o liil o Debleskro murshestar, o Mosestar.

Un ninna te hi len daar i wawar menshendar an o them, tchiwan le i sasterni chatchepaskri pre ap peskri phuri platsa, un anan kote viechen o baro Debleske, un chatchran len koi pre. Kowa kran le taissarlake un ratsjake.

Un jon rikran kol bare diwessa, kai djiwenn i Israelitarja an patjengre khera, jaake har tele tchinlo was, un chatchran jaake bud viechen o Debleske kol tsele efta diwessa, har hako diweske glan tchinlo his.

Pal ko tsiro anan le hako diwes kol viechen, kai wan taissarlake un ratsjake chatchedo o baro Debleske. Un ninna ap hako newo tchon un ap i wawar bare diwessa anan le viechen o baro Debleske. Un dan ninna kowa, hoi jek pestar kamas te dell o baro Debleste.
O ersto kopo har anan le viechen, te wenn le chatchedo o baro Debleske, his ap o ersto diwes an o eftato tchon. An ko tsiro his i telstune barra o baro Debleskro khereske gomme gar tchiddo.

Un jon dan lowe kol murshen, kai budrenn i barrentsa un kol murshen, kai budrenn o kashtentsa. Ninna dan le chapen un pipen un djet kol murshen dran Sidon un Tirus, te nai anenn le Zedertikro kasht dran o Libanon pral o baro pani an ko foro Jafo. Kowa lauter kran le jaake har les lenge o Kirus, ko rai pral Persia penas.

An o duito bersh har jon pale wan an o foro Jerusalem, un an o duito tchon, kran pen i Israelitarja ap i budi, te tchiwenn le o Debleskro kheer pale pre. O Serubbabel, koleskro dad o Shealtijel his, un o Jeshua, koleskro dad o Jozadak his, un lengre wawar phrala, kolla his i rashaja un i Levitarja, un halauter, kai wan dran pengro pandepen pale an o foro Jerusalem budran khetne ap o Debleskro kheer. Un jon rodan i Levitarjen win, kai biish bersh un phureder his, te denn le jak ap koi tseli budi an o baro Debleskro kheer.

Un o Jeshua un leskre mursh tchawe un leskre phrala, o Kadmijel, o Binnui un o Hodawja his khetne koi tardo, te nai sikrenn le kol budepangren ap o Debleskro kheer, har koi budi hunte kerdo wella. Koi pashel his ninna kol Levitarja, kolengro phuro dad o Henadad his.

Un har tchiwan i budepangre i telstune barra pre o baro Debleskro khereske, his i rashaja koi tardo an pengre rashajengre ripja un phurdan an pengre phurdepangre. Un i Levitarja, kolengro phuro dad o Asaf his, kolen his pengre bashepangre, hoi kharenn Zimbale, ninna pashel, te nai sharenn le o baro Debles, jaake har o David, ko baro rai pral Israel kowa penas.

Un jon giwan, sharan un parkran pen pash o baro Debleste: “Job hi latcho un leskro kamlepen hi an hako tsiro pral Israel.” Un i tsele menshe dan gole i bachtjatar, har parkran le pen pash o baro Debleste doleske, kai i telstune barra leskro khereske tchiddo his.

Bud i phure rashajendar, i Levitarendar un i familjengre pralstunendar djinan, har o baro Debleskro phuro kheer win dikas. Kolla rowan soreles, har jon kanna dikan, har i telstune barra kau newo khereske tchiddo wan. Wawar dan gole i bachtjatar, jaake his, kai nai wan le dur shunlo.
Un kek djinas, hoi sorleder hi, koi gole i bachtjatar oder ko sorelo ropen; i menshe dan jaake bares gole, te was kowa dur shunlo.

I wawar menshe an o them, kolla, kai kaman gar i bibolden dran i khera Juda un Benjamin, jon shunan, te krenn kolla, kai wan pale pale dran o them Babilonia, i newo kheer o baro Debleske, kai o Israeleskro Dewel hi.

Koi djan le pash o Serubbabel un pash i familjengre pralstunende un penan: “Mer kamah tumentsa o Debleske i kheer te krell. Mer mangah ninna tumaro Debles an, un maram leske viechen, jaake rah har o baro rai pral o them Assur, o Asarhaddon, men halauter kate an kau them mukas te anell.”

Kote penan lenge o Serubbabel un o Jeshua un i familjengre pralstune: “Kowa hi gar mishto, te krenn tumer un mer khetne o Debleskro kheer. Mer kokres kamah o kheer te krell o baro Debleske, kai o Israeleskro Dewel hi. Kowa penas menge jaake o baro rai pral o them Persia, o Kirus.”
Kote kran kol wawar menshe, kai djiwan ninna an o them, i biboldenge o djipen phares. Un jon kaman len daar te krell, te budrenn le buder gar dureder ap o Debleskro kheer.

Un jon dan kolende lowe, kai budran o baro rajeske, te rikrenn jon kowa pre, hoi i bibolde penge glan lan. Kowa kran le jaake rah, har o Kirus o baro rai pral o them Persia his, un gomme an ko tsiro, kai o Darius o baro rai pral o them Persia his.
Un har o Ahasveros baro rai was, an leskro ersto bersh, tchinan le i fullo liil pral i menshende dran o them Juda un Jerusalem.

Un an ko tsiro, har o Artaxerxes o baro rai his, tchinan o Bishlam, o Mitredat, o Tabeel un lengre mala i tchilatcho liil o rajeske pral o them Persia. Ko liil his tchinlo an o aramtikro tchinepen un an o aramtikro rakepen.
Ninna o pralstuno Rehum un o Shimshai, kai haiwas lila te tchinell, kolla dui tchinan i fullo liil pral Jerusalem, un bitchran les pash o baro rajeste Artaxerxes. An ko liil his tardo:

Mer, o pralstuno Rehum un o tchinepaskro, o Shimshai, un kolla wawar halauter, i tchatchepangre mursha, i bare lurde, i tchinepangre, un i wawar pralstune, un i mursha dran Erech, dran Babilon, un dran Susa, kolla hi i Elamarja,

mer tchinah kau liil khetne i menshentsa dran kol wawar themma, kolen o baro un sorelo Asenappar an kau them mukas te anell, te djiwenn le an o foro Samaria un an i wawar forja ap i wawar rig o panjestar Eufrat.
Un kal laba his tardo an ko liil: Ap o baro rajeste Artaxerxes, i murshendar ap i wawar rig o panjestar Eufrat. Mer ham tire budepangre,

un kamah tuke te penell, kai i bibolde, kolla kai dran tiro them kai pral pash mende wan, kolla hi kanna an o foro Jerusalem un kamenn ko foro pale pre te tchiwell, ko foro, kolestar i menshe jaake diwjo un tchilatcho hi. Jon tchiwenn bar ap bar, te wenn i massurja ko forestar kerdo. I telstune barra hi pale newes tchiddo.

Mer halauter hunte penas o baro rajeske: Kau foro te well newes kerdo, un i massurja hi pale tardo, denn i menshe buder kek themeskre lowe, witar kek foreskre lowe, un wawar koowa witar gar. Kek lowe wenn kolendar pash maro rajeste.
Mer halauter rikrah pash o baro rajeste un chah o loon dran leskro kheer, un mer kamah gar te dikell, har well ladj ap o baro rajeste anlo. Doleske bitchrah leske kau liil.

Muk pal te dikell an i familjakre lila tire phurendar, palle hatseh un dikeh, kai kau foro pes pre hadas, un pral wawar rajende un themma doosh anas. Ninna an i phure tsirja hadan pen i menshe an kau foro pre. Doleske was kau foro ninna khetne maredo, un kek bar atchas ap o wawar.

Un kanna penah mer o baro rajeske, kai job buder tchi an peskro wast nai rikrella, hoi ap i wawar rig o panjestar Eufrat tchiddo hi, te well kau foro pale newes kerdo, un i massurja pale pre-tchiddo wenn.

Koi bitchras lenge o rai pral o them Babilonia kau liil un mukas lenge te penell: Tuke Rehum, ko pralstuneske un tuke Shimshai, ko tchinepaskro, un tumenge wawarenge halauterenge an o foro Samaria un kol wawarenge halauterenge ap i wawar rig o panjestar Eufrat: Bacht tumentsa!
Un kanna kamau tumenge te penell: Ko liil, kai tumer mange tchinan, was mange lab pal lab glan drawedo.

Un har me les penom, was pal diklo, un halauter hi tchatchepen, hoi tumer mange tchinan, kai hadas pes ko foro pale te pale an o phuro tsiro un anas tchingepen i tsele rajenge, un peras tele lengre rajentsa.

Ninna his sorele bare raja an o foro Jerusalem, kai his i raja pral halauter, hoi ap i wawar rig o panjestar Eufrat djiwella, jaake kai was lenge hunte themeskre lowe dino, ninna foreskre lowe un wawar koowa.
Doleske kamau, te penenn tumer kol menshenge soreles, te nai budrenn le gar dureder, te nai well ko foro gar pale pre-tchiddo, jaake rah bis te me penau i wawar lab!
Denn jak, te krenn kowa sik, te well kek doosh pral maro them, un te nashrap kek lowe.

Un ko liil o baro rajestar Artaxerxes was drawedo glan o Rehum un ko tchinepaskro, o Shimshai, un glan kol tsele wawar murshende, kai pash lende his. Koi djan le sik an o foro Jerusalem pash i bibolde, un rikran len sorjah pengri budjatar pale, jaake te nai budran le buder gar dureder.
Kote atchas i budi ap o Debleskro kheer an o foro Jerusalem tardo. Un kowa atchas jaake bis o rai Darius an o duito bersh o baro rai his pral o them Persia.

Un o Debleskre rakepangre, o Haggai un o Sacharja, koleskro dad o Iddo his, kolla rakran i biboldentsa, kai djiwan an o them Juda un an o foro Jerusalem, un penan lenge, hoi lengro Dewel, ko Dewel pral o Israel, lenge kal biboldenge penas.

Kote kran pen ap i budi o Serubbabel, koleskro dad o Shealtijel his, un o Jeshua, koleskro dad o Jozadak his. Un jon budran dureder ap o Debleskro kheer an Jerusalem. Un lentsa khetne budran o Debleskre rakepangre un dan len soor.

An ko tsiro wan mursha pash lende: o Tattenai, ko his o pralstuno pral o them ap i wawar rig o panjestar Eufrat, un o Shetar-Bosnai un lengre mala un penan: “Koon penas tumenge, te tchiwenn kau kheer pale pre un te krenn kal massurja pale newo?”
Un palle putchan le lendar: “Har kharenn kol mursha, kai tchiwenn kau kheer pale pre?”
Un o Debleskre jaka his pral i phureder an o them Juda, un jon nai budran dureder, bis i liil pash o Darius bitchedo was un i liil lestar pale pale was.

Kawa hi ko tele tchinlo liil, hoi was bitchedo ap o rajeste Darius. Kau liil mukas o Tattenai te tchinell khetne o mursheha Shetar-Bosnai un lengre malentsa, kol tchatchepangre an o them, kai ap i wawar rig o panjestar Eufrat his.
Kalla hi i laba, hoi jon leske tchinan: O baro rajeske Darius bud bacht!

Mer kamah tuke te penell, kai mer nasham an o them Juda, pash o kheer o baro Deblestar. Ko kheer well bare barrentsa kerdo. Un kasht well an i massurja dren tchiddo. Un i budi well mishto kerdo, un djal an lengro wast sik dureder.
Kote putcham mer palle lengre pralstunendar: ‘Koon penas tumenge, te krenn kau kheer un te tchiwenn kal massurja pale pre?’
Un ninna putcham mer lendar pal lengre laba, jaake te nai tchinas mer len pre un nai penas tuke, koon i pralstune pral kai budi hi.

Un kowa hi, hoi jon menge penan: “Mer ham i budepangre o Deblestar, kai kras o bolepen un i phub, un tchiwah kau kheer pale pre, kai glan bud bersha kate tardo his, un koles i baro sorelo rai dran o them Israel mukas pre te tchiwell. Jaake his ko kheer shukar koi tardo.

Mare phure choiran o bolepaskro Debles; un palle das lo len an o wast o baro rajestar dran o them Babilonia. Kowa his o Nebukadnezar, ko Kaldeari. Job mukas kau kheer khetne te phagell, un anas i menshen, kai kate djiwan, an o them Babilonia.
An o ersto bersh, kai o Kirus o baro rai pral o them Babilonia was, mukas lo te penell, te well kau Debleskro kheer pale pre-tchiddo.

Ninna kol sonakangre un rupene kotja, hoi tchoras o Nebukadnezar dran o Debleskro kheer an Jerusalem, un mukas len an peskro debleskro kheer te anell an o them Babilonia, kolen las o baro rai Kirus pale win, un das halauter ko mursheste Sheshbazar. Koles tchiwas lo pral o them Juda,
un penas ap leste: ‘Le kal tsele kotja tuha, un dja an o foro Jerusalem, un an len kote an o Debleskro kheer! Un o Debleskro kheer hunte well pre-tchiddo kote, kai lo tardo his.’
Kote was o Sheshbazar un tchiwas i telstune barra pre o Debleskro khereske kate an Jerusalem. Jaake rah budrah ap o Debleskro kheer, un kowa hi gomme gar tseles kerdo.”

Un kanna, maro baro rai, te hi tuke mishto, palle muk an tiro kheer pal te dikell, kote kai tiro brawlepen un i phure familjakre lila hi, te hi tchatcho, kai mukas o baro rai Kirus te penell, te well o Debleskro kheer an o foro Jerusalem pale pre-tchiddo. Un ab jaake kamles un muk men te djinell, hoi tu pral kowa peneh.
Kote mukas o rai Darius te penell, te wenn i familjakre lila rodedo an i khera, kai o brawlepen un i phure lila tchiddo hi an o them Babilonia.
Koi was i liil hatslo an o foro Ekbatana an o them Media. Ap ko liil his tchinlo: Laba, hoi hunte wenn gar bistedo:

An o ersto bersh, kai o Kirus baro rai was, mukas lo te penell: O Debleskro kheer an o foro Jerusalem hunte well pale pre-tchiddo, jaake te well lo i platsa, kai wenn vieche anlo un pre chatchedo o Debleske. Un i massurja hunte wenn newes kerdo. O kheer hunte well trijanda metarja bares, un trijanda metarja buchles,

un well dran djudje dine barra jaake kerdo, te wenn triin barra jek ap o wawar tchiddo, un koi pral kasht, un palle pale triin barra jek ap o wawar, un koi pral kasht, un jaake dureder. Un i lowe koleske lautereske nai well dran o baro rajeskro kheer lino.

Ninna hunte wenn pale pale dino kol tsele sonakangre un rupene kotja, hoi an o Debleskro kheer an Jerusalem tardo his, kolla kai mukas o Nebukadnezar krik te anell an o them Babilonia. Halauter hunte well pale anlo an o Debleskro kheer an Jerusalem, un kote pre-tchiddo, kai lo tardo his an o Debleskro kheer.
Ap o Tattenai, ko pralstuneste pral o them ap i wawar rig o panjestar Eufrat, un ap o Shetar-Bosnai, un tumare tsele malenge, kol tchatchepangre mursha, penau me: Rikrenn tumen pale kau kowestar!
Mukenn o pralstunes i biboldendar un lengre phureden pengri budi te krell ap o Debleskro kheer, te nai tchiwenn le les kote pale pre, kai lo tardo his.

Me mukau tumenge ninna te penell, hoi tumer lengre pralstunen hunte denn, te nai well o Debleskro kheer pale pre-tchiddo. Lenn dran o rajeskro brawlepen kol lowendar, hoi dren well pash tumende ap i wawar rig o panjestar Eufrat, un denn len jaake bud, hoi len hunte well, te hi len hako tsiro doha halauterestar.

Denn len ninna hako diwes kol viechen, hoi len hunte well, te anenn le len o bolepaskro Debleske: terne gurma, bakre un terne bakre. Ninna djob, loon, mool un djet denn len jaake bud har penenn tumenge lengre rashaja an o foro Jerusalem. Denn jak, te well kowa lende jaake sik dino, te hunte mangenn le gar.
Palle nai chatchrenn le kol viechen jaake o bolepaskro Debleske, te dikell lo latches ap lende, un jon nai mangenn lestar latchepen mange, miro djipen un koleske mire tchawendar.

Un pale mukau tumenge te penell: Te rikrell pes jek tumendar gar ap mire laba, hunte well i baro kasht dran leskro kheer win tserdedo, un job hunte well koi pre dino. Un leskro tselo kheer hunte well tele phagedo, doleske kai job gar mire laba dren rikras.

Un ko Dewel, kai o Jerusalem win rodas, te well lo kote an-mangedo, job mu te phagell hako baro rajes un hako them, kai rikrell pes gar ap kau lab, hoi penom, un hadell peskro wast, te phagell lo ko Debleskro kheer tele an Jerusalem. Me, o Darius, penom kau lab un mukom les pre te tchinell, te rikrell pes hakeno ap leste!
Kote kras o Tattenai, ko pralstuno pral o them ap i wawar rig o panjestar Eufrat, un o Shetar-Bosnai un kol mursha, kai pash lende his, pal hako lab, hoi lenge o rai Darius penas.

Un o phureder i biboldendar kran pengri budi ap o Debleskro kheer dureder. Un i budi djas mishto, jaake har penan kowa o Debleskre rakepangre, o Haggai un o Sacharja, koleskro dad o Iddo his. Un jon tchiwan o kheer pre, un kran halauter jaake har les lenge o Israeleskro Dewel penas un pal i laba, kai penan i raja pral o them Persia, o Kirus, o Darius un o Artaxerxes.
Un koi tseli budi was kerdo ap o triinto diwes an o tchon Adar. Kowa his, har o Darius an o shobto bersh o baro rai his.
Un i Israelitarja, i rashaja, i Levitarja un kolla wawar, kai wan dran o pandepen pale pale, rikran kol bare diwessa i bachtele djijentsa, kai dan le o Debleskro newo kheer an leskre wasta.

Koleske anan le an o Debleskro kheer 100 (sheel) gurma, 200 (dui-sheel) bakre, un star-sheel (400) terne bakre, te wenn le maredo o Debleske, ninna deesh-te-dui mursh busja, jek haki bari familjake, hoi well o deesh-te-dui Israeleskre tchawendar. Kol busja wan chatchedo o Debleske, te well i doosh i Israelendar krik lino.

Un jon tchiwan i rashajen un i Levitarjen an pengri budi dren an o Debleskro kheer an Jerusalem, un kran win, hawe rashaja hunte khetne budrenn, un hawe Levitarja hunte khetne budrenn. Lauter kran le jaake har tele tchinlo was an o Moseskre lila.
Un kolla, kai wan dran o pandepen pale an o them Israel, rikran o Passa ap o 14. (deesh-te-starto) diwes an o ersto tchon.

Koleske thowan pen i Levitarja jaake har glan tchinlo his, te wenn le djudjo glan o Debleste. Un hake mursha lendar his djudjo un maran i terne bakre, hoi wenn Passa kharedo, lauterenge, kai wan dran o pandepen pale, ninna lengre phralenge un i rashajenge un penge kokres.

Un i Israelitarja, kai wan dran o pandepen pale, chan o Passa, un lentsa khetne ninna i tsele wawar menshe an kau them, kai mukan pengre menshen, kai wawar deblen an-mangenn. Un jon rikran pen kanna pash i Israelitarjen, te mangenn le kolengro Debles an. Kowa hi o baro Dewel.

Un jon lauter rikran kol bare diwessa, kai chan le efta diwessa maro, kai kek shutlo jarro dren hi. Halauterenge his i gipaskro tsiro. O baro Dewel das len bachtele djia un kras, te dikas o rai pral o them Assur kamles ap lende. Jaake wan lengre wasta soreles, te nai kran le o kheer o Israeleskro Debleske.

Pal kau koowa, an ko tsiro, kai o Artaxerxes o baro rai pral o them Persia his, djiwas an o them Babilonia i biboldo, koleskro lab Esra his. Leskro dad his o Seraja, koleskro dad o Asarja, koleskro dad o Hilkija,
koleskro dad o Shallum, koleskro dad o Zadok, koleskro dad o Ahitub,
koleskro dad o Amarja, koleskro dad o Asarja, koleskro dad o Merajot,
koleskro dad o Serachja, koleskro dad o Usi, koleskro dad o Bukki,
koleskro dad o Abishua, koleskro dad o Pinhas, koleskro dad o Eleasar, koleskro dad o Aron, ko baro rashai.

Kau mursh Esra djas win dran o them Babilonia, te djal lo an o foro Jerusalem. Job his i sikepaskro, un djinas kol laba mishto, hoi an o Moseskre lila tchinlo hi. Kol laba das o baro Dewel peskre menshende Israel. Un har o Esra gomme an Babilonia his, rikras o baro Dewel peskre wasta pral leste, un kras, te das o baro rai o Esraes halauter, hoi job lestar mangas.

Un khetne leha djan wawar Israelitarja pral an Jerusalem, rashaja, Levitarja, gipangre, mursha kai denn jak ap i wudja, un budepangre, kai budran an o Debleskro kheer. Kolla halauter wan an Jerusalem an o eftato bersh, kai o Artaxerxes o rai pral o them Persia his.
An o pantchto tchon an kau bersh wan le kote an.
Ap o ersto diwes an o ersto tchon kran le pen ap o drom, un ap o ersto diwes an o pantchto tchon wan le an o foro Jerusalem. O Debleskro kamlo wast his pral leste.

O Esra tchiwas peskre djijeskre jaka ap o Debleskro drom, te haiwell lo les bud un budeder, un te djiwell lo pal o Debleskro lab, un te sikrell lo halauterenge an o them Israel, hoi o baro Dewel lendar kamell, un har nai djiwenn le pal leskro tchatchepen.

Un o rai Artaxerxes mukas i liil te tchinell, te dell lo les o rashajeste, o Esra. Kowa his i sikepaskro un prindjras mishto o Debleskre laba un djinas, hoi o baro Dewel peskre menshendar, o Israel, kamell. An ko liil his kal laba tardo:
Me, o Artaxerxes, o rai pral i tsele raja, penau ap o Esra, ko rashai un sikepaskro i labendar ko Deblestar, kai an o bolepen hi. Bud bacht tuke!
Un kanna well mandar penlo, kai halauter kolla, kai dran o them Israel an miro them wan, ninna lengre rashaja un Levitarja, jon te kamenn tuha te djal an o foro Jerusalem, palle nai djan le.
O baro rai un leskre efta gosewe mursha bitchrenn tut, te djas an o them Juda un an o foro Jerusalem, te dikess, har rikrenn pen i menshe kote ap tiro Debleskro lab, hoi an tiro wast hi.
Tu aneh lenge rup un sonakai, hoi tut o baro rai un peskre gosewe mursha tuha denna, te dess kowa o Debleste pral o them Israel, koleskro kheer an Jerusalem hi.
Le ninna ko tselo rup un sonakai, hoi nai leh khetne an o tselo them Babilonia, un koi pashel hoi kol menshe un i rashaja pendar kokres kamenn te dell o khereske lengro Deblestar an Jerusalem.

Halauter kowa le un gin goswepah kol lowentsa gurma, bakre, terne bakre; koi pashel djob un mool o Debleske; te nai well kowa lauter chatchedo ap i chatchepaskri an o kheer tumaro Deblestar an Jerusalem.
Te atchenn lowe pral, krenn kolentsa, hoi tuke un tire phralentsa mishto hi, jaake har tumaro Dewel kowa kamella.
Un kol pirja un tchare un wawar koowa, hoi tuke dino wan i budjake an o kheer tiro Deblestar, an leske an o foro Jerusalem!
Ninna hoi tut budeder hunte well tiro Debleskro khereske, un hoi hunte plaissress, kowa well tut halauter dino dran i khera, kai o rajeskro brawlepen tchiddo hi.

Me, o rai Artaxerxes, penom ap halauterende, kai an o them wergel o panjestar Jordan ap i khera garda denn, kai miro brawlepen dren hi: Halauter, hoi mangell tumendar o Esra, ko rashai un sikepaskro kol labendar o bolepaskro Deblestar, kowa denn les sik;
rup bis 3.500 (triin-te-paash serja) kilogramme, un 100 (sheel) gone bijalo gib, un 100 (sheel) pirja mool, un 100 (sheel) pirja djet, un loon jaake bud har kamenn le.
Halauter, hoi o bolepaskro Dewel penas, te well an leskro kheer, kowa hunte well leste jaake dino, har lo penas, te well leskri choli gar pral o rajeste, leskre tchawende un leskro them.

Ninna penau tumenge: Kekeste tumendar dau me o tchatchepen, te nai mangell lo themeskre lowe, foreskre lowe un wawar koowa kol rashajendar un kol wawarendar, kai budrenn an o kheer kau Deblestar, har Levitarja, gipangre, mursha, kai jak denn ap i wudja un budepangre.

Un tu Esra, tchip o goswepah, hoi tiro Dewel tut dell, tchatchepangren un rakepangren an i budi dren, te rakrenn le o tchatchepen win i tsele menshenge, kai wergel o panjestar Eufrat djiwenna, halauterenge, kai i laba tiro Deblestar prindjrenn. Un koon kal laba gar prindjrell, koleske sikrenn, hoi tumaro Dewel lestar kamell!

Hakeno, kai dell gar jak ap o lab tiro Deblestar un rikrell pes gar ap o lab o rajestar, kowa lell peskri phagi: nai well, te well lo maredo, pale-tchiddo, hunte plaissrell lowe, oder well an o stilepen.
Sharedo well o baro Dewel, ko Dewel mare phurendar! Job hi kowa, kai tchiwas sau koowa an o rajeskro dji, te nai well o baro Debleskro kheer an o foro Jerusalem jaake railo un shukar!

O Dewel kras, te dikas o rai un leskre gosewe un pralstune mursha latches ap mande. Un o baro Debleskro wast his pral mande un kras man soreles, un nai anom bud murshen khetne, kai his pralstune pral pengre familje, te djan le lauter mantsa pre an maro them.
Kalla hi i pralstune pengre familjendar kol murshentsa, kai wan mantsa khetne dran o them Babilonia pre an o foro Jerusalem an ko tsiro har o Artaxerxes o baro rai his.
dran i familja Pinhas: o Gershom; dran i familja Itamar: o Daniel; dran i familja David: o Hattush, koleskro dad o Shechanja his;
dran i familja Parosh: o Secharja, un khetne leha his 150 mursha, kai an i liil tchinlo wan;
dran i familja Pahat-Moab: o Eljoenai, koleskro dad o Serachja his, un khetne leha 200 mursha;
dran i familja Sattu: o Shechanja, koleskro dad o Jahasijel his, un leha 300 mursha;
dran i familja Adin: o Ebed, koleskro dad o Jonatan his, un khetne leha 50 mursha;
dran i familja Elam: o Jeshaja, koleskro dad o Atalja his, un khetne leha 70 mursha;
dran i familja Shefatja: o Sebadja, koleskro dad o Michael his, un khetne leha 80 mursha;
dran i familja Joab: o Obadja, koleskro dad o Jehijel his, un khetne leha 218 mursha;
dran i familja Bani: o Shelomit, koleskro dad o Josifja his, un khetne leha 160 mursha;
dran i familja Bebai: o Secharja, koleskro dad o Bebai his, un khetne leha 28 mursha;
dran i familja Asgad: o Johanan, koleskro dad o Katan his, un khetne leha 110 mursha;
dran i familja Adonikam ninna i palstune, kai wan pale. Un jon kharan: Elifelet, Jehijel un o Shemaja, un khetne lentsa 60 mursha;
dran i familja Bigwai: o Utai, koleskro dad o Sabbud his, un khetne leha 70 mursha.
Un me anom len khetne pash ko lengsto pani, hoi an o foro Ahawa nashella. Un mer atcham kote triin diwessa. Un har lom kote i menshen an o jak, dikom rashajen mank lende. Me dikom kek Levitarjen.

Kote mukom i gosewe pralstune pengre familjendar pash mande te well: o Elijeser, o Arijel, o Shemaja, o Elnatan, o Jarib, o wawar Elnatan, o Natan, o Secharja un o Meshullam, un kol dui sikepangre, o Jojarib un o Elnatan,

un bitchrom len pash o Iddo, ko moskro an o foro Kasifja, kai i Levitarja djiwenn, te bitchrenn le menge budepangre o khereske maro Deblestar. Un me penom lenge, hoi te rakrenn le o Iddeha un leskre phralentsa, kai pash leste his an o foro Kasifja.

Un maro Debleskro kamlo wast his pral mende. Un jon anan menge i gosewo mursh dran i familja Machli, i Levitari. O Levi his i tchawo o Jakobestar. Kau mursh kharas Sherebja. Un pash leste his leskre tchawe un phrala. Khetne his le 18 (deesh-te-ochta) mursha.
Koi pashel wan o Hashabja un o Jeshaja dran i familja Merari, un leskre phrala un lengre mursh tchawe, khetne 20 (biish) mursha.

Palle wan gomme 220 (dui-sheel-te-biish) budepangre, te budrenn le an o Debleskro kheer. Lengre laba hi lauter pre-tchinlo. Jon wan kol menshendar, kai o David un i pralstune win rodan, te budrenn le i Levitarenge an o wast.

Un me mukom kote pash o pani Ahawa i tsiro win te kharell, kai chas mer tchi, un djas ap i tchanga glan maro Debleste, te djal lauter mishto ap maro drom, te djah an maro them, un te wenn kek tchilatche menshe pral mende un mare tchawende un halauter hoi men hi.

Kamom gar o rajestar klissepangre te mangell, kai denn jak ap mende un kurenn pen menge, te wenn tchilatche menshe pral mende. Ladjom man te mangap kowa lestar. Glan i tikno tsiro penam leske: O wast maro Deblestar hi kamlepah pral kolende, kai les rodenn, un leskri soreli choli well pral kolende, kai kamenn lestar tchi te djinell.
Doleske cham tchi un mangam halauter maro Deblestar, un job shunas ap maro mangepen.
Un me rodom mange 12 (deesh-te-dui) dran i pralstune rashajende win, koi pashel o Sherebja un o Hashabja un deesh wawar Levitarja.

Kolen dom ko tselo rup un ko tselo sonakai un kol tsele kutch kotja an o wast, hoi wan dino o Debleskre khereske, kowa lauter, hoi das o baro rai un leskre tchatchepangre un kol pralstune un i tsele Israelitarja, kitse kai le his, an o them Persia.
Me dom ko tselo koowa an lengre wasta: 20.000 (biish serja) kilogramme rup, un rupene koola, hoi khetne 3.000 (triin serja) kilogramme pharo his, un 3.000 (triin serja) kilogramme sonakai,

20 (biish) sonakangre tchare, kolla his enja kilogramme pharo un jaake bud moldo har 1.000 (jek sero) sonakangre lowe, un dui khore dran lolo saster, hoi win dikan har sonakai un jaake bud moldo his har sonakai.

Un me penom ap lende: “Tumer han o Debleske wi-rodedo, un kol tsele kotja hi o Debleske ap i rig tchiddo: Un ko rup un ko sonakai was o Debleske dino dran o menshengro kamlepen. Jon dan kowa pendar o baro Debleske, koles ninna pengre phure an-mangan.

Denn mishto jak koi pre, bis te wan an Jerusalem an o baro Debleskro kheer. Kote tchiwenn tumer kowa lauter ap i waga, un denn les an i wasta i pralstune rashajendar un i Levitarendar un i pralstunendar i familjendar an Israel.”
Kote lan i rashaja un i Levitarja ko tselo rup un sonakai un kol tsele kutch kotja o Debleskro khereske pentsa, te anenn le kowa an o foro Jerusalem an o kheer maro Deblestar.

Ap o deesh-te-duito diwes an o ersto tchon kram men ap o drom un mukam ko pani Ahawa pal mende, te djas an o foro Jerusalem. Un maro Debleskro wast his pral mende un das men gar an i wasta kolendar, kai kaman maro merepen un kai men ap o drom palla lan.
Un mer wam an Jerusalem, un kram triin diwessa tchi, te well men newi soor.

Ap o starto diwes djam an o Debleskro kheer, un dam ko tselo rup un sonakai un kol wawar kutch kotja o rashajeske Meremot an o wast, koleskro dad o Urija his. Un pash leste his o Eleasar, koleskro dad o Pinhas his. Un khetne lentsa his kol Levitarja, o Josabad, koleskro dad o Jeshua his, un o Noadja, koleskro dad o Binnui his.
Hako kotar, hoi lende dam, was ap i waga tchiddo un an i liil tchinlo, har pharo lo his, un kitse kotja kolendar koi his.

Un kol menshe, kai wan pale dran o pandepen, anan viechen o Israeleskro Debleske, un maran len leske: 12 (deesh-te-dui) terne gurma i tsele menshenge an Israel, 96 (enja-deesh-te-shob) mursh bakre, 77 (efta-deesh-te-efta) terne bakre. Ninna anan le 12 (deesh-te-dui) mursh busja, kai wan maredo, te well i doosh i menshendar krik lino. Un kol tsele vieche wan pre chatchedo o baro Debleske.

Un jon anan ko liil, hoi o baro rai dran o them Babilonia len lentsa das, pash i pralstunende un i themeskre rajende wergel o panjestar Eufrat. Un kolla wan i Israelenge ap i rig, un dikan ninna, te well o Debleskro kheer pale pre-tchiddo.

Har kowa halauter kerdo his, wan i pralstune pash mande un penan: “I menshe dran Israel, i rashaja un i Levitarja rikran pen gar pale i wawar menshendar, kai djiwenn an kau them: kol Kanaanitarja, Hetarja, Perisarja, Jebusarja, Ammonarja, Moabarja, Egiptarja un Amorarja. i Israelitarja krenn jaake djungelo koowa har kolla.

Jon lan kolengre djuwjen penge un pengre mursh tchawenge ninna. Un jaake hi mank o Debleskre menshende sawe, kai gar lendar hi. I pralstune un i tchatchepangre mursha his i erste, kai kowa kran, un peran o Deblestar tele.”
Har kowa shunom, krom miri baja un miro gad paash, un tserdom mange miro baal dran o shero un dran o tchor, un beshom man koi, un homs beshdo har mulo i dukatar.

Un pash mande wan halauter kolla khetne, kai an i traash his, hoi o Dewel pral o them Israel penella, kai leskre laba wan i pirentsa stakedo kolendar, kai wan dran o them Babilonia pale pale. Un me homs koi beshdo har mulo, bis te was rati - ko tsiro, kai o Debleske i viecho anlo un maredo well.
Har kau tsiro was, lom man khetne, stom pre an miro paash gad un miri paash baja, perom ap mire tchanga un rikrom mire wasta pral pash miro baro Debleste,
un penom: “Miro Dewel, me ladjau un trashau man, te hadap mire jaka pral pash tute, miro Dewel; mari doosh was pral maro shero, un maro tchilatchepen hi baro bis pral an o bolepen.

Ko tsirestar, kai mare phure djiwan, bis ap kau diwes anam mer bud doosh ap mende, un dran maro djunglepen dal men, mare rajen un rashajen an i wawar rajengre wasta, kai an i themma trul mende djiwenn. O chareha maran le men, an o stilepen witsran le men, un jon tchoran men win, un anan ladj ap mende, jaake har ninna kau diwes hi.

Kanna was men i tikno tsiro baro kamlepen dino tutar, maro baro Deblestar. Tu mukal menshen mendar djides un anal men pale kote, kai tu khere hal, te djiwas mer kote kek trashah. Doleske sanenn mare jaka, un newo djipen hi an mende, ninna te ham gomme budepangre.

Mer hams pandle budepangre, un tu, maro Dewel, mukal men gar kokres an maro pandepen. Tu kral, te dikan i raja pral o them Persia latches ap mende, un dal men newi soor, te nai tchiwas mer tiro kheer pale pre, jaake te was dran kol paash dine un chatchede barra i newo kheer tuke. Kowa kral tu, te djiwas mer pale an o them Juda un an o foro Jerusalem kek trashah.
Un kanna, maro Dewel, hoi te penas pal kau tselo koowa? Mer djiwam gar pal tire laba,

kai tu kolenge penal, kai tire budepangre, tire rakepangre his, te penenn le kowa menge dureder. Tu penal menge: ‘Ko them, kai tumer koi wenna, te lenn les tumenge, hi i pale-tchiddo them. I menshe, kai kote djiwenn, kran les pale-tchiddo ko tselo djungelo koweha, hoi le kran, har mangan le wawar deblen an. Lengre mule debla hi an o tselo them jek rigjatar bis ap i wawar.

Doleske ma denn tumare tchen lengre tchawenge! Un lengre tchen ma lenn len tumare tchawenge! Ma awenn lengre mala! Un denn jak, te wenn le gar brawelo, an kek tsiro. Palle nai wenn tumer soreles an o them, un nai chan ko latchepen, hoi an ko them koi hi. Kowa nai denn palle tumare tchawen, te djiwenn le an hako tsiro an ko them.’

Un har ko tselo tchilatcho koowa kram un jaake bud doosh ap mende anam, was kai bari bibacht ap mende. Ach, maro Dewel, tu rikral tut pale un dal men gar koi phagi, hoi hunte lams. Un mukal mendar sawe djides, kai wan dran o pandepen pale win, un wan pale kate an o them Israel.

Har nai was kowa jaake, te kras kowa kanna pale, te shunas gar ap tire laba, un te las menge romjen kol wawar menshendar, kai sawo djungelo koowa krenn? Hunte well tiri choli gar jaake pral mende, bis te atchell kek mendar ap o djipen? Bis te kek menshe mendar buder koi hi, kai pral atchan un nai djiwenn dureder?

Baro Dewel, tu o Israeleskro Dewel, hal an o tchatchepen tardo un lal men, kai pral atcham, win dran o merepen, jaake har kau diwes hi. Dik, kate ham glan tute an mari doosh, un djinah, mer nai atchah gar tardo glan tute!”

Un har o Esra glan o Debleskro kheer ap peskre tchanga tchiddo his, un ropah o Debleha rakras un koi tseli doosh win rakras, wan bud menshe dran Israel trul leste trujel, mursha, djuwja un tchawe; un jon halauter rowan soreles.

Un o Shechanja, koleskro dad o Jehijel his, i menshendar Elam, penas ap o Esra: “Awa, mer peram maro Deblestar tele, har lam menge romjen wawar menshendar, kai kate an kau them djiwenna. Un kanna dell gomme i drom menge, i Israelitarjen, te was mer dran kau tselo koowa win!

Mer kras maro Debleha win, te bitchras mer kol tsele djuwjen un lengre tchawen mendar krik, jaake har penan tumer – tu, miro rai, un kolla, kai rikrenn maro Debleskre laba. Mer kamah les jaake te krell, har an o Moseskre lila tchinlo hi.
Kanna ste pre! Ap tute hi kau koowa tchiddo. Un mer ham halauter tuha. Ab kanna soreles un kre kowa!”
Kote stas o Esra pre, un las i sowel i pralstune rashajendar un i Levitarendar un i tsele Israelendar, te krenn le pal kau lab. Un jon dan pen sowel.

Un o Esra djas peske krik o Debleskro kherestar, un djas an i kheer o Johananestar, koleskro dad o Eljashib his. Kote atchas lo i tseli rati, chas kek maro un pijas kek pani; leske his phares pral kolende, kai dran o pandepen dran o them Babilonia win wan un o Debleskro dromestar tele peran.
Un an o them Juda un an o foro Jerusalem was win kharedo halauterenge, kai pandle his an o them Babilonia: “Awenn khetne an o foro Jerusalem.

Un koon gar well an triin diwessa, jaake har i pralstune un i phureder penan, koleskro brawlepen un halauter hoi les hi, hunte well lestar krik lino. Un job te well infam kerdo un nai djiwell buder gar mank peskre menshende, kai wan win dran o pandepen an o them Babilonia.”

Kote wan i tsele mursha i menshendar Juda un Benjamin an o foro Jerusalem khetne. Ap o triinto diwes his le lauter koi. Kowa his o 20. (biishto) diwes an o 9. (enjato) tchon. Un i tsele menshe his beshdo ap i platsa glan o Debleskro kheer un trissan i trashatar pral kau koowa, hoi jon kran, un ninna o baro brishinestar.
Un o Esra, ko rashai, stas pre un rakras lentsa un penas: “Tumer peran o Deblestar tele, kai lan tumenge romjen kol menshendar, kai gar tumendar hi, un jaake anan tumer budeder doosh ap Israel.

Un kanna, penenn tumari doosh leske, ko baro Debleske tumare phurendar! Un krenn, hoi job kamella, un rikrenn tumen pale kol wawar menshendar, un bitchrenn tumare romjen, kai lendar hi, tumendar krik!”
Un lauter penan sorjah, har jek mursh: “Jaake har tu penal, jaake krah kowa!”

Un jon penan palle: “Dik, mer ham jaake bud menshe, un kanna hi brishinengro tsiro, un mer nai atchah gar halauter win tardo an o brishin. Ninna hi ko koowa gar an jek, dui diwessa kerdo, jaake bud mendar anan an kau koowa doosh pral mende.

Muk mare pralstune menge kate atchenn. Un hakeno, kai las peske i romjat wawar menshendar an mare forja, job te well glan lende ap i wi-kerdo tsiro, un khetne leha i phureder un i tchatchepangre mursha dran leskro foro. Jaake krah mer lauter, bis te was maro Debleskri choli pral kau koowa mendar krik lino.”
Kokres o Jonatan, koleskro dad o Asahel his, un o Jachseja, koleskro dad o Tikwa his, jon kaman kowa gar te krell. Un ap lengri rig his o Meshullam un o Levitari, o Shabbetai.

Kolla wawar halauter, kai wan win dran o pandepen an o them Babilonia, rikran pen ap kowa, hoi le penan. Un o rashai Esra kharas dran haki bari familja lengro pralstunes peskro labeha. Un tchiwas kol pralstunen ap i rig, te dell lo kau koowa an lengre wasta. Un kolla beshan pen khetne ap o ersto diwes an o deshto tchon, te dikenn le, hoi kerdo hunte wals pash hako mursheste,
kai las peske i romjat wawar menshendar. Un i pralstune kran pengri budi an triin tchonna. Ap o ersto diwes an o ersto tchon ko newo bershestar his halauter kerdo.

Kalla hi i mursha, kai lan penge romjen kol menshendar, kai kek Israelitarja his: an i familja o murshestar Jeshua, koleskro dad o Jozadak his, un pash leske phralende: o Maaseja, o Elijeser, o Jarib un o Gedalja.
Un jon dan pengro wast pre, kai bitchrenn le pengre romjen pendar krik, un kai kamenn le o Debleske i mursheskro bakro te dell, te well lengri doosh krik lino.
Un an i familja Immer: o Hanani un o Sebadja;
Un an i familja Harim: o Maaseja, o Elija, o Shemaja, o Jehijel un o Usija;
Un an i familja Pashur: o Eljoenai, o Maaseja, o Jishmael, o Netanel, o Josabad un o Elasa;
o Josabad, o Shimi un o Kelaja – ko hi o Kelita, o Petachja, o Juda un o Elijeser;
o Eljashib; o Shallum, o Telem un o Uri.
an i familja Parosh: o Ramja, o Jisija, o Malkija, o Mijamin, o Eleasar, o Malkija un o Benaja;
an i familja Elam: o Mattanja, o Secharja, o Jehijel, o Abdi, o Jeremot un o Elija;
an i familja Sattu: o Eljoenai, o Eljashib, o Mattanja, o Jeremot, o Sabad un o Asisa;
an i familja Bebai: o Johanan, o Hananja, o Sabbai un o Atlai;
an i familja Bani: o Meshullam, o Malluch, o Adaja, o Jashub, o Sheal un o Jeremot;
an i familja Pahat-Moab: o Adna, o Kelal, o Benaja, o Maaseja, o Mattanja, o Bezalel, o Binnui un o Manasse;
an i familja Harim: o Elijeser, o Jishija, o Malkija, o Shemaja, o Simeon,
o Benjamin, o Malluch un o Shemarja;
an i familja Hashum: o Mattenai, o Mattatta, o Sabad, o Elifelet, o Jeremai, o Manasse un o Shimi;
an i familja Bani: o Maadai, o Amram, o Uel,
o Benaja, o Bedja, o Keluhi,
o Wanja, o Meremot, o Eljashib,
o Mattanja, o Mattenai, o Jaasai;
an i familja Binnui: o Shimi,
o Shelemja, o Natan, o Adaja,
o Machnadbai, o Shashai, o Sharai,
o Asarel, o Shelemja, o Shemarja,
o Shallum, o Amarja un o Josef;
an i familja Nebo: o Jehijel, o Mattitja, o Sabad, o Sebina, o Jaddai, o Joel un o Benaja.
Kolla halauter lan penge romjen wawar menshendar, kai kek Israelitarja his; un kanna bitchran le kol djuwjen un lengre tchawen pendar krik.
Kawa hi, hoi pral o Nehemia tchinlo hi, koleskro dad o Hachalja hi. Har his o Artaxerxes an o biishto bersh o baro rai, homs an o tchon Kislew an baro rajeskro kheer an o foro Susa.

Ap ko tsiro was o Hanani pash mande, jek mire phralendar, wawar murshentsa dran o them Juda. Un me putchom lendar, har djal i biboldenge, kai wan gar pandles krik anlo un atchan an o them Juda. Ninna putchom lendar, har djal o foreske Jerusalem.
Un jon penan mange: “Kol menshe an o them Juda, kai wan gar pandles krik anlo, djiwenn an bari bibacht un ladj. Un i massuri trul Jerusalem hi tele phagedo, un i bare wudja hi pre-chatchedo.”
Un har me kol laba shunom, beshom man koi un rowom an bari duk budeder diwessa. Un me chom tchi, un mangom o Debles an o bolepen,

un penom: “Ach, baro Dewel, tu hal o Dewel an o bolepen, un hal baro un jaake sorelo, te daras hunte tutar. Tu rikreh koi sowel, hoi tu mentsa kral, un dikeh latches ap kolende, kai kamenn tut o djijestar un shunenn ap tire laba.

Dik latches ap mande, tiro budepaskro, un shun, hoi tutar mangau. Diwes un rati mangau i Israelenge, tire budepangre. Un o tchilatchepen, hoi mer ap tute kram, anau me pash tute: Me un miro dadeskro kheer anam ninna doosh ap mende.
Tchilatcho koowa kram ap tute, har shunam gar ap tire laba, hoi tu penal ap o Mose, koles tiro wast his. Un kram gar, hoi tu mendar kamal un djiwam gar pal tiro tchatchepen.
Ma biste tiro lab, hoi dal tu leske, har tu penal: ‘Tumer te phagenn mantsa, palle tradau me tumen dran tumaro them, un tumer hunte djiwenn mank wawar menshende.

Te rissrenn tumer pale trujel pash mande, un rikrenn mire laba un djiwenn pal lende, palle anau tumen pale ap koi platsa, hoi win rodom, te wap kote prindjedo. Kowa krau me, ninna te wans tumer krik tradedo bis an o palstuno kotar ap i phub.’
Jon hi tire budepangre, tire menshe, kolen tu win lal dran i tchilatche wasta tiri bari sorjah un tiro sorelo wasteha.

Ach rai, shun ap miro mangepen un ap o mangepen kolendar, kai ninna tire budepangre hi, kai mangenn tut o djijestar an. Jaake muk kowa mishto te djal, hoi man glan hi, un kre, te dikell o baro rai, o Artaxerxes, latches ap mande.” An ko tsiro homs ko mursh, dran koleskro wast o pipen o baro rajeske was.

Un an ko tsiro, har his o Artaxerxes an o biishto bersh o baro rai, an o tchon Nisan, homs glan leste tardo. Pash o chapen lom me i mool un dom lat o baro rajeste. Mange his ropaske. Glan kowa dikas lo kek tsireske, kai miro dji rowas.
Jaake putchas lo mandar: “Hoske dikau duk an tiro mui? Hal tu nasselo? Na-a, kowa hi kowa gar. Kowa hi tiro dji, hoi rowell.” I bari daar tapras man.
Un me penom ap o rajeste: “Baro rai, te djiwess hako tsireske! Har nai well mange gar ropaske? Ko foro, kai mire phure paskedo hi, hi paash kerdo. Un leskre bare wudja hi pre chatchedo.”
Un o baro rai putchas: “Hoi kameh tu?” Kote rakrom o Debleha an o bolepen,

un penom palle ap o baro rajeste: “Te hi mishto an tire jaka, miro rai, un te dikeh latches ap mande, palle bitche man an o them Juda, an ko foro, kai mire phure paskedo hi, te tchiwau ko foro pale pre.”

Kote putchas o baro rai mandar, un leskri romni, i rajetsa, his pash leste beshdo: “Har rah atcheh krik? Un kaana weh pale?” Un har o baro rajeske mishto his, te bitchrell lo man, penom leske jek tsiro.
Un me penom ap leste: “Miro rai, te hi tuke mishto, palle de man lila mantsa i rajenge pral ko them pal o pani Eufrat, jaake te hunte mukenn le man wergel te djal, bis te wom an o them Juda.

Un muk ninna i liil te tchinell ap o Asaf, ko pralstuno pral o rajeskre wesha, te dell lo man kasht, te nai krap wudja o sorelo khereske, hoi pash o Debleskro kheer tardo hi, un ninna kasht, te tchiwap i massuri trul o foro pale pre, un kasht ko khereske, an koleste me palle djiwau.” Un o baro rai das kowa lauter. Miro Debleskro latcho wast his mantsa.
Un o baro rai bitchras ninna pralstune lurden un murshen ap graja mantsa. Un me wom pash kol themeskre rajende, kai ap i wawar rig ko lengsto panjestar Eufrat his, un dom len o baro rajeskre lila.
Un har shunan kowa o Sanballat, ko Horonari, un leskro budepaskro, ko Ammonari o Tobija, wan le an bari choli, te was jek, kai kamas i Israelenge latchepen te krell.
Un me wom an o foro Jerusalem. Un pal triin diwessa

krom man rati pre, lom dui, triin murshen mantsa, un penom kek mensheske, hoi miro Dewel mange an o dji tchiwas, te krap me o foreske Jerusalem. Un his kek grai pash mande, har ko jek ap koleste me klissom.

Jaake djom rati dran o Telstuno Wudar win, un dureder glan wergel ko pani, hoi kharell Sapeskro Pani, un kotar dureder bis pash o Viechengro Fuleskro Wudar. Un me dikom mange mishto an, kai o foreskre massurja dren phagedo hi un kol wudja pre-chatchedo wan.
Un me klissom dureder pash o Djido Panjeskro Wudar un pash o rajeskro pani. Un har wom miro viecheha kote gar budeder dureder,
klissom i kotar dureder an o telstuno panjeskro them, un dikom mange mishto ko massuri kote an. Palle rissrom man un wom pale pash o Telstuno Wudar, kai glan i tsiro dren djom.

Un i tchatchepangre mursha an o foro haiwan tchi kolestar, kai me homs un hoi me krom. Tchi penom i biboldenge, witar gar i rashajenge, i pralstunenge, i tchatchepangre murshenge un kek wawarenge, kai pash koi budi hoi man glan his, pashel hunte wenn.

Kanna penom ap lende: “Tumer dikenn kai bibacht, an kalate mer ham: o tselo foro Jerusalem hi paash dino koi tchiddo. Un leskre wudja hi tele chatchedo. Awenn, te tchiwas mer i massurja trul o foro Jerusalem pale pre, jaake te nai praassenn le men gar buder.”

Un me penom lenge ninna, har latches miro Dewel ap miri rig was, un hoi o baro rai Artaxerxes ap mande penas. Kote penan le: “Awenn, kras men ap i budi, te tchiwas lauter pale pre!” Un jon kran jek o wawareske i wasta soreles, te krenn le koi latchi budi.

Kote his ninna mursha, kai praassan men un san pral mende, har shunan le kowa. Jon his o Sanballat, ko Horonari, un leskro budepaskro, o Tobija, ko Ammonari, un o Geshem, ko Arabari. Kolla penan: “Hoi hi kowa, hoi kote krenn? Kamenn tumer o baro rajestar tele te perell?”

Kote penom me ap lende: “O Dewel an o bolepen, job krell, te djal menge kawa mishto. Un mer, leskre budepangre, kram men ap i budi, te tchiwas o foro pale pre. Tumen hi kek tchatchepen ap ko foro, witar kek penepaske. Un tumare laba hi gar mank kolende, kai wenn gar bistedo.”

Un o baro rashai Eljashib kras pes ap i budi peskre phralentsa, kol wawar rashajentsa, un jon tchiwan o foreskro wudar pale pre, hoi kharas Bakrengro Wudar. Un jon rakran o Debleskri bacht pral leste win, un tchiwan kol dui wudja dren. Un jon tchiwan ninna koi massuri pale pre bis pash ko turmo, hoi kharell Mea, un bis pash ko turmo, hoi kharell Hananel, un rakran o Debleskri bacht pral i massuri win.
Un leske ap i rig budran i mursha dran Jericho. Un ap kolengri rig budras o Sakkur, koleskro dad o Imri his.

Un ko foreskro wudar, hoi kharella Matchengro Wudar tchiwan i mursha pre, kolengro dad o Senaa his. Jon tchiwan kol pesse buchle kashta pre, un tchiwan kol dui wudja dren, ninna i kashtengre un o saster, hoi kol wudja pandella.

Un kolenge ap i rig budras o Meremot, koleskro dad o Urija his un koleskro dad o Hakkoz his. Un ap koleskri rig budras o Meshullam, koleskro dad o Berechja his, koleskro dad o Meshesabel his. Un ab koleskri rig budras o Zadok, koleskro dad o Baana his.
Un ap koleskri rig budran i mursha dran o foro Tekoa. Un lengre pralstune kaman gar te budrell un kran gar, hoi lenge penlo was.

Un o foreskro wudar, hoi kharell Phuro Wudar, kras o Jojada, koleskro dad o Paseach his, khetne o Meshullam, koleskro dad o Besodja his. Jon tchiwan kol pesse sorele kashta pre, un tchiwan kol dui wudja dren, ninna i kashtengre un o saster, hoi kol wudja pandella.
Un kolenge ap i rig budras o Melatja dran Gibeon un o Jadon dran Meronot, ninna i mursha dran Gibeon un Mizpa, kai ko themeskro rai djiwas, kai ap i wawar rig o lengsto panjestar o rai his.

Un kolenge ap i rig budras o Usijel, koleskro dad o Harhaja his. Job his i mursh, kai kras shukar koowa dran sonakai. Un koleske ap i rig budras o Hananja. Kowa his i mursh, kai kras makepaskro djet. Un jon kran o kotar bis pash i Buchli Massuri.
Un kolenge ap i rig budras o Refaja, koleskro dad o Hur his. O Refaja his o pralstuno pral o paash foro Jerusalem.
Un koleske ap i rig budras o Jedaja, koleskro dad o Harumaf his. Leskro kheer his ap i wawar rig o dromestar, kai jon budran. Un koleske ap i rig budras o Hattush, koleskro dad o Hashabneja his.
Un i wawar kotar massuri kras o Malkija, koleskro dad o Harim his. Job budras khetne o mursheha Hashub, koleskro dad o Pahat-Moab his. Jon kran ninna o bobeskro turmo.
Un kolenge ap i rig budras o Shallum, koleskro dad o Lohesh his. Job his o pralstuno pral o wawar paash o forestar Jerusalem. O Shallum budras peskri tchentsa.

O Telstuno Wudar kras o Hanun un kol menshe, kai an foro Sanoach djiwan. Un jon tchiwan kol dui wudja dren, un i kashtengre un o saster, hoi i wudja pandenna. Un jon kran ko kotar massuri bis pash o Viechengro Fuleskro Wudar. Ko kotar massuri his jek seri mussja lengsto.

Un o Viechengro Fuleskro Wudar tchiwas o Malkija pre, koleskro dad o Rechab his. Kowa his o pralstuno pral o them trul Bet-Kerem. Un job tchiwas kol dui wudja dren, un i kashtengre un i saster, hoi i wudja pandenna.

Un o Djido Panjeskro Wudar kras o Shallum, koleskro dad o Kol-Hose his. O Shallum his o pralstuno pral o them trul o foro Mizpa. Job kras ko Djido Panjeskro Wudar un tchiwas i dacha pre, un kol dui wudja dren, ninna i kashtengre un i saster, hoi i wudja pandenna. Un job tchiwas i massuri pale pre pash ko tikno pani Shelah, hoi pash o baro rajeskri baar his, bis pash o barrengro drom, hoi djal tele dran o Davideskro foro.

Pal koleste budras o Nehemja, koleskro dad o Asbuk his. O Nehemja his o pralstuno pral o paash ko themestar trul o foro Bet-Zur. Job kras i massuri bis pash o Davideskro mulengro kheer un bis pash ko tikno pani, hoi kerdo was, un bis pash o kheer, kai i lurde djiwan.
Pal koleste budran i Levitarja: o Rehum, koleskro dad o Bani his; o Hashabja, kowa his o pralstuno pral o paash them trul o foro Kehila. Job budras ap i massuri ap kau kotar them;
o Binnui, koleskro dad o Henadad his. O Binnui his o pralstuno pral o wawar paash ko themestar trul o foro Kehila;

o Eser, koleskro dad o Jeshua his. O Eser his o pralstuno pral o foro Mizpa. Un job budras ap ko kotar ap i massuri, hoi hi tchiddo ap i wawar rig ko kherestar, kai i marepaskre koola dren hi, un djal bis pash i bangi ekka;
o Baruch, koleskro dad o Sabbai his. O Baruch budras peskro tselo djijeha ap ko kotar ap i massuri, hoi djal dureder bis pash o kheer, kai o baro rashai Eljashib djiwas;
o Meremot, koleskro dad o Urija his, koleskro dad o Hakkoz his. Job kras ko kotar, kai djal fun kotar, kai o wudar hi an o Eljashibeskro kheer bis kote, kai leskro kheer pre heras.
Pal koleste budran i rashaja ap i massuri: i mursha dran o telstuno them pash o pani Jordan;

o Benjamin un o Hashub. Jon kran ko kotar an i massuri, kai lengre khera ap i wawar rig o dromestar his; o Asarja, koleskro dad o Maaseja his, koleskro dad o Ananja his. O Asarja kras ko kotar an i massuri, hoi pash peskro kheer his;
o Binnui, koleskro dad o Henadad his. Job kras ko kotar an i massuri, pash o Asarjeskro kheer bis pash i bangi ekka un dureder bis pash i ekka;

o Palal, koleskro dad o Usai his. Job budras ap ko kotar an i massuri, hoi hi wergel i bangi ekka un ko pralstuno turmo o baro rajeskro kherestar. Ko turmo hi pash i lurdengri platsa. o Pedaja, koleskro dad o Parosh his, kras i massuri dureder

bis wergel o Panjeskro Wudar ap koi rig, kai o kham pre djal, un ko turmo, hoi pash o Debleskro kheer glan tardo hi. Kowa his gar dur fun koi platsa Ofel, kai kol budepangre djiwan, kai an o Debleskro kheer budran.
Pal koleste budran i mursha dran o foro Tekoa ap i massuri, wergel kotar, kai ko turmo glan tardo his, bis pash koi massuri trul i platsa Ofel.
Ko kotar massuri pral o Grajengro Wudar kran i rashaja newes, hakeno wergel peskro kheer.
Pal kolende budras o Zadok, koleskro dad o Immer his. Job budras wergel peskro kheer. Un pal leste budras o Shemaja, koleskro dad o Shechanja his. Job his kowa, kai ap o Glanstuno Wudar jak das.

Pal koleste budras o Hananja, koleskro dad o Shelemja his, un o Hanun, o shobto tchawo ko murshestar Zalaf. Kolla kran i wawar kotar an i massuri newes. Pal kolende budras o Meshullam, koleskro dad o Berechja his. Un job budras wergel peskri isema.

Pal koleste budras o Malkija. Kowa his jek kolendar, kai dran sonakai kutch koowa krenn. Un job kras i massuri dureder bis pash o kheer, kai djiwenn i parepangre un kol budepangre, kai an o Debleskro kheer budrenn. Kowa his ap i wawar rig ko wudarestar, hoi kharell Mifkad Wudar, un wergel koi pralstuni isema ap i ekka an i massuri.
Un mashkral i pralstuni isema ap i ekka un i Bakrengro Wudar budran i parepangre un kolla, kai krenn shukar koowa dran sonakai.
Har shunas o Sanballat, te tchiwah mer i massuri pale pre, kote was lo chojedo, un leskri choli his baro. Un job praassas i bibolden,

un penas glan peskre phralende un ap i kurepangre dran Samaria: “Hoi krenn kol paash-mule bibolde? Kamenn le tchatchepah o foro Jerusalem pale pre te tchiwell? Patsenn jon, te denn le viechen o Debleske, palle nai krenn le kowa lauter an jek diwes? Kamenn le kol chatchede barra dran koi tele-phagedi tchik pale djides te krell?”
Un o Tobija, ko Ammonari, his pash leste tardo un penas: “Muk len, te well i tikno diwjo djuklo un stell ap koi massuri pre, palle phagell li khetne.”
Me mangom miro Debles: “Shun maro Dewel, har praassenn le men. Un muk lengro praassepen ap lengre sherja pale te well. De lenge, te wenn le win randedo un pandles anlo an i wawar them.
Lengri doosh te well gar tele tchakedo tutar! Ma biste ko tchilatchepen, hoi le kran: Jon praassan men, kai krah i massuri trul tiro foro newes.”
Mer budram dureder ap koi massuri, jaake te was li paash pre kerdo. Un i tsele menshe his o tselo djijeha pash i budi pashel.

Un i budi ap o foreskri massuri djas mishto dureder, un kol kotja, kai i barra gomme win phagedo his, wan pale newes kerdo. Har shunas kowa o Sanballat un o Tobija, ninna kol menshe dran Arabia, dran Ammon un dran Ashdod, koi tapras len bari choli.
Un jon tchiwan pen khetne, te djan le ap o foro Jerusalem, un te krenn le i menshen kote jaake diwjo, te djinell kek buder, hoi te krell lo.
Kote mangam maro Debles an, un tchiwam murshen pre, kai jak hunte dan ap o diwes un an i rat, kaana jon wans.
I menshe dran Juda kran i gili, hoi le giwan: Koi hi tchiddo jaake bud tchik, hoi hunte hidjras mer gomme krik. Mari soor men mukas, koi massuri gar dureder nai kras.

Kolla, kai mentsa tchingepen rodan, penan jek ap o wawareste: “Mer kamah sik un tchorchanes mank lende te well, te dikenn le men gar, bis te mer mashkral lende wam. Palle dah len mulo. Jaake krah, te djal koi budi gar buder dureder.”
Kol bibolde, kai gar dur lendar djiwan, wan pale te pale pash mende un penan menge, hoi kolen glan his.

Doleske tchiwom me i murshen kote pash i massuri pre, kai i barra gomme win phagedo his. Un me tchiwom len jaake pre, te hi hako kopo kolla dran jek bari familja khetne tardo. Un len his pengre chare un witsepangre tchurja un boge pash pende.

Un har lengri daar dikom, djom pash lende un penom ap i pralstunende un ap i tchatchepangre murshende un ap i tsele murshende: “Ma darenn lendar! Dikenn ap o Debleste, kai hi baro un jaake sorelo, te darell hunte hakeno lestar! Un djan an o kurepen tumare phralenge, un tumare tchawenge un tchenge, tumare romjenge un tumare kherenge!”

Un kolla, kai kaman maro merepen, shunan, kai menge penlo was, hoi len glan his. Jaake mukas len o Dewel gar te krell, hoi len glan his. Kanna nai djam mer pale pale pash i massuri, hakeno kote, kai job budras.

Un o paash mendar budras ap i massuri. Un ko wawar paash das jak, un len his i witsepaskre tchurja, un i shilte un i boge pash pende un i kurepaskre gada ap pende. Un i pralstune his tardo pal i tsele menshende dran Juda,
kai ap i massuri budran. Un kolla kai i tchik krik hidjrenn, budran jaake: Koi jek wasteha budran le, un an o wawar wast rikran le pengro witsepaskro tchuri.

Un hakeno kolendar, kai i barra pre tchiwan, hidjras an peskri pereskri dori peskro charo trul peste pandlo. Un jaake budran le. Un ko mursh, kai an i phurdepaskri dren hunte phurdell, his pash mande tardo.
Un me penom ap i pralstunende un tchatchepangre murshende un ap lauterende, kai kote his: “Hi gomme bud budi te krell, un hakeno mendar hi tardo ap i massuri dur krik o wawarestar.
Tumer te shunenn koi phurdepaskri, djan koi un awenn kote mentsa khetne. Un maro Dewel kurell pes menge.”
Jaake budram mer o tselo diwes jaake rah har o kham pre djas bis pash ko tsiro, kai i bolepangre momlia glan wan. Un o paash mendar das jak un rikras o witsepaskro tchuri an o wast.
An ko tsiro penom me ap i pralstunende: “Hakeno te atchell peskre murshentsa rati an o foro Jerusalem, jaake te hi men doha mursha, kai denn jak an i rat un budrenn ap o diwes.”

Un kek mendar riwas peskre koola rati win, me un mire phrala gar, un witar gar kolla, kai tel mande budran un kolla, kai jak dan. Un hakenes his peskro witsepaskro tchuri tchiddo ap peskri tchatchi rig.
Un pal i tsiro was i bari gole pre, un i mursha un lengre romja tchingran pral i brawelende mank lengre biboldengre phralende.
His sawe koi, kai penan: “Mer un mare tchawe un tcha ham bud! Mer hunte ginas djob, te hi men chapaske jaake te nai djiwas!”
Un wawar penan: “Mer hunte dam mari hachetikri phub koi, ninna maro drakengro them un mare khera, te nai las lowe pre, te nai ginas chapen an kau tsiro, kai lauter bokenna.”
Un pale wawar penan: “Mer hunte patsam menge lowe ap mari hachetikri phub un ap maro drakengro them, te nai plaissras kol themeskre lowe o baro rajeske.”

Jon lauter penan: “Mer ham har mare phrala, lengro mass un rat. Mare tchawe hi har lengre tchawe! Un mer hunte das mare tchawen un tchen lende, te wenn le lengre budepangre. Un mank mare tchende hi sawe, kai wan sorjah an-tapedo. Un mer nai krah tchi. Un mari hachetikri phub un maro drakengro them hi wawaren.”
Koi was i bari choli an mande pre, har shunom koi bari gole un kol laba dran lengro mui!
Un rakrom miro djijeha, un djom pash i pralstunende un i tchatchepangre murshende un tchingrom ap lende un penom: “Tumer pijenn o rat tumare phralendar win!” Un me krom i baro tsillo,

un penom ap lende: “Kai kowa an maro wast his, ginam i bibolden, mare phralen, pale, kai ap i wawar menshende bikedo wan. Un kanna kamenn tumer, te bikrenn pen tumare phrala ap tumende, kai lengre menshendar han!” Kote atchas lenge o mui pre, un jon hatsan kek laba, hoi le nai penans.

Un me penom: “Gar mishto hi kowa, hoi tumer kai krenna! Tumer hunte djiwans glan o baro Debleskre jaka, un krans, hoi mishto hi, te nai praassens men kol wawar menshe gar, kai trul mende djiwenn un maro merepen kamenn.
Shunenn! Ninna me un mire phrala un mire budepangre patsan len lowe win un ninna djob. Mer te mukas lenge koi sijaan tele, jaake te hunte denn le tchi pale!

Denn len gomme kau diwes lengri hachetikri phub pale, ninna lengro drakengro them, lengre djeteskre ruka un lengre khera! Un mukenn lenge lengri tseli sijaan tele, hoi jon pash tumende hi, lowe, djob, mool un djet!”

Kote penan le: “Mer kamah kowa pale te dell, un tchi lendar pale te lell! Mer kamah jaake te krell har tu menge penal!” Un me mukom i rashajen te well, un mukom i pralstunen pen sowel te dell glan lende, te krenn le les jaake, har le kowa penan.

Ninna trisslom miri baja win, un penom: “Jaake trissell o Dewel hakenes tumendar, kai rikrell gar peskro lab. O Dewel lell lestar leskro kheer un lauter, hoi les hi.” Un lauter, kai kote khetne wan, penan: “Amen!” Un jon sharan o baro Debles. Un i menshe kran pal kol laba, har jon penan.

Fun ko diwes an, kai mange penlo was, te wap o rai pral o them Juda, lom me mange un mire menshenge tchi kolestar, hoi o themeskro rajeste hunte dino wals. Deesh-te-dui bersha krom jaake. Kowa his an ko tsiro, kai o Artaxerxes an o 20. (biishto) bersh baro rai his, bis an leskro 32. (trijanda-te-duito) bersh.

Kol wawar themeskre raja glan mande tchiwan pharo koowa ap i menshende. Hako diwes lan le lendar maro un mool un kote pashel gomme 40 (star-deesh) rupene beme. Un kolengre budepangre kran pen ninna rai pral i menshende, jaake har le kaman! Me krom kowa gar jaake, djinom, o Dewel dikell man!
Miri tseli sorjah budrom ap i massuri un ginom mange kek phub. Un mire tsele budepangre hunte budran kote mantsa khetne.
Un i biboldendar chan 150 (jek-sheel-te-paash) tchatchepangre mursha ap mari chapaskri, un ninna kolla, kai wan pash mende dran i wawar themma trul mende.

Un kowa, hoi an jek diwes o chapaske koi hunte his, his jek grumni, shob thulle bakre, ninna papja un kachja. Un hako deshto diwes ginom bud newi mool. Ninna te ginom jaake bud chapen, lom me gar kowa, hoi i themeskro rajeste hunte wals dino. Kowa, hoi i menshe hunte plaissrenn, his phares doha.
Ma biste kowa mange, miro Dewel, hoi lauter kol menshenge krom!

O Sanballat un o Tobija un o Geshem, ko Arabari, un kol tsele wawar, kai menge tchilatchepen kaman, kolla shunan, kai his i massuri kerdo, un kek kotar pral atchas, kai barra wi-phagedo his. An ko tsiro his kokres i wudja gomme gar dren.
Kote bitchras o Sanballat un o Geshem murshen pash mande, un mukan mange te penell: “Ab pash mende an o gab Kefirim an o telstuno them pash o foro Ono!” Len his glan, te krenn le mange tchilatchepen.

Un me bitchrom lenge bitchepangre pale, un mukom lenge te penell: “Me krau kate i bari budi, un me nai wau gar tele. Te mukoms kate lauter tchiddo un woms tele pash tumende, nai wals jaake, te djals koi budi gar dureder.”
Star kope bitchran le murshen pash mande kol labentsa. Un star kope penom lenge kal emlige laba pale.
Kote bitchras o Sanballat o pantchto kopo peskro bitchepaskres pash mande un das les i liil peha, hoi gar pandlo his.

An koleste his tchinlo: Mank i tsele menshende djal o rakepen trujel, un o Geshem penell les ninna: Tut hi glan, te hadess tut khetne i biboldentsa pral mende! Doleske tchiweh tu i massuri pale pre. Un pal kowa, hoi rakedo well, kameh tu lengro baro rai te well,

un mukal Debleskre rakepangre pash tute gole te dell, kai glan tute win kharenn an o foro Jerusalem, te hal tu o baro rai pral o them Juda. Djiness, kowa well ninna o baro rajeske penlo. Jaake ab pash mande, te rakras mer khetne pral lauter, hoi hunte kras!
Kote mukom leske te penell: “Tchi kolestar, hoi tu kai rakreh, hi tchatcho. Dran tiro dji well kawa lauter!”
Jon lauter kaman menge daar te krell, te budras gar dureder, te well i massuri gar kerdo. Doleske krom mire wasta sorleder.

Un me wom an o kheer, kai o Shemaja djiwas, koleskro dad o Delaja his, un koleskro dad o Mehetabel his. O Shemaja nai djas gar dran peskro kheer win, un penas mange: “Me un tu hunte was khetne an o Debleskro kheer un hunte pandas men dren an i palstuni isema. Jon wenna, te denn le tut temerl. Rati wenn le, te denn le tut temerl.”
Me penom: “I mursh, har me hom, nashell gar krik. Patseh, te djoms an o Debleskro kheer, te atchap djido? Me djau gar dren!”
Me haiwom, koles bitchras gar o Dewel! His o Tobija un o Sanballat, kai dan les lowe, te penell job sau koowa mange,
te darap man un krap kowa un anap jaake doosh ap mande. Palle wals len doha, hoi le pal mande nai rakrans, un nai praassans man koleha!

Miro Dewel, biste kowa lenge gar, hoi o Tobija un o Sanballat kran, un ninna hoi i Noadja an o Debleskro lab pral mande win rakras, un kol tsele wawar, kai kran, har te rakrans le Debleskre laba win, un kaman mange daar te krell.
Un ap o biish-te-pantchto diwes an o tchon Elul his lauter ap i massuri kerdo. Paash-sheel-te-dui diwessa djas koi tseli budi.

Har shunan kowa kolla lauter, kai menge tchilatchepen kaman, trashan i menshe an i tsele themma, hoi trul mende hi. Un lengro pre-phurdepen djas krik. Un jon haiwan, te his maro Dewel pal koi budi tardo.
An kol diwessa tchinan bud pralstune dran Juda lila ap o Tobija, un lila lestar djan ap lende.

An o them Juda his bud, kai pen sowel dan, te rikrenn le pash leste. O dad leskri romjatar his o Shechanja, koleskro dad o Arach his. Un leskro tchawo, o Johanan, romedineras i tchat fun o Meshullam, koleskro dad o Berechja his.
Un jon rakran glan mande pral ko tselo latchepen, hoi job lauter kras. Un penan leske, hoi me penom. Un o Tobija bitchras mange lila, kolentsa job kamas mange daar te krell.
Un har i massuri tardo his, un me o wudja dren tchiwom, was kol murshen pengri budi dino, kai pash i wudja jak hunte dan, ninna i gipangren un i Levitarjen.

Un me tchiwom dui pralstunen pral o foro Jerusalem, miro phrales, o Hanani, un o Hananja, kai o pralstuno lurdo pral o lurdengro kheer his. Job his i mursh o labestar, un djiwas jaake o Debleha har gar bud wawar.

Un me penom ap lende: “I bare foreskre wudja wenn gar pre kerdo jaake rah o kham gar pral ap o bolepen tardo hi. Un kol wudja hunte wenn pandlo un klido sorele kashtentsa jaake rah har o kham gomme ap o bolepen diklo well. Un mursha hunte wenn win rodedo dran kolende, kai an Jerusalem djiwenn, te denn le jak ap o foro. Kol jek wenn tardo kote, kai lenge penlo well. Un kol wawar denn jak trul pengre khera trujel.”
O foro Jerusalem his baro un buchlo, un gar bud menshe djiwan kote, un kek khera his koi.

Un miro Dewel das man an o dji, te dom khetne gole i pralstunen un tchatchepangre murshen, un lauter, kai kote djiwan, te wenn lengre laba pre tchinlo, hakeno pash peskri familja. Un me hatsom o familjakro liil kolendar, kai i glanstune his, kai pale wan. An ko liil his tchinlo:

Kalla hi kol menshe, kai an o them Juda djiwenn. Kolla wan pale dran o pandepen, kai o baro rai pral Babilonia, o Nebukadnezar, len krik anas. Kolla wan pale pale an o foro Jerusalem un an o them Juda, hakeno an peskro foro.

Jon wan khetne kol murshentsa Serubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemja, Asarja, Raamja, Nahamani, Mordokai, Bilshan, Misperet, Bigwai, Nehum, un Baana. Kolla hi i laba kol familjendar, kai wan pale an Israel un kitse mursha an lende his:
o kheer Parosh: 2.172 (dui-serja-jek-sheel-te-efta-deesh-te-dui);
o kheer Shefatja: 372 (triin-sheel-te-efta-deesh-te-dui);
o kheer Arach: 652 (shob-sheel-te-pantch-deesh-te-dui);
o kheer Pahat-Moab, kol tchawendar o Jeshua un o Joab: 2.818 (dui-serja-ochta-sheel-te-deesh-te-ochta);
o kheer Elam: 1.254 (jek-sero-dui-sheel-te-pantch-deesh-te-star);
o kheer Sattu: 845 (ochta-sheel-te-star-deesh-te-pantch);
o kheer Sakkai: 760 (efta-sheel-te-shob-deesh);
o kheer Binnui: 648 (shob-sheel-te-star-deesh-te-ochta);
o kheer Bebai: 628 (shob-sheel-te-biish-te-ochta);
o kheer Asgad: 2.322 (dui-serja-triin-sheel-te-biish-te-dui);
o kheer Adonikam: 667 (shob-sheel-te-shob-deesh-te-efta);
o kheer Bigwai: 2.067 (dui-serja-te-shob-deesh-te-efta);
o kheer Adin: 655 (shob-sheel-te-pantch-deesh-te-pantch);
o kheer Ater, o tchawestar Hiskija: 98 (enja-deesh-te-ochta);
o kheer Hashum: 328 (triin-sheel-te-biish-te-ochta);
o kheer Bezai: 324 (triin-sheel-te-biish-te-star);
o kheer Harif: 112 (jek-sheel-te-deesh-te-dui);
o kheer Gibeon: 95 (enja-deesh-te-pantch);
dran i forja Betlehem un Netofa: 188 (jek-sheel-te-ochta-deesh-te-ochta);
dran o foro Anatot: 128 (jek-sheel-te-biish-te-ochta);
dran o foro Bet-Asmawet: 42 (star-deesh-te-dui);
dran i forja Kirjat-Jearim un Kefira un Beerot: 743 (efta-sheel-te-star-deesh-te-triin);
dran i forja Rama un Geba 621 (shob-sheel-te-biish-te-jek);
dran o foro Michmas: 122 (jek-sheel-te-biish-te-dui);
dran i forja Betel un Ai: 123 (jek-sheel-te-biish-te-triin);
o wawar kheer Nebo: 52 (paash-sheel-te-dui);
o wawar kheer Elam: 1.254 (jek-sero-dui-sheel-te-pantch-deesh-te-star);
o kheer Harim: 320 (triin-sheel-te-biish);
dran o foro Jericho: 345 (triin-sheel-te-star-deesh-te-pantch);
dran i forja Lod un Hadid un Ono: 721 (efta-sheel-te-biish-te-jek);
o kheer Senaa: 3.930 (triin-serja-enja-sheel-te-trijanda);
I rashaja: o kheer Jedaja dran o kheer Jeshua: 973 (enja-sheel-te-efta-deesh-te-triin);
o kheer Immer: 1.052 (jek-sero-te-pantch-deesh-te-dui);
o kheer Pashur: 1.247 (jek-sero-dui-sheel-te-star-deesh-te-efta);
o kheer Harim: 1.017 (jek-sero-te-deesh-te-efta);
I Levitarja: dran i khera Jeshua, Kadmijel, Binnui un Hodawja: 74 (efta-deesh-te-star);
dran o kheer Asaf: 148 (sheel-te-star-deesh-te-ochta); kolla his gipangre;
dran i khera Shallum, Ater, Talmon, Akkub, Hatita un Shobai: khetne 138 (jek-sheel-te-trijanda-te-ochta); kolla dan jak ap o foreskre wudja;
I familje, kolendar i mursha wan, kai budran an o Debleskro kheer: Ziha, Hasufa, Tabbaot,
Keros, Sia, Padon,
Lebana, Hagaba, Salmai,
Hanan, Giddel, Gahar,
Reaja, Rezin, Nekoda,
Gasam, Usa, Paseach,
Besai, Meunim, Nefusim,
Bakbuk, Hakufa, Harhur,
Bazlut, Mehida, Harsha,
Barkos, Sisera, Temach,
Nezjach un Hatifa.
I familje kolendar, kai budran o baro rajeske Salomo: Sotai, Soferet, Perida,
Jaala, Darkon, Giddel,
Shefatja, Hattil, Pocheret-Zebajim, un Amon.
I tsele budepangre, kai budran an o Debleskro kheer un kolla, kolengre phure o Salomeske budran, his khetne 392 (triin-sheel-te-enja-deesh-te-dui).

Un koi his ninna menshe, kai khetne i Israelitarja pre wan dran Tel-Melach, un dran Tel-Harsha, un dran Kerub-Addon, un dran Immer. Jon nai penan gar, dran hawo dadengro kheer jon hi, un te hi lengre menshe dran o Israel.
Kolla his i familje Delaja, Tobija, un Nekoda. Khetne his le 642 (shob-sheel-te-star-deesh-te-dui) mursha.

Mank i rashaja his sawe, kai nai hatsan gar pengro familjakro liil. Kolla his i familje Habaja, Hakkoz un Barsillai. O phuro dad i familjatar Barsillai las i tchai ko murshestar Barsillai dran Gilead, un was pal koleskro lab kharedo. Un har sikran le nai gar, hawe menshendar jon hi, nai atchan le gar rashaja.
Un ko moskro penas lenge, te nai chan le gar o chapen, hoi kokres i rashajenge his, jaake rah bis te i rashai was un win hatsas, hoi i barra Momeli un Tchatchepen pral kau koowa penan.
Un i tsele Israelitarja, kai wan khere dran pengro pandepen, his khetne 42.360 (star-deesh-te-dui-serja-triin-sheel-te-shob-deesh) menshe.

Win lino his lengre budepangre. Kolla his 7.337 (efta-serja-triin-sheel-te-trijanda-te-efta) mursha un djuwja. Koi pashel wan lengre gipangre: 245 (dui-sheel-te-star-deesh-te-pantch) mursha un djuwja.

Un len his 736 (efta-sheel-te-trijanda-te-shob) graja, 245 (dui-sheel-te-star-deesh-te-pantch) maultikre burike, 435 (star-sheel-te-trijanda-te-pantch) khamele, un 6.720 (shob-serja-efta-sheel-te-biish) burike.

Un mank kolende, kai his i pralstune pral pengre familje, his sawe, kai dan pendar lowe un wawar koowa o Debleskro khereske. Ko moskro das 1.000 (jek-sero) sonakangre lowe un 50 (paash-sheel) tchare, un 530 (pantch-sheel-te-trijanda) rashajengre baja.
Un wawar pralstune dan 20.000 (biish-serja) sonakangre lowe un 1.100 (jek-sero-te-jek-sheel) kilogramme rup.
Un kol wawar menshe dan khetne 20.000 (biish-serja) sonakangre lowe un 1.000 (jek sero) kilogramme rup un 67 (shob-deesh-te-efta) rashajengre baja.

Un lauter djan an pengre forja, te djiwenn le kote: I rashaja un i Levitarja, kolla, kai ap o foreskre wudja jak dan, i gipangre, wawar menshe, kolla kai an o Debleskro kheer budran, un i tsele Israelitarja.

Un har o eftato tchon was, un i Israelitarja pale an pengre forja his, wan i tsele menshe khetne har jek mursh ap i platsa glan o Panjeskro Wudar. Un jon penan ap o Esra, te anell job o Moseskro liil, kai dren tardo hi, hoi o baro Dewel penas, hoi i Israelitarja hunte krenn un rikrenn. O Esra his i sikepaskro, kai prindjras mishto o Debleskro lab.
Jaake anas o rashai Esra ap o ersto diwes an o eftato tchon o Moseskro liil glan i tsele Israelitarja, kai khetne wan, glan kol tsele murshende un djuwjende, un lauterende, kai nai haiwan les.
Un sik taissarlakro bis mashkral o diwes draweras job dran ko liil glan, kote ap koi platsa glan ko Panjeskro Wudar. Un hakeno das jak ap kowa, hoi an ko liil dren tardo his.

Un o sikepaskro, o Esra, his tardo pre ap i kashteno mochton, hoi koleske kerdo was, te dikenn un nai shunenn les lauter. Un pash leste his tardo, ap i tchatchi rig: O Mattitja, un o Shema, un o Anaja, un o Urija, un o Hilkija, un o Maaseja. Un ap leskri serwi rig: O Pedaja, un o Mishael, un o Malkija, un o Hashum, un o Hashbaddana, un o Secharja, un o Meshullam.
Un o Esra his tardo pral ap o kashteno mochton. Un i tsele menshe dikan, har kras lo o liil pre. Koi stan le lauter pre.
