Un o Esra sharas o baro Debles, kai bareder hi har lauter wawar. Un i tsele menshe penan: “Amen, Amen!” Un har le kowa penan, hadan le pengre wasta pre. Un palle witsran le pen tele glan o baro Debleste lengre mujentsa ap i phub.

Palle stan le pale pre hakeno ap peskri platsa. Un i Levitarja penan i menshenge, hoi kol laba an o Moseskro liil kamenn te penell. Kol Levitarja his o Jeshua, un o Bani, un o Sherebja, un o Jamin, un o Akkub, un o Shabbetai, un o Hodija, un o Maaseja, un o Kelita, un o Asarja, un o Josabad, un o Hanan, un o Pelaja.

Un ko liil, kai o Debleskro lab dren tchinlo his, his an o hebretikro rakepen. Un i Levitarja rakran kol laba an o aramtikro rakepen, hoi kal menshe kote rakran. Un palle sikran le len, hoi kol laba kamenn te penell, jaake te haiwan le, hoi koi glan drawedo was.

Un i tsele menshe rowan, har shunan le kol laba, hoi an o Moseskro liil tardo his. Un o Nehemia, kowa his o moskro pral o foro Jerusalem, un o rashai Esra, kowa his o sikepaskro, un kol Levitarja, kai i menshenge penan, hoi o Debleskro lab kamell te penell, kolla penan ap lauterende: “Kau diwes hi i baro diwes o baro Debleske, kai tumaro Dewel hi. Doleske mukenn tumare djia gar phares te well! Un ma rowenn!”

Un job penas pale ap lende: “Djan koi un chan thullo chapen un pijenn gudlo pipen! Un bitchrenn kolestar ninna kolenge, kai kran pen kek chapen! Kau diwes hi i baro diwes o Debleske, maro rajeske. Mukenn tumenge o dji gar phares te well! Na-a, mukenn tumare djia giwenn o baro Debleske! Palle han sorelo.”
Un i Levitarja rakran latches ap i menshende un penan: “Atchenn kanna! Kawa diwes hi i Debleskro diwes. Mukenn tumare djia gar jaake phares te well!”
Kote djan i tsele menshe koi, te chan le un pijenn le. Un jon bitchran pengro chapastar kolenge, kai len tchi his, un giwan un khelan i bachtjatar. Jon haiwan kol laba, hoi lenge penlo wan.

Un ap o duito diwes wan i pralstune kol Israelengre familjendar un i rashaja un i Levitarja khetne pash o Esra, ko sikepaskro, kai o Debleskro lab mishto djinas, te sikrell lo len, hoi an o Moseskro liil tardo hi, te haiwenn le o Debleskro drom feteder.

Un an ko liil hatsan le kol laba, kai penas o baro Dewel ap o Moseste, te hunte rikrenn i Israelitarja kol bare diwessa, kai kharenn ‘Patjengre Khera ’ an o eftato tchon. Un an kol diwessa hunte djiwenn le an tikne khera, hoi jon penge dran patria krenn.

Jaake dan le win gole an pengre tsele forja, ninna an Jerusalem, un penan: “Djan win ap i berge un anenn kashta i djeteskre rukendar, ninna i diwje djeteskre rukendar, un i mirtetikre rukendar un i palmtikre rukendar un wawar rukendar, kolen bud patria hi. Un krenn kolendar tikne khera dran patria, jaake har an o Moseskro liil tchinlo hi.”

Kote djan i menshe win un anan kashta i patjentsa un kran penge patjengre khera. Un hakeno kras peske sau kheer, kol jek pral ap pengre khera, kol wawar pal pengre khera, ninna ap koi platsa glan o Debleskro kheer un ap i platse pash o Panjeskro Wudar un pash o Efrajimeskro Wudar.

Un i tsele menshe, kai khere wan dran i themma, kai le pandle his, kolla kran penge khera dran patria un djiwan an lende. Kowa kran i Israelitarja buder gar jaake rah, har o Josua mulo hi, koleskro dad o Nun his. Un jon his bud bud bachtelo.

Hako diwes draweras o Esra dran o liil glan, kai o Debleskro drom siklo well, o tselo tsiro, kai jon kol bare diwessa rikran. Un kol bare diwessa djan efta diwessa. Un ap o ochtato diwes wan le lauter jaake khetne, har tchinlo his an i tchatchepaskre laba.
Un ap o 24. (biish-te-starto) diwes an kau tchon wan i Israelitarja khetne, un jon chan tchi un riwan pen an gone un tchiwan tchik ap pengre sherja.
Un hakeno, kai i Israelendar hi, mukas kolen, kai gar peskre menshendar hi. Un jon wan glan o Debleste un mangan pen tele, un penan hawi doosh jon un pengre phure ap pende anan.

Un jon his hakeno ap peskri platsa tardo, har was glan drawedo dran ko liil, kai sikrell o drom o baro Deblestar, kai lengro Dewel hi. I starto kotar o diwestar was glan drawedo un o starto kotar o diwestar penan le pengri doosh, un witsran pen tele glan o baro Debleste, koles jon an-mangan.

Un ap i pralstuni platsa, hoi i Levitarenge his, stas o Jeshua pre, un o Bani, un o Kadmijel, un o Shebanja, un o Bunni, un o Sherebja, un o Bani, un o Kenani. Un jon dan bares gole ap pengro baro Debleste, te well lo ap lengri rig.

Un i Levitarja, o Jeshua, un o Kadmijel, un o Bani, un o Hashabneja, un o Sherebja, un o Hodija, un o Shebanja, un o Petachja penan: Stenn pre! Sharenn o baro Debles! Job hi tumaro Dewel. Sharenn les kanna un hako tsireske! Baro Dewel, hakeno te sharell tiro railo lab! Kek wawar lab hi jaake baro un railo har tiro lab.

Tu, baro Dewel hal kokres o Dewel! Tu kral o bolepen un leskre tsele bolepangre momlia, un i phub un lauter, hoi ap late hi, ninna o baro pani un lauter, hoi an leste hi. Un tu kral, te djiwell kowa lauter. Un i tsele bolepangre an o bolepen witsrenn pen tele glan tute.
Tu hal o baro Dewel, o Dewel, kai o Abrames win rodas, un anal les win dran o foro Ur dran o them Kaldea, un dal les o lab Abraham.

Un har dikal, te rikrell lo pes ap tute peskro tselo djijeha, kral tu leha win un dal tu tiro lab, te dess leskre tchawende un kolengre tchawende, kai pal lende wenn, ko them, kai djiwenn i Kanaanitarja, un i Hetarja, un i Amorarja, un i Perisarja, un i Jebusarja, un i Girgasharja. Un tu rikral tiro lab. Tu hal tardo an o tchatchepen.
Un tu dikal o pharo djipen mare phurendar an o them Egiptia, un shunal lengri gole, har his le pash o Baro Lolo Pani.

Un tu kral baro sorelo koowa, hoi kek wawar nai krell, ap o baro rajeste Farao un i pralstunende un i tsele menshende leskro themestar, har dikal, te rikran le mare phuren tele. Un jaake kral tiro lab bares, jaake har kowa kau diwes hi.

Tu dal o baro pani, jaake te djas lo ap dui rigja krik, un i drom koi his, kai nai djan tire menshe mashkral ko baro pani ap i wawar rig. Kolla, kai tire menshe palla lan, tassan un djan tele har barra an o telstuno pani.
Un tu sikral len o drom. Ap o diwes djas i wolka glan lende, un i rati i jag, te well len i momeli ap o drom, koles jon hunte djan.

Un ap i berga Sinai wal tu tele, un dran o bolepen rakral tu lentsa. Un tu penal lenge tchatchepaskre laba, hoi mishto hi, un sikral len tchatche dromma, un dal len latche laba, hoi penan lenge, hoi te krenn le.

Un tu sikral len, har te rikrenn le o diwes, hoi tuke hi. Kowa hi o Debleskro diwes. Un an wawar laba, hoi penas lenge o Mose, koles tiro wast his, sikral tu len, hoi tu lendar kameh un har nai djan le tire dromma.

Un maro dran o bolepen dal tu len, har len bok his. Un mukal lenge dran o baro bar pani win nashell, har len trush his. Un tu penal lenge, te djan le koi un lenn o them dren. Ko them koleske tu tiro wast hadal, un dal tut sowel, te dess len ko them.
Un mare phure hadan pen un djan pal pengro shero, kran pengre djia har bar, un shunan gar ap tire laba.

Un jon kaman gar te krell, hoi tu lenge penal, un bistran ko tselo baro koowa, hoi tu lenge kral, hoi kek wawar nai krella. Jon kran pengre djia pandlo har bar. Un rodan jekes win, te well lo lengro rai, un anell len pale an o them Egiptia, an pengro pandepen. Tu hal i Dewel, kai i doosh krik lell, un hal kamlo un kreh tiro dji pre i menshenge. Tu weh gar sik chojedo un tiro latchepen hi baro. Un tu djal gar lendar.
Ninna palle djal tu lendar gar, har kran jon penge i sonakaskro terno gurum un penan: “Kawa hi tumaro Dewel, kai anas tumen win dran o them Egiptia.” Jaake bud dukran le tut, maro Dewel.

Tu mukal len gar kokres, kote an o mulo them. Jaake baro his tiro kamlepen lenge. Koi bari wolka atchas ap o diwes, te sikrell li o drom, koles jon hunte djan. Un i jag atchas an i rat, te well len i momeli ap o drom, koles jon djan.
An tiro latchepen penal lenge, hoi te krenn le. Un tiro maro dran o bolepen dal len chapaske, ninna pani, har len trush his.
Star-desha bersha dal len lauter, hoi len hunte his o djipaske. Lengre koola djan gar paash, lengre pire wan gar pesso.
Un dal rajengre themma un wawar menshen an lengre wasta; jek them pal o wawar dal tu len. Jaake lan le o them Heshbon dren, kai o Sihon o baro rai his, ninna o them Bashan, kai o Og o baro rai his.
Un lengre tchawen mukal tu budeder te well har i momlia an o bolepen, un anal len an ko them, kolestar tu ap lengre phurende penal, te djan le koi un lenn ko them dren.

Un i tchawe wan an ko them un lan les dren. Un tu kral len sorleder har i Kanaanitarja, kolla, kai an ko them djiwan, un dal lengre bare rajen un ninna i menshen an lengro wast, un jon nai kran lentsa, hoi jon kaman.

Jon lan sorele forja dren, un i latcho them, khera, hoi pherdo latcho koowa his, pani, hoi dran wi-dine bare barra was, drakengre ruka, djeteskre ruka, un bud wawar ruka, hoi latcho chapen hidjran. Un jon chan un wan tchalo un thullo. Un jon mukan les penge latches te djal. Jaake baro his tiro latchepen ap lende.
Un pale shunan le gar buder ap tute, un hadan pen pral tute, un kaman buder gar tiro drom te djal. Un jon dan tire rakepangren mulo, kolla kai len trad dan, te anenn le len pale pale pash tute.

Doleske dal tu len an o wast kolendar, kai lenge i pharo djipen kran. Un har len bari daar his, dan le gole ap tute. Un tu shunal len dran o bolepen, un kral tiro dji lenge pre, un bitchral lenge murshen, kai len win lan dran i tchilatche wasta.

Un har lenge pale mishto djas, kran le pale, hoi tchilatcho his glan tute. Un tu dal len an o wast kolendar, kai lenge tchilatchepen kaman. Un kolla wan i raja pral lende. Un jon dan pale gole ap tute, te wess ap lengri rig. Un tu shunal dran o bolepen, un an tiro baro latchepen lal len win dran lengre wasta. Un kowa kral tu bud kope jaake.

Un tu dal len trad, te aness len pale pale ap tiro drom. Jon his pre-phurdo un shunan gar ap tire laba, un djiwan gar pal tire tchatchepaskre laba, kolendar tu penal: Koon len rikrell, djiwell. Un jon sikran tuke pengro dumo, un pandan pengre djia, un shunan gar ap tute.

Un tut his jaake bud latchepen lenge kol tsele bersha. Un dal len trad kol labentsa, hoi tire rakepangre lenge penan, kai an lende tiro ducho hi. Jon shunan gar koi pre. Kote dal len tu an o wast kol menshendar dran wawar themma.
An tiro baro latchepen dal len gar mulo, un mukal len gar. I latcho Dewel hal, un tut hi i baro dji.

Maro Dewel, har baro hal tu, jaake sorelo, te daras mer tutar. Tu pandal tiro dji ap mende, un rikreh tiro lab, hoi dal tut sowel. Kanna mangah tut, ma biste koi tseli bibacht, hoi pral mende was, pral mare bare rajende un mare pralstunende, pral i rashajende un o Debleskre rakepangre, pral mare phurende un men lauterende, an ko tselo tsiro, har wan i bare raja dran o them Assur pral mende bis ap kau diwes.
Tu hal an o tchatchepen tardo, har anal kowa lauter pral mende. Kowa, hoi tu kral, his mishto, ninna te djiwam mer jaake, har te wals men kek Dewel.
Mare bare raja un pralstune, mare rashaja un phure, kolla djan gar ap tiro drom, un shunan gar tire laba, hoi sikrenn, har te djiwenn le.
Un an ko tsiro, har his mare phure i raja an ko them, hoi tu len dal, mangan le tut gar an. An tiro latchepen dal tu len i buchlo un brawelo them. Un jon mukan gar pengro tchilatcho drom.
Dik, men hi kau diwes raja pral mende; an ko them, hoi tu mare phuren dal, te chan le ko tselo latcho koowa, an kau them hi men wawar raja pral mende.

Un ko bud koowa, hoi i phub win anell, lenn kol bare raja, kolla kai tu pral mende tchiwal, har anam doosh ap mende. Un jon krenn mentsa un mare viechentsa har jon kamenn. Un maro djipen hi jaake pharo.

Un doleske rakrah men kanna tele un tchinah kowa pre, te rikrah men ap lauter, hoi mer kate penam. Un mare pralstune, mare Levitarja, un mare rashaja tchiwenn pengre laba tel kau liil un pandenn palle o liil khetne.
Un kalla hi i laba kolendar, kai tchiwan pengro lab tel kau liil: Nehemia, ko moskro, koleskro dad o Hachalja his, un o Zedekja.
I rashaja: Seraja, Asarja, Jirmeja,
Pashur, Amarja, Malkija,
Hattush, Shebanja, Malluch,
Harim, Meremot, Obadja,
Daniel, Ginneton, Baruch,
Meshullam, Abija, Mijamin,
Maasja, Bilga, Shemaja.
I Levitarja: o Jeshua, koleskro dad o Asanja his, o Binnui, koleskro dad o Henadad his, un o Kadmijel;
un lengre phrala: Shechanja, Hodija, Kelita, Pelaja, Hanan,
Micha, Rehob, Hashabja
Sakkur, Sherebja, Shebanja,
Hodija, Bani, Beninu.
I pralstune pral i Israelitarja: Parosh, Pahat-Moab, Elam, Sattu, Bani,
Bunni, Asgad, Bebai,
Adonija, Bigwai, Adin,
Ater, Hiskija, Asur,
Hodija, Hashum, Bezai,
Harif, Anatot, Nebai,
Magpiash, Meshullam, Hesir,
Meshesabel, Zadok, Jaddua,
Pelatja, Hanan, Anaja,
Hoshea, Hananja, Hashub,
Lohesh, Pilha, Shobek,
Rehum, Hashabna, Maaseja,
Achija, Hanan, Anan
Malluch, Harim, Baana.

I tsele Israelitarja, i rashaja, un i Levitarja, un kolla, kai jak denn ap o foreskre wudja, un i gipangre, un i budepangre an o Debleskro kheer, un kolla i wawar menshendar, kai mukan pengre menshen un djan kanna o Debleskro drom, ninna lengre romja, lengre tchawe un tcha, kai haiwenn kowa,

jon dan pen khetne pengre phralentsa, kol pralstunentsa mank lende, un dan pen sowel, te djan le ap o Debleskro drom, jaake har sikras lende o Mose, koles o Debleskro wast his, te djiwenn le pal hako lab un pal o tchatchepen, hoi das len o baro Dewel, lengro rai, un te kamenn kowa te krell, hoi job lendar kamell.
Mer kamah mare tchen gar i murshentsa i wawar menshendar an kau them te romedinerell, un ninna lengre tchen gar mare tchawenge te lell.

Mer kamah gar ap o Debleskro diwes djob un wawar koowa te ginell kol menshendar, kai an kau them djiwenn, te wenn jon pengro koweha ginepaske ap o Debleskro diwes un ap wawar bare diwessa. An hako eftato bersh budrah gar ap mari hachetikri phub. Un mer mukah hakeneske peskri sijaan tele.
Koi budjake an o Debleskro kheer dell hakeno mendar star gramme rup.

Ko rup hi i marenge, hoi o Debleske koi tchiddo wenn, un ko chapaske un kol viechenge, hoi wenn leske chatchedo hako diwes; ninna kolenge, kai wenn o Debleske anlo ap hako Debleskro diwes, un ap hako newo tchon un ap i wawar bare diwessa. Ko rupeha well ninna o wawar koowa plaissedo, hoi denn le o Debleske, ninna kol vieche, hoi wenn chatchedo, te well i Israelengri doosh krik lino, un i tseli budjake an maro Debleskro kheer.

Mer anah hako bersh o kasht chatchepaske an maro Debleskro kheer, te nai well les chatchedo ap i chatchepaskri maro baro Deblestar, jaake har tchinlo hi an o Moseskro liil. Mer, i rashaja, i Levitarja un i wawar Israelitarja, witsrah tikne barra, te sikrenn le, koon mare familjendar an hawo tsiro kau kasht anell.
Ninna hako bersh dah o feteder halauterestar, hoi was baro ap mari phub un ap mare ruka, un anah kowa an o baro Debleskro kheer.

Mer anah hako phureder mursh tchawes un hako vieches, hoi o phureder peskri datar hi, an maro Debleskro kheer. Ninna i grumjendar un i bakrendar anah ko phureder pash kol rashajende, kai budrenn an maro Debleskro kheer.

Mer dah len ninna fun o newo jarro un kol newe rukengre, hoi ap mare ruka bares wan, ninna fun i newi mool un o newo djet un tchiwenn kowa lauter an i iseme pash maro Debleskro kheer. Ninna i Levitarjen te well, hoi lenge hi: o deshto kotar lauterestar, hoi ap maro phub baro was. Kolla te wenn un lenn penge o deshto kotar an hako gab un hako foro, kai mari hachetikri phub hi.

Un jek rashai kol menshendar Aron hunte djal lentsa ap ko tsiro, kai lenn le ko deshto kotar dren. Un i Levitarja hunte anenn o deshto kotar fun lengro deshto kotar an maro Debleskro kheer un tchiwenn kowa an ko kheer, kai sawo koowa pre garedo well.

An kau kheer anenn i Israelitarja un i Levitarja ko djob, i mool un o djet, hoi denn le o Debleske. Kote hi ninna kol koola, kolentsa budrenn le an o Debleskro kheer, ninna i rashaja, kai kote budrenn, un kol mursha, kai ap i wudja jak denn, un i gipangre. Jaake dah jak, te well lauterestar doha an o kheer maro Deblestar.

Un i pralstune pral i Israelitarja djiwan an o foro Jerusalem. Un i tsele wawar familje witsran kashta, te rodenn le jek familja dran deesh win. Un kolla te djan ninna an o Debleskro foro Jerusalem, te djiwenn le koi. Un kol enja wawar familje atchan an i wawar gaba un forja.
Un i menshe rakran i bacht pral kolende win, kai kaman an o Jerusalem te djan, te djiwenn le koi.

Ninna an i wawar forja an o them Juda djiwan Israelitarja, un rashaja, un Levitarja, un budepangre, kai an o Debleskro kheer budran, un kol menshe, kai wan kolendar, kai budran o Salomeske. Jon lauter djiwan ap pengro kotar phub an pengre forja. Un kalla hi i pralstune, kai djiwan an o them Juda, an o foro Jerusalem.

Un an o Jerusalem djiwan sawe i menshendar Juda un sawe i menshendar Benjamin. o Ataja, koleskro dad o Usija his, koleskro dad o Secharja his, koleskro dad o Amarja his, koleskro dad o Shefatja his, koleskro dad o Mahalalel his. Kolengro phuro dad his o Perez;

o Maaseja, koleskro dad o Baruch his, koleskro dad o Kol-Hose his, koleskro dad o Hasaja his, koleskro dad o Adaja his, koleskro dad o Jojarib his, koleskro dad o Secharja his. Kolengro phuro dad his o Shela.
I tsele mursha, kai wan pal o Perez un djiwan an Jerusalem, his 468 (star-sheel-te-shob-deesh-te-ochta) mursha, lauter tchatche mursha.

Un kalla his i menshendar Benjamin: o Sallu, koleskro dad o Meshullam his, koleskro dad o Joed his, koleskro dad o Pedaja his, koleskro dad o Kolaja his, koleskro dad o Maaseja his, koleskro dad o Itjel his, koleskro dad o Jeshaja his;
Un pal koleste: o Gabbai un o Sallai. Lauter khetne his 928 (enja-sheel-te-biish-te-ochta).
Un lengro pralstuno his o Joel, koleskro dad o Sichri his. Un o duito, kai pral o foro penepaske his, his o Juda, koleskro dad o Senua his.
I rashaja: O Jedaja, koleskro dad o Jojarib his, un o Jachin;
o Seraja, koleskro dad o Hilkija his, koleskro dad o Meshullam his, koleskro dad o Zadok his, koleskro dad o Merajot his, koleskro dad o Ahitub his; job his o pralstuno pral o Debleskro kheer.

Khetne lengre phralentsa, kai an o Debleskro kheer budran, his le 822 (ochta-sheel-te-biish-te-dui) mursha; o Adaja, koleskro dad o Jeroham his, koleskro dad o Pelalja his, koleskro dad o Amzi his, koleskro dad o Secharja his, koleskro dad o Pashur his, koleskro dad o Malkija his.

Khetne leskre phralentsa his le 242 (dui-sheel-te-star-deesh-te-dui) mursha, kai his pralstune pral pengre familje. o Amashsai, koleskro dad o Asarel his, koleskro dad o Achsai his, koleskro dad o Meshillemot his, koleskro dad o Immer his.
Khetne leskre phralentsa his le 128 (jek-sheel-te-biish-te-ochta) tchatche mursha. Un lengro pralstuno his o Sabdijel, koleskro dad o Haggedolim his.
I Levitarja: o Shemaja, koleskro dad o Hashub his, koleskro dad o Asrikam his, koleskro dad o Hashabja his, koleskro dad o Bunni his;
o Shabbetai un o Josabad; kolla his mank i pralstunende pral i Levitarja; an lengro wast his i budi win ap o Debleskro kheer;

o Mattanja, koleskro dad o Micha his, koleskro dad o Sabdi his, koleskro dad o Asaf his; job his kowa, kai glan giwas an i sharepaskre gilja, hoi giwan le o Debleske; o Bakbukja, jek leskre phralendar; job his o duito glan-gipaskro; o Abda, koleskro dad o Shamua his, koleskro dad o Galal his, koleskro dad o Jedutun his.
I tsele Levitarja an o Debleskro foro his 284 (dui-sheel-te-ochta-deesh-te-star).
Un kolla kai ap i bare wudja jak dan, his: o Akkub, un o Talmon un lengre phrala; kolla kai an i wudja tardo his un jak dan, his 172 (jek-sheel-te-efta-deesh-te-dui).
Un i tsele wawar Israelitarja, kol rashaja un i Levitarja atchan an o wawar forja an o them Juda, hakeno ap peskro kotar phub.
Un kol budepangre, kai budran an o Debleskro kheer, djiwan an ko kotar o forestar Jerusalem, hoi kharell Ofel. Lengre pralstune his o Ziha un o Gishpa.

Un o pralstuno pral i Levitarja an Jerusalem his o Usi, koleskro dad o Bani his, koleskro dad o Hashabja his, koleskro dad o Mattanja his, koleskro dad o Micha his. Lengro phuro dad his o Asaf, kolestar i gipangre wan, kolengri budi his, te giwenn le an o Debleskro kheer.
O baro rai mukas lenge te penell koon lendar ap hawo diwes an o Debleskro kheer hunte giwell.
Un o Petachja, koleskro dad o Meshesabel his, i menshendar Serach, koleskro dad o Juda his, job djas o baro rajeske pash o wast an kau tselo koowa, hoi trul i Israelitarja djas.
Bud i menshendar Juda djiwan an pengre khera pash pengri hachetikri phub an i forja: Kirjat-Arba un leskre gaba; Dibon un leskre gaba; Jekabzeel un leskre gaba;
Jeshua, Molada, Bet-Pelet,
Hazar-Shual, Beersheba un leskre gaba,
Ziklag, Mekona un leskre gaba,
En-Rimmon, Zora, Jarmut,
Sanoach, Adullam un leskre gaba, Lakish un o them koi trujel, Aseka un leskre gaba. Jaake djiwan le an ko tselo them mank o foro Beersheba un i tala Hinnom.
I menshe Benjamin djiwan an i forja: Geba, Michmas, Aja, Betel un leskre gaba,
Anatot, Nob, Ananja,
Hazor, Rama, Gittajim,
Hadid, Zebojim, Neballat,
Lod, Ono un an koi tala, kai djiwenn kolla, kai budrenn i kashteha.
Un mank i Levitarja dran Juda his sawe, kai djiwan an o them Benjamin.
Un kalla hi i rashaja un i Levitarja, kai wan pale dran o pandepen khetne kol dui murshentsa, o Serubbabel, koleskro dad o Shealtijel his, un o Jeshua: o Seraja, o Jirmeja, o Esra,
o Amarja, o Malluch, o Hattush,
o Shechanja, o Rehum, o Meremot,
o Iddo, o Ginneton, o Abija,
o Mijamin, o Maadja, o Bilga,
o Shemaja, o Jojarib, o Jedaja,
o Sallu, o Amok, o Hilkija, un o Jedaja. Kalla his i pralstune pral i rashaja un lengre phrala an ko tsiro, har o Jeshua djiwas.
I Levitarja: o Jeshua, o Binnui, o Kadmijel, o Sherebja, o Juda, o Mattanja; jon his i gipangre, kai giwan i sharepaskre gilja.
o Bakbukja, o Unni, un lengre phrala. Jon his i gipangre, kai giwan pale, har i wawar glan giwan.
O Jeshua las i tchawo. Leskro lab his Jojakim. Koleskro tchawo his o Eljashib, koleskro tchawo his o Jojada,
koleskro tchawo his o Jonatan, koleskro tchawo his o Jaddua.
Har his o Jojakim o baro rashai, his kal wawar rashaja i pralstune pral pengre familje: o Meraja pral i familja Seraja; o Hananja pral i familja Jirmeja;
o Meshullam pral i familja Esra; o Johanan pral i familja Amarja;
o Jonatan pral i familja Meluki; o Josef pral i familja Shebanja;
o Adna pral i familja Harim; o Helkai pral i familja Merajot;
o Secharja pral i familja Iddo; o Meshullam pral i familja Ginneton;
o Sichri pral i familja Abija; … pral i familja Minjamin; o Piltai pral i familja Moadja;
o Shamua pral i familja Bilga; o Jonatan pral i familja Shemaja;
o Mattenai pral i familja Jojarib; o Usi pral i familja Jedaja;
o Kallai pral i familja Sallu; o Eber pral i familja Amok;
o Hashabja pral i familja Hilkija; o Netanel pral i familja Jedaja.

An ko tsiro, har o Eljashib, un o Jojada, un o Johanan, un o Jaddua bare rashaja his, wan i laba an i liil tchinlo kol pralstunendar i familjendar, dran kolende i Levitarja un i rashaja wan. Kowa was jaake rah kerdo bis te was o Darius o baro rai pral o them Persia.
I laba kol pralstunendar pral i Levitarja wan jaake rah an i familjakro liil tchinlo, bis te was o Johanan o baro rashai, koleskro dad o Eljashib his.

Un i pralstune pral i Levitarja his: o Hashabja, o Sherebja, o Jeshua, o Binnui, un o Kadmijel. Lengre phrala, o Mattanja, o Bakbukja, un o Obadja his tardo wergel lende, har giwan le o Debleske. Lentsa khetne giwan le sharepaskre gilja o Debleske jaake, har o Debleskro mursh, o David penas. Kol jek giwan glan un kol wawar giwan pal. Pash i bare wudja, kai i khera hi, kai o chapen dren hi, dan kolla mursha jak: o Meshullam, o Talmon un o Akkub.

Jon djiwan an ko tsiro, kai o Jojakim rashai his, koleskro dad o Jeshua his, koleskro dad o Jozadak his. An ko tsiro djiwas ninna o Nehemia, kai o themeskro rai his, un o Esra, ko rashai un sikepaskro, kai o Debleskre laba mishto djinas.

Un har i massuri trul o foro Jerusalem kerdo was, kran le i baro festo, un mukan i Levitarjen gole te dell dran lengre tsele gaba, te denn jon i massuri an o Debleskro wast un parkrenn pen pash leste bachtele djijentsa, un giwenn un bashrenn leske ap sasterne patria, hoi wenn khetne dino, un ap dorjengre bashepangre, hoi kharenna Harfe un Laute.
Kote wan i gipangre khetne dran i gaba, hoi trul Jerusalem hi, un dran i gaba pash o gab Netofa,
ninna dran Bet-Gilgal un dran o them trul i forja Geba un Asmawet.
Un i rashaja un Levitarja tchoran Debleskro pani ap pende, te krenn le pen djudjo glan o Debleste. Un palle tchoran le ninna o Debleskro pani ap i menshende, ap o foreskre wudja un ap i massuri.

Un me – penas o Nehemia – mukom i pralstunen o themestar Juda pre ap i massuri te djal; un mukom gipangren ap i tchatchi rig un ap i serwi rig te djal, te sharenn le o Debles. Kolla, kai tchatches pre djan, djan dureder pash o Viechengro Fuleskro Wudar.
Un kolenge palla djas o Hoshaja un o paash i pralstunendar dran o them Juda.
Pal lende wan i rashaja: o Asarja, un o Esra un o Meshullam,
un o Juda, un o Benjamin, un o Shemaja, un o Jirmeja, un wawar, kai phurdan an i phurdepangre.
Pal lende was o Secharja, koleskro dad o Jonatan his, koleskro dad o Shemaja his, koleskro dad o Mattanja his, koleskro dad o Mikaja his, koleskro dad o Sakkur his, koleskro dad o Asaf his;

un leskre phrala: o Shemaja un o Asarel, un o Milalai, un o Gilalai, un o Maai, un o Netanel, un o Juda, un o Hanani. Len his sawe bashepangre, har o Debleskro mursh, o David, bashras. Un glan lende djas o Esra, ko sikepaskro, kai o Debleskre laba mishto djinas.

Un jon djan pash ko wudar, hoi Djido Panjeskro Wudar kharell; un dureder pre an o Davideskro foro, kote, kai djal i massuri bis pral o Davideskro kheer, un dureder bis pash o Panjeskro Wudar. Kowa hi ap koi rig o forestar, kai o kham pre djala.

Un kol wawar gipangre djan serwes. Un me djom pal lende khetne ko wawar paash kol pralstunendar. Un mer djam pral ap koi massuri bis pash ko bobeskro turmo un dureder pash ko kotar an i massuri, hoi kharell Buchli Massuri,

un palle dureder bis pash o Efrajimeskro Wudar, un palle pash ko Phuro Wudar un palle dureder pash ko Matchengro Wudar un dureder bis pash ko turmo, hoi kharell Hananel, un dureder bis pash ko turmo, hoi kharell Mea, un dureder bis pash o Bakrengro Wudar. Un pash ko Stilepaskro Wudar atchan le tardo.
Jaake wan i gipangre i tchatchi rigjatar un i serwi rigjatar, un atchan tardo pash o Debleskro kheer. Me ninna un ko paash kol pralstunendar, kai mantsa djam, wam un atcham koi tardo.
Un i rashaja, o Eljakim, un o Maaseja, un o Minjamin, un o Mikaja, un o Eljoenai, un o Secharja, un o Hananja, bashran ap i phurdepangre.
Pash lende his kol Levitarja tardo: o Maaseja un o Shemaja un o Eleasar un o Usi un o Johanan un o Malkija un o Elam un o Eser. Un i gipangre giwan bari goljah. Un lengro pralstuno his o Jisrachja.

Un ap ko diwes anan le bud viechen o Debleske. Un jon giwan un khelan i bachtjatar. O Dewel kras, te wan lengre djia bachtelo un san. Un ninna i djuwja un i tchawe dan gole i bachtjatar. Un koi bari bachteli gole an o foro Jerusalem was shunlo fun dural.

An ko tsiro wan mursha win rodedo, kai jak hunte dan ap kol khera, kai o chapen dren anlo was, hoi i Israelitarja jaake hunte dan, har an o Moseskro liil tchinlo his: newo djob un newe rukengre, un o deshto kotar lauterestar, hoi le ap pengri phub trul i forja dren anan. Kowa lauter his i rashajenge un i Levitarenge. Un kol menshe an Juda his bachtelo pral pengre rashaja un Levitarja,

kai o Debleske budran, un o thopaskri budi kran, te wenn i menshe djudjo un erligo glan o Debleste. Un ninna i gipangre un kolla, kai ap o foreskre wudja jak dan, kran pengri budi jaake har o David un leskro tchawo, o Salomo, lenge penas.
Glan i rah tsiro, har o David o baro rai his, his o Asaf o pralstuno pral i gipangre, kai giwan o Debleske un sharan les.

Un kau tsiro, kai o Serubbabel un o Nehemia i pralstune pral o them Juda his, dan i tsele Israelitarja i gipangren un kolen, kai jak ap i foreskre wudja dan, kowa, hoi len hako diwes o djipaske hunte well. I menshe anan kowa, hoi le o Debleske dan, pash i Levitarja. Un kolla dan palle i rashajen jaake bud kolestar, har glan tchinlo his.

Ap ko diwes draweran le dran o Moseskro liil glan i tsele menshende. Un jon hatsan, te hi an ko liil tchinlo: ‘Kek i menshendar Ammon, witar kek i menshendar Moab nai djiwenn o Debleskre menshentsa khetne, un kowa kek tsireske.’

Glan i rah tsiro dan i Ammonarja un i Moabarja i Israelende kek maro un kek pani, har kolla ap o drom his. Un i Moabarja plaissran o Bileames, te rakrell lo i bibacht pral i Israelitarja win. Maro Dewel kras dran i bibacht i bacht.
Un har shunan i Israelitarja kanna kau tchinlo lab, rodan le lauter kolen win, kai wawar menshendar his un mank lende djiwan. Un kolla nai atchan gar buder pash lende.
Glan jek tsiro was o rashai Eljashib o pralstuno pral i chapangre khera pash o Debleskro kheer. Un jek leskre menshendar his o Tobija.

Koles das lo ko baro kheer, kai glan kowa o djob tchiddo his, hoi o Debleske chatchedo was, ninna o sungepaskro koowa un kol tsele koola, hoi i budjake koi his, un ninna o djob un i mool, un o djet, hoi o deshto kotar kolestar his, hoi ap i Israelengri phub bares was. Kowa lauter his i Levitarenge un i gipangrenge un kolenge, kai ap o foreskre wudja jak dan un ninna i rashajenge.

Har o Eljashib ko baro chapaskro kheer o Tobijaske das, te djiwell lo koi, homs me gar an o foro Jerusalem. An ko bersh, har o Artaxerxes an o 32. (trijanda-te-duito) bersh o baro rai pral Babilonia his, djom me pash leste pale. Pal i tsiro putchom lestar, te mukell lo man pale pale te djal an Jerusalem.

Un har wom pale an o foro Jerusalem, dikom me kowa, hoi kote glan djas, un hoi gar pal o tchatchepen his, hoi o Eljashib koi o Tobijaske kras, har lo leste ko chapaskro kheer das ap platsa glan o Debleskro kheer.
Un miri choli pral kowa his baro. Un me djom koi un witsrom ko tselo koowa, hoi o Tobijas his, dran o kheer win,

un penom soreles, te krenn le ko kheer djudjo, un ninna kol khera, kai pashel his. Un pal kowa anom pale ko tselo koowa, hoi i budjake an o Debleskro kheer hi, ninna o djob chatchepaske, un o sungepaskro koowa.

Un kote dikom ninna, te anan i Israelitarja gar i Levitarenge ko koowa, hoi len hunte dino wals. Doleske kran i Levitarja un i gipangre buder gar pengri budi an o Debleskro kheer, un nashan penge hakeno ap peskri kotar phub.

Kote tchingrom ap i tchatchepangre murshende un putchom: “Har nai well jaake dur, te well buder kek budi kerdo an o Debleskro kheer?” Un me mukom i Levitarjen un i gipangren pale pale te anell, un dom hakenes peskri budi!
Un i tsele menshe dran Juda anan pale o deshto kotar pengro djobestar un djetestar un pengri moljatar an kol chapangre khera.

Un me rodom murshen win, te wenn le i pralstune pral i chapangre khera. Kolla his o rashai, o Shelemja, un o tchinepaskro, kai lila tchinell, o Zadok, un o Levitari, o Pedaja. Kolenge ap i rig his tardo o Hanan, koleskro dad o Sakkur his, koleskro dad o Mattanja his. Kolla star his mursha o labestar. Kolenge was penlo, te denn le ko chapen ap pengre phralende.
Dik, hoi kai krom, miro Dewel! Ma biste ko latchepen, hoi krom ap tiro kheer, te well koi budi an leste mishto kerdo.

An kol diwessa dikom me an o them Juda menshen, kai ap o Debleskro diwes molengre drake stakran, un wawar, kai anan djob un tchiwan les ap burike, ninna mool, drake, faige un wawar koowa, un anan kowa an o foro Jerusalem. Un me rikrom len pre un dom len trad, te bikrenn le kowa gar ap ko diwes.
An o foro Jerusalem djiwan ninna menshe dran Tirus. Kolla anan matchen un wawar koowa un bikran kowa ap o Debleskro diwes ap i menshende dran Juda.
Kote tchingrom ap i pralstunende an Juda un putchom lendar, hoi kowa te well. “Tumer lenn o Debleske leskro diwes krik”, penom me. “Ko diwes, kai leske kokres hi.

Kran kowa tumare phure gar ninna jaake, te anas maro Dewel koi bari bibacht pral mende un pral kau foro? Un tumer krenn i choli pral o Israel gomme bareder, doleske te budrenn tumer ap o Debleskro diwes.”

Un me penom, te wenn o foreskre wudja pandlo glan te was o Debleskro diwes, an ko tsiro har o kham tele djas, un te wenn le gar pale pre kerdo glan ko tsiro, kai hi o Debleskro diwes trujel. Un me bitchrom murshen an o foreskre wudja, te denn le jak, te well kek koowa an o foro Jerusalem dren hadedo.
Kote atchan kol parepangre un bikepangre pengro koweha jek, dui kope win glan o foro Jerusalem pral i rat.

Un me dom len trad un penom ap lende: “Hoske atchenn tumer pral i rat win glan i massuri? Te krenn kowa gomme jek kopo, mukau tumen an o stilepen te witsrell.” Fun ko tsiro wan le gar buder ap o Debleskro diwes.

Un me penom ap i Levitarja, te krenn le pen djudjo o Debleske. Palle te wenn le pash o foreskre wudja un denn koi jak, te well o Debleskro diwes dren rikedo. Ninna kawa biste mange gar, miro Dewel. Un dik latches ap mande an tiro baro kamlepen.
An ko tsiro dikom me bibolden, kai lan penge romjen dran o Filistarengro foro Ashdod, ninna dran i themma Ammon un Moab.
Un o paash kolengre tchawendar rakran ashdodikes un haiwan gar o biboldengro rakepen. Jon rakran o rakepen kol wawar menshendar.

Un me tchingrom kol murshentsa, praassom len, un dom ninna murshen lendar, un tserdom lengre balla win. Un krom, te denn le pen sowel pash o Debleste, te denn le kek pengre tchendar kol wawarengre tchawende, un lenn kek kolengre tchendar penge un pengre tchawenge.

“Djinenn gar”, penom, “te kras o baro rai Salomo sawo koowa un anas doosh ap peste? Un an bud wawar themma, his kek baro rai har job his. Un o Dewel kamas les jaake, te kras lo, te well lo rai pral o tselo them Israel. Ninna les anan peskre romja dran kol wawar themma jaake dur, te anas lo doosh ap peste!
Un kanna hunte shunap tumendar, te anenn sawi bari doosh ap tumende, un rikrenn tumen gar ap ko lab, hoi o Dewel das, un lenn tumenge romjen dran wawar themma!”
Un o tchawo o baro rashajestar Eljashib, o Jojada, koles his mursh tchawe, kolendar jek i romjat las, kolakro dad o Sanballat hi dran o foro Bet-Horon. Un koles tradom mandar krik!
Miro Dewel, ma biste, kai anan jon ladj ap o rashajeskri budi, un rikran pen gar ap ko lab, hoi tu i rashajentsa un i Levitarentsa win kral.

Un jaake krom me i Israelitarjen pale djudjo un erligo glan o Debleste, un las dran lende lauter krik, hoi dran o wi-them an lende dren was. Un penom lenge, koon i rashajendar un i Levitarendar hawi budi hunte krell, jaake te djinas hakeno, hoi te krell lo.
Un penom ninna, koon ap hawo tsiro o kasht hunte anell chatchepaske, un krom, te well o newo djob un i newe rukengre anlo. Biste kowa mange gar, miro Dewel, un dik latches ap mande!
His an ko tsiro, har o Ahasveros o baro rai his pral 127 (jek-sheel-te-biish-te-efta) themma, hoi djan o themestar India bis pash o them Etiopia.
Leskri rajeskri beshepaskri his tardo an peskro sorelo kheer an o foro Susa.

Har job o triinto bersh o baro rai his, kras job i baro festo i tsele pralstunenge un barenge: kolenge, kai his pralstune pral kol bud lurdende an i themma Persia un Media, ninna kol brawelenge un themeskre rajenge dran peskre tsele themma.
Kau baro festo djas 180 (jek-sheel-te-ochta-deesh) diwessa. Un an ko tsiro sikras lo len peskro baro brawlepen un ko tselo kutch koowa, pral kowa job halauter o rai hi.

Har kol diwessa trujel djan, kras o baro rai i baro chapen kolenge lauterenge, kai an peskro sorelo kheer an o foro Susa his, i barenge un i tiknenge. Ko baro chapen djas efta diwessa. Un i menshe wan khetne an i baar pash o baro rajeskro railo kheer.

Kote his parne un blauete plachte pandlo ap rupene gustria mank turme dran marmor. Trul kol plachte his laintikre un lole dorja. Beshepangre i herjentsa dran sonakai un rup his kote tardo ap i kutch barrengri phub, hoi senelo, parno, djelto un kalo his.
O pipen was win tchoredo an khore dran sonakai, kolendar his kek har o wawar. Un das bud rajeskri mool, budeder har bud. O baro rai rikras lat gar pale.
Job penas i pralstunenge pral peskro kheer, te nai pijell hakeno jaake bud har job kamella. Doleske penas kek o wawareske, har bud te pijell lo.
Un ninna i rani Wasti kras i baro chapen i djuwjenge an o railo kheer o baro rajestar Ahasveros.

Un ap o eftato diwes his o baro rajeskro dji bachteles bud moljatar. Un job kamas i rajenge un i tsele menshenge peskri romjat, i rani Wasti, te sikrell, kai jaake shukar his. Un job rakras kol efta pralstunentsa, kai ninna pral o djuwjengro kheer penepaske hi: o Mehuman, o Biseta, o Harbona, o Bigta, o Abagta, o Setar un o Karkas. Lenge penas lo, te anenn le i rani, un te hidjrell li peskro shereskro sonakai.
Har penan kol efta mursha i ranjake Wasti, hoi o baro rai latar kamell, kamas li gar pash leste te well. Kote tapras i bari choli i baro rajes.

Un o baro rai rakras i gosewe murshentsa, kai prindjran mishto o themeskro tchatchepen. Pash lende his jaake, kai o baro rajeskro koowa hunte well glan kolende, kai haiwan mishto o themeskro tchatchepen un djinan, hoi te krenn.

Mank lende his o Karshena, o Shetar, o Admata, o Tarsis, o Meres, o Marsena, un o Memukan. Kol efta his i raja pral i themma Persia un Media. Un pal o baro rajeste his jon i pralstune an o tselo them. Ap lende rakras lo, te kamell lo tchomone te djinell.

Un job penas ap lende: “Me, o baro rai, bitchrom mire budepangren pash i rani Wasti, te penenn le lake, hoi latar kamom. Un joi shunas gar ap miro lab. Hoi te kras mer kanna lah pal maro tchatchepen?”

Koi penas o Memukan glan o baro rajeste un glan i pralstunende: “Koi doosh, hoi i rani Wasti ap peste anas, hi gar kokres i doosh ap o baro rajeste, na-a, kaja hi i doosh ap i tsele pralstunende un ap i tsele murshende an i tsele themma, kai o Ahasveros o baro rai hi.
Kowa, hoi i rani Wasti kras, shunenn i tsele djuwja, un dikenn tele ap pengre romende un penenn: O baro rai Ahasveros penas, te well i rani Wasti glan leste. Un joi kamas gar.
Kau diwes penenn i pralstunengre romja an o them Persia un Media pengre romenge, hoi i rani kras. Un jon dikenn buder gar pre ap pengre romende. Un kolla wenn chojedo pral lende.

Te hi mishto an o baro rajeskre jaka, palle djal i lab win lestar, te nai well i Wasti buder gar glan leste. Ko lab well tchinlo an o tchatchepaskro liil ko themestar Persia un Media, kai kek nai lell les buder pale. Un palle lell o baro rai i wawar tchai, te well li rani, – i tchai, kai latcheder hi har i Wasti.
Kanna te well kau lab o baro rajestar penlo an o tselo them, palle dikenn i tsele djuwja pre ap pengre romende, – pash i brawelende, ninna pash i tchorwelende.”
Un kal laba his mishto an o baro rajeskre jaka un i jaka leskre pralstunendar. Un o baro rai kras jaake, har o Memukan penas.

Un bitchras lila an i tsele themma, kai lo baro rai his. Hako liil his jaake tchinlo, har an ko them tchinlo well, un an ko rakepen, har kote rakedo well, kai ko liil bitchedo was. Un an ko liil was penlo, te well hako romes an peskro kheer o penepaske, un te well an hako kheer ko rakepen rakedo, hoi o rom rakrella.
Un pal ko koowa, har djas i choli o baro rajestar Ahasveros pale, djas leske an o shero trujel, hoi i Wasti kras, un hoi lah kerdo was.
Kote penan leskre budepangre ap leste: “Maro rai, pen, te wenn shukar terne tchen rodede, kolen kek murshestar an-tapedo wan.

Un bitche murshen an i tsele themma, kai baro rai hal, te anenn le i tsele shukar terne tchen kate an tiro sorelo kheer an o foro Susa, un kote an o djuwjengro kheer. Un de len an o wast ko pralstunestar, o Hegai, kai dell jak ap i djuwjende. Un job mukell lauter ap lende te krell, hoi i djuwjat shukar krell.
Palle le koi terni tchai, hoi an tire jaka i shukeder hi, te well li rani, har i Wasti glan late rani his.” Un kol laba his mishto an i jaka o baro rajestar. Un job kras kowa jaake.
Un an o sorelo kheer an Susa djiwas i biboldo. Kowa kharas Mordekai. Leskro dad his o Jair, un leskro papo his o Shimi. Koleskro dad his o Kish. Kowa his i Benjaminari.

Leskri familja his mank kol menshende, kai pandlo wan, har lengro baro rai, ko baro rai pral o them Juda, o Jekonja, pandlo was. Un o baro rai pral o them Babilonia, o Nebukadnezar, mukas len an peskro them te anell.

Un pash o Mordekai djiwas i terni tchai, i Hadassa, kai ninna Ester kharedo was. Joi his leskro kakeskri tchai, un lat his buder kek dad un kek dai. Un joi his i shukar un raili tchai. Un har lakro dad un lakri dai meras, las o Mordekai lat pash peste un was lake har lakro dad.

Har kanna kol laba o baro rajestar trujel djan, wan bud tcha anlo an o sorelo kheer an o foro Susa. Un ninna i Ester his mank lende un was an o djuwjengro kheer anlo, un an o wast ko murshestar Hegai dino, kai dell jak ap o djuwjengro kheer.

Un joi his shukar an koleskre jaka, un las jaake leskro latchepen. Un job dikas koi pre, te lell li sik kutch makepaskro djet un sasto chapen, hoi i djuwjat shukar krell. Un job das lat efta wi-rodede djuwjen, te wenn le lake koi. Un anas lat un lakre budepaskretse an i feteder iseme an o djuwjengro kheer.
Glan kowa penas o Mordekai ap i Ester, te penell li gar, dran hawo them un hawe menshendar joi hi. Jaake penas i Ester tchi kolestar.
Un o Mordekai djas hako diwes glan ko djuwjengro kheer pre te tele, te nai hatsell lo win, har i Esterake djal, un hoi jon lah krenn.

Jek bersh rah was haki tchai shukar kerdo ko diweske, kai djal li pash o baro rajeste dren: shob tchonna was li dren maklo o djeteha, kai Myrrhe dren hi, un pale shob tchonna o djeteha, kai Balsam dren hi un wawar kutch sungepaskro koweha.
Un palle djas jek tchai pal i wawar pash o baro rajeste dren. Un lauter, hoi kamas li peha te lell, hunte was lat dino. Un joi was dran o djuwjengro kheer an o baro rajeskro kheer anlo.

Ap i rat djas li dren un taissarlake djas li palle an i wawar djuwjengro kheer, tel i wasta ko pralstunestar, kai kharas Shaashgas. Kowa das ap kol djuwjende jak, kai o baro rajeskre wawar djuwja his. Un kek kol djuwjendar was i duito kopo pash o baro rajeste, kokres kolla, kai his shukar an leskre jaka, un kolen job mukas pash pengro lab te kharell.

Ko tsiro was, te djal i Ester pash o baro rajeste. Lakro dad his o Abichajil un lakro kako o Mordekai, kai lat pash peste las, har well li leskri tchai. Un joi kamas tchi budeder peha te lell, har o Hegai, ko pralstuno pral i djuwjende, lake penas. Un an i jaka lauterendar, kai dikan lat, his li shukar.
Un jaake was i Ester pash o baro rajeste Ahasveros an leskro rajeskro kheer anlo. Un kowa his an o deshto tchon, har job an o eftato bersh o baro rai his. Kau tchon kharas Tebet.

Un o baro rai kamas lat budeder har i tsele wawar djuwjen. An leskre jaka his li shukeder un feteder har haki wawar terni tchai. Un job tchiwas ko shereskro sonakai ap lakro shero, hoi i rani hidjrell. Un kras latar i newi rani, jaake har i Wasti glan late his.

Un o baro rai kras i baro chapen i tsele rajenge un pralstunenge, te well i Ester hadedo. Un i tsele themenge mukas lo lowe palla, hoi jon leste hunte dans. Un mukas djob tchitcheske win te dell, jaake har bare raja krenna.
His an ko tsiro, har i duito kopo terne tcha khetne anlo wan o baro rajeske. Koi his o Mordekai beshdo an o baro wudar glan o baro rajeskro kheer.
I Ester shunas ap o Mordekai jaake har an ko tsiro, har joi gomme pash leste his. Un jaake har lo lake penas, penas li gar dran hawo them un hawe menshendar joi hi.

An kol diwessa har o Mordekai an ko baro wudar glan o baro rajeskro kheer beshdo his, wan dui budepangre an i bari choli. Kolla dan jak ap i wudja un kharan Bigtan un Teresh. Un jon lan penge glan, te denn le o baro rajes Ahasveros mulo.
Un ko koowa shunas o Mordekai un penas les ap i rani Ester, un penas lake ninna, te penell li les o baro rajeske dureder. Un i Ester kras kowa.
Un har dikan le palla, was win, te his kowa tchatcho. Un kol dui wan ap o kasht bladedo. Un o baro rai mukas kau koowa dren te tchinell an o bershengro liil o themestar.
Pal i tsiro hadas o baro rai Ahasveros i murshes pral i tsele pralstunende, kai pash leste hi. Ko mursh kharas Haman. Leskro dad his o Hammedata i menshendar Agag.

Un o baro rai penas, te djan i tsele pralstune, kai an o baro wudar glan leskro kheer hi, ap i phub glan o Haman un parkrenn les. Un jaake kran le. Kokres o Mordekai kamas gar, un djas gar glan leste tele ap i phub.
Kote putchan lestar i wawar pralstune, kai an o wudar glan o baro rajeskro kheer his: “Hoske kreh tu kowa gar, hoi o baro rai penas?”

Un jaake putchan le les hako diwes. Un job penas lenge: “Me hom i biboldo un nai witsrau man gar tele glan o Haman.” Un har job gar ap lende shunas, djan le koi un penan kowa o Hamaneske. Jon kaman te dikell, hoi o Haman penell, te djinals lo, hoi o Mordekai kras.
Un har o Haman dikas, te witsrell o Mordekai pes gar glan leste tele, tapras les i bari choli.

An leskre jaka his kowa gar doha, te taprell lo peske o Mordekai kokres. Job kamas ninna leskre menshen te marell. Har shunas lo, kai o Mordekai i biboldo hi, rodas lo, har nai marell lo i tsele bibolden, kai djiwenn an kol themma, kai o Ahasveros o baro rai hi.

Un an o ersto tchon, kowa hi o tchon Nisan, an o deesh-te-duito bersh ko baro rajestar Ahasveros, mukas o Haman peske tikne barra te witsrell, hoi kharenna ‘Purim’, te hatsell lo win, hawo diwes an hawo tchon ko feteder hi, te krell lo, hoi lo peske glan las. Un kol tikne barra Purim peran ap o deesh-te-triinto diwes un ap o deesh-te-duito tchon. Kowa hi o tchon Adar.

Koi pal penas o Haman ap o baro rajeste Ahasveros: “Kate denna menshe, kai djiwenn penge kokres mank i tsele wawar menshende kate te kote an tire tsele themma. Un len hi i wawar tchatchepen har i tsele wawar menshen. Un ap kowa, hoi tu, baro rai, peneh, te well kerdo, shunenn le gar. Kowa hi gar mishto tuke, te mukess len jaake dureder te krell.
Miro rai, te kameh, muk i liil te tchinell, kai dren tardo hi, te wenn le maredo. Un me dau deesh-serja kotar rup an i wasta i pralstunendar pral o rajeskro brawlepen.”
O baro rai las peskri gustri o gushto tele. Un das koi gustri an o Hamaneskro wast, kai kamas i bibolden te marell. Koleskro dad his o Hammedata kol menshendar Agag.
Un o baro rai penas ap o Haman: “O rup nai rikreh, ninna wenn tuke kol menshe dino, te nai kress lentsa hoi tu kameh.”

Ap o 13. (deesh-te-triinto) diwes an o ersto tchon wan kol mursha kharedo, kai o baro rajeskre lila tchinenn. Un kolla tchinan, hoi o Haman lenge penas, an lila ap i pralstunende ko themestar, ap i themeskre rajende un i pralstunende pral hako them. Hako liil his jaake tchinlo, har an ko them tchinlo was, un an ko rakepen, har kote rakedo was. An o lab o baro rajestar Ahasveros wan kol lila tchinlo. Un leskri gustjah was leskro sikepen tel hako liil tchiddo.

Koi dren his tchinlo: I tsele bibolde hunte wenn maredo, terne un phure, ninna i tchawe un djuwja, te atchell kek lendar buder djido. Un kowa te well ap jek diwes, ap o deesh-te-triinto diwes an o deesh-te-duito tchon. Kowa hi o tchon Adar. Un i biboldengro koowa nai lell hakeno peske. Un naashepangre wan kharedo, un lenge was penlo, te anenn le kol lila an i tsele themma, kai o Ahasveros baro rai hi.
Un o baro rai penas ninna, te hunte wenn kal tchinle laba prindjedo kerdo an hako them, jaake te rikrenn pen i menshe kote ap lende, un djinenn, hoi te krenn le, te well ko diwes.

Un kol naashepangre djan sik win, jaake har o baro rai penas. Un an o sorelo kheer an o foro Susa was ko liil kote ap i kasht dino, kai nai dikell les hakeno. Un o baro rai un o Haman beshan pen tele, te chan un pijenn le. O tselo fores Susa tapras i daar.
Un har o Mordekai shunas, hoi djas, kras lo peskre koola paash, hoi ap leste his. Un riwas peske i gono an, un tchiwas jagakri tchik ap peste. Un djas dren mashkral o foro un rowas un das gole.
Un jaake was lo bis glan o baro wudar o baro rajeskro kherestar. Un kote atchas lo. Kek, kai his rido an gone, nai djas dren.
Un an hako them, kai o liil o baro rajestar was, his baro ropen mank i bibolde. Un bud kaman buder tchi te chal, rowan un riwan pen an gone un tchiwan jagakri tchik ap pende.

Un i djuwja, kai i Esterake budrenn un kol pralstune, kai lake koi hi, wan pash late un penan lake kau koowa. Un kote tapras i rani bari daar. Un joi bitchras ripja pash o Mordekai, te riwell lo len an, un te tchiwell lo o gono pestar tele. Un job kamas gar.

Kote mukas i Ester i murshes te kharell. Kowa kharas Hatach un his i pralstuno, koles o baro rai late das, te well lo lake koi. Un koles bitchras li pash o Mordekai te putchell lo lestar, hoske job jaake krell.
Un o Hatach djas pash o Mordekai win ap i platsa, hoi his glan o wudar o baro rajeskro kherestar.
Un o Mordekai penas leske lauter, hoi leske djas, un ninna har bud rup o Haman kamas te tchiwell lo pash o baro rajeskro brawlepen pashel, te wenn i tsele bibolde maredo.

Un o Mordekai das les i liil peha, kai kol laba tele tchinlo his, hoi an o foro Susa ap i kasht dino his, kai tardo hi, te wenn i bibolde maredo. Kau liles te sikrell lo i Esterake, un te penell lo lake lauter, un mangell latar, te djal li pash o baro rajeste dren, un mangell les i ropah, te krell lo peskro dji pre lakre menshenge.
Un o Hatach djas un penas i Esterake, hoi o Mordekai penas.
Kote bitchras i Ester les pale pash o Mordekai, te penell lo leske:

“I tsele pralstune, kai o baro rajeske budrenn, ninna i menshe an hako them, koles o baro rai hi, kolla prindjrenn ko tchinlo lab, te well hako mursh un haki djuwel maredo, kai djal dren pash o baro rajeste un well ap i platsa an leskro kheer, un hi lestar gar kharedo. Kokres te lell o baro rai peskro sonakaskro raan un sikrell ap leste, atchell lo djido. Me wom trijanda diwessa buder gar pash o baro rajeste dren kharedo.”
Har shunas o Mordekai, hoi mukas i Ester leske te penell,
mukas lo lake pale te penell: “Ma pats, te nai weh tu tiro djipah krik, doleske, kai djiweh an o baro rajeskro kheer! Ma pats, te atchess tu kokres djido i tsele biboldendar!
Tu te peneh tchi kanna an kau tsiro, palle well i wawar, kai men bibolden win lell. Un tu un tiro dadeskro kheer wenn maredo. Un koon djinell, te wal tu gar rani sawo tsireske har kawa kanna hi?”
Kote mukas i Ester ap o Mordekai te penell:

“Dja koi un de i tsele bibolden an o foro Susa khetne gole! Chan un pijenn triin diwessa tchi, gar ap o diwes, witar gar an i rati. Krenn kowa mange, te dikell o Dewel latches ap mande! Un me un kol djuwja, kai mange budrenn, mer kamah kowa ninna jaake te krell. Un pal kowa kamau pash o baro rajeste dren te djal, ninna te hi khatar o tchinlo lab. Un te denn le man mulo, palle denn le man mulo.”
Un o Mordekai djas peske un kras lauter jaake har i Ester leske penas.

Un ap o triinto diwes riwas i Ester rajengre ripja an un djas ap koi platsa, hoi hi dren an o baro rajeskro kheer, wergel koi bari isema, kai o baro rai hi. Un job his beshdo ap peskri raili beshepaskri wergel o wudar.

Un har dikas o baro rai i rani Ester tardo ap koi platsa, dikas lo latches ap late, un sikras o sonakaskro raneha, hoi an leskro wast hi, ap late. Kote was i Ester pash leste un tapras o glanstuno kotar ko ranestar peskre gushtentsa an.
Un o baro rai putchas: “Hoi hi tuke, rani Ester? Un hoi kameh tu? Un te kameh o paash lauterestar, hoi man hi, palle well kowa tut dino.”
Koi penas i Ester: “Miro rai, te hi mishto an tire jaka, palle ab tu un o Haman kau diwes pash ko chapen, hoi me tumenge krau.”
Un o baro rai penas: “Djan sik un anenn o Hamanes, te kras kowa, hoi i Ester penas!” Un o baro rai un o Haman wan pash ko chapen, hoi i Ester lenge kras.
Un har le i mool pijan, putchas o baro rai: “Hoi hi kowa, hoi tu mandar mangeh? Me dau les tute. Hoi kameh tu? Un te kameh o paash lauterestar hoi man hi, kowa well tut dino!”
Koi penas i Ester: “Kowa, hoi me kamau un tutar mangau, hi kawa:

Te hal mange latches, un te hi mishto an tire jaka, miro rai, mange kowa te dell, hoi me tutar mangau, palle ab tu un o Haman pash o chapen, hoi me tumenge taissar krau. Un taissar penau tuke, hoi kamau tutar.”

Har o Haman ko diwes dran o kheer djas, his lo bachtelo un peskro dji sanas. Koi dikas lo o Mordekajes beshdo an o baro wudar glan o baro rajeskro kheer. Un kowa stas gar pre, un witsras pes gar glan leste tele. Koi tapras o Hamanes i bari choli pral o Mordekai.
Job rikras lat pale un djas dureder an peskro kheer. Kote mukas lo peskre malen un peskri romjat Seresh te well.

Glan lende phurdas pes o Haman pre un penas lenge, har baro leskro brawlepen hi, un kitse mursh tchawe les hi, un har hadas les o baro rai un tchiwas les pral i tsele pralstunende un pral i tsele rajeskre budepangre.

Un o Haman penas: “Un pash kowa lauter kamas i rani Ester, te well kek wawar pash o chapen pashel, hoi joi o baro rajeske kras, har man kokres. Un ninna taissar kamell li, te wap me o baro rajeha pash late te chal.
Kowa lauter hi mange tchi moldo, jaake rah me ko biboldes Mordekai dikau an o baro wudar glan o baro rajeskro kheer.”

Kote penas leskri romni Seresh un leskre tsele mala ap leste: “Muk i kasht pre te tchiwell, hoi hi i paash-sheel (50) mussja bares! Un taissarlakro pen ap o baro rajeste, te mukell lo o Mordekajes ap ko kasht pre te bladell. Un palle dja leha bachteles pash o chapen.” Un kol laba his o Hamaneske latches, un job mukas sawo kasht pre te tchiwell.
An koja rat nai sowas o baro rai gar, un mukas peske glan te drawerell dran o bershengro liil o themestar.

Un koi hatsas pes dren tchinlo, har kaman kol dui mursha, o Bigtan un o Teresh, o baro rajes mulo te dell. Kol dui his pralstune, kai dan jak glan o wudar o baro rajeskro kherestar. Ninna his kote tchinlo, kai o Mordekai kowa win hatsas un an-sikras.
Kote putchas o baro rai: “Hoi las o Mordekai koleske? Har was lo bares kerdo?” Un kol budepangre, kai leske koi hi, penan: “Leske was tchi kerdo.”

Kote putchas o baro rai: “Koon hi win ap i glanstuni platsa?” Un kote his o Haman ap ko tsiro ap i glanstuni platsa glan o baro rajeskro kheer, te penell lo o baro rajeske, te mukell job o Mordekajes pre te bladell ap ko kasht, hoi lo koleske pre-tchiwas.
Un kol budepangre o baro rajestar penan ap leste: “O Haman hi ap i platsa tardo.” Un o baro rai penas: “Job well dren!”

Un o Haman was dren. Un o baro rai putchas les: “Hoi te krap ko mursheske, koles me, o baro rai, kamau o djijestar te hadell?” Kote penas o Haman an peskro dji: “Kones kamell o baro rai budeder te hadell har man?”
Un o Haman penas ap o baro rajeste: “Ko mursheske, koles kamell o baro rai o djijestar te hadell,
mu wenn rajeskre koola anlo, ninna i rajeskro grai. Un ap leskro shero well i rajeskri stadi tchiddo.

Un jek o pralstunendar o baro rajestar riwell ko murshes an, un anell les ap o grai pral i foreskri platsa, un mukell glan leste win te kharell: ‘Jaake krell o baro rai ko mursheha, koles job kamell o djijestar te hadell.’”

Kote penas o baro rai ap o Haman: “Le sik kol koola un o grai, jaake har tu penal. Un kre kowa jaake ko biboldeha, o Mordekai. Kowa hi beshdo an o wudar glan o baro rajeskro kheer. Un muk tchi kolestar lauterestar krik, hoi tu penal!”

Kote las o Haman kol koola un ko grai un djas pash o Mordekai un riwas leske kol koola an, un anas les pral ko foreskri platsa, un kharas glan leste win: ‘Jaake krell o baro rai ko mursheha, koles job kamell o djijestar te hadell.’
Palle djas o Mordekai pale an o wudar pale glan o baro rajeskro kheer. Un o Haman ladjas pes un khatras peskro shero, un djas sik khere.

Un job penas peskri romjake, i Seresh, un peskre tsele malenge, lauter hoi leske djas. Kote penan leskre mala un leskri romni, i Seresh, ap leste: “Te peral tu kanna glan o Mordekai, koon i biboldendar hi, palle nai kreh tu buder tchi khatar leste. Na-a, tu djah tele un nashreh lauter.”
Un har jon gomme leha rakran, wan o baro rajeskre budepangre un anan les sik pash o chapen, hoi i Ester lenge kras.
Un o baro rai un o Haman wan pash o chapen, hoi i rani Ester kras.

Un o baro rai putchas ninna ap kau duito diwes, har jon i mool pijan: “Hoi hi kowa, hoi tu mandar mangeh, rani Ester? Me dau les tute. Hoi kameh tu? Un te kameh o paash lauterestar hoi man hi, kowa well tut dino!”

Kote penas i rani Ester: “Miro baro rai, te hal mange latches, un te hi mishto an tire jaka, mange kowa te dell, hoi me tutar mangau, palle, miro baro rai, muk man te djiwell, man un mire menshen. Kowa hi, hoi me kamau.

Mer wam bikedo, me un mire menshe, te was mer maredo, jaake te atchell kek mendar djido. Te wams mer kokres bikedo, mursha un djuwja, te was ginle budepangre, kroms miro mui gar pre. Kowa wals gar phares doha, te wap koleha pash o baro rajeste.”
Kote putchas o baro rai Ahasveros i ranjatar Ester: “Koon hi kowa? Un kai hi lo, koles an o shero was, te krell lo sau koowa?”
Un i Ester penas: “Kowa, kai lell men palla un kamell men te marell, kawa hi ko tchilatcho mursh Haman!” Kote tapras o Haman i daar glan o baro rajeste un i ranjate.

Un o baro rai stas chojedo pre kotar, kai le mool khetne pijan. Un djas win an i baar pash peskro kheer. Un o Haman atchas pash i ranjate Ester, te mangell lo latar peskro djipen. Job dikas koi bibacht, hoi pral leste well, hoi o baro rai peske glan las.

Har was o baro rai dran i baar pale pale an koi isema, kai jon khetne mool pijan, dikas lo o Haman, kai glan i diwana tchiddo his, kai i rani hi. Koi das lo gole: “Kamell lo kanna pash mande an miro kheer i ranjake tchomone te krell?” Kol laba his gomme gar dran o baro rajeskro mui tseles win, koi tchakran i budepangre o Hamaneskro shero.

Un jek o pralstunendar, o Harbona, penas: “Ake, kote pash o Hamaneskro kheer hi o kasht tardo, hoi hi i paash-sheel mussja baro, koles o Haman mukas pre te tchiwell o Mordekajeske. Kawa hi ko mursh, kai o baro rajeske penas, kai murshen glan his, te marenn le les.” Kote penas o baro rai: “Bladenn les koi pre!”
Jaake bladan le o Hamanes ap ko kasht pre, koles job o Mordekajeske mukas pre te tchiwell. Un i choli o baro rajestar djas pale.

Ap ko diwes das o baro rai, o Ahasveros, i ranjate Ester ko kheer, hoi his o Hamanes, kai i bibolden kamas te marell. Un i Ester penas o baro rajeske, kai o Mordekai lakro kako hi. Un o baro rai mukas les glan peste te well.
Un las peskri gustri, hoi job o Hamanestar krik las, un das lat o Mordekai. Un i Ester tchiwas o Mordekajes pral o Hamaneskro tselo kheer.

Un i Ester rakras i wawar kopo o baro rajeha, un witsras pes glan leskre herja tele, un rowas ap leste un mangas lestar, te well ko tchilatchepen gar pral i biboldende, hoi kamas o Haman i menshendar Agag, pral lende te anell.
Un o baro rai las peskro sonakaskro raan un sikras leha ap i Ester. Kote stas i Ester pre un was glan leste,

un penas: “Miro baro rai, te hi mishto un tchatcho glan tire jaka, un te hal mange latches un dikeh kamles ap mande, palle le kol lila pale, hoi tchinas o Haman, koleskro dad o Hammedata hi dran o kheer Agag, an kolende tchinlo hi, te wenn i bibolde maredo an hako them, kai tu baro rai hal.
Har nai dikap me sawi bari bibacht, hoi mire menshenge well? Un har nai wap me kote pashel tardo, te denn le mire tsele menshen mulo, un krau tchi?”

Kote penas o baro rai Ahasveros ap i rani Ester un ap o Mordekai, ko biboldo: “Djinenn, o Hamaneskro kheer dom i Esterate, te well lo lakro. Un les mukom ap ko kasht pre te bladell doleske, kai kamas lo i bibolden te marell.

Kanna tchinenn tumer i wawar liil, hoi te well i biboldenge, jaake har mishto hi an tumare jaka! Tchinenn ko liil an miro lab un tchiwenn miri gustjah miro sikepen koi pre! I liil, hoi an o lab o baro rajestar tchinlo was un ap koleste leskro sikepen hi, nai well gar pale lino.”

Jaake wan kol murshen kharedo, kai o baro rajeskre lila tchinenn. Kowa his an o triinto tchon, – kowa hi o tchon Siwan – ap o biish-te-triinto diwes. Un i lila wan jaake tchinlo, har o Mordekai penas: ap i biboldende, un ap i pralstunende ko themestar, ap i themeskre rajende un i pralstunende pral i tsele themma mank o pani Indus un o pani Nil. Kolla his 127 (jek-sheel-te-biish-te-efta) themma. Un tchinlo was jaake har an hako them tchinlo was, un an o rakepen kol menshendar, kai kote djiwan, un ninna ap i bibolde jaake har jon tchinenn un rakrenn.
Un i lila wan tchinlo an o baro rajeskro lab, un leskro sikepen was pre-tchiddo. Un klissepangre ap sik graja anan len kote, kai le bitchedo wan.

Un an kol lila his tchinlo: O baro rajeske hi mishto, te wenn i bibolde khetne an hako foro, kai djiwenn le, te kurenn le pengro djipaske, un marenn kolen, kai ap lende djan, ninna lengre tchawen un djuwjen, jaake te atchell lendar kek djido. Un lauter, hoi kolenge his, nai lenn le penge, te well lengro.
Un kowa nai krenn le an i tsele themma, kai o Ahasveros baro rai hi, ap o deesh-te-triinto diwes an o deesh-te-duito tchon, – kowa hi o tchon Adar.
Un an kol tsele themma hunte wan kal tchinle laba prindjedo kerdo, jaake te djinan i menshe kote, te krenn pen i bibolde soreles ko diweske, te djan le ap kolende, kai kamenn len te marell.

Un kol bitchepangre i lilentsa klissan sik win ap o rajeskre graja, jaake har o baro rai penas. Un ko tchinlo lab was ninna an o baro rajeskro kheer an o foro Susa ap i kasht dino, te well lo prindjedo.

Un o Mordekai djas win o baro rajestar, rido an rajeskre koola. Kolla his blaueto un parno. Un ap leskro shero his shereskro sonakai. Leskri baja his dran laintikro than un lolo bakrengro bal. Un i menshe an o foro Susa stan un dan gole i bachtjatar.
I biboldenge his o djipen pale shukar. Bacht un sapen was ap lende. Un jon wan hadedo un an-diklo.

Un an hako them un an hako foro, kai o baro rajeskro lab was, his bacht un sapen pash i biboldende. Un jon kran baro chapen un wan bachteles khetne. Un bud menshe i wawar menshendar lan daar i biboldendar un wan bibolde.

Un palle was o 13. (deesh-te-triinto) diwes an o 12. (deesh-te-duito) tchon. Kowa hi o tchon Adar. Ap ko diwes hunte wals kerdo pal o baro rajeskro tchinlo lab. Un i menshe, kai i bibolden gar kaman, patsan, te nai marans le i bibolden ap ko diwes. Kanna was kowa wawartchandes: I bibolde wan sorleder har i wawar menshe,

un wan khetne an pengre forja an i tsele themma, kai o Ahasveros baro rai hi, te djan le ap kolende pre, kai lengri bibacht kaman. Un kek nai atchas tardo glan lende. Un i bari daar glan lende peras ap i menshende an i tsele themma.
I darjatar glan o Mordekai tchiwan pen i pralstune an kol themma ap i rig i biboldendar, ninna i raja, i themeskre raja un i rakepangre o baro rajestar.
Jon shunan, kai was o Mordekai i baro mursh an o kheer o baro rajestar. An i tsele themma was prindjedo, har lo baro un bareder was.
Jaake maran i bibolde lauteren o chareha, kai ap lende djan, un mukan kekes djido, un kran jaake lentsa, har jon kaman.
Un an o sorelo kheer o baro rajestar an o foro Susa dan le pantch-sheel (500) murshen mulo.

Un ninna maran le o Hamaneskre deesh tchawen: o Parshandata, o Dalfon, o Aspata, o Porata, o Adalja, o Aridata, o Parmashta, o Arisai, o Aridai un o Wajesata. O Haman his kowa, kai kamas i bibolden te marell. Leskro dad his o Hammedata. Ko koowa, hoi lenge his, tchoran le penge gar.
Ap ko diwes was o baro rajeske penlo, kitse mule das an o rajeskro sorelo kheer an o foro Susa.

Un o baro rai penas ap i rani Ester: “Kokres an miro sorelo kheer an Susa dan i bibolde pantch-sheel murshen mulo. Ninna i deesh tchawen o Hamanestar maran le. Putchau man, hoi kran le an mire wawar themma? Hoi mangeh tu budeder, te well tut dino? Un hoi kameh tu? Kowa well kerdo.”

I Ester penas: “Te hi miro rajeske mishto, palle muk i bibolden taissar an o foro Susa gomme jek kopo pal ko lab te krell, hoi kau diweske tchinlo his. Un kol deesh tchawe o Hamanestar wenn ap deesh bare kashta pre bladedo.”
Un o baro rai penas, te well kowa jaake kerdo. Un ko lab was tchinlo un prindjedo kerdo an o foro Susa. Un kol deesh mule tchawe o Hamanestar wan ap kashta pre pandlo.
Un i bibolde an o foro Susa wan ap o 14. (deesh-te-starto) diwes an o tchon Adar gomme jek kopo khetne, un dan an Susa 300 (triin-sheel) murshen mulo. Lengro koowa tchoran le penge gar.

Un ninna i tsele wawar bibolde, kai an i themma o baro rajestar djiwenn, wan penge khetne, un kuran pen pengro djipaske, te perenn le buder gar an i tchilatche wasta. Un jon dan 75.000 (efta-deesh-te-pantch-serja) murshen mulo. Lengro koowa tchoran le gar penge.
Un kowa his ap o 13. (deesh-te-triinto) diwes an o tchon Adar. Un ap o 14. (deesh-te-starto) diwes kran jon tchi. Un kran lestar i diwes, kai wenn le khetne, chan un pijenn un hi bachtelo.

Kol bibolde, kai an o foro Susa djiwan, kolla djan an o marepen ap o 13. (deesh-te-triinto) un ap o 14. (deesh-te-starto) diwes an ko tchon. Un ap o 15. (deesh-te-pantchto) diwes kran le tchi. Un kran lestar i diwes, kai krenn le tchi un wenn khetne, chan un pijenn un hi bachtelo.
Doleske hi o 14. (deesh-te-starto) diwes an o tchon Adar i baro diwes kol biboldenge, kai djiwenn win ap o them un an i gaba. Un jon chan un pijenn un denn jek o wawareste latcho chapen.
Un o Mordekai tchinas kawa lauter an i liil, un bitchras lila ap i tsele biboldende, kai dur hi un kai gar dur hi, an hako them o baro rajestar Ahasveros.
An kol lila his tchinlo, te well o 14. un o 15. diwes an o tchon Adar i baro diwes. Koles hunte rikrenn le hako bersh,

te bistrenn le gar, kai an kol diwessa i bibolde win lino wan dran i tchilatche wasta, un kai kawa o tchon hi, kai was bacht dran lengre duka, un sapen dran lengro ropen. Doleske hunte rikrenn le kol diwessa bares, un wenn khetne, chan un pijenn un hi bachtelo. Un jek te dell o wawareste latcho chapen. Un ninna i tchorwele hunte wenn gar bistedo un hunte lenn tchomone.
Un i bibolde kran jaake har o Mordekai lenge an o liil tchinas. An hako bersh rikran le kal bare diwessa jaake har kran le o ersto kopo.

An ko liil, hoi o Mordekai lenge bitchras, tchinas lo lenge, hoi o Haman kras, koleskro dad o Hammedata his i menshendar Agag: Job kamas i bibolden te marell, un mukas kol tikne barra te witsrell, hoi kharenna Purim, te hatsell lo win, hawo diwes o feteder ko marepaske hi.

An ko liil his ninna tardo, har i Ester pash o baro rajeste djas un har kowa an i liil penas, te well o Hamaneha ko tchilatcho koowa kerdo, hoi job kamas i biboldentsa te krell. Un jaake was o Haman un peskre tchawe ap i bare kashta pre bladedo.
Doleske wan kol bare diwessa ‘Purim’ kharedo, jaake har kol tikne barra kharenna, hoi witsedo wan. Un jaake har o Mordekai lenge an o liil tchinas, un doleske, hoi jon kokres dikan un kran,

lan pen i bibolde glan, te rikrenn le kol dui diwessa bares, un mukenn gar tele, te rikrenn le len hako bersh jaake har glan tchinlo was. Un jaake was kowa pash lende kerdo. Un kowa his ninna moldo lengre tchawenge, kai pal lende wenna, un kolenge, kai kek bibolde hi un pash lende rikrenna.
Ap hako tsiro hunte rikrenn i bibolde kal diwessa ‘Purim’ an hako them un hako foro, te bistrenn lengre tchawengre tchawe gar, hoi an kol diwessa djas.

Un i rani Ester, kolakro dad o Abichajil his, tchinas i duito liil, khetne lakro kakeha, o biboldeha Mordekai. An kau liil tchinas li, te hunte well lauter jaake kerdo har an ko liil, hoi o Mordekai tchinas pral kol diwessa Purim.
Un lakro liil djas ap i tsele biboldende an kol 127 (jek-sheel-te-biish-te-efta) themma, kai o Ahasveros o baro rai his. An ko liil his tardo: “Bacht un tchatchepen tumenge!

Mer, o biboldo Mordekai un i rani Ester, mangah tumendar, te rikrenn kol diwessa Purim ap o tchatcho tsiro jaake dren, har mer kowa glan tchinam. Kal laba hi tumenge un tumare tchawenge, kai pal tumende wenna.” An kau liil penan le lenge ninna, har te rikrenn le ko ropaskro tsiro dren, kai rowenn le un chan tchi.
Un jaake har i Ester an kau liil tchinas, wan kol o bare diwessa Purim dren tchiddo. Un lakre laba wan an i baro liil tchinlo.
Un o rai Ahasveros tchiwas ap o them un ap i panjengre themma i sijaan, hoi i menshe hunte plaissrenna.

Ko tselo baro railo koowa, hoi lo kras un leskri soor pral kol bud themma, kowa hi tchinlo an i familjakro liil kol bare rajendar pral o them Media un Persia. Kote hi ninna tchinlo, har o baro rai o Mordekajes hadas un bares kras,

jaake te was o biboldo Mordekai o duito pal o baro rajeste Ahasveros. Un job his baro pash i biboldende un latches an-diklo pash i tsele biboldende. Job rodas o latchepen lenge un rakras, hoi leskre menshenge ko feteder his.
An o them Uz djiwas i mursh, kowa kharas Hiob. Job his an o tchatchepen tardo, un kek doosh his ap leste. Job mangas o Debles an, un rikras pes dur krik o tchilatchepastar.
Un les his efta mursh tchawe un triin tcha.

Ninna his les bud vieche: 7.000 (efta-serja) bakre un 3.000 (triin-serja) khamele, un jek serja grumja, kolendar hako kopo dui khetne budran, un 500 (pantch-sheel) djuwelkane burike. Un les his bud bud budepangre. Kek mensho his brawleder har o Hiob an ko them, hoi hi kote tchiddo, kai o kham pral djal.
Un leskre mursh tchawe, hakeno lendar, kras i baro chapen an peskro kheer ap peskro diwes. Un jon mukan pengre triin phenjen te well, te chan un pijenn le khetne.

Un har kol diwessa trujel his, kai le chan un pijan, palle bitchras o Hiob pash lende, te wenn le pash leste. Un job stas sik taissarlakro pre, un maras hakeneske lendar i viecho, un chatchras les o Debleske, te well lengri doosh krik lino. Job penas peske: Nai djals, te lan mire mursh tchawe doosh ap pende, un rakran djungeles pral o Debleste an pengre djia. Un jaake kras o Hiob pal hako baro chapen, hoi leskre mursh tchawe kran.
Un was i diwes, kote wan i tsele bolepangre pash o baro Debleste khetne, un tchiwan pen tardo glan leste. Ninna o beng his mashkral lende.
Un o baro Dewel putchas o benges: “Kai weh tu?” Un o beng penas ap o baro Debleste: “Wau i phubjatar. Kote djom trujel.”

Un o baro Dewel putchas o bengestar: “Dal tu ninna jak ap miro budepaskro, o Hiob? Kek wawar hi ap i phub, kai hi jaake har kowa. Job hi an o tchatchepen tardo, un kek doosh hi ap leste. Job mangell man an, un rikrell pes dur krik o tchilatchepastar.”
Un o beng penas ap o baro Debleste: “Patseh, te mangell lo tut tchitcheske an?
Tu deh jak ap leskro kheer un ap lauter, hoi les hi. Tu tchiwal tiri bacht ap lauter, hoi job an-taprell. Un leskre vieche wan bud un budeder an o tselo them.
Hoi hi, te leh tu lestar krik, hoi leskro hi? Tchatchepah palle praassell lo tut!”
Kote penas o baro Dewel ap o beng: “Mishto! Halauter, hoi les hi, dau an tiro wast. Les kokres ma tape an!” Pal kowa djas o beng krik o baro Deblestar.
Ap jek diwes his o Hiobeskre tchawe khetne an o kheer kolestar, kai o phureder lendar hi. Un jon chan un pijan mool khetne.
Kote was i bitchepaskro pash o Hiob un penas: “I grumjentsa rissram i phub trujel, un i burike chan kote pash lende.
Kote peran kolla dran o them Saba pral mende, un randan i viechen un dan tire budepangren o chareha mulo. Un me nai nashom, me kokres, te nai penap kowa tuke.”

Ko budepaskro rakras gomme, koi was i wawar un penas ap o Hiob: “Jag dran o bolepen peras tele, un chatchras i bakre un i busja un tire budepangre, kai ap lende jak dan. Un me nai nashom, me kokres, te penap kowa tuke.”

Har ko budepaskro gomme rakras, was i wawar un penas: “I Kaldearja wan ap triin rigja un peran pal tire khamele dren un lan len penge krik, un dan tire budepangren o chareha mulo. Un me nai nashom, me kokres, te nai penap kowa tuke.”
Kowa rakras gomme, koi was i wawar un penas: “Tire mursh tchawe un tire tcha his pash o chapen beshdo, un pijan mool an o kheer pengro phureder phralestar.

Koi was i phurdepen dran o mulo tato them un das ap ko kheer ap leskre star rigja. Un ko kheer peras khetne pral kol terne menshende. Un jon meran. Un me nai nashom, me kokres, te nai penap kowa tuke.”

Kote stas o Hiob pre, un sorjah tserdas lo peskre pralstune koola pestar tele, un kras len paash, jaake bud dukas leskro dji. Job tchinas peskre balla tele, mukas pes ap i phub te perell un mangas o Debles an.
Un job penas: “Har boldo wom, his kek koola ap mande. Un ap ko diwes, kai merau, lau kek koola mantsa. O baro Dewel das man lauter, hoi man hi. Un o baro Dewel las les pale mandar. Job well sharedo!”
Ninna te was kowa lauter jaake, anas o Hiob kek doosh ap peste, un witsras o Debleske kek tchilatchepen glan.
Un was o diwes, kai wan i bolepangre pale khetne pash o baro Debleste un tchiwan pen tardo glan leste. Un o beng his ninna pale mashkral lende.
Un o baro Dewel penas ap o beng: “Fun kai weh tu?” Un o beng penas ap leste: “Wau i phubjatar. Kote djom trujel.”

Un o baro Dewel putchas o bengestar: “Dal tu ninna jak ap miro budepaskro, o Hiob? Kek wawar hi ap i phub, kai hi jaake har kowa. Job hi an o tchatchepen tardo, un kek doosh hi ap leste. Job mangell man an, un rikrell pes dur krik o tchilatchepastar. Ninna kanna anell lo kek doosh ap peste, kai tu mandar kamal, te anap les an i bibacht, ninna te kras lo tchi.”
Un o beng penas ap o baro Debleste: “Lauter, hoi i menshes hi, dell lo peskro djipaske.
Hade tiro wast un tape leskre kokale un leskro mass an! Palle dikeh, te praassell lo tut glan hake menshende!”
Kote penas o baro Dewel ap o beng: “Mishto, dau les an tiro wast. Leskro djipen ma tape an!”
Kote djas o beng win o baro Deblestar, un das o Hiobes i djungelo nasslepen ap peskro mass, hoi chandjras un dukas leske fun o shero bis tele pash i pire.
Un o Hiob las i kotar i paash-dino khorestar, te chandjrell lo pes koleha. Un job his beshdo mashkral i jagakri tchik.
Kote penas leskri romni ap leste: “Rikreh tu gomme ap tiro patsepen? Pen tut o Deblestar tele un mere!”

O Hiob penas ap late: “Tu rakreh jaake har i dineli tchai rakrell. O latchepen lam o Deblestar. Las mer gar ninna o tchilatcho koowa lestar?” Ninna te was kowa lauter jaake, anas o Hiob kek doosh ap peste un witsras o Debleske kek tchilatchepen glan.

O Hiobes his triin mala. Har shunan jon fun koi bibacht, hoi was pral o Hiob, wan le pash leste khetne, hakeno fun kotar, kai job djiwell: O Elifas dran o foro Teman, o Bildad dran o them Shuach, o Zofar dran o them Naama. Un jon kran penge win, te djan le pash leste, te sikrenn le leste, har khaitell lo len, un te penenn le leske latche laba.

Har dikan le les fun dural, prindjran le les gar buder pale. Un jon rowan phares. Un sorjah tserdas hakeno lendar peskre koola pestar tele, un kras len paash. Un jon witsran tchik pre un ap pengre sherja.
Un jon his kote pash leste ap i phub beshdo efta diwessa un efta ratsja. Un kek lendar rakras leha. Jon dikan, leskre duka his baro un pharo.
Pal kowa kras o Hiob peskro mui pre, un praassas ko diwes, kai lo boldo was.
Un o Hiob penas:
Nashedo hunte djal ko diwes, kai me boldo wom, un koi rat, kai miri dai mantsa wawartchandes was!
Mu well ko diwes kali rat, – kai kek bolepaskri momeli pre djal, – kai ninna o Dewel an o pralstunepen ko diwes bistrell!
Mu well ko diwes pherdo kalepen un tamlepen! Kale wolke mu atchenn pral leste! Un o kham mu well kalo ap ko diwes, te well i menshenge bari daar!
Koi rat, kai miri dai mantsa wawartchandes was, mu lell o tamlepen koi rat peske, te well li gar kharedo mank i tsele diwessa an o bersh, witar gar mank i diwessa an o tchon!
Kek djuwel te well wawartchandes an koi rat, Kek te dell gole i bachtjatar an koi rat!
I durkepangre mu praassenn ko diwes – kolla, kai haiwenn i bibacht pral i diwes win te rakrell, un kai nai djangrell o Leviatan pre.
Koi rati te atchell kalo, kek bolepaskri momeli djal pre taissarlakro. Koi rati mu dikell pal o diwes – un kowa well gar. O kham djal gar pre.
Koi rati mukas miri dai wawartchandes te well, un mukas man bari bibacht te dikell.
Hoske merom me gar, har boldo wom, har me dran late win wom?
Hoske las li man an i gali? Hoske das li man i tchutchi te pijap?
Te woms mulo, woms koi tchiddo, un sowoms, un woms pokones.
Palle woms tchiddo mank i bare rajende un pralstunende ap kai phub, kai kran pen shukar mulengre khera.
Woms tchiddo mank i pralstunende, kolen sonakai his, un kolengre khera pherdo rup his.
Palle tchiwans le man tel i phub har sau ternepen, hoi glan o tsiro mules boldo was. Palle woms paskedo har sawo tchawo, hoi o kham kek tsireske dikas.
Kote mukenn i tchilatche tele pengri diwji goljatar. Kote nai sowenn kolla, kai hunte maran pen tele.
Ninna i pandle wenn buder gar tradedo, un shunenn kekes buder, kai dell len an-gole tchilatche labentsa.
Kote hi o baro un o tikno, lauter jek har o wawar. Un o pandlo budepaskres hi buder kek rai pral peste.
Hoske mukell o Dewel kolen djido, kai len jaake phares hi? Hoske dell lo kolen o djipen, kolengro dji pherdo ropen hi?
Jon kamenn te merenn, un o merepen well gar. Jon rodenn les budeder har brawlepen,
un giwans un sans i bachtjatar, te nai merans le.
Hoske hunte djiwell kowa, koleskro drom khatedo hi, un koles o Dewel haki rigjatar dren pandas?
Mire swa hi miro chapen. un koi gole, hoi dau, well dran mande win har pani.
Kowa, hoi me darom, was pral mande. Kolestar trashom, kowa tapras man.
Me hatsom kek ruha, un nai lom kek newi soor. Dap ap dap was ap mande.
Un o Elifas dran o foro Teman penas ap leste:
Te rakrau ap tute, muk kowa tuke gar chojedo te krell. Me nai rikrau gar mire laba pale.
Tu sikral bud menshen o tchatcho drom, un kral khine wasta pale soreles.
Tire laba hadan koles pale pre, kai peras. Tu kral kol herja pale soreles, hoi trissan.
Kanna, kai was i bibacht pral tute, nashreh tiri soor. Kanna, kai tut kowa tapras, pereh tu khetne i trashatar.
Tu rikreh tuke o Debles glan i jaka pash halauter, hoi kreh, un djah o tchatcho drom. Doleske nai leh newi soor, un patseh, te well lauter pale mishto tuke.
Rake tiro djijeha, un pen mange, kai maras o Dewel jekes, ap koleste kek doosh his? Kai las lo o djipen jekestar krik, kai his an o tchatchepen tardo?
Jaake har me les dikom, well tchilatchepen pral kolende, kai tchilatchepen kran, un bibacht pral kolende, kai bibacht ap wawarende anan.
O Dewel phurdell ap lende, un jon merenn. Leskri choljakro ducho marell len.
Jon nai denn bari gole har i lewe, o Dewel phagell lenge i danda win.
I lewe merenn, te hi len tchi marepaske un chapaske. Un lengre terne nashrenn pen kate te kote.
Mange wan tchorchanes laba penlo. I tikni goljah rakras jek an miro kand.
Rati, har sowom soreles dom djungeles suni.
Traash un trisslepen was ap mande. Mire tsele kokale trissan.
I ducho phurdas ap miro mui, un mire balla ap mande his pre tardo.
Glan mire jaka dikom jekes tardo, un djinom gar koon kowa his. Shunom tchi. Palle rakras jek un penas:
Har nai well i mensho an o tchatchepen tardo glan peskro Debleste? Har nai djiwell i mursh i djudjo djipen glan o Debleste, kai kras les?
O Dewel nai patsell gar peskre budepangren an o bolepen. Un ap leskre bolepangre hatsell lo doosh.
Har bud budeder hatsell lo doosh ap kolende, kai wan dran tchik kerdo – ap kolende, kai nai wenn khetne stakedo har i kirmo.
An i tsalla djal lenge mishto, un rati merenn le, un hi buder gar koi. Un kek dell jak pre.
Un wawar lenn, hoi len his. Jon merenn un haiwenn gar, hoi lenge djal.
De gole un dik: Hi jek koi, kai shunell ap tute? Hawo bolepaskres kameh an te mangell, te well lo ap tiri rig?
Koon choirell pes pral halauter, hi dinelo. Leskri choli tassrell les. Koon peskri choli gar pale rikrell, hi narwelo. Job merell ap peskri choli.
Me dikom i dineles, kai har i baro ruk soreles tardo his. Sik rakrom bibacht win pral leskro kheer.
Leskre tchawen his kek bacht an pengro djipen. Har anas jek tchomone ap lende pre, his kek koi, kai was ap lengri rig, un las lengro koowa an o wast.
Ko djob, hoi job tchinas un dren anas, kowa chan kolla pre, hoi bokenn. Ninna kowa, hoi mank i subjengre burra bares was, lan le penge. Bokle menshe chan leskro brawlepen.
Dran i phub well kek tchilatchepen win, witar kek bibacht dran o hachetikri phub.
Dran o mensheste kokres well i bibacht, jaake har dran i jag tikne chatchede kotja pre phurdedo wenn.
Te djals mange har tuke, rodoms o Debles, un anoms miro koowa glan leste.
Job hi kowa, kai krell bud baro un sorelo koowa, hoi kek haiwell un kek wawar nai krell.
Job dell brishin ap i phub, un mukell pani ap o them te perell.
Job krell kolen baro, ap kolende i wawar tele dikan. Un kolenge ropaske hi, kolen krell lo bachtelo.
Job dell kowa paash hoi penge kolla glan lan, kai kamenn i wawaren pral o kand te dell. Jaake nai krenn le tchi.
Job taprell i gosewen an pengro goswepen. Un kowa, hoi kolla dui tchipjentsa mank pende win kran, kowa mukell lo gar te djal.
Pral o diwes mukell lo len an o tamlepen te nashell, un mashkral diwes dikenn le pengro drom gar, har te wals rati.
