O Dewel lell o tchorweles dran o tchilatcho rakepen win, un dran o wast o sorleder tserdell lo les win.
Jaake lell o tchorwelo pale newi soor an peskro dji, un o tchilatchepen hunte rikrell peskro mui.
Dik, bachtelo hi ko mensho, koleske o Dewel leskri doosh sikrell! Doleske ma hade tut khatar leste, te dell tut o sorelo Dewel.
Job dukrell, un palle tchiwell lo i pandepen ap ko dukepen. Job dell khetne, un leskre wasta krenn pale sasto.
Hako kopo, kai perell i bibacht ap tute, lell lo tut win. Un kek tchilatchepen nai taprell tut an.
Te hi bari bok an o them, mukell lo tut gar te merell. Un an o kurepen mukell lo tut gar i chareha te marell.
Job khatrell tut glan o rakepen, hoi i tchilatche tchipja rakrenn. Te well i kurepaskro tsiro, hunte well tut kek daar.
Tu nai saneh, te well kurepen un bok, un kol diwje viechendar well tut kek daar.
I barra ap i hachetikri phub hi tire mala, un i diwje vieche krenn tuke tchi.
Un tu dikeh un haiweh, te djal lauter mishto an tiro kheer. Ninna kote, kai tire vieche hi, hi kek lendar nashedo.
Un tu dikeh, har tire tchawe bud wenna, awa, kolla, kai pal tute wenna, wenn jaake bud har o senlepen ap i phub.
Un tu mereh an o latcho phurepen, jaake har o djob dren anlo well, te was leskro tsiro.
Dik, kawa lauter hatsam mer win. Jaake hi kowa. Un tu, shun koi pre, un de jak koi pre!
Un o Hiob penas koi pre:
Kamoms, te nai lals jek miri duk un miri bibacht, un tchiwals len ap i waga!
Kolla hi phareder har i tseli santa glan o baro pani. Doleske rakrau har i dinelo rakrell.
Mange djal jaake, har te dals o sorelo Dewel karje ap mande, un leskre faile wans an mande, hoi anenn mange o merepen. Kowa, hoi mukell o Dewel ap mande te well, krell man i bari daar.
Kek burika dell gole, te hi lat senlepen te chal. Kek grumni dell gole, te hi lat doha te chal.
Koon kamell i chapen te chal, kai kek loon dren hi? Koon kamell o parnepen i jalo jarestar te chal?
Sau chapen taprau gar an. Kowa hi mange jaake djungeles, te nai lau les gar tele.
Ach, te shunell o Dewel, hoi lestar mangau, un krell kowa, hoi lestar kamau!
Har kamoms, te wals leske shukar, te dell lo man mulo, te lell lo miro djipen mandar.
Kowa krals koi duk an miro dji tikneder. An mire tsele bare duka djinau, te krom hako tsiro, hoi o Dewel mange penas.
Man hi buder kek soor, te nai rikrap dureder win. Hoi atchell miro djipastar, te dikap ap ko tsiro, hoi wella?
Miri soor hi gar dran bar. Un miro mass hi gar dran saster.
Tchatchepah, djinau buder gar dureder. Kek hi koi, kai dell man newi soor.
Kones kek dji hi peskro maleske, koles hi gar o sorelo Dewel glan i jaka pash kowa, hoi lo krell.
Mire mala sikran pen, te hi le chochene. Har panja hi le, kai truk wenn.
An o wend hi kol panja shila un tamlo un gib tchakrell len.
Te well o nijal, djal bud un budeder pani krik. Te well tato, hi buder kek pani koi.
I khamele un lengre klissepangre djan pengro dromestar tele, te rodenn le kote pani. Jon nashenn an o mulo them trujel un merenn.
Mursha pengre khamelentsa wenn dran Tema un Saba un rodenn kal panja.
Un har wenn le kote, his lauter tchitcheske: Kek pani hi koi.
Jaake har kal panja, hoi buder gar koi hi, jaake wan tumer kanna mange. Tumer dikenn, har djungeles mange djal, un tumen taprell i bari daar.
Penom me ap tumende: Denn man lowe? Plaissrenn tumer mange jekes tumaro brawlepastar?
Lenn tumer man win dran i wasta kolestar, kai kamell man te marell? Lenn tumer man win dran i wasta kolestar, kai rikrell man tele? Tchatchepah, sawo koowa penom gar.
Sikrenn mange, kai djom o tchatcho dromestar tele, un me rikrau miro mui. Sikrenn kowa mange jaake, te haiwap les!
Tchatche laba rakrenn an o dji. Tumare laba hi tchi moldo. Tumer penenn mange gar, hawo tchilatchepen me krom.
Hi mare laba tchilatcho an tumare kanda? Me hom i mursh, kai djinell buder gar, hoi te krell lo, un koleskro rakepen hi tchitcheske.
Tumer han sawe, kai khelans trul i tchaweste, koles kek dad buder hi, un bikrans tumaro males lowenge.
Dikenn mange an i jaka! Chochroms me tumenge an o mui dren?
Mukenn tele, tchilatchepen ap mande pre te anell! Awa, mukenn tele koleha! O tchatchepen hi ap miri rig!
Rakrell miro mui chochene laba? Na-a! Me djinau, hoi latcho un hoi tchilatcho hi!
I menshe hunte budrenn phares ap kai phub. Pengro tselo djipen marenn le pen tele har i budepangre, kai wenn haki rati plaissedo.
Jaake har i budepaskro, kai kamell, te well rati, kai well lo dran o kham, un kai well lo plaissedo,
jaake wan mange i tsele tchonna, kai djiwom tchitcheske, un bud ratsja pherdo daar un duk.
Te tchiwom man tele, penau me: Kaana nai stau pale pre? I rat kamell gar pre te herell, un me rissrau man jek rigjatar ap i wawar, bis te well o diwes.
Miro mass ap mande hi tchakedo kirmentsa un tchik. Miri hauta phagell pre, un djelto pani nashell win.
Mire diwessa djan trujel jaake sik har i sub, hoi pre un tele djal. Un kowa hoi gomme glan mande hi, nai well tchi, hoi shukar hi.
Ma biste, miro Dewel, te hi miro djipen har i ducho. Mire jaka dikenn buder kek bacht.
Tu, kai leh man kanna an o jak, nai dikeh man palle buder gar. Te rodeh pal mande, hom me buder gar koi.
Jaake har i wolka ap jek kopo buder gar koi hi, jaake hi o mensho, kai merell. Job well buder gar pale dran o mulengro them.
Pash peskro kheer well lo gar buder pale Un kote, kai djiwas lo, well lo bistedo.
Doleske kamau me ninna gar miro mui te rikrell, kamau te rakrap dran miro djijeskri daar, un miri bari duk win gole te dell.
Hom me o baro pani oder i baro panjeskro viecho, te dess tu jaake jak ap mande, te krap tchi?
Te penau: Ap miro tchiben djal mange feteder, an miro sopen well miri duk tikneder,
palle bitchreh tu mange djungele sunja, hoi krenn man daar un traash.
Mange wals feteder, te tassrals man jek. O merepen hi latcheder har sau djipen.
Me kamau gar buder, kamau gar buder te djiwell. Muk tele mandar! Miro djipen hi sik trujel.
Hoi hi o mensho, te dikess tu ap leste, har te well lo komone baro? Hoske rissreh tu tiro tselo dji pash leste?
Haki tsalla dikeh ap leste, un mukeh les gar i tikno tsireske dran tiro jak, te dikess palla, har un hoske job kowa kras, hoi lo kras?
Hoske dikeh gar krik mandar i tikno tsireske, jaake rah har me pijau miri tchunger an miro mui tele?
Tu hal kowa, kai lell i menshen an o jak. Lom me doosh ap mande? Te wals kowa jaake, hoi krom me koleha tuke? Hoske hom me kowa, ap koleste karje deh? Hom me tuke i pharepen, hoi hunte hidjress?
Hoske leh tu ko tchilatchepen gar krik mandar, hoi krom, un bistreh miri doosh? An i tikno tsiro wau tel i phub. Te rodeh pal mande, hom me gar buder koi.
O Bildad dran o them Shuach penas koi pre:
Har rah gomme kameh tu sau koowa win rakrell? Kowa, hoi rakreh hi har i sorelo phurdepen.
Patseh tchatchepah, te krell o sorelo Dewel gar, hoi mishto un tchatcho hi? Patseh, te rissrell lo peskre tchatchepaskre laba trujel?
Tire tchawe kran, hoi tchilatches his glan leskre jaka. Doleske das lo len pengri phagi.
Te rodeh tu o Debles tiro tselo djijeha, un mangeh ropah o sorelo Deblestar, te well lo tuke pale latches,
un djiweh i djudjo djipen an o tchatchepen, palle stell lo tuke pre, un mukell les tuke un tiri familjake pale mishto te djal, jaake har tchatcho hi.
Kowa, hoi tut glan kowa his, well tuke tiknes glan, te dikeh ko baro brawlepen, hoi dell tut o Dewel an ko tsiro, hoi wella.
Dik ap kowa, hoi djinan i menshe an o phuro tsiro! De jak ap kowa, hoi hatsan mare phure win!
Hi jaake har te wams boldo taissar. Mer djinah tchi. Maro tsiro, kai ham ap kai phub, hi tikno har i suni.
Tire phure nai sikrenn tut, hoi le win hatsan, un hoi jon an pengro djipen dikan:
I shilftikro khass nai well kokres kote baro, kai sapeno hi. Panjeskro senlepen nai djal gar kote pre, kai kek pani hi.
Te hi lo gomme senelo un gar bares doha, te well lo tele tchinlo, marell lo sikeder tele har ko wawar senlepen, te hi les kek pani.
Jaake djal hakeneske, kai o Debles bistrella. Kowa, kai gar o Debleha djiwell, koleske atchell tchi, hoi dell les pale newi soor.
Kowa, hoi kamell lo te well, kowa well gar. Ap koleste job pes rikrell, kowa hi jaake har i sano thab, hoi i spinna tserdell.
Rikrell lo pes ap peskro kheer, phagell kowa khetne. Rikrell lo pes ap kowa, hoi les hi, atchell kowa gar.
I mensho kek Debleha hi har senlepen, koles doha pani hi, glan te djal o kham pre, un hoi buchles well, un djal pral i tseli baar.
Leskre draba tserdenn pen pral barra, un rikrenn pen soreles ap lende.
Te tserdell jek les win, djinell buder kek, kai lo tardo his.
Kaja hi leskri tseli bacht an peskro djipen. Un ap leskri platsa djan pale wawar pre.
Penau tuke, o Dewel witsrell kolen gar pestar, kai an o tchatchepen djiwenn. Un job rikrell gar i tchilatchen pash o wast.
Job krell, te nai saneh pale, un deh gole i bachtjatar.
Kolla, kai kamenn tuke tchilatchepen te krell, hunte ladjenn. Un i khera i tchilatchendar atchenn gar tardo.
O Hiob penas koi pre:
Tchatchepah, djinau te hi jaake. Har nai well i mensho an o tchatchepen glan o Debleste?
Te kamell lo pes leha te tchingrell, nai putchals lestar o Dewel jek sero koowa. Un o mensho nai penals gar jek pale.
O Dewel hi gosewo an peskro dji un les hi bari soor. Kekeske, kai las pes glan te tchingrell lo leha, djas kowa mishto.
O Dewel tchiwell i berge jek rigjatar ap i wawar, glan te haiwenn le kowa. An peskri choli witsrell lo len trujel.
Job taprell ap i phub un koja trissell, Ninna i barra, hoi hidjrenn lat, trissenn.
Rakrell lo soreles ap o kham, djal o kham gar pre. Un i bolepangre momelentsa krell lo, te wenn le gar diklo.
Job kokres kras o bolepen buchles pral i phub, un djal pral o baro pani.
Job kras kol bolepangre momlia, hoi kharenna: Baro Wurdin, Orion, Efta Momelengre, ninna kol bolepangre ap koi rig, kai o kham pralstunes tardo hi.
Job krell sawo baro un sorelo koowa, te nai haiwah les gar, sawo bud baro koowa, hoi kek wawar nai krell, te nai djinah gar, har bud kowa hi.
Job djal glan mande dureder, un me dikom les gar. Job djal glan mande dureder, un me haiwom gar, te his lo koi.
Te lell lo jekes sorjah krik, koon kamell les pre te rikrell? Kek nai penell ap leste: Hoi kreh tu?
O Dewel rikrell peskri choli gar pale, un was sorleder har kolla, kai wan o baro panjeskro sapeske Rahab ap i rig.
Har nai hatsoms me laba, te nai penap tchomone ap leste?
Ninna te wals man tchatches, nai rakroms tchi ap leste, hoi job mandar putchas. Me nai mangoms kokres latchepen lestar, kai miro tchatchepaskro rai hi.
Ninna te mukals lo man leha te rakrell, patsau me gar, te shunals lo ap miro rakepen.
Job bitchrell i sorelo phurdepen, te taprell lo pal mande, un dell man bud dukepen, ninna te krom tchi.
Job mukell man gar jek kopo ducho te lell, na-a, job krell man pherdo ropen un duk.
Te djoms ap leste sorjah, job hi o sorleder! Te kamoms les glan i tchatchepangre te anell, penals lo: Kones kameh te bitchrell, te anell lo man koi?
Ninna te waus an o tchatchepen, miro rakepen anals i phagi pral mande. Ninna te wals kek doosh ap mande, dals lo man i doosh.

Kek tchilatchepen krom me. Miro djipen hi mange buder tchi moldo. Kamau buder gar te djiwell. Lauter hi mange jek. Doleske penau me: O Dewel dell koles mulo, kai latcho un tchatcho hi, un ninna koles, kai tchilatcho hi.
Te well i bari bibacht, un marell menshen ap jek kopo, palle sal lo pral kowa, ninna te hi kek doosh ap lende.
Job das i phub an o wast i tchilatchendar. Un kolla, kai o tchatchepen win krenn, kolen kras lo korelo, te dikenn le tchi. Te his job kowa gar, koon wawar his kowa?
Miro djipen nashell sikeder krik har i naashepaskro. Hako diwes djal trujel un anas mange kek bacht.
Miro djipen nashell jaake sik dureder har i sik bero un har i baro tchirklo, hoi mukell pes tele te perell ap i tikno viecho, te taprell lo les.
Te penau mange: Kamau te bistrap miri tseli duk, un kamau te krap i wawar mui, un pale te sanap,
palle taprau pale daar i tsele dukendar. Un djinau, glan o Debleskre jaka hi man doosh.
Job kamell i doosh ap mande te dikell. Hoske marap man palle tchitcheske tele?
Ninna te thowoms man gibeha tele, un mire wasta sapuneha,
witsrals lo man an i tchikli cheb, te wans mire ripja djungeles glan mande.
O Dewel hi kek mensho har me hom, te nai penoms leske i lab pale, te nai djams khetne pash jekeste, koon nai krals o tchatchepen mashkral mende win.
Kamoms te dals i tchatchepaskro mursh mashkral mende, koon o pralstuno pral mende dujende hi,
te lell kowa o kasht krik, koleha o Dewel man dell, un man buder gar daar wals!
Palle nai rakroms un man wals kek daar lestar. Jaake har kanna pash mande hi, nai krau kowa gar.
Kamau buder gar te djiwell. Doleske rikrau miro ropen ninna gar pale, un rakrau jaake, har miro dukedo dji mange penell.
Me penau ap o Debleste: Ma pen: Doosh hi ap tute! Pen mange, hawi doosh tu ap mande hatsal?
Hoi aneh kawa tuke, te rikreh man sorjah tele? Hoske witsreh man tutar krik, man, koles tire wasta kran, un mukeh kowa mishto te djal, hoi lan pen i tchilatche glan?
Hi tut mensheskre jaka? Dikeh tu jaake har i mensho dikell?
Hi tiro djipen jaake tikno har i mensheskro djipen? Djan tire bersha jaake sik trujel har i menshengre bersha?
Hoske rodeh doosh ap mande, un dikeh palla, hawo tchilatchepen krom?
Tu djineh, te hi ap mande kek doosh, un te hi kek koi, koon nai lell miro djipen dran tiro wast win.
Tu kral man tire wastentsa, lauter ap mande hi tutar kerdo; un kanna chah tu man pre!
Ma biste, te kral man dran tchik. Kameh tu kanna, te wap pale tchik?
Tu kral, te was miri dai mantsa wawartchandes, un kral, te wom me i tikno mensho an late.
Tu dal man kokale un muskle, pandal len khetne, un tchakral mass un hauta pral lende.
Tu dal man djipen un kral latchepen ap mande, un dal mishto jak ap miro djipen.
Ninna te his jaake, djinau, khatedo an tiro dji his tut tchomone wawar mantsa glan:
Tu kamal jak ap mande te dell, te dikess, te loms me doosh ap mande. Palle kamal miri doosh ap mande te mukell.
Te lom doosh ap mande, djal mange djungelo! Ninna te lom kek doosh ap mande, hunte rikrap miro shero tele. Miri ladjatar un miri dukatar hom har mato.
Te hadau miro shero pre, palle leh tu man palla, har te wals i lewo, un sikreh tiri bari soor, te dukress man.
Tu tchiweh menshen pre tardo, kai tchomone ap mande pre anenn. Un tiri choli ap mande well gomme bareder. Un tu bitchreh jek phagi pral i wawar ap mande.
Hoske mukal man boldo te well? Hoske mukal tu man gar glan kowa te merell? Palle dikals man kek!
Mange wals feteder, te woms har kolla, kai wan mules boldo, un paskedo.
Kol diwessa, hoi man gomme hi, hi buder gar bud. Muk mandar tele, dik krik mandar, te nai wap i tikno tsiro gomme bachtelo,
glan te djau koi, kai wau buder gar pale – an o tamlo them, kai hako tsiro kali rat hi
awa, an ko them pherdo tamlepen un kali rat, kai lauter diwjes trujel tchiddo hi, un kai ninna i momeli tamlo hi.
Pal kowa rakras o Zofar dran o them Naama un penas ap o Hiob:
Patseh, te nai penah mer tchi pale ap kau bud rakepen? Sikrenn bud laba, te hi jek an o tchatchepen?
Tiro tselo rakepen nai rikrell men gar pale, te kras mer maro mui pre. Te rikreh men dineleske, patseh, te tchingras gar tuha?
Tu penal: “Kowa hoi me rakrom, hi halauter tchatcho. Me hom djudjo glan o Debleskre jaka.”
Kamoms, te krals o Dewel kanna peskro mui pre un rakrals kokres ap tute!
Job djinell halauter pral halauter. Kamoms, te sikrals lo tute peskro goswepen, hoi menge khatedo hi. Palle hunte haiwess, te dikell o Dewel pral bud doosh tutar pral wergel!
Patseh, te djineh halauter, hoi an o Debleskro dji hi? Nai haiweh tu, har baro o sorelo Dewel hi?
O Debleskro goswepen hi dureder har o bolepen hi, un dureder tele har o mulengro them. Kowa hi bareder har i phub un buchleder har o baro pani. Tu nai haiweh un djineh gar halauter!
Te well job un pandell jekes, un anell les glan i tsillo, te krell lo o tchatchepen pral leste win, koon nai rikrals les pale?
Job djinell, koon i tchi-molde hi, un dikell o tchilatcho koowa, hoi le krenn. Kowa hi gar khatedo glan leste.
Nai well kowa gosewo, koles tchi an o shero hi? Jaake rah gar, har i burika kek menshes ap i phub anell!
Tu, Hiob, hunte rissress tut tiri tseli sorjah pash o Debleste, un hadess tire wasta pre leske.
Te kral tchilatchepen, muk tele kolestar, te well kek tchilatchepen an tiro kheer hatslo.
Palle nai hidjreh tu tiro shero pre, un hunte ladjess gar. Palle hal soreles tardo un dareh tchi.
Tiri bibacht nai bistreh. Te well li tuke an tiro shero, hi li har pani hoi krik nashas.
Un pral tiro djipen djal o kham pre, un hi sorelo har mashkral diwes. Ninna te hi kanna tamlo, well i newo diwes.
Un tiro dji lell pale newi soor un djineh, lauter well mishto. Rati dikeh tut trujel, un tchiweh tut pale tele kek darjah.
Un tu hal tchiddo, un kek well pral tute, un krell tut traash. Un bud wenna, kai mangenn tutar, te kress lenge latchepen.
I tchilatche haiwenn gar, hoske lenge djungeles djal, un hatsenn gar win dran lengri bibacht. Lenge atchell tchi har te dikenn le ap ko diwes, kai merenn le.
Koi rakras o Hiob un penas:
Tchatchepah, tumer han kolla, ap kolende hakeno hunte shunals! Tumentsa merell o goswepen win!
Me ninna hom jaake gosewo har tumer. An tchi krenn tumer mange tchomone glan. Hakeno djinell kowa, hoi tumer penan.
Hoske wom mire malenge sapaske? Me dom gole ap o Debleste, un job shunas man. Ninna te hom an o tchatchepen tardo un djau o tchatcho drom, sanenn le man win.
Kolla, kai lenge mishto djal, dikenn tele ap koleste, kai an i bibacht hi, un stakrenn kolen gomme, kolengre herja trissenn.
I khera kolendar, kai i wawaren sorjah tele rikrenn, hi soreles tardo. Un kek krell kolenge daar, kai krenn sawo koowa te well o Dewel chojedo, Jon patsenn, te hi len o Dewel an pengro wast.
Putch i viechen un i tchirklen, hoi djinenn le pral o Debleste. Un jon penenn les tuke.
Putch ninna i tikne viechen ap i phub, un i matche an o baro pani, un jon penenn les tuke.
Koon hi kowa, kai djinell gar, te kras o baro Debleskro wast kowa lauter?
An leskro wast hi o djipen halauterestar, hoi djiwella, ninna o djipaskro ducho i tsele menshendar!
Te shunell i mensho, hoi rakedo well, putchell lo pes gar, hoi tchatcho un hoi gar tchatcho hi? Kowa hi jaake har peskro mui djinell, hawo chapen latcho un hawo chapen gar mishto hi.
Phure menshen hi goswepen. Kolla, kai bud bersha djiwan, haiwenn bud.
O Debles hi goswepen un ninna soor. Job haiwell halauter, un nai penell, hoi te well kerdo.
Kowa, hoi job tele phagas, nai tchiwell kek pale pre. Kones job dren pandas, koleske nai krell kek pale pre.
Rikrell job o brishin pale, well o tselo them truk. Mukell lo bud brishin te perell, tchakrell bud pani o them, un krell les paash.
Pash leste hi i soor un o tchatcho goswepen. Les hi ninna i soor pral koleste, kai perell o tchatcho dromestar tele, un pral koleste, kai anell les o tchatcho dromestar tele.
Kol pralstune, hoi i rajenge penenn, hoi te krenn le, kolendar lell lo lengro goswepen krik, un krell i tchatchepangre rajen dinelo.
I pandlen kol bare rajendar anell lo dran o pandepen win, un anell i bare rajen an o pandepen.
I rashajenge lell lo lengre rashajengre ripja krik, un i sorelenge lengri soor pral i wawarende.
Kolla, kai nai rakrenn latches glan i wawarende, kolenge lell lo i laba krik, un i phurentsa krell lo, te djinenn le buder gar hoi tchatcho hi un hoi gar tchatcho hi.
Bari ladj anell lo ap i an-dikle pralstunende. Un i sorelendar lell lo lengro kurepaskro koowa krik.
Job anell kowa glan, hoi khatedo his an o kalo telstunepen, un krell, te well o tamlepen diklo.
Job krell, te wenn i natsjone baro, un ninna, te wenn le pale tikno. Un job dell i menshen i baro them, un tradell len pale kote win.
Job krell, te wenn lengre raja dinelo, un krell, te nashenn le trujel kote, kai kek drom hi.
Har korele rikrenn le pengre wasta win, te hatsenn le pengro drom an i kali rat, kai kek momeli hi, un har i mate nashrenn le pen.
Kawa lauter dikan mire jaka, un shunan mire kanda. Un me haiwom les.
Jaake bud har tumer djinenn, djinau me ninna, An tchi krenn tumer mange tchomone glan.
Gar tumentsa, na-a, o sorelo Debleha kamau te rakrell. glan leste kamau miro koowa glan te anell.
Tumer tchakrenn o tchatchepen o chochepah, han dramangre, kai tchi-moldo hi, – tumer halauter.
Kamoms, te rikrans tumare muja! Palle dikans jaake win, har te wans gosewo.
Shunenn mishto, har me miro koowa glan anau! Un denn jak, hoi miro mui penell!
Kamenn tumer o Debleske te chochell, un chochepen te rakrell, te well lo an o tchatchepen?
Kamenn tumer tumen ap leskri rig te tchiwell? Kamenn tumer leske mantsa an o tchingepen te djal?
Patsenn tumer, te djal kowa tumenge mishto, te lell lo tumen an o jak? Mukell lo pes tumendar te chochell, har te wals lo i mensho?
Te tchiwenn tumer tumen tchorchanes ap leskri rig, tchatchepah, palle sikrell lo tumen i sorelo rakepah, te hunte well kowa gar jaake kerdo.
Te hadell lo pes, taprell tumen i traash! Un bari daar mukell lo ap tumende te perell.
Tumaro gosewo rakepen hi gar budeder moldo har jagakri tchik. Kowa hoi tumer kate glan anenn, rikrell gar feteder har khera dran tchik.
Rikrenn tumare muja, un mukenn man te rakrell! Un kowa, hoi palle pral mande well, mu well lo!
Hoske rikrap ap miro djipen? Me dau gar jak ap miro djipen.
Mu marell lo man, man hi tchi te nashrell. Me djom tchatche dromma; un kowa kamau me leske an o mui te penell.
Te wap me glan leste, sikrell kowa, te hi kek doosh ap mande. Kek dui djijentsa well glan leste.
Shunenn mishto, hoi penau! Denn jak ap hako lab!
Me anom kawa pre, te well win kerdo, hoi o tchatchepen hi. Me djinau, te hi man tchatcho.
Koon hi, kai nai sikrell, te hi i doosh ap mande? Palle kamaus miro mui te rikrell, un te merell.
Miro Dewel, kal dui koowa kre mantsa, palle khatrau man ninna gar glan tire jaka:
Le tiri phagi mandar krik, kre mange buder gar daar un traash!
Palle de ap mande gole, un me dau pale gole. Oder muk man tut te putchell, un tu peneh mange pale!
Har bud doosh lom me ap mande? Hawo tchilatchepen krom me? Muk man te djinell, kai me tiro dromestar tele djom, un krom, hoi tu gar kameh!
Hoske khatreh tu tiro mui glan mande? Hoske rikreh man jekeske, kai kamell tuke tchilatchepen te krell?
Hoi hom me? – I patri, hoi o rukestar tele phurdedo was, un i kotar phuss, hoi i ducho krik hidjrell. Hoske kreh mange daar un leh man palla?
Tu aneh djungelo koowa ap mande pre un tchineh les an i liil. Ninna koi doosh, hoi anom ap mande, har terno homs, aneh tu ap miro shero pale.
Mire herja tchiwal an shelle, un deh jak ap hako drom mandar, un leh mire pire an o jak, kai le djan.
Jaake perau khetne har phuro kasht, har kol ripja, kolen i kirme paash chan.
O mensho, boldo i djuwjatar, djiwell i tikno tsiro, un marell pes tele peskro tselo djipen.
Har i bluma well lo baro un merell tele. Jaake har i shatto, hoi well buder gar diklo, te djal o kham tele, hi lo buder gar.
Un sawo hom me. Un tu leh man an o jak, un aneh man glan i tsillo, te kress o tchatchepen win pral mande.
I tsele menshen hi doosh ap pende. Har nai well lendar jek, koles kek doosh ap peste hi?
Tu penal, har phuro i mensho well, kitse tchonna job djiwell. Un penal, ap hawo diwes leskro djipaskro tsiro trujel hi.
Palle dik lestar krik, muk les kokres, te nai krell lo peskro diweskri budi!
Te dell jek i ruk tele, hi leske gar lauter trujel. Dran leste nai wenn pale newe tikne kashta win, un wenn bud un budeder.
Ninna te wenn leskre draba phuro an i phub, un o telstuno kotar merell tele an i tchik,
te perell pani ap leste, well lo pale senelo, ninna te hi kowa gar bud pani. Un newe tikne kashta wenn dran leste, har te wals lo i terno ruk.
Merell i mursh, hi lo buder gar. Kek ducho atchell an leste. Kai hi lo?
Dran o baro pani nashell o pani win. Un o lengsto pani nashrell bud un budeder pani, bis te hi lo truk.
Jaake hi ko mensho, kai tchiwell pes tele un merell. Job stell gar buder pre. Jaake rah har o bolepen koi hi, well lo buder gar djangelo, un kek djangrell les pre dran peskro sopen.
Har kamoms, te khatress tu man an o mulengro them, te pandess man kote dren, bis te tiri choli trujel hi. Kamoms te mukals man jek tsiro koi, un palle woms tuke pale an o shero!
Te merell i mensho, well lo palle pale djido? Palle bistroms, har djungeles mange kanna djal, un dikoms ap ko tsiro, kai mange feteder djal.
Tu dals ap mande gole, un me shunaus un daus pale gole. Un tiro dji nashals pal mande, koles tu tire wastentsa kral.
Tu dals jak ap mire dromma, dals gar jak, hawi doosh me ap mande laus!
Ko tchilatchepen, hoi krom, pandals khetne har an i possita. Koi doosh, hoi ap mande lom, tchakrals tu, te well li buder gar diklo.
I berga nai phagell an peste khetne, un i baro bar hi buder gar koi, kai lo his.
O pani thowell i barra jaake rah tele, bis te tchi lendar atchell. Jaake har hidjrenn sorele panja i tchik krik, jaake leh tu kowa krik, hoi i mensho glan-wi dikell peskro djipaske.
Tu witsreh les tele, te stell lo buder gar pre. An o merepen hi leskro mui buder gar shukar. Tu bitchreh les krik – job well buder gar pale.
Te wenn leskre tchawe an-dikle menshe, job djinell kowa gar. Te well tele diklo ap lende, job haiwell kowa gar.
Kokres peskro mass dukrell les. Un les hi ropaske trul peste kokres.
Koi penas o Elifas dran o them Teman ap o Hiob:
Te wals tchatchepah gosewo, rakrals gar sawe pre-phurde laba! Kawa, hoi tu kate rakreh, hi tchi har i tato ducho.
Tu rakreh tuke sawe labentsa, hoi kekeske mishto hi. Tiro rakepen hi tchi moldo.
Tchatchepah, tu kreh har te wals o patsepen ap o Debleste tchi moldo, un kreh, te mangell les buder kek an.
Pal bud laba khatreh tiri doosh, un rakreh har i chocheno rakrell.
Hi tiro mui, hoi penell, te hi doosh ap tute. Me hunte penap kowa gar. Hako lab, hoi rakreh, sikrell kowa.
Hal tu o ersto mensho, kai boldo was? Hals tu koi, har kras o Dewel i berge?
Hals tu pashel, har o Dewel peskre bolepangre khetne his, un shunal, hoi kote rakedo was? Patseh, te hal tu kokres gosewo?
Hoi djineh, hoi mer gar djinah? Un hoi haiwal, hoi mer gar haiwam?
Mank mende hi ninna phure mursha, mursha parne ballentsa, kai phureder wan har tiro dad.
Dran mende rakras o Dewel kamles tuha. Job kamell o duk dran tiro dji krik te lell. Hi kowa tuke gar doha?
Hoske kereh tu pral har thud ap i jag? An tire jaka chatchell tiri choli.
Ap o Debleste hal chojedo. Doleske well sawo rakepen dran tiro mui.
Hoi hi o mensho, te nai wals lo erligo glan o Debleste? Kek ap kai phub hi an o tchatchepen tardo glan leste.
Ninna leskre bolepangren nai patsell lo gar. Un o bolepen hi gar djudjo glan leskre jaka.
Har bud budeder hatsell lo doosh ap o mensheste. O mensho krell djungelo koowa un hi tchi-moldo. O tchilatchepen krell lo, har te pijals lo pani.
Me kamau tuha te rakrell. Shun ap kowa, hoi me penau! Kowa, hoi me dikom, kamau te penell:
Shunom les gosewe menshendar. Lengre phure rikran les lenge gar pale.
Lenge kokres his o them dino. Kek wi-themari djas mashkral lende peha.
I tchilatcho mensho marell pes tele i darjatar peskro tselo djipen. Kowa, kai i wawaren tele rikrell, hi gar bud bersha glan leste.
An leske kanda shunell lo i gole, hoi krell leske daar. An ko tsiro, kai leske latches djal, well o marepaskro pral leste.
Job nai patsell gar, te well lo dran o tamlepen pale win. un dikell o charo pral leskro shero.
Job djal kate te kote un rodell chapen, un hatsell tchi. Un job haiwas, te well i kalo diwes pral leste.
Daar un traash perenn ap leste, un pandenn les dren, har i baro rai an o kurepen i foro dren pandell.
Jaake djal ko mursheske, kai hadas peskro wast ap o sorelo Debleste, un kras pes bares ap leste,
un nashell peskro shereha ap leste, peskro shilto an o wast.
Leske djal mishto, un leskro per hi thullo.
Un job djiwell an mukle forja, an khera, hoi khetne perenn, kai kek hunte djiwell.
Job atchell gar brawelo. Leskro brawlepen atchell gar. Kowa, hoi les hi, well gar bareder ap kai phub.
Job nai well gar win dran o tamlepen, un hi har ko ruk, koleskre senele kashta chatchedo wenn an i jag. Un o Dewel phurdell ap leste, un krik hi lo.
Koon rikrell pes ap tchomone, hoi tchi moldo hi, kowa chochell pes kokres. un lell pale, hoi tchi moldo hi.
Job hi har i ruk, hoi well djelto glan peskro tsiro, un hidjrell an kek tsiro buder senele patria.
Har i drakengro ruk hi lo, kolestar i drake tele perenn an i tsiro, kai hi le gomme tikno. Un har ko djeteskro ruk hi lo, koleskre blume tele perenn, glan te wenn drake lendar.
Jaake djal i familjenge kolendar, kai djiwenn kek Debleha. Jon atchenn kek tchawentsa. Un i jag chatchrell lengre khera pre, hoi kran le kol lowentsa, hoi lenge plaissedo was te chochenn le.
An lengre sherja hi midjak koowa. Pral pende un i wawarende anenn le bibacht. Un lengre djia hi pherdo phukepen.
Un o Hiob penas koi pre:
Bud sau koowa shunom me. Tumare latche laba, hoi tumen mange hi, tumer halauter, krenn les mange gomme phareder!
Nai herenn tumer kanna pre kau dinelo rakepah! Elifas, hoi anell tut jaake pre te hunte rakress palpale?
Te wans tumer ap miri platsa, palle nai rakroms me jaake har tumer nai kroms bare laba pral tumende, un trissloms miro shero pral tumende.
Bud labentsa doms tumenge pale newi soor. Un kowa, hoi penoms, krals tumari duk tikneder.
Tchi, hoi penau, krell miri duk tikneder. un te rakrau gar, djal mange witar gar feteder.
Tchatchepah, o Dewel las mange miri soor krik. Tu, miro Dewel, lal mange miri tseli familja krik!
Un tu pandal man dren, har te kroms i tchilatcho koowa. Me hom tchi har hauta un kokale. Doleske patsenn i menshe, te lom doosh ap mande.
Leskri choli dandras man khetne un las man palla. Job sikrell peskre danda, un peskre jaka dikenn ap mande har te wans le tchurja.
Menshe wenn khetne trul mande, un dikenn ap mande pre-kerde mujentsa. Te well len tchomone sapaske denn le man tchamedinja.
Miro Dewel das man o tchilatchenge an i wasta, kolenge, kai kamenn lestar tchi te djinell.
Djiwom an o latchepen, har o Dewel das man khetne. Job tapras man ap miri meen, un witsras man tele. Job tchiwas man jaake pre, te dell lo ap mande karje.
Leskre faile djan haki rigjatar ap mande. Job dell man karje an mire buke dren. Un les khaitau gar. Miri galla tchorell lo win ap i phub.
Jek dap pal i wawar dell lo an mande dren. Har i kurepaskro nashell lo ap mande.
Me siwom mange i gono trul mande, un hom tchiddo kek sorjah an i tchik.
Miro tselo shero hi lolo miro bud ropah. Tel mire jaka hi kalepen.
Jaake hi kowa, ninna te krom kek tchilatchepen, un mangom miro Debles i djudjo djijeha an.
Me hom har i mursh, kai was maredo. I phub te khatrell gar miro rat, te well leskri gole hako tsiro shunlo.
Ninna kanna hi jek an o bolepen, kai stell mange pre un well ap miri rig. Kowa, kai mange mishto rakrell, hi an o pralstunepen.
Mire mala sanenn pral mande. Mire jaka hi pherde swa, har dikau me pre pash miro Debleste.
Jaake har i mensho peskro maleske mishto rakrell, kamoms te rakrell jek mange mishto glan o Debleste.
Gar bud bersha hi gomme glan mande, un me djau ko drom, kolestar kek palpale well.
Man hi buder kek soor. miro djipen hi trujel. Ap mande lurell o handako.
Hakeno sal pral mande. Un me hunte dikap, har tchingran le ap mande.
Hi jaake, har te woms an o stilepen. Mangau tut, plaisse tu kol lowe, te wap win lino! Man hi kek wawar, kai mange mishto rakrell.
I djia mire malendar kral tu korelo, jaake te nai dikenn le tchi dren. Doleske mukeh len tu gar sorleder te well har me.
Hi penlo: Jek chal khetne peskre malentsa, un leskre tchawe hunte bokenna.
Kanna wom jek, pral koleste i menshe sapaskre gilja giwenn, un koleske jon an o mui tchungrenn.
Mire jaka dikenn buder gar mishto i dukatar un ropastar. Mire mussja un herja hi sano har i kasht.
Te dikenn man kolla, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi, atchell lenge o rakepen krik i trashatar. Un kolla, an kolende kek doosh hatslo well, penenn chojedes: “Kowa djiwell gar o Debleha.
Jek, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi, mukell gar tele peskro dromestar. Un koon i djudjo djipen djiwell, well sorleder un sorleder.”
Ninna te wans jon halauter kai glan mande, hatsoms kek gosewo murshes mank lende.
Miro djipaskro tsiro hi trujel. Kowa, hoi me mange lauter glan lom, un hoi miro dji kamas, was tchitcheske.
Te hi rati, penenn le, te wals diwes. Te well tamlo, penenn le, te wals o diwes sik.
Hi buder tchi, ap kowa nai dikaus. Glan mande hi o mulengro them. Kote an o kalepen nai tchiwau man tele.
Ap i grufta penau: Tu hal miro dad! Ap i kirme: Tumer han miri dai un mire phenja.
Ap hawo wawar koowa dikap? Koon dikell latchepen mange te well?
Ko latchepen, ap hoi dikom, djal mantsa an o mulengro them tele, un well mantsa khetne an i tchik tchiddo.
Un o Bildad dran Shuach penas koi pre:
Har rah kamenn tumer gomme dureder te rakrell? Rakrenn tumare djijentsa! Un palle kamah mer khetne te rakrell!
Hoske rikreh tu men jaake narwelo har vieche? Hoske ham mer dinelo an tire jaka?
An tiri choli dukreh tut kokres! Patseh, i phub hunte well i mulo them, un i bare barra hunte djan jek rigjatar ap i wawar, te well diklo, kai hal tu an o tchatchepen?
Na-a, o djipaskri momeli o tchilatchestar djal win. Un leskri jag chatchell buder gar.
An leskro kheer well tamlo. Un koi momeli pral leste djal win.
Leskre herja, kolentsa job soreles pre stakras, hi palle buder kek soor an lende. Un job perell pral kowa, hoi las lo pes glan.
Leskre pire taprenn pen an i netsa, un job perell an i tchakedi gruba.
Pandle dorja rikrenn leskro piro soreles un mukenn les gar buder win.
Khatedo ap ko drom, kai lo djal, hi i dori win tchiddo, te taprell lo les.
Trul leste trujel well haki rigjatar bari traash, un lell les palla, kai job ninna stakrell.
I bok lell leske leskri soor krik. I bibacht hi tardo pash leste, har te wals li leskro maal.
O nasslepen chal les pre, i merepaskro nasslepen chal leskre mussja un herja krik.
O merepen tserdell les win dran o kheer, kolestar job patsas, te nai djal leske tchi. Un job well anlo glan koleste, kai hi o rai pral i mulende.
An leskro kheer djiwenn palle kolla, kai gar lestar wenn. Un ap leskro kheer wenn jagakre barra witsedo.
Job hi har i ruk: Tella merell leskro drab tele, un pral wenn leskre patria djelto.
Kek ap i tseli phub djinell gomme, koon job his. Pash hakeneste well lo bistedo.
I phubjatar, kai i djide djiwenn, was lo tradedo an ko tamlo them, kai i mule hi.
Leske atchell kek tchawo, witar kek tchawengro tchawo mank peskre menshende. Kote, kai djiwas lo, atchell kek lendar djido.
Te well o diwes, kai well leskri phagi pral leste, lenn kolla traash, kai kote djiwenn, kai o kham pre djal. Un kolenge atchell o rakepen krik i darjatar, kai kote djiwenn, kai o kham tele djal.
Tchatchepah, jaake djal i tchilatchenge un kolenge, kai kamenn tchi o Deblestar te djinell.
Un o Hiob penas koi pre:
Har rah kamenn tumer mange miro dji te phagell, un man tumare labentsa paash te krell?
Deesh kope praassan man kanna, un ladjenn tumen gar, te dukrenn man.
Ninna te wals man tchatchepah gar tchatches, wals kowa miro koowa.
Tchatchepah, tumer patsenn, te han feteder har me, un kamenn mange te sikrell, te hi miri doosh, hoi anas man an i ladj!
Dikenn tumer gar dren, te hi kowa o Dewel, kai djas gar mishto mantsa trujel? Hi jaake, har te taprals lo man an i netsa.
Te dau win gole ‘Awenn ap miri rig’, shunell man kek. Ninna te dau soreles gole, dell kek man miro tchatchepen.
Ap miro drom tchiwas lo jaake bud barra, te nai djau gar pral wergel. Un job mukell man an o kalepen miro drom te hatsell.
Job las miro tselo brawlepen mandar, ninna miro an-dikepen pash i menshende.
Job dell man khetne haki rigjatar, sik hom gar buder. Job kras, te patsap buder gar ap o latchepen, te dell lo man kowa.
Un peskri choli mukas lo pral mande pre chatchell, un rikrell man har sawo mursheske, kai kamell leske tchilatchepen te krell.
Hi jaake, har te bitchrals job peskre lurden, te djan le ap mande. Jon kran penge i drom pash mande, un tchiwan pen pre trul miro kheer.
Job rikras mire phralen dur mandar krik. Un kolen, kai me latches prindjrom, krenn jaake, har prindjrans le man gar.
Mire menshe wenn gar pash mande, un mire mala bistran man.
Kolla, kai mantsa an miro kheer djiwenn un kol djuwja, kai mange budrenn, an lengre jaka hom har i wi-themari, har jek, koles prindjrenn jon gar.
Te dau gole ap miro budepaskro, shunell lo gar, ninna te mangap les sorjah.
Miro ducho dran miro mui khandell jaake, te rissrell pes miri romni mandar krik. Ninna mire phralenge hom i khand.
Ninna i tchawenge hom tchi moldo. Te kamau me pre te stell, sanenn le pral mande.
Mire latche mala dikenn tele ap mande. Un kolen, kai me o djijestar kamom, sikrenn mange o dumo.
Mire mussja un herja hi sane har kashta. nashrom halauter, kokres miro djipen atchas.
Mire mala, krenn tumare djia mange pre! Awenn mange latches! O Debleskro wast das man!
Hoske lenn tumer man palla har o Dewel kowa krell? Kran tumer mange gomme gar doha duka?
Kamoms, te wans mire laba an i liil tchinlo, te wenn le gar bistedo.
Kamoms, te wenn le i sasteha dino an i baro bar, te atchenn le hako tsireske!
Me djinau, te djiwell o Dewel, kowa, kai miro koowa an peskro wast lell. Un an o tsillo, kai o tchatchepen win rakedo well pral kai phub, hi job miro rakepaskro.
Ninna te hi miro mass jaake dukedo un wom jaake sano, well ko tsiro, kai dikau miro Debles.
Awa, dikau les mire jakentsa. Un job hi mange kek, kai prindjrau gar. Miro dji nashell leste palla.
Te putchenn tumendar: “Har nai lah les palla? Hawo koowa nai anah ap leste pre?”
Palle darenn tumen o charestar! Jek, kai sawi doosh ap peste anell, pral leste well o charo. Palle djinenn tumer, te hi o Dewel o tchatchepaskro mursh.
Un o Zofar dran o them Naama penas koi pre:
Mange djan jaake bud laba an o shero trujel; doleske hunte rakrap me tuha pale:
Tu praassal man tiro tchingepah. Shun, me djinau, hoi te penap tuke koi pre.
Djinal tu gar hako tsiro, jaake rah har i mensho ap kai phub hi,
well koi bachteli gole kol tchilatchendar kokres i tikno tsiro shunlo. Un koi bacht kolestar, kai kamell tchi o Deblestar te djinell, djal sik trujel.
Ninna te well lo jaake baro, te djal lo bis pash o bolepen pre, un leskro shero pral bis pash i wolke,
well lo krik lino, un well pale tchik. Kek tsireske well lo buder hatslo. Un kolla, kai prindjran les putchenn palle: Kai hi lo?
Job djal krik har i suni, un well buder gar hatslo. Har kowa, hoi jek suni das, buder gar koi hi, jaake atchell tchi lestar.
Kolla, kai dikan les, dikenn les buder gar. Kote, kai djiwas lo, hi lo buder gar.
Leskre tchawe hunte denn kowa pale, hoi lengro dad i tchorwelendar tchoras.
Ninna te hi lo gomme terno un sorelo, hunte merell lo, un well an i tchik tchiddo.
An leskro mui hi o tchilatchepen har i gudlo chapen, hoi job khatrell tel peskri tchip,
un rikrell les kote jaake rah har djala, te pijell lo i rah tsiro leskro gudlepen.
Te well ko chapen an leskro per, nashrell lo peskro gudlepen, un well har i sapeskro tchunger, hoi anell o merepen.
Leskro randedo koowa hi har i chapen, hoi hunte tchadell lo pale win. O Dewel lell ko randedo koowa lestar krik.
Ko tchilatcho koowa, hoi lo kras, hi an leste har sapeskro tchunger, un marell les har i tchilatcho sap, kai dandras les.
Job dikell buder tchi o brawlepastar an kau them, ko bud gwin un thud, hoi har lengste panja nashenn.
Kowa, hoi lo peske khetne anas, hunte dell lo pale, un nai rikrell les gar. Un kowa, hoi lo dren paras, krell les gar bachtelo.
I tchorwelen rikras lo tele, un was lenge gar ap i rig. Job tradas menshen dran pengre khera, te lell lo peske kol khera, hoi job gar kras.
An kek tsiro nai las lo doha. Doleske atchell leske ninna tchi fun leskro kutch koowa.
Job chas lauter an peste dren, mukas tchi pral i wawarenge. Doleske atchell leskro shukar djipen gar.
An ko tsiro, kai les an lauter budeder har doha hi, well i daar pral leste. I phari bibacht dell les tele.
Ap ko tsiro, kai krell lo peskro per pherdo, bitchrell o Dewel peskri soreli choli ap leste, un mukell lat har brishin tele ap leste te perell.
Ninna te nai nashell lo glan o sasterno charo, dell les jek tele karje.
Ko failo well an leskro buko karje dino, un dran o dumo djal lo win. Bari traash taprell les.
Leskro tselo kutch koowa well paash kerdo. Un i jag, hoi kek mensho tchiwas, chatchrell les pre, un kolla, kai an leskro kheer pral atchan.
O bolepen rakrell win, hawi doosh job ap peste anas, un i phub hadell pes un penell: Tu hal tchilatcho.
Leskro tselo brawlepen an leskro kheer well krik lino – ap ko diwes, kai well o Debleskri choli pral i tchilatchende har diwje panja.
Kawa hi, hoi o Debles i tchilatchenge hi, kowa, hoi lo lenge glan dikas.
Koi pre penas o Hiob:
Shunenn mishto, hoi penau! Te shunenn tumer man, palle djal mange feteder an miro dji.
Mangau tumen, mukenn man te rakrell! Pal kowa nai sanenn pral mande!
Tchatchepah, miro tchingepen hi gar i mensheha. Ninna te wals jaake, hoske te wap me gar chojedo?
Dikenn ap mande! Un tumer krenn bare jaka i trashatar, un tchiwenn tumaro wast glan o mui!
Te well mange an miro shero, har djungeles mange djal, taprell man i daar, un mukell man te trissell.
Hoske atchenn kol tchilatche djido wenn phuro, un lengri soor well bareder?
Lengre tchawe djiwenn trul lende trujel. Un jon dikenn, har lengre tchawengre tchawe baro wenn.
Jon djiwenn an latchepen an lengre khera kek darjah. Un o Dewel dell len kek phagi.
Lengre gurma stenn ap i grumja, un kolla lenn terne, kolendar kek merell.
I tchilatche bitchrenn lengre tchawen win khelepaske. Un jon stenn trujel har tikne bakre.
Un giwenn pash o bashepen ap i tikne pauke un dorjengre bashepangre, un khelenn bachteles pash o bashepen ap i tikne phurdepangre.
Kol tchilatchen hi i shukar djipen. Un kek dukentsa merenn le, un djan an o mulengro them.
I tchilatche penenn ap o Debleste: “Dja tuke mendar! Mer kamah tchi tire dromendar te djinell.
Koon hi o sorelo Dewel, te budras mer leske? Hoi hi kowa menge moldo, te mangas les an?”
Kal menshe penenn, te hi len pengri bacht an pengre wasta. Me patsau gar, te hi kowa tchatcho, hoi rakrenn jon penge dren.
Gar bud kope meras i tchilatcho, glan te was lo phuro. Gar bud kope was i bibacht pral leste. Gar bud kope anas o Dewel i phagi pral leste an peskri choli,
un phurdas les krik, har phurdell i ducho o phuss krik, un har hidjrell i sorelo phurdepen o tchik krik.
Tumer penenn, te anell o Dewel i phagi pral i tchawende ko tchilatchestar. Me penau: Job hunte dals koi phagi koleste, kai tchilatcho koowa kras, te haiwell job kowa,
un dikell peskre jakentsa peskri bibacht, un haiwell kokres, har kowa hi, te well o sorelo Debleskri choli ap leste.
Hi lo mulo, hi leske jek, har djal leskre tchawenge.
Nai penell i mensho o Debleske, har tchomone hunte well – leske, kai hi o tchatchepaskro rai pral halauterende, ninna pral i pralstunende?
Ko jek merell, te hi lo sasto un sorelo, un djiwell i shukar djipen kek darjah.
Job hi thullo latcho chapastar, un leskre kokale hi sorelo.
Ko wawar merell pal i pharo djipen un dikas kek bacht.
Khetne hi le tel i phub, un i kirme tchakrenn len.
Me haiwau, hawo koowa an tumare sherja trujel djal, un har kamenn man te dukrell.
Tumer penenn: “Hoi was dran o kheer ko rajestar, kai jaake bud tchilatchepen kras?”
Putchan tumer gar kolen, kai ap tumaro drom wan? Patsenn tumer gar, hoi jon dikan un shunan?
Ap ko diwes, kai well i bibacht, kai well o Debleskri choli pral i menshende, atchell o tchilatcho djido.
Kek penell o tchilatcheske an o mui dren, hawo djungelo koowa job kras. Kek dell les ko tchilatchepen pale, hoi lo ap i wawarende kras.
Ap ko diwes, kai well lo ap o handako anlo, denn mursha jak ap leskri grufta.
Te well lo kote anlo, djan bud bud menshe pal leste un glan leste. Un jaake har lo paskedo well, hi kowa leske shukar.
Patsenn tumer, kai tumare laba krenn, te djal mange feteder an miro dji? Tumare laba hi tchi-moldo! Kowa, hoi mange penenn, hi tchi har chochepen!
Un o Elifas ko Temanari penas koi pre:
Nai well kowa, hoi i mensho krell, o Debleske tchomone moldo? Te hi i menshes goswepen, hi kowa leske kokres tchomone moldo.
Te hal tu i latcho un tchatcho mursh, un kek doosh hi ap tute, hi o sorelo Debles tchomone kolestar?
Tchingrell o Dewel tuha, un dell tut i phagi doleske, kai djiweh leha!
Na-a! Tiro tchilatchepen hunte wals baro – doleske krell lo kowa! Kreh tu gar pale te pale tchilatcho koowa?
Har tiro phraal tutar patsas, lal tuke tchomone lestar, te rikress les, bis te job peskri sijaan plaissras. Leskre koola lal lestar, un mukal leske kek an-ripaske.
Koles, kai trush his, dal kek pani. Koles, kai bokas, dal kek maro.
O mursh, koles bud penepaske hi, las peske o them, un o an-diklo djiwell kote dren.
Koi djuwel, kolakro rom meras, bitchral tu tutar krik, un dal lat tchi an o wast. Un djal kol tchawentsa tchilatches trujel, kolengro dad meras.
Doleske djal tuke kanna, har te wals pandlo an i netsa. Un tu trisseh i darjatar, hoi tut ap jek kopo tapras.
Tamlepen hi trul tute, te nai dikeh tchi. Un bare panja djan pral tute.
Hi o Dewel gar dur pre an o bolepen? Dik pre pash i bolepangre momlia, dik, har dur pre kolla hi!
Un tu putcheh: “Hoi nai djinell o Dewel? Hi lo gar khatedo pal kale wolke? Har nai rakrell lo o tchatchepen pral mende win?
Job nashell kote, kai o bolepen un i phub khetne wenn, un pesse wolke hi trul leste, jaake te nai dikell lo tchi.”
Kameh tu o phuro drom te djal, kai i tchilatche pre djan?
Kolla meran, har his le gomme gar phuro – wan krik thodo har i kheer i sorelo panjestar.
Un jon penan ap o Debleste: “Dja tuke mendar!” Un: “Hoi nai krell menge o sorelo Dewel?”
Un job his kowa, kai kras lengre khera pherdo latcho koowa! Hoske i tchilatche sau koowa rakrenna an pengre djia, haiwau me gar.
I latche menshe hi bachtelo, te dikenn le, har lenn i tchilatche pengri phagi, Un kolla, ap kolende kek doosh hi, sanenn pral lende:
“Tchatchepah, halauter, hoi i tchilatchen his, hi paash, Un kowa, hoi pral atchas, chatchras i jag.”
Jaake, ab o Debleha pale an o latchepen! Un ma tchinge leha! Palle well pale bacht an tiro djipen.
Muk tuke dran leskro mui tchomone te penell, un rike leskre laba an tiro dji!
Te weh tu pale pash o sorelo Debleste, krell lo tut pale sorelo. Tchip o tchilatchepen dur krik dran tiro kheer!
Te hi tuke tiro sonakai gar budeder moldo har tchik, tiro latcheder sonakai gar budeder har kol barra an i tikne panja,
palle well tuke o sorelo Dewel har tiro sonakai un kutch rup.
Palle hal bachtelo pral o sorelo Debleste. Un tu hadeh tiro shero pre pash leste.
Tu mangeh les an, un job shunell ap tute. Un tu aneh leste kowa, hoi tu leske sowel dal.
Hoi tu tuke glan lal, kowa djal tuke mishto. Un i momeli djal pre pral tire dromma.
Ap kolende, kai hunte djan i telstuno drom, peneh tu: Stenn pre! Un o Dewel hadell koles pale pre, kai hidjrell peskre jaka gar pre.
Ninna koles, kai doosh ap peste hi, lell lo dran o merepen win, dran kowa, kai tu kek tchilatchepen kreh.
Un o Hiob penas koi pre:
Ninna kau diwes rakrau me dran i dukedo dji. O Debleskro wast hi phares ap mande tchiddo, te hunte lap phares ducho.
Kamoms te djinap, har nai hatsau les, un har nai wau kote, kai lo o tchatchepen win rakrell!
Palle anoms miro koowa glan leste, un penoms leske kowa lauter, hoi nai rakrell mange mishto.
Kamoms te djinap, hoi job koi pre penell, un te shunap, hoi les hi mange te penell.
Tchingrals lo mantsa an peskri bari soor? Na-a, job shunals mishto ap mire laba.
Palle anoms miro tchingepen glan leste, un sikroms, te hom an o tchatchepen tardo. Un o Dewel, miro tchatchepaskro rai, dikals, te hi kek doosh ap mande, un mukals man te djal hako tsireske.
Te rodau me o Debles glan mande, hi lo gar koi, te rodau les pal mande, haiwau me lestar tchi.
Te djau serwes, dikau tchi, hoi job krell, te rissrau man ap i tchatchi rig, dikau les kote witar gar.
Job djinell hawo drom me djau. Dikals lo palla, har djiwau, hatsals lo win, te hom djudjo har sonakai.
Me rikrom mire pire ap leskro drom, un atchom ap leste, un djom gar tele lestar.
Me rikrom man ap hako lab, hoi was dran leskro mui. Un rikrom halauter an miro dji, hoi lo rakras.
Job atchell koon job hi. Koon nai anell les kolestar krik, hoi lo kamell te krell? Kowa, hoi kamell lo te krell, kowa krell lo.
Awa, job krell kowa dureder, hoi les mantsa glan his. Un les hi bud koowa mange an peskro dji.
Doleske taprell man i traash glan leste. Te well kowa mange an o shero, darau soreles lestar.
Awa, o Dewel kras miro dji darenes, o sorelo Dewel kras mange bari traash.
Hi gar i kali rat, witar gar ko tamlepen glan mande, te merap i darjatar. Na-a, darau o Deblestar.
Hoske dell o sorelo Dewel kek tsirja, kai rakrell lo o tchatchepen win pral i tchilatchende? Kolla, kai les prindjrenn, dikenn gar, har un kaana job kowa krell.
O tchilatche tchiwenn kol barra ap i rig, hoi sikrenn har baro jekeskro them hi. Un jon tchorenn bakre un anenn len ap pengro kotar phub.
Jon lenn penge i burika kolendar, kai len kek dad buder hi, un lenn koi grumni kolatar, kolakro rom meras, bis te plaissrell li peskri sijaan.
Jon tradenn i tchorwelen o dromestar tele. Un kolen tchi hi, kolla hunte khatrenn pen lendar.
Jaake har i diwje burike hunte djan le an o mulo tato them, te rodenn le chapen, kote, kai gar bud bares well, te hi len tchomone, hoi denn le pengre tchawen te chal.
Ap i hachetikri phub wawarendar rodenn le djob, hoi pral atchas. Un i drakengre rukendar, hoi i brawelen hi, lenn le penge kol drake, hoi bistedo wan.
An i rati hi len kek koola, te tchakrenn le pen, kek plachta, hoi len tato rikrell an o shil.
Te dell bari brishin an i berge, wenn le sapeno, un hunte beshenn tel i bare barra, te khatrenn le pen glan o brishin.
Tchilatche menshe lenn sorjah i tchorweli dake o ternepen dran i mussja krik, koleskro dad meras. Un jon penenn ap late: ‘Me dau les tuke pale, te plaissral mange tiri sijaan.’
I tchorwele djan trujel, un len hi tchi an-ripaske, un hunte bokenna, ninna te hidjrenn le o khetne pandlo djob.
Mank barra krenn le djet, un stakrenn i drake, te krenn le mool, un koi pashel hunte trushenn le.
An i forja denn kolla gole, kai hi dukedo un merenn. Un o Dewel dell kek jak ap ko narwelo koowa, hoi i tchilatche krenn.
Tchilatche menshe kamenn gar o diwes, un djan gar ap dromma, ap kolende o kham perell. Sawe dromendar djan le tele.
Glan te djal o kham pre, stell o marepaskro pre un marell o tchorweles, koles tchi hi. Un rati djal o marepaskro trujel, te tchorell lo.
Kowa, kai kamell pash o wawareskri romjate te djal, lurell ap i rat. Job penell peske: ‘An i rat nai dikell man kek jak.’ Un tchiwell i diklo glan peskro mui.
An i rat phagenn i tchorepangre an i khera dren. Un te well o diwes, khatrenn le pen, un kamenn gar, te wenn le diklo.
Kali rat hi lenge lauterenge har wawarenge i tsalla. An i rati hi len kek daar.
O tchilatcho well sik krik hidjedo har i patri ap o pani. Ap leskro kotar phub hi i praassepen tchiddo. Pash peskre drakengre ruka djal lo buder gar.
Jaake har o gib krik djal, te well o kham un o tatepen, jaake djan kolla an o mulengro them, kai o Debleskro dromestar tele djan.
Sawes bistrell ninna leskri dai. I kirme chan pen tchales ap leste. Kekeske well lo buder an o shero. Jaake phagell o tchilatchepen khetne har kasht.
Job randas kolatar, kai kek tchawe nai las, kolake kek tchawo boldo was. Un kolake o rom meras, lake kras lo kek latchepen.
Peskri sorjah lell o Dewel o djipen krik kolendar, kai bud penepaske hi. Te stell lo pre, hunte darenn le pengro djipaske.
Job mukell len te patsell, te djal lenge tchi. Un lell hako koowa an o jak, hoi le krenn.
Kol an-dikle wan baro i tikno tsireske. Un ap jek kopo hi le buder gar koi. Jon tchiwenn pengro shero tele har i bluma hoi merell. Un har o shero ap o djob wenn le tele tchinlo.
Hi kowa gar jaake? Koon kamell man kanna i chocheneske te krell, un sikrell, te his kowa gar tchatcho, hoi me penom?
O Bildad dran Shuach penas koi pre:
O Debles hi i soor pral halauter, un hakeno hunte trashell lestar. I sorelo wasteha krell lo, te well kek tchingepen an peskro bolepaskro them.
Kek nai ginell kitse bolepangre lurde les hi. Kek hi koi, pral koleste leskro kham gar pre djal.
Glan o Debleskre jaka hi kek mensho an o tchatchepen tardo. Kek mensho hi erligo glan leste.
Ninna o tchon un i bolepangre momlia hi gar djudjo glan leskre jaka.
Te dikell lo ap i mensheste, hi kowa glan leste gar budeder har i kiri un i kirmo!
Un o Hiob penas koi pre:
Patseh, kau rakepah wal ap i rig mange, i mursheske, koles kek soor buder hi, un kai nai rikrell pes buder gar ap i herja?
Har shukar penal mange, hoi te krap, mange, i mursheske, koles kek goswepen hi! Un sikral mange bud koowa, hoi hunte djinap un haiwap!
Koon penas tuke, te rakress jaake? Koon tchiwas tuke kal laba an o mui?
An o mulengro them, an i panja tel i phub trissenn i mule i darjatar.
O mulengro them hi pre tchakedo tchiddo glan o Debleste. Tchi khatrell les glan leskre jaka.
O Dewel kras o bolepen buchles pral kowa, kai tchi hi, un pandas i phub kote pre, kai tchi hi.
Job pandell o brishin dren an i wolke, un kolla djan gar paash, fothe pharo o pani ninna hi.
Job khatrell peskri beshepaskri pal pesse wolke.
Job tchiwas i bogo pral o baro pani jek rigjatar ap i wawar, te well o diwes un i rati gar khetne.
Te dell o Dewel kol bergen trad, hoi hidjrenn o bolepen, trissenn le i darjatar.
Peskri sorjah kras lo o baro pani, te well lo diwjo, un job haiwas, har nai das lo o Rahab mulo.
Job phurdas i wolke krik, un o bolepen was shukar. Un leskro wast das ko sik panjeskro sap mules tchurje.
Dik, kawa hi tchi har i tikno kotar kolestar, hoi job kras. Un hoi lestar shunam, hi gar budeder har i tikno lab. Kek nai haiwell, har baro leskri soor tchatchepah hi!
Un o Hiob rakras pale un penas kal laba:
O Dewel kras, te lap gar miro tchatchepen. O sorelo Dewel kras miro djipen shutlo. Me dau man sowel pash o djido Debleste:
Jaake rah har an mande gomme djipen hi, un o ducho o Deblestar an miro nak hi,
rakrell miro mui kek chochepen, un miri tchip kokres kowa, hoi tchatcho hi.
An kek tsiro kamau, te dap tumen tchatches. Bis te merau, penau me: ‘Kek doosh anom ap mande.’
Me hom an o tchatchepen. Ap kowa rikrau man soreles, un atchau koi pashel. Kek diwes penell miro dji mange: ‘Kowa hoi kral, his gar mishto.’
Koon kamell mange tchilatchepen, leske te djal har i tchilatchenge! Koon stakrell khatar mande pre, leske te djal har kolenge, kai gar an o tchatchepen hi!
Ap hoi nai rikrell pes kowa, kai kamell tchi o Deblestar te djinell, te well ko tsiro, kai lo hunte merell, un o Dewel leskro djipen lestar lell?
Te well i pharo tsiro pral leste, un job dell gole ap o Debleste, shunell o Dewel palle? Na-a!
Job hi gar sawo mensho, kai hatsell peskri bacht pash o sorelo Debleste, un dell hako tsiro gole ap leste.
Me kamau tumende te sikrell, hoi o sorelo Dewel krell. Kamau win te rakrell, hoi an leskro dji hi.
Tumer dikan kawa lauter ninna! Hoske rakrenn tumer palle sawo dinelo koowa?
Kowa hi koi phagi, hoi dell o sorelo Dewel i tchilatcheske, koleske, kai i wawaren sorjah tele rikras:
Te wenn leskre tchawe ninna bud, merenn bud lendar an o kurepen. Wawaren hi gar doha te chal.
Kolla lendar gomme pral atchenn, kolen marell i djungelo nasslepen. Un lengre romja nai rowan gar pral pengre mule romende.
Ninna te las job peske jaake bud rup khetne har tchik, un bud bud koola an-ripaske,
well i wawar, jek, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi, un hidjrell kol koola. Un ko rup lenn kolla, ap kolende kek doosh hi.
Leskro kheer, hoi lo peske kras, hi gar sorelo tardo – hi har i spinnakri netsa, un har sau patjengro kheer, hoi jek peske kras, kai dell garda ap i kotar phub.
Braweles tchiwell lo pes tele, – i letsto kopo! Te krell lo peskre jaka pale pre, hi buder tchi koi.
I daar well pral leste har i sorelo pani. An i rat lell les i bari phurdepen peha.
I tato sorelo ducho hadell les pre, hidjrell les krik, un phurdell les krik dran peskro kheer.
Ko ducho phurdell ap leste peskri tseli sorjah, un mukell gar tele. Un ko mensho marell pes tele, te nashell lo peske glan leskri soor.
Ko ducho hi har jek, kai dell i wasta pral leste khetne, un dell shol har te sals lo pral leste, kai lo ninna djal.
Tel i phub nai hatsenn le rup. Un o sonakai, les hi i platsa, kai thowenn le les win.
Dur dran i phub lenn le saster win, un lolo saster dran i barra, hoi wenn tato kerdo, te well o lolo saster win.
O mensho lell i momeli peha, te nai budrell lo tel i phub, un rodell kote an i barra, jaake dur har djala, pal kowa, hoi khatedo hi an o tamlepen.

Dur krik fun kotar, kai menshe djiwenn, krenn le i gruba, hoi djal dur tele, kote kai kek mensho ap i raisa djal. Un pandenn pen ap i shello, un mukenn pen tele an koi gruba, dur krik i wawar menshendar.
Pral ap i phub well djob baro. Un tella an i phub rissrenn le lauter trujel, jaake te dikell kowa win har pal i jag.
An kol bare barra an i phub hatsenn le kutch blauete barra, un an i tchik sonakai.
Kek adlari prindjrell o drom pash kol barra, un kek tchirklo, koles i feteder jaka hi.
Kek lewo un kek wawar diwjo viecho djas ap ko drom, hoi kote djal.
O mensho phagell an kol bare sorele barra, un rissrell i tsele berge trujel.
Dren an kol barrengre berge krell lo dromma, un hatsell kote bud kutch koowa.
Job dikell kol tikne panja, hoi wenn dran i phub, un wenn lengste panja. Un ko kutch koowa an i phub, hoi kek dikas, lell lo win, un anell les kote, kai well lo diklo.
Koon nai penell mange, kai nai well o goswepen hatslo? Kai nai hatsah win, har te djiwas i gosewo djipen?
Kek mensho djinell, har bud o goswepen moldo hi. Ap i phub, kai i menshe djiwenn, well lo gar hatslo.
O telstunepen penell: An mande hi lo gar! Un o baro pani penell: Pash mande hi lo witar gar.
I menshe nai ginenn gar o goswepen, nai denn kek rup witar kek sonakai, te plaissrenn le leske.
O goswepen hi budeder moldo har o latcheder sonakai un kutch blauete barra.
O sonakai un kutch glaso hi gar jaake kutch har o goswepen. Witar kek shukar sonakangre tchare nai dell jek, te lell lo o goswepen.
Koralle un kristallo hi gar doha moldo, te ginell jek lentsa o goswepen. Kones goswepen hi, hi brawleder har kones kutch mirklia hi.
Ninna ko kutch djelto bar dran o them Etiopia un ko latcheder sonakai hi gar jaake bud moldo har o goswepen.
O goswepen, fun kai well lo? Un kai nai hatsah mer win, har te djiwas i gosewo djipen?
Khatedo hi lo glan i jaka halauterendar, kai djiwenn. Ninna i tchirkle an o bolepen nai dikenn les gar.
Un an o mulengro them well penlo: Mer shunam mare kandentsa, har was pral leste rakedo.
O Dewel kokres hi kowa, kai djinell o drom, hoi anell pash o goswepen. Un job kokres djinell, kai o goswepen khere hi.
Job hi kowa, kai dikell ap i tseli phub, jaake dur har djal li, un lauter, hoi ap late hi.
Har job o ducho peskri soor das, har lo penas, bis kai ko baro pani nai djal,
har job o brishin peskre tsirja das, un o bolepaskri jag peskro drom sikras,
koi dikas lo, har bud moldo o goswepen hi. Job las les an i jak un penas: O goswepen hi latcho!

Job penas ap o mensheste: Sawo mensho hi gosewo, kai rikrell pes o Debles glan i jaka pash kowa, hoi lo krell. Sawo mensho haiwas, har te djiwell lo o gosewo djipen, kai rikrell pes pale o tchilatchepastar.
Un o Hiob rakras pale un penas kal laba:
Ach, te woms pale har an ko tsiro, hoi pal mande hi, har an kol bersha, kai o Dewel ap mande jak das,
har leskri momeli pral miro shero his, un me jaake an i kali rat nai trujel djom,
har his man gomme miri tseli soor, un o Dewel miro maal his, un jak das ap miro kheer,
har o sorelo Dewel mantsa his, un mire tchawe trul mande his,
har dan mire grumja un busja budeder har doha thud, un mire djeteskre ruka jaake bud djet dan, te nashas lo har pani win dran o bar, kai wan i djeteskre drake tiknes kerdo!
Har djom me pre an o foreskro baro wudar, un beshom man pash i pralstunende,
dikan man i terne un djan ap i rig, un i phure stan pre un atchan tardo.
I pralstune rikran pengre laba pale, un tchiwan pengro wast ap o mui.
Ninna i bare mursha o forestar rakran buder gar, un rikran pengro mui.
Hakeno, kai shunas man, sharas man. Un koon man dikas, rakras latcho koowa pral mande.
Me wom ko tchorweleske ap i rig, kai ap mande gole das. Un ko tchawo, koleskro dad meras, un leske kek buder koi his, koleske homs me koi.
Kolla, kai merans, te woms gar koi, rakran i bacht pral mande win. Un me krom, te giwas o dji kolatar, kolakro rom meras.
Hako tsiro krom, hoi tchatcho hi. Un miro tchatchepen his ap mande, har te wals lo miro ripen un miri stadi.
O koreleske homs me har i jak, un i heri koleske, kai nai nashell gar.
O tchorweleske homs me har i dad, un lom koleskro koowa an o wast, kai i wi-themari his.
I tchilatcheske dom i danda paash, un tserdom koles dran leskro mui, hoi kamas lo te chal.
An ko tsiro patsom, te wau i phuro mursh, un merau an o latcho phurepen mank mire tchawende.
Me homs har i ruk, koleskre draba djan bis pash o pani, un koleskre kashta wenn sapeno haki rat.
Pash i menshende homs hako tsiro an-diklo, un lom pale te pale newi soor.
Jon shunan, hoi man penepaske his. Un rakran tchi, bis te penom lenge, hoi te krenn le.
Pal mande penas buder kek wawar tchomone. Mire laba peran ap lende tele har latcho brishin.
Jon dikan ap mande, te rakrap, har kamenn le, te well brishin. un pijan mire laba, har i hachetikri phub o brishin pijell.
Te his lenge ropaske, som kamles ap lende. Un har dikom latches ap lende, lan le pale newi soor.
Me homs lengro pralstuno, un rodom lenge o drom win. Un djiwom mank lende har i baro rai mashkral peskre lurdende. Un rakrom latches kolentsa, kolenge ropaske his.
Kanna sanenn le pral mande, kolla, kai terneder hi har me, kolengre dada an mire jaka gar doha moldo his, te denn le jak ap mire bakre khetne mire djuklentsa.
Len his buder kek soor an pengre mussja. Hoi wals man kolestar, te budrans le mange?
Tchorwele his le, un i bokatar dandran le ap kowa trujel, hoi le an o mulo diwjo them hatsan, kai kek djiwell.
Kote rodan le pen o londo senlepen khetne mashkral i burra, un chan ninna i draba kol burrendar, hoi kharenn Ginster.
Fun kotar, kai i menshe khetne djiwenn, wan jon win tradedo. Jon dan pal lende gole, har pal i tchorepaskro.
An i barrengre berge, hoi djan ap i rigja i lengsto panjestar dur pre, hi le khere, ninna tel i phub, un mank i bare barra.
Mashkral i burra denn le gole, un tel i subjengre burra wenn le khetne.
Tchi-molde hi le, kolengre laba kek prindjrell, un kai wan win tradedo dran o them.
Un kanna giwenn lengre tchawe sapaskre gilja pral mande. Me wom lenge rakepaske.
Lenge well djungeles glan mande, un rikrenn pen dur krik mandar, un tchungrenn mange an o mui.
O Dewel phagas miri soor, un kras man tiknes. Doleske krenn le mantsa, hoi le kamenn.
Ap miri tchatchi rig hadenn pen tchilatche terne mursha, un stakrenn mange mire herja krik. Un kran mange sawe dromma, te hunte perap ap lende.
Jon kran bare chebja an miro drom, te nashap mange gar. Un kek hi koi, kai len pale rikrell.
Har lurde i foreskri massuri paash krenna, un tel i barra, hoi tele peran, dren wenna, wenn jon pash mande.
Bari daar tapras man. Miro an-dikepen djas peske, har te phurdals les i ducho krik. Un miri bacht djas krik har i wolka.
O djipen an mande nashell krik har pani. Tchilatche diwessa wan pral mande.
Rati dell i duk tchurje an mire kokale. un koi duk, hoi man chal, sowell gar.
Peskri sorjah krell li miri hauta phuro. Koja hi mange har miro gad, hoi mange buchlo trul i meen hi.
Job witsras man an i tchik. Kanna hom me ninna buder tchi har tchik.
Me dau ap tute gole un tu rakreh ap mande gar pale. Me hom kai tardo, un tu deh gar jak ap mande.
Tu wal mange har i tchilatcho, un tiri tseli sorjah leh man palla.
Tu mukeh i ducho te well, hoi hadell man pre un phurdell man krik, un witsrell man pre un tele an i baro phurdepen.
Me djinau kanna, tu kameh man an o mulengro them te anell, kai i tsele djide khetne wenn pal lengro merepen.
Te peras jekeskro kheer khetne, un job hi tchiddo tel i barra, rikrell lo gar peskro wast win? Te well i bibacht pral jekeste, dell lo gar gole?
Me rowom kolenge, kai len sawe phare diwessa his. Un miro dji dukas, har dikom ko tchorweles.
Me patsom, te well latchepen ap mande, un tchilatchepen was. Mire jaka rodan pal i momeli, un kalepen was.
Lauter an mande chatchella, un i duk mukell gar pale. Phare djungele diwessa peran pral mande dren.
Ropah djau me trujel, un kek kham dikau me buder. Kote kai i menshe khetne wenn, stau me pre un dau gole.
Miri gole hi har i gole i diwje djuklendar un kol tchirklendar, kai kharenn Strausse.
Miri hauta was kalo ap mande, un perell mandar tele. Un o fibro chatchell an mire kokale.
Miri dorjengri bashepaskri bashrell kokres ropaskre gilja. Un o bashepen ap miri tikni phurdepaskri hi har o ropen pral jekeste, kai meras.
Me djom i sowel mire jakentsa dren, te dikap gar lubekanes i terni tchake palla.
Te rikroms me gar ap kowa, hoi krals palle mantsa o Dewel an o pralstunepen? Tchatchepah o sorelo Dewel, kai hi an o pralstuno bolepen, dals man kek latcho koowa koleske!
Pral i tchilatcho well bibacht, un koleske, kai krell djungelo koowa, djal tchi mishto.
O Dewel dikell halauter, hoi krau, un djinell, hawo drom mire pire djan.
Djom me i chocheno drom? Rakrom dui tchipjentsa?
Me mangau o Debles, te dikell lo palla an o tchatchepen: Lom me doosh ap mande oder gar? Palle dikell lo, te hom an o tchatchepen tardo.
Te djan mire herja tele leskro dromestar, un te nashas miro dji mire jakenge palla, un te kran mire wasta tchomone, hoi gar mishto hi,
palle kamau djob an i phub te witsrell, un i wawar nai chal kowa, hoi kolestar bares was. Un kowa, hoi mange dran i phub win was, tserdenn palle i wawar dran i phub win.
Te mukas pes miro dji i wawareskri djuwjake dren, un te luroms me ap late pash koleskro wudar,
palle te kerell miri romni i wawareske, un wawar mursha te sowenn lah!
Kowa wals i wi-ladjedo koowa, un i doosh, hoi hunte well glan i tchatchepaskre murshende anlo.
Sawi doosh wals har i jag, hoi man tseles chatchrell, un ninna halauter, hoi man hi, pre chals.
Te doms miro budepaskres – nai well i mursh, nai well i djuwel – gar tchatches an i tchingepen, kai les tchatches his,
hoi kroms me nai palle, te hadals pes miro Dewel pre, un dikals ko koowa palla? Hoi nai penoms me leske?
Job, kai kras man an miri dakro per, hi kowa, kai kras ninna kolen, kai mange budrenn.
Dom me gar o tchorweles kowa, hoi lo mandar mangas? Wom me gar koi djuwjake ap i rig, kolakro rom meras, un kai gar doha djipaske his?
Chom me miro chapen kokres, un dom kolen tchi, kolen buder kek dad his?
Fun tiknes pre dom me ap lende jak, har te woms me lengro dad. Un miro tselo djipen wom kol djuwjenge ap i rig, kolengro rom meras.
Te dikom jekes, kai jaake tchorwelo his, te his les kek ripen, te tatsrell lo pes,
dom me leste koola kerdo dran i balla mire bakrendar, te was leske tato. Un job parkras pes pash mande o tselo djijestar.
An kek tsiro hadom me miro wast pre ap i tchaweste, koles kek dad buder hi, ninna te djinom, te hi halauter ap miri rig, kai his an o foreskro wudar beshdo.
Te kroms me sau koowa, palle mu phagell miri mussi, un win tserdedo well dran miri phik!
Sau koowa nai kroms me gar, me trashau o Deblestar, un hunte daroms, te well leskri choli pral mande!
Miro sonakai was gar miro dewel. Ap leste penom me gar: Tu hal kowa, hoi man hunte well!
Me stom gar i bachtjatar, te was miro brawlepen baro, un mange jaake bud khetne lom.
Me mangom gar o kham an peskro railepen an, witar gar o tchon an peskro shukapen.
Miro dji rissras pes gar tchorchanes pash lende, te witsroms me lenge i wasteskri tchum koi!
Kowa wals i doosh, hoi hunte wals glan o tchatchepangre murshende anlo. Koleha phukroms ap o Debleste an o pralstunepen.
Me wom gar bachtelo koi pral, har djas koleske djungeles, kai mange tchilatchepen kamas. Witar gar dom gole i bachtjatar, har was i bibacht pral leste.
Me anom kek doosh ap mande, te rakroms i bibacht pral leste win, te merell lo.
Na-a, lauter kai pash mande djiwenn, djinenn, hakeno, kai pash mande was, las latches un doha te chal.
Kolla, kai ap pengro drom pash miro wudar wan, kolenge krom me pre. Kek wi-themari hunte sowas win ap o drom.
An kek tsiro kamom miri doosh te khatrell, har wawar menshe krenn.
Man his kek daar kolestar, hoi nai rakrens i menshe pral mande, witar kek traash i ladjatar, hoi nai anens mire menshe ap mande, te penoms doleske tchi, un djoms gar glan miro wudar.

Ach, te wals jek koi, kai ap mande shunell! Hoi penom, tel kowa nai tchinau miro lab. O sorelo Dewel te rakrell pale! Kai hi ko liil, an koleste kowa miri doosh pre-tchinas, kai penell, te lom doosh ap mande?
Tchatchepah me hadaus kau liil ap miri phik pre, un hidjraus les har i rajeskri stadi ap miro shero.
Me penaus leske hako koowa, hoi krom an miro djipen, un har i rai waus me glan leste.
Te das miri hachetikri phub gole pral mande, un leskri tchik hunte rowas,
te chom ko djob, un plaissrom koleske tchi, un mukom i hachen i bokatar te merell,
palle te well buder kek gib un djob win dran miri phub! Na-a, palle te anell i phub subjengre burra un djungelo senlepen win! Kate herell o Hiobeskro rakepen pre.
Un kol triin mursha penan buder tchi pale ap o Hiob doleske, kai his job an peskre jaka an o tchatchepen tardo.

Kote was i choli an o Elihu, koleskro dad o Barachel his i menshendar, kai kharenn Busarja, dran i familja Ram. O Elihu was chojedo doleske, te patsas o Hiob, te wals job budeder an o tchatchepen har o Dewel.
Ninna was lo chojedo pral o Hiobeskre triin mala: Ninna te hatsan jon tchi, hoi nai penenn le o Hiobeske pale, patsan le, te his doosh ap leste.
O Elihu rikras pes o tselo tsiro pale peskro rakepah, bis te rakran kol wawar o Hiobeha. Jon his phureder har job.
Har job kanna dikas, te his len tchi buder te penell, mukas lo peskri choli win.
Un o Elihu, koleskro dad o Barachel his, ko Busari, penas: Me hom terno. Tumer han phure mursha. Doleske darom tumenge te penell, hoi djinau.
Me penom mange: Muk i phuren te rakrell. Jon hi kolla, kai nai sikrenn, hoi goswepen hi.
Hi tchatcho, kowa, hoi krell i menshes gosewo, hi o ducho o sorelo Deblestar, koles job an i mensheste dren tchiwas.
I phure hi gar hako tsiro i gosweder. Lengro phurepen krell gar, te djinenn le, hoi tchatcho hi.
Doleske penau me: Shunenn kanna, hoi man penepaske hi! Me kamau ninna te sikrap, hoi djinau.
Me mukom tumen win te rakrell, un dom jak hawe laba tumer hatsans, un har tumer kau koowa dikenn.
Un me shunom mishto, hoi penan. Un kek his mank tumende, kai nai sikrals o Hiobeste, te his les gar tchatcho. Kek penals leske ap leskro rakepen tchomone pale.
Ma penenn: “Mer hatsam win, hoi goswepen hi. Kowa hi o Dewel, kai hunte sikrell leste leskri doosh, un kek mensho!”
Ap mande rakras o Hiob gar. Un me rakrau witar gar kol labentsa, hoi tumer rakran ap leste pale.
Hiob, tire triin malenge atchas o rakepen krik. Jon djinenn buder gar, hoi te penell tuke.
Har nai rikrap man kanna pale, kai jon gar buder dureder rakrenn? Kote hi le tardo un nai penenn tchi pale.
Me kamau ninna te penell, hoi me djinau, un kowa, hoi me haiwom, tumenge dureder te dell.
Man hi bud laba te penell. Me nai rikrau gar mire laba pale, hoi an mande hi un win kamenn.
Te nai rakrau gar, djal mange har i moljakro gono, kai newi mool dren hi, hoi nai well gar win, un o gono pre phagell.
Me hunte rakrap, te nai lap pale ducho. Awa, kamau win te rakrell, hoi kamau tumenge te penell.
Me wau ap kekeskri rig tardo, un kek mensheske rakrau pal o mui.
Me haiwau man gar koi pre, te rakrap jekeske pal o mui. Te kroms kowa, lals kowa, kai mange miro djipen das, sik miro djipen pale mandar krik.
Tut Hiob mangau, shun miro rakepen, un de jak, hoi man tuke penepaske hi!
Dik, me krom miro mui pre, un mire laba hi mange ap i tchip tchidde.
Mire laba wenn dran miro dji, un hi tchatcho. Kowa hoi djinau, rakrau i djudjo djijeha.
O ducho o Deblestar kras man. Awa, o ducho o sorelo Deblestar das man o djipen.
Pen mange pale, te haiweh kowa! Muk tuke an o shero te well, hoi kameh glan te anell, un stake glan mande!
Dik, glan o Debleste hom me jaake bud har tu hal. Un me ninna hom dran i tchik kerdo.
Tut hunte well kek daar mandar. Un miro wast well gar phares ap tute tchiddo.
Tu rakral glan mire kanda. Un me shunom kol laba dran tiro mui, har tu penal:
“Me djiwom i djudjo djipen, un krom kek tchilatcho koowa. Kek doosh hi ap mande. O tchatcho dromestar djom gar tele.
O Dewel anell tchomone ap mande pre, hoi me gar krom. Job rikrell man har sawo mursheske, kai kamell leske tchilatchepen te krell.
Job tchiwell mire pire an shelle, un dell jak ap hako drom, kai me djau.”
Dik, Hiob, me hunte penap tuke, kate hal tu gar an o tchatchepen. O Dewel hi bareder har i mensho.
Hoske hal tu chojedo leha, te rakras lo tchi pale ap kowa, hoi penal?
Pale te pale rakrell job, jek kopo jaake, un jek kopo jaake. Un mer menshe dah gar jak koi pre.
An i rat, te perell o sopen ap i menshende, dell lo len sunja. Te hi le tchiddo ap pengro tchiben,
krell lo lenge i kanda pre, te denn le pen jak. Un soreles dell lo len trad,
te anell lo len tele pengro tchilatcho dromestar, un te rikrell lo len pale, te wenn le pre-phurdo.
Jaake rikrell lo o menshes pale, te nashrell lo gar peskro djipen, un merell.
Nai well, te bitchrell o Dewel i mensheske duka, te dell lo les jaake trad – sawe duka, hoi witsrenn les ap o tchiben un djan leske an leskre tsele kokale.
Un leske well djungeles glan o chapen, ninna glan ko chapen, hoi lo jaake kamas.
Job well sano, kek mass hi buder ap leskre kokale, jaake te stakrenn i tsele kokale glan.
Job hi gar dur o merepastar un o themestar, kai i mule hi.
Te well palle i bolepaskres pash leste, kowa ap leskri rig hi, jek kol serjendar, kolen o Dewel win bitchrell, te penenn le menge, hoi menge mishto hi,
palle krell o bolepaskro peskro dji leske pre, un penell ap o Debleste: “Le les win, te hunte djal lo gar tele pash i mulende. Me hatsom leske i lowe, hoi les dran o merepen win ginenn.”
Pale lell lo pale newi soor, well sasto un sorelo, har an ko tsiro, kai lo terno his.
Job mangell o Debles, un kowa dikell latches ap leste, un mukell les bachteles glan peste te well. Un o Dewel tchiwell les pale an o tchatchepen.
Ko mensho giwell palle glan i menshende un penell: “Me lom doosh ap mande, un rissrom mange o tchatchepen jaake har me kamom. Un miro Dewel mukas kowa gar ap miro shero pale te well.
Job las miro djipen win dran o merepen, te djap gar pash i mulende. Un me hom bachtelo te atchom djido.”
Dik, kawa lauter krell o Dewel dui, triin kope an o djipen i menshestar,
te anell lo leskro djipen tele ko dromestar, hoi anell an o mulengro them, un te well lo pale bachtelo pral peskro djipen.
Dik Hiob, shun ap mande! Ma rake tu, muk man te rakrell!
Te hi tut tchomone te penell, palle pen mange ap kawa tchomone pale. Rake, kamoms o djijestar, te dap tut tchatches!
Te hi tut tchi te penell, palle shun tu ap mande un ma rake, te sikrap tute, har te wess gosewo.
Un o Elihu rakras pale un penas:
Tumer gosewe mursha, shunenn miro rakepen! Tumer, kai sikle han, shunenn, hoi kamau tumenge te penell.
Jaake har o mui haiwell, hi o chapen latcho oder gar, jaake hunte hatsell o kand win, hi ko rakepen mishto oder gar.
Mer te hatsas kanna khetne win, hoi an kau koowa tchatcho un mishto hi.
O Hiob penas: “Me hom an o tchatchepen tardo. Un miro tchatchepen las o Dewel mandar krik.
Hunte rakrap chochepen un penap: Me lom doosh ap mande? Mange was i baro dukepen dino, ninna te hi kek doosh ap mande.”
Koon hi sawo mursh har o Hiob, kai rikrell pes gar pale te praassell lo i wawaren? Kowa hi leske har te pijals lo pani.
Un jaake hi lo har jek kolendar, kai djungelo koowa krenn, un djal ap o drom, kai i tchilatche djan.
Job penas kokres: Tchi hi jekes kolestar, te kamell lo o Debleskro maal te well!
Doleske, tumer mursha, kai jaake bud haiwenn, shunenn ap mande! An kek tsiro krell o sorelo Dewel i tchilatcho koowa. Hako tsiro hi lo an o tchatchepen tardo!
Job dell o menshes ap o shero pale, hoi job kras, un jaake, har djiwas lo, well kowa ap leste.
Tchatchepah, o sorelo Dewel krell kek tchilatcho koowa, un o tchatchepen rissrell lo gar trujel.
Koon his, koon les i phub an leskre wasta das? Kek! Job kras i phub. Kek hi pral leste tardo.
Te lals job peske glan, te lell lo peskro djipaskro ducho palpale o menshestar,
palle merans halauter, hoi djiwenn, ap jek kopo, un o mensho wals pale tchik.
Hiob, te haiweh, hoi penau, palle shun kawa! De mishto jak ap miro rakepen!
Nai wals o Dewel o rai pral i phub, te stakrals lo peskre pirentsa ap o tchatchepen? Kameh doosh ap o sorelo Debleste te anell, kai hako tsiro an o tchatchepen tardo hi?
Job nai penell ap i baro rajeste ‘tu tchi-moldo’ un ap i pralstuneste ‘tu tchilatcho’!
Job dikell gar i pralstunes feteder an har i wawares, un tserdell o braweles gar o tchorweleske glan. Leskro wast kras len halauter.
Ap jek kopo merenn le. Mashkral an i rat trissenn le un hi gar buder. Kol sorele wenn krik lino kek mensheskro wasteha.
O Dewel lell hako koowa an o jak, hoi i mensho krell, un dikell les, kai lo ninna djal.
Kek rat un kek kalepen hi jaake tamlo, te nai khatrans pen i tchilatche kote dren.
O Dewel hunte tchiwell kek tsiro dren, te anell lo i menshes glan peste, te rakrell lo o tchatchepen pral leste win.
Job dell i sorele rajen khetne, un hunte hatsell gar win, hoi jon kran. Ap lengri platsa tchiwell lo wawaren.
Tchatchepah, job djinell ko koowa, hoi le kran. Rati mukell lo len te perell, te wenn le khetne stakedo.
Ap i platsa, kai i tchilatche pengri phagi lenna, un hakeno nai dikell len, dell lo len lengri phagi.
Kowa krell lo doleske, kai djan jon leskro dromestar tele, un dan gar jak ap kowa, hoi job lendar kamas.
Jon djan jaake tchilatches i tchorwelentsa trujel, te dan jon gole ap o Debleste. Un job shunas koi gole kolendar, kai tele rikedo wan.
Te rikrell pes o Dewel pale, nai penell kek leske: ‘Tu anal doosh ap tute!’ Te khatrell lo pes, nai dikell les kek. Hoi nai krenn i menshe, hoi nai krell i natsjona,
te tchiwals o Dewel i tchilatches pral lende, te well lo lengro rai, un kowa anell len o tchatcho dromestar tele?
I mensho hunte penals ap o Debleste: “Me hidjrau miri doosh, un kamau buder gar tchilatcho koowa te krell.
Sike tu man, hoi me gar dikau! Te his kowa tchilatches, hoi me krom, krau me les palle buder gar.”
Kameh, te anell o Dewel ap saweste i phagi? Kameh tu kowa gar? Tu hunte peness, hoi kameh, un gar me. Pen menge kanna, har kau koowa dikeh!
Gosewe mursha un sawe, kai haiwenn bud, un shunan, hoi penom, kolla penenn ap mande:
O Hiob djinell gar, hoi lo rakrell. Un leskre laba sikrenn, te haiwas lo gar bud.
Kamoms, te wals o Hiob glan i tchatchepangre murshende anlo, te lenn jon hakenes leskre labendar an o jak, hoi job rakras, Job rakrell har i tchilatche rakrenna.
Gar kokres doosh anas lo ap peste, na-a, job hadas pes ninna pral o Debleste. Glan mare kanda krell bare laba un rikrell o Debles dineleske.
Un o Elihu penas palle:
Patseh, te hi kowa tchatcho, hoi penal? Tu penal: “Me hom an o tchatchepen glan o Debleste.”
Un tu putcheh: “Hoi hi man kolestar, te lau kek doosh ap mande? Hawo latchepen lom koleske?”
Kowa kamau tuke te penell, tuke un tire malenge pash tute:
Dik pre, dik an o bolepen pre! Dik ap i wolke dur pral tute!
Koi doosh, hoi tu ap tute leh, kolah nai kreh tu tchi ap o Debleste. Te kral bud tchilatcho koowa, nai kreh tu leske tchi koleha.
Te hal tu an o tchatchepen tardo, hoi hi les kolestar? Na-a, tu nai deh leske tchi dran tiro wast, hoi leske tchomone moldo hi.
Kolla hi i wawar menshe, kolenge kowa djungeles hi, te kreh tchilatcho koowa, un kolenge kowa latcho hi, te kreh latcho koowa.
Te krenn i sorele i wawarenge bud tchilatcho koowa, rowenn kolla, un denn gole pal jekeste, kai lell len win dran i wasta kol sorelendar.
Un kek lendar putchell pal o Debleste, kai les kras. Un job hi kowa, kai krell, te nai giwell i mensho gilja an i kali rat.
Job kras, te djinas mer budeder har i vieche ap i phub, un kras men gosweder har i tchirklen tel o bolepen.
Te denn i tchilatche palle gole, kolla, kai pen jaake bares kran, penell o Dewel lenge tchi pale.
Lengri gole hi tchitcheske! O sorelo Dewel shunell lat gar, un dell kek jak koi pre.
Tu Hiob peneh, tu nai dikeh les gar! Tiro koowa hi glan leste tchiddo. Muk gar tele, te dikess ap leste!
Tu peneh, o Dewel mukell peskri choli gar te well. Dell lo witar gar jak ap o narwelo rakepen?
O Hiob hi i baro mujeskro, job rakrell, hoi tchi-moldo hi, krell bare laba, un djinell gar, hoi lo rakrell.
