Un o Elihu rakras dureder un penas:
Rike gomme i tikno tsiro mantsa win, un me kamau tuke budeder te sikrell! Man hi tchomone budeder te penell o Deblestar.
Me sikrau tuke ko bud koowa, hoi me djinau, te sikrap, te hi kowa tchatcho un mishto, hoi kras o Dewel, kowa, kai man kras.
Tchatchepah miro rakepen hi kek chochepen. I mursh, kai djinell, kolestar job rakrell, hi glan tute tardo.
O Dewel hi baro un sorelo, un dikell ap kekeste tele. Koi hi tchi, hoi haiwell un djinell job gar.
Job mukell o tchilatches gar djides, un well koleske ap i rig, kai tele rikedo well, te lell job peskro tchatchepen.
Job dell jak ap kolende, kai hi an o tchatchepen tardo, un mukell len khetne i rajentsa ap rajengre beshepangre te beshell. Hako tsiro hi le baro.
Te hi le pandles tchiddo an shelle, un lenge djal djungeles an o stilepen,
palle sikrell job len, hoi le kran, un hawi doosh jon ap pende anan, har phurdan le pen pre.
Un job krell lenge i kanda pre, te shunenn le, har job len trad dell. un penell lenge, te mukenn le pengre tchilatche dromma.
Te shunenn le ap leste, un krenn, hoi job lendar kamell, palle djal lenge mishto, un jon hi bachtelo an kol tsele bersha, hoi glan lende hi.
Te shunenn le gar ap leste, nashrenn le pengro djipen, un haiwenn gar, hoske kowa lenge jaake djal.
Kolla, kai kamenn tchi o Deblestar te djinell, rikrenn pengri choli an lengre djia. Ninna te dell o Dewel len i phagi, denn le gar gole, te well lo lenge ap i rig.
Doleske merenn le an ladj, an i tsiro, kai hi le gomme terno.
Phare tsirja un duka hi ko Debleskro drom, har rakrell o Dewel i mensheha. Koi krell lo leske i kanda pre, te shunell lo ap leste.
Ninna tut anals o Dewel win dran i bibacht, un anals tut kote kai buder kek daar hi, un dals tut lauter, hoi tut hunte well djipaske. Un tumari chapaskri wals pherdo latcho koowa.
Kanna lal tu i phagi har i tchilatche lenna. I tchatchepaskre laba hi win rakedo pral tute, un tiri phagi was.
De jak, te anell tut tiri choli gar ap i djungelo drom! O Debles nai gineh tu gar, kitse lowe tu ninna deh!
Tiro brawlepen un tiro sonakai hi gar doha. Witar gar kowa, hoi tu tiri sorjah nai kreh.
Ma pen: Mu well sik rati! Kowa hi o tsiro, kai i natsjone ap jek kopo buder gar koi hi.
De tu jak, te wess gar ap i tchilatcho drom! Tire duka wan ap tute, te rikress tu tut pale o tchilatchepastar.
Dik, har baro o Dewel hi! Leskri soor hi bareder har halauter! Koon hi i sikepaskro har job?
Kek nai penell leske, hoi te krell lo! Kek nai penell leske: Hoi kral, hi gar mishto.
Ma biste, te sharess o Debles koleske, hoi job kras, har ninna wawar menshe sharenn les pengre giljentsa!
I tsele menshe dikenn ap kowa, hoi lo kras, ninna te nai dikenn le les kokres fun dural.
Dik, o Dewel hi jaake baro, te nai haiwah gar, har baro job hi. Un kek nai hatsell win, har phuro job hi.
Job tserdell o pani pre pash o bolepen, un lell les khetne, te well brishin,
hoi tele perell dran o bolepen ap kol bud menshende.

Jaake dell lo lenge budeder har doha te chal. Kek nai haiwell, har o Dewel i wolken ap o bolepen tchiwas, un har well koi bari gole dran leskro bolepaskro kheer, te dell i jag ap o bolepen karje trul leste trujel. O telstunepen o baro panjestar atchell an o tamlepen.
An leskro wast rikrell lo koi jag, un mukell lat kote karje te dell, kai job kamell.
Koi bari gole, hoi well koi pashel, sikrell, te well i sorelo phurdepen. Un ninna i vieche haiwenn kowa.
Koi pral trissell miro dji, un dell sik un diwjo.
Shunenn, har bares job gole dell, har chojedo koja gole dran leskro mui well!
Tel o tselo bolepen mukell lo koi jag karje te dell, un koja djal pral i tseli phub jek rigjatar ap i wawar.
Pal kowa well koi bari soreli gole shunlo, hoi hi har o baro Debleskro rakepen. Un job rikrell peskri jag gar pale, te mukell lo peskro rakepen te shunell.
Te mukell o Dewel peskro rakepen te shunell, krell lo kowa sawi bari goljah, te atchell menge o rakepen krik. Job krell baro koowa, hoi nai haiwah mer gar.
Ap o gib penell lo: Pere ap i phub! Ap i wolke: De sorelo brishin!
Jaake krell lo, te mukenn i menshe pengri budi tchiddo, te dikell hakeno, hoi job nai krell.
I diwje vieche djan an pengro khatepen, un tchiwenn pen kote tele.
O sorelo phurdepen well fun tchatches dran peskro kheer, un o shil well fun serwes.
Dran o ducho, hoi dran o Debleskro mui win djal, djajell o pani. Un kol buchle bare panja wenn sorelo har bar.
Job krell i wolke pharo un pherdo pani, un dran lende dell i jag karje.
Kol wolke djan kate te kote, jaake har job len bitchrell, te krenn le halauter jaake, har job les kamell ap i tseli phub.
Nai well, te bitchrell lo o brishin, te dell lo o themes i phagi, ninna nai well, te bitchrell lo les, te sikrell lo peskro latchepen.
Hiob, shun kawa mishto! Atch, un de jak ap kowa, hoi o Dewel an peskri soor krell!
Djineh tu, har o Dewel i wolkenge penell, kai te djan le? Un har lo i jag dran lende karje win dell?
Haiweh tu, har i wolke tel o bolepen djan, un gar tele perenn? Sawo koowa nai krell kokres kowa, kai halauter djinell.
Tu, koleske tel i koola tato well, te phurdell i tato ducho pral o them,
nai kreh tu o bolepen buchles pral i phub, har job kowa kras, te well o bolepen soreles har i dikepaskri?
Pen tu menge, hoi penas mer leske? Mer djinah tchi. Un men hi tchi, te anas glan leste!
Penell jek leske: Dik, kate hi jek, kai kamell tuha te rakrell? Na-a! Kowa wals jaake, har te kamals lo maredo te well.
Kanna nai dikell kek an o kham, jaake sorelo hi o kham, te phurdas o ducho i wolke krik.
Fun kotar, kai norden hi, well tchomone har sonakai. O Dewel well an peskro railepen. Ko railepen trul leste krell men daar.
Pash leste, ko soreleste, nai wah mer gar. Leskri soor hi baro. Hako tsiro krell lo, hoi mishto hi, un dell hakeneske peskro tchatchepen.
Doleske dikenn i menshe pre ap leste. Job dikell kekes an, kai rikrell pes jekeske, kai hi gosewo.
Palle rakras o baro Dewel o Hiobeha dran i baro phurdepen win, un penas ap leste:
Koon hal tu, te putcheh dineles: Hi kowa gosewo, hoi o Dewel krell?
Kanna ste pre har i mursh! Un me putchau tutar. Un tu peneh mange, hoi kamau te djinell.
Kai hals tu, har me i phub krom? Pen les mange, te djineh les tu?
Koon his, kai penas, har bares i phub well? Koon his kowa, kai tchiwas i dori pral late, te dikell lo, har bares i phub well? Djineh tu kowa?
Ap hoi hi kol hidjepangre tardo, hoi hidjrenn i phub? Koon tchiwas ko telstuno bar, hoi rikrell i phub ap peskri platsa?
Har lo tchiddo was, giwan i tsele bolepangre momlia, hoi tsalla pre djan, un i bolepangre dan gole i bachtjatar.
Har o baro pani win phagas dran i phub, koon pandas les dren, te djal lo gar pral o tselo them?
Me homs kowa, kai leske i ripen dran wolke kras, un kale wolke pral leste tchiwas.
Un me sikrom leste, har dur, un bis kai job nai djal, un krom leske wudja un pandom les dren.
Un me penom: “Bis kate, un gar dureder wess! Tire sorele panja hunte djan gar pral wergel!”
Penal tu jek kopo an tiro djipen ap i tsalla: “Ab pre!” Un sikral tu lake lakri platsa?
Penal lake, te djal li pral i tseli phub jek rigjatar ap i wawar, jaake te nashenn penge i tchilatche un khatrenn pen?
Te djal o kham pre, wenn i berge un tale mishto diklo. Un i phub hi tardo shukar an-rido.
Te well diwes, nai krenn i tchilatche buder kek tchilatcho koowa an o tamlepen, un nai dukrenn buder gar wawar menshen.
Hals tu an o telstunepen kai i bare panja boldo wan? Un hatsal win, hoi kote khatedo hi an o telstunepen?
Hals tu tardo pash i wudja an o mulengro them? Un dikal tu i wudja glan koi platsa, kai hi baro kalepen.
Djineh tu, har dur un buchlo i phub hi? Pen les mange, te djineh kowa lauter!
Kai hi ko drom, ap koleste weh pash o kham? Kai hi koi platsa, kai o kalepen hi?
Nai aneh tu len ap pengre dromma, un pale khere ap lengri platsa, kai le win djan.
Tu djiness kowa lauter, jaake phuro har hal, un boldo hals, har kowa krom!
Wal tu jaake dur, kai garau o gib pre? Dikal, kai rikrau i brishineskre barra i tsireske hoi wella?
Kolla rikrau pale ko tsireske, kai duka, kurepen un marepen wenna.
Kai hi ko drom kote, kai dell i jag karje ap o bolepen? Un kai phurdell ko ducho win, hoi well fun kotar, kai o kham pre djal?
Koon kras i drom o brishineske, kai perell lo tele? Koon kras ko drom, kai o bolepaskri jag pre te tele karje dell?
Koon dell o brishin ap o mulo tato them, kai kek mensho djiwell,
te lell o diwjo them, kai tchi bares was, pani, jaake te well senlepen win.
Hi o brishin har i mensho, koles i dad hi? Un ko pani, hoi haki tsalla ap o senlepen tchiddo hi, hi koles i dad?
Dran koneste win was o djajedo pani? Koon hi leskri dai? Konestar was o shil boldo, hoi well tele dran o bolepen,
un krell, te well o pani har bar, un o baro pani jaake soreles, te nai stakrell jek pre?
Pandal tu nai i bolepangre momlia khetne, kai kharenn ‘efta momelengre’? Nai pandeh tu i dorja pre, hoi rikrenn kol momlia khetne, hoi kharenn Orion?
Nai mukeh tu i bolepangre momlia win te well, te hi lengro tsiro? Nai sikreh tu kolende, hoi kharenn ‘Baro Wurdun’ un ‘Tikno Wurdun’ pengro drom, hoi le hunte djan?
Prindjreh tu kol laba, ap kolende o bolepen shunell? Peneh tu leske, har te well lo rai pral i phub?
Deh tu ap i wolke gole, te tchorenn le brishin ap tute tele?
Bitchreh tu o bolepaskri jag tele ap i phub, un putchell koja tutar: Kai kameh, te dap pre te tele karje?
Koon tchiwas o goswepen kote, kai lo khatedo hi? Un koon krell, te nai haiwell i mensho tchomone?
Koon hi jaake gosewo, te djinell lo, har bud wolke koi hi? Koon tchorell lengro pani ap i phub tele?
Palle well dran i stauba soreli tchik, un i pre-phagedi phub well pale jek tselo kotar phub.
Te hi i lewetsa un lakre tchawe an o khatepen tchiddo un lurenn ap i viecho, nai hatseh tu lake jekes marepaske, te wenn lakre tchawe tchalo?
Koon hi kowa, kai dell o korakeske leskro chapen, te denn leskre tchawe pash o Debleste gole, un i bokatar kate te kote nashenna?
Prindjreh tu o tsiro, kai i diwji busni peskro ternepen lell? Dikal tu, har i wesheskri grumni peskro ternepen las?
Nai peneh tu, kitse tchonna jon hunte hidjrenn, un djineh o tsiro, kai le pengro ternepen ap i phub anenn?
Jon beshenn tele, te perell o ternepen gar ap i phub, te well lo boldo.
Lengre tchawe wenn bares win ap o them, un wenn soreles, un djan penge, un wenn gar buder pale pash lende.
Koon mukas i diwji burika kote te nashell, kai li kamell, un pandas lat gar dren?
Me dom lat i diwjo truk them, te hi li kote khere, un ko londo them, te djiwell li kote.
Koi diwji burika rikrell pes dur krik koi bari goljatar, hoi krenn le an i forja, un hunte shunell gar ko murshes, kai dell gole: Sikeder! Sikeder!
Koi diwji burika hatsell peskro chapen ap i berge, un rodell pal halauter, hoi senelo hi.
Kamell o diwjo gurum tuke te budrell, kamell lo rati kote te atchell, kai tu tire viechenge chapen deh?
Nai pandeh tu leske i shello trujel, te budrell lo tuke ap i hachetikri phub, un tserdell ko saster, hoi i phub pre phagell?
Fothe sorelo job hi, nai deh tu leske tiri budi an o wast, un nai djineh, te krell lo, hoi tu lestar kameh?
Nai patseh leske, te anell lo tiro djob khere ap tiri djobeskri platsa?
Bachteles dell koi bari kachni, hoi kharell straussa, peskre mussjentsa. Lakre mussja hi gar har kol mussja un phora, kolen o storcho hi.
I straussa mukell peskre jare ap i phub tchiddo, an koi tchik mukell li len tates te well.
Un joi bistrell, te nai stakrell i heri len khetne, un te nai stakrenn i diwje vieche len paash.
Joi djal pengre tchawentsa jaake soreles trujel, har te wans jon gar latar. Te merenn le, un joi peskre jare tchitcheske tchiwas, krell kowa lake ninna tchi win.
O Dewel das lat kek goswepen, un kras, te haiwell li tchi.
Te hadell li pes un nashell, hi li sikeder har i grai un leskro klissepaskro, un nai sal pral lende.
Dal tu o grajes peskri soor? Tchiwal tu lengste balla pral ap leskri meen?
Dal tu leske i soor, te stell lo har i stepaskro? Te phurdell lo soreles win dran peskro nak, darenn i menshe.
O grai stakrell peskre herjentsa an i phub, un hi bachteles pral peskri soor, te nashell lo an o kurepen.
O grai prindjrell kek daar, un lell kek traash, un djal glan o charo gar pale.
Ap leskri rig hi i possita, an kolate stenn i faile, un i lengste tchurja dikenn win har jag, te perell o kham pre.
Te shunell o grai i phurdepaskri, witsrell lo pes bari sorjah glan, un mukell pes gar tele te rikrell.
Hako kopo, kai shunell lo i phurdepaskri, dell lo pre gole: Hui-i! Un sungell o kurepen fun dural – koi kurepaskri gole i lurdendar un lengre pralstunendar.
Sikral tu o baro tchirkles, har djal lo dur pre an o bolepen, un har te krell lo peskre mussja buchlo un djal kote, kai o kham pralstunes tardo hi?
Penal tu ap o adlari, te djal lo dur pre ap i berge, te krell lo kote peskro kheer?
Ap i bare barra hi lo khere, pral pre ap i berge un bare barra djiwell lo.
Fun kotar dikell lo tele, un rodell peskro chapen. Fun dural dikenn les peskre jaka.
Leskre tchawe trushenn pal rat, un kote, kai i mule tchiddo hi, kote hi job ninna.
Un o baro Dewel putchas o Hiobes:
Tu kameh tut mantsa te tchingrell – mantsa, kai o sorelo Dewel hom? Tu, kai doosh ap mande hatsal, un mange penal, hoi gar mishto krom, pen kanna tchomone kai pre!
Un o Hiob penas ap o baro Debleste:
Dik, me hom tchi moldo! Hoi penap me tuke? Me tchiwau miro wast ap miro mui.
Jek kopo rakrom, un me kamau tchi buder te penell. Un dui kope rakrom, un me kamau les gar buder te krell.
Un o baro Dewel rakras pale o Hiobeha dran i baro phurdepen win, un penas ap leste:
Kanna ste pre har i mursh! Un me putchau tutar. Un tu peneh mange, hoi kamau te djinell.
Kameh tu tchatchepah te penell, me djau gar pal o tchatchepen? Peneh, te anom me doosh ap mande, te nai wess tu koi tardo, har te wals tut tchatches?
Hi tut sawi bari soor har man? Nai rakreh tu sawi sorjah har me?
Sike, har baro un an-diklo hal! Muk tut an tiro shukapen un railepen te dikell!
Tchore tiri tseli choli win, dik ap lauterende, kai pre-phurdo hi, un witse len tele!
Awa, dik ap kol pre-phurde, un kre len tiknes! Un stake i tchilatchen ap jek kopo khetne!
Paske len halauteren an i phub, un pande len dren an o mulengro them!
Te kral tu kowa lauter, palle sharau ninna me tut, un penau, te das tiro tchatcho wast tuke i soor, te hal tu o sorleder.
Dik ap ko baro viecho, o Behemot, koles me krom, har me tut ninna krom! Job chal senlepen har i grumni.
Dik, hawi bari soor les an peskre herja hi, un hawi soor an leskro per!
Leskri pori hi jaake sorelo har i zedertikro ruk. Leskre muskle an leskre herja hi sorelo har pesse shelle.
Leskre herja hi har dran saster, leskre kokale har dran lolo saster.
Job his o glanstuno kol viechendar, hoi krom. Me, kowa kai les kras, das les ninna leskro charo.
Ap i berge well o senlepen baro, hoi leske chapaske hi, kote, kai i tsele diwje vieche penge khelenn.
Tel subjengre burra tchiwell lo pes tele, un khatrell pes mank shilftikro khass an i sapeni tchik.
Kol pesse subjengre burra khatrenn les glan o kham. Un kol ruka, hoi pash o pani tardo hi, hi trul leste trujel.
Ninna te well ko lengsto pani sorleder un diwjeder, nashell lo gar darenes krik. Ninna te dell o pani Jordan leske an o mui, krell leske kowa tchi.
Kek nai taprell leske an i jaka, un tserdell leske i shello an o nak.
Tserdeh tu o Leviatanes i ranjah pash tute, un pandeh i shello trul leskro mui?
Tserdeh tu leske i shello an o nak, un tchiweh leske i gustri an o kokalo tel leskro mui?
Mangell job tutar, te kress tiro dji leske pre, un rakrell tuha latche labentsa?
Krell lo tuha win, te well lo tiro budepaskro hako tsireske?
Kheleh tu leha, har te wals lo i tikno tchirklo, un pandeh les ap i shello i tchenge an tiro kheer?
Kamenn les i starepangre te bikrell? Tchinenn les i parepangre an kotja un bikrenn leskro mass?
Nai deh tu an leskri hauta un an leskro shero tchurje tchurjentsa, har te taprals i baro matcho?
Tchip tiro wast ap leste! Tu kreh kowa gar i duito kopo. Kau kurepen bistreh tu gar.
Hakeno, kai patsell, te nai well lo sorleder har o Leviatan, hunte dikell dren, te djal kowa gar. Hi gar jaake, te perell kowa i darjatar ap i phub, kai dikell les?
Kek hi jaake dineles, te choirell lo les. Un koon hi kowa, kai nai atchell tardo glan mande?
Koon nai djal i choljah ap mande, un me anau kowa gar ap leskro shero pale? Tel o tselo bolepen hi kek sawo!
Me kamau ninna pral kowa te rakrell, hawe herja o Leviatanes hi, un har sorelo un shukar job kerdo hi.
Kek nai riwell leske leskri baja win, hoi hi kerdo har dran saster! Un kek nai dell tchurje koi dren.
Nai krell jek leskro baro mui pre? Na-a! Te dikell lo leskre danda, taprell les i bari daar.
Leskro dumo tchakrenn shuppe, hoi hi sorelo har bar. Jek shuppa pal i wawar hi le pandlo ap leste.
Un jek shuppa tchiwell pes jaake ap i wawar, te nai djal kek ducho mashkral lende dren.
Jon hi jaake khetne kerdo, te taprell jek an o wawar, un kek nai tserdell jek dran o wawar win.
Te phurdell lo dran o nak, well tikno pani win, hoi dikell win har brishin an o kham. Leskre jaka hi lolo har o kham, hoi pre djal.
Dran leskro mui well jag, awa, jagakre kotja denn win karje.
Tampa well dran leskro nak har dran i piri, hoi hi pral i jag tardo, un an kolate tchomone kerell.
Leskro ducho mukell kasht te chatchell, un jag djal dran leskro mui.
Leskri meen hi sorelo. Kai lo ninna djal, taprell i menshen i daar.
Leskro per hi masselo un sorelo har saster.
Leskro dji hi har bar, awa, jaake sorelo har i baro bar.
Te stell lo pre, taprenn ninna i sorleder bari daar, un i trashatar tserdenn le pen pale.
Dell jek o chareha pal leste, krell kowa leske tchi. Kek lengsti tchuri, kek witsepaskro tchuri, kek failo nai dukrell les.
Leske hi saster jaake, har te wals lo phuss, un lolo saster har phuro sapeno kasht.
Kek failo nai tradell les krik, un witsepaskre barra hi leske har phuss.
Ninna i depaskro kasht hi leske gar budeder har i phusseskri halma. Un pral i lengsti tchuri, hoi ap leste witsedo was, sal lo.
Leskro per tchakrenn sawe shuppe, hoi tchinenn har i paash-dino tcharo. Te tserdell lo pes pral koi sapeni phub, dikell kowa win, har te djals i tchinepaskro wurdin koi pral.
Te djal lo an o baro pani, krell lo les diwjo, har pani, hoi kerell, un har djet, hoi an i piri pre kerell.
Pal leste mukell lo i parno drom. hoi dikell win, har te wans rupene balla.
Ap i phub hi kek wawar har job, jaake kerdo, te nai krell leske tchi daar.
Job dikell halauterenge an i jaka, un hi o rai pral i tsele diwje viechende.
Un o Hiob penas koi pre ap o baro Debleste:
Me haiwom kanna, te nai kreh tu halauter. Un halauter, hoi kameh te krell, kowa kreh tu ninna.
Tu putchal: “Koon hal tu, kai putcheh dineles: Hi kowa gosewo, hoi o Dewel krell?” Awa, tut hi tchatcho: Rakrom, hoi dinelo his, un hoi gar haiwom un kolestar tchi djinom.
Shun, penal tu, me putchau tutar. Un tu peneh mange, hoi kamau te djinell.
Ap ko tsiro djinom tchi tutar, har kowa hoi mange penlo was. Kanna dikom tut mire jakentsa.
Doleske lau pale, hoi rakrom un hom beshdo an i tchik un an i jagakri tchik, te sikrap, kai khaitell man kowa, hoi rakrom.

Un har o baro Dewel kol laba rakras o Hiobeha, penas job ap o Elifas dran Teman: “Kowa hoi o Hiob, koles miro tchatcho wast hi, pral mande rakras, hi tchatcho. Kowa, hoi tu un tire dui mala mandar rakran, hi gar tchatcho. Doleske hom chojedo ap tumende.

Kanna lenn efta terne gurma un efta bakre un djan pash o Hiob, un marenn kol viechen kote, un chatchrenn len mange! Un o Hiob, koles miro tchatcho wast hi, hunte mangell man tumenge. Ap koleste shunau un krau tumentsa gar, har hunte kroms. Tumer rakran gar o tchatchepen pral mande har job kras.”
Kote djas o Elifas peskre dui malentsa, o Bildad dran Shuach un o Zofar dran Naama, pash o Hiob, un jon kran, hoi o baro Dewel lenge penas. Un o baro Dewel shunas ap kowa, hoi o Hiob lestar mangas.
Un har o Hiob peskre malenge mangas, las o baro Dewel koi bibacht o Hiobestar krik, un kras les pale brawelo, un das les dui kope jaake bud, har les his.

Un leskre tsele phrala un phenja un kolla, kai les glan ko tsiro prindjran, wan pash leste, un chan khetne leha, un rakran latches leha, un penan har koi bibacht lenge dukas, hoi mukas o baro Dewel pral leste te well. Un hakeno das les i sonakaskri bema un i gustri.
Un o baro Dewel tchiwas budeder bacht ap o Hiob har glan kowa. Un job las 14.000 (deesh-te-star-serja) bakre un 6.000 (shob-serja) khamele un 2.000 (dui serja) grumja un 1.000 (jek sero) burike.
Un leske wan efta mursh tchawe boldo un triin tcha.
Un i phureder tchat das lo o lab Jemima un i duiti tchat o lab Kezia un i triinti tchat o lab Keren-Happuch.
Un an o tselo them his kek djuwja jaake shukar har o Hiobeskre tcha. Un lengro dad das len ninna dran leskro brawlepen jaake har lengre phralen, te lenn le kowa pal leskro merepen.
Un o Hiob djiwas pal kowa gomme 140 (sheel-te-star-deesh) bersha. Un job dikas peskre tchawen un tchawengre tchawen, un kolengre tchawen un kolengre tchawen.
Un job meras pal i lengsto djipen.

Bachtelo hi kowa, kai shunell gar ap kowa, hoi i tchilatche penenna, Bachtelo hi kowa, kai djal gar kolentsa, kai mukan o Debleskro drom. Bachtelo hi kowa, kai beshell gar pash kolende, kai sanenn pral o Debleste.
Kowa hi bachtelo, kai kamell o baro Debleskre laba, un mukell kol laba peske an o shero trujel te djal ap o diwes un an i rat.
Kowa hi har i ruk, hoi tardo hi pash o pani. Ap o tchatcho tsiro wenn leskre rukengre baro. Un leskre patria atchenn senelo. Lauter, hoi job krella, djala mishto.
Jaake hi i tchilatchentsa gar. Jon hi har tchik, hoi i ducho krik phurdell.
Ap ko diwes, kai i phagi win penlo wella, nai atchenn i tchilatche gar tardo. Un kolla, kai o Debleskro drom mukan, nai atchenn gar kote, kai kolla khetne wenna, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi.
O baro Dewel prindjrell o drom kolendar, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi. Un o drom i tchilatchendar anell len an i bibacht.
I menshe an i wawar themma hi diwjo. Hoi kamenn le? Jon hadenn pen pral o baro Debleste! Hoske? Hoi le krenn, hi tchitcheske!
I bare raja ap kai phub stakrenna pre, un i pralstune beshenn khetne, un krenn win, har nai hadenn le pen pral o baro Debleste un pral koleste, kones job win rodas.
“Mer kamah buder gar te wenn le rai pral mende”, penenn le. “Witsras lengre shelle mendar, kolentsa jon men pandan!”
O Dewel, kai an o bolepen beshdo hi, sal pral lende un lengro dinelo rakepen.
Well i diwes, kai rakrell lo lentsa i choljah. Awa, leskri choljah krell lo lenge daar, te penell lo:
“Ap i berga Zion, kai mange hi, tchiwom me i baro rajes, koles me wi-rodom.”
Kau baro rai penell: “Mukenn man tumenge kowa te penell, hoi o baro Dewel kamell te krell. Job penas ap mande: ‘Miro tchawo hal tu. Kau diwes wom tiro dad.’
Te mangeh mandar i tsele themma, dau me len tute. Awa, i tseli phub dau me tute, te well li tiro.
Ab rai pral lende i sasterno wasteha, tu phageh len nai har tchare.”
Doleske awenn gar dinele, tumer bare raja ap kai phub! Shunenn mishto ap kowa, hoi penau, tumer, kai han tchatchepangre raja ap kai phub!
Budrenn o baro Debleske un darenn lestar, perenn glan leste tele un tchumrenn leskre pire!
Tchumrenn o tchawes, te well lo gar chojedo ap tumende, un tumer ap o drom merenna. Leskri choli nai chatchella sik. Bachtele hi kolla lauter, kai khatrenn pen pash leste.
I gili o Davidestar, hoi lo kras an ko tsiro, har hunte nashas lo peske glan peskro tchaweste, o Absalom.
Baro Dewel, dik, har bud hi kolla, kai ap mande djan! Dik, har bud hadenn pen ap mande!
Bud penenn mandar: “O Dewel hi gar ap leskri rig.”
Tu, baro Dewel, rike tiro wast pral mande! Tu hal kowa, kai miro shero pale hadell, te hunte ladjap man gar.
Dau me gole ap o baro Debleste, shunell lo man ap peskri berga, kai job djiwell.
Me tchiwom man tele un sowom, un djinom, har djangrom, o baro Dewel das jak ap mande i tseli rat.
Me darau gar deesh-serja lurdendar, kai djan ap mande hake rigjendar.
Ste pre, baro Dewel, un le man win, mo Dewel! Hakenes, kai ap mande djal, deh tu ap i tcham. Awa, i tchilatchenge deh tu i danda paash.
Baro Dewel, tu hal kowa, kai lell man win dran i bibacht. Te well tiri bacht ap tire menshende!
I gili o rajeske pral i gipangre, te giwell pash o bashepen ap i dorjengri bashepaskri. O David kras kai gili.
Shun man, te dau ap tute gole! Miro Dewel, kai deh man tchatcho! An miri daar kral tu miro dji soreles. Ab latches ap mande un shun har me tut mangau!
Murshale, har rah tserdenn tumer miro lab an i tchik! Tumer rodenn pal kowa, hoi tchi moldo hi, un kamenn o chochepen.
Dikenn un haiwenn: O baro Dewel rodas kolen win, kai kamenn les o tselo djijestar. O baro Dewel shunell man, te dau ap leste gole.
Te well i choli an tumende pre, palle anenn kek doosh ap tumende! Rakrenn an tumare djia, te han an tumaro tchiben tchiddo, un rakrenn kek lab!
Denn kowa o Debleste, hoi mishto un tchatcho hi! Un patsenn, te krell o baro Dewel lauter mishto!
Bud penenna, koon mukell men latchepen dikell? Tu, baro Dewel, muk tiro latchepen har i momeli pral mende pre te djal!
Tu kral miro dji bachtleder har o dji kolendar, kolen bud djob un mool hi.
Me tchiwau man tele un sowau kek darjah. Tu kokres, baro Dewel, deh jak ap mande, te nai krell mange kek i tchilatcho koowa.
I gili o rajeske pral i gipangre, te giwell pash o bashepen ap i tikni phurdepaskri. O David kras kai gili.
Baro Dewel, shun mire laba! Shun, har me ap tute rowau!
De jak ap miri gole! Tu hal miro baro rai un miro Dewel, koles me mangau.
Baro Dewel, sik taissarlakro dau gole ap tute. Sik taissarlakro wau pash tute un penau tuke, hoi mange ap o dji hi. Un dau palle jak, hoi tu mange peneh.
Tu hal i Dewel, kai tchilatche dromma gar kamella. Pash tute nai atchell i tchilatcho gar.
Kol pre-phurden kameh tu gar glan tire jaka te dikell, un tu choireh tut ap hakeneste, kai i wawarenge tchilatchepen krella.
Tu mareh kolen, kai o chochepen rakrenna. Praassedo hi glan o baro Debleste kolla, kolen doosh ap o rat i wawarendar hi, un kai i wawaren chochenn.
Mange hal latches un mukeh man an tiro kheer dren te djal. Me nai witsrau man tele glan tiro railo kheer, un nai mangau tut an.
Baro Dewel, sike man o drom, hoi tchatcho hi glan tute! Kre mange o drom, hoi te djap! Muk kolen te dikell, kai mange tchilatchepen kamenna, kai hal tu ap miri rig!
Ap lengro lab nai dell jek tchi. An lende hi tchilatchepen. Lengro rakepen anell o merepen. Jon rakrenn dui tchipjentsa.
Tchip lengri doosh ap lengre shere, mo Dewel! Muk len te perell an pengre netse, hoi jon i wawarenge kran! Trade len tutar krik! Bud kope kran le o tchilatchepen. Pral tute hadan le pen.
Bachtele wenn kolla, kai khatrenn pen pash tute! Kolla denn gole i bachtjatar o tselo tsiro. Tu rikreh tiro wast pral lende. Doleske sanenn un giwenn le – kolla, kai tiro lab kamenna.
Tu, baro Dewel, tchiweh tiri bacht ap kolende, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi. Tu tchiweh tiro latchepen trul lende har i plaashka, jaake te nai dukrell len tchi.
I gili o rajeske pral i gipangre, te giwell pash o bashepen ap i bashepaskri ochta dorjentsa. O David kras kai gili.
Baro Dewel, tu hal chojedo ap mande. Ma de man sawi bari phagi! Ma de man gar an tiri choli!
Baro Dewel, ab latches ap mande, mange djal gar mishto! Baro Dewel, kre man pale sasto! Man hi buder kek soor an mande.
Man hi bari traash. Ach, baro Dewel, har rah hal tu chojedo ap mande?
Risse trujel, baro Dewel, un le man win! Tu hal jaake latcho, le man win!
Te hom mulo, nai sharau me tut buder gar. Pash i mulende parkrenn le pen gar pash tute.
Khino hom o ropastar. I tseli rat nashenn mire swa, un miro tchiben hi sapenes lendar.
Me dikau buder gar mishto, – jaake pharo hi miro dji. Mire jaka hi pesso o ropastar kol budenge, kai mange o djipen phares krenna.
Djan tumenge, tumer lauter, kai han tchilatches! O baro Dewel shunas miro ropen.
Awa, o baro Dewel shunas miri gole. Miro mangepen las lo an.
Ladj ap kolende, kai mange tchilatchepen kamenna! Sik te well i bari traash ap lende, te hunte nashenn le un ladjenn pen!
I ropaskri gili, hoi giwas o David o baro Debleske, har o Benjaminari Kush leske o djipen phares kras.
Baro Dewel, tu hal miro Dewel, pash tute khatrau man. Le man win dran i wasta kolendar, kai man palla lenna! Te weh tu gar ap miri rig,
wenn le har i lewo un taprenn man un dandrenn man. Un kek nai tserdell man mank lengre danda win.
Baro Dewel, tu hal miro Dewel, me te krom sawo koowa, hoi penan le, un te hi doosh ap mande,
te homs tchilatches ap kolende, kai mange latches kaman, un kolendar tchoroms, kai les mange phares kran, ninna te krom me lenge tchi,
palle mu lenn man palla kolla, kai hi chojede ap mande! Mu taprenn le man, un witsrenn man ap i phub, un mukenn le man an i tchik tchiddo!
Ab chojedo, baro Dewel, un hade tut ap kolende, kai chojede hi ap mande un ap mande djan. Un ab ap miri rig, un rake o tchatchepen win!
De i menshen dran i tsele themma khetne gole trul tute, un besh tut dur pral lende ap tiro tchatchepaskro stamin!
Baro Dewel, tu hal o baro tchatchepaskro rai pral i menshende dran i tsele themma. De man miro tchatchepen! Tu djineh, me hom tardo an o tchatchepen un kek doosh hi ap mande.
Tu hal i Dewel, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi, un dikeh an hakeneskro dji un shero. Kanna kre, te nai krenn i tchilatche kek tchilatchepen buder! Kre kolen sorelo, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi!
O Dewel rikrell peskro wast pral mande. Job lell kolen dran i bibacht win, kai shunenn ap leste pengro tselo djijeha.
O Dewel hi i tchatchepaskro rai, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi. Job hi i Dewel, koleskri choli nai chatchella hako diwes.
Tchatchepah, pale las o tchilatcho peskro charo, un hadell peskro bogo, te dell lo karje.
Dik, peskro merepaskro charo un i faile, hoi chatchenna, hadas lo pre, te dell lo karje!
Les hi tchilatchepen an o shero, un midjak koowa an o dji. Un dran leste well chochepen.
Job hadas i cheb win, hoi djas dur tele, un peras palle kokres dren, – an koi cheb, hoi job i wawareske wi-hadas.
Koi bibacht, hoi kamas lo ap i wawareste te anell, was ap leskro shero pale. Ko tchilatcho koowa, hoi kamas lo i wawareske te krell, peras ap leste pale.
Me parkrau man pash o baro Debleste, te hadas lo o tchatchepen pre, un sharau o baro Debles, ko Debles pral halauter.
I gili o rajeske pral i gipangre, te giwell pash o bashepen ap i bashepaskri ochta dorjentsa. O David kras kai gili.
Baro Dewel, maro rai, har railo hi tiro lab ap i tseli phub! Tiro railepen hi bareder har o bolepen.
Dran o mui i tchawendar un tikne tchawendar wenn kol laba, hoi sharenn tut. Jaake hunte rikrenn pengro mui kolla, kai kamenn tut gar un hi chojedo ap tute.
Me te dikau o bolepen, hoi tu tire gushtentsa kral, o tchon un i momlia an o bolepen, hoi tu kral,
palle putchau mandar: Hoi hi o mensho? Hoske well lo tuke an o shero? Hi lo tuke jaake kutch, te weh ap leskri rig?
Tu kral les gar bud tikneder har tut kokres. Baro un railo kral tu les.
Tu kral les rai pral halauter, hoi tire wasta kran. Lauter tchiwal tu tel leskre herja:
Bakre, busja un grumja, un i diwje vieche ninna,
i tchirkle an o bolepen un i matche an o baro pani, un lauter, hoi an o pani djiwell.
Baro Dewel, maro rai, har railo hi tiro lab ap i tseli phub!
I gili o rajeske pral i gipangre, te giwell har koi gili ‘Muth labben’. O David kras kai gili.
Baro Dewel, me parkrau man pash tute o tselo djijeha, un rakrau pral ko tselo baro koowa, hoi tu kral.
Pral tute hom bachtelo, un miro dji giwell tutar, un sharau tiro lab, tu Dewel pral halauter!
Glan tute hunte tserdan pen kolla pale, kai his chojedo ap mande. Jon peran un meran glan tute.
Awa, tu lal miro koowa an tiro wast, un beshal tut ap tiro tchatchepaskro stamin un dal man tchatches. Tu hal i tchatchepaskro rai, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi.
Tu dal trad kol menshen an wawar themma, un maral kolen, kai kaman tutar tchi te djinell. Lengre laba hi bistedo kanna un hako tsireske.
Awa, kolla, kai kaman tut gar, hi buder gar koi. Krik hi le hako tsireske. Lengre forja kral tu paash. Hako tsireske hi le bistedo.
O baro Dewel atchella hako tsireske. Leskro tchatchepaskro stamin hi tardo.
Job hi o tchatchepaskro rai pral i tseli phub. Un pral i tsele themma rakrell job o tchatchepen win.
I bibachtele nai khatrenn pen pash leste, un job rikrell peskro wast pral lende, un dell jak ap lende an phare tsirja.
Doleske rikrenn kolla ap tute, kai tiro lab prindjrenna. Koon tut, o baro Debles, rodella, koles mukeh tu gar kokres.
Giwenn o baro Debleske, kai ap i berga Zion khere hi! Penenn i menshenge an wawar themma, hoi job lauter kras!
Kowa, kai bistrell gar te dell lo kolen i phagi, kai lan i rateskri doosh ap pende. Job shunell i gole un o mangepen kolendar, kai tchorwelo un palla lino hi.
Ab latches ap mande, baro Dewel! Dik o tchilatchepen, hoi kolla mantsa krenna, kai hi mulo chojedo ap mande! Un tserde tu man win dran o merepaskro wast!
Palle djau an i wudja tiro forestar Zion dren, un rakrau lauterentsa pral ko latchepen, hoi tu ap mande kral, un sharau tut i bachtelo djijeha, kai tu man dran i bibacht win lal.
I menshe an wawar themma, peran an koi cheb, hoi jon i win hadan. An koi netsa, hoi jon win tchiwan, tapran le pen kokres.
O baro Dewel sikras, koon job hi, un das i tchilatchende pengri phagi. I tchilatche pandan pen an koi netsa, hoi jon pengre wastentsa kran.
Kamau, te djan le lauter pash i mulende, – kalla, kai kamenn o Deblestar tchi te djinell, un bistrenn, kai hi job o Dewel.
O Dewel bistrell o tchorweles gar – an kek tsiro. I bibachtele nai djinenn, te well i tsiro, kai wenn le bachtelo.
Baro Dewel, ste pre! Muk i menshen gar te hadenn le pen pral tute! An i menshen dran i tsele themma glan tute! Un rake o tchatchepen pral lende win!
Tchip i daar ap lende, baro Dewel, un sike lende, te hi le tchi har menshe!
Baro Dewel, hoske hal tu jaake dur mandar krik? Hoske khatreh tu tut mandar an o tchilatcho tsiro?
O tchilatcho hi pre-phurdo un lell i tchorwelen palla, un krell lentsa ko tchilatcho koowa, hoi leske an leskro shero trujel djal.
Job sharell pes pral kowa, hoi lo kamell te krell. Un kowa, kai i meen gar pherdo lell, praassella o baro Debles un sal pral leste.
O tchilatcho rikrell o nak pral un penell peske: O Dewel putchell gar palla. Lauter, hoi leske an o shero trujel djala, hi: Dell kek Dewel.
Lauter djal leske, har job kamella. Te deh tu leste i phagi, patsell lo kowa gar, jaake dur hal tu lestar krik. Job tchungrell ap lauterende, kai leske an o drom tardo hi.
Job penell peske an peskro dji: Tchi nai witsrell man trujel. Kek bibacht well ap mande.
Job koshell, chochell un dell trad. Leskro rakepen anella duka un bibacht.
Khatemen pal i khera hi lo beshdo, un tchorchanes dell lo kolen mulo, kai ap lende kek doosh hi. Leskre jaka djan o tchorweleske palla.
Tchorchanes khatedo har i lewo an i burra, jaake lurell job ap o tchorweleste, un taprell les an peskri netsa un tserdell les krik.
Job djal tele ap i tchanga un stell ap o tchorweleste, un peskri sorjah witsrell lo les an i tchik.
An peskro dji penell lo peske: “O Dewel djinell kowa gar. Job das gar jak pre un dikell tchi.”
Ste pre, baro Dewel! Mo Dewel, hade tiro wast! Ma biste i tchorwelen!
Hoske nai praassell tut kowa, kai kamell tutar tchi te djinell? Hoske nai penell lo an peskro dji: “O Dewel putchella gar palla.”

Tu dikal les. Tu deh jak ap kolende, kolenge le o djipen phares krenn, un djineh lengre duka, un leh lengro koowa an tiro wast. Awa, i tchorwele tchiwenn pengro djipen an tiro wast. Tu hal ap i rig kolendar, kolen kek dad buder hi.
Phage i soor kol tchilatchendar un midjak menshendar, hoi len pral i wawarende hi! De len pengri phagi, te krenn le buder kek tchilatcho koowa!
O baro Dewel hi o baro rai kanna un hako tsiro. Kolla, kai gar ap leste patsenna, djan penge dran leskro them.
Kowa, hoi i tchorwele tutar mangenna, shuneh tu, mo baro Dewel. Tu kreh lengro dji sorelo, un tiro kand hi lenge pre.
Un tu deh o tchatchepen i tchorwelenge un kolenge, kai len kek dad buder hi, jaake te nai krell buder kek mensho i wawarenge daar ap kai phub.
I gili o rajeske pral i gipangre. O David kras kai gili. Me tchiwau miro tselo patsepen ap o baro Debleste. Har nai penenn tumer palle ap mande: “Naash har i tchirklo an i berge!
Dikeh tu gar, te tserdenn i tchilatche o bogo un tchiwenn pengre faile koi pre, jaake te denn le khatemen karje ap kolende, kai shunenn pengro tselo djijeha ap o Debleste.
Te perell lauter an kotja, nai krell kowa tchi, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi.”
O baro Dewel hi an peskro railo baro kheer. Leskro rajeskri beshepaskri hi an o bolepen. Leskre jaka dikenna tele ap i menshende, un job lell len an o jak.
Job rodell an i djia i latchendar un i tchilatchendar. Koon o tchilatchepen kamell, ap koleste hi lo peskro tselo djijeha chojedo.
Mu dell lo i tchilatchen i phagi: Jag un jagakri khand mukell lo pral lende te perell, un i tato ducho phurdell ap lende.
O baro Dewel hi an o tchatchepen tardo, un kamell hakenes, kai o tchatchepen krella. Koon ap leste shunella peskro tselo djijeha, kowa dikell les peskre jakentsa.
I gili o Davidestar te giwess lat pash o bashepen ap i ochta-dorjengri bashepaskri.
Baro Dewel, ab ap miri rig! Tire menshe hi buder gar bud. Awa, kolla, kai patsle hi mank i menshende, hi gar bud.
Hakeno chochell o wawares. Jon rakrenn dui tchipjentsa un dran dui djia.
Baro Dewel, kre, te rikrenn le pengre muja, kolla, kai rakrenn dui tchipjentsa! Pande kolenge o mui, kai jaake bares rakrenna,
un penenna: “Mer haiwah te rakrell. Maro rakepah ham soreles. Koon hi o pralstuno pral mende?”
“Kanna”, penell o baro Dewel, “stau me pre. Ap i tchorwelende djan le sorjah. Me shunom lengro ropen. Kanna rikrau mire wasta pral hakeneste, kai peskro tselo djijeha kamell, te wap ap leskri rig.”
O baro Debleskre laba hi djudjo har rup, thodo an i jagakro bob efta kope.
Tu, mo baro Dewel, rikreh tiro lab, un rikreh tiro wast pral mende hako tsiro, te nai krenn kol menshe menge kek tchilatchepen,
ninna te nashenn kolla trujel, kai kamenn tutar tchi te djinell, un o tchilatchepen bareder well mank i menshende.
I gili o rajeske pral i gipangre. O David kras kai gili.
Baro Dewel, har rah bistreh tu man? Kameh tu man hako tsiro te bistrell?
Har rah darap an miro dji? Har rah putchap man darenes hako diwes: Har rah hadell pes kowa pral mande, kai kamell mange tchilatchepen te krell?
Tu, mo Dewel, dik ap mande un shun miro mangepen! Muk man i momeli te dikell, te merap gar!
Kowa, kai kamell mange tchilatchepen, nai sharals pes un penals, te wals lo sorleder har me. Kolla, kai hadenn pen ap mande, wans bachtelo pral miro perepen.
Me dikau ap tiro latchepen, miro dji bashrell koi pral, kai tu man win leh dran i tchilatche wasta. Me kamau te giwap o baro Debleske, kai mange jaake latches hi.
I gili o rajeske pral i gipangre. O David kras kai gili. Dinele hi le, kai rakrenn penge: “O Dewel dell pes gar!” Tchi-molde hi le! I ladj hi kowa, hoi jon krenn. Kek hi koi, kai krell latchepen.
O baro Dewel dikell dran o bolepen tele ap i menshende, te dikell lo: Dell jek, kai gosewo hi un pal leste putchella?
Halauter rissran pen lestar krik, un djiwenn i djungelo djipen, jek har ko wawar. Kek hi koi, kai krell o latchepen, awa, kek!
“Djinenn kol tchilatche gar, hoi jon krenna”, penell o baro Dewel, – “kolla, kai chan mire menshen har i kotar maro? Un ap mande denn le gar gole.”
Sik well ko tsiro, kai perenn le an i daar. O Dewel rikrell pash kolende, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi.
“Tumer kaman i tchorwelenge tchilatchepen te krell, un kowa paash te krell, hoi jon kaman. O baro Dewel rikrell peskre wasta pral lende.”

Har kamaus me, te wals kowa koi berga Zion tele, kai lell o Israel win dran i bibacht! Awa, har kamaus me, te anell o baro Dewel peskre pandle menshen pale! Palle stenna o Jakobeskre tchawe i bachtjatar, awa, o tselo Israel well bachtelo.
I gili o Davidestar. Baro Dewel, koon nai well an tiro kheer? Kones mukeh tu ap koi berga te djiwell, kai tu khere hal?
Koles kokres, kai i djudjo djipen djiwell, un hako tsiro krell, hoi tchatcho hi. Kowa, kai kek chochepen rakrella,
witar kek djunglepen pral jekeste penella. Kowa, kai peskro maleske kek tchilatchepen krella, un kolen gar praassella, kai pash leste djiwenna.
Kowa, kai hadell gar kolen, kai kowa krenna, hoi o baro Dewel gar kamella, Na-a, job hadell kolen, kai o baro Debleha djiwenna. Job krell, ap hoi job pes sowel das, ninna te well kowa leske phares.

Te patsas lo peskre lowe, lell lo gar budeder lowe pale. Ninna te denn le les shukar koowa, anell lo kek chochepen ap koleste, kai kek tchilatchepen kras. Koon jaake djiwella, kowa hi soreles tardo an peskro djipen.
I gili o Davidestar. Rike tiro wast pral mande, miro Dewel! Me tchiwau miro tselo patsepen ap tute.
Me penom ap o baro Debleste: Tu hal miro rai. Hako latcho koowa, hoi man hi, well tutar.
I Debleskre menshe an o them hi railo. Jon krenn miro dji bachteles.
Bud hi i duka kolendar, kai nashenn i wawar debleske palla. Me kamau kol chochene deblenge kek rat win te tchorell. Witar gar kamau lengro lab an miro mui te lell.
Tu, baro Dewel, hal miro brawlepen, un deh man lauter, hoi man hunte well djipaske. Miro tselo djipen hi an tiro wast.
Kowa, hoi job mange wi-rodas, hi an i shukar them. Awa, kowa, hoi job man dell, hi shukar.
Me sharau o baro Debles, kai mange penell, hoi hunte krap. Ninna an i rat rakrell miro dji mantsa, te bistrap gar, hoi job kamella.
Miro baro Dewel hi man hako tsiro glan mire jaka. Job te hi ap miri tchatchi rig, nai hom me soreles tardo.
Doleske hi miro dji bachtelo, un halauter an mande stell i bachtjatar. Awa, me nai tchiwau man tele kek darjah.
Tu mukeh man gar an o merepen, un kameh gar, te merell miro mass tele an i phub.
Tu sikreh o drom, kai an o djipen anell. Pash tute hom bachtelo. Te hom kote, kai tu hal, bashrell miro dji hako tsiro.
I mangepen o Davidestar. Baro Dewel, shun, hoi tutar mangau: De man miro tchatchepen! De jak, har dau ap tute gole! Shun miro mangepen, hoi well dran i mui, hoi gar chochella!
Rake tu mange latches! Tu dikeh, ap hawi rig o tchatchepen hi.
Tu djineh, hoi mange an o shero djal. Ninna an i rati dikal palla, har an miro dji wi-dikella, un hatsal tchi an mande, hoi gar mishto hi. Ninna kek tchilatcho lab was dran miro mui win.
Jaake har i menshe krenna, krau me les gar. Me rikrau man ap tire laba, un djau gar ap tchilatche dromma.
Mire pire djan ap tiro drom un peran gar tele.
Me dau ap tute gole, un tu, mo Dewel shuneh man. Risse tiro kand pash mande, un shun, hoi me ap tute rakrau!
Sike tiro latchepen, tu, kai leh kolen dran i tchilatche wasta win, kai pen pash tute khatrenna,
Rike tiro wast pral mande, jaake har te woms tiri jak. Khate man jaake har i tchirklo peskre tchawen tel peskre mussja khatrell!
Tu dikeh kol tchilatchen, kai i sorjah ap mande pre djan, kolla, kai haki rigjatar ap mande wenna, te denn le man.
Lengre djia pandenn le, te khaitell len kek, un pengro mujeha krenn le pen bares.
Kai mer ninna djah, jon hi trul mende un lenn men an i jak, te stakrenn le men an i phub.
Jon hi har i lewo, hoi khatedes beshdo hi, un ap jekeste lurella, hoi job nai chal.
Baro Dewel, ste tu pre, tchip tut lenge an o drom! Stake len khetne! Ab un le tiro charo, un le miro djipen win dran i wasta kol tchilatchendar.

Baro Dewel, tiro wasteha le man win dran o wast kol menshendar, kai djiwenn i phubjake. Lengro brawlepen lenn jon an kau djipen! Tu kreh lengro per pherdo ko koowa, hoi tu lenge deh. Ninna lengre tchawe wenn tchalo, un mukenn pral pengre tchawenge.
Me krom, hoi tchatcho hi. Doleske nai dikau tut. Te djangrau pre, dikau me tut un hom tchalo i bachtjatar.

I gili o rajeske pral i gipangre. O David, kai o baro Debleskro budepaskro hi, kras kai gili un giwas lat o baro Debleske ap ko diwes, har o baro Dewel les win las dran i wasta lauterendar, kai leske tchilatchepen kaman, un ninna dran i wasta o baro rajestar Saul.
Un job penas: Baro Dewel, miro tselo djijestar kamau tut. Tu kreh man soreles.

Baro Dewel, tu hal mange har i baro sorelo bar, kai nai khatrau man, har i sorelo kheer, kai nai krell kek mange tchilatchepen. Miro Dewel, tu hal kowa, pash koleste nai wau un man khatrau. Tire wasta rikreh tu pral mande. Tu hal ko sorelo ap miri rig, un hal mange har i sorelo kheer pral ap i berga.
Me sharau o baro Debles! Te dau ap leste gole, lell lo man win dran i wasta kolendar, hoi mange tchilatchepen kamenna.
O merepen pandas man an peskre shelle, un merepaskri daar djas pral mande har sorele panja.
I mulengro them pandas peskre shelle trul mande, un o merepaskre shelle tserdan man tele.
An miri daar kharom ap o baro Debleste. Awa, bari gole dom ap miro Debleste. An peskro railo kheer shunas lo man, un miri gole was glan leskre kanda.
Koi trissas i phub, pral un tele djan i berge o Debleskri bari choljatar.
Jagakro ducho djas dran leskro nak pre, baro tatepen was dran leskro mui win, ninna jag das karje lestar win.
Un job tserdas o bolepen ap i rig, un was tele. Kali rat his tel leskre herja.
Un job beshas ap i cherub un hadas pes har i tchirklo; awa, job mukas pes te hidjrell ap i mussja o duchestar.
Kali rat his leskro ripen, An kalo pani un pesse wolke his lo khatedo.
Dran o railepen glan leste djan leskre wolke dureder, brishineskre barra un barra, hoi chatchran, peran dran lende.
Un o baro Dewel mukas o bolepen bari gole te dell, awa, o Dewel pral halauter mukas pes te shunell bari goljah.
Un job das jag karje dran o bolepen kate te kote, un tradas i wolke krik.
Kote was o telstunepen tel i panja diklo, un i telstuni phub was pre-tchakedo, har tu, baro Dewel, tchingral un trad dal an tiri choli.
Dran o bolepen tapras man tiro wast, un tserdas man dran o baro pani win.
Tu lal man win dran o wast kol sorelendar, kai kaman miro merepen, awa, dran ko wast kolendar, kai his jaake chojedo ap mande un bud sorleder har me.
Ap o diwes, kai i bibacht pral mande was, peran le pral mande. Koi was o baro Dewel ap miri rig.
Job las man win dran lengre wasta un anas man an i buchlo them. Job kamell man, doleske kras lo kowa.
O baro Dewel djinas, te homs an o tchatchepen tardo. Doleske kras lo mange latchepen. Kek doosh his ap mande. Doleske his lo mange latcho.
Me rikrom man ap i dromma o baro Deblestar, un mukom gar miro Debles.
Awa, leskro tselo tchatchepen hi glan mire jaka, un rikrau ap lauter, hoi job kamell, te krap.
Jaake te hatsell lo tchi ap mande, kai nai tchingrell lo mantsa, un dau jak, te well kek doosh ap mande.
Miro tchatchepen his glan leskre jaka. Un kek doosh his ap mande. Doleske kras o baro Dewel mange latchepen.
Tu rikreh ap koleste, kai ap tute rikrell, un kreh, hoi mishto hi koleske, kai krella, hoi tu lestar kameh.
Tu hal latcho ap koleste, kai hi latcho ap i wawarende un hal gosweder har kowa, kai ap bange dromma djal.
Tu weh ap i rig i tchorwelenge, un kol pre-phurden kreh tu tiknes.
Miro baro Dewel, tu kreh miri momeli soreles, un kreh miri rat jaake har wals diwes.
Awa, khetne tuha nai djau me an o kurepen. Khetne miro Debleha nai stau me pral bare pre-tchidde barra.
I tsele dromma, kai o Dewel man anella, hi latcho. Leskre laba hi latcho un tchatcho. Job rikrell peskro wast pral hakeneste, kai well pash leste.
Jek kokres hi o Dewel. Kowa hi o baro Dewel. Jek kokres hi har i baro sorelo bar menge, kai nai khatrah men. Kowa hi maro Dewel.
Job hi kowa, kai dell man soor un krell i latcho drom glan mande.
Job krell mire herja jaake sik, har te wans le i herja i wesheskri grumjatar, te wap soreles tardo ap i pralstune berge.
Job sikrell man, har mire wasta hunte kurenn pen, un har miri mussi rikrell o sasterno bogo.
Baro Dewel, tu rikreh tiro wast pral mande, te dukrell man kek. Tiri tchatchi mussi dell man soor, un tu dikeh latches ap mande un kreh man bares.
Tu kral, te nai stakrau soreles pre, un kral mange o drom dur pre.
Me lom kolen palla, kai ap mande pre djan, un taprom len, un mukom gar tele, bis te his le mulo dino.
Me dukrom len jaake, te nai stan le gar buder pre, un stakrom len tel mire herja.
Tu dal man i soor, te nai kurom man lentsa un witsral kolen ap i phub glan mande, kai hadan pen ap mande.
Tu kral, te hunte nashan le mandar. Jaake nai marom kolen, kai mange tchilatchepen kaman.
Fothe dan le gole, his kek koi, kai nai lals len dran miro wast win. Ap o baro Debleste dan le gole, un job rakras gar pale ap lende.
Un me dom len khetne, dom len tiknes har tchik, hoi i baro ducho krik phurdell. Har tchik tchorom len win ap o drom.
Tu lal man win dran o tchingepen mire menshentsa, un kral man o rai pral i menshende dran wawar themma, Menshe, kolen me gar prindjrom, budrenn mange.
I wi-themarja rakrenn shukar ap mande, un shunenn ap mande un krenn sik, hoi penau.
Len hi buder kek soor an pende. Darjah wenn le dran pengre sorele rajengre khera win.
O baro Dewel djiwella! Les sharau: har i baro sorelo bar hi lo mange. Miro Debles hadau: job das ap mande jak,
un kras man sorleder har kolla, kai kuran pen mantsa, un witsras i menshen dran wawar themma tel mande.
Tu lal man win dran i wasta kolendar, kai kaman miro merepen. Tu hadal man pral kolende, kai hadan pen ap mande, un mukal man gar an i tchilatche wasta.
Doleske sharau tut mank kolende, kai hi gar tire menshendar, baro Dewel, un giwau gilja tuke.
Tu kreh baro koowa o Davideske, koles tu wi-rodal, te well lo o baro rai. Un hal jaake latches ap leste un kolende, kai lestar wenn. Tiro kamlepen lenge atchell hako tsireske.
I gili o rajeske pral i gipangre. O David kras kai gili.
O bolepen sikrella, har baro un railo o Dewel hi, un i bolepangre momlia sikrenna, hoi job lauter kras.
Jek diwes penell les o wawareske un jek rat i wawarake.
Kek labentsa rakrenn le. Un lengri gole well gar shunlo.
Lengro rakepen djal an hako them, un well shunlo ap i tseli phub. O Dewel kras i kheer o khameske an o bolepen.
Taissarlake djal o kham win har i bijabeskro dran peskri isema, un har i sorelo naashepaskro hi lo bachtelo, te nashell peskro drom.
O kham djal pre ap koi jek rig o bolepastar, un nashell peskro drom bis ap i wawar rig, un glan leskro tatepen atchella tchi khatedo.
O baro Debleskre laba hi lauter tchatcho un krenn mare djia sorelo. O baro Debleskro rakepen hi latcho, un krell i dinelen gosewo.
Kowa, hoi o baro Dewel menge penell, te kras mer, hi tchatcho, un krell maro dji bachtelo. Kowa, hoi lo mendar kamell, nai haiwell hakeno. Kowa hi har i momeli, hoi sikrell men o drom.
Te hadau o baro Debles pre, hi kowa mishto. Hako tsiro well lo hadedo. O tchatchepen, hoi o baro Dewel win rakrella, hi lauter latcho un tchatcho.
Leskro tchatchepen hi kutcheder har o sonakai, har o raileder sonakai, un gudleder har o gwin, har o djudjeder gwin.
Miro rai, me mukau tire laba ap miro dji te rakrell. Koon rikrell pes ap lende, koleske djal mishto.
Kek mendar djinell haki doosh, hoi lo ap peste anas. Le koi doosh mandar krik, hoi anom ap mande un djinau kowa gar!
Muk man gar khetne kolentsa te djal, kai hi pre-phurde, te tserdenn le man gar ap lengri rig. Jaake well kek doosh ap mande, un me krau kek baro tchilatcho koowa.
Muk o rakepen, hoi well dran miro mui, un kowa, hoi rakrau an miro dji, shukar te well tuke! Baro Dewel, tu rikreh man, un hal kowa, kai man win las dran o tchilatchepen.
I gili o rajeske pral i gipangre. O David kras kai gili.
Mangau o baro Debles, o Jakobeskro Debles, te shunell lo tut ap o diwes, kai i bibacht pral tute well. Mu rikrell job peskro wast pral tute!
Mu well lo dran leskro kheer ap tiri rig! Un dran o foro Zion bitchrell lo tuke soor!
Mu bistrell lo kek latcho koowa, hoi tu leske anal, un dikell latches ap kol viechen, hoi tu leske chatchral!
Mu dell lo tut lauter, hoi tiro dji kamella, un krell, te djal tuke lauter mishto, hoi tu tuke glan lal!

Palle kamah mer te giwell i bachtjatar. Un sharah maro Debles un hidjrah o themeskri plachta, te sikras, kai job tut soreles kras pral kolende, kai kuran pen tuha. O baro Dewel mu dell tut lauter, hoi tu lestar mangeh!
Kanna djinau, kai well o baro Dewel ap i rig kolestar, koles job win rodas, te well lo baro rai. Dran o bolepen, kai job khere hi, shunell lo ap leste, un peskri bari sorjah well lo ap leskri rig.
Wawar menshe patsenna ap i soor pengre grajendar un wurdja. Mer dah gole ap maro baro Debleste.
Jon hi kolla, kai phagenn khetne un perenn. Mer atchah tardo un dah gar palla.
Baro Dewel, ab o baro rajeske ap i rig! Mu shunell lo men ap o diwes, kai dah ap leste gole!
I gili o rajeske pral i gipangre. O David kras kai gili.
Baro Dewel, har bachtelo hi o baro rai pral tiri soor! Tu hal ap leskri rig. Doleske bashrell leskro dji.
Kowa, hoi job o djijestar kamas, dal tu les, un kowa, hoi job tutar mangas, rikral gar pale.
Tu tchoral pral leste bacht pral bacht, tchiwal shereskro sonakai ap leskro shero.
Djipen mangas lo tutar, un tu dal les leste: o djipen, hoi gar pre-herella, dal tu les.
Tu hal ap leskri rig un kral leskro railepen bares. Shukapen un barepen tchiwal tu ap leste.
Tiri bacht hi ap leste hako tsiro. Tu hal pash leste. Doleske bashrell leskro dji.
O baro rai patsell ap o baro Debleste, ko Debleste pral halauter. Un dran o Debleskro latchepen nai atchell o baro rai soreles tardo.
Tiro wast hatsell hakenes, kai kamell tuke tchilatchepen te krell. Tiro tchatcho wast hatsell kolen, kai pen ap tute choirenna.
Tu chatchreh len har an i bobeskri jag, an ko tsiro, kai tu mukeh tut te dikell. Tiri choli chatchrell har i jag, un chal len pre.
Kek lengre tchawendar atchenn djido, gar jek lendar atchell ap kai phub.
Jon wan khetne un rakran, har nai krenn le tuke tchilatchepen. Tchi, hoi kamenn le tuha te krell, djal lenge mishto.
Tu leh tiro bogo un rikreh ap lende, un kreh, te rissrenn le pen trujel un nashenn penge.
Baro Dewel, hade tut an tiri soor! Palle giwah tuke gilja un sharah tiri soor.
I gili o rajeske pral i gipangre, te giwell har koi gili ‘I wesheskri grumni, hoi sik ap o diwes tradedo wella.’ O David kras kai gili.
Mo Dewel, mo Dewel, hoske mukal tu man? Me dau gole ap tute, un tu weh gar ap miri rig. Hoske atcheh dur mandar?
Mo Dewel, ap o diwes dau ap tute gole, un tu shuneh man gar, ninna rati kharau tut, un hatsau kek sopen.
Tu hal ko jek tchatcho Dewel, un hal beshdo ap tiri rajeskri beshepaskri, un o Israel giwell tuke gilja.
Ap tute dikan mare phure, un tu wal ap lengri rig.
Ap tute dan le gole, un tu lal len win. Ap tute dikan le, un tu mukal len gar kokres.
I kirmo hom me un buder kek mensho. I menshe praassenn man, un dikenn tele ap mande.
Hakeno, kai dikell man, sal pral mande, rissrell peskre jaka, un tchiwell peskro shero ap i rig un penell:
“De gole ap o baro Debleste! Te kamell lo tut, palle lell lo tut win un rikrell peskro wast pral tute.”
Tu, mo Dewel hals kowa, kai kras te wom boldo, tu mukal man kek darjah te sowell ap o betch miri datar.
Fun tiknes pre, deh tu jak ap mande, Jaake rah har djiwau, hal tu miro Dewel.
Atch gar dur mandar, man hi daar, un kek hi ap miri rig tardo.
Bud gurma hi trul mande, awa, diwje sorele gurma pandan man dren.
Pengre bare muja krenn le pre, un denn bari gole ap mande har i lewo glan peskro chapen.
Miri soor hi win tchoredo har pani, mire tsele kokale rikrenn buder gar khetne, Miro dji nashras peskri soor, har i momeli hoi tele chatchras.
Miri meen hi truk. Ninna miro tchip hi buder gar sapeno, un tu tchiwal man an o merepaskri tchik.
Tchilatche menshe tchiwan pen khetne un djan trul mande, har djukle, kai mukenn man gar win te djal. Jon denn tchurje an mire wasta un an mire pire.
Me hom jaake sano, te nai dikenn le mire tsele kokale. Un kol tchilatche dikenn ap mande, un lenn man an i jak.
Jon lenn penge mire koola un khelenn win, koon miri plaashka lell.
Atch gar dur mandar, mo baro Dewel! Tu, miri soor, ab sik ap miri rig!
Le man win, te dell man o charo gar mulo, te chan kol djukle gar miro djipen!
Tserde man win dran o leweskro mui! Un le man krik glan i shinga diwje gurmendar! Tu shunal man.
Tutar kamau me te rakrell pash mire phralende. Kote, kai wenn le khetne, kamau me tut te sharell.
Tumer, kai o baro Debles an-mangenna, sharenn les! Tumer lauter dran o kheer Jakob, hadenn les pre! Un darenn lestar, tumer lauter dran o kheer Israel!
Job dikas gar krik o tchorwelestar un leskre duka, un khatras gar peskro mui lestar, Na-a, har job ap leste gole das, shunas lo les.
Tut kamau me te sharell, kote, kai bud khetne wenna. Glan kolende, kai tut an-mangenna, kamau me tuke te dell, hoi sowel dom.
Mu chan i tchorwele un wenn tchalo! Un kolla, kai ap o baro Debleste gole denna, mu sharenn les! Lenge te well i djipen, hoi gar pre-herella!
Mu rodenn i menshe ap i tseli phub o baro Debles, un wenn pash leste! Mu mangenn le les an, an hako them!
O baro Dewel hi o rai pral i tseli phub. Awa, o baro rai hi lo pral i tsele themma.
Ninna i brawele ap kai phub, kolen hako tsiro budeder hi har doha chapaske, hunte witsrenn pen tele glan leste. Ninna hakeno, kai meras un pale tchik was, hunte perell ap i tchanga glan leste.
Ninna kolla, kai bolde wenna, wenn leske koi. Un jon rakrenn ap pengre tchawende un tchawengre tchawende o baro Deblestar.
Ko tchatcho koowa, hoi job kras, penenn le dureder ap kolende, kai bolde wenna.
I gili o Davidestar. O baro Dewel dell jak ap mande har i bakrengro dell jak ap peskre bakre. Man hi lauter, hoi man hunte well djipaske.
Job mukell man tele te tchiwell ap i phub pherdo senlepen, un anell man pash latcho pani.
Job dell miro djipen newi soor. Job anell man ap o tchatcho drom, jaake har job peskro lab koi pre das.
Ninna te nashau me mashkral i tamli tala, darau me glan kek bibacht. Tu hal pash mande. Tiro kashteha aneh tu man pale, un rikreh i diwje viechen mandar krik, jaake hunte trashap gar.
Glan i jaka kolendar, hoi mange tchilatchepen kamenn, tchiweh tu mange latcho chapen pre. Miro shero makeh o djeteha, hoi mishto sungella. Miro khoro nashella pral.
Tchatchepah, tiro latchepen djal mange palla, un hako diwes kreh tu tiro dji mange pre, jaake rah, har me djiwau. Un me atchau an o baro Debleskro kheer hako tsiro.
I gili o Davidestar. O baro Debleske hi i phub un lauter, hoi koi pre hi, awa, i tseli phub un kolla, kai kote djiwenna.
Job kras lat un tchiwas lat pral o baro pani, un rikras lat soreles pral i panja.
Koon hi kowa, kai ap o baro Debleskri berga nai djal? Koon hi kowa, kai an leskro kheer nai tardo atchella?
Kawa, ap koleskre wasta kek doosh hi, un koles i djudjo dji hi. Kowa, kai djiwell gar peskro djipen ap chochepen, un dell pes gar chocheni sowel.
Sawo lell bacht o baro Deblestar. Leskro Dewel hi ap leskri rig un dell les tchatchepen.
Jaake hi i menshe, kai pal leste putchenna, un pash leste wenna. Jon hi i tchatche tchawe o Jakobestar.
Krenn i bare wudja buchles pre! Awa, krenn kol phure wudja bares pre, te nai djal o baro rai dren, kones o tselo railepen hi.
Koon hi kau baro rai, kones o tselo railepen hi? Kowa hi o baro Dewel, ko sorelo kurepaskro, awa, o baro Dewel hi sorelo an o kurepen.
Krenn i bare wudja buchles pre awa, krenn kol phure wudja bares pre, te nai djal o baro rai dren, kones o tselo railepen hi!
Koon hi kau baro rai, kones o tselo railepen hi? Kowa hi o baro Dewel, ko rai pral o bolepen un i phub. Job hi o baro rai, kones o tselo railepen hi.
I gili o Davidestar. Baro Dewel, miro mangepah wau pash tute.
Ap tute rikrau man, miro Dewel. Muk man gar tchitcheske ap tute te dikell, te nai san kolla pral mande, kai kamenn mange tchilatchepen.
Kek, kai pes ap tute rikrell, hunte ladjell pes. Kolla, kai phukrenn ap tute tchitcheske, hunte ladjenn pen.
Baro Dewel, sike man tiro drom, un hoi tu mandar kameh!
Sike mande, har te djiwap miro djipen an tiro tchatchepen! Tu hal miro Dewel, kai rikrell man! Hako diwes dikau ap tute.
Miro baro Dewel, ma biste tiro kamlepen un tiro latchepen, hoi hako tsiro ap tire menshende sikral.
Biste miri doosh, hoi ap mande lom, har terno homs, un miro tchilatcho koowa! Kre mange tiro dji pre, miro baro Dewel!
Latcho un tchatcho hi o baro Dewel. Doleske sikrell lo kolen, kai doosh ap pende lan, o tchatcho drom.
Kolen, kai tele rikedo hi, anell lo ap o tchatcho drom, un sikrell lende, hoi lo lendar kamella.
I tsele dromma hi latcho un tchatcho, kai o baro Dewel kolen anell, kai rikrenn pen ap leskre laba un krenn, hoi job lenge penell.
Baro Dewel, kre tiro lab baro, un le miri doosh mandar krik, hoi jaake bares hi!
Hoi hi ko mursheha, kai djiwell o baro Debleha? Koleste sikrell lo hawo drom job te djal.
Kowa djiwella an i bacht, un leskre tchawenge hi o them.
O baro Dewel hi o maal kolenge, kai djiwenn leha, un lende sikrell lo, te hi lo lengro Dewel un jon peskre menshe.
Mire jaka dikenn hako tsiro ap o baro Debleste, job lell mire pire dran i netsa win, kai jon dren pandle hi.
Risse tut pash mande, un kre tiro dji mange pre, me hom jaake muklo un kokres.
I daar an miro dji hi baro. Le man win dran miri bibacht!
Dik ap miro pharo djipen, un har djungeles mange djala, un biste miri tseli doosh!
Dik, har bud kolla hi, kai kamenn mange tchilatchepen, un hawi bari choljah jon pen ap mande choirenna!
Rike tiro wast pral miro djipen, un le man dran lengre wasta win! Muk man gar tchitcheske pash tute te well un ap tute te dikell!
Me rikrau man ap tute miro tselo djijestar. Doleske muk man te djiwap miro djipen an djudjepen un tchatchepen.
Miro Dewel, le o Israel win dran kau tselo parepen, hoi ap leste hi!
I gili o Davidestar. Baro Dewel, de man miro tchatchepen! Kek doosh hi ap mande. Un me patsau tut, mo baro Debles, un perom gar tutar tele.
Le man an i jak, baro Dewel! Dik palla, hoi an miro dji hi, un hoi mange an o shero trujel djal!
Tiro latchepen hi glan mire jaka, un me djiwau miro djipen an tiro tchatchepen.
Me beshau gar khetne chochene menshentsa. Un kolentsa, kai rakrenn dui tchipjentsa, hom gar khetne.
Me kamau gar kote te djal, kai i tchilatche khetne wenna, un kolendar, kai midjak koowa krenna, rikrau man pale.
Me thowau mire wasta, te sikrap, kai hi kek doosh ap mande, un djau kote, kai wenn vieche tuke chatchedo,
un parkrau man pash tute, un rakrau pral ko tselo baro koowa, hoi tu lauter kral.
Me kamau o kheer, kai tu djiweh, miro tselo djijestar, un koi platsa, kai tiro railepen diklo wella.
Ma de man mulo khetne i tchilatchentsa! Le mange gar o djipen khetne kolentsa, kai ap rat win djan,
kolengre wasta pherdo midjak koowa hi, un jon i lowenge chocheno koowa krenn.
Me djiwau an kek tchilatchepen. Ab mange latches un le man win dran o merepen!
Mire herja hi soreles tardo un perenn gar o tchatcho dromestar tele. Me kamau miro baro Debles te sharell, kote, kai leskre menshe khetne wenna.

I gili o Davidestar. O baro Dewel hi mange i momeli, un job hi kowa, hoi man win lella dran i wasta tchilatche menshendar. Kekestar hunte darap man. O baro Dewel rikrell man an o djipen. Kekestar hunte trashap me.
Te wenn i tchilatche ap mande har diwje vieche, kai kamenn man te chal, kolla, hoi les mange phares krenn un mange tchilatchepen kamenn, palle hi jon kolla, kai nashrenn pengri soor un perenn.
Ninna te wenn bud lurde trul mande trujel, taprell miro dji kek daar. Ninna te djan le an o kurepen khatar mande, hom me pherdo patsepen ap miro baro Debleste.

Jek koowa mangau miro baro Deblestar, kowa kamaus me lestar, te nai atchoms an leskro kheer jaake rah har me djiwau, te nai dikap o tselo tsiro leskro shukapen, un nai putchap pal leskro kamlepen an leskro kheer.
An o tchilatcho tsiro lell lo man an peskro kheer. Awa, an peskro kheer khatrell lo man, pral ap i baro bar hidjrell lo man.

Un kanna hadell pes miro shero pre pral kolende, kai trul mande hi un mange tchilatchepen kamenn, O baro Debleske kamau me viechen te chatchrell, un dau gole i bachtjatar un parkrau man pash leste an leskro kheer; i gipah un bashepah sharau les.
Shun, baro Dewel! Ap tute dau me gole. Ab mange latches un shun miro mangepen!
Tire laba wan mange an o shero, hoi tu penal: “Awenn pash mande!” Doleske wau pash tute.
Ma dja tuke mandar! Bitche man, tiro budepaskres, gar tutar krik an tiri choli! Tu hal kowa, kai was mange ap i rig hako tsiro. Miro Dewel, tu hal kowa, kai man win lell. Ma muk man! Ma de man pre!
Te mukenn man miro dad un miri dai, leh tu, baro Dewel, man pash tute pre.
Baro Dewel, sike man tiro drom! Un an man ap o tchatcho drom, te hunte rikrenn kolla pengro mui, kai mange tchilatchepen kamenna.
Ma de man an lengre wasta! Dik, menshe hi koi, kai chochepen ap mande pre anan, un ladjenn pen gar, te denn le man trad.
Me djinau, te dikau me o latchepen o baro Deblestar an kau djipen.
Rike tut ap o baro Debleste tiro tselo djijeha! Ab soreles, un ma traash, un rike tut ap o baro Debleste!

I gili o Davidestar. Tu, baro Dewel, hal mange har i baro sorelo bar, kai nai khatrau man. Ap tute dau me gole. Ma risse tire kanda mandar! Tu te shuneh gar, har gole dau, palle hom jaake har kolla, kai pash i mulende an o mulengro them djan.
Shun ap miro ropen! Shun, har ap tute gole dau! Dik ap mire wasta, hoi me pre-hidjrau pash tiro kheer, kai tu hal!
Ma kre mantsa har i tchilatchentsa un kolentsa, kai krenn i wawarenge tchilatchepen, kai rakrenn latches, un an lengro dji hi tchilatchepen!
Kre lentsa pal kowa, hoi jon kran, pal lengro tchilatchepen, hoi jon kran, pal kowa, hoi jon pengre wastentsa kran! De len pale pal kowa, hoi kran le i wawarenge!
Jon dikenn gar ap kowa, hoi o baro Dewel krell, witar gar ap kowa, hoi job peskre wastentsa kras. Doleske witsrell lo len ap i phub, te nai stenn le buder gar pre.
Sharedo well o baro Dewel, job shunas miro ropen.

O baro Dewel hi miri soor, un rikras peskro wast pral mande. Ap leste patsau miro tselo djijeha. Un job was ap miri rig. Kanna stell miro dji, un hi bachteles, un me kamau les sharell un leske giwell.
O baro Dewel hi o sorelo ap i rig peskre menshendar. Un o baro rajeske, hoi job wi-rodas, hi lo har i baro sorelo kheer.
Ab ap i rig tire menshenge! Tchip tiri soor un tiri bacht ap mende, kai tiro ham! Ab hako tsiro har i bakrengro menge, kai dell jak ap peskre bakrende un dell len lauter, hoi len hunte well djipaske!
I gili o Davidestar. Tumer bolepangre, sharenn o baro Debles! Sharenn leskro railepen un leskri soor!
Krenn leskro lab baro! Awenn un witsrenn tumen tele glan o baro Debleste, te well lo an peskre shukar un kutch ripja!
O baro Debleskro rakepen well shunlo pral i panja. Te dell o sorelo Dewel gole, hi kowa har koi bari gole, hoi dell o bolepen, te dell baro brishin. O baro Dewel hi o rai pral i tsele bare panja.
Leskro rakepen hi pherdi soor, un sikrell hawo baro rai job hi.
O baro Debleskro rakepen phagella sorele ruka, ninna kol zedertikre ruka ap i berga Libanon.
Job mukell len te stell har i terne grumja, I berga Libanon mukell lo te stell har i terni grumni stell, un i berga Sirjon har i terno diwjo gurum.
Te rakrell o baro Dewel, dell jag karje dran o bolepen.
Te rakrell o baro Dewel, trissell o mulo tato them. O baro Dewel mukell te trissell o mulo tato them, hoi kharella Kadesh.
Te rakrell o baro Dewel, anenn i wesheskre grumja pengre terne ap i phub. Ninna nashrenn i ruka pengre patria an i wesha. An o Debleskro kheer dell hakeno gole: “Har baro hi o Dewel!”
O baro Dewel hi beshdo pral i panja. O baro Dewel hi o baro rai hako tsireske.
O baro Dewel dell peskre menshende soor, ninna bacht un latcho koowa.
I gili o Davidestar, te giwenn le ap kol bare diwessa, kai o Debleskro kheer kerdo was.
Me hadau tut, miro baro Dewel, tu tserdal man pre, har me dur tele homs, un mukal gar kolen pral mande te sal, kai mange tchilatchepen kaman.
Miro baro Dewel, har dom gole ap tute, kral tu man sasto.
Baro Dewel, tu lal miro djipen win dran o merepen, te djom gar an o mulengro them. Tu dal man miro djipen pale.
Bashrenn o baro Debleske, tumer, kai han leskro! Sharenn les, un bistrenn gar, te hi lo o Dewel.
I tikno tsiro kokres hi lo chojedo. O tselo djipen hi lo menge latcho. Rati well o ropen dren, un taissarlakro hi pale sapen koi.
Har mange mishto djas, penom: “Tchi nai well, hoi nai krell mange tchomone.”
Tu, baro Dewel, hals mange latcho, un kral man jaake sorelo har i baro bar. Ap jek kopo khatral tu tut mandar, un man tapras i daar.
Ap tute, baro Dewel, dom gole, ap tute, miro rai, rowom un penom:
“Hoi hi tut miro merepastar, te merau? Te wom paskedo un wom pale tchik, nai sharau tut buder gar, witar gar nai rakrau pral tiro tchatchepen.
Shun, baro Dewel, un ab mange latcho! Ab ap miri rig, miro baro Dewel!”
Dran miro ropaskri gili kral tu mange i bachtjakro khelepen. Tu pandal mange ko gono tele, hoi miro ropaskro ripen his, un tchiwal bacht har i ripen ap mande.
Jaake kamau te giwap tuke gilja, un mukau gar tele, te sharap tut. Miro baro Dewel, me kamau man pash tute te parkrell kanna un hako tsiro.
I gili o rajeske pral i gipangre. O David kras kai gili.
Baro Dewel, pash tute wau, te rikress tire wasta pral mande. Muk man gar tchitcheske pash tute te well! Tu hal latcho un tchatcho. Doleske le man dran i tchilatche wasta win!
Shun, har dau ap tute gole, un ab sik ap miri rig! Ab mange har i baro sorelo bar, kai nai khatrau man! Ab mange har i sorelo kheer, te nai hatsell man kek!
Awa, tu hal mange har i sorelo kheer ap i baro bar. Dja mantsa un an man ap i drom, kai kek nai taprell man, te well tiro lab sharedo.
Tserde man dran koi netsa win, hoi kran le, te perap dren. Tu hal o sorelo, kai ap miri rig hi.
Me dau man an tire wasta. Tu leh man dran i tchilatche wasta win, baro Dewel. Tu hal i Dewel, kai rikrell peskro lab.
Me nai dikau kolen gar glan i jaka, kai mangenn wawar deblen an. Me rikrau man ap tute, baro Dewel.
Miro dji sal un me stau i bachtjatar pral tiro latchepen. Tu dikal, har mange djungeles djas, un djinal, har pharo miro djipen his.
Tu dal man gar an i wasta kolendar, kai mange tchilatchepen kaman. Kanna nai djau, kai me kamau.
Baro Dewel, ab latches mange! Me djiwau an i daar, mire jaka hi pesso o ropastar. Un kek soor hi buder an mande.
I daar chas miro djipen pre, un mire bersha his pherdo ropen. Miri doosh lell miri soor mandar, jaake te djap bango.
Kolla, kai mange tchilatchepen kamenn, san pral mande. Gomme djungleder kran mange kolla, kai djiwenn langs mande. Mire mala trashenn mandar. Te dikenn le man ap o drom, nashenn le penge mandar.
Bud bistran man, har te woms mulo un paskedo. Lenge hom har i phagedo tcharo, hoi krik witsedo was.
Me shunau, har rakrenn le djungeles pral mande. I traash hi trul mande. Jon tchiwenn pen khetne, un rodenn i drom, har te denn le man mulo.
Baro Dewel, me rikrau man ap tute. Miro Dewel hal tu.
Miro djipaskro tsiro hi an tire wasta. Le man win dran i wasta kolendar, kai mange tchilatchepen kamenn, un man palla lenn.
Dik latches ap mande! Me hom tiro budepaskro! Ab kamles mange un tserde man dran lengre wasta win!
Baro Dewel, muk man gar tchitcheske gole te dell ap tute! Kre, te ladjenn pen i tchilatche! Jon mu djan tele un merenn! Palle nai rakrenn le buder gar,
kolla chochene, kai hi pre-phurde un praassenn kolen, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi.
Har baro hi tiro latchepen, miro Dewel, kolenge, kai djiwenn tuha! Hakeneste sikreh tu, har latcho tu kolenge hal, kai rikrenn pen ap tute.
Tu khatreh len pash tute kol menshendar, kai tchiwenn pen khetne, te krenn le lenge tchilatchepen. Tu mukeh kek praassepen pral lende te well.
Baro Dewel, parkrau man pash tute. Tu sikral tiro baro latchepen ap mande, har homs har i foro, trul koleste bud lurde tarde his.
Me homs jaake dareno, te penom: “Mo Dewel, tu kameh mandar buder tchi te djinell!” Kowa his gar jaake: Tu shunal man, har rowom ap tute.
Kamenn o baro Debles o tselo djijestar, tumer kai leskre han! Koon ap leste patsella, hi an leskro wast. Koon pes pre phurdell, ap koleste well leskri choli.
Awenn soreles an tumaro dji, un ma darenn, tumer halauter, kai dikenn ap o baro Debleste.
Laba o Davidestar. Bachtelo hi kowa, koleske o tchilatchepen, hoi ap leste his, krik lino hi, un leskri doosh bistedo hi.
Bachtelo hi ko mensho, koneske o baro Dewel i doosh gar glan-rikrell, un an koleste kek chochepen hi.
Har kamom miri doosh gar win te rakrell, nashrom me miri soor un rowom hako diwes.
Miro Dewel, diwes un rati his tiro wast phares ap mande tchiddo, un miri djipaskri soor djas jaake peske mandar, har o senlepen peskri soor nashrella an o tato nijal.
Doleske penom me tuke miri doosh, un khatrom gar o tchilatchepen, hoi me krom. Me penom mange: “Me kamau o baro Debleske ko tchilatchepen te penell, hoi krom.” Un tu lal miri doosh mandar krik.
Doleske mangenn tut lauter kolla an, kai tiro hi, an ko tsiro, kai taprell len i daar. Palle, te wenn i bare panja, nai taprenn le len gar.
Pash tute nai khatrau me man, glan kowa, hoi mange daar krell. Doleske sharau tut i bachtelo djijeha pral kowa, har tu man win lal dran i bibacht.
“Me kamau tute te sikrell hawo drom tu hunte djas, un penau tuke, har tu les djas, un dau jak ap tute,” penell o baro Dewel.
“Ma awenn dinele har i graja, un i maultikre burike! Lenge hunte tchiwess i shello trujel un i saster an o mui, te nai aness len kote, kai kameh.”
Ap i tchilatche menshende wenn bud duka. Koon tchiwell peskro tselo patsepen ap o baro Debleste, trul koleste tchiwell job peskro latchepen.
Tumer, kai an o tchatchepen tardo han, awenn bachtelo pral tumaro baro Debleste! Mukenn tumare djia san un bashrenn! Denn gole i bachtjatar, tumer lauter, kai shunenn o tselo djijeha ap o Debleste.
Tumer, kai an o tchatchepen tardo han, denn gole i bachtjatar pral kowa, hoi o baro Dewel krell. Hi mishto, te sharenn les, tumer, kai tumaro tselo djijeha ap leste shunenn!
Parkrenn tumen pash o baro Debleste, un bashrenn leske ap dorjengre bashepangre! Giwenn leske gilja, un bashrenn leske ap i bashepaskri i deesh dorjentsa!
Giwenn leske i newi gili! Krenn shukar bashepen un denn gole i bachtjatar!
O baro Debleskro lab hi tchatcho. Un kowa, hoi krell lo, hi sorelo.
Job kamell i tchatche dromma un i tchatche laba. Un i tseli phub hi pherdo latchepen o baro Deblestar.
Dran o lab o baro Deblestar was o bolepen kerdo. Dran o ducho, hoi dran leskro mui djas, wan i tsele bolepangre momlia kerdo.
Job rikrell i bare panja khetne har an i gono, un tchiwell i bare panja khetne har an i kheer.
I tseli phub hunte darell o baro Deblestar, hakeno, kai ap i phub djiwella, hunte penell leske: “Tu hal o Dewel.”
Job te rakrell, palle well, hoi job penas, jaake har lo kowa penas, jaake hi kowa koi tardo.
O baro Dewel mukell kowa gar te well, hoi kol menshe an i wawar themma kamenn te krell. Lenge tchiwell lo barra an o drom.
Kowa, hoi o baro Dewel kamell te krell, atchell soreles tardo, un kowa, hoi les an peskro dji hi, te krell lo, atchell jaake rah har menshe koi hi.
Bachtele hi kol menshe, kolengro Dewel o baro Dewel hi, kol menshe, kai job peske wi-rodas, te wenn le leskre menshe.
O baro Dewel dikell tele dran o bolepen, un dikell i tsele menshen.
Job hi beshdo ap peskri rajeskri beshepaskri un dikell ap lauterende, kai ap i phub djiwenna.
Job tchiwell lenge an o dji, hoi te krenn le, un dell jak ap lauter, hoi jon krenna.
I baro rai bud lurdentsa well gar dran peskri soor o sorleder an o kurepen. Un i tchatcho mursh, koles bud soor hi, well gar dran peskri soor win lino dran o kurepen.
Hi witar gar i graja, kai nai lenn win dran o kurepen, ninna te hi len bari soor.
Kowa hi o baro Dewel, kai dell garda ap kolende, kai djiwenn leha, kolla, kai dikenn ap leste, te well lo lenge latcho,
un lell lengro djipen dran o merepen win. Ninna te well bari bok pral o them, merenn le gar.
Mer rikrah men ap o baro Debleste maro tselo djijeha. Job well ap mari rig, un rikrell peskro wast pral mende.
An leste hi maro dji bachtelo, un mer rikrah men ap leste, kai hi kokres o Dewel.
Dik, har mer dikah ap tute, baro Dewel, jaake muk tiro latchepen pral mende te well!
I gili o Davidestar, hoi job giwas, har job pash o Abimelech kras, har te wals lo dinelo, un kowa les krik tradas.
Me kamau o baro Debles te sharell hako tsireske, un kamau gar tele mukell, te parkrap man pash leste.
Kowa, hoi job lauter kras an miro djipen, kamau me te sharell. Mu shunenn kowa kolla, kai tele rikedo hi, un wenn bachtele!
Giwenn mantsa gilja o baro Debleske! Krenn leskro lab mantsa khetne baro!
Me rodom o baro Debles, un job shunas man. Job las man win dran miri tseli daar.
Kolla, kai ap leste dikenna, lengre jaka wenna har i momeli, un jon hunte ladjenn pen gar.
Ake hi jek, kai gole das ap o baro Debleste, har leske djungeles djas, un job shunas les un las les win dran lauter, hoi leske o djipen phares kras.
O baro Debleskro bolepaskro hi trul kolende, kai djiwenn o baro Debleha, un lell len win dran i bibacht.
Haiwenn un dikenn har kamles o baro Dewel hi! Bachtelo hi kowa, kai pes ap leste rikrella.
Tumer, kai o baro Debleskre menshe han, djiwenn leha! Kolen, kai djiwenn leha, hi lauter o djipaske.
I bare diwje margodje hatsenn gar hako diwes doha chapaske un hunte bokenna. Kol menshen, kai rodenn o baro Debles, hi lauter doha djipaske.
Awenn, tumer tchawe un shunenn, hoi me penau! Me kamau tumen te sikrell, har djiwenn tumer o baro Debleha.
Kamenn tumer te djiwenn i shukar un rah djipen?
Palle denn garda ap tumari tchip, te rakrell li kek tchilatchepen un kek chochepen!
Rikrenn tumen pale dran o tchilatchepen un krenn o latchepen! Tumari tseli sorjah krenn lauter, te well kek tchingepen mank tumende!
O baro Dewel dikell ap kolende, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi. Un leskre kanda shunenn len, te denn le gole.
O baro Dewel hi gar kolentsa, kai o tchilatchepen krenna, un krell, te wenn le sik bistedo pal lengro merepen.
Te denn kolla ap leste gole, kai rikrenn ap leste, palle shunell len o baro Dewel, un lell len win dran lengri tseli bibacht.
O baro Dewel hi pash kolende, kai lengro dji phagedo hi. Un kolenge, kai dikenn buder kek momeli an pengro djipen, hi lo ap i rig tardo.
Bud duka wenna ap koleste, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi. Dran kowa lauter lell o baro Dewel les win.
Job dell jaake jak ap leste, te well kek kokalo lestar phagedo.
O tchilatcho merell dran peskro tchilatchepen. Un kolla, kai kamenn tchilatchepen ap i latchende te anell, lenna pengri phagi.
O baro Dewel rikrell peskre budepangre ap o djipen. Un ap lauterende, kai rikrenn pen ap leste, well kek doosh anlo.
I gili o Davidestar. Baro Dewel, le miro koowa an tiro wast un tchinge kolentsa, kai mantsa tchingrenna! Kure tut kolentsa, kai kurenn pen mantsa!
Le tiro shilto an o wast, rib tiro sasterno ripen ap tute! Un ab ap miri rig!
Le tiro charo un tiro tower, un tchip tut kolenge an o drom, kai man palla lenna! Pen mange: “Me hom ap tiri rig.”
Mu well ladj un praassepen ap kolende, kai kamenn miro merepen! Mu wenn le pale-tchiddo un ladjenn pen, kolla, kai rodenn miri bibacht!
Mu tradell len o baro Debleskro bolepaskro krik, jaake te wenn le har phuss, hoi i ducho krik phurdell!
Lengro drom te well kalo un sapeno, te dikenn le tchi un perenn le! Un o baro Debleskro bolepaskro te lell len palla!
Jon tchiwan mange i netsa win, te perap dren, ninna te krom me lenge tchi. Tchitcheske hadan le mange i cheb win, te perap dren.
Muk i bibacht pral lende te well jaake sik har i dap! Mu perenn le an koi netsa, hoi jon tchiwan mange. Mu perenn le an koi cheb, hoi jon hadan mange win!
Miro dji mu giwell un bashrell, te las man o baro Dewel dran lengre wasta win.

Lauter, hoi an mande hi, penell: Baro Dewel, koon hi jaake har tu? Tu leh o tchorweles win dran i wasta kolendar, kai sorleder hi har job. Tu leh koles, kai bibachtelo un tchorwelo hi, win dran i wasta kolendar, kai tchoran leskro koowa.
Chochene wenna, un anenn doosh ap mande. Jon putchenn mandar, hoi me gar djinau.
Me homs ap lende latches. Jon denn man tchilatchepen pale, un krenn, te wap kokres.
Har jek lendar nasselo his, riwom ropaskre ripja ap mande, chom tchi un bokom leske, un pale te pale mangom o Debles leske,
har te wals lo miro maal un phraal. Mange was ropaske jaake har te wals lo miri dai.
Hi wawartchandes lentsa. Har me perom, stan le i bachtjatar, un tchiwan pen khetne, te djan le ap mande pre. Depangre wan, kai prindjrom gar, un dan man dawa un mukan gar tele.
Khetne kol tchilatchentsa praassan le man un sikran mange pengre danda.
Rai, har rah kameh tu kowa te dikell un kreh tchi? Le miro djipen dran i wasta kolendar win, kai peran pral mande har diwje vieche.
Palle kamau man pash tute te parkrell kote, kai bud menshe khetne wenna an o Debleskro kheer. Awa, glan i tsele menshende sharau tut.
Ma muk, te sanenn kolla pral mande, kai kamenn mange tchilatchepen, ninna te krom me len tchi. Ma muk len i jakentsa te dell pal mande!
