Jon rakrenna, hoi dukepen anella. Un anenn chochepen pre ap kolende, kai djiwenn kek tchingepah an kau them.
Pengre muja krenn le dur pre un denn gole ap mande: “Ha! Ha! Koleske dam les!”
Baro Dewel, tu dikal kowa. Rike tut gar pale, rake! Miro rai, ma ab kanna dur mandar krik!
Hade tut! Ste pre, un de man miro tchatchepen! Le miro koowa an tiro wast, mo Dewel un mo rai!
Baro Dewel, tu hal an o tchatchepen tardo. De man miro tchatchepen! Miro Dewel, muk len gar pral mande te sal!
Muk len gar an pengre djia te penell: “Dik! Men hi, hoi kamam. Kanna chah mer les djides!”
Kre, te ladjenn le pen, un nai hadenn pengro shero gar pral, kolla lauter, kai hi bachtelo pral miri bibacht! Mu well praassepen un ladj ap lende, kai hadenn pen pral mande.
Kre, te stenn un sanenn i bachtjatar kolla, kai kamenn, te lap miro tchatchepen. Mu penenn le pale te pale: “Har baro hi o baro Dewel, kai hi jaake latcho ap peskro budepaskro!”
Me kamau te rakrap pral tiro tchatchepen, un sharau tut hako diwes.
I gili o rajeske pral i gipangre. O David, ko baro Debleskro budepaskro, kras kai gili.
O tchilatchepen hi o tchilatcheske an o rat. Job kamell o Deblestar tchi te djinell un darell lestar gar.
An peskre jaka hi kowa jaake shukar, hoi lo krella, te haiwell lo gar, kai kowa i doosh hi, kai hunte rikrals pes lo latar pale.
Tchi har midjak un chochene laba wenn dran leskro mui win. Latcho koowa haiwell lo buder gar te krell.
Te hi lo ap peskro tchiben tchiddo, djal o tchilatchepen an leskro shero trujel. Un job rikrell soreles ap i drom, hoi gar mishto hi, un rikrell pes gar pale, te krell lo o tchilatchepen.
Baro Dewel, tiro latchepen hi jaake baro har o bolepen. Un tiro kamlepen ap tire menshende djal bis pash i wolke.
Tiro tchatchepen djal jaake pre har i bare berge. Un i tchatche laba, hoi tu win rakreh, djan dur tele har o baro pani. Baro Dewel, tu deh i menshen un i viechen kowa, hoi len hunte well.
Har railo hi tiro latchepen, miro Dewel! I menshe wenn pash tute, te rikress tire wasta pral lende, har i tchirklo rikrell peskre mussja pral peskre terne.
Tu tchoreh pral lende latcho koowa dran o brawlepen an tiro kheer. Un deh len tiro latchepen te pijell, har te pijans le latcho pani.
Tu hal o djido pani, hoi newo djipen della. Tu hal i momeli maro djipaske.
Tchip tiro latchepen ap kolende, kai tut prindjrenna, un muk tiro tchatchepen te well kolenge, kai shunenn ap tute o tselo djijestar.
Muk i pre-phurden gar te stakrenn le man tele. Kre te nai tradenn man i tchilatche gar dran miro kheer win.
Dikenn, i tchilatche peran! Jon hi tchiddo ap i phub, un nai stenn gar buder pre.
I gili o Davidestar. Ma choje tut pral i tchilatchende! Te djal kolenge mishto, kai krenn tchilatcho koowa, ma silwe ap lende!
Jon hi har khass, hoi merell, te dell kek brishin, un har o senlepen, hoi atchell gar.
Dik ap o baro Debleste, te krell lo tuke latchepen! Un kre, hoi mishto hi! Atch an o them, un djib kolestar, hoi tire wastentsa budral!
Rode tiri bacht pash o baro Debleste, palle dell job tut lauter, hoi tiro dji kamella.
De tiro djipen an o wast o baro Deblestar, un pats ap leste! Palle krell job lauter mishto.
Un job mukell tiro tchatchepen pre te djal har o kham, un mukell tiro tchatchepen diklo te well har o kham mashkral o diwes.
Atch pokones un dik ap o baro Debleste, te well lo ap tiri rig! Ab gar chojedo pral koleste, kai leske mishto djala, ninna te hi les tchilatchepen an o shero.
Muk tele i choljatar! Ma choje tut pral o tchilatchepen, hoi i wawar krenna! Kowa nai anell tut jaake dur, te kreh tu ninna o tchilatchepen.
I tsiro wella, kai hi buder kek tchilatche ap kai phub. Kolla, kai ap o baro Debleste dikenna, te well leskro tsiro, kolenge hi palle o them.
An i tikno tsiro hi o tchilatcho buder gar koi. Un kote, kai job djiwas, hatseh les buder gar.
I tchorwele lenn ko them. Kote hi len budeder bacht har doha.
O tchilatcho kamell midjak koowa te krell ap koleste, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi, un sikrell leske i danda.
O baro Dewel sal pral leste, job dikell leskro diwes te well.
I tchilatche lenn pengro charo, un hadenn pengro bogo, te marenn le i tchorwelen un kolen, kai nai kurenn pen gar, ninna lauteren, kai djan ap o tchatcho drom.
Jon denn pen pengro chareha kokres an pengro dji tchurje, un lengre boge wenna phagedo.
Ko tikno brawlepen, hoi koleskro hi, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi, hi feteder har ko baro brawlepen bud tchilatchendar.
Kolengri soor well phagedo. O baro Dewel rikrell kolen, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi.
O baro Dewel prindjrell i diwessa kolendar, kai ap leste shunenna pengro tselo djijeha, un lengro them atchell lenge hako tsireske.
An i tchilatcho tsiro mukell lo len gar, un an i boklo tsiro dell job len doha te chal.
I tchilatche merenna, un kolla, kai o baro Debles gar kamenna, hi har kol shukar diwje blume, hoi sik tele merenn, un djan penge har i jagakro ducho, hoi pre djal.
O tchilatcho patsell peske lowe, un plaissrell gar pale. Kowa, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi, krell peskro dji pre un della.
Kol menshe, ap kolende o baro Dewel peskri bacht tchiwas, lenn ko them. Kolla, ap kolende o baro Dewel i bibacht tchiwas, kolendar atchell kek.
O baro Deblestar well, te djal i mursh o tchatcho drom. Pral koleste hi lo bachtelo.
Ninna te perell lo, atchell lo gar tchiddo, o baro Dewel rikrell les ap peskro wast.
Me homs terno un wom phuro. An ko tselo tsiro dikom me kekes kokres muklo, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi; un kekes leskre tchawendar dikom, kai hunte mangas peske maro.
O tselo tsiro krell job peskro dji pre un patsella, un ap leskre tchawende well o Debleskri bacht diklo.
Muk o tchilatchepen pal tute, un kre o latchepen! Palle nai atcheh hako tsireske khere an o them.

O baro Dewel kamell o tchatchepen un mukell peskre menshen gar kokres. Hako tsiro dell job jak ap lende. Kolla, kai kamenn o Deblestar tchi te djinell, merenna, ninna lengre tchawe un kolengre tchawe.
Kolla, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi, lenn o them, un djiwenn kote hako tsireske.
Goswepen well dran o mui i latcho menshestar, un leskri tchip rakrell o tchatchepen.
O Debleskre laba hi an leskro dji. Un job perell gar o tchatcho dromestar tele.
O tchilatcho lell koles an o jak, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi, te hatsell lo i drom, te nai dell lo les mulo.
O baro Dewel mukell les gar an o tchilatcheskro wast. Te anenn le les glan i tchatchepangre, nai anenn jon kek doosh ap leste pre.
Dik ap o baro Debleste, te well lo ap tiri rig! Un atch ap leskro drom! Palle hadell lo tut un dell tut ko them. Un tu dikeh, har wenn i tchilatche maredo.
Me dikom i tchilatches, kai hadas pes pral i wawarende, un kras pes buchlo har i baro sorelo ruk.
Un har wom i wawar kopo koi, his lo buder gar koi. Un me rodom les, un hatsom les gar.
Kre jaake har kowa, kai shunell ap o Debleste peskro tselo djijeha! Un djib jaake har kowa, kai well kek doosh ap leste hatslo. Sawo mensheske djal mishto an ko tsiro, hoi wella.
Kolla, kai o Deblestar tele peran, wenna lauter mulo dino. Un i tchilatchendar pengre tchawentsa un tchawengre tchawentsa atchell kek pral.
O baro Dewel well ap i rig kolendar, kai ap leste rikrenna. An i pharo tsiro dell lo len soor.
Un o baro Dewel hi pash lende tardo, un lell len win, awa, dran o wast i tchilatchendar lell lo len win. Jon nashenn pash leste, un job dell garda ap lende.
I gili o Davidestar, te bistrell les o Dewel gar.
Baro Dewel, ma tchinge ap mande an tiri choli! Ma de man i phagi an tiri choli!
Tu dal karje ap mande un dukral man, un tiro wast das man ap i phub tele.
Ap miro mass hi buder tchi sasto dran tiri choli. Ninna mire kokale dukrenna. Dran miri doosh was kowa ap mande.
Miri doosh was jaake bares an mande, te djal li pral miro shero. Me nai hidjrau lat gar, jaake pharo hi li.
Miro bud dukepen khandella, un i djelto pani djal dran o dukepen win. Dran miro dinlepen well kowa ap mande.
Me nashau bango i dukatar, har te loms dawa. Un o tselo diwes rowell miro dji.
An mande chatchrell i tatepen, un tchi ap mande hi sasto.
Kek soor hi buder an mande, un me hom phagedo. Miro dji hi jaake dareno, kai dau gole i dukatar.
Miro rai, tu djineh, hoi me miro djijestar kamau, un miro tselo ropen hi gar khatedo glan tute.
Miro dji djal sikeder. Miri soor mukas man. Un mire jaka nashran pengri soor.
Mire mala un mire menshe darenn glan miro nasslepen. Un kolla, kai pash mande djiwenna, hi dur mandar krik tardo.

Kolla, kai kamenn man te marell, tchiwenn mange dorja win, te perap dren. Kolla, kai rodenn miri bibacht, rakrenn khetne, hoi nai krenn le mantsa. O tselo diwes rodenn le pal kowa, har nai chochenn le man.
Me krau har nai shunoms tchi, un krau miro mui gar pre har jek, kai buder gar nai rakrell.
Awa, me wom har i mursh, kai buder tchi shunell, kai les buder kek lab an o mui hi, hoi job pale nai rakrell.
Tchatchepah, me tchiwau miro tselo patsepen ap tute, baro Dewel, te rakress tu mantsa, mo rai un mo Dewel.
Un me penom tuke: “Ma muk len te sal pral mande!” Me te peroms, sharans jon pen pral mande.
Hi buder gar dur, te perap, un mire duka hi hako tsiro glan mire jaka.
Doleske penau tuke, hawo tchilatcho koowa me krom, un miri doosh khaitell man.
Kolla, kai mange tchilatchepen kamenna, hi soreles un hi bud. Bud choirenn pen ap mande, ninna te krom len tchi.
Awa, jon denn man tchilatchepen ap o latchepen pale. Un tchingrenn ap mande, kai krom o latchepen.
Ma biste man, baro Dewel! Miro Dewel, ab gar dur mandar!
Ab sik ap miri rig! Miro rai, tu hal kowa, kai man dran lengre wasta win lell.
I gili o rajeske pral i gipangre, o Jedutun. O David kras kai gili.
Me penom mange: Me dau ap mande jak, te rakrap kek tchilatchepen. Me tchiwom miro wast ap miro mui jaake rah har o tchilatcho his trul mande.
Un me rikrom miro mui, un homs pokones. Har penom tchi, witar kek latcho lab, was i daar an mande baro.
Un miro dji chatchras i dukatar, un miro shero was tato, un me nai rikrom man buder gar pale, un penom:
Baro Dewel, sike mande, har sik o djipen trujel hi, un kai miro merepen wella, te djinap, te nai atchau gar hako tsiro kai.
Miro djipen hi jaake tikno har i wast buchlo hi. Kowa hi har tchi pash tute. Har sorelo i mensho ninna tardo hi, leskro djipen hi har i ducho.
O mensho well un djal pale har i suni. O mensho budrella bud tchitcheske un krell bud gole trul tchi. Job anell peske bud brawlepen khetne, un djinell gar, koon kowa lella.
Kanna, miro rai, hoi well ap mande? Me dikau ap tute,
te less man win dran miri tseli doosh! Ma muk i dinelen pral mande te sal!
Me penau buder tchi. Miro mui atchell pandlo. Tutar well kowa, hoi pral mande was.
Me mangau tut: Le tiro wast mandar krik. Te deh tu man dureder, hunte merap.
Tu te deh o menshes i phagi, te anas lo doosh ap peste, palle djal lo jaake paash har i ripen, hoi chalo well i kirmestar. Awa, o mensheskro djipen hi tchi buder har i ducho.
Baro Dewel, shun miro mangepen! Un shun, har dau ap tute gole! Dik mire swa un rake mantsa! Me hom gar khere ap kai phub, djiwau har i wi-themari pash tute, jaake har ninna mire phure djiwan.
Muk man kanna, te lap newi soor, bis te hunte merap, un me gar buder hom.
I gili o rajeske pral i gipangre. O David kras kai gili.
Miro tselo djijeha dikom ap o baro Debleste, un job rissras peskro kand pash mande, un shunas, har ap leste gole dom.
Job hadas man win dran i grufta, dran o merepen un i tchik, un tchiwas mire pire ap i baro bar, te wap soreles tardo.
An miro mui tchiwas lo i newi gili, i gili, hoi maro Debles sharell. Bud, kai dikenn kowa, haiwenn, te hi o baro Dewel o rai, un jon patsenn ap leste.
Bachtelo hi ko mensho, kai rikrell pes ap o baro Debleste, un djal gar kolentsa, kai hi pre-phurde un chochene.
Miro baro Dewel, har bud hi ko baro koowa, hoi tu ap mende kral, hoi kek wawar nai krals, har tu kokres. Te kamoms pral kowa lauter te rakrell, nai kroms kowa gar, jaake bud hi kowa.

Kol viechen un ko chapen, hoi i menshe tuke anenna, kameh tu gar. Tu dal man kanda, te haiwap, hoi kameh: kek viechen, hoi i menshe tuke chatchrenna, witar kek, hoi marenn le, te less tu lengri doosh lendar krik.
Doleske penom tuke: Ake hom. Me krau, hoi mandar tchinlo hi an o liil:
“Miro Dewel, me kamau te krap o djijestar, hoi tu kameh. Un tiro lab hi an miro dji.”
Kote, kai lauter khetne wenna, penau me lenge, kai tu leh win dran o tchilatchepen. Miro mui pandau me gar. Tu, baro Dewel, djineh kowa.

Me rikrau man gar pale te penap lenge, hoi tu mendar kameh, un kai tu rikreh tiro lab, un leh i doosh krik. Un me rikrau man gar pale, te rakrap pral tiro latchepen un tchatchepen kote, kai bud menshe khetne wenna.
Baro Dewel, muk tiro dji hako tsiro mange pre te well! Tu kameh man un hal mange latches. Doleske rike tiro wast pral mande hako tsiro!

Haki rigjatar was bibacht ap mande, jaake bud, te djinau gar, har bud kope i bibacht man das. Miri doosh tapras man, un hi jaake bud, te nai dikap lat gar lauter. O tchilatcho koowa, hoi krom, hi budeder har mire balla ap miro shero, un miro dji hi dareno.
Baro Dewel, dik latches ap mande, un le man win dran o tchilatchepen! Ab sik ap miri rig!
Kre, te ladjenn le pen, un lenn i lolo shero, kolla lauter, kai kamenn man mulo dell! Kre len tikno, te ladjenn le pen, kolla, kai hi bachtelo pral miri bibacht!
Mu well ladj un daar ap lende, kai pral mande sanenn un gole denn: “Awa, Awa, Awa!”

Kolla lauter, kai tut rodenna, mu wenn le bachtelo pral tute un giwenn i bachtjatar! Kolla, kai mangenn tutar, te less len win dran o tchilatchepen, mu penenn le hako tsiro: “Sharedo well o baro Dewel!”
Me hom tchorwelo. Un man hi kek soor an mande. Miro Rai, biste man gar! Tu hal kowa, kai well ap miri rig un lell man win dran o tchilatchepen. Am sik miro Dewel!
I gili o rajeske pral i gipangre. O David kras kai gili.
Bachtelo hi kowa, kai dell jak ap kolende, kai gar soreles hi. Ap ko diwes, kai les i bibacht taprella, lell o baro Dewel les win.
O baro Dewel rikrell peskre wasta pral leste, un rikrell leskro djipen, un krell, te djal leske mishto ap i phub. Un job mukell les gar an i tchilatche wasta te perell.
O baro Dewel dell les newi soor ap o nasslengro tchiben, un krell les sasto.
Me penom: “Baro Dewel, kre tiro dji mange pre! Me anom doosh ap mande. Kre man sasto!”
Kolla, kai kamenn mange tchilatchepen, rakrenn djungeles pral mande un penenna: “Kaana merell lo, te well leskro lab bistedo?”

Te well jek lendar pash mande, te dikell lo pal mande, palle well lo i tchilatcho djijeha. Job rodell i doosh, hoi nai anell lo ap mande pre. Te djal lo palle mandar win, rakrell lo chochepen pral mande.
Kolla, kai kamenn mange tchilatchepen, tchiwenn pengre shere khetne, un rakrenn djungeles pral mande.
“I bibacht hi ap leste”, penenn le. “Koon jaake tchiddo hi, stell buder gar pre.”
Ninna miro latcheder maal, kowa, kai mantsa khetne chas, phukras ap mande.
Tu, baro Dewel, kre tiro dji mange pre! Hade man pale pre! Palle dau len lauter pale, hoi jon mange kran.
Muk len gar pral mande te sal! Palle dikau, te dikeh tu latches ap mande.
Me shunau ap tute miro tselo djijeha. Doleske rikreh tu miro djipen, un mukeh man te djiwell pash tute hako tsiro.
Sharas o baro Debles, ko Debles pral o Israel, kanna un hako tsiro. Amen! Awa, Amen!
I gili jekestar, kai hi dran i familja Korach. Kai gili hi o rajeske pral i gipangre.
Har i wesheskri busjat bari trush hi pal shila pani, jaake nashell miro dji pal tute miro Dewel.
Awa, man hi trush pal o Debleste, pal ko djido Debleste. Kaana nai wau glan tute an tiro kheer, te dikap tut?
I wawar penenn ap mande hako diwes: “Kai hi tiro Dewel?” Doleske rowau o tselo diwes un haki rati; mire swa wan miro pipen.

Miro dji phagell an mande, har mukau mange an miro shero trujel te djal, har djom bud menshentsa ap o drom un anom len an o Debleskro kheer. Ap o drom sharam les bari goljah, te parkras men pash leste, un hams bud, kai giwan leske gilja i bachtelo djijeha.
Hoske rowell miro dji, un hi jaake pharo an mande? Ap miro Debleste kamau te dikell. Me djinau, te well i tsiro, kai sharau les, miro Debles, te was lo ap miri rig.
Kanna, mo Dewel, rowell miro dji. Doleske dikau ap tute kote, kai hom: an o them pash o pani Jordan, pash i berge Hermon un Misar.
Tire panja perenn bari sorjah un goljah tele. Jek baro pani pal o wawar djal pral mande wergel.
Pral o diwes bitchrell o baro Dewel mange peskro latchepen, un rati giwau leske gilja, un mangau o Debles, kai les miro djipen an o wast hi.
Me penau ap miro Debleste, kai hi mange har i sorelo kheer, kai nai khatrau man: Hoske bistral tu man? Hoske hunte rowap me? Kolla djan ap mande, kai mange o djipen phares krenna.
Jon sanenn pral mande un putchenn mandar hako diwes: “Kai hi tiro Dewel? Kai atchell lo?” Lengro praassepen hi mange har i merepaskro dukepen an mire kokale.
Me penau mange: Hoske roweh tu, miro dji, un hal jaake pharo an mande? Ap mo Debleste kamau te dikell. Me djinau, te well i tsiro, kai sharau les, miro Debles, te was lo ap miri rig.

Miro Dewel, kre te lap miro tchatchepen! Le miro koowa an tiro wast, un rake mange latches pash kol menshende, kai kamenn tchi tutar te djinell! Le man win dran o wast i chochenendar un tchilatchendar!
Tu hal o sorelo Dewel ap miri rig. Hoske mukal tu man? Hoske djal mange jaake djungelo? Hoske nai krenn kolla mange o djipen pharo, kai mange tchilatchepen kamenn?
Bitche tiri momeli, te dikap tiro tchatchepen, hoi anell man ap o drom pash tiri Debleskri berga, kai tu djiweh.

Kote kamau me glan tiri Debleskri chatchepaskri te well, glan tute, miro Debleste, kai kreh, te giwap i bachtjatar. Miro bashepah ap i dorjengri bashepaskri kamau man te parkrap pash tute, miro Dewel.
Hoske rowell miro dji un hi jaake pharo an mande? Ap miro Debleste kamau te dikell. Me djinau, te well i tsiro, kai parkrau man pash leste, miro Debleste, te was lo ap miri rig.
I gili o rajeske pral i gipangre. Kai gili hi jekestar dran i familja Korach.
Maro Dewel, mare kandentsa shunam mer, har mare phure menge penan, hoi tu kral an lengre diwessa glan i rah tsiro.
Tu tradal tiro wasteha i wawar menshen win dran lengro them, un dal ko them mare phurende. Kol wawar menshen dal tu paash, te nai djiwan mare phure an ko them.
Jon lan o them gar dren pengre charentsa, witar gar pengri sorjah. Na-a! Kowa kras tiri tchatchi mussi un tiri soor. Tu hals pash lende un dikal kamles ap lende.
Tu hal miro baro rai, miro Dewel. Tu hal kowa, kai krell, te wenn o Jakobeskre tchawe o sorleder an o kurepen.
Khetne tuha witsrah mer kolen ap i phub, kai kurenn pen mentsa. Tiri sorjah stakrah mer kolen paash, kai hadenn pen ap mende.
Me djinau, miro bogo krell man gar soreles, un miro charo nai lell man gar win dran i tchilatche wasta.
Tu hal kowa, kai lell men win dran i tchilatche wasta. Un tu kreh kolen tikno, kai kamenn menge tchilatchepen.
Hako diwes ham bachtelo pral tute, maro Debleste, un sharah tut kanna un hako tsiro.
Kanna tchiwal men pale un witsral men an i ladj. Tu djah gar mare lurdentsa an o kurepen.
Tu mukal men pale te djal glan kolende, kai kuran pen mentsa. Jaake nai tchoran kolla mare koola, kai pral mende wan.
Har vieche, hoi wenn maredo, dal tu men pre. Un an i tsele themma trujel tradal tu men, jaake te atcham gar khetne.
Hi jaake har te bikrals tire menshen tchitcheske, un lals gar bud lowe lenge dren, har bikral len.
Tu kral, te hunte ladjas men glan i menshende, kai djiwenn an i themma trul mende; jon sanenn pral mende un praassenn men.
I menshe an wawar themma rakrenn laba sapaske pral mende, un tchiwenn pengre shere jek rigjatar ap i wawar pal mende.
O tselo diwes hi miri ladj glan mande, un miro mui chatchrell glan ladj.
Me shunau, har sanenn le pral mende un praassenn men, un hunte dikap kolen, kai menge tchilatchepen kamenn un menge o djipen phares krenn.
Kawa lauter was pral mende, ninna te bistram tut gar un kram, hoi tu mentsa win kral.
Mare djia mukan tut gar, witar gar djan mare herja tiro dromestar tele.
Fothe kram kowa gar, hi kowa jaake, har te dals tu men khetne, un mukals men mank diwje djukle te djiwell. Kek momeli hi glan mende.
Bistrams mer tut, maro Debles, un mangams i wawar debles an,
palle djinals tu kowa. Tu dikeh, hoi pash hakeneste an o dji khatemen hi, un hoi kek wawar djinell.
Tire menshe ham mer. Doleske wah mer o tselo tsiro mulo dino, har wams vieche, hoi wenn maredo.
Ste pre! Hoske soweh tu, mo rai? Ste pre un tchip men gar pale hako tsireske!
Hoske dikeh tu gar ap mende? Bistral tu, har djungeles menge djala, har phares jon menge o djipen krenna?
An i tchik ham witsedo. Un mer nai stah gar pre.
Ste pre un ab ap mari rig! Le men dran i tchilatche wasta win! Mer dikah ap tiro latchepen.
I bijabeskri gili jekestar, kai hi dran i familja Korach. Koi gili hi o rajeske pral i gipangre, te giwell pash o bashepen ap i shob-dorjengri bashepaskri.
Miro dji hi pherdo shukar laba i giljake, hoi kamau te giwap miro baro rajeske. Miri tchip hi har i tchinepaskro jekestar, kai haiwell mishto laba te tchinell.
Tu hal shukeder har i wawar menshe. Dran tiro mui wenn latche laba. Tchatchepah o Dewel tchiwas peskri bacht ap tute, te atchell li hako tsireske ap tute.
Tchip tiro charo ap tiri rig, tu tchatcho mursh, un sike tiro railepen un soor!

Besh tut ap tiro grai! Dja trujel an o them un kre o tchatchepen soreles! Le i tchorwelengro koowa an tiro wast un kre, te lenn le pengro tchatchepen! Jaake krell tiri tchatchi mussi baro sorelo koowa.
De tire faile karje, te djan le an o dji kolendar, kai kurenn pen tuha. Jaake perenna i wawar themma glan tute.
Miro Dewel, tiri rajeskri beshepaskri atchell hako tsireske. Tu hal i tchatcho un latcho rai pral tire menshende.

Tu kameh o tchatchepen, un nai dikeh gar kolen glan tire jaka, kai o tchilatchepen krenna. Doleske rodas tut o Dewel, tiro Dewel, win un tchoras bud bacht pral tute win, budeder har pral hako wawar rajeste.
Tire ripja sungenn mishto pal Myrrhe, Aloe un Kassia. Bashepangre bashrenn tuke an tire rajengre khera, hoi shukar un kutch kerdo hi.
I bare rajengre tcha hi pash tute, un ap tiri tchatchi rig hi tiri pirni tardo, un ap late hi o latcheder sonakai.
Shun miri tchai! Dik un shun mishto: Biste tire menshen un tiri tseli familja!
Tu hal jaake shukar, te kamell tut o baro rai. Job hi tiro rai. Doleske dja ap i tchanga glan leste!
I menshe dran o foro Tirus wenn pash tute un anenn tuke shukar koowa. I brawele dran o tselo them wenna, un rodenn te dikess kamles ap lende.
I baro rajeskri tchai well dren, shukar un railo kerdo, un an-rido an sonakangre ripja.
Pral i kutch stakepangre anenn le lat pash o baro rajeste. Un pal late djan kol terne tcha, lakre mala, kolen anenn le pash tute.
Har djan le an o baro rajeskro kheer, denn i menshe gole i bachtjatar.
Miro rai, mu well ko tsiro, kai beshenn tire mursh tchawe ap o rajeskri beshepaskri, kai tire phure dada beshdo his; un tu kreh len rajen pral i tseli phub.
Me kamau tutar te rakrell, te prindjrenn tut ninna kol menshe, kai pal mende wenna. Jaake sharenn tut i menshe an hake themma kanna un hako tsiro.
I gili jekestar, kai hi dran i familja Korach. Kai gili hi o rajeske pral i gipangre, te giwell lo lat har koi gili ‘terne tcha’.
O Dewel hi menge har i sorelo kheer, kai nai khatrah men. Job hi ap mari rig an phare tsirja.
Doleske hi men kek traash, ninna te djals kai phub tele, un perens i berge an o baro pani,
ninna te wals o baro pani diwjo un chojedo, un djals sawi sorjah pre, te perenn i berge khetne.
Latcho djudjo pani nashella an o Debleskro foro, kai o Dewel pral halauter djiwell un leskro kheer hi, Ko pani krell ko fores bachtelo.
O Dewel hi mashkral leste, doleske perell o foro gar khetne. O Dewel well ap leskri rig sik taissarlakro.
Job te dell gole, darenna i menshe an i wawar themma, un bare rajenge well i soor krik lino pral pengre themma. I tseli phub trissella i darjatar.
O baro Dewel, ko rai pral o bolepen un i phub, hi ap mari rig. Job hi o Jakobeskro Dewel un rikrell peskre wasta pral mende.
Awenn un dikenn ko baro koowa, hoi o baro Dewel kras! Dareno koowa krell lo ap i phub:
Ap o marepen penell lo: “Muk tele ap i tseli phub!” Kol kashta, kolentsa dan le karje, phagell lo khetne, un lengre chare dell lo paash, i kurepangre wurdja chatchrell lo pre.
“Mukenn tele”, dell lo gole, “un haiwenn, te hom me o Dewel. Me hom o pralstuno pral i menshende an i tsele themma, awa, o pralstuno pral i tseli phub.”
O baro Dewel, ko rai pral o bolepen un i phub hi pash mende. Job, o Jakobeskro Dewel, rikrell peskre wasta pral mende.
I gili o rajeske pral i gipangre. Kai gili hi jekestar dran i familja Korach.
Tumer menshe dran i tsele themma, denn an i wasta! Sharenn o Debles un denn leske bachteles gole!
O baro Dewel hi o pralstuno, lestar darenna lauter. Job hi o baro rai pral i tseli phub.
Job witsras menge i menshen dran wawar themma tel mare pire, un tchiwas men pral lende.
Job rodas menge o them win, un das les mende, te djiwas kote. Pral kowa ham bachtelo, mer, i tchawe o Jakobestar, kolen job bud kamell.
O Dewel djal pre pash peskri rajeskri beshepaskri, un i menshe denn bachteles gole un phurdenn an i phurdepaskri, har o baro Dewel pre djal.
Giwenn o Debleske! Giwenn un sharenn les, giwenn maro baro rajeske! Giwenn!
O Dewel hi o baro rai pral i tseli phub. Giwenn un sharenn les i giljentsa!
O Dewel hi o baro rai pral i tsele themma. O Dewel beshas pes ap peskri rajeskri beshepaskri, hoi leske kokres hi.
I raja pral i wawar themma wan khetne un hi kanna khetne o Debleskre menshentsa. Lengro Dewel hi o Abrahameskro Dewel. Leske hi kol tsele sorele ap i phub koi. Job hi pral hakeneste.
I gili jekestar dran i familja Korach.
O baro Dewel, sorelo hi lo! Maro Dewel, moldo hi lo, te sharas les an peskro foro, hoi hi pral ap koi berga, kai job djiwella.
Shukar hi o foro ap i berga Zion. I bacht hi i tseli phubjake. An kau foro hi o Dewel o baro rai.
Job hi an i sorele khera an kau foro. Un i menshe kote djinenn, te dell lo garda ap lende.
Bare raja dran wawar themma wan khetne un djan khetne pengre lurdentsa pash o foro pre.
Jon dikan kowa un lenge atchas o dji tardo. Len tapras i daar un jon nashan penge.
Lengri daar his jaake baro, te trissan le. Lengri traash his har i traash i djuwjatar, kai lell li i ternepen.
Lengre kokale djan, har i bare shiffe phagenn, te djal i sorelo ducho pral o baro pani.
Jaake har mer kowa shunam, jaake dikam les an o foro o baro Deblestar, kai hi o rai pral o bolepen un i phub. Job rikrell o foro un mukell les gar tele te djal an kek tsiro.
Maro Dewel, kate an tiro kheer mukah menge tiro latchepen an o shero trujel te djal.
Jaake baro har tiro lab, maro Dewel, jaake baro hi tiro railepen ap i tseli phub. Tiro tchatcho wast hi pherdo tchatchepen.
Pral kowa hi kol menshe ap i berga Zion bachtelo. Tu dal men maro tchatchepen. Doleske denn le gole i bachtjatar an i tsele forja an o them Juda.
Nashenn trul i berga Zion trujel! Dikenn, kitse bare turme koi hi!
Denn jak ap i pre-tchidde barra trul o foro un i sorele khera an o foro, jaake te nai penenn kowa tumare tchawenge.
Penenn lenge: Awa, kawa Dewel hi maro Dewel kanna un hako tsireske. Job djal mentsa an maro tselo djipen.
I gili o rajeske pral i gipangre. Kai gili hi jekestar dran i familja Korach.
Tumer menshe an hake themma, shunenn mishto! Tumer lauter, kai ninna han, krenn tumare kanda pre!
An-dikle menshe un sawe, kai gar an-diklo hi, brawele un tchorwele, tumer lauter, shunenn!
Miro mui rakrell gosewe laba, un dran miro dji well kowa, hoi mishto haiwom.
Miro kand shunell ap gosewe laba, un hoi kolla kamenn te penell, kamau me tumende te sikrell pash o bashepen ap i dorjengri bashepaskri.
Hoske te darap an i tchilatche diwessa, kai kolla trul mande hi, kai mange tchilatchepen kamenna?
Jon tchiwenn pengro patsepen ap pengro brawlepen, un sharenn pen har brawele jon hi.
Kek menshes hi doha lowe, te nai ginell lo peskro phraleskro djipen o Deblestar, un peskro djipen witar gar.
I mensheskro djipen hi jaake kutch, te nai plaissrell lo les gar. An kek tsiro hi les doha te dell,
te nai djiwell lo hako tsiro, un hunte merell gar.
Na-a, mer dikah: O gosewo hunte merell, jaake har o narwelo un o dinelo ninna. Un lauter, hoi len his, hunte mukenn le pale i wawarenge.
Paskedo wenn le un atchenn an lengre mulengre khera hako tsiro, ninna te das i tsiro, kai dan le pengro them pengro lab.
Fothe brawelo i mensho ninna hi, job hunte merell jaake har i viecho ninna.
Dikenn har kolenge djala, kai hi jaake dinelo un kamenn pengro rakepen te shunell!

Har bakre djan le an o mulengro them. Lengro bakrengro, kai anell len ap o drom, hi o merepen. Sik well ko diwes, kai wenn o Debleskre menshe i raja pral kolende, kolengro mass tele merell an i phub, kai hunte atchenn le pash i mulende.
Miro djipen lell o Dewel win dran o merepaskri soor. Awa, job lell man pash peste.
Ma choje tut, te well jek brawelo, un leskro kheer bareder un shukeder wella!
Te merell lo, lell lo tchi peha. Leskro tselo brawlepen hunte atchell pale.
Ninna te sharell lo pes pral peskro shukar djipen, un i wawar penenn leske shukar laba, te djal leske mishto,
hunte merell lo un djal kote, kai leskre mule phure hi, kolla, kai buder gar i momeli dikenna.
I mensho, kai haiwell gar, te nai atchell lo gar ap i phub, hunte merell har i vieche, ninna te his lo brawelo.
I gili o Asafestar. O Dewel rakrell, o baro un sorelo Dewel dell i menshen ap i tseli phub gole, kotar, kai o kham pre djas bis kote, kai lo tele djal.
Ap i berga Zion, an o shukeder foro, sikras pes o Dewel an peskro railepen.
Maro Dewel wella un mukell pes te shunell. Glan leste nashell i jag un chal lauter pre. Un trul leste phurdell i baro sorelo ducho.
O Dewel well te rakrell lo o tchatchepen win pral peskre menshende. Ap o bolepen un i phub dell job gole:
“Anenn mange mire menshen khetne, kai mantsa win kran, te wap me lengro Dewel, un mange viechen anan.”
O bolepen kharell: O Dewel hi o tchatchepaskro rai! Un lauter hoi job wi-rakrell, hi tchatcho.
“Mire menshe, shunenn! Me kamau rakrell. Israel, shun, har me, tiro Dewel penau tuke, kai kowa, hoi kral, gar mishto hi.
Tchingrau gar, te anals tu mange kek viechen. Kol viechen, hoi tu mange chatchral, hi hako diwes glan mire jaka.
Man hunte wals kek gurum dran tiri stanja, witar kek bakre.
I tsele vieche an o weesh hi mire, un ninna kol vieche ap i serja berge hi mire.
Me prindjrau i tsele tchirkle ap i berge. Un kowa, hoi ap i phub jaake trujel nashella, prindjrau me lauter.
Te wals man bok, me penoms tuke kowa gar. I tseli phub hi miro un lauter, hoi ap late hi, ninna.
Chap me grumjakro mass? Pijap me o rat i bakrendar? Na-a!
Kowa, hoi tutar kamau, hi, te parkress tut pash mande, tiro Debleste, un te rikress tiri sowel, hoi dal tu mande, o pralstuneste.
Un de gole ap mande ap ko diwes, kai hal an i bibacht! Palle lau tut win, un tu sharess man.”
Ap o tchilatcheste penell o Dewel: “Hoske leh tu mire laba an o mui? Hoske peneh, me woms tiro Dewel?
Kowa choirell tut, te hunte rikress tut ap mire laba. Kowa, hoi tuke penom, kameh tu gar te krell.
Hako kopo, kai dikeh tu i tchorepaskres, kreh tu tut leskro maal, un hal beshdo khetne kolentsa, kai djan i wawar romjentsa.
Dran tiro mui well praassepen win. Un tiri tchip rakrell chochepen.
Tu rakreh djungeles pral tire phralende. Pral tiri dakro tchaweste aneh tu chochepen pre.
Kowa kral tu, un me penom kek lab. Koi rikral tu man har jek, kai hi jaake har tu. Me sikrau tut koi doosh, hoi anal ap tute, un anau tuke tiro tchilatcho koowa glan tire jaka.
Tumer, kai kamenn tchi mandar te djinell, haiwenn, hoi penom, te wap gar un dap tumen, un kek hi koi, kai lell tumen win dran miro wast.
Kowa, kai pes pash mande parkrella, hi kowa, kai sharell man. Kowa hi o drom, kai sikrau leste, har latcho leske hom.”
I gili o rajeske pral i gipangre. O David kras kai gili,
har o Debleskro rakepaskro Natan pash leste was, pal kowa o David i wawareskri romjat, i Batsheba, las.
Miro Dewel, tu hal jaake latcho, un tiro kamlepen hi baro! Dik latches ap mande! Un le ko tchilatcho koowa, hoi krom, mandar krik!
Thob miri doosh mandar tele, un le ko tselo tchilatchepen mandar krik, te wap pale djudjo!
Awa, djinau, kai anom doosh ap mande. Un ko tchilatcho koowa, hoi krom, hi man o tselo tsiro glan mire jaka.
Ap tute kokres krom, hoi tchilatcho hi. Awa me krom, hoi midjak hi glan tire jaka. Doleske hi tut tchatches an tiro rakepen. Tu kreh o tchatchepen, te deh man i phagi.
Doosh hi ap mande, jaake rah har hom ap kai phub, ninna har boldo wom, his o tchilatchepen ap mande.
Tu rodeh o tchatchepen an o mensheskro dji. An miro dji sikreh tu, har te wap gosewo.
Le miri doosh mandar krik! Palle hom djudjo an miro dji. Thob man! Un me wau parneder har gib.
Muk man pale bacht te haiwell! Tu phagal man, kanna muk man pale te stell!
Ma dik ap miri doosh, un le o tchilatcho koowa, hoi krom, mandar krik!
Miro Dewel, de man i newo dji, hoi hi djudjo un tuke kokres koi!
Ma trade man tutar krik! Ma le tiro ducho mandar krik!
Muk man te dikell, kai hal pash mande, te sal miro dji pale! De man i dji, hoi shunell ap tute!
Kolen, kai shunenn gar ap tute, kamau me tiro drom te sikrell, te mukenn le pengro tchilatcho drom, un wenn pale pash tute.
Me anom rat ap mande, ma de man mulo, miro Dewel! Tu hal o Dewel, kai lell man win dran o merepen. Un me kamau tiro tchatchepen te sharell.
Baro Dewel, kre miro mui pre, te rakrap, hoi sharell tut!
Vieche, hoi anenn le tuke, kameh gar. Te wals jaake, doms len tute. Vieche, hoi tuke chatchedo wenna, krenn tiro dji gar bachtelo.
Kowa, hoi tu kameh te well tuke anlo, hi i phagedo dji. Ap i mensheste, kai rowell pral peskri doosh, dikeh tu, miro Dewel, latches.
Kre latchepen ap o foro Zion! Ab ap i rig kol menshenge an o foro Jerusalem, te wenn i barra o forestar pale newes pre-tchiddo!
Palle anenn le tuke latcho koowa an o tchatchepen, ninna vieche, hoi tuke tseles chatchedo wenn. Awa, palle wenn tuke terne gurma chatchedo ap tiri chatchepaskri. Un tu dikeh latches ap kowa lauter.
I gili o rajeske pral i gipangre. O David kras kai gili,
har o Doeg, ko mursh dran o them Edom, pash o Saul was, un leske penas: “O David hi pash o Ahimelech.”
Hoske shareh tu tut tiro tchilatchepah, tu, kai kameh te well tut penepaske pral halauter! O latchepen o Deblestar hi o tselo diwes kai.
Tu rodeh, har te dukress jekes, un tiri tchip tchinella har i latchi tchuri, tu chocheno!
Tu kameh o tchilatchepen budeder har o latchepen. Un o chochepen kameh tu budeder har o tchatchepen.
Tu kameh laba, hoi phagenn, un rakreh dui tchipjentsa.
Doleske phagell tut ninna o Dewel hako tsireske. Job stakrell tut khetne, witsrell tut win dran tiro kheer, lell tut krik kai phubjatar, kai djiwah.
Un kolla, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi, dikenn kowa un darenn un sanenn pral leste:
“Dikenn ko murshes! Kowa tchiwas gar peskro patsepen ap o Debleste. Na-a! Job patsas ap peskro baro brawlepen, un leskro tchilatchepen kras les sorelo.”
Me hom har i senelo djeteskro ruk an o Debleskro kheer. Me patsau ap o latchepen miro Deblestar kanna un hako tsiro.
Me kamau man hako tsireske pash tute te parkrell, hoi tu lauter mange kral. Miro Dewel, me dikau ap tute glan i jaka tire menshendar, tu hal jaake latcho.
I gili o rajeske pral i gipangre, te giwell har koi gili ‘Mahalat’. O David kras kai gili.
Dinele hi le, kai rakrenn penge: “Hi kek Dewel.” Tchi-molde hi le. Lauter, hoi le krenna, hi djungelo un chocheno koowa. Kek hi koi, kai krell o latchepen.
O Dewel dikell dran o bolepen tele ap i menshende, te hatsell lo jekes, kai gosewo hi un pal o Debleste putchella.
Halauter rissran pen lestar krik, un djiwenn i djungelo djipen, jek har ko wawar. Kek hi koi, kai krell o latchepen, awa kek!
“Kolla, kai o tchilatcho koowa krenna, haiwenn tchi”, penell o Dewel, – “kolla, kai mire menshen chana har i kotar maro. Man denn le gar an-gole.”

Ap jek kopo taprenn le i traash, ninna te hi tchi koi, hoi len nai traash krella. O Dewel marell kolen, kai ap peskre menshende pre djan. Un lengre kokale atchenn tchiddo un wenn gar paskedo. O Dewel tchiwas len pale.

Har kamaus me, te wals kowa koi berga Zion tele, kai lell o Israel win dran i bibacht! Awa, har kamaus me, te anell o Dewel peskre pandle menshen pale! Palle stans o Jakobeskre tchawe i bachtjatar, awa, o tselo Israel wals bachtelo.
I gili o rajeske pral i gipangre, te bashrell ap i dorjengri bashepaskri. O David tchinas koi gili, har kol mursha dran Sif pash o Saul wan un penan: “O David rikrell pes pash mende khatemen.”
Miro Dewel, sike koon tu hal un ab ap miri rig! Sike tiri soor un kre, te lap miro tchatchepen!
Miro Dewel, shun miro mangepen! Shun o rakepen, hoi dran miro mui wella!
Menshen, kai me gar prindjrau, kolla hadenn pen ap mande, depangre kamenn man te marell. O Dewel hi len gar glan i jaka.
Tu, miro Dewel, weh ap miri rig. Tu, miro rai, hal kowa, kai man rikrella.
Tu deh kolen ko tchilatchepen pale, hoi jon kaman ap mande te anell. Sike mande, te hal mantsa, un le len krik kai phubjatar!
Palle anau me tuke latcho koowa i bachtelo djijeha, un sharau tut, baro Dewel, tu hal jaake latcho.
Tu lal man win dran o tselo koowa, hoi mange o djipen phares kras. Kanna nai dikau tele ap kolende, kai kaman man te marell.
I gili o rajeske pral o gipangre, glan te giwell pash o bashepen ap i dorjengre bashepangre. O David kras kai gili.
Miro Dewel, shun miro mangepen! Me rowau ap tute. Ma khate tut mandar!
Dik ap mande un shun, har gole dau un rowau.
Kolla, kai kamenn man tchilatchepen, krenn bare laba, un o tchilatcho dell man trad. Jon kamenn bibacht pral mande te anell, un djan ap mande pre bari choljah.
Miro dji kamell i trashatar tardo te atchell. Un me darau, te hunte merap.
I daar tapras man jaake, te trissau, un o shil tchiwas pes ap mande.
Kamoms mussja har i tchirklo, te nai hadoms man pre un djoms krik, un hatsoms i platsa, kai nai krell man kek tchomone.
Dur krik djoms un atchoms an o mulo tato them.
Sik nashoms, te khatrap man glan o baro un sorelo ducho, hoi pral i phub phurdell, un glan o baro brishin.
Miro rai, kre, te rakrenn le bud tchipjentsa, te haiwenn le pen buder gar! An o foro dikau tchi har tchilatchepen un tchingepen,
hoi kolla krenn, kai djan hako diwes un haki rat trujel pral ap i barra, hoi djan trul o foro. Un an o foro hi bibacht un tchorwlepen.
O tchilatcho koowa hi baro mank lende. Ap i dromma, kai parenn un bikrenn le, wenn i menshe tikno rikedo un chochedo.

Kowa, kai praassell man kanna, hi gar jek kolendar, kai kaman mange tchilatchepen. Palle hidjroms kowa. Job, kai hadell pes pral mande, hi gar kolendar, kai djan ap mande pre. Palle khatroms man glan leste.
Na-a! Tu hal kowa, jek mendar, miro maal, kowa, kai leske lauter penoms.
Mer haiwam men jaake mishto, un djam khetne an o Debleskro kheer.
Mu taprell o merepen sik kolen, kai kamenn man te marell! Mu well lo sik pral lende, te djan le djides an o mulengro them! O tchilatchepen hi an lengre djia khere.
Me dau ap miro Debleste gole. Un o baro Dewel lell man win dran lengre wasta.
Rati un taissarlakro un mashkral o diwes, anau miro mangepen un miro ropen glan leste, un job shunell ap mande.
Job lell miro djipen win dran i wasta kol budendar, kai ap mande djan. Un krell, te mukenn le tele mandar.
O Dewel, kai hako tsiro o Dewel hi, kowa shunell miro mangepen un stakrell len tele, kolen, kai kamenn pal pengro shero te djiwell, un kamenn lestar tchi te djinell.
O phukepaskro djal ap peskro maleste pre un rikrell gar peskri sowel, hoi das lo leste glan o Debleste.
Leskro rakepen hi gudlo har gwin. An leskro dji kamell le o kurepen. Leskre laba hi har djet, un tchinenn har chare.
Witse kowa, hoi tuke phares hi, ap o baro Debleste! Job hi kowa, kai lell tiro koowa an peskro wast. An kek tsiro mukell job koles te perell, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi.
I marepangren un chochenen witsreh tu, miro Dewel, dur tele an o telstunepen. Glan ko tsiro, kai lengro djipen paash trujel hi, merenn le. Me kamau ap tute te dikell un man te rikrell.
I gili o rajeske pral i gipangre, te giwell har koi gili ‘I tauba an i dur them.’ Kai gili kras o David, har tapran les i Filistarja an o foro Gat.
Miro Dewel, ab latches ap mande, i menshe lenn man palla! Hako diwes djan le ap mande pre, un krenn mange o djipen phares.
Kolla, kai kamenn mange tchilatchepen, lenn man hako diwes palla. Bud djan pre-phurdemen ap mande.
Ap ko diwes, kai man i daar taprella, dikau me ap tute, mo Dewel, un rikrau man ap tute.
Me kamau o Debleskro lab te sharell, man ap leste te rikrell, un man gar te darell. Hoi nashte krenn man i menshe?
O tselo diwes rissrenn le mire laba trujel. Jon rodenn, har nai dukrenn le man.
An pengro khatepen hi le tchiddo, lenn le man an o jak, un djinenn hako djapen mandar. Jon rodenn, har nai denn le man mulo.
Miro Dewel, kameh len kek phagi te dell lengro tchilatchepaske? De kal menshen an tiri choli khetne!
Dik, har bud diwessa hom me ap o naashepen! Le mire swa an i tcharo khetne! Pash tute hi le lauter pre-tchinlo an i liil.
Ap ko diwes, kai dau ap tute gole, hunte djan kolla pale, kai kamenn man te marell. Kawa hi, hoi djinau: Tu hal mantsa, miro Dewel.
Me kamau o Debleskro lab te sharell. Awa, o baro Debleskro lab kamau te sharell.
Ap leste dikau un rikrau man, un darau gar. Hoi nashte krenn man i menshe?
Miro Dewel, me dom man sowel, te parkrap man pash tute.
Tu lal man win dran o merepen. Awa, glan o perepen rikral tu mire herja pale, jaake te nai djiwap glan tute, miro Dewel, khetne kolentsa, kai djide hi.
I gili o rajeske pral o gipangre, te giwell har koi gili ‘Ma mare men’. O David tchinas kai gili an ko tsiro, har job glan o Saul ap o naashepen his, un pes an koi grotta khatras.
Kre tiro dji mange pre, miro Dewel! Kre tiro dji mange pre! Pash tute wau, te khatrap man. An tire mussja nashau, bis te kai bibacht krik djas.
Ap o Debleste, ko pralstuneste, dau me gole, ap koleste, kai miro koowa mishto krella.
Dran o bolepen mu well lo mange ap i rig, un lell man win dran o praassepen kolestar, kai man palla lell. O Dewel mu sikrell man, te hi lo mange latcho, un te rikrell lo pash mande.
Me hom tchiddo mank menshe, kai hi har lewe, kai kamenn man pre te chal. Lengre danda hi har tchurja un faile, un lengri tchip dell tchurje har i charo.
Sike tiro barepen, hoi bareder hi har o bolepen, miro Dewel! Tiro railepen mu well pral i tseli phub!
I netsa tchiwan le glan mire pire, te perap dren. I dori pandan le trul miri meen. Ap miro drom hadan le i cheb win, – un jon peran kokres dren.
Sorelo was miro dji, miro Dewel, sorelo was miro dji. Me kamau tuke te giwell un te bashrell.
Ste pre miro dji! Kamau te bashrap ap i dorjengre bashepangre. Kau diwes kamau me o khames pre te djangrell!
Mank i menshende dran bud themma kamau tut te sharell, miro rai. Glan i natsjone kamau tuke te giwell.
Tiro latchepen hi jaake baro har o bolepen. Un tiro tchatchepen djal bis pash i wolke.
Sike tiro barepen, hoi bareder hi har o bolepen, miro Dewel! Tiro railepen mu well pral i tseli phub!
I gili o rajeske pral i gipangre, te giwell har koi gili ‘Ma mare men’. O David tchinas kai gili.
Tumer sorele, rakrenn tumer tchatchepah o tchatchepen win pral i menshende? Denn tumer hakeneste peskro tchatchepen?
Na-a, kowa krenn tumer gar. Tumer kamenn o tchilatchepen te krell. Tumare wastentsa krenn djungelo koowa.
I tchilatche peran o tchatcho dromestar tele, jaake rah har jon boldo wan. Fun tiknes pre djan le i chocheno drom.
Lengro rakepen marell har i tchip i tchilatcho sapestar. Jon hi har i sap, hoi nashte shunell gar.
Jon pandenn pengre kanda har i sap, kai kamell gar te shunell, hoi o durkepaskro ap leste rakrell, ninna te haiwell lo mishto i sapentsa te rakrell.
De lenge i danda dren, miro Dewel! Phage lengre lewengre danda win, miro baro Dewel!
Kre te atchenn le gar djido, un hunte krik djan har pani, hoi an i phub nashell. Te tchiwenn le pengre faile an, muk len tele phagenn.
Jaake har i momeli tele chatchrell, un buder gar koi hi, un jaake har i ternepen, hoi mulo boldo well un o kham gar dikas, jaake te atchenn jon witar gar.
Lenge djal har i subjengre burra: I baro ducho tserdell len dran i phub win. Jaake phurdell o Dewel len krik an peskri bari choli.
O dji kolendar well bachtelo, kai hi an o tchatchepen tardo, te dikenn le, kai lenn i tchilatche pengri phagi. An kolengro rat thowenn le pengre pire.
Un i menshe penenna: “Kowa, kai o tchatchepen kras, lell peskro plaissepen. Awa, o Dewel hi o tchatchepaskro rai pral i phub.”
I gili o rajeske pral i gipangre, te giwell har koi gili ‘Ma mare men’. O David tchinas kai gili an ko tsiro, har o Saul peskre lurden trul leskro kheer tardo tchiwas, te denn le les mulo.
Le man win dran i wasta kolendar, kai kamenn mange tchilatchepen, miro Dewel! An man krik kolendar, kai ap mande djan!
Le man win dran i wasta kol tchilatchendar, kol menshendar, kai kamenn te dikell, har miro rat nashell.
Dik, baro Dewel, har jon lurenn, te marenn le man! Fothe krom me tchi, un kek doosh ap mande hi, djan sorele mursha khetnes ap mande.
Ninna te krom me kek tchilatchepen, nashenn le kai, te denn le man mulo. Ste pre! Ab un dik les tuke kokres an!
Baro Dewel, tu, kai hal o rai pral o bolepen un i phub, un o Israeleskro Dewel, ste pre un de kol menshen an i tsele wawar themma pengri phagi! Ma ab latches ap kolende, kai phukepangre hi!
Haki rat wenn le pale un nashenn tchorchanes trul o foro. Har djukle denn le gole.
Tchilatchepen well dran lengro mui win. Lengre laba tchinenn har chare. Jon patsenn, te shunell len kek.
Tu, mo baro Dewel, tu saneh pral lende. Awa, tu saneh pral kol menshende an kol tsele wawar themma.
Tu hal miri soor. Ap tute kamau me man te rikrell. Miro Dewel, tu hal mange i sorelo kheer.
Tu hal latches ap mande. Tu hal ap miri rig un mukeh man sorleder te well har kolla, kai kamenn man te marell.
Ma de len mulo, te bistrenn kowa mire menshe gar! Trade len tiri sorjah, te nashenn le kate te kote! Stake len tele, tu, kai rikreh tiro wast pral mende.
Jon praassenna un chochenna. Hako labeha, hoi jon penenn, dukrenn le tut. Muk lengro pre-phurdepen i shello lenge te well, jaake te hunte perenn le, un wenn kokres dren pandlo.
De len mulo an tiri bari choli! De len mulo, te atchell lendar tchi, jaake te dikell hakeno ap i tseli phub, kai tu, maro Dewel, o rai hal pral o Israel.
Un haki rat wenn le pale, nashenn trul o foro trujel, un denn gole har i djukle,
hoi nashenn trujel, te rodenn le penge chapen. Un te wenn le gar tchalo, sikrenn le pengre danda.
Me kamau tiri sorjatar te giwell. Taissarlakro sharau tiro latchepen. Tu hal mange i sorelo kheer, un i khatepen an kol diwessa, kai mange ropaske hi.
Tu hal miri soor. Tuke kamau te bashrell, miro Dewel. Tu hal mange i sorelo kheer. Tu hal ko Dewel, kai mange latches hi.
I gili o rajeske pral i gipangre te giwell pash o bashepen ap i dorjengri bashepaskri. O David kras kai gili, te sikrell lo mende tchomone.
Job kras lat an ko tsiro, har lo an o marepen his i menshentsa Aram dran Mesopotamia un Zoba. Har was lo pale, maras o Joab i Edomarja an i Londi Tala: deesh-te-dui serja murshen.
Miro Dewel, tu tchiwal men pale, un tradal men kate te kote. Bari choli hi tut ap mende. Rake mentsa pale latches!
Tu kral, te trissas i phub jaake, te phagas li. Kre lat pale tseles, te phagell li gar khetne!
Tu mukal tire menshen pharo koowa te dikell. Tu dal men sawi mool te pijell, te wam mato.
Kolen, kai tuha djiwenna un ap tute shunenna, sikral, har te nai nashenn le penge glan i lurdende.
Ab ap mari rig tiro sorelo wasteha un le men, tire malen, win! Shun, har dah ap tute gole!
O Dewel penas an peskro kheer, kai job djiwell: “Me wom o sorleder”, “Me dau o foro Sichem mire menshende, un ninna i tala Sukkot.
O them Gilead hi miro un o them Manasse hi miro. O them Efrajim hi miri sasterni stadi, un o them Juda hi kowa, koles penepaske hi.
O them Moab hi miro thopaskro tcharo. Ap o them Edom witsrau miro kirach. Pral i Filistarja dau gole: Me hom o sorleder!”
Koon anell man an ko sorelo foro? Koon anell man an o them Edom?
Koon nai krell kowa, har tu kokres, maro Dewel? Tu mukal men un djah gar win mare lurdentsa an o kurepen.
Ab tu ap mari rig un le men win dran i tchilatche wasta! Te hi menshe ap mari rig, hi kowa tchitcheske un tchi moldo.
Maro Debleha krah mer baro koowa. Un job stakrell kolen khetne, kai jaake soreles ap mende djan.
I gili o rajeske pral i gipangre, te giwell pash o bashepen ap i dorjengri bashepaskri. O David kras kai gili.
Shun, miro Dewel! Shun miri gole! Shun, har me tut mangau!
Dur kotar, kai khere hom, dau me ap tute gole, miro dji tapras i daar. Le tu man un an man pre ap i baro sorelo bar.
Pash tute nai khatrau man. Awa, har i baro sorelo kheer wal tu mange, kai me man khatrau glan kolende, kai man palla lenn.
Muk man an tiro kheer te djiwell hako tsiro, tel tire mussja man te khatrell, har i tikno tchirklo khatrell pes tel peskri dakre mussja.
Kowa, hoi tuke sowel dom, shunal tu, miro Dewel, un deh dran tiro brawlepen kolende, kai djiwenn tuha.
De o baro rajes i rah djipen, de les bud bersha, te djiwell lo gomme i rah tsiro.
Job te atchell o baro rai glan tute, miro Dewel, hako tsiro! De tu an tiro latchepen un tchatchepen jak ap leste!
Jaake kamau tuke te giwell hako tsiro, un miri sowel te rikrell hako diwes.
I gili o rajeske pral i gipangre, o Jedutun. Kai gili kras o David.
Pash o Debleste kokres hi miro djijes kek daar, Job well ap miri rig.
Job hi mange har i baro sorelo kheer ap i barreskri berga, kai man khatrau, un job ap mande jak della, jaake te perap gar.
Har rah djan tumer lauter ap jek mursheste, te denn les mulo? Hom buder tchi har i bango kheer, hoi kamell dren te phagell, un koleskre barra buder gar khetne rikrenna.
Tumenge djal an o shero trujel, har nai krenn te perap khetne. O chochepen hi tumenge shukar. Tumare mujentsa rakrenn tumer i bacht win pral jekeste, un an tumare djia rakrenn i bibacht pral leste.
Pash o Debleste kokres hi miro djijes kek daar! Djinau, job hi, kai krell halauter mishto.
Job hi har i baro sorelo kheer ap i barreskri berga, kai man khatrau, un job ap mande jak della, jaake te perap gar.
Miro Deblestar well, te wap win lino dran o tchilatchepen, un te wap an-diklo. Lestar well miri soor, pash miro Debleste khatrau man.
Dikenn ap leste hako tsiro, tumer, leskre menshe! Tchorenn tumare djia win glan leste! Pash o Debleste nai khatrah men.
I menshe hi tchi har i ducho. Tikne har bare hi tchi moldo. Te wans le ap i waga tchiddo, wans le lauter khetne lino gar phareder har i ducho.
Ma patsenn, te lenn brawlepen, te djan ap jekeste i sorjah pre! Ma patsenn, te krell tumen kowa brawelo, hoi tchoran! Ninna te wenn brawleder un brawleder, ma tchiwenn tumare djia pre!
Budeder har jek kopo shunom: O Dewel kokres hi sorelo,
un leskro latchepen hi baro. Tu, miro rai deh hakenes pal kowa, hoi job kras.
I gili o Davidestar. Job kras kai gili an o mulo tato them Juda.
Dewel, tu hal miro Dewel. Tut rodau me o djijestar. Miro dji djal pal tute. Man hi trush pal tute har i truk tato them trushell pal o pani.
An tiro kheer rodau tut, kamoms te dikap tiri soor un tiro railepen.
Tiro latchepen hi mange budeder moldo har o djipen. Doleske sharau tut.
Me parkrau man pash tute jaake rah har me djiwau. Un me hadau mire wasta pre, te mangap tut an.
Tu kreh miro dji jaake tchalo un bachtelo, har te chap i shukar chapen. Miro mui giwell tuke i gili un sharell tut.
Me te hom ap o tchiben tchiddo, weh tu mange an o shero. An i rat, kai me sowau gar, rakrau tuha an miro dji.
Tu wal ap miri rig, Tu rikreh tiro wast pral mande, har i tchirklo rikrell peskre mussja pral peskre ternende. Kote giwau tuke i bachtjatar i gili.
Miro dji rikrell pes ap tute. Tiro tchatcho wast rikrell man.
Kolla, kai kamenn man mulo te dell, mu merenn le, un djan tele an o mulengro them!
Mu dell len o charo mulo, un i diwje djukle te chan len!
O baro rai hi bachtelo pral o Debleste. Koon dell pes sowel glan o Debleste, kowa nai sharell pes. Un i chochenenge well o mui pandlo.
I gili o rajeske pral i gipangre. O David kras kai gili.
Miro Dewel, shun har ap tute rowau. Man hi daar glan kolende, kai kamenn man te marell. De jak ap miro djipen!
Kol tchilatche wenn khetne un rakrenn, har jon nai krenn mange tchilatchepen. Khate man, miro Dewel, glan lengri choli!
Lengre tchipja hi har chare, hoi mishto tchinenna, lengre laba dukrenn har faile.
Ap jek kopo denn le karje dran pengro khatepen ap koleste, kai o tchatcho drom djal, un ladjenn pen gar.
Jek krell o wawares soreles an lengro tchilatcho koowa. Un jon rakrenn pen tele, har nai tchiwenn le dorja win, te perenn i wawar dren, un penenn pashel: “Koon dikell kowa?”
Len hi tchilatchepen an o shero, un penenn tchorchanes: “Jaake krah mer kowa. Jaake djal kowa mishto. Har gosewe ham mer!”
O Dewel dell ap lende karje. Sik hi le ap i phub tchiddo.
Lengre laba kokres krenn, te san kolla pral lende, kai dikenn len.
Un lauteren taprell i daar, un jon penenn: “Kawa kras o Dewel”, un haiwenn, te was kowa lestar.
Kolla, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi, hi bachtelo pral o baro Debleste, un rikrenn pen ap leste. Un hakeno, kai shunell ap o Debleste o djijestar, sharell pes leha.
I gili o rajeske pral i gipangre. Kai gili kras o David.
Tu, Dewel, kai djiweh ap i berga Zion, tu hal moldo, te sharas tut, un rikras mare sobja, hoi tuke dam.
Tu shuneh, hoi tutar mangah. Doleske wenn i tsele menshe pash tute.
Ko tchilatchepen, hoi krom, hi phares ap mande tchiddo. Tu hal kowa, kai i doosh krik lell.
Har bachtelo hi kowa, koles tu tuke win rodal, un mukeh les pash tute te well, te djiwell lo ap i platsa glan tiro kheer. Kowa well tchalo o latchepastar an tiro railo kheer, kai tu djiweh.

Tu rakreh mentsa dran baro koowa, hoi tu kreh an tiri soor un an tiro tchatchepen. Tu, Dewel, leh men win dran o tchilatchepen. Ap tute dikenn i menshe ap i tseli phub. Ninna kolla dikenn pal tute, kai djiwenn pash i bare panja, hoi jaake dur krik hi.
Tiri sorjah tchiwal tu i berge soreles ap i phub, un tchiwal tiri bari soor trul tute har i ripen.
Tu peneh ap o diwjo pani: “Muk tele”, un ap o pani, hoi dur pre djal: “Tchip tut”, un ap koi diwji gole, hoi i menshe an wawar themma krenna: “Atch kanna!”
Un i menshenge ap i tseli phub atchell o rakepen krik glan ko baro koowa, hoi tu kral. Kotar, kai o kham pre djal bis kote, kai lo tele djal, mukeh tu halauteren te sal un bachteles te well.
Tu djineh, hoi o themes hunte well, un deh jak, te well les doha pani, un kreh les braweles. Miro Dewel, tut hi hako tsiro doha pani. Tu mukeh bud djob bares te well i menshenge.
Koi hachetikri phub deh tu doha te pijell, un kreh i phub sapeno, un deh brishin, te well lauter bares.
Tu deh bud latcho koowa un kreh, te well o bersh i latcho bersh. Kote kai tu brishin dal, well jaake bud latcho koowa win, te hi budeder har doha koi.
Kote, kai i bakre djan, hi lauter pherdo senlepen, un ap i berge shunah khelepen un bashepen.
O pralstuno them hi pherdo bakre. Un ap o telstuno them hi o djob tardo pesso un thullo. Un lauter stenn un giwenn.
I gili o rajeske pral i gipangre. Sharenn o Debles ap i tseli phub!
Giwenn leske, te well leskro lab hadedo! Rakrenn win, har railo job hi!
Penenn ap o Debleste: Har baro hi kowa lauter, hoi tu kral. Kolla, kai tut gar kaman, hunte tchiwenn pen tele glan tute, glan tiri bari soor!
Mu mangell tut i tseli phub an un sharell tut i giljentsa, awa, mu sharenn le tiro lab.
Awenn un dikenn, hoi o Dewel kras. I menshenge atchell o rakepen krik, te dikenn le, hoi kras lo ap lende.
Dran o baro pani kras job i truk phub. Jon nai djan mashkral ap i wawar rig. Pral kowa giwam i bachtjatar.
Job hi o baro rai hako tsireske. Leskri soor pral i menshenge hi baro. Hake themma lell job an o jak, te nai hadenn pen kolla gar, kai lestar tele peran.
Tumer menshe an hake themma, sharenn maro Debles! Tumari sharepaskri gili te well dur shunlo!
Job rikras men ap o djipen, un das jak, te peras gar.
Tu, maro Dewel, kamal te dikell, har maro dji ap tute rikrell. Doleske kral tu mentsa har o rupeha, hoi an jag thodo well, te well lo djudjo.
Tu mukal men pandlo te well, un tchiwal menge pharo koowa pre.
Tu mukal menshe pral mende te well, mukal men an i jag un an o pani te djal. Un palle anal tu men dran lauter win un dal men newi soor.
Doleske kamau an tiro kheer te djal, te anap tuke viechen, hoi tuke chatchedo wenna. Kamau te dap tut, hoi dom man sowel glan tute.
Anau, hoi penom un win rakrom, har mange o djipen phares his.
I thulle bakrendar anau me tuke, te wenn le tuke chatchedo. Ninna grumja un busja anau glan tute. Te wenn le chatchedo ap tiri chatchepaskri, djal i jagakro ducho pre pash tute.
Awenn un shunenn, tumer lauter, kai ap o Debleste patsenna, te penap tumenge, hoi job mange kras.
Miro mujeha dom gole ap leste, miri tchipjah sharom les.
Job shunas miri gole, un das jak ap kowa, hoi lestar mangom. Te wals man tchilatchepen glan an miro dji, shunals man o Dewel, miro rai, gar.
Sharedo well miro Dewel! Job rissras pes gar krik miro mangepastar, un las peskro latchepen gar mandar.
I gili o rajeske pral i gipangre, te giwell pash o bashepen ap i dorjengre bashepangre.
Dewel, kre tiro dji menge pre, un tchip tiri bacht ap mende! Dik tu latches ap mende!
Palle dikenn i menshe ap i tseli phub, har tu sikreh men tiro drom. Un i menshe an i tsele themma dikenn har tu leh men win dran o tchilatchepen.
Maro Dewel, mu parkrenn pen pash tute i menshe dran hake themma, mu sharenn le tut halauter!
Mu stenn un giwenn le i bachtjatar: Te rakreh tu o tchatchepen win pral lende, djah tu pal o tchatchepen. Pral hake themma ap i phub hal tu o rai.
Maro Dewel, mu parkrenn pen pash tute i menshe dran hake themma, mu sharenn le tut halauter!
I phub mukas latcho chapen bares te well; o Dewel, maro Dewel das men bacht.
Awa, o Dewel das men bacht. Mu hadenn les hake menshe ap i phub!
I gili o rajeske pral i gipangre. O David kras kai gili.
O Dewel stell pre, un tradell kolen krik, kai kamenn les gar; awa, kolla, kai hi chojedo ap leste, hunte nashenn lestar.
Jaake har i jagakro ducho krik phurdedo well, jaake phurdell job len krik. Jaake har i momeli chatchrell tele un buder gar koi hi, jaake wenn kol tchilatche buder gar diklo glan o Debleste.
Hi wawartchandes kolentsa, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi: Jon wenn bachtelo, stenn un sanenn i bachtjatar glan o Debleste.
Giwenn o Debleske! Bashrenn un hadenn leskro lab! Krenn leske i drom, koleske, kai ulerell ap o bolepen. ‘Baro Dewel’ hi leskro lab. Awenn bachtelo un giwenn glan leste!
O Dewel, kai djiwell an peskro railo kheer, job hi i dad kolenge, kolen kek dad buder hi. Un job well kol romjenge ap i rig, kolengro rom meras.

Kolen, kai kokres hi, anell lo khere, kolen, kai stilde hi, lell lo win dran o stilepen, te djal lenge pale mishto. Hi wawartchandes kolentsa, kai kamenn tchi lestar te djinell: Kolla hunte atchenn an o mulo them.
Maro Dewel, har djal tu glan tire menshende, un anal len ap o drom mashkral o mulo tato them,
kote trissas i phub, un o bolepen das baro brishin glan tute, o Debleste ap i berga Sinai, awa, glan o Debleste pral o Israel.
Tu, maro Dewel, dal doha brishin, un mukal tiro tato themes pale pre te djiwell,
te djiwan nai tire menshe kote. Tu, maro Dewel, hal jaake latcho, te mukal kol tchorwelen kote khere te well.
O baro Dewel penas i lab; un bud djuwja nashan un penan ko shukar koowa, hoi djas:
“I bare raja nashenn penge, lengre lurde hi ap o naashepen, un kowa hoi jon hunte mukan tchiddo, hi budeder har bud. Un khere denn i djuwja hakenes kolestar.
Kamenn tumer win ap o them pash i bakre te atchell? Kote hi tchomone tchiddo, hoi wi-dikell har i rupene un sonakangre tchirklengre mussja.”
An ko tsiro, har o sorelo Dewel i bare rajen dran o them tradas, peras gib ap i berga Zalmon.
Baro hi i berga Bashan. Lat his bud bergetikre sherja.
Tumer berge, tumer bergetikre sherja, hoske silwerenn tumer ap koi berga, kolat o Dewel peske win rodas, te djiwell job kote? Awa, hako tsireske atchell o baro Dewel koi.
Bud serja wurdja hi o Debles. Lentsa was lo ap i berga Sinai, un djal dren an peskro kheer.
Tu, Dewel, djal pre an o pralstunepen un lal stilde tuha. Tu lal kutch koowa kol menshendar, kai kaman tchi tutar te djinell. Tu, baro Dewel, djiweh kote.
Sharedo well o Dewel, maro rai, hako diwes! Job hidjrell menge o pharo koowa, un well menge ap i rig.
Men hi i Dewel, kai menge koi hi. Job hi o baro Dewel, maro rai, kai lell men win dran o merepen.
Kolenge, kai les gar kamenna, stakrell lo o shero dren, hake tchilatchenge, kai mukenn gar pengro tchilatchepen.
O Dewel, miro rai, penas: Me anau len pale i bergatar Bashan, ninna dran o telstunepen o baro panjestar anau len pale pale.
Jaake te thoweh tire herja an o rat kolendar, kai kaman tut te marell, un tire djukle pijenn les.
Miro Dewel, tu hal miro baro rai. Halauter dikenn har tu weh an tiri soor, un dren djah an tiro Debleskro kheer.
I gipangre djan glan tute un i bashepangre pal tute. Un mashkral dren djan i terne tcha un denn pengre pauke.
“Sharenn o Debles kote, kai peskre menshe khetne wenna! Sharenn o baro Debles, tumer, kai han dran o Israel.”

I menshe dran o kheer Benjamin, ko terneder tchawo o Jakobeskre tchawendar, djan glan i wawarende. Pal lende wenn i pralstune dran o kheer Juda pengre bud menshentsa, pal lende i pralstune dran o kheer Sebulon un dran o kheer Naftali.
Bitche tiri soor, maro Dewel, tiri soor, hoi tu ap mende sikral!
Dran tiro Debleskro kheer an o foro Jerusalem, kai anenn tuke i bare raja kutch koowa,

de ko themes Egiptia trad, ko diwjo vieches pash o pani. Tchinge kol sorelentsa un rajentsa pral bud menshende! Tchip tut kolenge an o drom, kai pal o rup nashenna. Trade kol natsjone, kolenge o marepen shukar hi.
Dran o them Egiptia wenn bitchepangre pash tute, un kolla dran o them Etiopia hadenn pengre wasta pre pash o Debleste.
Tumer themma ap kai phub, giwenn o Debleske, bashrenn leske, maro rajeske!
Job ulerell pral pre ap o bolepen, hoi hako tsiro koi his. Shunenn, har soreles job gole dell!
Hadenn o Debles! Job hi o bareder. Leskro railepen hi pral o Israel, un leskri soor djal bis ap i wolke.
Har baro hi o Dewel an peskro Debleskro kheer! Job hi o Israeleskro Dewel, un krell peskre menshen soreles, un dell len soor pral wawar menshende. Sharedo well o Dewel!
I gili o rajeske pral i gipangre, te giwell pash o bashepen ap i shob-dorjengri bashepaskri. Kai gili kras o David.
Le man win, mo Dewel! O pani djal mange bis pash i meen.
Me tassau an sapeni tchik, mire herja hatsenn kek phub, kai jon nai tardo atchans. Hom an pani, hoi dur tele djal. Un sorele panja kamenn man tele te tserdell.
Me dom gole, bis te man kek soor buder an mande his, un miri meen dukas. Mire jaka wan khino, jaake rah dikau pal miro Debleste.

Budeder har mire balla ap miro shero hi kolla, kai hi chojedo ap mande, ninna te krom me len tchi. Un kolen, kai kamenn mange tchilatchepen, hi bari soor, un kamenn man te marell. Me krom len tchi, un hunte dap kowa pale, hoi me gar tchorom.
Miro Dewel, tu djineh, har dinelo homs, un prindjreh miri doosh, hoi ap mande anom.

Ma muk kolen pengro patsepen te nashrell, kai pen ap tute rikrenna, te dikenn le har djungeles mange djala. Tu, baro Dewel, kai hal o rai pral o bolepen un i phub, ma muk man te anap ladj ap kolende, kai tut rodenna, o Debles pral o Israel.
Dran tute hi i bari ladj ap mande, un miro shero hi lolo i ladjatar.
Wom har i gadjo mire phralenge. I tchawe miri datar prindjrenn man buder gar.
Kamau tiro kheer jaake bud, te chatchell miro dji an mande har i jag. Un kolla, kai praassenn tut, praassenn man ninna.
Rowom un kamom tchi te chal, un jon san man doleske win.
Har riwom i gono an, te sikrap har pharo miro dji hi, kran le i sapaskri gili pral mande.
Ap i platsa, kai le khetne wenn, rakrenn le pral mande. Un mate giwenn gilja pral mande.
Me mangau tut, baro Dewel, o tsiro hi kai, te wess mange latches. Mo Dewel, tiro latchepen hi baro! Shun man, rike tiro lab un ab ap miri rig!
Le man win dran kai sapeni tchik, te tassap gar dren, Le man win dran i wasta kolendar, kai kamenn man te marell! Tserde man win dran o pani, kai hi man buder kek phub tel i herja,
te tserdenn man i sorele panja gar tele, un me tassap. Ma muk man te merell!
Shun man, mo baro Dewel, tiro latchepen hi mishto mange. Kre tiro dji mange dur pre un dik ap mande!
Ma khate tut mandar, kai tiro budepaskro hom! Me hom an bari daar, shun man sik!
Ab pash mande un le man win! Le man win dran i wasta kolendar, kai kamenn miro merepen.
Tu prindjreh i ladj, hoi ap mande peras, tu djineh, har jon man praassan un pal mande rakran. Kolla, kai mange o djipen phares krenn, hi lauter glan tire jaka.
Kai ladj phagell miro dji, un krell man nasselo. Patsom, te khaitoms me jekes, te wals jek kai, kai mange mire swa tele khossals. Na-a, kote his kek, gar jek, kai kowa krals.
Jon dan man i shutlo chapen, un har his man trush, dan le man shut te pijell.
An kol diwessa, kai wenn le khetne te chan shukar chapen, muk lengro chapen lenge te well i netsa, kai perenn le dren!
Lengre jaka te wenn korelo, te nai dikenn le buder tchi! Le lendar lengri soor, te djan le bango.
De lenge i phagi! Un tiri bari choli mu taprell len.
Mu well koi platsa paash dino, kai lengre plachtene khera tardo hi, te djiwell buder kek mensho koi.
Jon lenn koles palla, koles tu dal, un lenge hi shukar, te rakrenn le pral i duka un dawa, hoi tu les dal.
Tchin haki doosh lendar an i liil; jaake te mukess len tu gar an tiro tchatchepen te well.
Le lengre laba win dran tiro liil, kai kolla dren tchinlo hi, kai o djipen lenna, te hi jon gar dren tchinlo khetne kolentsa, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi.
Me hom tchorwelo un man hi bud duka. Mo Dewel, ab ap miri rig un de ap mande jak!
I giljah kamau tut te sharell, un tiro lab te hadell, un man pash tute te parkrell.
Kowa hi tuke feteder har te anap tuke i grumni, awa, i sorelo gurum, te well lo tuke chatchedo.
Te dikenn kowa kolla, kai tele rikedo hi, wenn le bachtelo. Un kolenge, kai o Debles rodenna, djiwell lengro dji pale pre.
O baro Dewel shunell i gole kolendar, kai tele-rikede hi, un bistrell peskre pandle menshen gar.
O bolepen un i phub sharenn les! Ninna i bare panja un halauter, hoi dren djiwell.
O Dewel well o foreske Zion ap i rig, un krell i forja an o them Juda pale newes. Leskre menshe djiwenn kote, un o them hi lengro.
Un i tchawe kolendar, kai hi o Debleske koi, lenn ko them. Un kolla, kai o Debles o djijestar kamenna, djiwenn koi.
I gili o rajeske pral i gipangre. O David kras kai gili, te bistrell les o Dewel gar.
Kre sik, mo Dewel, te wess ap miri rig! Baro Dewel, le man win dran i tchilatche wasta!
Praassepen un ladj mu well ap kolende, kai kamenn man te marell! Kre, te djal kolenge gar, hoi jon penge glan lan, kai kamenn mange tchilatchepen. Kre, te sanenn i wawar pral lende!
Mu well lengri ladj jaake baro, te hunte rissrenn le trujel un djan pale, – kolla lauter, kai sanenn pral mande.
Bachtelo pral tute mu wenn kolla lauter, kai pal tute putchenna, un lengre djia mu giwenna. Kolla, kai kamenn tut, kai tu lal len dran o tchilatchepen win, te penenn le hako tsiro: Baro hi o Dewel!
Me hom tchorwelo un bibachtelo. Miro Dewel, ab sik pash mande! Tu hal kowa, kai hal ap miri rig, un leh man win dran lengre wasta. Baro Dewel, muk tut kek tsiro un ab sik pash mande!
Baro Dewel, me rikrau man ap tute. Muk man gar tchitcheske pash tute te well!
Tu kreh, hoi tchatcho hi. Doleske ab tu ap miri rig un le man win dran i tchilatche wasta! Shun miri gole un rike man!
Ab mange har i baro sorelo bar, pash koleste nai nashau un man khatrau! Tu dal tiro lab, te wess ap miri rig. Tu hal mange har i baro sorelo kheer ap i barreskri berga, kai nai khatrau man.
Miro Dewel, le man win dran i wasta i tchilatchendar, un kolendar, kai o tchatchepen stakrenna, un i wawaren i sorjah tele rikrenna.
Miro rai, tu baro Dewel, ap tute dikau, fun tiknes pre patsom ap tute.
Miro tselo djipen rikrom man ap tute. Jaake rah har boldo wom, rikral tu tire wasta pral mande. Tut kamau me te sharell hako diwes.
Ninna te patsenn bud, kai praassal tu man, hal tu mange har i sorelo kheer, kai nai khatrau man.
O tselo diwes kamau te sharap tut un giwap tuke gilja.
Kanna, kai phuro hom, ma muk mandar! Ma dja mandar kanna, kai hi buder kek soor an mande!
Kolla, kai mange tchilatchepen kamenn, rakrenn pal mande. Kolla, hoi kamenn mange o djipen te lell, rakrenn khetne,
un penenn: “O Dewel djas peske lestar. Las les palla un tapras les! Kek hi koi, kai les dran mare wasta win lell.”
Miro Dewel, ab gar dur mandar! Kre sik, un ab ap miri rig!
Mu wenn le tele witsedo un merenn, kolla, kai mange o tchilatchepen kamenn. Praassepen un ladj mu well ap kolende, kai kamenn miri bibacht.
Me dikau hako tsiro ap tute un sharau tut bud un budeder.
Me penau i wawarenge, har tchatcho tire dromma hi. Hako diwes rakrau pral o latchepen, hoi tu lauter kral. Kowa hi budeder har nai haiwau.
Me wau un rakrau pral o sorelo koowa, hoi tu kral, miro rai, baro Dewel, un sharau tchi wawar har tiro tchatchepen.
Miro Dewel, tu hal miro sikepaskro fun tiknes pre, un ninna kanna rakrau me pral ko baro koowa, hoi tu lauter kral.
Ninna kanna, kai phuro wom, un mire balla parno wan, ma dja mandar, miro Dewel! Kamau te penap i tchawengre tchawenge un lauterenge, kai pal lende wenna, har sorelo tu hal.
Miro Dewel, tiro tchatchepen djal bis pash o bolepen. Tu, kai kreh baro koowa, koon hi jaake har tu, miro Dewel?
Tu mukal bud un bari daar ap mande te well. Un tu deh man pale newo djipen, un aneh man pale win dran o telstunepen i phubjatar.
Tu kreh man an-diklo, un khosseh mire swa tele.

Jaake kamau me man pash tute te parkrell o bashepah ap i dorjengri bashepaskri, kai rikral tu tiro lab, miro Dewel. O bashepah ap i harfa kamau tuke gilja te giwell. Tu kokres hal o tchatcho Dewel, ko Dewel pral o Israel.
Tu lal miro djipen win dran o merepen. Doleske dau gole i bachtjatar un giwau tuke gilja.
Hako diwes penau dureder, har tu rikral pash mande. Un kolla, kai kaman miri bibacht, hunte wenn tikno un ladjenn pen.
I gili o Salomestar. Mo Dewel, de tiro tchatchepen o baro rajeste an o dji, te rakrell lo o tchatchepen jaake har tu o tchatchepen rakrals.
Kre lestar i tchatchepaskro rai, kai dell koles o tchatchepen, kones tchatcho hi, ninna te hi lo tchorwelo.
Kote, kai job o baro rai hi, djiwenn i menshe i latcho djipen o Debleha, un tchatchepen well an o tselo them, ninna ap peskre tikne un bare berge.
O baro rai mu rakrell i tchorwelenge mishto, un well ap i rig kolendar, kai tele rikedo wenn, un stakrell kolen khetne, kai len dukrenna.
Muk les te djiwell jaake rah har o kham un o tchon ap o bolepen hi, un jaake rah har menshe ap i phub hi!
Muk les te well har o brishin, hoi perell ap i phub, har o pani, hoi krell o them sapeno.
Palle djal mishto kolenge, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi. Un i menshe djiwenn latches khetne, bis te o tchon buder gar koi hi.
Un job well o baro rai pral i tsele themma, fun jek baro pani bis pash o wawar baro pani.
Glan leste mukenn pen kolla tele te perell, kai an o mulo tato them djiwenna. Un kolla, kai les gar kamenna, hunte tchiwenn pen glan leste an i tchik.
I bare raja, kai djiwenn an o foro Tarsis un an i panjeskre themma, kolla anenn leske kutch koowa. Ninna i bare raja pral i forja Saba un Seba bitchrenn leske shukar koowa.
I tsele bare raja perenn tele ap i phub glan leste. Un i tsele natsjone budrenn leske.
Job hi kowa, kai shunell o tchorweles, kai dell gole, un lell les dran i bibacht win, un well ap i rig kolestar, kones kek hi, hoi leske koi hi.
Kolen, kai kek soor hi un kolla, kai tchorwelo hi, ap kolende hi lo latcho un dell jak, te atchenn le djido.
Job lell len win dran o wast kolendar, kai lenge o djipen phares kran. Un kolendar, kai len dawa dan, lell lo len krik. Lengro djipen hi leske bud moldo.
Rah djiwell o baro rai! Denn les o sonakai dran o them Saba! Mangenn leske latchepen o Deblestar hako tsiro! Rakrenn o Debleskri bacht win pral leste hako diwes!
An o them muk bud djob bares te well, te hi lo tardo bis pral ap i berge, jaake har o weesh ap i berga Libanon. An i forja mu wenn jaake bud menshe har o senlepen ap o them!

Leskro lab mu atchell hako tsireske. Jaake rah har o kham ap o bolepen hi, mu well leskro lab sharedo! Lestar mu well latchepen ap i menshende an i tsele themma. Un jon te rakrenn i bacht pral leste win.
Sharas o baro Debles, ko Debles pral o Israel. Job kokres krell baro un sorelo koowa!
Sharas leskro baro railo lab hako tsiro! Leskro railepen mu well diklo an i tsele themma! Amen, jaake te well kowa!
Kate herenn pre o Davideskre gilja, kolentsa job o Debles an-mangas. O Davideskro dad his o Isai.
I gili, hoi o Asaf kras. O Dewel hi latcho ap o Israel, ap lauterende, kolen i djudjo dji hi.
Wals sik, kai peroms o Debleskro dromestar tele. Mire herja his buder gar soreles tardo,
har dikom, te djal i tchilatchenge jaake mishto. Me silwerom ap kolende, kai krenn pen baro.
Kek duka hi len, sasto un pesso hi le.
Lenge djal gar djungeles har i wawar menshenge. Jon hunte marenn pen gar tele har i wawar menshe.
Doleske hi le pre-phurdo, Lengro sharepen hi har i werkli trul i meen. Un lengro tchilatcho koowa hi lengro ripen.
Dran lengre djia well tchilatchepen. Un jon krenn lauter pal pengro shero.
Lenge hi tchi moldo. Jon rakrenn pral lauter tchilatches. Bare labentsa rikrenn le i menshen tele.
Jon krenn pengro mui pre, te tchingrenn le ap o bolepen. Un hoi le penenn, hunte well kerdo ap i phub.
Doleske nashenn lenge leskre menshe palla, un pijenn lengre laba har pani.
Jon penenna: “Har shunell nai o Dewel kawa? Har haiwell lo kowa, job, kai pral an o bolepen hi?”
Jaake hi kol tchilatche. Len hi i shukar djipen. Brawleder un brawleder wenn le.
His kowa tchitcheske, kai rikrom miro dji djudjo, un anom kek doosh ap mande?
Man hi duka hako diwes, haki tsalla haiwau tire dawa.
Te penoms me: Kamau ninna jaake te rakrell har jon, palle phukroms o Debleskre tchawen.
Koi lom mange tsiro, te nai haiwap kawa, un phares his kowa an mire jaka,
bis te djom an o Debleskro kheer. Kote haiwom, hoi ap lende wella:
Tchatchepah, tu tchiwal len ap i sapeni phub, kai hunte perenn le.
Ap jek kopo hi le buder gar koi. Lengro merepen nai wals gar djungleder!
Jon hi har i suni, hoi jek bistrell, te stell lo pre. Jaake bistreh tu len ap ko tsiro, kai hadeh tut tu, baro Dewel.
Har dukas man an miro dji, un tchurje das an mire buke,
koi homs dinelo un haiwom tchi. Awa, dinleder har i viecho homs glan tute.
Kanna atchau hako tsiro pash tute. Tu rikreh man pash miro tchatcho wast.
Tu aneh man ap ko drom, hoi tut mange hi. Un pal miro djipen ap kai phub leh tu man pash tute an tiro railepen.
Te hi man tut, putchau tchi pal o bolepen, un witar gar pal i phub.
Te djal i soor peske dran mande, un miro dji buder gar sorelo hi, palle atcheh tu, miro Dewel, hako tsiro miri soor un miro brawlepen.
Koon tutar krik djal, djal tele. Un koon mukell tut, koles aneh an o mulengro them.
Mange hi mishto, te rikrap man ap miro Debleste. Te wap pash tute, miro rai, baro Dewel, kowa hi miri bacht, te rakrap halauterestar, hoi tu kral.
Giwede laba o Asafestar. Maro Dewel, hoske tchiwal tu men pale hako tsireske? Hoske hal tu jaake chojedo pral mende? Tu hal maro bakrengro, un mer ham tire bakre!

Ma biste gar, te ham kol menshe, kai tu tuke glan i rah tsiro wi-rodal. Tu ginal men win dran i wasta kolendar, kai men tele rikran. Tu kamal, te was mer tiro. Ma biste i berga Zion, hoi tuke wi-rodal, te djiwess kote.
Ab kai un dik kol barra tchiddo, hoi tiro kheer his. Halauter hi paash dino kolendar, kai hadan pen pral tute.
Bari gole dan le an tiro kheer, un tchiwan kol plachte pre, hoi sikrenn, te hi jon i sorleder.
Mer dikam, har hadan le pengro tower, har te dans le kasht tiknes an o weesh.
Ko tselo kutch koowa, hoi dran o kasht wi-tchinlo was, dan le paash. Pengro tower un o saster dan le dren.
Tiro railo kheer chatchran le tele. Ko kheer, kai tu khere hals, kran le pale-tchiddo,
un penan penge an pengre djia: “Kras lenge jaake, te atchell lendar buder tchi.” An o tselo them chatchran le o Debleskre khera tele.
Kek sikepen hi buder kai, hoi men sikrell, te hal tu pash mende. Kek Debleskro rakepaskro hi buder kai. Un kek djinella, har rah kowa jaake atchell.
Miro Dewel, har rah mukeh tu len pal tute te sal? Mukeh tu len hako tsiro tiro lab te praassell?
Har rah rikreh tu tut pale, un sikreh len gar tiro wast?
Miro Dewel, fun tiknes pre hal miro baro rai. Tutar well, te wenn i menshe win lino dran i bibacht.
Tiri bari sorjah phagal o baro pani pre, stakral i sherja kol bare panjeskre sapendar dren.
Tu stakral i sherja ko baro viechestar Leviatan paash, un dal leskro mass i diwje viechenge te chal.
Tu mukal pani te nashell, kai kek his. Un kote, kai sorele panja nashan, hi le kanna buder gar koi.
Tiro hi o diwes, un tiro hi i rat. Tu dal o kham un o tchon pengro drom, kai te djan le.
Tu penal, har baro i phub te well. I nijal un o wend kral tu.
Kanna, baro Dewel, muk tuke an o shero te well, har praassenn tut kolla, kai hadan pen pral tute. Dik, har dinele menshe tiro lab an i tchik tserdenna.
Mer ham har i tikno tchirklo. De men gar i diwje viechen te chal! Ma biste men gar hako tsireske, men, tire menshen, kai palla lino wenn!
Biste gar koi sowel, hoi tu men dal, te rikreh tu pash mende! An o tselo them well djungelo un tchilatcho koowa kerdo an o khatepen.
Ma muk kolen i ladjah penge te djal, kai palla lino hi! Kre, te sharenn i tchorwele un tikne tiro lab!
Ste pre, miro Dewel, un kre o tchatchepen win! Dik ko praassepen, koleha tut kol dinele hako diwes praassenna.
Ma biste gar koi bari gole kolendar, kai hadan pen pral tute! Shun, har diwjo jon hi! Lengri gole well bareder un bareder.
I gili o rajeske pral i gipangre, te giwell har koi gili ‘Ma mare men’. Kai gili kras o Asaf.
Mer sharah tut, maro Dewel. Mer parkrah men pash tute, te hal pash mende, un rakrah halauterestar, hoi tu kral an tiri bari soor.
“Te was miro tsiro”, penell o Dewel, “rakrau o tchatchepen win pral hakeneste.
Ninna te trissell i phub un lauter, kai djiwell koi pre, me rikrau lat, te atchell li soreles tardo.”
Me penom ap kolende, hoi pen bares krenn: ‘Ma phurdenn tumen jaake pre!’ Un ap i tchilatchende penom: ‘Ma hadenn tumen!
Atchenn! Ma hadenn tumen! Mukenn tele tumaro tchilatcho rakepah!’
Tchatcho barepen well gar kotar, kai o kham pre-djala, un gar kotar, kai o kham tele djala, witar gar dran o mulo tato them.
Na-a, o Dewel hi o tchatchepaskro rai, kai ko jekeske i soor krik lell, un o wawares bares krell.
O baro Debles hi o khoro an o wast pherdo soreli mool, hoi job dren tchoras. Un i tsele tchilatche ap kai phub hunte pijenn lat, bis te buder kek mool an o khoro hi.
Me kamau o Deblestar te rakrell hako tsiro. Un leske, ko Jakobeskro Debleske, giwau un bashrau.
Maro Dewel, tu phageh i soor i tchilatchendar, un deh i soor kolen, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi.
I gili o rajeske pral i gipangre, te giwell pash o bashepen ap i dorjengre bashepangre. O Asaf kras kai gili.
An o them Juda prindjrell hakeno o Debles, an o tselo them Israel hi lo prindjedo.
An o foro Jerusalem was leskro kheer kerdo, kote ap i berga Zion djiwell lo.
Kote phagas job o marepaskre koola: i faile, i shilte un i chare.
Tu hal raileder un bareder har i berge, hoi hako tsiro atchenna.
I sorele mursha wan wi-tchoredo un meran. Un i kurepangre lan pengre mussja gar pre.
Har dal tu len trad, tu, o Jakobeskro Dewel, peran i graja un kolla, kai ap lende beshdo hi, an o sopen.
Glan tute kokres hunte well men daar. Koon nai atchell tardo glan tute, tu te choireh tut?
Tu rakral dran o bolepen i phagi win pral i phub. Un i phub trashas un penas kek lab,
har o Dewel pre stas, te rakrell lo o tchatchepen win, un te well lo halauterenge ap i rig, kai tikno rikedo wan ap kai phub.
Te hadenn pen chojede menshe pral tute, maro Debleste, well diklo, har baro tu hal. Un kowa, hoi pral atchell lengri choljatar, hi tuke har i shukar ripen, hoi riweh.

Denn tumen sowel, te denn tchomone o baro Debleste, kai tumaro Dewel hi. Un rikrenn tumari sowel! Anenn leske kutch koowa, tumer dran i tsele themma, kai trul leste hi. Job hi kowa, kolestar hakeno darella.
Job pandell i pralstunenge pengro baro mui, un i bare rajenge ap kai phub krell lo traash.
I gili o rajeske pral i gipangre, o Jedutun. Kai gili kras o Asaf.
Me dau gole ap miro Debleste, dau bari gole ap leste. Awa, ap o Debleste dau gole, bis te shunell lo man.
