An miri bari daar rodom me o baro Debles. Rati rikrom miro wast pre pash leste un mukom gar tele. Miro dji rowas un kamas gar tele te mukell.
Har djas mange o Dewel an o shero, phagas miro dji. Har rakrom miro djijeha, wan mange i swa.
Mire jaka rikral tu pre, jaake te nai sowom me gar. Me djinom gar dureder, un man his buder kek laba.
Mange was o phuro tsiro an o shero, kol bersha, hoi glan i rah tsiro his, stan an mande pre.
Rati djas mange bud an o shero trujel, rakrom miro djijeha un rodom te haiwap:
Bistras o baro Dewel men hako tsireske? Well lo menge buder gar latcho?
Hi leskro latchepen menge gar buder koi? Las job peskro lab pale?
Krell o Dewel buder gar peskro dji menge pre? Hi lo jaake chojedo, te pandas lo peskro dji menge?
Kote penom me: Kawa hi miro nasslepen, te kras pes o Dewel wawartchandes. I soor o pralstunestar well buder gar diklo.
Kanna mukau mange kowa an miro shero te djal, hoi tu, baro Dewel, kral, awa, penau mange ko baro un sorelo koowa, hoi kral an tiri bari soor.
Un rakrau miro djijeha pral kowa lauter, hoi tu kral, pale te pale penau mange kowa.
Miro Dewel, halauter, hoi tu kreh, hi tchatcho. Kek wawar dewel hi jaake sorelo har tu.
Tu hal ko Dewel, kai sawo baro koowa krell, hoi kek wawar nai krella. Tu sikral tiri bari soor pash i menshende an wawar themma.
Tiri sorjah lal tu tire menshen win dran lende. Awa, kolla, kai wan pal o Jakob un pal o Josef lal tu win.
I bare panja dikan tut, mo Dewel. Har dikan le tut, tapras len i daar, un jon trissan. Ninna an o telstunepen was o pani diwjo.
Dran o bolepen das baro sorelo brishin. O bolepen das bari gole, un i jag das karje ap o bolepen kate un kote.
Tu kral bari gole ap o bolepen. Koi jag ap o bolepen kras i rat har te wals diwes. I phub trissas i darjatar.
Tu djal mashkral o baro pani. Tire herja djan an o telstuno pani. Un kek nai dikas, kai tire herja stakran.
Tu djal glan tire menshende jaake har i bakrengro djal glan peskre bakrende, un rodal o Moses un o Arones win, te djan le glan lende ap o drom.
Giwede laba o Asafestar. Mire menshale, shunenn, hoi tumenge penau! Shunenn mishto ap mire laba!
Me kamau te rakrap i gosewe labentsa pral i phure tsirja.
Kowa, hoi mer shunam un djinah, un hoi mare phure menge penan,
kowa kamah gar te khatrell glan mare tchawende; na-a, kolenge, kai pal mende wenna, kamah te penell, har sorelo o baro Dewel hi un hawo baro koowa job kras an peskri soor.
Job sikras o Jakobeskre tchawende, har te djiwenn le. Un sikras i Israelende peskro drom. Mare phurenge penas lo, te sikrenn jon pengre tchawende, har te djan le leskro drom.
Jaake te djinenn les kolla, kai pal lende wenna, kolla, kai gomme gar bolde hi. Jon ninna sikrenn o Debleskro drom pengre tchawende,
jaake te rikrenn jon pengro tselo djijeha ap o Debleste, un bistrenn gar, hoi o Dewel lauter kras, un rikrenn lauter, hoi job penas,
jaake te wenn le gar har pengre phure, kai o Debleskro dromestar tele peran, un kaman gar te shunell. Kolengre djia his gar sorelo, un jon his gar pengro tselo djijeha pash o Debleste.
Jaake his i mursha dran o kheer Efrajim: Ninna le haiwan le mishto o bogeha trujel te djal, nashan le penge ap o diwes, kai o kurepen hi.
Jon rikran pen gar ap o Debleskre laba, hoi job lentsa win kras, un kaman gar ap leskro drom te djal.
Jon bistran, hoi job lauter kras, – ko tselo baro koowa, hoi job ap lende kras un hoi kek wawar nai krella.
Glan lengre phurende kras job baro sorelo koowa an o them Egiptia, pash o foro Zoan.
Job kras i drom an o baro pani, un mukas len mashkral ap i wawar rig te djal. Ap kol dui rigja his o pani pral tardo har i kheer.
Ap o diwes djas lo glan lende an i wolka, un rati an i jag, te was len i momeli.
An o mulo tato them phagas lo bare barra, un das len pani te pijell, budeder har doha hakeneske.
Job mukas panja te well dran i bare barra, te nashan le tele har bare lengste panja.
Ninna te kras lo kowa lauter lenge, shunan le gar ap leste, un an o mulo tato them hadan le pen ap leste, ko pralstuneste.
An pengre djia patsan le gar, te nai dals len o Dewel ko chapen, pal kowa len bok his.
Un jon rakran pal o Debleste un penan: “Nai dell men o Dewel chapen kate an o mulo tato them?
Kowa hi tchatcho: Job phagas o baro bar, un bud pani was win un nashas tele kate te kote pral o them. Nai dell lo men ninna maro? Haiwell lo peskre menshenge mass te anell?”
Har o baro Dewel kowa shunas, was lo chojedo ap o Jakobeskre tchawende. Peskri choli was ap o Israel har i jag.
Jon patsan gar, te hi lengro Dewel ap lengri rig, un dikan gar ap leste, te dell lo len, hoi len hunte well.
Un job rakras soreles ap i wolke un kras i bolepaskre wudja pre,
un das len bolepaskro djob te chal, hoi kharell Manna. Kowa peras tele ap lende, har brishin tele perell ap i phub.
Awa, maro, hoi i bolepangre chan, das lo lende lauterende. Bud chapen das lo len un kras len tchalo.
Job bitchras i baro ducho, hoi phurdas kotar, kai o kham pre djal. Un peskri sorjah tradas lo i wawar ducho pash lende, hoi phurdas kotar, kai o kham pralstunes hi,
Un o ducho anas bud bud tchirklen peha, te well len mass te chal, jaake bud tchirkle har i santa pash o baro pani.
Mashkral ap i platsa peran le, kote, kai lengre plachtene khera tardo hi.
Kote das lo len, hoi jon kaman, un jon chan un wan tchalo,
Har his le gomme pash o chapen un mass an lengro mui,
koi was o Debleskri choli pral lende, un job maras lengre pralstunen, un i terne sorele murshen i Israelendar mukas lo te merell.
Ninna te dikan le kowa lauter, anan le pale te pale doosh ap pende, un patsan gar ap lauter, hoi kras job an peskri bari soor.
Koi kras lo, te djal lengro djipen sik trujel, un lengre bersha his pherdi daar.
Te anas lo o merepen pral lende, rodan le o Debles, un putchan pale pal leste.
Un lenge was an o shero, te hi o Dewel kowa, kai rikrell len, un kai job, o Dewel pral halauter, kowa hi, kai len win lell dran o merepen.
Kowa, hoi le leske penan, his chochedo. un lengre laba his chochepen.
Pengre djijentsa his le gar pash leste, un ap leskre laba, hoi le leha win kran, rikran le gar pengro tselo djijeha.
Job kras lenge peskro dji pre, un maras len gar. Na-a, job las lendar i doosh tele. Bud kope rikras job peskri choli pale, un mukas gar peskri tseli choli ap lende te well.
Job djinas, te hi le menshe, kai hunte merenn, un hi sik buder gar koi, jaake har i ducho, hoi djal un gar pale wella.
Bud kope hadan le pen ap leste an o mulo tato them, un dukran leskro dji.
Pale te pale kaman le te dikell, hoi job haiwella. Jaake dan le leske an o dji, koleske, kai kokres o tchatcho Dewel hi, o Dewel pral o Israel.
Jon bistran leskri bari soor un ko diwes, har las lo len win dran i tchilatche wasta.
Lenge was gar an o shero, har sikras lo peskri bari soor an o them Egiptia, un hawo baro koowa job kras pash o foro Zoan.
Kote kras lo, te was o pani an o Nil rat, te nai pijan i Egiptarja gar dran pengre panja.
Un job bitchras matsille an lengro them, hoi len dandran, un djambe, hoi o them khandlo kran.
Lengro djob chan i stepangre pre. Kolla chan lauter, hoi ap lengri phub bares was.
Un lengre drakengre ruka das i barrengro brishin paash, un lengre faigetikre ruka o djajedo pani.
I brishineskre barra dan lengre grumjen mulo, un koi jag, hoi pral un tele djas ap o bolepen, das i bakren mulo.

Jaake bitchras o Dewel peskri bari choli ap i Egiptarja. Leskri choli his har i jag, hoi chatchras, un i bari phagi pral lende anas. I bibacht tapras len har te wals lat bitchedo i bolepangrendar, kai anenn o merepen.
Un o Dewel rikras peskri choli gar pale, un las len gar win dran o merepen, un mukas len te merell ap i djungelo nasslepen.
Job maras i tsele phureder mursh tchawen an o them Egiptia, kol tchawen kolendar, kai wenna pal o Ham, an kolende pengre dadengri bareder soor hi.
Palle anas job peskre menshen win, un djas glan lende har i bakrengro djal glan peskre bakre, un sikras len o drom an o mulo tato them.
Job rikras peskre wasta pral lende. Un len hunte was kek daar. Un kolla, kai len palla lan, an o baro pani jon tassan.
Job anas len an o them, hoi job peske wi-rodas, pash kai berga, hoi job peskri sorjah dren las.

Job tradas i tsele wawar menshen glan lende win, un das lengro them peskre menshende, hakeneste kol deesh-te-dui bare familjendar das lo lengro kotar, te well ko them lengro. An i plachtene khera kol wawar menshendar mukas lo i Israelitarjen te djiwell.
Kolla hadan pen pale te pale ap o Debleste, ko pralstuneste, un kaman gar ap leste te shunell, un rikran gar leskre laba.
Jon peran lestar tele. Un jaake har lengre phure menshe kran, kran jon ninna, un kaman o Deblestar buder tchi te djinell. Tchi-moldo his le har i bogo, koleskri dori buder gar sorelo hi.
Jon mangan i wawarengre deblen an. Un choiran o Debles, har kran le penge chochene deblen.
Har o Dewel kowa shunas, was lo jaake chojedo, te das lo o Israel pre.
Un job mukas peskro kheer an o foro Shilo, kote, kai job mank peskre menshende djiwas.
Un ko sonakaskro mochton, hoi sikras peskri soor un peskro railepen, mukas lo an i wasta kolendar te perell, kai kuran pen peskre menshentsa.
Un peskre menshen das job an lengre wasta, te marenn le len o chareha. Jaake chojedo his lo ap lende.
I terne murshen chas i jag. Un i terne tcha nai hatsan buder kek romes.
I rashaja wan maredo o chareha, un lengre romja nai rowan gar pral pengre mule romende.
Koi stas o baro Dewel pre, har jek, kai sowas un pre djangras. Sorelo his lo har jek, kai pash i pipen bachtelo was.
Un job das kolen, kai kuran pen peskre menshentsa un tradas len pale. Lengri ladj atchas hako tsireske ap lende.
O Josefeskre tchawen las job gar, te wenn lendar i pralstune pral o Israel, witar gar rodas lo peske i menshen dran o kheer Efrajim win.
Na-a, i menshen dran o kheer Juda rodas lo peske win, un koi berga Zion, hoi job o djijestar kamella.
Kote pre tchiwas lo peskro kheer, dur pral djal lo pre – har o bolepen, un hi soreles tardo har i phub, hoi lo kras hako tsireske.
Un job rodas peske o Davides win, te was lo leskro budepaskro, un las les kotar krik, kai das lo jak ap i bakrende.
Kolendar kharas lo les krik, te well lo o baro rai pral o Israel, te dell lo jak ap o Debleskre menshende, har i bakrengro dell jak ap peskre bakrende.
Un peskro tselo djijeha das o David jak ap lende, un goswepah sikras lo len o drom.
I gili, hoi o Asaf kras. Maro Dewel, menshe dran wawar themma peran an tiro them dren; tiro kheer, hoi tuke kokres his, kran le pale-tchiddo. Un o foro Jerusalem dan le paash.
Tire budepangren dan le mulo, un lengro mass dan le i tchirklende tel o bolepen te chal. Kolen, kai tu tuke wi-rodal, maran le, un lengro mass dan le i diwje viechen te chal.
Lengro rat nashas har pani trul o foro Jerusalem, un kek his koi, kai len paskras.
Mer ham praassedo kolenge, kai trul mende djiwenn, ham lenge sapaske, un jon rikrenn men dineleske.
Baro Dewel, har rah atchell tiri choli ap mende? Har rah chatchrell li har i jag?
Tchore tiri choli ap kol menshende win, kai tut gar prindjrenna, ap kol themma, kai tut gar an-gole denna!
Jon chan o Jakobes pre, un stakran leskro them paash.
De men kek phagi koleske, hoi mare phure kran! Kre sik tiro dji menge pre! Dik, men hi buder kek soor!
Ab ap mari rig, maro Dewel! un le men win! Le men win dran lengre wasta, te well tiro lab hadedo! Un le mari doosh mendar krik, te well tiro lab pale baro!
Hoske nai penenn i wawar menshe: ‘Kai hi tumaro Dewel?’ Muk men te dikell, har tu len khetne stakreh koleske, kai maran le tire budepangre!
Shun, har i stilde rowenn! Tu hal jaake sorelo, rike kolen ap o djipen, kai hi jaake mishto har mulo.
Kolla, kai an i themma trul mende djiwenn, praassan tut, maro rajes. De len kowa efta kope pale, hoi kran le ap tute!
Mer ham tire menshe. Tu hal menge har i bakrengro, kai anell peskre bakre kote, kai hatsenn le chapaske. Mer parkrah men pash tute hako tsiro, un sharah tut kanna un an ko tsiro, hoi wella.
I gili o rajeske pral i gipangre, te giwell pash o bashepen ap i shob-dorjengri bashepaskri. Kai gili kras o Asaf.
Shun ap mende, tu, kai deh jak ap i Israelende. Har i bakrengro jak dell ap peskre bakre, deh tu jak ap o Josefeskre tchawende. Tu, kai hal beshdo pral i cherubim, ab, un sike tut
glan tire menshende dran o kheer Efrajim, Benjamin un Manasse! Sike tiri bari soor un ab ap mari rig!
Baro Dewel, hade men pale pre! Dik latches ap mende, jaake djal menge pale mishto.
Tu, baro Dewel un rai pral o bolepen un i phub, har rah kameh tu mentsa chojedo te well, kanna, kai tire menshe tut an-mangenn?
I swa hi maro chapen, dran i khoro pherde swa deh tu men te pijell.
Kolla, kai trul mende djiwenna, tchingrenn pen pral maro them. Kolla, kai kamenn men krik te tradell, praassenn men.
Tu, Dewel un rai pral o bolepen un i phub, hade men pale pre! Dik latches ap mende, jaake djal menge pale mishto.
Dran o them Egiptia anal tu i drakengro ruk; tradal wawar menshen dran lengre themma, un tchiwal les an i phub.
Tu kral leske bud platsa, leskre draba nai djan dur an i phub, un job was buchlo an o tselo them.
Peskre kashtentsa tchakras lo i berge. Leskre lengste kashta tchakran i bare zedertikre ruka.
Leskre mussja djan bis pash o baro pani ap koi jek rig, un bis pash ko sorelo lengsto pani ap koi wawar rig.
Hoske phagal tu kol barra tele, hoi trul leste pre-tchiddo wan? Kanna nai lell hakeno peske drake lestar tele, kai kote djal.
I diwje bale chan les pre, un diwje vieche mukenn tchi pral.
Ab pale pash mende, tu, o Dewel pral o bolepen un i phub! Dik dran o bolepen ap mende, un de pale jak ap tiro drakengro ruk!
Rike tiro wast pral leste, hoi tu an i phub tchiwal, pral ko terno drakengro ruk, hoi tu bares un soreles kral.
Dik, har hi lo tele dino un pre-chatchedo! Tchinge jaake ap kolende, kai kowa kran, te phagenn le khetne.
Rike tiro wast pral koleste, kai hi beshdo ap tiri tchatchi rig, pral ko mursheste, koles tu soreles kral.
Jaake kamah mer gar tiri rigjatar te djal. Muk men te djiwell! Un mer dah tiro lab an-gole.
Tu, baro Dewel un rai pral o bolepen un i phub, hade men pale pre! Dik latches ap mende, jaake djal menge pale mishto!
I gili o rajeske pral i gipangre, te giwell ap i bashepaskri, hoi kharella gittit. O Asaf kras kai gili.
Giwenn i bachtjatar o Debleske! Job hi mari soor. Sharenn o Jakobeskro Debles!
Giwenn leske Debleskre gilja! Denn ap i pauka! Bashrenn ap i dorjengre bashepangre!
Phurdenn an i phurdepaskri ap ko diwes, kai well o tchon pale diklo, ninna ap ko diwes, kai well o tselo tchon diklo. Kowa hi o baro diwes, kai wah bachteles khetne.
Ap kau lab hunte rikrenn pen i Israelitarja. Kawa hi i tchatchepaskro lab, hoi o Jakobeskro Dewel lende das.
Kowa penas o Dewel o Josefeskre menshenge, har djas lo an o kurepen khatar i Egiptarja. Shunau i rakepen, hoi me gar prindjrom:
Me lom tumendar ko pharo koowa tele, hoi ap tumare phika his, un tumare wasta hunte hidjrenn buder gar kol phare barra.
Har tuke ropaske his, un tu pal mande gole dal, wom me un lom tut win. Tu putchal mandar, un me rakrom tuha dran koi wolka. Pash o pani Meriba lom tut an i jak, te dikap, har tu shuneh ap mande.
Mire menshe, shunenn ap mande, me dau tumen trad. Israel, shuness, hoi me tuke penau:
Pash tumende hunte well kek wawar dewel, un tu mangess kek wawar debles an!
Me hom tiro baro Dewel, kai tut dran o them Egiptia win anas. Kre tiro mui dur pre, un me dau tut bud chapen.
Mire menshe shunan gar ap mande. O Israel kamas man gar.
Jaake mukom len kowa te krell, hoi jon kaman, un mukom len pal pengro shero te djal.
Har kamoms me, te shunans mire menshe ap mande, te djals o Israel ap miro drom!
Sik anoms ladj ap kolende, kai ap lende djan, un tchiwoms miro wast phares ap lende.
Kolla, kai pen ap o baro Debleste choirenn, hunte witsrens pen tele glan leste. Lengri phagi atchals hako tsireske.
Un i Israelende doms o latcheder djob chapaske, un o feteder gwin, te wans le tchalo.
I gili o Asafestar. O Dewel hi tardo mashkral o bolepaskro tsillo, un rakrell o tchatchepen win pral i debla.
“Har rah djan tumer gar pal o tchatchepen? Har rah denn tumer koleste peskro tchatchepen, koles gar tchatcho hi?
Dikenn, te lenn i tchorwele pengro tchatchepen, ninna kolla, kolen kek dad buder hi! Awenn ap i rig kolendar, kolen tchi hi un gar an-diklo hi, un dikenn, te lenn le pengro tchatchepen!
Awenn ap i rig i tchorwelenge, un kolenge, kai tikno rikedo wenna, un lenn len win dran i wasta i tchilatchendar!
Tumer mukenn tumenge tchi te penell. Dinele han tumer, un djan tumaro drom, har te wals kali rat, kai dikenn tchi. Doleske dell kek tchatchepen buder ap kai phub.
Awa, me penom: ‘Tumer han debla, tumer lauter han tchawe o pralstunestar.’
Kanna penau: ‘Tumer hunte merenna jaake har i menshe merenna, awa, jaake har sorele raja perenna, perenn tumer ninna.’”
Ste pre, maro Dewel un rake o tchatchepen win pral i tseli phub! Tire hi i menshe an i tsele themma.
I gili o Asafestar.
Miro Dewel, rake! Muk tut te shunell! Atch gar pokones!
Dik! Kolla, kai choirenn pen ap tute, hi diwjo. Kolla, kai kamenn tuke tchilatchepen, hadenn pengro shero pral tute.
Jon tchiwenn pen khetne un rakrenn, har nai krenn le tire menshenge tchilatchepen. Pal o dumo krenn le win, te djan le ap kolende, kai khatrenn pen pash tute.
“Awenn”, penenn le, “Stakras len khetne, kol Israelitarjen! Kal menshenge hi kek platsa ap kai phub. Ko lab Israel hunte well bistedo!”
Jon hi jek dji un jek djipen un kran win, te djan le ap tute:
Kolla hi i menshe dran o Edom un dran o Ismael, dran o Moab, dran i Hagar,
dran o Gebal, o Ammon, un o Amalek, ninna i Filistarja un kol menshe dran o foro Tirus.
Ninna o Assur tchiwas pes ap lengri rig. Jon wan jek mussi i menshentsa, kai wenna pal o Lot.
Miro Dewel, kre lenge, har kral ap i Midianarja, ap o Sisera, un ap o Jabin pash ko tikno pani Kishon.
Kolla wan mulo dino pash En-Dor, un atchan koi tchiddo, un wan tchik.
Kre lengre pralstunenge har kral kol murshentsa o Oreb un o Seeb. Ap lengre tsele rajende kre jaake har kral ap o Sebach un o Zalmunna.
Kolla penan: “Mer kamah o Debleskro them menge te lell.”
Miro Dewel, phurde len krik har patria, har phuss an i baro ducho!
Ab lenge har i jag, hoi o weesh tele chatchrell, un pes an i berge dureder chal!
Bitche i baro phurdepen un trade len krik! Kre lenge daar tiro sorelo ducheha!
Kre, te wenn lengre sherja lolo i ladjatar, te putchenn le pal tute, baro Dewel.
An ladj un traash ap lende hako tsireske, te merenn le an i ladj.
Mu dikenn le, te hal tu kokres o baro Dewel un o pralstuno rai ap i tseli phub.
I gili jekestar dran i familja Korach. Kai gili hi o rajeske pral i gipangre, te giwell pash o bashepen ap i bashepaskri, hoi kharella Gittit.
Tu, baro Dewel un rai pral o bolepen un i phub, har kamau me tiro kheer o djijestar!
Miro dji nashell pal tiro kheer, baro Dewel. Kamau te wap dren ap i platsa glan tiro kheer. Miro tselo djijeha giwau bachtele gilja tuke, o djido Debleske.

O tchirklo hatsas peske i kheer, un o khereskro tchirklo kras peske i kheer peskre tchawenge, gar dur kotar, kai tu sharedo well. Tu baro Dewel un rai pral o bolepen un i phub, tu hal miro baro rai un miro Dewel.
Bachteles hi kolla, kai djiwenn an tiro kheer. Hako tsiro hadenn le tut.
Bachteles hi kol menshe, kolengri soor an tute hi, un kai o djijestar pash tiro kheer djan.
Te djan le an o tato them, nashell kote pani lenge win. Un o brishin mukell lauter senelo un baro te well.
Pale te pale lenn le newi soor, bis te dikenn le o tchatcho Debles ap i berga Zion.
Tu baro Dewel un rai pral o bolepen un i phub, shun miro mangepen! Muk les glan tute te well, tu o Jakobeskro Dewel!
Dik latches ap o baro rajeste, koles menge ap mari rig tchiwal! Dik ap leste, koles win rodal, te well lo maro rai!
Jek diwes ap i platsa glan tiro kheer hi feteder har i serja wawar diwessa. Me kamau budeder te wap tardo pash o wudar glan tiro kheer, har te djiwap pash i tchilatchende.

Maro baro Dewel hi o kham maro djipaske. Job rikrell peskre wasta pral mende. O baro Dewel dell men latchepen un railepen. Kolen, kai o djijestar ap leste shunenna, dell lo hako latchepen, hoi len hunte wella.
Tu baro Dewel un rai pral o bolepen un i phub, bachtelo hi ko mensho, kai rikrell pes ap tute.
I gili jekestar dran i familja Korach. Kai gili hi o rajeske pral i gipangre.
Baro Dewel, tut his i dji tiro themeske, un lal o Jakobeskre pandle menshen win dran i tchilatche wasta.
Tu lal o tchilatchepen, hoi tire menshe kran, lendar krik! Lengri tseli doosh bistral tu.
Tu rikral tiri choli pale, un chatchral buder gar i choljatar.
Maro Dewel, kai tu lauter menge mishto kreh, ab ninna kanna ap mari rig! Muk tele tiri choljatar, hoi tut ap mende hi!
Kameh i tsele tsirja ap mende chojedo te atchell? Mukeh tu buder gar tiri choljatar tele?
Kameh men buder gar newi soor te dell, te wenn tire menshe pale bachtelo pral tute?
Baro Dewel, ab menge latches, un kre lauter menge pale mishto!
Kamoms te shunap, har o baro Dewel penell, te well an leskro them un leskre menshenge kek kurepen, jaake te djas mer gar ap dinele dromma.
Tchatchepah, job hi ap kolengri rig, kai leha djiwenna un ap leste shunenna. Un leskro railepen atchell an maro them.
Palle well leskro latchepen ap mende, un mer rikrah soreles ap leste. Mer krah hoi tchatcho hi, un job dell men bacht an o dji.
Kate ap kai phub rikrah mer soreles ap o Debleste. Un dran o bolepen well o Debleskro tchatchepen ap mende.
Awa, o baro Dewel mukell menge mishto te djal, un mari phub anell menge bud chapen.
Hako tsiro un ap hake dromma djal o baro Dewel pal o tchatchepen.
O David mangas o Debles kol labentsa: Baro Dewel, me hom tchorwelo, un mange djal gar mishto. Shun, har dau ap tute gole, un rake mantsa!
De garda ap miro djipen! Me hom tiro. Ab ap miri rig, miro Dewel, me hom tiro budepaskro, un rikrau man ap tute.
Baro Dewel, ab mange latches! Ap tute dau gole hako diwes.
Miro dji djal pal tute, baro Dewel. Kre man pale bachtelo. Me hom tiro budepaskro.
Tu hal latcho, miro baro Dewel, un leh i doosh krik. Tiro latchepen hi baro kolenge, kai ap tute gole denn.
Baro Dewel, shun miro mangepen! Shun, har rowau ap tute!
Ap ko diwes, kai mange ropaske hi, dau ap tute gole, un tu shuneh man.
Miro rai, dell kek debles har tut. Kek nai krell kowa, hoi tu kreh.
I tsele natsjone, kolen tu kral, kolla wenna un mangenn tut an, maro rajes, un sharenn tiro railepen.
Tu hal baro un kreh baro koowa, hoi kek wawar nai krella. Tu kokres hal o Dewel.
Baro Dewel, sike man tiro drom, te djap an tiro tchatchepen. Rike miro dji pash tute, te krap, hoi tu kameh!
Mo Dewel un mo rai, parkrau man miro tselo djijestar pash tute, un hadau tut hako tsiro.
Tiro latchepen mange hi baro. Tu lal miro djipen win dran o merepen.
Miro Dewel, pre-phurde mursha hadenn pen ap mande. Kolla, kai sorelo un tchilatcho hi, tchiwan pen khetne, un kamenn man te marell. Pal tute putchenn le gar.
Tu, baro Dewel, hal i latcho Dewel, un kreh tiro dji tire menshenge pre. Tu weh gar sik chojedo, Tiro latchepen hi baro un tu rikreh pash tire menshende.
Risse tut pash mande, un ab mange latches! Hom tiro budepaskro, – de man tiri soor! Ninna miri dai his tiri budepaskretsa, doleske ab ap miri rig!
Sike mande, te hal tu mantsa latches, baro Dewel! Palle hunte ladjenn pen kolla, kai kamenn mange tchilatchepen, te dikenn le, kai tu ap miri rig hal, un mire swa tele khosseh.
I gili jekestar dran i familja Korach. O baro Dewel kras o foro Zion soreles, pral ap peskri berga.
O djijestar kamell lo o foro Zion peskre shukar wudjentsa. Budeder kamell lo ko foro har i tsele khera, kai djiwenn o Jakobeskre tchawe.
Shun, tu o Debleskro foro, hawo shukar rakepen o Dewel pral tute rakrell:
Mank kolende, kai man prindjrenna, hi i menshe dran i themma Egiptia un Babilonia, ninna i Filistarja un i menshe dran Tirus, ninna kolla dran o them Etiopia, kai kate boldo hi.
Pral o foro Zion nai peness: Hakeno hi kate khere; o Dewel, ko pralstuno, kokres rikrell o fores soreles.
An o liil, kai i menshe dran hake themma dren tchinlo wenn, tchinell o baro Dewel pal hako lab: ‘Kawa hi kate khere.’
Un pash o khelepen giwenn le lauter: Dran tute, tu foro Zion, well ko tselo latchepen, hoi men hi.
I gili o rajeske pral i gipangre, te giwell har koi gili ‘Mahalat Leannoth’. Kai gili kras jek dran i familja Korach. O Heman dran i familja Esra tchinas kal laba.
Baro Dewel, tu hal o Dewel, kai mange lauter mishto krell. Ap tute dau me gole hako diwes un haki rat.
Muk miro mangepen glan tute te well. Shun, har ap tute rowau!
Man hi doha kol tsele dukendar. Hom gar dur o merepastar.
Hom lauterenge har jek, kai ap o merepen tchiddo hi. Hom har i mursh, koles kek soor buder hi.
Man dan le pre har i mules. Mange djal har kolenge, kai mulo dino un paskedo wan, un kolen bistral, un lenge buder tchi kreh.
Tu tchiwal man an i phub, an o telstunepen, kai kali rat trul mande hi.
Tiri choli hi phares ap mande tchiddo, un jaake har bud pani jekes tele tserdell, tserdeh tu man tele.
Tu kral, te mukan man mire mala. Hom lenge djungelo. Me hom dre-pandlo an i bibacht un wau gar win.
I dukatar well mange kales glan i jaka. Ap tute, baro Dewel, dau me gole hako diwes. Mire wasta hadau me pash tute pre.
Kreh tu baro sorelo koowa ap i mulende? Stenn i mule pre un sharenn tut?
Rakrenn le pral tiro latchepen pash i mulende? – Pral tiro tchatchepen an o mulengro them?
Djinenn le kote, kai kali rat hi, hawo baro koowa tu kral an tiri soor? Haiwenn le tiro tchatchepen kote an ko them, kai lauter bistedo hi?
Me dau ap tute gole, baro Dewel. Sik taissarlakro anau miro mangepen glan tute.
Hoske tchiwal man pale un khatreh tut glan mande?
Fun tiknes pre hom nasselo, un gar dur o merepastar. Hoske tchiweh tu pale te pale i traash ap mande? Me nai hidjrau lat buder gar.
Tiri choli was pral mande har i jag. Tire dawa phagenn man.
Jon wenn ap mande haki rigjatar, har baro diwjo pani hi le trul mande o tselo diwes.
Mire tsele malen tserdal tu mandar krik, mire menshen rikreh tu mandar pale, un hom kokres har an i kali rat.
Giwede laba, hoi o Etan dran i familja Esra pre-tchinas.
Hako tsiro kamau te giwell pral o latchepen, hoi o baro Dewel men dell. Lauterenge kamau te penell, har job pash peskre menshende rikrell.
Kowa hi hoi me penau: Hako tsireske atchell leskro latchepen, jaake rah har dell o bolepen, rikrell job peskro lab.
Job penas: “Miri sowel dom man koleste, koles me mange win rodom: Me dom miro lab miro budepaskro, o Davideste:
I menshe, kai tutar wenna, hako tsireske jon atchenna. Dran tiro kheer i bare raja wenna, un hako tsiro i raja atchenna.”
Baro Dewel, o bolepen sharell, hoi tu an tiri soor lauter kral, I bolepangre sharenn, har hako tsiro pash tire menshende rikral.
Koon an o bolepen hi jaake har tu, maro baro Dewel? Hawo Dewel nai well jaake har maro baro Dewel?
Kote, kai i bolepangre khetne wenn, o Deblestar jon darenn. Kolla lauter, kai hi trul leste, hi dareno tardo glan o baro Debleste.
Tu baro Dewel un rai pral o bolepen un i phub, koon hi jaake sorelo har tu? Koon rikrell jaake pash peskre menshende har tu?
Tu hal o rai pral o baro diwjo pani. Job te hadell pes, kreh tu, te djal lo tele.
O baro panjeskro sap Rahab dal tu mulo, un kolen, kai tuke tchilatchepen kaman, tradal tu krik.
O bolepen, tiro hi lo, un i phub, tiri hi li, un tu kral lauter, hoi dren hi.
Ko them, kai o kham gar tardo hi, tu kral les. Ninna ko them, kai o kham pral tardo hi, tu kral les. Koi berga Tabor un i berga Hermon sharenn tut i bachtjatar.
Tut hi i soreli mussi, tiro wast hi sorelo, un pre hadedo tiro tchatcho wast, te sikress tiri soor pral i menshende.
O tchatchepen pral i menshende rakreh, un tchatchepaskre laba lenge peneh. Doleske atcheh tu o baro rai. An lauter, hoi kreh, dikah tiro latchepen, un har pash mende rikreh.
Baro Dewel, har bachtelo hi kol menshe, kai sharenn tut i giljentsa, kai djiwenn an tiro latchepen!
O tselo diwes hi le bachtelo pral tute. O tchatchepen, hoi tu len deh, krell len baro.
Tu kokres hal lengro railepen un lengri soor, un dran tiro latchepen nai hadah mare sherja.
Baro Dewel, tu dal men koles, kai ap mende garda della. Tu, o Dewel pral o Israel, rodal les win, te well lo maro baro rai.

Glan i rah tsiro rakral tu ap jekeste tire menshendar an i visiona un penal: “Me dom miro wast i tchatcho mursheste, te well lo ap tumari rig. Me rodom les win dran mire menshende, te well lo baro rai.
Me hatsom o Davides, miro budepaskro. Me makom les miro djeteha, te well lo baro rai.
Miro wast rikrell les, un miri mussi krell les soreles.
Kek, kai ap leste djal, well o sorleder pral leste, un kek tchilatcho nai hadell pes pral leste.
Me kamau kolen khetne te stakrell, kai ap leste djan, un kolen, kai leske tchilatchepen kamenn, dau me an i phub.
Hako tsiro rikrau pash leste, un hom leske latcho. Me krau les bareder har kolla, kai trul leste hi.
Me dau les penepaske pral ko tselo them mank o baro pani un o lengsto pani Eufrat.
Job penell ap mande: Tu hal miro dad, miro Dewel, kowa, kai rikrell peskre wasta pral mande un well ap miri rig.
Un me krau, te well lo miro phureder tchawo, un o pralstuno pral i bare rajende ap kai phub.
Hako tsiro atchell miro latchepen ap leste, un miro lab, hoi leske sowel dom, rikrau me.
Hako tsiro well jek leskre tchawendar, kai pal leste wenna, o baro rai pral o them, jaake rah har o bolepen koi hi.
Leskre tchawe, te mukenn le miro drom, un djan gar pal miro tchatchepen,
un krenn gar, hoi lendar kamau, un rikrenn pen gar ap mire laba,
palle dau len dawa lengri doshake, un duka lengro tchilatchepaske.
Miro latchepen lau lendar gar krik, un miro lab, hoi len dom, phagau me gar.
Koi sowel, hoi lenge dom, phagau gar. Un kol laba, hoi dran miro mui djan, krau me gar wawartchandes.
Jek kopo dom me man sowel, un chochau o Davides gar: Jaake har tchatcho hi, kai hom o Dewel, jaake hi tchatcho,
te wenn o Davidestar bare raja an hake tsirja, jaake rah har o kham koi hi,
un o tchon ap o bolepen tardo hi, un dikell, hoi ap kai phub djala.”
Kanna, baro Dewel, tchiwal tu les pale, koles tu win rodal, te was lo baro rai, Tu mukal les te perell, un hal chojedo ap leste.
Tu phagal tiri sowel, hoi tiro budepaskres dal. Leskri rajeskri stadi witsral ap i phub, an i tchik.
Leskro foro kral tu paash, un kol bare sorele khera dal an kotja paash.
Lauter, kai ap o drom djan un les dikan, tchoran les win. Kolla, kai langs leste djiwenn, san pal leste.
Kolla, kai ap leste djan, mukal, te hadenn le pen. Un kral kolen bachtelo, kai leske tchilatchepen kamenn.
An o kurepen his leskro charo buder gar sorelo. Un tu mukal o Davides gar o sorleder te well.
Tu lal lestar o railepen, un leskri raili beshepaskri stakral an i phub.
Glan o tsiro mukal tu les phuro te well, un anal ladj ap leste.
Baro Dewel, har rah kameh tut gomme te khatrell? Har rah mukeh tiri choli te chatchrell har i jag?
Tu djineh, har tikno miro djipen hi. Ma biste, har sik i mensho buder gar kai hi! Tu kokres kral les jaake.
Kek mensho hi koi, kai hunte merell gar. Kek nai lell peskro djipen win dran o merepen.
Baro Dewel, glan i rah tsiro dal tu men tiro lab, te tchiwess tiro latchepen ap mende. Hoske rikreh tu gar koi sowel, hoi dal o Davideste?
Ma biste koi ladj, hoi hi ap mande, tiro budepaskro! Dik, har hidjrau ko tselo praassepen kolendar, kai tut gar prindjrenna.
Baro Dewel, kolla, kai tut gar kamenna, praassenn man, o baro rajes, koles tu tuke win rodal.
Sharedo well o baro Dewel hako tsireske. Amen. Awa! Amen.
O mangepen o Mosestar, ko Debleskro murshestar. Baro Dewel, maro rai, tu hal kowa, pash koleste nai wah un khere ham.
Glan i berge kerdo wan, un tu i phub kral, hals tu, o Dewel, koi. Un tu atcheh hake tsirja.
Tu penell menge: “Awenn pale, tumer menshe!” Un mukeh men pale tchik te well.
Jek sero bersha hi pash tute har jek diwes, har ko diwes, hoi taissar his, un buder gar koi hi, un har i tikno tsiro an i rat.
Har i lengsto pani sik dureder nashell, jaake mukeh mare diwessa dureder te nashell. Maro djipen hi tikno har i sopen. Mer ham har i senlepen, hoi taissarlakro dran i phub well,
bares well un shukar hi, un rati tele merell un truk well.
Dran tiri choli merah jaake sik. Tiri choli khossell men krik.
Maro tchilatcho koowa hoi kram, tchiwal tu glan tute tardo. Mari khatedi doosh tchakreh tu pre.
Dran tiri choli djan mare diwessa tchitcheske trujel. Mare bersha djan jaake sik har te phurdell jek o ducho win.
Maro djipen hi 70 (efta-deesh) bersha, te hi bud, 80 (ochta-deesh) bersha. Un kowa, hoi menge shukar his, hi tchi har budi un pharepen. Un sikeder har sik hi lauter trujel.
Koon patsell, te nai well tiri choli jaake baro? Un koon darell tiri choljatar?
Sike men, har sik maro djipen trujel hi, te was mer gosewo.
Baro Dewel, har rah kameh te choireh tut ap mende? Dik pale latches ap mende, tire budepangre!
Haki tsalla kre maro djipen pherdo tiro latchepen! Palle sharah tut un giwah tuke gilja jaake rah har djiwah.
I rah tsiro hams tele rikedo. De men kanna jaake bud bachtele bersha, har hams an i bibacht.
Mer tire budepangre kamah te dikas o baro koowa, hoi tu kreh. Muk mare tchawen tiro railepen te dikell!
Tu rai, maro Dewel, dik latches ap mende, un tchip tiri bacht ap kowa, hoi mare wastentsa krah. Awa, muk mari budi mishto te djal!
Kowa, kai beshell tel o wast o Deblestar, ko pralstunestar, un atchell pash leste, ko sorelo Debleste,
kowa penell ap o baro Debleste: “Pash tute hom khere. Tu hal mange har i baro sorelo kheer, miro Dewel, ap tute dikau.”
O baro Dewel dell jak ap tute, te peress gar an i dorja, hoi tchiwell kowa tuke, kai kamell tut te taprell. Ninna lell o Dewel tiro djipen win dran o nasslepen, hoi anell an o merepen.

Har i kachni peskre ternen tel leskre mussja khatrell, jaake khatrell o Dewel tut tel leskre sorele mussja. Kote nai djal tuke tchi. Job rikrell tut jaake har lo penas. Doleske nai well kek tchilatchepen ap tute.
Tu hunte tapress kek daar glan kowa, hoi rati nai wella, witar gar glan kol kashta, hoi ap o diwes karje dino wenna,
witar gar glan ko nasslepen, hoi tchorchanes an i rat well, witar gar glan ko tchilatchepen, hoi ap o diwes marell.
Ninna te perenn i serja menshe ap tiri rig, un deesh serja ap tiri tchatchi rig, tuke djal tchi.
Awa, tire jakentsa dikeh tu les. Tu dikeh har i tchilatche lenn pal kowa, hoi jon kran.
Tu penal: “Pash o baro Debleste hom khere.” Tu khatral tut pash o Debleste, ko pralstuneste.
Doleske well kek bibacht ap tute, un kek nasslepen nai well an tiro kheer.
Job kokres penas ap peskre bolepangre, te denn le jak ap tute ap tire tsele dromma,
te hidjrenn le tut ap pengre wasta, jaake te nai dukress tiri heri ap kek bar.
I lewe un i sapa nai dukrenn tut gar. Tu stakreh len lauter khetne.
O Dewel penell: “Job kamell man o tselo djijestar. Doleske lau les dran kowa lauter win. Job prindjrell man. Doleske dau jak ap leste.
Job dell ap mande gole. Doleske shunau me ap leste, un hom pash leste, te djal leske gar mishto. Me lau les win dran i bibacht un krau les bares.
Me dau les i lengsto djipen un sikrau les, te hom kowa, kai les win lell dran i bibacht.”
I gili, te giwell ap o Debleskro diwes.
Har shukar hi, te parkrau man pash tute, o baro Debleste, te giwau gilja tuke, o pralstuneske,
te rakrau pral tiro latchepen taissarlakro, un pral tiro tchatchepen an i rat,
te bashrau tuke ap i deesh-dorjengri bashepaskri un ap i harfa.
Kowa, hoi tu kral, baro Dewel, mukell man bachteles te giwell. Kowa, hoi tire wasta lauter kran, sharau me.
Baro Dewel, hawo baro koowa kral tu! Hi phares menge te haiwas, hoi tuke an o shero djal.
I dinelo patsell kowa gar; un i narwelo haiwell les gar:
I tchilatche wenn baro har o senlepen. Kolenge, kai tchilatcho koowa krenna, djal mishto. Kowa lauter well, te wenn le krik lino hako tsireske.
Tu, baro Dewel, hal o pralstuno, un atcheh hake tsirenge.
Mer djinah, lauter, kai tut tchilatchepen kamenn, hunte merenn. Un lauter, kai tchilatcho koowa krenna, wenn krik tradedo.
Man kral tu sorelo har i diwjo gurum, un makal man newo djeteha, hoi pral mande tchoral.
Me dikau tele ap kolende, kai mange tchilatchepen kaman, un shunau i gole kol tchilatchendar, kai hadan pen ap mande.
Kolla, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi, wenn sorelo har i senele palmtikre ruka. Jon well baro har i zedertikre ruka ap i berga Libanon.
Jon hi har ruka, kai hi tardo an o baro Debleskro kheer, un kai wenn senelo ap i platsa glan o Debleskro kheer.
Ninna te wenn le phuro, hi le senele, pherdi soor, un rukengre wenn ap lende baro.
Jaake dikah: O baro Dewel krell lauter tchatches. Job hi har i baro sorelo bar, kai nai khatrau man, un kek chochepen hi ap leste.
O baro Dewel hi o baro rai. Railepen un soor hi trul leste har i ripen. Job kras i phub jaake te hi li soreles tardo.
Baro Dewel, jaake rah har o bolepen un i phub koi hi, hal tu o baro rai. Glan hako tsiro hals tu koi.
Baro Dewel, i bare panja hadenn pen. O pani well diwjo un dell soreli gole. Diwjo un sorelo djal lo pre.
Ninna te hi o baro pani diwjo un leskri gole sorelo, bareder hi o baro Dewel an o bolepen.
Tiro lab hi o tchatchepen, un tiro kheer hi hako tsiro tuke kokres, baro Dewel, jaake rah har i phub koi hi.
Baro Dewel, tu hal o Dewel, kai o tchilatchepen pale deh kolenge, kai wawaren tchilatchepen kran. Ab, un sike tut!
Tu hal o tchatchepaskro rai pral i tseli phub, de kol pre-phurden pengri phagi!
Baro Dewel, har rah nai krenn pen i tchilatche bares? Har rah?
Bare laba krenn le, sharenn pen kokres, kolla lauter, kai krenn i wawarenge tchilatchepen.
Tire menshen, baro Dewel, rikrenn le tikno. Tire menshenge krenn le o djipen phares.
Kol djuwjen, kolengro rom meras, marenn le, ninna i wi-themarjen, un kol tchawen, kolen kek dad buder hi, denn le mulo.
“O baro Dewel”, penenn le, “dikell kowa gar, o Jakobeskro Dewel dell gar jak pre.”
Denn jak, tumer dinele mank i menshende, tumer narwele, kamenn gar gosewo te well?
Kowa, kai kras o kand, nai shunell kowa gar? Kowa, kai kras o jak, nai dikell kowa gar?
Kowa, kai i menshen an i wawar themma tchingrell, dell lo tumen kek phagi? Job hi o sikepaskro halauterendar – hi les kek goswepen?
O baro Dewel djinell, hoi an i menshengre sherja hi: lauter tchi-moldo koowa.
Bachtelo hi kowa, koneste tu, baro Dewel, leskri doosh sikreh, koleste tu sikreh, har te djiwell lo.
Jaake rikreh les pale te djal lo an peskri bibacht, bis te well o tchilatcheske i phub win hadedo, te perell lo dren.
O baro Dewel tchiwell peskre menshen gar pale, un mukell gar len kokres.
I tchatchepangre mursha djan pale pal o tchatchepen. Un lauter, kai o tchatcho drom djan, rikrenn pen ap kowa.
Koon well ap miri rig, te kuras men i tchilatchentsa? Koon well pash mande, te djas mer khetne ap kolende, kai krenn midjak koowa?
Wals o baro Dewel gar ap miri rig, woms me jaake mishto har mulo.
Har penom, te perom, rikral man tu, baro Dewel, an tiro latchepen.
Har his mange ropaske, rakral tu latches ap miro dji, un kral les pale soreles.
Tu tchiwal tut gar khetne kolentsa, kai tchatchepangre mursha hunte wans, un jon djan gar pal o tchatchepen, un penenn ap o chochepen: “Kowa hi o tchatchepen.”
Jon tchiwenn pen khetne, te anenn le doosh ap koleste pre, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi, un denn koles i phagi, koles kek doosh hi, te well lo maredo.
Miro baro Dewel was mange har i sorelo kheer. Pash leste, miro Debleste, nai wau un khatrau man.
Job mukell lengro midjak koowa ap lende pale te perell, un dran lengro tchilatchepen marell lo len. Awa, maro baro Dewel marell len!
Awenn, te giwenn gilja o baro Debleske! Denn gole i bachtjatar glan leste! Job hi maro rikepaskro, kai menge lauter mishto krella.
Awenn glan leste, te parkras men pash leste, te giwas leske gilja un sharas les!
O baro Dewel hi o pralstuno Dewel, o baro rai pral i tsele debla.
An leskro wast hi o telstunepen i phubjatar, un i bareder berge hi ninna leskre.
Leskro hi o baro pani. Job kras les. Ninna o them, job kras les leskre wastentsa.
Awenn, mangas les an! Te djas ap mare tchanga, un peras tele glan o baro Debleste! Job hi kowa, kai kras men.

Job hi maro Dewel, un mer ham leskre menshe. Job dell jak ap mende har i bakrengro dell jak ap peskre bakre, un anell len kote, kai hi len doha te chal. Kau diwes rakrell job ap tumende. Shunenn ap leskre laba:
Ma pandenn tumare djia, har tumare phure kran ap i platsa Meriba un Massa an o mulo tato them.
Fothe dikan le lauter, hoi lenge krom, patsan le gar, te hom me, o Dewel, mank lende, un nai dau len lauter, hoi len hunte well djipaske.
Star-deesh bersha was mange djungeles, te dikom ap kol menshende, un penom: “Kalla hi menshe, kai peran ap pengre sherja un djinenn gar, hoi tchatcho hi. Ap miro drom kamenn le gar te djal.”
Doleske dom man sowel an miri choli: “Jon te djan gar dren an miro them, kai nai wans le khere!”
Giwenn o baro Debleske i newi gili! Tumer menshe ap i tseli phub giwenn gilja o baro Debleske!
Giwenn leske, o baro Debleske! Sharenn les! Penenn i menshenge, te hi job kowa, kai lell win dran o tchilatchepen.
Penenn kolenge, kai les gar prindjrenna, hawo railepen les hi. Penenn i menshenge an hake themma hawo baro koowa job kras.
O baro Dewel hi o pralstuno, un hakeno hunte sharell les. Mank i tsele wawar debla hi job kowa, konestar daras mer.
I debla i wawar menshendar hi chochene debla. O baro Dewel hi kowa, kai o bolepen kras.
Job hi bareder har hako wawar. Shukapen hi trul leste, Leskri soor un leskro railepen wenn diklo an leskro kheer.
Tumer dran i wawar themma, sharenn o baro Debles! Sharenn leskro railepen un leskri soor!
Krenn leskro lab bares jaake har job moldo hi! Awenn glan leskro kheer, un anenn leske shukar koowa!
Mangenn o baro Debles an ap ko diwes, kai well lo an shukar un kutch ripja. I tseli phub hunte trissell glan leste.
Penenn i tsele menshenge: O baro Dewel hi o baro rai. Job kras i phub, te well li soreles tardo. Job hi o tchatchepaskro rai pral i tsele themma un djal pal o tchatchepen.
O bolepen well bachtelo, un i phub sala. O baro pani stell i bachtjatar un lauter, hoi an leste hi.
O them well bachtelo un lauter, hoi ap leste baro was. I tsele ruka an o weesh giwenna i bachtjatar

glan o baro Debleste. Job wella. Awa, job wella, un anell o tchatchepen ap i phub. Job rakrell o tchatchepen win pral i menshende an hake themma. Un hi lengro tchatchepaskro rai, kai djal pal o tchatchepen.
O baro Dewel hi o baro rai! Doleske te giwell i phub un sal! Ninna kol bud panjengre themma te wenn le bachtelo!
Kale wolke hi trul leste trujel. Job hi i baro rai, kai djal pal o tchatchepen, un rakrell o tchatchepen win pral i menshende.
Glan leste djal i jag, un chatchrell halauteren, kai ap leste djan.
I jag dran o bolepen, hoi tele ap kai phub karje dell, mukell i rat win dikell har o diwes. Un i phub dikell kowa un trissell.
Jaake har i momeli tele chatchrell, wenna bare berge tikno glan o baro Debleste. Job hi o baro rai pral i tseli phub.
O bolepen sikrell leskro tchatchepen, un leskro railepen dikenn i tsele menshe.
Ladj ap kolende, kai krenn penge wawar debla, un sharenn pen pengre mule deblentsa! Perenn tele ap i phub, tumer wawar debla, glan o baro Debleste!
Tu, baro Dewel, hal i rai, kai djal pal o tchatchepen. Kowa shunenn i menshe an o foro Zion un hi bachtelo. Un kolla an o them Juda sanenn un khelenn i bachtjatar.
Tu, baro Dewel, hal o pralstuno pral i tseli phub. Tu hal bareder har i tsele debla.
Tumer, kai o baro Debles kamenna, stakrenn o tchilatchepen khetne. O baro Dewel rikrell peskre wasta pral o djipen kolendar, kai leskre hi, un lell len win dran o wast i tchilatchendar.
I momeli djal pre koleske, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi. Un bachtelo well kowa, kai o tchatcho drom djal.
Awenn bachtelo pral o baro Debleste, tumer, kai an o tchatchepen tardo han! Un parkrenn tumen pash leste, kai kokres o tchatcho Dewel hi!
I gili Giwenn o baro Debleske i newi gili! Job kras baro koowa. Peskro wasteha un Debleskri sorjah was lo o sorleder pral o tchilatchepen.
Job mukell i menshenge an i tsele themma te penell, te lell lo len win dran o tchilatchepen. Glan lende mukell lo peskro tchatchepen te dikell.
Job bistras gar peskro latchepen o khereske Israel, un rikrell peskro lab, hoi das lo lende. I tseli phub dikas, har las lo len win dran o tchilatchepen.
Giwenn o baro Debleske, tumer lauter, kai ap kai phub han! Denn gole i bachtjatar, sharenn les i giljentsa!
Bashrenn leske ap i harfa! Sharenn les o bashepah ap i dorjengre bashepangre!
Bashrenn ap i phurdepangre un shinga! Denn gole i bachtjatar glan o baro Debleste! Job hi tumaro baro rai.
Mu well o baro pani diwjo i bachtjatar, un lauter, hoi an leste djiwell, ninna i tseli phub, un kolla, kai ap late djiwenn.
Tumer bare lengste panja, denn an i wasta! Tumer berge, giwenn i bachtjatar
glan o baro Debleste! Job wella un rakrell o tchatchepen win pral i tseli phub. Job hi o tchatchepaskro rai pral i tsele themma, un dell hakeneste pal kowa, hoi lo kras.
O baro Dewel hi o baro rai. Job hi beshdo pral i Cherubim. Lestar darella i phub, un hake themma trissenna.
Sorelo hi o baro Dewel an o foro Zion, o pralstuno hi lo pral i tsele themma.
Mu hadenn le lauter tiro baro un railo lab! Tu kokres hal o tchatcho Dewel.

Tuke hi bari soor. Tu hal o baro rai, kai kamell o tchatchepen o djijestar. Tu penal, hoi tchatcho hi, un tchiwal o tchatchepen pre an o them Israel, te djan i tchatchepangre mursha pal o tchatchepen.
Hadenn maro baro Debles! Un perenn ap i phub glan i beshepaskri, kai job peskre herja pre tchiwella. O baro Dewel kokres hi o tchatcho Dewel.
O Mose un o Aron his leskre rashaja, un o Samuel his mank kolende, kai les an-mangan. Jon dan ap o baro Debleste gole, un job shunas len.
Dran i wolka rakras lo lentsa, un jon rikran leskre laba, un kran, hoi job lendar kamas.
Baro Dewel, tu hal maro Dewel. Tu shunal len, un lal i doosh tire menshendar krik, ninna te dal len i phagi koleske, hoi jon kran.
Hadenn maro baro Debles! Mangenn les an ap leskri berga, kai job djiwella. Maro baro Dewel kokres hi o tchatcho Dewel.
I gili, te parkras men pash o Debleste. Giwenn o baro Debleske, tumer lauter, kai han ap kai phub!
Mangenn o baro Debles bachteles an! Awenn glan leste un denn gole i bachtjatar!

Ma bistrenn: O baro Dewel kokres hi o Dewel! Job kras men, un leskre ham mer. Leskre menshe ham, un job hi menge har i bakrengro, kai djal glan leskre bakre un anell len kote, kai len doha chapaske hi.
Awenn an i wudja glan leskro kheer un parkrenn tumen! Awenn ap i platsa glan leskro kheer un sharenn les i giljentsa! Parkrenn tumen pash leste un sharenn les.
Kamlo hi o baro Dewel. Leskro latchepen atchell hako tsireske. Un leskro tchatchepen herell gar pre.
I gili o Davidestar. Pral o latchepen un o tchatchepen kamau me te giwell. Tut, mo baro Debles, kamau me te sharell.
Me dau jak, te djap o tchatcho drom. Kamau te wess pash mande. I djudjo djijeha djiwau khetne lauterentsa an miro kheer.
Rikrau man pale te krap chocheno koowa, un kamau gar khetne te well kolentsa, kai bango koowa krenn. Sawo koowa kamau gar glan i jaka te dikell.
Kones i chocheno dji hi, kowa hunte djal peske mandar. I tchilatchen kamau me gar te prindjrell.
Koon rakrell tchorchanes djungelo koowa pal o dumo kolendar, kai trul leste hi, koles pandau leskro mui. Kamau koles gar, kai pre-phurdo hi, un ap wawar menshende tele dikell.
Mire jaka rodenn pal kolende an o them, kai rikrenn pen ap tire laba, te djiwenn jon pash mande. Kolen, kai o tchatcho drom djan, lau me pash mande, te budrenn le mange.
Kolla, kai rakrenn dui tchipjentsa, nai atchenna gar an miro kheer, un i chochene hunte djan mange dran i jaka.
Hako diwes tchiwau i tsele tchilatchen an o them pale. Kolen, kai i wawaren tchilatchepen kran, mukau buder gar an o baro Debleskro foro te djiwell.
I mangepen jekestar, koleske gar mishto djal, un koles buder kek soor hi, un kai glan o baro Debleste peskri dji win tchorella.
Baro Dewel, shun miro mangepen! Shun, har dau ap tute gole!
Ma dja krik mandar ap kau diwes, kai mange ropaske hi! Risse tut pash mande ap kau diwes, kai ap tute gole dau! Shun man sik!
Mire diwessa djan trujel har i tampa hoi djal dran i jag pre. Mange hi tato, har wals i jag an mande.
Miro dji hi phagedo, un les hi buder kek soor jaake har o khass, hoi tele dino was. Bistrau ninna miro maro te chal.
Me hom jaake sano, kai nai dikeh i kokale, jaake bud rowau un dau gole.
Me wom har i diwjo tchirklo an o mulo them, har i ratsjakro tchirklo, hoi djiwell mank i barra i paash-dino forestar.
Rati sowau gar, dau gole har i tchirklo, hoi kokres hi un pral ap o kheer beshdo hi.
Hako diwes sanenn kolla pral mande, kai kamenn mange tchilatchepen, un praassenn man.
An tiri choli dal tu man trad, hadal man pre un witsral man pale tele ap i phub. Doleske chau jagakri tchik har maro. Un mire swa perenn an miro pipen.
Miro djipen djal peske har o diwes, te well i rat, har o khass, hoi tele merell an o kham.
Tu, baro Dewel, atcheh hake tsirenge, tut denn le an-gole an ko tsiro, hoi wella.
Ste pre un ab pale kamles ap i menshende an o foro Zion. O tsiro was, te less lengri doosh lendar krik. Kanna hi o tchatcho tsiro kai.
Tire budepangre kamans, te well o foro newes kerdo. Lenge hi ropaske pral i barra ko tele-phagedo forestar.
I menshe an i tsele themma trashenn palle glan tute, o baro Debleste. Un i tsele bare raja ap kai phub witsrenn pen tele glan tiro railepen.
O baro Dewel tchiwell o foro Zion pale pre, un mukell pes te dikell an peskro railepen.
Job shunell o mangepen kolendar, hoi muklo wan. Ap lengro mangepen dikell job latches.
Tchinenn kal laba pre kolenge, kai pal mende wenna, jaake te sharenn ninna kolla menshe o baro Debles!
O baro Dewel dikas pral tele dran o pralstunepen, kai lo khere hi. Dran o bolepen dikas lo tele ap i phub,
te shunell lo o ropen kolendar, hoi stilde hi, te krell lo i shelle pre kol menshendar, kai an o merepen hi.
Jaake te sharenn le o baro Debles ap i berga Zion, an o tselo foro Jerusalem hadenn le leskro lab,
ap ko tsiro, kai wenn menshe dran i tsele rajengre themma kote khetne, te mangenn le o baro Debles an.
Har homs gar dureder har mashkral ap miro drom, phagas job miri soor, mukas man sikeder phuro te well.
Me penom: Mo Dewel, le man gar krik ap o paash drom miro djipastar! Tiro djipen herell gar pre, an kek tsiro.
Tu kral i phub glan rah tsirja, un tire wasta kran o bolepen.
Jon atchenna gar. Tu hal kowa, kai atchella. Jon wenn phuro un djan paash har i ripen. Tu tchiweh len ap i rig har phure ripja un leh tuke newe. I phure hunte djan penge.
Tu atcheh jaake har tu hal, un djiweh hako tsiro.
Mare tchawen mukeh tu an o them te djiwell, un ninna lengre tchawe wenn bares glan tute.
O Davidestar. Miro tselo djijestar sharau o baro Debles. Lauter, hoi an mande hi, sharell leskro Debleskro lab!
Miro tselo djijestar sharau o baro Debles, un bistrau gar o latchepen, hoi job mange kras.
Job hi kowa, kai miri tseli doosh mandar krik lella, kowa, kai miro tselo nasslepen krik lella un man sastes krella,
kowa, kai man dran o merepen win lella, kowa, kai peskro latchepen un kamlepen pral mande win tchorella,
kowa, kai man tchales krella peskro latchepah, un man pale terno krella, un sorelo har i adlari.
O baro Dewel tchiwell o tchatchepen pre, un dell kolende pengro tchatchepen, kai wenn tele rikedo.
Job mukas o Moses te djinell, hoi job krella, un kras glan i Israelende baro koowa, kai kek wawar nai krella.
O baro Dewel hi i latcho Dewel, kai krell peskro dji pre peskre menshenge. Job well gar sik chojedo. Un leskro latchepen herell gar pre.
Job tchingrell gar hako tsireske, un atchell gar hako tsireske chojedo.
Job dell men gar i phagi pal kowa, hoi kram, un dell men maro tchilatchepen gar pale.
Jaake dur har o bolepen pral i phub hi, jaake baro hi leskro latchepen kolenge, kai djiwenn leha.
Koi rig, kai o kham pre djal, hi dur krik kolatar, kai lo tele djal. Jaake dur har kai jek rig hi koi wawaratar, jaake dur tchiwas job mari doosh mendar krik.
Jaake har i dad peskro dji pre krell peskre tchawenge, jaake krell o baro Dewel peskro dji pre kolenge, kai djiwenn leha.
Job djinell, kai menshe ham; te ham dran tchik kerdo, bistrell lo gar.
I mensho hi har khass, har senlepen, hoi pre-djas.
Palle phurdell i ducho pral wergel, un krik hi lo, un koi platsa, kai lo his, prindjrell les buder gar.
O latchepen o baro Deblestar hi gar jaake. Kowa atchella hako tsireske. An kek tsiro lell lo les krik kolendar, kai djiwenn leha. Ninna lengre tchawenge un kolengre tchawenge rikrell job peskro lab,
kolenge, kai bistrenn gar, hoi job lengre phurentsa win kras, un rikrenn pen ap leskre laba.
O baro Dewel tchiwas peskri raili beshepaskri an o bolepen. Un job hi o rai pral halauter.
Sharenn o baro Debles, tumer bolepangre, kai han leskre sorele kurepangre, un krenn, hoi job penell, un shunenn ap leskre laba!
Sharenn o baro Debles, tumer leskre bolepangre lurde, kai budrenn leske un krenn, hoi job kamell!
Sharenn o baro Debles, tumer lauter, kai wan lestar kerdo! Sharenn les, kai tumer ninna djiwenna an leskro them! Ninna tu, miro dji, share o baro Debles!
Miro tselo djijestar sharau o baro Debles. Miro baro Dewel, har baro hal tu! An shukapen un railepen hal tu rido.
Har i baja tchiwal i bari momeli trul tute. Tu tserdal o bolepen buchlo har i bari plachta,
un kral tuke i kheer pral i panja. Tu ulereh ap i wolke har ap i wurdin, un i winta hidjreh tut.
O ducho, hoi phurdell tel o bolepen, hi tiro bitchepaskro. Un i jag hi tiro budepaskro.
Tu tchiwal i phub soreles tardo, te atchell li tardo hako tsireske.
I panja tchakran lat har i ripen, un o pani his pral haki berga tardo.
Har tchingral ap leste, djas o pani pale, glan tiri gole nashas lo peske,
un nashas i berge pral tele an i tala, jaake dur har tu penal.
Tu penal, har dur i panja nai djan, un dureder nai djan le gar. I duito kopo hunte djal o pani gar pral i tseli phub.
An o telstuno them mukeh tu tikne panja dran i phub te well, te nashenn le mank i berge.
Jaake well i wesheskre viechen te pijell, un i diwje burike nai pijenn, bis te hi len buder kek trush.
Pral lende an i ruka hi i tchirkle beshdo un giwenna.
Dran o bolepen deh tu brishin ap i berge, un kreh te well i phubjat doha pani.
Tu mukeh i viechenge o khass bares te well, un djob un senlepen i menshenge. Jaake anell lenge i phub lengro chapen win:
i mool, hoi o mensheskro dji bachteles krella, o djet, hoi leskro mui shukar krella, un o maro, hoi o menshes soreles krella.
Ninna i bare ruka lenn doha pani, kol zedertikre ruka ap i berga Libanon, hoi tu, baro Dewel, kote an i phub tchiwal.
An kol ruka krenn i tikne tchirkle pengre khera, un i storche beshenn pral ap i ruka.
An i bare berge djiwenn i diwje busja. Un mank i barra hi i bergetikre shoshoja khere.
Tu kral o moonto, te sikrell lo men i deesh-te-dui tchonna an o bersh. O kham djinell peskro tsiro, har lo tele djala.
Tu peneh, te well rati, un koi wenn i tsele weshengre vieche win.
Kol terne diwje margodje denn gole pal mass, un mangenn o Deblestar pengro chapen.
Te djal o kham pre, tserdenn le pen pale, un tchiwenn pen tele an pengro khatepen.
Palle djan i menshe win ap pengri budi un budrenna bis ap i rat.
Baro Dewel, har baro un bud hi kowa, hoi tu halauter kral! Har gosewes kral tu halauter! I phub hi pherdo o tselo koowa, hoi tu kral.
Kote hi o baro pani, baro un buchlo. Un vieche hi dren: bare un tikne, jaake bud, te nai djinell kek har bud.
I shiffe ulerenn pengro drom; un koi hi o baro panjeskro viecho, o Leviatan, hoi tuke kral, te kheless tu leha.
Kolla lauter denn jak, kaana tu weh, te dess len te chal ap o tchatcho tsiro.
Tu deh len, un jon lenn les. Tu kreh tiro wast pre, un jon lauter wenn tchalo.
Tu te djah lendar krik, taprell len i daar. Tu te leh lendar o ducho, merenn le, un wenn pale tchik.
Tu te bitchreh tiro djipaskro ducho, wenn le kerdo, un tu deh newo djipen ap i phub.
O Debleskro railepen mu atchella hako tsiro! Mu well lo bachtelo pral kowa, hoi job kras!
Job dikell i phub an, un joi trissella. Job taprell i berge an, un i jagakri tampa djal pre dran lende.
Kamau te giwell o baro Debleske, jaake rah har djiwau, kamau te bashrell miro Debleske, jaake rah me hom.
Mu well miri gili leske shukar! Me hom bachtelo pral miro baro Debleste.
Mu atchenn kolla gar djido ap i phub, kai o Debleskro drom mukan. Mu well ko tsiro, kai hi buder kek tchilatche koi! Miro tselo djijestar sharau o baro Debles. Sharedo well o baro Dewel!
Parkrenn tumen pash o baro Debleste, un hadenn leskro lab! Penenn i menshenge an i wawar themma kowa, hoi job kras!
Giwenn un bashrenn leske! Rakrenn pral ko tselo baro koowa, hoi job lauter kras!
Sharenn koles, koon kokres o tchatcho Dewel hi! Awenn bachteles pral leste, tumer, kai rodenn o baro Debles!
Putchenn pal o baro Debleste, un pal leskri soor! Awenn glan leste hako tsiro!

Tumer, kai wenn pal o Abraham, o Debleskro budepaskro, tumer tchawe o Jakobestar, koles job win rodas, ma bistrenn, hoi job lauter kras an peskri bari soor, kowa, hoi kek wawar nai kras! Ma bistrenn, har job o tchatchepen pral i menshende win rakras!
O baro Dewel hi maro Dewel, un o tchatchepaskro rai pral i tseli phub.
An kek tsiro bistrell lo peskri sowel, hoi lo mentsa dren djas. Peskro lab, hoi das lo, atchella jaake rah har menshe ap i phub djiwenna.
Kowa hi ko lab, hoi das lo o Abrahameste, koi sowel, hoi das lo o Isaakeste,
un pal leste o Jakobeste, un das peskro wast pre, te atchell kau lab i Israelenge hako tsireske.
Job penas: “Tuke dau kau them Kanaan, kowa hi ko them, hoi tumenge well.”
An ko tsiro his le gar bud, gar budeder har i wast pherdo, un his wi-themarja an o them.
Un jon djan jek themestar an o wawar, djan trujel an bud rajengre themma.
Un o Dewel das jak, te taprell len kek an. Un i bare rajen pral kol themma das lo trad un penas lenge:
“Lenn i wasta krik mire menshenge, kolen mange win rodom! Ma krenn tchilatchepen kolenge, kai mire rakepangre hi!”
Un job mukas i bari bok an o them te well, te das buder kek maro.
[Un jon djan an o them Egiptia.] Glan lende bitchras lo i murshes. Kowa his o Josef. Job was i ginlo budepaskro.
Leskre herja pandan le an sasterne shelle, un trul leskri meen tchiwan le saster,
bis te was ko tsiro, kai ko lab tchatcho was, hoi o Josef o baro Deblestar las un glan-wi penas.
Un o baro rai bitchras jekes koi, te mukell lo les win dran o stilepen. Un o baro rai pral menshende an bud themma mukas les win.
Un kras, te was o Josef o pralstuno pral leskro kheer, un tchiwas lauter, hoi les his, an leskre wasta.
Job te sikrell o baro rajeskre budepangre, hoi te krenn le. Kol pralstunende pral o them sikras lo, har te krenn le o feteder o themeske.
Palle was o Jakob an o them Egiptia, un o Israel his i wi-themari an o them o Hameskre tchawendar.
O baro Dewel mukas peskre menshen bud un budeder te well. Jaake wan le bareder un sorleder har kolla, kai len tikno rikrenn.
Kolenge das lo an o dji, te dikenn le tchilatche jakentsa ap o Debleskre menshende, un kran lenge midjak koowa.
Job bitchras peskro budepaskres, o Moses, un o Arones, koles job peske wi-rodas.
Un jon kran baro koowa an o Debleskri soor mank i Egiptarja, sawo koowa, hoi kek wawar nai kras an o them o Hameskre tchawendar.
O baro Dewel bitchras i tamlepen, te was kales, har rati. I Egiptarja shunan gar ap leskre laba.
Job kras rat dran i tsele panja i Egiptarendar, un mukas i matche kote dren te merell.
Job kras o tselo them pherde djambe, ninna kote, kai i bare raja sowenna, his le.
Job penas, te wenn matsille, hoi tchurje denn, un bud matsille wan an o tselo them.
Har dikan i Egiptarja ap brishin, bitchras lo lenge barrengro brishin an lengro them, ninna jag, hoi pral un tele djas ap o bolepen.
Lengre drakengre ruka un faigetikre ruka das lo tele, un phagas i tsele ruka an lengro them.
Job penas, te wenn stepangre, un stepangre wan, jaake bud, te nai penas kek, kitse jon hi.
Un kolla chan lauter pre, hoi baro was an lengro them, ninna o djob ap i hachetikri phub.
Job das o phureder mursh tchawes mulo haki datar an o them Egiptia. Kolla his lengre dadengri feteder soor.
Har anas o baro Dewel i Israelitarjen win, lan le rup un sonakai pentsa. Un kek lendar his nasselo un hunte atchas pale.
I Egiptarja daran lendar, un his bachtele, har djan jon penge.
O baro Dewel khatras peskre menshen tel i wolka, un rati sikras len i jag o drom.
Jon mangan lestar mass, un job mukas pesse tchirkle te well. O mareha dran o bolepen kras lo len tchalo.
Job phagas i baro bar, un pani nashas win, un nashas an o mulo them har i lengsto baro pani.
Job bistras gar peskro Debleskro lab, hoi das lo peskro budepaskres, o Abraham.
Har anas lo peskre wi-rodede menshen win, sanas lengro dji. Un jon giwan i bachtjatar.
Job das len o them wawar menshendar, un halauter, hoi kolen his, das lo lende, te well kowa lengro.
Kawa kras lo, te rikrenn le leskre laba, un shunenn ap kowa, hoi job lenge penas. Sharedo well o baro Dewel!
Sharedo well o baro Dewel! Parkrenn tumen pash o baro Debleste! Job hi i latcho Dewel. Leskro latchepen atchella hako tsireske.
Koon nai penella ko tselo baro koowa, hoi o baro Dewel lauter kras? Koon nai sharell les doha?
Bachteles hi kolla, kai leskre laba rikrenna, un hako tsiro o tchatchepen krenna.
Baro Dewel, tu dal tire menshende tiro lab, te wess ap lengri rig. Biste man gar un ab mange latcho!
Te nai dikap i bacht, hoi tu kolen dal, hoi tuke wi-rodal, te nai wap bachteles khetne tire menshentsa, te nai sharas men, te ham tire.
Mer anam doosh ap mende jaake har mare phure, un kram gar, hoi tchatcho hi. Na-a, mer kram tchilatcho koowa.
Mare phure haiwan gar ko baro sorelo koowa, hoi tu an o them Egiptia kral, un bistran har bud lenge latches hals, un hadan pen pral tute pash o Baro Lolo Pani.
O baro Dewel sikras, te hi lo lengro Dewel, un was ap lengri rig, te sikrell lo peskri soor.
Job tchingras ap o Baro Lolo Pani. Koi djas o pani pale, un i phub his buder gar sapeno. Un job mukas len mank o pani te djal har te wals truk them.
Jaake las lo len win dran i wasta kolendar, kai kaman len te marell.
Un o pani tassas lauteren, kai len palla lan. Kek atchas djido.
Palle patsan le leskre laba, un giwan leske gilja.
Sik bistran le lauter, hoi job kras, un putchan gar, hoi job lendar kamell.
An o mulo them lan le bok pal o mass, un patsan gar, te nai dell o baro Dewel len lauter, hoi len hunte well djipaske.
Kote das lo len, hoi jon mangan, un das len jaake bud, te was lenge kowa dran o nak win.
Ap lengri platsa hadan le pen pral o Moseste, un pral o Aroneste, koles o baro Dewel peske win rodas.
Koi djas i phub pre, un chas o Datan, un tchakras tel peste o Abiram peskre menshentsa.
Un i jag chatchras mank lende un chatchras kolen, kai kau tchilatcho koowa kran.
Pash i berga Horeb kran le penge i sonakaskri terni grumni, witsran pen glan late tele un mangan lat an.
Jon mukan o railo baro Debles, un mangan i figura i grumjatar an, hoi khass chal.
Jon bistran ko Debles, kai lengro djipen dran o merepen win las, un baro koowa an o them Egiptia kras,
sawo koowa, hoi kek wawar nai kras, ninna sawo sorelo koowa pash o Baro Lolo Pani, kai lenge o rakepen krik atchas.
Doleske kamas lo len mulo te dell, te wals kote gar o Mose, koles job peske wi-rodas. Kowa stas pre, te rikrell lo o Debles leskri choljatar tele, jaake te dell lo len gar mulo.
Un lenge his ko shukar them tchi moldo, un patsan gar ap ko lab, hoi o Dewel len das.
An pengre plachtene khera rakran le djungeles pral leste, un shunan gar ap o baro Debleste.
Kote hadas lo peskro wast un das pes sowel, te marell lo len an o mulo tato them,
un tradell lengre tchawen an wawar themma, te djiwenn jon mank wawar menshende.
Pal i tsiro witsran pen i Israelitarja glan kol wawarengro debleste Baal tele ap i berga Peor, un chan ko mass kol viechendar, hoi wan maredo i mulenge.
O baro Debles tapras i bari choli pral kowa, hoi peskre menshe kran. Un job mukas i pharo nasslepen pral lende te well.
Kote stas o Pinhas pre, un das len i phagi, un ko nasslepen djas krik.
Kowa, hoi o Pinhas kras, his shukar glan o Debleskre jaka. Doleske kras o Dewel les tchatcho glan peskre jaka hako tsireske.
Pash o pani Meriba choiran le pale o Debles, un anan o Moses an i bibacht:
Jon kran les jaake chojedo, te rakras job sik, un leskre laba his gar gosewo.
Mare phure maran gar kol wawar menshen an o them, har o baro Dewel lenge penas.
Na-a, jon romedineran pen kolentsa, kai o Debles gar prindjrenn, un kran sau koowa har jon kran,
un mangan lengre deblen an. Jaake peran le o baro Debleskro dromestar tele.
Jon maran pengre tchawen un tchen i bengenge.
Awa, jon dan pengre tchawen un tchen mulo, kai kek doosh ap pende anan, un dan len kol mule deblen, kolen i Kanaanitarja an-mangan. Jaake anan le rateskri doosh ap o them Kanaan,
un kran pen pale-tchiddo koleha, hoi jon kran, un peran o baro Debleskro dromestar tele.
Kote choiras pes o baro Dewel ap peskre menshende, un nai dikas len buder gar glan peskre jaka.
Job das len an o wast i menshendar an wawar themma, te wenn kolla rai pral lende, kai dikan tchilatche jakentsa ap lende.
Un kolla, kai lenge tchilatchepen kaman, rikran len tikno, un soreles his lengro wast ap lende tchiddo.
Bud kope las lo len dran lengre wasta win. Un pale te pale kran le kowa, hoi choiras les, un mukan gar tele pengro tchilatcho koowa, un wan bud un budeder koi dren.
Un te dan le gole ap leste an pengre duka, un job dikas, har djungeles lenge djal,
palle was an leskro shero, hoi kras lo lentsa win, te hi lo lengro Dewel. Un an peskro baro latchepen khaitan le les.
Un job kras, te dikan lauter kolla latches ap lende, kai len pandan.

Baro Dewel, le men win dran i wasta kol wawar menshendar, maro Dewel! An men pale lauter khetne an o them Israel, te parkras men pash tute, kai kokres o tchatcho Dewel hal. Mari bacht hi, te nai sharah tut.
Sharedo well o baro Dewel, kai o Israeleskro Dewel hi, kanna un hako tsireske! Mu penenn i tsele menshen: “Amen! Sharedo well o baro Dewel!”
Sharenn o baro Debles. Job hi latcho. Leskro latchepen atchell hako tsireske.
Kowa te penenn i wi-line menshe, kolen o baro Dewel win las dran i wasta kolendar, kai len pandan.
Job anas len khetne dran bud themma, kotar, kai o kham pre-djala, kotar, kai o kham tele djal, kotar, kai o kham gar well, un kotar, kai o kham pralstunes tardo hi.
Mank lende his sawe menshe, kai his nashedo an o mulo tato them. Kek drom hatsan le, witar kek foro, kai menshe djiwenna.
Jon bokan un trushan, un patsan buder gar, te wenn le win.
Har lenge jaake djungeles djas, dan le gole ap o baro Debleste. Un job las len win dran lengri daar.
Un job sikras len o tchatcho drom, jaake te wan le an i foro, kai menshe djiwenna.
Jon hunte parkrenn pen pash o baro Debleste, te was lo jaake latches ap lende, un kras baro shukar koowa ap i menshende.
Kolen, kai his len trush, das lo doha te pijell, un kolen, kai his len bok, das lo bud latcho chapen.
Wawar his beshdo an o stilepen, kai his kek momeli, kokres kali rat. Lengre wasta un herja his pandle an saster un dukran len.
Jon shunan gar ap o Debleste, kai hi o Dewel pral halauter, un tchiwan leskre laba ap i rig.
Doleske mukas lo len khetne te phagell. Jon his koi tchiddo, un kek his koi, kai hidjrals len pre.
Har lenge jaake djungeles djas, dan le gole ap o baro Debleste. Un job las len win dran lengri daar,
un anas len win dran i kali rat, kai kek momeli his, un kras lengre sasterne shelle pre.
Jon hunte parkrenn pen pash o baro Debleste, te was lo jaake latches ap lende, un kras baro shukar koowa ap i menshende,
te das lo sasterne wudja dren, un phagas sasterne pandepangre.
Wawar kran dinelo koowa, peran o Debleskro drom tele, un anan doosh ap pende. Doleske djas lenge jaake djungeles,
te nai chan le buder tchi, un his budeder mulo har djido.
Har lenge jaake djungeles djas, dan le gole ap o baro Debleste. Un job las len win dran lengri daar,
un rakras i lab, un jon was sasto. Un job las len win dran o merepen.
Jon hunte parkrenn pen pash o baro Debleste, te was lo jaake latches ap lende, un kras baro shukar koowa ap i menshende.
Ninna hunte anenn le leske shukar koowa, te parkrenn le pen pash leste. Un i bachtelo djijeha hunte rakrenn le kolestar, hoi job lenge kras.
Wawar uleran ap i shiffe win ap o baro pani, te bikrenn un parenn le.
Kolla dikan, hoi o baro Dewel nai krell, un hawi soor les pral o baro pani hi.
Job rakras, un i sorelo ducho phurdas, hoi o pani pral un tele das.
Un o shiffo was pre hidjedo an o bolepen, un peras pale tele an o telstunepen. Un i mursha an o shiffo dan gole i darjatar,
un nai rikran pen gar ap i herja, har te wans le mate, un djinan buder gar, hoi te krenn le.
Har lenge jaake phares his, dan le gole ap o baro Debleste, un job las len win dran pengri daar,
un kras, te phurdas o sorelo ducho buder gar. Un o pani tchiwas pes pale.
Un jon wan bachtelo, te tchiwas pes lauter. Un job anas len pash o them, kai jon nai atchan.
Jon hunte parkrenn pen pash o baro Debleste, te was lo jaake latches ap lende, un kras baro shukar koowa ap i menshende.
Jon hunte sharenn les kote, kai jon khetne wenna, un hadenn les kote, kai i phureder khetne wenna.
Dran o them, kai pani nashell, kras lo i mulo them, un mukas kol lengste panja buder gar te nashell.
Jaake was i phub, kai bud djob un senlepen baro was, i mulo londo them. Kowa kras lo dran o tchilatchepen kol menshendar, kai kote djiwenn.
Un pale mukas lo an o mulo them bud pani te nashell, un dran i truk phub pani te well.
Un mukas kolen, kai bokenn, kote te djiwell, un kolla kran penge kote i foro,
un tchiwan djob an i phub, ninna drakengre ruka, un anan bud chapen dren.
Un job das len bacht, un jon wan bud un budeder. Un job das len ninna bud viechen.
Pale wan le tikno rikedo, un i bibacht his soreles ap lende. Un jon wan tikno un tikneder.
Koi mukas lo ladj ap lengre raja te perell, un jon hunte nashan an o mulo them trujel, kote kai kek drom hi.
I tchorwelen las lo win dran lengri bibacht, un kras, te wan jon pale bud, jaake har bakre, hoi wenn bud un budeder.
Kowa dikenn kolla, kai o tchatcho drom djan, un hi bachteles, un i tchilatchenge well o mui pandlo.
Koon gosewo hi, bistrell kowa gar, un haiwell, har latcho o baro Dewel hi.
I gili o Davidestar.
Miro Dewel, miro dji hi pale sorelo. Me kamau tuke te giwell un te bashrell, awa, kowa kamau me.
Bashrenn, tumer miri harfa un miri gitarra! Kau diwes kamau me o kham pre te djangrell.
Baro Dewel, me kamau tut te sharell, mank i menshende dran bud themma tuke gilja te giwell.
Tiro latchepen hi jaake baro, te djal lo pral o bolepen, un tiro tchatchepen jaake dur har i wolke nashenn.
Sike tiro barepen ap o bolepen, miro Dewel, un tiro railepen ap i tseli phub!
Ab ap mari rig tiro sorelo wasteha un le men, kolen tu kameh, win dran i tchilatche wasta! Shun, har dau ap tute gole!
O Dewel rakras an peskro kheer, kai job djiwell: “Me wom o sorleder”, dell lo gole i bachtjatar. “Me dau o foro Sichem mire menshende, un ninna i tala Sukkot.
O them Gilead hi miro, un o them Manasse hi miro. O them Efrajim hi miri sasterni stadi, un o them Juda hi kowa, koles penepaske hi.
O them Moab hi miro thopaskro tcharo. Ap o them Edom witsrau miro kirach. Pral i Filistarja dau wi-gole, te wom lengro rai.”
Koon anell man an ko sorelo foro? Koon sikrell man o drom an o them Edom?
Koon nai krell kowa, har tu kokres, mo Dewel, kai mukal men? Djah tu gar win mare lurdentsa an o kurepen?
Ab tu ap mari rig un le men win dran i tchilatche wasta! Te hi menshe ap mari rig, hi kowa tchitcheske un tchi moldo.
Maro Debleha krah mer baro koowa. Un job stakrell kolen khetne, kai jaake soreles ap mende djan.
I gili o rajeske pral i gipangre. Kai gili kras o David. Tu, miro Dewel, tut sharau un giwau gilja tuke, ma rike tut pale! Kre tchomone!
Tchilatche menshe rakrenn djungeles pal mande, un anenn chocheno koowa ap mande pre.
Pengre tchilatche tchipjentsa dukrenn le man, un tchingrenn ap mande, ninna te krom me lenge tchi.
Jon kamenn mange tchilatchepen, ninna te hom kamlo ap lende. Me mangau tutar latchepen lenge.
Har homs lenge latcho, dan le man tchilatchepen pale. Har sikrom len miro kamlepen, dikan le tchilatche jakentsa ap mande.
Tchip i tchilatches pral leste, kai dell les gar o tchatchepen. Tchip jekes ap leskri tchatchi rig, kai anell doosh ap leste pre!
Te well lo glan i tchatchepangre raja anlo, muk kolen i phagi pral leste win rakrell. Te mangell lo tut, dik ap leskro mangepen, har te wals kowa i doosh.
Muk les sik te merell, un leskri budi te lell i wawar dren.
Leskre tchawen well kek dad, un leskri romjat well buder kek romes.
Kre, te wenn leskre tchawe win tradedo dran pengro kheer, hoi paash dino was, un hunte nashenn trujel, un mangenn penge maro.
Kowa, kai leske lowe patsas, kowa lell lestar lauter, hoi les hi. Menshe, kai gar lestar hi, lenn lauter, koleske job budras.
Kek te krell leske latchepen, un kek krell peskro dji pre leskre tchawenge.
Kre, te merenn kolla win, kai pal leste wenna. Leskre tchawengre tchawen wenn kek tchawe buder, jaake te well lengro lab bistedo.
Baro Dewel, ma biste i doosh leskre phurendar! Ma biste o tchilatcho koowa, hoi leskri dai kras!
Muk kowa, hoi le kran, hako tsiro glan tire jaka te well! Kre, te well leskro lab bistedo an o tselo them!
Job kras kek latchepen i wawarenge. I tchorwelen un bibachtelen las job palla, ninna koles, kai les kek soor buder his, te dell lo les mulo.
Job kamas o praassepen. Jaake mu well kowa ninna ap leste! Job kamas gar te rakrell i bacht pral jekeste win. Kanna, mu atchell i bacht dur lestar!
Job riwas o praassepen an har i gad. Doleske mu djal o praassepen an leste dren har pani, hoi pijell lo, un har djet, koleha makell lo pes dren.
Mu atchell o praassepen ap leste tchiddo har i ripen, un har i pereskri dori, hoi job hako diwes trul peste tchiwella.
Kowa well i phagi o baro Deblestar kolenge, kai doosh ap mande pre anenn un tchilatcho koowa pral mande rakrenn.
Tu, miro baro Dewel, ab mantsa, te hadap tiro lab. Me rikrau ap tiro latchepen. Ab ap miri rig un le man win dran i tchilatche wasta!
Me hom tchorwelo un kek hi ap miri rig. Miro dji hi phagedo.
Miro djipen nashella mandar jaake har o diwes, te well i rat. Un me wau krik phurdedo har i stepaskro.
Chom tchi jaake bud diwessa, te hi mire herjen buder kek soor, un man hi kek thulepen ap i kokale.
Kolla, kai anan doosh ap mande pre, san pral mande. Te dikenn le man, rissrenn le pengre jaka.
Miro baro Dewel, ab ap miri rig! Tu hal jaake latcho. Sike tiro latchepen ap mande!
Muk len te dikell, te kreh tu kowa, te well kowa lauter tutar.
Jon te praassenn man, palle de tu man bacht! Jon te hadenn pen ap mande pre, palle kre, te hunte ladjenn le pen! Jaake te nai sau me pale!
An i ladj ap kolende lauterende, kai anan doosh ap mande pre. Lengri ladj mu well jaake baro, te wenn le latar tchakedo har i bajah.
Me kamau man te parkrap pash o baro Debleste o tselo djijestar, un les sharell glan bud menshende.
Job well o tchorweleske ap i rig, un lell les win dran i wasta kolendar, kai penenn: “Job hunte well maredo.”
I gili o Davidestar. O baro Dewel penas ap miro baro rajeste: “Besh tut ap miri tchatchi rig! Kamau te tchiwap kolen tel tire herja, kai tuke tchilatchepen kamenn.”
O baro Dewel kras, te wal tu baro rai ap i berga Zion, un job krell tiro them baro un bareder. “Ab rai”, penell lo, “pral lauterende, kai hadan pen ap tute.”
Tu te deh tire lurden gole, wenn le lauter o djijestar tuha. Shukar an-rido hi kol terne mursha, kai wenn pash tute ap o Debleskri berga, railo har o diwes, te djal o kham pre.
O baro Dewel das pes sowel, un job las lat gar pale. Job penas: “Tu hal rashai hako tsireske, sawo har o Melchisedek his.”
O baro Dewel hi ap tiri tchatchi rig tardo, un dell bare rajen khetne ap ko diwes, kai leskri choli wella,
un job o tchatchepen win rakrella, un an hake themma bud menshen i phagi della. Palle hi bud menshe mulo tchiddo ap o buchlo them. Bud pralstune wenn khetne dino.
O baro rai pijell dran o pani, hoi pash leskro drom nashell, un lell newi soor un well o sorleder.
Sharedo well o baro Dewel! Miro tselo djijestar sharau o baro Debles kote, kai kolla khetne wenna, kai o tchatcho drom djan.
Baro hi kowa, hoi o baro Dewel lauter kras. Koneske kowa an o shero trujel djal, kowa well bachtelo.
Kowa, hoi o baro Dewel krella, hi railo un shukar. Un leskro tchatchepen atchella hako tsireske.
Job mukell men gar te bistrell, hoi lo an peskri bari soor kras. Latcho un kamlo hi lo.
Chapen dell lo kolen, kai djiwenn leha. An kek tsiro bistrell lo ko lab, hoi das lo lengre phurende.
Job sikras peskre menshende, har sorelo job hi, un das len i themma wawar menshendar, te wenn le lengre.
Job rikrell peskro lab, un lauter, hoi krell lo, hi tchatcho. Un mer nai rikrah men ap leskre laba.
Kal laba atchenna hako tsireske. Tchatcho hi le, un mer te rikras men ap lende.
O baro Dewel las peskre menshen win dran i tchilatche wasta, un kras lentsa win, te wenn le leskre menshe hako tsiro. Job kokres hi lengro Dewel. Baro hi lo!
Koon djiwell o baro Debleha, kowa lell goswepen. Gosewo hi hakeno, kai ap o baro Debleskre laba shunella. Te sharas les hako tsiro!
Sharedo well o baro Dewel! Bachtelo hi kowa, kai djiwell o baro Debleha, un rikrell pes o tselo djijestar ap leskre laba.
Koleskre tchawe wenn soreles an o tselo them. O baro Dewel tchiwell peskri bacht ap kolengre tchawende, kai o tchatcho drom djan.
Lengre familje wenn brawelo. Len hi lauter, hoi len hunte well djipaske. Un lengro tchatchepen atchell hako tsireske.
Ninna an i kali rat well i momeli kolenge, kai o tchatcho drom djan, kolenge, kai hi latcho un kamlo un djan pal o tchatchepen.
Mishto djal koleske, kai krell peskro dji pre, un patsell i wawaren win, un krell peskro koowa jaake har tchatcho hi.
Job atchell soreles tardo hako tsireske. Kowa, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi, well an kek tsiro bistedo.
Les well kek daar, te shunell lo, kai tchilatcho koowa wella. Job dikell peskro tselo djijeha ap o baro Debleste.
Soreles atchell leskro dji, un darell gar, bis te job tele dikell ap kolende, kai leske tchilatchepen kaman.
Job dell bud i tchorwelen. Leskro tchatchepen atchell hako tsireske. Leskri soor un leskro railepen well baro.
O tchilatcho dikell kowa un choirell pes. I choljatar dandrell lo i danda khetne. Job merell, un kowa, hoi kamas lo te krell, hi tchitcheske.
Sharedo well o baro Dewel! Sharenn o baro Debles, tumer, kai han leskre budepangre! Sharenn leskro lab!
Mu well o baro Debles sharedo kanna un hako tsireske!
Mu well lo sharedo kotar, kai o kham pre djala bis kote, kai o kham tele djala!
O baro Dewel hi o rai pral i menshende an hake themma. Leskro railepen djal dur pral o bolepen.
Koon an o bolepen un ap i phub hi jaake har maro baro Dewel?
Job hi beshdo an o pralstunepen, un dikell tele ap o bolepen un i phub.
Koles, kai tchi hi, hadell lo dran i tchik win, un o tchorweles hadell lo pre dran i jagakri tchik,
un dell les i beshepaskri pash i pralstunende leskre menshendar.
Kolat, kai kek tchawe nai las, hadell lo, te well li i bachteli dai. Sharedo well o baro Dewel!
Har o Israel dran o them Egiptia win djas, har o Jakobeskre menshe kol menshen mukan, kolengro rakepen jon gar haiwan,
koi was o them Juda kowa them, kai le o baro Debles an-mangan. Un o Israel was kowa them, pral koleste job o baro rai hi.
Har wan le pash o baro pani, nashas o pani peske. Har wan le pash o pani Jordan, djas o pani pale.
I berge stan har bakre, un i tikne berge har terne bakre.
“Tu baro pani, hoi his tuha, te nashal tuke, un tuha, tu pani Jordan, te djal pale?
Un tumer berge, hoi his tumentsa, te stan har i bakre? Hoi his tumentsa, tumer tikne berge, te stan har terne bakre?”
O baro Dewel his koi. Doleske was kowa jaake. Hakeno ap i phub hunte trissell glan o baro Debleste, ko Debleste o Jakobestar.
Job hi kowa, kai kras pani dran i baro bar, un mukas dran barra tikne panja te nashell.
Tu kokres, baro Dewel, wess sharedo! Tu hunte wess sharedo, gar mer! Tu hal kowa, kai latcho hi un hako tsiro peskro lab rikrell.
Hoske penenn i wawar menshe: “Kai hi lengro Dewel?”
Maro Dewel hi an o bolepen, un job nai krell lauter, hoi lo kamella.
Lengre debla hi dran rup un sonakai. Menshengre wasta kran len.
I mui hi len, un jon nai rakrenn gar. Jaka hi len un jon nai dikenn gar.
Kanda hi len, un jon nai shunenn gar. I nak hi len, un jon nai sungenn gar.
Len hi wasta, un jon nai taprenn tchi an. Herja hi len, un jon nai djan gar. Kek gole well dran lengri meen.
Kol menshe, kai sawe deblen kran, un ap lende patsenn, mu wenn le jaake har jon!
Tumer Israelitarja, rikrenn tumen ap o baro Debleste! Job well ap tumari rig, un rikrell peskre wasta pral tumende.
