Tumer rashaja dran o kheer Aron, rikrenn tumen ap o baro Debleste! Job well ap tumari rig, un rikrell peskre wasta pral tumende.
Tumer, kai djiwenn o baro Debleha, rikrenn tumen ap leste! Job well ap tumari rig, un rikrell peskre wasta pral tumende.
O baro Dewel bistras men gar, un tchiwell peskri bacht ap mende. Job tchiwell peskri bacht ap o kheer Israel. Job tchiwell peskri bacht ap i rashajende dran o kheer Aron.
Job tchiwell peskri bacht ap hakeneste, kai djiwell leha, awa, ap i tiknen un ap i baren.
Mu dell tumen o baro Dewel bud tchawe, tumenge un tumare tchawenge!
Mu well ap tumende i bacht kolestar, kai o bolepen un i phub kras.
O bolepen hi o baro Debleske kokres. I phub das job i menshende.
Baro Dewel, i mule sharenn tut gar, kek, kai an o mulengro them djal, kote, kai tchi buder rakedo wella.
Mer, i djide, sharah tut kanna un hako tsireske. Sharedo well o baro Dewel!
Me kamau o baro Debles o djijestar, job shunas man, har rowom me ap leste.
Leskro kand hi mange pre. Doleske rakrau leha jaake rah har djiwau.
O merepen pandas man an peskre shelle. Djinom buder gar dren un win, jaake baro his miri daar te hunte meroms un djoms pash i mulende.
Kote dom gole ap o baro Debleste: “Me mangau tut, baro Dewel, le miro djipen win dran o merepen!”
O baro Dewel hi latcho un tchatcho, un o djijestar kamlo hi maro Dewel.
O baro Dewel dell jak ap kolende, kai nai denn gar kokres ap pende jak. Har his man kek soor, was lo mange ap i rig.
Me penau ap miro dji: “Ma dare buder! O baro Dewel his latcho ap tute.”
Tu lal man win dran o merepen. Mire swa khossal tu, un ap mire herja dal jak, te perap gar.
Jaake djiwau glan tute kate ap kai phub, kai i menshe djide hi.
Me patsom o Debles, ninna te penom: “Man hi kek soor buder.”
Homs jaake phagedo, te penom: “I tsele menshe hi chochene.”
Har nai krau me kowa pale mishto miro baro Debleske, hoi job lauter mange kras?
Me anau les i khoro mool, te parkrap man pash leste, kai las lo man win dran o merepen.
Glan peskre tsele menshende anau o baro Debleske kowa, hoi dom man sowel glan leste.
O baro Dewel dikell i dukentsa ap o merepen peskre menshendar.
Ach, baro Dewel, me hom jek kolendar, kai tuke budrenn. Awa, tiro budepaskro hom un budrau tuke har miri dai kras. Tu kral i shelle pre, hoi pandan man.
Pash tute kamau me man te parkrell, un tut an-mangell.
Glan tire tsele menshende anau tuke, hoi dom man sowel glan tute,
un dau les tute kote ap i platsa glan tiro kheer an o foro Jerusalem. Sharedo well o baro Dewel!
Sharenn o baro Debles, tumer menshe ap i tseli phub! Sharenn les, tumer menshe an i tsele themma!
Leskro latchepen un tchatchepen hi ap mende tchiddo jaake rah har i phub koi hi. Sharedo well o baro Dewel!
Parkrenn tumen pash o baro Debleste! Job hi kamlo, un leskro latchepen atchella hako tsireske.
Jaake hunte penenn i Israelitarja: Leskro latchepen atchella hako tsireske.
Jaake hunte penell o Aroneskro kheer: Leskro latchepen atchella hako tsireske.
Jaake hunte penenn kolla, kai djiwenn o baro Debleha: Leskro latchepen atchella hako tsireske.
Har tapras man i daar, dom me gole ap o baro Debleste, un job shunas man, un kras miro dji soreles.
O baro Dewel hi pash mande. Me darau gar. Hoi nai krell man i mensho?
O baro Dewel hi pash mande, te well lo ap miri rig tardo. Jaake dikau mire jakentsa, har tchiwell lo kolen tel mande, kai kamenn mange tchilatchepen.
Hi feteder te rikras men ap o baro Debleste, har te rikras men ap i menshende.
Hi feteder te rikras men ap o baro Debleste, har te rikras men ap i rajende.
Bud menshe his trul mande, kai kaman mange tchilatchepen. An i soor o baro Deblestar nai tradom len pale.
Haki rigjatar wan le ap mande pre. An i soor o baro Deblestar nai tradom len pale.
Jon peran ap mande pre har i biene. An i soor o baro Deblestar nai tradom len pale. Har i jag sik win djal, hoi an i subjengre burra chatchell, jaake sik his le krik.
Har dan le man i soreli dap, te perap, was o baro Dewel ap miri rig.
Lestar well miri soor. Leske giwau miri gili. Job was un las man win dran i tchilatche wasta.
Shun koi gili, hoi giwenn o Debleskre menshe bachteles an pengre khera: “O baro Dewel hi o sorleder. Job hi o sorleder an o kurepen.
Leskro tchatcho wast hi hadedo: Job hi o sorleder an o kurepen.”
Me merau gar. Na-a, atchau djido, un penau i menshenge, hoi o baro Dewel lauter kras.
Ninna te das lo man soreles, mukas lo man gar te merell.
Krenn mange i bare wudja pre an o Debleskro kheer, te djap dren, te parkrap man pash miro baro Debleste.
Kate hi o baro Debleskro wudar: i Debleskre menshe djana kote dren.
Me parkrau man pash tute, te shunal tu man, un wal ap miri rig.
Ko bar, hoi i budepangre ap i rig witsran, kowa was ko sorelo bar, ap koleste o kheer tardo hi.
O baro Dewel kras kowa. Un kowa hi menge i baro koowa, hoi haiwah gar.
Kawa hi o diwes, hoi o baro Dewel kras. Giwenn un khelenn i bachtjatar pral leste!
Baro Dewel, ab ap mari rig! De men bacht, te djal lauter mishto!
Sharedo well kowa, kai well an o baro Debleskro lab. Kate, dran o Debleskro kheer rakrah o Debleskri bacht pral tumende win.
O baro Dewel hi kokres o Dewel. Kamles dikell lo ap mende. Awenn, lenn palmtikre patria an o wast, un djan khelepah glan o Debleskri chatchepaskri!
Tu hal miro Dewel. Pash tute kamau man te parkrell. Miro Dewel, tut kamau me te sharell.
Parkrenn tumen pash o baro Debleste! Job hi kamlo, un leskro latchepen atchella hako tsireske.
Har bachtelo hi kolla, kai jaake djiwenna, te hunte tchingrell o Dewel gar lentsa, kolla, kai ap o baro Debleskro drom djana.
Har bachtelo hi kolla, kai jaake djiwenn, har job lenge sikras, un pengro tselo djijestar ap leste shunenn.
Kolla krenn kek tchilatchepen un djan ap o Debleskre dromma.
Tu, baro Dewel, penal menge, hoi te kras mer, te rikras mer kowa hako tsiro.
An miro tselo djipen kamoms te krap, hoi mandar kameh.
Te dau jak ap tire laba, krau tchi te hunte ladjap man.
Me parkrau man pash tute o tselo djijestar, te sikreh tu mange tire tchatchepaskre laba.
Me kamau te krap, hoi mandar kameh. Ma muk man kokres!
Har nai djal i terno mursh peskro drom jaake, te atchell peskro djipen djudjo? Kowa nai krell lo, te rikrell lo pes ap tiro lab.
Miro tselo djijeha rodau tut. Ma muk man te mukap tire laba.
Me rikrau tiro lab an miro dji, te anap kek doosh ap mande.
Sharedo wess tu, mo baro Dewel! Tu sikral mange, hoi mandar kameh.
Me penau i wawarenge, har tu o tchatchepen wi-rakral.
Me hom jaake bachtelo pral tiro drom, kai tu mange sikral, har te djiwap. Kowa hi mange shukeder har i baro brawlepen.
Me rakrau kolestar, hoi tu menge penal, te kras kowa, un dau jak, te atchap ap tiro drom.
Mange hi shukar, te krap, hoi tu mandar kameh, un bistrau tire laba gar.
Ab latches ap mande, tiro budepaskro, te djiwap un rikrap tiro lab.
Kre mange i jaka pre, te nai dikap har shukar hi te djap tiro drom.
Me hom gar khere ap kai phub. Muk man te haiwap tire laba!
Miro dji chatchrell, te dikap har tu rakreh o tchatchepen win.
Tu tchingreh pral kolende, kai phurdenn pen pre. Praassedo hi kolla, kai mukan tire laba.
Muk kek ladj ap mande te well! Muk len gar pral mande te sal! Me djau miro drom jaake har tu mange sikral.
I raja hi khetne beshdo, un rakrenna, har te krenn le mange tchilatchepen. Me hom tiro budepaskro un bistrau gar, hoi tu mandar kameh.
Tire laba, hoi sikrenn mange, har te djiwap, krenn man bachtelo. Jon hi mange har i latcho maal, ap koleste me shunau.
An i tchik hom witsedo. De man pale newi soor jaake har tu mange penal!
Me penom tuke lauter dran miro djipen, un tu shunal man. Sike mande, hoi mandar kameh!
Muk man te haiwap, hoi tire laba mange kamenn te penell. Jaake te rakrap pral ko baro sorelo koowa, hoi tu kral.
Miro dji rowell jaake te hi man buder kek soor. De man pale newi soor, jaake har penal.
Rike man pale i chocheno dromestar! An tiro latchepen sike man, har te djap ap tiro drom.
Me kamau tiro drom an o tchatchepen te djal, un jaake djiwell har tire tchatchepaskre laba menge penenn.
Me rikrau man soreles ap tire laba, hoi mange sikrenn, har te djiwap. Baro Dewel, ma muk i wawaren pral mande te sal!
Miro dji hi dur pre, te krap lauter jaake har tu mandar kameh.
Sike tu man, baro Dewel, har te krap kowa lauter jaake, har tu mandar kameh, te djiwap miro tselo djipen jaake, har tu kameh.
Muk man lauter haiwell, te dap jak ap tiro drom, un shunap ap tute o tselo djijestar.
Ab mange ap i rig, te rikrap tire laba! Shukar hi le mange.
Kre te dikap ap tire laba, hoi mange sikrenn, har te djiwap, un dikap gar ap o brawlepen!
Kre, te dikap gar ap kowa, hoi tchi moldo hi, un de man pale newi soor ap tiro drom!
Me hom tiro budepaskro. Rike mange tiro lab, ko lab, hoi tu lauterenge dal, kai mukenn tut pengro rai te well.
Le mandar koi ladj krik, kolatar darau. Jaake har tu o tchatchepen an o wast leh, hi mishto.
Pen mange, hoi te krap tuke! Tu hal an o tchatchepen tardo. De man pale newi soor an miro djipen!
Baro Dewel, ab mange latches, un ab mange ap i rig jaake har tu penal,
te well man i lab, hoi penau koleske, kai praassell man. Me lau tut pash tiro lab.
Kre te penap hako tsiro o tchatchepen! Me dikau ap tute, har tu o tchatchepen an o wast leh.
Me kamau tiro drom te djal kanna un hako tsiro.
Hoi tu mange penal, krau me. Doleske djau bachteles miro drom.
Glan i bare rajende rakrau kolestar, hoi tu menge penal, hoi te kras mer, un ladjau man gar.
Kamau tire laba o djijestar, un hom bachtelo te rikrap man ap lende.
Me hadau tire laba pre, un kamau len o djijestar, un mukau len an miro shero trujel te djal.
Ma biste tiro lab, hoi dal tu man, tiro budepaskres! Dikau ap tiro lab, te well jaake har tu les penal.
Har mange o djipen phares his, dal tu man newi soor. Tiro lab mukas man pre djiwell.
Ninna te sanenn pre-phurde menshe pral mande, mukom gar tiro drom.
Baro Dewel, te well mange an o shero, har lal tu an o phuro tsiro o tchatchepen an o wast, palle krell kowa miro dji pale sorelo.
I choli taprell man, te dikau, har i tchilatche mukan tiro drom.
Kate ap kai phub, kai me gar khere hom, giwau gilja pral tire laba.
Rati weh tu mange an o shero, baro Dewel, te djap ap tiro drom.
Mange hi shukar te krap kowa, hoi tu menge penal.
Me penom mange: O baro Dewel hi o pralstuno an miro djipen. Pal leskre laba kamau te djiwell.
Miro tselo djijeha rodau me tiro kamlepen. Ab mange latches jaake har tu les penal.
Me dau jak, har me miro djipen djiwap, un djau tiro drom jaake har tu les menge sikral.
Me tradom man, un krau sik, hoi tu mandar kameh.
I tchilatche tchiwan dorja win trul mande, te perap dren. Me bistrau tiro drom gar.
Mashkral an i rat stau me pre, te sharap tut, kai lal tu o tchatchepen an o wast.
Me rikrau man pash kolende, kai djiwenn tuha un krenn, hoi tu peneh.
Baro Dewel, latcho hal i menshenge ap i tseli phub. Sike mande, hoi tu mandar kameh!
Tu hals latches ap mande, tiro budepaskro, jaake har tu kowa penal.
Sike mande te haiwap un djinap, hoi te krap! Tire laba hi mishto. Kowa patsau.
Har djom tiro dromestar tele, dal tu man i phagi. Kanna rikrau tiro lab.
Tu hal latcho un kamlo. Sike mande, hoi tu mandar kameh!
Kol pre-phurde anan chochepen pre ap mande. Miro tselo djijestar krau me kowa, hoi tu menge penal.
Kolla menshe pandan pengre djia, te haiwenn le gar tiro lab. Me hom bachtelo, te djap tiro drom.
His mishto mange, te dal man i phagi, te shunap ap tute un krau hoi tu mandar kameh.
Tiro drom kamau me budeder har bud serja kotja sonakai un rup.
Tire wasta kran man un rikran man. Kre, te haiwap tire laba!
Kolla, kai djiwenn tuha, wenn bachtelo, te dikenn le, har patsau ap tiro lab.
Baro Dewel, me djinau, tu te deh i phagi, djah tu pal o tchatchepen. Tuke his tchatcho har dal man i phagi.
Kre miro dji pale sorelo dran tiro latchepen, jaake har tu penal ap mande, tiro budepaskro.
Kre tiro dji mange pre, te djiwap! Me hom bachtelo, te djap tiro drom.
Kre, te hunte ladjenn pen kol pre-phurde, kai chochepen ap mande pre anan. Miro djijeha rakrau pral kowa, hoi tu menge penal, te kras mer.
Ach, te rikrens kolla pash mande, kai djiwenn tuha un prindjrenn tire laba, hoi menge sikrenn, har te djiwas.
Muk miro dji ap tiro drom te atchell, te krap, hoi mandar kameh, jaake te hunte ladjap man gar.
Miro dji nashell pal tute: Ab ap miri rig! Me dikau ap tute, te rakress mantsa.
Me dikau mange i jaka win pal kowa, hoi tu mange penal. Kaana weh tu, un khosseh mange i swa tele?
Me perom an mande khetne har i moljakro gono, hoi pash i jag tchiddo hi. Ninna te hi man buder kek soor, bistrau me gar, hoi tu mandar kameh.
Har rah, baro Dewel, rikreh tut pale, bis te deh kolen i phagi, kai man, tiro budepaskres, palla lenn.
Kol pre-phurde kran chebja, te perap dren, kolla, kai djan gar ap tiro drom.
Tire tsele laba hi o tchatchepen. Kol pre-phurde lenn man palla un anenn chochepen ap mande pre. Ab ap miri rig!
His buder gar bud, palle marans le man an kau them. Me mukom gar tire laba, hoi menge penenn, hoi te kras mer.
Tu hal jaake latcho, de man pale newi soor, te rikrap tire laba, hoi sikrenn menge har te djiwas.
Baro Dewel, tiro lab atchella hako tsireske, un hi soreles tardo an o bolepen.
Tiro tchatchepen atchell jaake rah har menshe koi hi. Tu kral i phub un joi atchella tardo.
Jaake har tu kamal, hi li gomme kau diwes tardo. Lauter ap i phub hunte krell, hoi tu kameh.
Te woms gar bachtelo te djap tiro drom, palle meroms, jaake phares his miro djipen.
An kek tsiro kamau te bistrap hoi tu menge penal, te kras mer. Dran tire laba rikreh tu man djido.
Me hom tiro un kamau te krap, hoi mange peneh. Doleske ab ap miri rig!
I tchilatche lenn man an i jak, te denn le man mulo. Me dau jak ap tire laba, hoi menge sikrenn, har te djiwas mer.
Me dikom te atchell tchi, witar gar kowa, hoi mishto hi. Tiro lab kokres atchella tardo.
O djijestar kamau tiro drom te djal. O tselo diwes hi tire laba an miro shero.
Tire laba hi hako tsiro miro brawlepen, un krenn man gosweder har kolen, kai mange tchilatchepen kamenn.
Me rakrau miro djijeha pral tire laba, hoi menge sikrenn, har te djiwas. Doleske haiwau budeder har mire sikepangre.
Me krau, hoi tu menge penal. Doleske haiwau budeder har i phure.
Hako tchilatcho dromestar rikrom mire herja pale, te rikrap tiro lab.
Me krau pal tire tchatchepaskre laba. Tu hals miro sikepaskro.
Tiro lab hi har i gudlo chapen mange, awa, gudleder har gwin hi lo.
Tiro lab krell man gosewo. Doleske nai dikau gar chochene dromma glan i jaka.
Tiro lab hi har i momeli, hoi sikrell, kai te djap, awa, i momeli ap miro drom.
Me dom man sowel, un me kamau lat te rikrell: Kamau te djap pal tire tchatchepaskre laba.
Miro dji hi phares dukedo, baro Dewel. De man pale newi soor jaake har tu mange penal!
Baro Dewel, dik latches ap mire laba, kolentsa parkrau man pash tute. Sike mande tire tchatchepaskre laba.
Miro djipen hi hako tsiro gar dur o merepastar. Tiro drom bistrau me gar.
I tchilatche tchiwan dorja win, te taprenn le man. Me mukau gar tire laba, hoi menge penenn, hoi te kras mer.
Tire laba, hoi menge sikrenn, har te djiwas, hi mange kutch un atchenna mange hako tsiro. Awa, jon hi kolla, hoi miro dji bachteles krenn.
Me krau miro dji pre, te krap, hoi tu mandar kameh kanna un hako tsiro.
Me choirau man ap kolende, kolen dui djia hi, tiro drom kamau me o djijestar.
Tu hal kowa, pash koleste man khatrau, un koon peskre wasta pral mande rikrella. Doleske dikau ap tiro lab, hoi tu man dal.
Djan pale mandar, tumer, hoi krenn o tchilatchepen! Me rikrau ap i laba miro Deblestar.
Rike man ap o djipen jaake har dal man tiro lab. Ma muk man tchitcheske ap tute te dikell.
Hade man pre, te nai taprell man kek, un me kamau hako tsiro te krell, hoi mandar kameh.
Kolen, kai gar krenna, hoi lendar kameh, tradeh tu tutar. Lengro chochepen hi tchitcheske.
I tchilatchen khosseh tu krik kai phubjatar har tchik. Doleske kamau me tire laba, hoi menge sikrenn, har te djiwas.
Tutar darau jaake, te trissau. Tu deh i phagi kolen, kai shunan gar ap tute.
Me krau o tchatchepen, un djau o tchatcho drom. De man gar an o wast kolendar, kai kamenn ap mande pre te djan.
Me hom tiro budepaskro. Rake mange mishto, te nai djan gar i pre-phurde i sorjah ap mande pre.
Mire jaka nashenn pal tute: Le man win dran o tchilatchepen, jaake har tu penal an tiro tchatchepen.
Ab latches mange, kai tiro budepaskro hom, un sike mange, hoi tu mandar kameh.
Tiro budepaskro hom me. Muk man tire laba te haiwell, hoi menge sikrenn, har te djiwas.
Kanna hi o tsiro, kai o baro Dewel hunte krell tchomone. Jon peran tiro dromestar tele.
Me kamau tire laba budeder har o sonakai, awa, budeder har o latcheder sonakai.
Tire tsele laba, hoi menge penal, hi mange mishto. Kamau tchi te djinell i chocheno dromestar.
Tire laba, hoi sikrenn menge, har te djiwas, kolla sikrenn tiri bari soor. Doleske rikrau len o djijestar.
Te haiwah tiro lab, palle krell men kowa bachtelo, un ninna kolla, kai tchi djinenn, wenn gosewo.
Me krau miro mui dur pre, un pijau tiro lab, jaake bud trush hi man pal tire laba.
Risse tut pash mande, un ab mange latches, jaake har kolenge hal, kai kamenn tut o djijestar.
Muk te atchap soreles ap tiro drom, jaake har tu penal, te well o tchilatchepen kek rai pral mande!
Le man win dran i wasta kolendar, kai man tikno rikrenn, un me kamau kowa te krell, hoi tu menge penal.
Dik latches ap mande, tiro budepaskro, un sike mange, hoi tu mandar kameh!
Rowau bud swa pral kolende, kai mukenn tiro drom.
Baro Dewel, tu hal an o tchatchepen tardo, un tire tchatchepaskre laba hi mishto.
Tire laba, hoi sikrenn menge, har te djiwas, kolla lauter hi tchatcho un mishto.
I choli tapras man un kamas man pre te chatchrell, har dikom, kai bistran kolla tire laba, kai mange o djipen phares krenna.
Tire laba hi latcho un tchatcho, un me, tiro budepaskro, kamau len miro tselo djijeha.
Ninna te hom gar an-diklo, un i menshe dikenn tele ap mande, bistrau me tchi, hoi menge penal, te kras mer.
Tiro tchatchepen atchella hako tsiro, un tiro drom hi tchatcho.
Ninna te hi miro djipen pharo un i daar tapras man, hom bachtelo pral tire laba.
Tire laba, hoi menge sikrenn, har te djiwas, atchenna hako tsiro tchatcho. Sike mande, har te haiwap len! Palle djiwau.
O tselo djijeha dom me gole. Shun man, mo baro Dewel! Me kamau lauter te krell, hoi tu mandar kameh.
Ap tute dom me gole. Ab ap miri rig! Me kamau man te rikrap ap tire laba, hoi mende sikrenn, har te djiwas.
Sik taissarlakro dau me gole ap tute, te wess ap miri rig, un dau jak, te rakreh ap mande.
Ninna an i rat djangrau pre, un rakrau miro djijeha pral tire laba.
Shun man, hoi me penau! Baro Dewel! Tu hal jaake latcho! De man pale newi soor tire tchatchepaskre labentsa!
Kol tchilatche, kai man palla lenn, hi buder gar dur mandar. Tiro dromestar hi le dur.
Baro Dewel, tu hal pash mande. Un tire tsele laba hi o tchatchepen.
I rah tsiro prindjrau tire laba, hoi menge sikrenn, har te djiwas. Tu kral, te atchenn le hako tsireske.
Dik, har djungeles mange djal un le man win dran i bibacht! Tiro drom bistrom me gar.
Le tu miro koowa an tiro wast, un le man win dran i tchilatche wasta! De man pale newi soor jaake har tu mange penal!
I tchilatche krenn gar, hoi tu lendar kameh. Doleske tchiweh tu len gar an o tchatchepen.
Baro Dewel, tu kreh tiro dji dur pre menge. De man pale newi soor tire tchatchepaskre labentsa!
Bud hi kolla, kai man palla lenna, un les mange phares krenna. Me mukau gar tire laba, hoi menge sikrenn, har te djiwas.
Me nai dikau kol phukepangren gar glan i jaka, kai rikrenn pen gar ap tire laba.
Dik, har me kamau tire laba, hoi menge penenn, hoi te kras mer. Baro Dewel, tu hal jaake latcho, de man pale newi soor!
Tiro tselo lab hi o tchatchepen. Un tire tsele tchatchepaskre laba atchenna hako tsireske.
Raja lenn man palla, ninna te krom me lenge tchi, tire laba kokres hi kolla, kai me darau man lendar.
Pral tiro lab hom jaake bachtelo har jek, kai las bud brawlepen.
Chochepen hi mange djungelo, un me nai dikau les gar glan i jaka. Tiro drom kamau me o djijestar.
Jaake har tu o tchatchepen wi-rakreh, hi kowa mishto. Un me sharau tut koleske efta kope an o diwes.
I bari bacht hi kolen, kai tiro drom kamenna. Jon perenn gar tiro dromestar tele.
Baro Dewel, dikau ap tute, te tchiwess man an o tchatchepen, un krau, hoi mandar kameh.
Miro tselo djijeha rikrau man ap tire laba, hoi menge sikrenn, har te djiwas, un kamau len bud un budeder.
Me rikrau tire laba, hoi menge penenn, hoi te kras un har te djiwas; lauter, hoi krau, dikeh tu.
Baro Dewel, shun miro ropen! Muk man tire laba te haiwell, jaake har tu penal!
Shun koi gole miro djijestar! Le miro djipen win dran i bibacht jaake har tu mange penal!
Tu sikreh mange, hoi mandar kameh. Doleske kamell miro mui tuke te giwell.
Miri tchip kamell tiro lab te giwell. Tire tsele laba hi mishto un tchatcho.
De man tiro wast, hoi hadell man! Me krom miro dji pre, te rikrap tire laba, hoi menge penenn, hoi te kras mer.
Baro Dewel, miro tselo djijeha kamau, te tchiwess man an o tchatchepen. Me hom bachtelo te djap tiro drom.
Muk man te djiwell, te sharap tut, kre man soreles tire tchatchepaskre labentsa.
Me hom har i bakro, hoi nashedo djas. Rode man, tiro budepaskres, me bistrom tire laba gar!
I gili te giwell ap o drom an Jerusalem. Har djas mange djungeles, dom gole ap o baro Debleste, un job shunas man.
“Baro Dewel” penom, “ab un le man win dran i wasta kol chochenendar, kai dui tchipjentsa rakrenna.”
Hoi te krell lo tumentsa, tumer chochene? Hawi phagi anell lo ap tumende?
Jagengre faile dell i kurepaskro karje ap tumende!
Hawi bibacht hi mange, te hunte djiwap mank i wi-themarja, pash i menshende, kai prindjrenn gar miro Debles.
O tsiro well mange rah, kai djiwau pash kolende, kai kamenn o tchingepen.
Me kamau kek kurepen. Te penau kowa lenge, krenn jon o tchingepen.
I gili te giwell ap o drom an Jerusalem. Me dikau pre ap i berge. Kai well kowa, kai well mange ap i rig?
Kowa, kai well ap miri rig, hi o baro Dewel, job, kai o bolepen un i phub kras.
Job mukell tut gar te perell. Job sowell gar un rikrell peskre wasta pral tute.
Kowa, kai rikrell peskre wasta pral o Israel, well gar khino un sowell gar.
O baro Dewel rikrell peskre wasta pral tute, un atchell ap tiri rig.
Jaake chatchrell tut gar o kham ap o diwes, un o tchon nai krell tuke tchi an i rat.
O baro Dewel rikrell peskre wasta pral tiro djipen, te taprell tut kek bibacht.
O baro Dewel rikrell peskre wasta pral tute ap tire tsele dromma, kote kai weh un kote kai djah kanna un hako tsiro.
I gili o Davidestar te giwell ap o drom an Jerusalem. Miro dji giwas, har jon penan: Mer djah pash o baro Debleskro kheer.
Kanna hi mare herja tardo an o bare wudja o forestar Jerusalem.
Jerusalem hi i sorelo kerdo foro, kai i menshe khetne wenna.
Kote djan bud menshe pre, kol tsele menshe, kai o baro Debles an-mangenn. Kote sharenn le les, jaake har job lenge penas.
Kote hi beshdo ap pengre rajengre beshepangre kol bare raja, kai wenna dran o kheer David, te rakrenn le o tchatchepen win pral i menshende.
Mangenn o Deblestar i bacht pral o foro Jerusalem un penenn: “Kolenge, kai kamenn tut, Jerusalem, mu djal mishto!
Kek kurepen te well an tute! An tire shukar khera te well brawlepen!”
Kamau, te djal mishto mire phralenge un malenge. Doleske penau: “Mu well kek kurepen an o foro!”
Kote hi maro baro Debleskro kheer tardo. Doleske mangau maro Debles, te djal lauter mishto i menshenge an Jerusalem.
I gili te giwell ap o drom an Jerusalem. Ap tute dikau pre, kai tu an o bolepen khere hal.
Jaake har i budepaskro ap o wast peskro rajestar dikella, un i budepaskretsa ap i wasta peskri ranjatar dikella, jaake dikah mer ap maro baro Debleste, bis te krell lo menge peskro dji pre.
Kre tiro dji menge pre, baro Dewel, kre tiro dji menge pre! Har rah dikenn le ap mende, har te wams tchi moldo!
Dik, har rah sanenn i brawele pral mende! Har rah dikenn kolla ap mende tele, kai pre-phurde hi.
I gili o Davidestar te giwell ap o drom an Jerusalem. Hoi wals, te wals o baro Dewel gar ap mari rig? Pen les mange, tu Israel!
Te wals o baro Dewel gar ap mari rig, har i menshe pre djan ap mende,
palle chans le men djides pre an pengri bari choli ap mende.
Palle tassals men o pani, hoi pral mende was, un tserdals men peha,
un tchakrals men tel peste.
Sharedo well o baro Dewel! Job mukas men gar mank lengre danda.
Mer nai nasham menge har i tchirklo, dran koi netsa, hoi i tchirklengro pral leste witsras. Koi netsa was paash kerdo, un mer wam win.
Kowa hi o baro Dewel, kai las men win, job, kai o bolepen un i phub kras.
I gili te giwell ap o drom an Jerusalem. Kolla, hoi ap o baro Debleste patsenna, hi har i berga Zion, hoi soreles tardo hi, un atchell hake tsirenge.
Jaake har i berge trul o foro Jerusalem hi, jaake hi o baro Dewel trul peskre menshende kanna un hako tsiro.
I tchilatche atchenn gar i raja pral o them kolendar, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi. Te wals jaake, nai krans kolla ninna o tchilatchepen.
Ab latcho, baro Dewel, kolenge, kai latcho hi, kolenge, kai o djijestar ap tute shunenna.
Kolen, kai tiro drom mukenn un djan ap bange dromma, deh tu, baro Dewel, i phagi khetne kolentsa, kai i wawarenge tchilatchepen krenna. Bacht te well pral o Israel!
I gili te giwell ap o drom an Jerusalem. Har anas men o baro Dewel pale pash i berga Zion, hams mer har sawe, hoi suni denna.
Kote sanas maro mui, un mari tchip das gole i bachtjatar, un pash i tsele wawar menshende penan le: “O baro Dewel kras baro koowa ap lende.”
Awa, o baro Dewel kras baro koowa ap mende, un maro dji giwas i bachtjatar.
Baro Dewel, an pale lauteren mendar, kai pandle hi, jaake har tu aneh kol tikne panja pale, an o them, kai o kham pralstunes hi.
Koon ropah o djob an i phub witsrella, kowa dell gole i bachtjatar ap ko diwes, kai lell lo o djob dren.
Job djala ropah, te witsrell lo o djob win, un well bachteles khere, i gonentsa pherdo djob.

I gili o Salomestar te giwell ap o drom an Jerusalem. Te krell o baro Dewel gar o kheer, palle budrenn i budepangre tchitcheske. Te dell o baro Dewel gar jak ap o foro, palle hi tchitcheske, te denn mursha jak ap o foro.
Tchitcheske hi, te stenn tumer sik taissarlakro pre, un han beshdo bis an i rat, un marenn tumen tele, te lenn tumaro chapen. Kowa dell o baro Dewel peskre malen an o sopen.
Tumare tchawen das o baro Dewel tumende. Hi i kutch koowa, te nai lell jek tchawe.
Sorele mursh tchawe hi pengro dadeske har faile, hoi i kurepaskro an o wast hidjrell, te dell lo karje.
Bachtelo hi kowa, koles bud kolendar pash peste hi. Te well i doosh ap leste anlo, wenn le leske ap i rig, te lell lo peskro tchatchepen.
I gili te giwell ap o drom an Jerusalem. Bachtelo hi hakeno, kai djiwell o baro Debleha, un djal ap leskro drom.
Tu chah kolestar, hoi tire wasta budran. Mishto tuke! Tuke djal latcho.
Khere hi tiri romni. Un joi hi har i drakengro ruk, hoi bud drake hidjrella. Un tire tchawe hi beshdo trul tiri chapaskri har terne djeteskre ruka.
Sawi bacht hi ko murshes, kai djiwell o baro Debleha.
O baro Dewel dell tut bacht kotar, kai lo khere hi, ap i berga Zion. Jaake rah har djiweh, dikeh koi bacht, hoi well dran o foro Jerusalem.
Un ninna dikeh i tchawe tire tchawendar. Bacht te well pral o Israel!
I gili te giwell ap o drom an Jerusalem. Bud kope kran le mange o djipen phares jaake rah har djiwau, – kowa hunte penell o kheer Israel –
bud kope kran le mange o djipen phares. Mulo nai dan le man gar.
Miro dumo dan le pre, har i hacho i phub pre dell un lengste tchinepangre krell.
An peskro tchatchepen das o baro Dewel kol shelle paash, kolentsa i tchilatche man pandan.
Kolla, kai choirenn pen ap o foro Jerusalem, kamoms, te tserdenn le pen pale un hunte ladjenn pen!
Lenge te djal har o khass, hoi pral ap o kheer pre djal: Kowa hi gomme gar baro, koi well lo truk.
Kek hacho tchinell les tele, un witar kek pandell les khetne.
Un kek, kai kote ap o drom djal, penell ap lende: “O baro Debleskri bacht well ap tumende! Mer rakrah bacht pral tumende an o baro Debleskro lab.”
I gili te giwell ap o drom an Jerusalem. Dran o telstunepen miro djijestar dau me gole ap tute, baro Debleste.
Miro rai, shun man! Shun, har ap tute rowau!
Te tchinals tu, baro Dewel, mari doosh an i liil, koon nai atchals palle glan tute tardo?
Tu hal kowa, kai i doosh krik lella. Doleske dikah pre ap tute un shunah ap tute.
Ap tute, baro Dewel, rikrau me, miro tselo djijestar dikau ap tute, te rakress mantsa.

Miro dji dikell ap o Debleste, miro rajeste, te well lo ap miri rig. Un o tsiro well mange rah, budeder har kolenge, kai rati jak denn ap o foro un kamenn, te well sik o diwes. Awa, budeder har kolla!
Tu, Israel, dik ap o baro Debleste! Job hi latches menge, un leskro dji hi hako tsiro pre, te lell lo men win dran o tchilatchepen.
Awa, job lell o kheer Israel win dran leskri tseli doosh.

I gili o Davidestar te giwell ap o drom an Jerusalem. Baro Dewel, me hom gar pre-phurdo, un mire jaka dikenn gar tele ap i wawarende. Me kamau gar baro koowa, witar gar sawo koowa, hoi dur pral mande hi.
Na-a, miro dji hi pokones un tchalo, jaake har i tikno tchawo tchalo hi an i mussi peskri datar, awa, jaake tchalo hi miro dji.
Israel, dik ap o baro Debleste, kanna un hako tsiro.
I gili te giwell ap o drom an Jerusalem. Baro Dewel, ma biste o Davides un ko tselo pharo koowa, hoi lo ap peste las.
Job das pes sowel glan tute, o Jakobeskro sorelo Debleste, un penas:
“Me djau gar an miro kheer, un tchiwau man gar tele an miro tchiben,
pandau gar mire jaka, te sowap gar dren,
bis te hatsom i platsa o baro Debleske, un krom i kheer o Jakobeskro sorelo Debleske.”
Har hams an Efrata, shunam kai o sonakaskro mochton hi, ko sikepen, kai o Dewel khere hi. Kowa hatsam mer pash o foro Jaar.
Awenn, mer djah an leskro kheer, un perah tele glan o stamin, kai tchiwell lo peskre herja pre.
Baro Dewel, ste pre, un dja pash koi platsa, kai khere hal, tu un ko mochton, hoi men tiri bari soor sikrell.
Tchip o tchatchepen pral tire rashaja har i ripen! Mu denn tire menshe gole i bachtjatar!
Tu rodal o Davides win, te well lo baro rai. Ma bitche les tutar krik, tiro budepaskres!
O baro Dewel das o Davideste i sowel, un job lell koi sowel gar pale. Un job penas: Me rodau jekes tire tchawendar win, te well lo baro rai pal tute.
Te rikrenn tire tchawe ap mande un mire laba un krenn, hoi me lenge penau, palle wenn ninna lendar bare raja, jaake te well hako tsiro jek tire tchawendar baro rai.
O baro Dewel rodas peske i berga Zion win. Un leske hi shukar te djiwell lo kote.
“Kaja hi i platsa, kai khere hom hako tsiro” penell lo. “Kate kamau te djiwell.”
Me dau i menshen an o foro Jerusalem lauter, hoi len hunte well djipaske. Ninna i tchorwelende, kai kote djiwenn, dau doha chapen.
Lengre rashajenge dau an o dji, te penenn le miro latchepen dureder. Un kol menshe, kai mire hi, denn gole i bachtjatar.
Kote well jek o Davideskre tchawendar i sorelo baro rai. Ko baro rai, koles mange wi-rodom, well i menshenge har i momeli, hoi hako tsiro chatchella.
Leskro railepen well baro un bareder. Un ap kolende, kai leske tchilatchepen kamenn, tchiwau bari ladj.
I gili o Davidestar te giwell ap o drom an Jerusalem. Dikenn, har mishto un shukar hi, te djiwenn phrala an o latchepen khetne.
Kawa hi jaake har ko latcho makepaskro djet, hoi ap o Aroneskro shero tchoredo well, un tele nashella ap leskri tchora, un kotar dureder ap i meen leskro gadestar.
Kawa hi jaake har o taissarlakro pani, hoi i berga Hermon tele nashella ap i berge Zion! Kote kamell o baro Dewel peskri bacht te dell, un o djipen, hoi hako tsiro atchella.
I gili te giwell ap o drom an Jerusalem. Stenn pre! Sharenn o baro Debles, tumer tsele budepangre o baro Deblestar, kai han tardo rati an o baro Debleskro kheer!
Hadenn tumare wasta pre an leskro Debleskro kheer, un sharenn o baro Debles!
O baro Dewel, kai o bolepen un i phub kras, hi khere ap i berga Zion. Fun kotar mu tchiwell lo peskri bacht ap tute!
Halleluja! Sharenn o baro Debles! Sharenn les, tumer budepangre o baro Deblestar,
tumer, kai tardo han an o baro Debleskro kheer, ap koi platsa glan o kheer maro Deblestar.
Sharenn o baro Debles! Latcho hi o baro Dewel. Hadenn les tumaro bashepah. Kamlo hi lo menge.
O baro Dewel rodas peske o Jakobeskre menshen win, awa, o Israel las lo, te well lo leskro.
Kanna djinau: O baro Dewel hi o pralstuno. Maro baro Dewel hi bareder har hako wawar dewel.
Lauter, hoi job kamell te krell, krell lo an o bolepen un ap i phub, an o baro pani, un an o telstunepen.
Job mukell wolke pral i phub pre te djal, dell brishin ap i phub, ninna koi jag, hoi ap o bolepen pre un tele karje dell. Job anell o baro ducho win, hoi pral i phub phurdell.
Job hi kowa, kai das i phureder mursh tchawen mulo an o them Egiptia pash i menshende, ninna pash i viechende,
un sikras baro koowa un peskri bari soor ap tute, Egiptia, un ap tiro baro rai un leskre tsele budepangre.
O baro Dewel hi kowa, kai was sorleder har bud themma, un sorele bare rajen mulo das:
O Sihon, ko baro rai pral i Amorarja, un o Og, ko baro rai pral Bashan, un i tsele bare raja an o them Kanaan.
Lengre themma das lo peskre menshende Israel, te wenn le lengre.
Baro Dewel, tiro lab atchella hako tsirenge. Tiro barepen atchella jaake rah, har menshe koi hi.
O baro Dewel anell peskre menshenge o tchatchepen, un krell peskro dji pre peskre budepangre.
I debla i wawar menshendar hi dran rup un sonakai, Menshenge wasta kran len.
I mui hi len, un rakrenn gar. Jaka hi len, un dikenn gar.
Kanda hi len un shunenn gar. Len hi kek ducho an lengro mui.
Kolla, kai sawe deblen krenna, un ap lende patsenna, wenn jaake har jon.
Tumer dran o kheer Israel, sharenn o baro Debles! Tumer rashaja dran o kheer Aron, sharenn o baro Debles!
Tumer dran o kheer Levi, sharenn o baro Debles! Tumer lauter, kai djiwenn o baro Debleha, sharenn les!
Sharedo well o baro Dewel ap i berga Zion! An o foro Jerusalem hi lo khere. Halleluja!
Sharenn o baro Debles! Job hi kamlo! Leskro latchepen atchella hako tsireske.
Sharenn o Debles, kai hi bareder har i tsele debla. Leskro latchepen atchella hako tsireske!
Sharenn o Debles, kai hi o rai pral i tsele rajende. Leskro latchepen atchella hako tsireske!
Job kokres krell baro koowa, hoi kek wawar nai krella. Leskro latchepen atchella hako tsireske!
Job kras o bolepen an peskro goswepen. Leskro latchepen atchella hako tsireske!
Job tchiwas i phub pral o pani wergel. Leskro latchepen atchella hako tsireske!
Job kras o kham un o tchon. Leskro latchepen atchella hako tsireske!
O kham, te well lo rai pral o diwes. Leskro latchepen atchella hako tsireske!
O tchon un i bolepangre momlia, te wenn le rai pral i rat. Leskro latchepen atchella hako tsireske!
Job maras i phureder mursh tchawen i Egiptarendar. Leskro latchepen atchella hako tsireske!
Un anas o Israel dran o them Egiptia win. Leskro latchepen atchella hako tsireske!
Peskro sorelo wasteha kras lo kowa. Leskro latchepen atchella hako tsireske!
O Baro Lolo Pani kras lo an dui kotja. Leskro latchepen atchella hako tsireske!
Un mukas o Israel mashkral wergel te djal. Leskro latchepen atchella hako tsireske!
O baro rajes pral o them Egiptia un leskre tsele lurden witsras lo an o Baro Lolo Pani. Leskro latchepen atchella hako tsireske!
Job anas peskre menshen ap o drom mashkral o mulo tato them. Leskro latchepen atchella hako tsireske!
Job was sorleder har bare raja. Leskro latchepen atchella hako tsireske!
Un maras sorele rajen. Leskro latchepen atchella hako tsireske!
O Sihon, o baro rai pral i Amorarja. Leskro latchepen atchella hako tsireske!
Un o Og, o baro rai pral o them Bashan. Leskro latchepen atchella hako tsireske!
Un das lengro them peskre menshende. Leskro latchepen atchella hako tsireske!
Te well les i Israelenge, kai leskre budepangre hi. Leskro latchepen atchella hako tsireske!
Job bistras men gar, har tele rikede hams. Leskro latchepen atchella hako tsireske!
Un las men win dran i wasta kolendar, hoi menge o djipen phares kran. Leskro latchepen atchella hako tsireske!
Job dell chapen hake menshende un viechende. Leskro latchepen atchella hako tsireske!
Sharenn o Debles pral o bolepen! Leskro latchepen atchella hako tsireske!
Pash i panja an o foro Babilon hams beshdo un rowan, har menge o Zion an o shero was.
Mare harfe tchiwam kote ap kol ruka.
Kolla, kai men tapran, kaman, te giwas lenge i gili: “Giwenn menge i gili pral o Zion”, penan le.
Har nai giwams o baro Debleske i gili an i wawar them?
Bistrau me tut, Jerusalem, mu merell tele miri tchatchi mussi!
Miri tchip te atchell pral an miro mui, me te bistraus tut, Jerusalem, me te kamaus tchomone budeder har tut.
Baro Dewel, ma biste gar, hoi i Edomarja kran, har jon ap ko diwes gole dan an i Jerusalem: “Phagenn o foro tele! Phagenn les tele bis ap o telstuno bar!”
Tu, foro Babilon, tu, kai lauter an kotja deh! Bachteles well kowa, hoi tuke pale della kowa, hoi tu menge kral!
Bachteles well kowa, kai tire tchawe taprella un len ap i bare barra mulo witsrella!
I gili o Davidestar. Parkrau man pash tute miro tselo djijeha. Tuke giwau miri gili, un kek wawar debleske.
Glan tiro Debleskro kheer perau tele, un parkrau man pash tute, te kral tiro dji mange pre un rikral tiro lab. Awa, tu dal men budeder har menge penal. Tiro lab hi raileder har i tsele wawar.
Ap ko diwes, hoi me ap tute gole dom, shunal tu man, un dal man pale bari soor.
Baro Dewel, i tsele raja ap kai phub sharenn tut, te shunenn le tire laba, hoi dran tiro mui djana.
Jon giwenna pral kowa, hoi tu kral: ‘Tiro railepen hi baro.’
Awa, ninna te hal jaake dur pral halauter, dikeh tu kolen, kai tele rikede hi. Un kol pre-phurden prindjreh fun dural.
Ninna te hom an i daar, deh tu man newi soor, un tchiweh tut kolenge an o drom, kai kamenn mange tchilatchepen te krell. Tiri sorjah weh tu ap miri rig.
Baro Dewel, tu leh miro koowa an tiro wast. Baro Dewel, tiro latchepen atchella hako tsireske. Ma muk kowa, hoi lal an tiro wast!
I gili o rajeske pral i gipangre. Kai gili kras o David. Baro Dewel, tu dikeh an miro dji un prindjreh man mishto.
Tu prindjreh miro beshepen un miro tardepen. Tu haiweh fun dural, hoi an miro shero trujel djal.
Te djau win, un te hom tchiddo, tu hal pash mande. Mire tsele dromma, tu prindjreh len.
O lab hi gomme gar ap miri tchip, koi djineh tu, baro Dewel, hoi kamau te rakrap.
Haki rigjatar lal tu man trujel, un rikreh tiro wast pral mande.
Tu prindjreh man jaake mishto, kowa hi mange bares un phares. Me nai haiwau kowa gar.
Kai djau me nai, te wap dur tutar? Kai nashap, kai tu man gar dikeh?
Te djoms an o bolepen pre, palle hal tu koi. Te tchiwoms man pash i mulende, ninna kote wals tu koi.
Te hadoms man har i tchirklo un djoms kote, kai o kham pre-djala, un mukoms man tele pal o baro pani, kai o kham tele djal,
ninna kote taprals man tiro wast un rikrals man.
Un penaus me: “Kali rat te khatrell man, un tamlepen te well trul mande”,
palle wals tuke i rat gar kali, awa, i rat wals har o diwes, un o tamlepen har i momeli.
Tu kral lauter, hoi an mande hi. An miri date tchiwal man khetne.
Me parkrau man pash tute, te kral man jaake shukar. Ap mande dikau, lauter hoi kreh, hi jaake mishto, te atchell mange o rakepen krik.
Me homs gar khatedo glan tute, har kral man kote, kai kek dikell, har wom i ternepen an miri dakro per.
Tu dikal man, har gar kerdo homs, un hako diwes miro djipastar his tchinlo an tiro liil, har gomme kek lendar koi his.
Phares te haiwell hi mange kowa, hoi tu an tiro shero rakreh, mo Dewel. Har bud hi kowa!
Te kamoms les tele te ginell, wals kowa budeder har i santa pash o baro pani. Te stau pre o wawar diwes, hom gomme pash tute.
Mo Dewel, kamoms te dess tu i tchilatchen mulo! Kamoms, te djan penge kolla, kolen doosh ap o rat i wawarendar hi!
Jon, kai praassenn tut un hadenn pen ap tute, lenn tiro lab an o mui te chochenn le.
Baro Dewel, hunte choirap man gar ap kolende, hoi pen ap tute choirenn? Mange well djungeles, te dikau kolen, kai hadenn pen ap tute.
Kolla, kai kamenn tut gar, kamau me witar gar. Awa, nai dikau len gar glan mire jaka.
Dik an miro dji, miro Dewel, un dik, hoi lauter koi dren hi! Un le man an o jak, un dik, hoi mange an o shero trujel djala!
Un te dikeh, te hom ap i drom, hoi tutar krik djala, palle ab un le man pale ap ko drom, hoi pash tute djala!
I gili o rajeske pral i gipangre. Kai gili kras o David.
Baro Dewel, le man win dran i wasta kol tchilatchendar! Khate man glan i marepangre!
Kolen hi tchilatchepen an o dji, un krenn tchingepen hako diwes.
Lengre tchipja denn tchurje har sapengre tchipja, lengre laba anenn o merepen.
Baro Dewel, de ap mande jak, te taprenn man i tchilatche gar! Khate man glan i marepangre, glan kolende, kai kamenn te perap!
Kol pre-phurde tchiwan mange dorja win, te stakrap dren un perap. Jon tchiwan i netsa win ap miro drom, te taprenn le man.
Me penom ap o baro Debleste: Tu hal miro Dewel. Baro Dewel, shun, har ap tute rowau!
Baro Dewel, miro rai, tu hal o sorelo ap miri rig. Tu rikreh tire wasta pral mande an o kurepaskro tsiro.
De kol tchilatchen gar, hoi jon kamenna! Kowa, hoi jon pen glan lan, muk gar te djal, te hadenn le pen gar!
Kolla, kai trul mande hi, kamenn mange bibacht. Muk koi bibacht ap lende pale te djal!
Muk jagakre barra ap lende te perell! Witse len an i jag! Muk len te perell an o telstunepen, jaake te nai stenn le buder gar pre!
Koles i tchilatchi tchip hi, koles te well kek bacht an kau them! Un i marepangre, te wenn le tradedo i bibachtjatar un hunte perenn!
Me djinau, te lell o baro Dewel i tchorwelengro koowa an peskro wast, un dell jak, te lenn le pengro tchatchepen.
Awa, i tsiro wella kolenge, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi, te sharenn le tut. Un kolla, kai o tchatcho drom djan, djiwenna pash tute.
I gili o Davidestar. Baro Dewel, ap tute dau me gole. Ab sik pash mande! Shun ap mande ap ko tsiro, kai ap tute gole dau!
Muk miro mangepen tuke jaake shukar te well, har chatchroms me tuke sungepaskro koowa. Dik ap mire pre-hadede wasta jaake har ap i viecho, hoi mukoms tuke rati te chatchrell.
Baro Dewel, de jak ap miro mui, de garda ap miri tchip.
Muk miro dji gar o tchilatchepen palla te dell, te krap gar midjak koowa khetne i tchilatchentsa. Muk man gar te chap lengro shukar chapen!
Latche menshe mu denn man i phagi, un tchingrenn mantsa an o latchepen. I tchilatchendar kamau gar, te sharenn le man. Un me mangau o Deblestar, te krenn le mange kek tchilatchepen.
Ap ko diwes, kai well i phagi pral lengre pralstunende wi-rakedo, wenn jon i barrengri berga tele witsedo. Palle well diklo, har tchatcho mire laba pral lende his.
Jaake har o hacho i phub pre phagell un trujel witsrell, jaake hi lengre kokale trujel tchiddo. Un o mulengro them krell peskro mui lenge pre.
Ap tute, baro Dewel, dikenn mire jaka. Pash tute kamau me man te khatrell. Muk man gar te merell!
De jak ap mande, te perap gar an i dorja, hoi jon mange wi-tchiwan, awa, te perap gar kote dren, kai i tchilatche kamenn man te taprell.
Muk len lauteren kokres te perell an pengri netsa, hoi jon mange wi-tchiwan, un man muk te nashap mange!
Giwede laba o Davidestar. Har khatras job pes an koi grotta, mangas job o Debles kal labentsa.
Ap o baro Debleste dau bari gole. Ap o baro Debleste rowau!
Leske penau lauter, hoi ap miro dji hi, un mukau les te djinell, hoi mange phares hi.
Har djinom buder gar, hoi te krap, djinal tu, har mantsa dureder djal. Ap ko drom, hoi me hunte djom, tchiwan le dorja win, te perap dren.
Dik tut trujel: Kek kamell mandar tchomone te djinell. Me nashte nashau gar mange. Kek putchell pal mande.
Baro Dewel, ap tute dau me gole, un penau tuke: Pash tute nai khatrau man. Tu hal kowa, hoi man an miro djipen hunte well.
Shun, har dau gole. Mange hi ropaske. Le man win dran i wasta kolendar, kai man palla lenn! Jon hi sorleder har me.
Le miro djipen win dran kau stilepen, te nai sharap tiro lab mank kolende, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi, te kral tu mange latchepen.
I gili o Davidestar. Baro Dewel, shun miro mangepen! De jak ap miro ropen! Tu hal latcho un tchatcho! Doleske shun man!
De man, tiro budepaskres, kek phagi; glan tute hi kek mensho an o tchatchepen tardo.
Kowa, kai mange tchilatchepen kamell, lell man palla, stakrell miro djipen an i phub. Me hom har an i stilepen, kai kali rat hi, hom har kolla, kai meran glan i rah tsiro.
Bari daar hi an miro dji. Miri tseli soor, hoi an mande his, nashrom.
Mange djal kowa an o shero, hoi tu lauter kral glan i rah tsiro. Pral kowa, hoi tire wasta kran, rakrau miro djijeha.
Mire wasta hadau pre pash tute. Har i truk them trushella pal pani, jaake trushell miro dji pal tute.
Baro Dewel, shun man sik! Man hi buder kek soor. Ma khate tut mandar, te wap gar har kolla, kai hunte merenn.
Ap i tsalla muk man tiro latchepen te shunell. Me dikau ap tute. Sike man hawo drom me hunte djap. Miro dji nashell pal tute.
Baro Dewel, le miro djipen win dran i wasta kolendar, kai ap mande djan. Pash tute wau, te khatrap man.
Sike mange, hoi tuke shukar hi, te krap me, tu hal miro Dewel. Tiro latcho ducho mu sikrell man o tchatcho drom.
Baro Dewel, rike tire wasta pral miro djipen jaake har penal. Tu hal an o tchatchepen tardo. Doleske le man win dran i bibacht!
Tu hal jaake latcho ap mande. Doleske le kolen krik, kai ap mande djan, un mare lauteren, kai mange miro djipen phares krenn. Me hom tiro budepaskro!
I gili o Davidestar. Sharedo well o baro Dewel, kai rikrell peskre wasta pral mande. Job sikrell mange, har te kurap man. Mire wastenge sikrell lo har te dap i chareha.

Job well ap miri rig, un hi mange har i sorelo kheer, kai nai khatrau man, un kek man an-taprell. Job rikrell peskre wasta pral mande, Ap leste rikrau man. Job stakrell i menshen dran wawar themma tel mire herja.
Baro Dewel, hoi hi o mensho, tu te deh jak ap leste? Hoi hi o mensho, kai hunte merell, tu te dikeh ap leste?
Har i ducho hi lo. Leskro djipen djal trujel har i suni.
Baro Dewel, tchip o bolepen ap i rig un ab tele! Tape i berge an, te well jagakro ducho win!
Bitche tiri jag, hoi ap o bolepen pral un tele djal! De tire faile karje ap kolende, kai ap mande djan!
Rike mange tiro wast dran o bolepen! Tape man, un le man win dran kau baro pani, dran i wasta kol wawar menshendar!
Kolengro mui chochepen rakrella, ninna te denn le pen sowel.
Miro Dewel, me kamau tuke i newi gili te giwell. Ap i deesh-dorjengri bashepaskri kamau tuke te bashrell.
Tu kreh, te well jek themeskro rai sorleder har ko wawar. Un tu kreh, te well tiro budepaskro, o David, gar maredo o chareha.
Tape man, un le man win dran i wasta kol wawar menshendar! Kolengro mui chochepen rakrella, ninna te denn le pen sowel.
Muk mare mursh tchawen har ruka te well, hoi baro wenna an pengri terni soor. Un mare tchen muk shukar te well, har kol shukar figure an o rajeskro kheer.
Muk mare djobengre khera pherdo te well, te well men bud latcho chapen te chal. Muk mare bakren serja terne te lell, awa, deesh-serja an mare gaba.
Mare grumja te nashrenn kek pengre ternendar, hoi gar boldo hi. Kek ropaskri gole te well shunlo ap mare dromma!
Bachteles hi kol menshe, kolenge jaake djala! Awa, bachteles hi kol menshe, kolengro Dewel o baro Dewel hi!
Kai gili kras o David te sharell lo o Debles. Me kamau tut te hadell, miro Debles. Tu hal o baro rai. Tut kamau me te sharell kanna un hako tsiro.
Hako diwes kamau man pash tute te parkrell. Kanna un hako tsiro kamau tut te sharell.
Sorelo hi o baro Dewel un bud moldo, te well lo sharedo. Kek haiwell, har baro job hi.
Ninna mare tchawengre tchawe sharenn, hoi tu kral, un rakrenn pral tiro sorelo koowa.
Jon rakrenn pral tiro railepen un barepen. Un me mukau mange an o shero te well, hoi tu kral un hoi kek wawar nai krella.
Jon rakrenn pral tiri soor, hoi jaake baro hi, te well men daar. Un me rakrau pral tiro railepen.
Jon sharenn tiro baro latchepen, un giwenn pral tiro tchatchepen.
Latches hi o baro Dewel un krell i menshenge peskro dji pre. Job well gar sik chojedo. Un leskro kamlepen hi baro.
O baro Dewel hi latches ap hakeneste. Un krell peskro dji pre halauterenge, kolen job kras.
Kolla lauter, kai tu kral, mu sharenn le tut, baro Dewel, mu parkrenn pen pash tute kolla, kai tire hi,
un sharenn, hawo railo un latcho baro rai tu hal. Mu penenn le, har baro tiri soor hi,
te shunenn i tsele menshe, hawo baro koowa tu kral, un hawo railo un latcho rai tu hal pral mende.
Tu hal un atcheh o baro rai kanna un hako tsireske. O baro Dewel rikrell peskre tsele laba, un hi latcho an halauter, hoi krell lo.
O baro Dewel rikrell hakenes, kai perell, un hadell hakenes pale pre, kai tele dino hi.
Menshe un vieche denn jak ap tute, te dess len pengro chapen ap o tchatcho tsiro.
Tu kreh tiro latcho wast pre, un deh lauteren, hoi djiwenna, jaake bud te chal, te wenn le tchalo.
An lauter, hoi o baro Dewel krell, djal lo pal o tchatchepen. An lauter, hoi krell lo, hi lo latcho.
O baro Dewel hi gar dur hakenestar, kai dell les an-gole, hakeneske, kai dell les an-gole an o tchatchepen.
Kolenge, kai o djijestar ap leste shunenna, krell lo, hoi jon mangenna, un shunell, har denn le gole, un well ap lengri rig.
Kolla, kai les o djijestar kamenna, pral kolende rikrell lo peskre wasta. Kolla, kai tchilatcho koowa krenna, mukell lo te merell.
Miro mui te sharell o baro Debles! Lauter, hoi djiwella, mu sharell koles, kai kokres o tchatcho Dewel hi, – kanna un hako tsiro!
Halleluja! Miro dji sharell o baro Debles.
Jaake rah har me djiwau, kamau o baro Debles te sharell. Jaake rah har hom ap kai phub, kamau leske te bashrell.
Rikrenn tumen gar ap tumare pralstunende! Menshe hi le un nai lenn tumen gar win dran i bibacht.
O menshengro djipen atchell gar. Un job well pale tchik i phubjatar. Ko diwes, kai merell lo, djala lauter nashedo, hoi job peske glan las.
Bachtelo hi kowa, koleske o Jakobeskro Dewel ap i rig well, awa, kowa hi bachtelo, kai kokres ap peskro baro Debleste dikell.
Job hi o Dewel, kai o bolepen un i phub kras, un o baro pani, un kowa, hoi dren hi. Job hi kowa, kai hako tsiro peskro lab rikrell,
un kolen pengro tchatchepen dell, kai tele rikedo wenn. Kolen, kai bokenn, dell lo te chal. O baro Dewel hi kowa, kai i stilde win lell dran o stilepen.
O baro Dewel krell, te nai dikenn i korele pale. O baro Dewel hadell kolen pale pre, kai tele dino hi. O baro Dewel kamell kolen o djijestar, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi.
O baro Dewel dell ap i wi-themarja jak, un hi ap i rig kol tchawendar, kolen kek dad buder hi, un ap i rig kol djuwjendar, kolengro rom meras. I tchilatchenge tchiwell lo barra an lengro drom.
O baro Dewel hi o baro rai hako tsireske. Job hi tiro Dewel, Zion, kanna un hako tsiro. Sharedo well o baro Dewel!
Halleluja! Sharenn o baro Debles! Latcho hi, te giwas gilja maro Debleske! Shukar un mishto hi, te bashras leske.
O baro Dewel tchiwella Jerusalem pale pre, un lauteren, kai krik tradedo wan, anell job pale khetne.
Kolen, kai lengro dji phagedo hi, krell lo pale sasto, un kolenge, kai dukedo hi, tchiwell lo i pandepen pre.
Job ginell i bolepangre momlia tele un kharell lengre laba.
Baro hi o Dewel, maro rai, un les hi bari soor. Kowa lauter, hoi job an peskro goswepen krella, haiwah nai gar.
O baro Dewel hadell kolen pre, kai tele rikedo hi, un i tchilatchen witsrell lo tele ap i phub.
Giwenn i gili o baro Debleske! Parkrenn tumen pash leste! Bashrenn maro Debleske ap i harfa!
Job tchiwell wolke ap o bolepen, dell brishin ap i phub, mukell o senlepen bares te well ap i berge.
I viechende dell lo pengro chapen, ninna i terne korake, hoi pal chapen gole denna.
I grajengri soor hi leske gar shukar, witar gar i murshengri soor.
O baro Debleske hi kolla shukar, kai leha djiwenna un ap leste dikenna, te well lo lenge latches.
Tumer menshe an o foro Jerusalem, sharenn o baro Debles! Tumer dran o foro Zion, hadenn tumaro Debles!
Kol bare foreskre wudja krell lo soreles, un ap tumare tchawende tchiwas lo peskri bacht.
Kek kurepen well an tumaro them, un o latcheder djob dell lo tumen te chal.
Job penell, hoi te djal ap i phub. Un sik djal kowa, hoi penas lo.
Jaake mukell lo gib te perell, parno har bakrengro bal, un witsrell djajedo pani har jagakri tchik.
Bare brishineskre barra witsrell lo ap i phub; un bitchrell baro shilapen. Koon nai atchell an kawa shilapen?
Job penell i lab, un o gib well pani; job bitchrell i ducho, hoi phurdell pral i phub, un o pani, hoi djajedo his, nashella palle.
O Jakobeskre menshen mukell lo peskro lab te shunell; un ap i Israelitarja penell lo, hoi lo lendar kamell, un dell len peskre tchatchepaskre laba.
Kowa kras lo kek wawar menshenge. Leskre tchatchepaskre laba prindjrenn jon gar. Sharedo well o baro Dewel!
Halleluja! Sharenn o baro Debles, tumer an o bolepen! Sharenn les, tumer kai han dur pral an o bolepen!
Tumer tsele bolepangre, sharenn les! Tumer leskre kurepangre, sharenn les!
Tumer, kham un tchon, sharenn les! Ninna tumer bolepangre momlia, sharenn les!
Tu, o pralstuno bolepen, share les! Tu, o pani, hoi pral o bolepen hi, share les!
Tumer lauter, sharenn o baro Debles! Job rakras, un jon wan kerdo.
Job tchiwas len ap pengro drom. Un kote atchenn le hako tsireske. Job penas lenge, har dur nai djan le, un jon nai stakrenn gar wergel.
Sharenn o baro Debles, tumer kai han tele ap i phub: bare panjengre vieche un lauter, hoi an i telstune panja djiwella;
jag, brishineskre barra, gib un jagakro ducho, un o sorelo phurdepen, hoi krell, hoi job penell.
Sharenn les, tumer bare un tikne berge; tumer ruka, ap kolende rukengre baro wenna chapaske, ninna tumer subjengre ruka,
tumer diwje vieche un khereskre vieche, tikne vieche un tchirkle!
Sharenn les, tumer bare raja ap kai phub tumare menshentsa, tumer pralstune un tchatchepangre raja;
terne mursha un terne tcha, phure un terne!
Kolla lauter mu sharenn o baro Debleskro lab. Leskro lab hi bareder har i tsele wawar laba. Leskro railepen djal pral i phub un o bolepen.
Job das peskre menshende i soor pral i wawar menshende. Sharenn les, tumer, leskre menshe, tumer dran o Israel, kai han pash leste. Sharedo well o baro Dewel!
Sharedo well o baro Dewel! Giwenn o baro Debleske i newi gili! Sharenn les kote, kai leskre menshe khetne wenna!
Tu Israel, tiro dji mu bashrell pral koleste, kai kras tut. Tumer menshe dran Zion, giwenn i bachtjatar pral tumaro baro rajeste.
Sharenn leskro lab an tumaro khelepen! Bashrenn leske ap i pauka un i harfa!
O baro Dewel dikell latches ap peskre menshende. Job well kolenge ap i rig, kai tele rikedo hi un hadell len pre.
Kolla, kai leskre hi, mu giwenn i bachtjatar! Ninna an i rati mu sharenn le les un hadenn le les.
Lengre muja denn bari gole, te sharenn le pengro Debles. An lengre wasta well len i charo, hoi ap dui rigja tchinella,
jaake te denn le i menshen an wawar themma pale, hoi kolla ap lende kran, un anenn i phagi pral i natsjone.
Lengre bare rajen pandenn le an shelle, lengre pralstunen an sasterne shelle,
un anenn o tchatchepen pral lende, har kowa tchinlo hi an o Debleskro lab. Jaake well o railepen o Debleskre menshendar diklo. Sharedo well o baro Dewel!
Halleluja! Sharenn o Debles an peskro baro kheer! Sharenn les, ko soreles an o bolepen!
Sharenn les koleske, hoi job lauter kras! Sharenn leskro baro railepen!
Sharenn les o bashepah ap i bare phurdepangre! Sharenn les o bashepah ap i dorjengre bashepangre!
Sharenn les o bashepah ap i pauke, un khelenn leske! Sharenn les o bashepah ap i dorjengre bashepangre un tikne phurdepangre!
Sharenn les o bashepah ap i zimbale, hoi denn sawi gole, har te giwell i djuwel un har te giwell i mursh.
Lauter, koles ducho hi, sharell o baro Debles! Halleluja!
An kau liil hi i gosewe laba o Davideskro tchawestar, o Salomestar. Job his i baro rai pral o Israel.
Kal laba sikrenn mende, hoi tchatcho goswepen hi, te nai haiwas, hoi men dureder anell, un hoi gosewo rakepen kamell te penell.
Kol laba sikrenn mende, har te djiwas mishto un tchatcho, har te djiwas i djipen kek chochepah, un har te djas ap o tchatcho drom.
Jaake wenn ninna kolla gosewo, kolen tchi an o shero hi. Un terne mursha haiwenn, hoi hunte krenn le, un dikenn dren, hoi mishto hi.
Kolla, kai gosewo hi, shunenn, har te wenn le gomme gosweder. Kolla, kai siklo hi, hatsenn, har te djan le pengro drom.
Jon nai haiwenn gosewe laba, un rakepen, kai o tchatchepen dren khatedo hi, awa, laba, kai gosewe menshe penan, un sawe, kai hunte rodess, hoi jon kamenn te penell.
Glan halauter hunte djiwess o baro Debleha, te kameh gosewo te well. Koneske o goswepen tchi moldo hi, un koon kamell tchi te djinell, hi dinelo.
Miro tchawo, shun ap i laba, hoi tiro dad tuke penell! De jak ap kowa, hoi tiri dai tutar kamell!
Kowa hi tuke har i shukar stadi ap tiro shero, har i werkli trul tiri meen.
I tchilatche, te penenn le: ‘Dik, hoi krah!’ Palle dja gar koi!
Jon nai penans: “Am mentsa! Mer lurah jekes pre un marah les. Mer nai hatsams sawen, kai kek tchilatchepen an lengro shero hi. Kolen lah palla, te well men tchomone sapaske.
Mashkral dran lengro djipen las len win, un bitchras len tele pash i mulende an o mulengro them!
Tchoras kutch koowa menge, te kras mare khera pherdo kolestar.
Ab mentsa! Hakeno mendar lell jaake bud har ko wawar.”
Miro tchawo, ma dja lentsa ap lengro drom! Rike tut krik lendar!
Jon denn an i herja, te krenn le tchilatchepen. Sik nashenn le, te marenn le menshen.
Tchitcheske well i netsa glan i tchirkle pre-pandlo. Jon dikenn lat un djan gar dren.
Hi gar jaake kal murshentsa: Jon kamenn i wawaren te marell, un haiwenn gar, te perenn le kokres an pengri netsa.
Jaake djal hakeneske, kai kamell o wawareskro brawlepen te lell. Sawo mensho lell peske kokres o djipen.
O goswepen hi har i dai, kai kharell ap i dromma, un dell gole ap i forjengre platse.
Joi mukell pes glan i bare wudja an o foro te shunell, un kote, kai bud menshe khetne wenn:

Tumer, kolen tchi an o shero hi: Har rah kamenn tumer dinelo koowa te krell? Tumer sapangre, har rah kamenn tumer pral o wawareste te sal un les praassell? Tumer dinele, har rah penenn: Mer kamah gar te djinell, hoi tchatcho hi?
Te shunans ap mande, har dom tumen trad, sikroms tumende, hoi an miro dji hi, un mukoms tumen mire laba te haiwell.
Har kharom tumen, kaman gar te shunell. Har hadom miro wast, dan tumer gar jak.
Tumer mukan tumen tchi te penell, un dan gar jak ap kowa, hoi penom.
Jaake kamau me ninna te sal, te well i bibacht pral tumende, awa, me sau, te well kowa, hoi darenna,
un well pral tumende har i sorelo baro ducho; te well i bibacht pral tumende har i phurdepen, hoi lauter khetne phagell; te well i pharo tsiro un bari daar pral tumende.
Palle denn le pal mande gole, un me mukau tchi mandar te shunell. Palle rodenn le man un hatsenn man gar.
Jon kaman o tchatchepen gar te djinell, un gar o baro Debleha te djiwell.
Har penom lenge, hoi lenge latcho hi, kran le kowa gar. Har dom len trad, dikan le krik.
Doleske hunte chan le, hoi ap lengre dromma bares was. un wenn tchalo kolestar, hoi an lengre sherja trujel djas.
Kolen tchi an o shero hi, kolla rissrenn o Debleske o dumo; un kowa anell lenge o merepen. Un lengro pre-phurdepen marell len.
Koon ap mande shunell, nai djiwell kek darjah, un leskro dji hunte darell kek bibacht.
Miro tchawo, shun ap mire laba, un rike tut ap kowa, hoi me tuke penom,
de jak ap o goswepen, un kre tiro dji pre, te haiwess lauter mishto!
Mange mandar goswepen, un putch man, hoi te kress!
Rode pal miro goswepen, har te rodals rup un i khatedo brawlepen!
Palle haiweh, har nai djiweh o baro Debleha, un prindjreh les bud un budeder.
O baro Dewel hi kowa, kai dell goswepen. Lestar well, te djinell un haiwell i mensho bud koowa.
Kolen, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi, dell lo, hoi len hunte well. Un dell jak ap kolende, kai leskro drom djan, te krell lenge kek tchomone.
Job well ap i rig kolenge, kai krenn o tchatchepen, un rikrell peskre wasta pral kolende, kai djan ap leskro drom.
Palle haiweh, hoi glan o Debleste mishto un tchatcho hi, har nai djah ap leskro drom, un djiweh i djipen, hoi an leskre jaka latcho hi.
O Debleskro goswepen well an tiro dji, un hoi job tute sikrell, hi tuke shukar.
Un tu deh jak, har te djiwess, un djineh, hoi mishto hi,
un weh gar ap i tchilatcho drom, un shuneh gar ap i menshende, kai chochepen rakrenna,
un o tchatcho drom mukan, un i djipen an o tchilatchepen djiwenn.
Lenge hi shukar, te krenn le tchilatcho koowa, un jon sanenn, te krenn le djungelo koowa.
Lengre dromma hi bango, o tchatcho dromestar djan le tele.
Ma kre har jon, te peress gar dren ap i shukar laba i djuwjatar kai i wawareskri romni hi,
un mukas peskro romes, koleha li khetne djas har li terno his, un bistras, hoi li peskro romeste sowel das glan lakro Debleste.
Te djah an lakro kheer, weh ap i drom, hoi djal an o merepen. Lakre dromma djan an o mulengro them.
Hakeno, kai djal pash late dren, well gar buder pale, un well gar ap o drom, hoi an o djipen anell.
Doleske dja tu o drom, kai i latche djana, un atch an o tchatchepen tardo.
Kolla, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi, un o Debleskro drom djan, djiwenn an kau them un atchenn koi dren.
Kolla, kai o tchilatchepen krenn un o Debles mukenn, wenn win tradedo dran o them, jaake te hatseh buder kek lendar.
Miro tchawo, ma biste kowa, hoi tuke sikrom, rike mire laba an tiro dji!
Jaake well tut i lengsto djipen, un tire djipaskre bersha wenn pherdo latchepen.
Djib hako tsiro an o latchepen un an o tchatchepen! Pande mire laba har i werkli trul tiri meen, un tchin len an tiro dji!
Palle hal latcho un gosewo glan i jaka o Deblestar un i menshendar.
Tchip tiro tselo dji ap o baro Debleste! Ma pats, kai djineh kokres, hoi mishto un tchatcho hi!
Rike tut ap o baro Debleste, hoi tu ninna kreh! Un job krell tiro drom tchatcho glan tute.
Ma ab gosewo an tire jaka! Muk o baro Dewel tiro rai te well, un rike tut krik i tchilatche dromma!
Kowa dell tut sastepen un newi soor.
De o baro Debleste tiro brawlepastar un ko feteder kolestar, hoi tuke khetne anal, jaake hadeh leskro lab.
Palle wenn tire djobengre khera pherdo djob, un tiri bari moljakri piri jaake pherdo, te nashell i mool pral.
Miro tchawo, ma dik tchilatches, te dell tut o baro Dewel i phagi! Ma naash lestar krik, te dell lo tut trad.
Kones o baro Dewel o djijestar kamell, koles dell lo, jaake har i dad peskro tchaweha krell, ap koleste job latches dikell.
Har bachtelo hi ko mensho, kai o goswepen hatsas, kowa, kai djinell, hoi mishto hi.
Te hi tut goswepen, hi kowa budeder moldo, har te well tut rup un sonakai.
O goswepen hi kutcheder har mirklia. Awa, tchi, hoi kamals, te well tut, hi jaake bud moldo har o goswepen.
An peskro tchatcho wast, rikrell o goswepen i lengsto djipen tuke, peskro serwo wasteha dell lo tut brawlepen un railepen.
O goswepen anell ap shukar dromma, kai dell kek tchingepen.
Har i ruk, hoi o djipen dell, hi o goswepen hakeneske, kai les an peste pre-lell. Bachtele hi lauter, kai o goswepen an pengre djia rikrenn.
O baro Dewel kras i phub o goswepah, un o bolepen jaake, har job djinas, kai kowa mishto his.
Leskri goswepah mukas lo pani te well dran i phub un brishin dran o bolepen.
Miro tchawo, muk o goswepen gar dran tire jaka! Rike tut ap kowa, hoi mishto un gosewo hi!
Kowa dell tiro djipen soor un krell les shukar har i werkli trul tiri meen.
Jaake nai djah soreles tiro drom, un pereh gar pral i barra, hoi kote tchiddo hi.
Rati tchiweh tut tele kek darjah, un tu nai soweh mishto.
Tut hunte well kek daar glan i bibacht, hoi well sik, witar gar glan o merepen, hoi well pral kolende, kai kamenn o Deblestar tchi te djinell.
O baro Dewel hi pash tute. Job dell jak ap tute, te stakress gar an i khatede dorja, hoi kamenn tut te taprell.
Te hi tut latcho koowa, de ninna koleste, koles tchi hi.
Te nai deh les kowa kanna, ma pen ap leste: ‘Dja tuke un ab o wawar diwes pale! Palle kamau tut tchomone te dell’.
Ma le tuke glan, te kress tchilatchepen koleske, kai pash tute an o latchepen djiwell!
Ma tchinge tchitcheske jekeha, kai tuke tchi kras!
Ma dik silwe jakentsa ap jekeste, kai las pes i sorjah, hoi i wawareske his. Ma kre har job!
O baro Dewel dikell chojedes ap kolende, kai bange dromma djan. I maal hi lo kolenge, kai ap o tchatcho drom djan.
O baro Dewel tchiwell i bibacht ap o kheer i tchilatchendar, un bacht ap o kheer kolendar, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi.
Kolla, kai praassenn i wawaren, kolen praassell lo ninna. Kolla, kai krenn pen gar bares, ap kolende dikell lo latches.
Kolla, kai tchatchepah gosewo hi, wenna sharedo. Kolla, kai dinelo koowa krenn, hunte hidjrenn pengri ladj.
Mire tchawe, shunenn ap kowa, hoi me, tumaro dad, tumenge pashel anau. Denn jak ap mire laba, te wenn gosewo!
Mire laba hi latcho. Doleske ma bistrenn len!
Har me gomme i tikno tchawo homs pash miro dad, kek wawar tchawo his miri dat har man,
kote sikras lo man, har te djiwap, un penas: An tiro dji le mire laba pre un biste len gar! Rike ap mire laba, palle djiweh.
Kre lauter, te wess gosewo un haiwess, hoi mishto hi. Ma biste mire laba! Kre jaake, har tuke penom!
Ma muk o goswepen! Te hal gosewo, weh tu win lino dran o tchilatchepen. Te kameh o goswepen, hi lo har i sorelo kheer trul tute.
O feteder koowa, hoi nai leh, hi o goswepen. Doleske kre lauter, te less les!
Hidje o goswepen pral an tiro djipen, palle krell lo tut bares. Rike o goswepen soreles, palle dikenn i wawar pre ap tute.
Har i rajeskri stadi ap tiro shero hi o goswepen tuke. Awa, har i rajeskri stadi krell lo tut shukar.
Shun miro tchawo, un de jak ap miro rakepen, jaake te djiwess i lengsto djipen.
Me anau tut ap o drom, kai dikeh, har te djiwess gosewes. Me sikrau tut o tchatcho drom.
Ap kau drom hi tuke kek barra tchiddo, hoi tire herja nai pale rikrenn. Ninna te nasheh sik, hi tchi koi, pral koleste tu nai pereh.
Atch pash kowa, hoi tuke siklo was, muk kowa gar! Rike tut ap kol gosewe laba! Dran lende well tut i latcho djipen.
Ma dja ap o drom, kai i tchilatche djan! Ma kre har jon!
Muk lengro drom ap i rig tchiddo, ma dja ap leste! Risse tut lestar krik, un dja dureder!
Kol menshe nai sowenn gar jaake rah bis te kran le tchomone tchilatcho. Lenge well o sopen randedo, te anan le gar jekes an i bibacht.
Lengro tchilatcho koowa hi lengro chapen, hoi krell len tchalo. Jon djan i sorjah ap i wawarende pre. Un kowa hi lenge shukar har te pijenn le mool.
O drom kolendar, kai o tchatchepen krenn, hi har o kham, hoi taissarlakro pre djal, un o diwes anell un sorleder well bis te hi lo pralstunes tardo.
O drom kolendar, kai o tchilatchepen krenn, hi har i kali rat; jon nai dikenn gar, pral hoi jon perenn.
Miro tchawo, de jak ap kowa, hoi rakrau! Shun mishto ap mire laba!
Ma biste len! Rike len an tiro dji!
Kol laba anenn o djipen un o sastepen kolenge, kai len pre lenn.
De jak ap kowa, hoi patseh dur an tiro dji! Kolestar well o djipen.
Muk kek chochene laba dran tiro mui te well! Tiro rakepen te well mishto un tchatcho!
Muk tuke tchi an i jaka te well! Dik glan tute un gar tchatches un serwes!
De jak te djas i tchatcho drom! Un rake tiro djijeha pral lauter hoi kreh!
Dja gar tele kau dromestar, gar tchatches un gar serwes. Rike tire herja pale o tchilatcho dromestar!
Miro tchawo, de jak ap kol gosewe laba, hoi tuke penau! Shun ap kowa, hoi tuke pashel anau.
Palle haiweh hoi mishto hi, un tire laba sikrenn, kai hal gosewo.
O rakepen o wawareskri romni hi gudlo har gwin. Un lakre laba hi tuke shukar har latcho djet.
Pal kowa hi kowa, hoi tut latar hi, har i djungelo pipen un har i charo hoi ap dui rigja tchinell.
Joi tserdell tut peha an o merepen. Ko drom, kai li djal, anell an o mulengro them.
Joi djal gar ap o drom, kai anell o djipen. Lakro drom hi bango, un joi dikell kowa gar.
Doleske, mire tchawe, shunenn ap mande, un krenn, hoi tumenge penau!
Rike tiro drom dur krik latar! Ma dja pash o wudar lakro kherestar!
Te kreh tu kowa gar, nai well kowa jaake, te budreh i wawarenge, un deh tire feteder bersha kolende, kolen kek dji tuke hi.
Palle djiwenn wawar menshe tiro brawlepastar. Un kowa, hoi tu tuke jaake phares khetne lal, well an o wawareskro kheer.
Palle leh tu phares ducho, pereh khetne,
un peneh: “Har dinelo homs, har dom gar jak, hoi mange penlo was. Hoske shunom gar ap koleste, kai das man trad?
Hoske shunom gar ap mire sikepangre, un dom jak ap lengro rakepen?
Har sik nai woms an i bibacht! Un mire tsele menshe dikans kowa!”
Pi dran tiri brunna! Tut hi latcho pani, hoi nashella. Pi kolestar!
Kameh, te nashell tiro pani win ap o drom un an o foro?
Tuke kokres hi lo, un kek wawareske.
Ap tiro pani hi o Debleskri bacht tchiddo. Ab bachtelo pral tiri romjate, kolat romedineral, har terno hals.
I kamli wesheskri grumni hi li, i shukar diwji busni. Kokres mank lakre tchutchja tchiwess tut. Kokres an lakre mussja hatseh tiri bacht.
Miro tchawo, hoske rodeh tiri bacht pash i wawareskri romni? Hoske kameh i wawar romjat trujel te taprell?
O baro Dewel dikell, har hakeno djiwell. Kowa, hoi hakeno krella, djinell lo.
O tchilatcho koowa pandell koles, kai kowa krella. Leskri doosh hi har shelle, hoi les pandenn.
Sawo merella doleske, kai mukas job peske tchi te penell. Dran leskro dinlepen djal lo nashedo.
Miro tchawo, dal tu tiro dadeskro wast i wawareske un penal, te plaissreh koleskri sijaan?
Pandal tut tiro labeha? Hal tu pandlo an tiro rakepen, hoi dran tiro mui was?
Palle hal tu an o wawareskro wast, miro tchawo. Kanna kre lauter, te wess pale win! Dja pash leste, rake ap leste dren! Muk gar tele, te mangess lestar, te mukell lo tut win.
Rode kek sopen! Muk tire jaka gar dren te sowell!
Tserde tut win dran leskre wasta har i wesheskri busni dran i pandle dorja, un har i tchirklo dran o wast kolestar, kai tapras les.
Tu tchi-moldo, kai kameh gar te budrell, tuke penau: Dja pash i kiri, dik hawi budi joi krell! Un ab gosewo!
Kolat hi kek pralstuno, kek rai, kek, kai lake penell, hoi te krell li.
An i nijal anell li peskro chapen khetne. Un an ko tsiro, kai o djob dren anlo well, lell li peskro chapen khetne o tsireske, kai tchi dell.
Tu tchi-moldo, kai kameh gar te budrell, har rah kameh gomme tchiddo te atchell? Kaana kameh tu pre te stell?
Tu peneh: “Muk man gomme i tikno tsiro te sowell, i duito kopo i jaka te pandell, un i wasta an i gali te tchiwell.”
Un jaake well o tchorwlepen pral tute har i tchorepaskro, kai lell tuke lauter krik, hoi tut hi.
I tchilatcho mensho un i tchi-moldo hi kowa, kai chochepen rakrell,
kai i jakentsa dell, peskre herjentsa i sikepen krell, un i gustjentsa khatemen sikrell.
An peskro dji hidjrell lo tchilatchepen, un hako tsiro anell lo tchingepen.
Doleske well leskri bibacht sik pral leste. Sik hi lo dukedes ap i phub tchiddo, un kek sastepen hi leske koi.
Shob koowa hi, ap kolende dikell o baro Dewel chojedes; un i eftato koowa hi leske o djungleder:
jaka, kai dikenn tele ap i wawarende; i mui, hoi rakrell chochepen; wasta, hoi marenn sawen, kai kek tchilatchepen kran;
i dji, hoi tchilatcho koowa peske glan lell; herja, hoi sik tchilatcho koowa palla nashenn;
jek, kai tchomone ap i wawareste pre anell, hoi gar tchatcho hi; jek, kai anell tchingepen mank phralende.
Miro tchawo, rike tut ap i laba tiro dadestar! Ma biste ko drom, hoi tiri dai tute sikras.
Tchip lengre laba an tiro dji, pande len tuke trul tiri meen har i werkli.
Te djah, sikrenn le tuke o drom, te tchiweh tut, denn le ap tute jak. Un te steh pale pre, wenn le tuke an o shero.
Kowa, hoi tiro dad un tiri dai tuke pashel anan, hi har i momeli ap tiro drom. Te denn le tut trad, rikrenn le tut ap o drom, hoi o djipen anell.
Lengre laba rikrenn tut pale, te djas gar pash i romjate i wawarestar, te shuness gar ap i shukar laba i wawar djuwjatar.
Muk tiro dji gar lakro shukapen palla te nashell! Muk tut gar lakre shukar jakentsa te taprell!
Tu djineh, i lubjake hunte dess gar budeder har jek maro. I romjake i wawar murshestar hunte dess tiro djipen.
Nai hidjrell jek i jag tel peskre koola jaake te chatchenn le gar?
Nai nashell jek ap kasht, hoi chatchell, un chatchrell peskre pire gar?
Jaake djal koleske, kai pash i romjate i wawarestar djal. Hakeno, kai lat an-taprell, lell peskri phagi.
I ladj koleske, kai bokas un doleske tchoras

un palle tapedo was, hi gar jaake baro har koi ladj koleske, kai las pes i wawareskri romni. Ko tchorepaskro hunte dell efta kope jaake bud pale, har tchoras lo, ninna te hi kowa lauter, hoi les hi. Kowa, kai las peske i wawareskri romni, kowa hi narwelo. Sawo koowa krell kokres jek, kai kamell buder gar te djiwell.
Dawa un ladj perenn ap leste, un ko praassepen ap leste djal gar buder krik.
I rom, kai silwerell, leskri choli well baro. Un te well ko diwes, kai nai dell lo leske pale, hoi job leske kras, palle krell lo kowa un rikrell pes gar pale.
Job lell kek lowe, har bud les ninna kameh te dell, tchi nai deh, hoi les nai pale rikrell.
Miro tchawo, rike mire laba, un hoi tuke penom, khate an tiro dji!
Rike mire laba un tu djiweh, de jak ap lende har ap tiro jak!
Pande len trul tiro gushto, tchin len an tiro dji!
Dik ap o goswepen, har te wals lo tiri pheen, un ap gosewo rakepen, har te wals lo tiro feteder maal.
Te hal gosewo, rikreh tut pale i wawareskri romjatar, awa, i wawar djuwjatar, kai shukar laba rakrell.
His i diwes, kai homs tardo pash i wali miro kherestar un dikom win.
Ap o drom dikom bud terne murshen, un mank lende jek, koles tchi an o shero hi.
Job djas ap o drom kote, kai i dromma khetne wenna pash i kheer, kai i djuwel djiwell.
His tamlo un i rati was.
Koi dikom lat, koi djuwel, rido an i ripen har i lubni. Joi djal pash leste un djinell mishto, hoi lat glan hi.
Diwjo his li un bipandlo, te rikrell lat nai tchi an lakro kheer.
Ap i dromma, ap i platse un kote, kai i dromma khetne wenna was li diklo, har rodell li pal jekeste.
Un joi taprell ko terno murshes, tchumrell les, dikell leske an i jaka un penell ap leste:
Kau diwes anom o Debleske i viecho, jaake har leske sowel dom. Ko mass hi khere pash mande.
Doleske djom win, te rodap tut, un kate hatsom tut!
Me tchiwom shukar plachte ap miro tchiben, sawe plachte, hoi wan kerdo dran kutch than, hoi dran Egiptia wella.
Lom kutch panja, hoi latches sungenna pal Myrrhe, Aloe un zimto, un tchorom len ap o tchiben.
Ab, te kamas men i tseli rat, te was mer dui bachtelo hakeno an i mussja o wawarestar.
Miro rom hi gar khere; job djas krik ap i dur drom.
Leskri ladetsa bud lowentsa las lo peha, un well gar khere bis te o tchon pale pherdo hi.
Fothe joi ap leste dren rakras, kran kol bud laba les har mato, un lakro shukar rakepah tserdas li les peha.
Un job nashas lake palla, har i grumni, hoi gar djinell, te well li maredo, un jaake har i wesheskri busni, hoi stakrell an i dorja, hoi lat taprenn,
kai i failo lake an o dji tchurje dell. Ko terno mursheske djal jaake har i tchirklo, hoi an i netsa djal, un gar djinell, te hunte merell lo.
Doleske, mire tchawe, shunenn ap mire laba! Denn jak ap miro rakepen!
Ma nashe tiro dji ap sawi djuwjate! Ma dja lake palla!
Bud mursha kras li paash. Bud nashran dran late pengro djipen.
Lakro kheer hi o wudar an o mulengro them. Koon pash late djal, hi ap o drom an o merepen.
O goswepen hi har i dai, kai dell tut gole, har i pheen, kai mukell pes te shunell.
Pral pash o drom, hi li tardo, kote, kai i dromma khetne wenna.
Pash i foreskre wudja dell li gole, kote kai jek dran o foro win djal, un kote, kai jek an o foro dren djal:
Ap tumende lauterende dau gole, miro rakepen hi hakeneske ap kai phub.
Haiwenn tumer tchi? Palle denn jak ap gosewe laba! Han tumer dinelo? Palle dikenn dren, hoi tumenge mishto hi!
Shunenn, hoi rakrau! Me penau tumenge kutch laba. Un miro mui rakrell, hoi tchatcho hi.
Awa, miro rakepen hi o tchatchepen. Kamau te rakrap kek tchilatchepen. Kowa wals djungeles an mire jaka.
Lauter, hoi rakrau, hi tchatcho. An miro rakepen hi kek chochepen, tchi hoi gar tchatcho hi.
Koon haiwell, hoi mishto un gar mishto hi, kowa haiwell, te hi mire laba tchatcho. Un koon bud djinell, kowa dikell, te hi le o tchatchepen.
Mukenn tumen mandar te penell, har te djiwenn! Kowa hi tumenge feteder har te nashenn o rup palla! Rodenn, har te djinenn budeder. Kowa hi tumenge feteder har kutch sonakai.
O goswepen hi budeder moldo har kutch mirklia. Un tchi, koleske tiro dji nai palla nashell, hi jaake bud moldo har o goswepen.
Me hom o goswepen, un djinau, hoi tchatcho hi. un nai penau wawarenge, hoi lenge mishto hi.

Kowa, kai kamell o baro Debleha te djiwell, kowa kamell o tchilatchepen gar glan peskre jaka te dikell, kowa dikell gar tele ap o wawareste un phurdell pes gar pre, kowa djal gar i tchilatcho drom, un rakrell kek chochepen.
Mire labentsa sikrau jekeste o drom, un krau leskre jaka pre. Djinau, hoi mishto un gar mishto hi, un man hi i soor.
Mandar well i soor, hoi dau i bare rajenge. Mandar well, te nai rakrenn i tchatchepangre raja o tchatchepen win.
Mandar lenn i pralstune pengri soor, te penenn le i menshenge, hoi te krenn le. Mandar lenn i tchatchepangre raja pengri soor, te rakrenn le o tchatchepen win pral i menshende.
Me kamau kolen, kai man kamenn. Un kolla, kai rodenn man o djijestar, kolla hatsenn man ninna.
Brawlepen un barepen dau me, brawlepen, hoi atchella, un o tchatchepen well mandar.
Hoi tumer mandar lenn, hi feteder har o latcheder sonakai, kutcheder har o latcheder rup.
Kote, kai i menshe ap o tchatcho drom djan, un an o tchatchepen tardo hi, kote hom me ninna,
te dap kolen, kai man o djijestar kamenn, jaake bud, te nai djiwenn le mishto, te krap lengre khera pherdo brawlepen.
O baro Dewel kras man glan i rah tsiro. Glan hako wawar koowa kras lo man.
Me homs koi glan hako tsiro, har i phub gomme gar kerdo was.
Har i bare panja gomme gar koi his, wom boldo. Har i tikne panja gomme gar nashan, homs me.
Har i bare berge gomme gar tardo his, un i tikne berge gar kerdo his, wom me boldo.
O baro Dewel kras gomme gar i phub un o them, witar gar i tchik koi pre.
Me homs pashel, har kras lo o bolepen un koi platsa, kai dikell win, har te wans o bolepen un o baro pani kote khetne.
Har tchiwas lo i wolke ap o bolepen, un kras o pani an o telstunepen soreles,
har lo i panjenge penas ‘bis kate un gar dureder’, har lo i phub tardo kras,
kote homs leskro tchawo an leskri gali. Un job his bachtelo pral mande hako diwes. Un me khelom mange glan leste hako tsireske.
Ap i phub, hoi job kras, khelom, un miro dji sanas, har homs mashkral i menshende.
Doleske, mire tchawe, shunenn ap mande! Bachtele hi kolla, kai ap miro drom djana!
Shunenn, te dau tumen trad! Lenn kowa ap o dji un krenn, hoi penom!
Bachtelo hi ko mensho, kai shunell ap mande, kai hi tardo pash miro wudar hako diwes, un dell jak ap miro kheer.
Ko mensho, kai man hatsas, kowa hatsas o djipen, un o baro Dewel dikell latches ap leste.
Kowa, kai gar pash mande well, krell peskro djipen paash. Hakeno, kai kamell tchi mandar te djinell, hi ap o drom, hoi anell an o merepen.
O goswepen hi har i djuwel, kai mukas efta bare pesse kashta te tchinell un pre te tchiwell, un peskro kheer ap lende te krell.
Joi maras i grumjat, kras i mool mishto, un tchiwas tchare, khore, tchurja ap i chapaskri.
Palle bitchras li djuwjengre budepangre ap i pralstuni platsa an o foro, te denn le gole:
“Kones tchi an o shero hi, kowa well kate pash mande!” Ap o narweleste, penell li:
Ab, cha miro maro un pi i mool, hoi me krom!
Ma dja kolentsa, kolen tchi an o shero hi! Palle djiweh. Dja kolentsa, kai gosewe hi!
Te kameh i pre-phurdes tchomone pashel te anell, palle praassell lo tut. Te peneh i tchilatcheske, te kras lo, hoi gar mishto hi, palle dukell lo tut.
Te peneh i pre-phurdes, kai kowa, hoi lo kras, gar mishto hi, palle well lo chojedo ap tute. Te peneh i gosewes, kai kowa, hoi lo kras, gar mishto hi, palle kamell lo tut.
Pen i goseweske kowa, hoi job gar mishto kras! Palle well lo gomme gosweder. An koleske tchomone pashel, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi! Palle djinell lo gomme budeder.
Glan halauter hunte djiwess o baro Debleha, te kameh gosewes te well. Te prindjreh koles, kai o tchatcho Dewel hi, hal tu tchatchepah gosewo.
Me, o goswepen, dau tut i lengsto djipen, krau, te djiweh bud bersha.
Te hal gosewo, hi kowa tuke bud moldo. Te hal pre-phurdo, hunte hidjress kokres, hoi kowa tuke anell.
O dinlepen hi har i narweli, bi-pandli djuwel, kolat tchi an o shero hi.
Glan o wudar peskro kherestar hi li beshdo, pral ap i platsa an o foro.
Un penell ap hakeneste, kai koi djal un ap o tchatcho drom hi:
“Koles tchi an o shero hi, kowa well pash mande!” Un ap koleste, kai narwelo hi, penell li:
“Tchoredo pani hi gudlo! Un maro, hoi chah khatedo, hi o latcheder!”
Un job djinell gar, te hi kote i mule. Kolla, kai pash late wenn, hi ap ko drom, kai an o merepen djal.
