Kalla hi i gosewe laba o Salomestar. I gosewo tchawo krell peskro dades un peskri dat bachtelo. I dinelo tchawo krell, te well lenge ropaske.
Tchoredo brawlepen hi tchitcheske. O tchatchepen lell tut dran o merepen win.
O baro Dewel mukell i latches gar te bokell. Krik pestar tradell lo ko tchilatches, koles bok pral bud koowa hi.
Koon peskre wasta an i gali tchiddo mukell, kowa well tchorwelo. Koon bud budrell, kowa well brawelo.
Koon nijaleske peskro djob dren anell, hi i gosewo tchawo. Koon sowell an ko tsiro, kai o djob dren anlo well, kowa hi i tchawo, koleske peskro dad pes hunte ladjell.
O Debleskri bacht hi tchiddo ap koleste, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi. An o rakepen i tchilatchendar hi lengro djungelo koowa khatedo.
Latche menshe wenn gar bistedo. Kowa, hoi le kran, hi o Debleskro latchepen. I tchilatche wenn bistedo.
Koles, kai i gosewo dji hi, rikrell pes ap kol laba, hoi leske penlo wan. jek, kai dinelo koowa rakrell, nashrell halauter.
Kowa, kai an o tchatchepen djiwell, hunte darell gar. Kowa, kai ap bange dromma djal, well tapedo.
Kowa, kai i jakentsa dell, dukrell i wawaren. Kowa, kai dinelo koowa rakrell, nashrell halauter.
Har i brunna dran kolate djido pani nashell, jaake hi i laba kolestar, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi. Pal i laba i tchilatchendar hi lengro djungelo koowa khatedo.
Dran choli well tchingepen. Koon o wawares o djijestar kamell, bistrell leskro tselo tchilatcho koowa.
Kowa, kai haiwell, hoi mishto un gar mishto hi, rakrell gosewe laba. Koles, kai tchi an o shero hi, kowa lell dawa.
Gosewe menshe rodenn pal kowa, te djinenn le bud koowa. O rakepen i dinelestar anell sik an i bibacht.
O brawlepen i brawelestar hi leske har i sorelo kheer. I bibacht o tchorwelestar hi leskro tchorwlepen.
I budi kolestar, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi, anell leske doha djipaske. I chocheno kras peskro brawlepah tchilatcho koowa.
Kowa, kai shunell ap koleste, kai dell les trad, kowa djal ap o drom, hoi anell o djipen. Kowa, kai kamell gar te shunell, hi ap i drom, kai djal lo nashedo.
Koles hi i chocheno mui, kai peskri choli ap i wawareste khatrell. Un kowa, kai chochepen pral i wawareste rakrell, hi i dinelo.
Koon bud laba krell, anell ninna doosh ap peste. Koon peskro mui rikrell, hi gosewo.
O rakepen kolestar, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi, hi har kutch rup. Kowa, hoi i tchilatches an o shero hi, hi tchi moldo.
O rakepen kolestar, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi, dell bud menshen newi soor. Kolen tchi an o shero hi, kolla merenn dran ko dinelo koowa, hoi le kran.
Te tchiwell o baro Dewel peskri bacht ap tute, weh tu brawelo. Un kowa, hoi tu koi pashel kreh, hi tchitcheske.
O dineleske hi shukar, te krell lo wi-ladjedo koowa. O gosewo mursheske hi shukar, te haiwell lo gomme budeder.
Kolestar i tchilatcho darell, kowa well pral leste. Un kowa, hoi i latche mangenna, kowa well lenge dino.
Har i sorelo ducho pral i phub phurdas, his o tchilatcho buder gar koi. Kowa, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi, atchell hako tsireske.
Har shut i dandenge, un jagakro ducho i jakenge, jaake hi o tchi-moldo, kai kamell gar te budrell, kolenge, kai les ap i budi bitchran.
Kowa, kai djiwell o baro Debleha, djiwell bud bersha. O djipen o tchilatchestar well tikneder.
Kowa, kai i latche pre dikenna, te well len, kowa well lenge dino; un jon wenn bachtelo. Kowa, kai i tchilatche pre dikenn, te well len, kowa well gar.
O drom o baro Deblestar hi har i sorelo kheer kolenge, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi. I tchilatchen anell lo an o merepen.
Kowa, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi, atchell hako tsiro soreles tardo. I tchilatche atchenn gar an o them.
Dran o mui kolestar, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi, wenn gosewe laba. I chocheni tchip well tele tchinlo.
O rakepen kolestar, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi, krell bachtelo. O rakepen i tchilatchendar dukrell.
I waga, hoi sikrell gar tchatches, har pharo tchomone hi, hi i djungelo koowa glan o baro Debleskre jaka. Job hi bachtelo pral koleste, kai plaissrell pal o tchatcho pharepen.
I pre-phurdo dji well sik an i ladj. I dji, hoi hadell pes gar, hi gosewo.
Lengro djudjo dji anell i latchen ap o tchatcho drom. Ko midjak koowa, hoi i phukepangre krenn, well ap lende pale un phagell len.
O brawlepen hi i brawelenge tchi moldo ap ko diwes, kai o Debleskri choli pral i menshende well. Kol menshe, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi, wenn win lino dran o merepen.
Ko tchatcho koowa, hoi o Debleskre menshe krenna, krell lengre dromma tchatcho. Ko tchilatcho nashrell pes an peskro tchilatcho koowa.
Ko tchatcho koowa, hoi o Debleskre menshe krenna, lell len win dran o merepen. I phukepangre wenn tapedo an pengri bok pal i lowe.
Ap ko diwes, kai merell o tchilatcho, merell ninna kowa, kai lo peskro dji pre tchiwas. Kowa, hoi leske bud moldo his, hi tchitcheske.
Kowa, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi, well win lino dran i bibacht. Un pal leste well ko tchilatcho koi dren.
Jek, kai kamell tchi o Deblestar te djinell, anell peskro rakepah i wawaren o Debleskro dromestar tele. Kolla, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi, lenn pengro gosewo rakepah wawaren dran o merepen win.
Te djal i latchenge mishto, palle hi i menshe an o tselo foro bachtelo. I tchilatche, te merenn le, denn le an o foro gole i bachtjatar.
O Debleskre menshe anenn o Debleskri bacht pral o foro. Un o foro well sorelo. Dran o mui i tchilatchendar well sau rakepen, hoi phagell o foro tele.
Koon praassell o wawares, hi narwelo. I gosewo mursh rikrell peskro mui.
Kowa, kai djungelo koowa pral i wawarende rakrell, phukrell, hoi lo tchorchanes shunas. I mursh o labestar rikrell kowa peske.
Kote, kai kek an o them hi, kai i menshenge o drom sikrell, djan le tele. Kote, kai bud penenn, har nai dureder djal, djal i menshenge mishto.
Kowa, kai peskro dadeskro wast das, te plaissrell lo i wawareskri sijaan, koles khaitell kowa, hoi lo kras. Koon kowa gar kamell te krell, koleske djal feteder.
I kamli djuwel well sharedo. Un i mursh, kai haiwell pes te kurell, well brawelo.
Kowa, kai latcho ap o wawareste hi, krell peske kokres mishto. Kowa, kai o wawares dukrell, dukrell pes kokres.
I tchilatcho mensho lell peske sau koowa khetne, hoi leske gar atchell. Koon an o tchatchepen peskri budi krell, lell i plaissepen, hoi atchell.
Te kreh o tchatchepen, hal ap o drom an o djipen. Te nasheh o tchilatchepen palla, djah ap o drom an o merepen.
O baro Dewel dikell chojedes ap kolende, kolen dui djia hi. Latches dikell lo ap kolende, kai o tchatcho drom djan.
Tu nai deh tiro wast koi pre: O tchilatcho lell peskri phagi. Kolla, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi, wenn win lino dran o merepen.
I shukar djuwel, kai djinell gar, hoi tchatcho hi, hi har i sonakaskri gustri an o nak i balestar.
Kowa, hoi kolla kamenn, kai o tchatchepen krenn, anell lenge latchepen. Un kowa, hoi i tchilatche kamenn, anell lenge o Debleskri choli.
Kote hi jek, kowa dell un dell; un job lell budeder un budeder. Un kote hi i wawar, kowa hi tchinlo un dell tchi; un well tchorwleder.
Kones i baro dji i wawarenge hi, koleske well jaake bud dino, te well lo budeder har tchalo. Un kowa, kai i trusheles pani dell, koles well ninna pani dino.
Kowa, kai djob pale rikrell, pral koleste rakrenn le bibacht win. Un bacht rakrenn le win pral koleste, kai djob bikrell.
Kowa, kai kamell o tselo djijeha o latchepen te krell, ap koleste dikenn le latches. Kowa, kai o tchilatchepen rodell, ap koleste well kowa.
Kowa, kai tchiwell peskro dji ap peskro brawlepen, merell tele har patria. Kolenge, kai krenn o tchatchepen, djal mishto har i senelo ruk.
Kowa, kai gar jak dell ap peskro kheer un ap peskri familja, pral koleste well i phurdepen, hoi lauter krik phurdell. Un ko dinelo well palle o budepaskro kolestar, koles i gosewo dji hi.
Kowa, hoi i latcho un tchatcho mensho krell, hi har i ruk, hoi o djipen dell. Ko mensho, kai gosewo hi, tserdell wawar menshen ap peskri rig.
Djiness, i latcho mensheske ap kai phub well o latchepen pale dino, hoi lo kras. Har bud budeder well palle o tchilatchepen pale dino kolenge, kai o tchilatchepen kran un o Debleskro drom mukan.
Koleske, kai kamell gosewo te well, hi shukar, te well leske penlo, hoi lo gar mishtes kras. Kowa, kai mukell pes tchi te penell, atchell dinelo.
Ap i latcho mensheste dikell o baro Dewel latches. Pral koleste, koles o tchilatchepen glan hi, rakrell lo i phagi win.
O tchilatchepen dell kekes i soor, te atchell lo soreles tardo. Kowa, kai an o tchatchepen hi, atchell soreles tardo har i ruk bare drabentsa.
I romni, kai peskri budi mishto krell, hi peskro romeske har shereskro sonakai. I romni, kai anell ladj ap peskro romeste, hi har i djungelo nasslepen an leskre kokale.
O Debleskre menshe kamenn o tchatchepen te krell. Tchilatche menshen hi tchi an o shero har chochepen.
I tchilatchengre laba kamenn jekes an o merepen te anell. O rakepen kolendar, kai o tchatcho drom djan, lell len dran o merepen win.
I tchilatche wenn tele witsedo un hi gar buder koi. O kheer kolendar, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi, atchell tardo.
Kones gosewo koowa an o shero hi, kowa well sharedo. Kones dinelo koowa an o shero hi, ap koleste dikenn le tele.
Hi feteder, te hi jek tchorwelo un hunte djal ap i budi, har te krell pes jek bares un les hi gar doha chapaske.
Kowa, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi, les hi i dji peskre viechenge. I tchilatchen hi kek dji lenge.
Koon ap peskro kotar phub budrell, koleske well bud maro. Koon sawo koowa pal nashell, hoi tchi moldo hi, kowa hi narwelo.
Tchilatche menshenge hi shukar, te krenn le midjak koowa. Kolla, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi, hi soreles tardo un krenn latcho koowa.
O tchilatcho taprell pes kokres an peskre chochene laba. Kolla, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi, wenn win dran i bibacht.
Koon latchepen rakrella, djiwell ninna latches. I mensho lell pale, hoi lo peskre wastentsa krell.
O drom, kai o dinelo djal, hi an leskre jaka tchatcho. I gosewo mensho shunell ap kowa, hoi wawar leske penenn, te krell lo.
Koon peskri choli sik sikrell, hi dinelo. Koon krell, har te shunals lo o praassepen gar, kowa hi gosewo.
I mursh o labestar rakrell o tchatchepen win. I chocheno, kai dell glan, te penell lo, hoi lo dikas un shunas, anell chochepen pre.
Laba, hoi sik win rakedo wenna, nai denn tchurje har i charo. O rakepen i gosewe menshendar anell sastepen.
O tchatcho rakepen atchell hako tsireske. Chochene laba rikrenn gar rah.
Chochepen hi an i djia kolendar, kai tchilatcho koowa win krenn. Kolla, kai jaake rakrenn, te well kek tchingepen pre, wenn bachtelo.
Kek tchilatcho koowa well ap kolende, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi. Ap i tchilatchende well bud bibacht.
O baro Dewel dikell chojedes ap kolende, kai chochenna. Latches dikell job ap kolende, kai krenn o tchatchepen.
Jek, kai gosewo hi, sikrell gar, har bud job djinell. I dinele denn pengro dinlepen win gole.
Koon bud budrell, well o rai pral wawar. Koon peskre wasta an i gali tchiddo mukell, well i budepaskro, un hunte budrell tel dawa.
I pharo dji tserdell i menshes tele. I latcho lab krell les bachtelo.
Kowa, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi, hatsell peskro drom. I tchilatchen anell pengro drom kote, kai djan le nashedo.
Koon peskre wasta an i gali tchiddo mukell, hatsell tchi, hoi job nai chals. Koles, kai bud budrell, hi bud chapaske.
O djipen hi kote, kai djan le ap o tchatcho drom. Kau drom hi mishto kerdo un anell gar an o merepen.
I gosewo tchawo shunell ap peskro dadeste, te penell job leske, hoi lo gar mishto kras. I pre-phurdo sal un shunell ninna gar, te well lo trad dino.
I latcho mensho djiwell ko latchepastar, hoi dran leskre laba wella. I phukepangre bokenna pal o kurepen.
Kowa kai ap peskro rakepen jak dell, kowa dell jak ap peskro djipen. Koles i baro mui hi, kowa tserdell bibacht ap peste.
Kowa, hoi jek kamell, kai kamell gar te budrell, well les gar. Kolenge, kai bud budrenn, hi doha koi.
O chocheno rakepen hi djungeles glan i jaka kolestar, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi. O tchilatcho krell praassedo koowa un wi-ladjedo koowa.
Lengro tchatcho koowa anell kolen dran i bibacht win, kai kek doosh ap lende hi. I doosh i tchilatchendar anell len an i bibacht.
Kote hi jek, kai krell, har te wals lo brawelo. Un les hi tchi. Un kote hi jek, kai krell, har te wals lo tchorwelo. Un les hi bud brawlepen.
I brawelo nai ginell peskro djipen win. I tchorweleste dell kek trad. Pash leste hi tchi te lell.
Koon an o tchatchepen tardo hi, hi har i momeli, hoi bachteles chatchell, un i tchilatcho har i momeli, hoi djal win.
Mank i pre-phurde hi hako tsiro tchingepen. Te hal gosewo, mukeh tuke tchomone te penell.
O brawlepen, hoi sik khetne lino was, djal ninna sik pale krik. Kowa, kai anell lokes peskre lowe khetne, lell budeder un budeder.
Te dikell jek i rah tsiro ap tchomone, un kowa well gar, well leskro dji pharo. Te well kowa, ap hoi jek jaake rah dikas, palle djiwell leskro dji pale pre.
Koleske, kai i latcho lab i herjentsa stakrell, djal djungeles. Koleske, kai rikrell pes ap ko lab, djal mishto.
I laba, hoi i gosewo rakrell, hi har djipaskro pani, un sikrenn hawo drom jek hunte djal, te perell lo gar an o merepaskre shelle.
Kol menshe, kai haiwenn, hoi hunte kerdo well, hatsenn mala. I phukepangre djan i drom, kai anell len an i bibacht.
Hakeno, kai gosewo hi, krell tchi, te rakras lo gar peskro djijeha pral kowa. I dinelo mensho dell peskro narwlepen win gole.
I tchilatcho bitchepaskro anell bibacht. I bitchepaskro o labestar rakrell jaake, te well lauter pale mishto.
An tchorwlepen un ladj well kowa, kai mukell pes tchi te penell. An-diklo well kowa, kai shunell, te well lo trad dino.
Te well kowa, hoi jek jaake rah kamas, hi lo bachtelo. I dinele choirenn pen, te hunte mukenn le pengro tchilatcho drom.
Kowa, kai khetne hi kolentsa, kai gosewo hi, kowa well ninna gosewo. Kowa kai i maal hi i dinelentsa, kowa well bibachtelo.
Kolla, kai o Debleskro dromestar tele djan, kolen lell i bibacht palla un taprell len. Kolla, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi, lenn latcho koowa.
Kowa, hoi i latcho mursh pale mukell, well dureder dino leskre tchawende un tchawengre tchawende. O brawlepen kolestar, kai an o tchilatchepen djiwas, lell kowa, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi.
Bud djob well bares ap i phub i tchorwelenge. Lengro tchatchepen lenn le gar, un bud merenn i bokatar.
I dad, kai peskro tchaweste kek phagi dell, krell leske gar mishto. Koon les kamell o djijestar, kowa rikrell pes gar pale, te dell lo les i phagi.
Koles, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi, hi doha chapaske. O per i tchilatchestar bokella.
I gosewi djuwel krell, te well lakro kheer soreles tardo. I dineli djuwel phagell les peskre wastentsa tele.
Kowa, kai kamell o baro Debleha te djiwell, djal o tchatcho drom. Koon tchi lestar kamell te djinell, djal ap bange dromma.
O rakepen o dinelestar sikrell peskro pre-phurdepen. I laba i gosewendar hi har wasta trul leste, hoi rikrenn len.
Kote, kai kek grumja hi, well kek djob dren anlo. I sorjah i grumjendar aneh bud djob dren.
Te penell i mursh o labestar, hoi lo dikas un shunas, rakrell lo o tchatchepen. Te penell i chocheno, hoi lo dikas un shunas, anell lo chochepen pre.
I pre-phurdo, te rodell lo o goswepen, hatsell lo les gar. Kowa, kai peskro djijeha rakrell, koleske hi gar phares tchomone dren te dikell.
Ma dja khetne i narweleha! Tu shuneh lestar tchi wawar har dinelo koowa.
O gosewo dell jak har lo djiwell, doleske hi lo gosewo. I narwele perenn hako kopo ap dinlepen dren. Un jaake chochenn le pen kokres.
I dinele sanenn pral i doosh, hoi jon ap pende anan. O Dewel dikell latches ap kolende, kai o tchatcho drom djan.
Ko mensho, koleskro dji rowell, hi kokres. Un ninna te stell leskro dji i bachtjatar, nai haiwell kek wawar tchatchepah leskri bacht.
O kheer o tchilatchestar well tele phagedo, i familjake kolestar, kai djal o tchatcho drom, djal mishto un well bareder.
Hi menshe koi, kai patsenn, kai lengro drom o tchatcho drom hi, un djinenn gar, kai anell lo len an o merepen.
Ninna te sal jek, nai rowell o dji. Un pal o sapen well o ropen.
Koon bange dromma djal, koleske djal jaake, har lo djiwas. Ninna i latcho mursheha hi jaake: job lell pale pal kowa, hoi job kras.
Koles tchi an o shero hi, kowa patsell hako lab, hoi jek ap leste rakrell. Kones i gosewo dji hi, kowa dell jak, hoi lo krell un kai lo djal.
O gosewo darella un rikrell pes pale o tchilatchepastar. O dinelo well sik chojedo un patsell, te nai djal leske kek tchilatchepen.
Koon sik an i choli well, krell jek dinelo koowa pal o wawar. Un koon lell pes tchilatchepen glan, pral koleste hi le chojedo.
Kolen tchi an o shero hi, lenna pale, hoi dran lengro dinlepen well. O gosewo djinell bud. Kowa hi leske har i rajeskri stadi, hoi krell les shukar.
I tchilatche hunte witsrenn pen tele glan i latchende. Awa, jon hunte witsrenn pen tele glan i wudja kolendar, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi.
Kek kamell o tchorweles, witar gar kowa, kai pash leste hi. O braweles hi bud mala.
Kowa kai ap o wawareste tele dikell, anell doosh ap peste. Bachtelo well kowa, koles i dji i tchorwelenge hi.
Kolen, kai tchilatchepen an o shero hi, kolla djan nashedo. Kolla, kai kamenn o latchepen te krell, kolenge hi i wawar menshe latches un rikrenn ap lende.
Kote, kai budrenn le, wenn le ninna plaissedo. Kote, kai rakepen hi un tchi wawar, hi len gar doha djipaske.
O goswepen hi har shereskro sonakai i gosewenge. Ap o shero i narwelendar hi lengro dinlepen har i stadi.
Kowa, kai dureder penella an o tchatchepen, hoi lo dikas un shunas, kowa lell menshen dran o merepen win. Kowa, kai anell chochepen ap i wawareste pre, hi i chocheno.
Kowa, kai djiwell o baro Debleha, koles hi soor an o dji. Ninna pral leskre tchawende rikrell o baro Dewel peskre wasta.
Kowa, kai o baro Debleha djiwell, nai djiwell kek darjah. Job rikrell peskre herja pale, te perell lo gar an i dorja, hoi tserdenn les an o merepen.
Te hi i baro rajes bud menshe, palle hi lo sorelo. Te hi les gar bud menshe, djal lo tele.
Kowa, kai gar sik chojedo well, hi gosewo. Koon sik chojedo wella, sikrell har dinelo job hi.
Shukapen an o dji krell o tselo menshes sasto. I dji, hoi silwerell, hi har i nasslepen, hoi i kokale pre chal.
Koon sorjah i tchorweles tele rikrell, kowa praassell koles, kai o tchorweles kras. Kones leske i baro dji hi, sharell o Debles.
O tchilatcho well tele witsedo dran leskro tchilatchepen. Kowa, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi, koleskro patsepen rikrell les ninna gomme an o merepen.
O goswepen hi khere an o dji kolestar, kai haiwell, hoi mishto un gar mishto hi. An i dinelengre djia hi kek goswepen.
Te well hakeneste peskro tchatchepen dino an jek them, palle well kau them an-diklo. Kote, kai i menshe o tchatcho dromestar tele djan, hunte ladjenn le pen.
I baro rai dikell latches ap peskro budepaskro, kai lauter mishto haiwell. Un leskri choli well ap koleste, kai wi-ladjedo koowa krell.
I kamlo lab krell te djal o wawareskri choli pale. I lab, hoi o wawares dukrell, krell les chojedo.
O gosewo rakrell jaake, te haiwenn i wawar, hoi mishto hi. Dran o narweleskro mui well tchi har dinlepen.
I jaka o baro Deblestar dikenn lauter, kowa, hoi i tchilatche krenna, un kowa, hoi i latche krenna.
I latcho lab, hoi i wawares soor dell, hi har o ruk, hoi djipen della. I midjak lab phagell leskro dji.
O dinelo shunell gar ap leskro dadeste, te dell lo les trad. Kowa, kai shunell koi pre, hi gosewo.
Kowa, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi, les hi budeder har les hunte well djipaske. Kowa, hoi i tchilatcho khetne lell, anell leske bibacht.
I gosewengro rakepen sikrell i wawarende, hoi lenge mishto hi. Kowa, hoi i dinelen an o shero hi, hi tchi moldo.
O baro Dewel dikell chojedes ap kowa, hoi o tchilatcho leske anell. Te mangenn les kolla an, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi, dikell lo latches ap lengro mangepen.
O baro Dewel dikell chojedes ap kowa, hoi i tchilatche krenn. Koon peskro tselo djijeha o tchatchepen krell, koles kamell job.
Kolla, kai o Debleskro drom mukenn, lenn i phari phagi. Koon mukell pes tchi te penell, hunte merell.
O baro Dewel djinell, hoi hi an o telstunepen un an o mulengro them. Har bud budeder djinell job, hoi an i menshengre djia hi.
O pre-phurdo choirell pes pral koleste, kai leske penell, hoi lo gar mishto kras. Un job djal gar pash kolende, kai gosewo hi.
I bachtelo dji mukell o mujes te sal. Kones i pharo dji hi, koles hi tchi sapaske.
Jek, kai haiwell, hoi mishto un gar mishto hi, kowa rodell, har te djinell lo gomme budeder. O narwelo bokell pal dinelo koowa.
Kolen, kai i pharo dji hi, kolenge hi hake diwessa tchilatche. Jekes, kai shukapen an o dji hi, leskro dji giwell un bashrell hako diwes.
Hi feteder, te hal tchorwelo un djiweh o baro Debleha, har te hi tut i baro brawlepen un hunte daress halautereske.
Hi feteder te hi tut shacha te chal tire malentsa, har latcho grumjengro mass kolentsa, kai hi choli an lende.
I mursh an koleste choli hi, anell tchingepen. Jek, kai gar sik chojedo well, kowa lell i jag dran o tchingepen.
O drom kolendar, kai kamenn gar te budrell, hi pherdo subjengre burra. Kolenge, kai o tchatchepen krenn, hi kek barra an o drom tchiddo.
I gosewo tchawo krell peskro dades un peskri dat bachteles. I dinelo sal pral lende.
Kones tchi an o shero hi, kowa kamell narwelo koowa. I mursh, kai haiwell, hoi mishto un gar mishto hi, atchell ap o tchatcho drom.
Kowa, hoi jekes an o shero hi, djal gar mishto, te putchell lo gar i wawarendar, hoi jon patsenna. Kote, kai bud menshe hi, kai denn pengro goswepen pashel, kote djal mishto.
Bachtelo hi o mursh, te djinell lo, hoi te rakrell lo. Har latcho hi o tchatcho lab ap o tchatcho tsiro.
Kowa, kai haiwell, hoi mishto un gar mishto hi, koleske djal peskro drom pre an o djipen. Un job rikrell pes pale o dromestar, kai djal tele pash i mulende.
O baro Dewel phagell o kheer kolestar, kai pre-phurdo hi. Job dell jak, te lell kek koi phub i romjatar krik, kolakro rom meras.
O baro Dewel dikell chojedes ap ko midjak koowa, hoi lell pes i tchilatcho glan. Latches dikell lo ap koleste, kai rakrell latche laba.
Koon chochepah peskro brawlepen khetne lell, anell peskri familja an i bibacht. Koon mukell pes gar te ginell, sawo djiwell.
Koon an o tchatchepen tardo hi, rakrell peskro djijeha glan kowa job tchomone penell. Dran o mui o tchilatchestar wenn tchilatche laba win har diwjo pani.
O baro Dewel hi dur krik kolendar, kai tchilatcho hi. Job shunell kowa, hoi kolla lestar mangenna, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi.
Te dikeh latches ap jekeste, well lo bachtelo. Te peneh leske i latcho lab, well lo sorelo.
Te shuneh ap jekeste, kai penell tuke, hoi tuke mishto hi, palle hal mashkral i gosewende.
Koon gar shunell, te well lo trad dino, tchinell pes an peskro mass. Koon mukell pes tchomone te penell, kowa well gosweder.
Kolla, kai djiwenn o baro Debleha, dikenn dren, hoi lenge mishto hi, un wenn gosweder. Kolenge, kai krenn pen gar bares, well ko tsiro, kai sharenn len i wawar.
O mensho lell pes tchomone glan an peskro dji. Hoi tchatchepah wella, penell o baro Dewel.
Hako drom hoi i mursh djal, hi an leskre jaka tchatcho, o baro Dewel dikell dur an leskro dji.
Tchip kowa, hoi tu kameh te krell an o baro Debleskro wast, un job mukell kowa jaake te well, har tuke glan lal.
Lauter, hoi o baro Dewel kras, hi tchomoneske, ninna kras lo o tchilatcho menshes ko diweske, kai i bibacht wella.
O baro Dewel dikell chojedes ap hakeneste, koles i pre-phurdo dji hi. O wast pre, kowa lell peskri phagi.
Ab latches un rike pash o Debleste, un job bistrell tiri doosh. Te djiweh leha, rikreh tut pale o tchilatchepastar.
Te dikell o baro Dewel latches ap kowa, hoi jek krell, palle krell lo, te wenn ninna kolla leskre mala, kai kaman leske tchilatchepen.
Hi feteder, te hi tut gar bud, un kowa lal tuke khetne kek chochepah, har te well tut bud brawlepen, hoi anal khetne o chochepah.
O mensheskro dji lell peske tchomone glan, o baro Dewel hi kowa, kai anell leskre herja ap ko drom, har job kamell.
Te rakrell i baro rai, hoi o Dewel leske an o mui tchiwell, palle rakrell lo o tchatchepen win pral i mensheste jaake har tchatcho hi.
I waga, hoi o tchatcho pharepen sikrell, well o baro Deblestar. Job penas, har pharo i saster hunte well, hoi o pharepen sikrell.
Te krenn bare raja tchilatcho koowa, hi kowa i djungelo koowa glan o Debleste. Te krenn le o tchatchepen, atchell lengri rajeskri beshepaskri soreles tardo.
I mensho, kai o tchatchepen rakrell, krell, te dikell o baro rai latches ap leste. Job kamell o murshes o labestar.
I baro rai, kai choirell pes, nai bitchrell jekes an o merepen. Un i gosewo mursh krell lauter, te bistrell job peskri choli.
Te dikell o baro rai latches ap jekeste, nai djiwell kowa pre. Un leskro kamlepen hi har i brishin, hoi mukell o djob bares te well.
Hi budeder moldo te less goswepen har te less sonakai. Te haiweh, hoi mishto un gar mishto hi, hi kowa tuke feteder har rup.
Kolla, kai ap o tchatcho drom djan, atchenn dur krik o tchilatchepastar. Koon jak dell, hawo drom job djal, kowa dell jak ap peskro djipen.
Koon pes bares krell, well phagedo. Un i pre-phurdo mensho perell.
Hi feteder te weh gar an-diklo un djiweh i tchorwelentsa, har te wess jek kolendar, kolen i baro mui hi, un djiweh fun lengro tchoredo koowa.
Kowa, kai dell jak ap o lab, hoi leske penlo was, hatsell bacht, un kowa hi bachtelo, kai tchiwell peskro dji ap o baro Debleste.
Kowa kai haiwell, hoi mishto un gar mishto hi, kowa well kharedo ‘gosewo mursh’. Un jek, kai latche laba hatsell, hi i latcho sikepaskro.
Tchatcho goswepen hi har djido pani koleske, kai les hi. O dinlepen hi i phagi kolenge, kai dinelo hi.
I mensho i gosewo djijeha rakrell laba, hoi mishto hi. Un kowa, hoi lo penell, sikrell i wawarende, hoi te krenn le.
Kamle laba hi har gwin, rakrenn kamles an o dji un denn newi soor.
Kote dell i drom, kowa i mursheske tchatches win dikell, pal i tsiro anell lo les an o merepen.
Te hi i budepaskres bok, budrell lo budeder. Leskri bok penell leske, te krell lo dureder.
I tchilatcho mensho rodell i drom, har nai dukrell lo i wawaren. Hoi lo rakrell, chatchell har jag.
I midjak mensho anell tchingepen. Un kowa, kai djungelo koowa pral wawarende rakrell, krell, te tchingrenn pen latche mala.
I tchilatcho marepaskro anell peskro rakepah peskro males ap i drom, hoi gar mishto hi.
Kowa kai i jakentsa dell un peskro mui khetne tserdell, koles hi tchilatchepen an o shero.
Parne balla hi har i kutch rajeskri stadi, hoi o Dewel kolen dell, kai leskro drom djan.
Jek, kai gar sik chojedo wella, hi feteder har i tchatcho kurepaskro. Un koon o rai pral peste hi, hi budeder moldo har jek, kai i tselo foro dren lell.
O mensho witsrell tikne kashta, te djinell lo, hoi te krell. Har le perenn, kowa well o baro Deblestar.
I truk kotar maro un kek tchingepen hi feteder har i kheer pherdo mass o tchingepah.

I budepaskro, kai djinell, hoi te krell, kowa well o rai pral o tchaweste ko kherestar, kai ladj ap peste anas. Ko budepaskro lell palle ninna kolestar, hoi i tchawe lenna pral pengro dadeskro merepen.
Jaake har o rup an i jag tchiddo well, un o sonakai an i bob, jaake lell o baro Dewel i menshengre djia an o jak.
Kowa, kai tchilatcho koowa krell, shunell ap midjak rakepen. Un i chocheno shunell ap sawe laba, hoi bibacht anenn.
Kowa kai pral i tchorweleste sal, kowa praassell koles, kai les kras. Kowa, kai bachtelo hi pral o wawareskri bibacht, sawo lell peskri phagi.
Tchawengre tchawe hi har i rajeskri stadi i phurenge. Un i tchawe sharenn pen pengro papeha un pengri mami.
Kowa djal gar, te krenn i narwele bare un shukar laba. Witar gar djal, te rakrell i an-diklo mursh chochepen.
Kowa, kai wawaren tchorchanes lowe dell, te krenn le, hoi job kamell, an koleskre jaka hi peskre lowe har durkepangre barra, hoi anenn leske bacht an hako koowa.
Kowa, kai i doosh i wawarendar bistrell, krell peske mala. Kowa, kai pale te pale pral koi doosh rakrell, nashrell peskre malen.
Te tchingreh jekeha, kai mukell pes tchomone te penell, lell job kowa peske budeder an o dji, har te dell jek sheel kope an i dineleste dren.
I tchilatcho mensho rodell hako tsiro tchingepen. Doleske well jek pash leste bitchedo, ko dell les i phari phagi.
Hi tuke feteder, te wess pash i bari diwji margodja, kolake i terne krik lino wan, har te wess i dineleha khetne, kai narwelo koowa krell.
Koleske latchepen kerdo was, un job tchilatchepen pale das, dran koleskro kheer djal i bibacht buder gar krik.
Muk tele o tchingepah jaake rah har lo gomme tikno hi! Tchingepen hi har pani, hoi dran i phub win phagell. Muk tele glan kowa job sorleder well!
Kowa hi dui kope i djungelo koowa glan o baro Debleskre jaka: te rakrell jek koles tchatches, kai doosh ap peste las, un ninna, te tchiwell jek doosh ap koleste, kai o tchatchepen kras.
Hoske hunte dals i dinelo lowe win, te nai djal lo an i sikepaskri? Leske djal tchi an leskro shero.
I maal sikrell hako tsiro pengro kamlepen. Un i phraal well boldo, te well lo tuke ap i rig an phare tsirja.
Narwelo hi kowa, kai dell peskro dadeskro wast un penell, te plaissrell lo i sijaan i wawareske.
Kowa, kai tchingepen kamell, kowa kamell ninna o tchilatchepen. Kowa kai hadell pes kokres pral, nai perell sik.
Jek dui djijentsa hatsell kek latchepen. Un jek dui tchipjentsa perell an i bibacht.
Kones i tchawo hi, hoi narwelo koowa krell, koles hi i pharo djipen. I dineleskro dades hi tchi sapaske.
I bachtelo dji hi mishto tiro sastepaske. Te hi tuke hako tsiro ropaske, nashreh tiri soor.
O tchilatcho kamell i lowe, hoi leske tchorchanes dino well, te rissrell lo o tchatchepen trujel.
Kowa, kai haiwell, hoi mishto un gar mishto hi, mukell pes gar tele te rikrell, te lell lo gomme budeder goswepen. I dinelo dikell kate te kote.
I dinelo tchawo krell peskro dadeske choli. Un leskri date well ropaske pral leste.
Kowa hi gar mishto, te lell kowa i phagi, kai kek doosh ap peste anas. Gomme djungleder hi, te chal i an-diklo mensho dawa.
Kowa, kai peskre laba pale rikrell, sikrell, te djinell lo, hoi mishto hi. Kowa, kai gar sik an i choli well, sikrell, te hi lo gosewo.
Ninna i dinelo, kai rikrell peskro mui, nai well jaake an-diklo, har te wals lo gosewo. Te krell lo peskro mui gar pre, hi lo i wawarenge har i gosewo.
Koon pes i wawarendar krik rikrella, rodell, hoi peske kokres shukar hi, un kamell gar dren te dikell, hoi latcho leske wals.
I dinelo kamell tchi te haiwell, job kamell te sikrell, hoi job lauter djinell.
Tchilatchepen un ladj djan khetne. Un kai ladj hi, koi i ninna praassepen.
I laba i gosewo menshestar hi har telstune panja, hoi nashenna an i phub un denn djipen.
Hi gar mishto, te dell i tchatchepaskro mursh koles tchatchepen, kai i doosh ap peste anas, un shunell gar ap koleste, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi.
Kowa, hoi i dinelo rakrell, anell tchingepen. Un leskro mui dell pal dawa gole.
O rakepen o dinelestar anell les an i bibacht. Un job taprell pes kokres an peskre laba.
Te shunah djungelo rakepen pral i wawarende, hi kowa menge har shukar chapen, un djal menge tele har djet.
I tchi-moldo, kai kamell gar te budrell, hi gar feteder har kowa, kai marepen un merepen anell.
O baro Dewel hi har i baro sorelo kheer. Kowa, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi, nashell pash leste un khatrell pes pash leste.
Glan i braweleskre jaka hi leskro brawlepen har i sorelo foro un har i bari massuri trul leste.
Pre-phurdepen well glan o perepen. Kolenge, kai krenn pen gar bares, well ko tsiro, kai sharenn len i wawar.
Shun! Un palle rake! Te kreh wawartchandes, hal dinelo un hunte ladjess tut.
I mensho kai sorelo an peskro dji hi, nai hidjrell peskro nasslepen. Te hi leskro dji phagedo, har nai hidjrell lo peskro pharepen?
I gosewo mensho kamell bud te djinell, un krell peskre kanda pre, te haiwell lo, hoi tchatcho hi.
I mensho, kai i wawaren shukar koowa dell, krell peske i wudja pre pash i pralstunende.
An i tchingepen dikell win, har te wals koles tchatcho, kai glanstunes rakrell. Te well palle o wawar, well win, kones tchatchepah tchatches hi.
Te tchingrenn pen dui sorele, un tikne kashta wenn witsedo, te well diklo, kones tchatcho hi, djal o tchingepen krik, un jon mukenn pendar tele.
I phraal, kai dukedo was an peskro dji, mukell gar peha te rakrell, un hi pandlo har i foro, kai hi i soreli massuri trul leste. Un o tchingepen hi har ko kashteskro, hoi o foreskro wudar pandell.
I mursh lell, hoi leskro mui rakras. Dran leskre laba lell lo doha djipaske.
Kol laba, hoi jek rakrell, nai anenn leske o merepen un ninna o djipen. Un kowa, kai bud rakrell, dikella, hoi leskre laba leske dren anenn.
Koon i romjat hatsas, hatsas i bacht. O baro Dewel dikas latches ap leste.
O tchorwelo mangell o ropah, o brawelo rakrell pale i djijeha, hoi hi har i bar.
Dell mala, kai anenn tut an i bibacht. I tchatcho maal rikrell budeder ap tute har i phraal.
Hi feteder te hal an o tchatchepen tardo un djiweh an tchorwlepen, har te wess i dinelo, kai rakrell chochepen.
Jek, kai peskro koowa gar haiwell, hi tchi moldo, ninna te budrell lo sik. Kowa, kai sik nashell, perell.
O mensheskro dinlepen anell les ap i drom, kai nashrell lo pes. Un palle dell lo o baro Debleste i doosh.
Brawele menshe hatsenn bud mala. I tchorweleskre mala djan penge lestar.
Kowa, kai chochras, har penas lo, hoi lo dikas un shunas, kowa lell peskri phagi. Un kowa kai chochepen pre anas, kowa well tapedo un nai nashell gar peske.
Bud makenn o braweleske gwin trul o mui, un hakeno hi o maal kolestar, kai dell tchomone tchitcheske.
I phrala i tchorwelestar kamenn tchi lestar te djinell. Un har bud budeder rikrenn pen leskre mala lestar krik. Te kamell lo lentsa te rakrell, hi le buder gar koi.
Kowa, kai peske bud pashel anas, kras peske latchepen. Kowa, kai lauter mishto haiwell, hatsell bacht.
Kowa, kai chochras, har penas lo, hoi lo dikas un shunas, kowa lell peskri phagi. Un kowa hoi chochepen pre anell, kowa nashrell peskro djipen.
I latcho djipen hi gar i dinelenge. Har bud budeder djal gar, te well i budepaskro o rai pral i pralstunende.
Koles tchatcho goswepen hi an o dji, kowa well gar sik chojedo, un dikell gar ap i doosh i wawarendar. Doleske dikenn le pre ap leste.
Har koi gole, hoi i lewo dell, hi i choli o baro rajestar. Un leskro latchepen hi har o brishin ap i phub, hoi krell lat pale sapeno.
I dinelo anell peskro dades an i bibacht. Un i djuwel, kai i tselo tsiro tchingepen rodell, hi har i kheer, kai dren della.
I kheer un lowe lell o tchawo peskro dadestar pal koleskro merepen. I romni, kai an peskro dji dikell, glan te rakrell li, well o baro Deblestar.
Kowa, kai kamell gar te budrell, well khino. Mukell lo peskre wasta an i gali tchiddo, well ko tsiro, kai hunte bokell lo.
Kowa, kai rikrell pes ap o tchinlo lab, dell jak ap peskro djipen. Kowa kai gar jak dell ap peskre dromma, merella.
Kowa, kai peskro dji pre krell un i tchorweles dell, kowa hi har jek, kai patsals o baro Debleske. Un o baro Dewel dell les ko latchepen pale, hoi lo kras.
Tchinge tiro tchaweha jaake rah har job terno hi, un ap tute shunella. De jak, te dess les gar jaake, te merell lo.
Kowa, kai dran i bari choli tchomone kras, muk les peskri phagi te lell. Weh tu ap leskri rig, hunte kress tu kowa pale te pale.
Shun ap kowa, hoi jek ap tute penell, un muk tuke tchomone te penell, te wess pal kowa gosewo.
Bud koowa hi, hoi i mursh peske glan lell an peskro dji; kokres kowa wella, hoi o baro Debles glan hi jekeha.
Kowa, hoi i mensho rodell, hi kamlepen. Hi feteder te hal tchorwelo har te wals i chocheno.
Te djiweh o baro Debleha, hi tut o djipen: tut hi doha chapaske; tu nai soweh mishto; kek bibacht well ap tute.
I tchi-moldo, kai kamell tchi te krell, tchiwell peskro roi an o tcharo, un anell peskro wast gar pash o mui.
Te deh tu jekes, kai pral halauter sal, palle wenn kolla gosewo, kolen tchi an o shero hi. Un te tchingreh koleha, kai haiwell, hoi mishto un gar mishto hi, palle haiwell lo gomme budeder.
Kowa, kai peskro dades dell un peskri dat tradell, kowa hi i tchawo, hoi ladj ap peste un lende anell.
Miro tchawo, te mukeh tuke tchi buder te penell, palle djineh tu sik buder gar, hoi tchatcho hi.
Jek, kai hunte penell, hoi lo dikas un shunas, un kai tchi moldo hi, leske hi o tchatchepen sapaske. Un tchilatche menshe chan o tchilatchepen har maro.
Pral kol pre-phurden, kai pral halauter sanenn, well i phagi win rakedo; un dawa ap o dumo lell o dinelo.
Te pijeh i sorelo pipen, weh diwjo un saneh pral lautereske. Kowa, kai jaake bud pijell, te well lo mato, koles hi kek goswepen.
I baro rai, te dell lo trad, palle hi kowa, har te dell i lewo gole. Kowa, kai leskri choli ap peste tserdell, nashrell peskro djipen.
O mursh, kai rikrell pes o tchingepastar krik, well sharedo. Kolla, kai rodenn o tchingepen, hi halauter dinele.
Ko tchi-moldo, kai kamell gar ap peskri phub te budrell an o tchatcho tsiro, kowa hatsell tchi an ko tsiro, kai o djob dren anlo well.
Kowa, hoi i mensho peske glan lell, hi dur tele an peskro dji har pani an i brunna. I gosewo anell kowa nai pre.
Bud menshe sharenn pen pengro latchepah. Nai hatseh tchatchepah i murshes o labestar?
Kowa, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi un o Debleskro drom gar mukell, bachtelo hi leskre tchawe, kai pal leste wenna.
I baro rai, kai o tchatchepen win rakrella pral i menshende, hatsell kolen win, kai tchilatcho hi.
Koon nai penell pestar: ‘Me rikrom miro dji djudjes, man hi kek doosh?’
I waga, hoi gar tchatches sikrella, har pharo tchomone hi, un i khoro, kai gar jaake bud dren hi, har penlo was, kol dui hi i djungelo koowa glan o baro Debleskre jaka.
An kowa, hoi i tikno tchawo krell, mukell pes te dikell, har job wella: i mursh, kai djiwell i djudjo djipen un djal o tchatcho drom oder gar.
O kand, hoi shunell un i jak hoi dikell, kol dujen kras o baro Dewel.
Te kameh o sopen, weh tchorwelo. Kre sik taissarlakro tire jaka pre, palle well tut doha chapaske.
“Kawa hi tchi moldo”, penell o ginepaskro. Un te djal lo peske, palle sharell lo les!
Dell sonakai un bud kutch barra. I kutcheder koowa hi i mui, hoi rakrell, hoi mishto un tchatcho hi.

Jek, kai dinelo doha hi, te dell lo peskro dadeskro wast un penell, te plaissrell lo i wawareskri sijaan, kolestar le leskri baja un gar ko wawareskri baja, te hi tut tchomone an o wast, bis te job plaissrell.
Tchoredo maro hi gudlo. Pal i tsiro hi kowa har tikne barra an o mui.
Rake i wawarentsa pral kowa, hoi tuke glan lal, te well kowa mishto. Kowa hunte kress, hoi tut ninna glan hi, har bud budeder te kameh i kurepen te krell.
Kowa, kai djal trujel un rakrell djungelo koowa pral wawarende, phukrell ninna win, hoi i wawar leske tchorchanes penan. Doleske rike tut pale kolestar, kai nai rikrell gar peskro mui.
Kowa, kai pral peskro dades un peskri date bibacht win rakrell, koleske djal har jek, koleskri momeli win djal an i kali rat.
Te kameh sik kowa te lell, hoi jek tire phurendar peskre menshenge pale mukell, palle anell kowa tuke kek bacht.
Ma le tuke glan, te dess o tchilatchepen pale, hoi jek ap tute kras. Dik ap o baro Debleste! Kowa lell tiro koowa an peskro wast.

I bikepaskro, kai tchiwell pash jekeste sau saster ap i waga un pash i wawareste i wawar saster, kowa krell i djungelo koowa glan o baro Debleskre jaka. I waga, hoi i chocheno pharepen sikrell, hi gar mishto.
O baro Deblestar well, har o djipen hakenestar djal. Har djinell i mensho, kai leskro drom les anell?

Kowa, kai sik penell: “Me dau man sowel pash o baro Debleste, te dap les kawa te kowa”, un mukell les peske gar glan kowa an o shero trujel te djal, har nai rikrell lo peskro lab, koleske hi peskre laba har dorja, an kolende job dren stakrell un perell.
I baro rai, kai gosewo hi, hatsell i tchilatchen dran peskre menshende win, un les hi kek dji lenge un dell len pengri phagi.
O mensheskro ducho hi har i momeli o baro Deblestar. Koleha nai dikell o mensho an peste dren un dikell, hoi an peskro dji hi.
O baro rajeske atchell leskri rajeskri soor jaake rah har lo o latchepen un o tchatchepen krella.
O railepen i terne murshendar hi lengri soor. Un parne balla hi o shukapen i phurenge.
Ratle dawa lenn o tchilatchepen krik. Un dawa djan koleske, kai dino well, an o dji.
O baro rajeskro dji hi har i lengsto pani an o baro Debleskro wast, hoi mukell lo kote te nashell, kai job kamell.
Hako drom i menshestar hi mishto an peskre jaka. O baro Dewel dikell palla, hawo dji koi palla tardo hi.
Te djah o tchatcho drom un djiweh pal o Debleskro tchatchepen, hi kowa o baro Debleske budeder moldo har te anals leske viechen.
I tchilatchen hi i pre-phurdo dji un jaka, hoi tele dikenn ap i wawarende. Kowa hi lengri doosh.
Rake tiro djijeha pral kowa, hoi kameh te krell, un palle kre les tiri tseli sorjah. Un tut well bud djipaske. Kowa, kai lauter sik sik krella, koles hi tchi.
Ko brawlepen, hoi khetne anlo was o chochepah, hi har o ducho, hoi sik krik djal kolendar, kai o merepen rodenna.
I tchilatche kamenn gar te djiwell pal o tchatchepen. Ko tchilatcho koowa, hoi krenn le ap i wawarende, anell len jaake dur, te nashrenn le halauter.
Kowa, kai doosh ap peste anas, djal bange dromma. Koles, kai i djudjo dji hi, krell o tchatchepen.
Hi feteder te djiwell jek win ap i dacha, har dren an o kheer khetne i romjah, kai o tselo tsiro tchingepen rodell.
Tchilatche menshen hi o tselo tsiro bok pal o tchilatchepen. Len hi kek dji i wawarenge.
Te lell i pre-phurdo peskri phagi, wenn ninna kolla gosewo, kolen tchi an o shero hi. Te aneh i goseweske tchomone pashel, djinell lo budeder.
O Dewel hi an o tchatchepen tardo, un lell o tchilatcheskri familja an i jak, un witsrell i tchilatchen an i bibacht.
Kowa, kai jaake krell, har te shunell lo gar koi gole ko tchorwelestar, leske djala jaake, kai dell job ninna gole un kek shunell les.
Te hi jek chojedo ap tute, un tu deh les tchomone khatedo, kreh tu jaake, te djal leskri bari choli pale.
Te well o tchatchepen kerdo, hi kolla bachtelo, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi, un i tchilatche darenn pen.
I mensho, kai kamell gar te djinell, hoi gosewo hi, djal ap o drom pash i mulende.
Kowa, kai kamell i shukar djipen un dell bud lowe koleske win, kowa well tchorwelo. Un kowa, kai kamell mool un kutch djet makepaske, well gar brawelo.
Ap i tchilatchende un i phukepangre well koi bibacht anlo, hoi kaman le te anell ap i latche un tchatche menshende.
Hi feteder te djiwell jek an o mulo tato them har khetne i romjah, kai o tselo tsiro tchingepen rodell un chojedo hi.
I shukar brawlepen un kutch djet hi an o kheer kolestar, kai gosewo hi. I dinelo dell peskre lowe sikeder win, har lell lo len.
Kowa, kai o tchatchepen un o latchepen palla nashell, kowa hatseh o djipen un well an-diklo.
I gosewo mursh nai djal pre ap i foro, kai lauter tchatche kurepangre dren hi, un phagell ko foro tele, kolestar jon patsan, te hi lo soreles tardo.
Kowa, kai nai rikrell peskro mui un dell jak ap peskri tchip, sawo rikrell bibacht pestar krik.
Ko baro-mujeskro, kai dikell tele ap i wawarende, well pre-phurdo kharedo. Job patsell, te nai krell lo lauter un kek les pale rikrell.
Kol tchi-molde, kai kamenn gar te budrell, merenna i bokatar.
O tselo diwes djal lenge kowa an o shero trujel, hoi kamenn le te lell. Kowa, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi, kowa dell un rikrell gar pale.
Kowa, hoi anenn i tchilatche o baro Debleske, hi djungeles glan leskre jaka. Har bud budeder, te krenn le kowa dran i tchilatcho dji.

Kowa, kai chochras, har penas lo, hoi lo dikas un shunas, ap koleskro shero well leskro chochepen pale. Ko mursh, kai mishto shunas, hoi leske penlo was, koles mukenn le rakrell, un hoi job penell, atchell lenge an o shero.
O tchilatcho stakrell soreles pre i baro mujeha. Kowa, kai o tchatchepaske tardo hi, mukell gar peskro drom.
Kote dell kek goswepen, tchi hoi jek feteder nai djinals un penals, har nai krell o baro Dewel.
Tu nai leh i kurepaskro grai un djah an o marepen. Kowa, kai krell, te wess o sorleder, hi o baro Dewel.
Te rakrenn le pral tute latcho koowa, hi kowa feteder har baro brawlepen. Te dikenn le latches ap tute, hi kowa feteder har rup un sonakai.
Brawelen un tchorwelen hi jek koowa khetne: Kol dujen kras o baro Dewel.
Koles i gosewo dji hi, kowa dikell, har i bibacht wella un khatrell pes. Kolen tchi an o shero hi, kolla nashenn dureder, un i bibacht well ap lende.
Kowa, kai krell pes gar bares un djiwell o baro Debleha, lell brawlepen un sharepen un o tchatcho djipen.
O drom, kai i tchilatche djana, hi pherde subjengre burra un shelle, kai nai stakrenn le dren. Kowa, kai ap peskro djipen jak dell, djal kote gar.
Sike i tikno tchawes peskro drom, palle djal job gar kolestar krik, ninna te well lo phuro.
O brawelo hi o rai pral o tchorweleste. Un kowa, kai patsell peske lowe, hunte budrell koleske, pash koleste job sijaan hi.
Kowa, kai chochepen win witsrell har djob, kowa anell bibacht dren. Palle nai djal lo buder gar i wawarentsa jaake trujel har job kamell.
Kowa, kai latches ap i wawarende dikell, dell peskro maro i tchorweleste. Ap leste well bacht wi-rakedo.
Trade ko pre-phurdes win, kai sal pral halauter. Palle djal o tchingepen leha. Un kol tchilatche laba un o praassepen djan ninna krik.
Kowa, koles i djudjo dji hi un latchepen rakrell, koleskro maal hi o baro rai.
O baro Dewel dell jak, te well diklo, haweskre laba mishto un tchatcho hi. Un job tchakrell kol laba pre, hoi i phukepaskro rakras.
Ko tchi-moldo, kai kamell gar te budrell, penell: I lewo hi win ap o drom, kai nai chals man.
O mui i wawareskro romjatar hi har i gruba, hoi dur tele an i phub djal. Un kolla perenn dren, pral kolende o baro Dewel chojedo hi.
Tikne tchawe krenn dinelo koowa. Te chan le dawa, krenn le kowa buder gar.
Kowa, kai rikrell i tchorweles tele, te well job kokres brawleder, ninna kowa, kai dell i braweles tchomone, kowa krell, te well lo kokres tchorwelo.
Shun mishto un de jak ap i laba kol gosewendar! Le mire laba an o dji, hoi tuke sikrenn, hoi mishto un tchatcho hi.
Ma biste len! Har shukar hi, te nai peneh len dureder!
Kamoms, te dikess un rikress ap o baro Debleste. Doleske penau me tuke kowa kau diwes.
Me tchinom tuke 30 (trijanda) laba pre, hoi tuke penenn, hoi te kress, hoi tuke mishto hi,
te sikrap tute, hoi o tchatchepen hi, jaake te nai peness koleske, kai tut bitchras, hoi lo kamell te djinell.
Ma rande o tchorweles win, doleske kai lo tchorwelo hi! Te hal leha glan i tchatchepangre, ma le leskro tchatchepen krik.
O baro Dewel lell lengro koowa an o wast. Un kowa, kai len win randas, koleske lell job o djipen krik.
Muk tut gar dren jekeha, kai sik an bari choli well. Ma ab leha khetne beshdo!
Palle nai djal tuke jaake, te weh har job, un pereh an i bibacht.
Ma ab jek kolendar, kai denn pengro dadeskro wast un penenn, te plaissrenn le i sijaan i wawarenge.
Te nai plaissreh lat palle gar, lenn le ninna tiro tchiben tel tute krik.
Ma tchip kol phure barra krik, hoi sikrenn har baro tiro them hi, un hoi tire phure kote tchiwan.
Dikeh i mursh, kai peskri budi haiwella, palle djiness, kowa nai budrell bare rajenge. Sawenge, kai gar an-diklo hi, budrell lo gar.
Te well, te beshess pash i rajeste ap i chapaskri, palle biste gar, koon glan tute beshdo hi.
Ma pere pral o chapen, har bari ninna tiri bok hi.
Muk tiro dji gar pal leskro latcho chapen te nashell! Kowa nai well i chocheno chapen.
Ab jaake gosewo, te maress tut gar tele, brawelo te well.
Te dikeh tire jakentsa pre, hi o brawlepen gar buder koi, jaake sik hi lo krik har i tchirklo, hoi hadell peskre mussja un hadell pes an o bolepen.
Ma cha ko maro, hoi i tchinlo tute dell. Muk tiro dji gar pal leskro latcho chapen te nashell!
Les hi dui djia. Ap tute penell lo: “Cha un pi”, an leskro dji kamell lo tute tchi te dell.
Kowa, kai tu tele dandral un chal, koles hunte tchadess tu pale win. Un tire latche laba his tchitcheske.
Ma rake an i kanda i dinelestar! Ap tiro goswepen dikell job tele.
Ma tchip kol phure barra krik, hoi sikrenn, har baro tiro them hi. Ma le i phub kol tchawendar krik, kolen kek dad buder hi.
O baro Dewel well lenge soreles ap i rig, un lell lengro koowa an o wast, un krell o tchatchepen pral tute win.
De jak ap kowa, hoi tiro sikepaskro tuke penell, un shun ap kowa, hoi mishto un tchatcho hi.
Ma rike tut pale, te dess tiro tchawes i phagi. Te deh les o kashteha, merell lo kolestar gar.
Tu deh les o kashteha, un rikreh les jaake pale, ap o merepaskro drom te well.
Miro tchawo, te hi tiro dji tchatches gosewo, palle hi miro dji ninna bachtelo.
Te rakreh, hoi mishto hi, sal miro dji.
Ma silwe ap kolende, kai o Debleskro drom mukan. Hako diwes de jak, te djiwess o baro Debleha.
Palle hi tut i latcho djipen glan tute, un kowa wella, hoi tu o djijestar kamal.
Shun, miro tchawo un ab gosewo, un dja o djijestar o tchatcho drom!
Ma ab mank kolende, kai pen mates pijenn, witar gar mank kolende, kai budeder mass an pende dren chan har mishto hi.
Ko pipaskro un ko chapaskro wenn tchorwelo, un kolenge, kai kamenn gar te budrell, well ko tsiro, kai hi len tchi te riwell har koola hoi paash hi.
Shun ap tiro dadeste un tiri date! Jon dan tut o djipen. Ma dik tele ap lende, te wan le phuro.
Muk tuke o tchatchepen un o goswepen bud moldo te well! Muk tuke hako tsiro tchomone te penell, te haiwess lauter mishto.
Bachtelo hi i dad, te hi leskro tchawo an o tchatchepen tardo un les i gosewo dji hi.
Doleske kre tiro dades un tiri dai bachteles! Kre, te giwenn le i bachtjatar pral tute.
Miro tchawo, kre tiro dji mange pre, un dja ap mire dromma!
Ma dja pash i lubjate, witar gar pash o wawareskri romjate. Kolla hi har i brunna, hoi dur tele djal, kai weh gar buder win.
Jon hi har tchorepangre, kai lurenn khatemen pash o drom, un anenn bud murshen jaake dur, te chochenn le pengre romjen.
Koneske hi ropaske? Koneske djal djungelo? Koon krell tchingepen? Koon hi bibachtelo? Kones hi duk kek nasslepah? Kones hi mate jaka?
Kowa hi kolla, kai dur an i rati gomme pash i mool beshdo hi, un sorelo wawar pipen khetne tchorenn un pijenn.
Ma dik i mool an, te hi li jaake shukar loles an o khoro, un djal tele har djet.
O wawar diwes djal tuke jaake, har te dandrals tut i tchilatcho sap.
Tire jaka dikenn kowa, hoi gar koi hi. Un tiro dji penell tuke dinelo koowa.
Un tu hal har jek, kai hi tchiddo an i shiffo, hoi djal pral un tele ap o baro pani, un har sawo, kai hi kote beshdo pral pre ap o pesso kasht.
Palle peneh: “Mange hi, har dans le man, ninna te haiwom kek duk, har te marans le man khetne, ninna te dukell mange tchi. Te hom wi-sodo, palle djau pale koi.”
Ma silwe ap tchilatche menshende, ma rode lengro maal te well!
Lengre djia lenn penge sawo koowa pherdo marepen glan, un hoi le rakrenn, anell bibacht.
Tut hunte well goswepen, te tchiwess i kheer pre, un tu hunte haiwess mishto, hoi te kress, te atchell ko kheer soreles tardo.
Koon bud djinell, kowa haiwell, har te krell lo peskre tsele iseme pherdo kutch shukar koowa.
I gosewo mursh hi har i sorelo, un jek, kai bud djinell, an koleste hi pherdi soor.
Te kamell lo i kurepen te krell, hunte haiwell lo mishto, har te djal glan. Un kote, kai bud mursha pengro goswepen khetne tchiwenn un pral rakrenn, hoi mishto wals, djal lengro kurepen mishto.
I dinelo haiwell gar gosewe laba. Kote, kai i tchatchepangre khetne wenna, nai krell lo peskro mui gar pre.
Kowa, kai peske glan lell te krell lo tchilatcho koowa, koles denn le ‘tchilatcho bedo’ gole.
Kowa, kai mukell pes tchi te penell, lell peske sawo koowa glan, hoi anell les o Debleskro dromestar tele. Un i menshe dikenn chojedes ap koleste, koles i pre-phurdo dji hi.
Kowa hi gar sorelo, kai an phare tsirja gar soreles tardo hi.
Dja un le kolen dran o merepen win, kai wenn pandles ap koi platsa tserdedo, kai wenn le maredo. Rike kolen pale, kai koi djan.
Te peneh tu: Mer djinam kowa gar! Palle djiness: Kowa, kai an i djia dikell, haiwell les. Un kowa, kai ap tiro djipen jak dell, kowa djinell les. Un job dell o menshes kowa pale, hoi lo kras.
Cha gwin, miro tchawo! latcho hi lo, un gudlo an tiro mui.
Jaake hi o goswepen latcho tiro djipaske. Te hatsal les, palle hi tut i latcho djipen glan tute, un kowa wella, hoi o djijestar kamal.
Ma lure har i tchilatcho ap o kheer kolestar, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi! Ma de koi platsa khetne, kai tchiwell lo pes sopaske!
Kowa, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi, nai perell efta kope, hako kopo stell lo pale pre. I tchilatche perenn an i bibacht.
Te perell kowa, kai tuke tchilatchepen kamell, ma ab bachtelo! Tiro dji te sal gar pral leskri bibacht!
O baro Dewel nai dikals kowa i choljah, un palle rissrals lo peskri choli kolestar tele!
Ma ab chojedo ap kolende, kai midjak koowa krenn! Ma silwe ap i tchilatchende!
Kolenge, kai tchilatcho hi, well kek latcho tsiro. Lengro djipen hi har i momeli, hoi djal win.
Miro tchawo, djib glan o baro Debleskre jaka un kre, hoi o baro rai tutar kamella! Ma dja kolentsa, kai wawaren ap lende pre anenn!
Sik well i bibacht pral sawende. Nai djineh tu, hawi bibacht o baro Deblestar un o baro rajestar nai well?
Ninna kolla hi laba, hoi i gosewe penan: Kowa hi gar mishto, te dikenn i tchatchepangre mursha jekes feteder an har o wawares.
Kowa, kai ap koleste penell, kai doosh ap peste las ‘tut hi kek doosh’, koles praassenn i menshe un rakrenn i bibacht win pral leste.
Kol tchatchepangre mursha, kai djan pal o tchatchepen, kolenge djal mishto. Un bari bacht well ap lende.
Te deh tu i latcho lab pale, hi kowa har te dess i tchum.
Dja win ap tiri phub un kre tiri budi! Pal kowa le i romni, te well tut i familja!
Ma an chochepen pre ap i wawareste! Pen o tchatchepen!
Ma pen: “Jaake har job mange kras, krau me leske ninna. Hakeneste dau pale, har job mange kras.”
Me djom glan wergel ko kotar phub sawestar, kai kamell gar te budrell, un dikom i drakengro them jekestar, koles tchi an o shero hi.
Un subjengre burra his koi tardo un lauter djungelo senlepen, un i massuri trul ko kotar them his tele peredo.
Un me dikom kowa, un mukom les an miro dji te djal; un kowa sikras mange:
Te kameh o sopen un pandeh i jaka un tchiweh i wasta an i gali un kreh tchi,
palle well o tchorwlepen lengste herjentsa pral tute. Un tut wenn phare tsirja.
Ninna kalla hi gosewe laba o Salomestar. I sikepangre an o kheer o baro rajestar Hiskija lan kal laba khetne. O Hiskija his o baro rai pral o them Juda.
O Dewel well sharedo koleske, hoi job khatedo rikrell. O baro rai well sharedo koleske, hoi job pre tchakrell.
O bolepen djal dur pre, un i phub djal dur tele, un kek nai djinell, hoi an o baro rajeskro dji hi.
Le i tchik dran o rup win, palle nai krell kowa, kai budrell o rupeha, i shukar tcharo kolestar.
Le o tchilatches krik o baro rajestar, palle atchell job i baro rai, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi.
Ma kre tut bares glan o baro rajeste, un pash i pralstunende ab gar tardo!
Hi feteder, te penenn le ap tute ‘ab kate pre’, har te bitchrenn le tut tele kotar, kai beshal tut, un denn tiri beshepaskri i wawareste, kai budeder an-diklo hi.
Ma dja sik pash i tchatchepangre murshende, te peness lenge, hoi dikal. Te well palle i wawar un sikrell, kai hi tut gar tchatcho, hoi kreh tu palle?
Te hi tut i tchingepen i wawareha un mukeh o tchatchepen win te krell mashkral tumende, ma rake pral kowa, hoi djineh khatedes lestar.
Te kreh tu kowa, shunenn wawar menshe kolestar un kharenn tut ‘phukepaskro’. Un kowa well tuke gar buder bistedo.
I lab rakedo an o tchatcho tsiro, hi har sonakangre phabja an i rupeno tcharo.
I gosewo mensho, kai trad dell, un i kand, hoi ap leste shunell, kolla hi har i sonakaskri gustri un i sonakaskri werkli trul i meen.
I mursh o labestar hi koleske, kai les bitchras, har shila pani an ko tato tsiro, kai o djob dren anlo well, un dell les newi soor.
Kolla, kai penenn, te denn le tchomone, un palle denn le kowa gar, kolla hi har wolke un i phurdepen, hoi denn kek brishin.
Bud latche labentsa nai tserdeh pralstunen ap tiri rig. Un i kamlo rakepen phagella kokale khetne.
Te hatsal gwin, palle cha gar budeder har tuke mishto hi, te wess gar tchalo lestar un hunte tchadess les pale win.
Ma dja hako kopo pash tiro maleste khere. Les nai wals o nak tutar pherdo un wals chojedo ap tute.
Kowa, kai ap i wawareste chochepen pre anell, sawo hi har i tower, un i charo, un tchinell har i tchuri.
Te hi tut i kalo diwes un dikeh ap i maleste, te well lo ap tiri rig, un job hi kek mursh o labestar, palle hi kowa, har te dandals ap i tele phagedo dand, un har te nashals ap jek heri.
Te giweh gilja jekeske, koleskro dji rowella, palle hi kowa leske, har te randjell jek i baja win ap i shil diwes, un har te tchorell jek shut an i dukepen.
Te hi koles bok, kai kamell tuke tchilatchepen, palle de les maro te chal. Un te hi les trush, de les pani te pijell!
Palle chatchell les an leskro dji un les khaitell, hoi lo kras. Un o baro Dewel dell tut tiro latchepen pale.
I phurdepen un kale wolke anenn brishin, un i tchip, hoi pal o wast rakrell, anell choli.
Hi feteder te beshess ap i dacha, har an o kheer khetne i romjah, kai hako tsiro tchingepen rodell.
I liil dran i dur them latche labentsa hi har shil pani koleske, kai trushella.
Har i djungelo pani un i brunna, hoi khandella, hi jek, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi un glan i tchilatcheste trissella.
Bud gwin hi gar mishto. Jaake hi ninna, te shareh tu i wawares bud shukar labentsa.
Jaake har i foro, kai kek massuri trul leste hi, jaake hi i mursh, kai nai rikrell gar peskri choli pale.
Har gib an i nijal un har depen an ko tsiro, kai anenn le o djob dren, jaake djal gar, te well o dinelo sharedo!
Har i tchirklo, hoi hadell pes an o bolepen, un well gar tele pash i mensheste, jaake hi o praassepen, hoi was win rakedo pral jekeste, kai kek doosh ap peste anas. Ko praassepen taprell les gar.
I tchupni o grajeske, un i ledertikri rima trul i meen i eslatar, un i kasht ap o dumo i dinelestar.
Ma rake dinlepen ap i dineleste pale, te wess gar har job!
Rake i dineleha, kai rakrell dineles ap tute, jaake te haiwell lo, har dinelo job hi.
Kowa, kai i dinelo bitchepaskres bitchrell, kowa hi har jek, kai dell peske kokres i herja tele un chal dawa.
Har i herja i bango menshestar kek soor an lende hi, jaake hi i gosewo lab an o mui i dinelestar.
Jek, kai sharell o dineles hi har jek, kai pandell i bar jaake soreles an i witsepaskri, te nai witsrell lo les gar.
I subjengro kasht an o wast kolestar, kai mato hi, jaake hi i gosewo lab an o mui i dinelestar.
Har jek, kai trul peste karje dell, un hakenes dukrell, jaake hi kowa, kai lell i dineles, te budrell lo leske, oder sawen, kai djan ap o drom.
Har i djuklo, hoi pale chal, hoi lo win tchadas, jaake hi o narwelo, kai krell pale te pale dinelo koowa.
I dinelo nai well sikeder gosewo har jek, kai pestar kokres patsell, te hi lo gosewo.
Ko tchi-moldo, kai kamell gar te budrell, kowa penell: Win hi i lewo, awa, mashkral ap o drom hi i lewo.
Jaake har i wudar rissrell pes an i rikepangre, jaake rissrell pes an peskro tchiben ko tchi-moldo, kai kamell tchi te budrell.
I tchi-moldo, kai kamell tchi te krell, tchiwell peskro roi an o tcharo, un anell peskro wast gar pash o mui.
I tchi-moldo, kai kamell gar te budrell, hi an peskre jaka gosweder har efta, kai djinenn, hoi mishto un tchatcho hi.
Kowa, kai pes dren mukell an i wawarengro tchingepen, kowa hi har jek, kai taprell i djukles pash i kanda.
Har i baro dinelo, kai trul peste karje dell un menshen mulo karje dell,
jaake hi ko mursh, kai peskro males chochell, un palle penell: Hoi krom, his sapaske.
Kote, kai buder kek kasht hi, kote djal i jag win, un kote, kai kek buder hi, kai chochepen ap wawarende pre anell, kote djal o tchingepen krik.
Jaake har krell o kasht, te chatchell i jag dureder, jaake krell i mursh, hoi tchingepen rodell, te djal o tchingepen dureder.
Kol laba kolestar, kai chochepen ap wawarende pre anell, hi har latcho chapen, un djan tele har djet.
Har tchare dran chatchedi tchik, pral kolende rup maklo was, jaake hi o mui, hoi shukar laba rakrella, hoi wenn dran i tchilatcho dji.
I midjak mensho hi pherdo chochepen. Kowa khatrell lo pal shukar laba.
Te rakrell lo ninna jaake kamles, ma pats leske! Les hi efta bengeskro koowa an leskro dji.
Ninna te khatrell lo peskri choli ap i wawarende pal shukar laba, well ko diwes, kai dikell hakeno leskro tchilatchepen.
Kowa, kai i wawareske i gruba win hadas, kowa perell kokres dren. Un jek, kai witsrell i bar, ap koleste perell lo pale tele.
Kowa, kai chochepen rakrell, kamell o wawareske tchilatchepen te krell un les dukrell. Un kowa, kai gudle labentsa rakrell, anell i bibacht.
Ma share tut pral kowa, hoi hi tut glan o wawar diwes! Tu djineh gar, hoi tuke ko diwes anell.
Muk i wawaren tut te sharell un gar tiro mui! Hi feteder te sharell tut i wawareskro mui har tiro mui.
Phares hi barra un tchik. Dui kope phareder hi i choli, hoi jekes hi pral i dinelestar.
I choli hi diwjo un sorelo har i sorelo pani, hoi lauter peha krik tserdell. Koon nai atchell tardo te silwerell i mursh?
Feteder hi, te well jekeske an o mui penlo, hoi lo gar mishto kras, har te penell jek leske gar, te kamell lo les o djijestar.
Laba, hoi dukrenn har dawa un wenn tiro malestar, hi feteder har i tchumma kolestar, kai tuke tchilatches hi.
Kowa, kai tchalo hi, mukell o feteder gwin tardo. Koles bok hi, koleske hi shutlo koowa har te well lo gudlo.
Har i tchirklo, hoi krik djal dran peskri nesta, jaake hi ko mursh, kai hunte nashell peske dur krik dran peskro foro.
Djet un sungepaskre kashta krenn o dji bachteles. Feteder hi o djijeskro kamlepen i malestar.

Ma muk tiro males, witar gar tiro dadeskro males! Te djal tuke djungeles, ma dja an o kheer tiro phralestar. Hi feteder, te djas pash jekeste, kai gar dur tutar djiwell, har pash tiro phraleste, kai dur tutar krik djiwell.
Ab gosewo, miro tchawo! Un kre miro dji bachteles, jaake te nai rakrau ap kolende pale, kai man praassenn.
Koles i gosewo dji hi, kowa dikell i bibacht te well, un khatrell pes. Kolen tchi an o shero hi, kolla nashenn dureder, un i bibacht well ap lende.

Jek, kai dinelo doha hi, te dell lo peskro dadeskro wast un penell, te plaissrell lo i wawareskri sijaan, kolestar le leskri baja un gar ko wawareskri baja, te hi tut tchomone an o wast, bis te job plaissrell.
Kote hi jek, kai sik taissarlake bares gole dell ‘latcho diwes’ ap koleste, kai pash leste djiwell. Kowa hi koleske har te rakras lo bibacht pral leste win.
I romni, kai hako tsiro tchingepen rodell, hi har i kheer, kai dren dell, te hi brishin.
Kowa, kai kamell lat pale te rikrell, hi har jek, kai kamell i phurdepen pre te rikrell, un har jek, kai kamell djet an o wast te rikrell.
Te dell saster ap saster, wenn hake dui har i tchuri, hoi mishto tchinell. Kai menshe khetne hi, sikell jek o wawarestar, har te djan le mishto khetne trujel.
Kowa, kai ap peskro faigetikro ruk jak della, kowa chal lestar ninna. Un kowa, kai ap peskro rajeste latchepen krell, well lestar sharedo.
An o pani nai dikeh tiro mui. Un an tiro dji nai dikeh, har hal.
O mulengro them well gar tchalo. Jaake hi ninna i menshengre jaka: Jon lenn gar doha.
An i jag well diklo, har bud o rup moldo hi, un an o bob sikrell pes, har bud o sonakai moldo hi. Hoi i mursh moldo hi, sikrell pes ap kowa, hoi pral leste rakedo well.
I kashteha well djob tiknes kerdo an i piri. Ninna te krals jaake i dineleha, perals leskro dinlepen gar lestar tele.
De mishto jak ap tire bakre un busja, te hi len lauter, hoi len hunte well.
Brawlepen atchell gar, un i themeskro rai atchell gar rai hako tsiro.
Anal o phuss dren un o newo senlepen well pale win, un lal khetne ko senlepen ap i berge,
palle hi tut bakrengro bal tire ripjenge, un nai bikreh tire busjendar. Un kol lowentsa nai gineh tuke i hachetikri phub.
Un tut hi doha busjengro thud tuke un tiri familjake, un ninna i djuwjenge, kai budrenn tuke.
O tchilatcho hi ap o naashepen, ninna te lell les kek palla. Kowa, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi, hi har i terno lewo un darell tchi.
Te hi bud tchilatchepen an o them, wenn ninna bud raja pre. Te well sawo mursh o rai, kai djinell bud un haiwell lauter mishto, palle hi o tchatchepen i rah tsiro an o them.
I tchorwelo mursh, kai was baro un rikrell i tchorwelen tele, hi har depen, hoi lauter krik thowell un o djob paash krell.
Kolla, kai mukan o Debleskro drom, sharenn i tchilatchen. Kolla, kai djan ap o Debleskro drom, kurenn pen lentsa.
Tchilatche menshe haiwenn gar, hoi o tchatchepen hi. Kolla, kai o baro Debles rodenn, kolla haiwenn lauter mishto.
Hi feteder te hal tchorwelo un djiweh i djudjo djipen, har te wals brawelo un djals ap bange dromma.
Kowa, kai o Debleskro drom djal, haiwell, hoi mishto un gar mishto hi. Kowa, kai i maal kolentsa hi, kai tchi-molde hi, anell ladj ap peskro dadeste.
Kowa, kai bare lowe kolendar lell, kolen pash leste sijaan hi, un krell pes koleha braweles, koleskro brawlepen lell sawo mensho, koles i baro dji i tchorwelenge hi un lende dell.
Kowa, kai kamell tchi o Debleskro dromestar te djinell, un palle mangell lo tchomone o baro Deblestar, koleskro mangepen hi djungelo glan o Debleskre jaka.
Kowa, kai anell o Debleskre menshen ap i tchilatcho drom, kowa perell kokres an i gruba. Kolla, kai kek doosh ap pende anan, lenna latcho koowa.
O brawelo hi gosewo an peskre jaka, un o tchorwelo, kai tchatchepah gosewo hi, dikell, koon glan leste hi, un perell gar ap leste dren.
Te hi kolen penepaske, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi, palle hi bachtelo tsiro. Te well i tchilatchen penepaske, palle khatrenn pen i menshe.
Kowa, kai peskri doosh khatrell, kowa well gar dur an peskro djipen. Kowa, kai penell, hoi lo kras, un mukell peskri doosh, hatsell o Debleskro kamlepen.
Bachtelo hi kowa, kai hako tsireske o Debleha djiwell! Kowa, kai mukell peskro dji har i bar te well, perell an i bibacht.
I tchilatcho, kai hi o baro rai pral tchorwele menshende, hi har i lewo, hoi bares gole dell, un har i diwjo viecho, hoi bokell ap peskro chapen.
I rai, kai haiwell gar mishto peskre menshentsa trujel te djal, krell bud doosh. Koles, kai kamell gar chochepah braweles te well, koles well i lengsto djipen.
I mensho, kai i wawares mulo das, kowa atchell ap o naashepen, jaake rah har djiwell lo. Kek te rikrell les pre!
Kowa, kai i djudjo djipen djiwell, well win lino dran i bibacht. Kowa, kai ap dui dromma djal, perell ap jekeste.
Kowa, kai ap peskri phub budrell, les hi doha maro. Kowa, kai tchi-moldo koowa krell, well tchorwelo.
I murshes o labestar hi bacht an bud koowa. Kowa, kai kamell sik braweles te well, anell ninna doosh ap peste.
Te dikeh latcheder ap o braweleste har ap o tchorweleste, hi kowa gar mishto. I kotar mareske nai anell i mursh doosh ap peste.
Koles, kai bok pal i lowe hi, nashell o brawlepen palla, un djinell gar, te well jaake o tchorwlepen pral leste.
Te peneh jekeske, hoi job gar mishto kras, palle well ko tsiro, kai parkrell lo pes pash tute. Un kowa budeder, har te rakrals leske pal o mui.
Koon peskro dades un peskri dat wi-randell un penell ‘kowa hi kek doosh’, sawo hi gar feteder har i tchorepaskro.
Kowa, kai bokell pal i lowe, sawo anell tchingepen pre. Kowa, kai rikrell pes ap o baro Debleste, lell budeder har doha te chal.
Dinelo hi kowa, kai krell kokres, hoi peskro dji leske penell. Koon djiwell goswepah, well dran i bibacht win lino.
Kowa, kai dell i tchorweleste, koles well doha djipaske. Kowa, kai jaake krell, har te dikell lo o tchorweles gar, pral koleste rakrenn bud i bibacht win.
I tchilatche, te wenn le raja, palle khatrenn pen i menshe. Jon te merenn, palle wenn kolla budeder, kai o tchatchepen krenn.
Koon mukell pes tchi te penell, un djal hako tsiro pal peskro shero, sawo wella ap jek kopo phagedo, un kek hi palle koi, kai hadell les pale pre.
Te hi bud menshe koi, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi, palle hi i tsele menshe bachtelo. Te hi i tchilatcho o rai pral lende, palle hi i tsele menshenge ropaske.
Kowa, kai kamell o goswepen, krell peskro dades bachtelo. Kowa, kai pes lubjentsa dren mukell, nashrell peskro brawlepen.
I baro rai, kai rikrell pes ap o tchatchepen, kowa krell, te djal o themeske latches. Kowa, kai lell bud themeskre lowe peskre menshendar, kowa krell o them paash.
Kowa, kai makell i wawareske gwin trul o mui, kowa tchiwell i netsa khatedo win glan koleskre pire.
I tchilatcho taprell pes an peskro tchilatchepen. Kowa, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi, djal bachteles peskro drom.
Kowa, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi, kowa dell ninna jak, te lell o tchorwelo peskro tchatchepen. I tchilatche djinenn gar, hoi tchatcho hi.
Kol pre-phurde, kai djinenn lauter feteder, krenn i tselo fores diwjes. I gosewe haiwenn, har te lenn le lengro tchingepen krik.
Te well i gosewo khetne i dineleha pash o tchatchepaskro mursheste, te well o tchatchepen wi-kerdo, palle well o dinelo diwjo un sal. Tchi dikell lo dren.
I marepangre hi chojedo pral koleste, kai kek doosh ap peste anas. Kolla, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi, denn jak ap koleskro djipen.
I dinelo rikrell peskri choli gar pale. I gosewo hi o rai pral peskri choli.
I rai, kai ap chochene laba shunella, koleskre budepangre wenn lauter chochene.
O tchorwelo un kowa, kai les tele rikrell, kol dujen hi jek koowa khetne: Kol dujende das o baro Dewel jaka.
I baro rai, kai dell i tchorwelen lengro tchatchepen, atchell rai i rah tsiro.
Te lell i tchawo i phagi un well leske penlo, hoi lo gar mishto kras, palle well lo gosewo. I tchawo, kai ap peste kokres jak hunte dell, sawo anell ladj ap peskri date.
Kote, kai bud tchilatche hi, kote hi ninna bud doosh. Well ko tsiro, kai dikenn kolla, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi, har i tchilatche perenn.
Sike tiro tchawes soreles, hoi lo gar mishto kras. Palle krell lo tut bachtelo. Un tu hunte ladjess leske gar.
Te hi kek Debleskro rakepen koi, palle wenn i menshe diwjo un bi-pandlo. Bachtelo hi kowa, kai shunell ap o Debleskre laba.
I labentsa mukell pes o budepaskro tchi te sikrell. Ninna te haiwals job, rikrell lo pes gar ap kowa.
Dikeh tu i murshes, kai sik ap o rakepen hi, i dineleske nai djal feteder har saweske.
Te deh tu tiro budepaskres lauter, hoi kamell lo, fun tiknes pre, palle well ko diwes, kai shunell lo buder gar ap tute.
I mursh, kai hako tsiro an i choli hi, sawo krell tchingepen, un anell bud doosh ap peste.
O pre-phurdepen i menshestar krell, te perell lo. Kowa, kai hadell pes gar, well an-diklo.
Kowa, kai djal khetne jekeha, kai tchorell, tchinell pes an peskro mass: job djinell, o praassepen hunte wals ap leste, te penell lo tchi. Un job kamell tchi te penell.
Kowa, kai darell i menshendar, perella. Kowa, kai rikrell pes ap o baro Debleste, pral koleste rikrell lo peskre wasta.
Bud rodenn i rajes pre, te rakrenn le leha. Kowa, kai dell o menshes peskro tchatchepen, hi kokres o baro Dewel.
Chojedo pral kolende, kai tchilatcho koowa krenn, hi kolla, kai o tchatchepen krenn. Un chojedo pral koleste, kai o tchatchepen krell, hi kolla, kai tchilatcho koowa krenn.
Kolla hi laba, hoi rakras o Agur, koleskro dad o Jake his, dran Massa. Kau mursh penas: Me marom man tele, mo Dewel, me marom man tele, mo Dewel, un djinau gar buder dureder.
Har i viecho hom, un menshengro goswepen hi man kek.
Kek sikras man har te wap gosewo, un djinau tchi o Deblestar.

Koon djas pre an o bolepen un pale tele? Koon las o phurdepen an peskre wasta? Koon pandas i tsele panja an i baja? Koon penas, har dur i phub te djal? Har kharell lo? Har kharell leskro tchawo? Djineh tu kowa?
O Dewel rikrell hako lab, hoi das lo. Job rikrell peskre wasta pral kolende, kai wenn pash leste, te dell lo jak ap lende.
Tchip kek lab pash kowa pashel, hoi job penas, te dell lo tut gar trad, un hakeno dikell, kai hal i chocheno.
Mo Dewel, dui koowa mangau me tutar. De len mande jaake rah har djiwau:
Rike man pale, te chochap! Un ma kre, te wap tchorwelo un witar gar, te wap brawelo. De man kokres, hoi man hunte well o djipaske.
Te wals man budeder har man hunte well, nai penaus: “Koon hi o baro Dewel?” Un te wals man gar doha, nai tchoraus un anaus ladj ap miro Debleste.
Ma an chochepen pre ap i budepaskro pash leskro rajeste, te rakrell job kek bibacht pral tute win, un tu hunte plaissress koleske.
Hi menshe koi, kai rakrenn pral pengro dad bibacht win, un penenn kek latcho lab pral pengri date.
Hi menshe koi, kai an pengre jaka djudjo hi, un lengro djungelo koowa was gar tele thodo.
Hi menshe koi, kai patsenn pendar, har latcho jon hi, un dikenn tele ap hako wawareste.
Hi menshe koi, kolengre danda dukrenn har chare un tchinenn har tchurja. Un jon chan i tchorwelen an o them, un kolen, kai lenge kek ap i rig well.
Hi menshe koi, kai hi har ko kirmo, hoi o rat pijell. Koles hi dui tcha. Kolla kharenna: “De kai! De kai!” Triin hi koi, kai gar tchalo wenn, un star penenn an kek tsiro: “Kanna hi man doha”:
o mulengro them; o per i djuwjatar, kai lell kek tchawe; i phub, kai gar bud brishin dell; un i jag, hoi gar gole dell ‘Kanna hi doha!’.
Kowa, kai praassell peskro dades, un kamell gar ap peskri date te shunell, koleske hunte dens i korake i jaka win, un i bare tchirkle hunte chans len.
Triin koowa hi mange jaake baro, te haiwau len gar. Un o startestar djinau me tchi:
O drom o baro tchirklestar, har hadell lo pes an o bolepen; o drom o sapestar ap i bare barra; o drom fun i shiffo ap o baro pani; un o drom o murshestar pash i terni djuwjate.
I djuwel, kai chochell peskro romes un sowell i wawareha, thowell pes pal kowa un penell: “Me krom kek tchilatchepen”, jaake har te chals li un thowals peske o mui tele.
Tel triin koowa trissell i phub, un tel o starto rikrell li les gar win:
Tel i budepaskro, kai i baro rai was; un tel i narwelo, kai brawelo was;
tel i tchilatchi djuwel, kai well romedino. Un tel i budepaskretsa, kai las koi platsa peskri rajetsa dren.
Star vieche hi i tikneder ap kai phub, un hi gosweder har i gosewe menshe:
I kirja: Ninna te hi len kek soor, anenn le pengro chapen khetne an i nijal.
I bergetikre shoshoja: Len hi witar gar bud soor un krenn pengre khera an i bare barra.
I stepangre: Len hi kek rai un djan win har kurepangre, kolenge penlo was, har le hunte djan.
I eideksa: Tu nai taprell lat i wastentsa, un hatseh lat ninna an i sorele shukar khera i bare rajendar.
Triin hi, kai railes pre stakrenn, un o starto hi o raileder:
O lewo, ko sorleder mank i viechende: Glan kekeste djal lo pale;
o bashno, har djal lo pre-phurdemen trujel; o mursh busni; un o baro rai, har djal lo glan peskre lurdende.
Te hals jaake dinelo, te hadal tut pre, un lal tut tchilatcho koowa glan, atch un tchip o wast ap tiro mui!
Te deh thud, well kolatar khil. Te deh jekes ap o nak, ratell kowa. un te mukeh i choli win, well tchingepen.
Kolla hi i laba, hoi rakras i dai o baro rajestar Lemuel ap leste. O Lemuel his o baro rai pral Massa.
Miro tchawo, koles me ap i phub anom, tu, ko tchawo, koles o Deblestar mangom, hoi penap tuke?
Ma de tiri soor i djuwjenge! Ma dja ko drom, ap koleste i bare raja nashedo djan.
Ma pi tut mates! Mool un chatchedo pipen hi tchi bare rajenge un pralstunenge.
Te pijenn le, nai bistrans le, hoi o Dewel lendar kamell, un dikenn buder gar koi pre, te lenn i tchorwele pengro tchatchepen.
Denn sorelo pipen kolenge, kai ap o merepen tchiddo hi, un mool kolenge, kai lenge ropaske hi.
Sawe nai pijenna, te nai bistrenn le pengri bibacht un kowa, hoi lengre djia dukrell.
Kre tu tiro mui pre kolenge, kai gar nai rakrenna, hakeneske, koles gar i soor hi, te anell lo peske kokres peskro tchatchepen dren.
Kre tiro mui pre, kre o tchatchepen jaake win, te lell hakeno peskro tchatchepen, ninna i tchorwele un bibachtele.
I latchi romni, koon hatsell lat? Joi hi budeder moldo har kutch barra.
Lakro rom nai patsell lat un djinell, te rikrell li pash leste. Un dran kowa hoi les hi, krell li gomme budeder.
Joi krell leske latchepen un kek tchilatchepen, jaake rah har djiwell li.
Joi lell bakrengro bal un laintikre thaba, un budrell bachteles peskre wastentsa.
Joi anell chapen khetne fun dural har i shiffo, hoi paredo koowa anell.
Joi stell pre, kote hi gomme rati, un krell o chapen peskro khereske, un penell i djuwjenge, kai lake budrenn, hoi te krenn le.
Joi rodell i hachetikri phub un ginell lat, un kol lowentsa, hoi lakre wasta dren anan, tchiwell li terne drakengre ruka an i phub.
Joi budrell phares un krell peskre mussja soreles.
Joi haiwell, te anell lakri budi tchomone dren. Ninna rati djal pash late i momeli gar win.
Joi lell koi thabeskri spindla an o wast, un krell peskre thaba.
Joi krell peskro wast pre i tchorwelenge, un dell kolende, kolen gar doha hi.
Joi darell gar peskro khereske, te well o wend. Hakenes an lakro kheer hi tate koola.
Plachte krell li peske, rido hi li an latcho laintikro than un lolo bakrengro bal.
Lakro rom hi an-diklo an o foro, te rakrell lo pes tele i phurentsa.
Kutch gada krell li un bikrell len, un i parepangre lenn latar kol pereskre dorja, hoi jon bikrenn.
Joi hi sorelo un an-diklo, un joi darell gar o tsirestar, hoi wella.
Lakro rakepen hi pherdo goswepen, un latche labentsa sikrell li, har tchomone djal.
Joi dikell pal lauter, hoi an o kheer kerdo well. Un ko mareske, hoi li chal, budras li.
Lakre mursh tchawe stakrenn glan un sharenn lat. Un lakro rom sharell lat kal labentsa:
“Bud romja hi bud moldo, tu hal i latcheder lendar lauterendar!”
O shukapen atchell gar, un i shukar djuwel well ninna phuro. I romni, kai djiwell o baro Debleha, kolat sharenn le.
Parkrenn tumen pash late lautereske, hoi joi kras! Giwenn kolestar ap i platse an o foro!
Kalla hi i laba, hoi o sikepaskro rakras. Job hi i Davideskro tchawo un o baro rai an o foro Jerusalem.
Phares te haiwell hi halauter, penas o sikepaskro, halauter an o djipen hi phares te haiwell.
Hoi lell o mensho peske dran peskri tseli phari budi, hoi les hi ap kai phub?
Menshe wenna un djana. Kokres i phub atchell, har li hi.
O kham djal pre un djal pale tele, un nashell kote, kai lo pale pre djal.
O ducho tel o bolepen phurdell an jek rig, un palle rissrell lo un phurdell an i wawar rig, kai his lo.
I tsele tikne panja nashenn an o baro pani. Un o baro pani well gar pherdo. Un o pani well pale kote, kai lo his, un kotar nashell lo pale.
Khines krell man halauter, hoi i menshe rakrenna, un kek nai hatsell i tchatche laba. O jak nai dikell pes gar tchales, un o kand nai shunell pes gar tchales.
Hoi koi his, hi hoi wella, un hoi kerdo was, hi hoi kerdo wella. Kek newo koowa hi tel o kham!
Dik kowa, penenn le, ko hi newo! Ninna kowa his glan maro tsiro koi, an kol tsirja kai glan mende his.
Mer bistrah kol menshen, kai glan mende djiwan. Un kolla, kai pal mende wenn, wenn bistedo kolendar, kai pal lende wenn.
Me, o sikepaskro, me homs o rai pral o them Israel un djiwom an o foro Jerusalem.
Miri tseli djijeskri sorjah un goswepah rodom, te haiwap o tselo koowa, hoi ap i phub halauter kerdo wella. Hawo pharepen das o Dewel i menshende, te marenn le pen tele koleha.
Me dikom halauter, hoi kerdo was ap kai phub, un nai penau tumenge, halauter hi tchitcheske, un jaake har te nashals jek pal o ducho, hoi djal pral i phub.
Tu nai kreh gar tchatcho, hoi bango hi. Un hoi gar koi hi, nai well gar ginlo.
Me penom mange: Me wom i baro mursh, gosweder har hakeno, kai glan mande o baro rai an Jerusalem his. Man hi i gosewo dji un haiwau bud.
Miri tseli djijeskri sorjah kamom te hatsap win, hoi tchatchepah goswepen hi, un hoi dinelo un narwelo hi. Un kote hatsom win, kai kowa jaake hi, har te nashoms pal o ducho, hoi djal pral i phub.
Kones bud goswepen hi, koleske djal ninna bud an o shero trujel. Koon bud djinell, koleske well ropaske pral kowa.
Me penom mange: Mishto palle, me kamau latches te djiwell un mukau les mange mishto te djal! Kote haiwom, kai kowa ninna tchitcheske hi.
Me hatsom win, kai ninna o sapen dinlepen hi! Un o gipen an tiro dji anell tuke tchi.

An miro rodepen pal o goswepen rakrom miro djijeha, un penom mange: Pi tuke i mool, te wess bachtelo. Un jaake har i dinelo wom mato. Koi putchom mandar: Hi sawo koowa mishto o mensheske an peskro tikno djipen?
Me krom baro koowa: Me krom mange khera un drakengre themma,
un wawar kotja them, kai tchiwom shukar burra un ruka an i phub, ninna sawe ruka, kai hidjrenn rukengre.
Me krom mange tikne panja, te well man doha pani kol bud rukenge.

Me ginom mange budepangren, murshen un djuwjen. Un man his ninna budepangre, kai wan boldo an miro kheer. Man his budeder grumja un bakre har halauter, kai glan mande i bare raja an o foro Jerusalem his.

Me lom mange ninna rup un sonakai khetne, un hoi wawar raja un themma man dan. Me mukom gipangren pash mande khetne te well, murshen un djuwjen. Un man his jaake bud djuwja har kamom, te krenn le man bachtelo.
