Un me wom baro un bareder har hakeno, kai glan mande o rai an o foro Jerusalem his. Un ko tselo koowa, hoi kote krom, krom o goswepah.

Halauter hoi mire jaka kaman, kowa dom len. Un miro djijeske dom halauter, hoi mukas les te bashrell. Jaake wom bachtelo pral halauter hoi krom. Un halauter, koleske man tele marom, anas mange tchatchepah bacht an o dji.

Un har dikom ko tselo koowa, hoi mire wasta kran, un koi budi, hoi man koi pashel his, kote haiwom, lauter hi tchitcheske, har te nashoms pal o ducho, hoi djal pral i phub. Un tchi well win dran halauter, hoi krom an miro djipen.

Kote djom trujel, te dikap, hoi well dran o goswepen win? Hi kowa wawartchandes har kowa, hoi well dran o narwlepen un o dinlepen win? Hoi krell ko mursh, kai pal mande o baro rai hi? Kowa hoi glan leste kerdo was, krell job ninna!
Me dikom, o goswepen hi feteder har o dinlepen, jaake har o diwes feteder hi har i rati.
Kowa, kai gosewo hi, dikell, kai lo djal. O dinelo nashell an i rati. Un ninna haiwom, jekeske djal har o wawareske.
Kote penom mange: Te djal mange har o dineleske, hoske rodom palle pal o goswepen? Ninna kowa hi tchitcheske.
I gosewe hunte merenn, un i dinele ninna. Un ko gosewo well jaake sik bistedo har ko dinelo. An i tsirja kai wenna, hi halauter bistedo.
Kote his mange miro djipen buder gar shukar. Kowa, hoi i menshe krenna ap kai phub, hi tchitcheske. Halauter hi tchitcheske, un jaake har te nashals jek pal o ducho, hoi djal pral i phub.
Un kowa halauter, koleske man tele marom an miro djipen, hunte mukap jekeske, kai pal mande well. Doleske his mange kowa witar gar shukar.

Koon djinell, koon kowa hi, kai pal mande well, i gosewo mursh oder i dinelo mursh? Well har wella! Job well o rai pral halauter, koleske man tele marom un gosewes pre tchiwom an miro djipen. Jaake hi kowa ninna tchitcheske.
Awa, miro dji peras an i rati pral koleste me man tele marom an miro djipen.
Kowa, hoi i mensho goswepah un latche wastentsa kras, hunte mukell lo halauter i wawareske, kai kras tchi koleske. Kowa hi ninna tchitcheske un i bari bibacht.
Hoi atchell o mensheske, kai pes tele budras un tele maras pash peskri budi?
Leskro tselo djipen hi pherde duka, un leskro budepen pherdo ropen. Ninna an i rati nai sowell lo gar. Kowa hi ninna tchitcheske.
Tchi hi feteder o mensheske, har te chal lo un pijell lo un well bachtelo pral kowa, hoi lo krell. I bachtelo dji, kowa dikom, well dran o Debleskro wast.
Kekes hi chapen, un kek nai mukell les peske mishto te djal, te dell les o Dewel kowa gar!

Kol menshe, kai djiwenn jaake har glan o Debleste mishto hi, kolla lenna lestar goswepen un bacht an o dji. Kolla, kai djan o Debleskro dromestar tele, kolen mukell lo te budrell un brawlepen khetne anell, hoi pal i tsiro i wawareske well, jekeske, kai djiwell jaake har glan o Debleste mishto hi. Palle his leskri tseli budi tchitcheske, un jaake har te nashals lo pal o ducho, hoi djal pral i phub.
Halauter, hoi djal ap i phub, koles hi peskro tsiro. Halauter, hoi krah, djal an o tchatcho tsiro:
Jek tsiro hi koi, kai o mensho boldo wella, un jek tsiro hi koi, kai o mensho merella; jek tsiro, kai tchiwah senlepen an i phub, un jek tsiro, kai well ko senlepen pale win tserdedo.
Dell jek tsiro, kai well maredo, un jek tsiro, kai well o dukepen sasto; jek tsiro, kai well o kheer tele phagedo, un jek tsiro, kai well o kheer pre-tchiddo.
O ropaske hi jek tsiro, un o sapaske hi jek tsiro. Dell tsirja, kai rowell maro dji, un wawar tsirja, kai khelah i bachtjatar.
Jek tsiro hi koi, te witsras barra, un jek tsiro, te tchiwas barra khetne. Dell jek tsiro, kai taprah men trujel, un jek tsiro, kai taprah men buder gar trujel.
Jek tsiro hi koi, te rodas tchomone, un jek tsiro, kai rodah buder gar. Jek tsiro hi koi, kai rikrah tchomone, un jek tsiro, kai witsrah les krik.
Koi hi jek tsiro, kai krenn i menshe pengre koola paash, un jek wawar tsiro, kai siwenn le penge newe koola. Koi hi jek tsiro, kai rakrah gar, un i wawar tsiro, kai rakrah.
Koi hi tsirja, kai i menshe kamenn pen, un tsirja, kai tchingrenn le ap i wawarende. Dell tsirja, kai djiwah an o kurepen, un wawar tsirja, kai dell kek kurepen.
Hoi well koleske win, kai krell peskri budi un marell pes tele?
Me lom koi budi an o jak, hoi das o Dewel i menshende, kolah marenn le pen tele.

Hako koowa, hoi o Dewel krell, krell lo ap o tchatcho tsiro. Un job tchiwas o mensheske an o dji, te haiwell lo, kai hi tchomone koi, hoi atchell hako tsiro. Ninna te hi kowa jaake, nai haiwell o mensho gar ko tselo koowa, hoi o Dewel krell, kokres tikne kotja kolestar.
Doleske penom mange: Tchi hi feteder o mensheske, har te djiwals lo i shukar djipen un hi bachtelo koi pashel.
Jaake nai penah: Mer te chas, pijas un budras i bachtelo djijeha. Kowa lauter well men o Deblestar.
Me haiwom, kai halauter, hoi o Dewel krella, hako tsireske atchella. Kek mendar nai krell tchomone pashel, un kek mendar nai lell tchomone krik. Kowa halauter krell o Dewel, te sharas mer les.
Hoi kanna koi hi, his glan mende koi. Un hoi pal mende wella, his ninna koi. Un o Dewel anell pale, hoi jek kopo koi his.
Ninna dikom ap i phub, kote kai hunte rakrans i tchatchepangre o tchatchepen, his o tchilatchepen o rai. Un kote, kai hunte djans le pal o tchatchepen, rakran le chochepah.

Kote penom mange: O Dewel rakrell o tchatchepen win pral koleste, kai djiwell an o tchatchepen, un pral koleste, kai djiwell an o tchilatchepen. Hako koowa, un halauter, hoi jek krell, koleske dell i tchatcho tsiro.
Me penom mange: Halauter djal jaake, te dikell o Dewel, har hako mensho pes rikrella. Un job kamell les te sikrell, te hi lo gar feteder har i viecho.
O mensheske djal har o viecheske: I vieche merenna, jaake merenn ninna i menshe. Un len halauter hi i ducho. Un o menshes hi tchi glan-wi glan o viecho. Tchatchepah, kowa hi phares te haiwell.
Halauter hunte merell, hako djipen was dran i tchik, un hako djipen well pale tchik.
Kek nai djinell, te djal o mensheskro ducho pral an o bolepen un o viecheskro ducho tele an i phub.
Jaake dikom dren, tchi hi feteder, har te krell i mensho bachteles peskri budi; i bachtelo dji hi leskro brawlepen. Kek nai penell o mensheske, hoi ap i phub djala, te hi lo buder gar koi.

Palle dikom halauter, hoi gar tchatcho hi ap i phub. Me dikom i swa kolendar, kai dan le lenge gar lengro tchatchepen, un kolenge kek ap i rig was. Kolla, kai kran lenge tchilatchepen, his sorelo. Doleske was kek ap lengri rig.
Kote penom mange, bachteles hi kolla, kai meran un paskedo hi, kolenge hi feteder har kolenge, kai kanna djiwenna.
Un feteder har kol dujenge hi koleske, kai was gar boldo un dikas gar ko tselo tchilatchepen, hoi well kerdo ap i phub.

Un me dikom, har marenn pen i menshe tele un krenn latchi budi, te wenn le feteder har kol wawar, jaake te silwerenn kolla ap lende. Kowa hi ninna tchi-moldo, un jaake har te nashals jek pal o ducho, hoi djal pral i phub.
Koon kamell gar te budrell, tchiwell peskre wasta glan peskri betch khetne. Job hi dinelo un leske atchell tchi te chal.
Feteder i wast pherdo djipaske un tsirja, kai kreh tchi, har dui wasta pherdo djipaske un bud budi un i naashepen pal o ducho, hoi djal pral i phub.
Un palle dikom i wawar koowa ap i phub, hoi hi phares te haiwell.

Kote hi jek kokres, un kek hi pash leste. Kek tchawo hi les un kek phraal. Un job budrell un budrella, te well lo brawelo. Job hunte putchals pestar: Koneske budrau man tele, un mukau les mange gar mishto te djal? Sawo koowa hi phares te haiwell un i bibacht.
Dujenge djal feteder har jekeske. Te budrenn dui khetne, well jek o wawareske pash o wast.
Te perell jek, hadell les ko wawar pre. Har djungeles djal koleske, kai kokres hi, un perella! Palle hi kek wawar koi, kai hadell les pre.
Ninna, dui te hi an o tchiben tchiddo, nai tatsrenn le pen khetne. Har nai tatsrell pes jek, te hi lo kokres?
Jek te hi lo kokres, nai well sik khetne dino. Dui te hi khetne, nai wenn le sorleder har kowa, kai djal ap lende pre. Triin pesse thaba krenn i dori, hoi djal gar sik paash.
I terno mursh, kai gosewo hi, ninna te hi lo gar brawelo, hi feteder har i phuro baro rai, kai dinelo hi, un mukell peske tchi te penell.
Kowa hi tchatcho, ninna te his ko terno mursh i pandlo budepaskro un was win ginlo, te well lo baro rai, ninna te was lo boldo an i tchorweli familja an ko them, pral leste job o rai well.
Un me dikom, har i tsele djide menshe ap kai phub pengro djipen djiwenn. Ninna dikom i wawar terno murshes, kai pal leste o baro rai wals.

Un me dikom bud menshe, jaake bud te penau nai gar, kitse jon hi. Kolla kai his glan leste, un kolla, kai wan pal leste, kek lendar his bachtelo pral kowa, hoi job kras. Kowa hi ninna tchi-moldo, un jaake har te nashals jek pal o ducho, hoi djal pral i phub.

De garda, hoi kreh, te djah tu an o Debleskro kheer! Ab glan o Debleste un shun ap leskre laba! Kowa hi feteder, har te aneh leske viechen kokres, har dinele menshe krenn. Kolla djinenn gar, kai krenn le dinelo koowa.
Ma kre tiro mui sik pre, te rakreh glan o Debleste. O Dewel hi an o bolepen, un tu hal ap i phub. Doleske kre gar bud laba, te rakreh.
Koneske bud an o shero trujel djal, kowa dell phare sunja. Un koon bud laba krell, rakrell sik dinelo koowa.

Te deh tu tut sowel glan o Debleste, palle muk tut tchitchestar pale te rikrell, te kress kowa, hoi glan leste penal! O Dewel dikell gar latches ap ko dineleste, kai nai rikrell gar, hoi lo sowel das.
Feteder hi, te deh tut gar sowel, har te deh tut sowel un rikreh gar, hoi penal.

De garda te rakress gar sawo koowa, hoi nai rikreh gar dren! Ma pen glan i Debleskro mursheste: ‘Kowa kamom gar te penell’. O Debles nai well i choli pral tire laba, un job nai mukals kowa gar mishto te djal, hoi tire wastentsa kral.
Tchatchepah, bud sunja un bud laba molenn tchi. Dran kowa kre kowa, hoi o Debles sharell!

Te dikeh tu, har an o them o tchorwelo tele rikedo well, un o tchatchepen tele stakedo well, un kek peskro tchatchepen lell, palle kre kek bare jaka: I pralstune rikrenn khetne, un pral lende hi wawar pralstune, kai rikrenn i wasta pral kolende.
Hi feteder o themeske, te hi les i baro rai, kai dikell koi pre, te well ap o hachetikro them budedo, te well i menshen doha djipaske.
Kowa, kai i lowe kamella, koles nai well gar doha lowe. Un kowa, kai lell pes brawlepen khetne, koles nai well witar gar doha. Ninna kau koowa hi tchitcheske.
Kote kai bud brawlepen hi, kote hi ninna bud, kai chan o brawlepen pre; un koles, kai kowa lauter hi, leske atchell tchi, har te dikell lo les an!
Gudlo hi o sopen koleske, kai budrella, te chas lo bud oder gar bud; o brawlepen o brawelestar mukell les gar te sowell.
I djungelo koowa dikom ap i phub: Hi menshe koi, kai garenn pengro brawlepen pash peste un denn mishto jak ap kowa.
Un i bibacht well un jon nashrenn halauter. Un te hi i tchawo koi, atchell leske tchi an o wast.
Jaake har jek nanges boldo was, jaake djal lo pale, har lo was. Ninna te budras lo bud, nai lell lo tchi pestar peha, te merell lo.
Job hunte djal, har lo was. Kowa hi i bari bibacht leske. Leskri phari budjatar atchell leske tchi. Kowa hi, har te marals lo pes tele tchitcheske.
Peskro tselo djipen mukas lo pes gar mishto te djal. Bud pharo koowa djas leske an o shero trujel un kras leske daar. Un koi pashel was nasslepen un choli an leskro djipen.

Kowa hi, hoi me dikom dren, un hoi mishto hi, un ko feteder, hoi nai krah an maro tikno djipen, hoi o Dewel men das, te chas mer un pijas un kras i bachtelo djijeha mari budi. Jaake kamell kowa o Dewel mendar.

Te dell o Dewel i menshes brawlepen un latcho kowa, te nai chal lo un pijella, un te nai mukell lo peske mishto te djal, un leskro dji sal pral halauter, hoi leske dran peskri phari budi was, palle hi kowa tchomone, hoi o Deblestar was.
O Dewel das les bacht an o dji. Doleske hunte krell lo peske kek shero pral o tikno tsiro, kai hi lo ap kai phub.
Kote hi i bibacht, hoi me dikom ap kai phub, koja well pale te pale pral i menshende.

Kote hi jek, koles kras o Dewel baro un an-diklo, das les brawlepen un bud latcho koowa. Jaake hi les halauter, hoi o dji kamella. Un palle mukell les o Dewel gar kolestar te chal un bachteles te well. I wawar lell kowa halauter un chal les pre. Sawo koowa hi ninna phares te haiwell un krell man nasselo.

Nai well i mursh, koleske wenn sheel tchawe boldo, un job djiwell bud bersha. Te wals lo jaake phuro un wals gar bachtelo pral o latchepen an peskro djipen, un leske wals witar kek paskepen kerdo, kolestar penau me: I ternepen, kai mulo boldo was, djal feteder har leske.
Ko ternepen was boldo kek djipah, un an i rati djal lo koi. Kek nai djinell, hoi lestar wals.
O kham dikas lo gar un prindjras o djipen gar. Job sowell i latcho sopen, feteder har ko brawelo.
Ninna te wals kowa dui serja bersha phuro, les wals tchi peskro djipastar – hake dui hunte meran.
O mensho marell pes tele peskro chapaske. Un pale te pale lell lo bok un well gar tchalo hako tsireske.
Hoi hi o gosewes o dineleske glan-wi an kau koowa? Hoi molell kanna o tchorweleske, te djinell lo, har te djal lo peskro drom mishto?
Well penlo: Feteder hi te dikas ap kowa, hoi men hi, har te nashas wawar koowa palla. Kowa hi ninna tchitcheske, un jaake har te nashams pal o ducho, hoi djal pral i phub.
Halauter, hoi koi hi, las peskro lab. Mer djinah, har i menshe hi. Doleske nai tchingrell i mensho gar koleha, kai sorleder hi har job.
Jaake bud rakrell lo, jaake budeder hi leskro rakepen tchi-moldo. Hoi anell kowa o mensheske?
Kek djinella, hoi o mensheske mishto hi an peskro djipen, hoi jaake tikno hi. Kau diwes hi lo koi un o wawar diwes buder gar. Un koon nai penell o mensheske, hoi pal leste wella ap kai phub?

Well penlo: Hi feteder, te well jek latches an-diklo mank i menshende, har te makell lo pes latcho djeteha. Me penau: O diwes, kai i mensho merella, hi feteder har ko diwes, kai i mensho ap kai phub wella.

O mensheske hi feteder te djal lo an i kheer, kai jek meras un i menshe rowenna, har te djal lo an i kheer, kai krenn le i bijab. Kote, kai jek meras, well diklo, kai hako mensho hunte merella. Un koon gomme djido hi, mukell pes kowa an o dji te djal.
Ropen hi feteder har sapen; pash o ropen nai well jekeskro dji feteder.
O gosewo djal kote, kai jek meras un i menshe rowenna. O dinelo djal kote, kai sapaske hi.
O mensheske hi feteder te shunell lo ap i goseweste, kai tchingrell leha, har te shunell lo ap i gilja, kolentsa i dinele les sharenn.
O sapen i dinelendar hi menge gar budeder moldo har i gole, hoi denn sane kashta tel i piri, te wenn le chatchedo.
Ninna o gosewo well har i dinelo, te mukell lo pes te ginell. Dell jek leste lowe, te krell lo, hoi gar tchatcho hi, un job lell kol lowe an, palle nai djal lo buder gar pal o tchatchepen.
Feteder hi, te pandess tiro mui, har te kress tiro mui pre o rakepaske. Feteder hi, te dess gar sik pre, har te wess pre-phurdo.
De garda te wess gar sik chojedo! Koon choirell pes pral halauter, hi dinelo.
Ma pen: An o phuro tsiro his halauter feteder har kanna! Te wals tu gosewo, penals tu kowa gar!
O goswepen hi jaake mishto har i brawlepen, hoi o dad peskro tchaweske mukas. Hakeneske ap kai phub hi o goswepen bud moldo.
O goswepen hi har lowe. Kones kolestar doha hi, kowa hunte darell gar. Leskro goswepen rikrell o gosewes an o djipen.
Dik, hoi o Dewel halauter kras! Kek nai krell wawartchandes, hoi job bango kras!

Te hi tut i latcho tsiro, palle muk les tuke latches te djal. Te hi tut i djungelo tsiro, palle dikess dren: O Dewel kras ko jek tsiro har ko wawar, te djinell o mensho gar, hoi wella an kol diwessa, kai wenna.

Me dikom bud koowa an miro djipen, hoi haiwom me gar: Koi hi i latcho mursh, kai djiwas i tchatcho djipen, un job merella glan te was lo phuro. Un koi hi i chocheno mursh, ko djiwell an o tchilatchepen, un job djiwell i rah djipen.
Ma rike o tchatchepen sorleder dren har tchinlo hi! Un ma kre tut gosweder har hal! Hoske kameh tut paash te krell?
Rike tut pale o tchilatchepastar! Un ma ab har i dinelo! Hoske kameh te merell glan tiro tsiro?
Mishto hi, te rikreh tut ap ko jek lab, un bistreh witar gar ko wawar lab. Koon djiwell o Debleha, rikrell pes ap kowa lauter.
Leskro goswepen krell o gosewes sorleder har deesh sorele pralstune, kai an o foro garda denna.
Kek mensho hi jaake an o tchatchepen tardo, te krell lo kokres latcho koowa un anell kek doosh ap peste.
De tchi ap ko tselo rakepen, hoi i menshe rakrenna! Nai wals te shuneh, har tiro budepaskro pral tute tchingrell.
Tu djineh, bud kope tchingral pral wawarende.
Kowa halauter kamom te haiwell i gosewo djijeha. Me penom mange ‘me kamau gosewo te well’. Un me nai haiwom les gar.
Lauter, hoi koi hi, hi phares te haiwell. Un hoske kowa jaake hi, djinell kek.

Palle penom mange, tu hunte rodess budeder, te hatsess win, hoske tchomone jaake hi. Jaake lom bud koowa an i jak, te haiwap len. Kamom te djinap, well o tchilatchepen dran o dinlepen un o pre-phurdepen dran narwlepen?

Un me hatsom tchomone, hoi shutleder hi har o merepen, – i djuwel, kai i murshen taprell; kolakro kamlepen hi har dorja, kolentsa len pandell li; lakre mussja, hoi le trul lende tchiwell hi har shelle. I mursh, kai mishto hi glan o Debleskre jaka, kowa nai nashell peske latar; o dinelo well latar tapedo.
Dik, penell o sikepaskro, kowa hi, hoi hatsom win, har dikom ap jek koowa pal o wawar, te haiwap kau tselo koowa feteder.
Har rodom kate te kote, hatsom win: Me nai haiwau gar halauter. Jek koowa dikom: Mank serja menshe hatsom jek mursh, kai his, har hunte wals lo. Sawi djuwel hatsom me gar mank kol bud djuwjende.
Dik, kowa kokres hatsom: O Dewel kras o menshes jaake, te djiwell lo an o tchatchepen; i menshe rodenn penge bud dromma, kai nai krenn le tchilatchepen.

Kai hi ko mensho, kai hi tchatchepah gosewo? Kai hi kowa, kai haiwell te penell, hoske tchomone jaake hi har kowa hi? Dik i menshes an i jaka, palle nai peneh, hi lo gosewo oder gar. Te hi lo gosewo, palle dikell lo latches ap i wawareste. Leskro goswepen lell leskri choli krik.
Te dan tumen sowel glan o baro Debleste, te shunenn ap kowa, hoi o baro rai tumenge penell, palle rikrenn tumen ap kowa!
Ma djan sik lestar krik! Ma krenn, hoi djungeles hi glan leskre jaka! O baro rai nai krella, hoi job kamella.
An o baro rajeskro lab hi sorlepen, un kek nai penell ap leste: Hoske kreh tu kowa?
Kowa, kai rikrell pes ap o baro rajeskro lab, kowa djal gar khetne kolentsa, kai hadenn pen pral o baro rajeste. O gosewo djinell, o tsiro well, kai lenn le i phagi.
Lautereske, hoi i mensho krella, well o tsiro, kai well o tchatchepen pral leste wi-rakedo. Un o mensheskro tchilatchepen hi phares ap leste tchiddo.
Mer djinah gar, hoi wella. Koon nai penell menge, har halauter wella?

O menshes hi kek soor, te nai rikrell lo o phurdepen pre. Un les hi kek soor pral ko diwes, kai merell lo. Ninna glan o kurepen nai nashell peske kek. Un peskro tchilatcho koowa nai lell gar o tchilatches win dran i bibacht.
Kowa halauter dikom, un lom halauter an o jak, hoi well kerdo ap kai phub, kai hadell pes jek pral o wawareste un krell les bibachtelo.
Un pale dikom, har tchilatche menshe shukar paskedo wan. Un kolla, kai o tchatcho koowa kran, hunte mukan o Debleskro kheer, un wan bistedo an o foro. Kowa hi ninna phares te haiwell.
Ko mensho, kai kras tchilatcho koowa, lell gar sik pal kowa peskri phagi. Doleske rikrenn pen i menshe gar pale, te krenn le pengro djungelo koowa dureder.
Ninna te djiwell kowa i lengsto djipen, kai krell sheel kope fullo koowa, djinau me, te djal kolenge kokres mishto, kai djiwenn o Debleha un mukenn les lengro rai te well.
O tchilatcheske djal gar mishto. Un jaake har i shatto gar rah koi hi, djiwenn kolla gar rah, kai kamenn tchi o Deblestar te djinell.

Phares te haiwell hi kowa, hoi hi kerdo ap kai phub: Kote hi menshe kai djiwenn an o tchatchepen, un kolenge djal har i menshenge, kai djiwenn i djungelo djipen. Un pale hi menshe koi, kai djiwenn i fullo djipen, kolenge djal har te djiwans le an o tchatchepen. Kote penom: Kowa hi ninna phares te haiwell.

Doleske penau me: Men hunte wals i dji, hoi bachtelo hi. O mensheske dell tchi ap kai phub, hoi feteder hi, har te chal lo un te pijell lo, un te mukell lo les peske mishto te djal. Kowa hi, hoi nai krah pash mari tseli budi an maro djipen, hoi o Dewel men das ap kai phub.
Me kamom win te hatsell, har te nai wau gosewo, un lom halauter an o jak, hoi i menshe ap kai phub krenna. Diwes un rati nai sowom gar.

Un me dikom halauter, hoi o Dewel kras. Tchatchepah, i menshe nai haiwenn gar halauter, hoi job kras ap kai phub. Ninna te rodell o mensho phares, te haiwell lo ko koowa, nai hatsell lo gar win, hoske halauter jaake hi. Un ninna o gosewo, te penell lo: “Me djinau les”, nai hatsell lo les gar win.

Kowa halauter lom ap miro dji, te haiwap kowa: Tchatche un gosewe, un halauter hoi jon krenna, hi an o Debleskro wast. Kek djinella, wenn i wawar latches ap leste? Wenn le chojedo ap leste? Kowa lauter well diklo an ko tsiro, hoi wella.

Halauter hunte merenna. Kowa djal jaake jekeske har ko wawareske, koleske, kai shunell ap o Debleste har koleske, kai kamell tchi o Deblestar te djinell, koleske, kai krell o latchepen un koleske, kai krell o tchilatchepen, koleske, kai hi erligo un koleske, kai hi pale-tchiddo, koleske, kai chatchrell viechen o Debleske har koleske, kai chatchrell kek viechen leske. Jaake har o latcheske djal, jaake djal o tchilatcheske. Un kowa, kai dell pes sowel, koleske djal jaake har koleske, kai kamell pes gar sowel te dell.

Kowa hi koi bibacht pash halauter, hoi djal ap kai phub, te djal ko jekeske har ko wawareske djala. Un koi pashel hi o dji o menshendar pherdo tchilatchepen un pherdo dinlepen, jaake rah har jon djiwenna; pal kowa merenn le!
Kowa, kai gomme djido hi, dikell ap ko tsiro, hoi wella. I djido djukleske djal feteder har i mulo leweske.
I djide djinenna, kai hunte merenn le, i mule djinenn tchi. Koleske, hoi le kran, well len witar buder tchi. Bistedo hi le.

Har i menshe kaman len, un har choiran le pen pral lende, un har silweran jon ap lende, kowa lauter hi buder gar koi. Len hi tchi buder i menshentsa ap kai phub khetne, un koleha, hoi kerdo well ap kai phub.
Doleske cha tiro maro un pi tiri mool i bachtelo djijeha; kowa kamell o Dewel jaake tutar.
Rib shukar ripja un tchip sungepaskro djet ap tire balla!

Muk les tuke mishto te djal an tiro djipen tiri romjah, kai tu kameh, jaake rah har tut kau djipen hi, hoi tut o Dewel das, un hoi jaake sik trujel hi. Sawi bacht was tuke o Deblestar pash tiri tseli budi, hoi tu hunte kress kate ap kai phub.

Halauter, hoi tuke glan o wast well, te kress, kowa kre o tselo djijestar! Pash i mulende, kai tu ninna hunte djas, kote well buder tchi kerdo. Un kek krell peske kote i shero, hoi nai krell lo, har nai djinell lo tchomone, un har nai well lo gosewo.

Pale dikom, har ap kai phub djala: O sikeder naashepaskro well gar glanstunes an. O sorleder kurepaskro hi gar o feteder lurdo. Sikle menshe hi gar kolla, konen o budeder chapen hi. I gosewe hi gar i brawele. Kowa, kai tchomone mishto haiwell, hi gar kowa, kai an-diklo hi. O tsiro un i bacht penenn, har hakeneske djal.
Ninna djinell o mensho peskro tsiro gar, un well tapedo an o tchilatcho tsiro, hoi ap jek kopo pral leste perell, jaake har i matche tapedo wenn an i netsa, un i tchirkle an pandle dorja.
Ninna dikom ap kai phub, hoi i gosewo kras, un kowa his mange bares:

Kote his i tikno foro, un gar bud lurde his an ko foro. Un palle was i baro sorelo rai, un tchiwas pes un peskre lurden trul ko tselo foro trujel, un kras phubjakre dromma, hoi djan ap o foreskre massurja, te djal lo an o foro dren.
Un an ko foro his i tchorwelo, gosewo mursh. Peskro goswepah nai lals kowa ko foro win dran o wawareskro wast. Un kek his koi, kai rakras leha un putchas ko tchorwelo murshes.
Kote penom mange: Ninna te hi o goswepen feteder har o sorlepen, well o tchorweleskro goswepen gar an-diklo, un ap leskre laba well gar shunlo.
I gosewo rakepen, hoi kek goljah rakedo was, hi budeder moldo har i rajeskri bari gole mashkral i dinelendar.
O goswepen hi budeder moldo har i sorelo charo; un jek dinelo koowa krell bud latcho koowa paash.
Mule matsille an o sungepaskro djet krenn o latcho djet fulles. I tikno dinlepen nai krell o tselo goswepen un an-dikepen i menshestar paash.
O goseweske penell leskro dji, te krell lo, hoi tchatcho hi. O dineleske penell leskro dji, te krell lo, hoi gar tchatcho hi.
I narweleskro drom sikrell, har dinelo job hi. Lauter penenn lestar: Hawo narwelo hi lo!
Te well o rajeskri choli pral tute, palle ma dja tutar; jek kai haiwell te rikrell lo pes pale, rakrell jaake, te djal i choli krik.
I djungelo koowa dikom ap kai phub, kowa anenn i sorele pale te pale ap pende:
I dineleske denn le peskri beshepaskri kote, kai i pralstune beshenna, un i brawele hunte beshenn pen ap i telstune beshepangre.
Budepangren dikom, kai ap graja beshde hi, un pralstune hunte nashan har budepangre.
Koon i cheb win hadella, nai perell koi dren. Un koon i massuri khetne phagella, koles nai dandrell i sap.
Koon barra khetne phagella, kowa nai dukrell pes koi pashel. Un kowa, kai kasht tiknes krella, nai dukrell pes, te dell lo gar garda.
Te hi jekes i tower, hoi tchinell buder gar, hunte budrell job peskri tseli sorjah. Te hi lo gosewo, dikell lo palla, te tchinell o tower mishto.
I murshes, kai haiwell mishto o sapeha te rakrell, hi tchi kolestar, te well job dandedo, glan te durkras lo o sap.
O rakepen hoi dran o goseweskro mui win wella, anell leske an-dikepen, o dineleskro rakepen chal les pre.
Hako lab, hoi penell lo, hi fun glanstunes bis palstunes dinelo rakepen.
Ko dinelo krell bud laba un haiwas gar, kai kek mensho djinella, har halauter wella. Un kek nai penell leske, hoi pal leste wella.
I budi krell o dineles khino, un job djinell gar, har te hatsell lo o drom an o foro.
Djungeles djal i menshenge an i them, koleskro baro rai i tchawo hi, un kai i pralstune taissarlakro chapangre hi!
Bachtelo hi ko them, kai o baro rai i an-diklo mursh hi, un i pralstune an o tchatcho tsiro latches chana, har an-dikle mursha un gar har mate.
Te kamell jek gar te budrell, perell leskro kheer khetne, un o brishin well dren.
Kones chapen hi, nai sal. Koon mool pijell, nai giwell. I lowentsa nai well tut kowa halauter.
Ma praasse o baro rajes, witar gar an tiro dji! Un ma praasse i braweles, witar gar an tiro tchiben, kai tu tut pasheh. I tikno tchirklo nai shunals tut, un penals dureder, hoi penal.
Witse tiro maro ap o pani; un tu hatseh les pale pal bud diwessa.
Phage tiro maro an kotja, un de les efta, ochta menshenge; tu djineh gar, hawi bibacht well pral kai phub.
Te hi i wolke pherdo pani, palle denn le brishin ap i phub. Un te perell i ruk – nai well ap i tchatchi rig, nai well ap i serwi rig – kote kai lo perella, kote atchell lo tchiddo.
Koon ap o phurdepen garda della, ko tchiwell kek djob an i phub, te well kowa baro. Un koon ap i wolke garda della, ko anell gar o baro djob an peskro kheer dren.
Tu djineh gar hawo drom o phurdepen djala, un har i kokale kerdo wenna an i dakro per. Jaake nai djineh tu witar gar, hoi o Dewel halauter krella, un har job halauter krella.
Doleske tchip o djob taissarla an i phub, un muk gar tele bis an i rati. Tu djineh gar, hoi bares wella, kawa te kowa, oder hake dui.
Shukar hi menge, te dikas i momeli. Un mare jakentsa hi mishto, te dikenn le o kham.
I mensho, te djiwell lo bud bersha, mu well lo bachtelo pral hako bersh, kai djiwell lo. Mu bistrell lo gar, te wenn kale diwessa. Ninna kolla hi bud. Halauter, hoi wella, hi menge khatedo.

Terno mursh, muk tiro dji te giwell an tire terne bersha! Ab bachtelo jaake rah, har terno hal. Kre, hoi tiro dji tuke penella un tire jakentsa mishto hi; un biste gar, te well i diwes, kai rakrell o Dewel o tchatchepen win pral tute un halauter, hoi kral.
Dja koleske dran o drom, hoi anell tuke choli un duka. Ko tsiro, kai hal i tchawo un i terno mursh, hi sik trujel.
Jaake rah har terno hal, ma biste koles, kai tut kras! Un djin, te wenn kol tchilatche diwessa un kol bersha, kai tu peneh: “Jon hi mange gar mishto”!
Palle hi tuke, har te wals o kham tamlo, ninna o tchon un o bolepangre momlia. Un pal hako brishin, wenn pale newe wolke.
Palle trissenn tire mussja, hoi jaake sorelo his. Un tire herja, hoi hidjran tut, len hi buder kek soor. I danda perenn tuke win, jek pal o wawar. Tire jaka dikenn buder gar mishto,
un tire kanda shunenn buder gar mishto. Te deh tu gole, hi kaja har i tchirklengro ropen. Un tu haiweh buder gar te giwell.

Tut hi traash glan i treppa. Un ap o drom nai pereh. Tire balla wenn parno. Un tu tserdeh tut jek rigjatar ap i wawar. Tut hi buder gar bud bok. O mensho hunte djal peske kote, kai atchell lo hako tsiro. Un i wawar paskrenn les un rowenn ap o drom.

Maro djipen hi har i rupeni werkli, hoi perell an kotja, har i sonakaskro tcharo, hoi phagell, har o khoro, hoi djal an kotja pash i brunna, un har o shello, hoi djal paash, te tserdeh pani dran i brunna pre.
O mensho well pale phub, kolatar job kerdo was. Un o ducho hunte djal pale pash o Debleste, kai das o duches o mensheste.
Halauter hi tchitcheske, penell o sikepaskro, tchitcheske hi halauter.

Kau koowa atchell un hunte well penlo: O sikepaskro his i gosewo mursh un penas i menshenge tchatche laba. Job mukas peske bud gosewe laba an o shero trujel te djal. Job rodas, hoi kaman le te penell un tchinas len tele.
Job rodas, te hatsell lo kamle laba. Un job tchinas pre, har tchomone tchatchepah hi.
I laba, hoi i gosewe rakrenna, hi har subja. Un kowa, hoi le penenn, djal dur an o mensheskro dji. Kowa, kai rakras len, hi har i bakrengro, kai dell garda ap peskre bakre.
Miro tchawo, koi hi i wawar koowa, hoi hunte djiness: Jek, kai kamell lila te tchinell, las pes bud phari budi glan. Un jek, kai kamell bud te haiwell un te djinell, well khino.
Kowa lauter, hoi kate penlo was, hi khetne lino kowa: Shun ap o Debleste un rike leskre laba! Kowa molell i tsele menshenge.
O Dewel rakrell o tchatchepen win pral halauter, hoi kram, ko latcho un ko tchilatcho koowa, ninna te hi kowa kanna khatedo.
Kate hi i shukester gili, tchinlo o Salomeske.
Ab un tchumme man! Tiro kamlepen hi latcheder har mool.
Tiro sungepaskro djet sungell jaake latcho. Hakeno prindjrell tut. I tsele tcha kamenn tut.
Le miro wast, tradas men! Miro pirno mu anell man khere pash peste! Mer kamah khetne te sanell un bachteles te well. Tiro kamlepen hi mange shukeder har mool. Kol tchen hi tchatcho, kai tut kamenna.
Kales hom un shukar hom, tumer tcha dran o foro Jerusalem, kalo har i plachtene khera an o them Kedar un har o Salomeskre stakepangre.
Ma dikenn tele ap mande, har kalo hom! O kham chatchas man kales. Mire phrala his chojedo ap mande, un kaman te dap garda ap i drakengre ruka. Ap miro shukapen nai dom kek garda.
Tu, koles miro dji kamell, pen mange, kai aneh tire bakre, te chan le? Kai besheh tu tut tele mashkral o diwes? Te nashap gar trujel mank i bakre, te rodap tut pash i wawar bakrengre!
Djineh tu kowa gar, tu shukester mank i djuwjende, palle dja win, un naash pal i bakre un le tire tikne busja tuha, te chan le pash o plachtene khera, kai i bakrengre djiwenn!
Tu, miri pirni, hal shukar har i grai glan o wurdin o baro rajestar an o them Egiptia.
Tire tchamja hi shukar mank i kanengre, un tiri meen hi shukar an werklia dran mirklia.
Sonakangre werklia kamah mer tuke te krell, kai rupene mirklia dren hi.
Miro pirno, miro rai, his tchiddo ap peskro tchiben, un miro sungepaskro djet sungas latches.
Miro pirno hi mange har i tikno gono pherdo sungepaskro kasht, tchiddo ap miro betch.
Har i diwje blume mank i drakengre ruka an En-Gedi hi lo mange.
Har shukar tu hal, miri pirni, tu hal jaake shukar, tire jaka hi har taube.
Un tu, miro pirno, har shukar hal tu! Har kreh man bachtelo! Maro tchiben hi an o senlepen.
Shukar sorele ruka hi maro kheer, un ruka bud senele patjentsa krenn pen buchles pral mende.
I tikni bluma hom me, har hi le tardo ap o telstuno them Sharon, i lilja an i tala.
Awa, har i lilja – i lilja mank i subjengre burra, jaake hi miri pirni mank i tchende.
Har i phabjengro ruk mank i diwje ruka an o weesh, jaake hi miro pirno mank i terne murshende. Bachteles hom beshdo an leskro shatto, un leskre phabja hi gudlo mange.
Job anas man an o moljengro kheer, un tchakras man peskro kamlepah.
Krenn man pale soreles drakentsa, denn man newi soor phabjentsa! Miro kamlepen tuke krell man nasselo.
Leskro serwo wast hi tel miro shero tchiddo, un leskro tchatcho wast taprell man trujel.
Tumer tcha dran o foro Jerusalem, i wesheskre busja un i tserfe shunenn, har mangau tumen: Mukenn men kokres jaake rah har khetne ham, bis te stah pre.
Miro pirno dell gole pal mande! Dik, oke well lo, un stell pral i bare un tikne berge.
Miro pirno hi har i terni wesheskri busni har i terno tserfo. Kate hi lo! Pal maro kheer! Un dikell an i wochni, mank i kashta dren.
Miro pirno dell pal mande gole: Ste pre, miri pirni, miri shukester, un ab!
Dik, o wend hi buder gar, un o brishin djas peske.
I blume djan pre an o them, O tsiro o gipaske hi koi, un i tchirkle mukenn pen te shunell an maro them.
I faige wenn baro ap o ruk, un i drakengre ruka sungenna jaake gudlo. Ste pre, miri pirni, miri shukester, un ab mantsa!

Miri tauba, ma khate tut glan mande, har i tchirklo khatrell pes mank i bare barra, an o khatepen ap i berge! Muk man tut te dikell, muk man tut te shunell! Gudlo hi tiro rakepen, un kamles dikeh tu win.
Taprenn menge i diwje djukle, kol tikne diwje djukle, hoi krenn o moljengro them paash! Mare drakengre ruka hidjrenn knospe.
Miro pirno hi miro, un me hom leskri. Job hatsell peskri bacht mank i lilja.
O diwes te well shila, un o kham djal tele, ab pash mande, miro pirno! Ab sik har i wesheskri busni, har i terno tserfo ap i barrengre berge!
Ap miro tchiben an i ratsja rodom les, koles miro dji kamell, me rodom les un hatsom les gar.
Kamau pre te stell, kamau an o foro te nashell, ap i dromma un ap i platse kamau les te rodell, koles miro dji kamell. Me rodom les un hatsom les gar.
I lurde hatsan man, kolla, kai ap o foro garda denna un kote trujel djan: ‘Dikan tumer les, koles miro dji kamell?’

Har me lendar i tikno kotar dureder djom, hatsom les, koles miro dji kamell. Me taprom leskro wast, un mukom les buder gar mandar te djal, lom les khere pash mande, an miri dakri isema, kai boldo wom.
Tumer tcha dran o foro Jerusalem, i wesheskre busja un i tserfe shunenn, har mangau tumen: Mukenn men kokres, jaake rah har khetne ham, bis te stah pre.

Koon hi kolla, kai wenn pre dran o mulo tato them, har i jagakro ducho, hoi pre djal, te well sungepaskro koowa chatchedo? Latcho khand well pash mende, dran ko sungepaskro koowa, hoi i parepangre anenn.
Dikenn mishto kote! Kowa hi o Salomeskro tchiben! Shob-deesh tchatche mursha hi trul leste, kol sorleder murshendar an Israel.
Latche kurepangre hi le halauter, un haiwenn mishto te kurenn le pen o chareha. Hakeno lendar hidjrell peskro charo ap i rig, te kurell lo pes koleha, kai tchorchanes nai well an i rati.
O baro rai Salomo mukas pes kau tchiben te krell dran kutch kasht,
i pire dran rup, o palstuno kotar dran sonakai, un i pernitse dran lolo than, shukar khetne sido kamlepah i djuwjendar an o foro Jerusalem.

Tumer tcha dran o foro Jerusalem, awenn win! Tumer tcha dran Zion dikenn o baro rajes, o Salomes! Dikenn leskri rajeskri stadi, hoi leskri dai leske ap o shero tchiwas, ap ko diwes, kai lo romedineras, un leskro dji i bachtjatar bashras.
Har shukar hal tu, hejo! har shukar hal! Tire jakentsa dikeh latches win har i tauba pal tiro diklo! Tire balla hi har kale busja, kai stenn tele i berga Gilead.
Tire danda hi parno har bakre, kai wan newes tchinlo un thodo. Tire tsele danda hi shukar tardo; un i tsele pralstune danda un telstune danda hi koi.
Har i loli dori hi tiro mui, un tiro rakepen hi kamlo. Lolo har i phabi hi tire tchamja pal tiro diklo.
Har o Davideskro turmo, barra ap barra pre-tchiddo, un serja shilte an-pandlo, jaake shukar hi tiri meen kol werkjentsa, hoi hi trujel pandlo jek pral o wawar.
Tire dui tchutchja hi har dui terne wesheskre busja, kai hi tchiddo mank i lilja.
O diwes te djal peske un i rati well, kamau pash tire berge te djal, hoi jaake latcho sungenna.
Halauter ap tute hi shukar, hejo! Un kek djunglepen hi ap tute.

Ab mantsa, miri pirni! Muk o Libanon, ab mantsa! Ab tele i berge, kai hi jaake dur mandar, – kol berge Amana, Senir un Hermon! Naash krik kotar, kai i lewe djiwenn, un i bare diwje margodje pen khatrenn!
Tu tchoral mange miro dji, hejo, miri pirni. Tu tchoral mange miro dji tire jakentsa, har dikal ap mande, un jek werkliah, hoi trul tiri meen pandlo hi.
Har shukar hi tiro kamlepen, hejo, miri pirni! Har bud kope shukeder hi tiro kamlepen har mool! Un tiro sungepaskro djet hi feteder har i tsele wawar latche djeta.
Miri pirni, tire tchumma hi har gwin, gudlo har gwin un thud. Un tire koola, hoi ap tute hi, sungenna latches har o Libanon sungella.
Hejo, miri pirni, tu hal har i baar, kai o wudar pandlo hi, awa har i baar, har i brunna pandlo i tsele wawarenge.

Har i baar hal tu pherde ruka gudle phabjentsa, un rukengre, hoi mishto sungenna, un o chapen latches krenna: Henna un Narda, Safrano, gudlo sungepaskro khass un Zimto, Weihrauch, Myrrhe un Aloe, halauter latche kashta un patria.
I pani, hoi an i baar nashella hal tu, i djido pani, hoi dran o Libanon tele nashella.
Ab, tu phurdepen, ab fun serwes un ab fun tchatches, un phurde an miri baar, te djal o latcho sungepen an miri baar pre! Miro pirno mu well an peskri baar, un chal lakre latche phabja!

Me wau an miri baar, hejo, miri pirni. Un lau mire sungepaskre rukengre, kashta un patria. Un chau miro gudlo gwin, un pijau miri mool un miro thud. Chan, mala, un pijenn! Un wenn mate an tumaro kamlepen!
Me sowom, miro dji his djangelo. Shun, miro pirno dell ap o wudar: Kre mange pre, hejo, miri pirni, miri tauba, miri gudli! Mire balla hi sapeno.
Riwom miro ripen win, hoske te riwap les kanna pale an? Thowom mire pire, hoske te krap len kanna pale tchikles?
Miro pirno tchiwas peskro wast an o wudareskri wochni, un halauter, hoi an mande hi, kamas pash leste.
Me stom pre, te krap miro pirneske o wudar pre, un mire wasta his pherdo sungepaskro djet. O djet nashas mire gushte tele, har len ap i pandepaskri tchiwom.

Me krom o wudar miro pirneske pre, koi hi lo buder gar koi – djas peske dureder. Miro dji kamas tardo te atchell, har djas job peske. Me rodom les, un hatsom les gar. Me kharom les, un shunom kek rakepen lestar.
Koi hatsan man kol mursha, kai denn garda an o foro un kai kote trujel nashenn. Jon dan man dawa un dukan man. Kal mursha tserdan i plaashka mandar tele.
Tumer tcha dran Jerusalem, mangau tumen o tselo djijestar: Te hatsenn tumer miro pirnes, penenn leske, kai nasselo hom pal leste, jaake bud kamau les.
Hoske hi tiro pirno feteder har wawar mursha? Pen kowa menge, tu shukester mashkral i djuwjende! Hoske hi tiro pirno feteder har wawar mursha, te mangeh tu mendar jaake soreles kau koowa?
Miro pirno hi sasto un sorelo, kokres jek mank serjende hi har job.
Leskro shero hi shukar har dran latcheder sonakai. Leskre balla hi tchiddo har bakrengro baal, un hi kalo har i korako.
Leskre jaka hi har taube pash i panja, – taube, kai hi jaake bijalo har thud un beshdo kote, kai bud pani hi.
Leskre tchamja sungenna mishto har i phub, kai sungepaskre burra tardo hi. Leskre wushte hi har lilja, sapeno latcho djeteha.
Leskre gushte hi har dran sonakai, Ap lende hi gustria kutch barrentsa. Job hi har i kutch figura dran elefantikro dand, shukar kerdo kutch blauete barrentsa.
Leske herja hi har dran parno marmor, soreles tardo ap pire dran sonakai. Baro hi lo har o Libanon, sorelo har i zedertikre ruka.
Leskro rakepen hi gudlo, un halauter ap leste hi kamlo. Kowa hi miro pirno; awa, kowa hi miro maal, tumer tcha dran o foro Jerusalem!
Kai djas kanna tiro pirno koi, tu shukester mashkral i djuwjende? Hawo drom nashas tiro pirno, te nai rodas les tuha?
Miro pirno djas tele an peskri baar, kote, kai i sungepaskre burra tardo hi, te well lo bachtelo koi, un te lell lo peske lilja khetne.
Miro pirno hi miro, un me hom leskri. Job hatsell peskri bacht mank i lilja.
Shukar hal tu, miri pirni, har ko rajeskro foro Tirza, un kamlo har ko foro Jerusalem. Te dikau tut, atchell mange o rakepen krik.
Ma dik jaake ap mande! Tire jaka krenn man dineles! Tire balla hi har i kale busja, kai stenn tele i berga Gilead.
Tire danda hi parno har bakre, kai wenn win kotar, kai le thodo wan. Tire tsele danda hi shukar tardo, un i tsele pralstune danda un telstune danda hi koi.
Lolo har i phabi hi tire tchamja pal tiro diklo.
Shob-deesh romja hi o baro rajes, un ochta-deesh wawar djuwja, un jaake bud tcha, te nai djinell kek, kitse jon hi.

Jek kokres hi miri tauba, miri gudli. Lakri dat hi kek wawar tchai. Lake hi li i latcheder tchai. I wawar tcha dikan lat un penan: Har bachteli hi li! O baro rajeskre romja un wawar djuwja dikan lat un sharan lakro shukapen.
Dikenn kolat, kai stell pre har o newo diwes, shukar har o tchon hi li, un djudjo har o kham! Koon dikell lat, koleske atchell o rakepen krik.
An i rukengro baar djom tele, te dikap, har i ruka senelo wenn, un har i drakengre ruka newe patria lenn, un har i phabjengre ruka tikne phabja hidjrenn.
Hoi djal mantsa? Miro dji nashell pal tute, har te djoms an o rajeskro wurdin.
Risse tut trujel, risse tut trujel, Sulamit! Risse tut pash mende, te nai dikas tut! Hoi kamenn tumer ap i Sulamit te dikell, har khelell li mank i wawarende?
Har shukar hi tire pire an tire kircha, tu tchai i pralstunestar! Tire herja hi shukar har i werkli trul tiri meen, kerdo jekestar, kai haiwas, hoi lo kras.
Tiro gali hi har i tcharo, kai hako tsiro mool dren hi. un har i berga sonakaskro djob. Un lilja hi koi trujel tardo.
Tiro betch hi har terne wesheskre busja.
Tiri meen hi har i turmo dran elefantikre danda. Tire jaka hi har kol tikne panja an o foro Heshbon pash o wudar Bat-Rabbim. Tiro nak hi har ko turmo ap o Libanon, hoi dikell ap o foro Damaskus.
Har i berga Karmel rikreh tiro shero pral. Un tire balla hi har feteder phar. Tiro baro rai hi pandlo an lengro shukapen.
Har shukar hal tu, har kamlo! Tu hal kaja, kai miri bacht hi.
Baro har i palma hal tu. un tire tchutchja hi har drake.
Me kamau pre te djal ap koi palma un taprau pal lakre patria. Tire tchutchja mu wenn mange har drake ap i drakengro ruk! Un tiro ducho sungell har phabja.
Tire tchumma hi mange har i latchi mool, hoi nashell pral miro mui un mire danda.
Me hom miro pirneskri pirni, un pal mande nashell leskro dji.
Ab, miro pirno, te djas mer win glan o foro, un atchah pral i rati mank i diwje blume.
Taissarlake nashah menge kote, kai i drakengre ruka tardo hi, te dikas, har wenn le senelo un hidjrenn blume, un har i phabjengre ruka tikne phabja hidjrenn. Kote dau tut miro kamlepen.
I kamlepaskre phabja sungenna mishto. Un pash maro wudar hi lauter latcho koowa, newo un phuro koowa, kai me, miro pirno, tuke pre garom.
Kamoms te wals mange har i phraal, i tchawo miri datar! Hatsoms tut kaimone win, nai tchumroms tut, un kek nai wals chojedo ap mande.
Me loms tut pash o wast, un anoms tut khere pash mande, an miri dakri isema, kai boldo wom. Me doms tut miri feteder mool, un miri phabjengri mool.
Leskro serwo wast hi tel miro shero tchiddo, un leskro tchatcho wast taprell man trujel.
Tumer tcha dran o foro Jerusalem, me mangau tumen o djijestar: Mukenn men kokres, jaake rah har khetne ham, bis te stah pre.
Koon hi koja, kai well pre dran o mulo tato them, mussi an mussi peskri pirneha? Tel o phabjengro ruk djangrom tut, kote, kai tiri dai tuha wawartchandes was, un tu boldo wal.

Tchin miro lab ap tiro dji! Muk man har i gustri ap tiro wast te well! Te kamenn pen dui, hi lengro kamlepen soreles har o merepen, un rikrell len pandles har o mulengro them. Len hi i dji jek o wawareske, hoi chatchell soreles har i jag o baro Deblestar.
Ninna bud panja nai krenn o kamlepen gar win, un i sorele panja nai hidjrenn o kamlepen gar krik. Te kamals jek o kamlepen te ginell, un dals peskro tselo brawlepen koleske, sans i menshe les win.
Men hi i tikni pheen, koi hi jaake terno, te nai romedinerell li gar, Hoi te kras mari phenjah ap ko diwes, kai well jek te romedinerell lo lat?
Te hi li har i massuri, krah lat shukar kutch rupeha. Te hi li har i wudar, pandah ko wudar sorele tchinle kashtentsa.
Me hom i massuri, un mire tchutchja hi har turme. Doleske dikell lo ap mande har ap jekate, kai anell leske bacht.

O Salomes hi i kotar phub ap i berga Baal-Hermon, Kote hi drakengre ruka tardo. Koi kotar them das lo kol hachende an i wasta. Hakeno lendar hunte plaissrals i drakenge, hoi bikrals lo, i sero kotja rup.
Salomo, tut nai well kol sero kotja rup, un dui-sheel nai wenn i hachen! Man hi miro kotar them mire drakentsa!
Tu, kai hal beshdo an i baar, de man gole pash tute! Mire mala hi koi un kamenn tut te shunell.
Naash, miro pirno! Ab sik har i wesheskri busni un har i terno tserfo ap i berge, kai i burra tardo hi, hoi sungenna latcho.

Kowa hi, hoi mukas o baro Dewel o murshes Jesaja te dikell pral o them Juda un pral o foro Jerusalem. O Jesaja his o tchawo ko murshestar Amoz. Kowa his an ko tsiro, kai his o Usija, o Jotam, o Ahas, un o Hiskija i bare raja pral o them Juda.
Tu, o bolepen, un tu, i phub, shunenn, hoi me, o baro Dewel, penau: Me tserdom tchawen bares. Un har jon baro wan, phagan le mantsa.
Haki grumni prindjrell koles, koneske joi hi. Un haki burika djinell koi platsa, kai lakro rai dell lat te chal. O Israel prindjrell kowa gar. Mire menshe haiwenn kowa gar.

Tumenge djal djungelo, tumer tchilatche menshe, kai anan jaake bud doosh ap tumende! Tumer han bede, tchawe, kai molenn tchi! Tumer mukan o baro Debles, kamenn tchi buder te djinell o Israeleskro Deblestar, kai kokres o Dewel hi, un sikran leske tumaro dumo.
Han gomme gar doha dino? Hoske rikrenn tumare djia pandlo un djan dureder ap tumaro tchilatcho drom? Tumaro tselo shero hi pherdo dukepen, un tumaro tselo dji hi nasselo.

Fun o shero bis pash i pire hi kek kotar ap tumende, hoi sasto wals. Tumaro mass hi pherdo dukepen, phuro un newo dukepen, kai dino wan. Tumaro tchinepen hi gar wi-thodo, witar gar dren pandlo. Kek djet was pre tchiddo.
Tumaro them hi i mulo them, tumare forja wan tele chatchedo. Glan tumare jaka chan i wi-themarja kowa, hoi ap tumari phub bares was. Lauter hi mulo un paash, har te perans i diwje koi pral.

Kokres o foro Jerusalem atchas pral, i foro trul koleste i lurde tardo hi. Ko foro hi kokres har i tikno kheer an i drakengro them, har i kheer, kai jek jak dell an i rati ap kowa, hoi ap peskri phub bares well.
Te mukals o baro Dewel, ko rai pral o bolepen un i phub, gar mendar pral, djals menge har i forjenge Sodom un Gomorra.
Tumer raja dran Sodom, shunenn o lab o baro Deblestar! Tumer menshe dran Gomorra, shunenn, hoi kamell maro Dewel tumenge te penell!

“Hoi krap me kol tsele viechentsa, hoi tumer mange anenn”, putchell o baro Dewel. “Man hi doha tumare bakrendar, hoi mange chatchran, hom tchalo ko thulepastar i pesse grumjendar. Ko rat i murshkane grumjendar un tikne bakrendar un busjendar kamau me gar.
Te wenn tumer glan mande, glan miro kheer, stakrenn tumer i platsa glan miro kheer khetne. Koon penas tumenge te krenn tumer kowa?

Ma anenn buder kek chapen chatchepaske! Kowa hi tchitcheske. Ma chatchrenn mange buder kek sungepaskro koowa! Man hi o nak doha. Tumer wenn mange khetne ap o newo tchon, ap o Debleskro diwes un ap wawar bare diwessa. Kowa hi mange gar mishto, jaake rah har mukenn tumer gar tumaro djungelo koowa.
Kol bare diwessa, kai tumer rikrenn, te well i newo tchon, un ninna i wawar bare diwessa nai dikau gar buder. Jon wan mange phares te hidjrap len, un me wom khino tel lende.
Un te hadenn tumer tumare wasta pre, te mangenn man an, palle tchakrau me mire jaka tele, te dikap tumen gar. Un ninna te mangenn mandar pale te pale, me shunau tumen gar: Tumare wasta hi pherdo rat.
Thowenn tumen, krenn tumen djudjo! Anenn tumaro tchilatcho koowa, hoi kran, dran mire jaka krik. Mukenn o tchilatchepen!

Dikenn, har te krenn o latchepen, denn jak, te lell hakeno peskro tchatchepen. Awenn ap i rig kolenge, kai tele rikedo wenn. Kol tchawe, kolen kek dai un kek dad hi, kolenge krenn o tchatchepen win. Un kol djuwja, kolenge o rom meras, kolengro koowa lenn an tumaro wast!”

“Awenn”, penell o baro Dewel, “te kras men tel mende o tchatchepen win! Te hi i doosh, hoi tumer ap tumende anan jaake lolo har o rat, palle well li parno, jaake parno har gib. Un te hi li lolo har o purpur, palle well li jaake parno har o bakrengro bal.
Kamenn tumer ap mande te shunell? Palle nai chan tumer o tselo latchepen, hoi o them win anell.
Kamenn tumer gar te shunell, un pandenn tumare djia glan mande, palle wenn o chareha mulo dino. Kowa penau me, o baro Dewel!”

Har nai was kowa? Kau foro, hoi rikras pes ap mande peskro tselo djijeha, was har i lubni! O foro his pherdo tchatchepen, un i menshe djiwan pal o Debleskre tchatchepaskre laba. Un kanna djiwenn kate lauter marepangre, kai wawaren mulo denn!
Tu Jerusalem, hals har djudjo rup, kanna wal har tchik, hoi rupenes win dikell. Tu hals har latchi mool, kanna hal har mool, kai pani dren hi.

Tire pralstune hadan pen pral mande un djan khetne i tchorepangre. Un hakeno lendar mukell pes te ginell. Un kol tchawe, kolen kek dai un kek dad hi, kolenge krenn le kek tchatchepen win. Un ko koowa kol djuwjendar, kolengro rom meras, mukenn le gar glan pende te well.

Doleske penell o baro Dewel, ko rai pral o bolepen un i phub, kai hi o Israeleskro sorelo Dewel: Dikenn tumen glan! Me dau tumen pale, hoi ap mande kran, tumen, kai kamenn man gar. Miri bari choli well pral tumende, kai krenn lauter wawartchandes, har me kamau.
Jerusalem, miro wast hadau ap tute, te dap tut, te chatchap i tchik tutar win, har kowa o rupeha kerdo well, jaake te atchell o latcho rup pale.

Me dau tut pale tchatchepangre murshen un rakepangren, kai o tchatchepen win krenn, jaake har an i phure tsirja his. Un palle kharenn le tut ‘tchatchepaskro foro’ un ‘foro kolendar, kai ap o Debleste patsenna.’
Tumer menshe an Zion, te djiwenn pale pal o tchatchepen, un djan pale ap o Debleskro drom, plaissrom tumenge, te wenn win lino dran o pandepen.
Khetne phagedo wenn kolla, kai o Debleskro dromestar tele djan, khetne kolentsa, kai doosh ap pende anan. Un kolla, kai o baro Debles mukan, hunte merenn.
Tumer, kai mangan i bare ruka an, hunte ladjenn tumen koleske. Awa, tumer wenna lolo an o mui dran ladj pral kol wawar deblen, hoi rodan win un mangan len an ap lengre shukar platse.
Un tumer kokres wenn har i ruk, koleskre patria buder gar senelo hi, un har i baar, an kolate kek pani buder hi.

Un ko mursh, hoi sorelo his har i ruk, well har mulo kasht. Un ko sorelo koowa, hoi lo kras, well har i jag, hoi ko mulo kasht pre chatchell. Jaake djal lauter an i jag pre, un kek nai krell koi jag win.
Kawa hi, hoi dikas o Jesaja, pral o them Juda un o foro Jerusalem. Leskro dad hi o Amoz.
Well i tsiro, koi hi koi berga, kai o baro Debleskro kheer tardo hi, bareder har i tsele wawar berge, un dikell tele ap i tsele tikne berge. Un i menshe dran bud themma nashenn pash kai berga,

un penenn: “Awenn, te djas pre ap i berga o baro Deblestar, pash o kheer o Jakobeskro Deblestar, te sikrell lo men peskre dromma, te djinas, hoi lo mendar kamell.” O baro Debleskre laba djan win dran Zion. Dran o foro Jerusalem rakrell lo i menshentsa.

Un job well o tchatchepaskro rai, kai krell o tchatchepen win mashkral i menshende dran i wawar themma, un penell lenge, te mukenn le pengro tchingepen. Un kolla lenn palle pengre chare un witsepaskre tchurja, un krenn lendar hachetikre koola, kolentsa budrenn le nai an i phub un tchinenn i drakengre kashta tele. Un palle kurenn pen i menshe dran jek them buder gar i menshentsa dran i wawar them. Un kek sikrell i wawaren buder, har te marenn le pen.
Tumer menshe, kai wenn pal o Jakob, awenn, te djas o drom, kai o baro Debleskri momeli men sikrell, har te djiwas.

Baro Dewel, tu mukal tire menshen. Jon krenn drawepangro koowa, har kol menshe, kai wenn kotar, kai o kham pre djala. Un jon hi durkepangre har i Filistarja. I menshentsa dran wawar themma krenn le tchomone win, un denn pengro dadeskro wast pre.
O them Israel hi pherdo rup un sonakai, un leskro brawlepen hi jaake bud, te djinell kek, har bud kowa hi. Un o them hi pherde graja, un lengre kurepangre wurdja nai ginell kek tele.
Ninna hi o them pherde chochene deblen, un jon witsrenn pen tele glan kolende, kolen jon pengre wastentsa kran.
Doleske well hakeno tiknes kerdo, un hakeno hunte ladjell pes. Ma biste koi doosh, hoi le ap pende anan!
Dja mank i bare barra, un khate tut an i tchik, i darjatar o baro Deblestar un glan leskro railo barepen.
Hakeno, kai dikell tele ap o wawareste, hunte dikell tele glan peste i ladjatar. Un i pre-phurde menshe wenn phagedo. Ap ko diwes hi kokres o baro Dewel baro.
Leskro diwes wella, ko diwes o baro Deblestar, ko rajestar pral o bolepen un i phub. Ap ko diwes well hako pre-phurdo tiknes kerdo, ninna hakeno, kai hadas pes, hakeno kai kras pes bares.
Ap ko diwes wenn lauter tiknes kerdo: kol bare zedertikre ruka ap o Libanon un kol eichtikre ruka an o them Bashan,
ninna i bare berge, kai dur pre djan, un i tikne berge, hoi pen hadan,
ninna hako baro turmo un haki soreli massuri,
i tsele bare shiffe an o baro pani, un i tsele shukar bere.
Palle well lenge kowa krik lino, koleha i menshe phurdan pen pre. Un lengro sharepen atchell gar. Ap ko diwes hi kokres o baro Dewel o Dewel pral halauter.
Un kol tsele chochene deblentsa hi palle hako tsireske trujel.

Ap ko diwes, kai o baro Dewel pre stell, te anell lo i traash pral i phub, khatrenn pen i menshe an i grotte, mank i bare barra un an i phub, i darjatar o baro Debleskri choljatar un glan leskro railo barepen.
Un kol rupene un sonakangre figure, hoi i menshe pen kran, te mangenn le len an, kolen witsrenn le i kermusenge un i fledertikre kermusenge koi.
Un jon khatrenn pen mank i bare barra un an i barrengre grotte i darjatar o baro Deblestar un leskro railo barepen, te stell lo pre, te anell lo i traash pral i phub.
Mukenn tele i menshendar! Lengro djipen hi jaake tikno har i ducho. Hoi hi le moldo?

O baro Dewel, ko rai pral o bolepen un i phub, lell dran o foro Jerusalem un dran o them Juda lauter krik, ap koleste i menshe pen rikran un hoi len soor das. O tselo maro un o tselo pani lell lo lendar krik.
Ninna i sorele murshen, i kurepangren, i tchatchepangre murshen, o Debleskre rakepangren, i durkepangren un i phureden lell lo lendar.
Ninna i pralstune lurden, i an-dikle menshen, i rakepangren, i gosewen, i durkepangren un kolen, kai i mulen putchenn, lell lo kolendar krik.
Job penell: Me mukau terne murshen pral lende rai te well, kai lentsa krenn, hoi le kamenn.
Un an o them djal hakeno ap o wawareste un dell les pral o kand: o terno o phures, o tchi-moldo o an-dikles.
Palle taprell jek peskro phrales an peskro dadeskro kheer un penell ap leste: “Tut hi i baja ap tute, tu wess maro pralstuno an kau pharo tsiro.”
Ap ko diwes dell job pes sowel un penell: “Me hom kek dramaskro, un an miro kheer hi kek maro un kek baja. Ma krenn te wap me rai pral tumende!”
O foro Jerusalem peras, un o them Juda hi koi tchiddo. Hoske? Jon dukran o baro Debles pengre labentsa, un ninna koleha, hoi le kran. Kowa, hoi o sorelo Dewel lenge penas, kaman le gar te krell.

O tchilatchepen dikell dran lende win. Un jon anenn doosh ap pende un kolah sharenn le pen ninna gomme, jaake har kol menshe an o foro Sodom ninna kran. I bibacht well ap lende, koja anenn jon kokres pengro djungelo djipah pral pende!
I bacht well ap kolende, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi! Un lauter djal lenge mishto. Ko latcho koowa, hoi le kran, well ap lende pale.
Ap i tchilatchende well bibacht. Lenge djal gar mishto. Ap lengro shero well ko tchilatchepen pale, hoi le kran.

Mire menshe, penell o baro Dewel, tumare pralstune hi tchawe. Un djuwja hi i raja pral tumende. Kolla kai hunte sikrans tumenge o drom, anenn tumen o tchatcho dromestar tele, un krenn, te nashrenn tumen.
Koi well lo, o baro Dewel, te penell lo, kones tchatches hi an o tchingepen. Job hi koi tardo, te krell lo o tchatchepen win pral peskre menshende.
Ap i phurende un rajende pral peskre menshende penell job: Tumer chan i tsele drake, hoi ap miro drakengro them bares wan, An tumare khera hi kowa, hoi tumer i tchorwelenge randan!
Hoske stakran tumer mire menshen tel tumare herja? Un hoske dan o tchorweles an o mui? Me, o baro Dewel, ko rai pral o bolepen un i phub, putchau kowa tumendar.

Un o baro Dewel penas: Dikenn, har pre-phurde jon hi, kol djuwja an o foro Jerusalem! Lengre sherja hidjrenn le pre, witsrenn pengre jakentsa trujel, te dikenn len hakeno. Jon khelenn pash o naashepen. Lengre pire hadenn le jaake, te bashrenn kol werklia, hoi le trul pengre pire tchiwan.
Doleske mukau me, o baro Dewel, i tchiklo dukepen ap lengre sherja te well, un mukau lenge i tsele balla tele te tchinell.
Ap ko tsiro lell o baro Dewel i djuwjenge ko tselo kutch koowa krik, koleha jon pen jaake shukar krenn, kol werklia, hoi tchiwenn le trul pengre pire, pengre sherja, pengre menja,
pengre mussja. Un lengre kanengre un lengre shereskre dikle lell lo lendar ninna krik,
ninna lengre stadja, tikne werklia, pereskre dorja, lengro sungepaskro pani, lengre bachtjakre,
lengre gustria un nakeskre kanengre,
lengre shukar ripja, lengre plaashke un baja un ladetse,
lengre blendarja un lengre gada, lengre stadja un lengre shereskre bare dikle.

Un palle well, te hi djungeli khand, kai shukar sungepen his, un kote, kai i shukar pereskro pandepen his, hi kanna i dori. Un kolat, kai shukar bal his, kolat hi palle kek bal ap o shero, un kolat, kai kutch koola his, koja riwell palle i gono trul peste. Un kote, kai shukapen his, hi kanna tchi har i ladj.
I murshen an o foro wenn mulo dino o chareha. Ninna i sorleder merenn an o kurepen.
I menshe an tiro foreskre wudja, Jerusalem, denn palle gole un rowenn. Un o foro hi palle wi-tchoredo un muklo.
Ap ko tsiro taprenn efta djuwja jek murshes un penenn: Mer kamah kokres maro chapen un mare ripja te ginell. Romedine men, te well i ladj mendar krik lino!

I tsiro wella, kai krell o baro Dewel peskro them Israel railo un shukar. Un kolla, kai pral atchan un an o them djiwenn, hi bachtelo pral ko bud latcho koowa, hoi i phub win anell. Un wawar menshe sharenn len koleske.

Un kolla, kai djides atchan an Jerusalem, un pral atchan ap i berga Zion, kolla wenn kharedo ‘Debleskre menshe’. Lengre laba hi tchinlo an o liil, kai kolla o djipaske an o foro Jerusalem dren tchinlo hi.

Kowa wella, te thowell o Dewel i tchik tele i menshendar, kai djiwenn an Zion, un lell koi phari doosh krik dran Jerusalem. Te krell lo kowa, hi kowa har i jag, hoi chatchell ko tselo djungelo koowa krik.
Pral i tseli berga Zion un pral kai platsa, kai wenn le khetne, bitchrell o baro Dewel palle jek wolka ap o diwes, un i jagakro ducho an i rati. Jaake tchakrell lo o foro peskro railepah
har i kheer, kai djan le dren, te chatchrell o kham tella, un kai nai khatrenn le pen, te dell brishin un phurdell i sorelo ducho.
Shunenn, kamau miro maleske i gili te giwell, i gili pral leskro drakengro them. Miro males his i latchi phub ap i tikni berga.

Un job rissras koi phub, un las i tsele barra krik, un tchiwas wi-rodede, latche drakengre ruka an koi phub. Un job tchiwas i turmo pre tardo mashkral dren. Un hadas i gruba win, kai wenn i drake win stakedo, te well o mool win. Un palle dikas lo ap ko tsiro, kai wenn i drake bares, – latche drake, patsas lo. Har ko tsiro was, wan diwje shutle drake baro.
Kanna awenn, tumer menshe an o foro Jerusalem un an o them Juda, un krenn o tchatchepen win mashkral mande un miro drakengro them!
Hoi hunte kroms budeder an miro drakengro them, hoi gar krom? Hoske anas lo diwje shutle drake win? Un me patsom, te hi le latcho un gudlo.

Jaake kamau tumenge kanna penell, hoi kamau te krell ko drakengro themeha, hoi mange hi. Me kamau kol burra krik te lell, hoi trul leste hi, jaake te well lo tele chalo, un leskri massuri mukau tele te phagell, jaake te well lo khetne stakedo.

Un me mukau ko them tchiddo, har lo hi. I ruka wenn gar pale tchinlo, un i phub gar trujel witsedo. Palle wenna subjengre burra un subjengro senlepen bares koi pre. Un me penau o brishineske, te perell lo gar koi tele.

O kheer Israel hi o drakengro them o baro Deblestar, ko rajestar pral o bolepen un i phub. Un i mursha an o them Juda hi kol drakengre ruka, hoi job an i phub tchiwas un pral kolende job bachtelo his. Ap lende dikas lo, te anenn le o latchepen glan. Un hoi was, his tchilatchepen. Jon te dans hakenes peskro tchatchepen, un kran, hoi his tchi har tchilatchepen.
Djungelo djal kolenge, kai krenn pen jek kheer pal o wawar, un ginenn penge jek kotar phub pal o wawar, bis te buder kek kotja phub pral atchenn, un lenge kokres o tselo them hi.
O baro Dewel, ko rai pral o bolepen un i phub, das pes sowel un penas glan mire kanda: Kol bud khera wenn paash dino, un kek djiwell buder an kol bare shukar khera!
Ap deesh hektarja drakengro them wenn drake bares, hoi denn gar budeder har ochta litarja mool. Un sheel kilogramme djob, hoi wi-witsedo wan an i phub, anenn gar budeder har deesh kilogramme djob.
Djungelo djal kolenge, kai stenn pre taissarlake, te djan le an i kertchima, un rati gomme koi beshdo hi un mato wenn!

Jon mukenn penge mishto te djal un krenn bashepen ap dorjengre bashepangre un phurdepangre un wawar bashepangre. Un mool hi ninna pashel. Ap kowa, hoi o baro Dewel krell, dikenn le gar. Kolestar kamenn le tchi te djinell.
Doleske penell o baro Dewel: Mire menshe haiwan tchi. Doleske wenn le pandles krik lino, un i brawele mank lende merenn i bokatar, un kol bud menshe merenn i trushatar.
O mulengro them bokell pal lende un kras peskro mui dur pre, un peskri meen jaake dur har djal, un chal i brawelen un kol wawaren, kai i bachtjatar gole dan un khelan.
Un jaake well o mensho tikno, un hunte dikell dren, te hi lo tchi. Un kolla, kai dikan tele ap i wawarende, hunte tchiwenn pengre jaka tele pherdi ladj.
O baro Dewel, ko rai pral o bolepen un i phub sikrell peskri soor, un krell, hoi tchatcho hi. O tchatcho Dewel sikrell, te hi lo kokres o Dewel, kai rakrell o tchatchepen win.
Mank i barra ko paash-dino forestar nashenn i bakre trujel un rodenn o chapen. Un i busja chan mank i khera, hoi kol brawele pale hunte mukan.
Djungelo djal i tchilatchenge, kai kamenn o chochepen. Jaake har i grai o wurdin tserdell, jaake tserdenn jon lengri doosh pal pende,
un penenn: Mu well kowa sik, hoi o baro Dewel kamell te krell, te dikas kowa! Mu well tchatcho, hoi o Israeleskro latcho Dewel peske glan las, te prindjras kowa!

Djungelo djal kolenge, kai penenn ap o tchilatchepen ‘kowa hi latcho’, un ap o latchepen ‘kowa hi tchilatcho’. I rati kharenn le ‘diwes’, un o diwes kharenn le ‘rati’. Shutlo koowa hi lenge gudlo, un gudlo koowa hi lenge shutlo.
Djungeles djal kolenge, kai an pengre jaka kokres gosewo hi, un pash pende kokres krenn, har te haiwenn le halauter.
Djungeles djal kolenge, kai hi tchatche mursha pash o pipen, un sorele mursha te krenn le chatchedi.
Djungeles djal kolenge, kai i lowenge koles an o tchatchepen tchiwenn, kai doosh ap peste anas, un kolenge lengro tchatchepen krik lenn, kai an o tchatchepen tardo hi.

Doleske merenn le tele har o senlepen, koleskre draba nasselo hi, un koleskri bluma tele perell, un har o khass, pral koleste i jag djal un les pre chatchrell. Jon kaman gar te djal o drom o baro Deblestar, kai hi o rai pral o bolepen un i phub. Un i labendar lengro latcho Deblestar kaman le tchi te djinell.

Doleske mukell o baro Dewel peskri choli pral peskre menshende te well. Un job hadell peskro wast ap lende un dell len. Un i berge trissenn. Un i mule atchenn tchiddo ap i dromma har tchik. Un an kowa lauter mukell leskri choli gar palla, leskro wast atchell hadedo, te dell lo trad.
Un job bitchrell i sikepen i menshenge an i them, hoi dur krik hi. Un job sholell, te wenn le dran o palstuno i phubjatar. Dik, kote wenn le – jaake sik har djala!

Pash lende hi kek khino, un kek, kai djal banges, kek, koleske i jaka pandlo djan un kek, kai sowella. Un kekeske lendar djal o pereskro pandepen pre, un lengre dorja ap lengre kircha hi soreles un djan gar paash.
Lengre faile hi har tchurja, un lengre boge hi pre tserdedo. Ko saster tel lengre grajengre pire hi sorelo har bar. Un i rade ap lengre wurdja hi sik har i sorelo ducho, hoi phurdell pral i phub.

Lengri gole hi har koja, hoi i lewo dell, awa, jaake har dell i terno lewo gole, hoi well dur dran leskri meen. Un palle stell lo pre un taprell ko vieches, hoi lo chapaske kamell, un hidjrell les kote, kai kek nai lell les leske krik.
Un an ko tsiro well pral lende i bari gole, sawi gole har o baro pani krell. Un te dikell jek palle tele ap i phub, dikell lo kalepen un bare duka. Un pesse wolke krenn, te well o diwes tamlo.
An ko bersh. kai o baro rai Usija meras, kote dikom me o Debles, maro rajes, beshdo ap i bari raili beshepaskri. Un o Debleskro kheer his pherdo ko telstuno kotar leskri plaashka.

Jagengre bolepangre his pral leste tardo, hakenes lendar his shob mussja har tchirklengre mussja: dujentsa tchakran le pengre jaka, dujentsa tchakran le pengre pire un dujentsa hadan le pen an o bolepen.
Un jek das ap o wawareste gole un penas: Latcho - un tchatcho - har kek wawar - hi o baro Dewel, ko rai pral o bolepen un i phub. I tseli phub hi pherdo leskro railepen!
Koi gole lendar mukas i telstune barra o kherestar te trissell. Un o kheer his pherdo jagakro ducho.

Un me penom: “Kanna hunte merap! Me hom i mursh, dran koleskro mui sawo rakepen djas, te nai wau me gar glan o Debleste. Un me djiwau mank menshende, dran kolengre muja ninna sawo rakepen djal. Un mire jakentsa dikom o baro rajes, les, o baro Debles, kai hi o rai pral o bolepen un i phub.”
Un jek kol jagengre bolepangrendar was pash mande. Un job las i jagakri forshetta an leskro wast, un las kolah i kotar kasht, hoi chatchell, o Debleskro chatchepaskri tele.
Un ko kasht, hoi chatchell, rikras lo ap miro mui, un penas: “Dik kawa was ap tiro mui, un jaake hunte djas tiri doosh tutar krik, un ko tchilatchepen, hoi tu kral, hi tutar krik lino.”
Un me shunom, har o baro Dewel, maro rai putchas: “Kones bitchrap, un koon rakrell mange?” Kote penom me: “Kate hom, bitche man!”
Un job penas: Dja koi, un pen ap kal menshende: Tumer shunenn un shunenn, un haiwenn tchi, un dikenn un dikenn un haiwenn gar, hoi dikan.

Rake lentsa, ninna te pandenn le pengre djia, un krenn pengre kanda kashteno, un pengre jaka pandlo. Te dikans le pengre jakentsa, un shunans pengre kandentsa, un haiwans pengre djijentsa, mukans le pengro tchilatcho drom un wans pash mande, un me kroms len sasto.
Un me putchom: “Har rah, rai?” Un job penas: “Bis te buder kek menshe an i forja djiwenn, witar kek mensho an i khera, un ko hachetikri phub har i mulo them was.”
O baro Dewel tradell i menshen dur krik dran kau them. Un o tselo them atchell muklo koi tchiddo.

Ninna te atchell o deshto kotar gomme koi, djal lenge har i tikne kashta, kai wenn dran i tele-dino ruk. I jag chatchrell len pre. Ko telstuno kotar o rukestar atchell. Un dran leste well newo djipen, hoi hi o Debleske koi.

Un i kurepen was an ko tsiro, har o baro rai pral o them Juda o Ahas his, koleskro dad o Jotam his, un koleskro dad o Usija his. O baro rai pral Syria, o Rezin, un o baro rai pral Israel, o Pekach, koleskro dad o Remalja his, wan pash o foro Jerusalem, te kurenn le pen o foreha. Jon nai lan les gar dren.

Un har o baro rajeske pral Juda penlo was, kai tchiwan i Syrarja pengre plachtene khera pre an o Efrajimeskro them, kote trissas lo i trashatar. Un ninna i tsele menshe an Juda trissan jaake har i ruka an i wesha trissenn, te phurdell i sorelo ducho.

Un o baro Dewel penas ap o Jesaja: Dja win, dja pash o Ahas, tu un tiro tchawo Shear-Jashub. Tu hatseh les kote, kai o panjeskro drom gar dureder djal, pash ko pralstuno pani, ap ko drom pash koi platsa, kai kolla budrenn, kai plachte krenna.

Un pen ap leste: “De jak! Atch pokones! Ab sorelo un ma traash glan kol dujende, o Rezin, ko Syrari, un o Pekach, koleskro dad o Remalja hi. Ninna te hi le chojedo, hi le tchi wawar har tele chatchedo kasht, kai gomme jagakro ducho pre djal.
Hi tchatcho, i Syrarja un i Efrajimarja khetne lengro baro rajeha, o Pekach, lan penge tchilatchepen glan khatar tute un penan:
‘Mer kamah pral te djal an o them Juda, un i menshenge koi daar te krell, un lengro them dren te lell. Un o Tabealeskro tchawes tchiwah pral lende, te well lo lengro baro rai.’
Kawa penell o baro Dewel, maro rai: Kowa well gar jaake un djal lenge gar!

O foro Damaskus hi o shero o themestar Syria, un o Rezin hi o baro rai kokres pral Damaskus. Un o foro Samaria hi o shero o themestar Efrajim, un o Pekach hi o baro rai kokres pral Samaria. Un an 65 (shob-deesh-te-pantch) bersha dell buder kek them Efrajim. Un te patsenn tumer kawa gar, palle atchenn tumer gar!”
Un o baro Dewel rakras pale ap o Ahas un penas:
“Mange mandar, tiro baro Deblestar, i sikepen! Muk man te krap tchomone an o mulengro them oder an o bolepen, hoi tut sikrell, te well kowa jaake har penom!”
O Ahas penas: “Me kamau gar te mangap o baro Deblestar, te krell lo tchomone, te sikrell lo, kai lo ap mari rig hi.”
Kote pre penas o Jesaja: “Shunenn, tumer, kai wenna o Davideskre tchawendar! Hi tumenge gar doha, te krenn menshen khino? Krenn kanna ninna miro Debles khino?
Doleske dell o baro Dewel kanna kokres i sikepen, te sikrell lo, kai hi lo ap tumari rig: I terni tchai well wawartchandes un lell i mursh tchawes. Un koles dell li o lab Immanuel.
Khil un gwin chal lo, bis te djinell lo, hoi tchilatcho un hoi latcho hi.
Glan te was ko tsiro, kai djinell lo kowa, well ko them muklo tchiddo, glan koleskre dui bare rajende tut sawi bari daar hi.

Un pral tute un tire menshende un i menshende an tiro them anell o baro Dewel sawe diwessa, har jon gar wan, jaake rah har dran o them Israel dui themma wan: o Israel un o Juda. Kol diwessa wenna o baro rajeha pral o them Assur.”
An ko tsiro phurdell o baro Dewel an i tikni phurdepaskri: Un lurde wenna dran o them Egiptia har matsille, un dran o them Assur har biene.
Un jon lauter beshenn pen ap hake platse – an i telstuni tala un mank i bare barra, an i burra un ap o senlepen.

An ko tsiro bitchrell o Dewel o baro rajes dran o them Assur. I wawar rigjatar o panjestar Eufrat kharell lo les kai, te well lo har i tchuri, hoi tchinell tumare balla tele ap o shero un ap i herja. Un ninna i tchora tchinell lo tele.
An ko tsiro hi jek murshes jek terni grumni un dui bakre.
Kolla denn jaake bud thud, te well i tseli familja khil te chal. Koon an ko tsiro pral atchas an o them, chal khil un gwin.
Un an ko tsiro well jaake: Kote, kai kanna i seri drakengre ruka tardo hi, hoi khetne jek sero rupene beme moldo hi, kote hi palle subjengre burra un subjengro senlepen tardo.
Kote djan le o bogeha un i failentsa, te denn le viechen karje. O tselo them hi pherdo subjengre burra un subjengro senlepen.

Ninna koi phub, hoi kanna i hachetikri phub hi, well jaake pherde subjengre burra un subjengro senlepen, te darenn i menshe, te djan le koi. Un jon tradenn i grumja koi, un i bakre stakrenn lauter khetne.
Un o baro Dewel penas ap mande: “Le tuke tchomone, kai nai tchineh laba pre, un tchin an i latcho tchinepen jaake, te nai drawerell hakeno kol laba ‘Sik-randedo un sik-tchoredo’.”
Un me lom mange dui murshen, kai mursha o labestar hi, un sikrom lende kol laba, hoi tchinom. Kolla his o rashai Urija un o Secharja, koleskro dad o Jeberechja his.

Un me djom pash miri romjate dren. Joi his i Debleskri rakepaskretsa. Un joi was wawartchandes un anas i mursh tchawes ap i phub. Un o baro Dewel penas ap mande: “De les o lab ‘Sik-randedo un sik-tchoredo’!
Glan te nai dell o ternepen gole ‘tata’ un ‘mama’, mukell o baro rai pral Assur o tselo brawlepen dran Damaskus un o tselo kutch koowa dran Samaria krik hidjrell.”
Un o baro Dewel rakras pale ap mande un penas:
An i jaka kal menshendar hi o tikno pani Siloah tchi moldo, hoi nashell lokes an Jerusalem. Un kol dui raja, o Rezin un o Pekach, wenn lenge jaake sorelo glan, te trissenn le i darjatar.

Doleske mukell o Dewel o baro rajes dran Assur pral lende te well. Leskre bud sorele lurde wenna har o baro sorelo pani o panjestar Eufrat, hoi djal diwjes pral peskre rigja un tchakrell i phub koi trujel.
Un jon wenna an o them Juda dren, har pani hoi dren phagell, un hoi bis pash i meen pre djal. O Dewel hi pash mende! Leskre mussja hi pral mende jaake dur har o them buchlo hi.
Shunenn, tumer menshe an dur themma! Ninna te tchiwenn tumen khetne, te djan ap o Juda, ninna te denn i kurepaskri gole, tumer wenn khetne stakedo!
Rakrenn khetne har te djan glan, un djinenn, kolestar well tchi. Rakrenn jaake bud har kamenn, Tchi well win. O Dewel hi mentsa.
O baro Dewel rakras ap mande, har leskro wast soreles ap mande his un man sikras, te dap man jak, te djap gar ap o drom, kai kol wawar menshe an Juda djana. Un job penas:
Tu un kolla, kai ap tute shunenn, ma krenn har kal menshe, kai patsenn, kai lauter phukepaskro koowa hi. Un ma darenn kolestar, hoi jon darenn! Mukenn tumen koi darjatar gar te taprell!
O baro Debles, ko rajes pral o bolepen un i phub mukenn kokres tumaro Dewel te well! Un kolestar darenn un trashenn!

Pash leste nai khatrenn tumen. Kol wawarenge an Israel un Juda hi lo har i bar, pral koleste jon perenn, awa, har i baro sorelo bar, pral koleste jon pen choirenn. Un i menshenge an Jerusalem hi lo har khatede pandle dorja, an kolende jon perenn un pen taprenn.
Un bud lendar dukrenn pen, perenn un phagenn pen i herja, taprenn pen an i dori, un wenn pandlo.
Tumer, kai shunenn ap mande, pandenn kau liil, kai tchinlo hi, hoi o Dewel mande sikras, un denn jak ap kol laba!
Me kamau ap o baro Debleste te dikell. Miro dji djal leske palla, ninna te khatras lo peskre jaka o Jakobeskre menshendar.
Me un kol tchawen, kai o baro Dewel man das, ham har i sikepen, hoi sikrell, hoi kamell o baro Dewel te krell an Israel, job, ko rai pral o bolepen un i phub, kai hi khere ap i berga Zion.

Nai well, te penenn i menshe tumenge: “Putchenn kolen, kai i mulentsa rakrenn, un putchenn i drawepangren, kolla, kai rakrenn lokes glan pende.” Ap kolende penenn: “Hunte putchenn gar i menshe pengro debles? Putchenn le i mulen i djidenge?”
Rikrenn tumen ap o Debleskro drom, un ap kowa, hoi job tumende sikrell! Te penenn i menshe tumenge wawar koowa, palle well lenge kek momeli ap lengro drom.
Un jon djan an o them trujel, phares dino un bari bokah. Un palle, te hi len bari bok, taprell len i choli, un jon praassenn pengro themeskro rajes un pengro debles. Un jon dikenn pre an o bolepen
un tel pende ap i phub, un hatsenn tchi har daar un tamlepen, awa bari daar un kali rat, kai hi le dren tradedo.

Djinenn, kek tamlepen atchell pral kolende, kai an i daar djiwenn. An o phuro tsiro anas o Dewel praassepen pral i themma Sebulon un Naftali. An ko tsiro, hoi wella, anell lo railepen ap kau them, hoi pash o baro pani tchiddo hi, ninna ap o them wergel o panjestar Jordan, kai djiwenn kanna i wawar menshe.
Kol menshe, kai djiwenn an i kali rat, dikenn i bari momeli. Kolenge, kai djiwenn an i tamlo them, djal o kham pre.

Baro Dewel, tu kral, te wenn i menshe bud, kral, te well lengri bacht bares. Glan tute stenn un sanenn le i bachtjatar, jaake har an ko tsiro, kai lenn le o djob dren, un jaake har lurde bachtelo hi, te lenn le pengro kotar kolestar, hoi randedo was an o kurepen.
Tu kral, te hi le buder gar pandle budepangre, un phagal ko kasht, koleha jon ap i budi tradedo wan, jaake har ap ko diwes, kai lal i menshen win dran i wasta kol Midianendar.
I lurdengre kircha, kolentsa i lurde phares pre stakran un lengre baja, kai rat ap lende hi, wenn an i jag witsedo un chatchrenn pre.
I ternepen was menge boldo, i mursh tchawo was men dino. Kowa well i baro rai, un kharell: latcho rakepaskro, sorelo Dewel, dad-hako-tsireske, rai-kai-lell-o-kurepen-krik.

I rajeskri soor, hoi les hi, well baro un bareder. Un an kek tsiro dell tchingepen. Job well beshdo ap o Davideskri beshepaskri, un hi i rai, kai krell o tchatchepen jaake win, har o Dewel kamell un mishto hi kanna un hako tsireske. O baro Dewel, ko rai pral o bolepen un i phub, krell kowa lauter. Jaake las lo pes kowa soreles glan.
O baro Dewel rakras o tchatchepen win pral o kheer Jakob. Un leskri choli peras ap i Israelende.
Un i tsele menshe an Efrajim un an Samaria haiwan kowa. Un jon atchan pre-phurde un sharan pen un penan:
“Kol barra dran chatchedi tchik peran, – kowa krell tchi. Mer tchiwah mare khera sorele barrentsa pale pre. I faigetikre ruka wan tele dino. Kote tchiwah zedertikre ruka an i phub.”
O baro Dewel kras kolen soreles, kai kamenn i Israelenge tchilatchepen te krell, o Rezin un kol wawaren, te djan le ap lende pre:

I Syrarja wenna fun glan un i Filistarja fun pal, te chan le o Israel pre har i diwjo viecho, hoi peskro mui dur pre krell. Un pral kowa lauter mukell o Debleskri bari choli gar tele, un leskro wast atchell pre hadedo, te dell lo len i phagi.
Un i menshe dran Israel wan gar pale pash koleste, kai len kol dawa dell, un rodan gar o baro Debles, ko rajes pral o bolepen un i phub.

Ap jek diwes las o baro Dewel lendar i pralstunen krik, ninna kol chochene rakepangren, kai penan, kai lengre laba o Deblestar wan. Kowa hi, har te tchinals jek i matchestar o shero un o pori tele, un i rukestar i patria un i telstuno kotar. I phurende un i an-dikle hi o shero. Kol chochene, kai penenn, lengre laba wans o Deblestar, hi o pori.
I pralstune pral i menshende anenn i menshen ap bange dromma un krenn te djinenn jon buder gar, hoi tchatcho hi.

Doleske nai well o Dewel gar bachtelo pral lengre terne murshende, un les nai hi kek dji kol tchawenge, kolen kek dad buder hi, ninna kol djuwjenge, kolengre romma meran. Jon halauter peran o Debleskro dromestar tele, kran tchilatcho koowa, un rakrenn pen dinlepen khetne. Pral kowa lauter mukell o Debleskri choli lendar gar tele, un leskro wast atchell pre hadedo, te dell lo len i phagi.
O menshengro tchilatchepen hi har i jag, hoi chal trul peste, un chatchrell subjengre burra un subjengro senlepen, un ninna o tselo weesh. Un pesso kalo jagakro ducho djal kote pre.
I choli o baro Deblestar, ko rajestar pral o bolepen un i phub, hi har i jag: O them chatchell, un i menshe chatchrenn ninna. Un kek rowas o wawareske, un hakeno dikas kokres ap peste.
Un lengri bok hi jaake baro, te taprenn le pal chapen ap hake rigja, un chan hako tikno kotar, un wenn gar tchalo. Hakeno krell o djipen o wawarestar paash.

I menshe dran o kheer Manasse perenn ap kolende dran o kheer Efrajim, un kolla dran Efrajim ap kolende dran Manasse. Un kol dui khetne djan ap i menshende dran Juda. Un pral kowa lauter mukell o Debleskri choli lendar gar tele, un leskro wast atchell pre hadedo, te dell lo len i phagi.
Hawi bibacht well ap kolende, kai krenn tchatchepangre laba win, hoi denn i menshen gar lengro tchatchepen, un tchinenn laba pre, hoi krenn lenge o djipen phares.

An i tchorwelengro koowa rakrenn le kek tchatchepen win. Un kolenge, kai gar an-dikle hi mank mire menshende, lenn le kowa krik, hoi lenge pal o tchatchepen hi. Jon lenn kowa krik, hoi i djuwjen hi, kolengre romma meran, un tchorenn i tchawen win, kolen kek dad buder hi.

Hoi kamenn tumer te krell ap ko diwes, kai well tumari phagi pral tumende? Ap ko diwes, kai well i bibacht fun dural pral tumende? Pash koneste kamenn tumer palle te nashell? Un kai mukenn tumer palle tumaro brawlepen?

Te han gar mank kolende, kai mulo dino wan, atchell tumenge tchi pral, har te tchiwenn tumen glan tele kolentsa, kai pandle wan. Un pral kowa lauter mukell o Debleskri choli tumendar gar tele, un leskro wast atchell pre hadedo, te dell lo tumen i phagi.
Hawi bibacht well ap i menshende an o them Assur! Har homs chojedo ap o Israel, his i Assirja har i kasht an miro wast, koleha i Israelitarjen dom.
