Ninna tumer denn menshen pash mande gole, kolen gar prindjrenn. Un sawe, kai prindjrenn tumen gar, wenn pash tumende naashedo, te dikenn le, hoi me, tumaro baro Dewel, tumenge krom. Me, o tchatcho Dewel pral o Israel, krau tumen baro un railo.
Rodenn o baro Debles jaake rah job mukell pes te hatsell! Denn les an-gole jaake rah job gar dur hi!

Koon kamas tchi o Deblestar te djinell, kowa te djal kanna peskro tchilatcho dromestar tele! Un kowa, kai tchilatcho koowa an peskro shero hi, job te mukell sawo koowa, un well pale pash maro baro Debleste, jaake te krell job peskro dji leske pre, un lell leskri doosh krik.
O baro Dewel penell: Kowa, hoi mange an o shero djal, hi gar kowa, hoi tumenge an tumare sherja djal. Un tumare dromma hi gar mire dromma.
Jaake dur o bolepen pral i phub hi, jaake dur hi ninna mire dromma pral tumare dromma, un kowa hoi mange an miro shero djal, hi feteder har kowa, hoi tumenge an tumare sherja djal.

O brishin un o gib perenn tele dran o bolepen, un djan gar buder kote pale. Jon krenn i phub sapeno, te djal latar senlepen un djob win, jaake te well i menshen maro te chal, un djob, hoi nai witsrenn le an i phub o wawar bersh.
Jaake hi kol laba, hoi dran miro mui win djan. Jon wenn tchatcho, un kowa, hoi penom, well jaake har me kamau. Un kowa, hoi mange glan lom, well jaake kerdo.
Tumer djan bachteles win an o latchepen, un kek rikrell tumen pre. I bare un i tikne berge denn gole i bachtjatar, te dikenn le tumen. Un i ruka an o weesh denn an pengre wasta.

Kote, kai subjengre burra un subjengro senlepen bares wan, djan kanna bare senele ruka pre. Doleske well o baro Debleskro lab sharedo. Un kowa hi ninna i sikepen, te bistrell kek, te his o baro Dewel kowa, kai sau koowa kras.
Kawa penell o baro Dewel: Djiwenn pal mire tchatchepaskre laba, un krenn, hoi tchatcho hi! Sik well ko diwes, kai lau tumen dran o tchilatchepen win, un tchiwau tumen an o tchatchepen.

Mishto djal ko mensheske, kai djiwell jaake, un rikrell pes soreles ap mire laba: kowa, kai rikrell o Debleskro diwes dren un budrell gar ap leste; un kowa, kai rikrell peskro wast pale, te krell lo tchilatcho koowa.

Un i wi-themari, kai djal ap o baro Debleskro drom, kowa hunte penell gar: O baro Dewel tchiwell man pale peskre menshendar. Un ko mursh, kai jaake tchinlo hi ap peskro mass, te lell lo buder kek tchawe, hunte penell gar: Me hom i mulo ruk!
Leske penell o baro Dewel: Te rikreh tu o Debleskro diwes dren, un kameh kowa te krell, hoi mange mishto hi, un rikreh tut ap kol laba, hoi mire menshendar win krom,
palle dau tut i bar an miro kheer, kai tiro lab dren tchinlo hi. Kowa hi feteder har tchawe un tcha. Kau lab, hoi tut dau, well an kek tsiro bistedo.

Un kol wi-themarja, kai djan ap o baro Debleskro drom, un hi leske koi, un kamenn les pengro tselo djijeha, un kamenn leskre budepangre te well, hakeno, kai rikrell o Debleskro diwes dren un budrell gar ap leste, un rikrell pes ap kol laba, hoi mire menshentsa win krom,

kolen anau pash miri berga, kai me djiwau, un krau len bachteles an miro kheer, kai mangenn man i menshe an. Jon nai anenn mange viechen: sawe, hoi wenn mange chatchedo ap miri chatchepaskri, ninna sawe, hoi chan le glan mande. Un me dikau latches ap kowa. Miro kheer well kharedo: Kheer, kai i menshe dran hake themma o Debles an-mangenn.
O baro Dewel, maro rai, kowa kai anas i krik-tradede Israelitarjen pale an lengro them, penell: Me anau gomme budeder khetne pash kolende, kai khetne anlo wan.
Awenn kai, tumer lurde dran wawar themma, un perenn pral mire menshende har diwje vieche un chan!
Kol mursha, kai hunte jak denn ap mire menshende, hi korelo, un jon halauter haiwenn tchi, un hi har djukle, kai kek gole denn. Jon hi koi tchiddo un dikenn suni, un kamenn te sowell.
Bud chapen kamenn le, un lenn gar doha. Jaake hi kolla, kai ap mire menshende jak denn. Jon haiwenn tchi, hakeno dikell ap peste kokres, un rodell, har nai anell lo peskre lowe khetne.
Jon denn gole: Awenn kai, me kamau mool te anell, te pijas men mates! Un taissar krah har kau diwes, un gomme shukeder!

O baro Dewel penell: Kowa, kai an o tchatchepen tardo his, meras. Un kek lell kowa an peskro dji. Un kolla, kai rikran ap mande, nashran pengro djipen. Un halauter krenna, har te wals kowa gar lengro koowa. Tchatchepah, ko tchatcho mensho was win lino dran o tselo tchilatchepen un bibacht.
Job djal kote, kai leske mishto djal. Kek darjah hi kolla an pengre tchibja tchiddo, kai pengro drom an o tchatchepen djan.
Tumer, kai mangenn chochene deblen an, han har drawepangre, har mursha, kai pash wawar djuwjende djan, un har djuwja, kai lubja hi.
Tumer san pral mande, un krenn tumaro mui bares pre, un sikrenn mange i tchip. Tumer han phukepangre un chochene!
Tel hako baro ruk lubrenn tumer trujel, te sharenn i chochene deblen! Un an i tala mank i bare barra marenn tumer lenge tumare tchawen, har te wans le vieche.

Un ap kol latche platse an i tala tchorenn tumer lenge chapen un pipen win. Doleske well ko diwes, kai wenn kote maredo tchiddo! Patsenn tchatchepah, te dau jekes, kai sawo koowa krell, kowa gar pale?
Israel, tu kral tiro tchiben pral ap i bari berga, un djal koi pre, te maress viechen kolenge, kai kek dewel hi.

Un palla ap o wudar un ap i pesse kashta, hoi ap i rigja o wudarestar hi, kral tiro sikepen. Mandar rissral tut tele, un tchakral tiro tchiben wawarenge pre, djal dren un kral les buchles, un mukal tut lendar te plaissrell. Tu kamal te djal an o tchiben lentsa, un dikal len pre tchakedo un nango.
Tu djal latcho djeteha pash o debleste Moloch, un ap tute tchiwal bud kutch djet, hoi mishto sungella. Tu bitchral murshen an dur themma, bis an o mulengro them, te anenn le tuke wawar deblen.
Kowa lauter, hoi kral, kras tut khino. Un tu penal gar: “Mukau kanna kowa.” Na-a, tu hatsal newi soor un hals buder gar khino.
Konestar trashal un daral tu jaake, te chochral man un bistral man, un mukal man tuke gar an o shero te well? Hi kowa gar jaake: I rah tsiro penom tchi koi pral. Un doleske dareh buder gar mandar.
Kanna sikrau me, hoi kowa moldo hi, hoi tu ‘tchatcho koowa’ khareh. Ko tselo koowa, hoi tu kral, hi tuke gar mishto.

Te deh tu palle gole, mu wenn jon ap tiri rig – tire tsele chochene debla! I phurdepen hadell len lauter krik. I tikno ducho phurdell len trujel. Kolla, kai rikrenn pen ap mande, lenn o them, te well lo lengro, un djiwenn ap miri berga, kai an-mangedo wau.
O baro Dewel penell: Krenn o drom! Krenn o drom! Krenn mire menshenge o drom! Lenn halauter krik, hoi lenge ap o drom tchiddo hi!

Me, o pralstuno, kai hadedo hom, un hako tsiro djiwau, un kokres o tchatcho Dewel hom, penau: Me djiwau an o pralstunepen an miro bolepaskro kheer, un ninna pash o mensheste, kai i phagedo un tele-rikedo dji an leste hi, te dap pale soor koleste, kai tele rikedo hi, un mukap koles pre te djiwell, koleskro dji phagedo hi.
Kamau gar hako tsiro pral i menshende te tchingrell un man choirell. te merenn le gar lauter glan mande, kol menshe, kolen me krom.
Lengri doosh his, te lan le gar doha. Pral kowa wom chojedo, un koleske dom me len, khatrom man glan lende un choirom man. Un jon djan dureder ap pengro drom un wan gar pale pash mande.
Lengre dromma dikom me, un doleske krau jaake: Me krau len sasto, sikrau len o drom, un rakrau latches lentsa. Un kolenge, kai rowenn,
tchiwau i gili an lengro mui, kolah sharenn le man. Kolenge, kai dur krik hi, ninna kolenge kai gar dur hi, lenge halauterenge mu djal mishto, penell o baro Dewel. Me krau len sasto.
I tchilatche hi har i diwjo baro pani, hoi rikrell pes nai gar pale, un well pale te pale un hadell khandli phub un tchik pre.
Kek latcho koowa hi i tchilatchenge, penell miro Dewel.

De bari gole! Rike tut gar pale! Hade tiri gole, te well li jaake sorelo har i phurdepaskri! Un pen mire menshenge, hawo tchilatcho koowa jon kran! Awa, pen o khereske Jakob, hawi doosh job ap peste las!

Jon wenn hako diwes, har te rodans le man, un penenn, te kamans le mire dromma te djinell, har te wans le menshe, kai o tchatchepen krenn, un pengro Debles gar mukan. Un jon kamenn, te krap me o tchatchepen lenge win, un te wap pash lende.

Bud kope cham tchi, penenn le, te dikess latches ap mende. Hoske dikeh tu kowa gar? Mer rikram men pale o chapastar, un tu haiweh kowa gar! Dikenn, penell o baro Dewel, ap ko diwes, kai tumer mange tchi chan, krenn tumer, hoi tumenge mishto hi, un rikrenn tumare budepangre tele.

Ap ko diwes, kai chan mange tchi, tchingrenn tumen un kurenn tumen, un denn i tchilatcho wasteha dren. An kau tsiro, kai chan mange tchi un krenn sawo tchilatcho koowa, nai wenn tumer gar shunlo an o bolepen.

Patsenn tumer, kai mange mishto hi, te rikrell pes i mensho pale o chapastar, un mukell peskro shero tele te perell har i phagedo shilftikro halmo? Te pandell lo i gono trul peste un beshell pes an i jagakri tchik? Patsenn tumer, sawo koowa hi mishto mange? Hi kowa tchatchepah i diwes, ap koleste me, o baro Dewel, latches dikau?

Kanna penau tuke, hoi i diwes hi, hoi glan mire jaka mishto hi: I diwes, kai kreh tu kol shelle pre kolendar, kai pandlo wan, un kai kek tchilatchepen kran. Muk kolen te djan, ap kolende pharo koowa tchiwal! Le ko koowa krik, koleha len tele rikral! Un phage kol shelle, hoi trul lengre menja pandlo hi.
De koles te chal, kai bokell! un le kolen khere pash tute, kai tchorwelo hi un ap o drom djiwenn. Te dikeh jekes, koles kek ripja hi, de les koola! Un ab tiri familjake koi!

Palle well tiro tchatchepen glan har o kham taissarlakro. Un tiro dukepen well sik sasto. Un hakeno dikell ko latcho un tchatcho koowa, hoi kral. Un o baro Dewel djal pal tute peskri sorjah un dell jak ap tute.

Palle deh tu gole, un o baro Dewel rakrell ap tute pale! Hako kopo, kai deh gole ‘ab ap miri rig’, penell job: ‘Kate hom.’ Tu rikress kekes tele pash tute, un aness tchi ap jekeste pre, hoi gar tchatcho hi, un rakress gar djungeles pral leste.

Tu dess tiro maro koles, kai bokell, un dess koles, kai les gar doha djipaske hi, lauter, hoi les hunte well. Palle djal tuke o kham pre an o kalepen, kai tu djiweh. Un tiri rati well har o mashkral-diwes.

Un hako tsireske sikrell tut o baro Dewel tiro drom. Ninna te djiweh an o mulo tato them, dell lo tut doha djipaske, un dell tut newi soor. Palle hal tu har i baar, kolat hako tsiro doha pani hi, awa, har i pani, hoi dran i phub pre djal, un koleskro pani hako tsiro nashell.

Un tire menshe tchiwenn pale kol phure forja pre, hoi bud bersha paash dino koi tchiddo his. Awa, jon krenn kol phure massurja newes, kolen tire phure menshe koi tchiwan glan i rah tsiro. Un tu weh kharedo: Kowa, kai phagede massurja pale pre tardo tchiwell, un kowa, kai i dromma kote pale tseles krell, kai i menshe djiwenn.

Te rikreh tire herja pale, te djas gar ap i budi ap o Debleskro diwes, un djah gar i lowenge palla ap ko diwes, hoi mange hi, un peneh: Kowa hi miro shukeder diwes, kai sharau o baro Debles un mangau les an, te shareh les tu jaake, te djas gar ap i budi un kek lowenge palla, un kreh kek bare laba,
palle hatseh tchatchi bacht an o baro Debleste. Un me, o baro Dewel, hadau tut pral i pralstune berge. Un dau tut ko them, hoi dom tiro phuro dadeste, o Jakobeste. Kawa hi, hoi o baro Dewel penas.
Dik, o baro Debleskri mussi hi lengsto doha, te nai lell lo tumen dran o tchilatchepen win! Un leskre kanda hi gar pandlo, te nai shunell lo gar.
Na-a, tumari doosh, hoi ap tumende lan, hi tardo mank tumende un tumaro Debleste. Dran ko tchilatchepen, hoi kran, khatrell lo peskre jaka tumendar, un doleske shunell job gar.
I wawarengro rat kras tumare wasta ratlo, un koi doosh, hoi ap tumende lan, kras tumare gushte tchiklo. Tumaro mui rakrell chochepen, un tumari tchip tchilatchepen.

Kekeske tumendar, kai djal glan o tchatchepaskro mursheste, djal trul o tchatchepen. Un kek, kai anell tchomone ap i wawareste pre, penell o tchatchepen. Pash tumende hi jaake: Ap kowa, hoi tchi moldo hi, rikrenn tumen, un rakrenn o chochepen. Kowa, hoi an tumare sherja trujel djal, hi har nai chochenn un dukrenn i wawaren. Ko tchilatcho koowa, hoi win well, anell o merepen,
jaake har tikne tchilatche sapa, kai dran lengre jare wenn, un har koi netsa, hoi i spinna krell. Kowa, kai kol sapengre jare chala, hunte merell. Te stakrell lo i jaro khetne, well i sap win.

Kowa, hoi tumer win krenn, hi tchitcheske, hi gar budeder moldo har i ripen kerdo dran i netsa, hoi i spinna kras, un koleha nai tchakreh tchi tele. Kowa hoi tumer krenn, hi chochepen. Tumare wastentsa dukenn un marenn tumer.

Tumare herja nashenna pal o tchilatchepen, un hi sik, te mukenn le kolen te ratell, kai kek tchilatchepen kran. Kowa, hoi mukenn tumenge an o shero te djal, hi har nai chochenn un dukrenn i wawaren. Ap tumare dromma atchell phagedo djipen pale.
Tumenge hi tchi moldo, te djal i wawarenge mishto. Un o tchatchepen kamenn gar te krell. Bange dromma djan tumer. Sawe menshe perenn an i bibacht.

Doleske dell men o Dewel gar maro tchatchepen, un leskro latchepen well gar ap mende. Hoske bitchrell lo menge kek momeli? Lauter, hoi dikah, hi kali rat. Kaana djal menge o kham pre? An o pessester kalepen nashah mer trujel.
Har korele taprah pal i wanta, har sawe, kai dikenn gar, kai le djan. Mashkral o diwes perah har te wals rati. Mank i saste ham jaake har te wams mule.

Har pandle diwje vieche dah gole i dukatar, un rowah har i taube. Mare djia nashenn pal ko diwes, kai well menge o Dewel ap i rig, un lell men win dran i tchilatche wasta. Job well gar, un tchi djala.
Baro Dewel, bud kope peram tutar tele. Mari doosh, hoi mer ap mende lam, sikrell har tchilatcho ham. Ko tchilatchepen, hoi kram, hi glan mare jaka, un mer djinah, hawo djunglepen ap tute kram:
Mer phagam maro baro Debleha, djiwam har te prindjrams les gar, un peram lestar tele. Kram i wawaren tiknes maro rakepah, un phukram ap lende. Lam men chochepen glan un rakram chochepen.
Mer dam i wawaren gar lengro tchatchepen, un bud kope rakram gar o tchatchepen pral lende win. Ap i parepaskri platsa ginam un bikram o chochepah, un tchatcho rakepen hatseh kote gar.
Jaake meras o tchatchepen, un ko mensho, kai kamell tchi o tchilatchepastar te djinell, well win randedo. O baro Dewel dikas kowa lauter, un leske his djungeles, te dell kek tchatchepen buder.
Un bare jakentsa dikell lo, te hi kek mursh koi, kai koi djal, te well lo kolenge ap i rig, kai tele rikedo hi. Kote was lo kokres peskri sorjah, un peskro tchatchepen was leske pash o wast.

Un jaake har riwell i lurdo i sasterno gad an, jaake riwell job o tchatchepen an. Un jaake har i lurdo i sasterni stadi ap peskro shero tchiwell, jaake tchiwell job o kurepaskri bacht ap peste. Leskri choli hi har i plaashka ap leste, te dell lo kolende pengri phagi, kai i wawarenge tchilatchepen kran.
Kolen dell lo pale pal kowa, hoi jon kran. Bari choljah djal lo ap lende. Ninna kolen dell job pengri phagi, kai djiwenn dur krik wergel o baro pani.
Palle taprell i daar i menshen ap i tseli phub glan o baro Debleste un leskro railepen. Job wella har i diwjo sorelo pani hoi nashella, koles o ducho o baro Deblestar glan peste phurdell.
O baro Dewel penell: Mire menshenge an o foro Zion wau, te lap len dran o merepen win. Kolenge dran o kheer Jakob wau, kai mukan pengro tchilatcho drom.

Kawa krau me lentsa win, penell o baro Dewel: Me tchiwom miro ducho ap tumende. Un mire laba, hoi penom tumenge, atchenn pash tumende. Un tumer penenn len dureder ap tumare tchawende, un jon ap pengre tchawende, un kolla ap pengre tchawende. Kowa atchella jaake kanna un hako tsireske. Kowa penau me, o baro Dewel,
Ste pre, Jerusalem, ab railo har o kham! I newo diwes well tuke, un o Debleskro railepen djal pre pral tute.
Dik, kalepen tchakrell i phub un tamlepen i wawar themma, pral tute stell o baro Dewel pre, un leskro railepen mukell pes pral tute te dikell.
Un i menshe dran wawar themma wenna, te dikenn le, har railo tu hal. Un lengre raja wenna, te dikenn le ko railepen, hoi pral tute pre djas.
Dik trujel, un dik, hoi djal! Tire menshe wenn khetne, te djan le khere. Tire mursh tchawe wenn fun dural, un tire tcha wenn hidjedo ap mussja.

Palle dikeh tu kowa, un bari bachtjatar chatchell tiro mui har i momeli, un tiro dji trissella un djal dur pre. Bud brawlepen dran wawar themma well anlo pash tute, fun wergel o baro pani well lo pash tute.
Bud khamele tchakrenn tiro them, terne khamele dran Midian un Efa. Kolla anenna sonakai un sungepaskro koowa dran Saba. Un i menshe sharenn o baro Debles.
I tsele bakre dran Kedar un Nebajot wenn anlo pash tute, te wenn le maredo un chatchedo o baro Debleske, te dikell lo latches ap tute. Un jaake krell o baro Dewel peskro railo kheer gomme shukeder.
Koon hi kol shiffe, kai wenn sik har i wolke, un har i parne tchirkle, hoi wenn khere an pengro kheer?

Ap mande dikenn i menshe wergel o baro pani. Un i shiffe, hoi wenna dran Tarsis, ulerenna glan win, te anenn le tire tchawen, hoi dur krik his, khere. Un lengro sonakai un rup anenn le peha, te sharenn le tiro baro Debles. Job kokres hi o Israeleskro tchatcho Dewel, un kowa, kai kras tut railo.
Un i wi-themarja tchiwenn tire massurja pale pre, un lengre bare raja wenn tuke pash o wast. An miri choli dom me tut, an miro latchepen lau tut pale pre.
Un tire bare wudja atchenn hako diwes pre. Pral o diwes har an i rat wenn le gar pandlo, te nai anenn kol menshe dran wawar themma pengro brawlepen pash tute, un te nai wenn lengre raja glan tute.
Kol themma, kolengre menshe kamenn gar tuke te budrell, wenn paash stakedo, un lengre menshe maredo, te atchell tchi lendar pral.
Kutch kasht dran o shukar weesh ap i berge Libanon well pash tute anlo, te well miro kheer shukar kerdo. Un jaake sikrau, har railo kai platsa hi, kai tardo hom.

Un i tchawe kolendar, kai rikran tut tele, wenn pash tute, un tchiwenn pen glan tute tele. Un kolla, kai praassan tut, witsrenn pen glan tire herja an i tchik. Un jon kharenn tut ‘foro o baro Deblestar’, un ‘Zion, o foro o Israeleskro Deblestar’.
His i tsiro, kai hals muklo, un kek kamas tut un djas pash tute. Kanna krau tutar, te wess hako tsiro sharedo un shukar, i foro, kai hi hakeno bachtelo jaake rah har menshe ap kai phub hi.

Tu leh o brawlepen i menshendar dran wawar themma un kutch koowa lengre rajendar. Palle haiweh, te hom me, o baro Dewel, kowa, kai las tut win dran o pandepen, te hom me, o Israeleskro sorelo Dewel, kowa, kai tuke plaissras.

Sonakai anau me, un gar lolo saster. Rup anau un gar saster. Lolo saster anau un gar kasht. Un saster anau un gar barra. Tire raja rikrenn tut buder gar tele. Tel lende djal tuke mishto un tut well tiro tchatchepen.
I kurepaskri gole well gar buder shunlo an tiro them. Paash-dine forja un kurepen dell gar buder koi. Na-a, mank tire massurja krell kek tuke tchilatchepen, un tu shareh man koleske.
Tut hunte well buder gar o kham ap o diwes, witar gar o tchon an i rat, te well tut i momeli. Na-a, o baro Dewel well tuke i momeli hako tsireske. O railepen tiro Deblestar well tiri momeli.
Tiro kham djal gar buder tele, un tiro tchon atchell diklo. o baro Dewel well tuke i momeli hako tsireske. Un kol phare diwessa, an kolende tu rowal, hi palle trujel.
Tire menshe hi halauter an o tchatchepen tardo. Un kau them hi lenge hako tsireske. Jon hi har i tikne ruka, hoi tchiwom an i phub, un hoi bares wan. Mire wastentsa krom len, te sikrap miro railepen.
Ninna dran tiri tikneder familja wenn jek sero menshe. Un i familjatar, hoi gar an-diklo hi, well i soreli natsjona. Me, o baro Dewel, krau kowa peskro tsireske sik.

O baro Debleskro ducho hi ap mande. O baro Dewel rodas man win un bitchras man, te penap i tchorwelenge o latcho lab. te krap i phagede djia sasto, te penap i pandlen, te hi le buder gar pandlo, un penap i stilden, te nai djan le win dran o stilepen.

Me wom bitchedo, te dap win gole, te was ko bersh, kai sikrell o baro Dewel peskro latchepen ap peskre menshende. Ninna was ko diwes, kai dell maro Dewel hakenes ko tchilatchepen pale, hoi job ap o them Juda kras. Job bitchras man, te khossap i swa tele kolenge, kai kanna rowenn.

Un kolla an o foro Zion, kolengre djia rowenn, hunte wenn buder gar beshdo an i jagakri tchik un rido an gone. Na-a, me dau len werklia, te krenn le pen shukar, un sungepaskro djet. Lengre djia te giwenn un atchenn buder gar phagedo. Un jon wenn kharedo: ‘Bare ruka, hoi anenn sharepen o Debleske’, un ‘Ruka, hoi o baro Dewel peske an i phub tchiwas’, te well leskro railepen diklo.
Kol phure forja, hoi jaake rah tele phagedo un paash dino koi tchiddo hi, tchiwenn jon pale pre. Kal forja, kai bud bersha buder kek djiwell, wenn pale newes kerdo.
Wi-themarja wenna un denn jak ap tumare bakre, un budrenn tumenge ap i hachetikri phub un ap o drakengro them.
Tumer wenn rashaja o baro Deblestar, un wenn kharedo ‘maro Debleskre budepangre’. Un ko brawlepen dran wawar themma, koleha mukenn les tumer tumenge mishto te djal, un koleha sharenn tumen.
Tumer hidjran bari ladj un praassepen, doleske lenn tumer kanna i baro them un i bacht, hoi atchella hako tsireske.

Me, o baro Dewel kamau o tchatchepen, un hom chojedo pral o tchorepen un o tchilatchepen. Un tchatchepah, me dau latcho koowa i menshende an Juda ko tselo tchilatchepaske, hoi ap lende was. Un me krau lentsa win, te atchas mer mala hako tsiro. Koi pre dau miro tchatcho wast.
Lengre tchawe, kai pal lende wenna, hi prindjedo un an-diklo pash i menshende an hake themma. Un koon len dikell, haiwell: Kolla hi i menshe, ap kolende o baro Dewel peskri bacht tchiwas.

Me hom bachtelo pral o baro Debleste, un miro dji giwell miro Debleske. Job hi trul mende har i ripen, te well kek tchilatchepen ap mende, un tchiwas tchatchepen ap mende har i plaashka, jaake har hidjrell i bijabeskro i shukar stadi, un leskri pirni shukar werklia un gustria.
Jaake har mukell i phub o senlepen pre te djal, un bares te well, jaake mukell o baro Dewel, maro rai, o tchatchepen pre te djal, un maro sharepen bares te well pash i menshende an i tsele themma.
Te dikau tut, Jerusalem, nai rikrau gar miro mui, dran o kamlepen ap tute dau gar pre, bis te lell o foro peskro tchatchepen, un leskri bacht pre djal har o kham un diklo well har i jag an i rati.
Palle dikenn i menshe an wawar themma tiro tchatchepen, un i tsele bare raja dikenn tiro railepen. Un tu weh pash i newo lab kharedo, kowa, hoi o baro Dewel tut dell.
Un tu weh har i kutch rajeskri stadi an o baro Debleskro wast, awa, i rajeskro shereskro an tiro Debleskro wast.

Tu weh gar buder kharedo ‘muklo foro’ un tiro them ‘mulo them’. Tu weh gole dino ‘o Debleskri pirni’, un tiro them ‘bachteli romni’. O baro Dewel dikell latches ap tute, un romedinerell pes tiro themeha.

Jaake har i terno mursh peske i terni tchai lell, jaake lenn tire menshe o them Juda penge. Un jaake bachtelo ko bijabeskro hi pral i terni tchai, kolah job bijab krell, jaake bachtelo hi tiro Dewel pral tute.
Jerusalem, me tchiwom murshen ap tire massurja, te denn le jak ap tute. O tselo diwes un i tseli rat denn le bares gole, un mukenn gar tele, te bistrell tut o baro Dewel gar.
Jon denn jaake rah gole, bis te job o foro Jerusalem pale pre tardo tchiwas, un bis te job les jaake kras, te well o foro ap i tseli phub sharedo.

O baro Dewel das pes sowel un das peskro tchatcho wast pre, un hadas peskri soreli mussi, un penas, te dell kek tsiro buder, kai mukell lo kolen tiro djob te chal, kai kurenn pen tuha, un witar gar i menshen dran wawar themma tiri mool te pijell, kolake tu jaake phares budral.
Awa, kolla, kai o djob dren anan, kolla chan les ninna un sharenn o baro Debles. Un kolla, kai i drake dren anan, kolla pijenn ninna i mool lendar ap i platse glan miro kheer.

Murshale an o foro Jerusalem, djan win dran o foreskre wudja! Djan win! Krenn i drom i menshenge, kai khere wenn! Krenn o drom tchatcho! Lenn kol barra krik! Krenn ko drom djudjo! Hadenn i sikepen pre i menshenge dran wawar themma!

Dikenn, o baro Dewel mukell kal laba te shunell ap i tseli phub: Penenn i menshenge an o foro Jerusalem: Kowa, kai lell tumen win dran o tchilatchepen, hi ap o drom. Kolen job peske khetne anas, kolla hi pash leste. Awa, kolen job peske ginas, kolla djan glan leste.
Un jon wenn kharedo ‘Debleskre menshe’ un ‘wi-ginle o baro Deblestar’. Un tut denn le gole ‘o foro, hoi o Dewel kamell’ un ‘o foro, hoi buder gar muklo hi’.

Koon hi kowa, kai well dran o them Edom dran o foro Bozra, rido an lole koola? Koon hi kowa, kai hi jaake railes rido, un kai nashell railes an peskri bari soor. Kowa hom me, o baro Dewel, kai rakrell an o tchatchepen: Man hi i soor, te lap tumen dran o merepen win.
Hoske hi loles ap tire koola? Un hoske hi tire koola har jekestar, kai stakrell i drake?

Me stakrom kol drake kokres, un i menshendar dran wawar themma his kek pash mande. Me stakrom len miri choljah, awa, bari choljah stakrom len khetne. Un lengro rat was ap mire koola, un miri baja was ratlo.
An miro dji was o diwes, kai dau hakenes pale, hoi lo kras. Un ko bersh was, kai lau mire menshen dran o tchilatchepen win.
Me dikom man trujel, un kek his koi, kai ap miri rig his. Un kamom les gar te patsell, te rikrals kek pash mande. Koi kras man miri choli soreles.
Un me stakrom i menshen an wawar themma khetne an miri choli. Un jon wan mato dran miro choli. Un me mukom lengro rat ap i phub te nashell.

Me kamau te rakrap pral o Debleskro latchepen, ko baro koowa, hoi o baro Dewel halauter menge kras, un ko tselo latcho koowa, hoi mukas lo ap o kheer Israel te well. Les hi lenge i baro dji un hi lenge jaake latches.
Job penas: Tchatchepah, mire menshe hi le, menshe kek chochepah. Doleske was lo, te lell lo len win

dran ko tselo pharo koowa, hoi ap lende tchiddo his. Kek wawar, kek bolepaskro un kek bitchepaskro was lenge ap i rig. Na-a job kokres was, un las len dran kowa lauter win. Dran leskro tselo dji kamas lo len un his lenge latches. Doleske las lo len koi win, hadas len pre, un hidjras len hake diwessa an ko phuro tsiro.
Ninna te his lo lenge jaake latches, kaman le gar ap leste te shunell, un dukran les an leskro dji. Kote was lo chojedo ap lende, un kuras pes lentsa.

Kote mukan le penge pale i phure tsirja an o shero te djal, kol diwessa, kai o Mose, djiwas, un putchan pendar: Kai hi o baro Dewel, kai las peskre menshen win dran o baro pani, khetne kolentsa, kai ap lende jak dan? Kai hi o baro Dewel, kai ap lende peskro ducho tchiwas?
Kai hi kowa, kai peskri bari sorjah ap o Moseskri tchatchi rig was? – Kowa, kai kras, te djal ko pani glan lende ap dui rigja, un peske jaake i baro lab kras, hoi an kek tsiro bistedo well.
Kai hi kowa, kai mukas mare phuren mank telstune panja te djal, jaake har diwje graja, hoi soreles ap i herja hi?

Har grumja, kai djan i berga tele, te hatsenn le senlepen, jaake anas o baro Dewel peskre menshen kote, kai len doha djipaske his. Awa, baro Dewel, jaake anal tu len pengro drom, un kral tuke i railo lab.
Dik dran o bolepen tele, un dik tele dran tiro railo kheer! Kai hi tiro kamlepen, hoi menge chatchell? Kai hi tiri soor? Hi tut buder kek dji un kek latchepen menge?
Tu hal maro dad. O Abraham djinell tchi mendar, un o Jakob prindjrell men gar. Tu, baro Dewel, hal maro dad, kowa kai men win las dran o them Egiptia. Glan rah tsiro kral tu tuke koleha i baro lab.
Hoske, baro Dewel, mukeh tu men tire dromendar tele te djal, te kram mare djia har bar, jaake te djiwam buder gar tuha? Ab pale pash mende! Ma biste tire budepangre! Mer ham tire menshe.
I tikno tsiro tradan menshe dran wawar themma men, tire menshen, dran maro them. Kolla, kai kuran pen mentsa, stakran tiro kheer khetne, kai tu khere hals.
Un mer wam har sawe, pral kolende tu an kek tsiro o rai hals, un pral kolende tiro lab gar win gole dino was.
Ab har i jag, hoi chatchrell truk kasht, un mukell o pani an i piri te kerell! Sike koon tu hal mank kolende, kai kamenn tut gar, te trissenn i menshe dran wawar themma glan tute,
te kreh tu pale baro sorelo koowa, hoi kek wawar nai krell, witar gar glan-wi dikell. Ab tele, te trissenn i berge glan tute!
An kek tsiro shunas jek i deblestar jaake har tu hal. Kek kand shunas sawestar, un kek jak dikas i debles, kai krell sawo baro koowa kolenge, kai dikenn ap leste.

Tu wal pash kolende, kai kran o tchatchepen i bachtelo djijeha, un djan ap tire dromma un kran, hoi lendar kamal. Tu choiral tut, har shunam buder gar ap tute. Te djah ap tire dromma, leh tu men win dran o tchilatchepen.

Kanna wam halauter glan tute har jek, kai pale-tchiddo hi. Ninna o tchatcho koowa, hoi kram, hi har i ratli baja ap mende. Mer halauter wam har mule patria. Mari doosh hidjrell men krik, har i ducho mule patria krik phurdell.
Un koi hi kek, kai tiro lab an-gole dell, kek, kai well pash tute, te rikrell lo pes ap tute. Tchatchepah, tu kameh buder tchi mendar te djinell, un mukeh men tapedo an maro tchilatchepen.
Kanna, baro Dewel, tu maro dad, mer ham har i loli phub, dran kolate tu i tcharo chatcheh. Tire wasta kran men halauter.
Baro Dewel, muk tiri choli gar jaake bares te well, te bistress mari doosh gar buder. Dik ap mende, mangah tut, tire menshe ham halauter.
Tire forja wan har i mulo them. O foro Jerusalem hi paash dino un i berga Zion muklo.
Maro railo Debleskro kheer, kai sharan tut mare phure, chatchras i jag pre, un maro shukar koowa hi khetne stakedo tchiddo.
Baro Dewel, kameh tut pash kawa lauter kanna gomme pale rikrell? Kameh tu tchi penell, un mari ladj gomme dureder un bareder te krell?

O baro Dewel penell: Me homs koi, te rodenn le man. Un jon putchan gar pal mande. Me homs koi, te hatsenn le man. Un jon rodan man gar. Me penom: Kate hom! Kate hom! ap menshende, kai man gar an-gole dan.
Me rikrom o tselo diwes mire wasta win kol menshenge, kai kaman gar ap mande te shunell, un djan i drom, hoi gar mishto hi, un djiwenn pal pengro shero.
Kol menshe mukenn gar tele, te krenn le kowa, hoi man choirell: Jon anenn viechen i wawar deblenge ap lengre shukar platse, un chatchrenn lenge sungepaskro koowa ap barra.

Rati hi le beshdo pash i mulengre khera, te putchenn le i mulen, un atchenn pral i rat an khatede platse, kai mangenn le wawar deblen an. Jon chan balengro mass, un pijenn summi, hoi mass dren hi kol viechendar, hoi pale-tchiddo hi.

Un jon penenn i wawarenge: Atch krik tuke, ma tape man an! Me taprom ko koowa miro deblestar an. Sawe menshe, penell o baro Dewel, nai dikau me gar glan i jaka. Miri choli pral lende hi har i jag, hoi o tselo diwes chatchell.
Dikenn, kowa lauter hi pre tchinlo an i liil glan mande. Un me rikrau gar miro mui, bis te dom len ko tselo tchilatchepen pale, hakeneske ap peskro shero:

Ko tchilatcho koowa, hoi jon kran, un ko tchilatcho koowa, hoi lengre phure kran, penell o baro Dewel. Jon chatchran ap i berge wawar deblenge sungepaskro koowa, un koleha anan le ladj ap mande. Jaake dau me kowa ap lengre sherja pale, kowa lauter, hoi kran le ninna an i phure tsirja.

Kawa penell o baro Dewel: Jaake har kek hacho peskre drake tele dell un krik witsrell, kai gomme mool an lende hi, jaake kamau me ninna te krell mire menshentsa, te mukap len gar lauteren te marell. Hi sawe mank lende, kai mange koi hi.
O Jakobestar wenna pale menshe, un dran Juda wenna sawe, kai ap mire berge djiwenna. Kolen, kai me win rodom, lenge well o them, un mire budepangre djiwenn kote.
Mire menshenge, kai putchenn pal mande, well i tala Sharon koi platsa, kai anenn le pengre bakre, un i tala Achor well koi platsa, kai atchenn pengre grumja.

Tumenge, kai o baro Debles mukan, well wawartchandes: Tumer bistran miri berga, kai wau an-mangedo, un tchiwan o chocheno debleske, o Gad, chapen glan. Un glan o chocheno debleste, o Meni, tchoran mool win.

Doleske penau me, tumer wenn mulo dino o chareha, un hunte djan ap i tchanga, te wenn maredo har vieche. Har dom me tumen gole, dan tumen gar glan. Har rakrom tumentsa, shunan gar, un kran, hoi djungeles hi an mire jaka, un rodan tumenge kowa win, hoi gar kamau.

Doleske penell o baro Dewel, maro rai: An ko tsiro, kai tumer bokenn, hi mire budepangren chapaske. An ko tsiro, kai tumer trushenn, hi mire budepangren doha te pijell. An ko tsiro, kai han an i ladj, hi mire budepangre an i bacht.
An ko tsiro, kai denn tumer gole darjatar, un rowenn dran i phagedo dji, hi mire budepangre jaake bachtelo, te giwenn le i bachtjatar.

Pash mire wi-rodede menshe hi tumare laba sawe laba, kolentsa jon i bibacht pral jekeste win rakrenn, un penenn: “O baro Dewel maro rai, mu dell tut mulo har kales un koles.” Lengre budepangren dell job i newo lab.

Palle penenn kolla an o them Juda, kai rakrenn i bacht win pral jekeste: “I bacht o tchatchepaskro Deblestar well pral tute!” Un kowa, kai dell pes sowel an o them, kowa dell pes sowel pash o tchatchepaskro Debleste. Palle hi bistedo kol phare diwessa pherdi bibacht, hoi glan kau tsiro his, un wenn mange buder gar glan i jaka.
Tchatchepah, me krau i newo bolepen, un i newi phub. Un ko phuro bolepen un koi phuri phub hi palle bistedo, un wenn buder gar i menshenge an o shero.
Giwenn un denn gole i bachtjatar hako tsiro pral kowa, hoi me krau! Me krau, te well Jerusalem i bachtelo foro, un i tsele menshe koi dren giwenn i bachtjatar.
Me ninna, wau bachtelo pral Jerusalem, un miro dji giwell pral mire menshende. Ropen well kote buder gar shunlo, witar gar dell jek gole i darjatar.

Un kote dell buder kek ternepen, kai gar bud diwessa phuro well, un kek phuro, kai merell glan peskro tsiro. O terneder lendar well sheel bersh phuro. Un kowa, kai merell un his kek sheel bersh phuro, kolestar penenn le, te was pral leste i bibacht win rakedo.
Jon tchiwenn penge khera pre tardo, un djiwenn dren. Un jon tchiwenn penge drakengre ruka an i phub un chan lengre drake.

Jon tchiwenn kek kheer pre tardo, un i wawar djiwell palle dren. Un jon tchiwenn tchi an i phub, un i wawar chal les palle. Jaake phuro i ruk well, jaake phuro wenn ninna mire menshe. Un mire wi-rodede menshe wenn i rah tsiro bachteles pral kowa, hoi lengre wasta kran.
Jon budrenn gar tchitcheske, un lengre tchawe wenn gar boldo, te merenn le sik. Jon hi menshe, ap kolende o baro Debleskri bacht tchiddo hi, – ap lende, ninna ap lengre tchawende.
Un kawa well jaake: Jon dan gomme gar gole, koi dom man glan, un jon rakrenn gomme, koi shunau me.

O diwjo djuklo un o terno bakro chan khetne jek pash o wawar. Un o lewo chal phuss har i grumni, un o sap hunte chal tchik. Kek krell tchomone, hoi duka anell, witar tchi, hoi tchilatcho hi ap miri tseli berga, kai djiwau, penell o baro Dewel.
O baro Dewel penell: O bolepen hi miri raili beshepaskri, un i phub i tikno banko, kai me mire herja pre tchiwau. Hawo kheer kamenn tumer mange pre te tchiwell, An hawo kheer kamenn tumer, te djiwap?
Me, o baro Dewel, krom miro wasteha kowa lauter, hoi koi hi. Un me dikau kamles ap koleste, kai hi tele rikedo un phagedo an peskro dji, un kai darell glan miro lab.

Kowa, kai mange i gurum marell, marell ninna i menshes i chocheno debleske. Kowa, kai mange i terno bakro temerl dell, marell ninna i djukles i chocheno debleske. Kowa, kai mange chapen glan anell, anell ninna balengro rat i chocheno debleske. Kowa, kai mange sungepaskro koowa chatchrell, parkrell pes ninna pash i chocheno debleste. Jon djan pengre dromma jaake har jon les kamenna. Un shukar hi an lengre jaka, hoi an mire jaka djungeles hi.

Doleske hi mange shukar, te anap len an i bibacht. Un anau kowa pral lende, glan leste jon jaake darenna. Me dom ap lende gole, un kek shunas un kek rakras pale. Me dom len trad, un kek das pre jak. Awa, jon kran kowa, hoi an mire jaka tchilatcho hi, un lenge his shukar, te krenn le kowa, hoi an mire jaka djungelo hi.

Shunenn, hoi o baro Dewel penell, tumer, kai glan leskro lab darenna. Tumer rikrenn pash mande, doleske choirenn pen tumare phrala pral tumende, un tchiwenn tumen pale, un praassenn tumen un penenn: Mu sikrell o baro Dewel peskro barepen un peskri soor, te dikas mer, har job tumen bachteles krell! Kolla hunte ladjenn pen palle.
Shunenn i diwji gole dran o foro, i kurepaskri gole dran o Debleskro kheer! Shunenn, o baro Dewel rakrell i phagi win pral kolende, kai choiran les!
Miro foro hi har i djuwel, kai las i ternepen kek bare dukentsa.
Koon shunas sau koowa? Koon dikas sau koowa? Was i them ap jek diwes boldo? Wan lengre menshe ap jek diwes ap i phub? Jaake sik har i Zion duka las, anas li peskre tchawen ap i phub.
Me mukau gar jaake dur te well, te kamell o ternepen win te well, un palle mukau les gar, penell o baro Dewel.
Awenn bachteles o foreha Jerusalem, un giwenn un khelenn leske, tumer lauter, kai les o djijestar kamenn. Awenn bachteles leha, tumer lauter, kai pral leste rowan.
Kanna nai wenn tumer tchalo leskro brawlepastar, jaake har pijell pes i ternepen tchalo pash peskri date, un pijell bachteles jaake bud thud har nai pijell lo.

Kawa penell o baro Dewel ap o foro Jerusalem: Dik, me mukau bud latchepen pral tute te well har i lengsto pani. Un o brawlepen dran wawar themma nashell an tute har i diwjo pani. Me dau garda ap tute har i dai ap peskro ternepen, hoi hidjrell li ap i wasta, un tchiwell les ap peskre herja un khelell leha.
Awa, jaake har i dai peskro tchaweske i swa tele khossell, jaake krau me les tumentsa, un khossau tumare swa tele an o foro Jerusalem.

Tumer dikenn kowa, un tumare djia giwenna. Un tumer lenn newi soor, jaake har o senlepen, te dell brishin. Un i menshe dikenn, te hi o baro Debleskri soor pash peskre budepangre, un leskri choli ap kolende, kai shunenn gar ap leste.
Dik, o baro Dewel well an i jag, un leskre wurdja hi har i sorelo phurdepen. Job dell len lengro tchilatchepen pale i bari choljah, un leskro tchingepen hi har jag, kai chatchrell.
I jagah un peskro chareha krell o baro Dewel o tchatchepen win pral i tsele menshende, un bud lendar wenn jaake maredo.

Kolla hi sawe, kai krenn pen djudjo, te mangenn le i chocheno debles an, hoi hi tardo mashkral ap i shukar platsa. Kolla hi ninna sawe, kai chan ko mass i balendar un i kermuse un wawar pale-tchidde viechendar. Kolla lauter wenn khetne trujel, penell o baro Dewel.
Me djinau kowa, hoi jon kran, un kowa, hoi an lengre sherja glan djas. Un me wau, te lap i menshen khetne dran i tsele themma un dran hako rakepen. Un jon wenna un dikenn miro railepen.

Un me tchiwau i sikepen pre mank lende. Un kolendar, kai djides atchan, bitchrau me pash i menshende an themma Tarsis, Put un Lud, Meshech, Rosh, Tubal, Jawan un pash kolende dur wergel o baro pani, kai mandar gomme tchi shunan, un miro railepen gomme gar dikan. Un mire bitchepangre penenn kol menshenge, har railo me hom.

Un kolla anenn tumare phralen dran i tsele themma pale, te denn le len o baro Debleske. Ap miri berga an Jerusalem anenn le len ap graja, un ap wurdja, hoi pre hi, un an wurdja, hoi pandlo hi, ap maultikre burike un ninna ap khamele, penell o baro Dewel. Jon anenn len jaake har i Israelitarja anan djob an djudje tchare an o baro Debleskro kheer.
Un ninna kolendar lau mange, te wenn le mange rashaja un Levitarja, penell o baro Dewel.
Tumare tchawe un tumaro lab atchenn glan mande, jaake rah har o newo bolepen un i newi phub, hoi me krau, glan mande atchenna, penell o baro Dewel.
Un hako tchon, ap ko diwes, kai well o newo tchon diklo, un hako kurko ap o Debleskro diwes, wenna menshe dran hake themma glan mande, te witsrenn le pen glan mande tele, penell o baro Dewel.
Un jon djan win, te dikenn le penge kol mule menshen an, kai mantsa phagan. Kolengro kirmo merell gar, un lengri jag djal gar win. Un jon hi tchadepaske halauterenge, kai dikenn le.
Kalla hi kol laba, hoi o Jeremia rakras. Leskro dad his o Hilkija. Kowa his jek kol rashajendar an o gab Anatot an o them Benjamin.
O baro Dewel rakras ap o Jeremia, har o Josia, koleskro dad o Amon his, an o 13 (deesh-te-triinto) bersh o baro rai pral o them Juda his.

An ko tsiro pal kowa, har koleskro tchawo, o Jojakim, o baro rai his, rakras o baro Dewel pale ap o Jeremia bis ko tsiro was, kai i menshe dran Juda pandles an i wawar them anlo wan. Kowa his an o pantchto tchon an ko deesh-te-jekto bersh, har o Zedekja, koleskro dad o Josia his, o baro rai pral Juda his.
Un o baro Dewel penas ap mande:
Me prindjrom tut, glan te krom tut an tiri dakro per, un rodom tut win, glan te wal boldo, te wess miro rakepaskro i menshenge dran i tsele themma.
Un me penom: Baro Dewel, miro rai, me hom gar mishto doha te penap tiro lab. Me hom gar phuro doha.
O baro Dewel penas ap mande: Pen gar: Me hom gar phuro doha! Tu hunte djas, kai me tut bitchrau. Un pen halauter, hoi me tuke penau.
Ma traash lendar. Me hom pash tute, un rikrau mire wasta pral tute. Ko penau me, o baro Dewel.
Un o baro Dewel tchiwas peskro wast ap miro mui, un penas ap mande: Dik, me tchiwau mire laba an tiro mui.
Dik kai! Me dau tut kai diwes penepaske pral bud menshende un themma, te tradess len win, phagess len khetne, dess len tele un kress len paash, un mukess len pale bares te well, un kress len soreles.
Un o baro Dewel penas ap mande: “Jeremia, hoi dikeh tu?” “Dikau i kasht i mandeltikro rukestar,” penom me.
Un o baro Dewel penas ap mande: “Tu dikal mishto. Me dau garda ap miro lab, te krap kowa.”
Un o baro Dewel penas o duito kopo ap mande: “Hoi dikeh tu?” Penom: “Me dikau i piri pherdo pani, hoi kerell pral kotar, kai norden hi.”
Un o baro Dewel penas ap mande: Kotar, kai norden hi, well i bibacht pral halauterende, kai djiwenn an kau them.

Shun mishto: Me dau gole i tsele menshen an kol themma, hoi an o norden tchiddo hi, te wenn jon, penell o baro Dewel. Lengre raja tchiwenn pengre beshepangre glan kol wudja o forestar Jerusalem, un trul leskre massurja un trul kol tsele forja an o them Juda.
Un me dau i menshen an Juda i phagi lengro tchilatchepaske, hoi jon kran. Jon djan krik mandar un anan viechen wawar deblenge un mangan kol figuren an, hoi le pengre wastentsa kran.
Ab soreles! Un kre tut ap o drom! Un pen lenge halauter, hoi me tuke penau! Ma traash lendar, te krap me gar, te trashess tu glan lende!

Kau diwes dau me tut i soor, te wess jaake sorelo har i sorelo foro, i sasterno ruk, un i massuri dran lolo saster. Hakeno an kau them well chojedo ap tute: i bare raja un pralstune pral o them Juda, ninna i rashaja un i menshe an kau them.
Ninna te tchingrenn le tuha, nai krenn le tuke tchi. Me hom pash tute, te lap tut dran lengre wasta win. Kowa penau me, o baro Dewel.
O baro Dewel penas ap mande:

Dja koi, un rake glan i tsele menshende an o foro Jerusalem, un pen: Kowa penell o baro Dewel: Israel, me djinau, har ap mande rikral har terno hals, un har kamal man har i pirni peskro pirnes, un har tu mantsa djal an o mulo tato them, an ko them, kai tchi bares well an i phub.
An ko tsiro hals mange kokres koi, jaake har o newo djob mange hi. Koon tut an-tapras, anas doosh ap peste, un i bibacht was pral leste. Kowa penell o baro Dewel.
Shunenn o baro Debleskro lab, tumer Israelitarja, tumer, o Jakobeskre menshe!
Kowa penell o baro Dewel: Hawo djungelo koowa hatsan tumare phure ap mande, kai djan jon mandar krik, un mangan figuren an, kai kek dewel hi. Un jaake djan le tele.

Un putchan pen gar: Kai hi o baro Dewel, kai anas men dran o them Egiptia win, un djas glan mende an o mulo tato them, an ko diwjo un truk them, kai tchi har santa un barra hi, kai kek drom hi, un kek mensho djiwell?

Un me anom tumen an i latcho them, kai bud chapen hi, te chan ko tselo latcho koowa, hoi kote baro wella. Un har tumer an ko them djan, kran les tumer pale-tchiddo. Un miro them was djungeles glan mire jaka.

Tumare rashaja putchan gar: ‘Kai hi o baro Dewel?’ Har penan le i menshenge, hoi te krenn le, rikran le pen gar ap mire laba. Un kol pralstune pral mire menshende hadan pen pral mande, un shunan buder gar ap mande. Un mire rakepangre, kai hunte penans mire laba dureder, rakran an o lab ko chocheno deblestar Baal, un mangan figuren an, kai kek dewel hi.
Doleske hunte anap tumari doosh ap tumende, un ap tumare tchawende un kolengre tchawende.

Djan pral o baro pani pash i panjeskre themma, kai kol Kitarja djiwenn, un dikenn tumen trujel! Bitchrenn murshen an o them Kedar un lenn i menshen kote ninna an o jak! Krenn jon sawo koowa har tumer kran?
Ninna te hi lengre debla kek tchatche debla, lenn jon kek wawar deblen an! Mire menshe, kai miro railepen dikan, jon paran man dren jekeha, kai kek dewel hi, un koles kek soor hi.
Dare tu, bolepen, un tut well traash pral kau koowa, penell o baro Dewel.
Mire menshe kran tchomone, hoi dui kope tchilatcho hi: Man, ko djido pani mukan jon, un hadan penge panjeskre chebja win, kai paash hi, un nai rikrenn kek pani.
Hi o Israel i ginlo budepaskro? Hi lo i budepaskro, kai pandles boldo was, kai nai hakeno krell leha, hoi kamella?
O lewo dell gole pral leste, dell sorelo gole un krell leskro them paash. Un leskre forja wenn pre chatchedo jaake, kai nai djiwenn kek koi dren.
Ninna tchinenn kol menshe dran Memfis un Tachpanes tuke i tsele balla tiro sherestar tele.
Kowa lauter hi tiri doosh! Bud kope kamas o baro Dewel, tiro rai, tut ap o tchatcho drom te anell. Un tu mukal les!
Hoi hi tut kolestar, te djah an o them Egiptia, un kameh koi dran o pani Nil te pijell? Un hoi hi tut kolestar, te djah tu an o them Assur un kameh dran o pani Eufrat te pijell?

Dran tiro tchilatchepen well kowa ap tute. Tu shunal gar. Doleske leh tu sawi phagi. Tu hunte djiness un haiwess, hawo pharo koowa un duka ap koleste wenna, kai djal peskro baro Deblestar krik, un kamell lestar buder tchi te djinell. Kowa penell o baro Dewel, ko rai pral o bolepen un i phub.
O baro Dewel penell: Hako tsiro hadal tut pral mande, un kamal mange gar palla te djal. Tu penal: Me kamau kek rai pral mande. Un tchiwal tut koi har i lubni ap i berga tel hako senelo ruk.
Me tchiwom tut dren har i wi-rodedo drakengro ruk, i latcho shukar ruk. Un hoi was kanna dran tute? I diwjo djungelo ruk!
Tu nai thoweh tut jaake bud har kameh, un leh ko sorlester sapuni! Ko tchilatchepen, koleha tut pale-tchiddo kral, atchell glan mire jaka, penell o baro Dewel, maro rai.

Har nai peneh tu: Me krom man gar pale-tchiddo? Me nashom gar kol deblenge palla, hoi kharenn Baal. Dik ap tute, hoi tu kreh an i tala! Ma biste, har djiwal! Har i khamela, kai hi bipandlo, nasheh tu trujel,

har i diwji burika an o mulo them, te dell joi gole un nashell trujel an lakro bipandlo tsiro, un kek nai rikrella pre. Koon lat kamell, hunte rodell gar dur. Joi mukell pes sik te hatsell an ko tsiro.
Israel, de garda ap tire herja, te nashess len gar dukenes, un ap tiro mui, te well lo gar truk! Tu peneh: Rike man gar pre! Me kamau kol menshen dran wawar themma, un hunte nashap lenge palla.
Har i tchorepaskro hunte ladjell peske, te well job tapedo, jaake hunte ladjenn penge kol menshe an o them Israel, ninna kol bare raja, un pralstune un rashaja un Debleskre rakepangre,

kolla, kai ap i debla penenna: “Tu hal miro dad!” un ap i barrengre debla: “Tu anal man ap i phub.” Mange sikran le pengro dumo un gar pengro mui. Te well kanna i bibacht pral lende, denn le gole: “Rai! Ab ap mari rig!”
Kai hi tumare debla, kai tumenge kran? Mu stenn jon pre, un lenn tumen win dran tumari bibacht! Tumer menshe an o them Juda, tumen hi jaake bud debla har forja!
Tumer kamenn man i doosh te dell. Tumer han kolla, kai peran lauter mandar tele, penell o baro Dewel.
Koi tseli phagi, hoi dom tumen, his tchitcheske. Tumer mukan tumen gar te tserdell. Mire rakepangren, kai pash tumende bitchrom, maran tumer. Tumaro charo chas len har i chojedo lewo.

O baro Dewel penell: Tumer tchilatche menshe! Denn garda ap kowa, hoi me tumenge penau! Hom me i Israelenge i mulo them, i them, kai kek pani hi? Hoske penenn mire menshe: ‘Mer nai djah, kai kamah, un hunte nashas tuke gar buder gar pal.’
Nai bistrell i terni tchai peskro sonakai, i terni djuwel, kai kamell romedinerell, peskro bijabeskro ripen? Na-a! Mire menshe bistrenn man pale te pale.
Har sik hatseh tu i drom, te less tuke i wawar pirnes! Un jaake djas tu pale te pale ap tchilatche dromma.
Ninna hatsan le ap tire koola o rat i tchorwelendar, kai kran kek tchilatchepen, un kai tu gar koi pashel tapral, kai phagan le an tiro kheer dren. Ninna te kral tu kowa lauter,
peneh tu: ‘Me krom tchi. O baro Dewel hi buder gar chojedo ap mande.’ Djiness, me dau tut i phagi koleske, kai tu penal: ‘Me krom kek tchilatchepen.’
Har sik djal tu kai te koi, te rodess tuke menshen, kai krenn pen tuha khetne? O them Egiptia nai well tut gar feteder ap i rig har o them Assur.
O tsiro wella, kai djah tu kotar krik, un deh tire wasta pral o shero khetne i ladjatar; o baro Dewel kamell tchi lendar te djinell, ap konende tiro dji tchiwal, un lentsa hi tut kek bacht.

O baro Dewel penas: Te bitchras i mursh peskri romjat krik, un joi djal pash i wawar mursheste, nai lell job lat gar pale. Palle wals ko them pale-tchiddo. Tu dal tut trujel budentsa, un kameh pale pash mande te well?
Ap hawi berga hals tu gomme gar i mursheha tchiddo? Ap o drom hal tu beshdo, un lureh ap lende, har i Arabari an o mulo tato them. Un tu kreh ko them pale-tchiddo tiro wi-ladjedo un djungelo koweha.
Doleske dell kek brishin an o wend, witar gar an o nijal. Tu dikeh win har i lubni un kameh tut gar te ladjell.
Un kanna peneh ap mande: ‘Kamlo dad, tu hal miro maal jaake rah har djiwau.
Kameh tu hako tsiro chojedo atchell un tchilatches ap mande te dikell?’ Jaake rakreh un kreh tchilatchepen, un mukeh tuke tchi te penell.

An ko tsiro, kai o Josia o baro rai his, penas o baro Dewel ap mande: Dikal tu, hoi i Israelitarja kran? Jon hi har i djuwel, kai mukas peskro romes, un djas ap kol tsele berge un tel hake senele ruka un das pes trujel wawar murshentsa.
Un me patsom, har joi kowa lauter kras, well joi pash mande pale. Kowa kras joi gar. Lakri pheen, i Juda, kai man ninna chochras, dikas,

har me lakri phenjat, i Israel, krik bitchrom koleske, kai das li pes wawar murshentsa trujel, un dom lat i liil, kai tchinlo hi, te bitchrom lat krik. Kowa kras i chocheni Judake kek daar. Joi djas koi un das pes ninna trujel wawar murshentsa.
Un lakro wi-ladjedo koweha kras joi o them pale-tchiddo. Kasht un barra mangell li an.
Un an ko tselo koowa was i Juda, lakri pheen, gar pash mande o tselo djijestar, kokres o mujeha, penas o baro Dewel.
Un o baro Dewel penas ap mande: I Israel, kai djas mandar krik, hi feteder har i chocheni Juda.

Dja koi un de kol laba gole ap kolende, kai djiwenn an o norden un pen: “Tu Israel, kai djal mandar krik, am pale”, penas o baro Dewel. Palle kamau buder gar chojedo ap tumende te dikell. Man hi i dji tumenge, un kamau gar hako tsiro chojedo te well ap tumende.

Tu hunte kress tchi, har te dikess dren, kai anal doosh ap tute, har hadal tut pre pral o baro Debleste, kai tiro Dewel hi. Tu nashal kai te koi trujel, te mangess wawar deblen an tel hake senele ruka, un shunal gar ap mire laba, penell o baro Dewel.
Awenn pale, tumer tchawe, kai nashan mandar krik, penell o baro Dewel. Me hom tumaro rai. Me kamau tumendar te lell jekes dran hako foro un dui dran haki familja, un kamau tumen an Zion te anell.
Me kamau tumen sawe pralstunen te dell, kai denn garda ap tumende, har me kowa krau. Kolla sikrenn tumen tumaro drom goswepah, un haiwenn, hoi tumenge mishto hi.

Un an ko tsiro, kai wan tumer bud menshe, un djiwenn an o tselo them, koi penell buder kek tumendar: ‘Anenn o Debleskro mochton, te well o baro Dewel pash mende.’ Kekeske well kowa an o shero, kek putchell koi pal, un tumenge hi jek, kai hi lo krik. Un kek krell i newo. Ko penell o baro Dewel.
An ko tsiro well o foro Jerusalem kharedo: O baro Debleskri beshepaskri. Un i tsele menshe wenn koi khetne. Un jon djan buder gar pal pengro shero un pengro tchilatcho dji.
Ap ko diwes djan kol menshe dran o kheer Juda pash kol menshende dran o kheer Israel: Un jon djan khetne khere dran o norden an ko them, hoi dom me tumare phurende, te atchell kowa lengro.

Me, o baro Dewel penom, har nai rikrau me tut, har te wess tu miro tchawo? Kamoms te dap tut ko latcho them, ko shukester kotar them i tsele themendar. Un patsom, tu peness palle ap mande ‘kamlo tata’, un djals buder gar mandar krik.
Tchatchepah, har i romni, kai chochras peskro romes i wawar mursheha, jaake chochras man o kheer Israel. Me, o baro Dewel, penau kowa.
I gole un i ropen well shunlo ap o pralstuno them: Kolla hi i Israelitarja, kai djiwan i tchilatcho djipen, un bistran lengro baro Debles.
Awenn pale pale, tumer kai djan tumenge mandar! Un me kamau lauter bistrell, hoi kran. Dik, mer wah pash tute. Tu hal o baro Dewel, maro rai.
Tchatchepah, har dam gole pal kol deblende ap kol berge, wan le gar ap mari rig. Kokres tu, maro baro Dewel, nai leh men tchatchepah win dran mari bibacht.
Har mangam ko djungelo debles Baal an, nashram lauter, hoi mare phure penge khetne lan, har terne hams: bakre, grumja, tchawe un tcha.

Mer hunte ladjams men, un mari ladj hunte tchakrals men har i plachta! Maro tselo djipen djiwam jaake, har o baro Dewel, maro rai, gar kamas. Mer un mare phure djiwam jaake, un shunam gar ap kowa, hoi job menge penas, te kras mer.

O baro Dewel penell: Tumer Israelitarja, te kamenn tumaro tchilatcho drom te mukell, palle awenn pash mande! Te lenn tumer kol djungele deblen glan mire jaka krik, hunte nashenn buder gar jek rigjatar ap i wawar.

Te denn tumen sowel un penenn: Me dau man sowel pash o djido Debleste … un tumer chochenn gar koi pashel, un rikrenn tumaro lab, palle putchenn mandar i menshe an i wawar themma, te tchiwap miri bacht ap lende, un jon sharenn pen, kai prindjrenn jon man.
Kowa hi, hoi penell o baro Dewel i menshenge an Juda un an Jerusalem: Lenn i newo kotar phub un phagenn i phub pre! Ma witsrenn o djob mank i subjengro senlepen!

Rikrenn tumen ap i laba, hoi tumentsa win krom! Un krenn tumare djia mange pre, tumer menshe an Juda un Jerusalem. Te krenn kowa gar, well miri choli pral tumende har jag, un chatchella jaake, te nai krell kek koi jag win.
Denn soreles gole an Juda, kharenn win an Jerusalem, un penenn: Phurdenn koi phurdepaskri an o tselo them! Denn win gole, te wenn le an i sorele forja khetne!
Tchiwenn i sikepen pre ap o drom, hoi sikrell o drom an Zion! Nashenn un atchenn gar tardo, me anau bari bibacht un baro ropen, hoi well kotar, kai norden hi.

I marepaskro, hoi marell i menshen an bud themma, stas pre. Har i lewo, hoi well dran o weesh, kras lo pes ap o drom, te dell job tumaro them paash un chatchrell tumare forja jaake, kai nai djiwell kek koi dren.
Doleske riwenn tumen an i gono! Rowenn un denn gole! O baro Dewel las peskri bari choli gar mendar krik.
O baro Dewel penell: Ko diwes wella, kai trashenn o baro rai un i pralstune pral Israel. O Debleskre rakepangre un leskre rashaja djinenn gar buder, hoi te penenn le.
Koi penom me: Baro Dewel, miro rai, tu chochral kol menshen an Jerusalem an, har tu penal, kai kek kurepen mashkral lende well. O charo hi koi un kamell len mulo te dell.
An ko tsiro well kol menshenge an Jerusalem penlo: I sorelo tatepen well dran kol berge dran o mulo tato them pash tumende. Kowa hi kek phurdepen, hoi phurdell o phuss un o tchik krik,
na-a, ko phurdepen, hoi lenge bitchrau, hi bud sorleder. Palle dau len lengri phagi.
Dik, har wolke well ko marepaskro. Leskre kurepangre wurdja hi sik har i phurdepen, un leskre graja hi sikeder har i adlari. Hawi bibacht! Mer ham nashedo!
Jerusalem, te kameh win lino te well, palle thob tiro tchilatchepen tiro djijestar tele! Har rah kameh tu ko tchilatchepen an tiro shero te rikrell?
Shunenn, bitchepangre wenna dran o foro Dan un dran i berge Efrajim, un rakrenn pral ko tchilatcho koowa, hoi wella.
Denn i menshen trad! Penenn kolenge an o foro Jerusalem: kurepangre wenna dran dur themma, un denn pengro kurepaskri gole win, te lenn le i forja an o them Juda dren.
Jon tchiwenn pen trujel o foro Jerusalem, har kol mursha, kai denn garda ap i kotar phub. Tumer menshe an Jerusalem mukan tumenge tchi mandar te penell. Kowa penell o baro Dewel.
Hoi tumer kran un har djiwan, anas tumenge kowa dren. Kowa well dran tumaro tchilatchepen, te djal tumenge jaake djungelo, un djal tumenge an tumaro dji.
Har dukell man kowa, hawi daar hi an mande! Miro dji djal soreles an miro betch, me nai atchau gar pokones; me shunau koi phurdepaskri, un ko kurepaskri gole.
Jek foro pal i wawar well dino. O tselo them denn le paash. Ap jek kopo hi mire un plachtene khera khetne dino.
Har rah hunte dikap me kol kurepangro sikepen, un shunap koi phurdepangri gole?

O baro Dewel penell: Mire menshe hi diwjo, un patsenn man gar. Dinelo hi le, man prindjrenn le gar. Har dinele tchawe hi le, kai tchi haiwenn. Gosewo doha hi le, te krenn le tchilatchepen. Har jon latchepen krenna, djinenn le gar.
Me dikom ap kai phub. Koja his mulo. Kek djipen his koi. Me dikom an o bolepen. Kowa his tamlo.
Me dikom ap kol bare un tikne berge. Kolla trissan.
Me dikom pal i menshende. Un kek his buder koi. Ninna kol tchirkle djan penge krik.
Me dikom pal ko latcho them. Kowa was i mulo them. Un i tsele forja his paash tchiddo glan o baro Debleste un leskri soreli choli.
O baro Dewel penas: Ninna te well kai tseli phub har i mulo them, kamau gar lauter paash te krell.
I phub rowella, un o bolepen riwell pes an kalepen. Me, o baro Dewel penom, hoi kamau te krell, un kowa khaitell man gar, un mukau gar kolestar tele.

Dran kol tsele forja nashenn le penge glan koi gole kol lurdendar, kai klissenn ap i graja, un kolendar, kai denn karje, un nashenn an pesse wesha un khatrenn pen mashkral i barra. Hako foro well muklo tchiddo. Kek djiwell buder koi dren.

Jerusalem, tu hal dino! Hoi kreh tu? Tu riweh kutch lole koola ap tute, tchiweh sonakai ap tute, un makeh tire jaka an. Tu kreh tut shukar tchitcheske! Tire pirne kamenn tut gar buder, un kamenn tut mulo te dell.

Me shunau i gole, har i djuwjatar, kai lell o ersto kopo i ternepen. Kaja hi koi gole o forestar Zion, kai taprell pal ducho, un peskre wasta pre hadell, un gole dell: Me hom nashedo! Kolla wenna un denn man mulo!

Djan kol dromma an Jerusalem pral un tele! Krenn tumare jaka pre un rodenn ap kol dromma o forestar! Te hatsenn jekes, kai djiwell an o tchatchepen, un rikrell pes ap o Debleste, palle bistrau i doosh o tselo forestar.
Ninna te denn jon pen sowel pash o djido Debleste, hi kowa chochepen.

Baro Dewel, tire jaka dikenn ap i djipen an o tchatchepen. Tu dal len i phagi. – Jon haiwenn kowa gar. Tu kral len paash mulo. – Un jon atchan, har jon hi. Jon djan pal pengro shero. un kamenn gar pengro tchilatcho drom te mukell.
Me penom mange: Kolla hi tchorwele menshe, kai tchi djinenna, un prindjrenn gar o Debleskro drom un leskro tchatchepen.

Me kamau pash i pralstunende te djal, te rakrap lentsa. Kolla djinenn o Debleskro drom un nai penenn mange, hoi an i jaka lengro Deblestar mishto hi. Palle haiwom: Ninna kolla kaman gar, te well job lengro rai, un kaman gar ap leste te shunell.

Doleske wenna lewe dran o weesh un marenn len; diwje djukle dran o diwjo un truk them dandrenn len an kotja, un bare diwje margodje lurenn glan lengre forja. Hakeno, koon win wella, wella an kotja dandedo. Lengri doosh hi bud un phari. Bud kope djan le mandar krik.
Hoske bistrap i doosh mire menshendar? Jon djan mandar krik, un denn pen sowel pash koleste, kai kek dewel hi. Har me len tchalo krom, phagan le mantsa, un djan an i lubjengro kheer.
Hakenes hi chantch ap kol wawareskri romjate har i grai, kai diwjo hi pal haki djuwjate.
Un me hunte dap len kek phagi? penell o baro Dewel, un dap hawe menshen har kalla gar pale, hoi jon kran?
Nashenn pre, kai lengre drakengre ruka tardo hi, un krenn len paash! Ma tserdenn i tsele burra win! Mukenn tchomone tardo! Tserdenn i kashta i drakentsa win, kolla hi gar mange.
Jon sikran mange o dumo, penell o baro Dewel, kol menshe an Israel un kol menshe an Juda.
Jon penan chochepen pral o baro Debleste, un penan: ‘Kowa krell job gar! Jaake djungelo djal menge gar! Kurepen un bok well gar pash mende.
O Debleskre rakepangre rakrenn, hoi tchi moldo hi. Hoi jon penan, well gar o Deblestar. Mu perell ap lende, hoi le penan.’

Doleske penell o baro Dewel, ko rai pral o bolepen un i phub: Sawo koowa rakrenn tumer! Doleske kamau me mire laba an tiro mui, Jeremia, har jag te krell, un i menshen har kasht chatchepaske, un koi jag chal kol kashta pre.
Pen kol menshenge an Israel: Me anau menshen fun dural pash tumende, penell o baro Dewel, menshe, kolengro rakepen, un hoi jon penenna, haiwenn tumer gar. I phuri natsjona hi le. Un len hi bari soor.
Lengre faile anenn o merepen. Jon hi halauter tchatche mursha, kai haiwenn pen te kurell.

Jon chan tiro djob un tiro maro, tire tchawen, tire tchen, tire bakren un grumjen, tire drake, tire faigetikre ruka. Tumer patsenn, te djal tumenge tchi an tumare sorele forja. Kolen lenn jon tumendar o chareha krik.
Me, o baro Dewel, kamau mire menshen gar lauteren te marell an ko tsiro.

Un te putchenn jon: Hoske krell maro baro Dewel kowa menge lauter?, hunte peness tu lenge: Jaake har tumer mandar krik djan, un wan wawar deblenge koi an tumaro them, jaake hunte budrenn tumer wawar menshenge an i them, kai gar tumaro hi.
O baro Dewel penas ap mande: Pen ap kol menshende dran o kheer Jakob, un ap kol menshende an o them Juda:
Shunenn kai, tumer menshe, kai tumen tchi an o shero hi, kai len jaka hi, un dikenn tchi, kai len kanda hi un shunenn tchi!

Hi tumen kek traash mandar, putchell o baro Dewel. Trissenn tumer gar glan mande? Me krom, te atchell o baro pani ap jek platsa, un tchiwom santa koi glan. Koi hunte atchell o pani hako tsiro, un dureder nai nashell lo gar. Ninna te well ko pani jaake diwjo, un djal pral un tele, nai djal lo gar dureder.
Kal menshe djan pal lengro shero, un kamenn gar te shunell. Jon djan mandar krik un djan pengro drom.

An pengro dji penenn le gar: Mer te dikas pre ap maro baro Debleste! Job bitchrell menge o brishin an o tchatcho tsiro, brishin an o wend un brishin an i nijal, te well men o djob chapaske an ko tchatcho tsiro.
Tumari doosh, hoi ap tumende anan, un ko tchilatchepen, hoi krenna, rikras ko latchepen tumendar pale, jaake te wan phare tsirja ap tumende.
O baro Dewel penella: Mashkral mire menshende hi tchilatche menshe, kai lurenn ap wawarende, te taprenn le len, har kolla, kai tapenn i tchirklen dren,
un kolen tchirklengre khera pherde tchirkle hi. Jaake hi lengre khera pherdo tchoredo koowa. Doleske wan jon baro un brawelo.

Thullo un pesso hi le, un mukenn gar tele te krenn le tchilatchepen. O tchatchepen lenn le gar an o wast, te lenn kolendar pengro tchatchepen, kai tchorwelo hi, ninna kol tchawendar, kai len kek dad buder hi.
Mukap me len kowa te krell un penap tchi koi pre, penell o baro Dewel. Dap me sawe menshen kek phagi?
An kau them djal bud tchilatchepen un djungelo koowa.
O Debleskre rakepangre rakrenn chochepen, un kol rashaja rodenn penge ko feteder win, un mire menshe kamenn kowa jaake. Hoi kamenn tumer te krell, te hi tumaro tsiro trujel?

Tumer menshe dran o kheer Benjamin, nashenn dran Jerusalem! un phurdenn koi phurdepaskri an Tekoa! Krenn i jag ap i berga Bet-Kerem, te well o jagakro ducho i sikepen! Bari bibacht un merepen well kotar, kai norden hi.
Tu, shukar foro Jerusalem, ko tsiro hi koi, kai weh paash dino.
Bare raja pengre lurdentsa wenna pral tute har bakrengre pengre bakrentsa. Kolla tchiwenn pengre plachtene khera trul tute pre. Hakenes hi i platsa peskre lurdenge.
Jon penenna: Stas pre, te kuras men o foreha! Te djas pre jaake rah har mashkral o diwes hi! – Na-a, i rati kamell te well, un sik well tamlo.
Palle djas ap i rati, un kras lengre raile khera paash.

Kawa penell o baro Dewel, o rai pral o bolepen un i phub: Denn i ruka tele an o foro Jerusalem, un krenn i drom, hoi djal pre ap o foreskri massuri o forestar Jerusalem! An kau foro hi tchi har tchilatchepen dren. Doleske lell lo peskri phagi.
Jaake har dran i brunna o pani wella, jaake well dran o foro o tchilatchepen. I gole kolendar, kai wenn sorjah tele rikedo un dukedo, shunau. Menshe lenn glan mande dawa un wenn maredo.
Jerusalem, muk tut trad te dell! Te shuneh tu gar, krau me miro dji tuke pandlo. Un dran tute krau i nango them, kai kek nai djiwell buder.

O baro Dewel, ko rai pral o bolepen un i phub, penas ap mande: Jaake har i hacho dui, triin kope peskre drake tele tchinell, te lell lo ninna kolla tele, hoi pral atchan, jaake djas tu pale pash kolende, kai an Israel pral atchan, te aness len pash mande.
Koneha rakrap me? Koneske penap tutar? Koon shunella koi pre? Lengre kanda hi pandlo. Jon nai shunenn gar, hoi tu lenge kameh te penell, un san pral tire laba, un choirenn pen pral lende.

Tiri choli pral lende chatchell ninna an mande. Me nai rikrau lat gar pale. Koi penas o baro Dewel ap mande: Palle tchore miri choli pral lende win: pral kol tchawende ap o drom, un pral kol terne murshende. Jon lauter, mursha un djuwja, ninna kol phure un an-dikle, wenn pandles krik anlo.
Lengre khera lenn kol wawar, ninna lengre themma un lengre djuwjen. Me hadau miro wast, te marap kolen, kai djiwenn an kau them, penell o baro Dewel.
Kol baren un kol tiknen hi bok ap brawlepen, hoi gar lengro hi. Un o Debleskre rakepangre un i rashaja chochenn i menshen,
un krenn jaake, har te wans kol duka mire menshendar gar jaake pharo. Jon penenna: ‘Lauter hi mishto’, lauter hi mishto, ninna te hi tchi mishto.

Jon hunte ladjans pen ko djungelo koweha, hoi jon kran. Kowa krenn le gar. Jon ladjenn gar. Jon djinenn gar, hoi ladj hi. Doleske wenn jon maredo khetne kol wawarentsa. Te wau me, un dau len i phagi, atchell kek lendar djido, penell o baro Dewel.

O baro Dewel penas lenge: Atchenn tardo ap ko drom, kai tumer djan! Dikenn un putchenn pal i phure dromma! Hatsenn win, hawo drom anell tumenge latchepen! Un djan kau drom! Palle well shukapen an tumare djia. Jon penan: Kowa kamah mer gar te krell.
Ninna dom tumen menshen, kai denn jak ap tumende. Denn garda koi pre, te phurdenn le i phurdepaskri, hoi sikrella: Bibacht wella … Jon penan: Mer kamah len gar te shunell.
Doleske shunenn, tumer menshe an i tsele themma: Denn garda, hoi kal menshentsa krau!
I menshe ap i tseli phub hunte shunenn kowa. Me kamau bibacht pral kal menshende te anell. Ap mire laba denn le kek garda, un djan gar ap miro drom. Doleske lenn le pengri phagi.

Me putchau tchi pal o sungepaskro koowa dran o them Saba, un pal ko gudlo sungepaskro djet, hoi well dran i dur them. Kol vieche, hoi tumer mange chatchrenna, kamau me gar. Un ap kol vieche, hoi tumer mange marenna, dikau gar latches.
Doleske penell o baro Dewel: Me kamau kal menshenge bud barra an o drom te tchiwell, te perenn i mursha un lengre tchawe koi pral. Un ninna kolla, kai djiwenn pash lende, un lengre mala wenn maredo.
Kowa penell o baro Dewel: Denn garda: Bud menshe wenna dran lengro them, hoi kote tchiddo hi, kai norden hi. Awa, bud menshe krenn pen ap o drom an ko dur them, te djan le an o kurepen.

Lengre lurde kurenn pen i bogentsa un i charentsa. Jon hi midjak un len khaitell kek. Ap graja klissenn le i goljah, hoi jaake baro hi har i gole, hoi o baro pani krell. Jon wenna, te kurenn le pen tuha, tu foro Zion!
Mer shunam lendar, un mare mussja peran menge tele. Un i bari traash was ap mende. Men hi bare duka har i djuwel, kai i ternepen lella.
Ma djan ap tumaro kotar them, kharell jek ap o wawareste! Ma nashenn ap i drom! I lurde wenna haki rigjatar un marenn hakenes pengre charentsa.

Tumer, mire menshe, tumenge penau: Riwenn gone ap tumende! Tchiwenn tumen an i jagakri tchik! Rowenn har te merals tumaro tchawo, un tumen kek wawar hi! Giwenn i ropaskri gili! Kol marepangre perenn ap jek kopo pral mende.
O baro Dewel penas ap mande: Me kamau, te djas tu pash mire menshende, un dikess, hoi jon krenna, un har jon djiwenna.
Jon djan lauter penge krik mandar, un rakrenn djungeles jek pral o wawareste. Djia dran saster hi len. Jon lauter djiwenn an o chochepen.

Mire menshe hi har tchiklo rup. O bob chatchas soreles, kai o rup djudjo kerdo hunte wals. Ko tchik was gar win. Djudjo rup atchas gar pral. Lauter his tchitcheske. Mire menshe hi jaake tchilatcho, te well nai o tchilatchepen gar dran lende win.
Doleske wenn le kharedo: Ko rup, hoi molell tchi. O baro Dewel kamell buder tchi lendar te djinell.
O baro Dewel rakras ap o Jeremia un penas:
Dja un tchip tut an ko wudar o baro Debleskro kherestar, un pen i menshenge kal laba: Tumer lauter dran o them Juda, kai djan kate dren, te mangenn o baro Debles an, shunenn o baro Debleskro lab!
Kowa penell o baro Dewel, ko rai pral o bolepen un i phub, – job hi o Israeleskro Dewel: Mukenn tumaro phuro drom un tumaro phuro djipen, palle mukau tumen an kau them te djiwell.
Ma patsenn kol chochene laba, te penenn jon: ‘Kate hi o baro Debleskro kheer, kai djiwell lo. Awa, kate hi o baro Debleskro kheer!’
Mukenn tumaro phuro drom un tumaro phuro djipen, un awenn latcho ap hakeneste!

Ma rikrenn kolen tele, kai hi dran i wawar them, witar gar kol tchawen, kai len kek dad buder hi, un kol romjen, kai len kek rom buder hi! Ma denn kol menshen ratles, kai kek tchilatchepen kran! Ma nashenn wawar deblenge palla. Jon anenn tumen an i bibacht.
Palle kamau me hako tsiro pash tumende djiwell ap kai platsa, an kau them, hoi me tumare phurende dom.
Tumer patsenn chochene laba. Kowa hi tchitcheske.

Tumer han tchorepangre un marepangre, kai denn wawaren mulo, tumer mursha chochenn tumare romjen wawar djuwjentsa, tumer djuwja, chochenn tumare romen, wawar murshentsa, tumer denn tumen sowel un rikrenn koja gar dren, tumer chatchrenn viechen o chocheno debleske Baal un nashenn pal wawar deblende.
Un palle wenn tumer glan mande an kau kheer, hoi mange kerdo was, un penenn: ‘Menge nai djal tchi’. Un krenn sawo koowa dureder, hoi choiran man.
Kau kheer, hoi mange kerdo was, hi kawa tumenge i kheer, kai i tchorepangre pengro tchoredo koowa khatrenn? Mishto, palle dikau me kowa ninna jaake, penell o baro Dewel.
Djan pash ko foro Shilo, kai glan rah tsiro miro kheer tardo his. Un dikenn, hoi me kote krom doleske, kai mire menshe Israel tchilatchepen kran.
Tumer kran ninna lauter sawo koowa, penell o baro Dewel. Un me rakrom pale te pale tumentsa, un tumer kaman gar te shunell. Un me dom tumen gole, un tumer penan koi pre tchi.
Doleske krau me kau khereha, har me ko foreha Shilo krom, ninna te was kau kheer mange kerdo, un tumer patsenn, kote nai djal tumenge tchi. Me krau koi platsa paash, hoi dom tumen un tumare phuren.
Un me tradau tumen mandar krik, har me tumare phralen krik tradom, un kol tsele menshen dran Efrajim.

Tu, Jeremia, mangess gar un rowess gar glan mande kal menshenge, witar gar peness mange, hoi len ap o dji hi, un hoi len hunte well, un stakress lenge pash mande witar gar dren. Me kamau tumen gar an-shunell.
Dikeh tu gar, hoi jon krenna an kol forja an Juda un ap kol dromma an Jerusalem?
Kol tchawe rodenn kasht, kol dada krenn jag, i djuwja krenn merklia koi bolepaskri rajetsake. Un kol wawar deblenge anenn jon pipaske, te choirap me man koi pral.
Mange krenn jon koweha kek duka, penell o baro Dewel. Ap pende kokres anenn le ladj.

Doleske penell o baro Dewel, maro rai: Miri bari choli well pral kau foro, pral i menshende un pral i viechende, pral kol ruka an o weesh un pral ko djob an kau them. Miri choli hi har i jag, hoi kek nai krell win.

Kowa penell o baro Dewel, ko rai pral o bolepen un i phub, kai hi o Israeleskro Dewel: Hoske chatchrenn tumer viechen mange? Tchiwenn len pash kol wawarende, hoi chan tumer khetne glan mande! Chan ko tselo mass!
Ap ko diwes, har anom tumare phuren dran o them Egiptia, penom lenge gar, te anenn jon mange viechen chatchepaske, witar kek, hoi hunte chan le glan mande.
Me penom lenge: Shunenn ap miro lab, palle kamau me tumaro Dewel te well, un tumer han mire menshe. Djan ap ko drom, kai me tumenge penom, palle djal tumenge mishto.
Jon shunan gar ap mande, un lengre kanda pandan le, un djiwan pal lengro shero, un kran hoi lengro tchilatcho dji penella, un sikran mande pengro dumo, un gar pengro mui.
Fun ko diwes, har me tumare phuren dran Egiptia anom bis kai diwes, bitchrom pale te pale mire budepangren pash tumende, kol rakepangren, kai mire laba dureder penan.
Tumer shunan gar ap mande, un dan kek garda ap mire laba. Tumer djan pal tumaro shero, un kran budeder tchilatchepen har tumare phure.
Te peneh tu, Jeremia, lenge kowa lauter, shunenn jon gar ap tute. Te deh tu len gole, penenn jon tchi koi pre.
Doleske pen ap lende: tumer han kal menshe, kai shunan gar ap lengro baro Debleste. Un tumer mukenn tumen tchi te penell. O tchatchepen hi mulo. Kek rakrell buder pral o tchatchepen.
Tchin tire lengste balla tele, un witse len tutar krik! Gib i ropaskri gili ap i berge! O baro Dewel hi chojedo pral kal menshende, un tradell len pendar krik, un kamell lendar tchi te djinell.
Kol menshe an o them Juda krenn, hoi mange djungeles hi, penell o baro Dewel. Jon tchiwan kol djungele deblen an kau kheer, hoi mange kerdo was, un kran les pale-tchiddo.
Un kran an koi tala Ben Hinnom i chatchepaskri, hoi kharell Tofet, te chatchrenn jon pengre tchawen un tchen. Sawo koowa penom me lenge gar. Un kowa was mange gar an o shero.

“Doleske well ko tsiro”, penell o baro Dewel, “kai penenn le gar buder Tofet un Ben Hinnom ap koi tala. Palle kharell koi tala ‘tala, kai wan le maredo’. Kote paskrenn le pengre mulen, kek wawar platsa hi buder koi.
Tchirkle un diwje vieche chan kol mule menshen pre, un kek tradell len krik.
Un o them Juda well i mulo them. An lengre forja un ap kol dromma an Jerusalem giwell un sal kek buder i bachtjatar. Un koi bachteli gole o pirnestar un i pirnjatar shunah mer buder gar.”

O baro Dewel penell: An ko tsiro wenn kol kokale kol bare rajendar dran o them Juda kote win lino, kai le paskedo hi, ninna kol kokale kol pralstunendar un rashajendar, kol kokale o Debleskre rakepangrendar, un kol kokale kol menshendar an Jerusalem.

Un kol kokale wenn koi trujel witsedo glan o kham un o tchon un i tsele bolepangre momlia, kolen kaman kol menshe, un mangan len an, un nashan lenge pal. Kolendar putchan jon un sharan len. Kol kokale wenn gar pre hadedo un wenn gar paskedo. Jon wenn ful i phubjake.
Un lauter kolla, kai pral atchan kal tchilatche menshendar, kai djiwenn kote, kai me len tradom, lenge wals o merepen feteder har o djipen. Kowa penell o baro Dewel, ko rai pral o bolepen un i phub.
Ap mande penas lo: Pen ap lende: Kowa penell o baro Dewel: Te perell jek, stell job sik pale pre. Te nashrell pes jek, rissrell job sik pale trujel.
Hoske nashrenn pen kal menshe an o foro Jerusalem pale te pale, un rissrenn gar trujel? Jon atchenn pash kol chochene deblende, un kamenn gar palpale pash mande te well.

Me dikau un shunau, kai rakrenn jon gar o tchatchepen. Koi hi kek, kai khaitell les hawo tchilatchepen job kras. Kek putchella: Hoi krom me? Hakeno nashella dureder ap peskro drom, har i grai an o kurepen.
O storcho tel o bolepen djinell peskro tsiro, un kol wawar tchirkle rikrenn o tsiro dren, kai wenn le pale.
Har nai penenn tumer: ‘Mer ham gosewo. Men hi o baro Debleskro lab pash mende.’ Chochepen hi kowa lauter, hoi kol sikepangre dran kowa krenna.
Kol gosewe witsran o Debleskro lab pal pende. Hawo goswepen atchell lenge? O diwes well, kai well ladj un daar pral lende. Jon wenn tapedo un pandles krik anlo.

Lengre djuwjen dau wawar murshende. Un lengre kotja them dau kolende, kai tradan len krik. Halauter, tikne un bare, chochenna, te wenn le brawelo. Ninna i Debleskre rakepangre un rashaja chochenn i menshen,
un krenn jaake, har te wans kol duka mire menshendar gar jaake pharo. Jon penenna: Lauter hi mishto, lauter hi mishto, ninna te hi tchi mishto.

Jon hunte ladjans koleske hoi jon kran, koweha man choiran. Kowa krenn le gar. Jon ladjenn gar. Hoi ladj hi, djinenn le gar. Doleske wenn jon maredo khetne kol wawarentsa. Te wau me, un dau len i phagi, hunte perenn le, penell o baro Dewel.

Te kamau pash mire menshende latchepen te hatsell, hom har i hacho, kai kamell drake un faige dren te lell, un kai hatsell kek drake un kek faige ap i ruka. Ninna kol patria peran tele, penell o baro Dewel. Doleske dom kal menshen pre. Wawar menshe lenn penge lengro them.

Hoske ham mer kai trujel beshdo? [putchenn i menshe dran Juda.] Mer was khetne, te djas mer an kol sorele forja, te was koi maredo! Mer mukam o baro Debles, maro rajes. Doleske kamell lo maro merepen, un dell men sawo pani te pijell, hoi marell men.
Mer patsam, kai well lauter mishto. Tchi was mishto! Mer kamams, te well i tsiro, kai kowa, hoi an mende nasselo hi, sasto wals. Kowa was gar. I daar was.

Kolla, kai kamenn te kurenn pen mentsa, hi pash o foro Dan tardo. Fun kotar shunah koi gole lengre grajendar. O tselo them trissell koi goljatar hoi i graja denn. Jon wenna un chan ko tselo them pre, lauter, hoi ap ko them hi, kol forja un lauter, hoi koi dren djiwella.
Me, o baro Dewel penau: Me bitchrau tchilatche sapa pash tumende, sawe, kai anenn o merepen. Kolen nai rikrell kek pre. Kolla dandrenn tumen.
Miro dji phagell. Man hi ropaske. Hoi nai krell man pale sorelo?

Dran o tselo them shunau me, har denn mire menshe gole. Kamell o baro Dewel buder gar o Dewel an Zion te well? Hi o fores Zion buder kek baro rai? Hoske kran jon man jaake chojedo [penell o baro Dewel], har mangan le pengre figuren un chochene deblen an, kai kekeske ap i rig wenna?
O tsiro hi trujel, kai o djob dren anlo well. O nijal hi trujel, un kek was, kai men dran i bibacht win las.
Mire menshe phagan khetne. Doleske rowell miro dji. Mange hi, har te merap, un djinau gar, hoi te krap.
Hi an o them Gilead kek dukepaskro djet? Hi kek dramaskro koi? Hoske dell kek sastepen mire menshenge?
Ach, te wals man doha pani an miro shero, un mire jaka te wans har i quella, te rowap nai ap o diwes un ap i rati, pral kolende mire menshendar, kai wan mulo dino!
Te wals man an o mulo tato them i kheer, kai nai atchau, mukoms me mire menshen, un djoms mange. Jon lauter hi har romma, kai mukan pengre romjen beshdo. Jaake mukan kal phukepangre o baro Debles.
Lengri tchip hi har i tchuri. Lengro chochepah wan le soreles an o them. O tchatchepen rakrenn le gar. Jek tchilatcho koowa pal o wawar krenn le. Man prindjrenn jon gar, penell o baro Dewel.
Hakeno mu dell pes garda peskro malestar, un ninna peskro phralestar! Jek phraal dell kol wawar phrales pral i kanda. Un i maal rakrell djungeles pral o wawareste.
Jon lauter chochenn pengre malen. Un kek rakrell laba, hoi tchatcho hi. Jon penan pengre tchipja, te rakrenn le chochepen. Pale te pale krenn le tchilatchepen ap i wawarende,
Un mukenn gar tele, te rikrenn le i wawaren tele, un te chochenn le len. Man kamenn le gar te prindjrell, penell o baro Dewel.

Doleske penell o baro Dewel, ko rai pral o bolepen un i phub: Har o rup an i jag djudjes kerdo well, jaake kamau mire menshen dukentsa djudjes te krell. Dell tchi wawares, hoi krap me nai mire menshenge.
Lengro rakepen hi har faile, hoi anenn o merepen. Peskro mujeha rakrell hakeno kamles, an o dji lurell job, har te taprell lo o wawares.
Dap me sawe menshen kek phagi, penell o baro Dewel. Mukap me kal menshen jaake te djal, un krap lenge tchi?

Me kamau pral kau them an i berge rowell, un pral ko senelo pralstuno them i ropaskri gili te giwell. Lauter hi pre-chatchedo. Kek mensho djal koi trujel. Kek grumja un bakre denn kote gole. Ninna kol tchirkle un i diwje vieche nashan penge, un mukenn pen buder gar te dikell.

O baro Dewel penell: Me kamau Jerusalem tele te phagell, jaake te atchenn kokres barra pral, un kai diwje djukle dren djiwenna. Un dran kol forja an Juda krau i mulo them, kai nai djiwell kek buder dren.
Me putchom: Baro Dewel, hoske chatchell ko them un well mulo, jaake kai nai djal kek buder koi trujel? Koon hi gosewo un haiwell kowa? Ap koneste penal tu kowa, jaake te penell job kowa i wawarenge?
O baro Dewel penell koi pre: Me sikrom len miro drom, un jon mukan les, un shunan gar ap mire laba, un djiwan gar koi pal.
Jon kran, hoi lengre tchilatche djia lenge penan, un djan o debleske Baal palla, jaake har lengre phure lende sikran.
Doleske penell o baro Dewel, ko rai pral o bolepen un i phub, kai o Israeleskro Dewel hi: Me dau kal menshen shutlo senlepen chapaske, un pani, kolestar merenn le.
Me tradau len krik pash menshende, kai prindjrenn jon gar, witar gar lengre phure, un kamau o charo pal lende bitchrell, bis te jon lauter mulo hi.
