Ap ko tsiro kai rakrau pale tuha, krau me tiro mui pre. Un tu peness palle ap lende: Kawa penell o baro Dewel, maro rai … Koon kamell te shunell, kowa shunell ap tute. Koon kamell gar te shunell, kowa shunell gar ap tute. Jon hi menshe, kai mukenn pen tchi te penell.
Tu, mensho, le i bar dran chatchedi tchik, un tchip les glan tute, tchin dren, har o foro Jerusalem win dikell!

Kau barreha sike, har ko foro dren lino well! Kre bare turme trul leste, un tchip tchik khetne, te kress i drom, hoi djal ap o foreskre massurja pre. Tchip lurden trul o foro trujel! Un tchip bare pesse rukengre kotja pash i massurja trul o foro, kolentsa i massurja paash dino wenn.

Un le tuke i bobeskro saster, un tchip les pre mank tute un o foro, har te wals lo i massuri! Un palle dik ap o foro, un kre jaake, har te pandals les dren. Kowa hi i sikepen i Israelenge, hoi sikrell lende, hoi pral lende wella.

Un tu tchip tut ap tiri serwi rig, un me tchiwau i doosh o kherestar Israel ap tute pre. 390 (triin-sheel-te-enja-deesh) diwessa hunte wess koi tchiddo ap i phub, un hunte hidjress lengri doosh. Jaake bud bersha anas o Israel doosh ap peste. Jek diwes hako bersheske hunte hidjress lengri doosh.
Un te hi ko tsiro trujel, palle tchip tut i duito kopo tele, kau kopo ap i tchatchi rig, un hidje i doosh o kherestar Juda 40 (star-deesh) diwessa. Jek diwes hi jek bersheske.
Un koi pashel dikess kote, kai o dren pandlo foro Jerusalem hi, un dess les trad tiri pre tchakedo mussjah, un peness leske glan-wi, hoi pral o foro wella.
Un me tchiwau shelle ap tute, te nai rissress tu tut gar jek rigjatar ap i wawar, jaake rah har o foro Jerusalem dren pandlo hi.

Un le tuke gib un djob un bohne un linse un hirsa un dinkel. Un tchip len khetne an jek tcharo, un kre tuke maro kolestar! Kowa hi tiro chapen, hoi chah 390 diwessa, jaake rah har ap tiri serwi rig tchiddo hal.
Hako diwes chas tu i paash funto maro. Cha kowa hako diwes ap o emligo tsiro!
Un hako diwes pijess tu i paash litari pani. Pi kowa hako diwes ap o emligo tsiro!
Peke ko maro har sane mare dran djob. Peke les pral menshengro ful! Kre kowa glan i menshende, te dikenn le kowa.
Un o baro Dewel penas dureder: Kowa sikrell, te well i tsiro, kai tradau i Israelitarjen an wawar themma mank wawar menshende. Un kote hunte chan le maro, hoi pale-tchiddo hi.

Kote penom me: Ach miro rai, baro Dewel! An kek tsiro wom me pale-tchiddo. Fun tiknes pre bis kau diwes, chom gar viechen, kai meran, witar gar sawen, kai khetne dandedo wan. Kek mass, hoi pale-tchiddo hi, was an miro mui.
Un job penas ap mande: Mishto, palle le grumjengro ful un kek menshengro ful, te pekess tiro maro koi pre!

Un job penas pale ap mande: Tu, mensho, me krau, te well buder gar doha maro an o foro Jerusalem. Palle hi hakenes kokres i tikno kotar maro, un nai pijell kokres i tikno khoro pani. Un jon lenn daar, te hunte merans le i bokatar.
Awa, maro un pani hi gar doha lenge. Un an lengri traash wenn le sano, un jek pal o wawar merell. Kowa hi i phagi lengri doshake.

O baro Dewel penas: Tu, mensho, le tuke i charo, hoi mishto tchinell, un tchin tuke koleha i balla ap tiro shero tele un tiri tchor. Palle le i waga, tchip i balla pre, un kre triin kotja lendar, hakeno jaake pharo har ko wawar.

Ap ko tsiro, kai well o foro dren lino, chatche jek triinto kotar fun kol balla mashkral an o foro. Un i wawar triinto kotar de ko chareha paash win glan kol foreskre wudja. Un ko wawar triinto kotar witse pre, te lell len o ducho peha! Jaake lau me i menshen dran Jerusalem palla o chareha.
Rike kol ballendar tchomone pale un pande len tella an tiri baja.
Un kolendar less triin-star kotar un witse len an i jag un chatche len pre! Fun kolendar djal i jag win un well pral o tselo kheer Israel.
Kawa hi, hoi penau me, o baro Dewel, tumaro rai: Kau bar hi o foro Jerusalem! Mashkral dren an i themma, kai wawar menshe djiwenn, tchiwom kau foro.

I menshe an Jerusalem mukan pen tchi mandar te penell, un shunan gar ap mande. Jon wan tchilatcheder har kol themma, kai trul lende hi. Mire tchatchepaskre laba witsran le pal pende, un djiwan gar jaake har lendar kamom.

Doleske penau me, o baro Dewel, lengro rai, ap lende: Tumer hans tchilatcheder har i menshe an i themma trul tumende, un djiwan gar jaake har tumendar kamom, un rikran gar mire tchatchepaskre laba dren. Awa, tumer han jaake tchilatcho, te rikran tumen witar gar ap o tchatchepen kol wawar menshendar, kai trul tumende djiwenn.
Doleske shunenn, tumer menshe an Jerusalem, hoi penau me, o baro Dewel, tumaro rai: Kanna sikrau les tumenge! Un dau tumen tumari phagi glan i jaka kol wawar menshendar.
Un me kamau tumentsa jaake te krell, har kowa kekeha krom, un witar gar krau an ko tsiro, hoi wella. Kawa krau doleske, kai kran sawo bud djungelo koowa.

I tsiro well, kai chan dada pengre tchawen mashkral an Jerusalem, un tchawe chan pengre daden. Jaake pharo well miri phagi, hoi dau tumende. Un halauter, kai tumendar pral atchenn, wenn win tradedo ap hake rigja.

Tumer kran miro kheer pale-tchiddo kol chochene deblentsa un djungelo koweha, hoi kote kran, penau me, o baro Dewel, tumaro rai. Doleske dau man sowel, me o djido Dewel, te dap tumen paash. Tumer khaitenn man buder gar un me krau miro dji buder gar tumenge pre.

O triinto kotar tumendar merell ap i pharo nasslepen un i bokatar. Un i triinto kotar tumendar well glan o foro o chareha mulo dino. Un i triinto kotar tumendar tradau win ap hake rigja, un me lau len palla o chareha.

Te mukom miri tseli choli ap tumende win, un dom tumen pale, hoi kran, palle djal miri choli krik, un hom buder gar chojedo pral tumende. Un tumer djinenn, te homs me, o baro Dewel, kai das tumen trad o tselo djijeha.
Tutar, Jerusalem, krau i mulo foro. Tchi har barra atchenn tutar pral. I menshe an i wawar themma trul tute trujel, san pral tute – hakeno kai djal koi un dikell tut.

Awa, jon san pral tute un praassenn tut. Lenge well traash, te dikenn le, har miri bari choli pral tute well, un har djungeles sawe menshenge djal, kai man mukan. An miri choli anau tiri doosh ap tute pale. Me, o baro Dewel, rakrom.

Te bitchrau i bok mank tumende, hi kowa jaake har te doms tchilatche faile karje mank tumende, te marap tumen. An ko tsiro well tumen buder gar doha te chal. Un i bok well baro un bareder mank tumende.
Awa, i bok un diwje viechen bitchrau mank tumende. Kolla marenn tumare tchawen. Ninna pharo nasslepen, marepen un kurepen anau pral tumende. Me, o baro Dewel, rakrom.
Un o baro Dewel penas ap mande:
Tu, mensho, dik kote, kai i berge Israel hi, un pen lenge glan-wi, hoi pral lende wella!

Pen lenge: Tumer berge Israel, shunenn hoi o baro Dewel tumenge penell! O baro Dewel, maro rai, penell ap i bare un tikne berge, ap i panja un ap i tale, kai kran pen i menshe platse, kai le pengre chochene deblen an-mangenn: Shunenn, me anau o kurepen pral tumende, un krau kol mulne platse paash.

Kol chatchepangre, kai vieche chatchedo wenn, ninna kol boba, kai sungepaskro koowa chatchedo well, wenn khetne phagedo. Un kolla, kai tumendar mulo dino wenn, witsrau glan tumare chochene deblen ap i phub. Un i kokale kol mule Israelendar witsrau trul kol chatchepangre, kai mangan kol chochene deblen an.

An o tselo them atchell tumare forjendar tchi har barra pral. Tumare mulne platse wenn paash kerdo, un i chatchepangre tele phagedo, te atchell lendar tchi har barra pral. Tumare chochene debla wenn khetne dino, un nai wenn buder gar an-mangedo. Un kol boba, kai sungepaskro koowa chatchran, wenn tele dino. Kowa, hoi kran tumenge, hi kanna paash.
Un kolla tumendar, kai mulo dino wenn, atchenn tchiddo ap i phub. Palle dikenn un haiwenn tumer, te hom me o baro Dewel.
Gar halauter tumendar mukau o chareha mulo te dell. Kolla, kai atchenn djido, mukau pandles krik te anell an wawar themma.

Kote, kai le pandle hi, wau me lenge an o shero. Un jon dikenn dren, te dom len i phagi koleske, hoi jon kran: Jon phagan mantsa un nashan chochene deblen palla. Palle rissrell lenge halauter an pende pral ko tselo djungelo koowa, hoi jon kran.
Un jon dikenn un haiwenn palle, te dom me, o baro Dewel, len gar tchitcheske trad, har penom, hawi bibacht pral lende wella.

Un o baro Dewel, miro rai, penas ap mande: De an tire wasta un stake tire herjentsa soreles pre, un de win gole: Hawi bibacht well pral i menshende Israel dran ko bud djungelo koowa, hoi jon kran! O chareha un i bokatar un ap i pharo nasslepen hunte merenn le.

Kolla, kai an i dur them hi, merenn ap o nasslepen. Un kolla, kai djiwenn an o them Israel un trul o them trujel, kolla merenn an o kurepen. Un kolla, kai pral atchenn, merenn i bokatar. Jaake krau lentsa, bis te miri choli trujel hi.

Palle hi i mulo-dine tchiddo mashkral pengre chochene deblende, un trul lengre chatchepangre trujel ap haki tikni un bari berga, un tel hako baro ruk bud patjentsa, un tel hake wawar senele ruka, kai mangan le pengre chochene deblen an, un chatchran lenge latcho sungepaskro koowa. Un tumer dikenn un haiwenn, te hom me o baro Dewel.

Un me hadau miro wast ap lende un krau lengro them paash, te well ko tselo them mank o mulo diwjo them Juda un o foro Ribla i muklo them. Hako forestar, kai le djiwan, atchell tchi har barra. Palle dikenn un haiwenn le, te hom me, o baro Dewel.
Un o baro Dewel penas ap mande:
Tu, mensho, kawa hi, hoi penau me, o baro Dewel tumaro rai ap o them Israel. Hi doha! O tsiro hi koi, kai djal o tselo them Israel tele.
Israel, kanna well miri choli pral tute, un tu djah tele. Me rakrau o tchatchepen pral tute win, un tu leh tiri phagi. Ko tselo djungelo koowa, hoi kral, anau ap tiro shero pale.
Me dikau buder gar latches ap tute. Man khaiteh tu gar. Ko djungelo koowa, hoi kral, well ap tiro shero pale. Un tu leh tiri phagi. Un tumer dikenn un haiwenn palle, te hom me o baro Dewel.
Kawa hi, hoi o baro Dewel, maro rai penell: Shunenn, bibacht pal bibacht wella!
O tsiro hi koi, kai djal o tselo them tele. Tele djal o tselo them! Dikenn tumer, har i bibacht wella? Koi hi li!
I bibacht perell pral tumende dren, pral tumende kai djiwenn an o them. O tsiro was, ko diwes hi koi, kai o ropen well, un buder kek gipen pral ap i berge hi.

Sik tchorau miri choli pral tumende win. Un djau choljah tumentsa trujel, bis te miri choli trujel hi. Me rakrau o tchatchepen pral tumende win, un tumer lenn tumari phagi. Ko tselo djungelo koowa, hoi kran, anau ap tumare sherja pale.

Me dikau buder gar latches ap tumende. Man khaitenn tumer gar. Ko djungelo koowa, hoi kran, well ap tumare sherja pale. Un tumer lenn tumari phagi. Un tumer dikenn un haiwenn palle, te hom me o baro Dewel, kowa kai tumen dell.
Dikenn ko diwes! Dikenn, hoi wella! I bibacht hi glan o wudar. O tchilatchepen was bud un budeder. Un o pre-phurdepen hi baro.
Kolla, kai djan tchilatches i wawarentsa trujel, wan tchilatche raja. Tchi atchell lendar pral. Lengro brawlepen atchell gar, witar gar lengro railepen un an-dikepen.
Ko tsiro was, ko diwes hi koi! O ginepaskro nai sal gar buder. Un kowa, kai hunte bikrell tchomone, hunte rowell gar koi pral. O baro Debleskri choli well pral kal tsele menshende.

O bikepaskro lell kowa gar pale, hoi lo bikras, ninna te atchell lo djido. Kowa, hoi glan-wi penlo hi, well pral kal tsele menshende. O baro Dewel lell kowa gar pale. Kek, kai doosh ap peste las, atchell djido.
I menshe shunan, har an i phurdepaskri phurdedo was, te kharenn le len an o kurepen, un i kurepangre lan pengre karmangre. Un palle well miri choli jaake sik pral lende halauterende, te djal kek koi.

Glan o foro hi kol lurde, kai kamenn i Israelitarjen te marell. An o foro hi i pharo nasslepen un bok. Koon win glan o foro hi, kowa well o chareha maredo. Un koon an o foro dren hi, merell ap o pharo nasslepen un i bokatar.
Un kolla, kai nai nashenn penge, djiwenn ap i berge har darene taube mank i bare barra, un rowenn pral pengri doosh.
Kek soor hi len buder an pengre wasta. I darjatar nai rikrenn le pengro pani gar.
Gone tchiwenn le trul pende har ripja, un tchinenn pengre balla ap lengro shero tele, te sikrenn le har bud khaitell len lengri doosh. Jon trissenn i darjatar. Un lengre sherja hi lolo i ladjatar.

Lengro rup witsrenn le ap o drom, un lengro sonakai hi lenge har tchik. Lengro rup un lengro sonakai nai lell len gar dran o merepen win, ap ko diwes, kai i choli o baro Deblestar pral lende well. Lengro rup un sonakai was tchi-moldo. Jon nai chan les gar, un nai krenn gar pengro per lestar pherdo. Lengro brawlepen his kowa, hoi anas len jaake dur, te peran le o baro Debleskro dromestar tele.
Lengro tselo shukar koowa kras, te wan le pre-phurdo. Un jon kran pen kolestar djungele figure, chochene deblen, hoi le an-mangan. Doleske krom me, te well kau koowa lenge har tchik.
Un me dau kowa an o wast kolendar, kai wenn dran wawar themma. Kol tchilatche ap kai phub randenn les, un krenn, te nai wenn kol figure buder gar an-mangedo.
Un me rissrau miro shero krik mire menshendar. Un wawar menshe krenna, te well kowa pale-tchiddo, hoi mange jaake kutch hi. Awa, randepangre phagenn dren un krenn, te nai djiwau me buder gar koi.
Kre i shello! O tselo them hi pherdo kolendar, kai lan rateskri doosh ap pende. Un o foro hi pherdo kolentsa, kai rikran i wawaren i sorjah tele.

Doleske mukau lurden dran tchilatche natsjone pral o Israel te well, te lenn le lengre khera penge dren. Un kol raja, kai rikran i tchorwelen sorjah tele, lenge krau o pre-phurdepen paash. Un kol platse, kai mangan le pengre deblen an, mukau pale-tchiddo te krell.
I daar well bari. Tchitcheske rodenn le i khatepen, kai djal lenge tchi. Kek hatsenn le.

Bibacht pal bibacht well. Pale te pale shunenn le, hawo djungelo koowa was. Tchitcheske djan le pash o Debleskre rakepangre, un putchenn lendar, hoi o baro Dewel sikras len. Witar gar i rashaja nai penenn lenge, hoi te krenn le. Un i phureder djinenn kek drom win dran o merepen.

O baro rai rowell, un i pralstune darenn pengro djipaske. Hakeno an o them trissell i darjatar. Me krau lentsa pal kowa har jon kran. Un jaake har kran jon o tchatchepen win pral i wawarende, jaake krau me o tchatchepen win pral lende. Palle dikenn un haiwenn le, te hom me o baro Dewel.

An o shobto bersh, ap o pantchto diwes an o shobto tchon homs beshdo an miro kheer. Un i phureder kolendar, kai wan dran o them Juda pandles anlo an o them Babilonia, his glan mande beshdo. Kote peras i soor o baro Deblestar, miro rajestar, ap mande.
Un me dikom jekes, kai win dikas har i mursh. Un leskro shero un leskro betch dikan win har o sonakai, kai o kham pre perell. Un o telstuno kotar, kowa hoi win dikas har leskre herja, his har jag.

Un job tchiwas tchomone har i wast pal mande win, un tapras man ap mire balla ap o shero. Un an ko dikepen, hoi dikom, un hoi was o Deblestar, hadas man o ducho pre dur pral i phub, un anas man an o foro Jerusalem pash o baro wudar, hoi hi ap i nordetikri rig, glan koi platsa, hoi djal trul o Debleskro kheer. Kote his i figura tardo, hoi i menshe an-mangan, un pral kolate o baro Dewel bares chojedo his.
Kote dikom o Israeleskro Dewel an peskro railepen, jaake har les dikom an koi tala.

Un job penas ap mande: Tu, mensho, dik kote, kai norden hi! Un me dikom kote, kai norden hi. Un kote win glan o wudar his i chatchepaskri. Un pash o wudar his koi figura, pral kolate o Dewel jaake chojedo his.
Un o baro Dewel penas ap mande: Tu, mensho, dikeh tu, hoi le krenn? Baro djungelo koowa hi, hoi o kheer Israel kate krell, te djap mange dran miro kheer win. Un tu dikess gomme bareder djunglepen.
Un job anas man an o wudar glan koi platsa, hoi glan o Debleskro kheer hi. Kote dikom i cheb an i massuri.
Un job penas ap mande: Tu mensho, de koi massuri dren! Un me phagom koi massuri dren. Un dikom i wudar koi palla.
Un job penas ap mande: Dja koi dren, un dik ko tselo tchilatcho djungelo koowa, hoi jon kate krenn.
Un me djom dren an i isema un dikom bud djungele figure an i massurja dren dino: sapa un wawar djungele vieche, kolen i menshe dran o kheer Israel an-mangenn.

Glan kol figure his 70 (efta-deesh) phureder dran o kheer Israel tardo, mank lende o Jaasanja, koleskro dad o Shafan his. Un hakeno lendar his i tcharo an o wast, kai sungepaskro koowa dren hi. Un dran kowa hadas pes i tampa pre.

Un o baro Dewel penas ap mande: Tu mensho, dikal tu kawa, hoi krenn i phureder dran o kheer Israel tchorchanes – hakeno lendar glan peskri figura an lakri isema? Jon penenn penge: O baro Dewel dikell men gar, un djas peske dran kau them!
Un job penas dureder: Tu dikess gomme bareder djungelo koowa, hoi jon krenn.
Un job anas man pash o wudar ap i nordetikri rig glan o baro Debleskro kheer. Kote his djuwja beshdo. Un kolla rowan pral o merepen ko deblestar, kai kharell Tammus.
Un o baro Dewel penas ap mande: Tu mensho, dikal tu kowa? Tu dikess gomme bareder djungelo koowa, har kawa.

Un job anas man dren ap koi tikni platsa glan o baro Debleskro kheer. Un glan o wudar o kherestar mashkral i glanstuni halla un i sasterni chatchepaskri his 25 (biish-te-pantch) mursha tardo. Kolla rissran pengre dume khatar o baro Debleskro kheer, un dikan ap koi rig, kai o kham pre djal. Un jon mukan pen ap i phub te perell, un mangan o kham an.

Un job penas ap mande: Tu mensho, dikal tu kawa? Hi i menshenge dran o kheer Juda gar doha, te krenn le ko tselo djungelo koowa kate? O tselo them kran le pherdo tchilatchepen. Hunte choirenn le man pale te pale? Dik, har rikrenn le penge senele patria glan pengre naka!
Doleske djau lentsa i choljah trujel. Jon khaitenn man buder gar. Un man well kek latchepen lenge. Ninna te denn le palle glan mire kanda pre gole, shunau me gar ap lende.
Un me shunom, har das o baro Dewel soreles gole, un penas: Mu wenn le, kolla, kai denn o foro peskri phagi! Hakeno lendar te lell peskro kurepaskro kasht an o wast!

Koi wan shob mursha ap o drom, kai was kotar, kai o pralstuno baro wudar hi, ap i nordetikri rig o baro Debleskro kherestar. Un hakenes his tchomone an o wast, koleha job nai marell. Un pash lende his jek, koleskre koola his dran laintikro than. Ap leskro pereskri dori his i tchinepaskri pandlo, koleha job nai laba pre tchinell. Un jon wan un atchan pash i sasterni chatchepaskri tardo.

Un o railepen o Israeleskro Deblestar, kai his pral kol star bolepangren, kai kharan Cherubim, hadas pes fun kotar, un djas pash o kheer, kote kai o wudar hi. Un o baro Dewel das ap ko mursheste gole, koleskre koola dran laintikro than his, un koles i tchinepaskri ap peskri rig his,

un penas ap leste: An o foro Jerusalem hi gomme menshe, kolengro dji rowell un dell gole pral kau bud djungelo koowa, hoi kate kerdo well. Dja an o tselo foro trujel, un kre i sikepen glan ap kolengre sherja.
Ap kol wawar murshende penas lo jaake, te shunom kowa: Djan pal leste an o foro un denn hakenes mulo. Dikenn kek kamlepah ap lende! Kek hunte khaitell tumen!

Denn i phuren mulo, un i terne murshen un i terne tchen, ninna i tchawen un i djuwjen! Ma taprenn jekeske an, koles ko sikepen glan ap peskro shero hi! Djan glanstunes pash miro kheer, un fun kotar dureder. Jaake kran le, un maran glanstunes kol pralstunen, kai glan o baro Debleskro kheer tardo his.

Un o baro Dewel penas ap lende: Anenn kolen, kai mulo dino wan, ap i platse glan o Debleskro kheer! Krenn jaake o kheer pale-tchiddo! Palle djan win an o foro! Un jon djan win, un dan i menshen an o foro mulo.

Un har le kowa kran, atchom me kokres ap i platsa glan o Debleskro kheer pale. Un mukom man ap i phub te perell, un dom pre gole un penom: Baro Dewel, miro rai! Hal tu jaake chojedo pral Jerusalem, te mukess halauteren mulo te dell, kai i Israelendar pral atchan?

Un job penas ap mande: I doosh, hoi i menshe dran o kheer Israel un dran o kheer Juda ap pende anan, hi jaake bud. Bud marepen hi an o them. Un an o foro rikrenn i sorele i wawaren sorjah tele. Un jon penenn: “O baro Dewel djas peske dran kau them. Job dikell men gar!”
Doleske dikau me kek kamlepah ap lende, un jon khaitenn man gar. Lengro tchilatchepen anau ap lengre sherja pale.
Koi was ko mursh, koleskre koola dran laintikro than his, un koles i tchinepaskri ap peskro pereskri dori pandles his, un penas: “Me krom kowa, hoi tu mange penal.”
Un me dikom ap ko bolepen, hoi his pral i sherja fun i bolepangre, un dikom tchomone jaake blaueto har ko kutch blaueto bar, hoi kharell Safiro. Kowa dikas win har i rajeskri beshepaskri.

Un o baro Dewel penas ap ko mursheste, kai his rido an laintikro than: Dja mashkral kol rade tel i bolepangre, un le tire wasta pherdo jagengro kasht, hoi chatchell, un mashkral kol bolepangre hi. Un witse les pral o foro win. Un ko mursh djas glan mire jaka mank kol rade.
Un har lo kote dren djas, his kol bolepangre tardo ap i tchatchi rig o Debleskro kherestar. Un i wolka kras koi tikni platsa glan o Debleskro kheer pherdo.

Un o baro Debleskro railepen, hoi his pral kol bolepangren, hadas pes fun kotar, un djas pash o kheer, kote kai o wudar hi. Un o tselo kheer was pherdo fun koi wolka, un i glanstuni platsa his pherdo o baro Debleskro railepen.
Un kol tchirklengre mussja fun kol bolepangre kran jaake bari gole, har te rakrell o sorelo Dewel. Un me shunom lat ninna an koi bari glanstuni platsa.
Un har penas o baro Dewel ko mursheske, kai his rido an laintikro than, te djal lo mank i rade un mank i bolepangre, te lell lo jag, djas ko mursh mank lende un atchas tardo pash jek rada.

Kote tchiwas jek kol bolepangrendar peskro wast win, un las koi jagatar, hoi mashkral kol bolepangre his, un das lat an i wasta ko murshestar, kai his rido an laintikro than. Un kowa las koi jag un djas win.
Un tel lengre tchirklengre mussja his i bolepangren tchomone har win dikas har i mensheskre wasta.
Un me dikom star rade tardo pash i bolepangre, pash hako bolepaskro his jek rada. Un kol rade dikan senelo win har i kutch senelo bar.
Jek rada dikas win har i wawar. Un jon his jaake kerdo, har te well jek rada an i wawar dren.
Te djan le, nai djan le ap hake star rigja. Un jon rissran pen gar trujel. Kote, kai i glanstuni djas, ap koi rig djan i wawar ninna. Un jon rissran pen gar trujel.
Un halauter lendar, o dumo, i wasta, i tchirklengre mussja un lengre rade his pherde jaka ap haki rig. Un hakenes his peskri rada.
Un me shunom, har wan i rade kharedo ‘tradede rade’.

Un hakenes kol bolepangrendar his i shero, kai his ap hake star rigja jaka un i mui. Ap i glanstuni rig dikas lo win har i bolepaskro, ap i duiti rig har i mensho, ap i triinti rig har i lewo, ap i starti rig har i adlari.
Un kol bolepangre hadan pen. Kolla his kol emlige bolepangre har dikom, har homs pash o lengsto pani Kebar.
Te djan kol bolepangre, palle djan ninna kol rade pentsa. Un te kran le pengre tchirklengre mussja pre un buchlo, te hadenn le pen pre i phubjatar, palle atchan ninna i rade ap lengri rig.
Te atchan jon tardo, palle atchan jon ninna tardo. Un te hadan le pen pre i phubjatar, hadan jon pen ninna. I rade kran, hoi i bolepangre kaman.
Un o baro Debleskro railepen, hoi his pash o wudar o kherestar, djas pale krik un hadas pes pral kol bolepangre.

Un kol bolepangre kran pengre tchirklengre mussja buchlo, un hadan pen pre i phubjatar glan mire jaka. Un har djan le win, his kol rade ap lengre rigja. Un i bolepangre tchiwan pen pash ko wudar o baro Debleskro kherestar, hoi ap koi rig hi, kai o kham pre djal. Un o railepen o Israeleskro Deblestar his pral lende.
Kolla his kol bolepangre, hoi dikom me tel o Israeleskro Debleste, har homs pash ko lengsto pani Kebar. Un me haiwom, te his kolla Cherubim.
Hakenes lendar his jaka un i mui ap hake star rigja leskro sherestar. Un hakenes his star tchirklengre mussja, un tel kol tchirklengre mussja har wals len menshengre wasta.
Un lengre sherja his jaake har dikom me len, har homs pash ko pani Kebar. Un jon djan khetne ap hake rigja, har kaman le. Hakeno dikas glan peste.

Un o ducho hadas man pre un anas man glan o baro Debleskro kheer, pash ko baro wudar, hoi kote hi, kai o kham pre djala. Un glan ko baro wudar his 25 (biish-te-pantch) mursha. Un me dikom mashkral lende o Jaasanja, koleskro dad o Assur his, un o Pelatja, koleskro dad o Benaja his. Kolla his pralstune pral i menshende.

Un o baro Dewel penas ap mande: Tu, mensho, kalla hi kol mursha, kolen tchilatchepen glan hi. Te putchenn i menshe an o foro lendar: “Hoi hunte kras mer?” Palle penenn le lenge sawo koowa, hoi anell len an i bibacht.
Jon penenn: “Hi gar o tsiro koi, te kras menge khera? O foro hi har i piri, un mer ham har o mass, hoi dren hi. Menge djal tchi.”
Doleske peness tu, mensho, lenge, hoi mukau me, o Dewel, ap lende te well!
Un o ducho o baro Deblestar was ap mande, un penas ap mande: Pen i menshenge an Israel: Kawa penell o baro Dewel: Djinau tumaro rakepen. Un kowa, hoi an tumaro shero trujel djal, prindjrau me ninna.
Tumer dan buden mulo an kau foro. Un i dromma an kau foro hi pherdo kolendar, kai wan mulo dino.
Doleske penau me, o baro Dewel, tumaro rai: Kolen, kai tumer an o foro mulo dan, kolla hi o mass, un o foro hi i piri. Tumen witsrenn le dran leste win.
Tumer darenn glan o kurepen. Un o charo anau pral tumende. Kowa penell o baro Dewel, tumaro rai.
Me tradau tumen dran ko foro win, un dau tumen an o wast i menshendar dran i wawar them, un mukau len te denn le tumenge tumari phagi.
Tumer wenn o chareha mulo dino. Kate an o them Israel dau tumen tumari phagi. Un tumer dikenn un haiwenn, te hom me o baro Dewel.
Tumer atchenn gar an kau foro har o mass an i piri. Kate an o them Israel dau tumen tumari phagi.

Un tumer dikenn un haiwenn, te hom me o baro Dewel. Tumer kran gar kowa, hoi tumendar kamom. Un rikran gar ap mire tchatchepaskre laba. Na-a, tumer djiwan pal i tchatchepangre laba kol menshendar, kai an i themma trul tumende djiwenna.

Un har rakrom kal laba win, hoi o Dewel man das, meras o Pelatja, koleskro dad o Benaja his. Un me mukom man ap i phub te perell, un dom bari gole: Baro Dewel, miro rai! Kameh tu halauteren mulo te dell, kai i Israelendar pral atchan?
Un o baro Dewel penas ap mande:

Tu, mensho, kol menshe, kai gomme an o foro Jerusalem djiwenn, kolla penenn fun tire phralendar un tire menshendar un i tsele wawar Israelendar, kai pandles an o them Babilonia anlo wan: “Dur krik hi le o baro Deblestar! Menge hi kanna o them!”

Doleske pen: Kawa penell o baro Dewel, maro rai: Awa, me tradom len dur krik an wawar themma, un mank wawar menshende. Ninna te djiwenn le kate te kote an bud themma, un hi buder gar khetne, hom me pash lende, te nai mangenn le man an, an kol themma, kai le anlo wan.
Me, o baro Dewel, lengro rai, lau len khetne dran kol tsele themma un natsjone, an kolende jon tradedo wan, un dau len o them Israel pale.
Te wenn le kote khere, witsrenn le kol tsele chochene deblen un djungele figuren win dran o them.
Un me dau len i newo dji, un tchiwau i newo ducho an lende dren. Un me lau ko dji dran bar dran lengro betch win. Un dau len i masselo dji.
Palle krenn le, hoi lendar kamau, un djiwenn pal mire tchatchepaskre laba. Un jon hi mire menshe, un me hom lengro Dewel.
Kolla, kai pandan pengro dji ap i chochene deblen un djungele figuren, kolenge anau lengro tchilatchepen ap lengre sherja pale. Kawa penell o baro Dewel, maro rai.
Un kol bolepangre hadan pengre tchirklengre mussja, un khetne lentsa hadan pen kol rade. Un o railepen o Israeleskro Deblestar his pral lende.
Un o baro Debleskro railepen hadas pes un djas dran o foro win, un tchiwas pes ap i berga, hoi glan o foro tchiddo hi, kote kai o kham pre djala.
Un an ko dikepen, hoi dikom, un hoi was o Deblestar, hadas man o ducho pre, un anas man pale pash kolende, kai pandlo krik anlo wan an o them Babilonia. Un ko dikepen, hoi dikom, djas krik.
Un me penom kol pandlenge halauter, hoi o baro Dewel mange penas un sikras.
Un o baro Dewel penas ap mande:

Tu, mensho, djiweh mank sawe menshende, kai mukenn pen tchi te penell. Kolen hi jaka, te dikenn le, un kamenn tchi te dikell. Un len hi kanda, te shunenn le, un kamenn gar te shunell. Jon mukenn pen tchi te penell.

Tu mensho, le tire koola khetne, har te wals jek, kai hunte djal an o pandepen. Un kre tut pral o diwes ap o drom, te nai dikenn kowa halauter. Glan lengre jaka djas tu kote win, kai khere hals, un djas ap i wawar platsa. Jaake te nai wals, te djal lenge i jaka pre – kolenge, kai mukenn pen tchi te penell.
Ap o diwes hidje ko koowa hoi tuha leh win dran o kheer, te hunte dikenn le les. Un rati dja win glan lengre jaka, jaake har jek win djal, kai djal an o pandepen.
Glan lengre jaka phage barra dran i massuri win, un hidje tiro koowa koi win.

Glan lengre jaka le halauter ap tiri phik! Un har tamlo was, dja win! Un tchip i diklo trul tire jaka, jaake te dikess gar o them, hoi mukeh. Kamau, te wess i sikepen i Israelenge, hoi sikrell lende, har dau len trad.

Un me krom jaake, har mange penlo was. Miro koowa hidjrom pral o diwes jaake win, har jek, hoi hunte mukell peskro them. Un har rati was, phagom barra win dran i massuri mire wastentsa. Un har tamlo was hidjrom halauter koi win, lom les ap miri phik, un djom mange glan lengre jaka.
Un sik o wawar diwes penas o baro Dewel ap mande:
Tu, mensho, shunal, hoi penan i Israelitarja. Kal menshe, kai mukenn pen tchi te penell, putchan tutar: “Hoi kreh tu koi?”
Pen lenge: O baro Dewel, miro rai, rakras mantsa. Kowa hoi lo mange penas, te penap tumenge dureder, hi i pralstunenge an o foro Jerusalem un i tsele Israelenge, kai kote djiwenn.
Ap kowa, hoi krom, nai dikenn le, har lenge djal. Me hom lenge i sikepen: Jon hunte djan penge un wenn pandles krik anlo.

Un o rai pral lende lell peskro koowa ap i phik un djal win an o tamlepen. Un jon phagenn barra win dran i massuri, te hidjrell lo peskro koowa kote win. Trul peskre jaka pandell lo i diklo, te dikell lo gar o them.
Me, o baro Dewel, witsrau miri netsa pral leste win, te well lo tapedo an mire dorja. Un pandles well lo an o them anlo, kai i Babilonarja djiwenn. Ko them nai dikell lo gar. Un kote merell lo.
Un i tsele menshe, kai trul leste trujel hi, kolla, kai pash leste rikrenn, un leskre lurde, kolen tradau me ap hake rigja. Un o charo lell len palla.
Palle, te tradom len an wawar themma un mank wawar menshende, dikenn un haiwenn le, te hom me o baro Dewel.

O charo, i bok un i pharo nasslepen marenn bud lendar. Gar bud lendar mukau djido. Kolla nai penenn kol menshenge, pash lende jon djiwenn, hawo djungelo koowa i Israelitarja kran. Jaake dikenn un haiwenn kolla ninna, te hom me o baro Dewel.
Un o baro Dewel penas ap mande:
Tu, mensho, cha tiro maro trisslepah! Un an daar un trisslepen pijess tiro pani.

Un pen ap i Israelitarja, kai hi pash tute an kau them: Kawa penell o baro Dewel, maro rai, pral kolende, kai djiwenn an o foro Jerusalem an o them Israel: Bud tchilatcho koowa krenn le: Jek rikrell o wawares tele. Doleske well ko diwes, kai chan le pengro maro darjah, un pijenn pengro pani trisslepah i trashatar. Lengro them well i muklo them, kai tchi atchell.
An kol forja djiwell buder kek. Un o hachetikro them well i mulo them. Palle dikenn un haiwenn tumer, te hom me o baro Dewel.
Un o baro Dewel penas ap mande:
Tu mensho, pen mange, hawo rakepen hi kowa, hoi tumer rakrenn an o them Israel? Tumer penenn: O tsiro djal trujel un tchi well kolestar, hoi o Debleskre rakepangre penan.

Doleske pen ap lende: Kawa penell o baro Dewel, maro rai: Me sikrau lende, te hi kowa gar tchatcho. Un krau, te well ko rakepen gar buder rakedo an o them Israel. Pen lenge: O tsiro well sik, kai well lauter tchatcho hoi glan-wi penlo was.
Palle dikell kek mank i Israelitarja tchomone glan-wi, hoi tchi-moldo hi. Witar kek penell laba glan-wi, hoi i menshe kamenn te shunell, un hoi wenn gar o Deblestar.

Me, o baro Dewel, penau ap tumende! Kowa, hoi me rakrau, well ninna, un well an i tikno tsiro. Tumenge, kai mukenn tumen tchi te penell, penau me: Jaake rah har tumer djiwenn, krau, te well tchatcho, hoi penom. Kawa penau me, o baro Dewel, tumaro rai.
Un pale penas o baro Dewel ap mande:
Tu, mensho, shun, hoi penell o kheer Israel pral tute: “Ko dikepen, hoi kowa dikell, kowa well gar sik. Un kowa, hoi lo glan-wi penell, hi i tsireske, hoi gomme dur krik hi.”
Doleske pen lenge: Kawa penell o baro Dewel, miro rai: Kowa, hoi penom, well sik. Ko lab hoi me rakrom, well tchatcho. Kowa penau me, o baro Dewel, tumaro rai.
O baro Dewel penas ap mande:
Tu, mensho, de kolen an Israel trad, kai denn glan, te hi le mire rakepangre, un rakrenn dran pende win, un penenn ‘Kau lab well o Deblestar’. Pen lenge: Shunenn, hoi o baro Dewel penell tumenge!
Kawa penell o baro Dewel, maro rai: Bibacht well ap kol tchilatche rakepangre, kai penenn glan-wi, hoi dran lengro dji wella, un kolen kek dikepen dikan, hoi mandar was!
Tumer Israelitarja, kolla, kai penenn, te hi le tumaro Debleskre rakepangre, hi har diwje djukle, kai rodenn chapen mank i barra o tele-phagedo forestar.

Jon tchiwan pen gar pre an koi cheb, kai i barra win phagedo wan, un kran kek massuri trul o kheer Israel, te atchans le soreles tardo an o kurepen ap ko diwes, kai o baro Dewel o tchatchepen win krell pral lende.
Lengro dikepen hi tchi-moldo. Un lengro durkepen hi chochepen. Ninna te bitchras len gar o baro Dewel, penenn le ‘Jaake penas o baro Dewel’, un lurenn pre, te well kowa, hoi jon glan-wi penan.
Me penau lenge: Tumaro dikepen hi tchi-moldo. Un tumaro durkepen hi chochepen. Har nai penenn tumer: “Kawa penell o baro Dewel”, kai me tchi rakrom?
Doleske penell o baro Dewel, maro rai: Tumer rakrenn, hoi gar tchatcho hi, un penenn glan-wi, hoi chochepen hi, doleske wau me pral tumende, penell o baro Dewel, maro rai.

Miro wast well pral kol rakepangre, kai penenn glan-wi, hoi gar tchatcho hi, un kai durkrenn chochepen, te dap len i phagi. An o tsillo, kai mire menshe khetne wenn, nai wenn jon gar dren. Un an o liil, kai i laba i menshendar dran Israel dren tchinlo hi, wenn lengre laba gar dren tchinlo. Un an o them Israel wenn le gar palpale. Palle dikenn un haiwenn tumer, te hom me o baro Dewel, tumaro rai.

Jon anenn mire menshen o tchatcho dromestar tele, un penenn: “Lauter hi mishto.” Un tchatchepah, tchi hi mishto. Mire menshe kran pen i massuri dran barra, hoi rikrenn gar. Un i rakepangre wan, un makan lat parnes.
Pen kolenge, kai makenn parnepen koi pral: “Kai massuri perell khetne!” I sorelo brishin well, un brishineskre barra perenn, un i sorelo ducho phurdell.
Koi perell koi massuri khetne. Palle putchenn le tumendar: Kai hi ko shukar parnepen, hoi makan ap koi massuri?
Kawa penell o baro Dewel, maro rai: An miri tati choli mukau me i sorelo ducho win te phagell, un i sorelo brishin te well, un brishineskre barra te perell, te well i massuri paash dino.

Jaake phagau koi massuri tele, hoi tumer parnes makan. Me mukau lat trujel te witsrell, te wenn lakre telstune barra diklo. Te perell li khetne, perenn i barra ap tumende, un tumer merenn. Un tumer dikenn un haiwenn, te hom me o baro Dewel.
Te was miri tseli choli ap koi massuri un ap kolende, kai kran lat parno, penau ap tumende: Koi massuri hi buder gar koi, witar gar kolla, kai lat parnes makan.

Kolla hi i rakepangre an o them Israel, kai dan glan, te wals len i lab o Deblestar un penan i menshenge an Jerusalem glan-wi “lauter hi mishto”, ninna te hi tchi mishto. Kowa penau me, o baro Dewel, tumaro rai.
Tu mensho, pen ap i djuwjende tire menshendar, kai denn glan, te hi le Debleskre rakepangre! De len trad,

un pen lenge: Kawa penell o baro Dewel, maro rai: Bibacht well ap tumende! Tumer siwenn durkepangre dikle, hoi wenn pandlo trul i mussja un trul i sherja hakenestar, i ternendar un i phurendar, te well tumen soor pral lende. Kamenn tumer wawar menshen an o merepen te anell, un tumer kokres djido atchenn?

Tumaro durkepah anenn tumer ladj ap mande glan mire menshende, te lenn i wast pherdo djob un i kotar maro. Mire menshenge penenn tumer chochene laba. Un jon kamenn te shunell ap chochepen. Tumaro chochepah anenn tumer sawe menshen an o merepen, kai hunte merans gar, un krenn, te atchenn sawe djido, kai hunte merans.

Doleske penell o baro Dewel, maro rai: Me krau tumare durkepangre dikle paash, kolentsa taprenn tumer menshen har te wans le tchirkle. Kal dikle tserdau tumare mussjendar tele. Un lau kol menshen win, kolen tumer tapran, har te wans le tchirkle.
Un kol dikle, hoi tchiwan trul tumare sherja, tserdau krik. Un lau mire menshen dran tumaro wast win, te nai taprenn len buder gar. Palle dikenn un haiwenn tumer, te hom me o baro Dewel.

Tumare chochene labentsa dukran i djia kolendar, kai an o tchatchepen djiwenn, un kolenge kamom kek daar te krell. Un tumer kran i wasta kolendar sorelo, kai tchilatcho koowa krenn. Jaake kran tumer, te djan le gar tele lengro tchilatcho dromestar, te atchenn le djido.
Doleske krau, te penenn nai buder gar chochepen glan-wi, witar gar nai durkrenna! Na-a, me kamau mire menshen dran tumare wasta win te lell. Un tumer dikenn un haiwenn palle, te hom me o baro Dewel!
Un pash mande wan mursha i phurendar dran Israel, un jon beshan pen glan mande tele.
Koi penas o baro Dewel ap mande:
Tu, mensho, kal mursha rikran ap pengre chochene deblen, un tchiwan len pre glan pende, kolen, kai anenn len ap o tchilatcho drom. Hoske mukap man sawendar te putchell?

Pen lenge: Kawa penell o baro Dewel, maro rai: Hakeno dran o kheer Israel, kai kras peskro dji pre peskre chochene deblenge, un tchiwas len pre glan peste, kolen, kai anenn les ap o tchilatcho drom, un well palle pash miro rakepaskro, te putchell lo mandar tchomone, koleha rakrau me, o baro Dewel, jaake, har hunte well rakedo jekeha, kai bud chochene deblen an-mangell.
Jaake krau, te krenn i Israelitarja pengre djia pale mange pre, jon, kai mukan miro drom un mangenn wawar deblen an.
Doleske pen ap o kheer Israel: Kawa penell o baro Dewel, maro rai: Djan tele tumaro tchilatcho dromestar, un mukenn tumare chochene deblen, hoi jaake djungelo an mire jaka hi!

Hako Israelitari, un hako wi-themari pash tumende, kai mange o dumo sikrell, un peskro dji i chochene deblenge pre krell, un len glan peste tchiwell, kolen, kai anenn les ap o tchilatcho drom, un well palle pash miro rakepaskro, te putchell lo mandar tchomone, koleha rakrau me, o baro Dewel, kokres.

Me dikau tchilatches ap leste. Un ap leste dikenn i menshe, hoi saweha djal, kai sawo koowa krell, un jon rakrenn lestar i rah tsiro. Me krau les pale-tchiddo hako tsireske, te nai djiwell lo buder gar mank mire menshende. Jaake dikenn un haiwenn tumer, te hom me o baro Dewel.

Te mukell pes i Debleskro rakepaskro jaake dur te anell, te dell lo les i lab mandar dureder, palle krau me, o baro Dewel, te dell lo i chocheno lab dureder. Un me hadau miro wast pral leste, un krau les pale-tchiddo, te djiwell lo buder gar mank mire menshende Israel.
Jaake hunte hidjrenn kol dui pengri doosh: Kowa, kai putchas, un ko Debleskro rakepaskro.

Kowa krau, te perell o kheer Israel gar buder mandar tele, un krell pes buder gar pale-tchiddo dran ko tseli doosh, hoi le ap pende anenn. Un jon wenn mire menshe, un me wau lengro Dewel, penell o baro Dewel, maro rai.
Un o baro Dewel penas ap mande:

Tu, mensho, djiness, te phagenn i menshe an jek them mantsa, un rikrenn buder gar ap mande, dau me len i phagi. Un krau, te hi len buder gar doha maro. Un bitchrau i bok an o them, te merenn i menshe un i vieche i bokatar.

Ninna te wans kal triin mursha an ko them, o Noah, o Daniel un o Hiob, palle lans jon kokres pengro djipen dran o merepen win, kek wawar lentsa. Jon djiwan an o tchatchepen. Doleske loms len kokres dran o merepen win. Kawa penau me o baro Dewel, tumaro rai.
Te anoms diwje viechen an o them, kai marenn kolen, kai kote djiwenn, un o tselo them wals i mulo them, kai kek buder ap o drom hi i darjatar kol diwje viechendar,

un kal triin mursha wans ninna an ko them, nai lans le kokres pengro djipen dran o merepen win, un gar lengre tchawen un tchen. Un o them wals i mulo them. Jaake dau man sowel pash miro djipen, penell o baro Dewel, maro rai.
Te mukoms me i kurepen win te phagell an ko them, un mukoms menshen un viechen kote mulo te dell,
un kal triin mursha wans an ko them, nai lans le kokres pengro djipen dran o merepen win, un gar lengre tchawen un tchen. Jaake dau man sowel pash miro djipen, penell o baro Dewel, maro rai.
Te bitchroms i pharo nasslepen an ko them, un mukoms an miri tati choli menshen un viechen te merell,

un o Noah, o Daniel un o Hiob wans ninna an ko them, palle lans le gar pengre tchawen un tchen dran o merepen win. Kokres pengro djipen nai lans le dran o merepen win doleske, kai djiwan jon an o tchatchepen. Jaake dau man sowel pash miro djipen, penell o baro Dewel, maro rai.
Un kanna penell o baro Dewel, maro rai: Ap ko tsiro, kai bitchrau star phare dawa pral ko foro Jerusalem – kurepen, bok, diwje vieche un pharo nasslepen, – te merenn i menshe un vieche koi dren,

palle hi sawe koi, kai atchenn djido lendar. Kolla wenn khetne pengre tchawentsa un tchentsa win anlo pash tumende an o them Babilonia. Te dikenn tumer palle, har jon djiwenn, un hoi le krenn, well tumari duk pral koi bari bibacht tikneder, hoi anom pral o foro Jerusalem.

Te dikenn tumer, har le djiwenn, un hoi le krenn, haiwenn tumer, hoske me kowa jaake o foreha Jerusalem hunte krom. Un tumari duk koi pral well krik lino dran tumare djia. Kowa penau me, o baro Dewel, tumaro rai.
Un o baro Dewel penas ap mande:
Tu, mensho, pen mange: Hi o kasht i drakengro rukestar feteder har o wawar kasht dran o weesh?
Well lo lino, te krell jek tchomone lestar? Nai well lo an i massuri dino, te pandell jek tchomone ap leste?
Na-a, i drakengro kasht well an i jag witsedo, te well lo chatchedo. Te chatchras o glanstuno kotar un o palstuno kotar lestar un kowa mashkral hi an-chatchedo, hi lo gomme tchomone moldo?
Na-a! Har his ko kasht gomme tseles, nai kras kek tchomone lestar. Kanna, kai hi lo chatchedo, hi lo budeder tchi-moldo.
Doleske penell o baro Dewel, maro rai: Jaake har krom, te hi o drakengro kasht tchi wawareske moldo, har te well lo chatchedo, jaake krau ninna kolentsa, kai djiwenn an o foro Jerusalem.
Me dikau tchilatches ap lende, un dau len pengri phagi: Bis kanna wan le dran i jag win. Kanna well i jag pral lende, un chatchrenn len pre. Koi pre dikenn un haiwenn tumer, te hom me o baro Dewel.
Me krau, te well o them i mulo them. Kowa krau doleske, kai phagan le mantsa, penell o baro Dewel, maro rai.
Un o baro Dewel penas ap mande:
Tu mensho, rike i menshenge an o foro Jerusalem glan i jaka, hawo djungelo koowa jon kran!
Pen lenge: Kawa penell o baro Dewel, maro rai: O them Kanaan hi o them, dran koleste tire phure wan, un kai tu boldo wal. Tiro dad his i Amorari, tiri dai i menshendar Het.
Ap ko diwes, har tu boldo wal, his kowa jaake: Kek tchinas koi dori tele, kolah ap tiri date pandlo hals. Witar kek thowas tut an pani tele, un makas tut o loneha tele. Kek tchiwas pherne trul tute.
Kekes khaital tu, te krals lo sawo koowa ap tute dran kamlepen. Na-a, tu wal tchiddo muklo win ap i phub. Jaake his ap ko diwes, har tu boldo wal. Kek kamas tut.
Kote djom me kote miro drom, kai tu tchiddo hals. Un me dikom tut, har tu ratles koi tchiddo hals. Un me penom ap tute: Tu atchess djido! Awa, ap tute penom: Tu djiwess,
un wess baro! Tu wal har i shukar bluma. Un wal baro un i un shukar djuwel. Tire tchutchja wan baro un tire balla lengsto. Nango hals.

Un me djom miro drom, kai tu hals, un dikom tut. Un tiro tsiro was, te kamess i murshes un kress le bijab. Kote tchiwom miri baja pral tute un tchakrom tut. Un me djom tuha i sowel dren, un pandom miro dji ap tute, un penom: “Tu wess miro.” Kawa hi, hoi penas o baro Dewel, maro rai.
Un me thowom tut an pani, un thowom o rat tutar tele, un makom tut djeteha.

Un me riwom tut an raile ripja, kai shukar koowa dren sido his, un tchiwom kircha dran latcho ledera ap tire pire, un i pandepen dran kutch laintikro than ap tiro shero. Un i baja dran phar tchiwom trul tute.
Un kutch koowa tchiwom ap tute: Werklia trul tire mussja, un trul tiri meen,
i gustri an tiro nak, un kanengre an tire kanda, un i kutch rajeskri stadi ap tiro shero.

Un jaake wal tu shukar kerdo o sonakajeha un rupeha. Un tire koola his dran kutch laintikro than un dran phar. Un tut his raile ripja kerdo an shukar subjakri budi. Un tu chal o chapen dran latcho jarro, gwin un djet. Un tu hals i shukapen un wal i rajetsa.
Un tutar was an i wawar themma penlo, har shukar tu hal. Ko kutch koowa, hoi ap tute tchiwom, kras tiro shukapen jaake baro, te nai wals gar bareder. Kawa hi, hoi penas o baro Dewel, maro rai.
Un tu wal pre-phurdo dran tiro shukapen. Un har i wawar tut jaake sharan, witsral tut hakeneske ap i meen, kai kote djas, kai tu hals, un dal tut leske.
Un tu lal tire raile ripjendar, un tchiwal len kote ap i phub, kai i chochene debla an-mangedo wan. Un jaake har i lubni dal tut hakeneske, kai kamas. Sawo koowa das an kek tsiro, un well buder gar.
Un tu lal ko kutch koowa dran sonakai un rup, hoi me tut dom, un kral tuke figure lestar, un mangal len an, un chochral man jaake lentsa.
Un tu lal ninna tire raile ripja, kai hi kerdo an shukar subjakri budi, un riwal len lenge an. Un glan lende tchiwal ko djet un ko sungepaskro koowa, hoi mandar lal.
Un kowa hoi dom me tut te chal, ko latcho jarro, djet un gwin tchiwal tu glan lende, te dikenn le latches ap tute. Awa, jaake dur djal tu, penell o baro Dewel, maro rai.
Tire tchawe un tcha, kai hi mire tchawe, kolen lal tu un dal len lenge mulo, te chan le len pre. His tuke gar doha, te mukal man?
Hunte lal gomme mire tchawen un dal len mulo, un mukal len i chochene deblenge te chatchrell?
Un pash ko tselo djungelo koowa, hoi tu kral, un har i lubni djiwal, bistral ko tsiro, kai terno hals, un nango hals un ratles tchiddo hals.
Har djungeles djal tuke, penell o baro Dewel, maro rai! Gar kokres kau tchilatcho koowa kral!
Na-a, ap i tsele platse, kai menshe khetne wenn an i foro, kral tuke mangepaskre platse, kai mangal chochene deblen an.
Un kote kai i dromma khetne wenn, kral mangepaskre platse un kral te was tiro shukapen tchadepaske. Un sowal hakeneha, kai was tuke ap o drom. Un tiro lubjengro koowa was budeder un budeder.
Tu lubras trujel i Egiptarentsa, kolen bari chantch hi, un kolengro them pash tiro them tchiddo hi. Un kral bud lubjengro koowa, te tapras man i choli.

Doleske hadom miro wast, te dap tut i phagi, un lom tuke i kotar them krik kolestar, hoi dom tut. Un i djuwjenge an o them Filistia, kai his chojedo ap tute, dom tut an i wasta, te krenn le tuha, har jon kamenn. Un jon ladjan pral tiro wi-ladjedo djipen.
Tu lal gar doha, un lubral kolentsa dran o them Assur trujel. Un ninna kowa his tuke gar doha.
Koi kral gomme budeder lubjengro koowa, un lubral trujel kolentsa dran o them Babilonia, kai i parepangre djiwenn. Un ninna kolendar lal gar doha.
Har chatchell miri choli pral tute, te kral tu kowa lauter, penell o baro Dewel, maro rai. Tu wal i bari wi-ladjedi lubni.
Kote kai i dromma khetne wenn, un ap haki platsa kral mangepaskre platse, kai chochene deblen an-mangal. Un tu hals gar har wawar lubja: Tu kamal kek lowe koleske, hoi kral.
Tu hal har i djuwel, kai chochras peskro romes, un sowal wawar murshentsa un gar tiro romeha.
Haki wawar lubjat well lowe dino. Tu dal gomme kolen, kai tut lan, tchomone. Un ginal len, te wenn le pash tute dran kol themma, kai le hi, un sowenn tuha.
Jaake kral wawartchandes har i wawar lubja: Tuke nashas kek palla. Un kek das tut lowe. Tu plaissral len! Jaake kral wawartchandes har wawar lubja krenn.
Doleske shun, Jerusalem, tu lubni, hoi o baro Dewel penell!
Kawa penell o baro Dewel, maro rai: Tiri chantch his baro. Un har i lubni sikral tut nanges glan tire pirnende, un mangal tire djungele chochene deblen an, un maral lenge tire tchawen.

Doleske dik, me kharau lauteren khetne, kai tuha trujel kran, un an kolengre jaka jaake shukar hals, kolen tu kamal, un kolen gar kamal. Un dran i tsele themma, hoi trul tute tchiddo hi, anau len khetne, te djan le ap tute pre. Palle riwau tuke glan lengre jaka tire koola win, te dikenn le tut, har tu nango hal.
Un me dau tut sawi phagi, har kol djuwja lenna, kai chochran pengro romes un maran i menshes. Un me mukau miri soreli choli pral tute te well.

Un me dau tut an lengre wasta, te denn le tire mangepaskre platse khetne, kai chochene deblen an-mangal, un randjenn tuke tire koola win, un lenn penge tiro sonakaskro koowa, un mukenn tut nanges tchiddo.
Un jon lenn bud menshen khetne, kai djan khatar tute, un witsrenn tut barrentsa mulo. Un pengre charentsa denn le tut an kotja.
Un tire khera chatchrenn le an i jag pre, un denn tut tiri phagi glan i jaka bud djuwjendar. Jaake krau, te nai lubreh buder gar trujel, un nai gineh tuke buder kek pirnes.
Palle djal miri tati choli pral tute krik, un miro dji dukrell man buder gar, un hom buder gar chojedo pral tute.

Tu bistral, hoi tuke krom, har terno hals. Un choiral man ko tselo koweha, hoi kral. Bud djungelo koowa kral, un koi pashel kral wi-ladjedo koowa. Doleske anau kowa lauter, hoi kral, ap tiro shero pale, penell o baro Dewel, maro rai.
Jerusalem, tu dikess: Menshe san pral tute kal gosewe labentsa: “Jaake har i dai, jaake ninna i tchai.”

Tu hal i tchai tiri datar, koja peskro romeske un peskre tchawenge o dumo sikras. Un tu hal i pheen tiri phenjatar, kai peskro romeske un peskre tchawenge o dumo sikras. Tumari dai his i menshendar Het un tumaro dad his i Amorari.
Tiri phureder pheen hi i Samaria peskre tchentsa, kolla ap i serwi rig tutar djiwenn. Un tiri tikni pheen, hoi ap i tchatchi rig tutar djiwell, hi i Sodom peskre tchentsa.
Tuke his gar doha, te djas ap lengre tchilatche dromma, un te kress ko djungelo koowa, hoi jon kran! Na-a, tu wal gomme tchilatcheder har jon, un kral gomme djungleder koowa har jon kran.
Doleske dau man sowel pash miro djipen, me o baro Dewel, tumaro rai: I Sodom, tiri pheen, un lakre tcha kran gar sawo wi-ladjedo koowa, har kral tu un tire tcha!

Koi doosh tiri phenjatar Sodom his kaja: Joi his pre-phurdo. Lat his budeder har doha chapen un djiwas pengre tchentsa i shukar djipen. Kol tchorwelenge un kolenge, kai tele rikede wan, wan le gar ap i rig.
Na-a, jon kran pen bares, un kran glan mire jaka, hoi mange djungeles hi. Doleske lom lat ninna krik, har kowa latar dikom.

Tu hal budeder har dui kope jaake tchilatcho har i Samaria. Tu kral budeder djungelo koowa har i Sodom un i Samaria kran. Te dikell jek ap tute, un palle ap lende, hunte patsell lo, te hi kol dui latche forja.

Kanna hunte hidjress tiri ladj! Tiri doosh hi jaake bud bareder har tire phenjengri doosh. Un jon dikenn langs tute win, har te wals len kek doosh. Jaake dau tute i bareder phagi har lende dom. Doleske ladjess tu tut. Hidje tiri ladj!
O diwes well, kai krau, te well lauter pale latches i forjenge Sodom un Samaria un kol gabenge trul lende. Un ninna tuke well lauter pale mishto.

Kowa krau, te hidjress tiri ladj un ladjess pral halauter, hoi kral, jaake te dikenn i forja Sodom un Samaria, te anan le gar jaake bud doosh ap pende har tu ap tute anal. Palle lenn lengre djia newi soor.
Un tire phenja, i Sodom un i Samaria, un lengre tcha wenn pale jaake, har jon glan kowa his. Ninna tu un tire tcha wenn pale jaake, har tumer glan kowa hans.
An ko tsiro, kai jaake pre-phurdo hals, rakral pal tiri phenjate Sodom.
Palle was ko tsiro, kai dikas hakeno, har tchilatcho hals. Un kanna dikenn i menshe an i themma Edom un Filistia un an i wawar themma, hoi trul tute hi, ap tute tele un praassenn tut.
Jaake perell tiro wi-ladjedo un djungelo koowa ap tute pale. Un tu hunte hidjress tiri ladj. Kawa penell o baro Dewel.
Kawa penell o baro Dewel, maro rai: Awa, me krau tuke jaake, har tu kral: Tu dal tut sowel, te rikreh ap mande, un rikral koi sowel gar.
Ninna te rikral tiro lab gar, bistrau me kowa gar, hoi tuha win krom, har hals terno. Un me krau tuha pale newes win, te wap tiro Dewel. Un kowa, hoi tuha newes win krau, atchell hako tsireske.
Palle ladjeh tut pral kowa, hoi kral, te dikeh, har lau tiri phureder un tiri terneder pheen, un tchiwau tut pral lende, te wenn le tuke har tire tcha. Kowa hi bud budeder har tuke win krom.
Te krau tuha newes win, te wap tiro Dewel, dikeh un haiweh tu, te hom me o baro Dewel.
Me lau tiri tseli doosh tutar krik, hoi ap tute anal. Te well tuke palle tiro phuro djipen an o shero, ladjeh tu, un nai kreh tiro mui buder gar pre i ladjatar. Kawa penau me, o baro Dewel, tiro rai.
Un o baro Dewel penas ap mande:
Tu, mensho, pen i menshenge dran o kheer Israel phare laba, un putch lendar, hoi kamenn kolla te penell!

Pen lenge: Kawa penell o baro Dewel, maro rai: Kote his i baro adlari. Koles his bare mussja un pesse shukar phora trul peskro shero. Kowa djas ap i berga Libanon un phagas o pralstuno kotar i rukestar krik, hoi kharell zedera,
un anas ko pralstuno kasht an o them, kai i parepangre hi, un tchiwas les kote an i foro an i phub.
Palle las lo i drab dran o them un tchiwas les an latchi phub, kai bud pani his. Pash ko pani tchiwas lo les an i phub.

Un ko drab anas kashta un patria win, un was i drakengro ruk. Kowa was buchlo un atchas tikno. Leskre kashta djan kote, kai o adlari hi. Un leskre draba djan dur tele an i phub. Jaake was dran ko drab i drakengro ruk, kolestar wan kashta un newe tikne burra win.

Un kote his i wawar baro adlari. Koles his ninna bare mussja un bud phora trul peskro shero. Un kanna rissras o drakengro ruk peskre draba un kashta pash koleste, te dell kowa les budeder pani, har koi phub, an kolate job dren tchiddo was,
ninna te his job an latchi phub dren tchiddo, un his tardo pash bud pani. Un lestar nai djans bud kashta win, un nai djans bud drake ap leste pre, jaake te wals lo i shukar drakengro ruk.

Kanna putchell tumendar o baro Dewel, tumaro rai: Well o drakengro ruk bareder? Atchell lo djido? Hi gar jaake, te well o ersto adlari un tserdell les khetne peskre drabentsa win dran i phub, un phagell i drake lestar tele, jaake te merenn leskre newe senele patria lauter tele, un ko tselo bur merell? Palle well lo wi-tserdedo khetne peskre drabentsa. Un koleske hunte well kekes bud soor, un gar bud menshe.

Jaake well o bur gar baro, ninna te was lo an i phub tchiddo. Te well o sorelo tato ducho fun kotar, kai o kham pre djal, un phurdell ap leste, merell lo tele, ap koi platsa, kai was job an i phub tchiddo.
Un o baro Dewel penas ap mande:

Pen kol menshenge, kai mukenn pen tchi te penell: Haiwenn tumer gar, hoi kowa kamell te penell? O baro rai dran o them Babilonia was an Jerusalem, un las leskro baro rajes un leskre pralstunen pandles, un anas len pash peste an o foro Babilon.

Un job las o rajeskre tchawendar jekes, un kras leha win, te well job o rai pral o them Juda, un mukas les i sowel te dell, te perell lo gar lestar tele. I pralstunen dran ko them las lo pandles an Babilonia,
te well ko them Juda gar sorelo un nai hadell pes gar, un te well kowa dren rikedo, hoi jon win kran.

I tsiro koi pre hadas pes o rai o themestar Juda, un bitchras murshen an o them Egiptia, te bitchrenn le leske graja un lurden. Djal kowa mishto? Lell jek, kai sawo koowa krell, kek phagi? Nai phagell lo peskri sowel, un lell kek phagi?

Me dau man sowel pash miro djipen, penell o baro Dewel, maro rai: Ko rai pral Juda phagas peskri sowel, un rikras gar dren, hoi lo o baro rajeha dran o them Babilonia win kras, koleha, kai les rai kras. Doleske merell lo an koleskro foro – mashkral an Babilon.

Un o Farao peskre bud lurdentsa well witar gar ap leskri rig, ap ko tsiro, kai hunte kurell lo pes. I Babilonarja wenna, un tchiwenn bud tchik pre win trul o foreskri massuri, te nai djan le koi pral ap o foreskri massuri pre. Un jon krenn turme, te denn le karje tele an o foro, jaake te marenn le bud menshen.

O rai pral Juda phagas peskri sowel. Un kowa, hoi lo win kras ko baro rajeha dran Babilonia, un ap kowa job peskro wast das, rikras lo gar dren. Kau tselo koowa kras job. Doleske well lo gar win lino dran i bibacht.

Doleske penell o baro Dewel, maro rai: Jaake har tchatcho hi, kai djiwau, jaake hi tchatcho, te anap ap leskro shero pale, hoi lo kras. Job phagas peskri sowel, hoi das lo glan mande, un rikras gar dren, hoi lo mantsa win kras.
Me witsrau miri netsa pral leste win, te well lo tapedo an mire dorja. Un anau les an o them Babilonia. Kote dau les i phagi koleske, kai phagas lo mantsa.
Un leskre wi-rodede lurde wenn o chareha mulo dino. Un kolla, kai djido atchenn, wenn tradedo ap hake rigja. Un tumer dikenn un haiwenn, te rakrom me, o baro Dewel.

Kawa penell o baro Dewel, maro rai: Me phagau ko tikni kasht, hoi pralstunes ap i zedertikro ruk win was, un tchiwau les an i phub dren. Awa, me lau i pralstune kashtendar i terno newo kasht, un tchiwau les an i phub ap i berga, hoi bareder hi har halauter trul leste.

Pral ap koi bari berga an o them Israel, kote tchiwau les an i phub. Un job lell bud kashta un hidjrell rukengre, un well i railo zedertikro ruk. Un an leste djiwenn bud tchirkle un hi khere mank leskre kashta.

Un i tsele ruka an o them dikenn un haiwenn, te hom me o baro Dewel. I baro rukes krau tikno, un i tikno rukes krau baro. I senelo rukes mukau tele te merell, un i truk rukes senelo te well. Me, o baro Dewel, penau kowa, un krau kowa ninna.
Un o baro Dewel penas ap mande:
Hoske penenn tumer an o them Israel kau lab: I phure chan shutle drake, un i ternenge dukenn i danda.
Me, o baro Dewel, dau man sowel: Jaake har tchatcho hi, kai djiwau, jaake well sawo lab tumendar an o them Israel buder gar rakedo!
Djinenn, man hi o djipen hakenestar an miro wast – o dadeskro djipen jaake har o tchaweskro djipen. Kokres kowa, kai anell doosh ap peste, hunte merell.
I mursh, kai djiwell an o tchatchepen un krell, hoi mishto un tchatcho hi,

kowa chal tchi ko massestar, hoi i chochene deblenge dino was. Job mangell gar i chochene deblen an, kolen i Israelitarja an-mangenn, un djal gar i wawareskri romjah, un sowell gar i djuwjah an ko tsiro, kai lat peskro koowa hi.

Job rikrell kekes sorjah tele. Te patsas lo lowe win, dell lo kowa pale, hoi das les ko tchorwelo ko tsireske, kai les sijaan pash leste hi. Job lell kekestar tchomone sorjah peske. Peskro maro dell lo koles, kones bok hi, ninna koola koles, kai kek an-ripaske hi.
Te patsas lo lowe win, lell lo peske gar budeder lowe pale. Job rikrell peskro wast pale, te krell lo kek tchilatchepen. Un an i tchingepen dell lo jak, te lell hakeno peskro tchatchepen.
Job krell, hoi lestar kamau, un djiwell pal miro tchatchepen. Sawo menshes hi kek doosh ap peste. Job atchell djido. Kowa penau me, o baro Dewel, tumaro rai.
Hoi djal, te well leske i mursh tchawo boldo? Un kowa hi i tchi-moldo, kai dell i wawares mulo, un krell ko tselo koowa,
hoi leskro dad gar kras. Un chal ko massestar, hoi i chochene deblen dino was, un djal i wawareskri romjah,

un rikrell i tchorwelen sorjah tele, ninna kolen, kolen gar doha djipaske hi, un lell sorjah peske, hoi gar leskro hi. Te patsas lo lowe win, dell lo kowa gar pale, hoi das les ko tchorwelo ko tsireske, kai les sijaan pash leste hi. Un job mangell i chochene deblen an, un krell, hoi glan o Debleske jaka djungeles hi.
Te patsell lo lowe win, lell lo peske budeder lowe pale. Nai atchell sawo mensho djido? Na-a! Koon sawo djungelo koowa kras, hunte merell. Job hunte lell peskri phagi!
Hoi djal, te well koleske i mursh tchawo boldo, un kowa dikell ko tselo tchilatcho koowa, hoi leskro dad kras? Un ninna te dikell lo kowa, krell job kowa gar.
Job mangell gar kol chochene deblen an, hoi i Israelitarja an-mangenn, un chal gar o massestar, hoi lenge dino was. I wawareskri romjah djal lo gar.

Kekes rikrell lo sorjah tele. Te hi jekes sijaan pash leste, mangell lo lestar tchi ko tsireske, kai koles sijaan pash leste hi. Job lell gar sorjah peske, hoi o wawares hi. Un dell kolen maro, kolen bok hi, un koola kolen, kolen tchi an-ripaske hi.

Job rikrell peskro wast pale, te krell lo kek tchilatchepen. Te patsas lo lowe win, lell lo gar budeder lowe pale. Jaake djiwell lo pal miro tchatchepen un krell, hoi lestar kamau. Sawo mensho hunte merell gar. Job atchell djido, ninna te las leskro dad bud doosh ap peste.
Leskro dad, kowa, kai chochras i wawaren, un las peske sorjah, hoi i wawares hi, un kras wawar tchilatcho koowa mank peskre menshende, kowa hunte merell ko tselo tchilatchepaske, hoi lo kras.
Tumer putchenn: “Hoske hidjrell ko tchawo gar i doosh peskro dadestar?” Me penau tumenge: O tchawo kras, hoi mishto un tchatcho his, un rikras halauter, hoi lestar kamom. Doleske atchell job djido.

Kokres kowa, kai doosh ap peste anell, hunte merell. I tchawo hunte hidjrell gar i doosh peskro dadestar. Witar gar hunte hidjrell o dad koi doosh, hoi o tchawo ap peste anas. Kowa, kai o tchatchepen kras, ap leste well leskro tchatchepen pale. Un kowa, kai doosh ap peste anas, ap leste well leskri doosh pale.
I tchilatcho, kai mukell peskro tchilatcho drom, un ko tselo tchilatcho koowa, hoi lo kras, un krell kanna, hoi lestar kamau, un hoi mishto un tchatcho hi, sawo hunte merell gar.
Ko tselo tchilatcho koowa, hoi lo kras, well bistedo! Dran ko latcho un tchatcho koowa, hoi lo kanna krell, atchell lo djido.

Patsenn tumer, an mire jaka wals mishto, te merell kowa, kai tchilatcho koowa kras? putchell o baro Dewel, maro rai. Na-a, an mire jaka hi shukar, te mukell lo peskro tchilatcho drom un atchell djido.

I latcho mursh, te mukell job peskro latcho drom, un krell kanna o tchilatchepen, un ko tselo djungelo koowa, hoi ko tchilatcho kras, atchell lo djido? Na-a! Ko tselo latcho un tchatcho koowa, hoi lo kras, well bistedo. Job mukas o Debleskro drom un anas doosh ap peste. Doleske hunte merell lo.
Tumer penenn: O Dewel djal gar pal o tchatchepen. Shunenn, tumer dran o kheer Israel! Djau me gar pal o tchatchepen? Hi gar jaake, te han tumer kolla, kai djan gar pal o tchatchepen?
Te djal i latcho mensho peskro tchatcho dromestar tele, un krell o tchilatchepen, hunte merell lo. Dran peskro tchilatchepen, hoi lo kras, hunte merell lo.
I tchilatcho, kai djas tele peskro tchilatcho dromestar, un djiwell buder gar an o tchilatchepen, un krell kanna hoi mishto un tchatcho hi, kowa atchell djido.
Job dikas peskri tseli doosh dren, hoi lo ap peste anas, un mukas peskro tchilatcho drom, doleske atchell lo djido un hunte merell gar.
Un kote penenn tumer Israelitarja: “O Dewel djal gar pal o tchatchepen.” Hom me kowa, kai djal gar pal o tchatchepen? Hi gar jaake, te han tumer kolla, kai djan gar pal o tchatchepen?

Doleske penau me, o baro Dewel, tumaro rai: Me krau o tchatchepen win pral tumende dran o kheer Israel – pral hakeneste, jaake har djiwas lo. Mukenn tumaro tchilatcho drom! Krenn buder gar ko tselo tchilatcho koowa, hoi kran, te anenn kek doosh ap tumende.
Mukenn tumare tchilatche dromma! Un lenn tumenge i newo dji un i newo ducho! Hoske kamenn tumer te merell, tumer dran o kheer Israel?
Mange hi gar shukar, te hunte merell jek, penell o baro Dewel, maro rai. Doleske mukenn tumare tchilatche dromma, un djiwenn!
O baro Dewel penas mange: Tu, gib i ropaskri gili pral i rajende dran o kheer Israel.
Un pen: Hawi raili lewetsa his tiri dai! Mashkral terne lewe his li tchiddo, un tserdas peskre tchawen baro.
Un jek lendar, hoi tserdas li pre, was i terno sorelo lewo, Leske sikras li, har te dandrell lo viechen mulo, un ninna menshen chas lo pre.
Har i menshe an wawar themma lestar shunan, tapran le les an pengri gruba, un tserdan les shellentsa an o them Egiptia.
Un i dai luras, te well lo pale. Har dikas li, te luras li tchitcheske, un job buder gar pale was, kote las li i wawares peskre tchawendar un tserdas les baro.
Kowa djiwas mank i wawar lewe, was i sorelo terno lewo, un djinas, har te dandrell lo viechen mulo, un ninna menshen chas lo.
An forja un sorele khera phagas lo dren, un kras len paash; muklo atchenn le tchiddo. Un i menshe an ko them daran un trissan, har das lo gole.
Kote tchiwan pen i menshe dran i themma koi trujel, khetne, te djan le ap leste. Un witsran pengri netsa pral leste, un tapran les an lengri gruba.

Un jon tchiwan leske i gustri an o nak un i kasht trul leskri meen, un anan les pash o rajeste an o them Babilonia. Un kote tchiwan le les an o stilepen, te was leskri gole buder gar shunlo ap i berge an Israel.
Tiri dai his har i drakengro ruk, hoi was pash o pani an i phub tchiddo. Un har les jaake bud pani his, hidjras lo bud drake, un bud senele kashta his ap leste.
Un kolla wan jaake sorelo, te nai krans le rajengre kashta dran lende. Ko bur was baro, bareder har kol wawar ruka trul leste. Hakeno nai dikas, har sorelo job his, un har bud senele kashta les his.

Koi was i chojedo wast, un tserdas les win dran i phub, un witsras les tele. Un i tato ducho, hoi was fun kotar, kai o kham pre djal, mukas leskre drake truk te well. Leskre sorele kashta wan tele phagedo, te meran le tele un wan an i jag chatchedo.
Kanna hi ko drakengro ruk an i mulo tato them tardo, kai kek pani hi.

Un i jag djas win dran leskro pesseder kasht, un chatchras leskre drake. Kek sorelo kasht atchas buder pral, kolestar nai wals i rajeskro kasht kerdo. Kawa hi i ropaskri gili. Koja was giwedo kolendar, kolengro dji rowas.
An o eftato bersh an o pantchto tchon ap o deshto diwes an ko tchon, kote wan mursha kol phurendar dran Israel pash mande, te putchenn le o baro Deblestar tchomone. Un jon beshan glan mande tele.
Koi penas o baro Dewel ap mande:

Tu, mensho, pen kol phurenge dran Israel: Kawa penell o baro Dewel, maro rai: Tumer wan, te putchenn mandar? Me dau man sowel pash miro djipen: Me mukau man gar tumendar te putchell, me gar, penell o baro Dewel, maro rai.
Ap mande penas lo: Tu mensho, rake pral lende o tchatchepen win! Kre kowa! Rike lenge ko djungelo koowa glan i jaka, hoi lengre phure kran!

Pen lenge: Kawa penell o baro Dewel, maro rai: Me rodom i Israelitarja win, te wenn le mire menshe. Har jon gomme an o them Egiptia his, penom lenge, koon me hom. Awa, me hadom miro wast pre, te dap man sowel, un penom kolenge dran o kheer Jakob: Me, o baro Dewel, hom tumaro Dewel.

Me dau man sowel, te anap tumen win dran o them Egiptia un anau tumen an i them, koles me tumenge win rodom. Kowa hi i them, kai budeder har doha thud un gwin hi. Kau them hi shukeder har i tsele wawar themma.

Un me penom ap lende: Hakeno tumendar hunte witsrell kol djungele figuren krik, hoi lo an-mangell. Rikrenn tumen pale kol chochene deblendar, kolen i Egiptarja an-mangenn, te wenn tumer gar pale-tchiddo! Me, o baro Dewel, hom tumaro Dewel.

Jon mukan pen tchi mandar te penell, un kaman gar ap mande te shunell. Kek witsras kol djungele figuren krik, hoi lo an-mangas. Kol egiptikre deblen kaman le gar te mukell. Kote kamom miri choli pral lende win te tchorell. Gomme kote an o them Egiptia kamom miri tseli choli ap lende win te mukell.
Palle krom kowa gar, te nai rakrenn kol wawar menshe gar djungeles pral mande, mank kolende jon his, un glan kolende me penom, te hom o Israeleskro Dewel, un te anap len win dran o them Egiptia.
Un me anom len win dran o them Egiptia, un anom len an o mulo tato them.
Un kote penom lenge, hoi lendar kamau, har te djiwenn le pal miro tchatchepen. Miro tchatchepen hi kowa, koleha i mensho djido atchell, te rikrell lo pes ap leste.

Ninna tchiwom o diwes dren, hoi mange hi, kai hunte budrenn le gar. Ko diwes his o sikepen koleske, hoi win kram. Jaake kamom, te djinenn i Israelitarja, kai me, o baro Dewel, rodom len mange win, te wenn le mire menshe.

Ninna an o mulo tato them mukan pen i Israelitarja tchi mandar te penell. Jon djiwan gar jaake, har lendar kamom. Un ap mire tchatchepaskre laba dan le tchi. Un mire tchatchepaskre laba hi kolla, kolentsa o mensho djido atchell, te rikrell lo pes ap lende. Un jon kran bud koowa ap o Debleskro diwes, hoi hunte krans le gar, un jaake wom gar sharedo. Kote kamom miri choli pral lende win te tchorell, te hunte merans le lauter an o mulo tato them.
Palle krom kowa gar, te nai rakrenn kol wawar menshe gar djungeles pral mande, glan kolengre jaka mire menshen win anom dran o them Egiptia.
Me hadom miro wast pre, un dom man sowel, te anau len gar an ko them, hoi lenge win rodom, ko them, an koleste budeder har doha thud un gwin hi, un hoi shukeder hi har i tsele wawar themma.
Kowa wals i phagi doleske, kai dan le tchi ap mire tchatchepaskre laba, un kran gar, hoi lendar kamom, un rikran gar o Debleskro diwes dren. Na-a, pengre chochene deblen nashan le palla!
Palle khaitan le man. Doleske rikrom man pale, te marap len halauteren kote an o mulo tato them.

Un me penom lengre tchawenge an o mulo tato them: Ma rikrenn tumen ap kol laba, pal kolende tumare phure djiwan! Ma djiwenn pal lengre tchatchepangre laba! Rikrenn tumen pale lengre chochene deblendar, te wenn tumer gar pale-tchiddo!
Me, o baro Dewel, hom tumaro Dewel. Rikrenn tumen ap mire laba, hoi tumenge sikrenn, hoi tumendar kamau! Djiwenn pal mire tchatchepaskre laba!
Un rikrenn o Debleskro diwes dren, te krenn kek budi ap leste. Ko diwes hi i sikepen koleske, hoi win kram, te djinenn tumer, te hom me, o baro Dewel, tumaro Dewel.

Un ninna lengre tchawe mukan pen tchi mandar te penell, un kran gar hoi lendar kamom, un djiwan gar pal miro tchatchepen. Mire tchatchepaskre laba hi kolla, kolentsa i mensho djido atchell, te rikrell lo pes ap lende. Un jon kran sawo koowa ap o Debleskro diwes, hoi hunte krans le gar. Un jaake wom gar sharedo. Kote kamom miri choli pral lende win te tchorell. Kote an o mulo tato them kamom miri tseli choli ap lende win te mukell.
Un pale rikrom man pale un krom lenge tchi, te nai rakrenn kol wawar menshe gar djungeles pral mande, glan kolengre jaka mire menshen win anom dran o them Egiptia.
Me hadom miro wast pre, un dom man sowel kote an o mulo tato them, te tradap len an wawar themma un mank wawar menshende,
doleske, kai djiwan le gar pal miro tchatchepen un kran gar, hoi lendar kamom, un budran ap o Debleskro diwes, un nashan kol chochene deblenge palla, kolen lengre phure an-mangan.
Un ninna dom len tchatchepaskre laba, hoi tchi-moldo his, un hoi anan lenge kek djipen.

Un har mukan le pengre phureder mursh tchawen i chochene deblenge te chatchrell, rakrom pral lende win: “Tumer han mange pale-tchiddo.” Jaake kamom len bari daar te krell, te haiwenn le, te hom me o baro Dewel.
Tu, mensho, rake ap o kheer Israel, un pen lenge: Kawa penell o baro Dewel, maro rai: Tumare phure anan ladj ap mande, har phagan le mantsa.

Har me len an o them anom, kolestar man sowel dom, te dap les lende, mangan le wawar deblen an. Hako kopo, kai dikan le i tikni berga oder i baro ruk bud patjentsa, chatchran le viechen i chochene deblenge, un kran man chojedo koleha, hoi le lenge anan. Jon chatchran sungepaskro koowa lenge, un tchoran mool win lenge.
Un me putchom lendar: “Hoske djan tumer ap kal platse, te mangenn wawar deblen an?” Doleske kharenn kol platse bis kau diwes: mulne platse.

Doleske pen ap i Israelitarja: Kawa penell o baro Dewel, maro rai: Kamenn tumer har tumare phure te krell, kai mantsa phagan, un djungele figuren an-mangan? Un doleske wan le pale-tchiddo. Kamenn tumen ninna pale-tchiddo te krell?

Bis ap kau diwes chatchrenn tumer viechen kol chochene deblenge, un krenn tumen jaake pale-tchiddo. Ninna chatchrenn lenge tumare tchawe. Un me mukap man tumendar dran o kheer Israel, te putchell? Pash miro djipen, penell o baro Dewel, maro rai, dau man sowel, te mukau man gar tumendar te putchell!

Hoi was tumenge an o shero? Tumer penenn: “Mer kamah har i menshe an wawar themma te well! Mer kamah deblen dran kasht un bar an te mangell.” Me o baro Dewel, tumaro rai, penau: Sawo koowa te well kek tsireske! Me dau man sowel pash miro djipen, te atchap i sorelo rai pral tumende – i rai i sorelo wasteha, un i pre-hadedi mussjah, un i baro choljah.
Un me lau tumen win dran kol tsele themma un natsjone, kai tradedo wan, un anau tumen pale khetne. I sorelo wasteha un i pre-hadedi mussjah un bari choljah krau me kowa.
Un anau tumen an o mulo tato them mashkral kol wawar natsjone. Un kote krau me o tchatchepen pral tumende win, jaake te dikas mer menge an i jaka.
Jaake har tumare phurende lengri phagi dom, har his le an o mulo tato them pash o them Egiptia, jaake dau tumende ninna tumari phagi, penell o baro Dewel, tumaro rai.
Me krau, te wenn tumer pale menshe, kai djiwenn pal kowa, hoi mer win kram. Jaake har i bakrengro peskre bakrentsa krell, un bakre lendar ap i rig tchiwell, jaake djau tumentsa trujel.

Kolen, kai mantsa phagan un mandar tele peran, tchiwau ap i rig. Ninna te lau len win dran kol themma, kai le wi-themarja his, well kek lendar an o them Israel. Palle dikenn un haiwenn tumer, te hom me o baro Dewel.

Tumer dran o kheer Israel, shunenn, hoi o baro Dewel, tumaro rai, penell: Krenn, hoi kamenn! Hakeno tumendar nai mangell peskro chocheno debles an! Tchatchepah, pal kowa well ko tsiro, kai shunenn pale ap mande, un anenn buder kek ladj ap mande tumare chochene deblentsa, un koleha, hoi lenge chatchrenn.

Ap miri bari berga an Israel, kai me djiwau, kote mangenn man i tsele Israelitarja an, halauter kai an o them hi. Un me lau len an o latchepen an, un kamau, te anenn le mange kote viechen un djob, jaake har glan tchinlo hi, ninna ko koowa, hoi mange ap i rig tchiwan.

Te sungau ko latcho sungepen, hoi dran kowa win well, hoi tumer mange chatchrenn, dikau latches ap tumende. Jaake well kowa an ko tsiro, kai lom tumen win dran i themma un natsjone, kai wan tradedo. Un i tsele wawar natsjone dikenn, te hom me o tchatcho Dewel.
Me anau tumen pale an o them Israel – an ko them, kolestar sowel dom, te dap les tumare phurende. Palle dikenn un haiwenn tumer, te hom me o baro Dewel.
Un kote well tumenge kowa an o shero, hoi kran un har djiwan, koleha tumer tumen pale-tchiddo kran. Un ko tselo tchilatcho koowa, hoi kran, well tumenge tchadepaske.

Tumer Israelitarja, te djau me jaake tumentsa trujel, te wap sharedo, un krau gar pal tumare tchilatche dromma, un pal tumaro tchilatcho koowa, hoi kran, palle dikenn un haiwenn tumer, te hom me o baro Dewel, tumaro rai.
O baro Dewel penas ap mande:
Tu, mensho, dik kote, kai o kham pralstunes tardo hi. De o them trad, hoi kote hi! Un pen ap o weesh an o them Negev, hoi ap leste wella.

Pen leske: Kawa penell o baro Dewel, maro rai: Shun, hoi tuke penau! Me krau i jag an tute, koja chatchrell hako ruk, hoi senelo hi un koles, hoi truk hi. Kek nai krell koi jag win. Koja djal dureder an o tselo them, jek rigjatar ap i wawar. Un o tatepen chatchrell hakeneske peskro mui.
Un palle haiwell hakeno, te mukom me, o baro Dewel, koi jag pre te chatchell, un kek nai krell lat win.
Un me penom: Ach, baro Dewel, miro rai! Jon penenn mandar: Kol laba, hoi kowa rakrell, hi laba, hoi kek haiwell!
Un o baro Dewel penas ap mande:
Tu, mensho, dik kote, kai o foro Jerusalem hi! Rake kolestar, hoi djal o khereske, kai well o Dewel an-mangedo! Un pen i menshenge an o them Israel, hoi pral lende wella!
Pen lenge: Kawa penell o baro Dewel: Kanna sikrau les tumenge! Miro charo lau dran peskri possita, un marau tumen halauteren, i latchen har i tchilatchen.
Awa, miro charo well win dran peskri possita, un well pral hakeneste an o them jek rigjatar ap i wawar, te wenn i latchen har i tchilatchen maredo.
Palle dikell un haiwell hakeno, te lom me, o baro Dewel, miro charo dran peskri possita, un me tchiwau les gar pale pale koi.
Un tu mensho, dja banges un le phares ducho! Awa, le phares ducho, har te phagals tiro dji! Kre kowa glan i jaka i Israelendar!

Un te putchenn le tutar: Hoske le tu jaake phares ducho? Palle peness: Shunom djungelo rakepen, hoi gomme well. Koon kowa shunell, koles taprell i bari daar. An leskre wasta hi buder kek soor. Leskro dji dell sik. I darjatar nai rikrell lo peskro pani gar. O tsiro hi kai, kowa well sik! Tchatchepah, kowa well, penell o baro Dewel, maro rai.
Un o baro Dewel penas ap mande:
Tu, mensho, pen glan-wi, hoi wella! Pen lenge: Kawa penell o baro Dewel: Dik o charo, o charo, hoi latches tchinell, un djudjo kerdo hi.
Mishto tchinell lo. te marell lo bud menshen. Un djudjo kerdo hi lo, jaake djudjo har i blendari. Ma penenn: “Mer nai wah bachteles. Maro rai sal pral i tsele wawar rajende.”
Ko charo was djudjo kerdo o kurepaske. Mishto tchinell lo, un djudjo hi lo har i blendari. Denn les o marepaskro an o wast!
De gole un rob, tu mensho! Mire menshe hi, kolen o charo marell. I pralstunen an Israel dell miro charo mulo, un lentsa khetne mire tsele menshen! Doleske de ap tiro betch o ropastar!
Me dikom, hoi an lengre djia hi. Har djal lenge, te well o charo ninna pral lengro rajeske, un job atchell gar djido? Kawa penell o baro Dewel, maro rai.

Un tu mensho, de tire wasta pral tute khetne, un pen lenge, hoi pral lende wella! O charo dell tele ap lende: jek kopo, dui kope, triin kope! I marepaskro charo hi lo, bud menshen marell lo, haki rigjatar well lo ap lende,
te taprell i menshen bari daar, un bud merenn. Pash hake foreskre wudja wenn menshe maredo o chareha. Djudjo har i blendari hi ko charo. O marepaske hi lo kerdo.
Tu charo, de dren ap i tchatchi rig, un ninna ap i serwi rig, hako kopo glan tute, kote, kai hal!
Jaake kamau ninna me, o baro Dewel, mire wasta khetne te dell i choljatar. Un pal kowa hom buder gar chojedo.
Un o baro Dewel penas ap mande:

Tu mensho, tchin i tikno kashteha dui dromma an i phub. Un sike jaake, ap hawo drom nai well o baro rai dran Babilonia peskro chareha. Dran jek them djan kol dui dromma win. Un tchip i sikepen kote, kai dran jek drom kol dui win djan. Ko sikepen sikrell, an hawo foro hako drom djal.
Ko jek djal an o foro Rabba, kai i Ammonarja djiwenn, ko wawar an o sorelo foro Jerusalem an o them Juda. Jaake sikreh tu kol dromma, ap kolende o baro rai nai well peskre lurdentsa.

Kote kai ko jek dromestar dui dromma win djan, atchell lo o baro rai dran Babilonia tardo, te putchell lo i durkepangren, hoi te krell. Job witsrell kashta ap i phub, te dikell lo, har le perenn. Un putchell peskre khereskre deblen. Un job dikell palla, har i buko i maredo viechestar win dikell.

Ko sikepen sikrell ap i tchatchi rig un penell leske, te djal lo peskre lurdentsa an o foro Jerusalem. Kote denn le bari gole – i bari kurepaskri gole. Jon tchiwenn bare pesse rukengre kotja pash i wudja an o foreskri massuri, te denn le kolentsa i wudja dren. Ninna tchiwenn le tchik pre win trul i massuri, te nai djan le pral ap i massuri. Un jon krenn turme, te denn le karje an o foro.

I menshenge an o foro Jerusalem well kowa glan har i chocheno durkepen. O baro rai dran Babilonia krals lentsa win, te krell lo lenge tchi, un dals peskro wast koi pre. Kanna te well job pral lende, well lenge an o shero, te rikran jon gar dren, hoi le leha win kran. Un jon wenn tapedo.

Doleske penell o baro Dewel, maro rai: Tumari doosh was diklo. Tumare tchilatche dromma wan pre-tchakedo. An halauter, hoi krenna, well tumaro tchilatchepen diklo. Tumer kran, te well tumari doosh gar bistedo. Doleske wenn tapedo i sorelo wasteha.
Tu tchilatcho rai pral Israel, tu pale-tchiddo! Tiro diwes was! Tiri doosh hi jaake baro, te was ko tsiro, kai leh tiri phagi.
Me, o baro Dewel, tiro rai, penau tuke: Krik ko dikleha trul tiro shero! Le i rajeskri stadi tele! Tchi atchell har his. Kowa, kai pral his, well tele. Un kowa, kai tele his, well pral!
An kotja dau o foro Jerusalem! Paash, paash krau me les. Kawa well gar, bis te well ko mursh, koles wi-rodom, te dell lo o foro peskri phagi. An leskro wast dau o foro.

Tu, mensho, de kol menshen an o them Ammon trad, un pen: Kawa penell o baro Dewel, maro rai, pral i Ammonarja kai pral o Israel san. Pen lenge: Dik o charo! O charo was win lino dran peskri possita, te marell lo bud menshen. Djudjo kerdo hi lo o marepaske. Djudjo har i blendari hi lo.

O charo tchinell i pale-tchidde un tchilatche menshenge lengre sherja tele. Lengro diwes was. Lengri doosh was jaake baro, te was ko tsiro, kai lenn le pengri phagi. Kowa, hoi le pral o charo an i dikepen dikan, hi chochepen. Kowa, hoi lenge glan-wi penlo was, hi ninna chochepen.
Tchip tiro charo pale an peskri possita! An o them, kai tu boldo wal, an ko them kai khere hal, kote dau tut tiri phagi.
Me tchorau miri choli win ap tute, miri tati choli well soreles pral tute. Un me dau tut an i wasta diwje menshendar, kai haiwenn har te marenn le.
An i jag weh chatchedo. An tiro them nashell tiro rat. Un tu weh bistedo. Kawa penau me, o baro Dewel.
Un o baro Dewel penas ap mande:
