De jak, Gog! Krenn lauter, te nai djan an o kurepen, tu un tire tsele lurde, kai wan khetne, te djan le an o kurepen tuke! Un tu wess lengro pralstuno!

Bud bersha djan gomme trujel bis te wenn tumer khetne gole dino o kurepaske. Pal i rah tsiro djas tu tire lurdentsa an i them, hoi pal i kurepen pale newes kerdo was, un koleskre menshe dran bud themma khetne anlo wan, te djiwenn le ap i berge an Israel. I rah tsiro his kau them wi-meredo. Kanna wan leskre menshe win anlo dran bud themma, un djiwenn kote kek darjah.
Un tu djah pre an o them, un weh pral lende har i sorelo phurdepen, un har i wolka, hoi o tselo them tele tchakrell, tu un tire tsele lurde un kol bud lurde dran wawar themma, kai tuha djan.
Kawa penell o baro Dewel, maro rai: An ko tsiro well tchomone pre an tiro dji, un tu leh tuke tchilatcho koowa glan.

Un peneh tuke: Me kamau pral ko them te perell, kai kek massurja trul leskre forja hi. Un kamau pral kolende te well, kai djiwenn an o latchepen kek darjah. Kek massurja un pandle wudja hi trul lengre gaba un forja.

Tu kameh te randess lengro koowa, un te tchoress tuke lengro brawlepen. Lengre gaba un forja kameh tuke dren te lell, hoi paash-dino his, un kai kanna pale menshe djiwenn. Un kameh ap kol menshende pre te djal, kai dran wawar themma pale kate khetne wan, kolen pale vieche hi, un penge wawar brawlepen khetne lan. Jon djiwenn an ko them, hoi hi mashkral ap i phub.

I menshe dran i forja Saba un Dedan un kol tsele parepangre dran o foro Tarsis un leskre pralstune penenn palle ap tute: Dikah, tu wal, te randess! Un mukal tire tsele lurden khetne te well, te tchorenn le penge rup un sonakai, un lenn penge viechen un halauter, hoi tchomone moldo hi. Awa, koi hi bud, hoi nai randeh tuke khetne!
Tu, mensho, pen ap o Gog laba, hoi mandar wenna! Pen: Kawa penell o baro Dewel, maro rai: An ko tsiro, kai mire menshe Israel an o latchepen djiwenn kek darjah, kreh tu tut ap o drom.
Awa, tu weh dran tiro them, hoi dur krik kote hi, kai norden hi. Un lurde dran bud themma djan tuha, kai halauter ap graja klissenna. Bud bud lurde hi le, un khetne hi len i bari soor.

Un tu djah ap mire menshen Israel pre, un tire lurde tchakrenn o them har i wolka. An o palstuno tsiro well kowa jaake, te mukau tut pral miro them te well, te nai dikenn i menshe an wawar themma, koon me hom. Te dikenn le hoi krau tuha, Gog, haiwenn le, te hom me o Dewel.

Kawa penell o baro Dewel, maro rai, ap tute: Tu hal ko mursh, kolestar mukom mire rakepangren glan i rah tsiro te rakrell, kolla, kai kran, hoi lenge penom. An lengro tsiro penan le i Israelenge glan-wi, te mukau tut pral lende te well.
Un an ko tsiro, kai well o Gog un perell an o them Israel dren, well miro choli pre an mande, penell o baro Dewel, maro rai.
Un an miri bari un tati choli dau man sowel: Tchatchepah, an ko tsiro trissell i phub an o them Israel soreles.

Un glan mande trissenn i matche an o baro pani, i tchirkle un i wawar vieche, bare un tikne, hoi djiwenn ap i phub. Ninna i tsele menshe trissenn i darjatar. Un i berge phagenn khetne, i bare barra un i massurja perenn khetne.
Un me dau o charo gole, te well lo pral o Gog ap mire tsele berge, penell o baro Dewel, maro rai. Leskre lurde djan pengre charentsa jek ap o wawareste pre.

Un me dau les peskri phagi: I pharo nasslepen un marepen well ap leste. Un sorelo brishin, brishineskre barra, un jag un shwefla mukau ap lende tele te well, ap leste un ap leskre lurdende, un ap kol bud lurdende dran wawar themma, kai leha djan.
Un jaake sikrau me glan i jaka bud menshendar dran wawar themma, te hom i sorelo Dewel. Un jon dikenn un haiwenn palle, te hom me o baro Dewel.
Tu, mensho, pen ap o Gog, hoi pral leste wella! Pen: Kawa penell o baro Dewel, maro rai: Kanna sikrau les tuke, Gog, tu pralstuno pral i natsjone Meshech un Tubal.
Un krau, te rissress tut trujel, un tserdau tut win dran ko them, hoi dur krik kote hi, kai norden hi. Un me anau tut ap i berge Israel.
Un me dau tuke tiro bogo dran tiro serwo wast, un tire faile dran tiro tchatcho wast.
Ap i berge Israel weh tu mulo dino, tu un tire tsele lurde, ninna kol lurde dran wawar themma, kai tuha wan. Un me dau tumen i diwje viechenge un hake tchirklenge, kai mass chan, te chal.
Un tumer atchenn mulo tchiddo ap i phub. Me, o baro Dewel, penom kowa.
Un me bitchrau jag ap i forja an o them Magog, un ap kolende, kai djiwenn pash o baro pani, un kolen kek daar hi wawarendar. Palle dikenn un haiwenn le, te hom me o baro Dewel.
Me sikrau mire menshenge Israel, te hom o Dewel, un mukau buder kek ladj ap mande te anell. I menshe an wawar themma hunte dikenn un haiwenn, te hom me o baro Dewel, o Dewel pral o Israel.
Denn jak, kowa, hoi penom, wella, un well sik. Kowa hi o diwes kolestar me rakrom, penell o baro Dewel, maro rai.

Un kolla, kai djiwenn an i forja an o them Israel, djan palle win, un lenn kol karmangre kol mule lurdendar khetne, un krenn jag un chatchrenn len, kol tikne un bare shilte, kol boge un faile, kol kashtene depangre un witsepaskre tchurja. Un kolentsa krenn le efta bersha pengri jag.

Un jon hunte lenn buder kek kasht an o weesh khetne, witar gar hunte denn le ruka tele, te well len jagakro kasht. Na-a, kol karmangre lenn le un krenn lentsa pengri jag. Un jon randenn kolen win, kai kaman len win te randell. Kolla, kai kaman pash lende te tchorell, wenn kanna lendar win tchoredo. Kawa penell o baro Dewel, maro rai.

An ko diwes dau i platsa an o them Israel, kai well o Gog paskedo. Koja hi koi tala, hoi kharell Abarim, un hi pash o baro pani ap koi rig, kai o kham pre djala. Kote well job peskre bud lurdentsa paskedo. Doleske nai djan kolla, kai ap i raisa hi, buder gar wergel. Koi tala well kharedo Tala Hamon Gog.
Un i Israelitarja paskrenn len, te atchell o them buder gar pale-tchiddo. Len hunte well efta tchonna, te paskrenn le len halauter.
Un i tsele menshe an o them Israel paskrenn len. Koleske wenn le sharedo i wawar menshendar ap ko diwes, kai sikrau har baro un railo hom. Kowa penell o baro Dewel, maro rai.
Un pal kal efta tchonna bitchrenn le murshen win, te djan jon an o tselo them trujel un rodenn pal mulen, kai pral atchan, te wenn le paskedo, te atchell o them buder gar pale-tchiddo.

Un te djan kolla an o them trujel un hatsenn menshengre kokale, palle hunte tchiwenn le i sikepen pre, hoi sikrell, te hi i mulo koi tchiddo, bis te wenn kolla, kai paskrenn ko mules an i Tala Hamon Gog,
gar dur ko forestar Hamona. Un jaake krenn le, te hi ko them buder gar pale-tchiddo.

O baro Dewel, maro rai penas ap mande: Tu, mensho, pen ap i tsele tchirkle un ap i tsele diwje vieche: Awenn khetne, awenn kai, awenn khetne haki rigjatar, pash ko baro chapen, hoi krau tumenge. Kowa well i baro chapen ap i berge Israel. Awenn, chan mass un pijenn rat!

Chan o mass i sorele lurdendar, un pijenn o rat i pralstunendar ap kai phub! Jon wenn maredo, har te wans le thulle vieche, kai o Debleske maredo wenn, har murshkane bakre, tikne bakre, busja un gurma, kai halauter dran o them Bashan hi.
Pash kau chapen, hoi tumenge krau, chan tumer thulepen, bis te han tchalo. Un pijenn rat bis te han mato.
Chan i grajen un i klissepangren, i pralstunen un i tsele lurden! Chan tumen tchalo ap miri chapaskri! Kawa penell o baro Dewel, maro rai.
Un me sikrau i menshenge an wawar themma, har baro un railo me hom. Halauter dikenn, har me o tchatchepen win krau pral o Gog, un hawi sorjah dau les un leskre lurden pengri phagi.
Un an ko tsiro dikenn un haiwenn i Israelitarja, te hom me o baro Dewel, lengro Dewel, un bistrenn kowa buder gar.

Un i menshe an wawar themma dikenn un haiwenn palle, te wan i Israelitarja pengri doshake, hoi le ap pende anan, an o pandepen anlo. Jon rikran buder gar ap mande. Doleske mukom len. Un dom len an o wast kolendar, kai kuran pen lentsa. Jaake wan lengre tsele lurde o chareha maredo.
Jon kran pen pale-tchiddo glan mire jaka, har djan le miro dromestar tele. Doleske mukom len, un dom lenge lengri phagi jaake har mishto his.

Kanna krau, penell o baro Dewel, maro rai, te well lauter pale mishto o Jakobeske, un krau miro dji pre o tselo khereske Israel. Miro tselo djijeha krau, te well buder gar djungeles rakedo pral mande.
An ko tsiro, kai djiwenn le pale kek darjah an pengro them, un kek len traash krell, bistrenn le ko tsiro, kai was bari ladj ap lende har mukan le man.
Me anau len pale dran i themma kolendar, kai kuran pen lentsa un wan i sorleder, un anau len pale khetne an o them Israel. Un jaake sikrau bud menshen an wawar themma, te hom me o Dewel.

Palle dikenn un haiwenn i Israelitarja, te hom me, o baro Dewel, lengro Dewel, kowa kai anas len an o pandepen an wawar themma, un mukell len palpale te well an lengro them. Kek lendar atchell kote pale.
Me tchorau miro ducho win ap o kheer Israel, un mukau len buder gar. Kawa penell o baro Dewel, maro rai.

His an o 25. (biish-te-pantchto) bersh, kai mer an o pandepen hams – kowa his an o 14. (deesh-te-starto) bersh har o foro Jerusalem dren lino was – ap o 10. (deshto) diwes an ko bersh. Ap ko diwes was i soor o baro Deblestar pral mande. Un job anas man an o foro Jerusalem.
An i visiona anas lo man an o them Israel, un mukas man tele ap i bari berga, hoi dur pre djas. Ap koi rig i bergatar, kai o kham pralstunes tardo hi, dikom tchomone, hoi win dikas har i foro.

Un job anas man kote, un dikom i murshes. Kowa dikas win har wals lo dran saster. An leskro wast his i laintikri dori un i kasht, koleha jek tele ginell, har bares tchomone hi. Un job his mashkral an o baro wudar tardo.

Un ko mursh penas ap mande: Tu, mensho, dik un shun mishto, un de jak ap halauter, hoi sikrau tut. Doleske wal tu kate anlo, te sikrap kowa tuke. Halauter, hoi kate dikal, pen i menshenge dran o kheer Israel!

Un dikom i massuri, hoi win hi trul o Debleskro kheer. Un ko mursh ginas ko kashteha tele, har bares koi massuri hi. Ko kasht his jaake triin metarja lengsto. Un koi massuri his jaake pesso har ko kasht lengsto his, un djas ninna jaake dur pre har ko kasht.

Un job djas pash o baro wudar, hoi ap koi rig hi, kai o kham pre djal. Un djas i treppa pre. Un dikas pal, har dur ko wudar dren djal. Un kowa djas jaake dur dren, har ko kasht lengsto his – triin metarja.

Dren an o wudareskro kheer his ap hake dui rigja triin iseme. Haki isema his jaake lengsto har buchlo, – triin metarja lengsto un triin metarja buchlo. Un i massurja, hoi mank lende hi, his 2,5 (dui-te-paash) metarja pesso. Palla an o wudareskro kheer his pale i wudar, hoi djas triin metarja dren. Koi pal his koi wudareskri halla wergel o Debleskro kheer.
Un job dikas pal, har baro koi wudareskri halla hi.
Kaja his star metarja lengsto. Palla an lakri massuri his i kotar pre, kai djah win. Tchatches un serwes kolestar his i massuri jek metari pesso. Wergel koi wudareskri halla his o Debleskro kheer.
Un kol tikne iseme, hoi his ap kol dui rigja dren an o baro wudar, his triin ap haki rig, hakeni jaake buchlo har koi wawar. Un i massurja mank lende his ninna emligo buchlo.
Pal kowa dikas job pal, har lengsto un buchlo o wudareskro drom his: Kowa his 6,5 (shob-te-paash) metarja lengsto un pantch metarja buchlo.
Un glan i tikne iseme, his ap haki rig i tikni massuri i paash metari baro. Haki isema his triin metarja lengsto un triin metarja buchlo.

Un job dikas pal, har buchlo o tselo baro wudar hi: fun i winstuni rig fun koi jek tikni isema bis pash i winstuni rig fun koi tikni isema wergel: Fun jek rig ap i wawar his 12,5 (deesh-te-dui-te-paash) metarja.
Un koi wudareskri halla his deesh metarja buchlo. Un i glanstuni platsa djas bis pash i massuri fun ko baro wudar.
Un o tselo wudareskro drom fun win, kai weh dren, bis pash koi wudareskri halla his 25 (biish-te-pantch) metarja lengsto.

Un an i tikne iseme, hoi his ap kol dui rigja, his tikne wochja an kol winstune massurja. Ninna an i wudareskri halla his wochja ap lakre dui rigja. Un dren an kol massurja his palmtikre ruka dren dino.
Un job anas man an i bari glanstuni platsa. Un trul i glanstuni platsa trujel djas i barrengro drom. Un pal o barrengro drom his trijanda tikne iseme tardo trul i glanstuni platsa.
Un ko barrengro drom djas trul i tseli platsa, un djas jaake dur dren ap i platsa har i bare wudja. Ko barrengro drom his o telstuneder drom.

Un ko mursh dikas pal, har buchlo koi bari glanstuni platsa hi: Fun o telstuno wudar bis pash i massuri, hoi djas trul i tikni glanstuni platsa his 50 (paash-sheel) metarja. Kawa his koi rig, kai o kham pre djal. Palle djas lo glan mande ap koi rig, kai norden hi.
Un ko mursh dikas pal, har baro un buchlo ko wudar hi, hoi glan i bari glanstuni platsa hi ap koi rig, kai norden hi.

An kau wudareskro kheer his ninna tikne iseme, triin ap haki rig. Un leskre massurja un koi wudareskri halla his jaake baro har pash ko wawar baro wudar, kote kai o kham pre djal. Khetne his kau wudar 25 (biish-te-pantch) metarja lengsto un 12,5 (deesh-te-dui-te-paash) metarja buchlo.

Un leskre wochja un leskre palmtikre ruka, hoi an i massurja dino hi, his jaake har pash ko baro wudar ap koi rig, kai o kham pre djal. Glan kau wudar djan efta stufe pre. Un les his i wudareskri halla ap i wawar rig.

Un jaake har pash ko wudar ap koi rig, kai o kham pre djal, his pash kau wudar ap i nordetikri rig. Wergel lestar his i baro wudar, hoi djas an i tikni glanstuni platsa. Un ko mursh ginas tele, har dur hi fun ko jek wudar bis pash ko wawar. Un kowa his 50 (paash-sheel) metarja.

Palle anas man ko mursh ap koi rig, kai o kham pralstunes tardo hi. Un ap kai rig dikom ninna i baro wudar. Un job dikas pal, har baro leskre massurja un koi wudareskri halla hi. Un jon his jaake baro har pash kol wawar bare wudja.
Un kote his wochja an o wudar un an i wudareskri halla, jaake har pash kol wawar bare wudja. Khetne his kau wudar 25 (biish-te-pantch) metarja lengsto un 12,5 (deesh-te-dui-te-paash) metarja buchlo.
Un glan kau wudar djan efta stufe pre. Un les his i wudareskri halla ap i wawar rig. Un palmtikre ruka his an lakre massurja dren dino ap haki rig.

Un wergel kau baro wudar his ninna i wawar wudar, hoi djas an i tikni glanstuni platsa. Kol dui bare wudja his ap koi rig, kai o kham pralstunes tardo hi. Un ko mursh dikas pal har dur his fun ko jek wudar bis pash o wawar. Kowa his 50 (paash-sheel) metarja.

Un ko mursh djas mantsa an kau baro wudar, kai kote hi, kai o kham pralstunes tardo hi, un dureder ap i tikni glanstuni platsa. Un job dikas pal, har baro kau wudar hi. Un kowa his jaake baro har kol wawar wudja.

Un leskre tikne iseme un leskre massurja un koi wudareskri halla, jon his jaake baro, har kolla an i wawar bare wudja. Koi his ninna wochja an o wudareskro kheer un an i glanstuni halla. Khetne his kau wudar 25 (biish-te-pantch) metarja lengsto un 12,5 (deesh-te-dui-te-paash) metarja buchlo.
Un koi trujel his glanstune halle. Khetne his le 12,5 (deesh-te-dui-te-paash) metarja lengsto un 2,5 (dui-te-paash) metarja buchlo.
Un i wudareskri halla djas bis pash i bari glanstuni platsa. Un an lakri massurja his palmtikre ruka dren dino. Ochta stufe djan kote pre.
Un job anas man an koi tikni glanstuni platsa ap koi rig, kai o kham pre djal. Un dikas pal, har baro ko baro wudar kote hi. Un kowa his jaake baro har kol wawar.

Un leskre tikne iseme un leskre massurja un i wudareskri halla, jon his jaake baro har kolla an i wawar wudja. Koi his ninna wochja an o wudar un an i wudareskri halla. Khetne his kau wudar 25 (biish-te-pantch) metarja lengsto un 12,5 (deesh-te-dui-te-paash) metarja buchlo.
Un koi wudareskri halla djas bis pash koi bari glanstuni platsa. Un an i massurja ap lakre dui rigja his palmtikre ruka dren tchinlo. Un ochta stufe djan kote pre.
Un job anas man pash ko wudar, hoi kote hi, kai norden hi. Un dikas pal, har baro kawa hi. Kowa his jaake baro har kol wawar.
Les his tikne iseme, massurja, i wudareskri halla un wochja trul leste. Khetne his kau wudar 25 (biish-te-pantch) metarja lengsto un 12,5 (deesh-te-dui-te-paash) metarja buchlo.
Un koi wudareskri halla djas bis pash koi bari glanstuni platsa. Un an lakre massurja his palmtikre ruka dren tchinlo. Ochta stufe djan kote pre.
An i wudareskri halla fun o nordetikro wudar his i wudar, hoi djas an i tikni isema. Kote well o mass kol viechendar thodo, hoi wenn tseles chatchedo o Debleske.

Un an i wudareskri halla fun kau wudar his star chapangre tardo, dui ap haki rig. Un ap lende wenn kol vieche maredo, hoi o Debleste dino wenn, kolla kai wenn tseles chatchedo, un kolla kai wenn maredo, te well i doosh krik lino, ninna kolla kai wenn maredo, te well lauter pale mishto.
Un win glan i wudareskri halla his star chapangre, dui ap haki rig kote, kai djan le dren an o nordetikro wudar.
Jaake his ap haki rig pash ko baro wudar star chapangre tardo. Kolla hi khetne ochta chapangre, ap kolende i vieche maredo wenn.

Un kol star chapangre, hoi kol viechenge hi, hoi o Debleske tseles chatchedo wenn, kolla his dino dran bare barra, 75 (efta-deesh-te-pantch) centimetarja lengsto, un ninna jaake buchlo, un i paash metari baro. Koi pre wenn kol tchurja un wawar koola tchiddo, kolentsa i vieche maredo wenn, sawe vieche, kai wenn tseles chatchedo, un hake wawaren ninna.
Un ap i chapangre was o mass tchiddo. Un an i massurja trujel his hidjepangre dren dino, hoi hi i wast buchlo.

Palle anas lo man glan koi tikni glanstuni platsa. Kote dikom dui iseme, kolengre wudja ap koi tikni glanstuni platsa djan. Koi jek isema his pash o nordetikro wudar, un lakri glanstuni rig sikrell kote, kai o kham pralstunes tardo hi. Un koi wawar isema his pash ko wudar, hoi kote tardo hi, kai o kham pralstunes hi, un lakri glanstuni rig sikrell kote, kai norden hi.
Un ko mursh penas ap mande: Kai isema kolakri glanstuni rig kote sikrell, kai o kham pralstunes tardo hi, hi kol rashajenge, kai budrenn an o Debleskro kheer.

Un koi isema, kolakri glanstuni rig kote sikrell, kai norden hi, hi kol rashajenge, kolla pengri budi ap i chatchepaskri krenn. Kolla hi kol mursha, kolengro dad o Zadok his. I tsele murshendar, kai wenn dran o kheer Levi, hi jon kokres kolla, kai nai wenn glan o baro Debleste, te budrenn le leske.

Un ko mursh dikas pal, har baro koi tikni glanstuni platsa hi: Koles his star rigja, kolendar hakeni jaake baro hi har koi wawar: 50 (paash-sheel) metarja. Glan o Debleskro kheer his koi chatchepaskri tardo.

Un job anas man dren an i glanstuni halla o Debleskro kherestar. Un job dikas pal, har baro i glanstuni halla hi: Ap haki rig o wudarestar his i massuri 2,5 (dui-te-paash) metarja pesso. O wudar his efta metarja buchlo. Un i massurja ap haki rig lestar his 1,5 (jek-te-paash) metarja buchlo.
Koi tseli glanstuni halla his deesh metarja buchlo un shob metarja lengsto. Un deesh stufe djan ap late pre. Un pash o wudar his ap haki rig jek turmo tardo.
Un ko mursh anas man an koi bari isema o Debleskro kherestar dren. Un job dikas pal, har baro i massurja hi, hoi tchatches un serwes pash o wudar hi. Jon his triin metarja pesso.

Un o wudar his pantch metarja buchlo. Un i massurja tchatches un serwes o wudarestar his hakeni 2,5 (dui-te-paash) metarja buchlo. Un job ginas tele, har baro koi tseli bari isema hi. Koja his 20 (biish) metarja lengsto un 10 (deesh) metarja buchlo.

Palle djas ko mursh an koi palstuni isema. Un job dikas pal, har pesso koi massuri pash o wudar hi: Ap haki rig his li jek metari pesso. Un o wudar his triin metarja buchlo. Un i massurja ap kol dui rigja o wudarestar his hakeni 3,5 metarja lengsto.

Un job ginas tele, har baro koi tseli palstuni isema dren hi: Koja his 10 metarja baro un deesh metarja buchlo, jaake buchlo har koi bari isema ninna hi. Un job penas ap mande: Kaja hi o Debleskri kutch isema.
Un job dikas pal, har baro i massuri o Debleskro kherestar hi: Koja his triin metarja pesso. Trul o kheer trujel his i rigjakro kheer, kai tikne iseme dren hi. Haki isema his dui metarja buchlo.

Un kol tikne iseme his jaake tardo, te his trijanda iseme tella, un trijanda mashkralstunes un trijanda pralstunes. Un jon his jaake trul o Debleskro kheer trujel tardo, te wenn le rikedo an peste, un hunte wenn gar an o khereskri massuri dren.

Un kol tikne isema, hoi pral i wawarende his, his buchleder har kolla tel lende. Kolla, hoi telstunes his, his i tikneder. Un kolla, kai pralstunes his, his i buchleder. Un i treppa djas fun o telstuno an o mashkralstuno un fun kote an o pralstuno.
Palle dikom tele un dikom, kai his i hadedi platsa trul o Debleskro kheer. Kai platsa his triin metarja pesso. Koi pre his ko rigjakro kheer tardo.

Leskri massuri win his 2,5 (dui-te-paash) metarja pesso. Trul o rigjakro kheer his kai platsa 2,5 (dui-te-paash) metarja buchlo. Un an o rigjakro kheer his dui wudja, hoi djan ap kai platsa, jek wudar ap i serwi rig, un jek wudar ap i tchatchi rig. Trul kai platsa his i kotar phub, hoi tchi pre tardo hi. Koi phub his deesh metarja buchlo.

Wergel koi kotar phub un pal o Debleskro kheer his i wawar kheer tardo ap koi rig, kai o kham tele djal. Kau kheer his 35 (trijanda-te-pantch) metarja lengsto un 45 (star-deesh-te-pantch) metarja buchlo. Leskri massuri his ap hake star rigja 2,5 (dui-te-paash) metarja pesso.

Un o mursh dikas tele, har lengsto o Debleskro kheer hi: Kowa his 50 (paash-sheel) metarja lengsto. Un koi platsa pal o Debleskro kheer bis pash ko kheer, hoi ap koi rig hi, kai o kham tele djal, un kau kheer un leskre massurja his ninna 50 (paash-sheel) metarja.
Un o buchlepen o glanstuni rigjatar fun o Debleskro kheer un koi platsa ap koi rig, kai o kham pre djal, his khetne ninna 50 (paash-sheel) metarja.

Un o mursh dikas pal, har lengsto ko kheer hi, hoi ap koi rig tardo hi, kai o kham tele djal. Khetne peskre massurja ap kol dui rigja his kau kheer 50 metarja lengsto. Un kol massurja an koi bari isema an o Debleskro kheer un an i glanstuni halla,
his dren i kashteha tchakedo fun i phub bis pre pash i tikne wochja. Un trul i wochja djan triin shukar sane kashta trujel.
An i kashteni massuri pral o baro wudar un an i tsele kashtene massurja an o Debleskro kheer his shukar koowa dren tchinlo, koles his jek barepen.
Koi his bolepangre un palmtikre ruka: jek palmtikro ruk mashkral dui bolepangre. Hako bolepaskres his jaka un i mui ap dui rigja:

Ap jek rig dikas o mui i menshestar ap i palmtikro ruk. Ap i wawar rig dikas o mui i terno lewestar ap i palmtikro ruk. Un sawo tchinepen his an i tsele kashtene massurja trujel dren tchinlo an o Debleskro kheer:
Fun i phub bis pre pral i wudja his sawe bolepangre un palmtikre ruka an i kashtene massurja dren tchinlo.
An i bari isema his pesse kashta tchatches un serwes pash o wudar tardo, kolen his star rigja, hoi his emligo bares, jaake har ko wudar glan i kutch isema.

Koi his tchomone tardo, hoi win dikas har i kashteno altaro. Kowa his 1,50 (jek-te-paash) metari baro, un jek metari lengsto un jek metari buchlo. Un leskre ekke, leskro piro un leskre rigja his dran kasht kerdo. Un ko mursh penas ap mande: Kawa hi koi chapaskri, hoi glan o baro Debleste tardo hi!
Un glan i bari isema un glan i kutch isema his glan hakeneste dui wudja, jek pal o wawar. Un an hako wudar his dui kotja jek langs i wawar. Kolla nai rissrenn pen.
Un ninna an kol wudja glan i bari isema his bolepangre un palmtikre ruka dren tchinlo, jaake har an i kashtene massurja. Win glan o wudar glan i glanstuni halla his i dacha dran kasht.
Un an i massurja an i glanstuni halla his ap kol dui rigja tikne wochja dren. Un palmtikre ruka his an i kashtene massurja dren tchinlo, jaake har ninna an o rigjakro kheer un an i kashteni dacha.
O mursh anas man win ap i bari glanstuni platsa ap i nordetikri rig. Kote his i kheer tardo, kai iseme dren hi. Kau kheer his wergel ko kheer un leskri platsa, hoi pal o Debleskro kheer tardo his.
Kau kheer ap koi nordetikri rig his 50 (paash-sheel) metarja lengsto un 25 (biish-te-pantch) metarja buchlo. Leskri glanstuni rig his ap i nordetikri rig.

Kau kheer his tardo mank koi tikni glanstuni platsa, hoi his deesh metarja buchlo, un koi drom, hoi djas trul i bari glanstuni platsa. Kau kheer his jaake kerdo, te his iseme telstunes, mashkralstunes un pralstunes.
Un glan i iseme djas i drom, kolestar djan le dren an i iseme. Ko drom his pantch metarja buchlo un 50 (paash-sheel) metarja lengsto. Un i wudja his ap i nordetikri rig.
Un kol iseme, hoi pralstunes his, his tikneder har kolla koi tel. Un kol mashkralstune iseme his tikneder har kolla, hoi telstunes his. Jon his kerdo har i bari treppa,
hoi djas triin stufe pre. Doleske wan i iseme fun tel bis pral tikneder. Len his kek pesse kashta tardo tel pende, te hidjrenn le len, har an i glanstune platse his.
Un win his i massuri wergel kol iseme, koja his 25 (biish-te-pantch) metarja lengsto. Ap lakri wawar rig his koi bari glanstuni platsa.

O lengstepen fun kal iseme, hoi pash koi bari glanstuni platsa tchiddo hi, his 25 (biish-te-pantch) metarja. Kol iseme, hoi wergel o Debleskro kherestar tardo hi, his 50 (paash-sheel) metarja lengsto.
Ap koi rig, kai o kham pre djal, djas i drom an kol telstune iseme kolenge, kai wenn fun koi bari glanstuni platsa.

Ap koi buchli rig fun koi massuri, hoi djas trul i glanstuni platsa, kote, kai o kham pralstunes tardo hi, his ninna i kheer, kai iseme dren hi. Kal iseme his wergel ko kheer un koi platsa koi glan, hoi pal o Debleskro kheer tardo hi.

Kolla his jaake har kol iseme ap i nordetikri rig. Lengro lengstepen, lengro buchlepen, lengre wudjengre dromma un lengre wudja his emligo un jaake kerdo har kol wawar. Ninna o drom glan i iseme his jaake har ko drom glan kolende ap i nordetikri rig.
Lengre wudja sikran ap koi rig, kai o kham pralstunes tardo hi. Un ap i rig, kai o kham pre djal, nai wan le ap i drom, hoi djal an i iseme dren. Kau drom djas mank i iseme un i massuri.

O mursh penas ap mande: Kal isema, kolla ap i nordetikri rig, un kolla ap koi rig, kai o kham pralstunes tardo hi, hoi pash koi platsa tchiddo hi, hoi pal o Debleskro kheer hi, kolla hi kolenge, kai budrenn o Debleske. I rashaja, kai glan o baro Debleste pengri budi krenn, nai chan kote pengro kotar kolestar, hoi o Debleske anlo was, un hoi kokres i rashaja nai chan. An kal iseme tchiwenn le kowa, hoi o Debleske anlo was: ko djob, un ko mass kol viechendar, hoi i doshake maredo wan un doleske, te well lauter pale mishto. Kal iseme hi koleske, hoi o Debleske hi.

Te kran i rashaja pengri budi an o Debleskro kheer, un djan pale win dran o Debleskro kheer, hunte riwenn le pengre rashajengre koola win an kal iseme, un hunte riwenn wawar koola an. Palle nai djan le ap i glanstuni platsa mank i wawar menshende. I rashajengre koola hunte wenn gar an-tapedo wawar menshendar.
Un har ko mursh pal dikas, har baro o Debleskro kheer dren hi, anas lo man win dran ko wudar, hoi kote hi, kai o kham pre djal, un job dikas pal, har baro koi massuri hi, hoi trul halauter trujel hi.

Hake star rigja ginas lo peskro kashteha tele, glanstunes koi rig, kai o kham pre djal, palle i nordetikri rig, palle koi rig, kai o kham pralstunes tardo hi, un palle koi rig, kai o kham tele djal. Haki rig his 250 (dui-sheel-te-paash) metarja lengsto.

Jaake dikas lo pal, har baro koi tselo kotar them his, trul koleste i massuri djas. Koja his 250 (dui-sheel-te-paash) metarja ap haki rig. Haki rig his emligo lengsto. Koi massuri his koi, te well ko kotar them, hoi o Debleske hi, gar khetne o wawar themeha.
Un o mursh anas man pale pash ko baro wudar, hoi ap koi rig hi, kai o kham pre djal.

Un kote dikom, har was o railepen o Israeleskro Deblestar fun kotar, kai o kham pre djal. Khetne ko railepen was i gole, har i gole, hoi bare panja denn. Un dran o railepen was i momeli ap o tselo them.

Un kowa, hoi me dikom an kai visiona his har kowa, hoi dikom, har homs pash o lengsto pani Kebar, un ninna har kowa, hoi dikom, har was o Dewel an o foro Jerusalem, te dell lo o foro paash. Un me mukom man ap i phub te perell glan leste.
Un o baro Debleskro railepen was an o baro wudar, hoi kote hi, kai o kham pre djal, un djas an o kheer dren.
Un o ducho hadas man pre un anas man ap koi tikni glanstuni platsa. Un dikom o baro Debleskro railepen, kolestar o kheer pherdo his.
Un ko mursh his tardo pash mande. Un dran o kheer win shunom jekes, kai mantsa rakras.

Job penas ap mande: Tu, mensho, kate hi koi platsa, kai miri beshepaskri tardo hi un ko banko, ap koleste mire pire tchiwau. Kate djiwau hako tsireske mashkral i Israelitarjen. Un i Israelitarja anenn buder gar ladj ap mande, jon gar un lengre bare raja witar gar. Kowa kran le, har mangan le wawar deblen an, un har paskran le pengre bare rajen gar dur miro kherestar.

Jon kran pengre bare khera langs miro kheer, lengre wudja langs mire wudja, jaake te his jek massuri halauter mank mande un lende. Un jaake anan le ladj ap mande pengro djungelo koweha, hoi le kran. Doleske marom len an miri choli.
Kanna mangenn le buder gar wawar deblen an. Un pengre mule bare rajen rikrenn le dur mandar. Un me djiwau mashkral lende hako tsireske.
Tu, mensho, pen i Israelenge, har miro kheer win dikell. Te dikenn le har baro un shukar kowa hi, ladjenn le pen i doshake, hoi le ap pende lan.

Te khaitenn len kowa tchatchepah, hoi le kran, palle sike len, har o kheer wi-dikell un kerdo hi, leskre dromma un wudja un halauter, hoi koi pashel hi. Pen lenge, hoi jon hunte krenn, un hoi lendar kamau, te mangenn le man kate an kau kheer an. Un tchin kowa glan lengre jaka an i liil, te haiwenn le halauter, hoi un har le tchomone hunte krenn, te rikrenn le pen ap kowa, un krenn jaake!
Glan halauter hunte well dre-rikedo, te hi koi tseli platsa pral ap i berga, kai miro kheer tardo hi, kokres mange koi. Ninna halauter, hoi koi trujel hi, hi mange.

Jaake baro hi kai chatchepaskri: Leskri piri hi jek paash metari baro un jek paash metari buchlo. Un trul leste hi i tikni massuri, hoi hi 25 (biish-te-pantch) centimetarja baro. Kai chatchepaskri hi kerdo an triin kotja:

Fun i phub bis pash o telstuno kotar hi jek metari. Kau kotar hi jek paash metari buchleder har ko kotar, hoi well koi pral. Kowa hi dui metarja baro, un jek paash metari buchleder har ko kotar koi pral.
Ko triinto kotar hi o bob, kai well o mass chatchedo. O bob hi ninna dui metarja baro. Ap leskre star ekke djan star shinga pre.
O bobes hi star rigja un hi 6 (shob) metarja lengsto un 6 (shob) metarja buchlo.

O mashkralstuno kotar, les hi ninna star rigja, un hi 7 (efta) metarja lengsto un 7 (efta) metarja buchlo. Trul i chatchepaskri djal i tikni massuri trujel, hoi hi 25 (biish-te-pantch) centimetarja baro. Lakri piri hi jek paash metari baro. Un ap koi rig, kai o kham pre djal, djan stufe pre.

Un job penas ap mande: Tu mensho, kawa penell o baro Dewel, maro rai: Kawa hi, hoi hunte kress ap kau diwes, kai hi kai chatchepaskri kerdo, ap kolate vieche chatchedo wenn o baro Debleske, un viechengro rat ap late witsedo well.

Kokres i rashaja dran o kheer Levi, kolengro phuro dad o Zadok hi, nai wenn glan mande, te budrenn le mange. Kawa penell o baro Dewel, maro rai. Kal rashajenge dess tu i terno gurum, te marenn le les, te well i doosh i menshendar krik lino.

Un tu less leskro rat, un makess tchomone ap kol star shinga, un pral ap kol star ekke, un ap koi tikni massuri, hoi trujel djal. Jaake leh koi tseli doosh un o pale-tchiddo koowa krik, hoi ap i chatchepaskri hi.
Un tu less ko terno gurum, hoi i doshake maredo was, te well lo chatchedo ap i platsa, hoi koleske koi hi, win glan i massuri, hoi hi trul o Debleskro kheer.

Un ap o duito diwes aness tu i sasti mursh busni, te well li maredo i doshake. Tu kress lah jaake, har kowa kerdo was o gurumeha ninna, te well ko rateha i doosh un o pale-tchiddo koowa krik lino fun i chatchepaskri.
Pal kowa less i terno sasto gurum, un i sasto mursh bakro, te wenn le maredo o baro Debleske.
Un tu aness len glan leste. Un i rashaja witsrenn loon ap kol kotja mass un chatchrenn len o baro Debleske.
Efta diwessa maress tu hako diwes jek mursh busni, te well i doosh krik lino. Un ninna i terno gurum un i mursh bakro, hoi hake dui sasto hi, wenn maredo un chatchedo o baro Debleske.
Efta diwessa well kowa jaake kerdo, te well i doosh un o pale-tchiddo koowa krik lino fun i chatchepaskri, te nai well li o Debleske koi.

Un pal kal efta diwessa, ap ko ochtato diwes, un fun kotar dureder, chatchrenn i rashaja ko mass kol viechendar, hoi anenn tumer o baro Debleske, kolla, kai wenn leske tseles chatchedo, un ko thulepen kolendar, kai chan tumer khetne glan leste. Te krenn kowa jaake, dikau latches ap tumende, penell o baro Dewel, maro rai.
Un o mursh anas man pale pash ko wudar, hoi win glan i bari glanstuni platsa hi, ap koi rig, kai o kham pre djal. Kau wudar his pandlo.

Un o baro Dewel penas ap mande: Kau wudar atchell pandlo, un well gar pre kerdo. Un kek djal an kau wudar dren! Me, o baro Dewel, ko Dewel pral Israel, djom an kau wudar dren. Doleske atchell lo pandlo.

Kokres o rai pral Israel nai djal dren, un beshell koi, un chal kote glan mande peskro kotar kolestar, hoi mange, o baro Debleske anlo was. Te well lo kote, hunte djal lo an i wudareskri halla dren un ninna kote pale win.

Un o mursh anas man pash o wudar, hoi ap i nordetikri rig hi, un djas kote mantsa dren ap koi tikni glanstuni platsa glan o baro Debleskro kheer. Koi dikom, kau kheer his pherdo o baro Debleskro railepen. Un me mukom man ap i phub te perell glan leste.

Un o baro Dewel penas ap mande: Tu, mensho, kre tire jaka un kanda pre, un de jak ap halauter, hoi me tuha rakrau! Kamau tuke te penell, hoi tumendar kamau miro khereske, un hoi kote hunte krenn. De jak, te djiness, koon nai djal dren un koon gar.
Ap i Israelitarjen, kai hi sawe menshe kai mukenn pen tchi te penell, pen: Kawa penell o baro Dewel, maro rai: Tumer dran o kheer Israel, mukenn tele tumaro tselo djungelo koweha!

Tumer mukan wawar menshen an miro kheer dren, sawen kolengro dji gar mange hi, un kai hi gar tchinlo ap pengro mass. Jaake kran, te was miro kheer pale-tchiddo. Jon his koi pashel, har anan tumer chapen un thulepen un rat glan mande. Jaake phagan tumer, hoi mer win kram. Koi pashel well kau tselo djungelo kowa, hoi kran.
Tumer kokres kran gar koi budi an miro kheer. Na-a, tumer lan wawar murshen, te krenn le tumenge koi budi an miro kheer.

Doleske penau me, o baro Dewel, tumaro rai: Kek dran i wawar them, koleskro dji gar mange hi, un kai hi gar tchinlo ap peskro mass, nai well an miro kheer dren, witar kek wi-themari, kai mank tumende djiwell.
Har i Israelitarja mange o dumo sikran, un wawar deblenge palla nashan, koi djan ninna i Levitarja mandar krik. Kanna hunte hidjrenn le pengri phagi.

Lengri budi an miro kheer hi kanna, te denn le jak an i bare wudja glan miro kheer. Ninna hunte marenn le kol viechen, hoi i menshe mange anenn, sawe vieche, kai wenn tseles chatchedo un sawe, hoi chan le khetne glan mande. Jaake budrenn le mire tsele menshenge.

Bis kau diwes anan le viechen lenge glan lengre chochene deblende, un kran jaake, te peran i Israelitarja miro dromestar tele. Doleske hadom miro wast un dom man sowel, te dap len pengri phagi. Kawa penell o baro Dewel, maro rai.

Jon nai atchenn buder gar mire rashaja un wenn buder gar pash kol tsele koola, hoi mange hi, un hunte rikrenn pen pale fun ko chapen, hoi mange dino was, un kokres i rashaja nai chan. Jon hunte ladjenn pen pral ko djungelo koowa, hoi le kran.
Un me krau lendar budepangre, kai an miro kheer koi budi krenn, hoi kerdo hunte well.

Kol rashaja dran o kheer Levi, kolengro phuro dad o Zadok his, jon atchenn mire rashaja, un nai budrenn mange. Har i Israelitarja mandar tele peran, kran jon pengri budi mishto an miro kheer. Doleske nai atchenn le mire rashaja un nai anenn o thulepen un o rat kol marede viechendar glan mande. Kawa penell o baro Dewel, maro rai.
Jon nai wenn an miro kheer dren, un jon wenn pash miri chapaskri, te wenn le mange koi un budrenn mange an miro kheer.

Te wenn le an kol wudja dren, hoi djan ap koi tikni glanstuni platsa, hunte riwenn le i rashajengre laintikre koola an. Kek koola dran bakrengre balla hunte wenn ap lende an ko tsiro, kai budrenn ap i tikni glanstuni platsa un dren an o kheer.
Lengro shereskro diklo un lengre cholopja hunte wenn dran laintikro than. Kek koola hunte wenn ap lende, hoi krenn, te well lenge tato un te nashell o pani lendar tele.

Te djan le ap i bari glanstuni platsa win pash i menshende, hunte riwenn le kol koola, an kolende jon budran, pale win, un tchiwenn len tele an kol iseme, hoi i rashajenge hi. Un riwenn wawar koola an, te taprenn i menshe gar i rashajengre koola an, un merenn.
Un i rashaja hunte tchinenn gar pengre balla tseles tele, un mukenn len ninna gar lengsto te well. Tiknes hunte wenn le tchinlo.
Te djan le dren ap koi tikni glanstuni platsa glan o Debleskro kheer, hunte pijan le kek mool.

Un i mukli djuwjat nai romedinerenn le gar, witar gar i djuwjat, kolakro rom meras. Na-a, kokres i tchai dran o kheer Israel, kai kek murshestar an-tapedo hi, nai romedinerenn le, un i djuwel, kolakro rom i rashai his un meras.
I rashaja hunte sikrenn mire menshende, hoi mange, o Debleske hi, un kowa, hoi i menshenge hi. Un jon hunte djinenn, hoi pale-tchiddo glan mande hi, un hoi gar pale-tchiddo glan mande hi.

Te well i tchingepen glan lende anlo, hi jon i tchatchepangre mursha un hunte penenn o tchatchepen win, un hunte djan pal mire tchatchepaskre laba. Un jon hunte krenn, te wenn mire bare diwessa ap o tchatcho tsiro jaake dren rikedo, har me penom, te well kowa kerdo. Ninna denn le jak, te well o Debleskro diwes dren rikedo.

Un pash i muleste hunte djan le gar dren, te krenn le pen gar pale-tchiddo. Kokres pash pengro dadeste un pengri date un pash o tchaweste un pash i tchate un pash o phraleste un pash i phenjate, kolat gomme kek murshes hi, pash lende nai djan le. Kote nai krenn le pen pale-tchiddo.
Te kras pes i rashai ap sau muleste pale-tchiddo, hunte krell lo, hoi glan tchinlo hi, te well lo pale erligo. Te was lo pale erligo, atchell lo gomme efta diwessa khere.

Ap ko diwes, kai djal lo pale ap koi tikni glanstuni platsa, te krell lo peskri budi an miro kheer, hunte marell lo mange i vieches, te well o pale-tchiddo koowa lestar krik lino. Kawa penau me, o baro Dewel, tumaro rai.
I rashajenge well kek kotar phub, hoi o dadestar ap o tchaweste dureder dino well. Me hom lengro kotar. Len well kek kotar them an o them Israel. Me dau len, hoi len hunte well djipaske.

Lengro chapen lenn le kolestar, hoi glan mande anlo well, ko djobestar un kol viechendar, hoi maredo wenn, te well i doosh un o pale-tchiddo koowa krik lino, un kol viechendar, hoi wenn maredo, te well lauter pale mishto. Ninna lenn le halauter, hoi i menshe mange ap i rig tchiwan.

Ninna o feteder djob kolestar, hoi newes baro was, un kowa, hoi hunte denn i menshe o Debleske, hi i rashajenge. Anenn lenge ninna i erste mare, hoi o newo djobestar peklo wan. Koon kowa krell, ap koleste un leskri familja well o Debleskri bacht.
Kek tchirklen un wawar viechen, hoi meran oder mulo dandedo wan, te chan i rashaja.

Ap ko diwes, kai witsrenn tumer tikne kashta, te djinenn, koneske hawo kotar them well, tchiwenn i kotar them ap i rig, hoi o baro Debleske hi: 12,5 (deesh-te-dui-te-paash) kilometarja lengsto un 10 (deesh) kilometarja buchlo. Kau tselo kotar them hi o baro Debleske.

Fun kau kotar them, lenn i paash, kowa hi 12,5 (deesh-te-dui-te-paash) kilometarja lengsto un 5 (pantch) kilometarja buchlo. Lestar well i kotar phub lino o Debleskro khereske: 250 (dui-sheel-te-paash-sheel) metarja lengsto un 250 (dui-sheel-te-paash-sheel) metarja buchlo, un trul leste i platsa trujel, hoi hi 25 (biish-te-pantch) metarja buchlo. Un kote well o Debleskro kheer tardo, kai ninna o Debleskri kutch isema dren hi.

Kau tselo kotar them, hoi 12,5 (deesh-te-dui-te-paash) kilometarja lengsto un 5 (pantch) kilometarja buchlo hi, hi o Debleske ap i rig tchiddo. Kate hi o Debleskro kheer tardo. Un kate nai tchiwenn leskre rashaja pengre khera pre, kolla kai budrenn glan leste an leskro kheer.

Ko wawar kotar them, hoi hi 12,5 (deesh-te-dui-te-paash) kilometarja lengsto un 5 (pantch) kilometarja buchlo hi i Levitarenge, kolla an o Debleskro kheer budrenn. Kote nai krenn le penge forja, an kolla jon djiwenn.

Ap i rig fun ko kotar them, hoi o Debleske hi, well i kotar them o foreske Jerusalem, hoi hi 12,5 (deesh-te-dui-te-paash) kilometarja lengsto un 2,5 (dui-te-paash) kilometarja buchlo. Kate nai djiwenn menshe dran o tselo them Israel.

Un o rajeste pral o them denn i kotar them ap kai rig un ap i wawar rig fun ko kotar them, hoi hi o Debleske un o foreske Jerusalem, ap koi rig, kai o kham tele djal, un ap koi rig, kai o kham pre djal. Ap kal dui rigja djal o rajeskro them jaake dur, har ninna o them djal, hoi kol deesh-te-dui tchawe o Jakobestar lenna.

Kau kotar them well o rajeske. Les well gar budeder them an Israel. Kamau gar, te tchorenn mire raja o them mire menshendar. Na-a, jon hunte mukenn o them i Israelenge jaake har kowa o Jakobeskre tchawenge dino was.

Kawa penell o baro Dewel, maro rai: Kanna hi doha! Tumer raja pral o Israel, herenn pre, te rikrenn i menshen i sorjah tele! Dukrenn len buder gar! Krenn, hoi mishto un tchatcho hi! Mukenn tele, te tradenn mire menshen dran pengre khera win! Kawa penell o baro Dewel, maro rai.
Tumen hunte well i waga, hoi o tchatcho pharepen sikrell. Un tumare pirja un khore, hoi lenn tumer, te dikenn, har bud tchomone hi, kolla hunte wenn o tchatcho barepen.

I piri, hoi sikrell har bud djob dren hi, un o khoro, hoi sikrell har bud djet dren hi, kolla dui hunte wenn emligo bares. An hakeno lendar hunte djal i deshto kotar fun i korba, an koleste 220 litarja djan. Pal sawi korba well lengro barepen win kerdo, har bares jon wenn.
Un kol barra, hoi sikrenn har pharo tchomone hi, hunte sikrenn o tchatcho pharepen.
Kowa hi, hoi tumer hunte anenn o baro Debleske: o 60. (shob-deshto) kotar fun o djob un fun o gib, hoi tumer dren anan.
Un jek litari djet fun sheel litarja, hoi kran.

Te hi jekes dui sheel bakre, hunte anell lo jek lendar. Dran o tselo them Israel hunte anenn i menshe kowa, te well mange chapen dran djob chatchedo, ninna vieche, hoi tseles chatchedo wenn, un wawar, hoi chan le khetne glan mande, te well lauter krik lino, hoi mank mande un i menshende tardo hi. Kawa penell o baro Dewel, maro rai.
Un hakeno an o them Israel hunte dell kowa, un anell kau koowa pash o rajeste pral Israel.

O rai hunte dikell koi pre, te wenn i vieche, o djob un i mool anlo glan o baro Debleste an kol bare diwessa, kai wenn i Israelitarja khetne, te sharenn le o Debles, ninna ap ko diwes, kai well o newo tchon diklo, un ap o Debleskro diwes, un ap kol tsele wawar bare diwessa. O rai dell ko djob, koi mool un kol viechen i rashajen, te anenn jon kowa glan o baro Debleste, te well lauter krik lino, hoi mank o Debleste un i Israelitarjen tardo hi. I vieche, hoi maredo wenn, hi sawe, kai wenn tseles chatchedo un sawe, kai wenn maredo, te well i doosh krik lino, un sawe, kai chan i menshe khetne glan o baro Debleste.

Kawa penell o baro Dewel, maro rai: An o jekeskro tchon ap o jekeskro diwes an ko tchon well i terno sasto gurum wi-rodedo un maredo, te well leskro rateha i doosh un o pale-tchiddo koowa dran o Debleskro kheer krik lino.

Un o rashai lell ko rat ko viechestar, un makell les ap i pesse kashta, hoi hi tchatches un serwes o wudarestar an o Debleskro kheer, un ap i star ekke fun i chatchepaskri, un ap i pesse kashta tchatches un serwes o wudarestar glan i tikni glanstuni platsa.
Un jaake kress tu kowa ninna ap o eftato diwes fun ko tchon, hakeneske, kai doosh ap peste las, un kowa gar kamas un djinas. Un jaake lenn tumer i doosh un o pale-tchiddo koowa krik dran o kheer.
An o glanstuno tchon ap o 14. (deesh-te-starto) diwes an ko tchon, rikrenn kol bare diwessa dren, hoi kharenn Passa, un hoi djan 7 (efta) diwessa. An kau tsiro hunte chan kek maro dran shutlo jarro.
Ap o deesh-te-starto diwes anell o rai peske un i tsele menshenge an Israel i gurum, hoi maredo well, te well i doosh lendar krik lino.

Un an kol efta diwessa, anell lo hako diwes efta terne saste gurma, un efta saste mursh bakre, te wenn le maredo un tseles chatchedo o baro Debleske, un koi pashel hako diwes jek mursh busni, te well i doosh un o pale-tchiddo koowa krik lino.
Pash hako gurum un hako bakro wenn 12 (deesh-te-dui) kilogramme jarro un jek khoro djet koi pashel dino.

An o eftato tchon ap o 15. (deesh-te-pantchto) diwes an ko tchon well ko festo, kai djiwenn i Israelitarja an patjengre khera efta diwessa. An kal efta diwessa krell o rai jaake har an kal efta diwessa glan kowa, un anell ko emligo koowa o baro Debleske: vieche, hoi wenn maredo un tseles chatchedo, un sawe, hoi wenn maredo, te well i doosh krik lino, ninna djob un djet. Un halauter well jaake kerdo har glan kowa.

Kawa penell o baro Dewel, maro rai: Ko wudar glan i tikni glanstuni platsa ap koi rig, kai o kham pre djal, kowa atchell pandlo ap kol shob diwessa, kai budrenn le. Ap o eftato diwes – ko Debleskro diwes – well lo pre kerdo, ninna ap o diwes, kai o newo tchon diklo well.

Un o rai djal fun i bari glanstuni platsa dren an i wudareskri halla un atchell tardo pash i pesse kashta, hoi hi tchatches un serwes o wudarestar. Un i rashaja lenn leskre vieche, hoi lo o Debleske dell, un marenn len, un anenn len glan o baro Debleste, kolen kai wenn tseles chatchedo, un kolen, kai wenn chalo glan o Debleste. Un o rai atchell an o wudar un mangell o baro Debles an. Un palle djal lo pale win. O wudar atchell pre, bis te well i rati.
Ninna i Israelitarja wenn glan kau baro wudar ap o Debleskro diwes un ap ko diwes, kai well o newo tchon diklo, un mangenn o baro Debles an.
Kol vieche, hoi anell o rai o baro Debleske ap o Debleskro diwes, te wenn le leske maredo un tseles chatchedo, hi shob terne saste bakre, un jek murshkano bakro.

Un ko chapen dran djob, hoi glan o Debleste anlo well, hi 12 (deesh-te-dui) kilogramme jarro ko murshkano bakreske, un jaake bud jarro, har kamell lo, i terne bakrenge. Un jek khoro djet pash hake 12 (deesh-te-dui) kilogramme jarro.
Ap o diwes, kai well o newo tchon diklo, anell o rai jek terno gurum un shob terne bakre – halauter hunte wenn sasto – te wenn le maredo un chatchedo o Debleske.

Koi pashel anell lo 12 (deesh-te-dui) kilogramme jarro ko gurumeske un 12 (deesh-te-dui) kilogramme jarro ko murshkano bakreske, un jaake bud jarro, har kamell lo, i terne bakrenge. Un jek khoro djet pash hake 12 (deesh-te-dui) kilogramme jarro.
Un ap ko emligo drom, kai djas o rai dren an koi wudareskri halla, djal lo pale win.

I wawar Israelitarja, te wenn le glan o baro Debleste, te mangenn le les an ap kol bare diwessa, hunte djan jon gar an o emligo baro wudar dren un win. Koon dren djal an ko baro wudar, hoi ap koi rig hi, kai norden hi, kowa djal win dran ko wudar ap koi rig, kai o kham pralstunes tardo hi. Un koon an o wudar dren well, hoi ap koi rig hi, kai o kham pralstunes tardo hi, djal dran ko wudar win, kai kote hi, kai norden hi. Job djal gar an ko wudar win, kai lo dren djas. Na-a, dran o wudar, hoi wergel hi, djal lo win.
Un o rai djal lentsa dren ap koi bari glanstuni platsa, un djal ninna pale lentsa win.

Un ap kol bare diwessa anell lo 12 (deesh-te-dui) kilogramme jarro ko gurumeske un 12 (deesh-te-dui) kilogramme jarro ko murshkano bakreske, un jaake bud jarro, har kamell lo i terne bakrenge. Un jek khoro djet pash hake 12 kilogramme jarro.

Un te kamell o rai i viecho pestar o baro Debleske te anell, nai well sawo viecho, hoi well tseles chatchedo, nai well sawo viecho, hoi chan le khetne glan o baro Debleste, palle well leske o baro wudar pre kerdo, hoi ap koi rig hi, kai o kham pre djal, te nai well o dren, har lo ap o Debleskro diwes ninna dren well. Un palle djal lo pale koi win. Un o baro wudar hunte well pal leste pandlo.
Haki tsalla hunte well jek sasto terno bakro, hoi jek bersh phuro hi, maredo un chatchedo o baro Debleske.
Un haki tsalla well koi pashel i chapen glan o baro Debleste anlo: dui kilogramme jarro un jek litari latcho djet, hoi ap o jarro tchoredo well. Jaake well kowa kerdo hako tsireske.
Haki tsalla, diwes pal diwes, well o bakro, o jarro un o djet o baro Debleske chatchedo.
Kawa penell o baro Dewel, maro rai: Te dell o rai jekes peskre tchawendar i kotar them pestar, atchell kowa hako tsireske leske.

Te dell o rai i budepaskres i kotar them pestar, atchell ko kotar them koleske jaake rah, bis te well ko bersh, kai halauter pale dino hunte well ap koleste, koneske kowa his. Palle djal ko kotar them pale pale pash o rajeste. Kokres i tchawe o rajestar nai rikrenn, hoi len dino well.

Un o rai lell gar ko themestar, hoi i Israelenge dino was, te atchell kowa lenge. Jon hunte wenn gar win tradedo dran koleste, hoi lenge hi. Fun peskro, hoi leskro hi, dell o rai peskre tchawen, te well kowa lenge. Kek mire menshendar hunte well win tradedo dran kowa, hoi lenge hi.

Un ko mursh anas man ap ko drom, hoi langs ko baro wudar hi, hoi kote hi, kai norden hi, un anas man pash i rashajengre iseme, hoi kote hi, kai norden hi. Dur palla dikom i isema an koi ekka, kai o kham tele djal.

Un job penas ap mande: Kowa hi koi isema, kai kerenn i rashaja ko mass kol viechendar, hoi maredo wan, te well i doosh pale mishto, ninna kol viechendar, kai maredo wan, te well i doosh un o pale-tchiddo koowa krik lino, un kai le pengro maro pekenn dran ko djob un dran ko djet, hoi o Debleske dino was. Jon hunte hidjrenn kowa gar ap i bari glanstuni platsa, te taprenn gar i menshe kowa an, hoi o Debleske hi.
Un palle anas lo man win ap i bari glanstuni platsa, un mukas man an i star ekke fun kai platsa te djal. Un koi dikom an haki ekka his i tikni platsa.
Haki tikni platsa his jaake baro har koi wawar: 20 metarja lengsto un 15 metarja buchlo.
Un trul lende djas i massuri trujel. Un dren trul koi massuri his boba tardo.
Un o mursh penas ap mande: Kalla hi i boba, kate kerenn i budepangre o Debleskro kherestar o mass kol viechendar, hoi chan i menshe khetne glan o Debleste.

Un ko mursh anas man palpale pash o wudar o Debleskro kherestar. Leskri glanstuni rig his koi rig, kai o kham pre djal. Kote dikom pani, hoi nashas tel o wudar win. Kau pani nashas i kotar tele ap koi glanstuni rig o kherestar pash koi rig, kai o kham pralstunes tardo hi. Palle djas lo kote, kai koi chatchepaskri tardo hi, dureder ap koi rig, kai o kham pre djal.

Un job anas man win dran ko wudar, hoi kote hi, kai norden hi. Un anas man win trul i massuri pash ko wudar, hoi kote hi, kai o kham pre djal. Kote dikom, har nashas o pani tel o wudar win, ap koi rig, kai o kham pralstunes tardo hi.
Un ko mursh djas dureder kote, kai o kham pre djal, un les his i dori an peskro wast. Un kolah ginas lo 500 metarja tele, un mukas man an o pani dren te djal. O pani tchakras mire pire.

Un job ginas gomme 500 metarja tele, un mukas man an o pani dren te djal. Un o pani djas mange bis pash i tchanga. Un job ginas gomme 500 metarja tele, un mukas man an o pani dren te djal, un o pani djas mange tel o betch.
Un job ginas gomme 500 metarja tele, un ko pani djas jaake dur tele, te nai djom gar dren. Ko pani his jaake dur tele, te hunte shwimrals jek wergel.
Un job penas ap mande: Tu mensho, dikal tu kawa? Un job anas man palpale ap o panjeskri rig.
Un har pale wom, dikom kote bud ruka ap kol dui rigja o panjestar.

Un job penas ap mande: Kau pani nashell win an ko kotar them, hoi kote hi, kai o kham pre djal, un dureder tele an i tala, kai o Jordan nashell, bis te well lo an o Londo Baro Pani. Un ko baro pani well palle sasto.
Kote kai ko lengsto pani nashell un well, kote hi djipen. Un kau pani krell, te well o Londo Baro Pani sasto, un bud bud matche djiwenn koi dren. Kai kau pani nashell, well halauter sasto un djiwell.

Un pash leste hi matchengre tardo. An o tselo them mank En-Gedi un En-Eglajim tchiwenn le pengre matchengre gone win, te wenn le truk. Hako matcho, hoi dell, hi an leste, jaake bud har an o Mashkralstuno Baro Pani.
Kokres kote, kai o pani tardo hi, un gar nashell, atchell o pani londo, un lestar lenn le loon.

Ap kol dui rigja o lengsto panjestar hi ruka tardo. Kolla hi o tselo bersh senelo, un hidjrenn hako tsiro rukengre. Hako tchon wenn newe rukengre bares. Ko lengsto pani, kolestar jon pani lenn, well win dran o Debleskro kheer. Lengre rukengre hi o chapaske. Un lengre patria krenn i nasselen sasto.

Kawa penell o baro Dewel, maro rai: Kanna penau tuke, har baro kau them hi, un hawo kotar lestar lell hakeno kol deesh-te-dui tchawendar o Jakobestar. Denn hakeneste leskro kotar them, te atchell kowa leske hako tsireske! Kal deesh-te-dui kotja hi emliges baro. O kheer Josef lell dui kotja. Me dom man sowel, te dap kau them tumare phurende. Un jaake well lo tumenge, te atchell lo an tumare familje.
Ap koi rig, kai norden hi, djal o them Israel fun o baro pani bis pash o foro Hetlon, un dureder bis pash i forja Hamat un Zedad,

un dureder bis pash i forja Berota un Sibrajim, hoi kote tchiddo hi, kai o them trul Damaskus khetne well ko themeha trul Hamat. Fun kotar djal o them Israel dureder bis pash o foro Hazar-Enan, hoi pash o them tchiddo hi, hoi trul i berga Hauran hi.
Jaake djal o them Israel ap i nordetikri rig fun o Mashkralstuno Baro Pani bis pash o foro Hazar-Enan. Ap koi nordetikri rig lestar hi kol forja Damaskus un Hamat tchiddo.

Un koi rig o themestar Israel djal fun kotar, kai o kham pre djal, mashkral o foro Hauran un o foro Damaskus dureder langs o lengsto pani Jordan bis tele pash o Londo Baro Pani. O Jordan nashell mank o them Israel un o them Gilead. Pash o Londo Baro Pani djal o them Israel bis pash o foro Tamar. Jaake dur djal o them Israel ap koi rig, kai o kham pre djal.

Un ap koi rig, kai o kham pralstunes tardo hi, djal o them Israel fun o foro Tamar bis pash o pani, hoi kharell Meriba-Kadesh, un dureder langs ko tikno pani, hoi nashell mank Israel un Egiptia, bis pash o Mashkralstuno Baro Pani. Jaake dur djal o them Israel ap koi rig, kai o kham pralstunes tardo hi.
Un kote, kai o kham tele djal, djal o them Israel bis pash o Mashkralstuno Baro Pani, bis pre wergel o foro Hamat. Jaake dur djal o them Israel ap koi rig, kai o kham tele djal.
Denn kau them i Israelenge, te well hako tchaweske o Jakobestar peskro kotar them.

Kau them hi tumare familjenge, un well o dadestar ap o tchaweste dureder dino. Te witsrenn tumer kashta, hoi sikrenn, koon hawo kotar them lella, palle bistrenn gar kol wi-themarjen, kai mank tumende djiwenn, un kolenge pash tumende tchawe boldo wan! Jon hunte wenn tumenge har jek fun tumendar Israelitarja. Un khetne tumentsa lenn le pengro kotar them, un kowa atchell an lengre familje.
Un hakeno lendar lell peskro kotar them pash ko Jakobeskro tchaweste, kai job djiwell. Kawa penell o baro Dewel, maro rai.

Un kalla hi i laba kol deesh-te-dui bare familjendar un ko kotar them, hoi hakeni lendar lell. Ko kotar them, hoi ap i nordetikri rig tchiddo hi, lell o kheer Dan. Kau them djal fun o Mashkralstuno Baro Pani bis pash o foro Hetlon, un dureder bis pash o foro Hamat, un dureder bis pash o foro Hazar-Enan. Ap leskri nordetikri rig hi o foro Damaskus tchiddo, wergel ko foro Hamat. Jaake dur hi kau kotar them, hoi o kheer Dan lell, fun kotar, kai o kham pre djal, bis kote, kai o kham tele djal.

Ninna i wawar bare familje lenn i kotar them, hoi djal fun kote, kai o kham pre djal, bis kote, kai o kham tele djal. Ap i tchatchi rig ko themestar, hoi o kheer Dan lell, well ko them, hoi lell o kheer Asser. Ap i tchatchi rig ko themestar, hoi o kheer Asser lell, well ko them, hoi lell o kheer Naftali. Ap i tchatchi rig ko themestar, hoi o kheer Naftali lell, well ko them, hoi lell o kheer Manasse. Ap i tchatchi rig ko themestar, hoi o kheer Manasse lell, well ko them, hoi lell o kheer Efrajim. Ap i tchatchi rig ko themestar, hoi o kheer Efrajim lell, well ko them, hoi lell o kheer Ruben. Ap i tchatchi rig ko themestar, hoi o kheer Ruben lell, well ko them, hoi lell o kheer Juda.

Ap i tchatchi rig ko themestar, hoi o kheer Juda lell, tchiwenn i kotar ap i rig, hoi mange hi. Kau kotar djal ninna fun kote, kai o kham pre djal bis kote, kai o kham tele djal, un hi 12,5 (deesh-te-dui-te-paash) kilometarja buchlo, un jaake lengsto har kol wawar kotja ninna. Mashkral dren hi miro kheer tardo.
Kau kotar them, hoi tchiwenn tumer mange ap i rig hi 12,5 (deesh-te-dui-te-paash) kilometarja lengsto un 10 (deesh) kilometarja buchlo.
Fun kau kotar hi i paash i rashajenge: 12,5 (deesh-te-dui-te-paash) kilometarja lengsto un 5 (pantch) kilometarja buchlo. Mashkral dren hi miro kheer tardo.
Kau kotar hi kol rashajenge, kai wenn pal o Zadok. Jon hi mange koi, un budran mange, un peran gar mandar tele, har i Levitarja khetne i Israelentsa mandar tele peran.
Doleske well lenge kau kotar ko themestar, hoi mange hi, un kai miro kheer tardo hi. Kau kotar hi kokres i rashajenge, un hi tchiddo pash ko kotar them, hoi lenn i wawar Levitarja.

Un langs ko kotar them, hoi lenn kol rashaja, lenn i Levitarja pengro kotar them. Kowa hi ninna 12,5 (deesh-te-dui-te-paash) kilometarja lengsto un 5 (pantch) kilometarja buchlo. Ko tselo kotar, hoi o Debleske ap i rig tchiddo hi, hi 12,5 (deesh-te-dui-te-paash) kilometarja lengsto un 10 (deesh) kilometarja buchlo.
Un i Levitarja hunte bikrenn tchi pengro themestar un tchi parenn. Kau fetester kotar them hunte well gar an i wawarengre wasta. Kau kotar them was o baro Debleske dino.

Un ko kotar them, hoi pral atchell – 2,5 (dui-te-paash) kilometarja buchlo un 12,5 (deesh-te-dui-te-paash) kilometarja lengsto – kowa hi gar o Debleske. Kowa hi o foreske Jerusalem, te djiwenn i menshe kote, un te hatsenn i vieche kote senlepen. Un ko foro well mashkral dren.
Un jaake baro well ko foro: 2.250 (dui-serja-dui-sheel-te-paash-sheel) metarja ap haki rig.
Un trul o foro, ap hake star rigja, well i kotar them, hoi hi 125 (sheel-te-biish-te-pantch) metarja buchlo. Kote nai chan i vieche.

Ap kol dui rigja o forestar, kai o kham pral djal un kai lo tele djal, atchell i kotar them, hoi hi ap kal dui rigja 5 (pantch) kilometarja lengsto. Leskri nordetikri rig djal bis ap ko kotar them, hoi mange, o baro Debleske dino hi. Kate nai budrenn kolla ap i hachetikri phub, kai an o foro Jerusalem budrenn, te well len chapaske.
Jon wenna dran kol tsele 12 (deesh-te-dui) bare familje an Israel.
Ko tselo kotar them, hoi tumer ap i rig tchiwenn o Debleske un o foreske Jerusalem, kowa hi ap haki rig 12,5 (deesh-te-dui-te-paash) kilometarja lengsto. Haki rig hi emligo baro.

Un kowa hoi ap kol dui rigja pral atchell, ap ko rig, kai o kham pre djal bis pash o pani Jordan, un ap koi rig, kai o kham tele djal bis pash o Mashkralstuno Baro Pani, kowa hi o baro rajeske. Kowa hi o them mashkral o them Juda un o them Benjamin. Mashkral dren an o rajeskro kotar them hi ko kotar them, kai o Debleskro kheer tardo hi, un hoi hi i rashajenge, un ko kotar i Levitarenge, un ko kotar, kai o foro Jerusalem tardo hi.

Palle lenn i wawar bare familje, kai pral atchan, pengro kotar them, hoi djal fun kote, kai o kham pre djal bis kote, kai o kham tele djal. Ap i tchatchi rig ko themestar, hoi o rajeske hi, well ko them, hoi lell o kheer Benjamin. Ap i tchatchi rig ko themestar, hoi o kheer Benjamin lell, well ko them, hoi lell o kheer Simeon. Ap i tchatchi rig ko themestar, hoi o kheer Simeon lell, well ko them, hoi lell o kheer Issachar. Ap i tchatchi rig ko themestar, hoi o kheer Issachar lell, well ko them, hoi lell o kheer Sebulon. Ap i tchatchi rig ko themestar, hoi o kheer Sebulon lell, well ko them, hoi lell o kheer Gad.

O them Gad djal ap koi rig, kai o kham pralstunes tardo hi, bis pash o foro Tamar, un fun kote dureder bis pash o pani Meriba pash o foro Kadesh, un fun kotar dureder bis pash ko tikno pani, hoi nashell mank Israel un Egiptia bis pash o baro pani.

Kawa hi o them, hoi denn tumer i bare familjenge, kai wenna kol 12 (deesh-te-dui) tchawendar o Jakobestar, te lell hakeni peskro kotar them. Kau them hi hako tsireske i Israelenge, un well o dadestar ap o tchaweste dureder dino. Kawa penell o baro Dewel, maro rai.

Trul o foro Jerusalem hi i massuri, hoi ap haki rig 2.250 (dui-serja-dui-sheel-te-paash-sheel) metarja lengsto hi. An haki rig hi triin bare wudja. Un kol wudja kharenn har i laba o Jakobeskre 12 (deesh-te-dui) tchawendar. Ap i nordetikri rig: o wudar Ruben un o wudar Juda un o wudar Levi. Ap i rig, kai o kham pre djal: o wudar Josef un o wudar Benjamin un o wudar Dan. Ap i rig, kai o kham pralstunes tardo hi: o wudar Simeon un o wudar Issachar un o wudar Sebulon. Ap i rig, kai o kham tele djal: o wudar Gad un o wudar Asser un o wudar Naftali.
Kal star rigja o forestar hi khetne enja (9) kilometarja lengsto. Fun ko tsiro well o foro kharedo: O baro Dewel hi kai!

An ko tsiro, har o Jojakim an o triinto bersh o baro rai pral o them Juda his, was o baro rai pral o them Babilonia – leskro lab his Nebukadnezar – glan o foro Jerusalem, un tchiwas pes peskre lurdentsa trul o foro.

Un o baro Dewel, maro rai, das o Jojakimes, ko baro rajes pral o them Juda, an o wast o baro rajestar dran o them Babilonia. Ninna ko shukar koowa, hoi an o Debleskro kheer his, kolestar peras an leskre wasta. Un job anas kowa an o them Shinar, an o kheer leskro deblestar. Un tchiwas les pash ko brawlepen leskro deblestar pashel.
Un o baro rai penas o pralstuneske pral peskro kheer, – leskro lab his Ashpenas – te rodell lo dran i Israelitarjen terne murshen win, kai wenn dran rajengre un an-dikle familje.

“Jon hunte wenn sasto un shukar, gosewo un siklo”, penas lo. “Ninna hunte haiwenn le pen an halauter mishto win, un nai haiwenn sik, jaake te nai budrenn le mange an miro kheer. Un lenge well pashel anlo, har i Kaldearja rakrenn un pengro rakepen tchinenn.”
Un o baro rai penas, te lenn le o chapen, hoi job ninna chal, un i mool, hoi job pijell. Un triin bersha hunte well lende lauter siklo un pashel anlo. Un palle budrenn le leske.
Mank kol wi-rodede terne murshende dran o them Juda his: O Daniel, o Hananja, o Mishael un o Asarja.
Un o pralstuno pral o rajeskro kheer das hakenes lendar i wawar lab. O Daniel kharas kanna Beltsazar, un o Hananja Shadrach, un o Mishael Meshach, un o Asarja Abed-Nego.

O Daniel las peske an peskro dji glan, te chal lo gar o baro rajeskro chapen un pijell gar leskri moljatar, te krell lo pes gar pale-tchiddo. Un job mangas o pralstunestar pral o rajeskro kheer, te hunte krell lo pes gar pale-tchiddo.
Un o Dewel kras, te was o pralstuno pral o rajeskro kheer latches un kamles ap o Danieleste.

Un kowa penas ap o Daniel: “O baro rai kokres penas, hoi te chan un pijenn tumer. Me darau lestar, te dikell lo, te dikenn tumer gar jaake mishto win har kol wawar terne mursha. Te wals kowa jaake, wals mange tumenge o shero tele dino.”
Koi his i mursh, koles o pralstuno pral o rajeskro kheer pral lende tchiwas, te dell lo jak ap o Daniel, ap o Hananja un o Mishael un o Asarja. Ap koleste penas o Daniel:
“Hoi wals, te dess tu men, tire budepangren, deesh diwessa senlepen te chal un pani te pijell?
Un palle nai dikals tu, har mer wi-dikah, un har kol terne mursha win dikenn, kai chan o rajeskro chapen. Un pal kowa, hoi tu dikal, kre tu mentsa dureder.”
Un job shunas ap lende un kras deesh diwessa lentsa jaake har o Daniel penas.
Un pal kol deesh diwessa sikras pes, te dikan jon feteder un sorleder win har kol tsele terne mursha, kai o rajeskro chapastar chan.
Kote las ko mursh, kai ap lende jak das, ko chapen un koi mool krik, hoi lenge kerdo was, un das len senlepen te chal.

Un kol star terne murshen das o Dewel i baro goswepen, te haiwan le lila an bud rakepen te drawerell. Ninna haiwan le pen win an bud koowa. Un o Daniel haiwas ninna te penell, hoi sunja un dikepen kamenn te penell.
Un har ko tsiro trujel his, hoi o baro rai lende das, te wenn le siklo, anas len o pralstuno, o Ashpenas, glan o baro rajeste Nebukadnezar.
Un o baro rai rakras lentsa! Un mank kol tsele mursha was kek hatslo, koon jaake his har o Daniel un o Hananja un o Mishael un o Asarja. Un jon wan pralstune an o baro rajeskro kheer.
Un an hako koowa, hoi o baro rai lendar putchas, his jon deesh kope gosweder un haiwan budeder har i tsele durkepangre un drawepangre an i tsele themma, kai o Nebukadnezar baro rai his.
Un o Daniel atchas pralstuno bis an o ersto bersh, kai o Kirus baro rai his.
Un an ko tsiro, har o Nebukadnezar an o duito bersh o baro rai his, his les i suni, kai les sawi daar kras, te nai sowas lo buder gar dren.

Un o baro rai mukas khetne te kharell i tsele durkepangren un drawepangren, kolen, kai bengeskro koowa krenn un kolen, kai an i bolepangre momlia drawerenn. Jon hunte penan leske, hoi leskri suni kamell te penell. Un jon wan un his tardo glan leste.
Un o baro rai penas ap lende: “Me dikom i suni, koja mange palla djal, un me kamau tumendar te djinell, hoi dom suni, un hoi koi suni kamell te penell.”
Kote rakran i durkepangre an aramtikes ap leste un penan: “Maro baro rai, te djiwess hako tsiro! Pen tiri suni ap mende, tire budepangre! Un mer kamah tuke te penell, hoi koi suni kamell te penell.”

O baro rai penas ap lende: “Hi jaake har penom: Tumer hunte penenn mange i suni, un hoi koja kamell te penell. Te krenn tumer kowa gar, palle mukau me tumen an kotja te tchinell, un tumare khera tele te phagell.
Tumer te penenn mange koi suni un hoi koja kamell te penell, palle krau me tumen braweles un bares. Doleske penenn mange koi suni un hoi koja kamell te penell.”
Un jon penan o duito kopo: “Maro baro rai, mer ham tire budepangre. Pen menge tiri suni! Un mer penah tuke, hoi li kamell te penell.”
Un o baro rai penas: “Tchatchepah, me dikau, tumer rakrenn jaake, te well tumen budeder tsiro. Tumer djinenn, kowa hoi me penom, krau ninna tumentsa.

Tumer lan tumenge glan, te rakrenn o chochepen glan mande, bis te well o tsiro wawartchandes. Doleske penau: Te penenn tumer mange gar koi suni, palle well i phagi pral tumende lauterende. Kanna penenn mange koi suni! Palle nai djinau, te nai penenn mange ninna, hoi joi kamell te penell.”

Un jon penan ap leste: “Kek mensho ap kai phub nai penell tuke, hoi tu kameh, baro rai! Kek baro rai, har baro un sorelo job ninna his, putchas sawo koowa jekestar mank peskre durkepangre un drawepangre un kolendar, kai an i bolepangre momlia drawerenn.
Kowa, hoi tu, baro rai, kai kameh, hi jaake pharo, te nai penell kowa kek, kokres i debla. Un kolla djiwenn gar pash i menshende.”
Kote was o baro rai jaake chojedo, te penas lo, te wenn i tsele sikle mursha maredo an o them Babilonia.
Un kau lab was i lurdenge penlo. Un jaake rodan le ninna o Danieles un leskre malen, te marenn le len.

Koi djas o Daniel pash o pralstuno lurdeste kolendar, kai dan jak ap o baro rajeste. Leskro lab his Arjoch. Job his kowa, kai win djas, te marell lo i sikle murshen an o them Babilonia. Un o Daniel rakras gosewe labentsa leha un putchas lestar:
“Hoske rakras o baro rai sawi phari phagi win?” Un o Arjoch penas o Danieleske, hoi djas.
Kote pre djas o Daniel pash o baro rajeste dren, un mangas lestar, te dell lo les i tsiro, te nai penell lo leske, hoi koi suni kamell te penell.
Pal kowa djas o Daniel khere, un penas lauter peskre malenge, – un kolla his o Hananja un o Mishael, un o Asarja –
te mangenn le o bolepaskro Debles, te well lo lenge latches, un te sikrell lo len ko khatedo koowa, jaake te wenn jon gar maredo khetne kol wawar sikle murshentsa an o them Babilonia.
Un an i rati dikas o Daniel i dikepen un leske was koi suni sikedo. Un o Daniel sharas o bolepaskro Debles,
un penas: Sharedo well o Dewel kanna un hako tsireske! Leske hi o goswepen un i soor.

Job hi o rai pral o tsiro, un dell hakeneste peskro tsiro; job lell i bare rajendar lengro them, un tchiwell wawar rajen dren; job dell i gosewen lengro goswepen un kolen, kai haiwenn tchomone, das job an o shero, te nai haiwenn le.
Job tchakrella pre un sikrell, hoi khatedo hi, un djinell, hoi an o tamlepen hi; pash leste hi kek tamlepen.
Tu, o Dewel mire phurendar, pash tute parkrau man un tut sharau, te dal man goswepen un soor, un mukal man te djinell, hoi tutar mangam, un sikral man kowa, hoi o baro rai kamell te djinell.

Un o Daniel djas dren pash o Arjoch, koles o baro rai bitchras, te marell lo i siklen an o them Babilonia. Un o Daniel penas ap leste: “Ma mare i siklen dran Babilonia! An man pash o baro rajeste, te nai penap me leske, hoi leskri suni kamell te penell.”

Kote anas o Arjoch o Danieles sik pash o baro rajeste un penas ap leste: “Me hatsom i murshes mank kolende, kai wan pandlo dran o them Juda kate anlo. Kowa nai penell tuke, miro baro rai, hoi tiri suni kamell te penell.”
Un o baro rai putchas o Danielestar, koleskro lab kanna Beltsazar his: “Haiweh tu kowa, te nai peness tu mange, hoi me suni dikom, un hoi koi suni kamell te penell?”
Un o Daniel penas ap o baro rajeste: “Kowa, hoi tu kameh te djinell, miro rai, kowa nai penell tuke kek siklo, kek drawepaskro, kek durkepaskro un kek, kai nai drawerell an i bolepangre momlia.

Kanna djin, an o bolepen hi i Dewel, kowa nai sikrell, hoi khatedo hi. Un job mukell o baro rajes Nebukadnezares te djinell, hoi wella an kol tsirja, kai wenna. Ake kowa, hoi suni dal un ko dikepen, hoi dikal, har sowal:
Har hals ap tiro tchiben tchiddo, djas tuke, baro rai, an o shero trujel, hoi pal kawa lauter wella. Un o Dewel, kai tchakrell pre, hoi khatedo hi, kowa sikras tut, hoi wella.
Me hom gar gosweder har i wawar, kai ap i phub djiwenna. Man was kawa sikedo, te djiness tu, hoi koi suni kamell te penell, un te haiwess, hoi an tiro dji hi.
Tu, miro baro rai, dikal an i suni i bari figura glan tute tardo. Un i baro railepen djas latar win. Un i figura dikas win, te hunte las jek daar.
Lat his i shero, hoi his dran latcho sonakai. Un o betch un i mussja his dran rup. Un o per bis ap i herja his dran lolo saster.
Un i pralstune herja his dran saster. Un kotja i pirendar his dran saster, un wawar kotja dran phubjakri tchik.
Un har dikal ap koi figura, koi peras i bar tele, koles kek mensho witsras. Un ko bar peras ap kol pire dran saster un phubjakri tchik, un das len paash.

Koi djas i tseli figura paash. Un o saster, i phubjakri tchik, o lolo saster, o rup un o sonakai peran khetne an tikne kotja. Un i ducho phurdas len krik har phuss. Un kek nai hatsas len buder. Un ko bar, hoi koi figura khetne das, was i bari berga, un las i tseli phub dren.
Kawa hi koi suni. Un kanna kamau o baro rajeske te penell, hoi li kamell te penell:
Tu miro baro rai, hal o bareder i tsele rajendar. O bolepaskro Dewel kras, te wal baro rai, das tut soor un kras tut bares.
Un das an tiro wast i tsele themma, kai menshe djiwenna, ninna i viechen an o weesh un i tchirklen tel o bolepen. Un kras tut rai pral lende. Tu hal ko shero dran sonakai.
Un pal tute well i wawar rai. Kowa hi buder gar jaake sorelo har tu. Un pal koleste well i triinto rai. Koleskro them hi har dran lolo saster, un hi rai pral i tseli phub.
Un ko starto rai hi sorelo har saster. Un jaake har o saster lauter phagell un paash dell, jaake krell job ninna lauter paash, hoi leske an o drom tchiddo hi.

Tu dikal, kai i kotja i pirendar dran phubjakri tchik hi un wawar kotja dran saster. Kowa kamell te penell, koi hi budeder themma, hoi gar tchatchepah khetne rikrenna. Kai saster dren hi, kote hi le soreles.
Un kai kol tsebe dran saster un phubjakri tchik hi, kamell menge te penell, kai o paash them sorelo hi, un o wawar paash gar sorelo.
Un tu dikal, kai o saster un i phubjakri tchik khetne kerdo hi. Kowa kamell te penell, te romedineran le mank pende, un wan gar jek. Jaake har o saster un i phubjakri tchik nai wenn gar jek.

Un an ko tsiro, kai kol bare raja djiwenna, krell o bolepaskro Dewel jek them, hoi an kek tsiro paash kerdo nai well. Kau them well an kek tsiro wawar menshendar dren lino. Leskro baro rai krell kol wawar rajengre themma paash, un leskri soor atchell hako tsireske.

Kowa kamell ko bar te penell, hoi tu dikal, koles kek mensho witsras. Tu dikal, har was lo i berga tele un das koi figura dran saster, lolo saster, phubjakri tchik, rup un sonakai, an tikne kotja. Jaake mukell tut o baro Dewel te djinell, hoi pal kawa wella. Un kai suni penell o tchatchepen. Un hoi me penom, hoi kai suni kamell te penell, hi ninna tchatcho.”
Kote mukas pes o baro rai Nebukadnezar ap i phub te perell, glan o Daniel, un penas, te chatchrenn le leske chapen un sungepaskro koowa.

Un o baro rai penas ap o Daniel: “Tchatchepah tumaro Dewel hi o Dewel pral i tsele debla, un o rai pral i tsele bare raja ap kai phub. Job sikrell kowa, hoi khatedo his un kek djinas. Jaake nai penal tu menge, hoi koi suni kamas te penell.”

Un o baro rai kras o Danieles baro, un das les bud kutch koowa. Un job tchiwas les pral o tselo them Babilonia, un das les penepaske koi pral un kras, te well lo o pralstuno pral i tsele sikle murshende an o them Babilonia.
Un o Daniel mangas o baro rajestar, te wenn o Shadrach un o Meshach un o Abed-Nego i moskre pral i forja an o them Babilonia. Un kowa was jaake. O Daniel atchas an o baro rajeskro kheer.
O baro rai Nebukadnezar kras i sonakaskri figura, hoi shob-deesh (60) mussja bares un shob mussja buchles his. Un job tchiwas lat pre an o buchlo them Dura. Ko them Dura his an o them Babilonia.

Un o baro rai Nebukadnezar bitchras murshen win, te anenn le khetne i tsele pralstunen, bare lurden, themeskre rajen, tchatchepangre murshen, lowengre pralstunen, rakepangre, pralstune kliste un lauteren, kai his penepaske pral wawarende. Kolla te wenn pashel, te well koi figura o ersto kopo an-mangedo.
Un jon halauter wan un his tardo glan koi figura.
Un jek, kai win gole dell, hoi o baro rai kamella, stas pre un das gole: “Menshale dran hako them un rakepen, shunenn, hoi o baro rai tumenge penell:

Te shunenn tumer o bashepen ap i phurdepangre, ap i dorjengre bashepangre un ap i tsele wawar bashepangre, palle hunte witsrenn tumen tele glan koi sonakaskri figura, hoi mukas o baro rai Nebukadnezar pre te tchiwell.
Un kowa, kai witsrell pes gar tele un mangell koi figura gar an, kowa well sik lino un an i bobeskri jag witsedo.”

Un kol tsele menshe, kai khetne wan dran hako them un dran hako rakepen, shunan o phurdepaskro bashepen un o bashepen ap kol dorjengre bashepangre un ko tselo wawar bashepen. Koi witsran le pen tele ap i phub glan koi sonakaskri figura, hoi mukas o baro rai Nebukadnezar pre te tchiwell.
An ko tsiro wan Babilonarja un phukran ap i biboldende.
Un jon penan ap o baro rajeste Nebukadnezar: “O baro rai te djiwell hako tsireske!

Tu, maro baro rai rakral un penal: ‘Hakeno, kai shunell o phurdepaskro bashepen, o bashepen ap i dorjengre bashepangre un ko wawar bashepen, kowa hunte witsrell pes tele un hunte mangell koi sonakaskri figura an.
Un kowa, kai witsrell pes gar glan late tele un mangell lat gar an, kowa hunte well an i bobeskri jag witsedo.’

Un kate hi biboldengre mursha, hoi tu dren tchiwal an pengri budi, te wenn le pralstune an o them Babilonia. Kolla krenn gar, hoi tu penal, un sharenn tiro debles gar un mangenn koi figura gar an, hoi tu mukal pre te tchiwell. Kolla hi o Shadrach, o Meshach un o Abed-Nego.”
Un i bari choli tapras o Nebukadnezar. Un job penas, te anenn le kol triin murshen glan leste. Un i mursha wan glan leste anlo.
Un o Nebukadnezar putchas lendar: “Hi kowa tchatcho, Shadrach, Meshach, un Abed-Nego? Kamenn tumer gar miro debles te sharell, un koi sonakaskri figura gar an-mangell, hoi mukom pre te tchiwell?

Kanna shunenn: Jaake sik, har shunenn tumer o phurdepaskro bashepen un bashepen ap i dorjengre bashepangre un ko tselo wawar bashepen, witsrenn tumen tele ap i phub, un mangenn koi figura an, hoi me krom! Te witsrenn tumen gar glan late ap i phub, palle wenn tumer gomme kate an i bobeskri jag witsedo! Un koon hi ko dewel, kai nai lell tumen win dran miro wast?”
Un o Shadrach, o Meshach un o Abed-Nego penan ap o baro rajeste Nebukadnezar: “Mer hunte penas tuke kate tchi!
Maro Dewel, koles mer an-mangah, te kamell job, palle nai lell lo men win dran i bobeskri jag un dran tiro wast.
Un ninna te kamell lo kowa gar te krell, tu djiness: Mer sharah tiro debles gar, un mangah gar koi sonakaskri figura an, hoi tu mukal pre te tchiwell.”

Kote was o Nebukadnezar jaake pherdi choli, te was leskro mui lolo i choljatar pral o Shadrach, o Meshach un o Abed-Nego. Un job penas soreles, te well o bob efta kope jaake tateder kerdo, har glan ko tsiro.
Pale penas lo peskre sorleder lurdenge, te pandenn le o Shadrach un o Meshach un o Abed-Nego, un te witsrenn le len an koi bobeskri jag.
Un kolla pandan len un witsran len an koi bobeskri jag. Len his gomme pengre tsele koola ap pende: lengre baja, cholopja un stadja.

Un jaake har o baro rai penas, te krenn le, chatchras i jag an o bob soreles, jaake soreles, te tapras li kol murshen, kai kol trinen, o Shadrach un o Meshach un o Abed-Nego pre anan. Un kol mursha chatchran pre.
Un o Shadrach un o Meshach un o Abed-Nego peran pandles an i jag.

Un ap jek kopo kras o baro rai Nebukadnezar bare jaka. Un job stas ap peskre herja, un putchas kol pralstunendar, kai pash leste hi: “Mukam mer gar triin murshen te pandell un len an i jag te witsrell?” “Awa, baro rai, jaake hi!” penan le.
Job penas: “Me dikau star murshen, kai an i jag trujel djan. Un jon hi buder gar pandlo, un kek dukepen hi ap lende. Un ko starto dikell win har i bolepaskro.”

Un o Nebukadnezar djas pash ko wudar ko bobestar un das gole: “Shadrach, Meshach un Abed-Nego, tumer budepangre o pralstuno Deblestar, awenn koi win, un wenn pash mande!” Un o Shadrach, o Meshach un o Abed-Nego djan win dran i jag.

Un i pralstune, i bare lurde, o themeskre raja un wawar pralstune o baro rajestar wan khetne, un dikan penge kol murshen an, un dikan, kai i jag kek soor pral kolende his. Un i balla ap lengre sherja his gar chatchedo. Un lengre baja his gar paash. Un ap lende sungas nai kek i jagakri khand.

Un o Nebukadnezar penas: “Sharedo well o Dewel, koles o Shadrach un o Meshach un o Abed-Nego an-mangenn. Job bitchras peskro bolepaskres un las peskre budepangren dran o merepen win. Kolla rikran ap leste, un shunan gar ap miro lab, un dan pengro djipen an o merepen. Jon kaman kek wawar debles an-mangenn har pengro Debles kokres.

Un jaake penau me kanna: Koon i tsele menshendar dran hako them un rakepen rakrell djungeles pral ko Debleste, koles o Shadrach un o Meshach un o Abed-Nego an-mangenn, kowa well an kotja dino. Un koleskro kheer well pash dino. Hi kek wawar dewel, kai nai lell jekes jaake dran o merepen win har job.”
Pal kowa das o baro rai kol triin murshende bud penepaske an o them Babilonia.
O baro rai Nebukadnezar mukas i liil te tchinell ap i menshende dran hako them un hako rakepen, kai ap i tseli phub djiwenna. “Bari bacht tumenge!
Mange hi shukar, te penap tumenge ko baro koowa, hoi o pralstuno Dewel ap mande kras, hoi kek wawar nai krella.
Har baro hi kowa, hoi job krell! Har sorelo hi lo un krell, hoi kek wawar nai krella! Job hi un atchell o rai kanna un hako tsireske.”
Me, o Nebukadnezar homs bachtelo an miro kheer, un man his lauter, hoi kamom.
His jek rati, har homs tchiddo ap miro tchiben, koi dom suni. Un koja kras mange daar. Awa, kowa, hoi dikom, kras mange bari traash.
Un me penom soreles, te wenn i tsele sikle mursha an o them Babilonia pash mande khetne, te nai penenn le mange, hoi koi suni kamell te penell.

Kote wan pash mande: i tsele durkepangre un drawepangre, un kolla, kai an i bolepangre momlia drawerenn, un kolla, kai i mulen putchenn. Un me penom lenge, hoi me suni dom. Un jon nai penan mange gar, hoi koi suni kamell te penell.
Un o palstuno, koon glan mande was, his o Daniel, kowa kanna Beltsazar kharell pal o lab miro deblestar. Un an leste hi o ducho o bolepangre deblendar. Un ap leste penom:
“Beltsazar, tu pralstuno pral i tsele siklende, djinau, te hi o ducho i bolepangre deblendar an tute, un tuke hi tchi khatedo. Jaake pen mange, hoi miri suni kamell te penell!”
“Kawa hi koi suni, hoi dikom, har homs ap miro tchiben tchiddo: I baro ruk his tardo mashkral ap kai phub.
Ko ruk was bareder un sorleder, jaake te djal lo bis ap o bolepen. Un hakeno ap kai phub nai dikas les.
